articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行调整公开市场操作机制
articles.title_en: PBOC Adjusts Open Market Operations to Refine Short-Term Rate Framework
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日，中国人民银行发布公告，自11月2日起调整公开市场操作机制：每个工作日开展隔夜逆回购招标，7天期逆回购改为固定数量、利率招标。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, the People's Bank of China announced changes to its open market operations from Nov 2, adding daily overnight reverse repo auctions at 1.25% and shifting 7-day operations to fixed-quantity, rate-based tenders.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, during the 2026 Taiwan Media Professionals 'Qiyuji' event, a Chongqing-Taiwan new media symposium was held in Chongqing, where practitioners from both sides discussed content creation and industry development to build a platform for cooperation.

articles.summary_zh: 10月30日，揭阳市七届人大常委会召开第五十六次会议，审议产业集群发展报告并开展专题询问，表决通过桑浦山协同保护等决定，并通过有关人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, the standing committee of the 7th Jieyang Municipal People's Congress held its 56th session, reviewing a report on industrial cluster development with special inquiries, adopting decisions on Sangpushan Mountain protection and environmental rules, and approving personnel appointments and removals.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 30, Jieyang held a municipal finance committee meeting and third-quarter economic analysis meeting, chaired by Zeng Fengbao, with Qu Xiaojie deploying work for the fourth quarter.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保会见香港揭阳侨联联谊会会董会主要成员
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Meets Board Members of Hong Kong Jieyang Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese

articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao met board members of the Hong Kong Jieyang Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese, discussing hometown ties and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 张虎到揭阳调研：发挥工程综合效益，持续深化清淤行动
articles.title_en: Zhang Hu Inspects Jieyang: Maximizing Project Benefits and Deepening Desilting Campaign

articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, Guangdong Executive Vice Governor Zhang Hu inspected Jieyang to review the water-transfer project linking the Han, Rong and Lian rivers and the new winter-spring desilting campaign, and chaired a symposium on the work.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市人大常委会召开"推动产业科技互促双强"专题询问会

articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, the Jieyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a special inquiry session on boosting industry-tech integration and expanding local industrial clusters, with municipal government departments responding on site.

articles.title_zh: 潮侨聚故里暨香港揭阳侨联联谊会第七届会董就职典礼在揭阳举行

articles.summary_en: On the evening of Oct 30, the 7th board inauguration of the Hong Kong Jieyang Overseas Chinese Federation Association was held in Jieyang; Wang Xiaobin was re-elected chairman and Yao Lixuan, a member of the municipal Party committee standing committee and head of the united front work department, attended and spoke.

articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，外交部长王毅在北京同冰岛外长贡纳尔斯多蒂尔举行会谈，双方就中冰建交55周年、一个中国政策及全球治理协作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 29, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks in Beijing with Icelandic Foreign Minister Gunnarsdóttir, discussing 55 years of diplomatic ties, the one-China policy and cooperation on global governance.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院党组会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记在党的二十届五中全会上的重要讲话和全会精神 丁薛祥出席
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Party Group Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and the Session's Spirit, with Ding Xuexiang Attending
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日，李强主持召开国务院党组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记在党的二十届五中全会上的重要讲话和全会精神，丁薛祥出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, Li Qiang chaired a State Council Party Group meeting to study Xi Jinping's speech at the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and its spirit. Ding Xuexiang attended.

tags.name_en: Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 国务院任免国家工作人员（2026年10月30日）
articles.title_en: State Council Announces Appointments and Removals of State Personnel
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月30日，国务院任免一批国家工作人员，任命王守利、张力、冯鹏志分别担任国家民族事务委员会副主任、国际贸易谈判副代表、国家行政学院教育长，并免去李忠、秦海翔、陈荣辉等人职务。
articles.summary_en: On October 30, 2026, China's State Council announced a round of personnel changes, appointing Wang Shouli, Zhang Li and Feng Pengzhi to senior posts and removing Li Zhong, Qin Haixiang, Chen Ronghui and others from their positions.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见德国总统施泰因迈尔
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets German President Steinmeier
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日，国务院总理李强在北京会见来华进行国事访问的德国总统施泰因迈尔，双方就深化中德合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 30, Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing with German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier, who is on a state visit, to discuss deepening China-Germany cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 彭丽媛同德国总统夫人比登本德茶叙
articles.title_en: Peng Liyuan Chats Over Tea with German President's Wife Büdenbender
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日下午，国家主席习近平夫人彭丽媛在北京同陪同德国总统施泰因迈尔访华的总统夫人比登本德茶叙，双方表示将深化妇女儿童事业等领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 30, Peng Liyuan, wife of President Xi Jinping, had tea in Beijing with Elke Büdenbender, wife of German President Steinmeier, who is on a state visit to China; both voiced willingness to deepen cooperation on women's and children's affairs.

articles.title_zh: 李生潜主持召开五届市政府第121次常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Shengqian Chairs 121st Executive Meeting of the Fifth Dingxi Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，定西市委副书记、代市长李生潜主持召开五届市政府第121次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究推进卫生健康、经济运行、公安等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, Dingxi Acting Mayor Li Shengqian chaired the 121st executive meeting of the fifth municipal government, conveying Xi Jinping's guiding remarks and studying health, economic operations and public security work.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开（扩大）会议 传达学习贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神 王兴柱主持并讲话
articles.title_en: City Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Expanded Meeting to Study Spirit of the 20th CPC Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session, Chaired by Wang Xingzhu
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习党的二十届五中全会精神和习近平总书记近期重要讲话、重要指示精神，并分析前三季度经济形势、部署四季度工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu chaired an expanded meeting of the city Party committee standing committee to convey and study the spirit of the 20th CPC Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session and Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions, and to analyze the first three quarters' economy and plan fourth-quarter work.

articles.title_zh: 第十一届好设计颁奖大会在淮安举行
articles.title_en: 11th Good Design Award Ceremony Held in Huai'an
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，第十一届好设计颁奖大会在江苏淮安举行，副省长沈剑荣、市委书记顾坤等出席并致辞，中国工程院院士潘云鹤作主旨报告。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, the 11th Good Design Award ceremony was held in Huai'an, Jiangsu, with Vice Governor Shen Jianrong and Party Secretary Gu Kun speaking and academician Pan Yunhe delivering a keynote report.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在杜集区宣讲省市党代会精神并调研空天产业发展
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Briefs on Party Congress Spirit and Inspects Aerospace Industry Development in Duji District
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日上午，淮北市委副书记、市长黄韡赴杜集区宣讲省市党代会精神，调研空天产业发展情况并主持召开座谈会。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 30, Huaibei Mayor Huang Wei visited Duji District to brief on provincial and municipal party congress spirit, inspect aerospace industry development and chair a symposium.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在高铁西站开通运营保障工作现场会上强调：紧盯节点、协同发力，扎实做好开通运营保障各项工作
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Urges Coordinated Efforts to Ensure On-Schedule Opening of Huaibei West High-Speed Railway Station
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日下午，淮北市委副书记、市长黄韡以现场调研结合座谈的形式，主持召开高铁西站开通运营保障工作现场会，部署验收整改、班次优化和运营保障等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 30, Huaibei Mayor Huang Wei chaired an on-site meeting on preparations for opening the West High-Speed Railway Station, urging swift rectification of issues, optimized train schedules and solid operational support.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡主持召开高铁西站开通运营保障工作现场会
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Chairs On-Site Meeting on Support Work for Opening of High-Speed Railway West Station
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日下午，淮北市委副书记、市长黄韡主持召开高铁西站开通运营保障工作现场会，要求紧盯节点、协同发力，确保西站如期开通运营。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 30, Huang Wei, mayor of Huaibei, chaired an on-site meeting on support work for the opening of the city's high-speed railway west station, urging coordinated efforts to ensure it opens on schedule.

articles.title_zh: 河湖长制实施十周年绘就西藏生态新画卷
articles.title_en: Tenth Anniversary of the River and Lake Chief System Paints a New Picture of Tibet's Ecology
articles.summary_zh: 河湖长制实施十周年之际，西藏拉萨总结河湖治理成效，以河湖长制推动生态保护，绘就高原生态新画卷。
articles.summary_en: Marking ten years of the river and lake chief system, Lhasa, Tibet highlighted progress in waterway governance and ecological protection across the plateau.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁深入墨竹工卡县调研 强调以钉钉子精神开创长治久安和高质量发展新局面
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Inspects Mozhugongkar County, Urges Solid Work to Open New Prospects for Long-Term Stability and High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁深入墨竹工卡县调研，督导生态环保督察整改、基层治理、安全生产和群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering inspected Mozhugongkar County, overseeing ecological inspection rectification, grassroots governance, workplace safety and the crackdown on misconduct and corruption affecting the public.

articles.title_zh: 林芝市召开深化扫黑除恶专项斗争推进会
articles.title_en: Linzhi City Holds Meeting to Deepen the Anti-Crime Special Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 近日，林芝市委书记巴塔主持召开全市深化扫黑除恶专项斗争推进会，听取相关汇报并部署下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: Linzhi Municipal Party Secretary Ba Ta chaired a city meeting on deepening the anti-crime special campaign, hearing reports and setting out next steps.

articles.title_zh: 龚会才：全面落实“三个赋予一个有利于”总要求 因地制宜推动高质量发展 用心用情用力办好民生实事
articles.title_en: Gong Huicai: Implement the "Three Endowments and One Benefit" Requirement, Pursue Locally Tailored High-Quality Development and Deliver Practical Services to People's Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日至28日，西藏自治区党委副书记、政府常务副主席龚会才赴日喀则市、拉萨市调研重大项目、乡村振兴、基层党建和寺庙管理，强调因地制宜推动高质量发展、办好民生实事。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 26-28, Tibet's Gong Huicai inspected villages, enterprises, temples and party branches in Shigatse and Lhasa, urging high-quality development and better livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群会见国际潮团总会主席吴木兴及海内外潮籍侨领代表团一行
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Meets Wu Muxing, Chairman of the International Chaozhou Federation, and Overseas Chaoshan Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群会见国际潮团总会主席吴木兴及海内外潮籍侨领代表团，双方就深化经贸文化交流、做好新时代“侨”的文章深入交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 29, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn met Wu Muxing, chairman of the International Chaozhou Federation, and a delegation of overseas Chaoshan community leaders to discuss deeper trade, cultural exchanges and diaspora affairs.

articles.title_zh: 陈涛会见外国驻穗总领事馆官员和老挝塞塔尼县代表团一行
articles.title_en: Chen Tao Meets Foreign Consular Officials from Guangzhou and Lao Delegation from Xaythany District
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日上午，汕头市长陈涛在汕头国际会展中心会见外国驻穗总领事馆官员和老挝塞塔尼县代表团，就深化经贸、产业、文化、旅游等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 29, Shantou Mayor Chen Tao met in Shantou with foreign consular officials from Guangzhou and a delegation from Xaythany District, Laos, to discuss cooperation in trade, industry, culture and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 研究做好绿色发展、算力建设、社会主义学院办学、商贸发展等工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting Studies Green Development, Computing Power, Socialist College and Trade Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要贺信精神和李强总理讲话精神，研究绿色发展、算力建设、社会主义学院办学、商贸发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 29, Shantou party secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a meeting of the municipal party standing committee to convey Xi Jinping's speeches and congratulatory letters as well as Premier Li Qiang's remarks, and to study work on green development, computing power, the socialist college and trade.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰拜访省农业农村厅 着力抓好“三农”工作 纵深推进“百千万工程”
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Visits Provincial Agriculture Department to Advance Rural Work and the 'Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand' Project
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日，汕尾市委书记逯峰拜访广东省农业农村厅，与厅党组书记、厅长王再华座谈，就“三农”工作、“百千万工程”和农业农村现代化深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng visited the Guangdong Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and met its head Wang Zaihua to discuss rural work, the 'Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand' project and agricultural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰拜访南方报业传媒集团 深化地媒协同联动 共同讲好汕尾高质量发展故事
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Visits Nanfang Media Group to Deepen Local-Media Coordination
articles.summary_zh: 10月30日，汕尾市委书记逯峰赴广州拜访南方报业传媒集团，与社长刘启宇座谈，双方就深化地媒协同联动、讲好汕尾高质量发展故事进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng visited Nanfang Media Group in Guangzhou and met President Liu Qiyu to discuss deeper local-media coordination and promoting Shanwei's high-quality development story.

articles.title_zh: 中共泰安市委召开推动人工智能产业发展协商座谈会 杨洪涛出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Tai'an Municipal Party Committee Holds Consultation Meeting on AI Industry Development; Yang Hongtao Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，中共泰安市委召开推动人工智能产业发展协商座谈会，市委书记杨洪涛出席并讲话，听取各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, the Tai'an Municipal Party Committee held a consultation meeting on advancing the AI industry, with Party Secretary Yang Hongtao attending and speaking after hearing suggestions from democratic parties, business federations and independents.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大环资委来苏开展水污染防治工作调研
articles.title_en: NPC Environment Committee Conducts Research on Water Pollution Prevention in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日至29日，全国人大环资委主任委员鹿心社率调研组赴江苏，就水污染防治工作开展调研并召开座谈会。
articles.summary_en: From October 26 to 29, Lu Xinshe, chair of the NPC Environment and Resources Protection Committee, led a research team to Jiangsu to study water pollution prevention and hold a symposium.

articles.title_zh: 李岩主持召开通化市委农村工作领导小组（扩大）会议，部署常态化帮扶与乡村全面振兴工作
articles.title_en: Li Yan Chairs Tonghua Municipal Party Committee Rural Work Leading Group Meeting to Deploy Normalized Assistance and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，通化市委书记李岩主持召开市委农村工作领导小组（扩大）会议，研究部署常态化帮扶、巩固脱贫攻坚成果与乡村全面振兴工作，市长高山出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, Tonghua Municipal Party Secretary Li Yan chaired an expanded meeting of the municipal rural work leading group to plan normalized assistance, consolidate poverty-alleviation gains and advance rural revitalization; Mayor Gao Shan attended.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组召开扩大会议 传达学习省第十二次党代会精神
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting to Convey and Study Spirit of Provincial Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，市人大常委会党组召开扩大会议，传达学习省第十二次党代会和省委十二届一次全会精神，党组书记、主任张峰主持并讲话，部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, the Party group of the municipal people's congress standing committee held an expanded meeting to convey and study the spirit of the 12th Provincial Party Congress, with Party secretary and director Zhang Feng presiding and outlining implementation steps.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神 研究安排巡视巡察整改和招商引资等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Committee Standing Committee Meets on Implementing Xi Jinping's Instructions, Inspection Rectification and Investment Promotion
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，西安市委常委会召开会议，市委书记蒿慧杰主持，研究巡视巡察整改、信访、金融风险防范和招商引资等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, the Standing Committee of the CPC Xi'an Municipal Committee met under Secretary Hao Huijie to discuss inspection rectification, petition handling, financial risk prevention and investment promotion.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在市委专题会议上强调：用足用好政策机遇，做实做细项目谋划储备，为西安稳增长和高质量发展提供坚实支撑
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Stresses at Municipal Party Committee Special Meeting: Fully Leverage Policy Opportunities and Solidify Project Planning and Reserve to Support Xi'an's Stable Growth and High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰主持召开市委专题会议，听取项目谋划储备及中央政策性资金争取情况汇报，部署下一步稳增长重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie chaired a special municipal Party committee meeting to review project planning and reserve work and the securing of central policy funds, and to set priorities for stabilizing growth.

articles.title_zh: 徐光华调研铜基和先进合金材料产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Xu Guanghua Inspects Development of Copper-Based and Advanced Alloy Materials Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，新乡市委常委、组织部部长徐光华赴卫滨区调研铜基和先进合金材料产业发展情况，并主持召开座谈会研究解决企业发展诉求。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Xu Guanghua, a member of the Xinxiang Municipal Party Standing Committee and head of its Organization Department, inspected the copper-based and advanced alloy materials industry in Weibin District and chaired a meeting on resolving enterprises' problems.

articles.title_zh: 何淳宽主持召开“走进宁国市”政商恳谈会并宣讲省第十二次党代会精神
articles.title_en: He Chunkuan Chairs Government-Business Dialogue in Ningguo and Briefs on Provincial Party Congress Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 近日，宣城市委书记何淳宽在宁国市主持召开政商恳谈会，与10位企业家代表面对面交流，宣讲省第十二次党代会精神，并现场研究解决企业困难诉求。
articles.summary_en: Xuancheng Party Secretary He Chunkuan chaired a government-business dialogue with 10 entrepreneurs in Ningguo, briefing them on the 12th Provincial Party Congress spirit and addressing their difficulties on site.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市代表团在韩国首尔开展经贸交流活动
articles.title_en: Yancheng Delegation Conducts Trade and Economic Exchanges in Seoul
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日至29日，盐城市委书记严汉平率代表团在韩国首尔开展经贸交流，走访起亚、SK On等韩企并签约一批智能制造合作项目。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28-29, a Yancheng delegation led by city party secretary Yan Hanping conducted trade and economic exchanges in Seoul, meeting Korean firms such as Kia and SK On and signing a batch of smart-manufacturing cooperation projects.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市政府党组（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Government Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，盐城市政府党组（扩大）会议召开，代市长吴炜主持，研究贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话和重要文章精神。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, the Yancheng Municipal Government Party Group held an expanded meeting chaired by Acting Mayor Wu Wei to study and implement Xi Jinping's speeches and articles.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研民生“十心”实事完成情况 办实办好办到群众心坎上 用心用情满足市民新期待
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Progress on Yinchuan's 'Ten Hearts' Livelihood Projects, Vowing to Deliver Real Benefits to Residents
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，银川市委书记赵旭辉调研民生“十心”实事完成情况，实地察看社区居家养老、新就业群体服务、托育和足球场建设等项目，要求高质高效兑现民生承诺。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui inspected progress on the city's "Ten Hearts" livelihood projects, visiting community elderly-care, new-employment service, childcare and football-pitch sites and urging high-quality delivery of the promised benefits.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，营口市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记系列重要讲话精神并研究贯彻落实举措，史卫东主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, the Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Party Group held an expanded meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and directives and plan implementation steps. Shi Weidong chaired it.

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆调研县（市、区）国资国企运营情况
articles.title_en: Yang Zhengkun Inspects County-Level State-Owned Enterprise Operations in Yuxi
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日、29日，玉溪市委书记杨政昆赴易门县、峨山县调研国资国企运营情况，强调深化国资国企改革，提升国企市场化运营管理水平。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27 and 29, Yuxi Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun inspected state-owned enterprise operations in Yimen and Eshan counties, urging deeper SOE reform and more market-oriented management.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市七届人大常委会第四十次会议召开

articles.title_zh: 全市深入实施“百县千镇万村高质量发展工程”促进城乡区域协调发展攻坚动员会召开

articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, Zhanjiang held a meeting on Q1-Q3 economic performance and the municipal finance committee, chaired by Party Secretary Yu Gang, to plan Q4 economic work.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 30, Hebei Party Secretary Luo Wen chaired an expanded Provincial Party Standing Committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to advance implementation of the Fifth Plenum's spirit and full, rigorous Party governance.

articles.summary_zh: 10月30日上午，中共中央举行新闻发布会解读党的二十届五中全会精神，中央政策研究室主任唐方裕称全会最重要成果是审议通过关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党的《决定》。

Tang Fangyu, head of the Central Policy Research Office, said the plenum's most important outcome was adopting the Decision on persevering in full and rigorous Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 秦海翔赴福州新区（长乐区）调研

articles.summary_en: On Oct. 30, Qin Haixiang, a Standing Committee member of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party secretary, inspected Fuzhou New Area (Changle District) and held a symposium on high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: Fuzhou's statistics bureau will conduct household registration for its 2026 population sample survey from Nov 1 to 30, covering 104 townships and 280 villages and communities across the city.

articles.summary_en: On the 10th anniversary of the China-Switzerland innovative strategic partnership, President Xi Jinping and Swiss President Parmelin attended a signing ceremony, witnessing the inking of a protocol to upgrade the bilateral free trade agreement.

articles.summary_en: The 20th CPC Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session set out strategic plans for sustained full and rigorous Party governance; attending members and delegates pledged to implement the spirit of the plenum.

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Shanghai-Nanjing City Collaborative Innovation Day opens Oct 31 in Shanghai, with Putuo District linking nine Yangtze Delta cities to deepen industrial and tech cooperation.

articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Chairman Zhang Yizhen recently visited the provincial High People's Court, Civil Affairs Department and Health Commission to conduct research and solicit proposal leads and consultation topics ahead of the CPPCC's fifth plenary session.

articles.title_zh: 与会同志谈贯彻落实党的二十届五中全会精神
articles.title_en: Attendees Discuss Implementing the Spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee
articles.summary_zh: 党的二十届五中全会10月26日至29日在北京举行，审议通过《中共中央关于持之以恒推进全面从严治党若干重大问题的决定》，与会同志表示将抓好贯彻落实。
articles.summary_en: The Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, held in Beijing on Oct 26-29, adopted a decision on persevering in full and rigorous Party self-governance; attendees pledged to implement it.

tags.name_en: Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 2026年中国贵金属论坛在昆明举办
articles.title_en: 2026 China Precious Metals Forum Held in Kunming
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，2026年中国贵金属论坛在云南昆明开幕，院士专家与政府部门、行业协会、高校及企业代表围绕科技创新、产业链供应链安全和绿色低碳转型进行研讨，并发布《2026贵金属蓝皮书》。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China Precious Metals Forum opened in Kunming, Yunnan on Oct 29, gathering academicians, government departments, industry associations and companies to discuss technological innovation, supply chain security and green transition, and releasing the 2026 Precious Metals Blue Book.

articles.title_zh: 美国以所谓“强迫劳动”为由将三家中企列入实体清单，外交部回应
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to US Adding Three Chinese Firms to Entity List Over Alleged 'Forced Labor'
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上就美方以涉疆“强迫劳动”为由将三家中国企业列入实体清单表示强烈不满和坚决反对，并称将采取必要措施维护中企权益。
articles.summary_en: On October 29, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing that China strongly deplores and firmly opposes the US adding three Chinese companies to its entity list over alleged Xinjiang 'forced labor,' vowing necessary measures to protect their rights.

articles.title_zh: 商务部等四部门：进一步提高海南自由贸易港贸易自由化便利化水平
articles.title_en: Four Departments Including Commerce Ministry: Further Raising Trade Liberalization and Facilitation in Hainan Free Trade Port
articles.summary_zh: 商务部等四部门联合发文，从货物贸易、服务贸易、贸易新业态新模式三方面提出16条措施，提高海南自贸港贸易自由化便利化水平。
articles.summary_en: The Commerce Ministry and three other departments issued a joint notice with 16 measures on goods trade, services trade and new trade models to boost liberalization and facilitation in the Hainan Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：敦促美国立即停止对古巴的封锁制裁和胁迫施压
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Urges U.S. to Immediately End Blockade and Sanctions Against Cuba
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上敦促美方立即停止对古巴长达64年的非法封锁和单边制裁，停止以任何形式对古巴胁迫施压。
articles.summary_en: On October 29, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun urged the United States to immediately end its 64-year illegal blockade and unilateral sanctions on Cuba and to stop coercive pressure in any form.

articles.title_zh: 台湾再生能源发电目标再次延期 舆论称当局可信度趋零
articles.title_en: Taiwan's Renewable Energy Target Delayed Again; Credibility Said to Be Near Zero
articles.summary_zh: 台湾当局经济事务主管部门10月28日证实，原定今年11月实现的再生能源发电占比20%目标将延至2029年，这是该目标的第二次延期。
articles.summary_en: Taiwan's economic affairs authority confirmed on Oct 28 that the 20% renewable energy target due this November is postponed to 2029, the second delay, drawing criticism of the DPP's credibility.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：希望有关方面正视朝鲜半岛问题的根源
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Relevant Parties Should Face the Root Cause of the Korean Peninsula Issue
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上就朝鲜发射短程弹道导弹答问，呼吁有关方面正视半岛问题根源、坚持政治解决方向。
articles.summary_en: On October 29, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun, at a regular briefing in Beijing, responded to North Korea's launch of short-range ballistic missiles, urging relevant parties to face the root cause of the peninsula issue and pursue political settlement.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：日方执意挑动阵营对抗不得人心
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry: Japan's Insistence on Camp Confrontation Finds No Support
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日下午，国防部举行例行记者会，发言人张晓刚指出日本加速推进“再军事化”已成为地区安全的现实威胁，并强调台湾问题纯属中国内政。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press briefing on the afternoon of October 29, Defense Ministry spokesperson Zhang Xiaogang said Japan's accelerating "re-militarization" has become a real threat to regional security, and stressed that the Taiwan question is purely China's internal affair.

articles.title_zh: 中国国防部将邀请非洲中青年军官代表团访华
articles.title_en: China's Defense Ministry to Invite African Young and Middle-Aged Officers Delegation to Visit China
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，国防部新闻发言人张晓刚宣布，11月5日至11日非洲中青年军官代表团将访华，赴长沙、成都等地参访交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, Defense Ministry spokesman Zhang Xiaogang announced that a delegation of nearly 50 officers from over 20 African countries will visit Changsha and Chengdu from Nov 5 to 11.

articles.title_zh: 河北部署20项具体任务打造绿色港航示范区
articles.title_en: Hebei Deploys 20 Specific Tasks to Build a Green Port and Shipping Demonstration Zone
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月29日，河北省政府新闻办在石家庄举行发布会，宣布印发《“绿动渤海”行动方案（2026—2030年）河北篇》，提出20项任务打造绿色港航示范区。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, 2026, Hebei's provincial government announced a five-part action plan with 20 tasks to build green, low-carbon port and shipping demonstration zones in Qinhuangdao, Tangshan and Cangzhou through 2030.

articles.title_zh: 人民空军将组织成立77周年纪念日系列活动
articles.title_en: PLA Air Force to Hold Series of Events for Its 77th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 中国国防部新闻发言人张晓刚10月29日在北京表示，人民空军11月11日迎来成立77周年，将围绕“寻根逐梦、砥砺奋飞”主题联动第十六届中国航展组织系列活动。
articles.summary_en: Defense Ministry spokesperson Zhang Xiaogang said at a Beijing press briefing on Oct 29 that the PLA Air Force will mark its 77th anniversary on Nov 11 with a series of events themed "Seeking Roots, Chasing Dreams, Forging Ahead," linked to the 16th China Airshow.

articles.title_zh: 第十二届中华文化论坛举行 聚焦两岸文化认同与心灵契合
articles.title_en: 12th Chinese Culture Forum Held in Beijing, Focusing on Cross-Strait Cultural Identity
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，第十二届中华文化论坛在北京举行，由北京大学主办，聚焦两岸文化认同与心灵契合，两岸及港澳160余名专家学者与会。
articles.summary_en: The 12th Chinese Culture Forum was held in Beijing on Oct 29, hosted by Peking University and focused on cross-strait cultural identity, drawing over 160 scholars from across the strait, Hong Kong and Macao.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境部：三季度全国地表水Ⅰ—Ⅲ类水质比例为76.0%
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: 76.0% of National Surface Water Reached Grade I-III in Q3
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部10月29日通报，第三季度全国地表水Ⅰ—Ⅲ类水质比例为76.0%，同比上升0.7个百分点，劣Ⅴ类水质比例为1.3%。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported that 76.0% of national surface water reached Grade I-III in Q3, up 0.7 points year on year, while 1.3% was worse than Grade V.

articles.title_zh: 李鸿忠会见欧洲议会国际贸易委员会代表团
articles.title_en: Li Hongzhong Meets Delegation from European Parliament's Committee on International Trade
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，中共中央政治局委员、全国人大常委会副委员长李鸿忠在北京会见欧洲议会国际贸易委员会主席朗格率领的代表团，就中欧经贸关系交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Li Hongzhong, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Vice Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, met in Beijing with a delegation led by Bernd Lange, chair of the European Parliament's Committee on International Trade, to discuss China-EU trade ties.

articles.title_zh: 今年以来消费品以旧换新带动销售额超2万亿元
articles.title_en: Consumer Goods Trade-In Program Drives Over 2 Trillion Yuan in Sales This Year
articles.summary_zh: 2026年以来，消费品以旧换新政策带动相关品类销售额超2万亿元，惠及超2.5亿人次。商务部10月28日召开全国电视电话会议，部署下一步重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Since the start of 2026, China's consumer goods trade-in program has driven over 2 trillion yuan in sales, benefiting more than 250 million people. The Ministry of Commerce held a national teleconference on October 28 to deploy next steps.

articles.title_zh: 做伟大长征精神的传承者弘扬者践行者：全国大中小学生同上一堂思政大课
articles.title_en: Carrying Forward the Long March Spirit: Students Nationwide Take the Same Ideological Course
articles.summary_zh: 全国大中小学生同上一堂以长征精神为主题的思政大课，课程分小学、初中、高中和大学四个篇章，江西、贵州、陕西、重庆等地教师跨学段联合授课。
articles.summary_en: Students across China took the same ideological and political class on the Long March spirit, with four segments for primary, middle, high school and university students taught by teachers from Jiangxi, Guizhou, Shaanxi and Chongqing.

articles.title_zh: 奋力打造新时代鱼米之乡
articles.title_en: Hubei Strives to Build a 'Land of Fish and Rice' for a New Era
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报刊发“活力中国调研行”报道，介绍湖北以科技强农、产业链富农、党建引领善治、农文旅融合推进乡村全面振兴，打造新时代鱼米之乡。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports how Hubei is advancing rural revitalization through agricultural science and technology, industry chains, grassroots Party building and agri-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 四部门联合印发实施方案，推动农业保险迈向数字化、智能化、标准化
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Plan to Advance Digital, Smart and Standardized Agricultural Insurance
articles.summary_zh: 财政部等四部门近日联合印发《关于加快农业保险高质量发展的实施方案》，上调农业保险深度、密度等量化指标，提出“一户一单”、强化防灾减损与科技赋能。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Finance and three other departments issued a plan to boost high-quality agricultural insurance, raising coverage targets and pushing per-household policies, disaster prevention and digital tools.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠在全市前三季度高质量发展讲评会上强调 坚定不移推动产业加快转型升级 引领经济向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Stresses at City's First Three Quarters High-Quality Development Review Meeting: Firmly Advance Industrial Upgrading and Transformation to Drive the Economy Toward New, Better and Stronger Growth
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委常委会扩大会议暨全市前三季度高质量发展讲评会，总结前三季度经济工作，部署四季度稳增长、产业转型升级和民生保障等重点任务，市长顾刚作工作部署。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui chaired an expanded city Party committee meeting and the first-three-quarters high-quality development review, summing up economic work and setting tasks on growth stabilization, industrial upgrading and livelihood support; Mayor Gu Gang outlined work arrangements.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠主持召开市委常委会会议 动真碰硬抓好巡视反馈问题整改
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on Inspection Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和中央政治局会议精神，部署巡视整改等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui chaired a Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's speeches and the Politburo meeting, and deploy inspection rectification.

articles.title_zh: “我将无我，不负人民”的时代答卷
articles.title_en: “I Will Have No Self and Will Not Fail the People”: Answering the Test of the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 文章系统回顾习近平总书记“我将无我，不负人民”的执政理念，梳理新时代全面从严治党、反腐败斗争成效与民生实践，强调党始终坚守初心使命和人民立场。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's pledge "I will have no self and will not fail the people," recounting the CPC's full and rigorous self-governance, anti-corruption results and livelihood efforts, and stressing the Party's founding mission and people-centered stance.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组召开2026年第14次（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Chifeng Municipal Government Party Group Holds 14th Expanded Meeting of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，赤峰市委副书记、代市长胡兆民主持召开市政府党组2026年第14次（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，并部署落实市第九次党代会精神。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, acting mayor Hu Zhaomin chaired the 14th expanded meeting of Chifeng's municipal government Party group in 2026, conveying Xi Jinping's key speeches and mapping out implementation of the city's 9th Party Congress decisions.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就西班牙高速列车追尾脱轨事故向西班牙国王费利佩六世致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolence Message to Spain's King Felipe VI Over High-Speed Train Collision and Derailment
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，习近平就西班牙托莱多省高速列车追尾脱轨事故向西班牙国王费利佩六世致慰问电，同日李强向西班牙首相桑切斯致慰问电。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 29, Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Spain's King Felipe VI over the high-speed train collision and derailment in Toledo Province, and Premier Li Qiang sent a similar message to Spanish Prime Minister Sanchez the same day.

articles.title_zh: 张升民同志简历
articles.title_en: Biography of Comrade Zhang Shengmin
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月29日播发张升民同志简历，介绍其现任中央政治局委员、中共中央军委副主席、中央军委副主席、中央纪委副书记等职务。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua released the official biography of Zhang Shengmin on Oct 29, listing his posts as Politburo member, vice chairman of the CPC Central Military Commission and of the PRC Central Military Commission, and deputy secretary of the CCDI.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议公报
articles.title_en: Communique of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月26日至29日，中共二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议在北京举行，习近平发表重要讲话，全会通过持之以恒推进全面从严治党的《决定》，并决定2027年下半年召开党的二十一大。
articles.summary_en: The Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee was held in Beijing from Oct 26 to 29, 2026. Xi Jinping delivered an important speech, and the session adopted a decision on advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance and set the 21st Party Congress for the second half of 2027.

articles.title_zh: 坚持党的领导 加强党的建设——论学习贯彻习近平总书记在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Uphold Party Leadership and Strengthen Party Building: On Studying and Implementing Xi Jinping's Speech at the 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月28日播发评论，围绕习近平总书记在纪念长征胜利90周年大会上的重要讲话，强调坚持党的领导和加强党的建设是事业发展的根本保证，并要求持之以恒推进全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a commentary on Oct 28 on Xi Jinping's speech marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory, stressing that upholding Party leadership and strengthening Party building are the fundamental guarantee of progress and urging sustained full and rigorous Party self-governance.

articles.title_zh: 王庆海到高新区调研时强调筑牢安全生产防线 提升消防救援能力
articles.title_en: Wang Qinghai Inspects High-tech Zone, Stresses Firming Up Workplace Safety and Improving Fire Rescue Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，抚顺市市长王庆海到高新区调研在建项目安全生产和消防救援工作，要求筑牢安全防线、提升消防救援能力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Fushun Mayor Wang Qinghai inspected the high-tech zone, reviewing workplace safety at projects under construction and fire rescue work, urging stronger safety safeguards and better emergency response.

articles.title_zh: 周波在抚顺走访所联系企业时强调 强化服务意识 助力绿色能源产业发展壮大
articles.title_en: Zhou Bo Visits Contacted Enterprises in Fushun, Urges Stronger Services to Boost Green Energy Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，辽宁省政协主席周波到抚顺市走访所联系企业，调研抽水蓄能、生物质热电项目并座谈，推动解决企业诉求。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Liaoning CPPCC Chairman Zhou Bo visited enterprises in Fushun, inspecting pumped-storage and biomass power projects and holding a forum to help resolve their concerns.

articles.title_zh: 市九届人大常委会第三十七次会议召开
articles.title_en: 37th Meeting of the 9th Huai'an Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，淮安市九届人大常委会第三十七次会议召开，通过人事任免并审议国企对外投资、开发园区改革、乡村振兴等报告，表决通过淮扬菜传承发展促进条例。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the 9th Huai'an Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 37th meeting, approving personnel appointments and reviewing reports on SOE outbound investment, development park reform and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在全市招商引资工作调度会上强调 破解堵点难点 提升招商质效
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Chairs City Investment Promotion Meeting, Urges Breaking Bottlenecks to Boost Project Quality
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日上午，淮北市市长黄韡主持召开全市招商引资工作调度会，调度1—10月招商进展、查摆差距，并专题研究生物制造产业项目落地堵点难点。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 29, Huaibei Mayor Huang Wei chaired a citywide investment promotion meeting to review January-October progress, identify gaps and address bottlenecks in landing bio-manufacturing projects.

articles.title_zh: 新晃侗族自治县成立70周年庆祝大会举行
articles.title_en: Xinhuang Dong Autonomous County Holds 70th Anniversary Celebration
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日上午，新晃侗族自治县成立70周年庆祝大会在新晃全民健身中心举行，全国人大民委、国家民委致贺电，省、市祝贺团出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Xinhuang Dong Autonomous County held a rally marking its 70th founding anniversary, with congratulatory telegrams from national ethnic affairs bodies and speeches by provincial and municipal officials.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁深入城关区、八廓古城调研督导基层治理工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Inspects Chengguan District and Barkhor Ancient Town on Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日至27日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁以"四不两直"方式深入城关区、八廓古城，调研督导基层党建、基层治理、寺庙管理和治安工作。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 26 to 27, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering made unannounced inspections in Chengguan District and Barkhor Ancient Town, urging stronger grassroots Party building, governance, monastery management and public security.

articles.title_zh: 张海波赴索县人民医院看望地震受伤群众
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Visits Earthquake-Injured Residents at Suo County People's Hospital
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日下午，那曲市委书记张海波赴索县人民医院看望地震受伤群众，实地指导医疗救治保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 23, Nagqu Party Secretary Zhang Haibo visited Suo County People's Hospital to see residents injured in the earthquake and to direct medical treatment and support work.

articles.title_zh: 张海波主持召开巴青地震应急处置指挥部专题会议
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Chairs Special Meeting of Baqing Earthquake Emergency Response Command
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，那曲市委书记张海波主持召开巴青地震应急处置指挥部专题会议，部署灾区学生异地复课和34个集中安置点群众饮水保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Zhang Haibo, Party Secretary of Nagqu City, chaired a special meeting of the Baqing earthquake emergency response command, ordering arrangements for students to resume classes in relocation sites and safe drinking water for residents of 34 resettlement sites.

articles.title_zh: 张海波主持召开巴青县地震救灾工作调度会议

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，进一步安排部署巴青县7.0级地震抗震救灾工作

articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Tibet Party chief Hu Changsheng chaired a standing committee meeting to relay Xi Jinping's instructions and redeploy relief work after the 7.0-magnitude quake in Baqing County.

articles.title_zh: 任维深入震区安置点看望慰问受灾群众调研督导安置工作
articles.title_en: Ren Wei Visits Quake Resettlement Sites in Tibet to Comfort Displaced Residents and Inspect Relief Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日至25日，西藏自治区党委常委、常务副主席任维深入震区安置点看望慰问受灾群众，调研督导震后安置与防寒保暖工作。
articles.summary_en: Ren Wei, executive vice chairman of Tibet Autonomous Region, visited quake resettlement sites on Oct 24-25 to comfort displaced residents and inspect post-quake relief and winter-proofing work.

articles.title_zh: 张海波深入震区安置点看望受灾群众调研督导安置保障工作

articles.summary_en: On Oct 25, Nagqu Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo visited quake resettlement sites in Baqing County, meeting affected residents and inspecting prefab housing, winter supplies and site management.

articles.title_zh: 三亚电视问政栏目《责任面对面》第十二期录制

articles.summary_en: Sanya recorded the 12th episode of its TV accountability show 'Responsibility Face to Face' on Oct 28, focusing on delayed livelihood projects, safety hazards and business environment gaps.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群调研卫生健康事业高质量发展工作

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 27, Zhuang Yuequn, Party Secretary of Shantou, inspected local healthcare development, visiting several hospitals and chairing a symposium on specialty building, talent recruitment, public hospital reform and the biopharmaceutical industry.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰会见中国老区建设促进会副秘书长胡佳一行 加快推动海陆丰革命老区振兴发展

articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，周口市五届人大常委会召开第三十二次会议，郭力铭主持，会议审议太清宫遗址保护条例草案、国有资产管理报告及人事任免等事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the Standing Committee of the 5th Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress held its 32nd session, chaired by Guo Liming, reviewing a draft heritage protection regulation, state asset management reports and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会学习贯彻省第十二次党代会精神
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Studies Spirit of 12th Provincial Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，周口市人大常委会召开会议，传达学习河南省第十二次党代会精神，市人大常委会主任郭力铭主持会议并讲话，部署立法、监督与代表履职工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee met to study the spirit of the 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress, with director Guo Liming presiding and outlining work on legislation, oversight and deputy duties.

articles.title_zh: 31省份三季报均已发布：地区经济总体平稳，发展动能向优
articles.title_en: Q3 Reports From All 31 Provinces Released: Regional Economies Steady With Improving Growth Drivers
articles.summary_zh: 经济日报报道，31个省份前三季度经济数据均已发布，地区经济运行总体平稳，广东、江苏、山东等6个经济大省增速持平或高于全国水平，新质生产力加快形成。
articles.summary_en: Economic Daily reports that all 31 provincial-level regions have released their Q3 economic data, with regional growth staying stable and six major economic provinces matching or beating the national pace as new quality productive forces take shape.

articles.title_zh: 福州高新区搭台 推动“研发在福州 转化到全省”
articles.title_en: Fuzhou High-Tech Zone Hosts Meeting to Advance "R&D in Fuzhou, Commercialization Across the Province"
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，2026福建省国家高新区高质量发展（产业）联盟第二次会议在福州举行，现场签约3家单位并发布目标规模5亿元的新赛道基金。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the second meeting of the Fujian national high-tech zone industry alliance was held in Fuzhou, where three institutions signed cooperation agreements and a new-track fund targeting 500 million yuan was launched.

articles.title_zh: 福建省消委会解读绿色消费法律法规
articles.title_en: Fujian Consumer Council Interprets Laws and Regulations on Green Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省消委会解读绿色消费领域法律规范，帮助消费者辨识绿色食品、有机产品等认证差异，防范“漂绿”“洗绿”等虚假环保宣传，并提醒经营者履行减塑、回收等法定义务。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Consumer Council recently explained laws and regulations on green consumption, helping consumers distinguish green food and organic certification labels, guard against "greenwashing" and false environmental claims, and reminding businesses of their legal duties on plastic reduction and recycling.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研济滨高铁综合配套建设和项目建设
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Supporting Facilities and Construction of Jinan-Binzhou High-Speed Railway
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，济南市市长于海田调研济滨高铁综合配套建设及沿线企业项目，要求保障这条高铁年底如期开通运营。
articles.summary_en: On October 28, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian inspected supporting facilities for the Jinan-Binzhou high-speed railway and local enterprise projects, urging efforts to ensure the line opens by year-end as planned.

articles.title_zh: 严明纪律规矩 推动营造风清气正的政治生态
articles.title_en: Enforcing Strict Discipline and Rules to Foster a Clean Political Environment
articles.summary_zh: 央视新闻联播报道，党的十八大以来，党中央把纪律建设纳入党的建设总体布局；中央纪委国家监委自2024年起在全国集中整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题。
articles.summary_en: CCTV reports that since the 18th Party Congress the CPC has made discipline building central to party governance, and the CCDI has run a nationwide campaign since 2024 against corruption affecting ordinary citizens.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年前三季度31省份经济数据发布，地区经济总体平稳增长，新质生产力加快形成，需求结构持续改善。
articles.summary_en: All 31 Chinese provinces have released Q3 2026 economic data, showing stable regional growth, faster formation of new quality productive forces, and improving demand structure.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：坚决反对美将中国企业列入所谓涉疆法案实体清单
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry: China Firmly Opposes US Adding Chinese Firms to So-Called Xinjiang Bill Entity List
articles.summary_zh: 商务部就美方将中国生物医药技术企业列入所谓涉疆法案实体清单答问，表示强烈谴责和坚决反对，称将采取必要措施维护自身利益。
articles.summary_en: China's Commerce Ministry condemned the US for adding Chinese biopharmaceutical firms to its so-called Xinjiang bill entity list, saying it will take necessary measures to safeguard Chinese interests.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议公报
articles.title_en: Communiqué of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月26日至29日，中共二十届五中全会在北京举行，习近平作工作报告并发表讲话，全会通过持之以恒推进全面从严治党的决定，增选张升民为中央政治局委员。
articles.summary_en: The 20th CPC Central Committee held its fifth plenary session in Beijing from Oct 26 to 29, 2026. Xi Jinping delivered a work report and a speech, and the session adopted a decision on persevering in full and rigorous Party governance and added Zhang Shengmin to the Politburo.

articles.summary_zh: 人民日报刊文介绍湖南安化、四川营山、青海德令哈整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题的案例，追回违规收费并处分责任人。

articles.title_en: NRTA Issues Cable TV and IPTV Service Rules Requiring Live Broadcast Priority
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，国家广播电视总局发布有线广播电视与交互式网络电视运营服务管理规定，要求开机即看直播、不得播放开机广告，2026年11月27日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, China's National Radio and Television Administration issued rules for cable TV and IPTV operators requiring live broadcast priority, a ban on boot-up ads and free content zones, effective Nov 27, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 《知音》杂志主管单位调整，已划归湖北文旅集团
articles.title_en: Zhiyin Magazine Changes Supervisory Body, Now Under Hubei Culture and Tourism Group
articles.summary_zh: 国家新闻出版署批准《知音》等9种期刊变更主管主办单位，《知音》主管单位由湖北省妇联变更为湖北文化旅游集团有限公司。
articles.summary_en: China's National Press and Publication Administration approved changes to the supervisory and sponsoring bodies of nine periodicals including Zhiyin, whose supervisor is now Hubei Culture and Tourism Group instead of the Hubei Women's Federation.

articles.title_zh: 国内最长地铁环线全线开通：全长59.9公里，武汉12号线两次下穿长江
articles.title_en: China's Longest Subway Loop Line Fully Opens: Wuhan Line 12, 59.9 km, Crosses Yangtze Twice
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，武汉地铁12号线全线开通运营，全长59.9公里、设37座地下车站，为国内最长地铁环线，两次下穿长江、一次下穿汉江。
articles.summary_en: Wuhan Metro Line 12 opened fully on Oct 29, running 59.9 km with 37 underground stations, making it China's longest subway loop line; it crosses the Yangtze twice and the Han River once.

articles.title_zh: 推动农业保险迈向数字化、智能化、标准化
articles.title_en: China Pushes Agricultural Insurance Toward Digital, Smart and Standardized Services
articles.summary_zh: 财政部等四部门近日联合印发《关于加快农业保险高质量发展的实施方案》，全面上调农业保险深度、密度等量化指标，推动农业保险数字化、智能化、标准化。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and three other departments issued a plan to upgrade agricultural insurance, raising coverage targets and pushing digital, smart and standardized services.

articles.title_zh: 厦门探索“合作创新采购”方式 助力人工智能与具身智能产业发展
articles.title_en: Xiamen Explores 'Collaborative Innovation Procurement' to Boost AI and Embodied Intelligence Industries
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，厦门市工信局召开新闻发布会，介绍由市工信局、市财政局、市数据管理局联合印发的《厦门市人工智能与具身智能合作创新采购项目实施方案》，明确“先研发、后首购”的政府采购机制。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Xiamen's Industry and Information Technology Bureau held a press conference on a joint plan by the bureau, finance bureau and data administration to use 'research first, purchase later' government procurement to boost AI and embodied intelligence industries.

articles.title_en: Government-Bank-Enterprise Effort: Financing Service Launched for Fuzhou's County-Level Advanced Equipment Manufacturing Chain
articles.summary_zh: 福州县域先进装备制造产业链融资服务正式启动，12家企业与建行6家二级分支行签约，推动金融资源融入县域产业链发展。
articles.summary_en: A financing service for Fuzhou's county-level advanced equipment manufacturing supply chain was launched, with 12 enterprises signing cooperation agreements with six CCB sub-branches to channel financial resources into county industry development.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省发布2026年企业工资指导线
articles.title_en: Gansu Releases 2026 Enterprise Wage Guidance Line
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省近日发布2026年企业工资指导线，明确企业货币平均工资增长基准线为5.5%、下线为2.0%，适用于全省城镇各类企业。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Province released its 2026 enterprise wage guidance line, setting a 5.5% baseline and a 2.0% floor for average wage growth, applicable to all urban enterprises across the province.

articles.summary_en: Expansion projects on the G30 and G6 expressways in Gansu are advancing rapidly, using green, low-carbon construction to upgrade the Lanzhou ring road network.

articles.title_zh: 广西向海经济蓝皮书发布
articles.title_en: Guangxi Releases Blue Book on Marine-Oriented Economy
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，《广西向海经济发展蓝皮书（2026）》正式发布，首次系统总结2017年以来广西向海经济成效与经验。
articles.summary_en: On October 24, Guangxi released the Blue Book on the Development of Its Marine-Oriented Economy (2026), the first comprehensive report summarizing the region's progress and experience since 2017.

articles.title_zh: 广西前三季度新能源发电量突破600亿千瓦时
articles.title_en: Guangxi New Energy Generation Tops 60 Billion kWh in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 今年1至9月，广西新能源发电量达602.3亿千瓦时，同比增长17.4%，非化石能源电量占比达67.4%，新能源继续保持第一大电源地位。
articles.summary_en: In the first nine months of 2026, Guangxi's new energy generation reached 60.23 billion kWh, up 17.4% year on year, with non-fossil energy accounting for 67.4% of electricity and new energy remaining the region's largest power source.

articles.title_zh: 信阳港固始港区中心作业区一期工程通过交工验收
articles.title_en: Phase I of Xinyang Port's Gushi Port Area Central Operation Zone Passes Completion Acceptance

articles.summary_en: On October 27, a completion acceptance meeting for Phase I of the central operation zone at Gushi Port Area of Xinyang Port was held in Gushi County, Henan, with the project rated qualified and approved.

articles.summary_en: People's Daily's 'Vital China' research series reports how Hubei advances rural revitalization through agricultural technology, industry chains and rural tourism, with rural tourism revenue topping 430 billion yuan in 2025.

articles.summary_zh: 近日，琼北地震安全韧性城乡科技创新基地试验基地项目在海口江东新区开工，这是海南自贸港首个抗震试验重大科技平台。
articles.summary_en: Construction has begun in Haikou's Jiangdong New Area on Hainan's first major seismic testing platform, a base for earthquake resilience and disaster-prevention research in the free trade port.

articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Targets Beautiful China Pilot Zone, Polishes Its Ecological Base
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，黑龙江省举行新闻发布会，省生态环境厅厅长刘伟介绍推进生态振兴、筑牢祖国北方生态安全屏障的举措与成效。
articles.summary_en: On October 29, Heilongjiang held a press conference where Liu Wei, head of the provincial ecology and environment department, outlined measures and progress in advancing ecological revitalization and building a northern ecological security shield.

articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，南京市十七届人大常委会第三十次会议审议通过《南京市人工智能产业发展和创新应用促进条例》，报江苏省人大常委会批准后实施。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the Standing Committee of the 17th Nanjing Municipal People's Congress approved the Regulations on Promoting AI Industry Development and Innovative Applications in Nanjing, to take effect after approval by the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee.

articles.summary_en: Students across China took the same ideological-political class, structured in four segments for primary, middle, high school and university students, teaching the spirit of the Long March and encouraging them to carry it forward.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Shenglege International Airport in Hohhot held its fourth and final full-scale pre-opening drill, simulating 42 flights and 4,356 passengers across six core operational processes.

articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，内蒙古公布前三季度经济数据，装备制造业增加值同比增长18.4%，高技术制造业增长10.5%，现代煤化工增长15.5%，新旧动能转换支撑经济稳增长。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Inner Mongolia released its first three quarters economic data: equipment manufacturing value-added rose 18.4% year on year, high-tech manufacturing 10.5% and modern coal chemical industry 15.5%, as new growth drivers support stable growth.

articles.summary_zh: 英国伦敦时间10月27日，伦敦金属交易所正式推出以中国上海期货交易所热轧卷板期货结算价为基准的美元计价期货合约，这是金属期货“上海价格”首次对外授权，挂牌首日成交活跃。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27 London time, the London Metal Exchange launched a USD-denominated futures contract settling against the Shanghai Futures Exchange's hot-rolled coil futures settlement price — the first overseas licensing of a Shanghai metal futures price — with active trading on the debut day.

articles.summary_en: Cities including Shanghai and Chengdu are rolling out free companion medical services to help elderly patients navigate hospitals. China's first national standard for such services takes effect on Nov 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度我国海洋生产总值8.5万亿元
articles.title_en: China's Marine GDP Reaches 8.5 Trillion Yuan in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部10月28日发布数据，前三季度我国海洋生产总值8.5万亿元，同比增长4.9%，海洋传统产业与新兴产业均保持增长。
articles.summary_en: Ministry of Natural Resources said on Oct 28 that China's marine GDP hit 8.5 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, up 4.9% year on year, with traditional and emerging marine industries growing.

articles.title_zh: 法规制度既是“紧箍咒”、更是“护身符”
articles.title_en: Party Regulations Are Both a "Tightening Hoop" and a "Protective Talisman": Xi Jinping
articles.summary_zh: 2026年1月12日，习近平在二十届中央纪委五次全会上强调，法规制度既是“紧箍咒”、更是“护身符”，要提升明规矩执行力、坚持依规治党。
articles.summary_en: On Jan 12, 2026, Xi Jinping told the 20th CCDI's fifth plenary session that party regulations are both a "tightening hoop" and a "protective talisman," urging stronger enforcement of rules.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就西班牙高速列车追尾脱轨事故向西班牙国王费利佩六世致慰问电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Message of Condolence to Spain's King Felipe VI Over High-Speed Train Crash
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，国家主席习近平就西班牙托莱多省高速列车追尾脱轨事故向西班牙国王费利佩六世致慰问电，同日国务院总理李强向西班牙首相桑切斯致慰问电。
articles.summary_en: On October 29, President Xi Jinping sent a message of condolence to Spain's King Felipe VI over the high-speed train rear-end derailment in Toledo province, and Premier Li Qiang sent a similar message to Spanish Prime Minister Sanchez the same day.

articles.title_zh: 三季度末我国科技型中小企业获贷率为51.1%
articles.title_en: 51.1% of China's Tech SMEs Had Access to Loans by End of Q3
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行10月28日发布数据显示，2026年三季度末获贷的科技型中小企业达30.73万家，获贷率51.1%，贷款余额4.27万亿元，同比增长20.1%。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the People's Bank of China on Oct 28 shows that by the end of Q3 2026, 307,300 tech-based SMEs had obtained loans, a lending rate of 51.1%, with outstanding loans of 4.27 trillion yuan, up 20.1% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 二十届五中全会在北京举行，习近平代表中央政治局作工作报告
articles.title_en: Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee Held in Beijing as Xi Jinping Delivers Work Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日上午，中共二十届五中全会在北京开幕，习近平代表中央政治局作工作报告，并就持之以恒推进全面从严治党的决定讨论稿作说明。
articles.summary_en: The Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee opened in Beijing on the morning of Oct 26, where Xi Jinping delivered a work report on behalf of the Political Bureau and explained a draft decision on advancing full and rigorous Party governance.

tags.name_en: 20th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China

articles.title_zh: 全力冲刺四季度 确保完成全年目标任务
articles.title_en: Henan Executive Vice Governor Zhang Min Inspects Luoyang Economic Operations
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，河南省委常委、常务副省长张敏赴洛阳市新安县、宜阳县调研经济运行工作，走访多家企业并强调全力冲刺四季度，确保完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On October 28, Zhang Min, Executive Vice Governor of Henan Province, inspected economic operations in Xin'an and Yiyang counties of Luoyang, visiting local firms and urging a strong push in the fourth quarter to meet annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十七次会议举行
articles.title_en: 27th Session of Henan Provincial 14th NPC Standing Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，河南省十四届人大常委会第二十七次会议在郑州举行，表决通过接受刘宁辞去省人大常委会主任职务的决定，并表决通过有关人事任命事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, the 27th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress was held in Zhengzhou, approving Liu Ning's resignation as committee director and passing personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第92次主任会议召开
articles.title_en: 92nd Chairpersons' Meeting of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，河南省十四届人大常委会第92次主任会议在郑州召开，李亚主持，研究人事任免事项及多份政府、两院报告审议意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, the 92nd chairpersons' meeting of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Zhengzhou, chaired by Li Ya, reviewing personnel appointments and opinions on government and judicial reports.

articles.title_zh: 农事“丰”景丨金秋时节，农村都在忙什么？
articles.title_en: Autumn Harvest, Sowing and Grain Storage: What China's Rural Areas Are Busy With
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者10月在安徽等地探访秋收秋种一线，农业农村部农情调度显示全国秋收进度略快于常年，六省已启动中晚稻最低收购价预案稳粮价。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters visited autumn harvest and sowing sites in Anhui and elsewhere; the agriculture ministry says harvest progress is slightly ahead of normal, and six provinces have launched minimum purchase prices for mid-late rice.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: “信党爱党——永远的‘四大队’”主题展在延安完成布展
articles.title_en: Theme Exhibition 'Faith in and Love for the Party—Forever the Fourth Detachment' Completed in Yan'an
articles.summary_zh: 中国延安干部学院与新华社合办的“信党爱党——永远的‘四大队’”主题展近日在延安完成布展并投入教学，展现“四大队”跟随党中央转战陕北的历史。
articles.summary_en: An exhibition co-hosted by the China Executive Leadership Academy Yan'an and Xinhua on the 'Fourth Detachment' has been installed in Yan'an and put into Party education.

articles.title_zh: 文脉连两岸 匠心话传承——第十七届海峡两岸文博会启幕
articles.title_en: Cultural Ties Across the Strait: 17th Cross-Strait Cultural Industries Fair Opens in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日，第十七届海峡两岸（厦门）文化产业博览交易会在厦门启幕，两岸百余位工艺名家参展，展会将持续至11月1日。
articles.summary_en: The 17th Cross-Strait (Xiamen) Cultural Industries Fair opened in Xiamen on Oct 29, drawing more than 100 craft masters from both sides of the strait; the fair runs through Nov 1.

articles.title_zh: 文物安全的红线，碰不得
articles.title_en: The Red Line of Cultural Relic Safety Must Not Be Crossed
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院与国家文物局近日发布6个依法惩治文物犯罪典型案例，回应群众日常涉文物法律疑问，强调以法治守住文物安全红线。
articles.summary_en: China's Supreme People's Court and National Cultural Heritage Administration released six typical cases on punishing cultural relic crimes, underscoring the rule of law in protecting cultural heritage.

articles.title_zh: 迎寒保进度 我国最北电气化铁路改造工程持续推进
articles.title_en: China's Northernmost Electrified Railway Upgrade Keeps Pace Despite Freezing Cold
articles.summary_zh: 日前黑龙江遭遇持续低温，我国最北的富加铁路改造工程仍在施工，中铁二十局项目部启动冬季施工管控措施，保障混凝土浇筑与养护质量及工程进度。
articles.summary_en: Amid sustained low temperatures in Heilongjiang, work continues on the Fujia railway upgrade, China's northernmost electrified railway project, with the China Railway 20th Bureau launching winter construction controls to protect concrete work and keep the project on schedule.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度我国跨区域人员流动量超512亿人次
articles.title_en: Cross-Regional Passenger Trips Exceed 51.2 Billion in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部10月29日发布数据，前三季度跨区域人员流动量512.2亿人次，同比增长1.2%，交通运输经济运行总体平稳。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Transport said on Oct 29 that cross-regional passenger trips reached 51.22 billion in the first three quarters, up 1.2% year on year, with transport operations generally stable.

articles.title_zh: 中宣部组织召开学习宣传贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神电视电话会议
articles.title_en: Publicity Department Holds Teleconference on Studying and Implementing the Spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月29日晚，中宣部在北京召开电视电话会议，部署学习宣传贯彻党的二十届五中全会精神，中宣部部长李书磊出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Oct 29, the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department held a teleconference in Beijing to deploy work on studying and implementing the spirit of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee, with department head Li Shulei delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 住鲁全国政协委员赴滨州、德州进行考察
articles.title_en: National CPPCC Members Based in Shandong Inspect Binzhou and Dezhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日至28日，山东省政协组织住鲁全国政协委员围绕“打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板、推进农业农村现代化”主题赴滨州、德州考察，省政协主席葛慧君带队。
articles.summary_en: On October 27-28, Shandong's provincial CPPCC organized national CPPCC members based in the province for an inspection in Binzhou and Dezhou on rural revitalization and agricultural modernization, led by provincial CPPCC Chair Ge Huijun.

articles.title_zh: 130余位两岸茶人成都共话茶文化传承与产业创新
articles.title_en: Over 130 Tea Figures from Both Sides of the Strait Discuss Tea Culture Heritage and Industry Innovation in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，台盟中央两岸融合发展交流营成都分营暨第六届川台茶文化茶产业研习营在成都举行，130余位两岸茶人共话茶文化传承与产业创新。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, more than 130 tea culture experts and industry practitioners from both sides of the Taiwan Strait gathered in Chengdu for a five-day camp on tea culture heritage and industry innovation.

articles.title_zh: 释放“两院一湾”建设牵引效应 重庆南岸做强人工智能创新集群
articles.title_en: Chongqing's Nan'an District to Build AI Innovation Cluster Under 'Two Institutes, One Bay' Plan
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，重庆南岸区委书记周和华在发布会上介绍，“十五五”期间南岸将释放“两院一湾”牵引效应，从七个方面系统推进人工智能创新集群建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Nan'an District Party Secretary Zhou Hehua said at a Chongqing press conference that the district will leverage its 'Two Institutes, One Bay' project to build an AI innovation cluster through seven areas of work during the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 云南立法保护铁路安全 纳入跨境协作内容
articles.title_en: Yunnan Legislates to Protect Railway Safety, Adds Cross-Border Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，云南省在昆明举行《云南省铁路安全管理条例》新闻发布会，条例明确跨境铁路安全交流合作等内容，将于11月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan held a press conference in Kunming on Oct 28 to present its new railway safety management regulation, which includes cross-border railway safety cooperation and takes effect on Nov 1.

articles.title_zh: 退役军人事务部：今年又有8位已迎回在韩志愿军烈士确认身份
articles.title_en: Ministry of Veterans Affairs: 8 More Returned Korean War Martyrs Identified
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，退役军人事务部在北京举行褒扬纪念工作专题新闻发布会，介绍今年又有8位已迎回在韩志愿军烈士确认身份，累计已有44名烈士确认身份并找到亲人。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, China's Ministry of Veterans Affairs held a press briefing in Beijing, saying 8 more returned martyrs from the Korean War have been identified this year, bringing the total identified and reunited with relatives to 44.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向日本前首相福田康夫遗属致唁电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolence Message to Family of Former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，国家主席习近平就日本前首相福田康夫逝世向遗属致唁电，表示哀悼和慰问，并希望日方恪守中日四个政治文件。
articles.summary_en: On October 27, President Xi Jinping sent a condolence message to the family of former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda, expressing mourning and sympathy, and urging Japan to uphold the four political documents between the two countries.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺卢拉当选连任巴西总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Congratulates Lula on Re-election as Brazil's President
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，国家主席习近平致电卢拉，祝贺他当选连任巴西总统，表示愿推动中巴命运共同体建设迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva congratulating him on re-election as Brazil's president and pledging to advance the China-Brazil community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 研究统筹人口与经济社会发展有关工作
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Coordinating Population and Economic-Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，研究统筹人口与经济社会发展有关工作，并听取推进全国服务业大会部署落实情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing on coordinating population with economic and social development, and reviewed implementation of the national services industry conference's plans.

articles.title_zh: 财政金融促内需“组合拳”政策效能加速释放
articles.title_en: Fiscal-Financial Policy Package for Boosting Domestic Demand Accelerates
articles.summary_zh: 今年前三季度，财政金融协同促内需一揽子政策惠及民间投资和居民消费均超2万亿元，累计惠及企业836万家、居民1.47亿人次。
articles.summary_en: In the first three quarters, China's coordinated fiscal and financial policy package boosted both private investment and household consumption by more than 2 trillion yuan each, benefiting 8.36 million enterprises and 147 million residents.

articles.title_zh: 刘延东同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Liu Yandong Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党的优秀党员、国务院原副总理刘延东同志因病于2026年10月28日14时53分在北京逝世，享年81岁。
articles.summary_en: Liu Yandong, an outstanding CPC member and former vice premier of the State Council, died of illness in Beijing at 14:53 on October 28, 2026, at the age of 81.

articles.title_zh: 2026年8000亿元新型政策性金融工具完成投放
articles.title_en: China Fully Deploys 800 Billion Yuan of New Policy-Based Financial Instruments for 2026
articles.summary_zh: 截至10月28日，2026年8000亿元新型政策性金融工具全部完成投放，由国开行、进出口银行、农发行投向人工智能、数字经济等重点领域项目，用于补充项目资本金。
articles.summary_en: By Oct 28, China fully deployed 80 billion yuan of 2026 new policy-based financial instruments via CDB, Exim Bank and ADBC, funding AI, digital economy and other key projects as project capital.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰在凤城市接待群众来访
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Receives Visiting Citizens in Fengcheng City
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，丹东市委书记蒋冰在凤城市接待来访群众，现场研判化解矛盾纠纷，并部署信访与基层治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Dandong Party Secretary Jiang Bing received visiting citizens in Fengcheng City, addressing their grievances on site and outlining work on petition handling and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰赴凤城市督导信访工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Supervises Petition Work in Fengcheng
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，丹东市委书记蒋冰赴凤城市督导信访工作并主持召开调度会议，部署矛盾纠纷源头化解与基层治理。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Dandong Party Secretary Jiang Bing visited Fengcheng to supervise petition work and chaired a coordination meeting on resolving disputes at the source and improving grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 张丹赴振兴区调研
articles.title_en: Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan Inspects Zhenxing District
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日下午，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹赴振兴区调研基层社会治理、企业生产经营和安全生产责任落实工作，并现场协调解决实际问题。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 27, Zhang Dan, Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Dandong, inspected Zhenxing District to review grassroots governance, enterprise operations and workplace safety, resolving problems on site.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开市第六次党代会报告征求意见座谈会
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Symposium on Soliciting Opinions for City Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日下午，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开座谈会，就市第六次党代会报告征求退休老干部代表的意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 28, Dingxi Party Secretary Wang Shangxue chaired a symposium to solicit retired officials' opinions on the report for the city's 6th Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 李生潜现场督办人大代表建议办理工作
articles.title_en: Acting Mayor Li Shengqian Inspects On-Site Handling of NPC Deputy Suggestions in Dingxi
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，定西市委副书记、代市长李生潜赴安定区调研肉牛智慧养殖及屠宰加工项目，现场督办全国绿色草畜产品生产基地建设建议并召开座谈会征求代表意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Dingxi Acting Mayor Li Shengqian inspected smart beef cattle farming and slaughtering projects in Anding District, supervising on-site the handling of an NPC deputy suggestion on building a national green grass-livestock production base and soliciting deputies' feedback at a symposium.

articles.title_zh: 省人大常委会党组召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，省人大常委会党组召开会议，由党组书记、副主任陈向群主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要文章精神，研究卫生与健康、民生领域立法监督工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 26, the Party Group of the provincial People's Congress Standing Committee met under Secretary and Deputy Director Chen Xiangqun to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and articles, and to plan legislative and oversight work on health and livelihood issues.

articles.title_zh: 福州市委召开三季度工作会议 部署冲刺四季度
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Third-Quarter Work Meeting to Spur Fourth-Quarter Push
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，福州市委召开三季度工作会议，省委常委、市委书记秦海翔讲话，市长吴贤德主持并作部署，安排冲刺四季度、完成全年发展目标。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee held its third-quarter work meeting, where Party Secretary Qin Haixiang spoke and Mayor Wu Xiande presided, deploying a fourth-quarter push to meet annual development goals.

articles.title_zh: 秦海翔吴贤德赴永泰县调研
articles.title_en: Qin Haixiang and Wu Xiande Inspect Yongtai County
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，福州市委书记秦海翔、市长吴贤德赴永泰县调研，察看“一闸三线”引调水工程并召开座谈会，部署乡村振兴、生态保护与民生工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Fuzhou Party Secretary Qin Haixiang and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected Yongtai County, reviewing a cross-basin water diversion project and urging rural revitalization, ecological protection and livelihood work.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱、邓维元深入绥滨县和萝北县督导检查项目安全工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu and Deng Weiyuan Inspect Project Safety Work in Suibin and Luobei Counties
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱、市长邓维元深入绥滨县、萝北县督导检查重点项目安全工作，要求压实安全生产责任。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu and Mayor Deng Weiyuan inspected safety work at key projects in Suibin and Luobei counties, urging stricter implementation of safety responsibilities.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤在盱眙县调研高质量发展
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Xuyi County on High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，淮安市委书记顾坤在盱眙县调研高质量发展，走访天辰能源、盱眙技师学院并召开座谈会，部署新型工业化和县域经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected Xuyi County for high-quality development, visiting Tianchen Energy and a vocational training college and chairing a meeting on county industry.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大八次会议胜利闭幕 蒋曦发表讲话 黄韡当选市人民政府市长 徐胜利当选市人大常委会副主任
articles.title_en: Huaibei Municipal People's Congress Session Concludes; Huang Wei Elected Mayor
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，淮北市十七届人大八次会议闭幕，黄韡当选市人民政府市长，徐胜利当选市人大常委会副主任，市委书记蒋曦发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the 8th session of Huaibei's 17th Municipal People's Congress closed, electing Huang Wei as mayor and Xu Shengli as deputy director of the congress standing committee; Party Secretary Jiang Xi spoke.

articles.title_zh: 淮南市十七届人大常委会举行第三十八次会议 决定任命王瑞峰为副市长
articles.title_en: Huainan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 38th Session, Appoints Wang Ruifeng as Vice Mayor
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，淮南市十七届人大常委会举行第三十八次会议，决定任命王瑞峰为市人民政府副市长，并决定10月28日召开市十七届人大七次会议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, the Standing Committee of Huainan's 17th Municipal People's Congress held its 38th session, appointing Wang Ruifeng as vice mayor and scheduling the 7th plenary session for Oct 28.

articles.title_zh: 黄石市十五届人大常委会召开第三十四次会议
articles.title_en: Huangshi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 34th Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，黄石市十五届人大常委会召开第三十四次会议，审议财政预算调整方案、公共交通一体化条例草案，并表决通过人事议案。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Huangshi's 15th Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 34th session, reviewing budget adjustment and transit legislation plans and approving personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开十一届拉萨市委常委会第一次会议
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs First Meeting of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开十一届市委常委会第一次会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，部署稳定、发展、生态、强边等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering chaired the first meeting of the 11th Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee, conveying and studying Xi Jinping's key instructions and outlining work on stability, development, ecology and border security.

articles.title_zh: 三届市人民政府第2次常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Nyingchi City Government Holds Second Executive Meeting of Third Term
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，林芝市市长尹李峰主持召开三届市政府第2次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究前三季度经济运行情况，并部署防震避险与森林草原防灭火工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Nyingchi Mayor Yin Lifeng chaired the second executive meeting of the city's third-term government, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions, reviewing third-quarter economic performance and deploying earthquake and forest-fire prevention work.

articles.title_zh: 三届市委常委会第3次会议召开
articles.title_en: Nyingchi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Third Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，林芝市委书记巴塔主持召开三届市委常委会第3次会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神和胡昌升书记讲话精神，部署防灾减灾、生态保护与经济发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Nyingchi Party Secretary Ba Ta chaired the third meeting of the city's Party Standing Committee, conveying recent directives from Xi Jinping and Hu Changsheng's remarks, and outlining work on disaster prevention, ecological protection and economic development.

articles.title_zh: 邢鹏会见法国驻沈阳总领事罗毅睿
articles.title_en: Xing Peng Meets French Consul General in Shenyang Luo Yirui
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，盘锦市市长邢鹏会见法国驻沈阳总领事罗毅睿，双方就深化石化等领域经贸合作、优化涉外服务交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Panjin Mayor Xing Peng met with French Consul General in Shenyang Luo Yirui to discuss deepening trade cooperation, including in petrochemicals, and improving services for foreign businesses.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开九届117次党组会议
articles.title_en: Panjin Municipal Government Holds 117th Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，盘锦市政府召开九届117次党组会议，市长、市政府党组书记邢鹏主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，并部署民生保障、防灾减灾和海洋经济等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, the Panjin Municipal Government held its 117th Party group meeting, chaired by Mayor Xing Peng, to convey and study recent important speeches by Xi Jinping and to arrange work on public welfare, disaster prevention and the marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 市委财经委会议暨全市三季度经济形势分析会召开
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Municipal Finance Committee Meeting and Q3 Economic Situation Analysis Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开市委财经委会议暨全市三季度经济形势分析会，分析三季度经济运行情况，研究部署四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a meeting on the city's Q3 economic performance, reviewing third-quarter trends and setting priorities for fourth-quarter economic work.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴澄海区调研产业园区
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Industrial Parks in Chenghai District
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴澄海区调研产业园区，走访玩具与模架企业，强调以智能制造和工商并举推动先进制造业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 27, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected industrial parks and firms in Chenghai District, urging integrated smart manufacturing and trade to boost advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 李晖调研农贸市场领域民生实事项目推进情况
articles.title_en: Li Hui Inspects Progress of Livelihood Projects in Farmers' Markets
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，泰州市长李晖调研农贸市场领域民生实事项目，实地走访新迎江桥综合市场和海光农贸市场，要求做好保供稳价、严守食品安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui inspected farmers' market livelihood projects at two markets, urging stable supply and prices and stricter food safety oversight.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰主持召开西安市委专题会议 部署打好“问题整改硬仗”
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Chairs Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Special Meeting on Rectifying Problems
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰主持召开市委专题会议，听取联合督导反馈问题整改情况汇报，部署以更大力度打好“问题整改硬仗”。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie chaired a special municipal Party committee meeting to review progress on problems flagged by joint inspections and to step up the city's rectification campaign.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研政治安全与社会稳定工作 强调坚定不移贯彻总体国家安全观
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Political Security and Social Stability Work, Stressing Unswerving Implementation of the Holistic Approach to National Security
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰调研政治安全与社会稳定工作，走访市国家安全局、市公安局及基层社区，强调坚决维护政治安全、社会安定、人民安宁。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected political security and social stability work, visiting the state security bureau, police units and communities, and urging steady implementation of the holistic approach to national security.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见国家电网有限公司副总工程师兼西北分部主任、党委副书记陈红军一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Chen Hongjun of State Grid Northwest Branch
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见国家电网西北分部主任陈红军一行，双方就电网建设、电力保供和能源绿色低碳转型合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met Chen Hongjun, director of State Grid's Northwest Branch, to discuss power grid construction, power supply security and green energy transition.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平调研现代物流业发展工作
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Inspects Modern Logistics Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，新乡市委书记魏建平赴凤泉区、卫滨区、红旗区、经开区专题调研现代物流业发展，要求加快构建高效畅通的现代物流体系。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping inspected modern logistics development across the city's Fengquan, Weibin, Hongqi districts and the economic development zone, urging faster building of an efficient logistics system.

articles.title_zh: 陈维忠到中原农谷走访调研企业
articles.title_en: Chen Weizhong Visits Enterprises in Central Plains Agricultural Valley
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，新乡市市长陈维忠到中原农谷走访调研企业，推进制造业高质量发展和企业服务月活动。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Xinxiang Mayor Chen Weizhong visited enterprises in the Central Plains Agricultural Valley to promote high-quality manufacturing development and enterprise services.

articles.title_zh: 何淳宽到广德督导检查消防和道路交通安全工作
articles.title_en: He Chunkuan Inspects Fire Safety and Road Traffic Safety Work in Guangde
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日下午，宣城市委书记何淳宽到广德市督导检查消防和道路交通安全工作，实地察看中医院、交通路口、街道和住宅小区。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 27, Xuancheng Party Secretary He Chunkuan inspected fire safety and road traffic safety work in Guangde, visiting a hospital, intersections, a street and a residential community.

articles.title_zh: 中韩（盐城）产业园经贸合作投资说明会在首尔举行
articles.title_en: China-South Korea (Yancheng) Industrial Park Investment Promotion Conference Held in Seoul
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，中韩（盐城）产业园经贸合作投资说明会在首尔举行，盐城市委书记严汉平、中国驻韩国大使戴兵等出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, the China-South Korea (Yancheng) Industrial Park trade and investment promotion conference was held in Seoul, with Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Chinese Ambassador Dai Bing delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 市委生态文明建设领导小组召开会议 深入学习贯彻习近平生态文明思想 奋力推进美丽银川建设 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Ecological Civilization Leading Group Holds Meeting, Chaired by Zhao Xuhui
articles.summary_zh: 近日，银川市委生态文明建设领导小组召开会议，市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，部署生态环境保护督察反馈问题整改和美丽银川建设重点工作。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan party secretary Zhao Xuhui chaired a meeting of the municipal ecological civilization leading group to review rectification of environmental inspection findings and plan work for building a beautiful Yinchuan.
