articles.title_zh: 营口军分区党委第一书记任职宣布大会召开
articles.title_en: Yingkou Military Sub-district Holds Meeting to Announce Appointment of New Party Committee First Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，营口军分区党委第一书记任职宣布大会召开，省军区党委决定增补市委书记李军为军分区党委委员、常委，任第一书记。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Yingkou Military Sub-district held a meeting announcing that Li Jun, Yingkou Party Secretary, was appointed its Party committee's first secretary by the provincial military command's Party committee.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 研究分析经济形势 部署下阶段经济工作 徐晓霞主持会议
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Analyze Economic Situation and Deploy Next-Stage Economic Work, Chaired by Xu Xiaoxia
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日下午，云浮市委常委会召开会议，并套开全市三季度经济形势分析会，市委书记徐晓霞主持，研究部署四季度稳工业、扩投资、稳外贸、促消费等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 26, the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met with the city's Q3 economic analysis conference, chaired by Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia, to deploy Q4 work on industry, investment, foreign trade and consumption.

articles.title_zh: 佛山对口帮扶协作云浮党政联席会议召开
articles.title_en: Foshan-Yunfu Paired Assistance Party and Government Joint Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，佛山对口帮扶协作云浮党政联席会议在佛山召开，佛山市委书记唐屹峰、云浮市委书记徐晓霞出席并讲话，推动新一轮帮扶协作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, a joint meeting on Foshan-Yunfu paired assistance was held in Foshan, with Party secretaries Tang Yifeng of Foshan and Xu Xiaoxia of Yunfu attending and speaking on advancing a new round of cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市长李勇毅赴第140届广交会调研湛江参展企业
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi Inspects City's Exhibitors at the 140th Canton Fair
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，湛江市委副书记、市长李勇毅赴第140届广交会现场走访湛江参展企业，强调稳外贸、拓市场、促招商。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi visited local exhibitors at the 140th Canton Fair, urging stepped-up efforts to stabilize foreign trade, expand markets and attract investment.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党廉江市第十五次代表大会举行选举大会
articles.title_en: 15th Lianjiang Municipal Party Congress Holds Election Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日下午，中共廉江市第十五次代表大会举行选举大会，选举产生新一届市委委员、候补委员、市纪委委员及出席湛江市党代会代表。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 24, the 15th Lianjiang Municipal Party Congress held an election meeting, selecting new municipal Party committee and discipline committee members and delegates to Zhanjiang.

articles.title_zh: 秦海翔吴贤德赴永泰县调研
articles.title_en: Qin Haixiang and Wu Xiande Inspect Yongtai County
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月28日，福州市委书记秦海翔、市长吴贤德赴永泰县塘前乡莒口村及“一闸三线”工程调度中心调研并召开座谈会，部署生态保护、乡村振兴与供水安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 28, 2026, Fuzhou Party Secretary Qin Haixiang and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected Yongtai County, visiting Jukou Village and the water diversion project control center, and held a meeting on ecological protection, rural revitalization and water supply security.

articles.title_zh: 一条乌镇大道，一个科创主轴：桐乡推动人工智能产业成链起势
articles.title_en: Tongxiang Builds AI Industry Chain Along Wuzhen Avenue Innovation Axis
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，浙江桐乡依托乌镇大道科创主轴，推出人工智能“乌镇七子”企业集群，推动当地AI产业成链起势。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Tongxiang in Zhejiang unveiled its "Wuzhen Seven" AI enterprise cluster along the Wuzhen Avenue innovation axis, pushing the local AI industry into a full chain.

articles.title_zh: 广东省人大常委会原委员卓毅逝世，享年88岁
articles.title_en: Zhuo Yi, Former Member of Guangdong Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, Dies at 88
articles.summary_zh: 广东省人大常委会原委员、外事委员会原主任卓毅于2026年10月27日上午逝世，享年88岁。
articles.summary_en: Zhuo Yi, former member of the Guangdong Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and former director of its foreign affairs committee, died on the morning of Oct 27, 2026, aged 88.

articles.title_zh: 12872亿元，重庆促消费做对了什么？
articles.title_en: 128.72 Billion Yuan: What Has Chongqing Done Right in Boosting Consumption?
articles.summary_zh: 重庆前三季度社会消费品零售总额达12872亿元、增速逐季升至3.1%，当地通过以旧换新、消费券、活动引流和消费场景创新等举措持续激活消费市场。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing's retail sales of consumer goods reached 1.2872 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, with growth rising to 3.1%. The city boosted consumption through trade-in subsidies, vouchers, events and new shopping scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 贵州集中发布一批人工智能应用场景需求清单
articles.title_en: Guizhou Releases a Batch of AI Application Scenario Demand Lists
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，2026年贵州省人工智能行业大模型成果发布暨供需对接活动在贵阳举办，发布第三批150个应用场景开放清单，现场达成6项签约。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Guizhou held an AI large-model achievements and supply-demand matching event in Guiyang, releasing 150 new AI application scenarios and signing six cooperation projects.

articles.title_zh: 豫疆历史文化交流基地建设项目顺利通过竣工验收
articles.title_en: Henan-Xinjiang Historical and Cultural Exchange Base Passes Completion Acceptance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，由中建七局承建的豫疆历史文化交流基地在新疆哈密市伊州区通过竣工验收，总建筑面积约1.27万平方米。
articles.summary_en: The Henan-Xinjiang Historical and Cultural Exchange Base in Hami, Xinjiang, built by China Construction Seventh Engineering Bureau, has passed completion acceptance, with about 12,700 square meters of floor space.

articles.title_zh: 河南省消协发布“双十一”消费提示：警惕“低价噱头” 理性按需消费
articles.title_en: Henan Consumers Association Issues Double 11 Shopping Tips: Beware of Low-Price Gimmicks, Buy Rationally
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，河南省消费者协会发布“双十一”消费提示，提醒消费者理性按需消费，警惕先涨价再打折等低价噱头，谨慎看待直播带货并防范电信诈骗。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, the Henan Consumers Association issued Double 11 shopping tips, urging consumers to buy rationally, beware of fake discounts such as price hikes before markdowns, and stay cautious with livestream selling and telecom fraud.

articles.title_zh: 因地制宜推进乡村全面振兴
articles.title_en: Henan Advances Rural Revitalization Tailored to Local Conditions
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，人民日报报道河南以智能农机、特色产业和非遗文创推动乡村全面振兴，前三季度农村居民人均可支配收入同比增长6.4%。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, People's Daily reported how Henan is advancing rural revitalization through smart farm machinery, specialty industries and heritage crafts, with rural incomes up 6.4% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 黑土珍味走进京津 乾安肉羊亮出特色畜牧新名片
articles.title_en: Qian'an Mutton Brand Promoted in Beijing-Tianjin Region as a New Calling Card for Specialty Livestock
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，吉林乾安县肉羊品牌推介会在北京举办，副县长吴海涛携两大自主肉羊品种对接京津市场。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, Qian'an County of Jilin held a mutton promotion event in Beijing, where Deputy County Head Wu Haitao presented two self-developed sheep breeds to Beijing-Tianjin buyers.

articles.title_zh: 江西省以“我的井冈行”为重点的青少年思政实践活动在井冈山启动
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Launches Youth Ideological Education Program 'My Jinggangshan Journey' in Jinggangshan
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日上午，江西省青少年思政实践活动启动仪式在井冈山市红旗广场举行，省委常委卢小青、副省长孙洪山出席并为设区市授旗。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 28, Jiangxi province launched its youth ideological education program at Hongqi Square in Jinggangshan, with provincial officials Lu Xiaoqing and Sun Hongshan attending and presenting flags to cities.

articles.title_zh: 钢船逐浪 渔获满舱——辽宁推动渔船“木改钢”惠及万千渔民
articles.title_en: Steel Vessels Ride the Waves as Catches Fill the Holds: Liaoning's 'Wood-to-Steel' Fishing Boat Upgrade Benefits Thousands of Fishermen
articles.summary_zh: 2025年10月起，辽宁启动为期3年的渔船“木改钢”专项行动，通过补贴、精简审批、减船转产等措施，已更新改造1964艘渔船。
articles.summary_en: Since October 2025, Liaoning has run a three-year campaign to replace wooden fishing boats with steel ones, using subsidies, streamlined approvals and fleet-reduction programs; 1,964 vessels have been upgraded so far.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏银川市职工创新创业创造中心揭牌成立
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Workers' Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center Unveiled in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，宁夏银川市职工创新创业创造中心在银川市总工会揭牌成立，同步组建“孵化式”创业联盟，服务职工创业就业。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, the Yinchuan Workers' Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center was unveiled at the Yinchuan Federation of Trade Unions in Ningxia, together with an "incubation-style" entrepreneurship alliance to support workers' startups and employment.

articles.title_zh: 蔡成勇带队开展行政检察工作调研
articles.title_en: Cai Chengyong Leads Research Team on Administrative Procuratorial Work
articles.summary_zh: 青海省人大常委会副主任蔡成勇近日带队赴省检察院及西宁、海北、海东部分基层院，专题调研行政检察工作。
articles.summary_en: Cai Chengyong, deputy director of the Qinghai Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, recently led a team to the provincial procuratorate and grassroots procuratorates in Xining, Haibei and Haidong to research administrative procuratorial work.

articles.title_zh: 寻找下一粒好种子：从冷库到田埂，四问山东种业“强芯”之路
articles.title_en: Finding the Next Good Seed: Four Questions on Shandong's Seed Industry Push from Cold Storage to Farmland
articles.summary_zh: 记者走访济南种质资源库、科研院所、育种基地和种业企业，围绕资源鉴定、育种提速、成果转化与创新体系四问，剖析山东种业“强芯”的短板与探索。
articles.summary_en: Reporters toured seed banks, research institutes, breeding bases and seed companies in Shandong, examining gaps and progress in germplasm evaluation, breeding speed, commercialization and the innovation system.

articles.title_zh: 国家人工智能应用中试基地（家居家电方向）启动建设
articles.title_en: National AI Application Pilot Base for Home Appliances Launched in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，家居家电方向的国家人工智能应用中试基地在山东青岛启动建设，目标是打造“新一代智慧家电”中试基地，并搭建供需运营平台与应用服务市场。
articles.summary_en: On October 27, a national AI application pilot base for home and home-appliance products began construction in Qingdao, Shandong, aiming to build a pilot facility for next-generation smart appliances and to set up supply-demand and application-service platforms.

articles.title_zh: 退役军人事务部：确认8位在韩中国人民志愿军烈士身份
articles.title_en: Ministry of Veterans Affairs Confirms Identities of 8 Martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers from South Korea
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月28日，退役军人事务部确认施志成等8位在韩中国人民志愿军烈士身份。2014年以来，我国已迎回十三批共1023位烈士遗骸。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, 2026, China's Ministry of Veterans Affairs confirmed the identities of eight martyrs of the Chinese People's Volunteers from South Korea. Since 2014, China has received 13 batches totaling 1,023 sets of remains.

articles.title_zh: 探寻"中国之治"的成功密码——新时代全面从严治党为世界政党建设带来深刻启迪
articles.title_en: Decoding the Secret of 'China's Governance': Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance Inspires Global Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日至29日，中共二十届五中全会在北京举行，研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党；文章梳理国际社会对中共治党经验与反腐实践的关注和借鉴。
articles.summary_en: The 20th CPC Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session, held in Beijing from Oct 26 to 29, studied sustained full and rigorous Party self-governance, with foreign parties and officials praising the CPC's experience.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: “十五五”我国将全面提升农产品品质
articles.title_en: China to Comprehensively Improve Agricultural Product Quality During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部近期印发《全国农产品品质提升“十五五”规划》，部署标准引领、绿色生产、质量安全监管等任务，提出到2030年例行监测合格率稳定在98%以上。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs issued a plan to improve agricultural product quality during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, setting tasks on standards, green production and safety oversight, and aiming to keep routine monitoring pass rates above 98% by 2030.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 从16件到大于22件——每万人口高价值发明专利拥有量如何大幅跃升
articles.title_en: From 16 to Over 22: How China's High-Value Invention Patents per 10,000 People Will Leap
articles.summary_zh: 国务院近日印发《知识产权保护和运用“十五五”规划》，将每万人口高价值发明专利拥有量目标设定为大于22件，较“十四五”末的16件增长6件以上。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for IP protection and utilization, raising the target for high-value invention patents per 10,000 people to over 22 from 16 at the end of the 14th plan period.

articles.title_zh: 我国推进基层中医适宜技术推广，群众有望在“家门口”体验15项以上技术
articles.title_en: China Promotes Appropriate Traditional Chinese Medicine Techniques at Primary Level, Bringing 15+ Therapies to Communities
articles.summary_zh: 国家中医药管理局综合司、国家卫生健康委办公厅近日联合印发通知，推进基层中医适宜技术推广应用，县级将优先推广6类15项以上技术。
articles.summary_en: China's National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine and the National Health Commission jointly issued a notice to expand appropriate TCM techniques at primary-level clinics, with counties prioritizing at least 15 therapies across six categories.

tags.name_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

tags_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

articles.title_zh: 两部门部署西藏强降雪天气防范应对工作
articles.title_en: Two Departments Deploy Response to Heavy Snowfall in Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部会同相关部门和西藏自治区联合会商，部署29日至31日西藏强降雪防范应对工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 28, China's disaster relief and emergency authorities joined Tibet and other departments to assess and deploy response to heavy snowfall in Tibet from Oct 29 to 31.

articles.title_zh: 向“新”而行 以“质”争先——从“十五五”专项规划看新质生产力发展前景
articles.title_en: Driving Toward Innovation and Striving for Quality: New Quality Productive Forces in the 15th Five-Year Plan Special Plans
articles.summary_zh: 10月28日，新华社报道称，“十五五”专项规划密集部署科技创新、产业融合和要素改革，加快培育新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 28, Xinhua reported that China's 15th Five-Year Plan special plans deploy tech innovation, industrial integration and factor reforms to foster new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 廉毅敏：围绕中心服务大局 不断开创政协新闻宣传工作新局面
articles.title_en: Lian Yimin: Serving the Central Task and the Overall Situation, Opening New Prospects for CPPCC News and Publicity Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，浙江省政协新闻宣传工作座谈会在杭州召开，省政协主席廉毅敏出席并讲话，部署政协新闻宣传和意识形态工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, a symposium on CPPCC news and publicity work was held in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, where provincial CPPCC Chair Lian Yimin spoke and set out plans for CPPCC publicity and ideological work.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：对英国警方任意过度执法行为表示强烈不满、严重关切
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Strongly Dissatisfied, Seriously Concerned Over UK Police Arbitrary and Excessive Law Enforcement
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，中方对英国边境执法人员任意、过度执法表示强烈不满和严重关切，已向英方提出严正交涉。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China is strongly dissatisfied with and seriously concerned about arbitrary, excessive law enforcement by UK border officers against Chinese citizens, and has lodged solemn representations with the UK.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：日本右翼势力极力否认、甚至美化侵略罪行，国际社会应当共同抵制
articles.title_en: FM: Japan's Right-Wing Forces Deny and Even Glorify Aggression, International Community Should Jointly Resist
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，日本右翼势力罔顾东京审判定论、否认并美化侵略罪行，国际社会应当共同抵制。
articles.summary_en: On October 27, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular briefing that Japan's right-wing forces ignore the Tokyo Trial verdict and deny or glorify aggression, and the international community should jointly resist such moves.

articles.title_zh: 中国驻菲律宾使馆国防武官将作为中方代表出席东盟防长扩大会
articles.title_en: Chinese Defense Attaché in the Philippines to Attend ADMM-Plus as China's Representative
articles.summary_zh: 据国防部消息，10月29日中国驻菲律宾使馆国防武官将作为中方代表出席在宿务举行的第13届东盟防长扩大会，就增进互信与防务安全合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: China's defense attaché in the Philippines will represent China at the 13th ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus in Cebu on Oct 29, exchanging views on dialogue, mutual trust and regional defense cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 国务院部署应对AI替岗，劳动者转型能获得什么政策支持？
articles.title_en: State Council Deploys Measures on AI Job Displacement: What Policy Support Do Workers Get?
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，国务院办公厅印发《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》，围绕岗位创造、转型支持、技能培训和权益保障作出部署。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, China's State Council General Office issued guidelines on adapting to AI while building an employment-friendly development model, covering job creation, transition support, training and rights protection.

tags.name_en: General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 中国首个规模化商用卵内胚胎性别鉴定技术在银川发布
articles.title_en: China's First Large-Scale Commercial In-Ovo Embryo Sex Identification Technology Launched in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，中国首个规模化商用的高光谱卵内胚胎性别鉴定技术在宁夏银川发布，鉴定准确率超99%，打破海外技术垄断。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, China's first large-scale commercial in-ovo embryo sex identification technology was launched in Yinchuan, Ningxia, achieving over 99% accuracy and breaking foreign technological monopoly.

articles.title_zh: 中国作为首批签约国签署《联合国可转让货物单证公约》
articles.title_en: China Signs UN Convention on Negotiable Cargo Documents as a Founding Signatory
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间10月26日，在加纳首都阿克拉，商务部副部长蒋成华代表中国政府签署《联合国可转让货物单证公约》，中国成为首批26个签约国之一。
articles.summary_en: On October 26 local time in Accra, Ghana, Vice Minister of Commerce Jiang Chenghua signed the UN Convention on Negotiable Cargo Documents on behalf of the Chinese government, making China one of the first 26 signatories.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：对英国警方任意、过度执法行为表示强烈不满
articles.title_en: FM: China Strongly Dissatisfied with Arbitrary, Excessive Law Enforcement by UK Police
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上表示，中方对英国边境执法人员长时间扣留、盘查中国公民并查扣其电子设备表示强烈不满，已向英方提出严正交涉。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, FM spokesperson Guo Jiakun said in Beijing that China is strongly dissatisfied and seriously concerned over UK border officers' prolonged detention and questioning of Chinese citizens and seizure of their electronic devices, and has lodged solemn representations with the UK.

articles.title_zh: 中方将派驻菲武官出席第13届东盟防长扩大会
articles.title_en: China to Send Defense Attaché in Philippines to 13th ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting Plus
articles.summary_zh: 中国国防部10月27日宣布，中国驻菲律宾使馆国防武官将于10月29日作为中方代表出席在宿务举行的第13届东盟防长扩大会。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of National Defense announced on Oct 27 that China's defense attaché in the Philippines will represent China at the 13th ASEAN Defense Ministers' Meeting Plus in Cebu on Oct 29.

tags.name_en: Ministry of National Defense of China

tags_en: Ministry of National Defense of China

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国愿同全世界爱好和平的国家和人民一道坚定守护历史真相
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Ready to Safeguard Historical Truth Together with Peace-Loving Countries and Peoples
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上表示，中国愿同全世界爱好和平的国家和人民一道，坚定守护历史真相、维护战后国际秩序。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told a regular briefing in Beijing that China will join peace-loving countries and peoples in safeguarding historical truth and upholding the postwar international order.

articles.title_zh: 外媒称欧盟计划减少从中国进口相关产品 中方回应
articles.title_en: China Responds to Reports EU Plans to Cut Imports of Chinese Products
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上回应欧盟拟减少自华进口，称中欧经贸底色是互利共赢，望欧方避免滥用贸易救济工具。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, FM spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China-EU economic ties are mutually beneficial and urged the EU to avoid abusing trade remedy tools instead of curbing imports from China.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：希望欧方尊重市场经济和公平竞争原则 推动中欧关系健康稳定发展
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Hopes EU Respects Market Economy and Fair Competition Principles to Promote Healthy, Stable China-EU Relations
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上就中欧经贸关系表示，希望欧方尊重市场经济和公平竞争原则，避免滥用贸易救济工具，以实际行动推动中欧关系健康稳定发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 27, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing that China hopes the EU will respect market economy and fair competition principles, avoid abusing trade remedy tools, and take concrete action to promote healthy and stable China-EU relations.

articles.title_zh: 新疆霍尔果斯举办中亚媒体智库对话暨“Z世代推荐官计划”研学活动
articles.title_en: Xinjiang's Horgos Hosts Central Asia Media Think Tank Dialogue and 'Gen Z Promoter' Study Camp
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，中亚媒体智库对话沙龙在新疆霍尔果斯举办，“Z世代推荐官计划”研学营同日开营，并签署校地合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, a Central Asia media think-tank dialogue was held in Horgos, Xinjiang, alongside a Gen Z study camp, with a university-local cooperation agreement signed.

articles.title_zh: “蛟龙”号实现迭代升级 顺利完成7000米级海试
articles.title_en: Jiaolong Submersible Completes Upgrade, Finishes 7,000-Meter Sea Trials
articles.summary_zh: “蛟龙”号载人潜水器完成第二次迭代升级后，在菲律宾海盆开展3个潜次试验，最大下潜深度7056.9米，顺利完成7000米级海试。
articles.summary_en: After its second upgrade, China's Jiaolong manned submersible conducted three dives in the Philippine Basin, reaching a maximum depth of 7,056.9 meters and completing its 7,000-meter-class sea trials.

articles.title_zh: 德国总统施泰因迈尔今起对我国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: German President Steinmeier Begins State Visit to China
articles.summary_zh: 应国家主席习近平邀请，德国总统施泰因迈尔于10月27日至31日对中国进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of President Xi Jinping, German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier is making a state visit to China from October 27 to 31.

articles.title_zh: 中央编办、司法部负责人就《事业单位登记管理条例》答记者问
articles.title_en: Central Institutional Organization Commission and Ministry of Justice Officials Answer Questions on the Regulations on Registration and Administration of Public Institutions
articles.summary_zh: 中央编办、司法部负责人就新修订的《事业单位登记管理条例》答记者问，介绍修订背景、党的领导、公益性职责和监管举措。
articles.summary_en: Central Institutional Organization Commission and Ministry of Justice officials answered questions on the revised public institution registration rules, covering Party leadership, public welfare and supervision.

articles.title_zh: 中朝共同举行中国人民志愿军抗美援朝出国作战76周年纪念活动
articles.title_en: China and DPRK Mark 76th Anniversary of Chinese People's Volunteers Entering Korean War
articles.summary_zh: 10月25日，中朝在平壤中朝友谊塔举行纪念中国人民志愿军抗美援朝出国作战76周年活动，双方代表敬献花圈并瞻仰烈士资料。
articles.summary_en: On October 25, China and the DPRK held a commemoration at the China-DPRK Friendship Tower in Pyongyang marking the 76th anniversary of the Chinese People's Volunteers entering the Korean War.

tags.name_en: Commemoration of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea

tags_en: Commemoration of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea

articles.title_zh: 加强党的组织建设 夯实兴党强党根基
articles.title_en: Strengthening Party Organizational Building to Consolidate the Foundation for Building a Strong Party
articles.summary_zh: 央视新闻联播报道，党的十八大以来，党中央不断健全严密组织体系，推动全面从严治党向基层延伸，把基层党组织建成坚强战斗堡垒，为推进中国式现代化提供组织保证。
articles.summary_en: CCTV's Xinwen Lianbo reports that since the 18th CPC National Congress the Central Committee has tightened its organizational system, extended strict Party governance to the grassroots and built primary-level Party organizations into strong fighting bastions to support Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 六城市将开展数字家庭建设
articles.title_en: Six Cities to Launch Digital Home Construction Pilots
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委公布首批136项标志性重大应用场景项目清单，住房城乡建设部牵头的数字家庭场景入选，深圳、青岛等6城将先行落地建设。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission released its first list of 136 landmark major application scenarios, including a digital home scenario led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, with six cities such as Shenzhen and Qingdao to pilot it first.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development

tags_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development

articles.title_zh: 外交部：将同各方携手让外空发展成果更好惠及全人类
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Will Work With All Parties to Ensure Outer Space Development Benefits All Humanity
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上表示，中方将继续秉持开放、建设性精神同各方合作，让外空发展成果更好惠及全人类。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, MFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun said in Beijing that China will continue to work with all parties in an open and constructive spirit so that outer space development benefits all humanity.

articles.title_zh: 走近长征，感悟精神力量
articles.title_en: Diplomats Visit Exhibition Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日上午，来自106个驻华使馆和5个国际组织的驻华使节和外交官在北京中国人民革命军事博物馆参观纪念红军长征胜利90周年主题展览。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 26, diplomats from 106 foreign embassies and 5 international organizations visited a themed exhibition in Beijing marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

articles.title_zh: 二十届中央第八轮巡视完成进驻
articles.title_en: 20th CPC Central Committee's Eighth Inspection Round Completes Team Deployment
articles.summary_zh: 根据党中央统一部署，二十届中央第八轮巡视完成进驻，15个中央巡视组将对教育部和31所中管高校党组织开展常规巡视。
articles.summary_en: Fifteen central inspection teams deployed for the 20th CPC Central Committee's eighth inspection round, conducting routine inspections of the Ministry of Education and 31 centrally run universities.

articles.title_zh: 财经深一度丨救急不兜底，央行推出稳债市新工具
articles.title_en: PBOC Launches New Bond Market Stabilization Tool: Emergency Relief, Not a Bailout
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行10月26日发布公告，设立债市非银大额赎回互换便利（BNSF），为银行理财、公募基金等非银机构提供应急流动性支持，以稳定债券市场。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China announced on Oct 26 the creation of the BNSF facility, an emergency liquidity backstop for non-bank asset managers such as wealth management and mutual fund firms facing mass redemptions, aimed at stabilizing the bond market.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议 研究部署巡察、防灾减灾救灾、乡村振兴和集中整治等工作
articles.title_en: Ankang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Inspection Work, Disaster Relief and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，安康市委召开常委会会议，市委书记柯昌万主持，研究部署巡察、防灾减灾救灾、乡村振兴和群众身边腐败问题集中整治等工作。

articles.title_en: Xu Zhi Meets WorldSkills Gold Medalist Sun Guotai and Expert Team
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，芜湖市委书记徐志会见第48届世界技能大赛飞机维修项目金牌选手孙国泰及其专家团队，祝贺其蝉联金牌，并强调完善技能人才培养体系。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Wuhu Party Secretary Xu Zhi met Sun Guotai, gold medalist in aircraft maintenance at the 48th WorldSkills Competition, and his expert team, congratulating them and pledging to improve skilled-talent training systems.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研督导灞桥区民生领域信访问题治理工作并主持召开专题会
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Governance of Livelihood-Related Petitions in Baqiao District and Chairs Special Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰到灞桥区调研督导民生领域信访问题治理工作，并主持召开专题会，要求攻坚信访积案、化解历史遗留问题。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected Baqiao District on handling livelihood-related petitions and chaired a special meeting, urging resolve to clear backlogged cases and settle long-standing issues.

articles.title_zh: 习近平《在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上的讲话》单行本出版
articles.title_en: Booklet of Xi Jinping's Speech at the Commemorative Meeting for the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Long March Is Published
articles.summary_zh: 据新华社北京10月26日消息，习近平在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上的讲话单行本已由人民出版社出版，即日起在全国新华书店发行。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua News Agency reported on Oct 26 that a booklet of Xi Jinping's speech at the commemorative meeting marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Red Army's Long March has been published by the People's Publishing House and is now available at Xinhua Bookstores nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平到高新区调研新型储能产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Visits High-tech Zone to Study New Energy Storage Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，新乡市委书记魏建平深入高新区专题调研新型储能产业发展情况，并走访多家重点企业，部署产业链协同与要素保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping visited the high-tech zone to study the new energy storage industry and toured key firms, urging supply-chain coordination and stronger resource support.

articles.title_zh: 襄城县经济高质量发展第四次季度会暨2027年重点项目谋划工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Xiangcheng County Holds Fourth Quarterly Meeting on High-Quality Economic Development and 2027 Key Project Planning
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，襄城县召开经济高质量发展第四次季度会暨2027年重点项目谋划工作会议，县委书记范耀江主持并讲话，县长张国平作工作部署。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Xiangcheng County held its fourth quarterly meeting on high-quality economic development and 2027 key project planning, chaired by county Party secretary Fan Yaojiang, with county mayor Zhang Guoping outlining work arrangements.

articles.title_zh: 何淳宽在市委常委会扩大会议上强调：深入学习贯彻省第十二次党代会精神，以实干实绩推动省党代会精神在宣城落地见效
articles.title_en: He Chunkuan Urges Xuancheng to Implement Spirit of 12th Provincial Party Congress at Enlarged Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日上午，宣城市委常委会扩大会议召开，市委书记何淳宽主持并讲话，传达学习省第十二次党代会及省委常委会会议精神，部署贯彻落实工作，并安排年底经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 26, Xuancheng's municipal Party committee held an enlarged standing committee meeting chaired by Party Secretary He Chunkuan to convey the spirit of the 12th provincial Party congress and arrange implementation work and year-end economic tasks.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平会见天合光能董事长高纪凡
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Meets Trina Solar Chairman Gao Jifan
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平在盐城会见天合光能董事长高纪凡，双方就光伏产业合作、新型储能、零碳园区建设等深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 26, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping met Trina Solar Chairman Gao Jifan in Yancheng to discuss cooperation in photovoltaics, new-type energy storage and zero-carbon parks.

articles.title_zh: 余金富会见吉尔吉斯斯坦驻广州总领事叶尔尼斯特
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Meets Kyrgyz Consul General in Guangzhou Ernest
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，阳江市市长余金富会见吉尔吉斯斯坦驻广州总领事叶尔尼斯特一行，双方就经贸、五金刀剪、现代农业、文化旅游等领域合作深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On October 26, Yangjiang Mayor Yu Jinfu met with Kyrgyz Consul General in Guangzhou Ernest and his delegation, discussing cooperation in trade, hardware and knives, modern agriculture and cultural tourism.

articles.title_zh: 市委农村工作领导小组会议召开 加快农业农村现代化 扎实推进乡村全面振兴 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Rural Work Leading Group Meets on Agricultural Modernization and All-Round Rural Revitalization; Zhao Xuhui Chairs and Addresses the Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 近日，银川市委农村工作领导小组会议召开，自治区党委常委、市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，部署农业农村现代化与乡村全面振兴重点工作。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan's rural work leading group recently met, with municipal Party secretary Zhao Xuhui presiding and urging faster agricultural modernization and all-round rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 李军在西市区随机接待群众
articles.title_en: Li Jun Receives Residents Without Prior Arrangement in Xishi District
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，营口市委书记李军到西市区信访局随机接待五批群众，现场研究解决办法，强调健全一站式矛盾纠纷调处化解机制，把矛盾化解在基层。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Yingkou Party Secretary Li Jun received five groups of residents at the Xishi District petition office, studying solutions on site and urging better grassroots dispute resolution.

articles.title_zh: 玉溪干部职工学习习近平总书记在纪念红军长征胜利90周年大会上的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Yuxi Cadres Study Xi Jinping's Speech at Rally Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日纪念红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京举行后，玉溪市广大干部职工学习习近平重要讲话精神，表示要弘扬长征精神、推动玉溪高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: After the October 22 rally in Beijing marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory, cadres and staff in Yuxi studied Xi Jinping's speech, vowing to carry forward the Long March spirit and advance high-quality development in the city.

articles.title_zh: 徐晓霞率队赴肇庆市考察交流
articles.title_en: Xu Xiaoxia Leads Delegation to Zhaoqing for Exchange on Regional Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，云浮市委书记徐晓霞率队赴肇庆考察交流，肇庆市委书记张爱军参加，双方就深化肇云协同发展、产业与交通合作进行对接。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Yunfu Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia led a delegation to Zhaoqing for talks with Zhaoqing Party Secretary Zhang Aijun on deepening Yunfu-Zhaoqing coordinated development, industrial and transport cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 云城区持续推进“放管服”改革支持小微企业发展壮大 经营主体达7.25万户
articles.title_en: Yuncheng District Advances Streamlining-Administration Reform to Support Small Businesses, 72,500 Market Entities Registered
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，广东云浮市云城区推进“放管服”改革，通过优化准入服务、知识产权赋能、信用监管等支持小微企业，截至9月底经营主体达7.25万户，居全市第一。
articles.summary_en: Since early this year, Yuncheng District in Yunfu, Guangdong has advanced administrative reform, streamlining business registration, IP support and credit oversight to help small firms; by end-September it had 72,500 market entities, the most in the city.

articles.title_zh: 市委党校2026年第三期主体班暨领导干部履新能力提升专题培训班开班
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Party School Opens Third Main Class of 2026 and Training Program for Newly Appointed Officials
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日上午，湛江市委党校2026年第三期主体班暨领导干部履新能力提升专题培训班开班，市委书记余钢出席并作动员讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 26, the Zhanjiang Municipal Party School opened its third main class of 2026 and a special training program for newly appointed officials; Municipal Party Secretary Yu Gang attended and delivered a mobilization speech.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组2026年第14次（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal Government Party Group Holds 14th Expanded Meeting of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，湛江市市长李勇毅主持召开市政府党组2026年第14次（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记致第140届广交会重要贺信精神，部署外经贸、招商引资和营商环境建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired the municipal government party group's 14th expanded meeting of 2026, conveying Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter to the 140th Canton Fair and outlining work on foreign trade, investment promotion and the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开湛江市委常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Expanded Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示批示精神，部署先进制造业、卫生健康、对外开放和集中整治工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired a standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions and deploy work on manufacturing, health, opening-up and corruption rectification.

articles.title_zh: 张佩主持召开雷州市委十五届第1次常委会会议
articles.title_en: Zhang Pei Chairs First Standing Committee Meeting of 15th Leizhou Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，雷州市委书记张佩主持召开市委十五届第1次常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在纪念红军长征胜利90周年大会上的重要讲话精神，并研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Leizhou Party Secretary Zhang Pei chaired the first meeting of the 15th municipal Party committee's standing committee, studying Xi Jinping's speech on the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory.

articles.title_zh: 周口市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，并研究群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's speeches and discuss rectifying corruption and misconduct around the public.

articles.title_zh: 全市重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会召开，研究房地产分类去库存及问题楼盘处置
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Holds Weekly Meeting on Key Projects and Enterprise Appeals, Studies Property Destocking and Troubled Projects
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，周口市召开重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会，市委书记黄玉国讲话，市长詹鹏出席，研究房地产分类去库存及问题楼盘处置化解工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, Zhoukou city held its weekly meeting on key projects and enterprise appeals, with Party Secretary Huang Yuguo speaking and Mayor Zhan Peng attending, to study property destocking and the resolution of troubled housing projects.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇到香洲区调研督导先进制造业高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Inspects Xiangzhou District to Advance High-Quality Development of Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日下午，珠海市委书记陈勇到香洲区调研督导先进制造业高质量发展工作，走访多家科技企业，强调锚定智能化、绿色化、融合化方向做大做强先进制造业。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 26, Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong inspected advanced manufacturing firms in Xiangzhou District, urging the city to pursue smarter, greener and more integrated manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 市十六届人大常委会第三十四次会议召开
articles.title_en: 34th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 16th Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Held
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日上午，福州市十六届人大常委会第三十四次会议召开，审议船政文化遗存保护条例、国有资产管理、预算调整和任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 26, Fuzhou's 16th Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 34th meeting on cultural heritage protection, state assets, budget adjustment and appointments.

articles.title_zh: 福州人力资源服务业与制造业融合发展观察
articles.title_en: Fuzhou's Integration of Human Resources Services and Manufacturing Takes Shape Under National Pilot
articles.summary_zh: 去年11月，福州入选人社部“两业融合”试点城市。此后，该市推动人力资源机构嵌入制造业产业链，并配套园区补贴、引才奖励等激励措施。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou, selected last November as a national pilot for integrating human resources services with manufacturing, is embedding recruitment agencies in industrial chains and backing them with park subsidies and talent-referral rewards.

articles.title_zh: 福州市船政文化遗存保护条例获通过
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Regulation on Protection of Shipyard Culture Heritage Passed
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，福州市人大常委会会议表决通过《福州市船政文化遗存保护条例》，该条例将上报省人大常委会批准后颁布施行，以助力船政文化史迹申报世界文化遗产。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, the Standing Committee of the Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress passed the Regulation on the Protection of Shipyard Culture Heritage, which will be submitted to the provincial legislature for approval, supporting the site's World Heritage bid.

articles.title_zh: 锚定强国建设目标 铺就高质量发展路径
articles.title_en: Anchoring Strong-Nation Goals, Paving the Path for High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月24日播发“十五五”专项规划观察，梳理制造、科技、民生等领域专项规划，阐释16个“强国”建设目标的落实路径。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published an observation on Oct 24, 2026, reviewing China's 15th Five-Year Plan special plans and the implementation path for 16 'strong nation' goals.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：欢迎更多国家探讨人工智能能力建设合作路径
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Welcomes More Countries to Explore AI Capacity-Building Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上表示，中方欢迎更多国家加入世界人工智能合作组织，共同促进全球人工智能向善普惠发展。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press briefing in Beijing on October 26, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China welcomes more countries to join the World AI Cooperation Organization and to promote inclusive, beneficial global AI development.

articles.title_zh: AI乌镇 科创桐乡｜“乌镇七子”亮相！人工智能产业闭环加速成形
articles.title_en: AI Wuzhen, Innovation Tongxiang: 'Wuzhen Seven' Debut as AI Industry Loop Takes Shape
articles.summary_zh: 浙江桐乡推出尚元智行等七家AI企业组成的“乌镇七子”，覆盖算力、数据、机器人、智驾等环节，人工智能产业闭环加速成形。
articles.summary_en: Tongxiang in Zhejiang unveiled the 'Wuzhen Seven' AI companies, spanning computing, data, robotics and smart driving, as an AI industry loop takes shape.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：1至9月全国规模以上工业企业利润同比增长15.5%
articles.title_en: NBS: China's Industrial Profits Up 15.5% Year-on-Year in First Nine Months
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局10月27日发布数据，1至9月全国规模以上工业企业利润同比增长15.5%，高技术制造业利润增长52.0%，产业结构向新、向优升级。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics said on Oct 27 that profits at China's major industrial firms rose 15.5% year-on-year in the first nine months of 2026, with high-tech manufacturing profits up 52.0% as the industrial mix upgrades.

articles.title_zh: 海南三亚市“区直管社区”行政架构调整，四区新设13个街道
articles.title_en: Hainan's Sanya Adjusts 'District-Directly-Managed Community' Administrative Structure, Establishing 13 New Subdistricts in Four Districts
articles.summary_zh: 海南三亚市调整“区直管社区”行政架构，吉阳、天涯、海棠、崖州四区新设13个街道，街道办事处为区政府派出机关。
articles.summary_en: Sanya in Hainan is adjusting its 'district-directly-managed community' administrative structure, with four districts establishing 13 new subdistricts as district government agencies.

articles.title_zh: 广电总局发布新规：要求有线电视、网络电视实现开机看全屏直播功能
articles.title_en: NRTA Issues New Rules Requiring Cable and IPTV Services to Open With Full-Screen Live TV
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，国家广播电视总局公布《有线广播电视运营服务管理规定》《交互式网络电视运营服务管理暂行规定》，自2026年11月27日起施行，要求开机看全屏直播、不得播放开机广告。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, China's National Radio and Television Administration published new rules effective Nov 27, 2026, requiring cable and IPTV operators to open with full-screen live TV and to ban startup ads.

articles.title_zh: 南京市委书记周红波带领新一届市委常委班子到雨花台接受党性教育
articles.title_en: Nanjing Party Secretary Zhou Hongbo Leads New Municipal Party Standing Committee to Yuhuatai for Party Spirit Education
articles.summary_zh: 10月26日上午，南京市第十六次党代会闭幕次日，市委书记周红波带领新一届市委常委班子到雨花台烈士陵园接受党性教育，并召开第一次市委常委会会议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 26, the day after Nanjing's 16th Party Congress closed, Municipal Party Secretary Zhou Hongbo led the new standing committee to Yuhuatai Martyrs' Cemetery for Party spirit education and held its first meeting.

articles.title_zh: 第一届核聚变能控制大会暨第五届人工智能在磁约束聚变控制应用会议在合肥召开
articles.title_en: First Fusion Energy Control Conference and Fifth Conference on AI Applications in Magnetic Confinement Fusion Control Held in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月27日，第一届核聚变能控制大会暨第五届人工智能在磁约束聚变控制应用会议在合肥召开，聚焦聚变控制技术与产业应用。
articles.summary_en: On October 27, 2026, the first Fusion Energy Control Conference and the fifth Conference on AI Applications in Magnetic Confinement Fusion Control opened in Hefei, focusing on fusion control technology and industrial applications.

articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues Prefecture-Level Guidelines for Regulating Online Trading Platforms

articles.summary_en: Fangchenggang's market supervision bureau in Guangxi issued guidelines for regulating online trading platforms, setting inspection priorities, violation-handling mechanisms and compliance requirements for platform operators and merchants.

articles.title_en: China Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Enhancing Industrial Foundation Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等8部门近日联合印发《产业基础能力提升“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年产业基础薄弱问题明显缓解，并部署7方面22项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and seven other departments jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Foundation Capacity, aiming to ease weak links by 2030 through 22 tasks in seven areas.

articles.title_zh: 河北省深入实施固体废物综合治理行动
articles.title_en: Hebei Deepens Comprehensive Solid Waste Governance Action

articles.summary_en: In June 2026, an NPC Standing Committee inspection team visited Hainan to check enforcement of the Hainan Free Trade Port Law, affirming progress in closed-operation policies while flagging gaps in supporting regulations and talent support.

articles.title_en: Qinghai Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Team Conducts Special Research on Administrative Procuratorial Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日至21日，青海省人大常委会调研组赴省人民检察院及西宁、海北、海东等地专题调研行政检察工作，并召开座谈会听取汇报和意见建议。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 19 to 21, a research team from the Qinghai Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee visited the provincial procuratorate and sites in Xining, Haibei and Haidong to study administrative procuratorial work, holding a seminar to hear reports and suggestions.

articles.summary_en: On October 23, Sichuan released a three-year action plan for market-based reform of data elements, aiming by end-2028 to build at least 200 high-quality industry datasets, 400 benchmark application scenarios and over 500 data enterprises.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 26, 2026, Chengdu's housing, planning and financial regulators jointly issued rules requiring commercial housing presales only after structural topping-out and steadily expanding ready-built home sales.

articles.title_en: Shandong Unveils New Policy Package With Six Measures, Nearly 1 Billion Yuan to Strengthen 'Shandong Services'
articles.summary_zh: 山东省印发2026年第二批稳中求进政策清单，围绕服务业扩能提质推出6条措施，统筹近10亿元资金支持，10月23日省政府政策吹风会介绍相关安排。
articles.summary_en: Shandong issued the second batch of its 2026 pro-growth policy list, with six measures and nearly 1 billion yuan in funding to upgrade the service sector, detailed at an Oct 23 briefing.

articles.title_zh: 山东法院持续推动立案诉服工作高质量发展
articles.title_en: Shandong Courts Continue to Advance High-Quality Case Filing and Litigation Services
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山东省高级人民法院举办新闻发布会，通报全省法院立案诉服工作情况：今年1—9月收案218.79万件，立案满意度升至91.8%，并推介「礼润齐鲁」立案诉服品牌。
articles.summary_en: Shandong High People's Court held a press conference on case-filing and litigation services, reporting 2.19 million cases filed in Jan-Sep and satisfaction rising to 91.8%, and launching the 'Lirun Qilu' service brand.

articles.title_en: International Alliance for CO2 Fixation and Biotransformation Established
articles.summary_zh: 第二届二氧化碳固定和生物转化国际会议近日在天津举办，会上二氧化碳固定和生物转化国际联盟正式成立，由9个国家的专家和5家机构共同发起。
articles.summary_en: The Second International Conference on CO2 Fixation and Biotransformation was held in Tianjin, where an international alliance was formally launched by experts from nine countries and five institutions.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度云南省居民收支平稳增长
articles.title_en: Yunnan Residents' Income and Spending Grow Steadily in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局云南调查总队发布数据，前三季度云南居民人均可支配收入23738元，同比增长5.3%，人均消费支出17715元，增长2.8%。
articles.summary_en: Data from the NBS Yunnan Survey Office show Yunnan's per capita disposable income reached 23,738 yuan in the first three quarters, up 5.3% year on year, while per capita consumer spending rose 2.8% to 17,715 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 《综合交通枢纽发展"十五五"规划》印发
articles.title_en: China Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Integrated Transport Hub Development
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部等八部门近日联合印发《综合交通枢纽发展"十五五"规划》，提出到2030年打造若干全国性综合交通枢纽集群，并加快建设京津冀、长三角、粤港澳大湾区、成渝四大国际性枢纽集群。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Transport and seven other departments jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Integrated Transport Hub Development, aiming by 2030 to build several national-level transport hub clusters and accelerate four international hub clusters in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Greater Bay Area and Chengdu-Chongqing regions.

articles.title_zh: 浙江：数字经济挑大梁 人工智能锻筋骨
articles.title_en: Zhejiang: Digital Economy Takes the Lead, AI Builds the Backbone
articles.summary_zh: 2026年前三季度，浙江数字经济核心产业增加值突破万亿元，同比增长12.1%；浙江正深入实施“人工智能+”行动，打造人工智能产业高地。
articles.summary_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, the added value of Zhejiang's digital economy core industries surpassed 1 trillion yuan, up 12.1% year on year, as the province advances its 'AI Plus' drive to build an AI industry hub.

articles.title_zh: 国际人士高度关注中共二十届五中全会 聚焦全面从严治党
articles.title_en: International Figures Focus on CPC's Fifth Plenary Session and Full Strict Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 俄罗斯、阿塞拜疆、巴西、匈牙利、坦桑尼亚等国学者和前政要就中共二十届五中全会聚焦全面从严治党发表看法，认为自我革命有助于中共保持先进性、走在时代前列。
articles.summary_en: Scholars and a former premier from Russia, Azerbaijan, Brazil, Hungary and Tanzania commented on the CPC's Fifth Plenary Session, saying strict party governance keeps the CPC ahead of the times.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向日本前首相福田康夫遗属致唁电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Condolence Message to Family of Former Japanese PM Yasuo Fukuda
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，国家主席习近平向日本前首相福田康夫遗属致唁电，对福田康夫逝世表示哀悼，并希望日本当政者恪守中日四个政治文件。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, President Xi Jinping sent a condolence message to the family of former Japanese prime minister Yasuo Fukuda, mourning his passing and urging Japan's leaders to uphold the four political documents between the two countries.

articles.title_zh: 我国风光累计装机容量突破20亿千瓦
articles.title_en: China's Cumulative Wind and Solar Power Capacity Exceeds 2 Billion Kilowatts
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局10月26日宣布，截至2026年9月底，我国风电和太阳能发电累计装机容量达20.1亿千瓦，新能源主体地位进一步巩固。
articles.summary_en: The National Energy Administration announced on Oct 26 that China's cumulative wind and solar power installed capacity reached 2.01 billion kilowatts by the end of September 2026, further consolidating new energy's dominant role.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺卢拉当选连任巴西总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Lula on Re-election as Brazilian President
articles.summary_zh: 10月27日，国家主席习近平致电卢拉，祝贺他当选连任巴西总统，表示愿共同推动中巴命运共同体建设；同日，国家副主席韩正致电祝贺阿尔克明连任副总统。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 27, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva congratulating him on his re-election as Brazil's president, pledging to advance the China-Brazil community with a shared future; the same day, Vice President Han Zheng congratulated Geraldo Alckmin on his re-election.

articles.title_zh: 美媒：美军已准备好再次大规模打击伊朗
articles.title_en: US Media: US Military Ready for Another Large-Scale Strike on Iran
articles.summary_zh: 据美国媒体10月26日报道，美军已准备好对伊朗发动新一轮大规模打击，特朗普可能在11月美国中期选举后下令，打击目标或包括伊朗能源基础设施与核设施。
articles.summary_en: US media reported on Oct 26 that the US military is ready for a new large-scale strike on Iran; Trump may order it after the November midterms, with energy and nuclear sites among possible targets.

articles.title_zh: 2026年前三季度国内居民出游人次53.07亿
articles.title_en: China Records 5.307 Billion Domestic Tourist Trips in First Three Quarters of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 文化和旅游部10月26日发布数据，2026年前三季度国内居民出游53.07亿人次，同比增长6.2%，出游总花费4.95万亿元，同比增长2.2%。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Culture and Tourism released data on October 26 showing 5.307 billion domestic tourist trips in the first three quarters of 2026, up 6.2% year on year, with total spending of 4.95 trillion yuan, up 2.2%.

articles.title_zh: 以永远在路上的坚韧和执着推进全面从严治党
articles.title_en: Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance with Unyielding Perseverance

articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a commentary on Oct 26 as the 20th CPC Central Committee's Fourth Plenary Session opened in Beijing, saying the meeting will map out plans for sustained, full and rigorous Party governance.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 25-26, the Publicity Department of the Henan Provincial Party Committee held expanded and special meetings to convey and study the spirit of the 12th Provincial Party Congress and arrange implementation work, chaired by department head Yang Xiaojing.

articles.summary_en: A China News Service feature recounts Xi Jinping's remark that 'we cannot eat the people's apples even now,' stressing Party discipline and the people's interests as the fifth plenum opens in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 埃及前副外长：单极体系走向衰落，世界需要多边主义
articles.title_en: Former Egyptian Deputy Foreign Minister: Unipolar System Is Declining, the World Needs Multilateralism
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月24日，埃及前副外长阿里·希夫尼在雄安举行的2026全球治理论坛上表示，单极体系正走向衰落，世界需要让多边主义充分发挥作用。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Global Governance Forum in Xiongan on Oct 24, 2026, former Egyptian deputy foreign minister Ali El-Hefny said the unipolar system is declining and the world must give multilateralism a full role to play.

articles.title_zh: 学习周历·纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年特别篇：长征胜利蕴含的制胜之道
articles.title_en: Study Calendar Special Feature on the 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory: The Secrets of Victory Behind the Long March
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平总书记出席并发表重要讲话；《学习周历》推出特别篇，与读者一同学习讲话精神。
articles.summary_en: On October 22, a grand gathering marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech; the Study Calendar released a special feature on the speech's key points.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁履新福建省政府党组书记后主持召开会议：实干实干再实干、落实落实再落实、发展发展再发展
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Chairs Fujian Provincial Government Meetings After Taking Office as Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，新任福建省政府党组书记郭宁宁主持召开省政府党组会议和常务会议，部署巡视整改、全面从严治党、安全生产和经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Guo Ningning, new Party secretary of the Fujian Provincial Government, chaired party group and executive meetings on inspection rectification, discipline, safety and economic work.

articles.title_zh: 河南省委书记周祖翼带领新一届省委常委班子到信阳参加党性教育活动
articles.title_en: Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi Leads New Provincial Standing Committee to Xinyang for Party Spirit Education
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日上午，河南省委书记周祖翼率新一届省委常委班子赴信阳罗山县何家冲开展党性教育活动，并主持召开省委常委会会议研究加强自身建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi led the newly elected Provincial Standing Committee to Hejiachong in Xinyang's Luoshan County for Party spirit education, then chaired a Standing Committee meeting on strengthening the committee's own development.

articles.title_zh: 新任福州市委书记秦海翔：倍觉光荣，倍加珍惜，倍感重任在肩
articles.title_en: New Fuzhou Party Secretary Qin Haixiang: Honored, Cherished and Deeply Conscious of Responsibility
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，福州市召开全市领导干部会议，宣布秦海翔任福州市委书记，郭宁宁不再担任，福建省委书记赵龙出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Fuzhou held a city leadership meeting announcing Qin Haixiang as the new Fuzhou Party secretary, replacing Guo Ningning; Fujian Party secretary Zhao Long attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省实施先进制造业集群培育壮大工程
articles.title_en: Anhui Launches Advanced Manufacturing Cluster Cultivation Program
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省第十二次党代会新闻发布会披露，未来五年安徽将实施先进制造业集群培育壮大工程，培育4个以上万亿级集群和20个以上千亿级产业链。
articles.summary_en: Anhui will implement an advanced manufacturing cluster program over the next five years, aiming to build more than four trillion-yuan clusters and over 20 hundred-billion-yuan industrial chains, provincial officials said.

articles.title_zh: 从屏幕走进真实场景：一场大会照见通用人工智能新未来
articles.title_en: From Screens to Real Scenarios: Conference Charts the Future of General AI
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日至23日，通用人工智能大会在重庆举行，重庆通用人工智能研究院发布明镜平台，并联合14家企业启动合作，推动通用人工智能走进城市治理等真实场景。
articles.summary_en: The General Artificial Intelligence Conference was held in Chongqing on Oct 21-23, where the Chongqing AGI Research Institute unveiled its Mingjing platform and launched partnerships with 14 AI firms to bring AGI into real-world scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 《国家信息化“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: China Issues National Informatization Plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 中央网络安全和信息化委员会近日印发《国家信息化“十五五”规划》，部署“十五五”时期信息化发展，提出到2030年信息化取得重大进展。
articles.summary_en: The Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission has issued the National Informatization Plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, setting goals for 2030 including full construction of next-generation communications networks and the timely launch of 6G commercial services.

articles.title_zh: 江西省启动2026年中晚稻最低收购价执行预案
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Launches 2026 Minimum Purchase Price Plan for Mid-Late Rice
articles.summary_zh: 自10月20日起，江西省在符合条件的地区启动中晚籼稻最低收购价执行预案，三等稻每50公斤129元，首批5个收储库点已开仓收购。
articles.summary_en: Starting Oct 20, Jiangxi began implementing the minimum purchase price plan for mid-late indica rice in eligible areas at 129 yuan per 50 kg for third-grade grain, with the first five collection depots now open.

articles.title_zh: 顶住压力 向新而行：数读江西经济三季报
articles.title_en: Withstanding Pressure, Moving Toward the New: Jiangxi's Q3 Economic Report in Numbers
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，江西发布2026年前三季度经济运行数据：全省GDP同比增长3.5%，规模以上工业增加值增长3.1%，进出口总值增长19.4%。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Jiangxi released its Q3 2026 economic data: provincial GDP grew 3.5% year on year, above-scale industrial value-added rose 3.1%, and total goods trade jumped 19.4%.

articles.title_zh: 包钢到呼和浩特盛乐国际机场调研转场准备工作
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Inspects Transfer Preparations at Hohhot Shengle International Airport
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢到呼和浩特盛乐国际机场调研转场准备工作，并召开会议听取汇报。
articles.summary_en: On October 24, Inner Mongolia Chairman Bao Gang inspected transfer preparations at Hohhot Shengle International Airport and chaired a meeting on the work.

articles.title_zh: 《内蒙古自治区“十五五”水安全保障规划》印发
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Water Security
articles.summary_zh: 近日，内蒙古自治区水利厅印发《内蒙古自治区“十五五”水安全保障规划》，明确到2030年现代化水网建设全面提速、水安全保障能力全面提升。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia's water resources department has issued its water security plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, aiming to accelerate modern water network construction and fully upgrade water security capacity by 2030.

articles.title_zh: “一国两制”学术研讨会在深圳召开
articles.title_en: Academic Symposium on "One Country, Two Systems" Held in Shenzhen
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，中国社会科学院主办的“一国两制”学术研讨会在深圳召开，近100位嘉宾学者聚焦港澳五年规划与融入国家发展大局。
articles.summary_en: On October 24, an academic symposium on "One Country, Two Systems" hosted by the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences opened in Shenzhen, with nearly 100 guests and scholars focusing on Hong Kong and Macao's five-year plans and their integration into national development.

articles.title_zh: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年主题音像出版物公开发行
articles.title_en: Audio-Visual Works Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory Released at Home and Abroad
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日起，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年主题音像出版物面向海内外公开发行，包括电视剧《伟大的长征》、晚会《长征颂歌》和两部纪录片。
articles.summary_en: Starting Oct 24, audio-visual works marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory were released at home and abroad, including the TV drama "The Great Long March," a gala and two documentaries.

articles.title_zh: 青海省政府召开党组会议 诸葛宇杰主持
articles.title_en: Qinghai Provincial Government Holds Party Leadership Group Meeting Chaired by Zhuge Yujie
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，青海省委副书记、省政府党组书记诸葛宇杰主持召开省政府党组会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，部署四季度经济、生态、民生与安全稳定等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Zhuge Yujie, deputy party secretary of Qinghai and party secretary of the provincial government, chaired a party leadership group meeting to convey Xi Jinping's recent instructions and set priorities for the fourth quarter in the economy, environment, livelihoods and stability.

articles.title_zh: 青海“十五五”水安全保障专场发布会举办
articles.title_en: Qinghai Holds Special Press Conference on Water Security for the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，青海省举办“十五五”水安全保障专场新闻发布会，介绍已印发的《青海省水安全保障“十五五”规划》，部署五方面20项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Qinghai held a special press conference on water security for the 15th Five-Year Plan, outlining the newly issued provincial plan with 20 key tasks in five areas.

articles.title_zh: 四川启动实施新一轮育种攻关计划
articles.title_en: Sichuan Launches New Round of Breeding Research Program
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，四川省“十五五”农作物及畜禽育种攻关计划启动会在成都召开，拟投入3亿元实施23个项目。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Sichuan launched its 15th Five-Year Plan crop and livestock breeding research program in Chengdu, with 300 million yuan for 23 projects.

articles.title_zh: 20亿元生物医药基金在蓉启动
articles.title_en: 2 Billion Yuan Biopharma Fund Launched in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，由川创投与上实资本共同推进、目标规模20亿元的四川振兴合创生物医药基金在成都启动，重点投向生物制品整合与前沿技术转化。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the Sichuan Zhenxing Hechuang biopharma fund, with a target size of 2 billion yuan and jointly promoted by Chuangtou Capital and SIIC Capital, launched in Chengdu, focusing on biologics consolidation and frontier tech translation.

articles.summary_en: The Central Cyberspace Affairs Commission has issued China's National Informatization Plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, setting goals through 2030, including launching commercial 6G services in due course.

articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，云南省召开领导干部会议，中央决定莫高义任云南省委书记，刘奇凡任省委副书记，王宁、王予波不再担任原职。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Yunnan held a provincial leadership meeting where the central authorities announced Mo Gaoyi as Yunnan Party secretary and Liu Qifan as deputy secretary, replacing Wang Ning and Wang Yubo.

articles.title_zh: 商务部回应美发布新版对外投资限制拟议规则
articles.title_en: MOFCOM Responds to US Proposed New Outbound Investment Restrictions
articles.summary_zh: 商务部发言人回应美方发布新版对外投资限制拟议规则，指出限制对华投资也会损害美国企业自身利益，敦促美方停止将经贸问题政治化、武器化。
articles.summary_en: A MOFCOM spokesperson responded to the US's new proposed outbound investment restrictions, saying such limits harm US firms' own interests and urging Washington to stop politicizing trade issues.

articles.title_zh: 日本拟就修订“安保三文件”采取差异化宣传引担忧
articles.title_en: Japan Plans Differentiated Publicity Campaign for Revision of Three Security Documents, Raising Concerns
articles.summary_zh: 据共同社10月24日报道，日本政府拟从10月底起针对不同年龄群体加强安保政策宣传，为年内修订“安保三文件”营造舆论，此举在日本国内引发担忧。
articles.summary_en: Japan's government plans to step up security-policy publicity targeting different age groups from late October to build support for revising its three key security documents within the year, a move that has raised concerns in Japan, Kyodo News reported on Oct 24.

articles.title_zh: 共答时代之问 共创美好未来——习近平向2026全球治理论坛（雄安）致信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter to 2026 Global Governance Forum in Xiong'an
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，国家主席习近平向2026全球治理论坛（雄安）致信，呼吁践行共商共建共享的全球治理观，推动落实全球治理倡议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, President Xi Jinping sent a letter to the 2026 Global Governance Forum in Xiong'an, urging joint efforts to uphold the global governance vision of extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits and to advance the Global Governance Initiative.

articles.summary_en: A national meeting on implementing the cultural and tourism 15th Five-Year Plan was held in Zhengzhou from Oct 21 to 23, addressed by Vice Minister of Culture and Tourism Wang Jianhua and Henan Vice Governor Song Zhenghui.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 24, Henan Province held a symposium in Xinyang marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, with Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuji attending and delivering a speech.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Henan Acting Governor Wang Lujin chaired a provincial government executive meeting on high-quality development, 15th Five-Year Plan drafting and agricultural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼带领新一届省委常委班子到信阳市参加党性教育活动并主持召开省委常委会会议

articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi led the new provincial Standing Committee to Hejiachong in Xinyang's Luoshan County for Party spirit education and to renew their oath, then chaired a Standing Committee meeting on strengthening the body's own building.

articles.title_zh: 河南省三苏文化研究会成立
articles.title_en: Henan Sansu Culture Research Association Founded in Pingdingshan

articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, the Henan Sansu Culture Research Association was founded in Pingdingshan, creating a provincial platform to study and promote Sansu culture, family tradition and cultural tourism integration.

articles.summary_en: Mao Wanchun, chairman of the Hunan Provincial CPPCC, led a team to PetroChina Natural Gas Sales Hunan Company to inspect energy supply security and green low-carbon transition efforts.

articles.title_en: Study Notes: Being the First Person Responsible for One's Own Health
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上强调引导全社会树立正确健康观、进行有效的健康自塑和管理。文章梳理其关于“每个人是自己健康第一责任人”的系列论述及健康中国建设进展。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping stressed at the National Health Conference that society should adopt a correct view of health and pursue effective health self-management. The article reviews his remarks on "everyone is the first person responsible for their own health" and progress toward a Healthy China.

articles.title_zh: 2026全球治理论坛（雄安）为改革完善全球治理汇智聚力
articles.title_en: 2026 Global Governance Forum in Xiong'an Pools Wisdom to Reform and Improve Global Governance
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日至25日，中国人民外交学会主办的2026全球治理论坛在河北雄安新区举行，近400名中外嘉宾围绕改革完善全球治理研讨，中方宣布八项务实行动。
articles.summary_en: Nearly 400 Chinese and foreign guests gathered at the 2026 Global Governance Forum, hosted by the Chinese People's Institute of Foreign Affairs in Xiong'an, Hebei, from Oct 23-25, where China announced eight practical actions to advance the Global Governance Initiative.

articles.title_zh: 重点突破 多个“首部”“首次”布局发展新方向——“十五五”专项规划观察之四
articles.title_en: Breakthroughs in Key Areas: Multiple 'First-Ever' Plans Chart New Development Directions — Observations on the 15th Five-Year Plan Special Plans (Part 4)
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月25日发文梳理“十五五”系列国家级专项规划，指出多个“首部”“首次”规划聚焦高质量发展、民生保障与前沿产业布局。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua on Oct 25 reviewed China's 15th Five-Year Plan special plans, noting many first-ever national plans targeting high-quality development, livelihoods and frontier industries.

articles.title_zh: 二十届中央第七轮巡视完成反馈
articles.title_en: Feedback Completed for the 7th Round of Inspections by the 20th CPC Central Committee
articles.summary_zh: 据新华社10月25日报道，二十届中央第七轮巡视反馈工作近日完成，中央巡视工作领导小组召开集中反馈会议作出整改部署，15个中央巡视组向36家中央和国家机关单位一对一反馈。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Oct 25 that feedback for the 7th round of inspections by the 20th CPC Central Committee has been completed, with a central meeting on rectification and 15 teams delivering one-on-one feedback to 36 central Party and state institutions.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区党委十一届一次全会举行 陈小江任自治区党委书记
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Party Committee Holds First Plenary Session of 11th Term; Chen Xiaojiang Elected Regional Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月23日，中共新疆维吾尔自治区第十一届委员会第一次全体会议在乌鲁木齐举行，选举陈小江为自治区党委书记，并批准了自治区纪委领导班子人选。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, 2026, the first plenary session of the 11th Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region Party Committee was held in Urumqi, electing Chen Xiaojiang as regional Party secretary and approving the new leadership of the regional discipline inspection commission.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江主持召开新一届自治区党委常委会第一次会议并率班子参观红军师师史馆
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Chairs First Meeting of New Xinjiang Regional Party Standing Committee and Leads Delegation to Visit Red Army Division History Museum
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，新疆自治区党委书记陈小江主持召开十一届自治区党委常委会第一次会议，研究班子建设；会后率班子参观红军师师史馆并重温入党誓词。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 24, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang chaired the first meeting of the 11th regional Party Standing Committee on building the new leadership team, and afterwards led members to visit a Red Army division history museum and renew their Party oath.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党新疆维吾尔自治区第十一次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 11th CPC Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，中国共产党新疆维吾尔自治区第十一次代表大会在新疆人民会堂闭幕，选举产生新一届自治区党委和纪委，陈小江主持大会并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The 11th CPC Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Congress closed on Oct 23, electing a new regional Party committee and discipline inspection commission; Chen Xiaojiang presided and addressed the session.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江当选新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记并在自治区党委十一届一次全会上讲话
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Elected Xinjiang Party Secretary, Addresses First Plenary Session of 11th Regional Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日下午，中国共产党新疆维吾尔自治区第十一届委员会第一次全体会议在乌鲁木齐举行，陈小江当选自治区党委书记并讲话，部署稳定、发展、党建等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 23, the first plenary session of the 11th Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Regional Party Committee was held in Urumqi, where Chen Xiaojiang was elected regional party secretary and delivered a speech on stability, development and party building.

articles.title_zh: 云南大学与孟加拉国南北大学启动民族学联培项目
articles.title_en: Yunnan University and North South University of Bangladesh Launch Joint Ethnology Program
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，第二届中国-南亚文明互鉴国际学术研讨会在云南大学开幕，两校签署民族学专业本科生联合培养协议并启动“2+1+1”项目。
articles.summary_en: The second China-South Asia Civilization Dialogue International Academic Conference opened at Yunnan University on Oct 24, where Yunnan University and Bangladesh's North South University signed an agreement on joint undergraduate training in ethnology, launching a "2+1+1" program.

articles.title_zh: 中国商务部回应美发布新版对外投资限制拟议规则
articles.title_en: China's Commerce Ministry Responds to U.S. New Proposed Outbound Investment Restrictions
articles.summary_zh: 中国商务部就美方发布新版对外投资限制拟议规则作出回应，指美方限制对华投资损害中美经贸合作与美企自身利益，敦促美方停止将经贸问题政治化。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce responded to the U.S. release of new proposed outbound investment restrictions, saying the curbs harm bilateral trade ties and U.S. firms' own interests, and urged Washington to stop politicizing economic issues.

articles.title_zh: 唐登杰当选中共山西省委书记
articles.title_en: Tang Dengjie Elected Secretary of the Shanxi Provincial Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，中共山西省第十三届委员会第一次全体会议选举唐登杰为省委书记，卢东亮、李金科为省委副书记。
articles.summary_en: On October 24, the first plenary session of the 13th Shanxi Provincial Party Committee elected Tang Dengjie as its secretary, with Lu Dongliang and Li Jinke as deputy secretaries.

articles.title_zh: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会重要讲话在江苏干部群众中引发热烈反响
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at Rally Marking 90th Anniversary of Long March Victory Resonates Across Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会举行，习近平总书记发表重要讲话，江苏全省干部群众第一时间学习领会、反响热烈。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the rally marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March's victory; officials and residents across Jiangsu studied it and responded with enthusiasm.

articles.title_zh: 永葆赶考清醒 赢得历史主动——以习近平同志为核心的党中央引领新时代全面从严治党纪实
articles.title_en: Staying Clear-Headed on the Long March: Xi Jinping and the CPC Central Committee Lead Full and Rigorous Party Governance in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月24日播发纪实报道，回顾党的十八大以来以习近平同志为核心的党中央推进全面从严治党和反腐败斗争的历程与成效。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua on Oct 24 published a feature reviewing how the CPC Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core has advanced full and rigorous party governance and anti-corruption since 2012.

articles.title_zh: 各方贯彻落实习近平总书记重要指示全力开展西藏巴青县地震救援工作
articles.title_en: All Parties Implement Xi Jinping's Important Instructions and Fully Carry Out Earthquake Rescue Work in Baqing County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日22时33分许，西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，造成16人遇难、76人受伤。习近平总书记作出重要指示，各方力量迅速集结开展搜救、救治和群众安置工作。
articles.summary_en: A magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu, Tibet at about 22:33 on Oct 22, killing 16 and injuring 76. Following Xi Jinping's instructions, rescue forces mobilized for search, medical treatment and resettlement.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 研究统筹人口与经济社会发展有关工作
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Coordinating Population and Economic-Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，研究统筹人口与经济社会发展有关工作，并听取推进全国服务业大会部署落实情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On October 23, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing to study coordinating population with economic and social development, and to hear a report on implementing the national services industry conference's arrangements.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委常委会召开会议 顾坤主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Chaired by Gu Kun
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，淮安市委常委会召开会议，市委书记顾坤主持并讲话，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示重要贺信精神，并研究卫生健康、平安建设、民生实事、群众身边不正之风和腐败问题整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the Standing Committee of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee met, chaired by Party Secretary Gu Kun, to study recent remarks and directives by Xi Jinping and to advance work on health, public security, livelihood projects and corruption rectification.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委财经委会议暨经济运行工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Holds Finance and Economic Committee Meeting on Economic Operations
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，淮安市委书记顾坤主持召开市委财经委会议暨经济运行工作推进会，分析前三季度经济运行情况，安排四季度及下一阶段重点工作任务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun chaired a meeting of the municipal finance and economic committee to review economic performance in the first three quarters and set key tasks for the fourth quarter.

articles.title_zh: 王祺扬调研爱国卫生运动开展情况
articles.title_en: Wang Qiyang Inspects Patriotic Health Campaign in Sanya
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，三亚市委书记王祺扬深入在建项目工地调研爱国卫生运动开展情况，要求强化蚊媒防控、开展孳生地清理和健康科普宣教。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Sanya Party Secretary Wang Qiyang inspected construction sites to review the patriotic health campaign, urging stronger mosquito control, breeding-ground cleanups and public health education.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市2026年“军事日”暨军分区党委第一书记现场办公活动举行
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds 2026 Military Day and On-Site Office Meeting of the Military Sub-district Party Committee First Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，泰州市2026年“军事日”暨军分区党委第一书记现场办公活动在泰州市民兵训练基地举行，市委书记姜冬冬出席并现场办公。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Taizhou held its 2026 Military Day and an on-site office meeting of the Military Sub-district Party Committee first secretary at the city's militia training base, with Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong attending.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会召开第七十一次主任会议
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 71st Directors' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，芜湖市人大常委会召开第七十一次主任会议，主任张峰主持，听取市政府金融工作与文物保护工作报告并讨论多项审议意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 71st directors' meeting, chaired by Zhang Feng, reviewing government reports on financial work and cultural relic protection and adopting several review opinions.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会召开会议 研究平安西安建设和四季度稳增长等工作 蒿慧杰主持
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Safe Xi'an, Q4 Growth
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，西安市委常委会召开会议，市委书记蒿慧杰主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示精神，研究部署平安西安建设及四季度稳增长工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met, chaired by Party Secretary Hao Huijie, to study recent directives from Xi Jinping and to plan Safe Xi'an construction and fourth-quarter growth work.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在市信访局接待信访群众时强调 带着感情和责任做细做实信访工作 依法依规用心用情解决好群众合理诉求
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Receives Petitioners at Xi'an Letters and Visits Bureau, Urging Careful, Lawful Resolution of Public Grievances
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰在市信访局接待来访群众，现场协调解决莲湖区某小区不动产登记难等问题，要求跟踪督办、依法依规解决群众合理诉求。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie received petitioners at the city's letters and visits bureau, coordinating on-site solutions to property registration and other grievances in Lianhu District and urging follow-through on lawful, timely resolutions.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委理论学习中心组召开学习会 深入学习《习近平文化文选》 信长星主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Study Group Holds Session on Xi Jinping's Cultural Thought, Chaired by Xin Changxing
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，江苏省委理论学习中心组召开学习会，省委书记信长星主持并讲话，深入学习《习近平文化文选》第一卷、第二卷，部署高标准推进文化强省建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Jiangsu's provincial Party committee study group held a session chaired by Party Secretary Xin Changxing to study Xi Jinping's cultural thought and push forward building Jiangsu into a strong cultural province.

articles.title_zh: 全市国有资产深化盘活暨监督体系建设推进会召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Meeting on Deepening State-Owned Asset Revitalization and Building a Supervision System
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，盐城市在东台召开全市国有资产深化盘活暨监督体系建设推进会，市委书记严汉平出席并讲话，部署存量资产盘活、国资监督等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Yancheng held a meeting in Dongtai on revitalizing state-owned assets and building a supervision system; Party Secretary Yan Hanping spoke and set out tasks for asset revitalization and oversight.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上的重要讲话在江苏干部群众中引发热烈反响
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory Resonates Among Officials and Residents in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，习近平总书记在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上发表重要讲话，江苏全省干部群众第一时间学习领会，表示将弘扬长征精神、走好新时代长征路。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory; officials and residents in Jiangsu studied it and pledged to carry forward the Long March spirit.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市九届人大常委会第四十二次会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 42nd Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，盐城市九届人大常委会第四十二次会议召开，王荣主持，表决通过人事任免事项和《盐城市非物质文化遗产保护条例》，并听取审议多项政府工作报告。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the 42nd session of the Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, chaired by Wang Rong, approved personnel appointments and an intangible cultural heritage protection regulation, and reviewed several government reports.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委常委会召开会议学习贯彻习近平总书记在纪念红军长征胜利90周年大会上的重要讲话精神 信长星主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Speech at the 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory; Xin Changxing Presides
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，江苏省委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记在纪念红军长征胜利90周年大会上的重要讲话精神，省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee met to study and implement Xi Jinping's speech at the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory; Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市十五届人大常委会召开第五十一次会议
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 51st Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，湛江市十五届人大常委会召开第五十一次会议，初审台风防御条例草案，听取农业、养老、国有资产等报告并表决人事事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Zhanjiang's 15th Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 51st meeting, giving first reading to a typhoon defense regulation and hearing reports on agriculture, elderly care and state assets.

articles.title_zh: 2026粤港澳大湾区服务贸易大会珠海活动启动
articles.title_en: Zhuhai Events at 2026 Greater Bay Area Services Trade Conference Kick Off
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，2026粤港澳大湾区服务贸易大会珠海活动在珠海规划展览馆启动，市长吴泽桐出席并致辞，现场举行重点项目集中签约。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the Zhuhai program of the 2026 Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Services Trade Conference opened at the Zhuhai Planning Exhibition Hall, with Mayor Wu Zetong attending and key projects signed on site.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬伟大长征精神 走好新的长征路
articles.title_en: Carrying Forward the Great Long March Spirit and Taking the New Long March Road
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平发表重要讲话，提出弘扬长征精神、走好新长征路的“五个必须”要求。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, a rally marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered a speech outlining "five musts" for carrying forward the Long March spirit on a new long march.

articles.title_zh: 走好新的长征路，习近平强调志气、骨气、底气
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses Resolve, Integrity and Confidence on the New Long March
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，习近平在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上回顾红军长征历程、阐发长征精神，强调要增强全党全军全国各族人民的志气、骨气、底气。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Xi Jinping reviewed the Red Army's Long March and its spirit at a meeting marking the 90th anniversary of its victory, urging stronger resolve, integrity and confidence across the Party, the military and the nation.

articles.title_zh: 经纬线·让总书记驻足的长征故事：一场会议
articles.title_en: A Long March Story That Drew the General Secretary's Attention: The Zunyi Conference
articles.summary_zh: 2015年6月，习近平在贵州考察时参观遵义会议会址，叮嘱讲解员讲清党的来路；文章回顾遵义会议作为伟大转折的历史意义。
articles.summary_en: In June 2015, Xi Jinping visited the Zunyi Conference site in Guizhou and urged guides to explain how the Party came through the Long March; the article recalls the meeting as a great turning point.

articles.title_zh: 2027国考报名截止，多职位数千人竞争一岗
articles.title_en: Registration Closes for 2027 National Civil Service Exam as Thousands Compete for Single Posts
articles.summary_zh: 10月24日，2027年度国家公务员考试报名截止，共计划招录3.57万人，超300万人通过审核，多个岗位出现数千人竞争一岗。
articles.summary_en: Registration for China's 2027 national civil service exam closed on Oct 24, with 35,700 posts planned and over 3 million applicants passing review; several single posts drew thousands of applicants each.

articles.summary_en: China's State Taxation Administration released the latest invoice data on October 23, showing steady economic performance in the first three quarters and further improvement in industry, new growth drivers and equipment investment in the third quarter.

articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: U.S. Should Follow Market Economy Principles and Stop Interfering in Normal Business Cooperation Between Enterprises

articles.summary_en: On October 23, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning, at a regular press briefing, responded to a U.S. Treasury proposal to add biotechnology to the restricted technology list for outbound investment, saying the U.S. should follow market economy principles and stop interfering in normal business cooperation between enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 中国驻韩国大使馆提醒：请来韩团体游客远离低价团消费陷阱
articles.title_en: Chinese Embassy in South Korea Warns Group Tourists to Avoid Low-Price Tour Traps

articles.summary_en: China's Embassy in South Korea issued a consular reminder urging Chinese group tourists to choose travel agencies carefully and avoid unreasonably low-priced tours after several groups faced forced shopping and were stranded in South Korea.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中方坚定支持联合国在国际事务中发挥核心作用

articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, MFA spokesperson Mao Ning told a regular press briefing that China firmly supports the UN's central role in international affairs and will deepen all-round cooperation with the UN.

articles.summary_en: At a regular press briefing in Beijing on October 23, 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said China will continue to play its role as a responsible major country and deepen all-round cooperation with the United Nations.
