articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Vice Commerce Minister Jiang Chenghua outlined 15th Five-Year Plan measures for high-quality commerce at a State Council Information Office briefing, covering consumption and opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际主持召开十四届全国人大常委会第七十四次委员长会议

articles.summary_en: Zhao Leji chaired the 74th Chairman's Meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee in Beijing on Oct 22, which set the 25th session for Nov 2-6 and a legislative agenda covering finance, state assets and anti-corruption.

articles.title_zh: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在京隆重举行 习近平发表重要讲话

articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, a ceremony marking the 90th anniversary of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March victory was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech.

articles.title_en: Chen Wenqing Meets Russian Supreme Court President Krasnov

articles.title_zh: 习近平对西藏那曲市巴青县7.0级地震作出重要指示

articles.summary_en: A magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu, Tibet, on Oct 22. Xi Jinping issued instructions demanding all-out search and rescue, treatment of the injured and proper resettlement of affected residents; Li Qiang also gave instructions.

articles.title_zh: 出版界推出一批纪念中国工农红军长征胜利九十周年优秀主题图书
articles.title_en: Publishing Industry Releases Outstanding Thematic Books Commemorating the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March

articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on October 22 in Beijing that China's publishing industry has released a batch of thematic books commemorating the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, covering historical archives, academic studies, literature and youth reading materials.

articles.title_zh: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在京隆重举行

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 22, a grand gathering marking the 90th anniversary of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March victory was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech, with Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning and others attending.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 22, Premier Li Qiang returned to Beijing by chartered plane after concluding the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting, accompanied by State Councilor Wu Zhenglong and others.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记在纪念长征胜利90周年大会重要讲话金句

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 22, a meeting marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory was held in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered a speech urging efforts to carry forward the Long March spirit.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Shenyang Party Secretary Huo Bugang inspected the city court and procuratorate, urging a fair and just legal environment to support Shenyang's revitalization.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Standing Committee of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee met to study Xi Jinping's remarks during his inspection of Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, and his Qiushi article, and to set implementation measures. Party Secretary Xu Kunlin chaired the meeting.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Hu Zhaomin joined the Keshiketeng Banner and third municipal delegations to deliberate the Party congress report, urging faster industrial upgrading, better livelihood services and stronger safety safeguards.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 23, the 9th CPC Chifeng Municipal Congress closed at the Chifeng International Convention and Exhibition Center, adopting resolutions on the municipal party committee and discipline inspection commission work reports, with Kang Yongqiang presiding and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对西藏那曲市巴青县7.0级地震作出重要指示 强调全力搜救人员、妥善安置受灾群众 李强作出批示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Magnitude-7.0 Earthquake in Baqing County, Nagqu, Tibet, Stressing All-Out Rescue and Proper Resettlement of Affected Residents; Li Qiang Issues Written Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日22时33分许，西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，造成重大人员伤亡。习近平作出重要指示，要求全力搜救人员、救治伤员、防止次生灾害并保障群众生命财产安全，李强作出批示。
articles.summary_en: A magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu, Tibet at about 22:33 on Oct 22, causing heavy casualties. Xi Jinping ordered all-out rescue, treatment of the injured and prevention of secondary disasters, while Li Qiang issued written instructions.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度我国财政运行总体平稳
articles.title_en: China's Fiscal Operations Remain Generally Stable in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 财政部数据显示，今年前三季度全国一般公共预算收入17.23万亿元，同比增长5.1%，支出21.02万亿元，增长1%，财政运行总体平稳。
articles.summary_en: Ministry of Finance data show China's general public budget revenue reached 17.23 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, up 5.1% year on year, while spending rose 1% to 21.02 trillion yuan, indicating generally stable fiscal operations.

articles.title_zh: 丹东市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和指示批示精神

articles.title_zh: 邓维元主持召开全市2026年三季度经济形势分析会议

articles.title_zh: 怀化市委理论学习中心组（扩大）集体学习在通道转兵纪念馆举行

articles.title_en: Ye Yang Meets Cai Minjun, Director of HKSAR Government's Wuhan Economic and Trade Office

articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Huangshi Acting Mayor Ye Yang met Cai Minjun, director of the HKSAR Government's Wuhan Economic and Trade Office, to discuss deeper trade ties, industrial synergy and two-way investment.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保调研古城保育活化和“潮侨聚故里”主题活动筹备工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects Ancient City Conservation and Preparations for "Overseas Chaoshan Natives Return Home" Event
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保赴榕城区调研古城保育活化和“潮侨聚故里”主题活动筹备工作，要求打磨细节、全力冲刺，以最佳面貌迎接海外侨胞。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 22, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao inspected ancient city conservation and preparations for the "Overseas Chaoshan Natives Return Home" event in Rongcheng District, urging meticulous final preparations to welcome overseas Chinese guests.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议暨七届六十二次主席会议
articles.title_en: Jieyang CPPCC Holds Party Group Meeting and 62nd Chairman's Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，揭阳市政协召开党组会议暨七届六十二次主席会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神和省委政协工作会议精神，并研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Jieyang CPPCC held a Party group meeting and its 62nd chairman's meeting to study Xi Jinping's keynote speech and the provincial Party committee's work conference on CPPCC affairs, and to set out implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 11th Lhasa Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日中午，中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会闭幕，达娃次仁主持并讲话，大会选举产生新一届市委和市纪委，并通过相关决议。
articles.summary_en: The 11th Lhasa Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China closed on the afternoon of Oct 22, chaired by Dawa Tsering, electing a new municipal Party committee and discipline inspection commission and adopting key resolutions.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会闭幕
articles.title_en: 11th Lhasa Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日中午，中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会完成各项议程后在拉萨闭幕，达娃次仁主持闭幕会并讲话。大会于10月20日开幕，强调以政治建设为统领做好首府工作、维护稳定。
articles.summary_en: The 11th Lhasa Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China closed in Lhasa on the afternoon of Oct 22 after completing its agenda, with Dagwa Tsering presiding over and addressing the closing session. The congress opened on Oct 20, stressing political loyalty, stability and the city's role as the regional capital.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党拉萨市第十一届委员会第一次全体会议举行 达娃次仁主持
articles.title_en: First Plenary Session of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Held, Chaired by Dawaciren
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日下午，中国共产党拉萨市第十一届委员会第一次全体会议举行，达娃次仁主持会议，选举产生新一届市委常务委员会委员。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 22, the first plenary session of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Committee of the CPC was held. Chaired by Dawaciren, it elected the new Standing Committee members.

articles.title_zh: 那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，胡昌升第一时间调度部署并连夜赶赴灾区
articles.title_en: Magnitude 7.0 Earthquake Strikes Baqing County in Nagqu; Hu Changsheng Immediately Deploys Response and Rushes to Disaster Area Overnight
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日22时33分，西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震；自治区党委书记胡昌升、自治区主席嘎玛泽登当晚到自治区维稳指挥部调度部署，胡昌升连夜赶赴灾区指挥抗震救灾。
articles.summary_en: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu, Tibet at 22:33 on Oct 22. Regional Party Secretary Hu Changsheng and Governor Garma Cedain directed the response that night, and Hu traveled overnight to the disaster zone to lead rescue work.

articles.title_zh: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在京隆重举行 习近平发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Grand Gathering in Beijing Marks 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory, with an Important Speech by Xi Jinping
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京人民大会堂隆重举行，习近平发表重要讲话，李强等出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, a grand gathering marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升主持那曲市工作汇报会 强调推进长治久安和高质量发展
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Chairs Nagqu City Work Report Meeting, Stresses Long-Term Stability and High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日下午，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在那曲主持召开那曲市工作汇报会，听取两省五企援藏工作汇报，部署社会稳定、高质量发展、民生、生态保护与党建工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 21, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng chaired a work report meeting in Nagqu, hearing reports on aid-Tibet work by two provinces and five central SOEs, and setting tasks on stability, development, livelihoods, ecology and Party building.

articles.title_zh: 王祺扬调研赤田水库流域生态保护补偿工作并出席联席会议
articles.title_en: Wang Qiyang Inspects Ecological Compensation Work in Chitian Reservoir Watershed, Attends Joint Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，海南省委常委、三亚市委书记王祺扬赴保亭调研赤田水库流域生态保护补偿工作，并出席联席会议；会上，两地共同签订生态保护补偿责任书。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Wang Qiyang, Hainan provincial standing committee member and Sanya Party secretary, inspected ecological compensation work in the Chitian Reservoir watershed in Baoting and attended a joint meeting where the two localities signed an ecological compensation responsibility agreement.

articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，海南省委常委、三亚市委书记王祺扬赴保亭调研赤田水库流域生态保护补偿工作并出席联席会议，三亚、保亭两地共同签订生态保护补偿责任书。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Wang Qiyang, Hainan provincial standing committee member and Sanya party secretary, inspected ecological compensation work in the Chitian Reservoir basin in Baoting and attended a joint meeting, where Sanya and Baoting signed an ecological compensation responsibility agreement.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴潮阳区调研化妆品产业
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Cosmetics Industry in Chaoyang District
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴潮阳区调研化妆品产业，走访企业并召开座谈会，部署推动产业高质量发展、打造化妆品出口制造高地。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 21, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected the cosmetics industry in Chaoyang District, visiting companies and holding a symposium to advance high-quality industry development and build a cosmetics export manufacturing hub.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市委常委会召开会议 研究部署“三农”、平安建设、卫生健康等工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Agriculture, Public Security and Health Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，汕头市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署“三农”、平安建设、卫生健康等工作，市委书记庄悦群主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Shantou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's instructions and plan work on rural affairs, public security and health, chaired by Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会会议暨市委财经委员会会议召开 逯峰范德繁曾晓晖林少文出席会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Party Committee and Finance Committee Meet to Plan Fourth-Quarter Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，汕尾市委书记逯峰主持召开市委常委会会议暨市委财经委员会会议，听取三季度经济运行情况汇报，部署冲刺四季度、完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired a joint meeting of the municipal Party Standing Committee and Finance Committee, reviewing third-quarter economic performance and deploying a push to meet full-year targets.

articles.title_zh: “苏慧审·智慧审计平台（2026）”在泰发布
articles.title_en: "Suhuishen Smart Audit Platform (2026)" Launched in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，省市共建的“苏慧审·智慧审计平台（2026）”在泰州发布，市委书记姜冬冬、省审计厅厅长刘军出席活动并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the province-city co-built Suhuishen Smart Audit Platform (2026) was launched in Taizhou, with city Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong and provincial audit chief Liu Jun speaking.

articles.title_zh: “苏慧审·智慧审计平台（2026）”在泰州发布
articles.title_en: Jiangsu's "Su Hui Shen" Smart Audit Platform (2026) Released in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，省市共建的“苏慧审·智慧审计平台（2026）”在泰州发布，市委书记姜冬冬、省审计厅厅长刘军出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the province-city co-built "Su Hui Shen" Smart Audit Platform (2026) was released in Taizhou, with Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong and Jiangsu Audit Office head Liu Jun speaking at the event.

articles.title_zh: 省委召开正省级老领导座谈会 征求对省第十五次党代会报告的意见 信长星主持
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Chairs Seminar with Former Provincial-Level Leaders on Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，江苏省委召开正省级老领导座谈会，征求对省第十五次党代会报告的意见，省委书记信长星主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a seminar with former provincial-level leaders on the 15th Party Congress report, chaired by Secretary Xin Changxing.

articles.title_zh: 通化市政协召开2026年第十次党组会议暨九届三十次主席会议
articles.title_en: Tonghua CPPCC Holds 10th Party Group Meeting and 30th Chairpersons' Meeting of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，通化市政协党组书记、主席庄亚男主持召开市政协2026年第十次党组会议暨九届三十次主席会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，并部署卫生、平安建设、先进制造业、民生保障等方面履职工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Zhuang Yanan, Party group secretary and chair of the Tonghua CPPCC, chaired the city's 10th CPPCC Party group meeting and 30th chairpersons' meeting of 2026, conveying Xi Jinping's speeches and instructions and outlining work plans on public health, safety, advanced manufacturing and livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党安徽省第十二次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 12th CPC Anhui Provincial Congress Concludes Successfully in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日下午，中国共产党安徽省第十二次代表大会在合肥闭幕，李乐成主持大会并讲话，选举产生新一届省委和省纪委。
articles.summary_en: The 12th CPC Anhui Provincial Congress closed in Hefei on the afternoon of Oct 22, with Li Lecheng presiding and speaking; delegates elected the new provincial Party committee and discipline inspection commission.

articles.title_zh: TCL来锡对接深化合作
articles.title_en: TCL Visits Wuxi to Deepen Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，无锡市委书记蒋锋、代市长蔡剑峰与TCL创始人李东生一行会谈，围绕集成电路产业深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Wuxi Party Secretary Jiang Feng and Acting Mayor Cai Jianfeng met TCL founder Li Dongsheng to discuss deepening cooperation in integrated circuits.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在市委专题会议上强调：始终心怀“国之大者”，坚决当好秦岭卫士
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Stresses at Municipal Party Committee Meeting: Safeguard the Qinling Mountains as a Guardian
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰主持召开市委专题会议，听取秦岭生态环境保护情况汇报，研究部署下一步重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie chaired a special municipal Party committee meeting to review Qinling Mountains ecological protection and plan next steps.

articles.title_zh: 张国平调研“三秋”生产、秸秆禁烧和“三资”管理等工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoping Inspects Autumn Harvest, Straw-Burning Ban and Village Collective Asset Management
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，县长张国平赴麦岭镇、姜庄乡实地调研督导秋收生产、秸秆禁烧与生态环境保护、村级“三资”管理及豫意通平台使用等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, County Magistrate Zhang Guoping inspected autumn harvest, straw-burning controls, ecological protection and village collective asset management in Mailing and Jiangzhuang townships.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市政协九届十九次常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal CPPCC Holds 19th Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，盐城市政协九届十九次常委会会议召开，围绕科技创新和产业创新深度融合协商议政，市委书记严汉平到会讲话，市政协主席羊维达主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Yancheng Municipal CPPCC held its 19th standing committee meeting on deepening the integration of sci-tech and industrial innovation, with Party Secretary Yan Hanping speaking and Chairman Yang Weida presiding.

articles.title_zh: 省委召开正省级老领导座谈会 征求对省第十五次党代会报告的意见 信长星主持
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Presides Over Forum with Former Provincial-Level Leaders on Report to 15th Jiangsu Provincial Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，江苏省委召开正省级老领导座谈会，就省第十五次党代会报告征求意见，省委书记信长星主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a forum with former provincial-level leaders to seek opinions on the report to the 15th Provincial Party Congress, chaired by Xin Changxing.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省部署台风“蔷琵”防御工作
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Deploys Defense Work Against Typhoon Champi
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，江苏省召开防御台风“蔷琵”视频调度会，省委常委、常务副省长张文兵主持并讲话，要求落实监测预警、隐患排查、应急处置等各项防御措施。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Jiangsu held a video meeting on Typhoon Champi response; Executive Vice Governor Zhang Wenbing urged full implementation of monitoring, hazard checks and emergency response measures.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平会见法国驻上海总领事荣怡霞
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Meets French Consul General in Shanghai Rong Yixia
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平在射阳会见法国驻上海总领事荣怡霞，双方就深化现代农业、绿色能源等领域合作及支持法企在盐发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping met French Consul General in Shanghai Rong Yixia in Sheyang to discuss cooperation in agriculture, green energy and support for French firms.

articles.title_zh: 江苏徐州农商银行揭牌开业 刘小涛出席
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Xuzhou Rural Commercial Bank Opens, Governor Liu Xiaotao Attends
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，江苏徐州农商银行揭牌开业暨授信签约活动在南京举行，省长刘小涛出席并揭牌，江苏农商联合银行与徐州市签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Jiangsu Xuzhou Rural Commercial Bank opened in Nanjing; Governor Liu Xiaotao unveiled it, and Jiangsu Rural Commercial United Bank signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Xuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会调研组到市科技局调研外国专家服务管理工作
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Research Group Visits Science and Technology Bureau to Study Foreign Expert Service Management
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，阳江市人大常委会副主任冯周海率调研组赴市科技局等单位调研出入境管理和外国专家服务管理工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Feng Zhouhai, deputy director of the Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, led a research group to study exit-entry management and foreign expert services.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Supervises Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，阳江市委书记卢一先督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治，实地检查食品安全、医保基金和高标准农田建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Yangjiang Party Secretary Lu Yixian supervised rectification of misconduct and corruption affecting the public, inspecting food safety, medical insurance funds and high-standard farmland.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，阳江市委常委会会议召开，市委书记卢一先主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话、重要贺信和重要指示精神，并套开市委全面深化改革委员会会议和市委平安建设领导小组会议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Yangjiang's municipal Party Standing Committee met, chaired by Secretary Lu Yixian, to convey Xi Jinping's speeches and letters and discuss reform and public security.

articles.title_zh: 银川市各民主党派市委会换届大会召开 赵旭辉出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Democratic Parties Hold Municipal Committee Leadership Transition Conference; Zhao Xuhui Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，银川市各民主党派市委会换届大会召开，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉出席开幕式并讲话，各党派随后选举产生新一届领导班子。
articles.summary_en: On October 22, Yinchuan held a leadership transition conference for the municipal committees of its democratic parties, addressed by Zhao Xuhui, Yinchuan Party secretary; each party then elected new leadership teams.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神 决战决胜四季度 确保完成各项目标任务 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting on Studying Xi Jinping's Remarks and Securing Full-Year Targets
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，银川市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神和全国卫生与健康大会精神，听取扫黑除恶和经济运行汇报，部署四季度冲刺工作，赵旭辉主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and the national health conference, review anti-crime and economic reports, and plan the fourth-quarter push, chaired by Zhao Xuhui.

articles.title_zh: 自治区信访工作联席会议机制扩大会议召开 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Chairs Expanded Meeting on Ningxia Petition Work Joint Conference Mechanism
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，宁夏自治区信访工作联席会议机制扩大会议召开，自治区党委书记李邑飞主持并讲话，部署信访安全保障与积案化解工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Ningxia held an expanded meeting of its petition work joint conference mechanism, chaired by regional Party Secretary Li Yifei, who urged resolving public grievances and clearing backlog cases.

articles.title_zh: 李军到盖州市调研安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Li Jun Inspects Work Safety in Gaizhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，营口市委书记李军到盖州市调研安全生产工作，实地检查化工、压铸、渔船修造企业及渔港，要求全面排查整治风险隐患。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Yingkou Party Secretary Li Jun inspected work safety in Gaizhou, checking chemical, die-casting and ship-repair enterprises and a fishing port, and urging full rectification of hazards.

articles.title_zh: 李军到盖州市调研安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Li Jun Inspects Work Safety in Gaizhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，营口市委书记李军到盖州市调研安全生产工作，实地检查化工、压铸、渔船修造企业及渔港，现场指出隐患并要求整改。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Li Jun, Party Secretary of Yingkou, inspected work safety in Gaizhou, checking chemical, die-casting and fishing-boat firms and a fishing port, flagging hazards and ordering rectification.

articles.title_zh: 营口市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，营口市委书记李军主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记系列重要讲话和重要指示精神，并研究部署民生建设、卫生健康、平安营口建设等贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Yingkou Municipal Party Secretary Li Jun chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions, and to plan implementation work on livelihood, health and safe-city development.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬伟大长征精神 走好新的长征路——玉溪党员干部认真学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Yuxi Party Members Study Xi Jinping's Speech on the 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日纪念红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京举行，玉溪市广大党员干部认真学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，表示要弘扬伟大长征精神、以实干实绩推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: After the October 22 rally in Beijing marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory, Yuxi's Party members and officials studied Xi Jinping's speech, vowing to carry forward the Long March spirit and advance high-quality development through solid work.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究做好我市平安稳定工作 徐晓霞主持会议
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Implementing Xi Jinping's Important Instructions and Ensuring Safety and Stability, Chaired by Xu Xiaoxia
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日上午，云浮市委书记徐晓霞主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于建设更高水平平安中国的重要指示精神，研究部署全市平安稳定工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 21, Yunfu Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to implement Xi Jinping's important instructions on building a higher-level Peaceful China and to plan local safety and stability work.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党雷州市第十五次代表大会开幕
articles.title_en: 15th CPC Leizhou City Congress Opens
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日上午，中国共产党雷州市第十五次代表大会开幕，市委书记张佩作报告，提出打造“五个雷州”、推动跨越式高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 23, the 15th CPC Leizhou City Congress opened, with Party Secretary Zhang Pei delivering a report on building the "Five Leizhous" and pursuing leapfrog high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 杨杰东主持召开2026年第二十五次区党工委会议暨第十九次管委会主任办公会议
articles.title_en: Yang Jiedong Chairs 2026 District Party Working Committee and Management Committee Office Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日下午，湛江经开区管委会主任杨杰东主持召开区党工委会议暨管委会主任办公会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话及全省先进制造业大会精神。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, Yang Jiedong chaired a Zhanjiang Economic Development Zone party meeting that studied Xi Jinping's speeches and provincial advanced manufacturing plans.

articles.title_zh: 市五届人大常委会召开党组（扩大）会议暨第五十九次主任会议
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Party Group Meeting and 59th Chairpersons' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，周口市人大常委会主任郭力铭主持召开党组（扩大）会议暨第五十九次主任会议，传达学习中共中央政治局会议精神，并研究地方立法、国有资产管理、医养结合等议题。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Director Guo Liming chaired a Party group meeting and the 59th chairpersons' meeting, conveying the Political Bureau's guiding principles and reviewing local legislation, state asset management and elderly care integration.

articles.title_zh: 周口市代表团继续审议省纪委工作报告
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Delegation Continues Deliberation of Provincial Discipline Commission Work Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，出席河南省第十二次党代会的周口代表团继续审议省纪委工作报告，黄玉国、杜道泉等代表发言表示完全赞同。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Zhoukou delegation to the 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress continued deliberating the provincial discipline commission's work report, with delegates such as Huang Yuguo and Du Daoquan voicing full endorsement.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议，以更大力度更实举措抓好经济社会发展各项工作
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Zhuhai Municipal Government Party Group and Executive Meetings, Vows Stronger Efforts on Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，珠海市市长吴泽桐主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议，研究卫生与健康工作，部署四季度经济社会发展各项任务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong chaired municipal government Party group and executive meetings to study health work and deploy fourth-quarter economic and social development tasks.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委理论学习中心组进行集体学习
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group Holds Collective Study Session on Green Transition
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日下午，山东省委理论学习中心组围绕习近平生态文明思想开展集体学习，省委书记林武主持并讲话，部署生态环境改善与绿色低碳转型工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 23, the Shandong Provincial Party Committee's theoretical study center group held a collective session on Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization, chaired by Party Secretary Lin Wu, who urged faster green and low-carbon transition.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 郭宁宁主持并研究贯彻落实措施
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets, Guo Ningning Presides Over Implementation Measures
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，福州市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署卫生健康、绿色发展、技能人才及对外合作等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to study and implement Xi Jinping's key speeches and to plan work on health, green development, skilled talent and international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 最高法例举牟某虐待案、火锅小便案 完善人民陪审制
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Cites Abuse Case and Hotpot Contamination Case in Push to Improve People's Assessor System
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院以牟某虐待案、未成年人向火锅内小便侵权案为例，说明人民陪审员在事实认定、评议量刑中发挥的作用，以完善人民陪审员制度。
articles.summary_en: China's Supreme People's Court cited the Mou abuse case and a case in which minors urinated into a hotpot to show how people's assessors help establish facts and inform sentencing, as part of efforts to improve the people's assessor system.

articles.title_zh: 电动自行车等三类产品CCC认证新规11月1日起实施
articles.title_en: New CCC Certification Rules for E-bikes, Toys and Children's Vehicles to Take Effect on November 1
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局全面升级CCC认证实施规则，电动自行车、玩具、童车三类产品新规将于11月1日起实施，并正组织认证机构对生产企业开展全面检查。
articles.summary_en: China's State Administration for Market Regulation has upgraded its CCC certification rules for e-bikes, toys and children's vehicles, effective November 1, and is organizing certification bodies to conduct full inspections of manufacturers.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅印发意见 构建就业友好型发展方式以适应人工智能技术发展
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Opinion on Building Employment-Friendly Development Model to Adapt to AI Development
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅日前印发《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》，部署6方面18项任务，以促进人工智能发展与高质量充分就业相协调。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the State Council has issued an opinion on adapting to AI development and building an employment-friendly development model, setting out 18 tasks across six areas to align AI progress with high-quality employment.

articles.title_zh: 江苏徐州农商银行揭牌开业
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Xuzhou Rural Commercial Bank Unveiled in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，江苏徐州农商银行揭牌开业暨授信签约活动在南京举行，省长刘小涛出席揭牌，随后召开全省农商行减量提质改革专题会。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Jiangsu Xuzhou Rural Commercial Bank was unveiled and signed credit agreements in Nanjing; Governor Liu Xiaotao attended, followed by a provincial meeting on rural bank reform.

articles.title_zh: 六部门：老旧街区厂区改造瞄准五大重点
articles.title_en: Six Departments Target Five Priorities in Old Neighborhood and Factory District Renovation
articles.summary_zh: 住房城乡建设部等六部门联合印发指导意见，明确老旧街区厂区改造提升五大重点，涵盖厂区功能转换、商业街区业态升级、生活街区品质提升等。
articles.summary_en: Six Chinese departments, led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, jointly issued guidelines setting out five priorities for renovating old neighborhoods and factory districts, covering factory repurposing, commercial district upgrading and livability improvements.

articles.title_zh: 第36届中国新闻奖公示：钧正平工作室、晏秋秋等新闻IP拟获奖
articles.title_en: 36th China News Award Shortlist Released: Junzhengping Studio, Yan Qiuqiu and Other News IPs Nominated
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月23日，第36届中国新闻奖公示名单公布，钧正平工作室、晏秋秋、政事儿等新闻IP拟获奖，评选将“新闻专栏”拓展为“新闻IP”。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, 2026, China released the shortlist for the 36th China News Award, with news IPs such as Junzhengping Studio and Yan Qiuqiu nominated after the 'news column' category was expanded to 'news IP'.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区党委组织部：各级领导干部要做抗震救灾的排头兵
articles.title_en: Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee Organization Department: Officials at All Levels Must Lead Earthquake Relief Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震后，西藏自治区党委组织部划拨300万元党费并印发紧急通知，号召各级党组织和党员干部投身抗震救灾。
articles.summary_en: After a magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu, Tibet, on Oct 22, the Organization Department of the Tibet Regional Party Committee allocated 3 million yuan in Party dues and issued an urgent notice calling on Party organizations and officials to join relief efforts.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区党委书记抵达震中玛如乡：指挥应急救援，看望受灾群众
articles.title_en: Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng Reaches Quake Epicenter in Marru Township to Direct Emergency Rescue
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日晚那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震后，自治区党委书记胡昌升连夜赶赴灾区，23日上午抵达震中玛如乡2村指挥应急救援、部署抗震救灾并看望受灾群众。
articles.summary_en: After a magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County in Nagqu, Tibet on the night of Oct 22, regional Party Secretary Hu Changsheng rushed to the disaster zone and arrived at the epicenter in Marru Township on the morning of Oct 23 to direct rescue work and visit displaced residents.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党安徽省第十二届纪律检查委员会委员名单
articles.title_en: List of Members of the 12th Anhui Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection of the Communist Party of China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，中共安徽省第十二次代表大会产生第十二届纪律检查委员会，65名委员名单按姓氏笔画排序公布。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, the Communist Party of China's Anhui Provincial Congress released the list of 65 members of the 12th Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection, arranged by surname stroke order.

articles.title_zh: 重庆发布通用人工智能公共服务平台「明镜平台」
articles.title_en: Chongqing Unveils Mingjing AGI Public Service Platform
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，重庆通用人工智能研究院在通用人工智能大会上发布自研AGI公共服务平台「明镜平台」，可批量生成智能体，已在五大领域落地。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Chongqing Institute for AGI released Mingjing, a self-developed public AGI platform that mass-produces AI agents, at the General AI Conference in Chongqing.

articles.title_en: Chongqing-Made Electronic Oil Pumps Keep NEVs Running in Extreme Cold
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，重庆红宇精工介绍，其自主研发的电子油泵突破极寒启动难题，技术水平国内领先，销量从2025年约40万套增至2026年80万套。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Chongqing Hongyu Precision Industry said its self-developed electronic oil pumps, which solve extreme-cold starting problems, lead domestically, with sales doubling from about 400,000 units in 2025 to 800,000 in 2026.

articles.title_zh: 通用人工智能大会在渝开幕
articles.title_en: General Artificial Intelligence Conference Opens in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，通用人工智能大会在重庆开幕，重庆市委书记袁家军出席开幕式并致辞，市长陈新武出席，多位院士致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the General Artificial Intelligence Conference opened in Chongqing, with municipal Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun delivering remarks and Mayor Chen Xinwu attending alongside several academicians.

articles.title_zh: 一千多年后，“她”再次出海
articles.title_en: A Millennium Later, Mazu Culture Sets Sail Again
articles.summary_zh: 第十一届世界妈祖文化论坛将于10月31日至11月1日在福建莆田湄洲岛举行，由文化和旅游部等与福建省人民政府共同主办，聚焦妈祖文化与文明互鉴。
articles.summary_en: The 11th World Mazu Culture Forum will be held Oct 31 to Nov 1 in Putian, Fujian, co-hosted by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism and the Fujian provincial government.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省创新推出“交陇青创贷”专属融资产品
articles.title_en: Gansu Rolls Out Dedicated "Jiaolong Youth Entrepreneurship Loan" Financing Product
articles.summary_zh: 近日，甘肃省人社厅联合省商务厅、交通银行甘肃省分行等部门印发通知，推出“交陇青创贷”专项融资业务，为青年创业者和小微企业提供分级授信与贴息支持。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's human resources and other provincial departments, together with Bank of Communications' Gansu branch, issued a notice launching the "Jiaolong Youth Entrepreneurship Loan" to provide tiered credit and interest subsidies for young entrepreneurs and small businesses.

articles.summary_zh: 日前，甘肃省退役军人事务厅组织23家省内外用人单位，赴平凉、庆阳、天水、定西、甘南5地的8个重点区域开展退役军人专项招聘活动。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial Department of Veterans Affairs recently organized 23 employers to hold targeted job fairs for veterans in eight key areas across Pingliang, Qingyang, Tianshui, Dingxi and Gannan.

articles.title_zh: 资本招商引龙头 桂沪联动壮大人工智能产业
articles.title_en: Capital Investment Attracts Leading Firms as Guangxi and Shanghai Jointly Boost AI Industry
articles.summary_zh: 近期，广西（上海）产业合作中心以资本招商方式引入杭州极目智控，推动总投资10亿元的农业植保无人机项目落地柳州，并入选第五届广西直接融资提名案例。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi (Shanghai) Industrial Cooperation Center attracted drone maker Jimu Zhikong via capital investment, landing a 1-billion-yuan project in Liuzhou; the case won a Guangxi direct financing nomination.

articles.title_zh: “智汇五象 才聚良庆 创享未来”人才主题活动启动
articles.title_en: 'Talents Gather at Wuxiang, Thrive in Liangqing' Talent Event Launches in Nanning
articles.summary_zh: 南宁五象新区—良庆区启动人才主题活动，聘任桂林电子科技大学产业导师，成立人才多样化服务联盟并发布青年人才服务手册。
articles.summary_en: Nanning's Wuxiang New Area and Liangqing District launched a talent-themed event, appointing industry supervisors for Guilin University of Electronic Technology, forming a talent service alliance and releasing a youth talent service guide.

articles.title_zh: 健康河南建设持续推进 便民就医服务家门口可感可及
articles.title_en: Henan Advances Health Reforms, Bringing Medical Services to Residents' Doorsteps
articles.summary_zh: 河南省持续推进便民就医微改革，2025年全省居民健康素养水平达34.18%，935家二级及以上医疗机构实现检查检验结果线上互认，多项健康指标优于全国平均水平。
articles.summary_en: Henan Province is expanding convenience-oriented healthcare reforms, with health literacy reaching 34.18% in 2025, mutual recognition of test results at 935 secondary and higher-level hospitals, and key health indicators outperforming the national average.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“中国新闻传播大讲堂”在京启动
articles.title_en: 2026 China Journalism and Communication Lecture Series Launches in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月23日，“中国新闻传播大讲堂”在北京启动；该讲堂创设于2020年，以马克思主义新闻观为引领。启动仪式后，北京大学等9所高校的教师代表研讨了新闻传播人才培养。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China Journalism and Communication Lecture Series, launched in 2020 and guided by the Marxist view of journalism, kicked off in Beijing on Oct 23, 2026. Afterwards, faculty from nine universities including Peking University discussed journalism talent training.

articles.title_zh: 坚持以改革创新为根本动力 更加科学务实做好全省四季度及岁末年初各项工作
articles.title_en: Hubei Governor Li Dianxun Chairs Third-Quarter Economic Situation Analysis Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，湖北省省长李殿勋主持召开三季度全省经济形势分析会，部署稳增长、防风险、保民生及四季度和岁末年初重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun chaired the province's third-quarter economic analysis meeting, deploying work on growth, risk prevention and livelihoods for Q4 and the year-end period.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥会见南航集团董事长马须伦
articles.title_en: Guan Zhi'ou Meets China Southern Airlines Chairman Ma Xulun
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，湖北省委书记关志鸥在武汉会见中国南方航空集团董事长马须伦，双方就深化航线开拓、航空物流、临空经济等领域合作达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhi'ou met China Southern Airlines Chairman Ma Xulun in Wuhan, with both sides agreeing to deepen cooperation in route expansion, aviation logistics and airport economy.

articles.title_zh: 河北省开展2026年5G工厂建设工作
articles.title_en: Hebei Launches 2026 5G Factory Development Program
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，河北省工业和信息化厅、省通信管理局联合印发通知，启动2026年5G工厂建设工作，遴选5G工厂名录项目，加快实施“5G+工业互联网”升级行动。
articles.summary_en: On October 20, the Hebei Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology and the provincial communications administration jointly issued a notice to launch the 2026 5G factory development program, selecting 5G factory projects to accelerate the '5G plus Industrial Internet' upgrading initiative.

tags.name_en: Hebei Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 签约、揭牌、建平台 2026海南自由贸易港法律周成果丰硕
articles.title_en: Agreements, Unveilings and Platform Launches: 2026 Hainan Free Trade Port Legal Week Achieves Fruitful Results
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，2026海南自由贸易港法律周成果发布会在海南举行，本届法律周推动多项法律服务合作协议、平台和机构落地。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, a press briefing on the 2026 Hainan Free Trade Port Legal Week was held in Hainan, highlighting multiple legal service cooperation agreements, platforms and institutions launched.

articles.title_zh: 省委召开专题会议 研究部署全省“六张网”规划建设
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Holds Special Meeting on Planning and Building the Province's "Six Networks"
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，海南省委书记冯飞主持召开专题会议，研究部署水网、新型电网、算力网、新一代通信网、城市地下管网和物流网“六张网”规划建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei chaired a special meeting to plan the province's "six networks" — water, new power grid, computing, next-generation communications, urban underground pipelines and logistics.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞专题调研全面从严治党工作
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Work on Full and Rigorous Party Governance in Hainan
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日至22日，海南省委书记冯飞在海口专题调研全面从严治党工作并主持召开座谈会，省长刘小明、省委副书记杨晋柏参加。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 21 to 22, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei inspected work on full and rigorous Party governance in Haikou and chaired a symposium; Governor Liu Xiaoming and Deputy Secretary Yang Jinbai attended.

articles.title_zh: 「留学海南」：黎安国际教育创新试验区引进30所高校
articles.title_en: Studying in Hainan: Li'an International Education Pilot Zone Draws 30 Universities
articles.summary_zh: 海南陵水黎安国际教育创新试验区自2020年设立以来已引进30所国内外高校、24个中外合作办学机构及项目，2026年师生规模预计突破1.5万人。
articles.summary_en: Hainan's Li'an International Education Pilot Zone has brought in 30 universities and 24 Sino-foreign programs since 2020, with students and staff expected to top 15,000 in 2026.

articles.title_zh: 洋浦港迎来开港以来最大船舶 靠泊纪录刷新
articles.title_en: Yangpu Port Welcomes Largest Ship Since Opening, Setting New Berthing Record
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，近400米长的“中海大西洋”轮靠泊海南洋浦国际集装箱码头，刷新开港以来靠泊纪录，体现自贸港港口能力提升。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the nearly 400-meter CSL Atlantic berthed at Hainan's Yangpu International Container Terminal, setting a new berthing record and highlighting the free trade port's growing port capacity.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨90秒，首席指挥员带你回顾卫星从海南出发的“长征”
articles.title_en: Hainan Commercial Spaceport Enters Phase II Equipment Testing as New Launch Pads Near Completion
articles.summary_zh: 海南商业航天发射场一期一号、二号工位已投入使用，三号、四号工位土建完工，二期工程转入设备调试合练阶段。
articles.summary_en: Hainan Commercial Spaceport's first two launch pads are in service, pads three and four have finished civil works, and Phase II has moved into equipment testing and joint drills.

articles.title_zh: 《黑龙江省地名管理规定》重新制定 将于2026年12月1日起实施
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang's Geographical Name Management Regulation Revised, to Take Effect December 1, 2026
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，黑龙江省人民政府新闻办公室举行发布会，介绍重新制定的《黑龙江省地名管理规定》，该规定将于2026年12月1日起实施。
articles.summary_en: On October 23, Heilongjiang's provincial information office held a briefing on the newly revised Geographical Name Management Regulation, which will take effect on December 1, 2026.

tags.name_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Department of Civil Affairs

tags_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Department of Civil Affairs

articles.title_zh: 许勤：自觉践行为民服务宗旨 依法依规做好信访工作
articles.title_en: Xu Qin: Earnestly Serving the People and Handling Petition Work in Accordance with Laws and Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，黑龙江省委书记许勤到省人民来访来电受理中心接待来访群众，要求依法依规化解信访问题、限期办结，并推动源头治理。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Heilongjiang Party Secretary Xu Qin received petitioners at the provincial petition center, urging officials to resolve complaints lawfully, meet deadlines and tackle problems at the source.

articles.title_zh: 哈尔滨多举措推动县域工业稳中有进
articles.title_en: Harbin Adopts Multiple Measures to Boost Steady County-Level Industrial Growth
articles.summary_zh: 哈尔滨市通过规划引领、调研服务、主体培育、政策落地等举措推动县域工业稳中有进，1至8月9县（市）规上工业总产值同比增长5.7%。
articles.summary_en: Harbin has advanced county-level industrial growth through planning guidance, enterprise cultivation and policy implementation, with combined industrial output of its nine counties up 5.7% year-on-year in January-August.

tags.name_en: Harbin Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Harbin Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 伊春市连续多年打造示范宣讲报告会 推动理论宣讲走深走实
articles.title_en: Yichun Builds Model Theory-Propaganda Sessions Over Multiple Years to Deepen Grassroots Outreach
articles.summary_zh: 近年来，伊春市委讲师团连续多年举办系列主题示范宣讲报告会，把党的创新理论、红色历史记忆和林区奋斗故事搬上舞台，推动理论宣讲深入基层。
articles.summary_en: In recent years, the Yichun Municipal Party Committee Lecture Group has held a series of themed model propaganda sessions, bringing Party theory, revolutionary history and forestry stories to the stage to extend outreach to the grassroots.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府常务会议，分析前三季度经济形势、部署四季度经济工作，并研究支持信息通信业加快发展的措施。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a provincial government executive meeting to analyze third-quarter economic conditions, plan fourth-quarter work, and study measures to support the information and communications industry.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对江苏等4省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level IV Flood Defense Emergency Response for Jiangsu and Three Other Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，水利部对上海、江苏、浙江、福建启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，防范台风“蔷琵”带来的强降雨和汛情。
articles.summary_en: On October 22, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level IV flood defense emergency response for Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Fujian to guard against heavy rain and flooding brought by Typhoon Chanthu.

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布“物理AI与世界模型”典型成果
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Releases Typical Achievements in Physical AI and World Models
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，2026物理AI与世界模型大会在南京落幕，江苏发布高质量数据集建设行动计划，并展示9项创新成果与50个应用场景。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the 2026 Physical AI and World Model Conference closed in Nanjing, where Jiangsu released a dataset action plan and showcased 9 innovations and 50 application scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 全力推动经济稳中回升向好 庄兆林在赣州调研
articles.title_en: Zhuang Zhaolin Urges Steady Economic Recovery During Ganzhou Research Visit
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日至21日，江西省委常委、省委组织部部长庄兆林在赣州开展经济运行情况专题调研并召开座谈会，要求全力冲刺四季度，推动经济稳中回升向好。
articles.summary_en: Zhuang Zhaolin, a standing committee member of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee and head of its Organization Department, conducted a research visit on economic performance in Ganzhou on Oct 20-21 and chaired a symposium, urging a fourth-quarter push to stabilize and revive economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘主持召开江西省委财经委员会第二十九次会议 全力推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Chairs 29th Meeting of Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee's Financial and Economic Commission, Vowing to Boost Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，江西省委书记尹弘在南昌主持召开省委财经委员会第二十九次会议，分析前三季度经济运行情况，部署稳工业、扩投资、促消费和保障民生等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Jiangxi Party Secretary Yin Hong chaired the 29th meeting of the provincial Party committee's financial and economic commission, reviewing third-quarter economic performance and outlining steps to stabilize industry, investment, consumption and livelihoods.

tags.name_en: Financial and Economic Affairs Commission of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee

tags_en: Financial and Economic Affairs Commission of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee

articles.title_zh: 任珠峰在上饶接访并调度信访事项
articles.title_en: Ren Zhufeng Receives Petitioners in Shangrao, Coordinates Complaint Resolution
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，江西省委常委、常务副省长任珠峰在上饶市接访，就楼盘交付、饮水困难等4件信访事项现场会商解决方案并逐一答复。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Jiangxi Executive Vice Governor Ren Zhufeng received petitioners in Shangrao, holding on-site consultations and replying to four complaints including housing delivery delays and drinking water shortages.

articles.title_zh: 宜黄县靶向纠治“过度检查”筑牢医保防线
articles.title_en: Yihuang County Targets Excessive Medical Checks to Protect Medical Insurance Fund
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，江西宜黄县纪委监委联合医保、卫健部门整治医疗机构过度检查，已检查定点医药机构171家，追回违规医保基金并退还多收费用。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Yihuang County's discipline inspection commission, together with medical insurance and health departments, reported progress in curbing excessive medical checks, inspecting 171 designated medical institutions and recovering misused insurance funds.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘主持江西省委理论学习中心组集体学习，强调提升党建引领基层治理效能
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Chairs Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee Study Session on Party Building and Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月22日，江西省委理论学习中心组举行集体学习，省委书记尹弘主持并讲话，强调以党建引领提升基层治理效能、推动全省社会工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, 2026, the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee held a group study session chaired by Party Secretary Yin Hong, who urged stronger Party-building-led grassroots governance and higher-quality social work across the province.

articles.title_zh: 包钢调研大青山生态保护和秋冬季防火工作
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Inspects Daqingshan Ecological Protection and Autumn-Winter Fire Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢赴大青山国家级自然保护区，调研生态保护修复与秋冬季森林防火工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 22, Inner Mongolia government chairman Bao Gang inspected the Daqingshan National Nature Reserve to review ecological restoration and autumn-winter forest fire prevention work.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏率先推出电力服务算力发展全链条保障举措
articles.title_en: Ningxia First to Roll Out Full-Chain Power Support Measures for Computing Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，国网宁夏电力有限公司在银川发布服务算力发展八项措施，宁夏成为全国首个出台电力服务算力一揽子专项举措的省份。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, State Grid Ningxia Electric Power released eight measures in Yinchuan to support computing power development, making Ningxia the first province in China to launch a dedicated power service package for the computing industry.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 审议《关于二十届中央第七轮巡视情况的综合报告》 习近平主持会议
articles.title_en: Politburo of the CPC Central Committee Holds Meeting to Review Comprehensive Report on the Seventh Round of Inspections of the 20th Central Committee; Xi Jinping Presides
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，中共中央政治局在北京召开会议，审议《关于二十届中央第七轮巡视情况的综合报告》，习近平总书记主持会议，会议对巡视整改和中央和国家机关全面从严治党作出部署。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met in Beijing to review a comprehensive report on the seventh round of inspections of the 20th Central Committee. Xi Jinping presided, and the meeting urged stronger rectification and full strict governance of Party and state organs.

articles.title_zh: 李乐成当选中共安徽省委书记
articles.title_en: Li Lecheng Elected Secretary of the CPC Anhui Provincial Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月23日，中共安徽省第十二届委员会第一次全体会议选举李乐成为省委书记，王东伟、单向前为省委副书记；省纪委全会选举许永锞为省纪委书记。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the first plenary session of the 12th CPC Anhui Provincial Committee elected Li Lecheng as provincial party secretary, with Wang Dongwei and Shan Xiangqian as deputy secretaries; Xu Yongke was elected head of the provincial discipline inspection commission.

articles.title_zh: 截至10月23日凌晨3时 玉树州未出现人员伤亡
articles.title_en: No Casualties in Yushu as of 3 AM Oct 23 After 7.0-Magnitude Tibet Quake
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日22时33分西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，玉树杂多、囊谦有震感；截至23日凌晨3时玉树州无人员伤亡，基础设施总体正常。
articles.summary_en: A magnitude-7.0 earthquake hit Baqeng County in Nagqu, Tibet at 22:33 on Oct 22, shaking Zadoi and Nangqian in Yushu; by 3 am Oct 23 Yushu reported no casualties and normal infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 青海：用好科技援青机制 推动成果双向转化
articles.title_en: Qinghai: Better Use of Science and Technology Aid Mechanism to Promote Two-Way Transfer of Research Outcomes
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，青海省举行科技创新专场新闻发布会，提出“十五五”时期推动科技合作实现“三个转变”，打造青藏高原科技创新高地。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Qinghai held a science and technology innovation briefing, pledging to achieve "three shifts" in sci-tech cooperation during the 15th Five-Year Plan period and build a plateau innovation hub.

tags.name_en: Science and Technology Aid to Qinghai

tags_en: Science and Technology Aid to Qinghai

articles.title_zh: 青海省常态化帮扶重点工作推进调度会召开
articles.title_en: Qinghai Holds Meeting on Normalized Assistance Work to Consolidate Poverty Alleviation Gains
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日下午，青海省常态化帮扶重点工作推进调度会召开，省委书记罗东川出席并讲话，部署防止返贫监测、产业与就业帮扶等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 22, Qinghai held a meeting on normalized assistance work, where Provincial Party Secretary Luo Dongchuan called for stronger monitoring against a return to poverty and better industry and employment support.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁主持上海市委财经委会议，研究海外综合服务体系建设与入境游高质量发展
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Chairs Shanghai Municipal Financial and Economic Affairs Committee Meeting on Overseas Service System and Inbound Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，上海市委财经工作委员会召开会议，陈吉宁主持、朱忠明出席，研究完善海外综合服务体系、打造“出海选择上海”品牌，推动入境游高质量发展，并部署构建房地产发展新模式。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Shanghai's Municipal Financial and Economic Affairs Committee met, with Chen Jining presiding and Zhu Zhongming attending, to improve overseas service systems, boost inbound tourism and build a new real estate development model.

articles.title_zh: 更加精准有效做好事办实事解难事
articles.title_en: Zhu Zhongming Visits Hongkou District to Hear Residents' Petitions
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月22日，上海市委副书记、市长朱忠明到虹口区新临平泵站下访，聚焦防汛墙改造、商铺执照等信访问题听取群众意见并研究解决对策。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, 2026, Shanghai Mayor Zhu Zhongming visited Hongkou District to hear residents' petitions on flood-wall repairs and shop licenses, urging faster fixes and citywide risk checks.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“中国新闻传播大讲堂”在京启动
articles.title_en: 2026 China Journalism and Communication Lecture Hall Launches in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年“中国新闻传播大讲堂”在京启动，以马克思主义新闻观为引领，9所高校新闻传播院系教师代表围绕人才培养等议题研讨。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China Journalism and Communication Lecture Hall launched in Beijing, with faculty from nine universities discussing journalism talent training under the Marxist view of journalism.

articles.title_zh: 全力推动商务高质量发展不断取得新成效
articles.title_en: MOFCOM Vows to Push High-Quality Commerce Development Under 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，国务院新闻办公室举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，商务部副部长蒋成华等介绍“十五五”时期商务高质量发展部署，涉及消费、对外开放和自贸试验区建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where Vice Commerce Minister Jiang Chenghua outlined plans for consumption, opening-up and free trade zones under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震，胡昌升连夜赶赴灾区指挥抗震救灾
articles.title_en: Magnitude 7.0 Earthquake Strikes Baqing County in Nagqu; Hu Changsheng Rushes Overnight to Disaster Zone
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日22时33分，西藏那曲市巴青县发生7.0级地震。自治区党委书记胡昌升、自治区主席嘎玛泽登第一时间调度部署，胡昌升连夜赶赴灾区指挥抗震救灾。
articles.summary_en: A magnitude 7.0 earthquake hit Baqing County in Nagqu, Tibet, at 22:33 on Oct 22. Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng and Chairman Garma Zedeng immediately directed relief work, with Hu rushing overnight to the disaster zone.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨打出促消费与市场安全组合拳
articles.title_en: Lhasa Combines Consumption Stimulus with Market Safety Overhaul
articles.summary_zh: 2026年以来，拉萨市商务局统筹2.95亿元促消费资金，截至10月9日已核销2.6亿元、拉动消费33.93亿元，并完成餐饮行业全链条安全整治。
articles.summary_en: Since early 2026, Lhasa's Commerce Bureau has pooled 295 million yuan in consumption funds, redeeming 260 million by Oct 9 to spur 3.39 billion yuan in spending, and completed a restaurant safety overhaul.

articles.title_zh: 王宁王予波在昆明调研生态环保工作 强调保护好生态环境建设绿美云南
articles.title_en: Wang Ning and Wang Yubo Inspect Eco-Environmental Protection Work in Kunming, Vowing to Build a Green and Beautiful Yunnan
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，云南省委书记王宁、省长王予波在昆明市调研生态环境保护、农村生活垃圾收集转运等工作，要求抓好中央生态环保督察问题整改，建设绿美云南。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Yunnan Party Secretary Wang Ning and Governor Wang Yubo inspected eco-environmental protection and rural household waste collection in Kunming, urging continued rectification of central inspection findings.

articles.title_zh: 22个场景加快人工智能在水运领域创新应用
articles.title_en: 22 Scenarios to Accelerate AI Innovation in Waterway Transport
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部近日印发《水运领域人工智能应用场景指引》，从安全提升、提质增效、绿色转型三方面提出22个水运领域人工智能应用场景。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Transport issued guidelines proposing 22 AI application scenarios for waterway transport, covering safety improvement, efficiency gains and green transition.

articles.title_zh: 《对外投资管理办法》发布 自12月1日起施行

articles.title_zh: 中国红十字会总会紧急向西藏地震灾区调拨救灾物资

articles.summary_en: A magnitude-7.0 earthquake struck Baqing County, Nagqu, Tibet on Oct 22, 2026. The Red Cross Society of China activated its emergency response, dispatching 3,800 sets of relief supplies and a work team to the disaster area.

articles.title_zh: 接续奋斗，书写中国式现代化青岛实践新答卷

articles.summary_en: US media reported on Oct 23 that the Pentagon plans to start expanding military facilities in Greenland in 2027, using the winter to assess plans and upgrading an airport runway to host more troops.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 审议《关于二十届中央第七轮巡视情况的综合报告》 习近平主持会议

articles.summary_en: On Oct 23, the CPC Politburo met in Beijing to review the comprehensive report on the 20th Central Committee's seventh round of inspections, with Xi Jinping presiding and urging solid rectification and full rigorous Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 《中国工农红军长征胜利90周年》纪念邮票发行
articles.title_en: Commemorative Stamps Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory Issued
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，中国邮政发行《中国工农红军长征胜利90周年》纪念邮票1套6枚，以弘扬伟大长征精神、传承红色基因。
articles.summary_en: On October 22, China Post issued a set of six commemorative stamps marking the 90th anniversary of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March victory, aimed at carrying forward the Long March spirit.

articles.title_zh: 两岸媒体探访南宁港 聚焦平陆运河通航新气象
articles.title_en: Cross-Strait Media Visit Nanning Port, Highlighting Pinglu Canal's New Navigation Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，两岸媒体联合采访团走进南宁港六景作业区，探访平陆运河通航一个月来的港口变化。9月南宁港货物吞吐量66.84万吨，同比增长145%。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, a cross-strait media delegation visited Nanning Port's Liujing terminal to see changes one month after the Pinglu Canal opened, with September cargo throughput up 145% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 聚焦OPC 第七届两岸青年创业孵化器沙龙在南京举行
articles.title_en: Seventh Cross-Strait Youth Startup Incubator Salon Held in Nanjing, Focusing on OPC
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，第七届两岸青年创业孵化器沙龙在南京举行，百余名两岸青年探讨OPC（一人公司）轻创业，4家台青企业入驻南京台湾青年OPC创业空间。
articles.summary_en: The 7th Cross-Strait Youth Startup Incubator Salon was held in Nanjing on Oct 22, where over 100 participants discussed OPC light entrepreneurship and four Taiwan startups joined the city's OPC space.

articles.title_zh: 龙陵县召开石斛产业发展专题会议
articles.title_en: Longling County Holds Special Meeting on Dendrobium Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，云南龙陵县召开石斛产业发展专题会议，县委书记牛永东讲话，部署“十五五”时期石斛全产业链高质量发展任务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Longling County in Yunnan held a special meeting on its dendrobium industry, where Party Secretary Niu Yongdong laid out tasks for high-quality development of the full industrial chain during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚到双阳区、公主岭市调研乡村振兴工作
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Conducts Field Research on Rural Revitalization in Shuangyang District and Gongzhuling City
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，长春市市长顾刚到双阳区、公主岭市实地调研秋收作业、秸秆离田、农村人居环境整治和农业一二三产融合发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang visited Shuangyang District and Gongzhuling City to inspect autumn harvest operations, straw removal, rural living environment improvement and integrated agricultural development.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见俄罗斯总统普京
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Russian President Putin
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日下午，国务院总理李强在圣彼得堡会见俄罗斯总统普京，双方就深化战略沟通、拓展能源经贸等领域务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 21, Premier Li Qiang met Russian President Putin in St. Petersburg, with the two sides exchanging views on deepening strategic communication and expanding practical cooperation in energy, trade and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 新动能加速成长 带动作用不断增强
articles.title_en: New Growth Drivers Accelerate, Driving Role Continues to Strengthen
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委数据显示，今年前三季度我国新动能加速成长，创新成果涌现，产业结构持续优化，对经济带动作用增强。
articles.summary_en: Data from the National Development and Reform Commission show that in the first three quarters, China's new growth drivers accelerated, innovation outcomes emerged, and industrial structure continued to improve.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见俄罗斯总统普京
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Russian President Vladimir Putin
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间10月21日下午，国务院总理李强在圣彼得堡会见俄罗斯总统普京，双方表示将加强战略沟通、深化能源经贸等务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 21 local time, Premier Li Qiang met Russian President Vladimir Putin in St. Petersburg, with both sides pledging stronger strategic communication and deeper practical cooperation in energy and trade.

articles.title_zh: 中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤联合公报（全文）
articles.title_en: Joint Communiqué of the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting (Full Text)
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月20日至21日，国务院总理李强访问俄罗斯，在圣彼得堡与俄总理米舒斯京共同举行中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤并签署联合公报。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang visited Russia on Oct 20-21, 2026, holding the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting with Russian Premier Mishustin in St. Petersburg and signing a joint communiqué.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见吉布提外长奥马尔
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets with Djibouti's Foreign Minister Omar
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见吉布提外长奥马尔，双方就双边关系、地区和平稳定等议题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 21, Wang Yi, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Foreign Minister, met with Djibouti's Foreign Minister Omar in Beijing to discuss bilateral ties and regional peace and stability.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同刚果（布）外长邦达会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Congolese Foreign Minister Bonda
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同刚果（布）外长邦达举行会谈，双方就高层交往、战略对接与务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 22, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks in Beijing with Congolese Foreign Minister Bonda, discussing high-level exchanges, strategic alignment and practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和吉布提共和国外交部长关于维护非洲之角和平稳定及红海和亚丁湾航道安全的联合新闻公报
articles.title_en: Joint Press Communiqué of the Foreign Ministers of China and Djibouti on Safeguarding Peace and Stability in the Horn of Africa and the Safety of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden Shipping Lanes
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，中国与吉布提两国外交部长发表联合新闻公报，就非洲之角局势和红海航道安全达成六点共识，涉及加沙停火、反海盗及维护航行自由等。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the foreign ministers of China and Djibouti issued a joint communiqué setting out six points of consensus on the Horn of Africa and Red Sea shipping lane security, covering Gaza ceasefire, anti-piracy and freedom of navigation.

tags.name_en: Peace and Stability in the Horn of Africa

tags_en: Peace and Stability in the Horn of Africa

articles.title_zh: 习近平在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上的讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Rally Marking the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Long March
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月22日，习近平在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上发表讲话，回顾长征历史，号召弘扬伟大长征精神、走好新的长征路。
articles.summary_en: On October 22, 2026, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the rally marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March's victory, reviewing its history and calling for carrying forward the Long March spirit on the new journey.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度我国消费市场继续扩容
articles.title_en: China's Consumer Market Continues to Expand in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 前三季度，我国社会消费商品和服务零售总额同比增长2.6%，服务零售额增长5.0%，服务消费成为拉动消费增长的重要引擎。
articles.summary_en: In the first three quarters, China's total retail sales of goods and services rose 2.6% year on year, with services retail up 5.0%, making services consumption a key driver of growth.

articles.title_zh: 第二届辽宁沿海经济带城市人才一体发展交流会在丹东举行
articles.title_en: Second Liaoning Coastal Economic Belt Cities Talent Integration Development Exchange Conference Held in Dandong
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，第二届辽宁沿海经济带城市人才一体发展交流会在丹东举行，沿海六市签署人才需求共享协议，16个产才融合及校地合作项目签约。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the second Liaoning Coastal Economic Belt cities' talent integration exchange conference opened in Dandong, where six coastal cities signed a talent-demand sharing pact and 16 industry-talent and university-local cooperation projects were inked.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰会见哈曼国际集团客人
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Meets Harman International Group Executives
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，丹东市委书记蒋冰会见哈曼汽车事业部全球运营高级副总裁萨米·克里米，双方就企业在丹增资扩产、深化产业链合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Dandong Party Secretary Jiang Bing met Sami Krimi, senior VP of global operations at Harman's automotive division, to discuss the company's expansion in Dandong and deeper supply-chain cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日下午，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要贺信精神，安排部署卫生健康、教育等贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 21, Wang Shangxue, Party secretary of Dingxi, chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speeches and congratulatory letter, and to arrange implementation work on health, education and other areas.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱调研县乡人大换届选举工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects County- and Township-Level People's Congress Election Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱到兴山区、东山区调研县乡人大换届选举准备工作，实地查看投票站点和选民登记等情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu inspected preparations for county- and township-level people's congress elections in Xingshan and Dongshan districts, checking polling stations and voter registration.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元调研鹤矿集团非煤产业发展情况
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Inspects Non-Coal Industry Development at Hegang Mining Group
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，鹤岗市市长邓维元到鹤矿集团调研非煤产业发展，强调深化国企改革、培育壮大非煤产业并守住安全生产底线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan inspected Hegang Mining Group's non-coal businesses, urging deeper SOE reform, stronger diversified industries and strict safety oversight.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组学习（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Standing Committee Party Group Holds Expanded Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，鹤岗市人大常委会党组书记、主任李万军主持召开党组理论学习中心组学习（扩大）会议，学习习近平总书记重要论述和《中国共产党思想政治工作条例》并开展研讨。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 21, Li Wanjun, Party group secretary and director of the Hegang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, chaired an expanded theoretical study session on Xi Jinping's key discourses and the CPC regulations on ideological and political work.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委常委会召开会议分析前三季度经济形势
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets to Analyze First Three Quarters' Economic Performance
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，江苏省委书记信长星主持召开省委常委会会议，分析全省前三季度经济形势，研究部署四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing chaired a meeting of the provincial Party Standing Committee to analyze the province's economic performance in the first three quarters and plan work for the fourth quarter.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开常务会议 高靖生主持
articles.title_en: Huaihua Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting Chaired by Acting Mayor Gao Jingsheng
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日上午，怀化市委副书记、代市长高靖生主持召开市政府常务会议，研究市“十五五”规划编制、信访工作机制落实及世界级旅游廊道建设方案。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 21, Huaihua Acting Mayor Gao Jingsheng chaired a municipal government executive meeting on the city's 15th Five-Year Plan, petition-handling mechanisms and a world-class tourism corridor plan.

articles.title_zh: 李锦斌参加省第十二次党代会淮南市代表团审议
articles.title_en: Li Jinbin Joins Huainan Delegation Deliberations at 12th Anhui Provincial Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日下午，李锦斌在安徽省第十二次党代会淮南市代表团，与代表们共同审议省委报告，并就科技创新、产业升级、改革开放和管党治党等提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 19, Li Jinbin joined the Huainan delegation at the 12th Anhui Provincial Party Congress to deliberate the provincial Party committee's report, calling for progress in innovation, industrial upgrading, reform and opening-up, and Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组举行学习会议
articles.title_en: Huainan Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日下午，淮南市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组举行学习会议，党组书记、主任陈儒江主持并讲话，部署健康淮南建设、生态环保监督及全面从严治党工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 21, the Party Group of the Huainan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a theoretical study session chaired by Party Secretary and Director Chen Rujiang, focusing on health development, ecological oversight and full strict Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 张祥安参加省第十二次党代会淮南市代表团审议
articles.title_en: Zhang Xiang'an Joins Huainan Delegation Deliberation at 12th Provincial Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日下午，张祥安在安徽省第十二次党代会淮南市代表团参加审议省委报告，提出谋空间、抓交通、兴产业、聚人气、强队伍五方面意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Zhang Xiang'an joined the Huainan delegation's deliberation of the provincial Party report at Anhui's 12th Party Congress, urging progress on spatial planning, transport, industry and talent.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会主席团举行第三次会议 达娃次仁主持
articles.title_en: Presidium of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China Holds Third Meeting, Chaired by Dawa Tsering
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会主席团举行第三次会议，由达娃次仁主持，会议就大会相关议程和事项进行研究部署。
articles.summary_en: The presidium of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China held its third meeting, chaired by Dawa Tsering, to deliberate on agenda items of the congress.

articles.title_zh: 李强结束出访回到北京
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Returns to Beijing After Concluding Foreign Visit
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日上午，国务院总理李强在结束中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤后乘包机回到北京，国务委员兼国务院秘书长吴政隆等陪同人员同机抵达。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang returned to Beijing by chartered plane on the morning of Oct 22 after concluding the 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Regular Meeting, arriving with State Councilor and Secretary-General Wu Zhenglong and other accompanying officials.

articles.title_zh: 中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤联合公报
articles.title_en: Joint Communiqué of the 31st Regular Meeting of Chinese and Russian Heads of Government
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月20日至21日，国务院总理李强访问俄罗斯，在圣彼得堡与米舒斯京举行中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤并发表联合公报。
articles.summary_en: From Oct. 20-21, 2026, Premier Li Qiang visited Russia and held the 31st China-Russia regular heads-of-government meeting with Mishustin in St. Petersburg, issuing a joint communiqué.

articles.title_zh: 自治区“一表通”工作试点总结暨全面推广启动大会召开，韦秀长主持会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Meeting on Pilot Summary and Full Rollout of Tibet's "One Form" System Held, Chaired by Wei Xiuchang
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，西藏自治区“一表通”工作试点总结暨全面推广启动大会在拉萨召开，自治区副主席韦秀长主持会议并讲话，部署为基层减负的全面推广工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Tibet held a meeting in Lhasa to summarize the pilot of its "One Form" (Yibiaotong) reporting system and launch its full rollout; Vice Chairman Wei Xiuchang chaired the meeting and called for reducing burdens on grassroots units.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持召开西藏自治区人民政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Karma Tenzin Chairs Expanded Party Group Meeting of Tibet Autonomous Region Government
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，西藏自治区主席、政府党组书记嘎玛泽登在拉萨主持召开政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示重要贺信精神，部署意识形态与文化强区建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman and government Party group secretary Karma Tenzin chaired an expanded Party group meeting in Lhasa to convey and study Xi Jinping's key speeches and instructions and to plan ideological and cultural development work.

tags.name_en: Sense of Community for the Chinese Nation

tags_en: Sense of Community for the Chinese Nation

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升在那曲市调研时强调：用心用情用力抓好社会稳定乡村振兴民生保障
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Nagqu, Urges Solid Work on Social Stability, Rural Revitalization and Livelihoods
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日至21日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在那曲市色尼区、嘉黎县等地调研社会稳定、基层治理、乡村振兴与民生保障，并看望慰问干部职工。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 19 to 21, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected counties in Nagqu on social stability, grassroots governance, rural revitalization and livelihood support, and met local officials and workers.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森调研农业生产及秋收工作
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Inspects Agricultural Production and Autumn Harvest Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，盘锦市委书记王炳森到当地农业企业、合作社调研水稻收储、大米加工及梅花鹿养殖，部署秋收与粮食安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, Panjin Party Secretary Wang Bingsen visited local agricultural firms and cooperatives to inspect rice procurement, processing and sika deer farming, and to press for steady autumn harvest and food security work.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国青年企业家三亚行招商推介会举行
articles.title_en: 2026 China Young Entrepreneurs Sanya Investment Promotion Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，2026中国青年企业家三亚行招商推介会在三亚举行，三亚市委书记王祺扬出席并致辞，推介海南自贸港机遇与产业合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the 2026 China Young Entrepreneurs Sanya Investment Promotion Conference was held in Sanya. Wang Qiyang, Sanya Party Secretary, attended and spoke on Hainan free trade port opportunities and industrial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰带队拜访华南理工大学 加强产学研政协同创新 赋能先进制造业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to South China University of Technology to Strengthen Industry-Academia-Research Collaboration and Boost Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，汕尾市委书记逯峰带队拜访华南理工大学，与校党委书记于祥成会谈，就加强产学研政协同创新、赋能先进制造业高质量发展深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng visited South China University of Technology, meeting Party Secretary Yu Xiangcheng on deeper industry-academia-research cooperation to boost advanced manufacturing.

tags.name_en: Hundreds of Thousands and Millions Project

tags_en: Hundreds of Thousands and Millions Project

articles.title_zh: 杨洪涛到泰山区和泰安技师学院调研 强调深化产教融合 实现产业与教育“双向奔赴”
articles.title_en: Yang Hongtao Inspects Taishan District and Tai'an Technician College, Stressing Industry-Education Integration
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，泰安市委书记杨洪涛到泰山区和泰安技师学院调研，强调让学科跟着产业走、专业围着需求转，深化产教融合，并部署打造泰山机器人产业园。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Tai'an Party Secretary Yang Hongtao inspected Taishan District and Tai'an Technician College, urging deeper industry-education integration and planning a Mount Tai robot industrial park.

articles.title_zh: 省人大常委会来泰开展推进普惠托育服务工作专项监督调研
articles.title_en: Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Special Supervision Research on Inclusive Childcare Services in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日至21日，江苏省人大常委会副主任张爱军带队赴泰州，就推进普惠托育服务工作开展专题调研，实地考察托育机构并召开座谈会听取意见建议。
