articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，山东省政府新闻办发布会通报，前三季度山东进出口总值2.75万亿元，同比增长4.8%，汽车出口684.3亿元、增长46.2%。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Shandong reported foreign trade of 2.75 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, up 4.8% year on year, with auto exports rising 46.2% to 68.43 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 推动全过程人民民主走深走实
articles.title_en: Advancing Whole-Process People's Democracy in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，上海市人大常委会召开理论研讨会，围绕推动全过程人民民主融入城市治理现代化开展研讨交流，常委会主任黄莉新出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a theoretical seminar on integrating whole-process people's democracy into modern urban governance. Director Huang Lixin addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 推进应急管理体系和能力现代化建设
articles.title_en: Advancing the Modernization of the Emergency Management System and Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会，应急管理部、国家消防救援局等介绍“十五五”时期应急管理体系和能力现代化建设的重点举措。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where the Ministry of Emergency Management and other agencies outlined measures to modernize China's emergency management system and capacity under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：在纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会上的讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Rally Marking the 90th Anniversary of the Victory of the Red Army's Long March
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京举行，习近平发表讲话，号召大力弘扬伟大长征精神、走好新的长征路。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, 2026, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at a rally in Beijing marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, urging the Party and the people to carry forward the Long March spirit on the new journey.

articles.title_zh: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在京隆重举行 习近平出席大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Grand Ceremony Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory Held in Beijing; Xi Jinping Attends and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月22日上午，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，李强、赵乐际、王沪宁等出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 22, 2026, a grand ceremony marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory was held in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech, attended by Li Qiang, Zhao Leji and others.

tags.name_en: Communist Party of China Central Committee
90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory

tags_en: Communist Party of China Central Committee
90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Meeting Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日上午，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平发表重要讲话，李强、赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希、韩正出席，赵乐际主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 22, a meeting marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech. Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi and Han Zheng attended, with Zhao Leji presiding.

articles.title_zh: 李乐成参加安庆市代表团审议
articles.title_en: Li Lecheng Joins Anqing Delegation in Deliberating Provincial Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，李乐成到安庆市代表团参加审议省委报告，强调推动高质量发展、文旅融合、长江生态保护和民生改善。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Li Lecheng joined the Anqing delegation to review the provincial Party congress report, calling for high-quality development, industrial upgrading, ecological protection and better livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 王东伟参加安徽省第十二次党代会企业高校代表团审议
articles.title_en: Wang Dongwei Joins Enterprise and University Delegation Deliberations at Anhui Provincial Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，王东伟参加安徽省第十二次党代会企业高校代表团审议，与代表们共同审议省委报告和省纪委工作报告，强调推动企业高校协同创新。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Wang Dongwei joined the enterprise-university delegation at Anhui's 12th Party Congress to review provincial committee and discipline reports, urging deeper industry-academia collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 2026年世界科技与发展论坛在渝开幕 袁家军出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 2026 World Science and Technology Development Forum Opens in Chongqing, Yuan Jiajun Attends and Addresses the Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日上午，2026年世界科技与发展论坛在重庆开幕，重庆市委书记袁家军出席并致辞，全国政协副主席、中国科协主席王光谦致辞并宣布开幕。论坛聚焦未来产业新生态与国际科技合作。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Science and Technology Development Forum opened in Chongqing on the morning of Oct 21. Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun attended and spoke, while Wang Guangqian, CPPCC vice chair and CAST president, addressed the ceremony and declared it open.

articles.title_zh: 广西专题会研究台风“美莎克”及柳州5.2级震群地震灾后恢复重建推进工作
articles.title_en: Guangxi Governor Wei Tao Chairs Meeting on Post-Disaster Reconstruction After Typhoon Maysak and Liuzhou Earthquake Swarm
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，广西自治区主席韦韬主持召开专题会，研究台风“美莎克”及柳州5.2级震群地震灾后恢复重建推进工作，部署确保恢复重建按时保质完成。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Guangxi Chairman Wei Tao chaired a special meeting on reconstruction after Typhoon Maysak and the Liuzhou magnitude-5.2 earthquake swarm, ordering the work to be completed on schedule and to standard.

articles.title_zh: 2026年四季度广西经济发展调度会在南宁召开
articles.title_en: Guangxi Holds Q4 2026 Economic Development Meeting in Nanning
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，2026年四季度广西经济发展调度会在南宁召开，自治区党委书记陈刚讲话，主席韦韬主持，部署冲刺全年经济目标。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Guangxi held its Q4 2026 economic development meeting in Nanning. Party Secretary Chen Gang spoke and Governor Wei Tao presided, urging efforts to meet annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟：围绕中心服务大局推动人大工作高质量发展 更好把人民代表大会制度优势转化为治理效能
articles.title_en: Xu Lin: Focus on the Central Task and Serve the Overall Situation to Advance High-Quality People's Congress Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，贵州省委人大工作会议在贵阳召开，省委书记徐麟出席并讲话，要求围绕中心服务大局推动人大工作高质量发展，省长李炳军主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Guizhou's provincial Party committee held a people's congress work conference in Guiyang. Secretary Xu Lin urged high-quality legislation and oversight; Governor Li Bingjun presided.

articles.title_zh: 培育消费新动能 拓展开放新空间——国新办发布会聚焦“十五五”商务高质量发展
articles.title_en: Cultivating New Consumption Momentum, Expanding New Opening-Up Space: SCIO Briefing Focuses on High-Quality Commerce Development in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，国务院新闻办公室在北京举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，商务部有关负责人介绍培育消费新动能、推动贸易强国建设与双向投资等举措。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the State Council Information Office held a briefing in Beijing where Commerce Ministry officials outlined plans to boost consumption, build trade strength and expand two-way investment under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 第一观察丨党和人民军队铿锵前进的制胜之道
articles.title_en: Xinhua Observation: The Winning Path of the Party and the People's Army
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日上午，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平阐述党和人民军队铿锵前进的制胜之道。
articles.summary_en: A grand gathering marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Oct 22, where Xi Jinping expounded on the Party and the people's army's path to victory.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 我国已同153国缔结3196对友好城市（省州）关系
articles.title_en: China Has Established 3,196 Sister-City (Province-State) Ties with 153 Countries
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，2026中国国际友好城市大会在西安闭幕，会上签署12项友城结好和务实合作协议并发布《西安倡议》；我国已同153国缔结3196对友城关系。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China International Friendship Cities Conference closed in Xi'an on Oct 22, where 12 sister-city and cooperation agreements were signed and the Xi'an Initiative released. China now has 3,196 sister-city (province-state) ties with 153 countries.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部工业软件标准化技术委员会成立
articles.title_en: MIIT Industrial Software Standardization Technical Committee Established
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部工业软件标准化技术委员会成立大会日前在杭州召开，秘书处设在工业和信息化部电子第五研究所，并召开首次全体委员会议审议章程等文件。
articles.summary_en: The founding meeting of the MIIT Industrial Software Standardization Technical Committee was held in Hangzhou, with its secretariat at the Fifth Electronic Research Institute of MIIT; the committee held its first plenary session to approve its charter and work rules.

articles.title_zh: 两部门派工作组赴浙江协助指导防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Two Departments Dispatch Work Team to Zhejiang to Assist in Flood Control and Typhoon Response
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日8时，国家防总、应急管理部针对上海、浙江、福建启动防汛防台风四级应急响应，并派工作组赴浙江指导防御超强台风“蔷琵”。
articles.summary_en: At 8 a.m. on Oct 22, the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management launched a Level IV flood and typhoon emergency response for Shanghai, Zhejiang and Fujian, and sent a work team to Zhejiang to guide defenses against Super Typhoon Champi.

articles.title_zh: 碳排放双控，工业和信息化领域怎样推进
articles.title_en: How the Industrial and IT Sector Will Advance Dual Control of Carbon Emissions
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日新华社解读工业和信息化部印发的《加快构建工业和信息化领域碳排放双控工作体系实施方案（2026—2030年）》，明确零碳工厂、能效提升等量化指标与实施路径。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua on Oct 22 interpreted the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology's new implementation plan (2026-2030) for dual control of carbon emissions in the industrial and IT sector, setting quantified targets such as zero-carbon factories and energy-efficiency gains.

articles.title_zh: “党的创新理论大家读”丛书（第一辑）出版发行
articles.title_en: Book Series "Reading the Party's Innovative Theory Together" (Volume 1) Published and Released
articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部理论局组织专家学者编写的“党的创新理论大家读”丛书第一辑共5册，近日由人民出版社、学习出版社联合出版发行。
articles.summary_en: The first five-volume set of the "Reading the Party's Innovative Theory Together" series, compiled by the Theoretical Bureau of the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department, has been jointly published by the People's Publishing House and the Xuexi Publishing House.

articles.title_en: Huaihe Flood Control Headquarters and Huaihe Commission Launch Level-IV Flood Emergency Response for Jiangsu's Huaihe River System
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，淮河防总、淮委针对江苏省淮河水系启动防汛四级应急响应和洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，以应对台风“蔷琵”外围环流带来的强降雨。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, the Huaihe Flood Control Headquarters and Huaihe Commission activated a Level-IV flood response for Jiangsu's Huaihe river system ahead of heavy rain from Typhoon Champi.

articles.title_zh: 葛慧君在日照市调研
articles.title_en: Ge Huijun Conducts Research Tour in Rizhao
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日至21日，山东省政协主席葛慧君赴日照市，围绕“打造现代海洋经济发展高地”专题协商议题及政协工作开展调研，考察企业并了解协商议事室建设。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 20 to 21, Shandong CPPCC Chairman Ge Huijun visited Rizhao to research the consultative topic of building a modern marine economy hub, inspecting enterprises and grassroots consultative venues.

articles.title_zh: 天津市委常委会召开扩大会议 陈敏尔主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Party Committee Holds Enlarged Standing Committee Meeting, Chaired by Chen Min'er
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，天津市委书记陈敏尔主持召开市委常委会扩大会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取前三季度经济运行等情况汇报，分析形势并部署下步工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Tianjin party secretary Chen Min'er chaired an enlarged meeting of the municipal party committee's standing committee to study Xi Jinping's remarks, review third-quarter economic performance and plan next steps.

articles.title_zh: 林毅夫：第四次工业革命中，我们跟发达国家站在同一起跑线
articles.title_en: Justin Yifu Lin: China Stands on the Same Starting Line as Developed Countries in the Fourth Industrial Revolution
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日，第二十六届中国经济学年会在北京师范大学举行，林毅夫在会上表示，在人工智能引领的第四次工业革命中，中国与发达国家站在同一起跑线上。
articles.summary_en: At the 26th China Economics Annual Meeting at Beijing Normal University on Oct 17, Justin Yifu Lin said China stands level with developed nations in the AI-driven fourth industrial revolution.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境部副部长李高：我将再次担任中国代表团团长
articles.title_en: Vice Minister Li Gao: I Will Again Lead China's Delegation to COP31
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，生态环境部副部长李高表示将再次担任中国代表团团长，率团出席11月在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Oct 21, Vice Minister of Ecology and Environment Li Gao said he will again head China's delegation to COP31, to be held in Antalya, Turkey, in November.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：敦促美方立即停止对古巴的封锁和任何形式的胁迫施压
articles.title_en: Chinese Foreign Ministry Urges US to Immediately End Blockade and Coercive Pressure on Cuba
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京例行记者会上表示，中方反对滥用司法手段对古巴施压，敦促美方立即停止对古巴的封锁和胁迫施压。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning told a regular press briefing in Beijing that China opposes using judicial means to pressure Cuba and urged the US to immediately end its blockade and coercive pressure on Cuba.

articles.title_zh: 国家知识产权局解读知识产权强国建设“江苏实践”
articles.title_en: CNIPA Explains Jiangsu's Practice in Building an Intellectual Property Powerhouse
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，国家知识产权局在北京举行新闻发布会，解读知识产权促进江苏新质生产力发展的“江苏实践”，介绍知识产权与人工智能双向赋能的成效与举措。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, China's National Intellectual Property Administration held a press conference in Beijing on Jiangsu's practice in fostering new quality productive forces, highlighting mutual empowerment between IP and AI.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国国际友好城市大会西安开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 China International Friendship Cities Conference Opens in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 2026中国国际友好城市大会10月21日在陕西西安开幕，60多个国家700余名代表与会，将签署友城结好协议并发布《西安倡议》。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China International Friendship Cities Conference opened in Xi'an on Oct 21 with over 700 delegates from 60-plus countries; it will sign city-pairing deals and issue the Xi'an Initiative.

articles.title_zh: 中钢协：9月全国生产粗钢7359万吨，同比增长0.1%
articles.title_en: CISA: China's September Crude Steel Output Reaches 73.59 Million Tonnes, Up 0.1% YoY
articles.summary_zh: 中国钢铁工业协会10月21日发布数据，2026年9月全国生产粗钢7359万吨，同比增长0.1%；1-9月累计生产粗钢7.25亿吨，同比下降2.9%。
articles.summary_en: The China Iron and Steel Association said on Oct 21 that China produced 73.59 million tonnes of crude steel in September 2026, up 0.1% year on year, while output for January-September fell 2.9% to 725 million tonnes.

articles.title_zh: 艺人张凌赫赴台遭拒 国台办促摒弃政治操弄
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Urges DPP to Abandon Political Manipulation After Artist Zhang Linghe Denied Entry to Taiwan
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，国台办在北京举行例行新闻发布会，发言人张晗就大陆艺人张凌赫申请赴台举办见面会遭拒回应，敦促民进党当局摒弃政治操弄、取消不合理限制。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press conference in Beijing on Oct 21, Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson Zhang Han urged the DPP authorities to abandon political manipulation and lift unreasonable restrictions after mainland artist Zhang Linghe was denied permission to hold a fan event in Taiwan.

articles.title_zh: 洪秀柱：新疆不怕人来看
articles.title_en: Hung Hsiu-chu: Xinjiang Is Not Afraid of Visitors
articles.summary_zh: 9月，中国国民党前主席洪秀柱赴新疆参访并参观自治区成立70周年成就展，近日接受中新网专访，以“新、稳、暖”概括此行，呼吁台湾青年亲身走访。
articles.summary_en: In September, former KMT chairwoman Hung Hsiu-chu visited Xinjiang and its 70th anniversary achievement exhibition; in an interview with China News Service she summed up the region as "new, stable and warm" and urged Taiwanese youth to see it for themselves.

articles.title_zh: “五羊星座”先导星成功发射 将服务粤港澳大湾区等地
articles.title_en: Pilot Satellite for Wuyang Constellation Successfully Launched, Will Serve Greater Bay Area and Beyond
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日11时39分，谷神星一号海射型遥八运载火箭在山东日照附近海域成功发射，将“五羊星座”先导星西光肆号01星送入预定轨道。
articles.summary_en: At 11:39 on Oct 21, the Ceres-1 sea-launch rocket lifted off from waters near Rizhao, Shandong, successfully placing the Xiguang-4 01 satellite, a pilot for the Wuyang Constellation, into orbit.

articles.title_zh: 检察机关依法分别对黄伟、姚洪仲、包野、杜善周、罗佳玲提起公诉
articles.title_en: Prosecutors File Public Charges Against Huang Wei, Yao Hongzhong, Bao Ye, Du Shanzhou and Luo Jialing
articles.summary_zh: 贵州、青海、内蒙古等地检察机关日前分别对黄伟、姚洪仲、包野、杜善周、罗佳玲涉嫌受贿、挪用公款等案提起公诉。
articles.summary_en: Prosecutors in Guizhou, Qinghai and Inner Mongolia have filed public charges against five former officials, including Huang Wei, Yao Hongzhong, Bao Ye, Du Shanzhou and Luo Jialing, on suspicion of bribery and misappropriation of public funds.

articles.title_zh: 硬X射线自由电子激光装置实现首次出光
articles.title_en: Hard X-ray Free Electron Laser Facility Achieves First Lasing
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，上海科技大学宣布，国家重大科技基础设施硬X射线自由电子激光装置（SHINE）成功实现首次出光，向2027年底建成投用迈出关键一步。

articles.title_zh: 淮安市领导接待信访群众
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Meets Petitioners at City Petition Reception Center
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，淮安市委书记顾坤到市人民来访接待中心接待信访群众，当面倾听诉求并现场会办信访事项，要求依法依规解决群众合理诉求、推动源头治理。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun received petitioners at the city's petition reception center, hearing their grievances and handling cases on site, urging lawful resolution of reasonable demands and stronger source-level governance.

articles.title_zh: 省第十二次党代会淮北市代表团继续审议省委报告和省纪委工作报告
articles.title_en: Huaibei Delegation to Anhui's 12th Provincial Party Congress Continues Deliberations on Party Committee and Discipline Commission Reports
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，安徽省第十二次党代会淮北市代表团举行全体会议，继续审议省委报告和省纪委工作报告，代表们就绿色食品产业发展、全面从严治党等议题发言。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the Huaibei delegation to Anhui's 12th Provincial Party Congress met to continue deliberating the provincial Party committee and discipline inspection commission reports, with delegates speaking on green food industry growth and Party discipline.

articles.title_zh: 立足自身条件发挥比较优势 加快推进皖北地区全面振兴
articles.title_en: Leveraging Local Conditions and Comparative Advantages to Accelerate Comprehensive Revitalization of Northern Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日晚，王东伟参加安徽省第十二次党代会淮南市代表团审议省委报告，强调发挥比较优势，加快皖北全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 19, Wang Dongwei joined Huainan delegates at Anhui's 12th Party Congress to review the provincial report, urging faster revitalization of northern Anhui.

articles.title_zh: 市十五届人大常委会召开第60次主任会议

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Huangshi's municipal people's congress standing committee held its 60th chairpersons' meeting, chaired by Yu Yuanhan, to review budget, public transport and employment issues.

articles.title_zh: 任维：坚定信心乘势而上 全力以赴完成全年目标任务
articles.title_en: Ren Wei: Firm Confidence, Seize the Momentum, and Go All Out to Meet This Year's Targets
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，西藏自治区党委常委、常务副主席任维在拉萨主持召开经济运行调度会，分析1至9月全区经济运行情况，并部署四季度扩大投资、提振消费等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: Ren Wei, executive vice chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, chaired an economic operation meeting in Lhasa on Oct 19 to review Jan-Sept performance and set fourth-quarter priorities on investment, industry and consumption.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺中央社会主义学院建院70周年强调 持续加强政治培训广泛凝聚政治共识 更好服务党和国家工作大局
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter Marking 70th Anniversary of the Central Institute of Socialism, Urging Continued Political Training and Broader Political Consensus
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，中央社会主义学院建院70周年庆祝大会在北京举行，会上宣读习近平贺信，王沪宁出席并讲话，李干杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, a ceremony marking the 70th anniversary of the Central Institute of Socialism was held in Beijing, where Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter was read; Wang Huning attended and spoke, with Li Ganjie presiding.

articles.title_zh: 三亚市委常委会召开会议 研究部署生态环保、卫生健康、外资外贸等工作
articles.title_en: Sanya Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on Ecology, Health, Foreign Trade
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，三亚市委常委会召开会议，王祺扬主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和贺信精神，部署生态环保、卫生健康、外资外贸等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the Sanya Municipal Party Standing Committee met under Wang Qiyang to study Xi Jinping's speeches and messages and deploy work on ecology, health, foreign investment and trade.

articles.title_zh: 潮阳区召开海门镇“百千万工程”工作专题会议
articles.title_en: Chaoyang District Holds Special Meeting on Haimen Town's 'Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand' Project
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，汕头市潮阳区在海门镇召开“百千万工程”专题会议，区委书记尤朝东主持，部署镇域高质量发展和滨海旅游、临港产业建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Chaoyang District, Shantou, held a special meeting in Haimen Town on the rural revitalization project, chaired by district party secretary You Chaodong.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到市消防救援支队开展调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Shantou Fire and Rescue Detachment, Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到市消防救援支队调研并召开座谈会，强调汲取“12·9”重大火灾事故教训，系统推进消防安全标本兼治。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 19, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected the city's fire and rescue detachment and chaired a symposium, urging systematic efforts to address both symptoms and root causes of fire safety after the "12·9" major fire.

articles.title_zh: 陈涛带队督导重点项目建设情况
articles.title_en: Chen Tao Leads Inspection of Key Project Construction in Shantou
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，汕头市市长陈涛带队赴金平区、龙湖区督导重点项目建设，现场协调解决困难，要求加快项目建成投用。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 20, Shantou Mayor Chen Tao led an inspection of key projects in Jinping and Longhu districts, urging faster construction and on-site resolution of obstacles.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰率队到广州拜访国家新型储能创新中心、白云电气集团有限公司

articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，汕尾市委书记逯峰带队赴广州拜访国家新型储能创新中心和白云电气集团，围绕深化战略合作、延链补链强链座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng led a delegation to Guangzhou to visit the National Innovation Center for New Energy Storage and Baiyun Electric Group, discussing cooperation on advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰率队到广州拜访国家新型储能创新中心、白云电气集团有限公司

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 20, Lu Feng, Party Secretary of Shanwei, led a delegation to Guangzhou to visit the National New Energy Storage Innovation Center and Baiyun Electric Group, holding talks on deepening strategic cooperation and strengthening the advanced manufacturing supply chain.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会召开专题汇报会 推动“6+5+5”重点领域项目谋划储备建设

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the Shanwei Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a special report meeting on planning and reserving projects in the “6+5+5” key areas, with deputy director Lin Jun speaking and vice mayor Zhuang Hongqin outlining next steps.

articles.title_zh: 石嘴山市第十五届人民代表大会常务委员会举行第三十四次会议

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the 15th Shizuishan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 34th session, reviewing multiple reports and rules drafts, and approving resignations and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委召开理论学习中心组学习会

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Ningxia Regional Party Committee Standing Committee Meets, Li Yifei Presides and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，宁夏回族自治区党委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话，自治区党委书记李邑飞主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, the Standing Committee of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Party Committee met to study Xi Jinping's speech at the National Health Conference, with Regional Party Secretary Li Yifei presiding and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 李强出席上海合作组织成员国政府首脑（总理）理事会第二十五次会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends 25th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of Government

articles.summary_en: On October 20, Premier Li Qiang attended the 25th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of Government in Dushanbe, where he urged deeper practical cooperation under the Shanghai Spirit and signed a joint communique.

articles.title_zh: 江苏与中央广播电视总台深化战略合作 信长星慎海雄出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Jiangsu and China Media Group Deepen Strategic Cooperation; Xin Changxing and Shen Haixiong Attend and Deliver Remarks

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Jiangsu Province and China Media Group signed a 'Brand Power Project' strategic cooperation agreement in Nanjing, with Party Secretary Xin Changxing and CMG head Shen Haixiong attending and delivering remarks, launching several media initiatives.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记心中的伟大远征
articles.title_en: The Great Expedition in General Secretary Xi Jinping's Heart

articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a feature on Oct. 21 reviewing Xi Jinping's deep attention to the Long March and his visits to key sites, highlighting the enduring significance of the Long March spirit.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬延安精神 携手互利共赢 努力为苏陕协作走深走实作出更大贡献

articles.summary_en: From Oct 19 to 20, Wuxi Party Secretary Jiang Feng led a delegation to Yan'an; the two cities held a joint meeting on east-west cooperation and signed a 15th Five-Year Framework Agreement on paired cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市党政代表团到陕西铜川学习考察

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Yangjiang's municipal Party Committee held a theoretical study session, where scholar Zheng Yongnian gave a lecture on the APEC China year and building a world-class Greater Bay Area.

articles.title_zh: 银川市中卫市算力产业协同发展座谈会召开 全面落实“双城驱动”战略
articles.title_en: Yinchuan and Zhongwei Hold Symposium on Coordinated Development of Computing Power Industry, Vowing Full Implementation of 'Twin-City Drive' Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，银川市中卫市算力产业协同发展座谈会在中卫召开，赵旭辉、刘国强出席并讲话，双方就共建算网协同体系、共育算力产业生态等达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Yinchuan and Zhongwei held a symposium in Zhongwei on coordinated development of the computing power industry, with Zhao Xuhui and Liu Guoqiang speaking and both sides agreeing to jointly build a computing network and industrial ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏自治区党委政府召开2026年第二次为企业纾困解难集中办公会
articles.title_en: Ningxia Party Committee and Government Hold Second 2026 On-Site Meeting to Relieve Enterprise Difficulties

articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Ningxia's Party committee and government held their second 2026 on-site meeting on easing enterprise difficulties, with Li Yifei speaking and Zhang Yupu presiding, focusing on advanced manufacturing and resolving company concerns.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会开展人工智能专题培训

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the Yingkou Municipal People's Congress held a special training session on artificial intelligence, attended by director Shi Weidong, focusing on AI trends and industrial policy to boost deputies' governance capacity.

articles.title_zh: 李强在上海合作组织成员国政府首脑（总理）理事会第二十五次会议上的讲话

articles.summary_en: On October 20, 2026, Premier Li Qiang attended and addressed the 25th SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting in Dushanbe, urging stronger institutional efficiency and more concrete cooperation projects.

articles.title_zh: “一张工单”贯通民生服务“全链条”

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆调研县（市、区）国资国企运营情况

articles.summary_en: On Oct 13 and 20, Yuxi Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun visited Jiangchuan, Yuanjiang and Xinping to survey county-level SOE operations and push deeper state-owned enterprise reform.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐赴金湾区走访调研外资企业，支持外资外企在珠海更好发展

articles.title_zh: 感悟长征之喻：习近平内蒙古考察寄语算力建设者

articles.title_en: China Releases First Batch of National Standards for Humanoid Robots
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月15日，市场监管总局发布我国首批六项人形机器人国家标准，涉及技术要求和仿真测试平台，将于2027年4月1日起实施。
articles.summary_en: China's market regulator released the country's first six national standards for humanoid robots on Oct 15, 2026, covering technical requirements and simulation test platforms. They take effect on April 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 教育部等三部门部署防控儿童青少年高度近视
articles.title_en: Three Departments Including MOE Deploy Measures to Prevent and Control High Myopia in Children and Adolescents
articles.summary_zh: 近日，教育部、国家卫生健康委、国家疾控局联合印发通知，部署防控儿童青少年高度近视，从用眼环境、户外活动、视力监测等六方面提出举措。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education, the National Health Commission, and the National Disease Control and Prevention Administration jointly issued a notice to prevent and control high myopia among children and adolescents, setting out six measures covering eye-care environments, outdoor activity, and vision monitoring.

tags.name_en: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration

tags_en: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration

articles.title_zh: 济南市文学艺术界联合会第七次代表大会开幕 刘强讲话
articles.title_en: Seventh Congress of Jinan Federation of Literary and Art Circles Opens, Liu Qiang Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，济南市文学艺术界联合会第七次代表大会在舜耕会堂开幕，市委书记刘强出席并讲话，于海田、韩金峰、杨峰等出席。
articles.summary_en: On October 20, the Seventh Congress of the Jinan Federation of Literary and Art Circles opened at Shungeng Hall. Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研企业运营和安全生产工作时强调：主动为企解难题办实事 抓紧抓实抓细安全生产
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Enterprise Operations and Workplace Safety in Laiwu District
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，济南市市长于海田到莱芜区调研企业运营和安全生产，强调精准落实惠企政策、主动为企业解难题，并抓紧抓实安全生产各项工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian inspected enterprises in Laiwu District, urging precise implementation of pro-business policies, proactive problem-solving for firms, and strict workplace safety measures.

articles.title_zh: “单家集夜话”里的为民初心
articles.title_en: The Original Aspiration to Serve the People in the 'Danjiaji Night Talk'
articles.summary_zh: 新华社回顾1935年10月毛泽东率中央红军途经宁夏西吉单家集，与宗教人士促膝夜谈、宣讲党的民族政策，讲述红军为民初心与民族团结的当代传承。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua looks back to October 1935, when Mao Zedong led the Central Red Army through Danjiaji village in Xiji, Ningxia, and held a night-long talk with religious figures to explain the Party's ethnic policies, highlighting the Red Army's commitment to the people and ethnic unity today.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：坚决反对美污名化中国企业并实施制裁
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry: China Firmly Opposes US Stigmatizing Chinese Firms and Imposing Sanctions
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，商务部新闻发言人在北京表示，美方炒作所谓“窃取商业秘密”问题、污名化中国企业并实施制裁，中方坚决反对，并敦促美方纠正错误做法。
articles.summary_en: On October 20 in Beijing, a Commerce Ministry spokesperson said China firmly opposes the US stoking claims of "trade secret theft" to stigmatize Chinese firms and impose sanctions, urging Washington to correct its approach.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在一幅油画前驻足凝视
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Pauses Before a Painting, Recalling the Xiangjiang Battle
articles.summary_zh: 中新网「习言道」回顾2021年4月习近平在广西桂林红军长征湘江战役纪念馆驻足凝视陈树湘油画，强调长征精神与理想信念。
articles.summary_en: A China News Service feature recalls Xi Jinping pausing before a painting of martyr Chen Shuxiang at the Xiangjiang Battle memorial in Guilin, Guangxi in April 2021, stressing the Long March spirit and firm ideals.

articles.title_zh: 稳、新、韧！权威解读中国经济“三季报”
articles.title_en: NDRC Interprets China's Q3 Economic Report: Steady, New, Resilient
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，国家发展改革委举行新闻发布会解读前三季度经济数据，副司长左刚称经济可用稳、新、韧概括，下一步将推出增量政策、扩大内需。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the NDRC held a briefing on China's Q3 economic data; official Zuo Gang said the economy is steady, innovative and resilient, pledging new incremental policies and steps to expand domestic demand.

articles.title_zh: 国家发展改革委资源节约和环境保护司原司长任树本接受纪律审查和监察调查
articles.title_en: Former NDRC Resource Conservation and Environmental Protection Department Director-General Ren Shuben Under Disciplinary Review and Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据中央纪委国家监委消息，国家发展改革委资源节约和环境保护司原司长、中国招标投标协会原会长任树本涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动投案，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Ren Shuben, former director-general of the NDRC's Resource Conservation and Environmental Protection Department and former head of the China Tendering and Bidding Association, has turned himself in and is under disciplinary review and investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 《交通管理电子证照 机动车行驶证》国家标准发布
articles.title_en: National Standard for Electronic Vehicle License Issued
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局（国家标准委）批准发布《交通管理电子证照 机动车行驶证》国家标准，标准自2027年4月1日起实施，统一证照信息、授权使用与安全防护要求。
articles.summary_en: China's market regulator approved a national standard for electronic vehicle licenses, effective April 1, 2027, unifying license data, authorization rules and security protections.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期将推动出台《生产安全事故隐患排查治理条例》
articles.title_en: China to Introduce Regulation on Workplace Accident Hazard Investigation and Governance During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，国务院新闻办公室举行“开局起步‘十五五’”新闻发布会，介绍将推动出台《生产安全事故隐患排查治理条例》，推动企业落实安全投入等“四个到位”。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, the State Council Information Office held a press conference announcing that a regulation on workplace accident hazard investigation and governance will be introduced during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 盐城唯一！盐南高新区新河街道项目亮相2026物理AI与世界模型大会并成功签约
articles.title_en: Yancheng's Only Entry: Xinhe Subdistrict Project Signs at 2026 Physical AI and World Models Conference
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，2026物理AI与世界模型大会在南京召开，盐城盐南高新区新河街道与际上导航项目现场签约，将在盐城设立全资子公司。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the 2026 Physical AI and World Models Conference opened in Nanjing, where Xinhe Subdistrict of Yannan High-tech Zone, Yancheng, signed an investment deal with Jishang Navigation, which will set up a wholly owned subsidiary in Yancheng.

articles.title_zh: 数看海南——自贸风来万象新
articles.title_en: Hainan in Numbers: Free Trade Port Ushers in New Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 2026年前三季度海南货物进出口总额达2854.4亿元、增长49.8%；自2025年12月全岛封关后，自贸港开放政策持续落地生效。
articles.summary_en: Hainan's goods trade hit 285.44 billion yuan in the first nine months of 2026, up 49.8%, as free trade port policies took effect following the island-wide customs closure in December 2025.

articles.title_zh: 成都市教育局回应“取消中考”建议：完全取消尚不具备条件
articles.title_en: Chengdu Education Bureau on Abolishing Zhongkao: Full Cancellation Not Yet Feasible
articles.summary_zh: 成都市教育局近日在“问政四川”答复网友，称中考是高中招生基本制度，完全取消尚不具备条件，将扩大指标到校、推进普职融通以弱化一考影响。
articles.summary_en: Chengdu's education bureau told residents on a government Q&A platform that the zhongkao remains the basic system for high school admissions and full abolition is not yet feasible, pledging gradual reforms.

articles.title_zh: 城中村改造和停车难治理，银川如何算好“空间账”
articles.title_en: How Yinchuan Balances Its 'Spatial Ledger' in Urban Village Renovation and Parking Governance
articles.summary_zh: 银川依托国土空间规划政策，推进兴庆区北塔三、四、六队城中村原址改造安置，并在中山公园苗圃地下建成265个车位停车场，缓解老城区停车难。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan is using territorial spatial planning policy to redevelop the Beita urban village in Xingqing district with in-place resettlement and to build a 265-space underground parking lot beneath Zhongshan Park, easing parking shortages in the old city.

articles.title_zh: 深入贯彻习近平强军思想 推动安徽国防动员和后备力量建设再上新台阶
articles.title_en: Li Lecheng Urges Deeper Implementation of Xi Jinping Thought on Strengthening the Military to Advance Anhui's National Defense Mobilization and Reserve Force Building
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，李乐成参加驻皖解放军和武警部队代表团审议省委报告，强调深入贯彻习近平强军思想，推动安徽国防动员和后备力量建设再上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 20, Li Lecheng joined the delegation of PLA and Armed Police units stationed in Anhui to review the provincial party committee work report, urging deeper implementation of Xi Jinping Thought on Strengthening the Military and further progress in Anhui's defense mobilization and reserve force building.

articles.title_zh: 李锦斌、王清宪、徐立全、唐良智参加代表团审议省委报告
articles.title_en: Li Jinbin, Wang Qingxian, Xu Liquan and Tang Liangzhi Join Delegation Deliberations on Provincial Party Committee Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日下午，李锦斌、王清宪、徐立全、唐良智分别在淮南、六安、铜陵、安庆市代表团，与代表共同审议安徽省委报告。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 19, Li Jinbin, Wang Qingxian, Xu Liquan and Tang Liangzhi joined delegates from Huainan, Lu'an, Tongling and Anqing to deliberate the Anhui Provincial Party Committee report.

articles.title_zh: 卓朴智能战略投资签约大会在黄山市徽州区举行
articles.title_en: Zhuopu Intelligent Holds Strategic Investment Signing Ceremony in Huizhou District, Huangshan
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，工业母机产业投资基金、温润投资、深高新投三家机构与安徽卓朴智能装备股份有限公司在黄山市徽州区签署战略投资协议，以资本支持高端数控机床研发。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 20, three investment institutions signed strategic investment agreements with Anhui Zhuopu Intelligent Equipment in Huizhou District, Huangshan, funding R&D in high-end CNC machine tools.

articles.title_zh: 重庆“千里轻舟”货运量已突破1100万吨
articles.title_en: Chongqing's "Qianli Qingzhou" Waterway Tops 11 Million Tonnes in Cargo
articles.summary_zh: 10月21日，重庆市交通运输委员会发布“千里轻舟”航线一口价及“千里轻舟保”产品，该航线累计货运量已突破1100万吨，货值超200亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, Chongqing's transport commission launched fixed-price and insurance products for its "Qianli Qingzhou" waterway, whose cumulative cargo has topped 11 million tonnes worth over RMB 20 billion.

tags.name_zh: 重庆市交通运输委员会

tags_zh: 重庆市交通运输委员会

articles.title_zh: 连江县“以侨搭桥·卖向全球”招商推介会暨琯头镇侨联成立70周年庆典举行
articles.title_en: Lianjiang County Holds "Bridging via Overseas Chinese, Selling Globally" Investment Promotion Conference and 70th Anniversary of Guantou Township Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，连江县在琯头镇举行“以侨搭桥·卖向全球”招商推介会暨琯头镇侨联成立70周年庆典，县委书记郭勇致辞，冀以侨资侨智助推家乡发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Lianjiang County held an investment promotion conference and the 70th anniversary celebration of the Guantou Township federation of returned overseas Chinese, with county party secretary Guo Yong urging overseas Chinese to invest in their hometown.

articles.title_zh: 探索多元校企互促新模式：福建开放大学三棵树漆匠学院成立
articles.title_en: Fujian Open University and SKSHU Launch Painters College to Explore New School-Enterprise Cooperation Models
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，福建开放大学与三棵树涂料股份有限公司在莆田签署战略合作协议，并共同为“福建开放大学三棵树漆匠学院”揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Fujian Open University and SKSHU Paint signed a strategic cooperation agreement in Putian and jointly unveiled the Fujian Open University SKSHU Painters College.

articles.title_zh: 赵龙滕佳材郭宁宁等省领导参观福建省纪念红军长征胜利90周年主题展览
articles.title_en: Zhao Long, Teng Jiacai, Guo Ningning and Other Provincial Leaders Visit Fujian Exhibition Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，福建省委书记赵龙等省领导在省革命历史纪念馆参观纪念红军长征胜利90周年主题展览，重温长征历史，缅怀革命先烈。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Fujian Party Secretary Zhao Long and other provincial leaders visited a themed exhibition at the provincial revolutionary history museum in Fuzhou marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory.

articles.title_zh: 简牍领域垂域大模型“简问”发布
articles.title_en: Domain-Specific Large Model 'Jianwen' Released for Bamboo Slip Studies
articles.summary_zh: 近日，第四届简牍学学术研讨会在甘肃酒泉金塔县举行，会上正式发布由西北师范大学研发的简牍领域垂域大模型“简问”。
articles.summary_en: At the 4th Symposium on Bamboo Slip Studies in Jinta County, Gansu, Northwest Normal University released 'Jianwen', a domain-specific large AI model for bamboo slip research.

articles.title_zh: 河南省第十二次党代会主席团举行第二次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress Holds Second Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日晚，河南省第十二次党代会主席团第二次会议在省人民会堂举行，周祖翼主持，会议通过十二届省委委员、候补委员和省纪委委员预选候选人建议名单。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Oct 20, the presidium of the 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress held its second meeting at the Provincial People's Hall, chaired by Zhou Zuli, approving the candidate lists for provincial Party committee and discipline commission members.

articles.title_zh: 6部门推出首批136项标志性重大应用场景项目
articles.title_en: Six Departments Roll Out First Batch of 136 Landmark Major Application Scenario Projects
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，国家发展改革委等6部门推出首批136项标志性重大应用场景项目清单，覆盖五大类场景，并向民营企业、中小企业开放场景验证机会。
articles.summary_en: On October 20, the National Development and Reform Commission and five other departments released the first list of 136 landmark major application scenario projects, covering five categories of scenarios and opening verification opportunities to private and small businesses.

tags_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 盛阅春调研信访工作并接待来访群众
articles.title_en: Sheng Yuechun Inspects Petition Work and Receives Visiting Residents
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，武汉市委书记盛阅春赴洪山区调研信访工作并现场接待来访群众，研究解决群众反映的道路出行问题。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Wuhan Party Secretary Sheng Yuechun inspected petition work in Hongshan District and met residents on site, studying solutions to road access problems they raised.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥在神农架林区调研强调：高标准推进国家公园创建，坚决守牢生态安全屏障
articles.title_en: Guan Zhi'ou Inspects Shennongjia, Urging High-Standard National Park Creation and Firm Ecological Security
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，湖北省委书记关志鸥在神农架林区调研，强调高标准推进神农架国家公园创建，守牢生态安全屏障。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Hubei Party Secretary Guan Zhi'ou inspected the Shennongjia forestry district, urging high-standard creation of Shennongjia National Park and firm protection of the ecological security barrier.

articles.title_zh: 河北省实施户外运动发展三年行动计划
articles.title_en: Hebei Implements Three-Year Action Plan for Outdoor Sports Development
articles.summary_zh: 河北印发户外运动发展三年行动计划，提出2028年产业规模达2100亿元、冰雪产业突破1000亿元，并部署赛事、场地、装备和品牌建设。
articles.summary_en: Hebei issued a three-year action plan for outdoor sports, aiming for a 210 billion yuan industry and over 100 billion yuan ice-and-snow industry by 2028, with tasks on events, venues, equipment and branding.

articles.title_zh: 河北着力推动电子信息产业提质扩容
articles.title_en: Hebei Moves to Upgrade and Expand Its Electronic Information Industry
articles.summary_zh: 河北省提出培育“一核、两区、两带、多点支撑”产业格局，围绕集成电路、新型显示等重点领域推动电子信息产业提质扩容，打造五条重点产业链。
articles.summary_en: Hebei has unveiled a plan to upgrade and expand its electronic information industry, fostering a "one core, two zones, two belts" layout and building five key industrial chains, including integrated circuits and new displays.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨22年，深耕一尾鱼
articles.title_en: 22 Years on a Single Fish: Hainan Firm Builds World-Leading Tilapia Germplasm Bank
articles.summary_zh: 海南宝路水产科技深耕罗非鱼育种22年，通过给亲鱼植入电子芯片建立数据档案，累计选育22代、构建3300个家系，年产优质鱼苗超10亿尾。
articles.summary_en: Hainan Baolu Aquatic Technology has spent 22 years breeding tilapia, using electronic chips implanted in broodstock to build data records, completing 22 generations of selection with 3,300 families and producing over 1 billion high-quality fry a year.

articles.title_zh: 海南出台建筑业新政 实现从“有房住”向“住好房”转变
articles.title_en: Hainan Unveils New Construction Industry Policy to Upgrade Housing Quality
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，海南召开政策解读发布会，介绍《关于推动建筑业高质量发展的若干措施》，对智能建造及“好房子”项目给予容积率奖励，该措施将于11月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Hainan briefed the press on new measures for high-quality construction, offering floor-area-ratio incentives for smart-building and "good housing" projects, effective Nov 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨一瓶抗癌新药的海南自贸港之旅
articles.title_en: Vital China Research Tour: A Cancer Drug's Journey Through the Hainan Free Trade Port
articles.summary_zh: 记者走访海口国家高新区先声药业，探访抗癌新药科赛拉依托博鳌乐城“特许医疗”政策先行使用、在海口实现本土化生产并计划反向出口欧美的全链条。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visited Simcere in Haikou National Hi-Tech Zone to trace how cancer drug Cosela, first used under Boao Lecheng's special medical policy, was localized for production in Haikou and is now set to be exported to Europe and the US.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到哈尔滨市调研督导重大项目建设
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Inspects Major Projects in Harbin
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨调研督导重大项目建设，强调加力推进项目建设，发展先进制造业和现代服务业，为振兴发展注入动能。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Heilongjiang Party Secretary Xu Qin inspected major project sites in Harbin, urging faster project construction and the development of advanced manufacturing and modern services to boost revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省招商引资领导小组推进招商引资和产业项目调度会召开
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Leading Group for Investment Promotion Holds Meeting on Investment and Industrial Projects
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，黑龙江省招商引资领导小组推进招商引资和产业项目调度会在肇东市召开，省长梁惠玲出席并讲话，部署冬季招商百日行动。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a meeting in Zhaodong on investment promotion and industrial projects, urging a 100-day winter campaign to attract investment and complete annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 全球最大绿色氢氨醇一体化项目二期开工
articles.title_en: Phase II of World's Largest Green Hydrogen-Ammonia-Methanol Integrated Project Breaks Ground
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，中国能建投资建设的松原氢能产业园二期在吉林松原开工，总投资108.28亿元，建成后一、二期将形成年产60万吨绿氨能力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, construction began in Songyuan, Jilin, on Phase II of China Energy Engineering Group's hydrogen park, with 10.828 billion yuan invested; combined phases will reach 600,000 tons of green ammonia annually.

articles.title_zh: 张西明在黄山代表团审议省委报告和省纪委工作报告
articles.title_en: Zhang Ximing Joins Huangshan Delegation to Review Anhui Party Congress Reports
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日晚，张西明在黄山代表团审议安徽省委报告和省纪委工作报告，表示省政协将学习贯彻省第十二次党代会精神。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Oct. 19, Zhang Ximing joined the Huangshan delegation to review Anhui provincial Party congress reports, pledging that the provincial CPPCC will implement the congress's decisions.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军在区县委书记和部门“一把手”例会上强调 锚定目标 坚定信心 奋进攻坚 全力以赴实现“十五五”开好局起好步
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Tells Chongqing District and County Party Secretaries to Hold to Targets and Secure a Strong Start for the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，重庆市委召开区县委书记和部门“一把手”例会，市委书记袁家军出席并讲话，部署四季度经济收官、安全生产与民生保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Chongqing party secretary Yuan Jiajun addressed a meeting of district and county party secretaries, urging efforts to hit annual economic targets and secure a strong start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚深入河池调研并主持召开全区向海经济高质量发展工作推进会（内陆片区）
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Inspects Hechi and Chairs Regional Meeting on High-Quality Development of the Sea-Oriented Economy
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日至20日，广西自治区党委书记陈刚深入河池市调研龙滩水电站等项目，并在东兰县主持召开全区向海经济高质量发展工作推进会（内陆片区）。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang inspected projects including the Longtan Hydropower Station in Hechi on Oct 19-20 and chaired a meeting in Donglan on high-quality development of the sea-oriented economy.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟：用心用情用力推进全省卫生与健康事业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xu Lin: Advancing High-Quality Development of Guizhou's Health Undertakings with Dedication
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日至20日，贵州省委书记徐麟到毕节市调研卫生与健康工作，强调推动优质医疗资源下沉、推进全省卫生与健康事业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 19-20, Guizhou Provincial Party Secretary Xu Lin inspected health and medical work in Bijie, urging high-quality development of the province's health sector and better grassroots medical services.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，贵州省省长李炳军主持召开省政府常务会议，分析研究前三季度经济形势，安排部署四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun chaired a provincial government executive meeting to review the first three quarters' economic performance and set priorities for the fourth quarter.

articles.title_zh: 出席省第十二次党代会代表分团审议报告
articles.title_en: Delegates to 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress Review Report in Delegation Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，出席河南省第十二次党代会的代表分团审议党代会报告，认为报告务实有力、民生情怀深厚，表示将把大会部署落到实处。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 20, delegates to the 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress reviewed the congress report in delegation groups, calling it practical and people-oriented and pledging to implement its plans.

articles.title_zh: 张巍在参加平顶山市代表团审议时指出深学笃行担使命 奋力谱写新篇章
articles.title_en: Zhang Wei Attends Pingdingshan Delegation Deliberation, Urges Deeper Study and New Progress
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，张巍在河南省第十二次党代会平顶山市代表团审议报告时强调，要深学笃行党代会精神，推动转型发展、高质量发展和全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Zhang Wei reviewed the report with the Pingdingshan delegation at Henan's 12th Party Congress, urging deeper study of its spirit, high-quality development and strict Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党河南省第十二次代表大会隆重开幕
articles.title_en: The 12th CPC Henan Provincial Congress Opens
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，中国共产党河南省第十二次代表大会在省人民会堂开幕，周祖翼代表第十一届省委作报告，王陆进主持大会。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the 12th Congress of the Communist Party of China Henan Provincial Committee opened at the provincial People's Hall, with Zhou Zuyi delivering the work report on behalf of the 11th committee and Wang Lujin presiding.

articles.title_zh: 牢记嘱托勇担使命 确保部署落地见效
articles.title_en: Keeping the Mission in Mind and Shouldering Responsibilities to Ensure Deployments Take Effect
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，安伟、秦国文、王刚、张雷明分别在河南三门峡、驻马店、许昌、濮阳代表团，与代表们一起审议省党代会报告。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, An Wei, Qin Guowen, Wang Gang and Zhang Leiming joined delegates from Sanmenxia, Zhumadian, Xuchang and Puyang in Henan to review the provincial Party congress report.

articles.title_zh: 河南省第十二次党代会代表资格审查委员会举行会议
articles.title_en: Credentials Review Committee of 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日下午，中共河南省第十二次党代会代表资格审查委员会举行会议，听取代表选举和资格初步审查情况汇报，通过提请大会主席团审议的资格审查报告（草案）。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 19, the credentials review committee of the 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress met, heard a report on delegate elections and preliminary qualification reviews, and approved a draft report for the congress presidium.

articles.title_zh: 河南省第十二次党代会主席团举行第一次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress Holds First Meeting

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 19, the presidium of the 12th Henan Provincial Party Congress held its first meeting at the Provincial People's Hall, chaired by Zhou Zuyi, approving the standing committee membership list and a delegate qualification review report.

articles.title_zh: 孔昌生参加信阳市代表团审议
articles.title_en: Kong Changsheng Joins Xinyang Delegation in Deliberating Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，孔昌生到信阳市代表团参加河南省第十二次党代会报告审议，强调省政协要深入宣传解读报告、广泛凝心聚力，助力谱写中原新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Kong Changsheng joined the Xinyang delegation to deliberate the report of Henan's 12th Provincial Party Congress, urging the provincial CPPCC to publicize the report and build consensus for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明主持召开省委全面深化改革委员会会议
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Chairs Meeting of Hunan Provincial Party Committee's Commission for Deepening Reform
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，湖南省委书记沈晓明主持召开省委全面深化改革委员会会议，审议通过农村产权流转交易、丘陵山区农业机械化、乡镇财政管理等改革文件。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming chaired a meeting of the provincial Party Committee's Commission for Deepening Reform, approving documents on rural property-rights trading, farm mechanization in hilly areas and township fiscal management.

articles.title_zh: 江苏与中央广播电视总台深化战略合作 信长星慎海雄出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Jiangsu and China Media Group Deepen Strategic Cooperation; Xin Changxing and Shen Haixiong Attend and Speak

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Jiangsu Province and China Media Group signed a strategic cooperation agreement on the "Brand Power Project" in Nanjing, with Xin Changxing and Shen Haixiong attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 2026物理AI与世界模型大会在南京开幕 刘小涛出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 2026 Physical AI and World Model Conference Opens in Nanjing, Liu Xiaotao Attends and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，2026物理AI与世界模型大会在南京开幕，江苏省省长刘小涛出席并致辞，表示江苏将拓展场景应用、夯实算力底座、优化产业生态。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the 2026 Physical AI and World Model Conference opened in Nanjing, where Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao said the province will expand application scenarios, boost computing capacity and improve the industrial ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 省政协召开主席专题协商会 张义珍主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Holds Chairman's Special Consultation Meeting Chaired by Zhang Yizhen
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，江苏省政协召开主席专题协商会，围绕加快发展生产性服务业协商建言，省政协主席张义珍主持并讲话，省委常委、常务副省长张文兵到会通报。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC held a chairman's special consultation meeting on developing producer services, chaired by CPPCC chair Zhang Yizhen, with Executive Vice Governor Zhang Wenbing briefing the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 第一观察丨今天中国的进步和发展，就是从长征中走出来的

articles.summary_en: Xinhua published an observation piece on Oct 21 reviewing Xi Jinping's visits along the Red Army's Long March route and the spirit of the Long March for a new era.

articles.title_zh: 中国工农红军长征胜利90周年金银纪念币即将发行
articles.title_en: PBOC to Issue Gold and Silver Commemorative Coins Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行10月21日发布公告，定于2026年10月22日发行中国工农红军长征胜利90周年金银纪念币一套，共2枚，均为中华人民共和国法定货币。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China announced on October 21 that it will issue a two-coin gold and silver commemorative set on October 22, 2026, marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory, both as legal tender of the PRC.

articles.title_en: MIIT and Three Other Departments Issue Draft Rules Setting Safety Red Lines for Auto Design Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，工业和信息化部等四部门印发征求意见稿，聚焦汽车创新设计与研发测试验证，列出禁用配置清单并提出验证要求，为车企创新划定安全红线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, MIIT and three other departments issued draft rules on auto innovation design and R&D testing verification, listing banned features and testing requirements to set safety red lines for carmakers.

articles.title_en: Striding Forward on the New Long March — Written on the 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 10月22日，人民日报发表任仲平文章，纪念长征胜利90周年，号召弘扬伟大长征精神、走好新时代长征路。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 22, People's Daily published a Ren Zhongping article marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory, urging the nation to carry forward the Long March spirit on the new journey.

articles.title_en: National Energy Administration Issues Document to Promote Integrated Development of Coal Power and New Energy
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局近日印发《关于推动煤电与新能源融合发展的实施意见》，提出到“十五五”末融合场景模式成熟应用、碳排放显著降低，并明确五类典型场景模式和技术要求。

articles.title_zh: 新华社记者在美国找到一批红军长征时的珍贵照片

articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者在美国杨百翰大学图书馆特藏部找到一批红军长征时期的珍贵历史照片，包括红二十五军渡渭河等罕见行军影像。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters found a batch of rare photographs from the Red Army's Long March, including images of the 25th Red Army crossing the Wei River, in the special collections of Brigham Young University's library in the United States.

articles.title_en: Resolving Hidden Dangers Before They Become Disasters: Ministries Detail Modern Emergency Management System for the 15th Five-Year Plan

articles.summary_en: On Oct 21, officials from emergency management, fire, earthquake and mining safety agencies briefed in Beijing on building a modern emergency response system for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在潍坊调研
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Conducts Research Visit in Weifang
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，山东省省长周乃翔在潍坊市调研，走访多家企业并考察政务服务中心，强调深入实施“人工智能+”行动、培育新质生产力、抓好第四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 20, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang visited Weifang, touring enterprises and a government service center, urging deeper implementation of the "AI+" initiative, cultivation of new quality productive forces and solid fourth-quarter economic work.

articles.title_zh: 林武在聊城调研
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Conducts Inspection Tour in Liaocheng
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，山东省委书记林武在聊城调研，考察人工智能、循环经济、能源和农业企业，部署四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Shandong Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu inspected Liaocheng, visiting AI, recycling, energy and agricultural firms and urging efforts to meet annual economic goals.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚主持召开省政府党组会议
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Chairs Shaanxi Provincial Government Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，陕西省省长、省政府党组书记赵刚主持召开省政府党组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，部署卫生健康、生态保护、算力产业及开放型经济发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Shaanxi Governor and provincial government Party group secretary Zhao Gang chaired a Party group meeting to implement Xi Jinping's recent speeches, deploying work on health, ecology, computing power and opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在全省县域经济高质量发展推进会上强调 因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展再上新台阶

articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，陕西省县域经济高质量发展推进会暨县（市、区）委书记工作交流会在西安召开，省委书记赵一德主持会议并讲话，省长赵刚部署县域经济重点工作和高质量项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Shaanxi held a provincial meeting in Xi'an on high-quality county-level economic development. Party Secretary Zhao Yide chaired and spoke, while Governor Zhao Gang set out key tasks and high-quality project construction.

articles.title_zh: 张工会见空客公司首席执行官傅里
articles.title_en: Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong Meets Airbus CEO Guillaume Faury

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong met Airbus CEO Guillaume Faury in Tianjin to discuss the Airbus Tianjin project's dual-line operation, stronger local supplier networks and industrial clustering.

articles.title_zh: 全市先进制造业大会召开
articles.title_en: Tianjin Holds Citywide Advanced Manufacturing Conference

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Tianjin held a conference on advanced manufacturing, with Chen Min'er attending and Mayor Zhang Gong outlining deployment and support policies for high-quality manufacturing development.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江参加自治区第十一次党代会和田地区代表团讨论

articles.title_en: Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan Inspects Erdaojiang District for Industrial Development

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan inspected Erdaojiang District, visiting new materials, edible fungi and steel firms, urging industrial upgrading, new quality productive forces and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 张海波调研重大基础设施建设和森林防火工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Major Infrastructure Construction and Forest Fire Prevention Work

articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo inspected Weihai Airport, the Kunyushan airport project, the Wendeng pumped-storage power station and a forest fire brigade, urging faster infrastructure construction and strict autumn-winter fire prevention.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 19, Wang Dongwei joined the Wuhu delegation's deliberations on the provincial Party congress report, urging the city to strengthen its sub-center role and deepen integration of technology and industrial innovation.

articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Veterans Affairs Work in Xi'an, Stresses Carrying Forward the Tradition of Mutual Support Between Civilians and the Military
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰在西安调研退役军人事务工作，走访民兵训练基地、军休干部休养所和基层退役军人服务站，要求满腔热忱做好服务保障。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected veterans affairs work in Xi'an, visiting a militia training base, a retirement home for military veterans and grassroots service stations, urging dedicated service and support.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu chaired the regional government's 26th executive meeting, reviewing third-quarter economic performance and studying the computing power industry, farmland protection and other matters.

articles.title_en: Wu Xiande Chairs Joint Meeting on Fuzhou University Town Campus-Local Cooperation

articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired a joint campus-local meeting at Fuzhou University Town, calling for deeper cooperation and faster building of a first-class university town.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀：广大人民群众是长征胜利的力量源泉
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Bond with the People: The Masses Are the Source of Strength for the Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布考察时强调，广大人民群众是长征胜利的力量源泉，走好新时代的长征路必须紧紧依靠人民。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, Xi Jinping stressed during an inspection tour in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, that the broad masses are the source of strength for the Long March victory, and that the new Long March must rely closely on the people.

articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab's green computing industry in Inner Mongolia, stressing that all regions should leverage their own conditions and comparative strengths to pursue high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: Sichuan Energy Nuclear Industry Co. was unveiled in Chengdu on Oct 20, jointly founded by Sichuan Energy Development Group and the Nuclear Power Institute of China with 1 billion yuan in initial capital.

articles.title_zh: 增长4.6%背后：中国经济新动能孕育新机遇
articles.title_en: Behind 4.6% Growth: China's New Economic Drivers Breed New Opportunities
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局公布前三季度经济数据，GDP同比增长4.6%，高技术制造业增加值增长14.3%，新动能加速孕育。
articles.summary_en: China's GDP grew 4.6% year-on-year in the first three quarters, with high-tech manufacturing value-added up 14.3%, as new growth drivers take shape.

articles.title_zh: 自然资源部：坚决拥护党中央对张建龙的处理决定
articles.title_en: Ministry of Natural Resources Backs Party Decision on Zhang Jianlong
articles.summary_zh: 近日，自然资源部党组召开会议，通报中央纪委国家监委给予原党组成员、国家林草局原局长张建龙开除党籍处分的决定，与会同志表示坚决拥护。
articles.summary_en: The Party group of China's Ministry of Natural Resources recently held a meeting to convey the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission decision to expel Zhang Jianlong, former head of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, from the Party, with attendees voicing firm support.

articles.title_zh: 兰海高速湛江段计划年内开工 进出海南岛的第二条高速通道要来了
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Section of Lanzhou-Haikou Expressway to Start Construction This Year, Creating Second Highway Link to Hainan

articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区政府主席包钢在呼和浩特会见中国工程院院士、鹏城实验室主任高文一行，双方就绿色算力、人工智能等领域合作深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong and government head Bao Gang met with Gao Wen, director of Pengcheng Laboratory and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, in Hohhot to discuss cooperation on green computing power and AI.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古全区领导干部大会传达学习习近平总书记在乌兰察布考察时的重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Holds Regional Cadre Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Key Speech From Ulanqab Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，内蒙古自治区全区领导干部大会在呼和浩特召开，传达学习习近平总书记在乌兰察布市考察时的重要讲话重要指示精神，自治区党委书记王伟中出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Inner Mongolia held a regional leadership meeting in Hohhot to convey and study Xi Jinping's key instructions from his inspection tour of Ulanqab, with regional Party secretary Wang Weizhong delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏国资国企推动创新链产业链深度融合
articles.title_en: Ningxia State-Owned Enterprises Promote Deep Integration of Innovation and Industrial Chains
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，宁夏多家区属国企展示低空经济、智慧牧场、数字政务、智慧水务等数字化应用场景，自治区国资委推动创新链与产业链深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, state-owned enterprises in Ningxia showcased digital applications in low-altitude economy, smart farming, e-government and smart water services, as the regional SASAC pushes deeper integration of innovation and industrial chains.

tags.name_en: Integration of Innovation and Industrial Chains

tags_en: Integration of Innovation and Industrial Chains

articles.title_zh: 四川能源核产业有限公司揭牌成立 施小琳申彦锋出席活动
articles.title_en: Sichuan Nuclear Energy Industry Co. Unveiled as Governor Shi Xiaolin and CNNC Chairman Shen Yanfeng Attend
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日下午，四川能源核产业有限公司在成都揭牌成立，四川省长施小琳、中核集团董事长申彦锋出席活动。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan Nuclear Energy Industry Co. was officially unveiled in Chengdu on the afternoon of Oct 20, with Governor Shi Xiaolin and CNNC Chairman Shen Yanfeng attending the ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 山东奋力谱写黄河流域生态保护和高质量发展新篇章
articles.title_en: Shandong Strives to Write a New Chapter in Yellow River Basin Ecological Protection and High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 山东持续推进黄河流域生态保护和高质量发展，2025年GDP达10.3万亿元，成为北方首个突破10万亿元的省份，能耗强度较2020年下降21.4%。
articles.summary_en: Shandong advances Yellow River basin protection and high-quality development; 2025 GDP hit 10.3 trillion yuan, first in north China to top 10 trillion, with energy intensity down 21.4% from 2020.

articles.title_zh: 山东系统部署美丽中国省域先行区建设 2030年基本建成
articles.title_en: Shandong Deploys Systematic Plan for a Beautiful China Provincial Pioneer Zone, to Be Basically Completed by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，山东省政府新闻办在济南举行政策吹风会，解读《山东省美丽中国先行区建设实施方案》，提出到2030年基本建成美丽中国省域先行区，并部署21项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, Shandong's provincial government information office held a briefing in Jinan to explain its plan for building a Beautiful China provincial pioneer zone, aiming for basic completion by 2030 through 21 key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 云南省人大常委会党组召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Party Leadership Group of Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Expanded Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，云南省人大常委会党组召开扩大会议，由党组书记、副主任李小三主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，并研究贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, the Party leadership group of the Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee held an expanded meeting chaired by Li Xiaosan, conveying and studying General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions and discussing implementation.

articles.title_zh: 保护文化遗产 推动文明对话
articles.title_en: Protecting Cultural Heritage, Promoting Dialogue Among Civilizations
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日至20日，第四届“良渚论坛”在浙江杭州举行，由文化和旅游部、国家文物局与浙江省政府共同主办，近60个国家和地区的嘉宾参会。
articles.summary_en: Hosted by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, the National Cultural Heritage Administration and Zhejiang province, the Fourth Liangzhu Forum ran Oct 18-20 in Hangzhou with guests from some 60 countries.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺中央社会主义学院建院70周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter Congratulating the Central Institute of Socialism on Its 70th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月20日，中央社会主义学院建院70周年庆祝大会在北京举行，习近平致贺信，王沪宁出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On October 20, 2026, a ceremony marking the 70th anniversary of the Central Institute of Socialism was held in Beijing, where Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter was read and Wang Huning delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致中央社会主义学院建院70周年的贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on 70th Anniversary of the Central Institute of Socialism
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，习近平致信祝贺中央社会主义学院建院70周年，希望学院加强政治培训、凝聚政治共识，服务党和国家工作大局。
articles.summary_en: On October 20, Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter marking the 70th anniversary of the Central Institute of Socialism, calling for stronger political training and consensus-building to serve the Party and state's overall work.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党安徽省第十二次代表大会隆重开幕
articles.title_en: 12th CPC Anhui Provincial Congress Opens in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，中国共产党安徽省第十二次代表大会在合肥开幕，李乐成代表十一届省委作报告，王东伟主持，779名代表出席。
articles.summary_en: The 12th CPC Anhui Provincial Congress opened in Hefei on Oct 19, 2026, with Li Lecheng delivering the work report for the 11th provincial committee and Wang Dongwei presiding over 779 delegates.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会举行会议 分析前三季度经济社会形势 部署下阶段工作
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Review First Three Quarters' Economy and Deploy Next-Stage Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日下午，重庆市委常委会举行会议，市委书记袁家军主持，分析全市前三季度经济社会形势，研究部署下阶段工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 19, the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met, chaired by Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun, to analyze the city's economic and social situation in the first three quarters and deploy work for the next stage.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组举行专题学习会 袁家军主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Holds Special Study Session on National Security, Chaired by Yuan Jiajun
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，重庆市委书记袁家军主持市委理论学习中心组专题学习会，强调贯彻总体国家安全观，深入开展群防群治百日攻坚，提升超大城市本质安全水平。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Chongqing party secretary Yuan Jiajun chaired a special study session on the overall national security concept, urging a 100-day campaign to boost grassroots risk prevention and elevate the megacity's intrinsic safety.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军在数字重庆建设推进会上强调 重点突破 整体提升 全面迈向数字重庆体系能力建设
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Stresses Key Breakthroughs and Overall Upgrade Toward Systemic Capacity Building for Digital Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，数字重庆建设推进会在重庆召开，市委书记袁家军出席并讲话，强调抢抓人工智能时代机遇，坚持重点突破、整体提升，全面迈向数字重庆体系能力建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Chongqing held a meeting on Digital Chongqing construction. Municipal Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun urged seizing AI-era opportunities to advance systemic capacity building for digital governance in the megacity.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚在凤山县督导调研溶洞污染问题排查整治工作
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Inspects Cave Pollution Remediation in Fengshan County
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚赴河池市凤山县督导调研溶洞污染问题排查整治工作，要求摸清底数、立行立改、标本兼治。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, inspected cave pollution remediation work in Fengshan County, Hechi City, urging full investigation and immediate, systematic rectification.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟在毕节市调研 强调以高质量项目建设支撑全省高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xu Lin Inspects Bijie, Stressing High-Quality Project Construction to Support Guizhou's Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，贵州省委书记徐麟到毕节市七星关区、大方县调研，强调以高质量项目建设支撑全省高质量发展，全力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Guizhou Party Secretary Xu Lin inspected Qixingguan District and Dafang County in Bijie, urging high-quality project construction to support provincial development and meet full-year economic goals.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军：为贵州高质量发展和现代化建设凝聚强大精神力量
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Calls for Cultural Strength to Drive Guizhou's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，贵州省长、省政府党组书记李炳军主持召开省政府党组理论学习中心组集中研讨会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想，加快建设多彩贵州文化强省。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun chaired a provincial government Party group study session, urging deeper study of Xi Jinping Thought on Culture to build Guizhou into a strong cultural province.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省党政代表团到陕西学习考察
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Delegation Visits Shaanxi to Deepen Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日至19日，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛率党政代表团赴陕西考察，与陕西省委书记赵一德、省长赵刚座谈，推动苏陕协作向更宽领域迈进。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18-19, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao led a delegation to Shaanxi, meeting Shaanxi Party Secretary Zhao Yide and Governor Zhao Gang to deepen Jiangsu-Shaanxi cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 坚持正确政治方向 夯实共同思想根基——习近平总书记致中央社会主义学院建院70周年贺信汇聚同心奋进新征程强大力量
articles.title_en: Upholding the Correct Political Direction and Strengthening the Common Ideological Foundation: Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter on the Central Institute of Socialism's 70th Anniversary Inspires United Efforts on a New Journey
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月20日，新华社报道，习近平总书记致中央社会主义学院建院70周年贺信在统一战线成员中引发热烈反响，大家表示要坚持正确政治方向、广泛凝聚政治共识。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, 2026, Xinhua reported that Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter marking the Central Institute of Socialism's 70th anniversary drew warm responses from united front members, who pledged to uphold the correct political direction and build broad political consensus.

articles.title_zh: 跟着总书记的足迹，感悟伟大长征精神

articles.summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, Xinhua launched a six-part series following Xi Jinping's inspection footsteps, revisiting people in old revolutionary base areas and descendants of Red Army soldiers.

articles.title_en: Carrying Forward the Enterprising Spirit of 'He Who Has Not Reached the Great Wall Is No True Man'
articles.summary_zh: 新华社学习手记回顾毛泽东《清平乐·六盘山》创作背景，梳理习近平总书记多次引用“不到长城非好汉”，阐释长征精神的当代意义。
articles.summary_en: An official Xinhua study note revisits Mao Zedong's poem on Mount Liupan and Xi Jinping's repeated invocation of 'he who has not reached the Great Wall is no true man', expounding the lasting relevance of the Long March spirit.

articles.title_zh: 国新办发布会聚焦“十五五”时期加强文化遗产保护
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Briefing on Strengthening Cultural Heritage Protection in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，国务院新闻办公室在北京举行发布会，介绍《文化遗产保护传承“十五五”规划》，这是我国文化遗产保护领域首个五年规划。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, the State Council Information Office held a briefing in Beijing on the Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance 15th Five-Year Plan, the country's first five-year plan in this field.

articles.title_zh: 长征文物资源家底基本摸清
articles.title_en: China Completes Survey of Long March Cultural Relics
articles.summary_zh: 国家文物局10月20日介绍，全国长征主题不可移动文物2100余处，第四次全国文物普查新发现长征遗址遗迹63处，资源家底基本摸清。
articles.summary_en: The National Cultural Heritage Administration said on Oct 20 that China has basically completed its survey of Long March relics, counting over 2,100 immovable sites, including 63 newly found in the fourth national cultural relics census.

articles.title_zh: 我国发布《历史文化名城（镇、村）与历史建筑保护传承“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: China Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Protecting Historic Cities, Towns, Villages and Buildings
articles.summary_zh: 住房城乡建设部近日印发历史文化名城（镇、村）与历史建筑保护传承“十五五”规划，提出坚持保护第一、传承优先、合理利用，并部署四方面重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development issued a 15th Five-Year Plan for protecting historic cities, towns, villages and buildings, setting four key tasks and goals through 2030.

articles.title_zh: 推动技术与市场高效对接——多部门详解科技兴商
articles.title_en: Better Connecting Technology and Market: Multi-Ministry Briefing Details Tech-Empowered Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，商务部等9部门发布关于加快推进科技兴商的意见，提出18条举措，国新办当日举行发布会详解有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, the Ministry of Commerce and eight other departments issued guidelines with 18 measures to advance tech-empowered commerce, detailed at a State Council Information Office briefing the same day.

articles.title_zh: 三部门部署防控儿童青少年高度近视
articles.title_en: Three Departments Deploy Measures to Prevent and Control High Myopia in Children and Adolescents
articles.summary_zh: 教育部、国家卫生健康委、国家疾控局近日联合印发通知，要求医疗机构和中小学校为高度近视学生建立视觉健康档案，加强随访检查与针对性干预。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Education, National Health Commission and National Disease Control Administration have jointly issued a notice requiring medical institutions and schools to build visual health records for highly myopic students and strengthen follow-up checks and targeted intervention.

articles.title_zh: 万里红路 精神丰碑——长征国家文化公园建设扎实推进
articles.title_en: A Million-Li Red Road, a Spiritual Monument: Construction of the Long March National Cultural Park Advances Steadily
articles.summary_zh: 在中国工农红军长征胜利90周年之际，长征国家文化公园建设持续推进，沿线15个省区市构建“一轴四线”整体格局，系统保护长征文物、传承长征精神并推动文旅融合。
articles.summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, construction of the Long March National Cultural Park is advancing across 15 provincial-level regions, protecting revolutionary relics, passing on the Long March spirit and boosting culture-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 柳梧铁路顺利接入国家铁路网
articles.title_en: Liuzhou-Wuzhou Railway Successfully Connects to National Rail Network
articles.summary_zh: 10月20日，柳梧铁路在柳州枢纽进德站插入道岔，顺利接入柳南客运专线，从而接入国家铁路网，为下一步开通运营奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On October 20, the Liuzhou-Wuzhou railway was connected to the Liuzhou-Nanning passenger line at Jinde Station in the Liuzhou rail hub, integrating it into the national rail network and laying the groundwork for operations.

articles.title_zh: 薪火七秩铸同心 团结奋进启新程——中央社会主义学院建院70周年发展建设综述
articles.title_en: Review: Central Institute of Socialism Marks 70 Years of Development in United Front Education
articles.summary_zh: 新华社综述梳理中央社会主义学院建院70年发展历程，聚焦其作为统一战线人才教育培养主阵地的政治共识教育、课程体系建设与中华文化认同工作。
articles.summary_en: An Xinhua review traces the Central Institute of Socialism's 70-year history, highlighting its role as the main base for training united front personnel through political consensus education and Chinese cultural identity programs.

articles.title_zh: 信仰之光照亮新的征程——“伟大的远征”主题展览传递精神的力量
articles.title_en: Light of Faith Illuminates a New Journey: "The Great Expedition" Exhibition Conveys Spiritual Strength
articles.summary_zh: 纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年主题展览自9月25日起在中国人民革命军事博物馆向公众开放，累计接待观众50余万人次。
articles.summary_en: The exhibition "The Great Expedition," marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, opened to the public on Sept 25 at the Military Museum in Beijing and has drawn over 500,000 visitors.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·走好新时代的长征路丨实干之道
articles.title_en: Learning New Words: Walking the Long March of the New Era — The Path of Solid Work
articles.summary_zh: 在中国工农红军长征胜利90周年之际，新华社「学习新语」栏目推出系列融合报道「走好新时代的长征路」，本期主题为「实干之道」，重温习近平关于长征精神与实干奋斗的论述。
articles.summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, Xinhua's 'Learning New Words' column released the episode 'The Path of Solid Work' in its series on the Long March of the new era, citing Xi Jinping on perseverance and hard work.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府召开第119次常务会议 张工主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 119th Executive Meeting Chaired by Zhang Gong
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日下午，天津市市长张工主持召开市政府第119次常务会议，研究部署健康天津建设和科技金融工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 19, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong chaired the municipal government's 119th executive meeting to advance Health Tianjin construction and sci-tech finance.

articles.title_zh: 云南昭通：发展光伏玻璃制造 推动资源就地转化
articles.title_en: Zhaotong, Yunnan Develops Photovoltaic Glass Manufacturing to Convert Local Resources On Site
articles.summary_zh: 云南昭通依托硅矿与绿电优势引进龙头企业，发展光伏玻璃制造，已初步形成从硅矿开采、洗选到光伏玻璃、光伏组件的产业链条。
articles.summary_en: Zhaotong in Yunnan, drawing on its silicon ore and green power advantages, has brought in leading enterprises to build photovoltaic glass manufacturing and has formed a chain from silicon mining and washing to PV glass and modules.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：因地制宜 产业富民 加快实现绿色发展高质量发展
articles.title_en: Wang Hao: Tailor Industries to Local Conditions to Enrich People and Accelerate Green, High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，浙江省委书记王浩在丽水市遂昌县、莲都区调研，强调因地制宜发展富民产业，带动群众增收，推动绿色发展与高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Zhejiang Party Secretary Wang Hao inspected Suichang County and Liandu District in Lishui, urging locally tailored industries to raise rural incomes and advance green, high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 尹力围绕市属高校发展在北方工业大学、北京农学院、首都经济贸易大学调研
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects Municipal Universities on Their Development in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 连日来，北京市委书记尹力到北方工业大学、北京农学院、首都经济贸易大学调研，强调推动市属高校分类卓越发展，为首都提供人才、科技、智力支撑。

articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande inspected flood and typhoon preparedness in Gulou and Taijiang districts and took part in a river-protection and clean-up campaign, urging stronger drainage capacity and Minjiang River ecological governance.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 17, Anhui Party Secretary Li Lecheng visited the Huainan delegation to the 12th Provincial Party Congress, urging delegates to produce a sound report, elect a good leadership team and foster a healthy atmosphere.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 安排部署贯彻落实工作

articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和胡昌升在拉萨调研时的讲话精神，部署卫生健康与基层综治工作。
articles.summary_en: Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering chaired a municipal Party standing committee meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's speech and Hu Changsheng's Lhasa remarks, and deploying health and grassroots governance work.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会主席团举行第二次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Party Congress Holds Second Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月19日，中国共产党拉萨市第十一次代表大会主席团在拉萨举行第二次会议，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁等出席。
articles.summary_en: On October 19, 2026, the presidium of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China held its second meeting in Lhasa, attended by Dawaciren, member of the regional Party Standing Committee and Lhasa Party secretary.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁看望出席市第十一次党代会代表

articles.summary_en: In October 2026, Lhasa leader Dawa Tsering met delegates attending the 11th Lhasa Municipal Party Congress in Lhasa and extended greetings to them.

articles.title_zh: 李强抵达杜尚别对塔吉克斯坦进行正式访问并出席上合组织总理会议

articles.summary_en: On October 18, Premier Li Qiang arrived in Dushanbe, Tajikistan, beginning an official visit and attending the 25th Meeting of the SCO Council of Heads of Government.
