articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng: Stabilize, Develop and Improve Livelihoods to Build a Modern Socialist New Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日至16日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在阿里地区调研，走访普兰、札达、噶尔等县并主持座谈会，就稳定、发展、生态、民生和从严治党等工作提出要求。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 14 to 16, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected Ngari Prefecture, visiting Burang, Zanda and Gar counties and chairing a meeting on stability, development, ecology, livelihoods and party discipline.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升调研全区纪检监察工作 强调持之以恒推进全面从严治党
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Regional Discipline Inspection Work, Vows Sustained Full and Rigorous Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升到自治区纪委监委机关看望纪检监察干部并调研，强调持之以恒推进全面从严治党、坚定推进反腐败斗争。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng visited the regional discipline inspection commission in Lhasa, urging sustained full and rigorous party governance and firmer anti-corruption efforts.

articles.title_zh: 从亚太伙伴关系到亚太共同体——习近平主席引领推动亚太合作迈上新台阶

articles.summary_en: China hosts APEC for the third time in 2026. Xi Jinping has guided Asia-Pacific cooperation toward building an Asia-Pacific community, with the Shenzhen meeting set to open a new stage.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开理论学习中心组学习会

articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Linzhi Municipal Party Secretary Ba Ta chaired the committee's 10th theoretical study session of 2026, focusing on Xi Jinping's remarks on improving people's livelihoods and on implementing livelihood programs.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 国务院关于发展新质生产力的意见
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council Issue Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，中共中央、国务院发布关于发展新质生产力的意见，提出以科技创新为引领，推动产业创新、发展方式创新和体制机制创新，加快形成新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, the CPC Central Committee and State Council issued opinions on developing new quality productive forces, calling for tech-led innovation in industry, development models and institutions.

articles.title_zh: 巴塔重阳节看望慰问集中供养老人

articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, the Double Ninth Festival, Nyingchi Party Secretary Ba Ta visited a congregate care center for impoverished elderly people in Bayi District, extending festive greetings and studying elderly care work.

articles.title_zh: 全市县域重点产业链专家服务团座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Longyan Holds Symposium for Expert Service Teams on County Key Industrial Chains

articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, Longyan held a symposium with expert service teams for county-level key industrial chains. Party Secretary Hu Sheng spoke, and experts offered proposals.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市市长蔡琳会见市级工业主导产业专家服务团代表
articles.title_en: Longyan Mayor Cai Lin Meets Delegation of Industry Expert Service Teams
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，龙岩市委副书记、市长蔡琳会见出席第二届龙岩市产业链人才创新大会的“矿业+”“新新有机”工业主导产业专家服务团代表，希望专家在科技攻关、人才传帮带、项目招引等方面持续发力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Longyan Mayor Cai Lin met with expert service teams for the city's mining and new organic materials industries attending the second Longyan industrial chain talent innovation conference, urging them to help with tech breakthroughs and talent cultivation.

articles.summary_en: On October 19, 2026, the National Bureau of Statistics reported that GDP grew 4.6% year on year in the first three quarters, with the economy running steadily and high-quality development achieving new progress.

articles.title_zh: 江苏连续三年召开专题会议，聚焦海洋经济和沿海经济带高质量发展

articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Jiangsu held a special meeting in Lianyungang, its third straight year focusing on the marine economy and high-quality coastal belt development, and mapped out building a strong maritime province.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平到市人民群众来访接待中心接访

articles.summary_en: On October 16, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping received petitioners at the city's people's petition reception center, hearing their concerns face to face, discussing solutions with relevant departments, and urging deeper efforts to resolve livelihood-related petition issues.

articles.title_zh: 张国平调度信访稳定、秋季秸秆禁烧等工作

articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, County Magistrate Zhang Guoping chaired a video meeting on petition stability and the autumn straw-burning ban, hearing reports from townships and departments and outlining next steps.

articles.title_zh: 高新区召开党工委会议
articles.title_en: High-tech Zone Holds Party Working Committee Meeting

articles.summary_en: On October 18, the High-tech Zone held its 27th Party Working Committee meeting in 2026, studying recent important instructions and articles by Xi Jinping and deploying work on public security, livelihood support, industrial development and petition handling.

articles.title_zh: 李军赴国家发展改革委争取政策并赴北京广东等地招商引资、洽谈推进项目

articles.summary_en: From Oct 13 to 16, Yingkou Party Secretary Li Jun led a delegation to Beijing to seek policy support from the NDRC and visited firms in Beijing and Guangdong to advance project cooperation.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Yuxi Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun led a team in Hongta District for "Respect for the Elderly Month" visits, urging full implementation of social assistance and medical security policies for needy seniors.

articles.title_zh: 县委副书记、县长候选人梁健敏调研曲界镇中心镇创建工作
articles.title_en: County Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor Candidate Liang Jianmin Surveys Qujie Town's Central Town Development

articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, Liang Jianmin, deputy county party secretary and mayor candidate of Xuwen, inspected Qujie Town's provincial modern central town development and urged project and tourism-agriculture integration.

articles.title_zh: 习近平考察内蒙古乌兰察布：以“慢功夫”与“快节奏”探索发展新路径
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, Highlighting a Green Development Path
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察黄旗海自然保护区和察哈尔高新技术开发区，强调统筹高质量发展与高水平保护，走生态优先、绿色发展之路。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, visiting the Huangqihai Nature Reserve and the Chahar High-Tech Development Zone, stressing coordinated high-quality development and ecological protection.

articles.title_zh: 和总书记面对面丨让青春智慧点亮未来
articles.title_en: Face to Face with the General Secretary: Youthful Wisdom Lights the Future
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布考察察哈尔高新技术开发区，与算力中心青年技术人员亲切交流，勉励发展绿色算力产业。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping visited the Chahar High-Tech Development Zone in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, talking with young technicians at computing centers and urging development of the green computing industry.

articles.title_zh: 网约车司机酒后载客被查，拘留15天、5年禁驾
articles.title_en: Ride-Hailing Driver Detained 15 Days, Banned From Driving 5 Years for Drunk Driving Passengers in Huai'an
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日晚，淮安一网约车司机胡某酒后载客营运被查，血检酒精含量50.3mg/100ml，被罚款5000元、行政拘留15日，驾照吊销且5年内不得重新考取。
articles.summary_en: A Huai'an ride-hailing driver carrying passengers while drunk on Oct 9 was fined 5,000 yuan, detained 15 days and banned from driving for five years after a blood test showed 50.3mg/100ml.

articles.title_zh: 自然资源部原党组成员、国家林草局原局长张建龙严重违纪违法被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Zhang Jianlong, Former Party Leadership Member of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Former Director of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, Expelled from the Party for Serious Discipline and Law Violations
articles.summary_zh: 经中共中央批准，中央纪委国家监委对自然资源部原党组成员、国家林草局原局长张建龙严重违纪违法问题立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍处分并移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: With CPC Central Committee approval, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission investigated Zhang Jianlong, former Party leadership member of the Ministry of Natural Resources and former head of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, and expelled him from the Party, transferring his suspected crimes to prosecutors.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 江苏聚焦海洋经济和沿海经济带高质量发展
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Focuses on High-Quality Development of Marine Economy and Coastal Economic Belt
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，江苏在连云港召开会议，首次把海洋经济与沿海经济带发展统筹谋划，提出加快建设海洋强省。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Jiangsu held a meeting on Oct 16 in Lianyungang, for the first time integrating the marine economy with coastal economic belt development, aiming to accelerate building a strong marine province.

articles.title_zh: 重庆第二轮土地延包30年办事指南发布
articles.title_en: Chongqing Releases Service Guide for Second-Round 30-Year Rural Land Contract Extension
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市农业农村委近日发布第二轮土地承包到期后再延长30年试点农户办事指南，明确不强制换证、支持线上网签和委托代办，分五个阶段办理。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing's municipal agriculture commission released a service guide for the pilot extending second-round rural land contracts by another 30 years, allowing online signing and proxy handling while keeping existing certificates valid, with procedures in five stages.

articles.title_zh: “加减乘除”促消费：福建、山东、湖南加力提振消费
articles.title_en: Adding, Subtracting, Multiplying and Dividing: Fujian, Shandong and Hunan Step Up Efforts to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，人民日报调研报道显示，福建、山东、湖南通过扩容消费供给、减轻民生负担、放大政策乘数、破除消费壁垒等方式提振消费、扩大内需。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, a People's Daily field report showed how Fujian, Shandong and Hunan are boosting consumption and domestic demand by expanding supply, easing household burdens, amplifying policy multipliers and removing hidden barriers.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃十部门印发《职业技能竞赛管理办法》
articles.title_en: Ten Gansu Departments Issue Measures for Management of Vocational Skills Competitions
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省人力资源和社会保障厅等十部门近日联合印发《甘肃省职业技能竞赛管理办法》，共10章48条，对竞赛职责分工、竞赛体系、组织实施、经费奖励等作出全流程规范。
articles.summary_en: Ten Gansu provincial departments, led by the Department of Human Resources and Social Security, jointly issued measures for managing vocational skills competitions, with 10 chapters and 48 articles covering division of duties, the competition system, organization, funding and awards.

tags.name_zh: 甘肃省人力资源和社会保障厅
tags.name_en: Gansu Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security

articles.title_zh: 以港兴产，挺起广西向海“脊梁”
articles.title_en: Port-Driven Industry Bolsters Guangxi's Marine Economy
articles.summary_zh: 广西北海铁山港依托深水良港发展铝基新材料、不锈钢、钢铁等临港产业集群，园区规上工业总产值增至1710.12亿元。
articles.summary_en: Beihai's Tieshangang zone in Guangxi is building port-based aluminium, stainless steel and steel industrial clusters, with the park's industrial output rising to 171 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 河北省启动工业领域绿色低碳先进技术装备目录推荐工作
articles.title_en: Hebei Launches Recommendation Work for Catalogue of Advanced Green and Low-Carbon Industrial Technologies and Equipment
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日至11月16日，河北省工信厅组织开展工业领域绿色低碳先进技术装备目录推荐工作，择优推荐七类节能降碳技术装备。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 13 to Nov 16, Hebei's provincial industry and IT department is soliciting recommendations for a catalogue of advanced green and low-carbon industrial technologies and equipment, covering seven categories.

articles.title_zh: 2026海南自由贸易港法律周闭幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Hainan Free Trade Port Legal Week Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，2026海南自由贸易港法律周在海口闭幕，海南省委副书记、政法委书记杨晋柏出席并讲话，强调以法治保障自贸港建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18 the 2026 Hainan Free Trade Port Legal Week closed in Haikou; Hainan deputy party secretary Yang Jinbai pledged stronger rule-of-law safeguards for the free trade port.

articles.title_zh: 海南四部门联合发布通告：在全省开展专项行动依法严惩性侵害未成年人违法犯罪
articles.title_en: Hainan's Four Departments Issue Joint Notice Launching Province-wide Campaign Against Sexual Offenses Targeting Minors
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，海南省公安厅等四部门联合发布通告，在全省开展打击防范性侵未成年人犯罪“攻坚—2026”专项行动，持续至2027年2月底。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Hainan's Public Security Department and three other departments issued a joint notice launching a province-wide campaign against sexual offenses targeting minors, running until the end of February 2027.

articles.title_zh: 刘小明在昌江调研农村安全饮水保障和乡村振兴工作
articles.title_en: Hainan Governor Liu Xiaoming Inspects Changjiang on Rural Drinking Water Safety and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，海南省省长刘小明在昌江黎族自治县调研农村安全饮水保障和乡村振兴工作，要求守住饮水安全底线、健全防止返贫动态监测帮扶机制。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Hainan Governor Liu Xiaoming inspected Changjiang Li Autonomous County on rural drinking water safety and revitalization, urging stronger water source protection and anti-poverty monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 2026年"活力中国调研行"海南主题采访活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Vital China Research Tour' Hainan Reporting Activity Launches
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，由中宣部组织的2026年"活力中国调研行"海南主题采访活动在海口启动，上百名记者将实地调研展现海南自贸港封关运作成效。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, a Hainan-themed reporting tour organized by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee launched in Haikou, with over 100 reporters to showcase the free trade port's customs-closure progress through field research.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江扩开放促消费 商务运行稳中提质
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Expands Opening-Up and Boosts Consumption as Commerce Sector Steadily Improves
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，黑龙江省人民政府新闻办公室在哈尔滨举行新闻发布会，省商务厅厅长李继刚介绍今年以来扩大高水平对外开放、推动消费扩容升级的进展成效。
articles.summary_en: On October 19, Heilongjiang's Provincial Information Office held a press conference in Harbin, where Commerce Department Director Li Jigang presented progress on expanding high-level opening-up and upgrading consumption this year.

articles.title_zh: 江苏：以集成式服务推动地方特色产业提质升级
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Promotes Upgrading of Local Specialty Industries Through Integrated Services
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，江苏各地整合资源要素、创新服务模式，建成153个集成式服务站点，累计服务企业超100万家次，推动特色产业提质升级。
articles.summary_en: Since the start of this year, localities across Jiangsu have pooled resources and adopted new service models, building 153 integrated service stations that have served over one million enterprise visits and boosted the upgrading of specialty industries.

articles.title_zh: 呼和浩特市纪念长征胜利90周年系列活动启动
articles.title_en: Hohhot Launches Series of Events Marking 90th Anniversary of Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，呼和浩特市“赓续红色血脉 奋进戎耀北疆”纪念长征胜利90周年系列活动在丝绸之路文化公园启动，200余人参加。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Hohhot launched a series of events marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March victory at the Silk Road Culture Park, with over 200 participants including veteran representatives.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区党委常委会召开扩大会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记在乌兰察布市考察时的重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Expanded Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Remarks from Ulanqab Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，内蒙古自治区党委常委会召开扩大会议，王伟中主持，传达学习习近平总书记在乌兰察布考察时的重要讲话重要指示精神，并部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, the Inner Mongolia Party Committee Standing Committee held an expanded meeting chaired by Secretary Wang Weizhong to study Xi Jinping's remarks from his Ulanqab inspection and arrange implementation.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同黑山副总理兼外长伊布拉希莫维奇会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Montenegrin Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ibrahimović
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在波德戈里察同黑山副总理兼外长伊布拉希莫维奇会谈，双方就提升双边关系定位、基础设施与绿色转型合作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 18, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks with Montenegrin Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ibrahimović in Podgorica, with the two sides exchanging views on elevating bilateral relations and expanding cooperation in infrastructure, tourism and green transition.

articles.title_zh: 第五届中国报业创新发展大会在重庆召开
articles.title_en: Fifth China Newspaper Industry Innovation and Development Conference Opens in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，由国家新闻出版署主办的第五届中国报业创新发展大会在重庆召开，主题为“奋进十五五 变革谱新篇”，聚焦主流媒体系统性变革。
articles.summary_en: The Fifth China Newspaper Industry Innovation and Development Conference, hosted by the National Press and Publication Administration, opened in Chongqing on Oct 19 under the theme of advancing reform during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, focusing on systemic reform of mainstream media.

articles.title_zh: 2026年青海省网络文明周启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Qinghai Online Civilization Week Launches
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，2026年青海省网络文明周在青海职业技术大学启动，由省委宣传部、省委网信办等六部门联合主办，活动持续至10月23日。
articles.summary_en: On October 18, the 2026 Qinghai Online Civilization Week opened at Qinghai Vocational and Technical University, co-hosted by six provincial departments including the Publicity Department and Cyberspace Administration, running through October 23.

articles.title_zh: 四川出台自然科学基金管理办法 构建“7+N”资助体系
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues Management Measures for Natural Science Fund, Building a '7+N' Funding System
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，四川省科学技术厅宣布《四川省自然科学基金管理办法》已印发，明确构建“7+N”资助体系，增强原始创新能力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Sichuan's Science and Technology Department announced newly issued management measures for the provincial natural science fund, creating a '7+N' funding system to strengthen original innovation.

tags.name_en: Sichuan Provincial Department of Science and Technology

tags_en: Sichuan Provincial Department of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 2026人工智能产业大会“AI走进千行百业”专题论坛举行
articles.title_en: AIIC 2026 Forum on AI Empowering All Industries Held in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 2026人工智能产业大会在山东济南举行，专题论坛聚焦AI落地千行百业，贝壳文化科技集团牵头共建AIGC公共服务平台。
articles.summary_en: The AIIC 2026 forum on AI applications across industries was held in Jinan, Shandong, where Beike Culture & Technology Group led a pact to build an AIGC public service platform.

articles.title_zh: 我国已累计发布1775项食品安全国家标准
articles.title_en: China Has Issued 1,775 National Food Safety Standards in Total
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，国家卫生健康委在北京举办2026年全国食品安全宣传周主题日活动，会上介绍我国已累计发布1775项食品安全国家标准，并推广食品数字标签。
articles.summary_en: On October 18, the National Health Commission held a themed event in Beijing for the 2026 National Food Safety Awareness Week, announcing that China has issued a total of 1,775 national food safety standards and is promoting digital food labeling.

articles.title_zh: 全球首创3公里高温超导带材在沪发布
articles.title_en: World's First 3-Kilometer High-Temperature Superconducting Tape Unveiled in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月18日，全球首根3公里长第二代高温超导带材在上海超导总部基地发布，其产线计划明年一季度投产。
articles.summary_en: On October 18, 2026, the world's first 3-kilometer second-generation high-temperature superconducting tape was unveiled at Shanghai Superconductor's headquarters base, with production planned for the first quarter of next year.

articles.title_zh: 向强而行：中国的金融街，世界的金融街
articles.title_en: Aiming High: China's Financial Street, the World's Financial Street
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日至22日，2026金融街论坛年会在北京举行，以“开放·合作·包容”为主题，400余位中外嘉宾共议金融改革与开放新生态。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Financial Street Forum ran in Beijing from Oct 19 to 22, gathering over 400 guests from 40-plus countries to discuss financial opening, cooperation and reform.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：9月份一线城市商品住宅销售价格环比继续上涨
articles.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: New Home Prices in First-Tier Cities Continued to Rise Month-on-Month in September
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局10月19日发布数据显示，2026年9月一线城市新建商品住宅售价环比上涨0.1%，二三线城市环比降幅收窄，各线城市同比降幅均收窄。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Oct 19 showed new home prices in first-tier Chinese cities rose 0.1% month-on-month in September 2026, while declines in lower-tier cities narrowed and year-on-year drops shrank across all tiers.

articles.title_zh: 亚洲文化遗产保护联盟新增1个观察员国和1个伙伴国
articles.title_en: Alliance for Cultural Heritage in Asia Admits One Observer and One Partner Country
articles.summary_zh: 亚洲文化遗产保护联盟理事会第四次会议10月18日在浙江杭州召开，批准埃及成为伙伴国、哈萨克斯坦成为观察员国，联盟成员总数达到26个。
articles.summary_en: The Alliance for Cultural Heritage in Asia's fourth council meeting in Hangzhou, Zhejiang on Oct 18 approved Egypt as a partner country and Kazakhstan as an observer, bringing total membership to 26.

articles.title_zh: 向着健康中国的目标扎实迈进
articles.title_en: Steadily Marching Toward the Goal of a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 近日，全国卫生与健康大会在北京召开，习近平总书记强调“十五五”时期是建成健康中国目标的关键时期，要推动卫生与健康事业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: China recently held the National Health Conference in Beijing, where Xi Jinping stressed that the 15th Five-Year Plan period is critical to building a Healthy China and urged high-quality development of health services.

tags.name_en: Coordinated Medical, Insurance and Pharmaceutical Reform

tags_en: Coordinated Medical, Insurance and Pharmaceutical Reform

articles.title_zh: 伊朗：已针对可能的新“冒险行径”制定应对方案
articles.title_en: Iran Says Contingency Plans Ready for Possible New 'Adventurism'
articles.summary_zh: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊10月18日称，伊朗武装力量已针对任何新的“冒险行径”制定应对方案，破坏力将远超此前。
articles.summary_en: Iran’s SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei said on Oct 18 that Iran’s armed forces have contingency plans for any new “adventurism,” with far greater destructive power.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议 通报国家监委对黄日波进行监察调查的决定
articles.title_en: Regional Party Standing Committee Convenes Meeting to Convey Supervisory Investigation Decision on Huang Ribo
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，广西自治区党委常委会召开会议，通报国家监委对自治区政协原副主席黄日波涉嫌严重职务违法进行监察调查的决定，自治区党委书记陈刚主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, the Guangxi regional Party Standing Committee met to convey the decision by the National Commission of Supervision to investigate former regional CPPCC vice chairman Huang Ribo for suspected serious duty-related violations. Party secretary Chen Gang chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 省委召开省级老同志座谈会和党外人士座谈会 就省第十二次党代会报告广泛征求意见
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Holds Forums with Veteran Officials and Non-Party Figures to Seek Input on 12th Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河南省委书记周祖翼先后主持召开省级老同志座谈会和党外人士座谈会，就省第十二次党代会报告征求意见稿广泛听取意见建议，代省长王陆进、省政协主席孔昌生出席。
articles.summary_en: Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi recently chaired forums with veteran provincial officials and non-party figures to gather broad input on the draft report for the province's 12th Party Congress, with acting governor Wang Lujin and CPPCC chairman Kong Changsheng attending.

articles.title_zh: 2026年四季度全省经济运行工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Henan Holds Q4 2026 Provincial Economic Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，2026年四季度河南省经济运行工作推进会在郑州召开，省委书记周祖翼出席并讲话，代省长王陆进主持，会议部署四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Henan held its Q4 2026 provincial economic work meeting in Zhengzhou, where Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi spoke and Acting Governor Wang Lujin presided, setting year-end tasks.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事·长征丨革命老区奋进新程
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: Long March — Old Revolutionary Areas Forge Ahead on a New Journey
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道长征沿线革命老区传承红色基因、改善医疗养老等民生福祉，并发展特色农林与算力产业，走好新时代长征路。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that old revolutionary areas along the Long March route are preserving red heritage, improving healthcare and elderly care, and developing specialty agriculture and computing industries.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 钟华论：在新的长征路上继续奋勇前进
articles.title_en: Zhong Hualun: Forging Ahead on the New Long March
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月19日播发钟华论文章，纪念红军长征胜利90周年，号召弘扬伟大长征精神，并预告党的二十届五中全会10月26日至29日在北京召开。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's Zhong Hualun commentary marks the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March, calling for renewed commitment to the Long March spirit and noting the CPC's Fifth Plenum in Beijing on Oct 26-29.

articles.title_zh: 让所有老年人都能有一个幸福美满的晚年
articles.title_en: Ensuring a Happy and Fulfilling Life for All Elderly People
articles.summary_zh: 新华社学习手记梳理习近平总书记多年来关心关爱老年人的讲话与调研，指出积极应对人口老龄化已上升为国家战略，养老服务体系持续完善。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua study note reviews Xi Jinping's long-standing care for the elderly, noting that actively responding to population aging is now a national strategy and elderly care services keep improving.

articles.title_zh: 商务部等9部门关于加快推进科技兴商的意见
articles.title_en: Nine Departments Including MOFCOM Issue Opinions on Accelerating Technology-Driven Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 商务部等9部门联合发布《关于加快推进科技兴商的意见》，提出以人工智能、大数据等技术推动商品消费提质、服务消费扩容和商贸流通数智化升级。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce and eight other departments jointly issued opinions on accelerating technology-driven commerce, pledging to use AI, big data and other technologies to upgrade goods consumption, expand services consumption and digitalize commercial circulation.

articles.title_zh: 国家邮政局公布2026年1-9月邮政行业运行情况
articles.title_en: State Post Bureau Releases Postal Industry Statistics for January-September 2026
articles.summary_zh: 国家邮政局公布2026年1-9月数据：邮政行业业务收入累计完成13893.1亿元，同比增长5.8%；快递业务量累计完成1513.0亿件，同比增长4.3%。
articles.summary_en: China's State Post Bureau released January-September 2026 data showing postal industry revenue of 1.39 trillion yuan, up 5.8% year-on-year, with 151.3 billion express deliveries, up 4.3%.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解实事求是、知行合一的哲学思想
articles.title_en: Deeply Understanding the Philosophical Thought of Seeking Truth from Facts and the Unity of Knowledge and Action
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐释“实事求是、知行合一”的哲学内涵及其在党的思想路线与治国理政中的实践，强调党员干部要真抓实干、树立正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: The article explains the philosophy of seeking truth from facts and the unity of knowledge and action, and how the CPC applies it in governance, urging cadres to deliver real results.

articles.title_zh: 金秋看“丰”景丨科技赋能 粮满金秋
articles.title_en: Autumn Harvest in View: Technology Empowers a Bumper Grain Season
articles.summary_zh: 金秋时节，安徽各地以科技支撑秋粮抢收与秋冬种生产，通过履带式收割机、智慧农田监测和无人机飞播提升全链条效率。
articles.summary_en: During the autumn harvest, Anhui Province is using technology — tracked harvesters, smart-field monitoring, and drone seeding — to speed up grain harvesting and winter planting across the whole production chain.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度我国GDP同比增长4.6%
articles.title_en: China's GDP Grows 4.6% Year-on-Year in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局10月19日发布数据，初步核算，前三季度我国国内生产总值1071071亿元，按不变价格计算同比增长4.6%。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics said on Oct 19 that China's GDP reached 107.11 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, up 4.6 percent year-on-year at constant prices.

articles.title_zh: 全国秋粮收获超七成，秋粮旺季收购有序开展
articles.title_en: Over 70% of China's Autumn Grain Harvested as Peak-Season Purchases Proceed in an Orderly Manner
articles.summary_zh: 据农业农村部农情调度，全国秋粮收获过七成，秋冬种同步推进；国家粮食和物资储备局称，各类经营主体已收购中晚稻1800万吨。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, more than 70 percent of China's autumn grain has been harvested and winter planting is under way; the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration says 18 million tonnes of mid-to-late rice have been purchased.

articles.title_zh: 自治区第十一次党代会举行预备会议
articles.title_en: Preparatory Meeting Held for Xinjiang's 11th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日下午，中国共产党新疆维吾尔自治区第十一次代表大会举行预备会议，陈小江主持会议并讲话，通过大会主席团名单、代表资格审查委员会名单和大会议程。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 18, Xinjiang's 11th Party Congress held a preparatory meeting chaired by Chen Xiaojiang, approving the presidium, the credential committee and the congress agenda.

articles.title_zh: 云南民族大学举行建校75周年高质量发展论坛
articles.title_en: Yunnan Minzu University Holds High-Quality Development Forum for 75th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，云南民族大学建校75周年高质量发展论坛在雨花校区举行，研讨民族院校特色发展路径，并与地方政府等单位签署合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Yunnan Minzu University held a high-quality development forum marking its 75th anniversary at its Yuhua campus, discussing distinctive development paths for ethnic universities and signing cooperation agreements with local government bodies.

articles.title_zh: 长春市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Changchun Mayor Gu Gang Chairs Municipal Government Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日，长春市市长顾刚主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，部署经济运行、产业培育、科技创新、城市更新等工作，并原则通过《中国光电城空间布局规划》。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang chaired the municipal government's party group and executive meetings, deploying work on the economy, industry, innovation and urban renewal, and approving the China Optoelectronics City spatial layout plan.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰会见中投公司国际咨询委员会委员
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Meets Members of CIC International Advisory Council
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日晚，国务院副总理何立峰在北京钓鱼台国宾馆会见中投公司国际咨询委员会委员，介绍中国经济形势与“十五五”时期扩大高水平对外开放、深化金融体制改革的举措。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Oct 18, Vice Premier He Lifeng met members of the China Investment Corporation's International Advisory Council at the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse in Beijing, briefing them on China's economy and plans to expand high-level opening up and deepen financial reform.

articles.title_zh: 李强赴杜尚别对塔吉克斯坦进行正式访问并出席上海合作组织成员国政府首脑（总理）理事会第二十五次会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Arrives in Dushanbe for Official Visit to Tajikistan and 25th SCO Heads of Government Council Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，国务院总理李强抵达杜尚别，开始对塔吉克斯坦进行正式访问，并将出席上合组织成员国政府首脑（总理）理事会第二十五次会议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 18, Premier Li Qiang arrived in Dushanbe for an official visit to Tajikistan and will attend the 25th SCO Heads of Government Council meeting.

articles.title_zh: 从亚太伙伴关系到亚太共同体——习近平主席引领推动亚太合作迈上新台阶
articles.title_en: From Asia-Pacific Partnership to an Asia-Pacific Community: Xi Jinping Leads Asia-Pacific Cooperation to a New Level
articles.summary_zh: 2026年中国第三次担任亚太经合组织东道主，领导人非正式会议下月将在广东深圳举行，文章回顾习近平主席引领亚太合作的思想与实践。
articles.summary_en: China is hosting APEC for the third time in 2026, with the leaders' meeting set for Shenzhen next month; the article reviews Xi Jinping's ideas and practice in guiding Asia-Pacific cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 李强同乌兹别克斯坦总理阿里波夫会谈
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with Uzbek Prime Minister Aripov
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日下午，国务院总理李强在塔什干同乌兹别克斯坦总理阿里波夫举行会谈，双方就深化经贸、能源、人工智能、互联互通等领域合作达成共识并签署多项合作文件。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 17 in Tashkent, Chinese Premier Li Qiang held talks with Uzbek Prime Minister Abdulla Aripov, agreeing to deepen cooperation in trade, energy, AI and connectivity, and witnessing the signing of multiple cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 李强同塔吉克斯坦总理拉苏尔佐达会谈
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with Tajik Prime Minister Rasulzoda
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日下午，国务院总理李强在杜尚别同塔吉克斯坦总理拉苏尔佐达举行会谈，双方商定深化经贸、能源、互联互通等领域合作，并见证签署多项合作文件。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 18, Premier Li Qiang held talks with Tajik Prime Minister Rasulzoda in Dushanbe, agreeing to deepen cooperation in trade, energy and connectivity, and witnessing the signing of multiple bilateral documents.

articles.title_zh: 李强同乌兹别克斯坦总理阿里波夫举行会谈
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with Uzbek Prime Minister Aripov
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间10月17日下午，国务院总理李强在塔什干同乌兹别克斯坦总理阿里波夫举行会谈，双方就深化多领域务实合作达成共识，并共同见证签署多项合作文件。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 17 local time, Premier Li Qiang held talks with Uzbek Prime Minister Aripov in Tashkent, where the two sides agreed to deepen practical cooperation and witnessed the signing of multiple documents.

articles.title_zh: 今年前三季度全国铁路发送旅客超37亿人次
articles.title_en: National Railway Passenger Trips Exceed 3.7 Billion in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日，中国国家铁路集团公布，今年前三季度全国铁路发送旅客37.1亿人次，同比增长4.8%，创历史同期新高。
articles.summary_en: China State Railway Group said on Oct 18 that national railways carried 3.71 billion passenger trips in the first three quarters, up 4.8% year on year and a record high for the period.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见乌兹别克斯坦总统米尔济约耶夫
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Uzbek President Mirziyoyev in Tashkent
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间10月17日，国务院总理李强在塔什干会见乌兹别克斯坦总统米尔济约耶夫，双方就加强战略沟通、拓展经贸能源互联互通合作及多边平台协作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 17 local time, Premier Li Qiang met Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev in Tashkent, with the two sides agreeing to strengthen strategic communication, expand trade, energy and connectivity cooperation, and coordinate on multilateral platforms.

articles.title_zh: 总书记指引“十五五”帮扶工作迈向常态化新阶段
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides China's Assistance Work Into a Normalized Phase Under the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日国家扶贫日，新华社梳理习近平总书记在“十五五”开局之年就常态化帮扶作出的部署，要求守牢不发生规模性返贫致贫底线。
articles.summary_en: On the National Poverty Relief Day of Oct 17, Xinhua reviewed Xi Jinping's directives on normalized assistance in the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, urging efforts to prevent any large-scale return to poverty.

articles.title_zh: 四平市委书记王相民主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Siping Party Secretary Wang Xiangmin Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，四平市委书记王相民主持召开市委常委会会议，研究部署现代农业、法治政府建设、卫生健康及高校毕业生就业等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Siping Party Secretary Wang Xiangmin chaired a standing committee meeting to deploy work on modern agriculture, rule-of-law government building, healthcare and graduate employment.

articles.title_zh: 王相民主持召开四平市委常委会会议，研究部署“三农”、法治建设与高校毕业生就业工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xiangmin Chairs Siping Municipal Party Committee Meeting on Agriculture, Rule of Law and Graduate Employment
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，四平市委书记王相民主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署现代农业、法治政府建设、卫生健康及高校毕业生就业工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Siping Party Secretary Wang Xiangmin chaired a municipal Party committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's guiding remarks and plan work on modern agriculture, rule of law, health services and graduate employment.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研督导全面依法治市工作 强调全面推进更高水平法治西安建设
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Work on Law-Based Governance, Pledges Higher-Level Rule of Law in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰调研督导全面依法治市工作，强调规范涉企行政检查、提升司法执行质效和行政争议化解水平。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected the city's law-based governance work, urging standardized corporate inspections, better judicial enforcement and stronger resolution of administrative disputes.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察，部署算力网建设与绿色算力产业发展
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, Deploys Computing Power Network and Green Computing Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察，了解“东数西算”枢纽节点建设情况，部署算力网建设与绿色算力产业发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, reviewing the East Data West Computing hub project and setting out plans for the national computing power network and green computing industry.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察算力产业
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Computing Power Industry in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察察哈尔高新技术开发区，了解“东数西算”枢纽节点建设和绿色算力产业发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Chahar High-tech Development Zone in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, learning about the "East Data, West Computing" hub project and the green computing industry.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省第十八届运动会在衢州开幕 王浩宣布开幕
articles.title_en: 18th Zhejiang Provincial Games Opens in Quzhou, Wang Hao Declares Opening
articles.summary_zh: 10月18日晚，浙江省第十八届运动会在衢州市体育中心开幕，省委书记王浩宣布开幕。本届省运会设39个大项，参赛规模创历届之最。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Oct 18, the 18th Zhejiang Provincial Games opened at Quzhou Sports Center, with Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao declaring the event open. It features 39 sports and record participation.

articles.title_zh: 事关国民经济运行与科技兴商，两场发布会今日将举行
articles.title_en: Two Press Conferences Today on National Economic Performance and Technology-Empowered Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 10月19日，国务院新闻办将举行两场发布会，分别由国家统计局介绍前三季度国民经济运行情况，商务部等介绍推进科技兴商情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 19, China's State Council Information Office will hold two press conferences: the National Bureau of Statistics on third-quarter economic performance, and the Ministry of Commerce and others on advancing technology-empowered commerce.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台财政常态化帮扶资金管理办法
articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues Measures for Managing Regular Fiscal Assistance Funds
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，广西自治区财政厅会同农业农村厅等部门联合印发《广西财政常态化帮扶资金管理办法》，自2026年起增设少数民族任务方向，按自治区资金总量4%切块安排。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Guangxi's finance department and other agencies jointly issued rules for regular fiscal assistance funds, adding a minority-area task from 2026 with 4% of regional funds allocated to it.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到哈尔滨市走访慰问 向全省老年人致以节日祝福
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Visits Elderly Residents in Harbin, Extends Festival Greetings to Seniors Across Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 重阳节当天，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨走访慰问院士沈世钊、老战士王凤楼及康养机构，强调大力发展老龄事业、建设幸福龙江。
articles.summary_en: On the Chongyang Festival, Heilongjiang Party Secretary Xu Qin visited Harbin to greet academician Shen Shizhao, veteran Wang Fenglou and elderly-care facilities, pledging to develop elderly care and build a happier Heilongjiang.

tags_zh: 黑龙江省第一荣军优抚医院

articles.title_zh: “勤廉龙江好家风”县（市、区）巡讲示范活动在鹤城启动
articles.title_en: County-Level Tour on Integrity-Focused Family Values Launches in Qiqihar
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，黑龙江省“勤廉龙江好家风”县（市、区）巡讲示范活动在齐齐哈尔启动，由省妇联、省纪委监委机关主办，近700名机关干部及配偶现场参会。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Heilongjiang launched a county-level tour promoting integrity-focused family values in Qiqihar, hosted by the provincial women's federation and discipline commission, with nearly 700 officials and spouses attending.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省2027届高校毕业生就业工作全面启动
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Launches 2027 College Graduate Employment Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，黑龙江省教育厅联合省人社厅等部门在哈尔滨师范大学召开2027届高校毕业生就业工作启动会，并同步举办大型校园招聘会。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, Heilongjiang's Education Department, together with several provincial departments, held a launch meeting at Harbin Normal University for 2027 graduate employment work, alongside a large campus job fair.

articles.title_zh: 有效化解信访突出问题 解决好群众急难愁盼
articles.title_en: Lu Xiaoqing Receives Petitioners in Yingtan, Urges Effective Resolution of Public Grievances
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，江西省委常委、省委宣传部部长卢小青在鹰潭市接待来访群众并专题调度信访工作，要求依法及时解决群众合理诉求。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Lu Xiaoqing, a standing committee member of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee and head of its publicity department, received petitioners in Yingtan and chaired a special meeting on petition work, urging timely, law-based resolution of residents' legitimate grievances.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘会见中国通用技术集团董事长于旭波
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Meets China General Technology Group Chairman Yu Xubo
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日，江西省委书记尹弘在南昌会见中国通用技术集团董事长于旭波，双方就深化央地合作、拓展装备制造和医疗健康领域合作进行了交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, Jiangxi Party Secretary Yin Hong met in Nanchang with Yu Xubo, chairman of China General Technology Group, to discuss deeper central-local cooperation in equipment manufacturing and healthcare.

articles.title_zh: 坚持生态优先，因地制宜推动高质量发展
articles.title_en: Upholding Ecological Priority and Pursuing High-Quality Development Tailored to Local Conditions
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布考察并发表重要讲话，强调坚持生态优先、绿色发展，因地制宜推动高质量发展，广大干部群众表示要认真贯彻落实。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia and called for ecological priority, green development and high-quality development suited to local conditions; officials pledged to act on his speech.

articles.title_zh: 王沪宁在四川调研时强调：坚持为推进中国式现代化凝心聚力，扎实做好新时代党的民族宗教工作
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Stresses Cohesion for Chinese Modernization and Solid Work on Ethnic and Religious Affairs During Sichuan Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日至16日，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁在四川成都、德阳、甘孜调研，强调铸牢中华民族共同体意识、推进宗教中国化。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 13 to 16, Wang Huning, member of the CPC Politburo Standing Committee and chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, inspected Chengdu, Deyang and Garze in Sichuan, stressing ethnic unity and the sinicization of religion.

articles.title_zh: 坚持生态优先，因地制宜推动高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Ulanqab Inspection Speech Inspires Cadres to Pursue Eco-Priority, High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布考察并发表重要讲话，广大干部群众表示要坚定不移走生态优先、绿色发展之路，因地制宜推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia and delivered a speech; officials and residents pledged to follow an eco-priority, green path and pursue locally tailored high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: “长板”发力托稳增长大盘
articles.title_en: Leveraging Strengths to Stabilize Growth: Shaanxi Accelerates Emerging Industries
articles.summary_zh: 陕西加快打造新兴支柱产业、培育潜力产业并布局未来产业，半导体、光子、氢能等产业链产值快速增长，支撑经济稳增长。
articles.summary_en: Shaanxi is accelerating emerging and future industries, with semiconductor, photonics, hydrogen and modern chemical chains posting rapid output growth to support stable economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 陈新武在市安委会、市防减救灾委全体（扩大）会议上强调：深化拓展百日攻坚，抓紧抓实安全防范
articles.title_en: Chen Xinwu Stresses Deeper Push on 100-Day Campaign and Solid Safety Precautions at Chongqing Safety and Disaster Relief Committees' Plenary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日，重庆市市长陈新武出席市安委会、市防减救灾委全体（扩大）会议，部署群防群治百日攻坚及重点行业领域安全隐患整治。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu addressed a plenary meeting of the city's work safety and disaster relief committees, urging deeper 100-day public safety campaigns and hazard clearance in key industries.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚向全区老干部代表作形势报告
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Delivers Situation Report to Retired Officials in Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚向全区老干部代表作形势报告，介绍广西“十五五”发展思路与成效，并致以重阳节问候。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang delivered a situation report to retired officials, outlining the region's 15th Five-Year Plan development priorities and extending Chongyang Festival greetings.

articles.title_zh: 省政协赴连云港开展调研 张义珍参加
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Conducts Research Visit to Lianyungang, Zhang Yizhen Participates
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日至16日，江苏省政协主席张义珍赴连云港东海县、赣榆区，围绕金融惠企政策措施落实情况开展民主监督调研并召开座谈会。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 14 to 16, Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Chair Zhang Yizhen visited Donghai County and Ganyu District in Lianyungang to conduct democratic-supervision research on the implementation of financial policies that support enterprises, and chaired a symposium.

articles.title_zh: 江苏举办市县党政正职树立和践行正确政绩观专题培训班 信长星讲开班“第一课”
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Holds Training Session for City and County Party and Government Leaders on Correct Views on Political Achievements; Xin Changxing Delivers Opening Lecture
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日至17日，江苏举办市县党政正职树立和践行正确政绩观专题培训班，省委书记信长星讲开班第一课，省长刘小涛作专题辅导。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16-17 Jiangsu held a training session for city and county party and government chiefs on correct views on political achievements; party secretary Xin Changxing gave the opening lecture and governor Liu Xiaotao a special briefing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事｜让湖泊扮靓美丽中国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: Lakes Beautify a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 新华社梳理习近平总书记对湖泊生态保护的关切：10月16日他考察内蒙古黄旗海自然保护区，要求全面实施湿地保护法，各地以制度创新和科技赋能推进湖泊治理。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua review of Xi Jinping's focus on lake conservation: on Oct 16 he inspected the Huangqihai reserve in Inner Mongolia, urging full enforcement of the Wetland Protection Law as localities restore lakes with institutional and technological tools.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 习近平内蒙古乌兰察布考察：登高望远处，风光正无限
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, Stressing Green Development and Green Computing
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布考察黄旗海生态治理与绿色算力产业，强调因地制宜推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, reviewing lake restoration and green computing industries and urging tailored high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 云南多个公路口岸实施中外边民快捷通关试点
articles.title_en: Yunnan Launches Fast-Track Clearance Pilot for Chinese and Foreign Border Residents at Multiple Highway Ports
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月18日起，云南河口、磨憨、天保、金水河等公路口岸正式实施中外边民快捷通关试点，边民经备案“扫码”通关，平均通关时间从1分钟缩短至10秒。
articles.summary_en: Starting October 18, 2026, Yunnan's Hekou, Mohan, Tianbao and Jinshuihe highway ports began a fast-track clearance pilot for Chinese and foreign border residents, cutting average clearance time from one minute to 10 seconds via registered QR-code scanning.

articles.title_zh: 中国研发全球农情遥感监测平台获联合国粮农组织成就奖
articles.title_en: China-Developed Global CropWatch Remote Sensing Platform Wins FAO Achievement Award
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，中科院空天院研发的全球农情遥感监测平台在罗马获联合国粮农组织2026年度成就奖，该平台已支撑40多个国家的粮食安全决策。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16 in Rome, the CropWatch platform developed by the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Aerospace Information Research Institute won the 2026 FAO Achievement Award; it supports food-security decisions in over 40 countries.

articles.title_en: 16th Airshow China to Open in Zhuhai in December, Multiple New Types of Equipment to Debut
articles.summary_zh: 第十六届中国国际航空航天博览会将于12月7日至13日在广东珠海举办，近50个国家和地区超1100家企业参展，空军、海军多型新型装备将同台亮相。
articles.summary_en: The 16th Airshow China will run in Zhuhai, Guangdong on Dec 7-13 with over 1,100 exhibitors from nearly 50 countries and regions, as new PLA Air Force and Navy equipment debuts in a 'one show, three zones' layout.

articles.title_zh: 台湾新住民经贸文化交流协会参访河北
articles.title_en: Taiwan New Residents Economic, Trade and Cultural Exchange Association Visits Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日至17日，台湾新住民经贸文化交流协会参访团一行24人应河北省台联、省黄埔军校同学会邀请赴河北参访，走访雄安新区、邯郸等地。
articles.summary_en: A 24-member delegation from Taiwan's New Residents Economic, Trade and Cultural Exchange Association visited Hebei from Oct 10 to 17 at the invitation of the Hebei Taiwan Compatriots Association, touring the Xiong'an New Area, Handan and other sites.

articles.title_en: Gansu Courts Use "Plus" Approach to Resolve Cases at Source
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，中新网报道甘肃法院推进“示范性诉讼+批量化调解”试点，已受理4.3万余件类型化纠纷，化解成功率超七成，并借助人工智能平台辅助调解。
articles.summary_en: Gansu courts' pilot pairing model litigation with batch mediation has handled over 43,000 clustered disputes with a resolution rate above 70%, aided by an AI dispute-resolution platform.

articles.title_zh: 克罗地亚总统米拉诺维奇会见王毅
articles.title_en: Croatian President Milanović Meets Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间10月16日，克罗地亚总统米拉诺维奇在萨格勒布会见中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅，双方就中克关系和中欧关系交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 16 local time, Croatian President Zoran Milanović met Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Zagreb, where they exchanged views on China-Croatia relations and China-EU ties.

articles.title_zh: 习近平考察内蒙古乌兰察布 部署算力网与绿色算力产业发展
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, Deploying Computing Network and Green Computing Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察，了解“东数西算”枢纽节点建设和绿色算力产业发展情况，并对算力网建设作出部署。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, reviewing the East-to-West Computing hub project and green computing industry and setting out plans for building the national computing network.

articles.title_zh: 第140届广交会新品首发区亮相 境外采购商青睐中国制造
articles.title_en: New Product Launch Zone Debuts at 140th Canton Fair as Overseas Buyers Warm to Made-in-China Goods
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，第140届广交会新品首发展示区吸引众多境外采购商体验中国制造新品，本届新品首发活动超700场，首发数量增长15%。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, the new-product launch zone at the 140th Canton Fair drew overseas buyers eager to try made-in-China innovations, with more than 700 launch events this session, up 15%.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国将继续与国际社会一道共促减贫合作
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China to Continue Working with International Community on Poverty Reduction Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京表示，中国将继续与国际社会共促减贫合作，并介绍中国消除绝对贫困及全球发展倡议下的减贫行动。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said in Beijing that China will continue working with the international community to advance poverty reduction cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺湖南大学建校100周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on Hunan University's 100th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平致信祝贺湖南大学建校100周年，向全体师生员工和校友致以祝贺，希望学校培养更多经世致用的优秀人才。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee and Chinese president, sent a letter congratulating Hunan University on its 100th anniversary, urging it to cultivate more outstanding talent.

articles.title_zh: 科技进乡间 农业焕新机
articles.title_en: Technology Brings New Vitality to Agriculture in Rural Gansu
articles.summary_zh: 10月，甘肃会宁县推进高标准农田建设，通过土地流转、水肥一体化等技术提升秋粮生产。
articles.summary_en: In October, Huining County in Gansu promoted high-standard farmland construction, using land transfers and integrated water-fertilizer technology to boost autumn grain production.

articles.title_zh: 第九届进博会首发首展首秀品数量创新高
articles.title_en: Debut Products at 9th CIIE Hit Record High
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，国务院新闻办介绍第九届进博会筹备情况；本届进博会将于11月5日至10日在上海举办，首发首展首秀展品超480件。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the State Council Information Office briefed on the 9th CIIE, set for Shanghai on Nov 5-10, with more than 480 debut exhibits, a record high.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平在内蒙古自治区乌兰察布市考察，来到察哈尔右翼前旗的黄旗海自然保护区。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, inspected Ulanqab City in Inner Mongolia, visiting the Huangqihai Nature Reserve in Chahar Right Front Banner.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：中欧混动汽车磋商所谓“欧方施压奏效”的说法毫无依据
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry: Claims That 'EU Pressure Worked' in China-EU Hybrid Vehicle Talks Are Groundless
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，商务部新闻发言人在北京表示，中欧就混动汽车达成的谅解是对等互利的，有力维护了中国企业利益，所谓“欧方施压奏效”毫无依据。
articles.summary_en: On October 16 in Beijing, a Ministry of Commerce spokesperson said the China-EU understanding on hybrid vehicles is mutually beneficial and safeguards Chinese firms' interests, calling claims that EU pressure worked groundless.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察纪实：有高远目标，更有耐心有定力
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia: High Goals Demand Patience and Resolve
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记赴内蒙古乌兰察布市考察调研，实地察看黄旗海湿地治理成效和绿色算力产业，强调坚持生态优先、推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, reviewing restoration of Huangqi Lake wetland and the green computing industry, stressing ecological priority and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 听取“人工智能+”行动进展情况汇报等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on the "AI Plus" Initiative and Draft Laws
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，听取“人工智能+”行动进展汇报，讨论教师法修订草案和价格法修正草案。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing to hear a report on the "AI Plus" initiative and discuss draft revisions to the Teachers Law and the Price Law.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究平安沈阳建设等工作 霍步刚主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Safe Shenyang and Urban Renewal; Huo Bugang Presides
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，沈阳市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究平安沈阳建设、城市更新等工作，市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Shenyang's municipal Party committee met to study Xi Jinping's instructions and discuss Safe Shenyang, urban renewal and public security, with Huo Bugang presiding.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神 许昆林主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Party Standing Committee Studies Xi Jinping's Speech at National Health Conference, Xu Kunlin Presides
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，辽宁省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见，省委书记许昆林主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the Liaoning Provincial Party Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's speech at the National Health Conference and plan implementation, with Party Secretary Xu Kunlin presiding.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察时强调 统筹高质量发展和高水平保护 坚定不移走生态优先绿色发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses Coordinated High-Quality Development and High-Level Protection During Inner Mongolia Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察，强调走生态优先、绿色发展之路，并实地调研湿地保护、绿色算力产业和“东数西算”工程建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, stressing an ecological-priority, green development path and reviewing wetland protection, green computing and the East-to-West Computing project.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，听取“人工智能＋”行动进展汇报，讨论教师法修订草案和价格法修正草案，并审议通过修改废止部分行政法规的决定草案。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on Oct 16, reviewing progress on the AI Plus initiative, discussing draft revisions to the Teachers Law and Price Law, and approving changes to certain administrative regulations.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见以色列总统赫尔佐格
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Israeli President Herzog
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在巴库出席亚信峰会期间应约会见以色列总统赫尔佐格，双方就中以关系和中东局势交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Foreign Minister Wang Yi met Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of the CICA summit in Baku to discuss China-Israel ties and the Middle East situation.

articles.title_zh: 王毅在巴库会见巴勒斯坦外长法尔辛
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Palestinian Foreign Minister Farsin in Baku
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在巴库出席亚信峰会期间会见巴勒斯坦外长法尔辛，双方就巴勒斯坦问题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Palestinian Foreign Minister Farsin on the sidelines of the CICA summit in Baku, with both sides exchanging views on the Palestinian issue.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察 强调生态优先绿色发展
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, Stressing Ecological Priority and Green Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察，察看黄旗海湿地生态，就统筹高质量发展和高水平保护、走生态优先绿色发展之路作出重要指示。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia's autonomous region, viewing the Huangqihai wetland and issuing instructions on balancing high-quality development with high-level protection and pursuing green development.

articles.title_zh: 开放底色鲜明 创新动能强劲——第九届中国国际进口博览会亮点前瞻
articles.title_en: Openness and Innovation: Preview of the 9th China International Import Expo
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办10月16日举行发布会，介绍第九届进博会将于11月5日至10日在上海举办，4142家境外企业参展，首发首展展品创新高。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Information Office on Oct 16 previewed the 9th China International Import Expo, to be held in Shanghai on Nov 5-10 with 4,142 overseas exhibitors and many debut products.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察绿色算力产业 指引因地制宜发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Green Computing Industry in Inner Mongolia, Guiding Tailored Development of New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察察哈尔高新技术开发区，了解“东数西算”枢纽节点建设和绿色算力产业发展情况，强调因地制宜发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping visited the Chahar High-tech Zone in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, reviewing the East Data West Computing hub and green computing industry and urging tailored development of new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 前八个月我国服务贸易保持较快增长
articles.title_en: China's Services Trade Maintains Relatively Fast Growth in First Eight Months

articles.title_zh: 通航满月！探寻平陆运河向海图强的活力密码
articles.title_en: A Month After Opening: Pinglu Canal's Vitality in Connecting Southwest China to the Sea
articles.summary_zh: 平陆运河通航满月，航运、生态保护与文旅全面升温，截至10月11日游船接待游客达28932人次。
articles.summary_en: One month after opening to navigation, the Pinglu Canal is seeing rising shipping traffic, ecological safeguards and tourism, with 28,932 visitors on its tour boats as of Oct 11.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事·长征丨守护好红色传家宝
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: The Long March — Protecting the Red Heirlooms
articles.summary_zh: 沿着习近平总书记关于加强革命文物保护利用的重要指示，长征沿线各地修缮红色遗址、建好长征国家文化公园，推动革命文物活化利用与长征精神活态传承。
articles.summary_en: Following Xi Jinping's instructions on protecting and utilizing revolutionary relics, regions along the Long March route are restoring red heritage sites and building the Long March National Cultural Park to keep the Long March spirit alive.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军调研创新强市建设：强化企业创新主体地位，加快培育壮大新质生产力
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Inspects Innovation-Driven City Development: Strengthening Enterprises' Role as Innovation Entities to Cultivate New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军赴重庆高新区调研创新强市建设，走访科技企业并强调强化企业创新主体地位、推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 16, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun inspected the Chongqing High-tech Zone to study innovation-driven city development, visiting tech firms and urging stronger corporate innovation and deeper integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 福建省数智文旅OPC联合体行动在龙岩长汀正式启动
articles.title_en: Fujian Smart Digital Cultural Tourism OPC Consortium Initiative Launched in Changting, Longyan
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，福建省数字文旅项目成果交流展示活动在龙岩市长汀县举行，福建省数智文旅OPC联合体行动正式启动，探索AI赋能县域文旅的产业协同新模式。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Fujian held a digital cultural tourism showcase in Changting County, Longyan, launching the provincial smart digital tourism OPC consortium to explore AI-driven, county-level tourism industry collaboration.

tags.name_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Fujian Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 2026世界航海装备大会在福州开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 World Maritime Equipment Conference Opens in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，2026世界航海装备大会在福州开幕，福建省委书记赵龙出席并致辞，大会主题为“绿智共生、链动蓝海”。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the 2026 World Maritime Equipment Conference opened in Fuzhou. Fujian Party Secretary Zhao Long attended and addressed the event themed “Green-Intelligent Coexistence, Linking the Blue Ocean.”

articles.title_zh: 省委召开省级老干部经济社会发展情况通报会
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Holds Briefing for Retired Provincial-Level Officials on Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，海南省委召开省级老干部经济社会发展情况通报会，省委书记冯飞主持并讲话，省长刘小明通报全省经济社会发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the Hainan Provincial Party Committee held a briefing for retired provincial-level officials, with Party Secretary Feng Fei presiding and Governor Liu Xiaoming reporting on economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 2026海南自由贸易港法律周启幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Hainan Free Trade Port Legal Week Opens in Haikou
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，2026海南自由贸易港法律周在海口启幕，省长刘小明出席并致辞，海南省司法厅与香港特区政府律政司等签署法律服务合作协议。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Hainan Free Trade Port Legal Week opened in Haikou on Oct 16, with Governor Liu Xiaoming delivering remarks and Hainan's Justice Department signing legal-services cooperation arrangements with Hong Kong's Department of Justice and others.

articles.title_zh: 省委召开专题会议 研究赤潮灾害科学防范和综合治理工作
articles.title_en: Hainan Provincial Party Committee Holds Special Meeting on Scientific Prevention and Comprehensive Governance of Red Tide Disasters
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，海南省委书记冯飞主持召开专题会议，研究赤潮灾害科学防范与综合治理，部署监测预警、源头防控与渔业保障等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei chaired a special meeting on preventing and governing red tide disasters, deploying monitoring, early warning, source control and fishery support measures.

articles.title_zh: 全谷物食品加快走向千家万户
articles.title_en: Whole Grain Foods Reach More Households as China's Action Plan Advances
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日世界粮食日，全国粮食安全宣传周主会场活动在安徽合肥举行，国家粮食和物资储备局介绍全谷物行动计划实施以来的产业与科普进展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, World Food Day, the main event of China's National Food Security Week was held in Hefei, Anhui, where the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration reported progress on the whole grain action plan.

articles.title_zh: 推动地方学习平台提质增效
articles.title_en: Research Team Visits Ganzhou to Improve Local Learning Platforms' Quality and Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中宣部宣传舆情研究中心与“学习强国”学习平台调研组赴江西赣州调研并召开推广运用座谈会，明确内容提质、技术升级方向。
articles.summary_en: A research team from the CPC Central Committee Propaganda Department's public opinion research center and the "Xuexi Qiangguo" platform visited Ganzhou, Jiangxi, holding a symposium on platform promotion and content quality.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委常委会召开会议 尹弘主持
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets, Chaired by Yin Hong
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，江西省委常委会召开会议，省委书记尹弘主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和中央会议精神，并审议“十五五”教育、交通、应急等规划。
articles.summary_en: Jiangxi's provincial Party standing committee met on Oct 16, chaired by Secretary Yin Hong, to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and central directives and review 15th Five-Year Plan drafts.

articles.title_zh: 发挥特色优势做大做强产业集群 卢小青在鹰潭调研
articles.title_en: Lu Xiaoqing Conducts Research in Yingtan on Strengthening Copper Industry Cluster
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，江西省委常委、省委宣传部部长卢小青在鹰潭调研并召开座谈会，要求发挥铜产业优势，做大做强鹰饶抚昌铜基新材料国家级先进制造业集群。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Jiangxi Provincial Party Standing Committee member and Publicity Department head Lu Xiaoqing conducted research and held a symposium in Yingtan, urging efforts to strengthen the national-level copper-based new materials manufacturing cluster.

articles.title_zh: 大力弘扬优良传统美德 让老年人安享幸福晚年
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Visits Elderly in Nanchang Ahead of Chongyang Festival
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，江西省委书记尹弘在南昌走访青云谱区养老服务中心慰问老年人，检查膳食与照护服务并提出完善老龄工作体系、落实惠老政策。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Jiangxi Party Secretary Yin Hong visited an elderly care center in Nanchang, checking meals and care services and urging better implementation of policies for seniors.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见以色列总统赫尔佐格
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Israeli President Herzog
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在巴库出席亚信峰会期间应约会见以色列总统赫尔佐格。双方就中以关系和中东局势交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Foreign Minister Wang Yi, also a member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, met with Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of the CICA summit in Baku, exchanging views on bilateral ties and the Middle East situation.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“铸牢共同体 中华一家亲”主题宣传活动云南集中采访启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Forging a Strong Community, One Chinese Family' Campaign Kicks Off Yunnan Reporting Tour
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日，2026年“铸牢共同体 中华一家亲”主题宣传活动云南集中采访在昆明启动，由中央宣传部会同中央统战部、国家民委组织，采访团将赴昆明、德宏、普洱等地调研。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 17, the 2026 'Forging a Strong Community, One Chinese Family' themed campaign launched its Yunnan reporting tour in Kunming, organized by the Central Propaganda Department with the United Front Work Department and the National Ethnic Affairs Commission; reporters will visit Kunming, Dehong and Pu'er.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见巴勒斯坦外长法尔辛
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Palestinian Foreign Minister Varsen in Baku
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在巴库出席亚信峰会期间会见巴勒斯坦外长法尔辛，表示中方将继续支持巴勒斯坦正义事业。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Palestinian Foreign Minister Varsen on the sidelines of the CICA summit in Baku, pledging continued Chinese support for the Palestinian cause.

articles.title_zh: 我国首个百万吨级低浓度CCUS全链条示范工程开工
articles.title_en: China's First Million-Ton Low-Concentration CCUS Full-Chain Demonstration Project Begins Construction
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，我国首个百万吨级低浓度CCUS全链条示范工程在胜利油田开工建设，预计2028年底建成投运。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, China's first million-ton low-concentration CCUS full-chain demonstration project began construction at the Shengli Oilfield and is expected to be completed and operational by the end of 2028.

articles.title_zh: 中国AI高成长企业榜单发布
articles.title_en: China AI High-Growth Enterprise List Released
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月16日，2026 AI Cloud 100 China榜单在上海发布，遴选中国AI领域高成长未上市企业，52家首次入围，DeepSeek等位列前五。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 AI Cloud 100 China list was released in Shanghai on Oct 16, 2026, ranking high-growth private AI companies in China; 52 firms debuted and DeepSeek ranked among the top five.

articles.title_zh: 十二届上海市委第九轮巡视完成进驻
articles.title_en: 12th Shanghai Municipal Committee's 9th Round of Inspections Completes Stationing
articles.summary_zh: 近日，十二届上海市委第九轮巡视完成进驻，10个市委巡视组对22家市管单位开展常规巡视，并对12家单位进行重点延伸了解。
articles.summary_en: The 12th Shanghai Municipal Committee's ninth round of inspections has completed stationing, with 10 inspection teams conducting routine inspections of 22 municipal-level units and extended scrutiny of 12 others.

articles.title_zh: 上海市委常委会会议传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，推动卫生健康事业实现突破性进展
articles.title_en: Shanghai Party Standing Committee Studies Xi's Speech, Pledges Breakthroughs in Health Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，上海市委常委会举行会议，传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话，市委书记陈吉宁主持并讲话，部署健康上海与平安上海建设。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai's municipal party standing committee met on Oct 16 to study Xi Jinping's speech at the national health conference; party secretary Chen Jining chaired and set out steps on Health Shanghai and safe-city building.

articles.title_zh: 陕西持续推动行政复议工作提质增效
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Continues to Improve the Quality and Efficiency of Administrative Reconsideration
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，陕西省司法厅介绍，陕西各级行政复议机关贯彻新修订的行政复议法，2026年上半年新收复议案件11103件，并通过调解和解、涉企绿色通道等举措化解行政争议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Shaanxi's Justice Department said the province's administrative reconsideration bodies, implementing the revised law, received 11,103 cases in the first half of 2026 and resolved disputes through mediation and fast-track channels for enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 全谷物食品加快走向千家万户
articles.title_en: Whole Grain Foods Rapidly Reaching Households Across China
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日第46个世界粮食日，全国粮食安全宣传周主会场活动在安徽合肥举办，国家粮食和物资储备局介绍全谷物行动计划实施以来的成效。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, World Food Day, the main event of the national grain security publicity week was held in Hefei, Anhui, where the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration reported progress under China's whole grain action plan.

articles.title_zh: 新疆党委常委会召开会议 推动新疆卫生与健康事业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Promote High-Quality Development of Health Undertakings
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，新疆自治区党委常委会召开会议，自治区党委书记陈小江主持，研究部署卫生与健康事业发展、自治区第十一次党代会筹备、前三季度经济运行及教育布局等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xinjiang's regional Party Committee Standing Committee met under Secretary Chen Xiaojiang to plan health development, preparations for the 11th regional Party congress, fourth-quarter economic work and education reform.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区党委理论学习中心组举行专题学习会
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Party Committee Theoretical Study Group Holds Special Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委理论学习中心组举行专题学习会，自治区党委书记陈小江主持并讲话，强调深入学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想、完整准确全面贯彻新时代党的治疆方略。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Party Committee's theoretical study group held a special session chaired by Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang, stressing deeper study of Xi Jinping Thought and full implementation of the Party's strategy for governing Xinjiang in the new era.

articles.title_en: First Unit of CGN's Weijiachong Pumped-Storage Station in Tuanfeng, Hubei Begins Operation
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，中广核湖北团风魏家冲抽水蓄能电站首台机组投入商运，总装机29.8万千瓦，将承担湖北电网调峰储能任务，并带动大别山革命老区经济发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the first unit of CGN's pumped-storage plant in Tuanfeng, Hubei, began commercial operation. The 298 MW project aids grid peak-shaving and clean energy use in the old revolutionary base area.

articles.title_zh: 尹力调研市属高校发展时强调 深耕优势领域 提高办学水平 为新时代首都发展提供人才科技智力支撑
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects Municipal Universities, Urging Deeper Focus on Strengths and Higher Education Quality to Support the Capital's Development
articles.summary_zh: 北京市委书记尹力连日到北方工业大学、北京农学院、首都经济贸易大学调研，强调市属高校要坚持分类发展、深耕优势领域，为首都发展提供人才、科技和智力支撑。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li inspected North China University of Technology, Beijing University of Agriculture and Capital University of Economics and Business, urging municipal universities to pursue differentiated development and deepen their strengths to support the capital with talent, technology and expertise.

articles.title_zh: 城镇供热“温暖工程”三年行动方案发布：运行满20年老管网将改造
articles.title_en: Three-Year 'Warmth Project' Plan for Urban Heating Released: Heating Networks Over 20 Years Old to Be Renovated
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，住房城乡建设部等六部门联合印发《城镇供热“温暖工程”三年行动方案（2026—2028年）》，明确2028年底前显著推进存量供热老化管网更新改造。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, six Chinese ministries led by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development jointly released a three-year 'Warmth Project' plan for urban heating (2026-2028), aiming for major progress by end-2028 in renovating aging heating networks.

articles.title_zh: 尹力在西城区检查指导人大换届选举工作
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects People's Congress Election Work in Xicheng District
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，北京市委书记尹力在西城区检查指导人大换届选举工作，强调选出政治素质高、履职能力强、群众广泛认可的人大代表，李秀领一同参加。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li inspected people's congress election work in Xicheng District, urging the selection of qualified, broadly recognized deputies. Li Xiuling joined the inspection.

articles.title_zh: 四部门组织重点车企座谈，部署加强汽车产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理
articles.title_en: Four Departments Convene Key Automakers to Strengthen Auto Product Innovation Design and R&D Testing Management
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，工信部、公安部、生态环境部、市场监管总局组织30余家重点汽车生产企业座谈，要求坚决抵制非理性竞争，加强产品创新设计和研发测试验证管理。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, four Chinese departments met with over 30 major automakers, urging them to reject irrational competition and strengthen innovation design and R&D testing management for vehicle safety.

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 三部门发文首次明确普惠养老收费政策
articles.title_en: Three Departments Issue Document Clarifying Pricing Policy for Subsidized Elderly Care for First Time
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委近日联合印发指导意见，首次明确普惠养老收费政策，推动扩大普惠养老服务供给。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the National Health Commission jointly issued guidelines to clarify pricing for subsidized elderly care for the first time, aiming to expand such services.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席心系全球减贫事业
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Commitment to Global Poverty Reduction
articles.summary_zh: 10月17日国际消除贫困日，文章回顾习近平主席推动中国脱贫攻坚与全球减贫合作，包括菌草技术、杂交水稻援外等实践。
articles.summary_en: On the International Day for the Eradication of Poverty (Oct 17), the article reviews Xi Jinping's role in China's fight against poverty and in global poverty-reduction cooperation, including juncao technology and hybrid rice assistance abroad.

articles.title_zh: 商务部、科技部就修订《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》公开征求意见
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry and Science Ministry Seek Public Comment on Revision to China's Catalogue of Technologies Prohibited or Restricted from Export
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月16日，商务部、科技部发布2026年第48号公告，拟在人工智能、生物医药、光伏三个领域增列40项技术并实施出口前登记管理，公开征求意见至11月15日。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, 2026, China's Commerce Ministry and Science and Technology Ministry issued Announcement No. 48 of 2026, proposing to add 40 technologies in AI, biomedicine and photovoltaics to the export control catalogue and to require pre-export registration, with public comment open until Nov 15.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军在调研创新强市建设时强调 强化企业创新主体地位 加快培育壮大新质生产力
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Urges Strengthening Enterprises' Role as Innovation Entities, Accelerating New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军赴重庆高新区调研创新强市建设，走访科技企业，强调强化企业创新主体地位、加快培育壮大新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 16, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun visited high-tech firms in the Chongqing High-tech Zone to study innovation-driven city building, urging stronger corporate roles in innovation and faster cultivation of new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市政府召开第93次常务会议 陈新武主持
articles.title_en: Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu Chairs 93rd Municipal Government Executive Meeting

Liu Jie chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 中方回应日政客谬论：在历史和法理问题上都需要补课
articles.title_en: China Responds to Japanese Politician's Erroneous Remarks: Japan Needs to Brush Up on History and Legal Principles
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月16日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京例行记者会上表示，日本作为二战战败国和《不扩散核武器条约》无核武器缔约国，不能突破“专守防卫”、不能拥核，日本政客需在历史和法理问题上补课。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said at a regular briefing in Beijing that Japan, as a defeated power in World War II and a non-nuclear state party to the NPT, cannot breach its "exclusively defense-oriented" policy or possess nuclear weapons, and that Japanese politicians need to brush up on history and legal principles.

articles.title_zh: 人脑为何比AI更灵活？我国科学家破解底层奥秘
articles.title_en: Why Is the Human Brain More Flexible Than AI? Chinese Scientists Uncover the Underlying Mechanism

articles.summary_en: Researchers at the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Center for Excellence in Brain Science have for the first time revealed how individual neurons perform the computations behind flexible decision-making, a finding that could inspire next-generation AI algorithms.

articles.title_zh: 山东省青岛市委原常委、市政府原副市长王波被“双开”
articles.title_en: Former Qingdao Deputy Mayor Wang Bo Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 据山东省纪委监委10月16日消息，青岛市委原常委、市政府原副市长王波因严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职，涉嫌受贿问题移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: Wang Bo, former Standing Committee member of the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee and former deputy mayor, has been expelled from the Party and public office for serious disciplinary and legal violations, with his bribery case transferred to prosecutors, Shandong's discipline watchdog said on Oct. 16.

articles.summary_en: The Xi'an-Yan'an high-speed rail opened on Dec 26, 2025, and 92-year-old Yan'an resident Zhe Zhengqian's nearly 5 kg of clippings chronicle 70 years of the line's construction, as the railway boosts Luochuan apple exports and red tourism.

articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Chairs Consultative Symposium on Key Research Topic Results
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，威海市市长孔凡萍主持召开重点调研课题成果协商座谈会，听取各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士的调研成果与意见建议，并要求相关部门跟进落实。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping chaired a consultative symposium on key research topic results, hearing reports and suggestions from democratic parties, the federation of industry and commerce, and personages without party affiliation, and urging government departments to follow up and implement them.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 听取“人工智能+”行动进展情况汇报等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on AI Plus Initiative Progress and Draft Laws
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，听取“人工智能+”行动进展汇报，讨论教师法修订草案和价格法修正草案，并审议通过修改和废止部分行政法规的决定草案。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing, reviewing progress on the AI Plus initiative, discussing draft revisions to the Teachers Law and the Pricing Law, and approving changes to and repeal of certain administrative regulations.

articles.title_zh: 第七届海峡两岸（陕西）经贸科技合作大会在西安开幕 郭金龙出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Seventh Cross-Strait (Shaanxi) Economic, Trade and Technology Cooperation Conference Opens in Xi'an as Guo Jinlong Attends and Addresses the Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，第七届海峡两岸（陕西）经贸科技合作大会在西安开幕，两岸企业家峰会大陆方面理事长郭金龙，以及赵一德、张志军等致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the 7th Cross-Strait (Shaanxi) Economic, Trade and Technology Cooperation Conference opened in Xi'an, with Guo Jinlong, Zhao Yide, Zhang Zhijun and others delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研西安食品产业发展情况，强调做优做强做大食品产业、守牢食品安全底线
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Xi'an's Food Industry, Stressing Growth and Food Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰赴高新区、莲湖区、临潼区、经开区调研食品产业发展，走访多家食品企业，强调做强食品产业、守牢食品安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected food industry development across four districts and zones, visiting food companies and urging stronger industry growth and strict food safety safeguards.

articles.title_zh: 西安市政府党组（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Government Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，西安市政府党组召开扩大会议，常务副市长杨建强主持，传达学习习近平总书记国庆招待会讲话精神，并研究市属国企提质发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Xi'an's municipal government Party group held an expanded meeting chaired by Vice Mayor Yang Jianqiang, conveying Xi Jinping's National Day reception speech and studying reform of a municipal state-owned asset firm.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 认真学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究安排卫生与健康招商引资等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Speech, Arrange Health, Investment Promotion Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，西安市委常委会召开会议，学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神，研究卫生与健康、招商引资及开发区党的领导等工作，蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the Xi'an Municipal Party Standing Committee met, chaired by Hao Huijie, to study Xi Jinping's speech at the National Health Conference and arrange work on health, investment promotion and Party leadership in development zones.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察时强调 统筹高质量发展和高水平保护 坚定不移走生态优先绿色发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, Stressing Coordinated High-Quality Development and High-Level Protection and a Path of Ecological Priority and Green Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察黄旗海湿地保护与绿色算力产业，强调统筹高质量发展和高水平保护，坚定不移走生态优先、绿色发展之路。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, reviewing wetland protection at Huangqi Lake and green computing projects, and urged coordinated high-quality development and high-level ecological protection.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平主持召开全市“六张网”建设工作推进会
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Chairs City Meeting on "Six Networks" Construction
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，新乡市委书记魏建平主持召开全市“六张网”建设工作推进会，部署项目谋划、储备、申报与实施，强调抢抓政策窗口期、扩投资稳增长。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping chaired a city meeting on building the "Six Networks," urging faster project planning, application and implementation to expand investment and stabilize growth.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省与南方航空集团签署战略合作协议 信长星刘小涛会见马须伦一行
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Province Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement with China Southern Airlines Group; Xin Changxing and Liu Xiaotao Meet Ma Xulun
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，江苏省与中国南方航空集团签署战略合作协议，省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛会见南航集团董事长马须伦一行，双方将深化航线网络、智慧物流、航空文旅等合作。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Jiangsu Province signed a strategic cooperation agreement with China Southern Airlines Group. Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao met Chairman Ma Xulun to deepen cooperation in route networks, smart logistics and aviation tourism.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞会见中国石化董事长侯启军
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Meets Sinopec Chairman Hou Qijun in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞在银川会见中国石化董事长侯启军，双方就深化央地合作、油气勘探开发与新能源布局交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei met Sinopec Chairman Hou Qijun in Yinchuan to discuss deeper central-local cooperation in oil and gas exploration and new energy investment.
