articles.title_zh: 王毅出席亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议第七次峰会
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Attends 7th CICA Summit in Baku
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，习近平主席特别代表、外交部长王毅在巴库出席亚信第七次峰会并发表讲话，提出维护和平稳定等四点倡议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Wang Yi, Xi Jinping's special representative and China's foreign minister, attended the 7th CICA Summit in Baku and proposed four initiatives, including jointly safeguarding peace and stability.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，营口市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和中央有关会议部署，研究落实市委要求。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the Party group of the Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held an expanded meeting to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's key speeches and central directives, and to implement municipal Party committee requirements.

articles.title_zh: 营口市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组召开专题学习会
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Thematic Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，营口市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组召开专题学习会，学习习近平总书记关于加强新时代廉洁文化建设的重要论述和习近平外交思想，史卫东主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Party group held a thematic study session on Xi Jinping's expositions on building a culture of integrity in the new era and on Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy, chaired by Shi Weidong.

articles.title_zh: 中央第五生态环境保护督察组对贵州省、云南省开展溶洞天坑山谷污染问题专项督察
articles.title_en: Fifth Central Eco-Environmental Inspection Team Launches Special Inspection on Cave and Sinkhole Pollution in Guizhou and Yunnan
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，中央第五生态环境保护督察组进驻贵州、云南，开展溶洞天坑山谷污染问题专项督察，宋秀岩任组长，督察持续至10月29日。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the fifth central ecological inspection team led by Song Xiuyan began a special inspection of cave, sinkhole and valley pollution in Guizhou and Yunnan, running until Oct 29.

articles.title_zh: 第140届广交会采购商联盟正式成立
articles.title_en: Buyer Alliance Officially Established at 140th Canton Fair
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，第140届广交会采购商联盟举行成立仪式，已有58家来自32个国家和地区的头部采购企业确认加入，为全球供采双方搭建常态化对接平台。
articles.summary_en: The Buyer Alliance of the 140th Canton Fair was launched on October 15, with 58 leading purchasing companies from 32 countries and regions already confirmed as members, creating a regular matchmaking platform for global buyers and suppliers.

articles.title_zh: 世界黄金协会：上半年中国金饰消费金额1440亿元 创下史上第二高
articles.title_en: World Gold Council: China's Gold Jewelry Spending Hits 144 Billion Yuan in H1, Second Highest on Record
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，世界黄金协会发布报告称，2026年上半年中国金饰消费金额同比增长5%至1440亿元，创史上第二高，但需求吨数同比下降30%。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16 the World Gold Council said China's gold jewelry spending rose 5% year on year to 144 billion yuan in H1 2026, the second highest on record, while demand in tonnage fell 30%.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：望欧方同中方相向而行推动中欧贸易发展
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Hopes EU Will Work With It to Advance China-EU Trade
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月16日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京表示，中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会取得积极进展，希望欧方恪守自由开放承诺，避免出台保护主义和歧视性措施。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, 2026, MFA spokesperson Mao Ning said in Beijing that the second China-EU trade and investment consultation meeting made progress, urging the EU to avoid protectionist and discriminatory measures.

articles.title_zh: 习近平考察乌兰察布绿色算力产业发展展示厅
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab Green Computing Industry Exhibition Hall
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察调研，前往察哈尔高新技术开发区展示厅，了解“东数西算”枢纽节点建设和绿色算力产业发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, Xi Jinping visited Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia and toured an exhibition hall in the Chahar High-Tech Development Zone to learn about the region's "East Data, West Computing" hub project and green computing industry.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：有关言论再次暴露日本执政当局不断膨胀的拥核野心
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Remarks Expose Japan's Growing Nuclear Ambitions
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会上就日本首相有关言论表示，这再次暴露日本执政当局不断膨胀的拥核野心，敦促日方彻底放弃“再军事化”和拥核企图。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning told a regular press briefing that remarks by Japan's prime minister again expose Tokyo's expanding nuclear ambitions, urging Japan to abandon its push for remilitarization and nuclear weapons.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界航海装备大会主论坛举行
articles.title_en: Main Forum of 2026 World Maritime Equipment Conference Held in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，2026世界航海装备大会主论坛在福州海峡国际会展中心举行，福建省副省长林瑞良、福州市委书记郭宁宁出席并致辞，市长吴贤德主持。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, the main forum of the 2026 World Maritime Equipment Conference was held at the Strait International Conference and Exhibition Center in Fuzhou; Fujian Vice Governor Lin Ruiliang and Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning spoke, with Mayor Wu Xiande presiding.

articles.title_zh: 福建省海洋经济产业合作创新发展大会在福州举行
articles.title_en: Fujian Marine Economy Industry Cooperation and Innovation Conference Held in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，福建省海洋经济产业合作创新发展大会在福州举行，省委书记赵龙等出席，会上发布全球可持续海事创新案例与展望。
articles.summary_en: On October 16, the Fujian Marine Economy Industry Cooperation and Innovation Conference was held in Fuzhou, attended by provincial party secretary Zhao Long and other officials, releasing global sustainable maritime innovation cases and outlook.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席三封广交会贺信的“开放”底色
articles.title_en: The 'Openness' Theme in Xi Jinping's Three Congratulatory Letters to the Canton Fair
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，第140届中国进出口商品交易会在广州开幕，国家主席习近平致贺信。文章以三封贺信为线索，阐释中国坚持高水平对外开放、推动普惠包容经济全球化的立场。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the 140th China Import and Export Fair opened in Guangzhou with a congratulatory letter from President Xi Jinping. The article traces three such letters to explain China's commitment to high-level opening up and inclusive economic globalization.

articles.title_zh: 从“人民”这个关键词，读懂这场大会
articles.title_en: Reading the National Health Conference Through the Keyword "the People"
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日至13日，时隔十年，全国卫生与健康大会再次召开，习近平总书记出席会议并发表重要讲话，部署“十五五”时期健康中国建设。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping attended the National Health and Health Conference on Oct 12-13 and delivered a speech, setting out priorities for building a Healthy China during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 陈一新会见电视剧《交锋》主创团队
articles.title_en: Chen Yixin Meets Creative Team of TV Drama "Encounter"
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，国家安全部党委书记、部长陈一新在国家安全部机关会见电视剧《交锋》主创团队，祝贺该剧播映取得优异成绩，并表示隐蔽战线斗争案例、英模形象是文艺创作的资源“富矿”。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Chen Yixin, China's Minister of State Security, met the creative team of the TV drama "Encounter" at the ministry's headquarters, congratulating them on the show's success and calling covert-front cases and hero figures a rich resource for artistic creation.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局公布修订后的《统计严重失信企业信用管理办法》
articles.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics Publishes Revised Measures on Credit Management for Enterprises with Serious Statistical Dishonesty
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，国家统计局局长康义签署局令，公布修订后的《统计严重失信企业信用管理办法》，该办法自2026年12月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, National Bureau of Statistics Commissioner Kang Yi signed an order publishing revised measures on credit management for enterprises with serious statistical dishonesty, effective Dec 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 三部门联合印发指导意见，完善养老服务价格形成机制、推动普惠养老提质扩面
articles.title_en: Three Ministries Issue Joint Guidance to Improve Elderly Care Pricing and Expand Affordable Services
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，国家发展改革委、民政部、国家卫生健康委联合印发《关于进一步完善价格形成机制 推动普惠养老服务提质扩面的指导意见》，规范养老机构收费并治理乱收费、价格不透明等问题。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the National Development and Reform Commission, the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the National Health Commission jointly issued guidance to improve pricing mechanisms for elderly care, targeting arbitrary fees and opaque pricing.

articles.title_zh: 曲解政策、捏造灾情、虚假摆拍，多部门协同整治谣言乱象
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Jointly Crack Down on Rumors Distorting Policies and Fabricating Disasters
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，网信、公安等部门针对曲解民生政策、捏造灾情、利用AI编造虚假事件等网络谣言开展协同整治，依法处置相关责任人。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, China's cyberspace and public security authorities jointly cracked down on online rumors involving distorted policies, fabricated disasters and AI-generated false events, punishing those responsible.

articles.title_zh: 五部门发布警惕“央国企内推”等骗局风险提示
articles.title_en: Five Departments Issue Risk Alert on 'SOE Internal Referral' Job Scams
articles.summary_zh: 人力资源社会保障部等五部门发布风险提示，提醒求职者特别是高校毕业生警惕冒用央国企名义的“内部推荐”“直签保录”等招聘骗局。
articles.summary_en: Five Chinese departments issued a risk alert warning job seekers, especially new graduates, about scams that falsely use central SOE names to sell 'internal referrals' and 'guaranteed' job offers.

articles.title_zh: 全国即将进入省级党代会时间
articles.title_en: China's Provinces to Enter Party Congress Season
articles.summary_zh: 2026年下半年起多个省份陆续召开新一届党代会，安徽省第十二次党代会定于10月19日在合肥召开。
articles.summary_en: Starting in the second half of 2026, multiple Chinese provinces will hold new Party congresses; Anhui's 12th provincial Party congress is set for October 19 in Hefei.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河通航满月，南宁港迎“江海之变”
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Marks One Month of Navigation as Nanning Port Embraces River-Sea Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，平陆运河通航满月，南宁港六景作业区累计吞吐量达26.66万吨，南宁港由内河港升级为江海联运始发港。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, the Pinglu Canal marked one month of navigation, with Nanning Port's Liujing terminal handling 266,600 tonnes and transforming into a river-sea intermodal hub.

articles.title_zh: 广西首个留学回国人才“一站式”服务平台启动
articles.title_en: Guangxi Launches First One-Stop Service Platform for Returned Overseas Talents
articles.summary_zh: 近日，广西首个留学回国人才“一站式”服务平台在南宁启动，整合落户、就业创业、职称认定、项目申报、政策咨询等高频事项，实现集成办理。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi launched its first one-stop service platform for returned overseas talents in Nanning, integrating household registration, employment and entrepreneurship, professional title recognition, project applications and policy consulting into a single window.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼、王陆进在河南信阳调研 强调弘扬大别山精神、加快革命老区振兴发展
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuli and Wang Lujin Inspect Xinyang, Henan, Urging Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Bases
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日至15日，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进到信阳新县、光山县调研红色文化传承、乡村振兴和产业发展，强调弘扬大别山精神、加快老区振兴。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14-15, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuli and acting Governor Wang Lujin visited Xinyang, urging red-culture inheritance, rural revitalization and old revolutionary base development.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议 推动卫生与健康事业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Expanded Meeting on High-Quality Health Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，省委书记罗文主持，传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见，并部署安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Hebei's provincial party standing committee held an expanded meeting chaired by Secretary Luo Wen to study Xi Jinping's speech at the national health conference, plan implementation, and deploy workplace safety work.

articles.title_zh: 许勤主持召开黑龙江省委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话及关于平安中国建设的重要指示，审议生态环境损害责任追究实施细则。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Heilongjiang Party Secretary Xu Qin chaired a provincial standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's speeches on health and on building a safer China, and to review rules on ecological damage accountability.

articles.title_zh: 第十届未来网络发展大会在南京开幕 多项科研成果发布
articles.title_en: 10th Future Network Development Conference Opens in Nanjing, Releasing Multiple Research Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，第十届未来网络发展大会在南京开幕，由南京市政府主办。刘韵洁、尤肖虎两位院士发布智能体互联平台、卫星互联网组网系统等三项重大成果。
articles.summary_en: The 10th Future Network Development Conference opened in Nanjing on Oct 16, hosted by the Nanjing municipal government. Academicians Liu Yunjie and You Xiaohu released three major research results, including an agent interconnection platform and a satellite internet networking system.

articles.title_zh: AI药材检测大模型在江西樟树正式发布
articles.title_en: AI Herbal Medicine Testing Model Launched in Zhangshu, Jiangxi
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，樟树第57届全国药材药品交易会开幕式上，融合多模态识别与光谱检测技术的AI药材检测大模型正式发布。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, an AI herbal medicine testing model integrating multimodal recognition and spectral detection was launched at the opening of the 57th National Medicinal Materials Trade Fair in Zhangshu, Jiangxi.

articles.title_zh: 2026思政课一体化发展与创新交流大会在抚顺举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Conference on Integrated Development and Innovation of Ideological and Political Courses Held in Fushun
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，“红色领航 同心铸魂”2026思政课一体化发展与创新交流大会在辽宁抚顺举行，辽宁省委常委、组织部部长蒋天宝出席并致辞，300余位嘉宾参会。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the 2026 conference on integrated development and innovation of ideological and political courses opened in Fushun, Liaoning. Jiang Tianbao, member of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee and head of its Organization Department, attended and addressed over 300 guests.

articles.title_zh: 赤峰市推动农畜产品加工业倍增升级
articles.title_en: Chifeng City Pushes Doubling and Upgrading of Agricultural and Livestock Product Processing
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古赤峰市落实农畜产品加工业倍增行动方案，推动玉米、肉牛肉羊、杂粮等向精深加工延伸，2026年上半年加工企业销售收入达197.49亿元。
articles.summary_en: Chifeng City in Inner Mongolia is implementing a five-year action plan to double its agricultural and livestock product processing sector, shifting from raw-material sales to finished goods; in the first half of 2026, processing firms posted 19.749 billion yuan in sales revenue.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏粉煤灰搭乘图定班列进藏
articles.title_en: Ningxia Fly Ash Reaches Tibet via Scheduled Freight Train
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，首列满载粉煤灰的图定班列从宁夏青铜峡驶往西藏林芝，将按每月2万吨常态化开行，提升工业固废综合利用率。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, the first scheduled freight train carrying fly ash departed Qingtongxia, Ningxia for Nyingchi, Tibet, and will run regularly at 20,000 tonnes monthly to boost industrial waste recycling.

articles.title_zh: 2026人工智能产业大会在山东济南开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 AI Industry Conference Opens in Jinan, Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月15日，2026人工智能产业大会在山东济南开幕，由中国信息通信研究院、山东省工信厅、济南市政府主办，发布赋能新型工业化高价值场景等多项成果。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 AI Industry Conference opened in Jinan, Shandong on Oct 15, hosted by CAICT, the Shandong Industry and IT Department and Jinan's city government, releasing high-value AI-enabled industrial scenarios and other outcomes.

articles.title_en: XPCC Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Health Corps Development, Work Safety and Fiscal Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，兵团党委常委会召开会议，何忠友主持，部署健康兵团建设、安全生产和财政等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the XPCC Party Committee Standing Committee met under He Zhongyou to plan health development, work safety and fiscal management.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区政府召开常务会议 研究抓好生态环境保护工作等
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Government Holds Executive Meeting on Ecological Protection, University Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月5日下午，新疆自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究生态环境保护、加强与兄弟省市高校合作，并审议通过授予六位外国专家2026年度“天山奖”的决定。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 5, Xinjiang chairman Erkin Tuniyaz chaired a regional government executive meeting on ecological protection, cooperation with universities, and the 2026 Tianshan Award for six foreign experts.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察时强调 统筹高质量发展和高水平保护 坚定不移走生态优先绿色发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, Stressing Coordination of High-Quality Development and High-Level Protection and Firm Commitment to Eco-Priority, Green Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察，强调统筹高质量发展与高水平保护，走生态优先、绿色发展之路，并调研绿色算力产业。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, stressing coordination of high-quality development with high-level protection, eco-priority green development and the green computing industry.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺湖南大学建校100周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter Congratulating Hunan University on Its 100th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平致信祝贺湖南大学建校100周年，希望学校继承革命传统、提升办学质量，为建设教育强国、推进中国式现代化作出新贡献。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping sent a letter congratulating Hunan University on its 100th anniversary, urging it to carry on revolutionary traditions, raise educational quality and contribute to building a strong education nation and advancing Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致湖南大学建校100周年的贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter on Hunan University's 100th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平致信祝贺湖南大学建校100周年，希望学校提升办学质量，培养更多经世致用人才，为建设教育强国、推进中国式现代化作出新贡献。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping sent a letter congratulating Hunan University on its 100th anniversary, urging it to raise its educational quality, train more practical talents and contribute to building an education powerhouse and advancing Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 王东伟会见外国驻港领团和商界代表一行
articles.title_en: Wang Dongwei Meets Foreign Consular Corps and Business Delegation from Hong Kong
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，安徽省代省长王东伟在合肥会见外交部驻港公署副特派员花有带领的外国驻港领团和商界代表，双方商谈深化开放合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Anhui Acting Governor Wang Dongwei met in Hefei with a delegation of foreign consuls and business representatives from Hong Kong, discussing deeper openness and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 省委理论学习中心组举行学习会议 李乐成主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Study Session Held, Li Lecheng Presides and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日上午，安徽省委理论学习中心组举行学习会议，省委书记李乐成主持并讲话，要求深入学习贯彻习近平总书记考察安徽重要讲话精神，确保完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 15, the Anhui Provincial Party Committee's theoretical study group held a session chaired by Party Secretary Li Lecheng, urging deeper implementation of Xi Jinping's guidance from his Anhui inspections and fulfillment of this year's targets.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市人大常委会党组会议、市六届人大常委会第六十二次主任会议召开
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Party Group Meeting and 62nd Chairpersons' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，重庆市人大常委会党组会议、市六届人大常委会第六十二次主任会议召开，主任王炯主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，听取多项工作报告。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Chongqing's Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a Party group meeting and its 62nd chairpersons' meeting, chaired by Wang Jiong, conveying recent remarks by Xi Jinping and hearing multiple work reports.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军会见国家消防救援局党委书记、政治委员李良生一行
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Meets Li Liangsheng, Party Secretary and Political Commissar of the National Fire and Rescue Administration
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军在重庆会见国家消防救援局党委书记、政治委员李良生一行，双方就灾害事故应对、消防救援能力建设和超大城市安全治理交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 15, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun met in Chongqing with Li Liangsheng, Party Secretary and Political Commissar of the National Fire and Rescue Administration, on disaster response, firefighting capacity and mega-city safety governance.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省发展改革委与湖南省税务局签署合作协议
articles.title_en: Hunan DRC and Hunan Tax Service Sign Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，湖南省发展改革委与湖南省税务局签署经济和税收数据协同应用合作协议，推动信息共享和数据应用，助力经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Hunan's Development and Reform Commission and Tax Service signed an agreement to share and apply economic and tax data, supporting high-quality development.

articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察察哈尔高新技术开发区，了解“东数西算”枢纽节点建设和绿色算力产业发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected the Chahar High-tech Development Zone in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, learning about the region's "East Data, West Computing" hub and green computing industry.

articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping inspected the Huangqihai Nature Reserve in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia on Oct 16, setting out requirements on strengthening ecological protection and advancing a Beautiful China.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语丨坚定不移走生态优先绿色发展之路

articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平在内蒙古乌兰察布考察时强调，要统筹高质量发展和高水平保护，协同推进降碳、减污、扩绿、增长，坚定不移走生态优先、绿色发展之路。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping stressed during an inspection in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, that China must balance high-quality development with high-level protection and firmly follow an eco-priority, green development path.

articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia on Oct 16, calling on regions to pursue high-quality development suited to their own resource endowments and local strengths.

articles.title_en: From Ulansuhai to Huangqihai: Xi Jinping's Consistent Concern for the Ecology
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日，习近平总书记在内蒙古乌兰察布市考察调研，来到黄旗海自然保护区，听取生态治理和生态系统修复情况汇报，并实地察看水岸滩涂生态和栖息鸟类。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 16, Xi Jinping inspected Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia, visiting the Huangqihai Nature Reserve to hear reports on ecological governance and ecosystem restoration and to view the lake's shoreline and birds.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在泰安调研
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Conducts Research Visit in Tai'an
articles.summary_zh: 山东省省长周乃翔在泰安调研，实地察看秋收秋种和高标准农田建设，部署粮食安全、乳业发展与森林防火工作。
articles.summary_en: Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang visited Tai'an to inspect autumn harvest and planting, high-standard farmland, dairy production and forest fire prevention, urging stronger food security efforts.

articles.title_zh: 雪克来提·扎克尔率全国人大常委会调研组赴新疆调研
articles.title_en: Shohrat Zakir Leads NPC Standing Committee Research Team on Inspection Tour in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日至14日，全国人大常委会副委员长雪克来提·扎克尔率调研组赴新疆，围绕铸牢中华民族共同体意识、民生保障和民族团结进步等开展调研。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 10 to 14, NPC Standing Committee Vice Chairman Shohrat Zakir led a research team to Xinjiang to study ethnic unity, livelihood development and high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 马来西亚沙捞越州稻田里的中国技术
articles.title_en: Chinese Technology in the Rice Fields of Sarawak, Malaysia
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，记者探访马来西亚沙捞越州美里的多年生稻试验田。云南大学团队与当地企业合作试种成功，首季亩产超500公斤，高于当地传统水稻。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visited a perennial rice trial field in Miri, Sarawak on Oct 15. A Yunnan University team working with a local firm saw first-season yields above 500 kg per mu, far exceeding conventional local rice.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：日本当政者一再对“战犯神社”顶礼膜拜，良知何在？
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Japanese Leaders' Repeated Worship at War Criminal Shrine Leaves No Conscience
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会上批评日本当政者一再参拜供奉甲级战犯的靖国神社，要求日方正视历史、反省罪责。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning criticized Japanese leaders for repeatedly worshipping at the Yasukuni Shrine that honors Class-A war criminals, urging Japan to face history and reflect on its guilt.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中方高度重视津巴布韦方面债务处置的诉求，双方保持着沟通
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Highly Values Zimbabwe's Debt Treatment Request, Both Sides Stay in Communication
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会上表示，中方高度重视津巴布韦方面债务处置的诉求，双方有关部门和金融机构保持着沟通。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, MFA spokesperson Mao Ning said at a regular press briefing that China highly values Zimbabwe's debt treatment request, with relevant departments and financial institutions of both sides in communication.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日出版的《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章《以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党》，强调把权力关进制度笼子、坚定不移推进反腐败斗争。
articles.summary_en: The 20th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on Oct 16, carries Xi Jinping's article urging stricter and more concrete steps in full and rigorous Party governance, including binding power by institutions and deepening the anti-corruption fight.

articles.title_zh: 第七届海峡两岸（陕西）经贸科技合作大会在西安开幕
articles.title_en: 7th Cross-Strait (Shaanxi) Economic, Trade and Technology Cooperation Conference Opens in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，第七届海峡两岸（陕西）经贸科技合作大会在西安开幕，两岸约400名各界代表参会，将举办20余场经贸洽谈与文化交流活动。
articles.summary_en: The 7th Cross-Strait (Shaanxi) Economic, Trade and Technology Cooperation Conference opened in Xi'an on Oct 15, drawing about 400 participants from both sides of the strait for over 20 trade, cultural and youth events.

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办等部门开展网络涉军不当营销和炒作信息专项整治
articles.title_en: Cyberspace Administration and Other Departments Launch Special Campaign Against Improper Military-Related Marketing and Hype Online
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，中央网信办等部门开展网络涉军不当营销和炒作信息专项整治，重点筛查处置10类违规网站账号，压实平台主体责任。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, the Cyberspace Administration of China and other departments launched a special campaign against improper military-related marketing and hype online, targeting 10 categories of violating accounts to tighten platform responsibility.

articles.title_zh: 中国再添4处世界灌溉工程遗产
articles.title_en: China Adds Four More World Heritage Irrigation Structures
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，国际灌排委员会在法国马赛公布2026年世界灌溉工程遗产名录，中国申报的河南沁河广利渠、甘肃讨赖河绿洲灌溉系统等4处工程全部入选，中国总数达46项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage in Marseille, France, inscribed four Chinese projects onto the 2026 World Heritage Irrigation Structures list, bringing China's total to 46.

articles.title_zh: 第十三届职业教育与城市发展高层对话会在陕西咸阳举行
articles.title_en: 13th Vocational Education and Urban Development High-Level Dialogue Held in Xianyang, Shaanxi
articles.summary_zh: 由中华职业教育社主办的第十三届职业教育与城市发展高层对话会10月15日在陕西咸阳开幕，陈昌智等出席，会上签约33项产教融合项目，总投资8520万元。
articles.summary_en: The 13th Vocational Education and Urban Development High-Level Dialogue opened Oct 15 in Xianyang, Shaanxi, where 33 industry-education projects worth 85.2 mln yuan were signed.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：中欧双方在混动汽车领域达成的谅解是对等互利的
articles.title_en: MOFCOM: China-EU Understanding on Hybrid Vehicles Is Mutually Beneficial
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月15日，商务部例行新闻发布会上，发言人何亚东表示中欧在混动汽车领域达成的谅解对等互利，基于全流程合规、尊重事实、非歧视三大原则，避免贸易摩擦升级。
articles.summary_en: At the Ministry of Commerce's regular press conference on October 15, 2026, spokesperson He Yadong said the China-EU understanding on hybrid vehicles is mutually beneficial, based on full-process compliance, respect for facts and non-discrimination, averting an escalation of trade friction.

articles.title_zh: 江水奔流，精神不息：从音乐剧《四十天》看爱国企业家精神的当代传承
articles.title_en: Spirit Ever Flowing: Musical "Forty Days" and the Modern Legacy of Patriotic Entrepreneurship
articles.summary_zh: 以宜昌大撤退为蓝本的音乐剧《四十天》近日在重庆上演，再现爱国实业家卢作孚的精神；重庆同步以立法和政策助推民营经济发展。
articles.summary_en: A musical "Forty Days," retelling Lu Zuofu's 1938 Yichang evacuation, was staged in Chongqing, highlighting his patriotic spirit as the city pushes private-sector growth.

articles.title_zh: 李强将访问乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦并出席上合组织成员国政府首脑（总理）理事会第二十五次会议、赴俄罗斯举行中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤
articles.title_en: Li Qiang to Visit Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, Attend 25th SCO Prime Ministers' Council, and Hold 31st China-Russia Premier Meeting in Russia
articles.summary_zh: 外交部宣布，国务院总理李强将于10月17日至22日访问乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦，出席上合组织总理理事会会议，并赴俄举行中俄总理定期会晤。
articles.summary_en: The Foreign Ministry announced Premier Li Qiang will visit Uzbekistan and Tajikistan on Oct 17-22, attend the 25th SCO Prime Ministers' Council, then hold the 31st China-Russia premier regular meeting.

articles.title_zh: 李强将访问乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦并出席上合组织总理理事会第二十五次会议、赴俄举行中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤
articles.title_en: Li Qiang to Visit Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, Attend 25th SCO Prime Ministers' Council and Hold 31st China-Russia Prime Ministers' Meeting in Russia
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，外交部宣布李强将访问乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦，出席上合组织总理理事会第二十五次会议，并赴俄举行中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤。
articles.summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry announced on Oct 15 that Premier Li Qiang will visit Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, attend the 25th SCO Prime Ministers' Council, and hold the 31st China-Russia prime ministers' meeting in Russia.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：日当政者应正视历史，反省罪责，洗心革面
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Japanese Leaders Must Face History, Reflect on Guilt and Turn Over a New Leaf
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京例行记者会上就日本媒体首次公开靖国神社内部会议记录答问，表示日本当政者应正视历史、反省罪责、洗心革面。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning told a regular briefing in Beijing that Japanese leaders should face history and reflect on their guilt, after Japanese media released internal meeting records of Yasukuni Shrine.

articles.title_zh: “联大第2758号决议与台湾问题”学术研讨会在北京举行
articles.title_en: Academic Seminar on UNGA Resolution 2758 and the Taiwan Issue Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，由中国法学会海峡两岸法学交流促进会主办的“联大第2758号决议与台湾问题”学术研讨会在北京举行，近百名专家学者与会研讨。
articles.summary_en: An academic seminar on UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 and the Taiwan issue, hosted by the China Law Society's cross-strait legal exchange body, was held in Beijing on October 14, drawing nearly 100 scholars and experts.

articles.title_zh: 快新优好，外贸增速近5年同期最快（权威发布）
articles.title_en: Fast, New, Optimal, Good: China's Foreign Trade Growth Fastest in Nearly Five Years for the Same Period
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，海关总署副署长王军介绍，前三季度我国货物贸易进出口39.94万亿元，同比增长18.8%，为近5年同期最快增速。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Customs Deputy Director Wang Jun said at a State Council Information Office briefing that China's goods trade grew 18.8% to 39.94 trillion yuan in the first three quarters, the fastest in five years.

articles.title_zh: 电视纪录片《伟大远征》即将播出
articles.title_en: TV Documentary "The Great Expedition" to Air
articles.summary_zh: 经中央军委批准，中央军委政治工作部等联合摄制的7集电视纪录片《伟大远征》自10月15日起在央视综合频道晚8点黄金时段播出，纪念红军长征胜利90周年。
articles.summary_en: Approved by the Central Military Commission, the 7-episode documentary "The Great Expedition" airs in prime time on CCTV-1 from Oct. 15, marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向第140届中国进出口商品交易会致贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to the 140th China Import and Export Fair
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，国家主席习近平向在广州开幕的第140届广交会致贺信，强调维护多边贸易体制、保障全球产业链供应链稳定畅通。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 140th Canton Fair, which opened in Guangzhou, stressing the need to uphold the multilateral trading system and keep global industrial and supply chains stable and smooth.

articles.title_zh: 确保健康中国建设取得决定性进展
articles.title_en: Ensuring Decisive Progress in Building a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 全国卫生与健康大会10月12日至13日在北京召开，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，强调推动卫生与健康事业高质量发展，确保健康中国建设取得决定性进展。
articles.summary_en: China's national health conference was held in Beijing on Oct 12-13, where Xi Jinping called for high-quality development of health services to ensure decisive progress in building a Healthy China.

articles.title_zh: 四川省成都市人大常委会原党组书记、主任包惠严重违纪违法被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Bao Hui, Former Party Secretary and Director of Chengdu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, Expelled from Party for Serious Disciplinary and Legal Violations
articles.summary_zh: 经中共中央批准，中央纪委国家监委对四川省成都市人大常委会原党组书记、主任包惠立案审查调查，认定其严重违纪违法并涉嫌受贿犯罪，决定给予开除党籍处分并移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: With approval from the CPC Central Committee, the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission investigated Bao Hui, former Party secretary and director of the Chengdu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee in Sichuan, and expelled her from the Party for serious disciplinary and legal violations, including suspected bribery, transferring her case to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党
articles.title_en: Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance with Higher Standards and More Concrete Measures
articles.summary_zh: 2026年1月12日，习近平在二十届中央纪委五次全会上发表讲话，要求以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党，强化政治监督、制度治党和反腐败斗争。
articles.summary_en: On January 12, 2026, Xi Jinping addressed the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, urging higher standards and more concrete measures in full and rigorous Party self-governance, political oversight, institution-based governance and the fight against corruption.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向第140届中国进出口商品交易会致贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to 140th China Import and Export Fair
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，国家主席习近平向第140届广交会致贺信，指出广交会已成为中国扩大高水平对外开放的有效平台。本届广交会当日在广州开幕，由商务部和广东省人民政府共同主办。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 140th Canton Fair, saying it has become an effective platform for China's high-level opening-up. The fair opened the same day in Guangzhou, co-hosted by the Ministry of Commerce and Guangdong Province.

articles.title_zh: 李强在中朝新鸭绿江大桥开通仪式上发表视频致辞
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Delivers Video Address at Opening Ceremony of New China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，国务院总理李强在中朝新鸭绿江大桥开通仪式上发表视频致辞，称大桥将成为象征中朝传统友谊的新地标。朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成也发表视频致辞。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Chinese Premier Li Qiang delivered a video address at the opening ceremony of the new China-DPRK Yalu River Bridge, calling it a new landmark of traditional friendship. DPRK Premier Pak Thae Song also gave a video address.

articles.title_zh: 李强将访问乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦并出席上合组织总理理事会第二十五次会议、赴俄罗斯举行中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤
articles.title_en: Li Qiang to Visit Uzbekistan and Tajikistan, Attend 25th SCO Heads of Government Council Meeting, and Hold 31st China-Russia Regular Prime Ministers' Meeting in Russia
articles.summary_zh: 应乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦和俄罗斯总理邀请，国务院总理李强将于10月17日至22日先后访问乌兹别克斯坦、塔吉克斯坦并出席上合组织成员国政府首脑理事会第二十五次会议，随后赴俄罗斯举行中俄总理第三十一次定期会晤。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of the prime ministers of Uzbekistan, Tajikistan and Russia, Chinese Premier Li Qiang will visit Uzbekistan and Tajikistan and attend the 25th SCO Heads of Government Council meeting from Oct 17 to 20, then hold the 31st China-Russia regular prime ministers' meeting in Russia from Oct 20 to 22.

articles.title_zh: 李强同多哥部长会议主席会谈
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with Togo's Prime Minister
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，国务院总理李强同多哥部长会议主席福雷举行会谈，双方见证签署多项合作文件，并发表关于构建新时代中多命运共同体的联合声明。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Premier Li Qiang held talks with Togo's Prime Minister Faure; they witnessed the signing of cooperation documents and issued a joint statement on building a China-Togo community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 李强举行仪式欢迎多哥部长会议主席福雷访华
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Holds Ceremony to Welcome Togolese Prime Minister Faure on Visit to China
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日下午，国务院总理李强在北京人民大会堂举行仪式，欢迎对华进行正式访问的多哥部长会议主席福雷，并陪同其检阅仪仗队。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 15, Premier Li Qiang held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing for Togolese Prime Minister Faure, who is on an official visit to China, and accompanied him in inspecting the honor guard.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见博茨瓦纳总统
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Botswana President Duma Boko
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，国务院总理李强在北京会见来华进行国事访问的博茨瓦纳总统博科，双方就深化政治互信、共建“一带一路”及矿业、数字、绿色等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing with Botswana President Duma Boko, who is on a state visit to China; the two sides discussed deepening political trust, Belt and Road cooperation and collaboration in mining, digital and green sectors.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Advance Full and Rigorous Party Governance with Higher Standards and Firmer Measures
articles.summary_zh: 2026年1月12日，习近平在二十届中央纪委五次全会上讲话，强调以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党，要求贯彻党中央重大决策部署、把权力关进制度笼子、深入推进反腐败斗争。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping told the 20th CCDI plenary session on Jan 12, 2026 that full and rigorous Party governance must advance with higher standards and firmer steps, stressing policy execution, institutional checks on power and anti-corruption.

articles.title_zh: 张丹调研文化惠民和产业振兴工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Inspects Public Cultural Services and Industrial Revitalization Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹到市图书馆和辽宁东方测控集团有限公司，调研文化惠民与先进制造业高质量发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan visited the city library and Liaoning Dongfang Measurement & Control Group to inspect public cultural services and high-quality development of advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 定西市委理论学习中心组召开专题学习会
articles.title_en: Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group Holds Special Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，定西市委理论学习中心组围绕学习贯彻习近平总书记视察甘肃重要讲话重要指示精神召开专题学习会，市委书记汪尚学主持并讲话，开展调研成果交流研讨。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee's theoretical study center group held a special session on implementing Xi Jinping's instructions during his Gansu inspection, chaired by Party Secretary Wang Shangxue, with research findings discussed.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见德国宝马集团董事长聂科维 霍步刚参加
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet with BMW Group Chairman Nie Kewei
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见德国宝马集团董事长聂科维一行，就深化在辽投资布局、扩大整车出口等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with BMW Group Chairman Nie Kewei to discuss deeper investment and cooperation in the province.

articles.title_zh: 李强出席第140届中国进出口商品交易会开幕式并发表主旨演讲
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends Opening Ceremony of 140th Canton Fair and Delivers Keynote Speech
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月14日下午，国务院总理李强在广州出席第140届广交会开幕式并发表主旨演讲，强调中国扩大高水平开放、推动互利共赢。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 14, 2026, Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 140th Canton Fair in Guangzhou and delivered a keynote speech, stressing China's commitment to high-level opening up and mutual benefit.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤调研组织工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Organizational Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，淮安市委书记顾坤调研全市组织工作，强调加强政治机关建设、干部选任与人才工作，为淮安高质量发展提供组织保证。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected the city's organizational work, urging stronger political institution building, cadre selection and talent programs to underpin high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组学习扩大会议暨第三十八期淮北大讲堂举办 杜军作报告 蒋曦黄韡出席
articles.title_en: Huaibei Party Committee Holds Enlarged Theoretical Study Session and 38th Huaibei Lecture, Du Jun Gives Report
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，淮北市委理论学习中心组学习扩大会议暨第三十八期淮北大讲堂举办，市委书记蒋曦等出席，企业专家杜军作合成生物制造专题报告。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Huaibei's municipal Party committee held an enlarged theoretical study session and the 38th Huaibei Lecture, attended by Party Secretary Jiang Xi, with industry expert Du Jun giving a report on synthetic biology manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生部署溶洞天坑山谷污染问题排查整治等工作
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Deploys Remediation of Karst Cave and Tiankeng Pollution
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日上午，怀化市委副书记、代市长高靖生主持召开专题会议，部署溶洞天坑山谷污染问题排查整治工作，并就招商引资、国省道隐患排查治理作出部署。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Huaihua Acting Mayor Gao Jingsheng chaired a meeting deploying cleanup of pollution in karst caves and tiankengs, along with investment promotion and road safety hazard checks.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开市委统一战线工作领导小组专题会议
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Special Meeting of Huaihua Municipal Committee's United Front Work Leading Group
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日上午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖主持召开市委统一战线工作领导小组专题会议，研究部署下阶段统战工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 14, Huaihua Party Secretary Wei Zhaohui chaired a special meeting of the municipal United Front Work Leading Group, hearing reports and planning the next stage of united front work.

articles.title_zh: 稻浪千重映江淮 粮仓丰实写担当
articles.title_en: Golden Rice Waves Across Jianghuai: Huainan Fills the Granary with a Bumper Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 淮南市2025年实现粮食生产“二十二连丰”，总产量326.95万吨，通过高标准农田建设、规模经营和“五良”融合抓好秋收秋种，助力江淮粮仓建设。
articles.summary_en: Huainan in Anhui achieved its 22nd consecutive bumper grain harvest in 2025 with 3.27 million tonnes, using high-standard farmland, scaled farming and integrated technology to secure autumn harvest and planting for the Jianghuai Granary.

articles.title_zh: 淮南市委常委会召开会议 朱艾勇主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Huainan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Chaired by Zhu Aiyong
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，淮南市委常委会召开会议，市委书记朱艾勇主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，审议通过服务业扩能提质实施方案。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the Huainan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met, chaired by Party Secretary Zhu Aiyong, to study Xi Jinping's directives and approve a plan to upgrade the service sector.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance
articles.summary_zh: 10月16日出版的第20期《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章，强调以更高标准、更实举措推进全面从严治党，狠抓决策部署落实、制度治权与反腐败斗争。
articles.summary_en: The 20th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on Oct 16, 2026, carries a major article by Xi Jinping urging stronger and more concrete steps to advance full and rigorous Party self-governance, focusing on implementing central decisions, binding power through institutions and fighting corruption.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开拉萨市委理论学习中心组集体学习会
articles.title_en: Da Wa Ciren Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市委召开理论学习中心组集体学习会，由市委书记达娃次仁主持，深入学习习近平经济思想，推动高质量发展与高水平安全良性互动。
articles.summary_en: Lhasa Municipal Party Committee held a theoretical study session chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Da Wa Ciren, focusing on Xi Jinping Thought on the Economy and the interaction between high-quality development and high-level security.

articles.title_zh: 2026年拉萨社保服务提质增效惠民生
articles.title_en: Lhasa Boosts Social Security Services to Benefit Residents in 2026
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，拉萨市推进社保服务提质增效惠民生，市委书记达娃次仁主持市委理论学习中心组学习会，代理市长李修武主持全市高质量发展务虚会。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, Lhasa moved to improve social security services for residents, as Municipal Party Secretary Dawa Tsering chaired a Party committee study session and acting mayor Li Xiuwu led a high-quality development meeting.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴在吉林调研时强调 高质量筹办好长春大冬会 高水平运营好足球青训中心
articles.title_en: Shen Yiqin Stresses High-Quality Preparations for Changchun Winter World University Games and Better Operation of Football Youth Training Centers During Jilin Inspection

articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Conducts Forest Patrol, Inspects Reed-Field Fire Prevention and Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，盘锦市委书记王炳森到食用菌合作社、苇田垛场、采油厂作业区等地巡林，检查森林苇田防灭火及安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Panjin Party Secretary Wang Bingsen patrolled forests and inspected reed-field fire prevention and workplace safety at a mushroom cooperative, a reed stack yard and an oil production station.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 14, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected urban renewal along the Meixi River in Jinping District, urging the revitalization of inefficient land and the upgrading of the old urban area.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴潮南区调研产业园区

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 13, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected industrial parks in Chaonan District, visiting firms and urging upgrades of traditional industries and a modern industrial system.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Shanwei Mayor Fan Derong inspected the Shenzhen-Shanwei paired assistance command, urging deeper all-round cooperation and a focus on green energy, new-energy vehicles and other key industries.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu inspected health and medical projects in Yinchuan, urging full implementation of the health-first development strategy and higher-quality medical services.

articles.title_en: Xu Long Inspects 2027 Industrial Project Planning, Stresses Solid Groundwork for High-Quality Development

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Shizuishan Mayor Xu Long inspected 2027 industrial project planning, visiting company sites and chairing a meeting to set key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Ningxia Autonomous Region Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，自治区主席张雨浦主持自治区政府常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神，研究耕地保护、秋收和防范非法集资等事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu chaired a government executive meeting on health, farmland protection, autumn harvest and illegal fundraising.

articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Inspects Shandong Agricultural University and Chairs Symposium, Urging Solid Path of Connotative Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，山东省省长周乃翔到山东农业大学调研并主持召开座谈会，祝贺学校建校120周年，强调坚定走内涵式发展道路，建设一流农业大学。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang inspected Shandong Agricultural University and chaired a symposium, congratulating the school on its 120th anniversary and urging connotative development toward a top agricultural university.

articles.title_en: Gao Shan Chairs Tonghua Municipal Government Party Group Meeting on Rectifying Corruption and Misconduct Around the Public
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，通化市委副书记、市长高山主持召开市政府党组会议，传达学习9月21日中共中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记近期重要指示精神，研究部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治及安全生产、粮食安全、先进制造业等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Tonghua Mayor Gao Shan chaired a municipal government Party group meeting to convey the spirit of the Sept 21 CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting and Xi Jinping's recent directives, and to plan a campaign against corruption and misconduct affecting the public, along with work on safety, food security and advanced manufacturing.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Weihai held a briefing for retired municipal cadres. Party Secretary Zhang Haibo presided and spoke, while Mayor Kong Fanping reported on the city's economic and social development this year.

articles.title_zh: 省人大常委会执法检查组来威海开展食品安全法执法检查

articles.summary_en: From Oct 12 to 13, an inspection team led by Jiang Cheng, deputy director of the Shandong Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, conducted an enforcement check in Weihai on the implementation of national and provincial food safety laws.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋到市委宣传部调研
articles.title_en: Jiang Feng Visits Municipal Party Committee Propaganda Department for Research

articles.summary_en: On October 14, Wuxi Party Secretary Jiang Feng visited the Municipal Party Committee Propaganda Department and chaired a symposium, urging deeper study of Xi Jinping's thinking on culture and high-quality development of propaganda and cultural work.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见吉利控股集团首席执行官、吉利汽车董事会主席安聪慧一行

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met An Conghui, CEO of Geely Holding Group, to deepen cooperation in new energy and smart connected vehicle industry chains.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在市委专题会议上强调 守牢安全底线 优化服务保障 确保赛事精彩安全圆满举办
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Chairs Xi'an Party Committee Meeting on Marathon Safety and Service Support
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰主持召开市委专题会议，听取2026西安马拉松赛筹备情况汇报，部署赛事安全与服务保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Xi'an party secretary Hao Huijie chaired a special municipal party committee meeting on preparations for the 2026 Xi'an Marathon, urging tighter safety and service guarantees.

articles.title_zh: 市贸促会赴高新区调研外贸企业

articles.title_zh: 宋占华调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Song Zhanhua Inspects Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，禹州市委书记宋占华到环卫工人驿站、市人民医院、古城镇调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，强调聚焦医保基金、校园餐、农村集体“三资”等重点领域动真碰硬。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Yuzhou Municipal Party Secretary Song Zhanhua inspected a campaign against misconduct and corruption affecting the public, urging tougher action in areas such as medical insurance funds, school meals and rural collective asset management.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping chaired a special meeting on stalled and suspended urban construction projects, calling for tailored, science-based measures to speed up their resumption.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研卫生健康和养老服务工作
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Inspects Health and Elderly Care Services in Yancheng

articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，阳江市委常委会会议召开，市委书记卢一先主持，传达学习习近平总书记关于“三农”工作重要指示，部署农村集体“三资”管理、高标准农田建设整治及耕地保护工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Yangjiang's Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met under Secretary Lu Yixian to relay Xi Jinping's instructions on agriculture and rural affairs and to plan rectification of rural collective asset management and high-standard farmland construction.

articles.title_en: Tao Shaohua Chairs 121st Executive Meeting of Yinchuan Municipal People's Government

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Yinchuan Mayor Tao Shaohua chaired the 121st executive meeting of the municipal government, deploying work on building a safer Yinchuan, anti-corruption rectification and equal access to public services.

articles.title_zh: 张雨浦调研城市建设工作强调让城市环境更美好 让群众生活更方便

articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，宁夏自治区主席张雨浦在银川调研城市建设和民生工程，检查保障房、保交房、交通疏堵及冬季供热准备情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu inspected urban construction and livelihood projects in Yinchuan, checking affordable housing, home-delivery guarantees, traffic improvements and winter heating preparations.

Xi Jinping delivered a key speech stressing the path of health development with Chinese characteristics and decisive progress in building a Healthy China during the 15th Five-Year Plan period; Li Qiang gave concluding remarks.

articles.title_zh: 李强出席第140届广交会开幕式并发表主旨演讲

articles.summary_zh: 10月14日下午，国务院总理李强在广州出席第140届中国进出口商品交易会开幕式并发表主旨演讲，强调中国坚定不移扩大高水平开放、推动互利共赢。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 14, Premier Li Qiang attended the opening of the 140th China Import and Export Fair in Guangzhou and delivered a keynote speech, stressing China's commitment to high-level opening up and mutual benefit.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市委城市工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Yueyang Municipal Urban Work Conference Convened
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，岳阳市委城市工作会议召开，省委副书记、市委书记谢卫江出席讲话，市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然主持，部署推动现代化人民城市建设。

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江与长三角等地企业家座谈

Acting Mayor Tang Haoran attended.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记发展先进制造业重要指示精神，并研究部署安全生产、社会治安、信访稳定和污染防治攻坚工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a standing committee meeting to implement Xi Jinping's instructions on advanced manufacturing and to arrange work on safety, social stability and pollution control.

articles.title_zh: 张华带领调研组到扶沟县、太康县调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Hua Leads Delegation to Fugou and Taikang Counties to Inspect People's Congress Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，周口市人大常委会副主任张华带队到扶沟县、太康县调研，重点了解乡镇街道人大工作条例实施和县乡人大换届选举进展。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Zhang Hua, deputy director of the Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, led a delegation to Fugou and Taikang counties to inspect township and sub-district people's congress work and preparations for county and township elections.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐赴香洲区调研先进制造业发展情况
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Inspects Advanced Manufacturing Development in Xiangzhou District
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐赴香洲区调研先进制造业发展情况，走访多家企业，强调坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，推动先进制造业集聚成势。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong inspected advanced manufacturing development in Xiangzhou District, visiting several enterprises and urging intelligent, green and integrated development to build up advanced manufacturing clusters.

articles.title_zh: 胡劲军调研珠海文旅工作 立足资源禀赋打造具有珠海辨识度的文旅品牌
articles.title_en: Hu Jinjun Inspects Zhuhai's Cultural Tourism Work, Urges Distinctive Brand Building
articles.summary_zh: 近日，广东省委常委、宣传部部长胡劲军到珠海海岛调研文旅工作，强调严守生态保护红线，立足资源禀赋发展海岛文旅，打造具有珠海辨识度的文旅品牌。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong Party Standing Committee member and publicity chief Hu Jinjun inspected Zhuhai's island cultural tourism, urging strict ecological protection and distinctive cultural tourism brands.

articles.title_zh: 福州“五全”招商续写“海上福州”建设新篇章
articles.title_en: Fuzhou's 'Five-All' Investment Push Writes New Chapter for 'Maritime Fuzhou'
articles.summary_zh: 2026世界航海装备大会将于10月16日在福州开幕，福州依托“五全”招商机制推进“海上福州”建设，已谋划涉海招商项目100多项、总投资超700亿元。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Marine Equipment Conference opens in Fuzhou on Oct 16, as the city pushes its 'Maritime Fuzhou' plan with over 100 marine-economy investment projects worth more than 70 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·走好新时代的长征路｜人民之本
articles.title_en: Learning New Words: Walking the Long March Road of the New Era | The Foundation of the People
articles.summary_zh: 在红军长征胜利90周年之际，新华社“学习新语”栏目推出“走好新时代的长征路”系列融合报道，本期“人民之本”阐释习近平总书记有关依靠人民、为了人民的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, Xinhua's "Learning New Words" column released the latest installment of its "Walking the Long March Road of the New Era" series, titled "The Foundation of the People," expounding Xi Jinping's remarks on relying on and serving the people.

articles.title_zh: 福建累计发布两岸共通标准390项 建设两岸标准共通试点75个
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues 390 Cross-Strait Common Standards, Builds 75 Pilot Projects
articles.summary_zh: 福建省市场监管部门推进两岸标准共通，相关条例于2026年1月1日施行，全省已累计发布两岸共通标准390项、建设试点75个。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's market regulator is advancing cross-strait common standards; the province's local regulation took effect on Jan 1, 2026, with 390 such standards issued and 75 pilot projects built.

articles.title_zh: 省政协重点提案办理“三结合”座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Zhao Long Attends Fujian CPPCC Symposium on Key Proposal for Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，福建省政协召开“前瞻布局未来产业、打造福建高质量发展新引擎”重点提案办理“三结合”座谈会，省委书记赵龙出席并讲话，省政协主席滕佳材主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Fujian's provincial CPPCC held a symposium on handling a key proposal to advance future industries and high-quality development; Provincial Party Secretary Zhao Long spoke and CPPCC Chairman Teng Jiacai chaired.

articles.title_zh: 刘强调研水务工作时强调：加快推进现代化水网建设 以可靠水安全保障赋能高质量发展
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Inspects Water Affairs in Jinan, Urges Faster Modern Water Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，济南市委书记刘强调研水务工作，察看智慧排水调度中心及排水管网、河道治理工程，要求加快现代化水网建设，保障城市供水与防洪安全。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang inspected water projects, including a smart drainage command center and river and pipe network works, urging faster construction of a modern water network to ensure reliable supply and flood safety.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣到西海岸新区调研督导经济运行、项目建设和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects West Coast New Area on Economic Operation, Project Construction and Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，青岛市委书记曾赞荣到西海岸新区调研督导经济运行、项目建设和安全生产工作，要求全力稳定增长、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong inspected the West Coast New Area, urging efforts to stabilize growth, advance key projects and hold the safety bottom line.

articles.title_zh: 四部门联合调查组发布婴幼儿纸尿裤甲酰胺问题核查情况通报
articles.title_en: Four-Department Joint Investigation Team Releases Findings on Formamide Claims in Infant Diapers
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，市场监管总局、工信部、国家卫生健康委、国家疾控局组成的联合调查组通报，对国内168家企业368批次婴幼儿纸尿裤抽检均未检出甲酰胺。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 15, a joint investigation team of four Chinese government departments reported that no formamide was detected in 368 batches of infant diaper samples from 168 domestic manufacturers.

articles.title_zh: 总书记讲过的长征故事：一江碧血 万千英魂
articles.title_en: Long March Stories Told by the General Secretary: Blood in the River, Heroic Souls
articles.summary_zh: 在中国工农红军长征胜利90周年之际，央视网《天天学习》栏目推出系列策划，重温习近平总书记讲述的湘江战役故事与红军烈士事迹。
articles.summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, CCTV.com's "Daily Learning" series revisits Xi Jinping's accounts of the Battle of the Xiangjiang River and its fallen Red Army soldiers.

articles.title_zh: 视频丨日本民间组织负责人：推动修改“无核三原则”与和平理念背道而驰
articles.title_en: Video: Japanese Civil Group Leader Says Pushing to Revise the 'Three Non-Nuclear Principles' Betrays Pacifism
articles.summary_zh: 日本民间和平组织负责人谷雅志批评日本政府推动重新审视“无核三原则”、讨论拥有核动力潜艇，认为这与和平理念背道而驰并将加剧地区紧张。
articles.summary_en: Yasushi Tani, head of a Japanese civil peace group, criticized Tokyo's push to revisit the 'three non-nuclear principles' and debate nuclear submarines, saying it betrays pacifism and raises regional tensions.

articles.title_zh: 社会工作部不宜简称“社工部”，地方提出可称“社会部”
articles.title_en: Party Social Work Departments Should Not Be Abbreviated as "Shegong Bu"; Localities Propose "Shehui Bu"
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，陕西延川县委社会工作部发文规范党委社会工作部称谓，明确不宜简称“社工部”，确需简化可统一称“社会部”。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, the Social Work Department of the CPC Yanchuan County Committee in Shaanxi issued guidance on standardizing the abbreviation of Party committee social work departments, saying "shegong bu" should not be used and "shehui bu" is the preferred short form.

tags.name_en: Social Work Department of the CPC Yanchuan County Committee
Standardization of Party and Government Bodies

tags_en: Social Work Department of the CPC Yanchuan County Committee

articles.title_zh: 我国地理信息产业总产值超9000亿元，已构建起完整产业链
articles.title_en: China's Geospatial Information Industry Output Exceeds 900 Billion Yuan, Full Industrial Chain Established
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，中国地理信息产业协会披露，2025年我国地理信息产业总产值达9005亿元，增速5.9%，从业单位约26.9万家，已形成完整产业链，并规划“十五五”期间年均总产值突破万亿。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, the China Association for Geospatial Industry and Sciences announced that China's geospatial information industry output reached 900.5 billion yuan in 2025, up 5.9%, with about 269,000 firms and a complete industrial chain, targeting over 1 trillion yuan annually during the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古诗词学会因派系对立等致运转失灵，被限期停止活动三个月
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Poetry Society Ordered to Halt Activities for Three Months Over Factional Rifts
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区民政厅公布2026年度查处的28件社会组织违法违规案件，内蒙古诗词学会因内部管理不力、派系对立导致运转失灵，被限期停止活动三个月。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia's civil affairs department ordered the regional poetry society to halt activities for three months over management failures and factional infighting that paralyzed its operations.

tags.name_en: Civil Affairs Department of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region
Investigation of Legal and Regulatory Violations

articles.title_zh: 深圳：APEC会议期间公交地铁票价打五折，倡议市民自愿申报停驶私家车
articles.title_en: Shenzhen: Bus and Metro Fares Halved During APEC Meeting, Residents Urged to Voluntarily Suspend Private Cars
articles.summary_zh: 10月15日，深圳市政府新闻办举行发布会，市交通运输局宣布APEC会议期间公交地铁票价五折，增加运力并倡议市民自愿停驶私家车。
articles.summary_en: On October 15, Shenzhen announced half-price bus and metro fares during the APEC meeting, along with increased public transport capacity and a call for residents to voluntarily stop driving private cars.

articles.title_zh: 我国再添4处世界灌溉工程遗产
articles.title_en: China Adds Four More World Heritage Irrigation Structures
articles.summary_zh: 北京时间10月14日晚，国际灌排委员会在法国公布2026年世界灌溉工程遗产名录，中国申报的河南沁河广利渠等4处工程全部入选，总数达46项。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Oct 14 Beijing time, the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage in France released the 2026 World Heritage Irrigation Structures list, with all four Chinese nominations selected, bringing China's total to 46.

tags.name_en: International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage

tags_en: International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage

articles.title_zh: 重庆市委常委会：坚决拥护党中央对黄奇帆进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Backs Central Decision on Disciplinary Review of Huang Qifan
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，重庆市委常委会举行会议，通报黄奇帆涉嫌严重违纪违法、接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查有关情况，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话，与会同志一致表示坚决拥护党中央决定。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to hear a report that Huang Qifan is suspected of serious disciplinary and legal violations and is under investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission, with Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun presiding.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 福建省政协重点提案办理“三结合”座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial CPPCC Holds Symposium on Handling Key Proposal
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，福建省政协召开“前瞻布局未来产业、打造福建高质量发展新引擎”重点提案办理“三结合”座谈会，省委书记赵龙出席并讲话，省政协主席滕佳材主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the Fujian Provincial CPPCC held a symposium on handling a key proposal to advance future industries. Provincial Party Secretary Zhao Long spoke, and CPPCC Chairman Teng Jiacai presided.

tags.name_en: Fujian Provincial Committee of the CPPCC

tags_en: Fujian Provincial Committee of the CPPCC

articles.title_zh: 广西一矿山生态修复工程项目通过审核
articles.title_en: Guangxi Mine Ecological Restoration Project Passes Central Review
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，广西南方丘陵山地带历史遗留废弃矿山生态修复工程项目通过财政部、自然资源部审核，入围全国首批22个项目，预计获中央资金支持3亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Guangxi's abandoned-mine ecological restoration project passed review by the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Natural Resources, becoming one of China's first 22 approved projects with an expected 300 million yuan in central funding.

articles.title_zh: 首个火龙果国家标准正式实施
articles.title_en: China's First National Standard for Dragon Fruit Officially Takes Effect
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，广西自治区市场监管局宣布，由广西牵头制定的我国首个火龙果国家标准《火龙果》正式实施，统一了品质分级与理化指标。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the Guangxi market regulation authority announced that China's first national standard for dragon fruit, drafted under Guangxi's leadership, has taken effect, unifying quality grading and physicochemical indicators.

articles.title_zh: 中央依法治国办启动领导干部依法办事情况法治督察
articles.title_en: Central Law-Based Governance Commission Office Launches Rule-of-Law Inspection on Officials' Compliance
articles.summary_zh: 经党中央批准，中央依法治国办组建8个督察组，对河北、黑龙江、福建、山东、西藏、陕西、青海、新疆8省（区）及新疆生产建设兵团开展为期10天的实地法治督察。
articles.summary_en: Approved by the Party Central Committee, the Office of the Central Commission for Law-Based Governance sent eight inspection teams to eight provincial-level regions and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps for a 10-day on-site rule-of-law inspection of officials' compliance.

tags.name_en: Office of the Central Commission for Law-Based Governance

tags_en: Office of the Central Commission for Law-Based Governance

articles.title_zh: 田间开讲生物安全课 武汉启动外来入侵物种全民防除
articles.title_en: Wuhan Launches Public Campaign to Eradicate Invasive Alien Species
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，武汉市在长江新区举办2026年外来入侵物种防除行动启动会暨科普宣传活动，向群众普及加拿大一枝黄花、福寿螺等识别与防控知识，部署全域常态化防除。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Wuhan launched its 2026 invasive alien species control campaign and a public science outreach event in Changjiang New District, teaching residents to identify and prevent species such as Canada goldenrod and the golden apple snail.

tags.name_en: Wuhan Municipal Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau

tags_en: Wuhan Municipal Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau

articles.title_zh: 盛阅春会见中国融通集团董事长李文清
articles.title_en: Sheng Yuechun Meets with China Rongtong Group Chairman Li Wenqing
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，湖北省委常委、武汉市委书记盛阅春在武汉会见中国融通集团党组书记、董事长李文清，双方就深化央地合作、拓展在汉业务布局交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Sheng Yuechun, member of the Hubei Provincial Party Standing Committee and Party Secretary of Wuhan, met in Wuhan with Li Wenqing, Party Secretary and Chairman of China Rongtong Group, to discuss deeper central-local cooperation and expanded business presence in the city.

articles.title_zh: 坚决抓好溶洞天坑山谷污染问题排查整治 更好满足新时期人民群众对优美生态环境的新需求
articles.title_en: Hubei Governor Li Dianxun Urges Rectification of Pollution in Karst Caves, Sinkholes and Valleys
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日上午，湖北省政府召开视频会议，省长李殿勋出席并讲话，研究部署全省溶洞、天坑、山谷污染问题排查整治工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 14, the Hubei Provincial Government held a video meeting, where Governor Li Dianxun spoke and laid out plans to investigate and remediate pollution in the province's karst caves, sinkholes and valleys.

articles.title_zh: 城市更新 发展焕新
articles.title_en: Urban Renewal Brings New Development to Wuhan
articles.summary_zh: 湖北武汉系统推进城市更新，计划2025至2027年完成182个片区改造，目前开工率超九成，推动产业焕新、治理革新和文化出新。
articles.summary_en: Wuhan in Hubei is advancing urban renewal with over 90% of its 182 planned districts under construction, driving industrial upgrading, better governance and cultural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 全国新时代“枫桥经验”工会实践工作会议在汉召开
articles.title_en: National Conference on Trade Unions' Practice of the "Fengqiao Experience" Held in Wuhan
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，全国新时代“枫桥经验”工会实践工作会议在武汉召开，全国总工会党组书记陆治原等出席并讲话，部署工会参与基层社会治理、化解劳动关系矛盾等工作。
articles.summary_en: A national conference on trade unions' practice of the "Fengqiao Experience" was held in Wuhan on Oct 14, where ACFTU Party chief Lu Zhiyuan and other officials spoke on union roles in grassroots governance and labor dispute resolution.

tags.name_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

tags_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥会见中国化学工程集团董事长莫鼎革
articles.title_en: Guan Zhiou Meets China National Chemical Engineering Group Chairman Mo Dingge
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，湖北省委书记关志鸥在武汉会见中国化学工程集团党委书记、董事长莫鼎革，双方就化工新材料、磷石膏资源化利用等领域深化合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhiou met in Wuhan with Mo Dingge, Chairman of China National Chemical Engineering Group, to discuss deeper cooperation in new chemical materials and phosphogypsum utilization.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在海口专题调研“六张网”规划建设情况
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Planning of Hainan's "Six Networks" Infrastructure in Haikou
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，海南省委书记冯飞在海口专题调研水网、电网、算力网、通信网、地下管网和物流网“六张网”规划建设，强调完善“六网协同”推进机制，加快构建现代化基础设施体系。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei inspected the planning of six infrastructure networks in Haikou, urging improved coordination to build a modern infrastructure system.

articles.title_zh: 刘小明在文昌调研：精耕细作特色产业 把独特资源优势转化为高质量发展胜势
articles.title_en: Hainan Governor Liu Xiaoming Inspects Wenchang, Urging Fine-Tuned Development of Signature Industries
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，海南省省长刘小明在文昌市调研经济社会发展情况，实地考察海南商业航天发射场二期项目、珠溪河流域治理及特色农产品加工产业，并就商业航天发展、生态问题整改和乡村振兴作出部署。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Hainan Governor Liu Xiaoming inspected Wenchang's economic and social development, visiting the second phase of the Hainan commercial spaceport, the Zhuxi River treatment project and a local processing industry, and outlining tasks for commercial space, ecological rectification and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 海南：海天热土间的“兴业密码”
articles.title_en: Hainan: Decoding the 'Secret of Prosperity' in a Land of Sea and Sky
articles.summary_zh: 人民网调研采访团走进海南，从商业航天、热带农业、深海科技三方面，记录海南加快建设现代化产业体系、支撑自由贸易港建设的实践。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily Online reporters visited Hainan, where commercial spaceflight, tropical agriculture and deep-sea technology are driving a modern industrial system for the free trade port.

articles.title_zh: 长春大冬会筹备工作有序推进，报名人数历届最多
articles.title_en: Preparations Advance for Changchun 2027 Winter World University Games as Registration Hits Record High
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会，介绍长春2027年第33届世界大学生冬季运动会筹备情况，已有63个国家和地区超3700人报名，为历届最多。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the State Council Information Office briefed on preparations for the 2027 Winter World University Games in Changchun, with a record 3,700-plus athletes from 63 countries registered.

articles.summary_en: On October 14, Hunan Provincial CPPCC Chairman Mao Wanchun led a team to inspect Bank of Changsha, reviewing operations and risk prevention and urging stronger financial support for Hunan's modern industrial system.

articles.title_en: Xin Changxing, Liu Xiaotao and Zhang Yizhen Meet Jiangsu Winners and Coaches of 48th WorldSkills Competition

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing, Governor Liu Xiaotao and CPPCC Chairman Zhang Yizhen met in Nanjing with Jiangsu winners and expert coaches of the 48th WorldSkills Competition, congratulating them on a record haul of five golds, two silvers and two merit awards.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开扩大会议传达学习全国卫生与健康大会精神

articles.title_zh: 千年古城澎湃创新活力——杭州着力塑造城市发展新优势

articles.title_zh: 网络涉军不当营销和炒作信息专项整治开展

articles.summary_en: Four Chinese departments, including the Cyberspace Administration of China and the Ministry of Veterans Affairs, have issued a notice launching a two-month nationwide campaign from October to clean up improper military-related marketing and sensational content online, targeting 10 categories of offending accounts.

articles.title_zh: 9月末社会融资规模存量同比增长7.1%
articles.title_en: China's Outstanding Social Financing Reaches 468.17 Trillion Yuan, Up 7.1% Year-on-Year at End of September
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，中国人民银行公布金融数据显示，9月末广义货币（M2）余额359.63万亿元，同比增长7.2%；社会融资规模存量468.17万亿元，同比增长7.1%。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, the People's Bank of China reported that at the end of September, M2 money supply stood at 359.63 trillion yuan, up 7.2% year-on-year, while outstanding social financing reached 468.17 trillion yuan, up 7.1%.

articles.title_zh: 迈向均衡普惠、优质高效的健康中国——习近平总书记重要讲话为做好新时代新征程卫生与健康工作指明方向
articles.title_en: Toward a Balanced, Inclusive and High-Quality Healthy China: Xi Jinping's Key Speech Charts the Course for Health Work in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 全国卫生与健康大会10月12日至13日在北京召开，习近平总书记出席并发表重要讲话，充分肯定卫生与健康事业发展成就，并就“十五五”时期健康中国建设进行再部署、再动员。
articles.summary_en: The National Health and Health Conference was held in Beijing on Oct 12-13, 2026, where Xi Jinping delivered a key speech redeploying efforts to build a Healthy China during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度我国物价保持平稳运行
articles.title_en: China's Prices Remain Stable in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局10月14日发布数据，前三季度全国CPI同比上涨0.9%，PPI同比上涨2.3%，物价总水平保持平稳运行。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics said on Oct 14 that China's CPI rose 0.9 percent year on year in the first three quarters, while PPI rose 2.3 percent, keeping overall prices stable.

articles.summary_en: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met with French presidential foreign policy adviser Emmanuel Bonne at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Oct. 13, exchanging views on China-France economic cooperation and China-EU trade ties.

articles.title_zh: 张丹赴东港市调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Inspects Donggang City
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹率相关部门负责同志赴东港市调研企业生产经营情况，强调深耕实体经济、优化营商环境、推进“智改数转”。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan led a delegation to Donggang City to inspect local enterprises, urging deeper work on the real economy, a better business environment and digital upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元调研市供销合作社及所属企业发展情况
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Inspects Municipal Supply and Marketing Cooperative and Its Affiliated Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元调研市供销合作社及所属企业，强调深化综合改革、盘活存量资产、做强做优社有企业并守住安全生产底线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan inspected the municipal supply and marketing cooperative and its affiliated enterprises, urging deeper reform, better use of assets, stronger cooperative-run businesses and strict work safety.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱深入萝北县调研项目建设情况并督导检查安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects Project Construction and Safety Production in Luobei County
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱深入萝北县调研产业项目建设情况，并督导检查安全生产、燃气安全及道路运输安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu inspected industrial project construction in Luobei County and oversaw workplace, gas and road transport safety work.

articles.title_zh: 省人大常委会领导来淮调研人大换届选举工作
articles.title_en: Provincial People's Congress Leader Visits Huai'an to Inspect People's Congress Election Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，江苏省人大常委会副主任、党组副书记储永宏率队赴淮安调研市县镇三级人大换届选举工作，听取汇报并强调严肃换届纪律、充分发扬民主。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Chu Yonghong, deputy director of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, led a team to Huai'an to inspect election work for people's congresses at the city, county and township levels, stressing strict discipline and full democracy.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤在淮安区调研高质量发展
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Huai'an District on High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，淮安市委书记顾坤在淮安区调研高质量发展，走访学校和企业并召开座谈会，强调聚焦新型工业化、推动县域经济振兴。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected Huai'an District's high-quality development, visiting a school and a tech firm and calling for a stronger push on new industrialization.

articles.title_zh: 全省关工委“三基行”现场会在淮北召开 张俊蒋曦出席
articles.title_en: Provincial Care for the Next Generation Committee Holds On-Site Meeting on Grassroots Construction in Huaibei
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，全省关工委“三基行”现场会在淮北召开，省关工委主任张俊、淮北市委书记蒋曦出席，部署推进基层关工委组织与“五老”队伍建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the provincial on-site meeting on grassroots work of the Care for the Next Generation Committee was held in Huaibei, attended by provincial committee director Zhang Jun and Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi to advance grassroots organization building.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦主持召开市委常委会会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究卫生与健康等工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs Huaibei Municipal Party Committee Meeting on Health Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日下午，淮北市委书记蒋曦主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神，研究全市贯彻落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 14, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi chaired a municipal Party committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's speech at the National Health Conference and review local implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 朱艾勇在全市巡察工作会议上强调：以高质效巡察护航高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhu Aiyong Stresses High-Quality Inspection Work to Safeguard High-Quality Development at Huainan City Inspection Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，淮南市召开全市巡察工作会议暨十二届市委第一轮巡察动员部署会，市委书记朱艾勇出席并讲话，强调以高质效巡察护航高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Huainan held its city inspection work meeting and launched the first round of the 12th Municipal Party Committee's inspection. Party Secretary Zhu Aiyong urged high-quality inspection work to support development.

articles.title_zh: 郄英才赴浙江省绍兴市考察学习
articles.title_en: Qie Yingcai Visits Shaoxing, Zhejiang for Study Tour
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，黄石市委书记郄英才率队赴浙江绍兴考察学习，重点了解营商环境优化、项目建设服务及新质生产力培育经验，绍兴市委书记施惠芳陪同。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Huangshi Party Secretary Qie Yingcai led a delegation to Shaoxing, Zhejiang, to study its experience in improving the business environment, project construction services and new quality productive forces; Shaoxing Party Secretary Shi Huifang accompanied the visit.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Jieyang Municipal Government Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署全面从严治党、粮食安全和重点项目建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie chaired municipal government Party group and executive meetings, deploying work on full Party discipline, food security and key projects.

articles.title_zh: 市政府与人保财险广东分公司签订战略合作框架协议
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Government Signs Strategic Cooperation Framework Agreement with PICC P&C Guangdong Branch
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，揭阳市政府与人保财险广东分公司在揭阳市区签署战略合作框架协议，市长曲晓杰、人保财险广东分公司总经理李旭出席致辞。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, the Jieyang Municipal Government and PICC P&C Guangdong Branch signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement in Jieyang, with Mayor Qu Xiaojie and branch general manager Li Xu attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 尹李峰在波密、察隅、墨脱调研
articles.title_en: Linzhi Mayor Yin Lifeng Inspects Bomi, Zayu and Medog Counties
articles.summary_zh: 近日，林芝市委副书记、市长尹李峰深入波密、察隅、墨脱三县，调研重大项目建设、生态环保督察整改、地质灾害治理及兴边富民等工作。
articles.summary_en: Linzhi Mayor Yin Lifeng recently inspected Bomi, Zayu and Medog counties, reviewing major projects, ecological inspection rectification, geological disaster control and border-area prosperity programs.

articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng: Steady Efforts to Rectify Central Environmental Inspection Feedback and Build a Strong National Ecological Security Barrier
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，西藏自治区党委生态文明建设领导小组在拉萨召开会议，自治区党委书记胡昌升主持并讲话，部署中央生态环保督察反馈问题整改和生态安全屏障建设重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee's ecological civilization leading group met in Lhasa, where Party Secretary Hu Changsheng urged steady rectification of central environmental inspection feedback and stronger ecological security safeguards.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Longyan Mayor Cai Lin chaired municipal government party group and executive meetings, deploying work on economic operations, workplace safety, ecological protection and high-standard farmland construction.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, the 18th meeting of the 6th Longyan CPPCC Standing Committee was held to consult on high-quality development of the "mining plus" economy, with Party Secretary Hu Sheng attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森会见农民日报社副总编辑杨志华一行
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Meets with Yang Zhihua, Deputy Editor-in-Chief of Farmers' Daily
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，盘锦市委书记王炳森会见农民日报社副总编辑杨志华一行，就加强“三农”宣传、助力盘锦振兴发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Panjin Municipal Party Secretary Wang Bingsen met with Yang Zhihua, deputy editor-in-chief of Farmers' Daily, to discuss agricultural publicity and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市委书记庄悦群主持专题会议 研究部署土地盘活与全域土地综合整治工作

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 12, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a special meeting to review land revitalization and citywide comprehensive land consolidation, and to deploy work on idle and inefficient land.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市政府党组（扩大）会议暨党组理论学习中心组学习会议、常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 13, Shantou Mayor Chen Tao chaired the municipal government's expanded Party group meeting and executive meeting, which studied grassroots governance, ecological inspection rectification and advanced manufacturing development.

articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng led a delegation to visit Xinhua News Agency's Guangdong bureau and held talks on deepening cooperation between local authorities and central media to showcase Shanwei's modernization efforts.

articles.title_zh: 王荣率队到汕尾考察

articles.summary_en: On Oct 12-13, Wang Rong, a national CPPCC member and former Guangdong CPPCC chair, led a delegation to Shanwei to inspect progress on the 'Hundred Counties, Thousand Towns, Ten Thousand Villages' project.

articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang attended a symposium in Guangzhou on October 14 marking 70 years of the Canton Fair, saying China will further strengthen the fair by making it smarter, greener and more people-oriented.

articles.title_zh: 李岩赴柳河县调研产业发展与乡村振兴

articles.summary_en: On October 13, Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan visited Liuhe County to survey industrial development, project construction and rural revitalization, urging high-quality county economic growth suited to local conditions.

articles.title_zh: 通化市委书记李岩赴柳河县调研产业发展与乡村振兴
articles.title_en: Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan Inspects Liuhe County on Industry and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，通化市委书记李岩深入柳河县，就产业发展、项目建设、乡村振兴等工作开展调研，强调因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan visited Liuhe County to inspect industrial development, project construction and rural revitalization, urging high-quality county-level economic growth tailored to local conditions.

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见惠普公司客人

articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo met Miguel Guzman, HP's senior vice president of global supply chain operations for printing, to discuss deepening cooperation and HP's continued presence in Weihai.

articles.title_zh: 高层次人才齐鲁行座谈会在威海举行

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见惠普公司客人
