articles.summary_en: On October 13, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo met with Miguel Guzman, Senior Vice President of Global Supply Chain Operations for HP's printing business, to discuss deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 陈东主持召开市政府第130次常务会议
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Chairs the 130th Executive Meeting of the Municipal Government

articles.summary_en: On October 13, Wuhu Acting Mayor Chen Dong chaired the 130th executive meeting of the municipal government, conveying recent remarks by Xi Jinping and reviewing the results of a cleanup of municipal regulations and documents.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰督导检查“保回迁”工作并主持召开推进会
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects 'Ensuring Resettlement' Work and Chairs Meeting

articles.summary_en: On October 13, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected resettlement housing projects and chaired a meeting, urging faster construction and strict quality control to ensure residents can return to comfortable homes.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研督导西安秋收秋播秋管工作
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Autumn Harvest, Sowing and Field Management Work in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰赴长安区调研督导秋收秋播秋管工作，强调抢抓农时、科学调度、精准服务，保障秋粮丰产丰收、秋播种足种好。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Hao Huijie, member of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Standing Committee and Secretary of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected autumn harvest, sowing and field management in Chang'an District, urging timely, well-organized efforts to secure a bumper autumn grain harvest and full, high-quality winter wheat sowing.

articles.title_zh: 陈维忠赴经开区调研企业服务月开展和外贸工作
articles.title_en: Chen Weizhong Inspects Economic Development Zone on Enterprise Service Month and Foreign Trade Work

articles.summary_en: On October 13, Xinxiang Mayor Chen Weizhong inspected the economic development zone to review the enterprise service month, key enterprise development and foreign trade work, visiting production lines and trade platforms and holding a symposium.

articles.title_zh: 襄城县推动文化繁荣兴盛暨文旅强县建设大会召开
articles.title_en: Xiangcheng County Holds Conference on Cultural Prosperity and Building a Strong Cultural-Tourism County
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，襄城县召开推动文化繁荣兴盛暨文旅强县建设大会，县委书记范耀江出席并讲话，县长张国平主持，部署文化事业与文旅产业发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Xiangcheng County held a conference on cultural prosperity and building a strong cultural-tourism county, where Party Secretary Fan Yaojiang spoke and County Head Zhang Guoping presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 张国平实地调研重点项目建设情况
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoping Conducts On-Site Inspection of Key Project Construction
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，县长张国平到襄恒化工产业园实地调研彩达油墨等四家化工企业项目建设情况并召开座谈会，要求部门分类施策、优化营商环境，为项目推进扫清障碍。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, County Head Zhang Guoping inspected key chemical projects at the Xiangheng Chemical Industry Park and held a symposium, urging departments to resolve enterprise difficulties case by case and improve the business environment to support project construction.

articles.title_zh: 宣城市委常委会召开会议 何淳宽主持
articles.title_en: He Chunkuan Chairs Xuancheng Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日上午，宣城市委书记何淳宽主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 13, Xuancheng Party Secretary He Chunkuan chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Standing Committee to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions and to plan implementation work.

articles.title_zh: 宣城市委理论学习中心组学习会议召开
articles.title_en: Xuancheng Municipal Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Group Meeting on Ecological Civilization
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日上午，宣城市委理论学习中心组召开学习会议，专题学习习近平生态文明思想，市委书记何淳宽主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 13, Xuancheng's municipal Party committee held a theoretical study group session on Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization, chaired by Party Secretary He Chunkuan.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平到大丰调研海洋经济发展工作
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Inspects Marine Economy Development in Dafeng
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，盐城市委书记严汉平到大丰区调研海洋经济发展工作，走访重点企业、实验室和港口，强调坚定向海图强、深耕蓝色沃土。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping inspected marine economy development in Dafeng District, visiting key enterprises, laboratories and the port, urging stronger efforts toward the sea-based economy.

articles.title_zh: 江成调研交通重点项目建设时强调强化要素保障严把安全质量
articles.title_en: Jiang Cheng Inspects Key Transportation Projects, Urges Stronger Resource Support and Safety Quality Control
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日上午，山东省人大常委会副主任、烟台市委书记江成实地调研德润快速路、龙烟铁路市域化改造、烟台南站、山海快速路等交通重点项目，要求强化要素保障、严把安全质量，推动项目早日建成投用。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 14, Jiang Cheng, deputy director of the Shandong Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and Yantai Party secretary, inspected key transportation projects including the Derun Expressway interchange, the Longyan Railway urbanized upgrade, Yantai South Station and the Shanhai Expressway, urging stronger resource support and safety and quality control to speed up completion.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研算力应用产业有关工作：加快打造算力之都
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Computing Power Application Industry, Vows to Build Yinchuan into a "Computing Power Capital"
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，银川市委书记赵旭辉在银川调研算力应用产业，走访医疗、文旅及人工智能企业，要求强化应用牵引和场景赋能，加快打造算力之都。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui inspected computing-power application firms in Yinchuan, urging stronger scenario-driven adoption of AI to build the city into a "computing power capital".

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥会见清华大学经济管理学院顾问委员会委员代表
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Representatives of Tsinghua SEM Advisory Board
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在北京会见清华大学经济管理学院顾问委员会委员代表，重点就人工智能发展和治理进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13 in Beijing, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang, a Politburo Standing Committee member, met representatives of the Tsinghua SEM Advisory Board, focusing on AI development and governance.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然赴省直单位对接工作
articles.title_en: Yueyang Acting Mayor Tang Haoran Visits Provincial Departments to Seek Support
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，岳阳市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然率队赴湖南省农业农村厅、住建厅、发改委、自然资源厅及湖南银行对接工作，争取政策、项目、资金和试点支持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Yueyang Acting Mayor Tang Haoran led a delegation to Hunan provincial departments and Bank of Hunan to seek policy, project, funding and pilot support.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江会见中国化学工程集团董事长莫鼎革一行
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Meets with China National Chemical Engineering Chairman Mo Dingge
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江在岳阳会见中国化学工程集团董事长莫鼎革一行，双方就深化战略合作、推动化工产业链升级交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Xie Weijiang, Hunan deputy party secretary and Yueyang party secretary, met with Mo Dingge, chairman of China National Chemical Engineering Group, to discuss deeper strategic cooperation and upgrading the chemical industry chain.

articles.title_zh: 胡艳华带领调研组赴项城市、郸城县开展实地调研
articles.title_en: Hu Yanhua Leads Research Team to Xiangcheng and Dancheng for Field Study
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，周口市人大常委会副主任胡艳华带领调研组赴项城市、郸城县，围绕养老服务、基层治理和县乡人大换届选举筹备等开展实地调研。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Hu Yanhua, deputy head of the Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, led a research team to Xiangcheng and Dancheng to inspect elderly care, grassroots governance and local people's congress election preparations.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国到扶沟县调研
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Conducts Inspection Tour in Fugou County
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，周口市委书记黄玉国到扶沟县调研市第六次党代会精神贯彻落实情况，以及基层党组织建设、项目建设和基层社会治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo inspected Fugou County to review implementation of the city's 6th Party Congress spirit, grassroots Party building, project construction and community governance.

articles.title_zh: 山东省党政代表团赴新疆考察调研
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party and Government Delegation Visits Xinjiang for Inspection and Research
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日至14日，山东省委书记林武率山东省党政代表团赴新疆维吾尔自治区及新疆生产建设兵团考察调研，推进对口援疆和鲁疆合作。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 12 to 14, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu led a provincial party and government delegation to Xinjiang and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps to advance pairing-assistance work and Shandong-Xinjiang cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 福州市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记建设更高水平平安中国重要指示精神，郭宁宁主持
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Chairs Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on Building a Higher-Level Safe China
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，福州市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于建设更高水平平安中国的重要指示精神，研究部署平安福州建设落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning chaired a meeting of the municipal Party committee standing committee to implement Xi Jinping's instructions on building a higher-level Safe China and advance the construction of Safe Fuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 海军福州舰回到家乡开展城舰共建活动
articles.title_en: PLA Navy's Fuzhou Warship Returns Home for City-Ship Co-building Activities
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，海军福州舰回到福州开展“战舰回家乡”城舰共建活动，省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德出席欢迎仪式并登舰参观。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the PLA Navy's Fuzhou warship returned to Fuzhou for city-ship co-building events; Party Secretary Guo Ningning and Mayor Wu Xiande attended the welcome ceremony aboard the ship.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能重塑软件业竞争格局
articles.title_en: AI Reshapes the Competitive Landscape of the Software Industry
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部印发《“人工智能+软件”专项行动实施方案》，提出到2028年推广应用覆盖2万家规模以上软件企业，推动软件生产、产品与服务智能化升级。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issued an action plan for integrating AI into the software industry, aiming to reach 20,000 major software firms and upgrade production, products and services by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月14日，青岛市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神，市委书记曾赞荣主持会议并讲话，会议还听取了全市人才工作情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, 2026, the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's speech at the National Health Conference; Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong chaired the meeting, which also reviewed local talent work.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省委常委会召开会议 研究部署四季度经济工作
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Deploy Fourth-Quarter Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，浙江省委书记王浩主持省委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记在全国卫生与健康大会上的重要讲话精神，并部署四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, Zhejiang Party Secretary Wang Hao chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study the spirit of Xi Jinping's speech at the National Health Conference and deploy fourth-quarter economic work.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市政府党组会议：坚决拥护党中央对黄奇帆审查调查的决定
articles.title_en: Chongqing Government Party Group Meeting Backs CPC Central Committee Decision on Huang Qifan Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，重庆市长陈新武主持市政府党组会议，通报黄奇帆涉嫌严重违纪违法接受中央纪委国家监委审查调查，与会者表示坚决拥护中央决定。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu chaired a municipal government Party group meeting on Huang Qifan's disciplinary probe, voicing firm support for the CPC Central Committee's decision.

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 安徽省医疗数据要素创新中心在合肥揭牌成立
articles.title_en: Anhui Medical Data Element Innovation Center Unveiled in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，安徽省医疗健康数据要素创新中心在合肥揭牌成立，由中国科大附一院与数字安徽公司共建，现场签署医疗健康数据开发利用合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, the Anhui Medical Health Data Element Innovation Center was unveiled in Hefei, jointly built by the First Affiliated Hospital of USTC and Digital Anhui, with a data development cooperation agreement signed.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇主持会议 研究北京市“十五五”时期生态涵养区发展规划等事项
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Chairs Meeting on Beijing's 15th Five-Year Plan for Ecological Conservation Areas
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日下午，北京市政府召开常务会议，市长殷勇主持，研究“十五五”时期生态涵养区发展规划、花园城市建设规划及法治宣传教育等事项。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 13, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong chaired a municipal government executive meeting on the 15th Five-Year Plan for ecological conservation areas, garden-city construction and legal education.

articles.title_zh: 惠安开展干部作风建设提质增效行动 实施五大专项工程
articles.title_en: Hui'an Launches Cadre Work-Style Improvement Drive with Five Special Projects
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，福建省惠安县召开干部作风建设提质增效行动动员部署大会，县委书记黄育奇提出“三个聚焦”，并发布实施五大专项工程，靶向纠治作风顽疾。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Hui'an County in Fujian held a mobilization meeting on improving cadre work style, where county Party Secretary Huang Yuqi announced five special projects targeting work-style problems.

articles.title_zh: 福建部署老旧水库改造提升工作：抢抓政策窗口期，年底前完成拉网式排查
articles.title_en: Fujian Deploys Upgrade of Aging Reservoirs, Requiring Sweep Inspection by Year-End
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，福建省水利厅召开全省老旧水库改造提升工作视频推进会，要求年底前完成拉网式排查并抢抓政策窗口期争取中央资金支持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Fujian's Provincial Department of Water Resources held a video meeting on upgrading aging reservoirs, demanding a sweep inspection by year-end and more central funding support.

articles.title_zh: 厦门自贸片区“逐绿向智”发展向好向优
articles.title_en: Xiamen Free Trade Zone Advances Green and Smart Development
articles.summary_zh: 厦门自贸片区两年来推进绿色化、数字化转型，深化两岸经济合作，扩大高水平对外开放。
articles.summary_en: Over the past two years, the Xiamen Free Trade Zone has advanced green and digital transformation, deepened cross-Strait economic cooperation, and expanded high-level opening up.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到绥化市调研督导农业生产工作
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Inspects Agricultural Production Work in Suihua
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，黑龙江省委书记许勤到绥化市北林区、望奎县调研督导秋收、秋整地和黑土地保护等农业生产工作，强调当好国家粮食安全“压舱石”。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Heilongjiang Party Secretary Xu Qin inspected autumn harvest, land preparation and black soil protection in Suihua, urging efforts to safeguard national food security.

articles.title_zh: 制度创新赋能向北开放 绥芬河片区成立七周年成果展落幕
articles.title_en: Institutional Innovation Empowers Northward Opening: Suifenhe FTZ Area Concludes 7th Anniversary Achievements Exhibition
articles.summary_zh: 10月中旬，中国（黑龙江）自贸试验区绥芬河片区成立七周年暨绥芬河—东宁重点开发开放试验区获批十周年制度创新成果展落幕，巡展走进机关、校园、园区、枢纽、景区，展示366项制度创新成果。
articles.summary_en: The institutional innovation achievements exhibition marking the 7th anniversary of the Suifenhe area of the China (Heilongjiang) Pilot Free Trade Zone, and the 10th anniversary of the Suifenhe-Dongning key development and opening pilot zone, concluded in mid-October, with touring displays in government offices, campuses, industrial parks, transport hubs and scenic spots showcasing 366 innovation outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 银川多点发力推动工业经济提质增效
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Steps Up Efforts to Improve Quality and Efficiency of Industrial Economy
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日消息，今年前三季度银川市加大政策兑现与要素保障力度，拨付奖补资金6659万元，协调解决企业生产经营问题50余件。
articles.summary_en: As of Oct 13, Yinchuan city in Ningxia said it had allocated 66.59 million yuan in subsidies and resolved over 50 production problems for industrial enterprises in the first three quarters of the year to boost stable output and upgrading.

articles.title_zh: “齐鲁七星”山东人工智能垂域大模型集中亮相
articles.title_en: "Qilu Seven Stars": Shandong's Vertical AI Large Models Debut Together
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日上午，“齐鲁制造会客厅”人工智能垂直领域大模型专场活动在济南举办，七家垂域大模型企业集中亮相，展示山东人工智能与制造业深度融合成效。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 14, a special event on vertical AI large models was held in Jinan, where seven leading vertical-model firms showcased Shandong's integration of AI with manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 工博会观察：从“技术可行”到“产业可用”，中国智造呈现新范式
articles.title_en: CIIF Observation: From "Technically Feasible" to "Industrially Usable," China's Smart Manufacturing Shows a New Paradigm
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日至16日，第二十六届中国国际工业博览会在上海国家会展中心举行，超3200家参展商参展，国产算力底座、具身智能机器人等成果集中亮相。
articles.summary_en: The 26th China International Industry Fair ran from Oct 12 to 16, 2026 at Shanghai's National Exhibition and Convention Center, drawing over 3,200 exhibitors and showcasing domestic computing-power bases and embodied AI robots.

articles.title_zh: 我国矿产资源目录发布
articles.title_en: China Releases National Mineral Resources Catalogue
articles.summary_zh: 经国务院批准，自然资源部会同国家发展改革委近日发布《矿产资源目录》，划分为4类、174个矿种、119个亚矿种。
articles.summary_en: Approved by the State Council, the Ministry of Natural Resources and the National Development and Reform Commission released China's Mineral Resources Catalogue, covering four categories, 174 minerals and 119 sub-minerals.

articles.title_zh: 观云测雨惠民生：5名气象领域代表与中外记者见面交流
articles.title_en: Five Meteorology Representatives Meet Chinese and Foreign Press on Weather Services for the People
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，5名气象领域代表围绕监测预报护冷暖、气象服务惠民生与中外记者交流。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, the State Council Information Office hosted a press meeting where five meteorology representatives discussed monitoring, forecasting and weather services that benefit the public.

articles.title_zh: 拾光纪·踏寻习近平工作足迹后，两位非洲国家领导人由衷表达敬意
articles.title_en: African Leaders Express Respect for Xi Jinping After Visiting His Former Work Sites
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，习近平主席同博茨瓦纳总统博科会谈，并会见多哥部长会议主席福雷；两位非洲国家领导人此前踏访习近平工作过的地方。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, President Xi Jinping held talks with Botswana President Duma Boko and met Togo's Faure Gnassingbe, after the two African leaders visited places where Xi once worked.

articles.title_zh: 山东首条跨里海TIR国际公路运输新线路在上合示范区开通
articles.title_en: Shandong's First Trans-Caspian TIR Road Transport Route Opens at SCO Demonstration Zone, Reaching Georgia
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，上合示范区至格鲁吉亚TIR国际公路运输新线路开通，首批两辆运输车从青岛胶州出发，为山东首条跨里海TIR线路。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, a new TIR road transport route linking the SCO Demonstration Zone in Qingdao with Georgia opened, the first trans-Caspian TIR line in Shandong.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向第140届中国进出口商品交易会致贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to the 140th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair)
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，国家主席习近平向在广州开幕的第140届广交会致贺信，强调共同维护多边贸易体制、保障全球产业链供应链稳定畅通。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 140th Canton Fair, which opened in Guangzhou, calling for joint efforts to uphold the multilateral trading system and keep global supply chains stable.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军调研推进全面从严治党工作并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Inspects Work on Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，重庆市委书记袁家军赴大渡口区、九龙坡区调研全面从严治党工作并主持召开座谈会，强调牢固树立大抓基层导向，推动基层党组织全面进步全面过硬。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun inspected grassroots sites in Dadukou and Jiulongpo districts and chaired a symposium on advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance, stressing a firm focus on strengthening Party organizations at the grassroots level.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼王陆进看望慰问部分中央驻豫新闻单位
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi and Wang Lujin Visit Central Media Outlets Stationed in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进走访人民日报社河南分社、新华社河南分社等中央驻豫新闻单位，看望慰问新闻工作者。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 14, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and Acting Governor Wang Lujin visited central media outlets stationed in Henan and met with journalists, urging better storytelling about the province.

articles.title_zh: 学习手记｜变废为宝 点绿成金
articles.title_en: Study Notes: Turning Waste into Treasure, Greening into Gold
articles.summary_zh: 新华社播发学习手记，梳理习近平总书记关于发展循环经济的论述与实践，指出2025年我国主要再生资源回收利用量已突破4.1亿吨。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua study note reviews Xi Jinping's guidance on developing the circular economy, noting that China's recovery of major renewable resources exceeded 410 million tonnes in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 我国批准清洁能源国家标准600余项
articles.title_en: China Approves Over 600 National Standards for Clean Energy
articles.summary_zh: 10月14日，国家市场监督管理总局在北京发布信息显示，我国已批准发布水电、光伏、氢能等清洁能源国家标准600余项、团体标准1300余项。
articles.summary_en: On October 14, the State Administration for Market Regulation announced in Beijing that China has approved over 600 national standards and 1,300 group standards for clean energy, including hydropower, solar and hydrogen.

articles.title_zh: 高质量共建“一带一路”成就观察
articles.title_en: Observations on Achievements in High-Quality Belt and Road Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 报道梳理共建“一带一路”13年成就：从中国倡议走向国际实践，在互联互通、民生改善、绿色发展等领域取得成果，习近平总书记为其指明方向。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua report reviews 13 years of Belt and Road cooperation, highlighting its transformation from a Chinese initiative into international practice and achievements in connectivity, livelihood and green development.

articles.title_zh: 我国发布15项氢能国家标准
articles.title_en: China Releases 15 National Hydrogen Energy Standards
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局10月14日通报，集中发布15项氢能国家标准，覆盖制氢、储运、加氢及安全检测全链条。
articles.summary_en: China's State Administration for Market Regulation announced on Oct 14 the release of 15 national hydrogen energy standards covering production, storage, transport, refueling, and safety.

articles.title_en: Ge Huijun Conducts Research in Dongying on Green, Low-Carbon High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日至13日，山东省政协主席葛慧君到东营市，围绕“加快绿色低碳高质量发展先行区建设”民主监督议题开展调研。
articles.summary_en: From October 12 to 13, Ge Huijun, Chairwoman of the Shandong Provincial CPPCC, conducted a research visit to Dongying on accelerating the construction of a green, low-carbon high-quality development pilot zone.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在西安调研全面依法治省工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Inspects Work on Advancing the Rule of Law in Shaanxi
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安市调研全面依法治省工作，走访行政争议预防调处中心、未央区人民法院执行局和西北政法大学。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Shaanxi Provincial Party Secretary Zhao Yide inspected rule-of-law work in Xi'an, visiting an administrative dispute mediation center, a court enforcement bureau and Northwest University of Political Science and Law.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行批准威士公司筹备银行卡清算机构
articles.title_en: PBOC Approves Visa Subsidiary to Prepare Bank Card Clearing Institution
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行10月13日公布，向威士信息技术（北京）有限公司下发准予行政许可决定，批准其筹备银行卡清算机构，须在一年内完成筹备并申请开业。
articles.summary_en: China's central bank announced on Oct 13 that it has granted administrative approval to Visa Information Technology (Beijing) Co. to prepare a bank card clearing institution, with preparations to be completed within one year.

articles.title_zh: 2026北京接诉即办改革论坛开幕，尹力出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 2026 Beijing Immediate Response Reform Forum Opens, Yin Li Attends and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，2026北京接诉即办改革论坛在北京开幕，北京市委书记尹力出席并致辞，吴汉圣、慎海雄、高翔、殷勇、李秀领等出席，论坛发布多项城市治理研究成果。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, the 2026 Beijing Immediate Response Reform Forum opened in Beijing. Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li attended and delivered a speech, alongside Wu Hansheng, Shen Haixiong, Gao Xiang, Yin Yong and Li Xiuling, with several urban governance research reports released.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：坚决反对印方公布所谓标准地名，印方此举是非法的、无效的
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Firmly Opposes India's Publication of So-Called Standard Place Names, Calling the Move Illegal and Invalid
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会上表示，中方从不承认印方非法设立的所谓“拉达克中央直辖区”，坚决反对印方公布所谓标准地名。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said at a regular press briefing that China has never recognized India's so-called "Central Ladakh" administrative region and firmly opposes India's publication of standard place names, calling the move illegal and invalid.

articles.title_zh: 多哥部长会议主席福雷向人民英雄纪念碑敬献花圈
articles.title_en: Togo's Council of Ministers President Faure Lays Wreath at Monument to the People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日下午，多哥部长会议主席福雷前往北京天安门广场，向人民英雄纪念碑敬献花圈。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 13, Faure, President of Togo's Council of Ministers, visited Tiananmen Square in Beijing and laid a wreath at the Monument to the People's Heroes.

articles.title_zh: 中国空军多型主战装备、海军现役装备将亮相中国航展
articles.title_en: PLA Air Force Main Combat Equipment, Navy Active-Duty Equipment to Debut at China Airshow
articles.summary_zh: 第十六届中国航展将于12月7日至13日在广东珠海举办，已有近50个国家和地区超1100家企业参展，中国空军多型主战装备、海军现役装备将亮相。
articles.summary_en: The 16th China International Aviation and Aerospace Exhibition will be held in Zhuhai, Guangdong from Dec 7 to 13, with over 1,100 companies from nearly 50 countries and regions; PLA Air Force combat and Navy equipment will debut.

articles.title_zh: 检察机关依法分别对廖正伟、江海、马忠华、雷楚英提起公诉
articles.title_en: Procuratorates File Public Prosecution Against Liao Zhengwei, Jiang Hai, Ma Zhonghua and Lei Chuying in Bribery Cases
articles.summary_zh: 海南、四川、云南检察机关日前分别对原海南省国土资源厅副厅长廖正伟、原四川省文旅厅副厅长江海、原云南省委政法委副书记马忠华、原大理州副州长雷楚英涉嫌受贿案提起公诉。
articles.summary_en: Procuratorates in Hainan, Sichuan and Yunnan have filed public bribery charges against four former officials, including Liao Zhengwei, Jiang Hai, Ma Zhonghua and Lei Chuying, over huge illegal payments.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市委原副书记、市政府原市长黄奇帆被查
articles.title_en: Huang Qifan, Former Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Chongqing, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据中央纪委国家监委网站10月13日消息，重庆市委原副书记、市政府原市长黄奇帆涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Huang Qifan, former deputy party secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Committee and former mayor of Chongqing, is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, per the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission.

articles.title_zh: “红星照耀中国·新长征再出发”网络主题宣传活动在江西于都举行
articles.title_en: 'Red Star Shines Over China: New Long March' Online Campaign Held in Yudu, Jiangxi
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，“红星照耀中国·新长征再出发”网络主题宣传活动在江西省赣州市于都县举行，由中央网信办、中央党史和文献研究院、新华通讯社、江西省委网信委共同主办。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, a themed online campaign, 'Red Star Shines Over China: New Long March', was held in Yudu, Jiangxi, co-hosted by the Cyberspace Administration of China, Xinhua and other central and provincial bodies.

articles.title_zh: 增值税法施行后，文旅行业这些政策有变化
articles.title_en: New VAT Law Brings Policy Changes for China's Cultural and Tourism Industry
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月13日，人民日报刊发政策解读，梳理增值税法施行后文旅行业在团餐抵扣、免费开放日免税、景区配套项目税目等方面的规则变化。
articles.summary_en: A policy explainer published on Oct 13, 2026 outlines how China's newly effective VAT Law changes deduction, exemption and tax-category rules for cultural and tourism businesses.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺马迪塞就任爱沙尼亚总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Madise on Her Assumption of Estonian Presidency
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，国家主席习近平致电于勒·马迪塞，祝贺她就任爱沙尼亚共和国总统，并表示愿以两国建交35周年为契机深化双边关系。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Ülle Madise on her assumption of the presidency of Estonia, voicing readiness to deepen bilateral ties on the 35th anniversary of diplomatic relations.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席全国卫生与健康大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends National Health Conference and Delivers Key Speech
articles.summary_zh: 全国卫生与健康大会10月12日至13日在北京召开，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，强调坚定不移走中国特色卫生与健康发展道路，确保“十五五”时期健康中国建设取得决定性进展，李强作总结讲话。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Conference was held in Beijing on Oct 12-13. Xi Jinping attended and delivered a key speech stressing a health development path with Chinese characteristics, while Li Qiang gave the concluding address.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际同越南国会主席陈青敏会谈并共同主持中越立法机构联合委员会第二次会议
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man and Co-Chairs Second Meeting of China-Vietnam Joint Committee on Legislative Bodies
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月12日，全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际在北京人民大会堂同越南国会主席陈青敏举行会谈，并共同主持中越立法机构联合委员会第二次会议。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, 2026, NPC Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji held talks with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing and co-chaired the second meeting of the China-Vietnam Joint Committee on Legislative Bodies.

articles.title_zh: 造一台更懂番茄的收获机
articles.title_en: Building a Tomato Harvester That Truly Understands Tomatoes
articles.summary_zh: 我国自主研发的4FZ—80自走式番茄收获机2024年投放市场，每小时可收获80吨，效率相当于400至800个人工，累计采收面积已超5万亩。
articles.summary_en: China's domestically developed 4FZ-80 self-propelled tomato harvester, launched in 2024, can harvest 80 tonnes per hour, matching the output of 400-800 workers, with over 50,000 mu harvested so far.

articles.title_zh: 第三轮第七批中央生态环境保护督察全面启动
articles.title_en: Third Round, Seventh Batch of Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspections Fully Launched
articles.summary_zh: 中央生态环境保护督察工作领导小组办公室致函被督察对象，要求精准科学依法推进边督边改，禁止“一刀切”和敷衍应对，并规范突出生态环境问题问责工作。
articles.summary_en: The Office of the Leading Group for Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspections has written to inspected entities, urging precise, science-based and law-compliant rectification, banning one-size-fits-all responses, and regulating accountability work.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同巴布亚新几内亚总督达达埃就中巴新建交50周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Dadae Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 50th Anniversary of China-PNG Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，习近平同巴布亚新几内亚总督达达埃互致贺电，庆祝两国建交50周年；同日李强同巴新总理马拉佩互致贺电。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Dadae exchanged congratulatory messages marking 50 years of diplomatic relations, while Li Qiang did the same with PNG Prime Minister Marape.

articles.title_zh: 新皇岗口岸正式开通
articles.title_en: New Huanggang Port Officially Opens
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，历时7年重建升级的深圳皇岗口岸正式开通，实施“一地两检”“合作查验、一次放行”，深港通关效率显著提升。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, the rebuilt Huanggang Port in Shenzhen officially opened after seven years of reconstruction, adopting a co-location and single-clearance model that markedly speeds up Shenzhen-Hong Kong cross-border travel.

articles.title_zh: 我国生成式人工智能用户规模超7亿人
articles.title_en: China's Generative AI User Base Surpasses 700 Million
articles.summary_zh: 中国互联网络信息中心发布的报告显示，截至2026年上半年，我国生成式人工智能用户规模超7亿人，普及率超50%，应用场景呈多元化发展。
articles.summary_en: A report by China's Internet Network Information Center shows that as of the first half of 2026, China's generative AI user base exceeded 700 million, with a penetration rate above 50% and increasingly diverse applications.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事：长征精神薪火相传
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: Passing On the Long March Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月12日播发报道，长征胜利90周年之际，长征沿线各地传承长征精神、发展红色文旅与特色产业、推进乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Oct 12 that 90 years after the Long March's victory, communities along its route are carrying on the Long March spirit through red culture, local industries and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠到榆树市农安县德惠市调研 抓好农业生产 解决群众急难愁盼
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Inspects Yushu, Nong'an and Dehui to Boost Agricultural Production and Address Public Concerns
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，长春市委书记张恩惠赴榆树市、农安县、德惠市部分乡镇调研，围绕秋收生产、粮食收储和精深加工、信访稳定等重点工作提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui inspected townships in Yushu, Nong'an and Dehui, urging efforts on autumn harvest, grain storage and processing, and handling public complaints.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚在中国科学院沈阳自动化研究所主持召开座谈会 深化院地合作促进科技成果转化
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Chairs Symposium at Shenyang Institute of Automation on Deepening Institute-Local Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，省委副书记、沈阳市委书记霍步刚在中国科学院沈阳自动化研究所主持召开座谈会，推进院地合作与科技成果转化，市长马珊珊出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Shenyang Party Secretary Huo Bugang chaired a symposium at the Shenyang Institute of Automation, CAS, on deepening institute-local cooperation and technology transfer. Mayor Ma Shanshan attended.

articles.title_zh: 亢永强胡兆民会见伊电控股集团董事长霍斌一行
articles.title_en: Kang Yongqiang and Hu Zhaomin Meet with Yi Dian Holding Group Chairman Huo Bin
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，赤峰市委书记亢永强、代市长胡兆民会见伊电控股集团董事长霍斌一行，就重点项目建设、深化地企合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang and Acting Mayor Hu Zhaomin met with Yi Dian Holding Group Chairman Huo Bin to discuss key projects and deeper local-enterprise cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 亢永强到翁牛特旗巴林左旗巴林右旗林西县调研督导
articles.title_en: Kang Yongqiang Inspects Ongniud, Bairin Left, Bairin Right Banners and Linxi County in Chifeng
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日至12日，赤峰市委书记亢永强到翁牛特旗、巴林左旗、巴林右旗、林西县调研经济社会发展、党的建设、乡村振兴、生态文明建设，并督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治。
articles.summary_en: From October 11 to 12, Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang toured Ongniud, Bairin Left, Bairin Right Banners and Linxi County, inspecting economic development, Party building, rural revitalization and ecological governance, and supervising anti-corruption work.

articles.title_zh: 习近平举行仪式欢迎博茨瓦纳总统博科访华
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Ceremony to Welcome Botswana President Boko on State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日下午，国家主席习近平在人民大会堂北大厅举行仪式，欢迎博茨瓦纳总统博科对中国进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 13, President Xi Jinping held a welcome ceremony at the Great Hall of the People for Botswana President Duma Boko, who is on a state visit to China.

articles.title_zh: 第140届广交会推出超50项创新举措提升展会服务效能
articles.title_en: 140th Canton Fair to Launch Over 50 Innovative Measures to Improve Service Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 第140届广交会开幕在即，将推出超50项创新举措，首次推出22个智慧应用场景和16项AI特色应用，并引入超230家服务机构实现10大类生产性服务业全覆盖。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of its opening, the 140th Canton Fair will roll out over 50 innovative measures, including 22 smart application scenarios and 16 AI applications, plus more than 230 service providers covering 10 categories of producer services.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰会见美中关系全国委员会负责人
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Meets with Head of the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰在北京钓鱼台国宾馆会见美中关系全国委员会董事会执行副主席格林伯格一行，表示双方应落实好两国元首重要共识，为中美经贸合作注入确定性。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met in Beijing with Evan Greenberg, Executive Vice Chairman of the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations, urging both sides to implement the leaders' consensus and add certainty to China-U.S. economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议 集体学习《习近平文化文选》
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on Studying Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Culture
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日上午，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议，集体学习《习近平文化文选》第一卷、第二卷，并安排部署全市贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 13, Dingxi Municipal Party Secretary Wang Shangxue chaired a meeting of the municipal Party committee standing committee to study the first two volumes of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Culture and to arrange implementation work across the city.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事·长征：长征精神薪火相传
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: The Long March Spirit Passed Down Through Generations
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月12日播发报道，回顾习近平总书记多次考察长征沿线红色热土，讲述长征精神在新时代薪火相传、革命老区接续推进乡村振兴的故事。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Oct 12 on how Xi Jinping's visits along the Long March route have carried the Long March spirit into the new era, as old revolutionary areas press ahead with rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同巴布亚新几内亚总督达达埃就中巴新建交50周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Dadae Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 50th Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，国家主席习近平同巴布亚新几内亚总督达达埃互致贺电，庆祝两国建交50周年；同日，李强同巴新总理马拉佩互致贺电。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, President Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Dadae exchanged congratulatory messages marking 50 years of diplomatic ties; Premier Li Qiang and PNG Prime Minister Marape did the same.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德检查2026世界航海装备大会全要素演练并召开评估总结会
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Full-Element Rehearsal for 2026 World Maritime Equipment Conference
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁与市长吴贤德赴海峡国际会展中心检查2026世界航海装备大会全要素演练，并召开评估总结会部署冲刺阶段筹备工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Fujian Deputy Party Secretary and Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected the full-element rehearsal for the 2026 World Maritime Equipment Conference and held a review meeting on final-stage preparations.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤赴淮阴区调研高质量发展
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Huaiyin District on High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，淮安市委书记顾坤在淮阴区调研，走访荣芯半导体和区域医共体指挥中心，并主持召开座谈会，部署新型工业化、项目招引与基层治理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected Huaiyin District, visiting a semiconductor firm and a county medical consortium center, and chaired a meeting on new industrialization, investment and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦主持召开市委常委会会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究高质量发展与安全稳定等工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on High-Quality Development, Stability and Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究高质量发展、安全稳定和巡察等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 13, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi chaired a meeting of the municipal Party committee standing committee on high-quality development, social stability and inspection work.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦在市委理论学习中心组学习研讨会议上强调 深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想 推动文化强市建设不断取得新成效
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Stresses Deeper Study of Xi Jinping Thought on Culture to Advance Cultural City Building at Municipal Party Committee Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦主持召开市委理论学习中心组2026年第12次学习研讨会议，深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想，部署文化强市建设、精神文明建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 13, Huaibei Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Xi chaired the municipal Party committee's 12th theoretical study session of 2026, focusing on Xi Jinping Thought on Culture and on advancing cultural city development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席全国卫生与健康大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends National Health Conference and Delivers Key Speech
articles.summary_zh: 全国卫生与健康大会10月12日至13日在北京召开，习近平出席会议并发表重要讲话，强调坚定不移走中国特色卫生与健康发展道路，确保“十五五”时期健康中国建设取得决定性进展；李强作总结讲话。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Conference was held in Beijing on October 12-13, where Xi Jinping delivered a keynote speech urging unswerving commitment to a health development path with Chinese characteristics and decisive progress in building a Healthy China during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. Li Qiang delivered the concluding speech.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区党委常委会召开会议 胡昌升主持 研究部署民生改善和特色产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Chairs Tibet Party Committee Meeting on Livelihood Improvement and Specialty Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，西藏自治区党委常委会在拉萨召开会议，自治区党委书记胡昌升主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话、重要文章和重要指示精神，研究部署民生改善与特色产业发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, the Standing Committee of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Region Committee met in Lhasa, chaired by regional party secretary Hu Changsheng, to study recent directives from Xi Jinping and plan work on livelihood improvement and specialty industry development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺马迪塞就任爱沙尼亚总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Madise on Assuming Estonian Presidency
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，国家主席习近平致电于勒·马迪塞，祝贺她就任爱沙尼亚总统，并表示愿以两国建交35周年为契机增进政治互信、拓展互利合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Ulle Madise congratulating her on becoming Estonia's president, pledging to deepen political trust and mutually beneficial cooperation as the two countries mark 35 years of diplomatic ties.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升会见邱勇一行
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Meets with Qiu Yong and Tsinghua Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨会见清华大学党委书记、中国科学院院士邱勇一行，双方就落实战略合作协议、人才培养与科技创新等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: Hu Changsheng, Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, met in Lhasa with Qiu Yong, Party Secretary of Tsinghua University and a CAS academician, to discuss implementing their strategic cooperation agreement, talent training and sci-tech innovation.

articles.title_zh: 第五届自治区发展咨询委员会第三次会议在林芝召开 次仁平措主持
articles.title_en: Fifth Tibet Autonomous Region Development Advisory Committee Holds Third Meeting in Nyingchi
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，第五届西藏自治区发展咨询委员会第三次会议在林芝召开，自治区副主席次仁平措主持，委员们围绕新质生产力引领高原特色优势产业发展建言献策。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 11, the third meeting of the fifth Tibet Autonomous Region Development Advisory Committee was held in Nyingchi, chaired by regional vice chairman Tsering Phuntsok, with members advising on plateau industries driven by new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 严金海：对标看齐担当实干推动人大工作不断迈上新台阶
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai: Align with the Central Leadership and Take Solid Action to Lift People's Congress Work to a New Level
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日上午，西藏自治区人大常委会党组书记、主任严金海在拉萨主持召开自治区人大常委会党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要指示精神，并通报中央纪委国家监委给予丁业现开除党籍处分的决定。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Yan Jinhai chaired a Party group meeting of the Tibet People's Congress Standing Committee in Lhasa, conveying Xi Jinping's recent directives and announcing the decision to expel Ding Yexian from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛同美国总统特朗普夫妇茶叙
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Hold Tea Meeting with U.S. President Trump and His Wife
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月25日上午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在白宫同美国总统特朗普和夫人梅拉尼娅举行茶叙，双方同意共同构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系”。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 25 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan held a tea meeting with U.S. President Trump and his wife Melania at the White House, agreeing to build a constructive strategic relationship of stability based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_zh: 烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在京隆重举行 习近平等党和国家领导人出席
articles.title_en: Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony Held in Beijing; Xi Jinping and Other Party and State Leaders Attend
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在北京天安门广场举行，习近平、李强、赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希、韩正等党和国家领导人同各界代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, the Martyrs' Day ceremony to lay flower baskets before the Monument to the People's Heroes was held at Tiananmen Square in Beijing, attended by Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi, Han Zheng and other Party and state leaders along with representatives from all walks of life.

articles.title_zh: 严金海：对标看齐担当实干 推动人大工作不断迈上新台阶
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Chairs Tibet People's Congress Party Group Meeting, Ding Yexian's Expulsion Announced
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，西藏自治区人大常委会党组书记严金海在拉萨主持召开党组扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要指示精神，并通报丁业现被开除党籍、取消待遇的决定。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Yan Jinhai chaired an expanded party group meeting of the Tibet People's Congress Standing Committee, conveying Xi Jinping's recent instructions and announcing Ding Yexian's expulsion from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛出席特朗普总统夫妇举行的欢迎国宴
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Attend Welcome State Dinner Hosted by President Trump and First Lady
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日晚，美国总统特朗普和夫人梅拉尼娅在白宫为习近平和彭丽媛举行欢迎国宴，两国元首分别致辞，蔡奇、王毅、何立峰等出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 24 local time, President Trump and First Lady Melania hosted a welcome state dinner at the White House for President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, with both leaders delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在米林市巴宜区调研时强调协同推进生态保护富民增收
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Stresses Coordinated Ecological Protection and Income Growth During Survey in Milin City and Bayi District
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月11日前后，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登深入林芝米林市、巴宜区调研生态保护、安全生产和富民增收工作，要求统筹特色产业发展与生态文明高地建设。
articles.summary_en: Around Oct 11, 2026, Tibetan Autonomous Region Chairman Gama Zedeng inspected Milin City and Bayi District in Nyingchi, urging coordinated ecological protection, workplace safety and household income growth alongside building a national ecological civilization highland.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区党委常委会召开会议 胡昌升主持 研究部署民生改善和特色产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Chairs Tibet Regional Party Committee Meeting on Livelihood Improvement and Specialty Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日下午，西藏自治区党委常委会召开会议，自治区党委书记胡昌升主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究部署民生改善和特色产业发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 10, the Standing Committee of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee met under Secretary Hu Changsheng to study Xi Jinping's key speeches and instructions and plan work on livelihood improvement and specialty industries.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到市农业农村局调研
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Municipal Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau in Shantou
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到市农业农村局调研，强调锚定农业农村现代化，扎实推进乡村全面振兴和“百千万工程”。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 12, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected the Municipal Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau, stressing rural revitalization and agricultural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 孙喜民来泰调研 杨洪涛参加
articles.title_en: Vice Governor Sun Ximin Surveys Tai'an on Digital Industry and AI Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，山东省副省长孙喜民带队到泰安市调研数字产业和人工智能发展，察看多家企业数智化转型与大模型应用情况，市委书记杨洪涛参加。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Shandong Vice Governor Sun Ximin led a team to Tai'an to survey digital industry and AI development, inspecting enterprises' digital-intelligent transformation and large-model applications; Municipal Party Secretary Yang Hongtao took part.

articles.title_zh: 李晖调研民生实事项目推进情况
articles.title_en: Taizhou Mayor Li Hui Inspects Progress of Public Livelihood Projects
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，泰州市市长李晖调研民生实事项目推进情况，实地察看南官河闸站工程、市第六人民医院建设项目及社区居家养老服务中心。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui inspected livelihood projects, visiting the Nanguanhe sluice station, the Sixth People's Hospital construction site and community elderly care centers.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市委书记姜冬冬专题调研科技创新工作
articles.title_en: Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong Inspects Sci-Tech Innovation Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到医药高新区（高港区）专题调研科技创新工作，强调推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，打造长三角产业科创强市。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong inspected sci-tech innovation work in the Taizhou Medical High-Tech Zone (Gaogang District), urging deeper integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 李晖调研民生实事项目推进情况
articles.title_en: Li Hui Inspects Progress of Public Welfare Projects in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，泰州市长李晖调研民生实事项目推进情况，实地察看南官河闸站工程、市第六人民医院建设项目及社区居家养老服务中心。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui inspected the progress of public welfare projects, visiting the Nanguan River sluice-pump station, the city's Sixth People's Hospital construction site and community home-care service centers.

articles.title_zh: 张海波调研“三秋”农业生产、耕地保护和粮食安全工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Autumn Agricultural Production, Farmland Protection and Food Security Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，威海市委书记张海波到临港区调研“三秋”农业生产、耕地保护和粮食安全工作，强调抓好秋收秋种、高标准农田建设和农业产业化。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo inspected autumn agricultural production, farmland protection and food security work in Lingang District, urging solid progress in autumn harvest and planting.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍调研重点项目建设
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Inspects Key Construction Projects in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，威海市委副书记、市长孔凡萍到腾森橡胶轮胎、海潮汽车部件及环山快速路二期隧道施工点调研重点项目建设，强调抓项目、强产业，严把质量、安全、环保关。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping inspected key construction projects, including tire and auto-parts plants and the Huanshan Expressway Phase II tunnel site, urging faster project progress along with strict quality, safety and environmental controls.

articles.title_zh: 徐志会见外国驻港领团和商界参访团
articles.title_en: Xu Zhi Meets Foreign Consular Corps and Business Delegation Based in Hong Kong
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，芜湖市委书记徐志会见外交部驻港公署副特派员花有率领的外国驻港领团和商界参访团，双方就深化芜湖与香港在金融、贸易、产业、科技创新等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Wuhu Party Secretary Xu Zhi met a delegation of foreign consular officials and business representatives based in Hong Kong, led by Hua You, Deputy Commissioner of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Hong Kong, to discuss deeper cooperation in finance, trade, industry and technology.

articles.title_zh: 蔡剑峰调研梁溪区经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Wuxi Acting Mayor Cai Jianfeng Inspects Liangxi District's Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，无锡市代市长蔡剑峰到梁溪区调研经济社会发展情况，强调抓好城市更新、产业焕新，推动商业航天等产业提质升级。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Wuxi Acting Mayor Cai Jianfeng inspected Liangxi District's economic development, urging urban renewal and industrial upgrading, including the commercial space sector.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研督导西安国有“三资”盘活工作：以盘活存量支撑做优增量
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Xi'an's Work on Revitalizing State-Owned Assets, Urges Using Stock Revival to Support Better Increment
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰在西安调研督导国有“三资”盘活工作，强调以盘活存量支撑做优增量，最大化提高资源配置效率。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Hao Huijie, Standing Committee member of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Party Secretary of Xi'an, inspected the city's work on revitalizing state-owned assets, urging that reviving existing stock support better increments and maximize resource allocation efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平调研中心城区文旅街区建设工作
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Inspects Cultural Tourism District Development in Central Urban Area
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，新乡市委书记魏建平深入中心城区部分文化街区、文保单位，专题调研文旅街区建设工作，要求加快城市更新、促进文商旅体融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping inspected cultural districts and heritage sites in the central urban area, urging faster urban renewal and integrated development of culture, commerce, tourism and sports.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研红色资源保护利用工作
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Inspects Protection and Use of Red Resources
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日上午，盐城市委书记严汉平在盐城市烈士陵园、五条岭烈士陵园调研红色资源保护利用工作，强调建好纪念设施、讲好英烈故事。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 12, Yan Hanping, Party Secretary of Yancheng, inspected the protection and use of red resources at the Yancheng Martyrs' Cemetery and Wutiaoling Martyrs' Cemetery, urging better memorial facilities and storytelling about martyrs.

articles.title_zh: 张明康赴牟平区调研农业生产和黄金产业
articles.title_en: Zhang Mingkang Inspects Muping District on Agricultural Production and Gold Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日下午，烟台市委副书记、市长张明康赴牟平区调研"三秋"生产和黄金产业运行情况，强调紧盯农业生产、抓实重点产业，完成全年发展目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 13, Zhang Mingkang, Deputy Secretary of the Yantai Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, inspected Muping District to review autumn agricultural production and the gold industry, urging efforts to secure annual development goals.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到阳春市督导调研
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Inspects Yangchun City on Rural Asset Management and Autumn Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，阳江市委副书记、市长余金富赴阳春市督导农村集体“三资”管理、高标准农田建设等专项整治，并调研“三秋”农业生产和企业经营情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Yangjiang Mayor Yu Jinfu inspected Yangchun City on rural collective asset management and high-standard farmland construction, and surveyed autumn agricultural production and local enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 银川市委宣传思想文化工作领导小组会议召开 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on Propaganda, Ideological and Cultural Work, Chaired by Zhao Xuhui
articles.summary_zh: 日前，银川市委宣传思想文化工作领导小组会议召开，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，部署理论武装、主流舆论、文化建设等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: The Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee's leading group for propaganda, ideological and cultural work recently held a meeting chaired by Zhao Xuhui, Yinchuan Party Secretary, to plan work on theoretical study, mainstream public opinion and cultural development.

articles.title_zh: 李军曹阳史卫东会见新疆塔城地区人大工委党组书记迟国君一行
articles.title_en: Li Jun, Cao Yang and Shi Weidong Meet with Chi Guojun, Party Secretary of the NPC Working Committee of Tacheng Prefecture, Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，营口市委书记李军、代市长曹阳、市人大常委会主任史卫东会见新疆塔城地区人大工委党组书记迟国君一行，双方就深化对口支援、产业发展、经贸互动等交流。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Yingkou Party Secretary Li Jun, Acting Mayor Cao Yang and NPC Standing Committee Director Shi Weidong met with Chi Guojun, Party Secretary of the NPC Working Committee of Tacheng Prefecture, Xinjiang, discussing deeper paired assistance, industry and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 连云港市人大常委会一行来岳调研
articles.title_en: Lianyungang Municipal People's Congress Delegation Visits Yueyang for Research
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日至12日，连云港市人大常委会副主任华宏铭一行到岳阳，就市县乡三级人大换届选举及代表工作开展专题调研，岳阳市人大常委会副主任喻文参加。
articles.summary_en: From October 11 to 12, a delegation led by Hua Hongming, deputy director of the Lianyungang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, visited Yueyang to research county- and township-level people's congress elections and deputy work, joined by Yueyang's deputy director Yu Wen.

tags.name_en: Lianyungang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Lianyungang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江会见中国诚通集团董事长奚正平一行
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Meets China Chengtong Chairman Xi Zhengping in Yueyang
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江在岳阳会见中国诚通控股集团董事长奚正平一行，双方就落实有关协议、深化战略合作、加快产业项目落地交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Xie Weijiang, deputy secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Yueyang Party secretary, met China Chengtong Holdings Group chairman Xi Zhengping in Yueyang to discuss implementing cooperation agreements and speeding up industrial project investment.

articles.title_zh: 省第三生态环境保护督察组督察岳阳市第二轮督察“回头看”情况反馈会召开
articles.title_en: Feedback Meeting Held on Provincial Third Ecological Inspection Team's Second-Round "Look-Back" Inspection of Yueyang
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，湖南省第三生态环境保护督察组向岳阳市反馈第二轮督察“回头看”情况，谢卫江作表态讲话，唐浩然主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Hunan's third ecological and environmental protection inspection team gave Yueyang feedback on its second-round "look-back" inspection; Xie Weijiang pledged rectification and Tang Haoran chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 徐晓霞走访看望老同志
articles.title_en: Xu Xiaoxia Visits and Calls on Veteran Comrades in Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，云浮市委书记徐晓霞走访看望温耀深等老同志，致以问候并听取对云浮高质量发展的意见建议，市政协主席梁丽娴等参加。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Yunfu Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia visited veteran comrades including Wen Yaoshen to extend greetings and gather suggestions on the city's high-quality development; CPPCC Chairman Liang Lixian joined the visit.

articles.title_zh: 福建纪检监察机关推动高标准农田建设领域集中整治
articles.title_en: Fujian Discipline Inspection Organs Drive Special Rectification of High-Standard Farmland Construction
articles.summary_zh: 福建省纪检监察机关围绕高标准农田建设突出问题开展集中整治，运用大数据监督查处违规套取耕地地力保护补贴等问题，督促整改并建章立制。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's discipline inspection organs ran a special rectification of high-standard farmland construction, using big-data monitoring to catch subsidy fraud and push reforms.

articles.title_zh: 2026年济南市外资企业座谈会召开 刘强讲话 于海田主持
articles.title_en: Jinan Holds 2026 Symposium for Foreign-Funded Enterprises, Liu Qiang Addresses Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，2026年济南市外资企业座谈会在山东大厦召开，市委书记刘强出席并讲话，市长于海田主持，韩金峰、孙开连出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, 2026, Jinan hosted its foreign-funded enterprises symposium at Shandong Mansion; Party Secretary Liu Qiang spoke and Mayor Yu Haitian presided.

articles.title_zh: 第140届广交会推出超50项创新举措 提升服务效能
articles.title_en: 140th Canton Fair Launches Over 50 Innovation Measures to Boost Service Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 第140届广交会将于10月15日至11月4日在广州分三期举办，推出超50项创新举措，包括22个智慧应用场景、16项AI特色应用及70个办证点，提升客商办证与供采对接效率。
articles.summary_en: The 140th Canton Fair will be held in Guangzhou in three phases from Oct 15 to Nov 4, launching more than 50 innovation measures including 22 smart application scenarios, 16 AI features and 70 badge-issuing points to speed up registration and matchmaking.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记引领健康中国建设
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads the Building of a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 党的十八大以来，以习近平同志为核心的党中央把保障人民健康放在优先发展的战略位置，全面推进健康中国建设，2025年我国人均预期寿命提升至79.25岁。
articles.summary_en: Since the 18th CPC National Congress, the Party Central Committee led by Xi Jinping has given priority to people's health and advanced the Healthy China initiative, with average life expectancy rising to 79.25 years in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 夹金山隧道通车一年 川西红色文旅与高原特色农业提速
articles.title_en: One Year After Jiajinshan Tunnel Opening, Red Tourism and Plateau Agriculture Accelerate in Western Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 夹金山隧道通车一年来，四川宝兴县与小金县之间通行时间从1小时缩短至10分钟，带动红色文旅与高原特色农业发展。
articles.summary_en: A year after the Jiajinshan Tunnel opened, travel between Baoxing and Xiaojin counties in Sichuan has been cut to 10 minutes, boosting red tourism and plateau agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 肯尼亚教育部长：中肯职教合作助力肯尼亚人才培养
articles.title_en: Kenyan Education Minister: China-Kenya Vocational Education Cooperation Boosts Talent Training in Kenya
articles.summary_zh: 肯尼亚教育部长奥甘巴表示，中肯职业技术教育长期合作通过教学设备支持、技术人员培训和示范中心建设，助力肯尼亚培养技能人才，并期待天津世界职业技术教育发展大会。
articles.summary_en: Kenyan Education Minister Ogamba said long-term China-Kenya vocational education cooperation, through teaching equipment support, technician training and demonstration centers, is helping Kenya cultivate skilled talent.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能虚构史料、伪造文献频现，多家期刊声明抵制此类学术不端
articles.title_en: Multiple Academic Journals Issue Statements Against AI-Fabricated Sources and Other Academic Misconduct
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，多家学术期刊编辑部相继发布声明，禁止使用生成式人工智能伪造文献、虚构史料出处，并明确对相关学术不端的处理措施。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, several Chinese academic journals issued statements banning the use of generative AI to fabricate references, data and historical sources, and set out penalties for such misconduct.

articles.title_zh: “全国大赛”规范评比后更名“技能竞赛”，奖项改为参与证明
articles.title_en: "National Competition" Renamed "Skills Competition" After Evaluation Reform, Prizes Replaced by Participation Certificates
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，中国民族民间工艺美术家协会发布补充说明，落实社会组织评比表彰活动管理办法，将泥塑技艺大赛更名为技能竞赛，取消优秀奖与获奖证书，改发参与证明。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10 a national folk arts association renamed its clay-sculpture contest a skills competition under new rules on social-organization awards, dropping prizes for participation certificates.

articles.title_zh: 三部门：开发农村助老公益性岗位，按规定给予岗位补贴
articles.title_en: Three Ministries: Develop Rural Elderly-Care Public Welfare Positions with Subsidies
articles.summary_zh: 民政部、人力资源社会保障部、农业农村部联合印发通知，部署加强农村助老员队伍建设，明确开发农村助老公益性岗位并按规定给予岗位补贴。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministries of Civil Affairs, Human Resources and Social Security, and Agriculture jointly issued a notice to build up the rural elderly-care workforce, including creating public welfare posts for rural elderly helpers with subsidized wages.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security
Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security
Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 赵龙会见博茨瓦纳总统博科一行
articles.title_en: Zhao Long Meets with Botswana President Boko
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，福建省委书记赵龙在福州会见来访的博茨瓦纳总统博科一行，双方表示将深化卫生医疗、经贸投资、人文往来、友城结好等领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Fujian Provincial Party Secretary Zhao Long met with visiting Botswana President Duma Boko in Fuzhou, with both sides pledging deeper cooperation in health care, trade and investment, cultural exchanges and sister-city ties.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省思政课教师跟岗锻炼工作启动
articles.title_en: Gansu Launches On-the-Job Training Program for Ideological and Political Course Teachers
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省委教育工委、省教育厅召开2026年思政课教师跟岗锻炼行前动员会，首批48名高校思政课教师分赴省市两级教育、宣传、共青团等部门开展为期半年的跟岗锻炼。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's provincial education authorities held a pre-departure meeting for a 2026 on-the-job training program, sending the first batch of 48 college ideological and political course teachers to education, publicity and Communist Youth League departments for six months.

tags.name_en: Education Work Committee of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee

tags_en: Education Work Committee of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee

articles.title_zh: 人工智能应用加速“出海”
articles.title_en: AI Applications Accelerate “Going Global” via Guangxi-ASEAN Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，2026年“活力中国调研行”广西主题采访团走进中国—东盟国家人工智能应用合作中心，探访广西依托人工智能赋能产业升级、深化面向东盟跨境科创合作的实践。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, a “Vital China” media tour visited the China-ASEAN AI Application Cooperation Center, highlighting Guangxi's AI-driven industrial upgrading and cross-border tech cooperation with ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 河南省机关党建工作经验交流座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Henan Province Holds Experience-Sharing Symposium on Party Building in Government Agencies
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，河南省机关党建工作经验交流座谈会在郑州召开，省委书记周祖翼作批示，省委常委、组织部长王刚出席讲话，省委常委、秘书长李涛主持。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Henan Province held an experience-sharing symposium on Party building in government agencies in Zhengzhou. Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi issued instructions, while Wang Gang, head of the Organization Department, addressed the meeting and Li Tao presided.

tags.name_en: Integration of Party Building and Daily Work

tags_en: Integration of Party Building and Daily Work

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼会见国家文物局局长饶权
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi Meets Rao Quan, Director of the National Cultural Heritage Administration
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，河南省委书记周祖翼在郑州会见文化和旅游部副部长、国家文物局局长饶权一行，双方就文物保护利用、考古学科建设、文旅产业发展等深化部省合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi met in Zhengzhou with Rao Quan, vice minister of culture and tourism and director of the National Cultural Heritage Administration, to deepen provincial-ministerial cooperation on heritage protection and cultural tourism.

articles.title_zh: 武汉经开区低空经济产业园建设加速，二期项目基本完工
articles.title_en: Low-Altitude Economy Industrial Park in Wuhan Economic Development Zone Nears Completion
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，武汉经开区低空经济产业园二期项目已基本完工，正推进收尾工作，即将迎来联合验收。园区由经开产投集团投资建设，聚焦低空经济全产业链。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, the second phase of the low-altitude economy industrial park in Wuhan Economic Development Zone was basically completed and is entering final inspections. Built by Jingkai Industrial Investment Group, the park targets the full low-altitude economy supply chain.

articles.title_zh: 9月新能源汽车出口同比增1.6倍
articles.title_en: NEV Exports Up 1.6 Times Year-on-Year in September
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会数据显示，9月我国汽车出口105.3万辆，同比增长61.4%，其中新能源汽车出口57.1万辆，同比增长1.6倍，月度新车销量占比连续3个月突破60%。
articles.summary_en: CAAM data shows China exported 1.053 million vehicles in September, up 61.4% year-on-year, including 571,000 new energy vehicles, up 1.6 times, with NEVs topping 60% of monthly new car sales for a third month.

articles.title_zh: 河北加快推进后奥运经济 推动体文旅与青少年冰雪普及双向发力
articles.title_en: Hebei Advances Post-Olympic Economy, Promoting Sports-Culture-Tourism and Youth Ice-Snow Popularization
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，河北省加快推进后奥运经济发展工作现场会在正定举办，并举行冰雪进校园公益校队集中签约仪式，全省21所大中小学与正定热雪奇迹达成合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 13, Hebei held a site meeting in Zhengding on advancing its post-Olympic economy, where 21 schools signed agreements with a local indoor ski resort to bring ice-snow courses to campuses.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省工信厅开展2026年度国家级绿色工厂推荐和动态管理工作
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Department of Industry and Information Technology Launches 2026 National Green Factory Selection and Dynamic Management
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省工信厅组织开展2026年度国家级绿色工厂、绿色供应链领航企业、绿色工业园区推荐及国家、省级动态管理工作，符合条件的企业和园区可自愿申报。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang's provincial industry and information technology department has launched the 2026 selection of national-level green factories, green supply chain leaders and green industrial parks, along with national and provincial dynamic management; eligible firms and parks may apply voluntarily.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布2027年应届优秀大学毕业生选调工作公告
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Announces 2027 Selection of Outstanding University Graduates for Government Posts
articles.summary_zh: 中共江苏省委组织部发布公告，2027年江苏省分两批选调1208名应届优秀毕业生到县级以上机关和乡镇（街道）工作，10月26日起报名。
articles.summary_en: The Organization Department of the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee announced the selection of 1,208 outstanding 2027 university graduates for government posts at county level and above and at township and street level, with registration opening Oct 26.

articles.title_zh: “见证中国新时代”俄罗斯媒体中国行采访活动启动
articles.title_en: Russian Media China Tour "Witnessing China's New Era" Kicks Off in Manzhouli
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，内蒙古自治区政府新闻办主办的“见证中国新时代”俄罗斯媒体中国行采访活动在满洲里启动，中俄记者将赴满洲里、赤峰、北京、青岛采访。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, the "Witnessing China's New Era" Russian media tour started in Manzhouli, hosted by Inner Mongolia's information office; 21 Chinese and Russian reporters will visit four cities.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界新能源新材料大会在鄂尔多斯市召开
articles.title_en: 2026 World New Energy and New Materials Conference Opens in Ordos
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，2026世界新能源新材料大会在内蒙古鄂尔多斯市启幕，300余家企业、8000余名嘉宾参会，聚焦能源绿色转型与新材料创新。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World New Energy and New Materials Conference opened on Oct 12 in Ordos, Inner Mongolia, drawing more than 300 companies and 8,000 guests to explore green energy transition and materials innovation.

articles.title_zh: 中央机关及其直属机构2027年度考试录用公务员报名即将开始
articles.title_en: Registration for 2027 Central Government Civil Service Exam to Begin
articles.summary_zh: 国家公务员局10月13日宣布，2027年度中央机关及其直属机构考试录用公务员报名将于10月14日至24日进行，计划招录3.57万人，公共科目笔试定于11月29日举行。
articles.summary_en: China's National Civil Service Bureau announced on Oct 13 that registration for the 2027 central government civil service exam will run from Oct 14 to Oct 24, with 35,700 positions planned and the written test set for Nov 29.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见阿联酋总统中国事务特使哈勒敦
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets UAE President's Special Envoy for China Affairs Khaldoun
articles.summary_zh: 10月13日，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在北京会见阿联酋总统中国事务特使哈勒敦，双方就中阿关系及中东局势深入交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 13, Wang Yi, member of the CPC Political Bureau and director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission, met in Beijing with Khaldoun, the UAE President's special envoy for China affairs, to discuss bilateral ties and the Middle East situation.

articles.title_zh: 全球最大“人造太阳”关键部件通过最终设计评审
articles.title_en: Key Component of World's Largest 'Artificial Sun' Passes Final Design Review
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，核工业西南物理研究院透露，该院牵头承担的国际热核聚变实验堆（ITER）7号中子通量监测器系统设计方案通过最终评审，标志我国在ITER关键诊断系统研制上取得阶段性成果。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, the Southwestern Institute of Physics announced that its ITER neutron flux monitor system (NFM#7) design passed final review, marking progress in China's development of key ITER diagnostic systems.

tags.name_zh: 核工业西南物理研究院

tags_zh: 核工业西南物理研究院

articles.title_zh: 全省国有企业“一把手”铸魂提能专题培训班开班
articles.title_en: Sichuan Opens Special Training Class for State-Owned Enterprise Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，全省国有企业“一把手”铸魂提能专题培训班在四川省委党校彭州校区开班，省委常委、组织部部长周立伟出席并作开班动员讲话，160余家国企负责人参训。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, a special training class for top executives of Sichuan's state-owned enterprises opened at the provincial Party school's Pengzhou campus, with Zhou Liwei, provincial standing committee member and head of the organization department, giving the opening address; over 160 SOE leaders took part.

articles.title_zh: 合伙人来了！成都国资为何嵌入汽车产业链
articles.title_en: Partners Arrive: Why Chengdu's State Capital Is Embedding Itself in the Auto Industry Chain
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，“成都国资合伙人”第二场活动在成都举办，聚焦四川汽车产业高质量发展，推动全省国资国企与在蓉央企以供需对接撬动新能源与智能网联汽车产业。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Chengdu held the second session of its "State Capital Partner" program, gathering provincial SOEs and central enterprises in the city to spur Sichuan's new energy and smart-connected vehicle industry through supply-demand matchmaking.

tags.name_en: Chengdu State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission

tags_en: Chengdu State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission

articles.title_zh: 上海将实施四大工程 推动人工智能与制造业深度融合
articles.title_en: Shanghai to Launch Four Major Projects to Deepen AI- Manufacturing Integration
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，上海在第二十六届中国国际工业博览会上启动“加快发展新一代智能制造行动”，实施四大工程推动人工智能与制造业深度融合，目标到2028年推动8000台人形机器人进工厂。

articles.title_zh: 夯实中国式现代化的健康根基——习近平总书记引领健康中国建设
articles.title_en: Building the Health Foundation of Chinese Modernization: Xi Jinping Leads the Healthy China Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 文章综述十八大以来习近平引领健康中国建设，我国人均预期寿命2025年达79.25岁，建成世界最大医疗卫生体系，深化医改并推进中医药传承创新。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's leadership of the Healthy China initiative, noting life expectancy reached 79.25 years in 2025 and China built the world's largest healthcare system.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰会见苹果公司执行董事长蒂姆·库克
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Meets Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日下午，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰在人民大会堂会见美国苹果公司执行董事长蒂姆·库克，双方就中美经贸关系及苹果在华发展交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 12, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met with Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook at the Great Hall of the People, discussing China-US economic ties and Apple's long-term development in China.

articles.title_zh: 李强同新西兰总理拉克森通电话
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Speaks by Phone with New Zealand Prime Minister Luxon
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，国务院总理李强应约同新西兰总理拉克森通电话，双方就深化贸易、新能源汽车、人文等领域合作及亚太经合组织框架下协作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Premier Li Qiang took a phone call from New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, with the two sides exchanging views on deepening cooperation in trade, new energy vehicles and cultural exchanges, as well as coordination within APEC.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见越南国会主席陈青敏
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，国务院总理李强在北京会见越南国会主席陈青敏，双方表示将深化贸易投资、互联互通、人工智能等领域互利合作。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Premier Li Qiang met in Beijing with Vietnamese National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man; both sides agreed to deepen cooperation in trade, investment, connectivity and AI.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事：长征精神薪火相传
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: Passing On the Long March Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月12日播发报道，回顾习近平总书记多次考察长征沿线红色热土，讲述长征精神在新时代的传承，以及沿线干部群众接续奋斗、推进乡村振兴的实践。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Oct 12 on the enduring Long March spirit, recalling Xi Jinping's visits to key sites along the route and how officials and residents carry on that legacy through rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 王沪宁出席中国侨联成立70周年纪念大会
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Attends Commemorative Meeting Marking 70th Anniversary of All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，中国侨联成立70周年纪念大会在北京举行，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁出席并讲话，并会见与会全体代表。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, the commemorative meeting for the 70th anniversary of the All-China Federation of Returned Overseas Chinese was held in Beijing, where Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Political Bureau and chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, attended, delivered a speech and met with delegates.

tags.name_en: Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference National Committee

tags_en: Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference National Committee

articles.title_zh: 前三季度新能源汽车产销量实现较高增长
articles.title_en: NEV Production and Sales Post Strong Growth in First Three Quarters
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会10月12日数据显示，1—9月新能源汽车产销量分别达1248.3万辆和1247.2万辆，同比增长11%和11.1%，新车销量占比升至53.6%。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on Oct 12 showed China's new energy vehicle output and sales reached 12.483 million and 12.472 million units in the first nine months, up 11% and 11.1% year on year, taking 53.6% of new car sales.

articles.title_zh: 张丹到元宝区调研重点企业生产经营和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan Visits Yuanbao District to Inspect Key Enterprises and Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹到元宝区调研重点企业生产经营和安全生产工作，强调推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合、壮大特色产业。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan inspected key enterprises in Yuanbao District to review operations and workplace safety, urging deeper integration of technological and industrial innovation and stronger support for local industries.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省政府参事、省文史研究馆馆员聘任仪式举行 王新伟颁发聘书并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei Issues Appointment Letters at Ceremony for Provincial Government Counselors and Culture and History Research Institute Members
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，辽宁省政府参事、省文史研究馆馆员聘任仪式举行，省长王新伟向新聘的15位省政府参事、2位省文史研究馆馆员颁发聘书并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei presented appointment letters to 15 newly appointed provincial government counselors and two members of the provincial culture and history research institute, and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁赴连江县开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动并接待群众来访
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Visits Lianjiang County for River Protection Campaign and Receives Public Petitioners
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁赴连江县察看敖江水质并接待来访群众，强调用心用情办好民生实事。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning visited Lianjiang County to inspect Aojiang River water quality and receive petitioners, pledging to resolve livelihood concerns.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元调研鹤岗市项目建设进展情况
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Inspects Project Construction Progress in Hegang
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元到工农区文化娱乐综合体、明瑞药业木糖醇项目、永新村农文旅融合示范项目及鹤伊高速服务区等建设现场调研，要求高标准推进项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan inspected construction sites including a cultural complex, a xylitol plant, a rural tourism project and the Heyi expressway service area, urging high-standard, efficient project delivery.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委举行学习报告会 深入学习贯彻总体国家安全观
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Holds Study Session on the Overall National Security Concept
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省委举行学习报告会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于总体国家安全观的重要论述，省委书记信长星主持，省长刘小涛、省政协主席张义珍等出席。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee recently held a study session on General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on the overall national security concept. Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing presided, with Governor Liu Xiaotao and CPPCC Provincial Committee Chairman Zhang Yizhen attending.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡会见江苏嘉和热系统公司客商
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Meets Delegation from Jiangsu Jiahe Thermal Systems
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日上午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡会见来淮北考察的江苏嘉和热系统股份有限公司董事长李宝民一行，市委常委、常务副市长张卫国等参加会见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 12, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the Huaibei CPC Committee and acting mayor, met with a delegation led by Li Baomin, chairman of Jiangsu Jiahe Thermal Systems Co., during their visit to Huaibei.

articles.title_zh: 淮北市政府召开2026年第18次党组会暨理论学习中心组学习会议
articles.title_en: Huaibei Municipal Government Holds 18th Party Leadership Group Meeting and Theoretical Study Session of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，淮北市政府党组书记、代市长黄韡主持召开2026年第18次党组会暨理论学习中心组学习会议，学习先进制造业与新质生产力相关精神并部署产业转型工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Huang Wei, acting mayor and Party secretary of the Huaibei municipal government, chaired the 18th Party leadership group meeting and theoretical study session of 2026, studying directives on advanced manufacturing and new quality productive forces and deploying industrial upgrading work.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生调研㵲水大型灌区项目建设
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Inspects Wushui Large Irrigation District Project
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日上午，怀化市委副书记、代市长高靖生赴江秀水厂、㵲水大型灌区总干渠施工点及蟒塘溪取水口调研，察看工程进度与安全生产，要求加快项目建设、打造民心工程。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 11, Gao Jingsheng, Deputy Party Secretary and Acting Mayor of Huaihua, inspected the Wushui Large Irrigation District project, reviewing construction progress and safety measures and urging faster, high-quality delivery of the livelihood project.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在林芝米林市、巴宜区调研 强调协同推进生态保护富民增收
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Inspects Milin and Bayi in Nyingchi, Urges Coordinated Ecological Protection and Income Growth
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月11日，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区主席嘎玛泽登深入林芝米林市、巴宜区调研生态保护、安全生产等工作，强调统筹生态保护与富民增收。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 11, 2026, Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman Gama Zedeng inspected Milin City and Bayi District in Nyingchi, urging coordinated ecological protection, work safety and higher rural incomes.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同美国总统特朗普会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with U.S. President Trump
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日上午，国家主席习近平同美国总统特朗普在白宫举行会谈，就中美关系、经贸合作、人工智能、台湾问题及重大国际和地区问题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 24 local time, President Xi Jinping held talks with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House, exchanging views on China-U.S. relations, trade, AI, Taiwan and major international issues.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记同卫生健康工作者的故事
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Story with Healthcare Workers
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月10日播发报道，在中国医师节之际讲述习近平总书记同卫生健康工作者的故事，涉及基层医疗、医改、中医药和援外医疗。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Oct 10, 2026, a feature recounting Xi Jinping's interactions with healthcare workers, covering grassroots care, medical reform, traditional Chinese medicine and overseas medical aid.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省党政代表团来藏考察并座谈 胡昌升许勤出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Party and Government Delegation Visits Tibet, Holds Work Symposium with Hu Changsheng and Xu Qin
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日至10日，黑龙江省党政代表团赴西藏考察，10日在拉萨举行西藏·黑龙江工作座谈会，自治区党委书记胡昌升主持并讲话，黑龙江省委书记许勤出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: A Heilongjiang Party and government delegation visited Tibet on Oct 8-10; a Tibet-Heilongjiang work symposium was held in Lhasa on Oct 10, chaired by Hu Changsheng, with Xu Qin delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴汕头高新区六合产业园调研
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Liuhe Industrial Park in Shantou High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴高新区调研六合产业园，强调高起点规划、高标准设计、高质量建设、高水平运营，打造现代产业集聚区，市长陈涛参加。
articles.summary_en: Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected the Liuhe Industrial Park on Oct 11, calling for high-standard planning and construction of a modern industrial cluster. Mayor Chen Tao joined.

articles.title_zh: 胡玉亭在四平市调研卫生健康工作
articles.title_en: Jilin Governor Hu Yuting Inspects Health Care Work in Siping
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，吉林省委副书记、省长胡玉亭在四平市调研市、县、乡、村、社区卫生健康工作，强调推进医疗卫生强基工程、构建分级诊疗格局。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Jilin Governor Hu Yuting inspected health care services across city, county, township, village and community levels in Siping, urging stronger grassroots medical capacity and a tiered diagnosis and treatment system.

articles.title_zh: 泰安市委常委会召开会议 研究服务业、机器人产业发展等事项
articles.title_en: Tai'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Service Industry and Robotics Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，泰安市委书记杨洪涛主持市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，审议推进服务业扩能提质行动方案及具身智能机器人产业发展措施。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Tai'an Party Secretary Yang Hongtao chaired a meeting of the municipal Party committee standing committee to convey Xi Jinping's remarks and instructions, and review plans on upgrading the service industry and developing embodied-AI robotics.

articles.title_zh: 李岩赴集安市调研产业发展与兴边富民工作
articles.title_en: Li Yan Inspects Ji'an City on Industrial Development and Border Area Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，通化市委书记李岩深入集安市，就产业发展、兴边富民、基层治理、基层减负和群众身边不正之风集中整治等工作开展调研，并开展巡边。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan inspected Ji'an City to review industrial development, border-area prosperity, grassroots governance, and anti-corruption work, and conducted a border patrol.
