articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍主持召开威海市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Chairs Weihai Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，威海市市长孔凡萍主持召开市政府第76次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，部署安全生产、生态环境保护工作，并审议《威海市地震应急预案》。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 10, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping chaired the 76th executive meeting of the municipal government, conveying recent remarks by Xi Jinping and deploying work on workplace safety, environmental protection, and a revised earthquake emergency plan.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会召开会议 研究生态环境保护与联动巡视整改等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on Ecological Protection and Inspection Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，西安市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署生态环境保护、联动巡视整改和全面从严治党等工作，市委书记蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, the Xi'an Municipal Party Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's remarks and arrange work on ecological protection, inspection rectification and strict Party governance, chaired by Party Secretary Hao Huijie.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研西安大型实景演出：坚持守正创新，加快建设中华文化重要展示窗口
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Large-Scale Live Performances in Xi'an, Urging Cultural Innovation and Heritage
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰到西安城墙永宁门调研《梦长安》大型实景演出，强调抓好文化遗产保护传承与文旅融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 11, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected the large-scale live performance "Dream of Chang'an" at the city wall, stressing heritage protection and cultural tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 新乡市委常委会召开会议 魏建平主持
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Chairs Xinxiang Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，新乡市委书记魏建平主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究部署贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and directives and plan their implementation.

articles.title_zh: 何淳宽赴宣城经开区、宣城现代产业园调研
articles.title_en: He Chunkuan Inspects Xuancheng Economic Development Zone and Modern Industrial Park
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，宣城市委书记何淳宽赴宣城经开区、宣城现代产业园调研项目建设和招商引资工作，并主持召开座谈会。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 11, Xuancheng Party Secretary He Chunkuan inspected project construction and investment promotion in the city's economic development zone and modern industrial park, then chaired symposiums.

articles.title_zh: 太湖光谷大会暨中国（苏州）光子产业发展大会开幕 刘小涛范波出席
articles.title_en: Taihu Photonics Valley Conference and China (Suzhou) Photonics Industry Development Conference Opens, Attended by Liu Xiaotao and Fan Bo
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，太湖光谷大会暨中国（苏州）光子产业发展大会开幕，省长刘小涛、省委副书记兼苏州市委书记范波出席，会上19个重大项目签约，江苏省太湖光谷产业联盟成立。
articles.summary_en: The Taihu Photonics Valley Conference and China (Suzhou) Photonics Industry Development Conference opened on Oct 11 with Governor Liu Xiaotao and Suzhou Party Secretary Fan Bo attending; 19 major projects were signed.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委举行学习报告会 信长星主持 刘小涛张义珍范波出席
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Holds Study Report Meeting, Chaired by Xin Changxing
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省委举行学习报告会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于总体国家安全观的重要论述，省委书记信长星主持，省长刘小涛、省政协主席张义珍等出席。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee recently held a study report meeting on the holistic approach to national security, chaired by Party Secretary Xin Changxing and attended by Governor Liu Xiaotao and others.

articles.title_zh: 以创新赢未来——习近平经济思想引领中国加快发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Innovation Drives the Future: Xi Jinping Thought on the Economy Guides China's Push to Develop New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，《中共中央 国务院关于发展新质生产力的意见》公开发布，部署科技创新、产业创新等任务，以新质生产力推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued guidelines on developing new quality productive forces, outlining sci-tech and industrial innovation tasks to drive high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞张雨浦会见出席第47届世界葡萄与葡萄酒大会的驻华使节代表团
articles.title_en: Li Yifei and Zhang Yupu Meet with Diplomatic Delegation Attending 47th World Grape and Wine Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞、自治区主席张雨浦在银川会见出席第47届世界葡萄与葡萄酒大会暨OIV成员国代表大会的31国驻华使节代表团。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 11, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei and Chairman Zhang Yupu met in Yinchuan with a delegation of diplomats from 31 countries attending the 47th World Grape and Wine Congress and the OIV General Assembly.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉主持市优化营商环境委员会会议 推进“宜商银川”建设
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Chairs Meeting of Yinchuan Business Environment Optimization Committee to Advance 'Business-Friendly Yinchuan'
articles.summary_zh: 近日，银川市优化营商环境委员会召开会议，市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，部署深化营商环境改革、打造“宜商银川”品牌等重点工作，市长陶少华参加。
articles.summary_en: The Yinchuan Municipal Committee for Business Environment Optimization recently held a meeting chaired by Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui, who outlined key tasks to deepen reform and build the 'Business-Friendly Yinchuan' brand; Mayor Tao Shaohua attended.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞张雨浦在银川会见出席第47届世界葡萄与葡萄酒大会的国内嘉宾
articles.title_en: Li Yifei and Zhang Yupu Meet Domestic Guests Attending the 47th World Vine and Wine Congress in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞、自治区主席张雨浦在银川会见出席第47届世界葡萄与葡萄酒大会暨OIV成员国代表大会和第六届中国（宁夏）国际葡萄酒文化旅游博览会的国内嘉宾。
articles.summary_en: On October 11, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei and Autonomous Region Chairman Zhang Yupu met in Yinchuan with domestic guests attending the 47th World Vine and Wine Congress, the OIV General Assembly and the 6th China (Ningxia) International Wine Culture and Tourism Expo.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 加快建设更高水平的平安银川 推动算力产业提质增效 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on Building a Safer Yinchuan and Upgrading the Computing Power Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，银川市委常委会召开会议，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，部署平安银川建设、闽宁协作深化和算力产业提质增效等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, the Yinchuan Municipal Party Standing Committee met, chaired by Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui, to plan a safer Yinchuan, deeper Fujian-Ningxia cooperation and computing power industry upgrades.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组理论学习中心组集体（扩大）学习会议
articles.title_en: Municipal CPPCC Holds Expanded Collective Study Session of Party Group Theoretical Study Center
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，岳阳市政协党组理论学习中心组召开2026年第九次集体（扩大）学习会议，深入学习习近平文化思想，市政协党组书记、主席汪涛等出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, the Party Group of the Yueyang Municipal CPPCC held its ninth expanded collective study session of 2026, focusing on Xi Jinping Thought on Culture, with Party Group Secretary and Chairman Wang Tao attending.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和中央会议精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Xie Weijiang, Hunan deputy party secretary and Yueyang party secretary, chaired a municipal standing committee meeting to study recent Xi speeches and central meeting spirits.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持市委理论学习中心组2026年第九次集体学习
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs 2026 Ninth Collective Study of Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，岳阳市委理论学习中心组开展2026年第九次集体学习，谢卫江主持并讲话，强调深学笃行习近平生态文明思想、贯彻《生态环境法典》。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Yueyang Municipal Party Committee's theoretical study group held its 2026 ninth collective study, chaired by Xie Weijiang, stressing ecological civilization thought and the Ecological Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 遂溪县召开2026年财政收入组织工作第三次调度会议
articles.title_en: Suixi County Holds Third 2026 Fiscal Revenue Coordination Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日上午，广东遂溪县召开2026年财政收入组织工作第三次调度会议，县委书记张洋出席讲话，部署冲刺全年收入目标并谋划2027年财源。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 9, Suixi County in Guangdong held its third 2026 fiscal revenue coordination meeting, where county Party Secretary Zhang Yang urged efforts to meet budget targets and plan 2027 revenue sources.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Chairs Zhoukou Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，周口市市长詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议，研究稳增长、现代化产业体系建设、粮食安全及灾后恢复重建等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting on steady growth, industrial upgrading, food security and post-disaster reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Chairs Zhoukou Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，周口市市长詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署稳增长、粮食安全、灾后恢复重建等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speeches and to plan work on stable growth, food security and post-disaster reconstruction.

articles.title_zh: 张华带队开展农业政策资金落实暨生态环境保护专题调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Hua Leads Special Research on Agricultural Policy Funds and Environmental Protection
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，周口市人大常委会副主任张华带队赴淮阳区、郸城县、商水县开展农业政策资金落实、项目建设及生态环境保护专题调研，并在商水县召开座谈会督导重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Zhang Hua, deputy director of the Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, led a research team to Huaiyang, Dancheng and Shangshui on agricultural policy funds, project construction and ecological protection, holding a symposium in Shangshui County.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁赴连江县开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动并接待群众来访
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Visits Lianjiang County for River Protection Drive, Receives Petitioners
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁赴连江县开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动，察看敖江水质，并在县信访接待中心接待来访群众。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou party chief, visited Lianjiang County to inspect the Aojiang River and receive petitioners at the county petition center.

articles.title_zh: 守护绿水青山 共绘美丽中国新画卷
articles.title_en: Safeguarding Lucid Waters and Lush Mountains to Paint a New Picture of a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”开局之年，各地统筹山水林田湖草沙一体化保护治理：洱海水质稳定优良，海菜花分布面积扩至95万平方米，“三北”工程三年完成治理2.65亿亩。
articles.summary_en: In the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, localities are advancing integrated ecological protection, with Erhai Lake water quality stable and 265 million mu treated under the Three-North project.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·走好新时代的长征路｜信仰之基
articles.title_en: Studying New Discourses: Walking the Long March Road of the New Era — The Foundation of Faith
articles.summary_zh: 新华社“学习新语”栏目在红军长征胜利90周年之际推出“走好新时代的长征路”系列报道，首期“信仰之基”聚焦习近平总书记有关理想信念的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's "New Discourses" column launched a series marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March, with the first installment focusing on Xi Jinping's remarks on ideals and faith.

tags.name_en: Long March Road of the New Era

tags_en: Long March Road of the New Era

articles.title_zh: 大道致远，笃行不怠——记中国元首外交金秋繁忙季
articles.title_en: A Far-Reaching Path, Unwavering Commitment: China's Busy Autumn Season of Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月11日播发特稿，回顾习近平主席2026年金秋三次出访：出席上合组织比什凯克峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及，赴新德里出席金砖会晤，以及对美国进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua feature on October 11 reviews Xi Jinping's busy autumn 2026 diplomacy: the SCO summit in Bishkek, state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, the BRICS summit in New Delhi, and a state visit to the United States.

articles.title_zh: 困难再大，想想红军长征，想想湘江血战
articles.title_en: However Great the Hardships, Think of the Long March and the Bloody Battle at the Xiang River
articles.summary_zh: 新华社「学习进行时」刊文重温长征湘江战役，引述习近平关于伟大长征精神的重要论述，强调以坚定信念和斗争精神克服一切困难。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua "Study Time" feature revisits the Xiang River battle of the Long March and quotes Xi Jinping on the great Long March spirit, urging firm faith to overcome all hardships.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃印发规划推进林业草原保护利用
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues Plan to Advance Forestry and Grassland Protection and Utilization
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省林草局等部门日前印发《甘肃省林业草原保护利用“十五五”规划》，明确到2030年“三北”工程攻坚战取得决定性胜利，布局九大重点工程、31项主要任务。
articles.summary_en: Gansu provincial forestry and grassland authorities issued a plan for the protection and use of forestry and grassland during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, aiming for a decisive victory in the Three-North Shelterbelt program by 2030 through nine major projects and 31 tasks.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“活力中国调研行”广西主题采访活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Vital China Research Tour' Guangxi Media Tour Launches
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，由中宣部组织的2026年“活力中国调研行”广西主题采访活动在南宁启动，记者将围绕“开放活力”开展为期6天的调研采访。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, the 2026 "Vital China Research Tour" Guangxi media tour, organized by the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department, launched in Nanning for a six-day visit themed "open vitality."

articles.title_zh: 江苏首个市场化“整村光伏”项目在沛县并网投运
articles.title_en: Jiangsu's First Market-Based Whole-Village Solar Project Connects to Grid in Peixian
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，江苏省首个市场化推广的“整村光伏”项目在徐州沛县祁庄村并网投运，73户农房屋顶光伏经汇流升压后统一送入10千伏配电网。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, Jiangsu's first market-driven whole-village solar project connected to the grid in Qizhuang village, Peixian, Xuzhou, feeding rooftop PV from 73 rural households into the 10kV network.

articles.title_zh: 江苏推出知识产权服务券 助力企业海外专利布局
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Launches Intellectual Property Service Vouchers to Support Enterprises' Overseas Patent Layout
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省财政厅、省知识产权局联合推出知识产权服务券，省级财政安排3000万元补助资金，支持企业购买海外专利布局与风险防控服务。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's Provincial Department of Finance and Intellectual Property Administration jointly launched IP service vouchers, with 30 million yuan in provincial subsidies to help enterprises fund overseas patent layout and risk prevention services.

articles.title_zh: 扩能提质，进一步打响“上海服务”品牌
articles.title_en: Shanghai to Expand and Upgrade Its "Shanghai Services" Brand
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月12日，上海市委书记陈吉宁出席上海市市长国际企业家咨询会议并致辞，提出深化服务业扩能提质、扩大开放，力争到2030年服务业增加值达6万亿元左右。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, 2026, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining addressed the Shanghai Mayor's International Business Leaders' Advisory Council, pledging to expand and upgrade the service sector and open it wider, targeting about 6 trillion yuan in service value added by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺马迪塞就任爱沙尼亚总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Madise on Her Assumption of Estonian Presidency
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，国家主席习近平致电于勒·马迪塞，祝贺她就任爱沙尼亚共和国总统，并表示愿以两国建交35周年为契机深化双边合作。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Chinese President Xi Jinping sent a message to Jüri Madise congratulating her on assuming the presidency of Estonia, expressing willingness to deepen bilateral cooperation on the 35th anniversary of diplomatic ties.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同巴布亚新几内亚总督达达埃就中巴新建交50周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Dadae Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 50th Anniversary of China-PNG Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，习近平同巴布亚新几内亚总督达达埃互致贺电庆祝两国建交50周年；同日李强同巴新总理马拉佩互致贺电。
articles.summary_en: On October 12, Xi Jinping and Papua New Guinea Governor-General Dadae exchanged congratulatory messages marking 50 years of diplomatic ties, while Li Qiang and PNG Prime Minister Marape did the same.

articles.title_zh: 水净景美满目新——多地水生态保护一线观察
articles.title_en: Clear Waters and Renewed Landscapes: Ground-Level Observations of Water Ecology Protection in Multiple Regions
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者近日探访河北、山西等多地，观察水生态保护成效。水利部已在88条母亲河实施复苏行动，并将在“十五五”时期启动第二批111条。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters recently visited Hebei, Shanxi and other regions to observe progress in water ecology protection. The Ministry of Water Resources has revived 88 "mother rivers" and will launch a second batch of 111 in the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 首批国家公园生态效益评估指标优秀比例达75%
articles.title_en: First Batch of National Parks Rated Excellent in 75% of Ecological Benefit Indicators
articles.summary_zh: 国家林业和草原局10月12日通报，三江源等首批5个国家公园设立五年来建设成果丰硕，生态效益评估指标优秀比例达75%，旗舰物种种群稳步增长。
articles.summary_en: China's forestry authority said on Oct 12 that the first five national parks, established in 2021, have made major gains, with 75% of ecological benefit indicators rated excellent.

articles.title_zh: 我国部署“十五五”铁路科技创新重点任务
articles.title_en: China Deploys Key Tasks for Railway Technological Innovation Under 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国家铁路局近日印发《铁路科技创新“十五五”规划》，部署基础研究、工程建造、技术装备、数智铁路等领域重点任务，提出到2030年基本建成引领铁路现代化发展的科技创新体系。
articles.summary_en: China's National Railway Administration issued a plan for railway technological innovation during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, setting tasks in fields such as engineering, equipment, digitalization and green development, aiming to basically build an innovation system leading railway modernization by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 第三轮第七批中央生态环保督察启动
articles.title_en: Third Round, Seventh Batch of Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspections Launched
articles.summary_zh: 经党中央、国务院批准，第三轮第七批中央生态环境保护督察10月12日启动，对住房城乡建设部、农业农村部开展例行督察，并对湖北、湖南、广西、重庆、四川、贵州、云南开展溶洞天坑污染专项督察。
articles.summary_en: Approved by the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, the seventh batch of the third round of central ecological and environmental protection inspections was launched on Oct 12, with routine inspections of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, plus special inspections of karst cave and sinkhole pollution in seven provincial-level regions.

articles.title_zh: 从三星堆感悟中华民族的创造力
articles.title_en: Reflecting on the Chinese Nation's Creativity Through Sanxingdui
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日学习《习近平文化文选》座谈会在京召开，文章以三星堆、良渚等为例，阐述中华民族创造力与文化强国建设。
articles.summary_en: A symposium on studying Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Culture was held in Beijing on Oct 9; the article cites Sanxingdui and Liangzhu to illustrate the Chinese nation's creativity and cultural strength.

articles.title_zh: 截至9月底全国共有4万余家“为老服务”类社会组织
articles.title_en: Over 43,900 Elderly-Care Social Organizations Nationwide as of End of September
articles.summary_zh: 民政部10月12日在山东济南举办“社服惠民”主题活动，据介绍截至9月底全国共有77.98万家社会组织，其中“为老服务”类4.39万家。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Civil Affairs said at an event in Jinan, Shandong on October 12 that as of the end of September the country had 779,800 social organizations, including 43,900 focused on elderly-care services.

articles.title_zh: 第三轮第七批中央生态环保督察启动
articles.title_en: Third Round, Seventh Batch of Central Ecological and Environmental Inspections Launched
articles.summary_zh: 10月12日，经党中央、国务院批准，第三轮第七批中央生态环境保护督察启动，对住建部、农业农村部开展例行督察，并对7省区市开展溶洞天坑污染专项督察。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 12, with approval from the CPC Central Committee and the State Council, the seventh batch of the third round of central ecological and environmental inspections was launched, covering two ministries and seven provincial-level regions.

articles.title_zh: 广东省省长孟凡利会见库克
articles.title_en: Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli Meets with Tim Cook
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，广东省省长孟凡利在广州会见美国苹果公司执行董事长蒂姆·库克一行，双方就扩大在粤业务布局与供应链合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 11, Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli met in Guangzhou with Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook, discussing expanded business and supply chain cooperation in the province.

articles.title_zh: 尹力：统筹抓好兴业强村富民各项工作，走出一条符合首都实际的乡村振兴之路
articles.title_en: Yin Li: Coordinate Work to Boost Rural Industry, Villages and Incomes, Forging a Capital-Specific Rural Revitalization Path
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，北京市委书记尹力在门头沟区调研并出席全市“百千工程”工作会，强调统筹兴业强村富民，探索符合首都实际的乡村振兴之路；市长殷勇一同调研主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li inspected Mentougou District and attended a city meeting on the 'Hundreds and Thousands Project,' urging coordinated rural industry, village, and income development; Mayor Yin Yong joined.

articles.title_zh: 多国城市官员古都洛阳对话 吁文明互鉴
articles.title_en: Municipal Officials from Multiple Countries Dialogue in Ancient Capital Luoyang, Call for Inter-Civilization Exchange
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，中国、意大利、希腊等十余国近百位市长、政要、学者在河南洛阳举行“2026世界市长对话·洛阳”，就以人为本、赓续文脉、绿色转型、文明互鉴达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 11, nearly 100 mayors, officials and scholars from over ten countries including China, Italy and Greece met in Luoyang, Henan for the 2026 World Mayor Dialogue, reaching consensus on people-centered development, cultural heritage, green transition and inter-civilization exchange.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：赖清德所谓“双十”讲话暴露其“台湾之祸”“和平之灾”本质
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry: Lai Ching-te's 'Double Ten' Speech Exposes His Nature as a 'Scourge to Taiwan and Calamity for Peace'
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，国防部新闻发言人陈曦在北京就赖清德所谓“双十”讲话答记者问，指其顽固坚持“台独”立场、煽动两岸对立，再次暴露“台湾之祸”“和平之灾”本质。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 11, MND spokesperson Chen Xi said in Beijing that Lai Ching-te's 'Double Ten' speech, with its stubborn 'Taiwan independence' stance and incitement of cross-strait confrontation, exposes him as a 'scourge to Taiwan and calamity for peace.'

articles.title_zh: 广东省省长孟凡利会见蒂姆·库克一行
articles.title_en: Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli Meets with Tim Cook
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，广东省省长孟凡利在广州会见美国苹果公司执行董事长蒂姆·库克一行，双方就扩大在粤业务布局与深化合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 11, Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli met with Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook in Guangzhou, discussing expanded business operations and deeper cooperation in the province.

articles.title_zh: 王毅在大同与法国总统外事顾问博纳举行第二十八次中法战略对话
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds 28th China-France Strategic Dialogue with French Presidential Adviser Bonne in Datong
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在山西大同与法国总统外事顾问博纳举行第二十八次中法战略对话，双方就深化中法战略合作达成广泛共识。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Wang Yi, China's top diplomat, held the 28th China-France Strategic Dialogue with French presidential adviser Emmanuel Bonne in Datong, Shanxi, with both sides reaching broad consensus on deepening strategic cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 精准监督，让公平正义更加可感可触：五名检察系统代表与中外记者见面交流
articles.title_en: Five Prosecutors Meet Chinese and Foreign Journalists on Strengthening Procuratorial Supervision
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，国务院新闻办公室举行中外记者见面会，5名检察系统代表围绕强化检察监督、履行国家法律监督机关职责与中外记者交流。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where five procuratorial representatives met Chinese and foreign journalists to discuss strengthening procuratorial oversight.

articles.title_zh: 中法举行战略对话
articles.title_en: China and France Hold Strategic Dialogue
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在山西大同与法国总统外事顾问博纳举行第二十八次中法战略对话，双方就高层交往、经贸合作与全球治理交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Wang Yi, member of the CPC Political Bureau and head of the Central Foreign Affairs Office, held the 28th China-France Strategic Dialogue with French presidential diplomatic advisor Emmanuel Bonne in Datong, Shanxi, covering high-level exchanges, trade cooperation and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 加快建设知识型、技能型、创新型劳动者大军
articles.title_en: China to Accelerate Building a Knowledge-Based, Skilled and Innovative Workforce
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会，人力资源社会保障部介绍“十五五”就业和社会保障工作安排，拟开展补贴性职业技能培训5000万人次。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where the HRSS ministry outlined 15th Five-Year Plan employment and social security measures, including 50 million subsidized skills trainings.

articles.title_zh: 前8月货物贸易进出口总值同比增长17.6%
articles.title_en: China's Goods Trade Up 17.6% in First Eight Months of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 据海关统计，今年前8个月我国货物贸易进出口总值34.78万亿元，同比增长17.6%；8月当月进出口4.65万亿元，同比增长19.8%，进口月度同比增速连续6个月超过出口。
articles.summary_en: China's goods trade reached 34.78 trillion yuan in the first eight months of the year, up 17.6% year on year, while August trade rose 19.8%, with import growth outpacing exports for a sixth straight month, customs data show.

articles.title_zh: 四川夹金山隧道通车一年：长征天险变通途 带动红色文旅与高原特色农业
articles.title_en: Sichuan's Jiajinshan Tunnel One Year On: Long March Snowy Pass Becomes a Passage, Boosting Red Tourism and Highland Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 四川夹金山隧道通车一年，翻越夹金山由至少1小时缩短至10分钟，便利雅安宝兴与阿坝小金11万群众出行，带动红色文旅和高原特色农业发展。
articles.summary_en: A year after Sichuan's Jiajinshan Tunnel opened, crossing the snowy Long March pass fell from an hour to ten minutes, easing travel for 110,000 residents and boosting red tourism and highland farming.

articles.title_zh: 张国清在吉林调研时强调 持续做大做强先进制造业 提升产业链自主可控水平
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoqing Inspects Jilin, Stresses Strengthening Advanced Manufacturing and Industrial Chain Self-Reliance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月8日至10日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理张国清在吉林省长春、吉林市调研先进制造业发展和高端科研仪器自主创新，强调提升产业链自主可控水平。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing inspected advanced manufacturing and high-end research instrument innovation in Jilin from Oct 8-10, 2026, urging greater self-reliance in industrial chains.

articles.title_zh: 第六届中国—太平洋岛国政党对话会在北京举行
articles.title_en: Sixth China-Pacific Island Countries Political Party Dialogue Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，由中共中央对外联络部主办的第六届中国—太平洋岛国政党对话会在北京举行，中联部部长刘海星及汤加副首相拉图等太平洋岛国政党政要和驻华使节出席。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, the sixth China-Pacific Island Countries Political Party Dialogue, hosted by the International Department of the CPC Central Committee, was held in Beijing, attended by IDCPC Minister Liu Haixing and Tonga's Deputy Prime Minister Latu, among other Pacific island political party leaders and diplomats.

articles.title_zh: 全省学习贯彻习近平关于基层工作方法的重要论述专题党课举行 许昆林讲授专题党课 王新伟主持 周波霍步刚出席
articles.title_en: Liaoning Holds Special Party Lecture on Xi Jinping's Important Expositions on Grassroots Work Methods; Xu Kunlin Lectures
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，辽宁省学习贯彻习近平关于基层工作方法重要论述专题党课在沈阳举行，省委书记许昆林讲授，省长王新伟主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Liaoning held a special Party lecture in Shenyang on Xi Jinping's expositions on grassroots work. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin lectured, and Governor Wang Xinwei presided.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市召开装备制造产业重点企业座谈会 加快装备制造业转型升级
articles.title_en: Shenyang Holds Symposium with Key Equipment Manufacturing Enterprises to Accelerate Industrial Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，沈阳市委书记霍步刚主持召开装备制造产业重点企业座谈会，市长马珊珊出席，与沈阳机床、沈鼓、新松机器人等企业负责人交流，推动装备制造业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Shenyang Party Secretary Huo Bugang chaired a symposium with key equipment manufacturing enterprises, joined by Mayor Ma Shanshan, to hear from firms including Shenyang Machine Tool, Shengu and SIASUN and push industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 大道致远，笃行不怠——记中国元首外交金秋繁忙季
articles.title_en: A Journey of Far-Reaching Vision and Unwavering Action: China's Busy Autumn Season of Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月11日播发特稿，回顾习近平主席今秋三次出访：出席上海合作组织比什凯克峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及，赴新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a feature on October 11 reviewing Xi Jinping's three autumn overseas trips: the SCO summit in Bishkek with state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, the 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi, and a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25.

articles.title_zh: 《中共中央国务院关于发展新质生产力的意见》公开发布
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council Release Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，《中共中央国务院关于发展新质生产力的意见》公开发布，提出19条重大发展改革任务，将习近平总书记的新质生产力理论转化为行动指南。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council publicly released the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces, setting out 19 major development and reform tasks to guide nationwide action.

articles.title_zh: 中国物流业景气指数连续5个月扩张
articles.title_en: China's Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Expands for Five Consecutive Months
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，中国物流与采购联合会发布数据，9月份中国物流业景气指数为51.5%，环比回升0.6个百分点，连续5个月处于扩张区间。
articles.summary_en: On October 11, the China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing reported that China's logistics industry prosperity index stood at 51.5% in September, up 0.6 percentage points month on month and in expansion territory for a fifth straight month.

articles.title_zh: 前三季度新开工重大水利工程数量超去年全年
articles.title_en: Major Water Conservancy Projects Started in First Three Quarters Exceed Last Year's Full-Year Total
articles.summary_zh: 水利部消息，前三季度全国新开工重大水利工程数量超去年全年，葛洲坝航运扩能等工程开工，预计年底农村自来水普及率达97%。
articles.summary_en: China started more major water conservancy projects in the first three quarters of 2026 than in all of last year, the Ministry of Water Resources said, with rural tap water coverage expected to reach 97% by year-end.

articles.title_zh: 坚持人民至上、生命至上——习近平总书记引领健康中国建设
articles.title_en: Putting People and Life First: Xi Jinping Leads the Building of a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月11日播发长文，梳理党的十八大以来习近平总书记引领健康中国建设，从顶层设计到基层医疗、深化医改、中医药传承与全球卫生合作的历程与成效。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a long-form report on Oct 11 reviewing how Xi Jinping has led the building of a Healthy China since the 18th Party Congress, covering top-level planning, grassroots medical care, healthcare reform, traditional Chinese medicine and global health cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 全省学习贯彻习近平关于基层工作方法的重要论述专题党课举行
articles.title_en: Liaoning Holds Special Party Lecture on Xi Jinping's Important Discourses on Grassroots Work Methods
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，辽宁省学习贯彻习近平关于基层工作方法重要论述专题党课在沈阳举行，省委书记许昆林讲授党课，省长王新伟主持。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Liaoning Province held a special Party lecture in Shenyang on Xi Jinping's discourses on grassroots work methods, delivered by Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and presided over by Governor Wang Xinwei.

articles.title_zh: 福州市委常委会召开会议 郭宁宁主持并研究贯彻落实措施
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Chaired by Guo Ningning
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，并部署安全生产、两岸融合发展和反腐败整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning chaired a municipal standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's speeches and plan work on workplace safety, cross-strait integration and anti-corruption.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤调研纪检监察工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Discipline Inspection and Supervision Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，淮安市委书记顾坤到市纪委监委机关调研，强调持之以恒推进全面从严治党，强化政治监督，护航全市高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected the city's discipline inspection and supervision commission, urging sustained full and rigorous Party governance, stronger political oversight and better service for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 淮安新一届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员开展廉政教育
articles.title_en: Huai'an New Party Committee Members Conduct Anti-Corruption Education
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，淮安市委书记顾坤带领新一届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员赴金堤永固党风廉政教育基地、德园，集体接受党性教育和廉政教育。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun led newly elected municipal Party committee members and discipline inspection commission members to anti-corruption education bases to receive Party spirit and integrity education.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦调研中国农大淮北试验基地和秸秆禁烧工作

articles.summary_zh: 10月11日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦前往濉溪县、烈山区，调研中国农业大学淮北试验基地和秸秆禁烧工作，强调以科技创新赋能农业现代化。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 11, Jiang Xi, Party Secretary of Huaibei, inspected the China Agricultural University Huaibei Experimental Base and straw burning ban work in Suixi County and Lieshan District, stressing tech-driven agricultural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保到榕城区调研古城保育活化工作

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of the 10th, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao inspected old town preservation and revitalization in Rongcheng District, reviewing demolition, construction and renovation sites and urging faster project progress and safe production.

articles.title_zh: 《中共中央国务院关于发展新质生产力的意见》公开发布

articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，《中共中央国务院关于发展新质生产力的意见》公开发布，提出19条重大发展改革任务，为因地制宜发展新质生产力确立行动指南。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council publicly released the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces, setting out 19 major development and reform tasks.

articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月11日播发综述，回顾党的十八大以来习近平总书记引领健康中国建设，推动我国卫生与健康事业取得历史性成就。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua, Oct 11: A review of how Xi Jinping has guided the Healthy China initiative since the 18th Party Congress, highlighting historic progress in the country's health and medical services.

articles.title_zh: 李晖调研黄桥琴韵小镇建设情况
articles.title_en: Taizhou Mayor Li Hui Inspects Huangqiao Qinyun Music Town Construction
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，泰州市市长李晖在泰兴市调研黄桥琴韵小镇建设，强调加强产业规划、品牌打造与政策扶持，推动产城一体和文旅体商深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui inspected Huangqiao Music Town in Taixing, urging stronger industrial planning, brand building and policy support for industry-city and culture-tourism integration.

articles.summary_en: On October 10, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui inspected the Huangqiao Qinyun music town in Taixing, urging stronger industrial planning, brand building and policy support to deepen culture-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 李岩深入辉南县调研产业发展与乡村振兴
articles.title_en: Li Yan Visits Huinan County to Inspect Industrial Development and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月11日，通化市委书记李岩深入辉南县调研产业发展、乡村振兴和民生项目建设，考察香菇产业园、珍珠养殖、药企及人民公园等。
articles.summary_en: On October 11, Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan visited Huinan County to inspect industrial development, rural revitalization and livelihood projects, including a mushroom industrial park, pearl farming, pharmaceutical firms and a public park.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋到市委组织部调研
articles.title_en: Jiang Feng Visits Municipal Party Committee Organization Department
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，无锡市委书记蒋锋到市委组织部调研，看望慰问组工干部并主持召开座谈会，强调推动全市组织工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Wuxi Party Secretary Jiang Feng visited the Municipal Party Committee Organization Department, met with staff and chaired a symposium, urging high-quality development of the city's organizational work.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在全市乡村振兴重点工作推进会上强调：以更高站位更实举措推进乡村全面振兴
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Urges Stronger Push for All-Round Rural Revitalization at Xi'an Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，西安市召开全市乡村振兴重点工作推进会，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰出席并讲话，部署耕地保护、粮食安全、常态化帮扶和乡村建设等重点工作，市委副书记李婧主持。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Xi'an held a meeting on key rural revitalization work, where Municipal Party Secretary Hao Huijie called for stronger farmland protection, food security and sustained assistance to prevent a return to poverty.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委理论学习中心组学习会议深入学习贯彻习近平法治思想
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Group Meets to Deepen Study of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，西安市委理论学习中心组举行会议，深入学习贯彻习近平法治思想，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Group held a meeting to deepen the study of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, chaired by Hao Huijie, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee.

articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，宣城市市长邓继敢赴泾县、宁国市调研皖南川藏线建设并主持召开推进会，要求补齐基础设施短板、推动文旅业态提质升级。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Xuancheng Mayor Deng Jigan inspected the Wannan Sichuan-Tibet Line in Jingxian and Ningguo and chaired a meeting urging infrastructure fixes and higher-quality tourism development.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市委常委会召开会议 严汉平主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，盐城市委书记严汉平主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，并研究人工智能发展、深化改革和反腐集中整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping chaired a standing committee meeting of the municipal Party committee, studying Xi Jinping's recent speeches and reviewing AI development, reforms and anti-corruption work.

articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开今年第十期政企恳谈会，围绕加快构建现代物流体系、服务实体经济听取企业和行业协会意见建议。

articles.title_en: US Justice Department Investigates Five Major TV Networks Over 'White House Boycott'
articles.summary_zh: 美国司法部10日说，正调查CNN等五家电视媒体集体抵制白宫采访是否违反联邦反垄断法。此前特朗普禁止三家新闻机构记者进入白宫。
articles.summary_en: The U.S. Justice Department is investigating whether five major TV networks violated antitrust law by jointly boycotting White House coverage after Trump barred three outlets' reporters.

articles.title_zh: 专访：全球发展倡议推动将发展置于国际议程中心位置——访巴基斯坦常驻联合国日内瓦办事处代表安德拉比
articles.title_en: Interview: Global Development Initiative Puts Development at Center of International Agenda, Says Pakistan's UN Representative in Geneva
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月11日在日内瓦专访巴基斯坦常驻联合国日内瓦办事处代表安德拉比。他表示，全球发展倡议把发展重新置于国际议程中心，5年来落实1800多个合作项目。
articles.summary_en: Pakistan's permanent representative to the UN in Geneva, Andrabi, told Xinhua in an Oct 11 interview that the Global Development Initiative has put development back at the center of the international agenda, with over 1,800 projects carried out in five years.

articles.title_zh: 国防部新闻发言人陈曦就赖清德发表所谓“双十”讲话答记者问
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry Spokesperson Chen Xi Answers Questions on Lai Ching-te's So-called "Double Ten" Speech
articles.summary_zh: 国防部新闻发言人陈曦就赖清德所谓“双十”讲话答记者问，重申一个中国原则，批驳其“台独”立场，强调祖国统一大势所趋。
articles.summary_en: Defense Ministry spokesperson Chen Xi answered questions on Lai Ching-te's so-called "Double Ten" speech, reaffirming the one-China principle and rejecting his Taiwan independence stance.

articles.title_zh: 陕西榆林成立工作专班整治危货运输超载问题
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Yulin Establishes Special Task Force to Rectify Hazardous Cargo Transport Overloading
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日晚央视《焦点访谈》曝光靖边县企业长期超载运输原油后，榆林市委、市政府连夜成立联合工作专班，赶赴现场查处并全市开展危运行业排查整治。
articles.summary_en: After CCTV exposed a Jingbian firm's long-term crude oil overloading on Oct 10, Yulin formed a joint task force overnight to investigate and launch citywide hazardous cargo transport rectification.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市党政代表团赴贵州考察 深化新时代渝黔高质量合作
articles.title_en: Chongqing Party and Government Delegation Visits Guizhou to Deepen High-Quality Chongqing-Guizhou Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日至10日，重庆市党政代表团赴贵州考察，两地举行经济社会发展合作交流座谈会，袁家军、徐麟、李炳军、陈新武参加。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 9 to 10, a Chongqing Party and government delegation visited Guizhou, where the two sides held a symposium on economic and social development cooperation, attended by Yuan Jiajun, Xu Lin, Li Bingjun and Chen Xinwu.

articles.title_zh: 川渝联合印发《重庆都市圈建设“十五五”实施方案》
articles.title_en: Sichuan and Chongqing Jointly Issue Implementation Plan for Chongqing Metropolitan Area During 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，川渝联合印发《重庆都市圈建设“十五五”实施方案》，明确到2030年都市圈地区生产总值达3.6万亿元以上、城镇人口达2000万人以上。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Sichuan and Chongqing jointly issued the implementation plan for the Chongqing metropolitan area under the 15th Five-Year Plan, targeting GDP of over 3.6 trillion yuan and an urban population of over 20 million by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 王陆进主持召开省政府常务会议 研究统筹推进高质量发展和高水平保护等工作
articles.title_en: Wang Lujin Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting on Coordinating High-Quality Development and High-Level Protection
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，河南省委副书记、代省长王陆进主持召开省政府常务会议，集体学习习近平生态文明思想，研究统筹推进高质量发展和高水平保护、加强基层消防等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Wang Lujin, Deputy Party Secretary and Acting Governor of Henan, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to study Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization and coordinate high-quality development with high-level protection and grassroots fire safety.

articles.title_zh: 食品安全法大幅修订回应哪些关切
articles.title_en: China's Food Safety Law Set for Major Revision to Address Key Concerns
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，市场监管总局就《食品安全法（修订草案征求意见稿）》公开征求意见，首次将直播带货等新业态纳入调整范围，并全面调整罚款计算方式。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, the State Administration for Market Regulation released a draft revision of the Food Safety Law for public comment, bringing livestream e-commerce and other new business models under regulation for the first time.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥会见国家体育总局副局长张家胜
articles.title_en: Guan Zhiou Meets Zhang Jiasheng, Deputy Director of the General Administration of Sport
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日下午，湖北省委书记关志鸥在孝感会见国家体育总局副局长张家胜，双方就支持湖北体育事业发展、推进体育强省建设交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 10, Hubei provincial Party secretary Guan Zhiou met in Xiaogan with Zhang Jiasheng, deputy director of China's General Administration of Sport, to discuss support for Hubei's sports development and building a strong sports province.

tags.name_en: General Administration of Sport of China

tags_en: General Administration of Sport of China

articles.title_zh: 河北推动绿电直连再升级：从「单用户」到「多用户」
articles.title_en: Hebei Upgrades Green Power Direct Connection from Single to Multi-User
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河北省发展改革委印发通知，组织开展多用户绿电直连项目申报，重点支持钢铁、石化、算力等行业，推动绿电直连由单一用户专属拓展为多主体共享。
articles.summary_en: Hebei's Development and Reform Commission has issued a notice launching multi-user green power direct connection applications, expanding the model from single-user supply to shared multi-user supply for key industries.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在海南省委办公厅干部大会上强调干部队伍建设
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Stresses Building a Loyal, Clean and Professional Cadre Team at Hainan Provincial Party Committee General Office Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，海南省委办公厅干部大会召开，省委书记冯飞讲话，宣布李锋任海南省委常委、省委秘书长。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Hainan's Provincial Party Committee General Office held a cadre meeting where Party Secretary Feng Fei spoke; Li Feng was appointed a standing committee member of the Hainan Provincial Party Committee and its secretary-general.

articles.title_zh: 海南自贸港大讲堂聚焦脑机接口技术与产业创新体系构建
articles.title_en: Hainan Free Trade Port Lecture Focuses on Building Brain-Computer Interface Technology and Industrial Innovation System
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，2026年第5期海南自贸港大讲堂举行，中国科学院院士、海南大学校长骆清铭就脑机接口技术与产业创新体系作专题授课，省委书记冯飞、省长刘小明等省领导参加。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, 2026, the fifth Hainan Free Trade Port Lecture featured CAS academician Luo Qingming speaking on brain-computer interface technology and industry, attended by Party Secretary Feng Fei and other provincial leaders.

articles.title_zh: 海南部署开展2026年青少年版权保护工作
articles.title_en: Hainan Deploys 2026 Copyright Protection Work for Minors
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省版权局联合省教育厅、省公安厅、省旅游和文化广电体育厅等部门部署开展2026年青少年版权保护工作，重点整治盗版教材教辅、盗版网络小说与游戏私服等行为。
articles.summary_en: Hainan's Copyright Bureau, together with the provincial education, public security, and tourism, culture, radio, television and sports departments, launched the 2026 copyright protection campaign for minors, targeting pirated textbooks, online novels and game servers.

articles.title_zh: 江西省首个新型电网重点工程建成投运
articles.title_en: Jiangxi's First Key New-Type Power Grid Project Put Into Operation
articles.summary_zh: 江西南昌1000千伏变电站主变扩建工程完成送电调试，标志江西首个新型电网重点工程建成投运，总投资3.54亿元。
articles.summary_en: The main transformer expansion project at the Nanchang 1,000 kV substation completed commissioning, marking the launch of Jiangxi's first key new-type power grid project, with total investment of 354 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 青海新能源与清洁能源公交车占比达99.1%
articles.title_en: New Energy and Clean Energy Buses Account for 99.1% in Qinghai
articles.summary_zh: 青海省交通运输厅推进道路运输绿色低碳转型，截至9月底全省新能源与清洁能源公交车占比达99.1%，出租车占比达83.5%。
articles.summary_en: Qinghai's transport authorities reported that as of end-September, new-energy and clean-energy buses made up 99.1% of the province's fleet, with such taxis reaching 83.5%.

articles.title_zh: 四川省“专精特新”专板企业赋能券正式推出
articles.title_en: Sichuan Launches Empowerment Vouchers for Firms on 'Specialized and Innovative' Board
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，四川省经济和信息化厅、省财政厅联合印发方案，推出“专精特新”专板企业赋能券，新入板企业年度申领额度8万元。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Sichuan's economy and finance departments launched empowerment vouchers subsidizing services for firms on its 'specialized and innovative' board, with new entrants eligible for 80,000 yuan a year.

articles.title_zh: 四川出台职业教育教学关键要素改革实施方案
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues Plan to Reform Key Elements of Vocational Education Teaching
articles.summary_zh: 近日，四川印发深化职业教育教学关键要素改革实施方案，推进专业、课程、教材、教师、实习实训等改革，到2030年职教专业设置与重点产业匹配度超60%。
articles.summary_en: Sichuan issued a plan to reform key elements of vocational education teaching, aiming for over 60% alignment between vocational majors and key industries by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 山东出台数字强省建设“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Digital Powerhouse Province
articles.summary_zh: 山东省人民政府近日印发《山东省数字强省建设“十五五”规划》，提出以数智化赋能高质量发展，推动实体经济与数字经济深度融合，到2030年全面提升数字强省建设水平。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial People's Government has issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for building a digital powerhouse province, aiming to empower high-quality development through digital and intelligent technologies and to deepen the integration of the real and digital economies by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁会见来沪参加第38次市咨会的跨国企业负责人
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Meets Multinational Business Leaders Attending 38th Shanghai Mayor's Advisory Council
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月10日，上海市委书记陈吉宁会见来沪参加第38次上海市市长国际企业家咨询会议的铁狮门、淡水河谷、西门子负责人，表示上海将持续优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, 2026, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining met executives of Tishman Speyer, Vale and Siemens attending the 38th Shanghai mayor's advisory council, pledging to keep improving the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 天津印发文商旅体展融合发展“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Tianjin Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Integrated Culture, Commerce, Tourism, Sports and Exhibition Development
articles.summary_zh: 天津市商务局、市文化和旅游局、市体育局近日印发《天津市文商旅体展融合发展“十五五”规划》，部署5个方面21项重点任务，并在市政府新闻办发布会上介绍主要内容。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin's commerce, culture and tourism, and sports bureaus issued a 15th Five-Year Plan for integrated culture, commerce, tourism, sports and exhibition development, outlining 21 key tasks in five areas.

articles.title_zh: 杭州发布2026年首号总河长令
articles.title_en: Hangzhou Issues Its First Municipal Chief River Chief Order of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 杭州发布2026年第1号市总河长令，要求纵深推进河湖水域空间管控，全面铺开河道倾倒垃圾整治、河湖“四乱”清零、违法侵占河湖存量问题整治三大专项行动，严守行洪安全底线。
articles.summary_en: Hangzhou issued its No. 1 municipal chief river chief order for 2026, calling for tighter control of river and lake spaces and three special campaigns against dumping, illegal occupation and the "four disorders," to safeguard flood discharge safety.

articles.title_zh: 尹力在门头沟区调研并出席全市“百千工程”工作会
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects Mentougou District and Attends Citywide "Hundred Villages, Thousand Households Project" Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，北京市委书记尹力在门头沟区调研并出席全市“百千工程”工作会，强调统筹抓好兴业、强村、富民各项工作，走出一条符合首都实际的乡村振兴之路，市长殷勇一同调研并主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li inspected Mentougou District and attended the city's rural revitalization work meeting, urging coordinated efforts in industry, villages and farmers' incomes; Mayor Yin Yong joined and chaired.

articles.title_zh: 国防部新闻发言人就近期涉军问题发布消息并答记者问
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry Spokesperson Releases Information and Takes Questions on Recent Military Issues
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，国防部新闻发言人陈曦在北京就近期涉军问题发布消息并答记者问，涉及中美两军交往、中老边境国防交流、中巴联训、维和培训及反恐论坛等。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Chinese Defense Ministry spokesperson Chen Xi briefed the press in Beijing on recent military issues, covering China-U.S. military exchanges, China-Laos border defense exchanges, China-Pakistan joint training, peacekeeping training and a counterterrorism forum.

articles.title_zh: 三季度高频数据折射我国经济向好态势
articles.title_en: Q3 High-Frequency Data Reflect Positive Momentum in China's Economy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月11日报道，国家发展改革委国家信息中心数据显示，三季度消费、外贸、投资等多项高频数据平稳向好，经济保持稳中有进、稳中向优态势。
articles.summary_en: Q3 high-frequency data show consumption, trade and investment all improving steadily, indicating China's economy is holding stable and positive momentum, per the National Information Center.

articles.title_zh: 四部门就加强汽车产品创新设计管理征求意见
articles.title_en: Four Departments Seek Public Comment on Strengthening Management of Automotive Product Innovation Design
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，工业和信息化部等四部门发布通知征求意见稿，就汽车产品创新设计审查评估、研发测试验证提出安全管理要求，禁止配备全隐藏式门把手。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and three other departments released a draft notice seeking public comment on tighter safety management of automotive product innovation design and R&D testing, banning fully hidden door handles.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 实施就业优先战略 织密社会保障网络
articles.title_en: Employment-First Strategy and a Stronger Social Security Net: Briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室10月10日在北京举行发布会，人力资源社会保障部副部长李忠等介绍“十五五”时期促进高质量充分就业、健全社会保障体系等工作安排。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing in Beijing on Oct 10, Vice Minister Li Zhong and other MOHRSS officials outlined plans to promote high-quality employment and improve the social security system during the 15th Five-Year Plan.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

tags_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

articles.title_zh: 世界市长对话·洛阳：把会场搬进石窟、车间与古城
articles.title_en: World Mayors' Dialogue in Luoyang: Bringing the Venue into Grottoes, Workshops and the Ancient City
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日至11日，以“赓续古都文脉，互鉴城市文明”为主题的2026世界市长对话·洛阳举行，来自10多个国家的90多位来宾围绕遗产保护、产业转型与城市更新展开对话。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 9 to 11, the 2026 World Mayors' Dialogue was held in Luoyang, where over 90 guests from more than 10 countries discussed heritage protection, industrial transformation and urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 河南省建筑业出海联盟成立
articles.title_en: Henan Construction Industry Going-Global Alliance Established
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，河南省建筑业出海联盟成立大会在郑州举行，副省长刘玉江出席并为联盟揭牌，旨在整合全省建筑业及产业链资源，推动建筑企业抱团出海。
articles.summary_en: The Henan Construction Industry Going-Global Alliance was launched on Oct 10 in Zhengzhou, with Vice Governor Liu Yujiang attending and unveiling the alliance, which aims to pool the province's construction and industry-chain resources to help firms go abroad jointly.

articles.title_zh: 做优做强特色优势产业 努力当好乡村振兴示范
articles.title_en: Strengthen Characteristic Advantage Industries to Serve as a Model for Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，河南省委常委安伟赴三门峡灵宝市调研乡村振兴，强调做强特色农业、做优乡村旅游，促进农民增收。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, An Wei, a member of the Henan Provincial Party Standing Committee, inspected rural revitalization work in Lingbao, Sanmenxia, urging stronger specialty agriculture and rural tourism to boost farmers' incomes.

articles.title_zh: 张敏到临颍县调研乡村振兴工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Min Inspects Rural Revitalization Work in Linying County, Henan
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，河南省委常委、常务副省长张敏到临颍县调研乡村振兴工作，实地察看农文旅融合项目并走访农产品加工企业。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Zhang Min, executive vice governor of Henan Province, inspected rural revitalization work in Linying County, visiting village tourism projects and agricultural processing firms.

articles.title_zh: 张巍到南阳市南召县调研：抓实“三秋”生产 抓好精准帮扶
articles.title_en: Zhang Wei Inspects Nanzhao County in Nanyang, Urging Solid Autumn Production and Targeted Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，河南省委副书记张巍到南阳市南召县调研“三秋”生产、产业发展和基础教育等工作，强调抓实秋收备播、精准帮扶，加快推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, Henan Deputy Party Secretary Zhang Wei inspected Nanzhao County in Nanyang, stressing solid autumn harvest and wheat planting, targeted assistance, and faster rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 三季度高频数据折射我国经济向好态势
articles.title_en: Q3 High-Frequency Data Reflect Positive Momentum in China's Economy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月11日报道，国家发展改革委国家信息中心数据显示，三季度消费、外贸、投资等多项高频数据平稳向好，经济稳中有进。
articles.summary_en: Data from the State Information Center under the National Development and Reform Commission show that in the third quarter, high-frequency indicators in consumption, trade and investment all improved steadily, pointing to a stable and upgrading Chinese economy.

articles.title_zh: 打造现代物流体系 更好服务实体经济
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Symposium on Building a Modern Logistics System
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，江苏省长刘小涛主持召开今年第十期政企恳谈会，围绕加快构建现代物流体系、推动产业高质量发展听取企业和行业协会意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired the province's tenth government-enterprise symposium this year, hearing from logistics firms and industry bodies on building a modern logistics system.

articles.title_zh: 三峡水运新通道葛洲坝航运扩能主体工程开工
articles.title_en: Main Works of Gezhouba Navigation Expansion Under Three Gorges New Waterway Channel Begin
articles.summary_zh: 10日上午，三峡水运新通道葛洲坝航运扩能上下游围堰正式启动施工，标志着该工程全面进入主体施工阶段。工程将拆除既有三号船闸，原址新建两座万吨级船闸。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 10, cofferdam construction began for the Gezhouba navigation expansion, part of the Three Gorges New Waterway Channel, marking the start of main works. The project will replace the existing No. 3 ship lock with two new 10,000-tonne-class locks.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：持续攻坚确保完成全年改革任务 把准方向谋深谋实明年改革工作
articles.title_en: Wang Hao: Sustain the Push to Complete This Year's Reform Tasks and Set a Clear Direction for Next Year's Reform Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日上午，浙江省委全面深化改革委员会第二十次会议暨高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区推进例会在杭州召开，省委书记王浩主持并讲话，部署四季度改革攻坚、谋划明年改革工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 10, the 20th meeting of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee for Deepening Reform, held together with a meeting on building the common prosperity demonstration zone, took place in Hangzhou, where Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao urged finishing this year's reform tasks and planning next year's reform agenda.

articles.title_zh: 中国国防部：日本“新型军国主义”这头灰犀牛正在变异失控
articles.title_en: China's Defense Ministry: Japan's "New Militarism" Gray Rhino Is Mutating Out of Control

articles.summary_en: China's State Information Center under the National Development and Reform Commission released leading indicators on Oct 10 showing continued growth in offline consumption, foreign trade and new infrastructure investment, consolidating the economic recovery.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰范德繁带队拜访省工业和信息化厅 推动汕尾产业强链条促转型增效益
articles.title_en: Lu Feng and Fan Defan Lead Delegation to Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology to Boost Shanwei's Industrial Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，汕尾市委书记逯峰、市长范德繁带队拜访广东省工业和信息化厅，与厅长曾进泽座谈，就落实全省先进制造业大会部署、推动汕尾先进制造业高质量发展深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng and Mayor Fan Defan visited Guangdong's Industry and Information Technology Department to discuss advancing Shanwei's advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 李国强主持召开泰安市人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Chairs Tai'an Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，泰安市市长李国强主持召开市政府常务会议，研究部署森林防灭火、大气污染防治及秸秆禁烧、具身智能机器人产业发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang chaired an executive meeting of the municipal government to discuss forest fire prevention, air pollution control and straw burning bans, and the development of the embodied AI robotics industry.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬调研泰州早茶产业高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects High-Quality Development of Taizhou Morning Tea Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到海陵区调研泰州早茶产业高质量发展工作，强调打造特色富民产业、做强全产业链。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong inspected the morning tea industry in Hailing District, urging standardization, brand building and talent training to develop it into a signature people-enriching industry.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市委常委会会议暨市委理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting and Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，泰州市委常委会会议暨市委理论学习中心组学习会召开，市委书记姜冬冬主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，深入学习《习近平文化文选》和《中国共产党思想政治工作条例》并部署深化落实。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Taizhou's municipal Party committee held a standing committee meeting and theoretical study session, chaired by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong, to study Xi Jinping's speeches and related regulations and deploy implementation work.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市委常委会会议暨市委理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting and Theoretical Study Session Convened
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬主持市委常委会会议暨市委理论学习中心组学习会，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神并部署落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong chaired the municipal Party committee standing committee meeting and a theoretical study session on implementing Xi Jinping's remarks.

articles.title_zh: 徐志调研新兴领域党建工作
articles.title_en: Xu Zhi Surveys Party Building Work in Emerging Sectors
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，芜湖市委书记徐志调研新兴领域党建工作，走访制造业企业和社工服务机构，并到镜湖区新就业群体党群服务中心与外卖员交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Wuhu Party Secretary Xu Zhi surveyed Party building work in emerging sectors, visiting a manufacturing firm, a social work agency and a service center for new employment groups in Jinghu District.

articles.title_zh: 国家发展改革委有关负责同志就《关于发展新质生产力的意见》答记者问
articles.title_en: NDRC Officials Answer Reporters' Questions on the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央、国务院印发《关于发展新质生产力的意见》，国家发展改革委有关负责同志就该文件接受采访，围绕科技创新、全面实施“人工智能+”行动、能源革命、体制机制与人才改革等答记者问。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces, and NDRC officials answered reporters' questions on the document, covering sci-tech innovation, the AI Plus initiative, the energy revolution and related reforms.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平到东台宣讲市第九次党代会精神并调研
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Visits Dongtai to Promote the Spirit of the Municipal Party Congress and Conduct Field Research
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，盐城市委书记严汉平到东台宣讲市第九次党代会精神，并深入村庄、企业调研乡村振兴、产业发展与生态文旅工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping visited Dongtai to promote the spirit of the city's 9th Party Congress and inspect rural revitalization, industry and eco-tourism.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市政府党组（扩大）会议召开 研究平安盐城建设与秋粮生产
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Government Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting on Safe Yancheng and Autumn Grain Production
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日下午，盐城市政府党组书记、代市长吴炜主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署平安盐城建设、扫黑除恶、安全生产及秋粮收获等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 9, Wu Wei, Party Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Government Party Group and acting mayor, chaired an expanded meeting to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's directives and arrange work on safe Yancheng construction, anti-crime efforts, workplace safety and autumn grain harvest.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开扩大会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话、重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Yantai Municipal Party Committee Holds Expanded Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speeches and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日下午，烟台市委常委会召开扩大会议，市委书记江成主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神及省委主要领导来烟台调研座谈要求，部署经济运行、黄金产业高质量发展与平安烟台建设。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 10, the Yantai Municipal Party Committee held an expanded meeting chaired by Party Secretary Jiang Cheng to convey Xi Jinping's speeches and provincial leaders' research requirements, and to deploy work on the economy, the gold industry and public security.

tags.name_en: High-Quality Development of the Gold Industry

tags_en: High-Quality Development of the Gold Industry

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉督导调研第47届世界葡萄与葡萄酒大会暨中国（宁夏）国际葡萄酒文化旅游博览会筹备情况
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Preparations for World Grape and Wine Congress in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，银川市委书记赵旭辉督导调研第47届世界葡萄与葡萄酒大会暨第六届中国（宁夏）国际葡萄酒文化旅游博览会筹备工作，要求统筹高水平安全、高标准组织、高质量服务。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui inspected preparations for the 47th World Grape and Wine Congress and the 6th China (Ningxia) International Wine Culture and Tourism Expo, urging high-standard security and service.

articles.title_zh: 李军到市人大常委会、市政协机关走访调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Li Jun Visits Municipal People's Congress and CPPCC Organs, Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，营口市委书记李军到市人大常委会、市政协机关走访调研并召开座谈会，看望机关干部并听取意见建议，强调凝聚各方力量推动营口全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, Yingkou Party Secretary Li Jun visited the municipal People's Congress and CPPCC organs, met with staff and held a symposium, urging all sides to unite behind high-quality development and Yingkou's comprehensive revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市政府常务会议研究贯彻民营经济促进法
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal Government Executive Meeting Studies Implementation of Private Economy Promotion Law
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日上午，湛江市市长李勇毅主持召开十五届市政府第136次常务会议，传达学习《中华人民共和国民营经济促进法》并研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 8, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired the 136th executive meeting of the 15th Municipal Government, conveying and studying the Private Economy Promotion Law and discussing implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 黄坤明：向先进制造全面进军，勇立潮头，走在前列
articles.title_en: Huang Kunming: Guangdong to Make a Full Advance into Advanced Manufacturing, Ride the Tide and Lead the Way
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，广东全省先进制造业大会在广州召开，省委书记黄坤明出席并讲话，部署制造强省建设与先进制造业高质量发展，省长孟凡利主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Guangdong held a provincial conference on advanced manufacturing in Guangzhou. Party Secretary Huang Kunming called for a full advance into advanced manufacturing to build a strong manufacturing province, with Governor Meng Fanli presiding.

articles.title_zh: 第七届中国人工智能大赛启动报名 10月18日截止
articles.title_en: 7th China AI Competition Opens Registration, Deadline October 18
articles.summary_zh: 第七届中国人工智能大赛正式启动报名，由国家互联网信息办公室、公安部指导、厦门市人民政府主办，聚焦大模型、具身智能、智能体三大方向，报名10月18日截止。
articles.summary_en: The 7th China Artificial Intelligence Competition has opened registration, guided by the Cyberspace Administration of China and the Ministry of Public Security and hosted by the Xiamen municipal government, covering large models, embodied intelligence and AI agents. Registration closes on October 18.

tags_zh: 国家互联网信息办公室

articles.title_zh: 第二十届全国半导体与集成技术会议在青岛开幕
articles.title_en: 20th National Conference on Semiconductors and Integration Technology Opens in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，第二十届全国半导体与集成技术会议在青岛西海岸新区开幕，省委常委、青岛市委书记曾赞荣与中国工程院院士、山东大学校长李术才出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 20th National Conference on Semiconductors and Integration Technology opened on Oct 10 in Qingdao's West Coast New Area, with Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong and Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Li Shucai delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委常委会召开会议 研究就业、教育领域“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets on Employment and Education Plans for the 15th Five-Year Period
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日下午，山东省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，审议山东省就业优先战略和教育事业发展“十五五”规划等事项，省委书记林武主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 10, the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee met to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important remarks and to review the province's 15th Five-Year Plans on employment priority and education development. Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu chaired the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Adapting to Local Conditions to Advance High-Quality Development of County Economies
articles.summary_zh: 报道称，各地因地制宜发展特色县域经济，贵州雷山文旅、江苏昆山人工智能产业、青海大通冷凉蔬菜成为富民强县新增长点。
articles.summary_en: Localities are developing distinctive county economies based on their own resources, from tourism in Leishan, Guizhou to AI in Kunshan and cold-climate vegetables in Datong, Qinghai.

articles.title_zh: 从源头和底层破题 夯实科技强国根基
articles.title_en: Breaking Ground at the Source: Strengthening the Foundations of a Science and Technology Power
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”开局之年，我国加大基础研究投入与统筹布局，多部门协同攻关，在极宏观、极微观、极端条件等领域取得新突破，为高质量发展提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: In the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China is boosting basic research with coordinated government efforts, yielding breakthroughs that support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 王浩主持召开浙江省委全面深化改革委员会第二十次会议
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Chairs 20th Meeting of Zhejiang Provincial Committee for Deepening Reform
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日上午，浙江省委书记王浩在杭州主持召开省委全面深化改革委员会第二十次会议暨高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区推进例会，部署四季度改革攻坚和明年改革谋划。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 10, Zhejiang Party Secretary Wang Hao chaired in Hangzhou the 20th meeting of the provincial committee for deepening reform and a progress meeting on building the common prosperity demonstration zone, urging fourth-quarter reform breakthroughs and planning for next year.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组第105次会议暨省政府第128次常务会议召开 刘捷主持
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Zhejiang Provincial Government Party Group Meeting and 128th Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日下午，浙江省长刘捷主持召开省政府党组第105次会议暨第128次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取前三季度经济运行汇报并研究谋划四季度经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 10, Zhejiang Governor Liu Jie chaired the provincial government's Party group meeting and 128th executive meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's remarks and planning fourth-quarter economic work.

articles.title_zh: 江苏九部门发文，联合推动电梯安全再升级
articles.title_en: Nine Jiangsu Departments Issue Joint Notice to Upgrade Elevator Safety
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省市场监督管理局等九部门联合下发通知，从电梯制造、采购、使用、维保、检验检测等环节推出措施，推动电梯行业从拼低价转向拼质量、拼安全、拼服务。
articles.summary_en: Nine Jiangsu departments jointly issued a notice with measures covering elevator manufacturing, procurement, use, maintenance, inspection and testing, shifting the industry from price wars to quality, safety and service.

articles.title_zh: 杨振宁数学与基础物理研究所揭牌仪式在合肥举行，翁帆出席并发言
articles.title_en: Yang Zhenning Institute of Mathematics and Fundamental Physics Unveiled in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，杨振宁数学与基础物理研究所揭牌活动在合肥举行，安徽省委书记李乐成出席，省委副书记、代省长王东伟致辞，翁帆及多位院士致辞。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, the Yang Zhenning Institute of Mathematics and Fundamental Physics was unveiled in Hefei, with Anhui Party Secretary Li Lecheng attending and acting Governor Wang Dongwei delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省纪念红军长征三大主力会宁会师90周年座谈会举行
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Holds Symposium Marking 90th Anniversary of the Red Army's Huining Rendezvous
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，甘肃省纪念红军长征三大主力会宁会师90周年座谈会在白银市会宁县举行，省委书记吴晓军出席并讲话，与会者向红军英烈敬献花篮并参观红军长征胜利纪念馆。
articles.summary_en: On October 10, Gansu Province held a symposium in Huining County, Baiyin City, marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's three main forces' rendezvous; Provincial Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun attended and spoke, and participants laid flower baskets and visited the Long March Victory Memorial Hall.

articles.title_zh: 巴布亚新几内亚潘古党全国总书记：一个中国原则是众多岛国同中国建交的根基
articles.title_en: PNG Pangu Party General Secretary: One-China Principle Is the Foundation of Island States' Ties with China
articles.summary_zh: 中国—太平洋岛国政党对话会期间，巴布亚新几内亚潘古党全国总书记托维贝接受采访，强调一个中国原则，并提议加强气候韧性、经济协同与人文交流三大支柱合作。
articles.summary_en: During the China-Pacific Island Countries Political Parties Dialogue, Pangu Party General Secretary Morris Tovebabe reaffirmed the one-China principle and proposed three pillars of cooperation: climate resilience, economic synergy and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 合肥市区级公共排水设施移交签约工作顺利完成
articles.title_en: Hefei Completes Signing for Transfer of District-Level Public Drainage Facilities
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，合肥高新技术产业开发区与合肥水务集团签订公共排水设施移交委托运维管理协议，标志着合肥市区级公共排水设施移交签约工作全部完成。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, the Hefei High-tech Industrial Development Zone and Hefei Water Group signed an agreement transferring operation and maintenance of public drainage facilities, completing the transfer signing for all district-level drainage facilities in Hefei.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇接听市民来电并调研数智赋能基层工作
articles.title_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong Takes Citizen Calls, Inspects Digital Empowerment of Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 日前，北京市委副书记、市长殷勇在市市民热线服务中心接听市民来电，并赴丰台区调研数智赋能基层工作，强调深化接诉即办改革，以数智赋能推动超大城市治理现代化。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong recently took citizen calls at the city's 12345 hotline center and inspected AI-powered digital empowerment of grassroots governance in Fengtai District, calling for deeper reform of the immediate-response system.

articles.title_zh: 财政部下达5500亿元地方政府债务结存限额
articles.title_en: Ministry of Finance Allocates 550 Billion Yuan in Local Government Debt Balance Limits
articles.summary_zh: 财政部近日安排使用地方政府债务结存限额5500亿元，其中一般债务3000亿元全部分配县区，专项债务2500亿元支持地方扩大有效投资。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Finance has allocated 550 billion yuan in local government debt balance limits, with 300 billion yuan in general debt going to counties and districts and 250 billion yuan in special debt supporting expanded effective investment.

articles.title_zh: 检验检测，为经济发展添动能
articles.title_en: Inspection and Testing Adds Momentum to Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 截至2025年底，我国获资质认定的检验检测机构达54340家，全年出具报告5.71亿份；市场监管总局推动产业优化升级、打假清源和国际互认。
articles.summary_en: China had 54,340 accredited inspection and testing bodies issuing 571 million reports in 2025, as regulators push industry upgrading, fraud crackdowns and global mutual recognition.

articles.title_zh: 零售行业智能体征集启动，金台圆桌交流会共探零售产业创新路径
articles.title_en: Retail AI Agent Solicitation Launched as Jintai Roundtable Explores Innovation in Retail
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，人民网财经研究院与人民网河北频道联合举办金台圆桌交流会，探讨AI驱动零售升级，并启动零售行业智能体征集活动。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 10, the finance research institute and Hebei channel of People's Daily Online co-hosted a Jintai Roundtable on AI-driven retail upgrading and launched a nationwide solicitation of retail AI agent solutions.

articles.title_zh: 串串光伏创新技术项目在海口启动运营
articles.title_en: Innovative String PV Project Starts Commercial Operation in Haikou
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，具备错峰发电能力的串串光伏创新技术项目在海口落成并启动商业化运营，采用垂直悬空架设方式实现不占地发电。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, an innovative "string PV" project with off-peak power generation capability was completed and began commercial operation in Haikou, using vertically suspended panels to generate power without occupying land.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲：深化“人工智能＋”政务应用 更好服务经济社会高质量发展
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling: Deepen "AI Plus" Government Applications to Better Serve High-Quality Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月10日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲到省数字政府运营中心调研空间地理数据共享平台、政府合同监督管理平台运行情况，并主持召开会议部署“人工智能＋”政务深化应用工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 10, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling inspected the provincial digital government operations center and chaired a meeting to deploy deeper "AI Plus" government applications.

articles.title_zh: 任珠峰在萍乡市调研 强调立足特色优势推动产业转型升级
articles.title_en: Ren Zhufeng Inspects Pingxiang, Urges Industrial Transformation and Upgrading

articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Education and Ministry of Finance issued a notice to implement the 2026 Silver Age Teaching Program, recruiting 6,000 retired teachers for underdeveloped counties.

articles.summary_en: On October 8, Ankang Municipal Party Committee Secretary Ke Changwan chaired a standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent remarks and to plan audit rectification, follow-up support for relocated residents and education development.

articles.title_zh: 中老铁路累计进出口货值突破1000亿元
articles.title_en: China-Laos Railway Cumulative Import-Export Value Tops 100 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 截至10月7日，中老铁路国际货运列车累计开行超2.5万列，进出口货物超2077万吨、货值超1004亿元，规模年均增长超24%。
articles.summary_en: As of Oct 7, the China-Laos Railway has operated over 25,000 international freight trains, carrying more than 20.77 million tonnes of goods worth over 100.4 billion yuan, with annual growth of over 24 percent.

articles.title_zh: 增值税发票数据显示：国庆假期服务消费态势良好
articles.title_en: VAT Invoice Data Shows Robust Service Consumption During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 国家税务总局10月8日发布增值税发票数据，今年国庆假期全国服务消费旺盛，相关行业日均销售收入同比增长19.5%，旅游、餐饮、家电数码等消费增幅明显。
articles.summary_en: The State Taxation Administration released VAT invoice data on Oct 8 showing average daily revenue of service consumption industries rose 19.5% year-on-year during the National Day holiday, with tourism, dining and electronics sales growing strongly.

articles.summary_en: On October 9, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued opinions on developing new quality productive forces, calling for innovation-led industrial upgrading and measures including an "AI Plus" initiative, institutional reform and talent development.

articles.title_zh: 铁路中秋国庆假期运输期间发送旅客超3亿人次

articles.summary_en: China's railways carried 302 million passengers and 192 million tons of freight during the Sept 23-Oct 8 holiday travel period, up 24.6% and 5.0% year on year.

articles.summary_en: On October 9, China's Ministry of Finance allocated 550 billion yuan of local government debt carryover quota to strengthen county-level fiscal capacity and support expanded effective investment.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰会见欧盟委员会贸易和经济安全委员谢夫乔维奇

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 9, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met in Beijing with EU Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security Maroš Šefčovič to exchange views on China-EU economic and trade relations.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟在丹东调研县域经济发展
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Conducts Research Tour in Dandong on County-Level Economy

articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei toured Dandong, visiting local firms and calling for tailored leading industries and stronger specialty sectors to boost high-quality county-level economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 王兵在定西市调研时强调：锚定全年目标精准发力，推动经济运行向新向优
articles.title_en: Wang Bing Inspects Dingxi, Urges Focused Efforts to Hit Annual Targets and Improve Economic Performance
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，甘肃省委常委、副省长王兵在定西市调研经济运行、重大项目建设、产业发展和债务风险防范工作，并主持召开经济运行调研座谈会。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Wang Bing, Standing Committee member of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee and Vice Governor, inspected Dingxi City on economic operations, major projects, industrial development and debt risk prevention, and chaired a symposium on the local economy.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开推进服务业扩能提质专题协商座谈会
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Consultative Symposium on Expanding and Upgrading the Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开推进服务业扩能提质专题协商座谈会，听取各民主党派和无党派人士代表关于服务业发展的意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, Dingxi Party Secretary Wang Shangxue chaired a consultative symposium on expanding and upgrading the service industry, hearing suggestions from democratic parties and non-party representatives.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在沈阳调研城市更新工作
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects Urban Renewal Work in Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，辽宁省委书记许昆林到沈阳市调研城市更新工作，强调高标准推进城市更新和“好房子”建设，稳定房地产市场。省委副书记、沈阳市委书记霍步刚参加。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin inspected urban renewal work in Shenyang, urging high-standard urban renewal and "good housing" construction to stabilize the real estate market. Huo Bugang, deputy party secretary and Shenyang party secretary, accompanied him.

articles.title_zh: “探索浩瀚宇宙，发展航天事业”——习近平总书记重要论述引领加快建设航天强国
articles.title_en: "Exploring the Vast Universe, Developing the Space Industry": Xi Jinping's Important Expositions Guide Building China into a Space Power
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月8日播发综述，在中国航天事业创建70周年之际，梳理习近平总书记自党的十八大以来关于航天强国建设的重要论述，回顾探月、深空探测等重大工程进展。
articles.summary_en: In a review published on Oct 8, Xinhua traced Xi Jinping's expositions on building China into a space power, marking 70 years of China's space program and reviewing lunar, deep-space and international cooperation progress.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱督导检查第三轮中央生态环境保护督察反馈问题整改工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects Rectification of Issues Flagged by Third Round Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱督导检查第三轮中央生态环境保护督察反馈问题整改工作，实地查看污水处理厂、选煤厂、矿井水深度处理及侵蚀沟治理现场。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu inspected rectification work for issues flagged by the third round of central ecological and environmental protection inspections, visiting sewage, coal washing, mine water and gully treatment sites.

articles.title_zh: 鹤岗市市长邓维元调研文体旅产业发展情况
articles.title_en: Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan Inspects Culture, Sports and Tourism Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元调研全民健身中心、冰花瓷基地、气象园区等地，部署推动文体旅产业融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, Deng Weiyuan, Mayor of Hegang, inspected sports venues, the ice-flower porcelain base and a meteorological park, vowing to boost the integrated culture, sports and tourism industry.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研淮安经济技术开发区高质量发展
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Economic Development Zone on High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，淮安市委书记顾坤调研淮安经济技术开发区高质量发展，走访企业并召开座谈会，部署新型工业化与营商环境建设。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected the Huai'an Economic and Technological Development Zone, visiting firms and chairing a forum to press for new industrialization and a better business environment.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦调研段园新型功能区建设发展工作

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 9, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi inspected the Duanyuan New Functional Zone, urging it to seize Yangtze River Delta integration opportunities and become a bridgehead for linking with Xuzhou and the delta.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖：拿出“决战决胜”的勇气魄力 坚决打赢创建全国文明城市攻坚战
articles.title_en: Wei Chaohui Urges Decisive Push to Win Huaihua's Campaign for National Civilized City Status
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，怀化市召开创建全国文明城市工作推进会，市委书记韦朝晖出席并讲话，部署点位整改、设施补短、品牌打造和民生微实事等创文攻坚任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 8, Huaihua City held a meeting to advance its campaign for National Civilized City status, with Party Secretary Wei Chaohui speaking on rectifying key sites, upgrading infrastructure and delivering livelihood projects.

articles.title_zh: 淮南市委常委会召开会议 朱艾勇主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Huainan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Chaired by Zhu Aiyong
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日上午，淮南市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻9月21日中共中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记在国庆77周年招待会上的重要讲话精神，市委书记朱艾勇主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 8, the Huainan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study the spirit of the September 21 CPC Politburo meeting and Xi Jinping's speech at the reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PRC. Municipal Party Secretary Zhu Aiyong chaired the meeting and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市委常委会召开会议 部署先进制造业发展与乡村振兴
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Advanced Manufacturing and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习全国先进制造业大会精神和省委政协工作会议精神，研究部署产业强市、乡村振兴及政协等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 8, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to convey the spirit of the National Advanced Manufacturing Conference and the provincial CPPCC work conference, and to plan industrial upgrading, rural revitalization and CPPCC work.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市委常委会召开会议 研究部署贯彻落实工作
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Policy Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习全国先进制造业大会精神和省委政协工作会议精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 8, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao chaired a municipal standing committee meeting to convey national advanced manufacturing and provincial CPPCC work conference directives and plan implementation.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升调研基层综治中心并主持召开西藏自治区党委政法委干部大会

articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨调研基层综治中心建设运行，并主持自治区党委政法委干部大会，宣布何录春任自治区党委副书记、政法委书记。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected grassroots dispute-resolution centers in Lhasa and announced He Luchun as the region's new deputy Party secretary and political-legal affairs chief.

articles.title_zh: 国务院批复《国家残疾预防行动计划（2026—2030年）》

articles.summary_en: The State Council approved in principle the National Disability Prevention Action Plan (2026-2030), ordering provincial governments to implement it as a key task of the 15th Five-Year Plan period and to strengthen prevention across the whole population and life cycle.
