articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议 赵龙主持并研究贯彻落实措施
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting Chaired by Zhao Long
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，福建省委书记赵龙主持召开省委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，部署推进平安福建建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Fujian Party Secretary Zhao Long chaired a meeting of the provincial Party Standing Committee to study and implement Xi Jinping's directives and to advance the building of a safer Fujian.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要论述引领加快建设航天强国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Expositions Guide Accelerated Building of a Space Power
articles.summary_zh: 在中国航天事业创建70周年、“十五五”开局之际，习近平总书记围绕月球探测、深空探测等航天重大工程作出一系列重要论述，指引中国加快建设航天强国。
articles.summary_en: Marking 70 years of China's space program and the start of the 15th Five-Year Plan, Xi Jinping's expositions on lunar and deep-space projects are guiding the country's accelerated drive to become a space power.

tags.name_en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

tags_en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到市委统战部调研
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Shantou Municipal United Front Work Department
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到市委统战部调研，听取侨务及各领域统战工作汇报，强调做好新时代“侨”的文章、凝聚力量推动汕头高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 8, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected the Municipal United Front Work Department, reviewing work on overseas Chinese affairs and urging stronger united front efforts to support Shantou's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市八届人大常委会第五十次会议召开
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 50th Session
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，汕尾市八届人大常委会召开第五十次会议，审议《汕尾市海岸线保护和利用条例（草案修改稿）》，并表决通过人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, the standing committee of Shanwei's 8th Municipal People's Congress held its 50th session, reviewing a revised draft regulation on coastline protection and use and approving personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会会议暨党委农村工作领导小组会议召开 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Ningxia Party Standing Committee and Rural Work Leading Group Meeting Held; Li Yifei Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，宁夏自治区党委书记李邑飞主持召开自治区党委常委会会议暨党委农村工作领导小组会议，研究平安宁夏建设、经济运行和“十五五”农业农村现代化等规划。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei chaired a meeting of the regional Party Standing Committee and its rural work leading group, reviewing the economy and 15th Five-Year Plan drafts.

articles.title_zh: 李晖检查节日文旅促消费和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Taizhou Mayor Li Hui Inspects Holiday Tourism Consumption and Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，泰州市市长李晖在兴化市检查国庆假期文旅促消费和安全生产工作，要求放大“河蟹第一县”品牌效应并排查整治安全隐患。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui inspected holiday cultural tourism consumption promotion and safety production in Xinghua, urging stronger hazard checks and more tourism-driven spending.

articles.title_zh: 威海市委政协工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Weihai Municipal Committee Holds CPPCC Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，威海市委政协工作会议召开，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，总结政协工作成绩并部署下步重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Weihai held a municipal Party committee work conference on the CPPCC, at which Party Secretary Zhang Haibo spoke and laid out key tasks for the next stage.

articles.title_zh: 芜湖市委常委会召开会议研究部署当前工作
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Deploy Current Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，芜湖市委常委会召开会议，市委书记徐志主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话指示精神，传达学习省委书记李乐成来芜调研讲话精神，研究部署当前工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, the Standing Committee of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee met under Secretary Xu Zhi to study recent directives and convey the provincial party secretary's remarks from his Wuhu inspection, deploying current work.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋到市纪委监委机关调研
articles.title_en: Jiang Feng Visits Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，无锡市委书记蒋锋到市纪委监委机关调研，看望慰问纪检监察干部并主持召开座谈会，要求推动纪检监察工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Wuxi Party Secretary Jiang Feng inspected the Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision and chaired a symposium, urging high-quality discipline inspection and supervision work.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在西安调研重点项目建设情况 强调提升服务质效强化要素保障
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Key Projects in Xi'an, Urging Better Services and Stronger Factor Support
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰到高新区、西咸新区、浐灞国际港调研重点项目建设，要求提升服务质效、强化要素保障、加快项目开工建设。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Hao Huijie, Shaanxi provincial standing committee member and Xi'an party secretary, inspected key projects in Xi'an's high-tech zone, Xixian New Area and Chanba International Port, urging faster construction and better services.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神 信长星主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Recent Remarks, Chaired by Xin Changxing
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，江苏省委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究统筹发展和安全、加快建设更高水平平安江苏等工作，省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee met to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions, focusing on coordinating development and security and building a higher-level Safe Jiangsu. Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing chaired the meeting and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平专题研究盐城工学院和盐城师范学院有关工作
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Chairs Meeting on Work of Yancheng Institute of Technology and Yancheng Normal University
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，盐城市委书记严汉平专题研究盐城工学院、盐城师范学院工作，强调集聚各方资源，加快建设高水平应用型大学。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping chaired a meeting on the work of Yancheng Institute of Technology and Yancheng Normal University, urging pooled resources to build high-level applied universities.

articles.title_zh: 信长星主持召开江苏省委全面深化改革委员会会议
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Chairs Jiangsu Provincial Committee Meeting on Comprehensively Deepening Reform
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，江苏省委书记信长星主持召开省委全面深化改革委员会会议，听取重点改革任务推进情况，部署下一阶段改革工作，省长刘小涛、省政协主席张义珍出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing chaired a meeting of the provincial committee for comprehensively deepening reform, reviewing progress on key reform tasks and planning the next stage of work; Governor Liu Xiaotao and CPPCC Chair Zhang Yizhen attended.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会机关召开传达学习市第十四次党代会精神大会
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Spirit of 14th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，营口市人大常委会机关召开传达学习市第十四次党代会精神大会，市人大常委会主任史卫东主持并讲话，部署立法、监督和换届选举等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Yingkou's Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee met to study the spirit of the city's 14th Party Congress; director Shi Weidong presided and set out legislative, oversight and election tasks.

articles.title_zh: 营口市委常委会召开会议学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on Implementing Xi Jinping's Key Directives
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，营口市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记对辽宁振兴发展的重要讲话精神及9月21日中央政治局会议精神，部署党建、三农、公安和先进制造业工作。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, the Yingkou Municipal Party Standing Committee met to implement Xi Jinping's directives on Liaoning's revitalization and the Sept 21 Politburo meeting, covering Party building, agriculture, public security and advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开专题会议研究基层社会治理工作
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Special Meeting on Grassroots Social Governance
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开专题会议，研究基层社会治理工作，部署体系化建设、资源下沉和试点推进。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Xie Weijiang, Hunan deputy party secretary and Yueyang party secretary, chaired a special meeting on grassroots social governance, urging stronger local foundations and pilot reform.

tags.name_en: Yueyang Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China

tags_en: Yueyang Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江与北京岳阳商会和京津冀等地企业家一行座谈
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Holds Symposium with Beijing Yueyang Chamber of Commerce and Entrepreneurs from Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江与北京岳阳商会及京津冀等地企业家座谈，希望企业用好岳阳区位、政策、生态、成本优势，深化合作共赢。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, met with the Beijing Yueyang Chamber of Commerce and entrepreneurs from Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, urging them to leverage Yueyang's location, policy, ecology and cost advantages for deeper win-win cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组2026年第13次（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal Government Party Group Holds 13th (Expanded) Meeting of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，湛江市市长李勇毅主持召开市政府党组扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记致农民的节日祝贺精神，部署粮食安全、防返贫与和美乡村建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired an expanded meeting of the municipal government Party group, conveying Xi Jinping's festive greetings to farmers and outlining food security, poverty-relapse prevention and rural development tasks.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅主持召开环北广东工程二期建设推进会
articles.title_en: Li Yongyi Chairs Meeting on Advancing Phase II of the Huanbei Guangdong Water Project
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，湛江市委副书记、市长李勇毅主持召开环北广东工程二期建设推进会，部署雷州半岛灌区等重大水利工程重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 8, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired a meeting to advance Phase II of the Huanbei Guangdong Water Project, deploying key tasks for the Leizhou Peninsula irrigation district and other major water works.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开全市爱国卫生运动暨蚊媒传染病防控工作会议
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Zhuhai Meeting on Patriotic Health Campaign and Mosquito-Borne Disease Control
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，珠海市市长吴泽桐主持召开全市爱国卫生运动暨蚊媒传染病防控工作会议，对节后疫情防控工作进行再研判、再部署、再落实。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong chaired a citywide meeting on the patriotic health campaign and mosquito-borne disease control, redeploying prevention measures after the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 山东省召开黄金产业高质量发展专题会议
articles.title_en: Shandong Province Holds Special Meeting on High-Quality Development of Gold Industry
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，山东省黄金产业高质量发展专题会议在烟台召开，省委书记林武主持并讲话，部署深挖产能潜力、推动产业升级，巩固全国黄金产业“压舱石”地位。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, Shandong Province held a special meeting in Yantai on the high-quality development of its gold industry. Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu chaired the meeting and urged tapping production capacity, upgrading the industry and consolidating Shandong's role as China's largest gold-producing base.

articles.title_zh: 福州市政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，福州市长吴贤德主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，学习贯彻中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired municipal government Party group and executive meetings to study the Political Bureau meeting and Xi Jinping's speeches and plan implementation.

articles.title_zh: “人工智能+民航”迈向规模化落地
articles.title_en: China's "AI Plus Civil Aviation" Drive Moves Toward Large-Scale Deployment
articles.summary_zh: 在第四届中国航协航空大会上，中国民航局副局长韩钧表示，“人工智能+民航”将坚守安全底线、聚焦场景落地，推动人工智能从概念探索转向规模化应用。
articles.summary_en: At the 4th CATA Aviation Conference, CAAC Deputy Administrator Han Jun said China will move "AI plus civil aviation" from pilot exploration to large-scale application, guided by the 2025 implementation guidelines.

articles.title_zh: 济南市委书记刘强调研“三秋”生产 强调守牢粮食安全底线
articles.title_en: Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang Inspects Autumn Harvest Work, Stresses Food Security
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，济南市委书记刘强到长清区调研“三秋”生产，实地察看秋收现场与高标准农田建设，强调抢抓农时、保障秋粮丰产丰收，守牢粮食安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang inspected autumn harvest work in Changqing District, visiting fields and high-standard farmland projects and urging timely harvesting to secure grain output and food security.

articles.title_zh: 外交部批日本数据“投毒”歪曲侵略历史
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Condemns Japan's Data "Poisoning" Distortion of Aggression History
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月9日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京批评日本右翼势力利用新型技术进行数据“投毒”，歪曲美化侵略历史，为日本“再军事化”制造舆论，呼吁国际社会共同抵制。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning in Beijing accused Japanese right-wing forces of using new technology to "poison" data and distort the history of aggression, urging the international community to jointly resist such efforts.

articles.title_zh: 中国残联、中央宣传部等七部门联合实施新一轮国家手语和盲文规范化行动
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Including China Disabled Persons' Federation Launch New Round of Sign Language and Braille Standardization Action
articles.summary_zh: 中国残联、中央宣传部等七部门联合印发《第三期国家手语和盲文规范化行动计划（2026-2030年）》，系统部署“十五五”时期手语和盲文工作。
articles.summary_en: Seven Chinese departments led by the China Disabled Persons' Federation jointly issued the Third National Sign Language and Braille Standardization Action Plan (2026-2030).

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖主持召开省委理论学习中心组专题学习（扩大）会 强调加强民族宗教领域重大问题理解把握
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui Chairs Sichuan Party Committee Study Session on Ethnic and Religious Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，四川省委书记王晓晖主持召开省委理论学习中心组专题学习（扩大）会，深入学习习近平总书记关于民族宗教工作的重要论述，部署推动新时代四川民族宗教工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Sichuan Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui chaired a provincial Party Committee study session on ethnic and religious work, calling for high-quality development of such work in Sichuan in the new era.

tags_en: Sense of Community for the Chinese Nation

articles.title_zh: 央行为什么发布关于人民币汇率的政策立场
articles.title_en: Why the PBOC Issued a Policy Position on the RMB Exchange Rate
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，中国人民银行发布关于人民币汇率的政策立场，系统阐述有管理的浮动汇率制度，反对将汇率问题政治化和曲解IMF评估，并就全球失衡问题阐明三点关切。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 8, the People's Bank of China issued a policy position on the RMB exchange rate, rejecting politicization of currency issues and misuse of IMF assessments, and setting out three concerns on global imbalances.

articles.title_zh: 不忘红色来路，走好发展新路
articles.title_en: Keeping the Red Origins in Mind, Taking the New Road of Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者回访贵州遵义，重温习近平总书记2015年考察遵义会议会址和花茂村的场景，展现十余年间脱贫攻坚与乡村振兴带来的巨变。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua revisits Zunyi, Guizhou, recalling Xi Jinping's 2015 visit to the Zunyi Conference site and Huamao Village, and the decade of poverty alleviation and rural revitalization that followed.

articles.title_zh: 李乐成任安徽省委书记
articles.title_en: Li Lecheng Appointed Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，安徽省召开全省领导干部会议，宣布中央决定：李乐成同志任安徽省委委员、常委、书记。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Anhui Province held a provincial leadership meeting announcing the central leadership's decision to appoint Li Lecheng as a member, standing committee member and secretary of the Anhui Provincial Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省人大常委会决定王东伟代理省长职务
articles.title_en: Anhui Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Appoints Wang Dongwei as Acting Governor
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省第十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议决定，安徽省人民政府副省长王东伟代理省长职务。当地同时依托人民网“领导留言板”征集群众对安徽发展的意见建议。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th Anhui Provincial People's Congress decided at its 26th session that Vice Governor Wang Dongwei will serve as acting governor of Anhui Province. The province is also soliciting public suggestions for its development via an online message board.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议 部署平安福建建设等工作
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Standing Committee Meeting Deploys Work on Peaceful Fujian Construction
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，福建省委书记赵龙主持召开省委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，部署推进平安福建建设，并审议碳达峰行动方案等文件。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Fujian Party Secretary Zhao Long chaired a meeting of the provincial Party Standing Committee to implement Xi Jinping's directives, deploy work on building a higher-level Peaceful Fujian, and review carbon peaking and county economy plans.

articles.title_zh: 黄坤明到深圳调研 强调扎扎实实干好四季度夺取全年胜
articles.title_en: Huang Kunming Inspects Shenzhen, Urges Solid Work to Win the Fourth Quarter
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，广东省委书记黄坤明赴深圳调研皇岗口岸和腾讯公司，强调抓好四季度经济收官、加快人工智能产业发展并做好APEC会议筹备。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Guangdong Party Secretary Huang Kunming inspected Huanggang Port and Tencent's Shenzhen headquarters, urging solid work to close out the fourth quarter, faster AI industry growth and good APEC meeting preparations.

articles.title_zh: 吴晓军任甘肃省委书记 邀网友通过人民网领导留言板建言
articles.title_en: Wu Xiaojun Appointed Gansu Party Secretary, Invites Netizens' Suggestions via People's Daily Message Board
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，甘肃省召开领导干部会议宣布中央决定，吴晓军任甘肃省委委员、常委、书记；他通过人民网“领导留言板”向网友征集对甘肃发展的期盼与建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Gansu province announced the central decision appointing Wu Xiaojun as its new Party secretary; he is inviting netizens to share expectations and suggestions via the People's Daily leadership message board.

articles.title_zh: 广西自治区人大常委会召开面向东盟开放营商环境建设专题调研座谈会
articles.title_en: Guangxi People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Symposium on Business Environment for ASEAN Opening-Up
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，广西自治区人大常委会召开面向东盟开放的国际化法治化营商环境建设专题调研座谈会，自治区高级法院、检察院、发展改革委等单位汇报相关工作情况。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, the Standing Committee of the Guangxi Regional People's Congress held a symposium on building an internationalized, rule-of-law business environment for ASEAN opening-up, with the regional high court, procuratorate and development commission reporting on their work.

articles.title_zh: 王陆进代理河南省人民政府省长职务
articles.title_en: Wang Lujin Appointed Acting Governor of Henan Province
articles.summary_zh: 河南省第十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议决定，王陆进代理河南省人民政府省长职务。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress decided at its 26th session to appoint Wang Lujin as acting governor of Henan Province.

articles.title_zh: 新任河南省委书记周祖翼通过人民网领导留言板邀网友建言
articles.title_en: New Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi Invites Netizens to Share Expectations via People's Daily Online Message Board
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，河南省召开全省领导干部会议，宣布中央决定：周祖翼任河南省委委员、常委、书记。人民网“领导留言板”邀网友向其留言建言。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Henan announced the central decision appointing Zhou Zuyi as provincial Party secretary; People's Daily Online's message board invited netizens to send him suggestions.

articles.title_zh: 河北发布县域特色产业集群“揭榜挂帅”项目榜单
articles.title_en: Hebei Releases Open-Call Project List for County-Level Specialty Industry Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 河北省科技厅发布2026年度县域特色产业集群关键核心技术攻关“揭榜挂帅”项目榜单，布局14个攻关任务，面向国内外高校、科研院所和企业公开寻才，揭榜截止10月11日。
articles.summary_en: Hebei's Department of Science and Technology released its 2026 open-call project list for key technology breakthroughs in county-level specialty industry clusters, covering 14 research tasks and inviting universities, institutes and firms to bid by Oct 11.

tags.name_en: Hebei Provincial Department of Science and Technology

tags_en: Hebei Provincial Department of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 罗文调研走访河北省人大常委会机关和省政协机关
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Visits Hebei Provincial People's Congress and CPPCC Bodies
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，河北省委书记罗文到省人大常委会机关和省政协机关调研走访，强调围绕中心服务大局，推动人大和政协工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Hebei Party Secretary Luo Wen visited the provincial People's Congress and CPPCC offices, urging both bodies to serve the province's central work and advance high-quality development.

tags.name_en: Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial People's Congress

tags_en: Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial People's Congress

articles.title_zh: 海南多部门联合督导红树林保护区赶海违法行为整改
articles.title_en: Hainan Multi-Department Joint Task Force Supervises Rectification of Illegal Clam-Digging in Mangrove Nature Reserves
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日至8日，由海南省林业局、省生态环境厅、省农业农村厅及省政府督查室组成的省级联合工作组，在三亚市、陵水黎族自治县实地督导红树林自然保护区赶海违法行为整改整治工作。
articles.summary_en: From October 7 to 8, a provincial joint task force comprising Hainan's forestry, ecology and environment, and agriculture departments plus the provincial government inspection office supervised rectification of illegal clam-digging in mangrove nature reserves in Sanya and Lingshui Li Autonomous County.

articles.title_zh: 海南省与中国旅游集团举行工作会谈
articles.title_en: Hainan Province Holds Working Meeting with China Tourism Group
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，海南省委书记冯飞、省长刘小明在海口与中国旅游集团董事长石岱、总经理范云军举行工作会谈，商讨离岛免税、航天旅游等领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei and Governor Liu Xiaoming held a working meeting in Haikou with China Tourism Group Chairman Shi Dai and General Manager Fan Yunjun to discuss cooperation in offshore duty-free shopping and space tourism.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲主持召开黑龙江省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Chairs Executive Meeting of Heilongjiang Provincial Government
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府常务会议，部署高标准农田建设突出问题专项整治，研究赋予自贸试验区、哈尔滨新区省级行政权力事项，并审议通过残疾人保障和发展“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a provincial government executive meeting on a special campaign to fix problems in high-standard farmland construction, delegation of provincial administrative powers to the Heilongjiang Pilot Free Trade Zone and Harbin New Area, and the 15th Five-Year Plan for people with disabilities.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘在南昌调研传统产业发展 强调推动传统产业转型升级
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Inspects Traditional Industry Development in Nanchang, Urging Intelligent, Green and Integrated Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，江西省委书记尹弘赴南昌经开区、高新区专题调研传统产业发展，强调坚定不移推动传统产业智能化、绿色化、融合化转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Jiangxi Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong inspected traditional industry development in Nanchang, stressing unswerving efforts to upgrade traditional industries toward intelligent, green and integrated development.

articles.title_zh: 常态化帮扶接续发力
articles.title_en: Normalized Assistance Continues to Gain Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 2026年为常态化帮扶开局之年，全国256.2万防止返贫致贫对象已落实针对性帮扶措施，中央财政安排常态化帮扶资金1770亿元。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the first year of normalized assistance, all 2.562 million people at risk of falling back into poverty have received targeted support, backed by 177 billion yuan in central government funding.

articles.title_zh: 陈永奇：以高质效检察履职更好服务保障现代化江西建设
articles.title_en: Chen Yongqi Urges High-Quality Procuratorial Work to Support Jiangxi's Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，第十九次江西省检察工作会议在南昌召开，省委副书记、省委政法委书记陈永奇出席并讲话，要求以高质效检察履职服务保障现代化江西建设。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, the 19th Jiangxi Provincial Procuratorial Work Conference was held in Nanchang, where Chen Yongqi, deputy secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, called for high-quality procuratorial work to support the province's modernization.

articles.title_zh: 双节期间内蒙古各地举办促消费活动360余场
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Holds Over 360 Consumption Promotion Events During Holiday Period
articles.summary_zh: 中秋、国庆假期期间，内蒙古各级商务部门发放惠民消费券超1.3亿元，举办促消费活动360余场，累计带动消费超43亿元。
articles.summary_en: During the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, commerce departments across Inner Mongolia issued over 130 million yuan in consumer vouchers and held more than 360 promotion events, driving over 4.3 billion yuan in spending.

articles.title_zh: 包钢主持召开自治区人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Chairs Executive Meeting of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢主持召开政府常务会议，听取污染防治攻坚战和中央生态环保督察整改情况汇报，审议“十五五”生态环境保护等规划。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 8, Bao Gang, chairman of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region government, chaired an executive meeting to review pollution-control efforts and central environmental inspection rectification, and to deliberate the region's 15th Five-Year Plan for environmental protection.

articles.title_zh: 学习《习近平文化文选》第一卷、第二卷座谈会在京召开 李书磊出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Symposium on Studying Volumes I and II of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Culture Held in Beijing; Li Shulei Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，学习《习近平文化文选》第一卷、第二卷座谈会在北京召开，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并讲话。座谈会由中宣部举办。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, a symposium on studying Volumes I and II of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Culture was held in Beijing, attended by Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department. The symposium was organized by the Publicity Department.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见太平洋岛国政治家联合考察团
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Joint Delegation of Pacific Island Politicians
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅在北京会见以汤加副首相拉图为首的太平洋岛国政治家联合考察团，双方表示将加强政党交流合作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Wang Yi, member of the CPC Political Bureau and head of the Central Foreign Affairs Office, met in Beijing with a joint delegation of Pacific Island politicians led by Tonga's Deputy Prime Minister, with both sides pledging stronger party exchanges and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 青海新型电力系统研究中心组建成立
articles.title_en: Qinghai New-Type Power System Research Center Established
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，由国网青海省电力公司组建的青海新型电力系统研究中心正式成立，下设多类电源、负荷与储能、双碳发展3个研究室，服务青海新型电力系统省级示范区建设。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, the Qinghai New-Type Power System Research Center, established by State Grid Qinghai Electric Power Company, was officially launched with three research divisions covering power sources, load and storage, and dual-carbon development.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖主持召开四川省委专题会议 研究部署“三州”民族地区医疗卫生帮扶提升行动
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui Chairs Sichuan Provincial Party Committee Meeting on Medical Assistance for Ethnic Minority Areas
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，四川省委书记王晓晖主持召开省委专题会议，研究部署“三州”民族地区医疗卫生帮扶提升行动，省长施小琳讲话，省委副书记于立军出席。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Sichuan Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui chaired a provincial committee meeting to plan medical assistance for the "three prefectures" ethnic minority areas, with Governor Shi Xiaolin speaking and Yu Lijun attending.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛上海市总结大会举行，陈吉宁强调加快打造技能人才“上海高地”
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Stresses Building Shanghai into a Skills-Talent Highland at WorldSkills Shanghai Summary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，第48届世界技能大赛上海市总结大会举行，市委书记陈吉宁讲话，要求用好办赛成果、发扬办赛经验，加快打造技能人才“上海高地”。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai held a summary meeting on Oct 8 for the 48th WorldSkills Competition; Party Secretary Chen Jining urged the city to use the event's legacy to build a skills-talent highland and improve urban governance.

articles.title_zh: 十二届上海市委第九轮巡视启动，将对22家单位党组织开展常规巡视
articles.title_en: 12th Shanghai Municipal Party Committee Launches Ninth Round of Inspections Covering 22 Party Organizations
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，上海召开十二届市委第九轮巡视工作动员部署会，将对市纪委监委机关等22家单位党组织开展常规巡视，并对12家单位重点延伸了解。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Shanghai held a mobilization meeting for the ninth round of inspections by the 12th Municipal Party Committee, which will conduct routine inspections of Party organizations in 22 units and carry out extended scrutiny of 12 others.

articles.title_zh: 上海市委季度工作会议举行 陈吉宁主持部署四季度经济社会发展重点工作
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Chairs Shanghai Municipal Party Committee Quarterly Meeting on Fourth-Quarter Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，上海市委季度工作会议举行，市委书记陈吉宁主持并讲话，市长朱忠明部署四季度经济社会发展重点工作，要求全力冲刺全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 8, the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee held its quarterly work meeting, chaired by Party Secretary Chen Jining, with Mayor Zhu Zhongming outlining key fourth-quarter economic and social development tasks and calling for a full-year sprint to meet targets.

articles.title_zh: 在陕单位参编的2项网络安全国家标准获批发布
articles.title_en: Two National Cybersecurity Standards Co-Authored by Shaanxi Institution Approved for Release
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，据陕西省网络与信息安全测评中心消息，国家市场监督管理总局、国家标准化管理委员会批准发布由其参编的2项网络安全国家标准，将于2027年2月1日起实施。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, the Shaanxi Provincial Network and Information Security Evaluation Center announced that two national cybersecurity standards it co-authored were approved and released by China's market regulator and standards administration, taking effect on February 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 西安发布推进服务业扩能提质实施方案
articles.title_en: Xi'an Releases Plan to Expand and Upgrade Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 西安市政府近日发布《西安市推进服务业扩能提质实施方案》，明确到2030年服务业增加值达1.25万亿元、年均增速约5%。
articles.summary_en: The Xi'an municipal government released a plan to expand and upgrade its service industry, targeting 1.25 trillion yuan in service sector value added and about 5 percent annual growth by 2030.

tags.name_zh: 西安市发展和改革委员会

tags_zh: 西安市发展和改革委员会

articles.title_zh: 薛斌在草湖项目区调研时强调 以高质量规划引领高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xue Bin Stresses High-Quality Planning to Lead High-Quality Development During Caohu Project Area Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，自治区副主席、兵团党委副书记、司令员薛斌到草湖项目区调研规划建设、经济发展和民生保障工作，强调以高质量规划引领高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Xue Bin, vice chairman of Xinjiang and commander of the XPCC, inspected the Caohu project area, stressing that high-quality planning should lead high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升调研基层综治中心并主持西藏自治区党委政法委干部大会
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Local Governance Centers and Chairs Tibet Political and Legal Affairs Commission Cadre Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日上午，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨调研基层综治中心建设运行，并主持自治区党委政法委干部大会宣布何录春任自治区党委副书记、政法委书记，免去刘江相关职务。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 8, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected community governance centers in Lhasa and chaired a meeting announcing He Luchun as deputy party secretary and political and legal affairs commission secretary, replacing Liu Jiang.

articles.title_zh: 两部门发文稳妥有序推动内贸险扩大覆盖面
articles.title_en: Two Departments Issue Notice to Steadily Expand Coverage of Domestic Trade Credit Insurance
articles.summary_zh: 国家金融监督管理总局、商务部近日联合发布通知，明确9项重点任务，支持北京、江苏、四川等地加大内贸险实践探索力度，服务扩内需战略。
articles.summary_en: China's National Financial Regulatory Administration and Ministry of Commerce jointly issued a notice with nine key tasks to expand domestic trade credit insurance, backing pilot exploration in regions such as Beijing, Jiangsu and Sichuan.

tags.name_zh: 国家金融监督管理总局

tags_zh: 国家金融监督管理总局

articles.title_zh: 世贸组织上调2026年全球货物贸易增长预期
articles.title_en: WTO Raises 2026 Global Goods Trade Growth Forecast
articles.summary_zh: 世界贸易组织10月8日在日内瓦发布全球贸易展望报告，预计2026年全球货物贸易增长3.9%，高于3月预测的1.9%。
articles.summary_en: The WTO released its Global Trade Outlook report on October 8 in Geneva, raising its 2026 global goods trade growth forecast to 3.9% from 1.9%, citing supply chain shifts and strong AI investment.

articles.title_zh: 国务院国资委与中国科学院签署一批重大合作项目
articles.title_en: SASAC and Chinese Academy of Sciences Sign a Batch of Major Cooperation Projects
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，国务院国资委与中国科学院2026年度合作会商会议在北京举行，集中签署一批院企合作协议与所企重大合作项目。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 8, SASAC and the Chinese Academy of Sciences held their 2026 annual cooperation meeting in Beijing, signing a batch of institute-enterprise cooperation agreements and major projects.

tags_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council (SASAC)

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行发布关于人民币汇率的政策立场
articles.title_en: People's Bank of China Issues Policy Stance on the RMB Exchange Rate
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，中国人民银行在北京发布关于人民币汇率的政策立场，强调实施有管理的浮动汇率制度，中国无意通过汇率贬值获取贸易竞争优势。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, the People's Bank of China issued a policy stance on the RMB exchange rate, stressing a managed floating regime and stating that China has no intention of seeking trade advantage through currency depreciation.
keywords: 有管理的浮动汇率制度

articles.title_zh: 徐麟李炳军会见中信集团总经理张文武一行
articles.title_en: Xu Lin and Li Bingjun Meet with CITIC Group General Manager Zhang Wenwu
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，贵州省委书记徐麟、省长李炳军在贵阳会见中信集团总经理张文武一行，双方就深化综合金融、产业发展、基础设施建设等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Guizhou Party Secretary Xu Lin and Governor Li Bingjun met in Guiyang with Zhang Wenwu, general manager of CITIC Group, to discuss deeper cooperation in finance, industry and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期河南省新能源汽车充电量再创历史新高
articles.title_en: Henan NEV Charging Volume Hits Record High During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日至7日国庆假期，国网河南电力运营的电动汽车充电设施总充电量达1023万千瓦时，同比增长47.6%，创历史新高。
articles.summary_en: During the Oct 1-7 National Day holiday, EV charging facilities operated by State Grid Henan Electric Power delivered 10.23 million kWh, up 47.6% year on year, setting a record high.

articles.title_zh: 各省辖市工作汇报会召开 周祖翼主持并讲话 王陆进出席
articles.title_en: Provincial Meeting on Municipal Work Reports Held in Henan; Zhou Zuyi Presides and Speaks, Wang Lujin Attends
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，各省辖市工作汇报会在郑州召开，河南省委书记周祖翼主持并讲话，代省长王陆进出席，部署经济社会发展和党建工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Henan held a municipal work report meeting in Zhengzhou, chaired by Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi with acting Governor Wang Lujin attending, to set economic and Party-building tasks.

articles.title_zh: 南京市与南京大学共建上海（长三角）国际科技创新中心南京关键支点工作推进会举行
articles.title_en: Nanjing and Nanjing University Hold Meeting on Building Nanjing Key Pillar of Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Sci-Tech Innovation Center
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，南京市—南京大学共建上海（长三角）国际科技创新中心南京关键支点暨紫金山创新带工作推进会在南京大学仙林校区举行，省长刘小涛出席，双方签署共建协议并启动仙林校区二期建设。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, a meeting on jointly building Nanjing's key pillar of the Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Sci-Tech Innovation Center and the Zijinshan Innovation Belt was held at Nanjing University's Xianlin campus, attended by Governor Liu Xiaotao, with agreements signed and phase-two campus construction launched.

articles.title_zh: 习近平经济思想引领中国加快发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Economic Thought Guides China in Accelerating the Development of New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，《中共中央 国务院关于发展新质生产力的意见》公开发布，阐明总体要求和重点任务；文章系统梳理习近平总书记引领发展新质生产力的理论与实践。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council released the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces, setting out overall requirements and key tasks under Xi Jinping's economic thought.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”北京城市副中心将继续保持每年千亿投资
articles.title_en: Beijing Sub-Center to Keep 100 Billion Yuan Annual Investment in 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，北京市政府新闻办举行发布会，通州区区长郑皓介绍，“十五五”时期北京城市副中心将保持每年千亿级投资，滚动实施约500个重大项目。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 9, Tongzhou District Governor Zheng Hao said Beijing's sub-center will keep annual investment at around 100 billion yuan during the 15th Five-Year Plan, rolling out about 500 major projects.

tags.name_en: Information Office of the Beijing Municipal Government

tags_en: Information Office of the Beijing Municipal Government

articles.title_zh: 中国的“十一”，世界的“黄金周”
articles.title_en: China's National Day Holiday, the World's Golden Week
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月8日播发随笔指出，国庆假期内地居民出境444.4万人次、同比增长9.3%，入境外国人68.2万人次，出入境旅游呈现双向热潮。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua essay says that during the National Day holiday mainland residents made 4.444 million outbound trips, up 9.3% year on year, while 682,000 foreigners entered China, reflecting a two-way travel boom.

articles.title_zh: 两部门组织开展全国受灾群众冬春救助工作
articles.title_en: Two Departments Launch Nationwide Winter-Spring Relief for Disaster-Affected People
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部、财政部近日印发通知，组织开展2026—2027年度全国受灾群众冬春救助工作，要求全面摸排救助对象、精准分档救助，确保春节前款物发放到位。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Emergency Management and Ministry of Finance have issued a notice to launch nationwide winter-spring relief for disaster-affected people for 2026-2027, requiring thorough needs assessments and delivery of aid funds before the Spring Festival.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央、国务院印发《关于发展新质生产力的意见》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council Issue Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月9日，中共中央、国务院印发《关于发展新质生产力的意见》，围绕科技创新等5方面提出19项重点举措，部署发展新质生产力、推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, 2026, the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the Opinions on Developing New Quality Productive Forces, setting out 19 measures across five areas of innovation to advance high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 国家发展改革委有关负责人就《关于发展新质生产力的意见》答记者问
articles.title_en: NDRC Official Answers Questions on Guidelines for Developing New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，国家发展改革委有关负责人就中共中央、国务院印发的《关于发展新质生产力的意见》答记者问，阐释19条改革任务及科技创新、能源革命、人才机制等部署。
articles.summary_en: On October 9, an NDRC official answered reporters' questions on the CPC Central Committee and State Council's guidelines for developing new quality productive forces, detailing 19 reform tasks.

articles.title_zh: 中国大洋100航次第二航段起航 “蛟龙”号首赴南太平洋开展作业
articles.title_en: Second Leg of China Ocean Expedition 100 Sets Sail; Jiaolong Submersible Bound for First Mission in South Pacific
articles.summary_zh: 10月9日，中国大洋事务管理局称，搭载“蛟龙”号载人潜水器的“深海一号”船近日从福建厦门起航，赴南太平洋执行大洋100航次第二航段科考，系“蛟龙”号首次在该海域作业。
articles.summary_en: The vessel Shenhai-1, carrying the Jiaolong manned submersible, departed Xiamen in Fujian for the South Pacific on the second leg of China Ocean Expedition 100, Jiaolong's first mission in those waters.

articles.title_zh: 天津市委常委会会议暨市委理论学习中心组集体学习举行 陈敏尔主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting and Theoretical Study Group Session, Chen Min'er Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，天津市委常委会会议暨市委理论学习中心组集体学习举行，深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想，市委书记陈敏尔主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Tianjin held a Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee meeting and a theoretical study group session to study Xi Jinping Thought on Culture. Municipal Party Secretary Chen Min'er presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 尹力、殷勇检查调度国庆假期安全生产和城市运行保障工作
articles.title_en: Yin Li and Yin Yong Inspect and Coordinate National Day Holiday Safety Production and Urban Operations Support
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期期间，北京市委书记尹力、市长殷勇分别赴天安门地区、新发地农产品批发市场及在建工地等场所，检查调度安全生产和城市运行保障工作，慰问一线值守人员。
articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li and Mayor Yin Yong inspected Tiananmen area, Xinfadi agricultural market and construction sites, coordinating safety production and urban operations support and greeting frontline workers.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省随州市人大常委会党组成员汪海涛接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Wang Haitao, Party Member of Suizhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据湖北省纪委监委10月8日消息，湖北省随州市人大常委会党组成员汪海涛涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Hubei's discipline watchdog said on Oct 8 that Wang Haitao, a Party member of the Suizhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Hubei Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

tags_en: Hubei Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

articles.title_zh: 台积电2026年前三季合并营收超2025年全年
articles.title_en: TSMC's First Three Quarters of 2026 Revenue Surpasses Full-Year 2025
articles.summary_zh: 台积电10月8日公布，2026年前三季合并营收约3.8987万亿元新台币，同比增长41.1%，已超越2025年全年；第三季营收创单季历史新高，主因AI需求强劲。
articles.summary_en: TSMC announced on Oct 8 that its consolidated revenue for the first three quarters of 2026 reached about NT$3.8987 trillion, up 41.1% year-on-year and already surpassing its full-year 2025 total, with record third-quarter sales driven by strong AI demand.

articles.title_zh: 新就业形态劳动者权益保障办法公开征求意见
articles.title_en: China Seeks Public Comment on Regulation to Protect Rights of New-Economy Workers
articles.summary_zh: 中国人力资源和社会保障部10月8日发布《新就业形态劳动者权益保障办法(征求意见稿)》，至11月8日向社会公开征求意见，首次以规章形式保障网约配送员、网约车司机、网络主播等群体劳动权益。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security released a draft regulation on October 8 to protect the rights of new-economy workers such as delivery riders, ride-hailing drivers and livestreamers, opening a one-month public consultation until November 8.

articles.title_zh: 台湾9月对大陆进出口同比双增
articles.title_en: Taiwan's September Trade with the Mainland Grows Year-on-Year in Both Exports and Imports
articles.summary_zh: 台当局财政事务主管部门10月8日在台北发布统计，9月台湾对大陆（含香港）出口206.2亿美元，同比增长30.2%；自大陆进口135亿美元，同比增长59.1%。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, Taiwan's finance authority in Taipei reported September exports to the mainland and Hong Kong of $20.62 billion, up 30.2% year-on-year, and imports of $13.5 billion, up 59.1%.

articles.title_zh: 集装箱铁水联运装载和安全检查国家标准发布
articles.title_en: China Releases National Standard for Container Rail-Water Intermodal Loading and Safety Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局批准发布《集装箱铁水联运装载和安全检查技术规范》国家标准（GB/T 48309—2026），统一铁路与水路货物装载和安全检查要求，助力“全程不开箱”。
articles.summary_en: China's State Administration for Market Regulation approved a national standard, GB/T 48309-2026, unifying cargo loading and safety inspection rules for container rail-water intermodal transport to enable "no container opening along the route."

tags_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局

articles.title_zh: 中央巡视组原副部级巡视专员许传智一审获刑12年
articles.title_en: Former Deputy Ministerial-Level Inspection Commissioner Xu Chuanzhi Sentenced to 12 Years in First Instance
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，宁波市中级人民法院一审宣判中央巡视组原副部级巡视专员许传智受贿、利用影响力受贿案，决定执行有期徒刑十二年，并处罚金250万元。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, the Ningbo Intermediate People's Court in Zhejiang sentenced Xu Chuanzhi, former deputy ministerial-level inspection commissioner of the Central Inspection Team, to 12 years in prison for bribery and influence-based bribery, plus a 2.5 million yuan fine.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要论述引领加快建设航天强国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Guiding Expositions Steer China's Push to Build a Space Power
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月8日播发报道，在习近平总书记重要论述引领下，中国航天事业迎来创建70周年，"十五五"开局之年加快推进航天强国建设。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Oct 8 that, guided by Xi Jinping's expositions on space, China's space program marked its 70th anniversary and is accelerating efforts to build the country into a space power.

tags.name_en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

tags_en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Strengthening Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Programs
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日出版的第19期《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章《加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设》，为其2012年11月至2026年1月相关论述节录。
articles.summary_en: The 19th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on Oct 1, carried Xi Jinping's article on strengthening inclusive, basic and safety-net livelihood programs, excerpting his remarks from Nov 2012 to Jan 2026.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在京举行 习近平发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Delivers Important Speech at Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the PRC
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，李强主持，赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希、韩正出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 30, a reception marking the 77th anniversary of the People's Republic of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech; Li Qiang presided, with Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi and Han Zheng attending.

articles.title_zh: 2027长春大冬会倒计时100天活动举行 火炬奖牌及推广曲正式发布
articles.title_en: Changchun 2027 Winter World University Games Marks 100-Day Countdown with Torch, Medal and Song Release
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日，长春2027第33届世界大学生冬季运动会倒计时100天活动在长春举行，发布火炬“吉翔”、奖牌“吉梦”及推广曲，长春市委书记张恩惠向世界各地朋友发出邀约。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 7, Changchun held a 100-day countdown event for the 2027 Winter World University Games, unveiling the torch "Jixiang", medal "Jimeng" and theme songs; Party Secretary Zhang Enhui invited friends worldwide to the ice and snow gala.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟检查调度国庆假期安全生产和交通文旅等工作
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Inspect National Day Holiday Safety, Transport and Tourism Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳检查调度国庆假期安全生产、交通运输和文旅等工作，并召开视频调度会部署节日保障。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 1, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei inspected National Day holiday work on workplace safety, transport and tourism in Shenyang and held a video meeting on holiday security.

articles.title_zh: 以文化滋养精神家园——习近平文化思想引领文化强国建设迈出新步伐
articles.title_en: Nourishing the Spiritual Home Through Culture: Xi Jinping Thought on Culture Guides New Steps in Building a Cultural Power
articles.summary_zh: 2023年全国宣传思想文化工作会议正式提出习近平文化思想以来，党的创新理论宣传深入基层，文化创新创造活力持续迸发，文化遗产保护与文明交流互鉴成果丰硕。
articles.summary_en: Since Xi Jinping Thought on Culture was formally introduced in 2023, theory outreach at the grassroots, cultural innovation and heritage protection have advanced, marking new progress in building a cultural power.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期全社会跨区域人员流动量预计21.44亿人次
articles.title_en: Cross-Region Travel During National Day Holiday Estimated at 2.144 Billion Trips
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月1日至7日国庆假期，全社会跨区域人员流动量预计达21.44亿人次，交通运输部称行业运行总体平稳有序。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Transport said cross-region passenger trips during the Oct 1-7 National Day holiday are estimated at 2.144 billion, with rail passenger volume up 13.1% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于《国家残疾预防行动计划（2026—2030年）》的批复
articles.title_en: State Council Approves National Disability Prevention Action Plan (2026-2030)
articles.summary_zh: 国务院批复原则同意《国家残疾预防行动计划（2026—2030年）》，要求各地将其纳入“十五五”时期经济社会发展重要任务，完善残疾预防政策体系和防控网络。
articles.summary_en: The State Council approved in principle the National Disability Prevention Action Plan (2026-2030), requiring local governments to make disability prevention a key task of the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

tags.name_en: State Council Working Committee on Disability

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期高速公路新能源汽车日均充电量同比增长51.42%
articles.title_en: Highway EV Daily Charging Volume Rises 51.42% Year-on-Year During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，国家能源局数据显示，10月1日至7日全国高速公路新能源汽车充电671.1万次，充电量1.63亿千瓦时，日均充电量同比增长51.42%。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, the National Energy Administration said China's highway EV charging hit 6.711 million sessions and 163 million kWh from Oct 1 to 7, with daily charging volume up 51.42% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰同英国财政大臣希利举行视频通话
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Holds Video Call with UK Chancellor Healey
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，国务院副总理、中英经济财金对话中方牵头人何立峰应约同英方牵头人、英国财政大臣希利举行视频通话，就加强中英经济财金合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 8, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng, who leads the Chinese side of the China-UK Economic and Financial Dialogue, held a video call with UK Chancellor Healey to discuss stronger bilateral economic and financial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰调研检查节日道路交通保障和景区安全工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Inspects Holiday Traffic and Scenic Area Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，丹东市委书记蒋冰调研检查国庆假期道路交通保障和景区安全工作，强调守牢安全底线、优化服务供给、提升红色文旅品质。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Dandong Party Secretary Jiang Bing inspected holiday traffic control and scenic area safety work, calling for firm safety safeguards and better tourism services.

articles.title_zh: 张丹赴宽甸满族自治县调研特色农业与文旅融合发展
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Inspects Kuandian Manchu Autonomous County on Specialty Agriculture and Cultural Tourism Integration
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹赴宽甸满族自治县，调研软枣猕猴桃、中药材等特色农业以及满族民俗文化传承和文旅产业融合发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan visited Kuandian Manchu Autonomous County to inspect specialty agriculture such as kiwi berry and Chinese medicinal herbs, along with Manchu folk culture heritage and cultural tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡调研督导秋收秋种和秸秆禁烧工作
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Inspects Autumn Harvest, Sowing and Straw Burning Control Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡赴濉溪县和烈山区，调研督导秋收秋种和秸秆禁烧工作，要求扛牢粮食安全政治责任。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 8, Huang Wei, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Huaibei, inspected autumn harvest, sowing and straw-burning control work in Suixi County and Lieshan District, urging solid implementation of food security responsibilities.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁深入曲水县调研县域经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Inspects Qushui County on High-Quality County Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月5日，西藏自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁赴曲水县调研县域经济高质量发展，走访企业与乡村，强调坚持兴业、强县、富民一体发展。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 5, Dawa Tsering, Standing Committee member of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee and Lhasa Party Secretary, inspected Qushui County on high-quality county economy development, visiting firms and villages and stressing integrated industrial, county and public prosperity.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在京举行 习近平发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the PRC Held in Beijing, Xi Jinping Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，李强主持招待会。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, a reception marking the PRC's 77th anniversary was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing; Xi Jinping delivered an important speech and Li Qiang presided.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰同英国财政大臣希利举行视频通话
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Holds Video Call with UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Healey
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日下午，国务院副总理何立峰应约同英国财政大臣希利举行视频通话，就加强中英经济财金合作深入交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 8, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Healey to exchange views on strengthening China-UK economic and financial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森邢鹏调研全市项目建设工作
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen and Xing Peng Inspect City Project Construction Work in Panjin
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，盘锦市委书记王炳森、市长邢鹏调研全市多个项目建设现场，并主持召开全市项目建设推进会。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Panjin Party Secretary Wang Bingsen and Mayor Xing Peng inspected several city project construction sites and chaired a meeting to advance project construction.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴濠江区调研“百千万工程”推进情况
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Progress of the "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project" in Haojiang District
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群带队赴濠江区澳头、葛洲等社区及达濠古城、达濠渔港新产业集聚区，实地调研“百千万工程”推进情况。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 7, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn led a team to Haojiang District, inspecting communities including Aotou and Gezhou along with Dahao Ancient Town and the Dahao fishing port industrial zone to review progress of the "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project."

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets, Chaired by Lu Feng
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日，汕尾市委书记逯峰主持召开市委常委会会议，研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党、生态环境保护督察整改和群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired a meeting of the municipal Party Standing Committee to study sustained efforts on full and rigorous Party governance, rectification of ecological inspection findings, and the crackdown on misconduct and corruption around the public.

articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，宁夏全区基础教育优化布局工作推进会在银川召开，自治区党委书记李邑飞出席并讲话，自治区主席张雨浦主持，部署推进基础教育优质均衡发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Ningxia held a meeting in Yinchuan on optimizing its basic education layout. Regional Party Secretary Li Yifei spoke and Chairman Zhang Yupu presided, urging balanced urban-rural education development.

articles.title_en: Ningxia Holds Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony for People's Heroes; Li Yifei, Zhang Yupu and Zhuang Yan Attend

articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 30, Ningxia held a Martyrs' Day ceremony at Yinchuan Martyrs' Cemetery, presenting flower baskets to people's heroes. Li Yifei, Zhang Yupu, Zhuang Yan and others attended.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬调研节日消费市场和服务业发展工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects Holiday Consumer Market and Service Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 10月5日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到海陵区调研国庆假期消费市场和服务业发展工作，实地察看乡村旅游、商业零售、文旅街区及文保场所情况。
articles.summary_en: On October 5, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong inspected the holiday consumer market and service industry in Hailing District, visiting rural tourism sites, retail stores, cultural districts and heritage venues.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬检查国庆假期文旅消费和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Inspects National Day Holiday Tourism Consumption and Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到兴化检查国庆假期文旅消费和安全生产工作，要求统筹抓好文旅消费、安全保障和民生服务。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong inspected tourism consumption and workplace safety in Xinghua during the National Day holiday, urging coordinated efforts on holiday consumption, safety and public services.

articles.title_zh: 黄强在吉林网络名人座谈会上强调 弘扬主旋律 传播正能量 激发吉林全面振兴的强大力量
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Chairs Jilin Internet Influencer Symposium, Urges Positive Energy to Drive Northeast Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日，吉林省委书记黄强在长春主持召开网络名人座谈会，强调把握正确舆论导向、弘扬主旋律、传播正能量，激发吉林全面振兴的强大力量。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 7, Jilin Party Secretary Huang Qiang chaired a symposium with internet influencers in Changchun, urging them to uphold correct public opinion guidance and spread positive content to support the province's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平调研督导生态环保、安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Inspects Ecological Protection and Work Safety in Xinxiang
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，新乡市委书记魏建平到高新区、卫滨区、新乡县、卫辉市调研督导生态环保和安全生产工作，要求企业落实整改、守牢生态红线和安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping inspected environmental protection and work safety in local districts and counties, urging firms to rectify problems.

articles.title_zh: 宋占华调研检查“十一”假期安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: Song Zhanhua Inspects Safety Production Work During National Day Holiday in Yuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，禹州市委书记宋占华到当地商超、敬老院、客运站调研检查“十一”假期安全生产、保供稳价和养老服务等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, Yuzhou Party Secretary Song Zhanhua inspected local supermarkets, a nursing home and a bus station to check holiday safety production, supply stabilization and elderly care services.

articles.title_zh: 宋占华调研数智城市建设和应急值守工作
articles.title_en: Song Zhanhua Inspects Digital Smart City Construction and Emergency Duty Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日，禹州市委书记宋占华专题调研数智城市建设与应急值守工作，先后走访智慧城市运行中心、消防救援、公安情指、120急救及应急指挥中心。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 2, Yuzhou Party Secretary Song Zhanhua inspected digital smart city construction and emergency duty work, visiting smart city, fire, police, medical and emergency command centers.

articles.title_zh: 曹阳调研中央生态环保督察反馈问题整改工作
articles.title_en: Cao Yang Inspects Rectification of Issues Flagged by Central Ecological Environmental Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日，营口市委副书记、代市长曹阳专题调研中央生态环保督察反馈问题整改工作，实地检查钢铁企业、污水处理厂和能源技术公司整改情况。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 2, Cao Yang, deputy party secretary and acting mayor of Yingkou, inspected rectification of issues flagged by the central ecological environmental inspection, visiting a steel plant, a sewage treatment plant and an energy firm.

articles.title_zh: 曹阳开展国庆节前走访慰问和安全生产专项检查
articles.title_en: Cao Yang Conducts Pre-National Day Enterprise Visits and Special Workplace Safety Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，营口市委副书记、代市长曹阳到辽宁（营口）沿海产业基地、盖州市走访慰问重点企业并检查安全生产工作，要求以高水平安全护航高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Cao Yang, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Yingkou, visited key enterprises in the Liaoning (Yingkou) Coastal Industrial Base and Gaizhou City to extend holiday greetings and inspect workplace safety, calling for high-level safety to underpin high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 李军曹阳看望正市级老同志
articles.title_en: Li Jun and Cao Yang Visit Retired Municipal-Level Officials in Yingkou
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，营口市委书记李军、代市长曹阳看望李洪彦等正市级老同志，感谢他们为营口经济社会发展作出的贡献并听取意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Yingkou Party Secretary Li Jun and Acting Mayor Cao Yang visited retired municipal-level officials including Li Hongyan, thanking them for their contributions to the city's development and seeking their advice.

articles.title_zh: 徐晓霞调研安全生产和“百千万工程”等工作
articles.title_en: Xu Xiaoxia Inspects Workplace Safety and the "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand" Project in Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日至4日，云浮市委书记徐晓霞深入新兴县、郁南县镇村和重点项目一线，调研安全生产、“百千万工程”推进、绿美广东生态建设及重点项目建设情况。
articles.summary_en: From October 2 to 4, Xu Xiaoxia, Party Secretary of Yunfu, inspected villages and key project sites in Xinxing and Yunan counties, reviewing workplace safety, the rural revitalization "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand" project, Green Beautiful Guangdong ecological construction and major project progress.

articles.title_zh: 徐晓霞调度检查国庆假期值班值守和安全保障工作
articles.title_en: Xu Xiaoxia Inspects National Day Holiday Duty and Safety Work in Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，云浮市委书记徐晓霞到市公安局、市委网信办、市应急管理局调度检查国庆假期值班值守和安全保障工作，要求压实责任、排查风险，确保社会大局平安稳定。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 1, Yunfu Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia inspected holiday duty and safety work at the city's public security, cyberspace and emergency management bodies, ordering stepped-up risk checks to keep the National Day holiday period safe and stable.

articles.title_zh: 罗文调研走访河北省人大常委会机关和河北省政协机关
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Visits Hebei Provincial People's Congress and CPPCC Bodies
articles.summary_zh: 罗文调研走访河北省人大常委会机关和省政协机关，就推进人大立法监督和政协协商民主等工作提出要求。
articles.summary_en: Luo Wen inspected the Hebei Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and the Provincial CPPCC, urging progress in legislative oversight and consultative democracy.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 8, a matchmaking meeting on provincial SOEs supporting Qingdao's high-quality development was held in the SCO Demonstration Area. Zeng Zanrong and Sun Ximin spoke, and Ren Gang presided.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神

articles.summary_zh: 10月8日上午，青岛市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话、重要指示精神，市委书记曾赞荣主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On October 8, the Standing Committee of the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions. Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong chaired the meeting and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨以人的需求为原点 激活消费大市场
articles.title_en: New Thought Leads a New Journey: Putting People's Needs First to Energize the Consumer Market
articles.summary_zh: 2026年国庆假期，全国78个重点步行街（商圈）客流、营业额同比分别增长2.5%、4.7%，消费品以旧换新惠及639.2万人次，带动销售额334.8亿元，智能、绿色、健康商品需求旺盛。
articles.summary_en: During the Oct 1-6 National Day holiday, traffic and sales at 78 key shopping districts rose 2.5% and 4.7% year on year, while consumer trade-in programs reached 6.392 million people and drove 33.48 billion yuan in sales.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神 王浩主持

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 8, the Zhejiang Provincial Party Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches, articles and congratulatory letters and to review implementation measures. Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao presided.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委常委会召开会议 信长星主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Chaired by Xin Changxing

articles.summary_en: On Oct 8, the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee met to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, with Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing presiding.

articles.summary_zh: 10月初，山西长治市沁县等地迎来谷子丰收。山西以有机旱作农业为抓手，打造“特”“优”农业品牌，推进农业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: In early October, Shanxi's Changzhi and other areas reported a bumper millet harvest, as the province advances organic dryland farming to build its 'special and premium' agricultural brands and high-quality farming.

articles.title_zh: 天津市制定突发事件应对条例
articles.title_en: Tianjin Formulates Emergency Response Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 天津市十八届人大常委会第二十八次会议审议通过《天津市突发事件应对条例》，自2026年11月1日起施行，强化预防准备、监测预警与应急处置机制。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Tianjin Municipal People's Congress approved the Tianjin Emergency Response Regulations, effective November 1, 2026, strengthening risk prevention, monitoring, early warning and emergency handling.

articles.summary_zh: 新华社发布长征特辑，回顾习近平总书记2015年考察贵州遵义和花茂村等地，讲述传承遵义会议精神、推动乡村振兴的故事。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's Long March special recalls Xi Jinping's 2015 visit to Zunyi and Huamao Village in Guizhou, highlighting the Zunyi Meeting spirit and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫生健康委等印发医疗康复护理扩容提升工程实施方案
articles.title_en: China Issues Implementation Plan for Expanding and Upgrading Medical Rehabilitation and Nursing Care
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委、国家发展改革委联合印发《医疗康复护理扩容提升工程实施方案》，经国务院批复同意，提出到2030年基本建成功能完备、上下联动、中西医结合、高效可及的康复护理服务体系。
articles.summary_en: China's National Health Commission and National Development and Reform Commission issued an implementation plan, approved by the State Council, to expand medical rehabilitation and nursing care, aiming to build a comprehensive service system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 四条高铁新线交出首份国庆运输答卷

articles.summary_zh: 2026年国庆假期，京港高铁雄安至商丘段等四条新开通高铁迎来首个假日运输，沿线客流与文旅消费明显增长。
articles.summary_en: During the 2026 National Day holiday, four newly opened high-speed rail lines, including the Xiongan-Shangqiu section, handled their first holiday travel rush, boosting passenger flows and tourism spending along their routes.

articles.title_zh: 从太空“行李箱”看中国航天70年
articles.title_en: China's 70-Year Space Journey Through Its 'Space Luggage'
articles.summary_zh: 10月8日是中国航天事业创建70周年。天舟十号货运飞船发射、嫦娥六号月背采样返回并向联合国捐赠月壤样品，中国航天国际合作持续扩大。
articles.summary_en: China marks the 70th anniversary of its space program on Oct 8, highlighted by the Tianzhou-10 cargo mission, Chang'e-6's far-side lunar sampling and a moon soil donation to the UN, amid widening international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期高速公路新能源汽车日均充电量同比增长51.42%
articles.title_en: Average Daily EV Charging Volume on Expressways Rose 51.42% Year-on-Year During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局10月8日数据显示，10月1日至7日全国高速公路新能源汽车充电671.1万次、充电量1.63亿千瓦时，日均充电量同比增长51.42%。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the National Energy Administration on Oct 8 showed 6.711 million EV charging sessions and 163 million kWh of electricity used on China's expressways from Oct 1 to 7, with average daily charging volume up 51.42% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期全国安全形势总体平稳
articles.title_en: National Safety Situation Generally Stable During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部10月8日通报，截至10月7日22时，国庆假期全国安全形势总体平稳，未发生重大以上灾害事故。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Emergency Management reported on Oct 8 that as of 22:00 on Oct 7, the national safety situation remained generally stable during the National Day holiday, with no major or larger-scale disasters or accidents.

articles.title_zh: 卢东亮在晋中昔阳县调研
articles.title_en: Lu Dongliang Conducts Research Visit in Xiyang County, Jinzhong
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，山西省委副书记、省长卢东亮深入晋中市昔阳县调研基层财政运行、县域经济发展和假期文旅消费、安全工作，并主持召开市县财政科学管理工作座谈会。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang visited Xiyang County in Jinzhong to inspect grassroots fiscal operations, county economic development, holiday tourism consumption and safety work, and chaired a meeting on scientific fiscal management.

articles.title_zh: 俄罗斯总统助理、海事委员会主席帕特鲁舍夫将访华
articles.title_en: Russian Presidential Aide and Maritime Board Chairman Patrushev to Visit China
articles.summary_zh: 中国外交部10月7日宣布，俄罗斯总统助理、海事委员会主席帕特鲁舍夫将于10月8日至13日访华，中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅将与其会谈交流。
articles.summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry announced on Oct 7 that Russian Presidential Aide and Maritime Board Chairman Nikolai Patrushev will visit China from Oct 8 to 13, and will hold talks with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau and Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China

tags_en: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of China

articles.title_zh: 世界最大容量柔性直流变压器在广州就位
articles.title_en: World's Largest-Capacity Flexible DC Transformer Installed in Guangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 世界最大容量柔性直流变压器在广州220千伏天河棠下柔直背靠背工程就位，容量达770兆伏安，将服务“十五五”新型电网建设。
articles.summary_en: The world's largest-capacity flexible DC transformer, rated at 770 MVA, has been installed at a back-to-back converter station project in Guangzhou, supporting China's new-type power grid buildout.

articles.title_zh: 中国科研团队成功绘制水稻全生命周期时空细胞图谱
articles.title_en: Chinese Research Team Maps Full-Lifecycle Spatiotemporal Cell Atlas of Rice
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日，三亚发布会宣布，来自崖州湾国家实验室、华大生命科学研究院等机构的12个团队首次构建覆盖水稻全生命周期的三维时空细胞图谱，成果已在线发表于《细胞》。
articles.summary_en: At a press conference in Sanya on Oct 7, 12 Chinese research teams announced they had built the first full-lifecycle 3D spatiotemporal cell atlas of rice, with results published online in Cell.

articles.title_zh: 成都强化校地合作提升科创动能
articles.title_en: Chengdu Strengthens University-Locality Cooperation to Boost Innovation Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 成都市与四川大学等50余所高校院所开展校地合作，共建天府实验室和新型研发机构，推动科技成果转化与片区高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Chengdu has partnered with more than 50 universities and research institutes, including Sichuan University, to build joint labs and new R&D institutions that speed up the commercialization of research results.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷西文版读书交流会在马德里举行
articles.title_en: Reading Exchange on Spanish Edition of Volume V of "Xi Jinping: The Governance of China" Held in Madrid
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷西文版读书交流会在西班牙马德里举行，中西两国政府、高校、媒体等60余名代表参加。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, a reading exchange on the Spanish edition of Volume V of "Xi Jinping: The Governance of China" was held in Madrid, Spain, drawing over 60 representatives from government, universities and media in both countries.

articles.title_zh: 三株“草”长成一片原
articles.title_en: Three 'Grasses' Grow into a Vast Plain: Henan's Old Revolutionary Bases Develop Specialty Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 河南信阳、光山、卢氏等革命老区依托茶叶、油茶、连翘三株“草”发展农业特色产业，带动老区群众增收致富。
articles.summary_en: In Henan's old revolutionary base areas such as Xinyang, Guangshan and Lushi, the wartime 'three grasses' — tea, camellia oil and Forsythia — have grown into thriving specialty agriculture that boosts local incomes.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 铸就社会主义文化新辉煌——习近平文化思想引领文化强国建设迈出坚实步伐
articles.title_en: Building New Glory for Socialist Culture: Xi Jinping Thought on Culture Guides Solid Progress in Building a Cultural Power
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月7日播发综述：习近平文化思想引领下，“十五五”开局之年社会主义文化强国建设迈出坚实步伐，文化传承创新与文明交流互鉴成果显著。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua, Oct 7: Under the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Culture, China has made solid progress in building a socialist cultural power in the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, with advances in cultural heritage, innovation and exchanges among civilizations.

articles.title_zh: 马珊珊出席辽宁材料实验室与方大集团深化合作座谈会
articles.title_en: Shenyang Mayor Ma Shanshan Attends Symposium on Deeper Cooperation Between Liaoning Materials Laboratory and Fangda Group
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，沈阳市市长马珊珊出席辽宁材料实验室与方大集团深化合作座谈会并讲话，强调精准对接、务实合作，推动更多科技成果转化为新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, Shenyang Mayor Ma Shanshan attended a symposium on deepening cooperation between the Liaoning Materials Laboratory and Fangda Group, calling for targeted collaboration to turn more scientific results into new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 亢永强调研国庆期间森林草原防灭火和应急值班值守工作并看望一线工作人员
articles.title_en: Kang Yongqiang Inspects Forest and Grassland Fire Prevention and Emergency Duty Work During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，赤峰市委书记亢永强到市应急管理局、消防救援支队、市公安局等地调研国庆期间森林草原防灭火和应急值班值守工作，看望慰问一线工作人员。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 1, Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang inspected National Day holiday forest and grassland fire prevention and emergency duty work, and visited frontline workers.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期智能、绿色、健康商品需求旺盛
articles.title_en: Strong Demand for Smart, Green and Health Products During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 商务部商务大数据显示，10月1日至6日国庆假期，智能、绿色、健康商品需求旺盛，消费品以旧换新带动销售额334.8亿元，全国消费市场总体平稳。
articles.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce big data show that during the Oct 1-6 National Day holiday, demand for smart, green and health products was strong, with consumer trade-in programs driving 33.48 billion yuan in sales as the market stayed stable.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期出行需求旺盛 发展活力持续释放
articles.title_en: Robust National Day Holiday Travel Demand Reflects Sustained Development Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部10月7日发布数据，今年国庆七天假期全社会跨区域人员流动量预计达21.44亿人次，同比增长0.7%，铁路、公路、民航客流均保持高位。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Transport said on Oct 7 that cross-regional passenger trips during the seven-day National Day holiday were expected to reach 2.144 billion, up 0.7% year on year, with rail, road and air travel all running at high levels.

articles.title_zh: 各地秋粮加紧收获
articles.title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Accelerated Across China
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部农情调度显示，全国秋粮收获已过四成，东北、黄淮海等地抢抓农时、调配农机，保障粮食颗粒归仓。
articles.summary_en: China's autumn grain harvest has passed 40 percent, with northeast and Huang-Huai-Hai regions deploying machinery to bring in the crop, according to the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 铸就社会主义文化新辉煌——习近平文化思想引领文化强国建设迈出坚实步伐
articles.title_en: Forging New Glory for Socialist Culture: Xi Jinping Thought on Culture Guides Solid Progress in Building a Cultural Power
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月7日，新华社播发综述，梳理在习近平文化思想引领下，理论武装、文化传承创新与文明交流互鉴等方面推进文化强国建设的进展。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua retrospective published on Oct 7, 2026 reviews progress in building China's cultural strength under Xi Jinping Thought on Culture, covering theory, cultural heritage and exchanges among civilizations.

tags.name_en: Exchanges and Mutual Learning Among Civilizations

tags_en: Exchanges and Mutual Learning Among Civilizations

articles.title_zh: 入境游持续升温 外国游客深度体验多彩中国
articles.title_en: Inbound Tourism Continues to Heat Up as Foreign Visitors Explore a Diverse China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年国庆假期，入境游持续升温，客源地从东亚、东南亚向欧洲、大洋洲拓展，前6天北京接待入境游客11.2万人次，同比增长24.6%。
articles.summary_en: During China's 2026 National Day holiday, inbound tourism kept growing, with source markets expanding from East and Southeast Asia to Europe and Oceania; Beijing received 112,000 inbound visitors in the first six days, up 24.6% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元：坚决打非治违抓整改 确保社会大局稳定
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan: Crack Down on Illegal Violations and Rectify Problems to Ensure Overall Social Stability
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元以“四不两直”方式深入煤矿和酒店，督导国家和省级督查组反馈问题整改，并调研文旅消费服务保障与市场稳价工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 7, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan made unannounced inspections of a coal mine and a hotel, pressing for rectification of problems flagged by national and provincial inspection teams and for stable tourism market prices.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦主持召开市委常委会会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究平安建设等工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting, Conveys Xi Jinping's Important Instructions, Studies Peacebuilding and Other Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日下午，淮北市委书记蒋曦主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究平安建设和全面从严治党等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 7 afternoon, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi chaired a Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee meeting on implementing Xi Jinping's instructions, peacebuilding and party governance.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦调研秋收工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Inspects Autumn Harvest Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦赴濉溪县调研秋收工作，强调扛牢粮食安全政治责任，确保秋粮颗粒归仓。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 7, Jiang Xi, Party Secretary of Huaibei, inspected autumn harvest work in Suixi County, urging solid implementation of food security responsibilities and ensuring all autumn grain is safely collected.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦在调研秋收工作时强调 紧盯农时应收尽收 确保秋粮颗粒归仓
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Stresses Timely Harvesting to Ensure Autumn Grain Is Fully Stored
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦赴濉溪县调研秋收工作，强调紧盯农时应收尽收，做好秋粮烘干、秸秆综合利用和农机安全生产工作，确保秋粮颗粒归仓。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 7, Jiang Xi, Party Secretary of Huaibei, inspected autumn harvest work in Suixi County, urging timely harvesting, grain drying, straw utilization and farm machinery safety to ensure all autumn grain is safely stored.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰调研节日交通运输服务保障和“百千万工程”重点项目建设
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Inspects Holiday Transport Services and Key Projects of the "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand" Program
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到市城区调研节日交通运输服务保障和“百千万工程”重点项目建设，强调优化服务保障、狠抓项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 7, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng inspected holiday transport services and key projects of the "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand" program, urging faster construction and better public services.

articles.title_zh: 李乐成在芜湖市调研时强调：推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合 着力塑造高质量发展新动能新优势
articles.title_en: Li Lecheng Inspects Wuhu, Stresses Deep Integration of Technological and Industrial Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，安徽省委书记李乐成赴芜湖调研，走访埃夫特、奇瑞、海螺集团和华为云数据中心，强调推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Li Lecheng inspected Wuhu, visiting EFORT Robotics, Chery, Conch Group and a Huawei Cloud data center, stressing deeper integration of technological and industrial innovation to foster new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 余金富督导检查国庆节期间安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Inspects Workplace Safety During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，阳江市委副书记、市长余金富到市公安局交通指挥调度中心、沈海高速阳江服务区及江城区那蓬村等地，督导检查国庆节期间交通安全、地质灾害防治和文旅项目安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Yangjiang Mayor Yu Jinfu inspected traffic safety, geological hazard control and tourism project safety across the city during the National Day holiday, urging thorough risk screening and strict accountability.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先到海陵湾新区调研国庆假期旅游服务保障工作
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Inspects Hailing Bay New Area for National Day Holiday Tourism Services
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，阳江市委书记卢一先到海陵湾新区调研国庆假期旅游服务保障、安全生产和值班值守工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, Yangjiang Communist Party Secretary Lu Yixian inspected the Hailing Bay New Area to review holiday tourism services, safety production and duty staffing during the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德调研检查国庆假期文旅促消费和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Holiday Cultural Tourism Promotion and Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，福州市委书记郭宁宁、市长吴贤德赴台江、仓山调研检查国庆假期文旅促消费和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected Taijiang and Cangshan districts to check holiday cultural tourism promotion and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 泰德能源生产基地新能源研发大楼封顶
articles.title_en: New Energy R&D Building Tops Out at Taide Energy Production Base
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，位于福州闽侯县竹岐乡的泰德能源科技智能发电设备生产基地新能源研发大楼完成主体结构封顶，项目总投资10亿元，预计明年建成投用。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, the new energy R&D building at Taide Energy Technology's smart power generation equipment base in Minhou County, Fuzhou, topped out. The 1 billion yuan project is expected to be completed and put into use next year.

articles.title_zh: 返程客流持续走高 新能源车充电需求激增 高速44处路段易拥堵
articles.title_en: Return-Holiday Traffic Keeps Climbing, EV Charging Demand Surges, 44 Highway Sections Prone to Congestion
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月6日国庆假期第六天，全社会跨区域人员流动量超3亿人次，全国高速44处路段易拥堵，新能源车充电需求大幅增加。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, 2026, the sixth day of the National Day holiday, cross-region travel topped 300 million trips, with 44 highway sections prone to congestion and EV charging demand surging.

articles.title_zh: 激活民间投资 打开“六张网”建设新空间
articles.title_en: Activating Private Investment Opens New Space for the Building of the "Six Networks"
articles.summary_zh: 2026年国庆期间，国家发展改革委向民营企业公开推介36个投资项目，滇中引水二期等重大工程引入民间资本，激活“六张网”建设新空间。
articles.summary_en: During the 2026 National Day holiday, the National Development and Reform Commission promoted 36 investment projects to private firms, drawing private capital into major projects such as the second phase of the Central Yunnan Water Diversion.

articles.title_zh: 决议通过！多国向中方表示祝贺
articles.title_en: UN Human Rights Council Adopts China-Led Accessibility Resolution; Many Countries Congratulate China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月5日，联合国人权理事会第63届会议协商一致通过中国代表47国提出的“无障碍建设促进所有人享有人权”决议，多国向中方表示祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On October 5, 2026, the 63rd session of the UN Human Rights Council adopted by consensus a resolution on accessibility for all, proposed by China on behalf of 47 countries; many countries congratulated China.

articles.title_zh: 物业费收上来了！改变何以发生？——涟水以物业服务为切口推动小区共治
articles.title_en: Property Fees Now Collected: How Did Change Happen? Lianshui Promotes Community Co-governance Through Property Services
articles.summary_zh: 江苏涟水县纪委监委推动物业管理服务突出问题专项整治，通过多方协同共治，全县物业类12345热线工单同比下降28.2%，多个小区物业费收缴率升至90%。
articles.summary_en: Lianshui County in Jiangsu is driving community co-governance via a special rectification of property services led by its discipline inspection commission; property-related hotline complaints fell 28.2% and fee collection rates rose to 90%.

articles.title_zh: 长三角铁路今日迎来返程客流最高峰，预计发送旅客415万人次
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Railways Hit Peak Return Passenger Flow, Expected 4.15 Million Trips
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日国庆假期最后一天，长三角铁路迎来返程客流最高峰，上铁集团预计当日发送旅客415万人次，同比增长17.7%，并增开旅客列车557列保障运力。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 7, the last day of the National Day holiday, China Railway Shanghai Group expected to carry 4.15 million passengers, up 17.7% year-on-year, adding 557 trains to handle the peak return flow.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞调研国庆假期返程高峰保障、交通安全及社会稳定情况
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects National Day Holiday Return-Travel Peak Support, Traffic Safety and Social Stability
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，海南省委书记冯飞前往省公安厅、海口秀英港码头和美兰国际机场，调研国庆假期返程高峰保障、交通安全及社会稳定情况，并慰问一线工作人员和志愿者。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei visited the provincial public security department, Xiuying Port and Meilan International Airport in Haikou to inspect return-travel peak support, traffic safety and social stability during the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 江苏现有烈士纪念设施3.86万处
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Has 38,600 Martyr Memorial Facilities
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省退役军人事务厅近日表示，江苏现有烈士纪念设施3.86万处，其中17处为国家级，并实行分级保护管理，推进质效提升。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu has 38,600 martyr memorial facilities, including 17 national-level ones, the provincial Department of Veterans Affairs said, with graded protection and management.
