articles.title_zh: 钛合金粉末充型技术通过验收
articles.title_en: Titanium Alloy Powder Filling Technology Passes Acceptance Review
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区科技领军人才项目“低成本钛合金复杂结构件粉末充型技术研究”通过自治区科技厅验收，综合绩效评价为优秀，可使钛合金零部件成本降低30%以上。
articles.summary_en: A low-cost titanium alloy powder filling technology project in Inner Mongolia passed acceptance review by the regional science and technology department with an excellent rating, cutting part costs by over 30%.

articles.title_zh: 大食物观里的中国味道
articles.title_en: The Big Food Concept: Building China's Diversified Food Supply
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期期间，央视报道称我国正加快构建多元化食物供给体系，践行大食物观，向耕地之外的国土、森林与深海拓展食物来源。
articles.summary_en: China is accelerating a diversified food supply system under the "Big Food Concept," tapping forests, deserts and deep seas for food, CCTV reported during the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 共青团中央在贵州遵义举办纪念长征胜利90周年实践育人主题活动
articles.title_en: Communist Youth League Central Committee Holds Practice-Based Education Event in Zunyi, Guizhou, Marking 90th Anniversary of Long March Victory
articles.summary_zh: 共青团中央近日在贵州遵义举办纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年党团队实践育人主题活动，通过情景展演、典型宣讲、研学实践等打造“大思政课”。
articles.summary_en: The Communist Youth League Central Committee recently held a practice-based education event in Zunyi, Guizhou, marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, combining staged performances, lectures and study tours into a "grand ideological and political course."

articles.title_zh: 海西：257.74万元促消费资金点燃假日市场
articles.title_en: Haixi Deploys 2.5774 Million Yuan to Boost Holiday Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 海西蒙古族藏族自治州商务局启动2026年第四批促消费活动，统筹省、州两级财政资金257.74万元，依托云闪付等平台投放补贴和消费券，激发秋冬消费潜力。
articles.summary_en: The Commerce Bureau of Haixi Prefecture launched its fourth 2026 consumption promotion round, deploying 2.5774 million yuan via platforms like UnionPay to boost autumn-winter spending.

articles.title_zh: 云南省出台财政常态化帮扶资金管理实施办法
articles.title_en: Yunnan Province Issues Measures for Managing Regular Fiscal Assistance Funds
articles.summary_zh: 云南省财政厅会同省农业农村厅等部门近日制定《云南省财政常态化帮扶资金管理实施办法》，聚焦资金投入、分配使用和监管提出8项创新举措。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan's Finance Department, together with the provincial agriculture and rural affairs department, issued measures for managing regular fiscal assistance funds, proposing eight innovative steps on fund allocation, use and oversight.

articles.title_zh: 商务部回应法德要求欧盟强化贸易防御等保护主义工具
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry Responds to France and Germany's Push for Stronger EU Protectionist Trade Tools
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，商务部新闻发言人在北京就法德要求欧盟强化贸易防御等保护主义工具答问，希望法德坚持开放合作和自由贸易，不要鼓动欧盟动辄使用保护主义工具。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, a Ministry of Commerce spokesperson in Beijing urged France and Germany to uphold open cooperation and free trade, warning against pushing the EU to resort to protectionist trade tools.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷西文版读书交流会在马德里举行
articles.title_en: Reading Exchange on Spanish Edition of 'Xi Jinping: The Governance of China' Volume V Held in Madrid
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷西文版读书交流会在西班牙马德里举行，中西两国政府、高校、媒体等领域60余名代表参加，中方并赠送西文版图书。
articles.summary_en: A reading exchange on the Spanish edition of Xi Jinping's 'The Governance of China' Vol. V was held in Madrid on Oct. 6, with 60-plus Chinese and Spanish officials, academics and media representatives taking part.

articles.title_zh: 我国秋粮收获三成半
articles.title_en: China's Autumn Grain Harvest Reaches 35 Percent
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部10月6日农情调度显示，我国秋粮已收获三成半，其中西南近七成、长江中下游近五成、黄淮海和西北过四成、东北过一成。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reported on October 6 that 35 percent of the autumn grain crop has been harvested, with the southwest at nearly 70 percent, the middle and lower Yangtze at nearly 50 percent, the Huang-Huai-Hai and northwest regions above 40 percent, and the northeast above 10 percent.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 外交部：美方应慎重处理台湾问题
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: U.S. Should Handle Taiwan Issue Prudently
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上就台湾、南海等问题答问，强调台湾问题是中国内政，敦促美方慎重处理。
articles.summary_en: On October 7, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun responded to questions on Taiwan and the South China Sea, stressing that Taiwan is China's internal affair and urging the U.S. to handle it prudently.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼王陆进在南阳调研检查有关工作
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi and Wang Lujin Inspect Work in Nanyang
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进赴南阳市淅川县调研南水北调中线工程水源地保护、乡村振兴、移民安置帮扶及中医药传承创新工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and acting Governor Wang Lujin inspected Nanyang, focusing on water source protection for the South-North Water Diversion, rural revitalization and TCM innovation.

articles.title_zh: 国庆期间全国社会治安秩序良好
articles.title_en: Nationwide Public Security Order Sound During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 公安部消息，截至10月7日16时，国庆期间全国社会治安秩序良好，刑事、治安警情同比分别下降23.7%和7%，2700余场大型活动安全顺利举行。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Public Security reported that as of 4 p.m. on October 7, public security order nationwide remained sound during the National Day holiday, with criminal and public-order cases down 23.7% and 7% year on year and over 2,700 large events held safely.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期全国道路交通总体平稳有序
articles.title_en: National Road Traffic Generally Stable and Orderly During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 据公安部交通管理局10月7日消息，截至当日19时，国庆假期全国道路交通总体平稳有序，未发生重大道路交通事故，未接报长时间大范围交通拥堵。
articles.summary_en: As of 19:00 Oct 7, China's road traffic was generally stable and orderly during the National Day holiday, with no major accidents or prolonged large-scale congestion, the Ministry of Public Security said.

articles.title_zh: 运力加码 服务升级——各地护航旅客顺畅返程
articles.title_en: More Capacity, Upgraded Services: Localities Ensure Smooth Holiday Return Travel
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日国庆假期返程高峰，交通运输部预计全社会跨区域人员流动量达29375万人次，各地交通运输部门加开列车、延长地铁运营时间、增配充电设施，保障旅客平安顺畅返程。
articles.summary_en: At the peak of the National Day holiday return rush on Oct 7, the Ministry of Transport estimated 293.75 million cross-region passenger trips, with local transport departments adding trains, extending subway hours and expanding charging facilities to ensure smooth travel.

articles.title_zh: 今年“三秋”生产有更多高端智能农机投入应用
articles.title_en: More High-End Smart Farm Machinery Deployed in This Year's Autumn Harvest and Planting
articles.summary_zh: 10月7日，农业农村部表示，今年“三秋”生产中有更多高端智能农机投入一线应用，谷物联合收获机、植保无人机及丘陵山地拖拉机等加快推广。
articles.summary_en: On October 7, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs said more high-end smart farm machinery is being deployed in this year's autumn harvest and planting, with combine harvesters, plant-protection drones and hilly-area tractors being promoted.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 云南省出台财政常态化帮扶资金管理实施办法
articles.title_en: Yunnan Issues Implementation Measures for Managing Fiscal Regular Assistance Funds
articles.summary_zh: 云南省财政厅会同省农业农村厅等部门近日制定《云南省财政常态化帮扶资金管理实施办法》，聚焦资金投入、分配使用和监管全流程提出8项创新举措。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan's Provincial Department of Finance, together with the Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, recently issued implementation measures for managing regular fiscal assistance funds, introducing eight innovative steps covering fund allocation, use and oversight.

articles.title_zh: 国家税务总局发布全国统一的税务行政处罚裁量基准
articles.title_en: State Taxation Administration Issues Nationwide Unified Tax Administrative Penalty Discretionary Benchmarks
articles.summary_zh: 国家税务总局近日发布《全国税务行政处罚裁量基准（2026年版）》，自11月1日起施行，并对9类66项处罚事项优化裁量标准，同时发布“轻微不罚”清单。
articles.summary_en: China's State Taxation Administration released the 2026 edition of nationwide discretionary benchmarks for tax administrative penalties, effective Nov. 1, optimizing standards for 9 categories and 66 penalty items and issuing a list of minor violations exempt from punishment.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：反对借战事关联抹黑中国
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Opposes Smearing It by Linking It to Conflicts
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月6日，中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京答记者问时表示，中方反对借战事关联抹黑中国，并称中俄在传染病防控领域保持密切交流合作。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters in Beijing that China opposes attempts to smear it by linking it to conflicts, and said China and Russia maintain close exchanges on infectious disease prevention.

articles.title_zh: 中方：坚决反对菲律宾损害中国主权和权益的任何行径
articles.title_en: China Firmly Opposes Any Philippine Acts Undermining Its Sovereignty and Rights
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月6日，中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京答记者问时表示，中方坚决反对菲律宾损害中国主权和权益的任何行径，将继续采取必要措施捍卫南海领土主权和海洋权益。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said in Beijing that China firmly opposes any Philippine acts that undermine its sovereignty and rights, and will continue taking necessary measures to defend its territorial sovereignty and maritime rights in the South China Sea.

articles.title_zh: 在旅游中感悟中华文化、增强文化自信
articles.title_en: Experiencing Chinese Culture and Building Cultural Confidence Through Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月5日播发综述，梳理习近平总书记关于以文塑旅、以旅彰文、推动文化和旅游融合发展的重要论述，强调以保护为前提、以融合为关键、以育人为落脚点。
articles.summary_en: In a piece released on Oct 5, Xinhua reviewed Xi Jinping's guidance on integrating culture and tourism, stressing heritage protection, cultural-tourism fusion and nurturing cultural confidence.

articles.title_zh: 假期客流集中返程 多措并举保有序出行
articles.title_en: Holiday Travelers Head Home in Droves as Multiple Measures Ensure Orderly Return Trips
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，全国迎来假期返程高峰，全社会跨区域人员流动量超3亿人次，铁路、公路、民航均加大运力投放保障有序出行。
articles.summary_en: On October 6, China saw a holiday return-travel peak with over 300 million cross-region trips, as rail, road and civil aviation operators boosted capacity to keep travel orderly.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德调研检查国庆假期文旅促消费和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect National Day Holiday Tourism Promotion and Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，福州市委书记郭宁宁、市长吴贤德赴台江、仓山调研检查国庆假期文旅促消费与安全生产工作，并看望慰问一线工作人员。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected National Day holiday tourism consumption promotion and work safety in Taijiang and Cangshan districts, and visited frontline staff.

articles.title_zh: 顾坤杨新忠调研企业复工复产和节日交通运输保障工作
articles.title_en: Gu Kun and Yang Xinzhong Inspect Enterprise Work Resumption and Holiday Transportation Support
articles.summary_zh: 10月5日，淮安市委书记顾坤、代市长杨新忠调研企业复工复产和节日交通运输保障工作，强调统筹发展和安全。
articles.summary_en: On October 5, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun and Acting Mayor Yang Xinzhong inspected enterprise work resumption and holiday transportation support, stressing coordinated development and safety.

articles.title_zh: 李岩赴东昌区调研人参、文旅等特色产业发展并慰问一线干部职工
articles.title_en: Tonghua Party Secretary Li Yan Inspects Ginseng and Cultural Tourism Industries in Dongchang District
articles.summary_zh: 10月6日，吉林省通化市委书记李岩赴东昌区调研人参、文旅等特色产业发展情况，并看望慰问国庆假期坚守岗位的一线干部职工。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 6, Li Yan, Party Secretary of Tonghua, Jilin Province, inspected ginseng and cultural tourism industries in Dongchang District and met frontline workers on duty during the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Key Article on Strengthening Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Programs
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日出版的第19期《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章《加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设》，强调在发展中保障和改善民生，把发展经济与改善民生有机统一。
articles.summary_en: The 19th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on Oct 1, 2026, carried a key article by Xi Jinping on strengthening inclusive, basic and safety-net livelihood programs, stressing that improving livelihoods must go hand in hand with economic development.

articles.title_zh: 柳州：做大做强智能网联及新能源汽车产业
articles.title_en: Liuzhou Moves to Strengthen Intelligent Connected and New Energy Vehicle Industry
articles.summary_zh: 柳州介绍智能网联及新能源汽车产业发展情况，2025年新能源汽车产量突破100万辆，并出台2026—2028年三年行动方案推动产业升级。
articles.summary_en: Liuzhou officials presented the city's intelligent connected and new energy vehicle industry, citing 2025 NEV output of over 1 million units and a 2026-2028 action plan to boost the sector.

articles.title_zh: 打造新能源汽车产业新生态
articles.title_en: Building a New Ecosystem for the New Energy Vehicle Industry
articles.summary_zh: 近日，2026广西国际消费季暨汽车出海合作交流活动在南宁举行，广西工信厅副厅长柯梅现场推介智能网联新能源汽车产业优势，推动汽车跨境产业链建设。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Guangxi International Consumption Season and Auto Export Cooperation Exchange was held recently in Nanning, where Ke Mei, deputy head of Guangxi's industry and information technology department, promoted the region's smart connected NEV industry and cross-border auto supply chains.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江当好国家粮食安全“压舱石”
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Serves as the 'Ballast Stone' of National Food Security
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报调研报道显示，黑龙江推进黑土地保护、农业科技和产业链延伸，2025年粮食总产量达1640.06亿斤，实现“二十二连丰”，加快建设农业强省。
articles.summary_en: A People's Daily survey says Heilongjiang's 2025 grain output hit 164.006 billion jin, a 22nd straight record, driven by black-soil protection, farm technology and industry-chain expansion.

articles.title_zh: 习近平惦记的大河之洲展现生态新画卷
articles.title_en: The Great River Delta Xi Jinping Cares About Shows New Ecological Progress
articles.summary_zh: 2021年10月20日，习近平在山东东营考察黄河三角洲湿地，要求创建黄河口国家公园；5年来当地湿地生态持续改善。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 20, 2021, Xi Jinping inspected the Yellow River Delta wetland in Dongying, Shandong, urging the creation of a national park at the Yellow River estuary. Five years on, the wetland ecosystem has improved markedly.

tags.name_en: Ecological Protection of the Yellow River Basin

tags_en: Ecological Protection of the Yellow River Basin

articles.title_zh: 学习原声丨以文化滋养精神家园
articles.title_en: Learning from the Original Voice: Nourishing the Spiritual Home Through Culture
articles.summary_zh: 新华社推出《学习原声》音视频节目，重温2023年10月全国宣传思想文化工作会议正式提出习近平文化思想，强调文化兴国运兴、文化强民族强。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua released a video feature revisiting the October 2023 national meeting on publicity, ideological and cultural work, where Xi Jinping Thought on Culture was formally introduced as a guide for building a strong socialist culture.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 习近平的文化足迹：有文化自信的民族，才能立得住、站得稳、行得远
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Cultural Footprints: A Nation with Cultural Confidence Can Stand Firm and Go Far
articles.summary_zh: 新华社播发“近镜头·习近平的文化足迹”特写，回顾习近平总书记考察四川都江堰，强调中华文明的连续性，倡导从先贤治水智慧中汲取治国理政智慧。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua feature traces Xi Jinping's cultural footprints at Dujiangyan in Sichuan, where he stressed the continuity of Chinese civilization and drew governance lessons from ancient water management.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 加强红色资源保护利用 做好红色文化传承弘扬
articles.title_en: Strengthening Protection and Use of Red Resources, Carrying Forward Red Culture
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期正值中国工农红军长征胜利90周年，各地红色旅游火热，长征国家文化公园建设与长征文物保护利用持续推进。
articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March's victory, red tourism flourished as China advanced protection of Long March relics and built the Long March National Cultural Park.

articles.title_zh: 假期消费市场平稳有序
articles.title_en: Holiday Consumer Market Stable and Orderly as New Scenarios Enrich Supply
articles.summary_zh: 商务部10月4日发布数据显示，国庆假期全国消费市场平稳有序，前三天重点监测步行街客流量、营业额同比分别增长3.4%和5.3%。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce said on Oct 4 that China's holiday consumer market was stable and orderly, with foot traffic and sales at 78 key shopping areas up 3.4% and 5.3% year-on-year in the first three days.

articles.title_zh: 中国匠心筑造沙特“东气西输”大动脉
articles.title_en: Chinese Craftsmanship Builds Saudi Arabia's East-West Gas Transmission Artery
articles.summary_zh: 中国石化石油工程建设公司承建的沙特国家天然气管网三期管道项目总体进度超80%，累计完成超678公里管道焊接，助力共建“一带一路”能源合作。
articles.summary_en: Sinopec's oil engineering unit has welded over 678 km of the Saudi national gas pipeline Phase III project, now more than 80% complete, boosting Belt and Road energy cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚到长春大冬会专班、市应急局指挥中心等地慰问检查工作
articles.title_en: Changchun Mayor Gu Gang Inspects Greater Winter Games Task Force and Municipal Emergency Command Center
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日至4日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚赴长春大冬会专班、市应急局指挥中心、净月潭、长春站等地检查工作，看望慰问坚守岗位的干部职工。
articles.summary_en: From October 2 to 4, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang inspected the Greater Winter Games task force, the municipal emergency command center and other sites, and visited staff on duty.

articles.title_zh: 我国大宗商品市场景气水平进一步提升
articles.title_en: China's Bulk Commodity Market Sentiment Improves Further
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会10月5日公布，9月中国大宗商品价格指数为137.6点，环比上涨4.1%，同比上涨22.9%，50种重点监测商品中38种价格环比上涨。
articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing announced on October 5 that China's bulk commodity price index stood at 137.6 in September, up 4.1% month-on-month and 22.9% year-on-year, with 38 of 50 monitored commodities posting price gains.

articles.title_zh: 升级交通服务 强化返程保障
articles.title_en: Transport Services Upgraded to Ensure Smooth Holiday Return Travel
articles.summary_zh: 10月5日国庆假期返程客流启动，全社会跨区域人员流动量超3亿人次，交通运输部指导各地加开列车、延长地铁运营、增开接驳公交，保障旅客顺利返程。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 5, cross-regional trips exceeded 300 million as National Day return travel peaked; the Ministry of Transport mobilized extra trains, extended metro hours and added shuttle services.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开国庆期间应急值守视频调度会
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Video Meeting on National Day Emergency Duty
articles.summary_zh: 10月5日下午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖在市应急指挥中心主持召开国庆期间应急值守视频调度会，部署假期应急值守工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of October 5, Huaihua Party Secretary Wei Zhaohui chaired a video meeting at the city emergency command center to coordinate emergency duty work during the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开拉萨市委常委会（扩大）会议 安排部署贯彻落实工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Expanded Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Meeting to Deploy Implementation Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，部署节日期间维稳、安全生产和民生保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering chaired an expanded municipal Party committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's key instructions and deploy stability, work-safety and livelihood measures for the holiday period.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁深入城关区、高新区督导值班值守、节日保供、安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Ciren Inspects Duty Rota, Holiday Supply and Workplace Safety in Chengguan District and High-Tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，西藏自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁以“四不两直”方式深入城关区、高新区，督导值班值守、节日保供和安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, Dawa Ciren, Standing Committee member of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee and Secretary of the Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, made unannounced inspections in Chengguan District and the High-Tech Zone on duty rosters, holiday supply and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁深入达孜区林周县调研督导生态环境保护等工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Inspects Dazi District and Linzhou County on Ecological Protection, Major Projects and Public Security
articles.summary_zh: 10月4日，西藏自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁深入达孜区、林周县调研督导生态环境保护、重大项目建设、社会治安综合治理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 4, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering inspected Dazi District and Linzhou County, overseeing ecological protection, major project construction and public security governance.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅关于发展体育赛事激发消费活力的意见
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Opinions on Developing Sports Events to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，国务院办公厅发布意见，提出推动体育赛事品牌化、融合化、市场化发展，到2030年基本形成具有中国特色的现代化赛事体系，以激发消费活力。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, the General Office of China's State Council issued guidelines to make sports events more branded, integrated and market-driven, aiming to build a modern events system with Chinese characteristics by 2030 and boost consumption.

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 为变乱交织的世界注入更多确定性和正能量
articles.title_en: Injecting More Certainty and Positive Energy into a Turbulent World
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月3日播发评论，学习贯彻习近平在庆祝新中国成立77周年招待会上的重要讲话，强调坚持和平外交、落实四大全球倡议。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua commentary dated Oct 3 studies Xi Jinping's speech at the reception marking the 77th anniversary of the PRC, stressing independent peaceful diplomacy and the four global initiatives.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

articles.title_zh: 蔡剑峰走访调研假期连续生产企业并调度节日重点工作
articles.title_en: Cai Jianfeng Inspects Enterprises Operating Through the Holiday and Coordinates Key Holiday Work
articles.summary_zh: 10月4日，无锡代市长蔡剑峰走访调研国庆假期连续生产企业，并视频调度城市运行、文旅消费和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 4, Wuxi Acting Mayor Cai Jianfeng visited enterprises running through the National Day holiday and coordinated city operations, tourism spending and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜察看“苏超”联赛盐城主场赛事准备工作
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Inspects Preparations for Yancheng's Home Jiangsu Super League Match
articles.summary_zh: 10月4日上午，盐城市委副书记、代市长吴炜现场察看“苏超”联赛盐城主场对阵宿迁的赛事准备工作，要求做好赛事组织、消防安全和消费服务保障。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 4, Yancheng Acting Mayor Wu Wei inspected preparations for the city's Jiangsu Super League home match against Suqian, urging solid event organization, fire and food safety, and consumer services.

articles.title_zh: 创新场景 丰富供给 假期消费市场平稳有序
articles.title_en: New Scenarios and Enriched Supply Keep Holiday Consumption Market Stable and Orderly
articles.summary_zh: 商务部10月4日发布消息显示，国庆假期过半全国消费市场平稳有序；假期前三天重点监测的78个步行街（商圈）客流量、营业额同比分别增长3.4%和5.3%。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce said on Oct 4 that the consumer market was stable and orderly halfway through the National Day holiday, with foot traffic and sales at 78 monitored shopping streets up 3.4% and 5.3% year on year in the first three days.

articles.title_zh: 河北省启动二〇二六年度国家级绿色制造名单推荐工作
articles.title_en: Hebei Launches 2026 National Green Manufacturing List Recommendation Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日起，河北省启动2026年度国家级绿色制造名单推荐工作，涵盖绿色工厂、绿色供应链领航企业和绿色工业园区，省工信厅将于10月25日前组织申报审核。
articles.summary_en: Starting Sept 30, Hebei Province launched its 2026 national green manufacturing list recommendation work, covering green factories, green supply chain leader enterprises and green industrial parks, with applications due by Oct 25.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江强化农业科技和装备支撑 智慧农业聚木成林
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Strengthens Agricultural Science and Equipment Support as Smart Agriculture Takes Root
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江借AI育种、数字施肥地图、农服APP和智能加工线等提升智慧农业水平，全省农作物耕种收综合机械化率超99%，居全国首位。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang is scaling up smart agriculture with AI breeding, digital fertilization maps, farm-service apps and smart processing lines, with its crop mechanization rate topping 99 percent, the highest in China.

articles.title_zh: 加强红色资源保护利用 做好红色文化传承弘扬
articles.title_en: Strengthening Protection and Use of Red Resources, Carrying Forward Red Culture
articles.summary_zh: 在中国工农红军长征胜利90周年之际，2026年国庆假期各地推进长征文物和文化资源保护利用，长征国家文化公园及革命旧址、主题展览迎来大批参观者。
articles.summary_en: Marking the 90th anniversary of the Long March's victory, China is boosting protection of Long March relics, with red sites and exhibitions drawing crowds during the 2026 National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 假期消费市场平稳有序
articles.title_en: Holiday Consumer Market Remains Stable and Orderly
articles.summary_zh: 商务部10月4日发布消息显示，国庆假期过半，全国消费市场平稳有序，重点步行街客流量、营业额同比分别增长3.4%、5.3%，以旧换新带动销售额196.3亿元。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce said on Oct 4 that China's consumer market stayed stable and orderly during the National Day holiday, with foot traffic and sales at 78 key commercial districts up 3.4% and 5.3% year on year, while trade-in deals drove 19.63 billion yuan in sales.

articles.title_zh: 2026年成都市民间投资机会清单发布
articles.title_en: Chengdu Releases 2026 Private Investment Opportunity List
articles.summary_zh: 成都市发展改革委发布2026年民间投资机会清单，共225个项目、总投资超1000亿元，涵盖现代服务、公共服务、先进制造、科技创新和现代农业五大领域。
articles.summary_en: Chengdu's Development and Reform Commission released its 2026 private investment opportunity list, covering 225 projects with total investment exceeding 100 billion yuan across five sectors.

tags_en: Chengdu Municipal Development and Reform Commission

articles.title_zh: 陕西出台国内首个无人驾驶航空器保险理赔服务规范
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues China's First Insurance Claims Standard for Unmanned Aircraft
articles.summary_zh: 陕西金融监管局指导陕西省保险行业协会印发《陕西无人驾驶航空器保险理赔指引（暂行）》，统一理赔争议认定与赔付标准，系国内首个无人机保险理赔服务规范。
articles.summary_en: Guided by the Shaanxi Financial Regulatory Bureau, the Shaanxi Insurance Industry Association issued interim guidelines on unmanned aircraft insurance claims, China's first such standard, unifying evidence and payout rules to support the low-altitude economy.

articles.title_zh: 绍兴嵊州加速构筑新能源装备产业高地
articles.title_en: Shengzhou of Shaoxing Accelerates Building a New Energy Equipment Industry Hub
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，浙江绍兴嵊州推动新能源汽车及零部件产业全链发展，1至8月该集群产值99.9亿元、同比增长44.2%，全力冲刺全年目标。
articles.summary_en: Shengzhou in Shaoxing, Zhejiang is advancing full-chain development of new energy vehicle and parts production, with the cluster's output rising 44.2% year-on-year to 9.99 billion yuan in the first eight months of 2026.

articles.title_zh: 商务部回应G20贸易部长会议：坚持原则 促谈促合
articles.title_en: MOFCOM Responds on G20 Trade Ministers Meeting: Upholding Principles, Promoting Talks and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月4日，商务部新闻发言人就9月30日至10月1日在美国密尔沃基举行的G20贸易部长会议答记者问，表示会议就粮食议题达成联合声明，中方建设性参与讨论、发挥促谈促合作用。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 4, a MOFCOM spokesperson commented on the G20 trade ministers meeting held Sept 30-Oct 1 in Milwaukee, saying members reached a joint statement on food and China played a constructive role in promoting talks and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 司法部：2025年共调解各类案件1653.7万件
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice: 16.537 Million Cases Mediated Nationwide in 2025
articles.summary_zh: 2025年全国共调解各类案件1653.7万件，调解成功率96.5%；全国有人民调解委员会69.7万个、人民调解员310.2万人，已累计培育“法律明白人”440万人。
articles.summary_en: China mediated 16.537 million cases in 2025 with a 96.5% success rate, the Ministry of Justice said, citing 697,000 people's mediation committees and 3.102 million mediators nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 王东伟检查全省政府系统值班值守工作
articles.title_en: Wang Dongwei Inspects Government Duty and Emergency Operations in Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期期间，安徽省代省长王东伟赴省政府总值班室检查全省政府系统值班值守工作，并视频调度应急、文旅、交通运输等领域安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday, Anhui Acting Governor Wang Dongwei inspected the provincial government's duty and emergency operations and urged stronger safety measures in tourism, transport and key industries.

articles.title_zh: 出行热 体验丰 门市旺——国庆假期消费市场观察
articles.title_en: Travel Boom, Rich Experiences, Bustling Stores: National Day Holiday Consumption Market Observation
articles.summary_zh: 新华社10月5日报道，国庆中秋假期消费市场观察显示，长线游与小城游火热、沉浸式体验走红，以旧换新政策带动10月1日至3日销售额196.3亿元。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Oct 5 that China's National Day and Mid-Autumn holiday saw booming long-distance travel, immersive experiences and trade-in subsidies that drove 19.63 billion yuan in sales from Oct 1 to 3.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛率团在阿联酋考察访问
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Leads Jiangsu Delegation on Visit to UAE
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日至10月2日，江苏省省长刘小涛率代表团访问阿联酋，会见多位阿方部长和企业负责人，并见证省港口集团与迪拜环球港务集团签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: From September 29 to October 2, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao led a delegation to the UAE, meeting several Emirati ministers and business leaders and witnessing a strategic cooperation agreement between Jiangsu Provincial Port Group and DP World.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语·家国同心丨让民族团结进步之花越开越绚烂
articles.title_en: Study New Discourses · One Heart for Country and Family | Let the Flower of Ethnic Unity and Progress Bloom Ever More Brilliantly
articles.summary_zh: 新华社发布专题内容，引用习近平关于民族团结的重要论述，强调各民族像石榴籽一样紧紧抱在一起，共同推进民族团结进步事业。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua released a feature quoting Xi Jinping's important discourses on ethnic unity, stressing that all ethnic groups should stick together like pomegranate seeds and jointly advance ethnic unity and progress.

articles.summary_en: In May 2021, Xi Jinping visited the home of resettled villager Zou Xinzeng in Zouzhuang Village, Xichuan County, Henan, stressing that the Party's purpose is to serve the people.

articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期，消费品以旧换新、消费贷款贴息等惠民政策加快落地，第四批625亿元超长期特别国债资金节前到位，各地投放消费券促消费。
articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday, China accelerated consumer goods trade-in and loan interest subsidy policies, with 62.5 billion yuan in ultra-long special treasury bonds disbursed before the holiday.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期第四天全国道路交通总体平稳
articles.title_en: Road Traffic Nationwide Generally Stable on Fourth Day of National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月4日国庆假期第四天，全国主干公路交通流量保持高位运行，公安部交管局称截至18时全国道路交通总体平稳有序，并提示返程高峰注意事项。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 4, the fourth day of the National Day holiday, traffic on major highways stayed heavy; the Ministry of Public Security traffic bureau said nationwide road traffic was broadly stable and orderly as of 18:00 and issued return-trip safety tips.

articles.title_zh: 智慧交通助力国庆假期出行
articles.title_en: Smart Transportation Facilitates National Day Holiday Travel
articles.summary_zh: 10月4日，交通运输部预计国庆假期全社会跨区域人员流动量超3亿人次，铁路、公路、民航依托智慧调度、AI客流预测和大数据共享提升出行效率与安全。
articles.summary_en: On October 4, the Ministry of Transport estimated that cross-regional passenger flows during the National Day holiday would exceed 300 million trips, as railways, highways and civil aviation used smart dispatching, AI passenger forecasting and shared data to make travel more efficient and safer.

articles.summary_en: On October 4, China's Ministry of Commerce reported that in the first three days of the National Day holiday, foot traffic and sales at 78 key shopping areas rose 3.4% and 5.3% year on year, while trade-in programs drove 19.63 billion yuan in sales and daily necessities remained well supplied at stable prices.

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见中国西班牙商会客人
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Meets with Guests from the China-Spain Chamber of Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，威海市委书记张海波会见中国西班牙商会会长路易斯·卢比奥一行，双方就产业、经贸、文体旅游等领域深化合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo met with Luis Rubio, president of the China-Spain Chamber of Commerce, to discuss deeper cooperation in industry, trade and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 陈东调研数字经济发展工作
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Surveys Digital Economy Development in Wuhu
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日至3日，芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东赴江北新区、经开区专题调研数字经济发展，并主持召开数字经济重大项目谋划推进会议。
articles.summary_en: From Oct 2 to 3, Chen Dong, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Wuhu, inspected digital economy projects in Jiangbei New Area and the Economic Development Zone and chaired a meeting on major digital economy projects.

articles.title_zh: 上汽集团来锡对接深化合作
articles.title_en: SAIC Motor Visits Wuxi to Deepen Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，上汽集团副总裁杨怀景一行来无锡对接深化合作，市委书记蒋锋与代表团会谈，双方围绕深化务实合作、加速项目落地深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 3, a SAIC Motor delegation led by Vice President Yang Huaijing visited Wuxi for talks with Party Secretary Jiang Feng on deepening cooperation and speeding up project implementation.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人大常委会就涉农财政专项资金使用绩效开展专题询问
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Conducts Special Inquiry on Performance of Agricultural Fiscal Funds
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议举行联组会议，就全省农业农村领域财政重点专项资金使用绩效开展专题询问，省政府副省长及有关部门负责人到会应询。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the Standing Committee of the 14th Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress held a joint meeting to question provincial departments on how agricultural fiscal funds are spent, with the vice governor and department heads attending to respond.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语・家国同心｜怀爱国之心 立报国之志

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事丨观天十载探苍穹
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: A Decade of Exploring the Cosmos with China's FAST Telescope
articles.summary_zh: 中国天眼（FAST）落成启用十周年之际，新华社报道其累计发现脉冲星超1300颗，中性氢巡天发布第二期数据集，FAST二期工程稳步推进。
articles.summary_en: As China's FAST telescope marks ten years since launch, Xinhua reports it has found over 1,300 pulsars, released a second neutral-hydrogen survey dataset, and is advancing a second-phase array.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨生态为民 绘就美丽中国新图景
articles.title_en: Ecological Civilization Serves the People, Painting a New Picture of a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期期间，各地展现生态惠民成果。在习近平生态文明思想指引下，我国生态治理重心下沉，让群众身边的水、气、噪声问题加快解决，共享生态红利。
articles.summary_en: Amid the National Day holiday, China highlighted ecological gains as environmental governance shifts toward issues affecting people's daily life, guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization.

articles.summary_en: Xinhua's New Media Center released a themed feature on patriotism, compiling Xi Jinping's remarks since the 18th CPC National Congress that elaborate on the meaning of patriotism.

articles.title_en: Study Notes: Spending the Holidays with Clean and Upright Conduct

articles.summary_en: As Mid-Autumn Festival meets National Day, Xinhua reviews Xi Jinping's decade-long push since 2012 to curb holiday corruption and uphold clean Party conduct.

articles.title_zh: 2025年全国政府采购规模超3.32万亿元
articles.title_en: China's 2025 Government Procurement Scale Exceeds 3.32 Trillion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 财政部日前发布2025年全国政府采购简要情况，全年采购规模达33212.96亿元，其中货物、工程、服务分别为7953.92亿元、13045.08亿元和12213.96亿元。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Finance released a summary of national government procurement for 2025, showing total procurement of 3.3213 trillion yuan, including 795.39 billion yuan in goods, 1.3045 trillion yuan in works and 1.2214 trillion yuan in services.

articles.title_zh: 商务部就对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查答记者问
articles.title_en: MOFCOM Spokesperson Answers Questions on Anti-Dumping Investigation into EU-Origin Para-Nitrotoluene Imports
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月3日，商务部新闻发言人表示，应国内产业申请，中方对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查，并指出欧盟2025年以来已对中国发起28起贸易救济调查。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, 2026, a MOFCOM spokesperson said China has launched an anti-dumping investigation into para-nitrotoluene imports from the EU following a domestic industry petition, noting the EU has opened 28 trade remedy probes against China since 2025.

articles.title_zh: 商务部对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销立案调查
articles.title_en: China's Commerce Ministry Launches Anti-Dumping Probe into EU-Origin p-Nitrotoluene Imports
articles.summary_zh: 商务部公告2026年第44号，决定自2026年10月3日起对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销立案调查，倾销调查期为2025年7月至2026年6月。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced on October 3, 2026 that it has launched an anti-dumping investigation into p-nitrotoluene imports originating in the European Union, with a dumping investigation period from July 2025 to June 2026.

articles.title_zh: AI时代中国网络文学“跃”上荧屏
articles.title_en: In the AI Era, Chinese Online Literature Jumps onto the Screen
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日中新社报道，生成式AI加速中国网络文学IP影像化，杭州中国网络作家村已促成超270部网文IP转化，成交额逾22.4亿元。
articles.summary_en: A China News Service report on Oct 3 says generative AI is accelerating screen adaptations of Chinese online literature, with the China Online Literature Writers Village in Hangzhou having turned over 270 web novels into shows and games worth more than 224 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 焦点访谈｜从雪山草地到治沙一线 长征精神永不褪色
articles.title_en: Focus Report: Long March Spirit Lives On, From Snow Mountains and Grasslands to Desert Control Frontline
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日央视《焦点访谈》回顾红军翻越夹金山、穿越草地的长征历程，并讲述内蒙古鄂尔多斯治沙人推进“三北”工程攻坚战的故事。
articles.summary_en: CCTV's Focus Report on Oct 3 reviewed the Red Army's Long March over Jiajin Mountain and the grasslands, and told the story of desert-control workers in Ordos, Inner Mongolia, advancing the 'Three-North' afforestation campaign.

articles.title_zh: 跟着政策走 日子有奔头
articles.title_en: Following Policy, Life Has Prospects: Yak Industry Lifts Qinghai's Banma County
articles.summary_zh: 青海果洛藏族自治州班玛县立足资源禀赋发展牦牛产业，通过合作社收购、企业加工牦牛阿胶带动农牧民增收，并组建生态管护队伍守护草原。
articles.summary_en: Banma County in Qinghai's Golog Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture is developing its yak industry, with cooperatives and processing firms turning yak hide into ejiao to lift herders' incomes while ecological rangers protect the grasslands.

articles.title_zh: 因地制宜发展具身智能产业
articles.title_en: Developing the Embodied AI Industry by Leveraging Local Strengths
articles.summary_zh: 浙江绍兴市上虞区深入实施“人工智能+”行动，以场景开放和生态协同推动具身智能产业落地，已引进相关项目20个、总投资超150亿元。
articles.summary_en: Shangyu District in Shaoxing, Zhejiang, is advancing the embodied AI industry by opening up industrial application scenarios, having attracted 20 projects with total investment exceeding 15 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 产业家底厚 县域活力足
articles.title_en: Shandong Taps Local Industry Strengths to Energize County-Level Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 山东立足县域产业基础，深耕产品、拓宽品类、创新场景，宁津健身器材、曹县汉服、邹城户外乐园等带动县域消费活力持续释放。
articles.summary_en: Shandong is drawing on local industrial strengths to boost county-level consumption, from fitness equipment in Ningjin and hanfu in Caoxian to an outdoor theme park in Zoucheng.

articles.title_zh: 以奋斗之姿书写时代华章——习近平总书记在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上的重要讲话汇聚团结奋进力量
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the 77th National Day Reception Inspires Unity and Striving for a New Chapter of the Era
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，习近平总书记在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上发表重要讲话，广大干部群众表示要团结奋进，把中国式现代化宏伟事业推向前进。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 30, Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PRC, and officials and citizens pledged to unite and strive to advance Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 铿锵步伐 献礼祖国
articles.title_en: Macau SAR Adopts Chinese-Style Parade Steps at National Day Flag-Raising Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，澳门特区政府庆祝新中国成立77周年升旗仪式首次全面采用中式队列步操及解放军敬礼方式，相关修订后的《敬礼及礼仪规章》行政法规当日生效。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 1, Macau's National Day flag-raising ceremony for the PRC's 77th anniversary used Chinese-style marching and PLA salutes for the first time, under revised protocol rules effective the same day.

articles.title_zh: 学习国庆招待会重要讲话 读懂开局之年的奋进中国
articles.title_en: Studying the Key Speech at the National Day Reception: Understanding a Striving China in the Opening Year
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，庆祝新中国成立77周年招待会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，总结今年以来成就，指引“十五五”开局方向。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 30, Xi Jinping delivered a key speech at the National Day reception in Beijing, reviewing this year's achievements and charting the opening year of the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期第三天全国道路交通平稳有序
articles.title_en: Nationwide Road Traffic Remains Orderly on Third Day of National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，公安部交通管理局表示，国庆假期第三天全国道路交通流量持续回落但仍处高位，各地交管部门加强重点路段疏导管控、严查交通违法，截至19时全国道路交通总体平稳有序。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, the Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security said traffic volume kept falling but stayed high on the third day of the National Day holiday, as traffic police stepped up guidance on key routes and crackdowns on violations; by 19:00 nationwide road traffic was generally orderly.

tags.name_en: Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security

tags_en: Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期第二天全国道路交通总体平稳有序
articles.title_en: National Road Traffic Generally Stable and Orderly on Second Day of National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日，国庆假期第二天，全国公路交通流量较前一日下降，主干公路通行总体有序，各地公安交管部门加大警力投入，严查交通违法行为。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 2, the second day of the National Day holiday, highway traffic volume fell from the previous day and main roads ran largely in order, as traffic police stepped up patrols and enforcement.

tags.name_en: Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security

tags_en: Traffic Management Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学在安定区督导检查国庆假期重点工作
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Inspects Key Holiday Work in Anding District
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，定西市委书记汪尚学深入安定区，督导检查地质灾害防治、道路交通安全生产、马铃薯秋收及促消费活动等国庆假期重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, Dingxi Municipal Party Secretary Wang Shangxue inspected Anding District, checking geological hazard control, road traffic safety, the potato harvest and holiday consumption-promotion activities.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱调研秋收生产工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects Autumn Harvest Production
articles.summary_zh: 10月3日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱赴新华农场、东山区等地调研秋收生产，要求抢抓农时、确保粮食颗粒归仓，并部署秋整地与粮食收储工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 3, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu inspected autumn harvest production at farms in Xinhua and Dongshan District, urging timely harvesting, grain storage and farmland preparation to safeguard food security.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生走访慰问国庆一线值守工作人员
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Visits Frontline Workers on Duty During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日下午，怀化市委副书记、代市长高靖生走访慰问国庆假期一线值守人员，检查道路交通安全、运输保障和文旅市场工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 1, Gao Jingsheng, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Huaihua, visited frontline workers on National Day duty, inspecting road traffic safety, transport services and the holiday tourism market.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升在拉萨调研文旅市场、节日保供、安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Lhasa on Cultural Tourism, Holiday Supply and Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨调研文旅市场、节日保供和安全生产等工作，并向全区各族干部群众及坚守岗位的工作人员致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, Hu Changsheng, Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, inspected Lhasa's cultural tourism market, holiday supply and work safety, extending festive greetings to officials and workers on duty.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年“升国旗、唱国歌”仪式在拉萨举行
articles.title_en: Tibet Autonomous Region Holds Flag-Raising Ceremony in Lhasa to Mark 77th Anniversary of the PRC
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日上午，西藏自治区在拉萨布达拉宫广场举行庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年“升国旗、唱国歌”仪式，胡昌升、严金海、嘎玛泽登等自治区领导出席，达娃次仁主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Oct 1, the Tibet Autonomous Region held a flag-raising and national anthem ceremony at the Potala Palace square in Lhasa marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PRC, attended by regional leaders including Hu Changsheng and Yan Jinhai.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升与在拉萨的离退休省级老干部座谈
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Meets with Retired Provincial-Level Cadres in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日上午，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨与离退休省级老干部座谈，介绍全区工作并强调用心用情做好新时代老干部服务保障。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 2, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Hu Changsheng met with retired provincial-level cadres in Lhasa, briefing them on regional work and urging better care and services for veteran officials.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升：在视频调度全区维稳工作时强调 加强值班值守 强化服务保障 确保人民群众平安祥和过节
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Region-Wide Stability Work via Video, Urges Safe Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨视频调度全区维稳工作，检查国庆假期值班值守、服务保障和安全生产，要求确保群众平安祥和过节。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 1, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng held a video meeting in Lhasa on region-wide stability work, urging stronger duty, service, and safety measures for a safe National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 徐志"四不两直"检查督导安全生产工作并看望慰问值班值守人员
articles.title_en: Xu Zhi Conducts Unannounced Inspection of Work Safety and Visits On-Duty Staff
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日，芜湖市委书记徐志以"四不两直"方式赴湾沚区检查督导安全生产、应急值守和道路交通安全工作，并看望慰问一线值班值守人员。
articles.summary_en: On October 2, Wuhu Party Secretary Xu Zhi made an unannounced inspection in Wanzhi District on work safety, emergency duty and road traffic safety, and visited frontline staff on duty.

articles.title_zh: 新能源车假日迎“充电大考” 如何应对？
articles.title_en: New Energy Vehicles Face a Holiday Charging Test: How to Respond?
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期新能源汽车出行激增，高速服务区充电压力大，交通运输部与国家电网通过应急充电设施、智慧引导等措施缓解排队。
articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday, surging EV travel strained highway service-area charging; the Ministry of Transport and State Grid deployed emergency chargers and smart guidance to ease queues.

articles.title_zh: 福州市人大常委会作出审议意见推动文旅发展
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Issues Deliberation Opinions to Boost Cultural Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 福州市十六届人大常委会第三十三次会议听取并审议市政府提升文旅发展质量工作报告，近日作出审议意见，提出打造世界知名旅游目的地。
articles.summary_en: The 33rd session of the 16th Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee reviewed the municipal government's report on improving cultural tourism quality and issued deliberation opinions aimed at building a world-renowned tourism destination.

tags.name_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 从“红色电波”到数智之城
articles.title_en: From "Red Radio Waves" to a Smart Digital City: Zunyi's Digital Economy Push
articles.summary_zh: 贵州省遵义市抢抓数字经济发展机遇，2025年全市大数据融合发展指数提升至50.51，落地175个数字化应用场景，推动数实融合与文旅数字化升级。
articles.summary_en: Zunyi in Guizhou is advancing its digital economy, with the city's big-data integration index rising to 50.51 in 2025 and 175 digital application scenarios deployed across agriculture, industry and tourism.

tags.name_en: Integration of Digital and Real Economy

tags_en: Integration of Digital and Real Economy

articles.title_zh: 凝心聚力把强国建设、民族复兴的宏伟蓝图变成美好现实——习近平总书记在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上的重要讲话引发热烈反响
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Reception Marking the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China Draws Warm Response
articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月，习近平总书记在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上发表重要讲话，各界反响热烈，表示要凝心聚力把强国建设、民族复兴的宏伟蓝图变成美好现实。
articles.summary_en: In October 2026, Xi Jinping delivered an important speech at the reception celebrating the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, drawing warm responses from all sectors committed to turning the blueprint for national strength and rejuvenation into reality.

articles.title_zh: 广西印发通信行业发展“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Information and Communications Industry
articles.summary_zh: 广西通信管理局近日印发《广西壮族自治区信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年建成全域覆盖、陆海贯通、辐射东盟的信息通信基础设施。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi's Communications Administration issued the region's 15th Five-Year Plan for the information and communications industry, aiming to build by 2030 infrastructure that covers the whole region, links land and sea, and reaches ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 广西一批重点电网工程密集投运
articles.title_en: Batch of Key Power Grid Projects Put into Operation in Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期期间，广西621项电网基建项目不停工，超9000名建设者坚守岗位；今年1—9月广西电网累计投产72项主网、6200余项配网工程。
articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday, 621 power grid construction projects in Guangxi continued without pause with more than 9,000 workers on site; in the first nine months of the year, 72 main-grid and over 6,200 distribution-grid projects were completed.

articles.title_zh: 河北省实施省级耕地保护经济奖励机制
articles.title_en: Hebei Implements Provincial Economic Incentive Mechanism for Farmland Protection
articles.summary_zh: 河北省自然资源厅、省财政厅近日联合印发《河北省省级耕地保护经济奖励暂行办法》，对耕地保护成效突出的县级人民政府给予资金奖励，每县（市、区）不超过100万元。
articles.summary_en: Hebei's provincial natural resources and finance departments issued interim rules granting up to 1 million yuan to county governments with outstanding farmland protection results.

tags.name_en: Hebei Provincial Department of Natural Resources

tags_en: Hebei Provincial Department of Natural Resources

articles.title_zh: 以旧换新再扩围 真金白银促消费
articles.title_en: Trade-in Program Expanded Further, Real Subsidies Spur Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 河北省9月1日起加力推出消费品以旧换新自主品类补贴，国庆假期首日全省使用补贴资金5459.05万元，销售额5.01亿元，惠及消费者8.08万人次。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province expanded its consumer goods trade-in subsidies to new categories from September 1; on the first day of the National Day holiday, 54.59 million yuan in subsidies drove 501 million yuan in sales, benefiting 80,800 consumers.

articles.title_zh: 两百余项促消费活动激活鹿城假日经济
articles.title_en: Baotou Launches 200-Plus Consumption Promotion Events to Boost Holiday Economy
articles.summary_zh: 2026年国庆期间，包头市启动“约惠鹿城·乐享金秋”促消费专项活动，安排700万元财政资金，推出11大类200余项活动及汽车、家电等专项补贴。
articles.summary_en: During the 2026 National Day holiday, Baotou launched its "Yuehui Lucheng - Enjoy Golden Autumn" consumption campaign, allocating 7 million yuan in fiscal funds for over 200 events in 11 categories, including subsidies for cars and appliances.

articles.title_zh: 山东出台体育强省建设“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Sports Powerhouse Province
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山东省人民政府印发体育强省建设“十五五”规划，部署全民健身、竞技体育、体育产业等重点领域，提出到2030年全省体育产业总规模突破9000亿元。
articles.summary_en: Shandong issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for building a sports powerhouse province, covering fitness, elite sports and industry, targeting over 900 billion yuan in sports industry output by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 山西发布首批省级零碳园区建设名单
articles.title_en: Shanxi Releases First Batch of Provincial Zero-Carbon Park Construction List
articles.summary_zh: 日前，山西省发展改革委、省工信厅、省能源局联合发布首批省级零碳园区建设名单，朔州、孝义等7家开发区入选，建设周期为2026年至2029年底。
articles.summary_en: Shanxi's Development and Reform Commission, Industry and Information Technology Department and Energy Bureau jointly released the first batch of provincial zero-carbon industrial park construction list, with seven development zones selected for a construction period running from 2026 to the end of 2029.

tags.name_en: Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality Goals

tags_en: Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality Goals

articles.title_zh: 云南省新能源重卡充电量创新高
articles.title_en: Yunnan's New Energy Heavy Truck Charging Volume Hits Record High
articles.summary_zh: 今年1至8月，云南全省新能源重卡充电量达15.59亿千瓦时，同比增长542.20%，重卡充换电网络已覆盖全省16个州（市）。
articles.summary_en: In the first eight months of this year, new energy heavy truck charging volume in Yunnan reached 1.559 billion kWh, up 542.2% year on year, with a truck charging and battery-swap network now covering all 16 prefectures and cities.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委推广浙江第三批共富经验做法
articles.title_en: NDRC Promotes Zhejiang's Third Batch of Common Prosperity Experience
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委办公厅印发浙江高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区第三批经验做法，推广青年入乡发展集成改革等10条经验，供全国复制推广。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC General Office issued the third batch of experience practices from Zhejiang's high-quality development demonstration zone for common prosperity, promoting 10 measures including integrated reform for youth returning to rural areas.

articles.title_zh: 多国政要祝贺新中国成立77周年 希望继续深化对华关系
articles.title_en: Foreign Dignitaries Congratulate China on 77th Founding Anniversary, Vow to Deepen Ties
articles.summary_zh: 10月2日，多国政要出席中国驻外使领馆国庆招待会等活动，祝贺新中国成立77周年，高度评价中国发展成就并希望继续深化对华关系。
articles.summary_en: On October 2, dignitaries from many countries attended National Day receptions at Chinese diplomatic missions, congratulating the PRC on its 77th founding anniversary and voicing hope to further deepen relations with China.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming inspected sci-tech journal development in Hunan, visiting Central South University of Forestry and Technology and the provincial academy of agricultural sciences, and chairing a symposium on building world-class journals.

articles.title_zh: 多地多举措护航新能源车国庆假期出行
articles.title_en: Multiple Regions Take Measures to Support New Energy Vehicle Travel During National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期新能源车出行规模预计达日常1.8倍，交通运输部及多省电力部门扩容充电设施、开展专项巡检并强化值守，保障高速服务区与景区充电服务。
articles.summary_en: With NEV holiday travel expected at 1.8 times daily levels, the Ministry of Transport and provincial power grids expanded charging facilities, ran inspections and stepped up duty shifts to secure reliable charging.

articles.title_zh: 信长星检查调度国庆假期文旅消费和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Inspects Holiday Cultural Tourism Consumption and Work Safety in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，江苏省委书记信长星在南京检查国庆假期全省文旅消费和安全生产工作，察看地铁站与街区运营情况，并主持召开调度会部署隐患排查整治。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing inspected holiday cultural tourism consumption and work safety in Nanjing, visiting a subway station and a lakeside commercial district, and chaired a meeting to order thorough hazard inspections.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事丨观天十载探苍穹
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: China's FAST Telescope Marks a Decade of Cosmic Exploration
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道“中国天眼”FAST落成启用十周年：该装置已发现脉冲星超1300颗，二期工程稳步推进，并带动贵州平塘天文科普研学发展。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua marks the 10th anniversary of China's FAST telescope in Pingtang, Guizhou, which has found over 1,300 pulsars, with a second-phase array underway and local astro-tourism growing.

articles.title_zh: 王予波：全力防风险保安全护稳定 营造平安祥和的节日环境
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo: Fully Guard Against Risks, Ensure Safety and Stability to Create a Peaceful Festive Environment
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日国庆假期首日，云南省省长王予波到省政府应急指挥中心视频检查调度值班值守工作，要求全力防风险、保安全、护稳定。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, the first day of the National Day holiday, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo inspected and coordinated duty operations by video from the provincial government emergency command center, urging full efforts to prevent risks and safeguard safety and stability.

articles.title_zh: 纪念刘华清同志诞辰110周年：赤胆忠诚写春秋 强军报国建功勋
articles.title_en: Marking the 110th Birth Anniversary of Liu Huaqing: Loyalty in Writing History, Merit in Building a Strong Military
articles.summary_zh: 中央军委办公厅在刘华清同志诞辰110周年之际发表纪念文章，回顾其82年革命生涯及为国防和军队现代化建设作出的卓著贡献。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Central Military Commission published an article marking the 110th birth anniversary of Liu Huaqing, recalling his 82-year revolutionary career and his contributions to national defense and military modernization.

tags.name_en: General Office of the Central Military Commission

tags_en: General Office of the Central Military Commission

articles.title_zh: 4个国家级行业产教融合共同体成立
articles.title_en: Four National Industry-Education Integration Communities Established
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，国家工业母机、粮食、铁路建设、新能源汽车行业产教融合共同体集体成立会议在北京召开，50家校企单位签署合作协议，达成24个重大校企合作项目。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, a collective founding meeting for four national industry-education integration communities in industrial machine tools, grain, railway construction and new energy vehicles was held in Beijing, where 50 school and enterprise units signed cooperation agreements covering 24 major joint projects.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同文莱苏丹哈桑纳尔就中文建交35周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Brunei Sultan Hassanal Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 35th Anniversary of China-Brunei Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，国家主席习近平同文莱苏丹哈桑纳尔互致贺电，庆祝两国建交35周年，双方表示将深化战略对接与互利合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, President Xi Jinping and Brunei's Sultan Hassanal exchanged congratulatory messages marking 35 years of diplomatic ties, pledging deeper strategic alignment and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 第四十八届世界技能大赛在上海落幕，激励更多青年投身技能事业
articles.title_en: 48th WorldSkills Competition Concludes in Shanghai, Inspiring More Youth to Pursue Skilled Careers
articles.summary_zh: 第四十八届世界技能大赛日前在上海落幕，68个国家和地区1385名青年选手参赛。人社部、上海市政府与世界技能组织签署合作意向书，世界技能创新中心将落地上海。
articles.summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition concluded in Shanghai with 1,385 competitors from 68 countries; China's HR ministry, Shanghai's government and WorldSkills agreed to base the WorldSkills Innovation Center in the city.

articles.title_zh: 现代化水网建设加快推进（开局起步“十五五”）
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Modernization of Its National Water Network
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，水利部部长李国英介绍现代化水网建设目标，力争到“十五五”末国家水网覆盖国土面积达82%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, the State Council Information Office held a briefing at which Water Resources Minister Li Guoying set out goals for a modern national water network, targeting 82% land coverage by the end of the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 国家广播电视总局发布促进公益广告高质量发展意见
articles.title_en: National Radio and Television Administration Issues Guidelines on High-Quality Development of Public Service Advertising
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，国家广播电视总局发布《关于促进广播电视和网络视听公益广告高质量发展的意见》，自发布之日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, China's National Radio and Television Administration issued guidelines on promoting the high-quality development of public service advertising in radio, television and online audio-visual services, effective immediately.

articles.title_zh: 习近平等党和国家领导人出席庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Other Party and State Leaders Attend Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在北京人民大会堂举行，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平出席并发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 30, a reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, attended and delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章《加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Programs
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日出版的第19期《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设》，文章节录其2012年11月至2026年1月相关重要论述。
articles.summary_en: The 19th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on October 1, carries an important article by Xi Jinping on strengthening inclusive, basic and safety-net livelihood programs, drawn from his remarks between November 2012 and January 2026.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记给四川大学全体师生回信 勉励在服务新时代国家战略中当先锋作表率
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Sichuan University Faculty and Students, Urging Them to Lead in Serving National Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 在四川大学建校130周年之际，习近平总书记给该校全体师生回信，表示祝贺并勉励大家在服务新时代国家战略中当先锋作表率，广大师生和教育工作者备受鼓舞。
articles.summary_en: On the 130th anniversary of Sichuan University, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to its faculty and students, offering congratulations and urging them to take the lead in serving China's national strategy in the new era.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席烈士纪念日献花篮仪式和国庆77周年招待会
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Martyrs' Day Ceremony and Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the PRC
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，习近平先后出席烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式，以及庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会并发表重要讲话，强调坚持稳中求进、实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Xi Jinping attended the Martyrs' Day flower basket ceremony and the reception marking the 77th anniversary of the PRC, delivering a speech on steady progress and a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 马珊珊调研沈阳市供热准备工作
articles.title_en: Ma Shanshan Inspects Heating Preparations in Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，沈阳市委副书记、市长马珊珊调研全市供热准备工作，要求压实属地、部门、企业三方责任，确保群众温暖过冬。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Shenyang Mayor Ma Shanshan inspected the city's heating preparations, urging officials to fulfill their responsibilities and ensure residents stay warm through the winter.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚调研文体旅项目建设并检查督导安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Inspects Cultural, Sports and Tourism Projects and Checks Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，辽宁省委副书记、沈阳市委书记霍步刚实地调研文体旅项目建设并检查督导安全生产工作，要求激发文旅体商消费活力、守牢安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Shenyang Party Secretary Huo Bugang inspected cultural, sports and tourism projects and checked work safety, calling for efforts to boost cultural, tourism, sports and commercial consumption and safeguard public safety.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省暨沈阳市烈士纪念日向英雄烈士敬献花篮仪式举行 许昆林出席 王新伟主持 霍步刚出席
articles.title_en: Liaoning and Shenyang Hold Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony; Xu Kunlin Attends, Wang Xinwei Presides
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，辽宁省暨沈阳市烈士纪念日向英雄烈士敬献花篮仪式在沈阳抗美援朝烈士陵园纪念碑广场举行，省委书记许昆林出席，省长王新伟主持，省委副书记、沈阳市委书记霍步刚出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, Liaoning Province and Shenyang City held a Martyrs' Day flower basket ceremony at the Korean War Martyrs' Cemetery in Shenyang, attended by Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and presided over by Governor Wang Xinwei.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Strengthening Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Programs
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日出版的第19期《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章，强调中国式现代化民生为大，要坚持在发展中保障和改善民生。
articles.summary_en: The 19th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on October 1, carried a key article by Xi Jinping stressing that people's livelihood is paramount in Chinese modernization and that livelihood must be safeguarded and improved through development.

articles.title_zh: 澳门特区政府举行升旗仪式和国庆酒会庆祝新中国成立77周年
articles.title_en: Macau SAR Government Holds Flag-Raising Ceremony and National Day Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the PRC
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，澳门特区政府举行升旗仪式和国庆酒会，庆祝新中国成立77周年。行政长官岑浩辉致辞，表示将主动对接国家“十五五”规划并推进各项施政工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, the Macau SAR government held a flag-raising ceremony and a National Day reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PRC. Chief Executive Sam Hou Fai said Macau will align with the national 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期首日全国铁路预计发送旅客2480万人次
articles.title_en: China's Railways Expect 24.8 Million Passenger Trips on First Day of National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日国庆假期首日，全国铁路预计发送旅客2480万人次，客流保持高位运行，计划加开旅客列车2324列。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, the first day of the National Day holiday, China's railways are expected to handle 24.8 million passenger trips, with 2,324 additional trains scheduled to cope with the travel peak.

articles.title_zh: 国庆假期迎出行高峰 交通部门全力保障
articles.title_en: Transport Departments Step Up Efforts as National Day Holiday Travel Peaks
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日国庆假期首日，全社会跨区域人员流动量预计3.34亿人次，七座及以下小客车免收高速通行费，交通运输部及铁路、水路、民航系统加强运力与安全保障。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 1, the first day of the National Day holiday, cross-region trips are expected to hit 334 million, with toll-free highway travel for small cars and stepped-up rail, water and air transport measures.

articles.title_zh: 香港特区政府举行升旗仪式和国庆酒会庆祝新中国成立77周年
articles.title_en: Hong Kong SAR Government Holds Flag-Raising Ceremony and National Day Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the PRC
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日上午，香港特区政府在金紫荆广场举行升旗仪式，并在香港会议展览中心举办国庆酒会，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年，行政长官李家超在酒会上致辞。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 1, the Hong Kong SAR government held a flag-raising ceremony at Golden Bauhinia Square and a National Day reception to mark the 77th anniversary of the PRC, with Chief Executive John Lee delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上的重要讲话激励亿万人民踔厉奋发
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Reception Marking the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the PRC Inspires the Nation
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，习近平在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上发表重要讲话，强调坚定信心、锚定目标、扎实前行，广大干部群众备受鼓舞。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 30, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PRC, urging firm confidence and steady progress toward national goals.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟检查调度国庆假期安全生产和交通文旅等工作
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Inspect Holiday Safety Production, Transport and Tourism Work in Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳检查国庆假期安全生产、交通文旅和电力保障工作，并召开视频调度会部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On Oct 1, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei inspected holiday safety, transport, tourism and power supply work in Shenyang and held a video dispatch meeting.

articles.title_zh: 烈士纪念日向革命烈士敬献花篮仪式在福州举行
articles.title_en: Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony Held in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，福建省、福州市在福州文林山革命烈士陵园举行烈士纪念日敬献花篮仪式，赵龙、滕佳材等省领导出席，郭宁宁主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Fujian Province and Fuzhou City held a Martyrs' Day flower basket ceremony at the Wenlinshan Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery in Fuzhou; provincial leaders Zhao Long and Teng Jiacai attended and Guo Ningning presided.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱看望慰问节日期间在岗职工
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Visits Workers on Duty During the National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日国庆节，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱看望慰问节日期间在岗职工，检查消防、联合执勤和电力保障工作，要求抓好假期安全稳定服务与值班值守。
articles.summary_en: On National Day, October 1, He Gang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu visited workers on duty during the holiday, inspecting firefighting, joint policing and power supply, and urging solid holiday safety and duty arrangements.

articles.title_zh: 新一届市委常委班子到周恩来纪念馆重温入党誓词
articles.title_en: New Huai'an Municipal Party Standing Committee Renews Party Oath at Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，淮安市委书记顾坤带领新一届市委常委班子到周恩来纪念馆重温入党誓词，缅怀周恩来同志，强调弘扬其崇高风范、推动淮安高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun led the new municipal Party Standing Committee to the Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall to renew their oath of Party membership and pledge to advance Huai'an's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委常委会召开会议，市委书记顾坤主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Chaired by Party Secretary Gu Kun
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，淮安市委常委会召开会议，市委书记顾坤主持并讲话，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话、重要指示和重要回信精神，并研究部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治、巡视整改、安全生产及社会稳定等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, the Huai'an Municipal Party Standing Committee met under the chairmanship of Party Secretary Gu Kun to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions and to plan work on anti-corruption rectification, inspection follow-ups, workplace safety and social stability.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在京举行 习近平发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the PRC Held in Beijing; Xi Jinping Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，李强主持。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 30, a reception marking the 77th anniversary of the People's Republic of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech.

articles.summary_zh: 10月1日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡到部分景区督导国庆假日旅游安全工作，要求提升服务品质、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Oct. 1 afternoon, Huang Wei, acting mayor of Huaibei, inspected scenic spots for National Day holiday tourism safety, urging better service and stronger safety safeguards.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦黄韡督导调研节日期间安全稳定和应急值班工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi and Huang Wei Inspect Holiday Safety and Emergency Duty Work in Huaibei
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，淮北市委书记蒋曦、代市长黄韡赴相山区、烈山区督导调研国庆假期安全稳定和应急值班工作，慰问一线值守干部职工。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi and Acting Mayor Huang Wei inspected safety, stability and emergency duty work in Xiangshan and Lieshan districts and met frontline staff on duty during the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅关于进一步加强烟花爆竹全链条安全监管的意见
articles.title_en: General Office of the State Council Issues Opinions on Strengthening Whole-Chain Safety Supervision of Fireworks and Firecrackers
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅印发国办发〔2026〕26号意见，要求加强烟花爆竹生产、储存、经营、运输、燃放全链条安全监管，严厉打击非法违法行为，提升行业本质安全水平。
articles.summary_en: The State Council General Office issued opinions to tighten whole-chain safety supervision of fireworks and firecrackers in production, storage, sales, transport and use.

articles.title_zh: 怀化高新区部署安全生产和消防安全工作
articles.title_en: Huaihua High-tech Zone Deploys Work on Production and Fire Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，湖南怀化高新区召开2026年第三季度安全生产暨消防安全工作会议，部署四季度及国庆假期重点工作，管委会主任赵湘玲出席并讲话。

articles.summary_en: Shanwei's Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met on Sept 30 to plan workplace safety, National Day holiday security and economic work, chaired by Party Secretary Lu Feng.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 30, Li Yan, Party Secretary of Tonghua, inspected Tonghua County, reviewing river restoration, road safety checkpoints, forest fire prevention and the autumn harvest.

articles.summary_en: On September 30, the Party Group of the Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting to study the spirit of the city's 12th Party Congress and plan its implementation, chaired by Director Zhang Feng.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 30, Wuhu Party Secretary Xu Zhi inspected Jiujiang District and the Economic Development Zone on full and rigorous Party self-governance, workplace safety and environmental protection.

articles.title_zh: 习近平等党和国家领导人出席庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Other Party and State Leaders Attend Reception Marking the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China

articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 30, a reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping attended and delivered an important speech, joined by Li Qiang and other Party and state leaders.

articles.summary_en: Xu Zhi inspected Wuhu's workplace safety and environmental protection, checking an elderly care home, a shipbuilder and a wharf project, and urged stricter accountability and rectification.

articles.title_zh: 长电科技高端先进封测项目在无锡签约落地
articles.title_en: JCET's High-End Advanced Packaging and Testing Project Signed in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，长电科技高端先进封测项目在无锡签约落地，无锡市委书记蒋锋、代市长蔡剑峰与长电科技首席执行长郑力一行会谈并出席签约仪式。项目聚焦硅转接板2.5D先进封装技术研发与产业化。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, JCET's high-end advanced packaging and testing project was signed in Wuxi, with Wuxi Party Secretary Jiang Feng and Acting Mayor Cai Jianfeng meeting JCET CEO Zheng Li and attending the signing ceremony. The project focuses on R&D and industrialization of silicon interposer 2.5D advanced packaging technology.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议闭幕 决定任命张文兵为省政府副省长

articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, the 25th session of the Standing Committee of Jiangsu's 14th Provincial People's Congress closed, appointing Zhang Wenbing as vice governor and adopting a housing safety management regulation.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 30, Jiangsu Vice Governor and Public Security Director Hu Binchen inspected National Day holiday security work at key scenic spots, commercial districts and grassroots police units in Nanjing, and met frontline officers.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Yangjiang Party Secretary Lu Yixian inspected a mall, a garment factory and a park playground ahead of National Day, urging thorough risk checks and tighter safety responsibilities to ensure a safe holiday.

articles.summary_en: On September 30, Yunfu Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia inspected Yuncheng District to oversee rectification of feedback from the third central ecological environmental protection inspection and check pre-holiday safety and market supply work.

articles.title_zh: 福建省首条高速公路零碳运输通道示范线投运

articles.summary_en: Fujian put into operation its first zero-carbon highway transport demonstration corridor along the 649-km Fujian section of the G15 expressway, with 23 charging and battery-swap stations for heavy trucks built along the route.

articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，福州市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，并研究贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning chaired a meeting of the municipal Party committee standing committee to convey and study the spirit of the Politburo meeting and Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to review implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 福建：轻工业跃升，迈向“世界品牌”
articles.title_en: Fujian's Light Industry Upgrades Toward 'World Brands'

articles.summary_en: Fujian Province rolled out an action plan for high-quality development of its specialty light-industry clusters, targeting 500 billion yuan in output and 30 firms with over 1 billion yuan in revenue by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 俄外交部发言人扎哈罗娃重申日本不应“入常”
articles.title_en: Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Zakharova Reiterates Opposition to Japan's Bid for a Permanent UN Security Council Seat
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月30日，俄外交部发言人扎哈罗娃重申不应为日本等西方国家增加安理会席位，并指日本背离和平宪法、加速再军事化。
articles.summary_en: On September 30 local time, Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova reiterated that Japan and other Western states should not receive additional UN Security Council seats, saying Japan is abandoning its pacifist constitution and remilitarizing.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研督导节日市场供应和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian Inspects Holiday Market Supply and Production Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田深入大型商超、供水加压站、公交枢纽，调研督导国庆节日市场供应和安全生产工作，要求保供稳价、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian inspected a supermarket, a water pumping station and a bus hub to check National Day holiday market supply and production safety, urging stable supply and prices and strict safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 济南市委常委会召开会议研究“人工智能+”与大气污染防治等工作

articles.summary_zh: 2026年10月1日，济南市委常委会召开会议，市委书记刘强主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话指示精神，研究“人工智能+”工作、大气污染防治及群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等事项。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, 2026, the Jinan Municipal Party Standing Committee met under Party Secretary Liu Qiang to study implementing Xi Jinping's directives and review work on the AI Plus initiative, air pollution control and rectification of corruption and misconduct around the public.

articles.title_zh: 搭建友好桥梁 促进民心相通——习近平主席国事访问推动中美人民友谊之树向更深处扎根
articles.title_en: Building Bridges of Friendship, Promoting People-to-People Bonds: President Xi Jinping's State Visit Deepens China-US Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日至25日，国家主席习近平对美国进行国事访问，宣布增加中美直航航班、未来5年邀请10万名美国青少年来华交流学习等新举措，推动中美人文交流与民间友好。
articles.summary_en: From September 23 to 25, President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States, announcing new measures including more direct flights and invitations for 100,000 American youth to study in China over five years, deepening people-to-people ties.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研督导安全生产工作并调度全市国庆假期安全稳定工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Work Safety and Chairs Qingdao Meeting on National Day Holiday Security
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，青岛市委书记曾赞荣以“四不两直”方式调研督导农贸市场、景区、地铁站安全生产工作，并主持召开全市国庆假期安全稳定工作调度会议。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong carried out unannounced inspections of work safety at a farm market, a scenic spot and a subway station, and chaired a meeting on security and stability during the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市委、市政府领导分别带队检查安全生产和民生保障工作
articles.title_en: Xiamen Party and Government Leaders Inspect Workplace Safety and Livelihood Security Ahead of National Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日至30日，厦门市委书记林涛、代市长闫剑波等市委市政府领导分别带队赴生产企业和交通枢纽等场所检查安全生产与民生保障，要求压实责任、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 29 to 30, Xiamen Party Secretary Lin Tao and acting Mayor Yan Jianbo led separate inspections of workplace safety and livelihood security at factories, construction sites and transport hubs ahead of the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在北京天安门广场举行

articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 30, a flower-basket ceremony marking Martyrs' Day was held at Tiananmen Square in Beijing, attended by Xi Jinping, Li Qiang and other Party and state leaders along with representatives from all walks of life.

articles.title_zh: 多国政要祝贺新中国成立77周年 盛赞中国发展成就
articles.title_en: Foreign Dignitaries Congratulate China on 77th Anniversary, Praise Development Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 连日来，中国驻外使领馆在全球多地举办招待会庆祝新中国成立77周年，多国政要出席并高度评价中国发展成就，期待深化互利合作。
articles.summary_en: Chinese embassies and consulates worldwide held receptions marking the PRC's 77th founding anniversary, with foreign dignitaries praising China's development and seeking deeper cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 香港特区政府举行升旗仪式 庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年
articles.title_en: Hong Kong SAR Government Holds Flag-Raising Ceremony to Mark 77th Anniversary of the PRC
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日上午，香港特区政府在金紫荆广场举行升旗仪式，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年，行政长官李家超及中央驻港机构负责人出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of October 1, the Hong Kong SAR government held a flag-raising ceremony at Golden Bauhinia Square to mark the PRC's 77th anniversary, with Chief Executive John Lee and central government agencies' heads in Hong Kong attending.

articles.title_zh: 俄外交部发言人用中文祝贺中国国庆
articles.title_en: Russian Foreign Ministry Spokeswoman Congratulates China on National Day in Chinese
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，俄罗斯外交部发言人扎哈罗娃在莫斯科例行记者会上用中文祝贺中国国庆，并祝贺俄中建交77周年，高度评价两国新时代全面战略协作伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Russian Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Maria Zakharova congratulated China on its National Day in Chinese at a regular briefing in Moscow, marking 77 years of Russia-China diplomatic ties and praising the bilateral strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 南昌国庆烟花晚会当日，江西省委书记尹弘赴指挥部调研

articles.summary_en: On October 1, the day of Nanchang's National Day fireworks show, Jiangxi Party Secretary Yin Hong visited the command center, urging rigorous safety controls and thorough hazard checks to ensure the event runs flawlessly.

articles.title_zh: 泉州开发区开展保供稳价、安全生产和食品安全检查

articles.summary_en: On September 30, Fujian Province and Fuzhou City held a Martyrs' Day wreath-laying ceremony at Wenlinshan Revolutionary Martyrs Cemetery in Fuzhou, with provincial leaders including Zhao Long and representatives from all walks of life attending.

articles.title_zh: “推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合” “央媒话厦门”探寻厦门产业科技发展密码

articles.summary_en: On September 30, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun chaired a provincial government executive meeting to advance the pollution prevention campaign and the comprehensive governance and ecological restoration of Honghu Lake.

articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday, State Grid Hubei coordinated grid maintenance and dispatch, using measures such as bundling station storage into the power spot market to boost new energy consumption and ensure reliable supply.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Wuhan Party Secretary Sheng Yuechun and Mayor Xiong Zhengyu inspected safety production and urban operation support for the National Day holiday, urging risk checks, safe cultural tourism events and stronger consumption.
