articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区质量大会召开 包钢出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Holds Quality Conference; Bao Gang Delivers Address
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，内蒙古自治区质量大会在呼和浩特召开，自治区主席包钢、市场监管总局副局长白清元讲话，部署质量强区建设与食品安全监管。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Inner Mongolia held its regional quality conference in Hohhot, where chairman Bao Gang and market regulation deputy head Bai Qingyuan urged stronger quality and food safety work.

tags.name_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局

tags_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局

articles.title_zh: 自治区领导和首府各族各界代表向人民英雄敬献花篮
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Leaders and Representatives Lay Flower Baskets to People's Heroes on Martyrs' Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日烈士纪念日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、政府主席包钢、政协主席张延昆等与首府各族各界代表在呼和浩特向人民英雄敬献花篮。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Martyrs' Day, Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong, government chairman Bao Gang and CPPCC chairman Zhang Yankun joined representatives in Hohhot to lay flower baskets to the people's heroes.

articles.title_zh: 《中国发展报告2026》在京首发
articles.title_en: China Development Report 2026 Launched in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，国务院发展研究中心编写的《中国发展报告2026》中英文版首发仪式在北京举行，记录2025年及“十四五”时期中国发展成果。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, the Development Research Center of the State Council released the Chinese and English editions of the China Development Report 2026 in Beijing, documenting China's progress in 2025 and during the 14th Five-Year Plan period.

tags.name_en: Development Research Center of the State Council

tags_en: Development Research Center of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 中国政府友谊奖颁奖仪式在北京举行 谌贻琴出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Chinese Government Friendship Award Ceremony Held in Beijing, Shen Yiqin Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 2026年度中国政府友谊奖颁奖仪式9月30日在北京人民大会堂举行，国务委员谌贻琴向50名获奖外国专家颁奖并讲话。
articles.summary_en: State Councilor Shen Yiqin presented the 2026 Chinese Government Friendship Award to 50 foreign experts and spoke at a ceremony in Beijing's Great Hall of the People on Sept 30.

articles.title_zh: 川渝间枢纽通道建设加速 成达万高铁铺轨启动
articles.title_en: Track Laying Begins on Chengdu-Dazhou-Wanzhou High-Speed Railway as Sichuan-Chongqing Corridor Construction Accelerates
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日，成达万高铁铺轨施工在四川南充北站正式启动，向西铺向成都、向东铺往万州，全线铺轨总里程约890公里，预计2027年建成。
articles.summary_en: Track laying for the Chengdu-Dazhou-Wanzhou high-speed railway started on October 1 at Nanchong North Station in Sichuan, running west toward Chengdu and east toward Wanzhou, with about 890 km of track and completion expected in 2027.

articles.title_zh: 四川省隆重举行向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式
articles.title_en: Sichuan Holds Solemn Flower-Basket Ceremony Honoring People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日烈士纪念日，四川省在成都市烈士陵园举行向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式，省委书记王晓晖等省领导与各界代表约800人参加。
articles.summary_en: On Martyrs' Day, Sept 30, Sichuan held a flower-basket ceremony at Chengdu Martyrs' Cemetery, with Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui and other provincial leaders joining about 800 attendees.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记给四川大学全体师生回信 勉励在服务新时代国家战略中当先锋作表率
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Sichuan University Faculty and Students, Urging Them to Lead in Serving the National Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 在四川大学建校130周年之际，习近平总书记给四川大学全体师生回信，勉励大家赓续红色血脉，在服务新时代国家战略中当先锋作表率。
articles.summary_en: On the 130th anniversary of Sichuan University, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to its faculty and students, urging them to lead in serving China's national strategy.

articles.title_zh: 上海举行国庆招待会 陈吉宁朱忠明黄莉新胡文容出席
articles.title_en: Shanghai Holds National Day Reception, Attended by Chen Jining and Zhu Zhongming
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日傍晚，上海市人民政府在上海展览中心举行国庆招待会，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年，市委书记陈吉宁、市长朱忠明等与中外来宾出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 30, the Shanghai Municipal Government held a National Day reception at the Shanghai Exhibition Center marking the 77th anniversary of the PRC, with Party Secretary Chen Jining, Mayor Zhu Zhongming and Chinese and foreign guests attending.

articles.title_zh: 省城各界向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式举行
articles.title_en: Ceremony Held in Taiyuan to Present Flower Baskets to People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日第十三个烈士纪念日，山西省城各界在太原牛驼寨烈士陵园举行向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式，省委书记唐登杰、省长卢东亮等省领导出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, China's 13th Martyrs' Memorial Day, a flower-basket ceremony honoring people's heroes was held at Niutuozhai Martyrs' Cemetery in Taiyuan, Shanxi, attended by Party Secretary Tang Dengjie and Governor Lu Dongliang.

articles.title_zh: 水利部介绍加快建设现代化水网：力争到“十五五”末国家水网覆盖国土面积82%
articles.title_en: Water Resources Ministry Briefs on Modern Water Network: 82% of China's Land Area to Be Covered by End of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，水利部部长李国英介绍现代化水网建设进展，力争到“十五五”末国家水网覆盖国土面积82%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, the State Council Information Office held a briefing at which Water Resources Minister Li Guoying outlined plans to extend the national water network to 82% of China's land area by the end of the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 加强安全管理提升服务质效 让群众欢乐祥和过节
articles.title_en: Strengthen Safety Management and Improve Service Quality to Ensure a Joyous and Peaceful Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，天津市委副书记、市长张工在天津调研检查国庆假期城市安全运行保障工作，强调加强燃气供应、安全生产和民生商品保供稳价。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong inspected urban safety operations for the National Day holiday, urging stronger gas supply, workplace safety, and stable prices for daily necessities.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜会见武汉大学党委书记朱孔军校长张平文
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Meet with Wuhan University Party Secretary Zhu Kongjun and President Zhang Pingwen
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，新疆自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐会见武汉大学党委书记朱孔军、校长张平文，商谈深化教育援疆与校地合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30 in Urumqi, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz met Wuhan University Party Secretary Zhu Kongjun and President Zhang Pingwen to discuss deeper educational aid and university-region cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府举行庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会 尹力致辞 殷勇主持 李秀领出席
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Government Holds Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China; Yin Li Delivers Speech, Yin Yong Presides, Li Xiuling Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，北京市政府举行国庆招待会，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年。市委书记尹力致辞，市长殷勇主持，市人大常委会主任李秀领出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, the Beijing municipal government held a National Day reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. Party Secretary Yin Li spoke, Mayor Yin Yong presided, and Li Xiuling attended.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武检查节日安全和城市治理工作
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Inspect Holiday Safety and Urban Governance Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武赴重点景区、项目施工现场和交通枢纽，实地检查国庆假期景区运行、安全生产和交通运输服务保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu inspected key scenic spots, construction sites and transport hubs to check holiday safety, operations and transport service guarantees ahead of National Day.

articles.title_zh: 缅怀革命先烈 致敬人民英雄 重庆市社会各界向英雄烈士敬献花篮
articles.title_en: Chongqing Holds Martyrs' Day Flower-Basket Ceremony to Honor Fallen Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，重庆市在歌乐山烈士陵园举行社会各界向英雄烈士敬献花篮仪式，市委书记袁家军等出席，市长陈新武主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, Chongqing held a flower-basket ceremony at Gele Mountain Martyrs' Cemetery to honor fallen heroes, attended by Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and presided over by Mayor Chen Xinwu.

articles.title_zh: 王陆进主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Lujin Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，河南省委副书记、代省长王陆进主持召开省政府常务会议，重温习近平总书记关于河南工作的重要讲话精神，传达学习发展先进制造业重要指示，并研究集中整治群众身边不正之风和民生保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Henan Acting Governor Wang Lujin chaired a provincial government executive meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions on Henan's work and advanced manufacturing, and to review anti-corruption rectification and livelihood protection efforts.

articles.title_zh: 洛阳市委常委会召开扩大会议 加快建强中原城市群副中心城市
articles.title_en: Luoyang Municipal Party Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting to Accelerate Building the Sub-center of the Central Plains Urban Agglomeration
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，洛阳市委常委会召开扩大会议，传达省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进在洛阳调研时的指示要求，市委书记陈春江主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, the Standing Committee of the Luoyang Municipal Party Committee held an enlarged meeting to convey the instructions given by provincial party secretary Zhou Zuyi and acting governor Wang Lujin during their inspection tour of Luoyang. Municipal party secretary Chen Chunjiang chaired the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国“敬老月”活动启动仪式暨河南省“敬老月”主题活动在郑州举行
articles.title_en: 2026 National "Respect for the Elderly Month" Launch Ceremony and Henan Themed Event Held in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，2026年全国“敬老月”活动启动仪式暨河南省“敬老月”主题活动在郑州举行，民政部副部长孙硕鹏、中国老龄协会会长蒋玮、河南省副省长李酌出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, the launch ceremony of the 2026 national "Respect for the Elderly Month" and Henan's themed event were held in Zhengzhou, with speeches by Civil Affairs Vice Minister Sun Shuopeng, China National Ageing Association President Jiang Wei and Henan Vice Governor Li Zhuo.

articles.title_zh: 2026年烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在郑州举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony Held in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，2026年烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在郑州烈士陵园举行，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进、省政协主席孔昌生等与省会各界代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, a 2026 Martyrs' Day flower basket ceremony was held at Zhengzhou Martyrs' Cemetery, with Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi, Acting Governor Wang Lujin and provincial CPPCC chairman Kong Changsheng joining representatives from all sectors.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Chairs Provincial Party Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，湖南省委书记沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于发展先进制造业的重要指示等精神，研究部署加快建设以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming chaired a meeting of the Provincial Party Standing Committee to convey and study Xi Jinping's instructions on developing advanced manufacturing and to plan a modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 中南大学、湖南大学湖南未来产业技术研究院同日揭牌
articles.title_en: Central South University and Hunan University Launch Hunan Future Industry Technology Research Institutes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，中南大学、湖南大学湖南未来产业技术研究院在长沙揭牌成立，湖南省委书记沈晓明出席并为两个研究院揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, the Hunan Future Industry Technology Research Institutes of Central South University and Hunan University were unveiled in Changsha, with Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming attending the ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明节前在长沙暗访检查安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Conducts Unannounced Safety Inspections in Changsha Ahead of National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，湖南省省长毛伟明以“四不两直”方式在长沙暗访检查烟花爆竹、客运站、燃气等安全生产工作，要求隐患排查无盲区、监管执法零容忍。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming carried out unannounced inspections in Changsha on fireworks, bus station and gas safety, demanding full hazard checks and zero tolerance in enforcement ahead of the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省暨长沙市烈士纪念日向英雄烈士敬献花篮仪式举行
articles.title_en: Hunan Province and Changsha City Hold Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，湖南省暨长沙市烈士纪念日向英雄烈士敬献花篮仪式在长沙湖南烈士公园举行，省委书记沈晓明等省领导同社会各界代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, 2026, Hunan Province and Changsha City held a Martyrs' Day flower basket ceremony at Hunan Martyrs' Park in Changsha, attended by provincial leaders including Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming.

articles.title_zh: 青海省举行2026年烈士纪念日活动 罗东川出席
articles.title_en: Qinghai Holds 2026 Martyrs' Day Commemoration, Luo Dongchuan Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，青海省在西宁市烈士陵园举行2026年烈士纪念日活动，省委书记罗东川等党政军领导与社会各界代表向革命烈士纪念碑敬献花篮。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, Qinghai held its 2026 Martyrs' Day ceremony at Xining Martyrs' Cemetery, where Provincial Party Secretary Luo Dongchuan and other officials laid flower baskets in tribute.

articles.title_zh: 新疆各族各界向人民英雄敬献花篮
articles.title_en: People of All Ethnic Groups in Xinjiang Lay Flower Baskets to Honor People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在乌鲁木齐人民广场举行，陈小江、艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜等自治区和兵团领导同各族各界代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, a flower-basket laying ceremony marking Martyrs' Day was held at Urumqi People's Square, attended by Chen Xiaojiang, Erkin Tuniyaz and other regional and corps leaders together with representatives of all ethnic groups.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：压实责任链条筑牢安全防线 确保人民群众过一个欢乐祥和的节日
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Party Secretary Wang Hao Inspects National Day Holiday Safety Work in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日下午，浙江省委书记王浩在杭州检查国庆假期安全工作，强调压实责任、筑牢安全防线，确保群众欢乐祥和过节。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 30, Zhejiang Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao inspected National Day holiday safety work in Hangzhou, urging tighter responsibility and stronger safety measures to ensure a joyful and peaceful holiday.

articles.title_zh: 国台办发布会聚焦中美元首会晤、两岸交流等热点
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Press Conference Focuses on China-US Summit, Cross-Strait Exchanges
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，国务院台办在北京举行例行新闻发布会，发言人张晗就中美元首会晤涉台内容、两岸交流活动等热点问题答记者问。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, the State Council Taiwan Affairs Office held a press conference in Beijing, where spokesperson Zhang Han addressed Taiwan-related issues in the China-US summit and cross-strait exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 第四次全国文物普查省域整体验收全面完成
articles.title_en: Provincial-Level Verification for the Fourth National Cultural Heritage Census Fully Completed
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月1日起，第四次全国文物普查领导小组办公室组成32个验收组，随机抽检32个县级普查单元和509处不可移动文物，目前省域整体验收已全面完成。
articles.summary_en: Starting Aug 1, 2026, the Office of the Leading Group for the Fourth National Cultural Heritage Census dispatched 32 verification teams that inspected 32 county-level census units and 509 immovable relics; provincial-level verification is now fully complete.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给四川大学全体师生回信强调 发挥文理工医交叉融合优势 在服务新时代国家战略中当先锋作表率
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Sichuan University Faculty and Students, Urging Cross-Disciplinary Integration to Serve National Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平给四川大学全体师生回信，在建校130周年之际表示祝贺，希望学校赓续红色血脉、发挥文理工医交叉融合优势，为教育强国、科技强国、人才强国建设作贡献。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, replied to a letter from Sichuan University faculty and students, congratulating the school on its 130th anniversary and urging it to leverage its interdisciplinary strengths to serve national strategy.

articles.title_zh: 加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping on Strengthening Inclusive, Basic and Safety-Net Livelihood Programs
articles.summary_zh: 习近平2012年11月至2026年1月关于加强普惠性、基础性、兜底性民生建设的重要论述节录，涵盖教育、就业、社会保障、医疗卫生等领域。
articles.summary_en: A compilation of Xi Jinping's remarks from November 2012 to January 2026 on strengthening inclusive, basic and safety-net livelihood programs, covering education, employment, social security and health care.

articles.title_zh: 习近平等党和国家领导人出席烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Other Party and State Leaders Attend Martyrs' Day Flower-Basket Ceremony for People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，习近平、李强、赵乐际、王沪宁、蔡奇、丁薛祥、李希、韩正等党和国家领导人来到北京天安门广场，出席烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 30, Xi Jinping, Li Qiang, Zhao Leji, Wang Huning, Cai Qi, Ding Xuexiang, Li Xi, Han Zheng and other Party and state leaders attended the Martyrs' Day ceremony to present flower baskets to the people's heroes at Tiananmen Square in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 牛恺主持召开市政府第十六次常务会议
articles.title_en: Niu Kai Chairs 16th Executive Meeting of Baoji Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，宝鸡市市长牛恺主持召开市政府第十六次常务会议，研究部署先进制造业发展、国庆期间安全稳定及常态化帮扶等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Baoji Mayor Niu Kai chaired the municipal government's 16th executive meeting, focusing on advanced manufacturing, holiday safety and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 省暨长春市向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式举行
articles.title_en: Jilin Province and Changchun City Hold Flower Basket Ceremony for People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，吉林省暨长春市向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在长春市烈士陵园举行，省委书记黄强、省长胡玉亭、省政协主席朱国贤等出席并整理花篮缎带。
articles.summary_en: Jilin Province and Changchun held a flower-basket ceremony at Changchun Martyrs' Cemetery on Sept 30, 2026, attended by Party Secretary Huang Qiang, Governor Hu Yuting and CPPCC Chairman Zhu Guoxian.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅印发《关于发展体育赛事激发消费活力的意见》
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Opinions on Developing Sports Events to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅日前印发《关于发展体育赛事激发消费活力的意见》，部署5个方面17项任务，提出到2030年基本形成具有中国特色的现代化赛事体系。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council General Office has issued a guideline on developing sports events to spur consumption, setting out 17 tasks in five areas and aiming to basically form a modernized events system with Chinese characteristics by 2030.

tags.name_en: General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在京隆重举行
articles.title_en: Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony Held in Beijing to Honor People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在北京天安门广场举行，习近平等党和国家领导人同各界代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, a flower basket ceremony marking Martyrs' Day was held at Tiananmen Square in Beijing, attended by Xi Jinping, other Party and state leaders, and representatives from all walks of life.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在京举行 习近平发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the PRC Held in Beijing, Xi Jinping Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日晚，庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，李强主持，约800名中外人士出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 30, a reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered an important speech and Li Qiang presided, with about 800 Chinese and foreign guests attending.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要指示激励广大干部群众奋力建设更高水平平安中国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Important Instructions Inspire Efforts to Build a Higher-Level Safe China
articles.summary_zh: 习近平近日就建设更高水平平安中国作出重要指示，肯定党的十八大以来平安中国建设成效并提出明确要求，各地干部群众表示将扎实推进更高水平平安中国建设。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued important instructions on building a higher-level Safe China, affirming progress since the 18th CPC National Congress and setting clear requirements; officials and citizens pledged to implement them.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅关于发展体育赛事激发消费活力的意见
articles.title_en: General Office of the State Council Issues Opinions on Developing Sports Events to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅印发《关于发展体育赛事激发消费活力的意见》，提出到2030年基本形成具有中国特色的现代化赛事体系，通过丰富赛事供给、深化融合发展激发消费活力。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the State Council issued opinions on developing sports events to spur consumption, aiming to build a modern events system with Chinese characteristics by 2030 through richer event supply and deeper integration with tourism, business and technology.

tags.name_en: General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 习近平：在庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会上的讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Reception Celebrating the 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，习近平在北京出席庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会并发表讲话，向全国各族人民致以节日祝贺，阐述经济、港澳台与外交方针。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Xi Jinping delivered a speech at the reception marking the 77th anniversary of the People's Republic of China in Beijing, offering festive greetings and outlining economic, Taiwan and foreign policy priorities.

articles.title_zh: 李强在全国安全生产视频会议上强调抓实抓细安全生产各项工作
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Stresses Solid Safety Work at National Video Conference on Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国务院在北京召开全国安全生产视频会议，总理李强强调压实责任、防范遏制重特大事故，张国清主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the State Council held a national video conference on workplace safety in Beijing, where Premier Li Qiang urged tightened accountability and prevention of major accidents; Zhang Guoqing chaired.

articles.title_zh: 全省安全生产和秋冬季森林草原防灭火视频会议召开 王新伟出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei Addresses Provincial Meeting on Work Safety and Autumn-Winter Forest and Grassland Fire Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，辽宁省召开全省安全生产和秋冬季森林草原防灭火视频会议，省长王新伟出席并讲话，部署国庆假期安全防范和第四季度安全生产重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Liaoning held a provincial video meeting on work safety and autumn-winter forest and grassland fire prevention, where Governor Wang Xinwei spoke and set tasks for the National Day holiday and the fourth quarter.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见参加辽宁籍文化人才回乡行动嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Guests of Liaoning Cultural Talent Homecoming Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见参加“辽宁籍文化人才回乡行动”的嘉宾代表，欢迎文化人才回乡助力辽宁全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with guests of the Liaoning cultural talent homecoming initiative, welcoming them back to support the province's full revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德调研城市更新工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Urban Renewal Work in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，福州市委书记郭宁宁、市长吴贤德赴鼓楼、仓山调研城市更新工作，察看危旧房自主更新项目与洪塘历史风貌区保护情况并提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected urban renewal work in Gulou and Cangshan, reviewing a self-funded dilapidated-housing rebuild project and the Hongtang historic district conservation effort.

articles.title_zh: 我市举行烈士纪念日向烈士敬献花篮仪式
articles.title_en: Hegang Holds Wreath-Laying Ceremony for Martyrs' Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日烈士纪念日当天上午，鹤岗市在北山公园革命烈士纪念碑前举行向烈士敬献花篮仪式，市委书记王兴柱等市领导出席，市长邓维元主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 30, Martyrs' Day, Hegang City held a wreath-laying ceremony at the revolutionary martyrs' monument in Beishan Park, attended by Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu and other city leaders, with Mayor Deng Weiyuan presiding.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会第五十九次主任会议、主任月度办公会召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 59th Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，淮安市人大常委会召开第五十九次主任会议暨主任月度办公会，周青主持并讲话，部署立法、市县乡三级人大换届选举等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the Huai'an Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 59th director meeting and monthly office meeting, chaired by Zhou Qing, to plan legislative work and township-level election preparations.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤检查节日安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Holiday Production Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，淮安市委书记顾坤在清江浦区、生态文旅区、淮安工业园区检查节日安全生产工作，强调抓好危化品、燃气、消防等重点领域风险隐患排查整治。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected holiday production safety work in Qingjiangpu District, the Ecological Culture and Tourism Zone and Huai'an Industrial Park, urging thorough hazard checks in chemicals, gas and fire safety.

articles.title_zh: 顾坤专题调研推进淮安先进制造业发展
articles.title_en: Gu Kun Conducts Inspection on Advancing Advanced Manufacturing in Huai'an
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，淮安市委书记顾坤专题调研先进制造业发展，走访中天钢帘线、台华新材、天合光能等企业，强调因地制宜培育新质生产力、构建先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected advanced manufacturing development, visiting firms such as Zhongtian Steel Cord, Taihua New Materials and Trina Solar, urging efforts to cultivate new quality productive forces and build a modern industrial system anchored by advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦主持召开十届市委常委会第一次会议
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs First Meeting of the 10th Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦在双堆集镇主持召开十届市委常委会第一次会议，学习习近平总书记考察安徽重要讲话精神及党内法规，传达全省领导干部会议和省委常委会会议精神。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, Jiang Xi, Party Secretary of Huaibei City, chaired the first meeting of the 10th Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee in Shuangduiji Town, studying Xi Jinping's speech on Anhui and Party regulations, and conveying provincial meeting directives.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦主持召开十届市委常委会第一次会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs First Meeting of the 10th Huaibei Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦在双堆集镇主持召开十届市委常委会第一次会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记考察安徽重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, Jiang Xi, Party Secretary of Huaibei, chaired the first meeting of the 10th Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee in Shuangduiji Town, studying Xi Jinping's speeches on Anhui and mapping out implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市七届人大常委会召开第五十五次会议 通过人事任免
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 55th Meeting, Approves Personnel Appointments and Removals
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日上午，揭阳市七届人大常委会召开第五十五次会议，审议多项条例草案和审计、生态、司法保护等工作报告，表决通过企业信用促进条例、2025年市级决算决议及人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, the Standing Committee of the 7th Jieyang Municipal People's Congress held its 55th meeting, approving the 2025 municipal final accounts, local regulations and personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 中国政府友谊奖颁奖仪式在北京举行 谌贻琴出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Chinese Government Friendship Award Ceremony Held in Beijing, State Councilor Chen Yiqin Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月30日，2026年度中国政府友谊奖颁奖仪式在北京人民大会堂举行，国务委员谌贻琴向50名获奖外国专家颁奖并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, 2026, the 2026 Chinese Government Friendship Award ceremony was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, where State Councilor Chen Yiqin presented awards to 50 foreign experts and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升在中央第六生态环境保护督察组督察西藏自治区情况反馈会上作表态发言
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Pledges Full Rectification at Central Eco-Environmental Inspection Feedback Meeting for Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日上午，中央第六生态环境保护督察组督察西藏自治区情况反馈会在拉萨召开，自治区党委书记胡昌升作表态发言，表示全面认领督察反馈问题并坚决抓好整改。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, the Central Sixth Eco-Environmental Inspection Team held a feedback meeting with the Tibet Autonomous Region in Lhasa, where regional Party Secretary Hu Changsheng pledged to fully accept the findings and resolutely carry out rectification.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在西藏分会场部署全区安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Garma Zedeng Deploys Regional Work on Production Safety in Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日全国安全生产视频会议后，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在西藏分会场部署全区安全生产工作，要求压实责任、排查隐患，确保社会大局稳定。
articles.summary_en: After the national video conference on production safety on Sept 28, Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman Garma Zedeng deployed regional safety work at the Tibet sub-venue, urging tightened responsibility and hazard inspections to ensure social stability.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党龙岩市第七次代表大会举行第二次全体会议
articles.title_en: Second Plenary Session of the 7th CPC Longyan City Congress Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，中国共产党龙岩市第七次代表大会举行第二次全体会议，选举产生新一届市委委员、市纪委委员及出席福建省第十二次党代会代表，胡盛主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the 7th CPC Longyan City Congress held its second plenary session, electing new municipal Party committee and discipline inspection committee members and delegates to Fujian's 12th Party congress.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党龙岩市第七次代表大会关于中共龙岩市第六届委员会报告的决议
articles.title_en: Resolution of the 7th CPC Longyan Municipal Congress on the Report of the 6th CPC Longyan Municipal Committee
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月30日，中国共产党龙岩市第七次代表大会批准胡盛代表中共龙岩市第六届委员会所作的报告，部署未来五年老区振兴发展。
articles.summary_en: The 7th CPC Longyan Congress approved Hu Sheng's report for the 6th Municipal Committee, setting five-year goals for revitalizing the old revolutionary base area.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党龙岩市第七次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: Seventh CPC Longyan Municipal Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日下午，中国共产党龙岩市第七次代表大会在龙岩闭幕，选举产生新一届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员，通过六届市委报告的决议，胡盛致闭幕词、蔡琳主持大会。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 29, the Seventh CPC Longyan Municipal Congress closed in Longyan, electing new municipal Party committee and discipline commission members and adopting resolutions on the work reports, with Hu Sheng giving the closing address and Cai Lin presiding.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记给四川大学全体师生回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Sichuan University Faculty and Students
articles.summary_zh: 在四川大学建校130周年之际，习近平总书记给四川大学全体师生回信，向师生员工和校友表示祝贺，激励广大青年学生和教育工作者砥砺前行。
articles.summary_en: On the 130th anniversary of Sichuan University, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to its faculty and students, congratulating them and urging young students and educators to press ahead.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登：全力以赴抓好安全生产各项工作 坚决确保社会大局和谐稳定
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng: Full Efforts to Ensure Work Safety and Social Stability in Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，全国安全生产视频会议结束后，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区主席嘎玛泽登在西藏分会场部署全区安全生产工作，强调防范遏制重特大事故，确保人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: After the national video conference on work safety on Sept 28, Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman Gama Zedeng deployed regional work safety measures at the Tibet sub-venue, stressing prevention of major accidents and protection of lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 汕头召开市委书记专题会议研究部署停车秩序管理工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Party Secretary Chairs Meeting on Parking Order Management
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开专题会议，听取公安、城管部门汇报，研究部署中心城区停车秩序管理工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 29, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a special meeting to study and deploy parking order management in the city's central urban area.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到汕头海事局开展调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Conducts Research Visit and Holds Symposium at Shantou Maritime Safety Administration
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到汕头海事局调研并召开座谈会，强调携手走好向海图强高质量发展之路，加快建设特色型现代海洋城市。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn visited the Shantou Maritime Safety Administration for research and a symposium, stressing joint efforts to advance high-quality marine-oriented development and build a distinctive modern ocean city.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰主持召开市委书记专题会议 听取八届市委第九轮巡察情况汇报
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Chairs Municipal Party Committee Special Meeting on the Ninth Round of Inspection Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，汕尾市委书记逯峰主持召开市委书记专题会议，听取八届市委第九轮巡察情况汇报，并研究部署下一步巡察工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired a special municipal party committee meeting to hear a report on the ninth round of city inspections and to plan the next stage of inspection work.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市各界隆重举行公祭烈士活动
articles.title_en: Shanwei Holds Public Memorial Ceremony for Martyrs
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，汕尾市在海丰县烈士陵园举行公祭烈士活动，市委书记逯峰、市长范德繁等与各界代表800余人参加，缅怀革命先烈、传承红色基因。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Shanwei City held a martyrs' memorial ceremony at Haifeng County Martyrs' Cemetery, attended by Party Secretary Lu Feng, Mayor Fan Defan and over 800 representatives.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在吴忠市石嘴山市调研时强调 统筹推进“两化一振兴”促进城乡融合发展
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Stresses Coordinated Push for "Two Modernizations and One Revitalization" to Advance Urban-Rural Integration During Inspection in Wuzhong and Shizuishan
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日至29日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞到吴忠市、石嘴山市调研，强调统筹推进“两化一振兴”、促进城乡融合发展，抓产业、保安全、促消费、惠民生。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28-29, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei inspected Wuzhong and Shizuishan, calling for stronger urban-rural integration, industrial growth, safety and livelihood work.

articles.title_zh: 自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu Chairs Regional Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，宁夏自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府2026年第24次常务会议，研究乡村振兴战略实绩考核、中央安全生产考核巡查反馈问题整改和城镇开发边界管理等事项。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu chaired the regional government's 24th executive meeting of 2026, reviewing rural revitalization performance assessments, rectification of central workplace-safety inspection findings, and urban development boundary management.

articles.title_zh: 四平市人大常委会党组召开第十九次（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Siping Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds 19th Expanded Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，四平市人大常委会党组召开第十九次（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话及赵乐际在吉林、黑龙江调研讲话精神，陶立春主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Siping's Municipal People's Congress Party group held its 19th expanded meeting to convey recent speeches by Xi Jinping and Zhao Leji's Jilin-Heilongjiang inspection remarks, chaired by Tao Lichun.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬接待来访群众会办信访事项
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Meets Petitioners to Address Public Complaints
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到市信访局接待来访群众、会办信访事项，强调用心用情解决群众急难愁盼问题，维护群众合法权益，促进社会和谐稳定。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong received petitioners at the city petition bureau to address public complaints, urging officials to resolve pressing livelihood issues and protect residents' rights.

articles.title_zh: 泰州召开生物医药产业链服务团队工作例会 姜冬冬出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds Working Meeting of Biopharmaceutical Industry Chain Service Team; Jiang Dongdong Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，泰州市召开生物医药产业链服务团队工作例会，市委书记姜冬冬出席并讲话，要求抢抓政策窗口期、优化涉企服务、提高项目转化率。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Taizhou held a meeting of its biopharmaceutical industry chain service team, where Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong urged seizing policy windows and boosting project conversion.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议举行第二次全体会议
articles.title_en: Second Plenary Session of 25th Session of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日上午，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议举行第二次全体会议，常务副主任樊金龙主持，会议听取人事任免案说明和履职情况报告。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, the Standing Committee of the 14th Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress held the second plenary session of its 25th meeting, chaired by Executive Vice Chairman Fan Jinlong, hearing personnel appointment and removal explanations and duty reports.

articles.title_zh: 张海波督导节日旅游、市场保供和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Holiday Tourism, Market Supply, and Safety Production
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，威海市委书记张海波到经开区督导节日旅游、市场保供和安全生产工作，强调统筹发展和安全，确保群众度过安定祥和的节日。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo inspected holiday tourism, market supply, and safety work in the development zone, urging coordinated development and safety.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党芜湖市第十二次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: Communist Party of China Wuhu Municipal 12th Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月29日上午，中共芜湖市第十二次代表大会闭幕，选举产生新一届市委、市纪委及出席安徽省第十二次党代会代表，徐志主持大会并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, 2026, the 12th Wuhu Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China closed, electing a new municipal Party committee, discipline inspection commission and delegates to the Anhui provincial congress. Xu Zhi chaired the session and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在全市服务业大会上强调：促进服务业优质高效发展，擦亮“西安服务”品牌
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Calls for High-Quality Service Sector Growth and a Stronger 'Xi'an Service' Brand
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，西安市召开全市服务业大会，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰出席并讲话，部署推动服务业扩能提质、擦亮“西安服务”品牌。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Xi'an held its municipal service industry conference, where Hao Huijie, Party secretary of the city, urged expanding and upgrading the sector to build a stronger 'Xi'an Service' brand.

articles.title_zh: 全市安全稳定工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Xinxiang Holds Citywide Safety and Stability Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，新乡市召开全市安全稳定工作会议，市委书记魏建平出席并讲话，部署政治安全、安全生产、社会稳定、网络安全及国庆假期保障等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Xinxiang held a citywide safety and stability work meeting. Party Secretary Wei Jianping spoke and laid out work on political security, workplace safety, social stability, cybersecurity and National Day holiday safeguards.

articles.title_zh: 魏都区召开“曹魏·187”整体风貌提升工作推进会
articles.title_en: Weidu District Holds Meeting to Advance "Cao Wei · 187" Area Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，河南许昌魏都区召开“曹魏·187”整体风貌提升工作推进会，听取规划汇报，部署交通动线、停车治理与文旅服务提升工作。
articles.summary_en: Weidu District in Xuchang, Henan held a meeting on Sept 29 to advance the "Cao Wei · 187" heritage-area renewal, reviewing traffic, pedestrian and parking plans and tourist services.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研民生领域服务窗口运行情况
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Inspects Public Service Windows in Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，盐城市委书记严汉平调研市住房公积金管理中心、不动产登记中心、人社综合服务中心等民生领域服务窗口，要求优化服务流程、深化“放管服”改革。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Yancheng Communist Party Secretary Yan Hanping inspected public service windows including the housing provident fund center and human resources service center, urging streamlined procedures and deeper administrative reform.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见招商银行南京分行戴深宇
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet with Dai Shenyu of China Merchants Bank Nanjing Branch
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜在盐城会见招商银行南京分行行长戴深宇，双方就金融支持实体经济、港口物流、国资国企等领域合作深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Acting Mayor Wu Wei met in Yancheng with Dai Shenyu, head of China Merchants Bank's Nanjing Branch, to discuss cooperation in financial support for the real economy, port logistics and state-owned enterprise development.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议举行第二次全体会议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Second Plenary Session of Its 25th Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日上午，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议举行第二次全体会议，听取人事任免案说明、任命人员履职情况报告及专项监督报告。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, the Standing Committee of the 14th Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress held the second plenary session of its 25th meeting, hearing personnel appointment matters, performance reports and special oversight reports.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要指示激励广大干部群众奋力建设更高水平平安中国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Important Instructions Inspire Cadres and Public to Build a Higher-Level Safe China
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平总书记就建设更高水平平安中国作出重要指示，肯定平安中国建设成效并提出明确要求，各地干部群众表示将扎实推进更高水平平安中国建设。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on building a higher-level Safe China, affirming progress since the 18th Party Congress and setting clear requirements; officials and citizens pledged to advance the effort.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞张雨浦会见中国大唐集团董事长吕军总经理李向良
articles.title_en: Li Yifei and Zhang Yupu Meet with China Datang Chairman Lyu Jun and General Manager Li Xiangliang
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，宁夏自治区党委书记李邑飞、自治区主席张雨浦在银川会见中国大唐集团董事长吕军、总经理李向良，双方就新能源开发、绿电园区建设与能源保供合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei and Chairman Zhang Yupu met in Yinchuan with China Datang Chairman Lyu Jun and General Manager Li Xiangliang to discuss cooperation on new energy development, green power parks and energy supply.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在吴忠市石嘴山市调研时强调：统筹推进“两化一振兴”促进城乡融合发展
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Inspects Wuzhong and Shizuishan, Urges Coordinated Push for "Two Modernizations and One Revitalization" and Urban-Rural Integration
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日至29日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞到吴忠市、石嘴山市调研，考察重大项目建设、现代农业、基层党建与基本医疗服务，并检查节假日市场保供和促消费工作。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 28 to 29, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, inspected Wuzhong and Shizuishan, reviewing major projects, modern agriculture, grassroots Party building and medical services, and checking holiday market supply and consumption promotion.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研节日期间市场保供、氛围营造、安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Holiday Market Supply, Festive Atmosphere and Work Safety in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，银川市委书记赵旭辉调研国庆节期间市场保供、氛围营造和安全生产等工作，强调全力抓安全、聚人气、激活力。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui inspected holiday market supply, festive atmosphere and work safety, urging stronger safety controls and consumption vitality.

articles.title_zh: 自治区隆重举行烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式 李邑飞张雨浦庄严出席
articles.title_en: Ningxia Holds Martyrs' Day Ceremony to Lay Flower Baskets for People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，宁夏回族自治区在银川烈士陵园举行烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式，自治区党委书记李邑飞、自治区主席张雨浦、自治区党委副书记庄严等与各界代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 30, Ningxia held a Martyrs' Day ceremony at the Yinchuan Martyrs' Cemetery, where regional Party Secretary Li Yifei, Chairman Zhang Yupu and Deputy Party Secretary Zhuang Yan joined representatives from all walks of life in laying flower baskets for people's heroes.

articles.title_zh: 全区基础教育优化布局工作推进会在银川召开
articles.title_en: Regional Meeting on Optimizing Basic Education Layout Held in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，全区基础教育优化布局工作推进会在银川召开，自治区党委书记李邑飞出席并讲话，自治区主席张雨浦主持，部署基础教育扩优提质与城乡均衡发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, a regional meeting on optimizing basic education layout was held in Yinchuan, where Party Secretary Li Yifei spoke and Chairman Zhang Yupu presided, deploying steps to improve basic education quality and urban-rural balance.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党营口市第十四次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 14th CPC Yingkou Municipal Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，中国共产党营口市第十四次代表大会在营口文化艺术中心闭幕，选举产生新一届市委、市纪委及出席省第十四次党代会代表，李军主持大会并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The 14th CPC Yingkou Municipal Congress closed on Sept 29 in Yingkou, electing a new municipal Party committee, discipline inspection commission and delegates to the provincial congress. Li Jun presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_en: 14th CPC Yingkou Municipal Congress Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，中国共产党营口市第十四次代表大会在营口文化艺术中心闭幕，选举产生新一届市委、市纪委及出席省第十四次党代会代表，李军主持大会。
articles.summary_en: The 14th CPC Yingkou Municipal Congress closed on Sept 29 in Yingkou, electing new municipal Party and discipline committees and delegates to the Liaoning provincial congress. Li Jun presided.

articles.title_zh: 玉溪市部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治暨农村集体“三资”专项工作
articles.title_en: Yuxi City Deploys Campaign Against Misconduct and Corruption Around the Public and Special Work on Rural Collective "Three Assets"
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，玉溪市召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治推进会暨第二批农村集体“三资”专项工作部署会，市委书记杨政昆讲话，市长胡江辉主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Yuxi advanced its campaign against grassroots misconduct and corruption and deployed work on rural collective "three assets"; Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun spoke, Mayor Hu Jianghui presided.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开九届市委常委会第一次会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs First Meeting of the 9th Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开九届市委常委会第一次会议，研究管党治党、群众身边腐败问题集中整治及安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Xie Weijiang, Hunan deputy Party secretary and Yueyang Party chief, chaired the first meeting of the 9th Yueyang Municipal Party Standing Committee on Party discipline, graft cleanup and safety.

articles.title_zh: 全市文旅体商融合发展工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Yueyang Holds Meeting on Integrated Development of Culture, Tourism, Sports and Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，岳阳市文旅体商融合发展工作推进会在临湘市召开，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江出席并讲话，要求系统推进文化、旅游、体育、商贸深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Yueyang held a meeting on integrating culture, tourism, sports and commerce in Linxiang; provincial deputy party secretary and Yueyang party chief Xie Weijiang called for deeper industry integration.

articles.title_zh: 余钢到廉江市督导检查国庆节前安全生产工作并开展巡河
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Inspects Pre-National Day Safety Production in Lianjiang and Conducts River Patrol
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，湛江市委书记余钢赴廉江市督导国庆节前安全生产工作并巡河，检查鹤地水库整改、市场保供及道路交通安全。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang inspected pre-National Day safety work in Lianjiang and patrolled the Jiuzhou River, checking reservoir remediation, market supply and road safety.

articles.title_zh: 河北隆重举行向烈士敬献花篮仪式
articles.title_en: Hebei Holds Solemn Ceremony to Lay Flower Baskets for Martyrs
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，河北省在华北军区烈士陵园举行向烈士敬献花篮仪式，省委书记罗文、省长王正谱等出席并瞻仰纪念碑。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Hebei Province held a ceremony at the North China Military Region Martyrs' Cemetery to lay flower baskets for martyrs, attended by provincial leaders including Party Secretary Luo Wen and Governor Wang Zhengpu.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研节日保供安全稳定工作
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Inspects Holiday Supply and Security Work in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研国庆假期保供、安全稳定等工作，并看望慰问一线干部职工。
articles.summary_en: On September 30, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu inspected holiday supply, safety and stability work in Jinan and visited frontline workers ahead of the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 福州市交通运输局发布国庆出行保障“大礼包”
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Transport Bureau Rolls Out National Day Travel Support Package
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期（10月1日至7日）前，福州市交通运输局部署运力优化、公交地铁免费乘坐、临时接驳专线与安全隐患排查等多项保障举措。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the National Day holiday (Oct 1-7), the Fuzhou Municipal Transport Bureau rolled out measures including free bus and subway rides, temporary shuttle lines and citywide safety inspections.

articles.title_zh: 我国生成式人工智能用户规模突破7亿人
articles.title_en: China's Generative AI Users Surpass 700 Million
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，中国互联网络信息中心发布《生成式人工智能应用发展报告（2026）》，显示截至2026年上半年我国生成式AI用户规模突破7亿人，普及率超50%。
articles.summary_en: CNNIC released its 2026 generative AI application report on Sept 29, showing China's generative AI users surpassed 700 million by mid-2026, with penetration above 50%.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式举行
articles.title_en: Qingdao Holds Flower Basket Ceremony to Honor People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日烈士纪念日，青岛市在市革命烈士纪念馆举行向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式，市委书记曾赞荣等出席，市长任刚主持。
articles.summary_en: On Martyrs' Day, Sept 30, Qingdao held a flower basket ceremony at the city's Revolutionary Martyrs Memorial Hall, attended by Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong and Mayor Ren Gang.

articles.title_zh: 山东省、驻济部队暨济南市向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式举行
articles.title_en: Shandong Province, Garrison Troops and Jinan City Hold Flower-Basket Ceremony for People's Heroes
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日烈士纪念日，山东省、驻济部队暨济南市向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在济南英雄山革命烈士纪念塔广场举行，省委书记林武、省长周乃翔等出席。
articles.summary_en: On Martyrs' Day (Sept 30), Shandong Province, garrison troops and Jinan City laid flower baskets at the Hero Mountain martyrs' monument in Jinan; Party Secretary Lin Wu and Governor Zhou Naixiang attended.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣到平度市调研产业发展和重点项目建设等工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Industrial Development and Key Projects in Pingdu
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，青岛市委书记曾赞荣到平度市调研产业发展和重点项目建设，强调做强产业、抓实项目、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong inspected industrial development and key projects in Pingdu, urging stronger industries, solid projects and strict safety controls.

articles.title_zh: 省党政军领导向烈士敬献花篮 王浩刘捷廉毅敏等出席
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Party, Government and Military Leaders Lay Flower Baskets for Martyrs; Wang Hao, Liu Jie and Lian Yimin Attend
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日烈士纪念日，浙江省和杭州市党政军领导与社会各界代表在杭州云居山浙江革命烈士纪念碑前举行敬献花篮仪式，王浩、刘捷、廉毅敏等出席。
articles.summary_en: On Martyrs' Day, Sept 30, Zhejiang and Hangzhou party, government and military leaders laid flower baskets at the Revolutionary Martyrs Monument in Hangzhou; Wang Hao, Liu Jie and Lian Yimin attended.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省政府党组第104次会议暨省政府第127次常务会议召开 刘捷主持
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Zhejiang Provincial Government Party Group Meeting and 127th Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日下午，浙江省长、省政府党组书记刘捷主持召开省政府党组第104次会议暨第127次常务会议，研究部署先进制造业发展、数字贸易和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 30, Zhejiang Governor and provincial government Party group secretary Liu Jie chaired the 104th Party group meeting and 127th executive meeting, deploying work on advanced manufacturing, digital trade and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省委常委会召开会议 王浩主持
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting Chaired by Wang Hao
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，浙江省委常委会召开会议，省委书记王浩主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 30, the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee met in Hangzhou, chaired by Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao, to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议闭幕，张文兵任副省长
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes 25th Session, Appoints Zhang Wenbing as Vice Governor
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议闭幕，信长星主持会议。会议决定任命张文兵为省政府副省长，接受马欣、赵岩辞去副省长职务和张忠辞去省监委主任职务的请求。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, the 25th session of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee concluded, chaired by Xin Changxing. The session appointed Zhang Wenbing as provincial vice governor and accepted the resignations of Vice Governors Ma Xin and Zhao Yan and of supervisory commission head Zhang Zhong.

articles.title_zh: 全军部队在练兵备战中迎接国庆
articles.title_en: PLA Troops Mark National Day with Training and Combat Readiness
articles.summary_zh: 新中国成立77周年到来之际，全军部队通过战备拉动演练、比武考核和巡逻执勤迎接国庆。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, PLA and armed police units carried out combat-readiness drills, evaluations and patrols to mark National Day.

articles.title_zh: 109岁老红军、广东省原副省长范希贤逝世
articles.title_en: Fan Xixian, 109-Year-Old Red Army Veteran and Former Guangdong Vice Governor, Dies
articles.summary_zh: 广东省原副省长、省人大常委会原副主任范希贤同志因病医治无效，于2026年9月29日在广州逝世，享年109岁。他1930年参加红军，参加过长征。
articles.summary_en: Fan Xixian, former vice governor of Guangdong and a veteran of the Red Army's Long March, died in Guangzhou on September 29, 2026, at the age of 109.

articles.title_zh: 国家安全部举行隐蔽战线英烈纪念仪式
articles.title_en: Ministry of State Security Holds Memorial Ceremony for Hidden-Front Martyrs
articles.summary_zh: 第十三个烈士纪念日来临之际，国家安全部在北京西山无名英雄纪念广场举行隐蔽战线英烈纪念仪式，部党委书记、部长陈一新出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 13th Martyrs' Day, the Ministry of State Security held a memorial ceremony for hidden-front martyrs at the Unknown Heroes Memorial Square in Beijing's Western Hills, with Minister Chen Yixin attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 文旅部印发《艺术发展“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Ministry of Culture and Tourism Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Arts Development
articles.summary_zh: 文化和旅游部近日印发《艺术发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年全民审美素养稳步提升，并要求细化任务清单、强化政策引导、健全监测评估。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Culture and Tourism has issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Arts Development, calling for steadily improving public aesthetic literacy by 2030 and for detailed task lists and stronger policy guidance.

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办部署开展“清朗·整治短视频虚假人设乱象”专项行动
articles.title_en: Cyberspace Administration of China Launches "Qinglang" Campaign Against Fake Personas in Short Videos
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中央网信办印发通知，在全国范围部署开展为期2个月的“清朗·整治短视频虚假人设乱象”专项行动，从严查处虚假人设营销账号并规范内容标注。
articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China has issued a notice launching a two-month nationwide "Qinglang" campaign against fake personas in short videos, tightening enforcement on deceptive marketing accounts and content labeling.

articles.title_zh: 《民政事业发展“十五五”规划》发布，部署30余项重点工作
articles.title_en: China Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Civil Affairs, Deploying Over 30 Key Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 民政部近日公布《民政事业发展“十五五”规划》，部署30余项重点工作及9项重大工程，提出到2030年养老、救助、福利等领域多项发展指标。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Civil Affairs, deploying more than 30 key tasks and 9 major projects, with targets for elderly care, social assistance and welfare by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 被中央通报虚假贸易问题后，通用技术集团整改：1800余人参加警示教育大会
articles.title_en: After Central Rebuke Over Fake Trade, China General Technology Group Rectifies: Over 1,800 Attend Warning Education Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 4月20日中央通报通用技术集团下属企业虚假贸易虚增收入问题后，集团部署整改，召开警示教育大会，1800余名干部参会。
articles.summary_en: After central authorities flagged fake-trade revenue inflation at China General Technology Group subsidiaries on April 20, the group rectified and held a warning meeting with over 1,800 cadres.

tags.name_en: General Office of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection

tags_en: General Office of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection

articles.title_zh: 公安部明确依法处置涉无人驾驶航空器违法行为行政处罚裁量基准
articles.title_en: Ministry of Public Security Clarifies Discretionary Standards for Administrative Penalties on Unmanned Aircraft Violations
articles.summary_zh: 公安部近日公开涉无人驾驶航空器违法行为行政处罚裁量基准，明确未经实名登记实施飞行活动等5类行为的处罚标准，自印发之日起施行。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Public Security released discretion standards for administrative penalties on unmanned aircraft violations, covering five categories of illegal conduct including flying without real-name registration.

articles.title_zh: 天津市行政区全域为无人驾驶航空器管制空域
articles.title_en: Tianjin Designates Entire Municipal Area as Controlled Airspace for Unmanned Aircraft
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月30日，天津市人民政府发布通告，将本市行政区全域划为无人驾驶航空器管制空域，并废止6月4日的适飞空域通告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 30, 2026, the Tianjin Municipal People's Government designated the city's entire administrative area as controlled airspace for unmanned aircraft, repealing its June 4 notice on permitted flight areas.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升：大力整治软弱涣散基层党组织，着力提振党员干部干事创业精气神
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng: Rectify Weak and Lax Primary-Level Party Organizations, Boost Officials' Drive to Take Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日下午，西藏自治区党委常委会召开会议，自治区党委书记胡昌升主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话、重要指示和重要贺信回信精神，部署维护稳定、安全生产、意识形态等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 29, the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee Standing Committee met, chaired by Secretary Hu Changsheng, to convey Xi Jinping's recent speeches and letters and to deploy work on stability, work safety and ideology.

articles.title_zh: 鲁渝消费帮扶产销对接大会签约金额超6000万元
articles.title_en: Shandong-Chongqing Consumption Assistance Matchmaking Conference Signs Deals Worth Over 60 Million Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，2026年鲁渝消费帮扶产销对接大会在山东济南举办，现场达成10个产销合作协议，签约金额超6000万元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the 2026 Shandong-Chongqing consumption assistance matchmaking conference was held in Jinan, Shandong, where 10 production-marketing cooperation agreements worth over 60 million yuan were signed.

articles.title_zh: 广东省长孟凡利出席全省安全生产视频会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli Addresses Provincial Video Meeting on Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日上午，广东省长、省安委会主任孟凡利出席全省安全生产视频会议并讲话，部署风险隐患排查整改和国庆假期安全保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, Guangdong Governor and provincial safety committee director Meng Fanli addressed a provincial video meeting on workplace safety, ordering thorough hazard inspections and stricter safety measures ahead of the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省修订最低生活保障审核确认实施细则
articles.title_en: Gansu Revises Detailed Rules for Review and Confirmation of Minimum Living Guarantee
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省民政厅近日修订印发《甘肃省最低生活保障审核确认实施细则》，共六章四十七条，明确低保审核确认职责划分、家庭经济状况调查标准及办理时限。
articles.summary_en: The Civil Affairs Department of Gansu Province has revised and issued detailed rules for reviewing and confirming minimum living guarantee eligibility, setting out responsibilities, family economic status checks and processing deadlines across six chapters and 47 articles.

tags.name_en: Gansu Provincial Department of Civil Affairs

tags_en: Gansu Provincial Department of Civil Affairs

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼王陆进在洛阳调研 强调加快建强中原城市群副中心城市
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi and Wang Lujin Inspect Luoyang, Calling for Faster Development of the Central Plains City Cluster Sub-center
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进赴洛阳调研先进制造业发展、历史文化遗产保护与文旅产业，强调建强中原城市群副中心城市。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and acting Governor Wang Lujin inspected Luoyang, reviewing advanced manufacturing, cultural heritage protection and tourism development.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议 深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神 持之以恒推进全面从严治党
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting on Studying Xi Jinping's Important Speeches and Advancing Full and Rigorous Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，省委书记罗文主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究河北省贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Hebei's Provincial Party Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting chaired by Party Secretary Luo Wen to study Xi Jinping's important speeches and directives and advance full and rigorous Party governance.

articles.title_zh: 全力夺取粮食丰收到手（权威发布·开局起步“十五五”）
articles.title_en: Full Effort to Secure Grain Harvest as China Maps Agriculture for 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，农业农村部部长张柱介绍秋粮丰收形势，并说明“十五五”粮食安全、高标准农田与常态化帮扶部署。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where Agriculture Minister Zhang Zhu detailed autumn grain harvest prospects and 15th Five-Year Plan policies on food security, farmland and rural support.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 江西高速18对服务区闪充站点国庆前投运
articles.title_en: 18 Jiangxi Expressway Service Areas Launch Flash Charging Stations Ahead of National Day
articles.summary_zh: 国庆前夕，江西婺源北、鄱阳等18对高速公路服务区新增比亚迪闪充站点，充电至70%最快仅需5分钟，年内将建成全省77对服务区闪充网络。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of National Day, 18 Jiangxi expressway service areas added BYD flash charging stations, charging EVs to 70% in five minutes, with a 77-pair province-wide network planned by year-end.

articles.title_zh: 南昌1000千伏变电站主变扩建工程投运
articles.title_en: Nanchang 1,000 kV Substation Main Transformer Expansion Project Goes into Operation
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，南昌1000千伏变电站主变扩建工程建成投运，为“十五五”期间江西首个投运的特高压交流变电工程，总投资3.54亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the Nanchang 1,000 kV substation expansion, Jiangxi's first UHV AC substation project of the 15th Five-Year Plan period, began operation with a 354 million yuan investment.

articles.title_zh: 山东援青消费帮扶系列活动在济南启动
articles.title_en: Shandong's Consumption Assistance Series for Qinghai Launches in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，青海特色产品产销对接会暨“我为青海带好物”山东援青消费帮扶系列活动启动仪式在济南举行，12家鲁青企业现场签约，意向采购金额2000万元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, a Qinghai specialty products matchmaking fair and the launch of Shandong's consumption-assistance series for Qinghai were held in Jinan, where 12 Shandong and Qinghai firms signed deals worth 20 million yuan in intended purchases.

articles.title_zh: 海西第四批促消费活动全面启动
articles.title_en: Haixi Launches Fourth Batch of Consumption Promotion Activities
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，青海海西州启动第四批促消费活动，统筹省州财政资金257.74万元，投放购车补贴及商超餐饮、成品油等消费券。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Haixi Prefecture in Qinghai launched its fourth round of consumption promotion, allocating 2.5774 million yuan for car-purchase subsidies and shopping, dining and fuel vouchers.

articles.title_zh: 四川推出334个文旅招商项目
articles.title_en: Sichuan Unveils 334 Culture and Tourism Investment Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，2026四川省文化和旅游发展大会暨第十二届中国（四川）国际旅游投资大会在成都举行，发布招商指南，推出334个文旅项目，总投资超1800亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Sichuan held its culture and tourism development conference and the 12th China (Sichuan) International Tourism Investment Conference in Chengdu, unveiling 334 projects worth over 180 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给四川大学全体师生回信强调发挥文理工医交叉融合优势
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Sichuan University Faculty and Students, Urging Cross-Disciplinary Integration
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央总书记习近平给四川大学全体师生回信，在该校建校130周年之际表示祝贺，勉励其发挥文理工医交叉融合优势，为建设教育强国、科技强国、人才强国作贡献。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, recently replied to a letter from faculty and students of Sichuan University, congratulating the school on its 130th anniversary and urging it to leverage its cross-disciplinary strengths in the humanities, science, engineering and medicine to serve national strategy.

articles.title_zh: 山东深入实施“万企出海 鲁贸全球”行动
articles.title_en: Shandong Deepens "Ten Thousand Enterprises Going Global" Campaign to Expand International Markets
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，山东省政府新闻办举行发布会，介绍“万企出海 鲁贸全球”国际市场开拓行动进展，前8个月全省外贸进出口2.43万亿元、同比增长4.7%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Shandong's provincial government information office briefed media on its campaign to expand international markets, reporting that foreign trade reached 2.43 trillion yuan in the first eight months, up 4.7% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁朱忠明分赴多地检查国庆期间城市安全运行和服务保障工作
articles.title_en: Chen Jining and Zhu Zhongming Inspect City Safety and Service Operations Ahead of National Day
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期将至，上海市委书记陈吉宁、代市长朱忠明近日分赴虹桥交通枢纽、公安联勤指挥部、消防救援站和燃气热线平台，检查城市安全运行与服务保障工作。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the National Day holiday, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining and Acting Mayor Zhu Zhongming inspected transport hubs, police command centers, fire stations and gas service hotlines to check city safety and public services.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁：以科技现代化支撑中国式现代化
articles.title_en: Chen Jining: Supporting Chinese-Style Modernization with Scientific and Technological Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月29日上午，上海市委书记陈吉宁为复旦大学师生代表作形势与政策报告，强调加强基础研究、以科技现代化支撑中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, 2026, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining told Fudan University faculty and students that stronger basic research and scientific modernization should underpin Chinese-style modernization.

articles.title_zh: 陕西公布首批20个“人工智能+”典型案例
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Releases First Batch of 20 'AI Plus' Typical Cases
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，陕西省发展改革委公布首批20个“人工智能+”典型案例，涵盖制造、能源、文旅等8个类别，意在示范带动规模化应用。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Shaanxi's Development and Reform Commission released the first batch of 20 'AI Plus' typical cases across eight sectors to promote scaled application.

articles.title_zh: 车船税政策调整，新能源汽车行业有何变化
articles.title_en: Vehicle and Vessel Tax Adjustment: What It Means for China's New Energy Vehicle Industry
articles.summary_zh: 财政部、税务总局、工信部调整车船税政策，取消对部分类型新能源汽车的税收减免，人民日报刊发政策问答解读其背景与行业影响。
articles.summary_en: China's finance, tax and industry ministries adjusted the vehicle and vessel tax policy, ending exemptions for some new energy vehicles; a People's Daily policy Q&A explains the rationale and industry impact.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 天津：全方位引领自然资源保护利用提质增效
articles.title_en: Tianjin Unveils Plan to Guide Natural Resource Protection and Utilization
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，天津市政府新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”新闻发布会，市规划资源局局长陈勇介绍“十五五”时期天津自然资源保护利用部署，提出到2030年国土空间治理现代化取得决定性进展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Tianjin's municipal information office held a briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan, where planning and resources chief Chen Yong outlined goals for natural resource protection and land-space governance, aiming for decisive progress in modernization by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 中国北方首个省级船员行业党委在天津成立
articles.title_en: Northern China's First Provincial-Level Seafarers' Industry Party Committee Established in Tianjin
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，天津市船员行业党委揭牌，成为中国北方地区首个、全国沿海第二个省级船员行业党委，由天津海事局等共同推动成立。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, the CPC Tianjin Seafarers' Industry Committee was unveiled, becoming northern China's first and the country's second provincial-level seafarers' industry Party committee, jointly promoted by the Tianjin Maritime Safety Administration and other bodies.

articles.title_zh: 何忠友在十二师调研检查市场供应和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: He Zhongyou Inspects Market Supply and Work Safety in the 12th Division
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委副书记、兵团党委书记、政委何忠友赴十二师调研检查市场供应和安全生产工作，强调抓实安全生产与民生保障，确保职工群众平安祥和过节。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, He Zhongyou, Party secretary of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, inspected market supply and work safety in the Corps' 12th Division, urging solid safety and livelihood measures so workers can enjoy a safe holiday.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升：坚定坚决抓好督察反馈问题整改 不断筑牢国家生态安全屏障
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Pledges Full Rectification After Central Ecological Inspection Feedback on Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日上午，中央第六生态环境保护督察组督察西藏自治区情况反馈会在拉萨召开，自治区党委书记胡昌升作表态发言，承诺全面认领问题、坚决抓好整改。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 29, the Central Sixth Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection Team gave feedback on its Tibet inspection in Lhasa, where regional Party Secretary Hu Changsheng pledged full acceptance and firm rectification of the issues raised.

articles.title_zh: 2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会将于11月2日至5日举办
articles.title_en: 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit to Be Held November 2-5
articles.summary_zh: 2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会将于11月2日至5日在浙江乌镇举办，主题为“开源开放 共建共享”；9月29日，主办方在北京举行新闻发布会介绍筹备情况。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit will be held Nov 2-5 in Wuzhen, Zhejiang, under the theme of open-source openness and shared development. Organizers briefed media in Beijing Sept 29.

tags.name_en: Cyberspace Community with a Shared Future

tags_en: Cyberspace Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开全市安全生产工作会议 殷勇主持会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Government Holds Citywide Work Meeting on Production Safety, Chaired by Mayor Yin Yong
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，北京市政府召开全市安全生产工作会议，市长殷勇主持会议并讲话，部署隐患排查整改、重点领域风险防控及国庆假期安全保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the Beijing municipal government held a citywide meeting on workplace safety, chaired by Mayor Yin Yong, who ordered deeper hazard inspections and safeguards for the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 着力破解制约外商投资的卡点堵点
articles.title_en: Removing the Bottlenecks Restricting Foreign Investment
articles.summary_zh: 《求是》杂志刊发专访，对外经济贸易大学教授桑百川就破解外资准入、准营与营商环境堵点、扩大服务业开放及规范地方招商引资等议题作出分析。
articles.summary_en: Qiushi magazine published an interview with UIBE professor Sang Baichuan analyzing bottlenecks in China's foreign investment environment and measures to expand opening-up, especially in services.

articles.title_zh: 烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在京隆重举行 习近平等党和国家领导人出席
articles.title_en: Martyrs' Day Flower-Basket Ceremony Held in Beijing, Attended by Xi Jinping and Other Party and State Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 9月30日上午，烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在北京天安门广场举行，习近平等党和国家领导人同各界代表一起出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 30, a flower-basket-laying ceremony marking Martyrs' Day was held at Tiananmen Square in Beijing, with Xi Jinping and other Party and state leaders attending alongside representatives from all walks of life.

articles.title_zh: 先进制造业调查：锻造大国核心竞争力的战略引擎
articles.title_en: Advanced Manufacturing Survey: Forging the Strategic Engine of a Nation's Core Competitiveness
articles.summary_zh: 求是杂志社与工信部新型工业化研究中心联合课题组刊发先进制造业深度调研，梳理我国制造业成就、短板与未来方向。
articles.summary_en: A joint team from Qiushi Journal and MIIT published an in-depth survey of China's advanced manufacturing, covering its achievements, gaps and future path.

articles.title_zh: 激活向海经济新引擎
articles.title_en: Activating New Engines for the Seaward Economy
articles.summary_zh: 广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚撰文，系统阐述广西推动向海经济高质量发展的总体布局、产业安排与开放路径。
