articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤调研市政协工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Municipal CPPCC Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日上午，淮安市委书记顾坤调研市政协工作，强调要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于加强和改进人民政协工作的重要思想，履职尽责、创新实干。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 28, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected the municipal CPPCC, urging thorough study and implementation of Xi Jinping's thinking on improving CPPCC work and calling for diligent, innovative efforts.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤调研市人大工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun Inspects Municipal People's Congress Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日上午，淮安市委书记顾坤调研市人大工作，强调依法履职尽责、主动担当作为，为推动高质量发展新跨越作出人大新贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 28, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun inspected the municipal people's congress work, urging deputies to perform duties in accordance with the law and contribute to high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党淮北市第十次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 10th CPC Huaibei Municipal Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日下午，中国共产党淮北市第十次代表大会在淮北矿业会议中心闭幕，蒋曦主持大会并讲话，选举产生新一届市委和市纪委。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 29, the 10th CPC Huaibei Municipal Congress closed at the Huaibei Mining Convention Center, chaired by Jiang Xi, electing a new municipal Party committee and discipline inspection commission.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党淮北市第十届委员会举行第一次全体会议 选举产生新一届市委常委和书记、副书记 蒋曦当选市委书记
articles.title_en: CPC Huaibei City 10th Committee Holds First Plenary Session; Jiang Xi Elected Municipal Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日下午，中共淮北市第十届委员会举行第一次全体会议，选举蒋曦为市委书记，黄韡、孙艳辉为市委副书记，并产生新一届市委常委。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 29, the 10th Huaibei Municipal Committee of the CPC held its first plenary session, electing Jiang Xi as municipal party secretary and Huang Wei and Sun Yanhui as deputy secretaries, along with a new standing committee.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦黄韡李朝晖钱界殊孙艳辉等分别参加各代表团讨论 共谋发展大计 共绘奋进蓝图
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi, Huang Wei, Li Zhaohui and Others Join Delegation Discussions at Huaibei Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日至28日，淮北市第十次党代会期间，蒋曦、黄韡、李朝晖、钱界殊、孙艳辉等分别到各代表团参加讨论，审议市委报告和市纪委工作报告。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 27-28, city leaders including Jiang Xi, Huang Wei and Li Zhaohui joined delegation discussions at Huaibei's 10th Party Congress, reviewing the municipal committee and discipline reports.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市委常委会召开会议 研究部署全面从严治党工作
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets to Deploy Work on Full and Rigorous Party Self-Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日上午，揭阳市委书记曾风保主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，研究部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 28, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao chaired a meeting of the municipal Party Standing Committee to convey and study the spirit of Xi Jinping's speech at a CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and plan local implementation.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开专题会议研究防灾减灾救灾工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Special Meeting on Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief
articles.summary_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开专题会议，研究部署防灾减灾救灾工作，强调着力补短板强弱项，不断提高防灾减灾救灾能力和水平。
articles.summary_en: Dawa Tsering chaired a special meeting on disaster prevention, reduction and relief, calling for efforts to shore up weak links and steadily improve related capacity and response levels.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升在日喀则市调研宗教工作并会见班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Religious Work in Shigatse and Meets Panchen Erdeni Chos-kyi Gyalpo
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在日喀则市调研宗教工作，考察萨迦寺、扎什伦布寺，并会见班禅额尔德尼·确吉杰布。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 26, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected religious work at Sakya and Tashilhunpo monasteries in Shigatse and met Panchen Erdeni Chos-kyi Gyalpo.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升：立足工作全局发挥自身优势更好助力社会主义现代化新西藏建设
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng: Leverage Overall Work and Strengths to Better Support Modernization of a New Socialist Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在日喀则与援藏干部座谈，强调提升援藏工作水平，更好助力社会主义现代化新西藏建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 27, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Hu Changsheng met with aid-Tibet officials in Shigatse, urging improved aid work to support the modernization of a new socialist Tibet.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就建设更高水平平安中国作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Building a Higher-Level Safe China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日，平安中国建设工作会议在北京召开，传达习近平就建设更高水平平安中国作出的重要指示，陈文清出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, 2026, the Safe China Construction Work Conference was held in Beijing, conveying Xi Jinping's important instructions on building a higher-level Safe China; Chen Wenqing attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升任西藏自治区党委书记
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Appointed Party Secretary of Tibet Autonomous Region
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央决定胡昌升任西藏自治区党委委员、常委、书记。9月22日西藏全区领导干部会议上，胡昌升表示将倾情倾力保障和改善民生，解决各族群众急难愁盼问题。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee appointed Hu Changsheng as Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region. At a regional leadership meeting on Sept 22, Hu pledged to prioritize improving people's livelihoods and resolving pressing public concerns.

tags.name_en: Prospering Border Areas and Enriching Residents

tags_en: Prospering Border Areas and Enriching Residents

articles.title_zh: 严金海：进一步统一思想、统一意志、统一行动 凝心聚力扛起人大职责、抓好贯彻落实
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Chairs Tibet People's Congress Party Group Meeting on Strict Party Governance and Legislative Duties
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，西藏自治区人大常委会党组书记严金海在拉萨主持召开党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要指示重要讲话精神，部署全面从严治党和人大履职工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Yan Jinhai, Tibetan People's Congress party chief, chaired an expanded party group meeting in Lhasa to convey Xi Jinping's recent directives and plan strict party governance and legislative oversight work.

articles.title_zh: 胡盛参加上杭永定武平漳平和市直代表三团等代表团审议
articles.title_en: Hu Sheng Joins Deliberations with Shanghang, Yongding, Wuping and Zhangping Delegations
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，胡盛先后来到上杭县、永定区、武平县、漳平市代表团和市直代表三团，与代表们共同审议市党代会报告并听取意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Hu Sheng joined delegations from Shanghang County, Yongding District, Wuping County, Zhangping City and the municipal delegation to deliberate the city party congress report and hear suggestions.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 蔡琳参加新罗长汀连城及市直代表团审议党代会报告
articles.title_en: Cai Lin Joins Xinluo, Changting, Liancheng and Municipal Delegations in Reviewing Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，蔡琳到龙岩市第七次党代会新罗、长汀、连城和市直代表团，与代表共同审议党代会报告，强调做强实体经济、壮大县域经济。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Cai Lin joined delegations at Longyan's 7th Party Congress to review the work report, urging stronger real economy and county-level development.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市第七次党代会主席团举行第二次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of Longyan's 7th Party Congress Holds Second Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日下午，中国共产党龙岩市第七次代表大会主席团举行第二次会议，胡盛主持会议，通过市委、市纪委报告决议草案及大会选举办法草案。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 28, the presidium of the 7th CPC Longyan Municipal Congress held its second meeting, chaired by Hu Sheng, approving draft resolutions and the congress election rules.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党那曲市第三届委员会常务委员会班子召开见面会
articles.title_en: New Standing Committee of the 3rd Nagqu Municipal Party Committee Meets Delegates and Press
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，中共那曲市第三届委员会第一次全体会议选举产生新一届市委常委会，张海波继续当选那曲市委书记，会后率新班子与党代表和媒体记者见面。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 25, the 3rd Nagqu Municipal Party Committee elected a new Standing Committee; Zhang Haibo was re-elected Party Secretary and led the new team to meet delegates and the press.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群调研教育高质量发展工作并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects High-Quality Education Development and Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴华侨试验区金湾学校、金山中学调研教育高质量发展工作并召开座谈会，强调办好人民满意的教育，建设教育强市。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 28, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected Jinwan School and Jinshan Middle School and chaired a symposium on high-quality education development, urging efforts to build Shantou into a strong education city.

articles.title_zh: 陈涛带队开展国庆节前安全生产督导检查并调研产业园区建设情况
articles.title_en: Chen Tao Leads Pre-National Day Safety Inspection and Surveys Industrial Park Construction
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日下午，汕头市市长陈涛带队赴潮南区开展国庆节前安全生产督导检查，并调研产业园区建设情况，要求压实安全责任、加快重点园区平台建设、推动产业聚链升级。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 28, Shantou Mayor Chen Tao led a pre-National Day workplace safety inspection in Chaonan District and surveyed industrial park construction, urging tighter safety responsibilities and faster development of key industrial park platforms.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市基孔肯雅热疫情防控工作调度会召开
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Meeting on Chikungunya Fever Prevention and Control
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日晚，汕头市在澄海区召开基孔肯雅热疫情防控工作调度会，市委书记庄悦群主持并讲话，市长陈涛等出席，部署中秋国庆期间蚊媒传染病防控工作。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 27, Shantou held a meeting in Chenghai District on chikungunya fever control, chaired by Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn, to step up measures over the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 徐龙在全市安全生产工作推进会上强调 落实落细安全防控措施 牢牢守住安全发展底线
articles.title_en: Xu Long Stresses Tightening Safety Precautions at City Work Safety Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，石嘴山市委副书记、市长徐龙主持召开全市安全生产工作推进会，部署安全生产治本攻坚、隐患排查整治和重点领域风险防控工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Shizuishan Mayor Xu Long chaired the city's work safety promotion meeting, ordering full implementation of safety precautions, hazard inspections and risk control in key sectors.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议 部署全面从严治党和国庆前后安全发展稳定工作
articles.title_en: Ningxia Party Standing Committee Meeting Deploys Strict Party Governance and Holiday Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，宁夏自治区党委常委会召开会议，自治区党委书记李邑飞主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，部署全面从严治党及国庆前后经济发展、安全生产、社会稳定等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the Standing Committee of the Ningxia Party Committee met in Yinchuan, chaired by Party Secretary Li Yifei, to convey Xi Jinping's recent speeches and deploy strict Party governance plus economic, safety and stability work around the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 全区精神文明建设表彰大会召开 李邑飞讲话 张雨浦主持 陈雍庄严出席
articles.title_en: Ningxia Regional Spiritual Civilization Commendation Conference Held; Li Yifei Speaks, Zhang Yupu Presides, Chen Yong and Zhuang Yan Attend
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，宁夏全区精神文明建设表彰大会在银川召开，自治区党委书记李邑飞出席并讲话，自治区主席张雨浦主持，陈雍、庄严出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Ningxia held a regional spiritual civilization commendation conference in Yinchuan. Party Secretary Li Yifei spoke, Chair Zhang Yupu presided, and Chen Yong and Zhuang Yan attended.

tags.name_en: Commendation of Advanced Units and Individuals

tags_en: Commendation of Advanced Units and Individuals

articles.title_zh: 李国强到肥城市调研
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Conducts Inspection Tour in Feicheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强到肥城市调研，实地查看红色教育基地、农业龙头企业和镇卫生院，强调统筹红色资源保护、特色产业培育与民生改善。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Tai'an Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor Li Guoqiang inspected Feicheng City, visiting a revolutionary education base, an agricultural enterprise and a township clinic, urging coordinated efforts in red heritage protection, specialty industry development and livelihood improvement.

articles.title_zh: 李晖在靖江市开展节前安全生产检查
articles.title_en: Li Hui Conducts Pre-Holiday Workplace Safety Inspection in Jingjiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，泰州市市长李晖在靖江市开展国庆节前安全生产检查，走访产业园和造船企业，要求压实责任、排查隐患。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui inspected workplace safety in Jingjiang ahead of the National Day holiday, visiting an industrial park and a shipyard and urging stricter risk controls.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬开展节前安全生产检查
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Conducts Pre-Holiday Safety Production Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬赴泰兴市开展节前安全生产检查，实地检查酒店、乐园、汽渡及造船企业，部署国庆假期安全防范工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong inspected workplace safety in Taixing, checking a hotel, amusement park, ferry crossing and shipyard ahead of the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开扩大会议 深入贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 持续做大做强吉林先进制造业
articles.title_en: Jilin Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting on Strengthening Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，吉林省委常委会召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记就发展先进制造业所作重要指示和全国先进制造业大会精神，省委书记黄强主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the Jilin Provincial Party Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions on advanced manufacturing and the National Advanced Manufacturing Conference, chaired by Party Secretary Huang Qiang.

articles.title_zh: 张海波督导矿山安全生产并调研黄金产业高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Mine Safety Production and Surveys High-Quality Development of the Gold Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，威海市委书记张海波到乳山市督导矿山安全生产，并调研黄金产业高质量发展工作，强调提升企业本质安全水平、做强黄金产业链。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo inspected mine safety production and surveyed high-quality development of the gold industry in Rushan, urging stronger intrinsic safety and an expanded gold industry chain.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛同美国总统特朗普夫妇茶叙
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Have Tea with U.S. President Trump and His Wife
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月25日上午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在白宫同美国总统特朗普和夫人梅拉尼娅举行茶叙，随后参观美国国家档案馆。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 25 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan had tea at the White House with U.S. President Trump and his wife Melania, then visited the U.S. National Archives.

articles.title_zh: 无锡市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting on Study and Implementation of Xi Jinping's Key Directives
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，无锡市委书记蒋锋主持召开市委常委会第2次会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，审议贯彻落实市第十五次党代会重点任务分解方案。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Wuxi Party Secretary Jiang Feng chaired the 2nd meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee, studying Xi Jinping's key directives and reviewing the task breakdown for the 15th Municipal Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 新一届无锡市委委员、市纪委委员开展现场集体学习
articles.title_en: New Wuxi Municipal Party Committee and Discipline Commission Members Conduct On-Site Collective Study
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，无锡市第十五次党代会闭幕后首个工作日，市委书记蒋锋率新一届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员赴延安精神展示馆等基地开展现场集体学习并重温入党誓词。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the first working day after Wuxi's 15th Party Congress, Party Secretary Jiang Feng led newly elected municipal committee members and discipline commission members in an on-site collective study session at red-education and anti-corruption bases, where they renewed their Party oath.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《文化遗产保护传承“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee General Office and State Council General Office Issue the 15th Five-Year Plan for Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《文化遗产保护传承“十五五”规划》并发出通知，要求各地区各部门结合实际认真贯彻落实。规划提出到2030年基本形成文化遗产大保护格局。
articles.summary_en: The General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance, urging all regions and departments to implement it in line with local conditions. The plan aims to basically form a comprehensive heritage protection framework by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于《医疗康复护理扩容提升工程实施方案》的批复
articles.title_en: State Council Approves Implementation Plan for Expanding Medical Rehabilitation and Nursing Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 国务院批复原则同意《医疗康复护理扩容提升工程实施方案》，要求国家卫生健康委、国家发展改革委统筹协调，各地细化落实，扩大医疗康复护理资源供给。
articles.summary_en: The State Council approved in principle the Implementation Plan for Expanding Medical Rehabilitation and Nursing Capacity, tasking the National Health Commission and the National Development and Reform Commission with coordinating its rollout nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在全市群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会上强调：以更大决心更大力度系统整治，让市民群众看到更多新变化、得到更多新实惠
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Urges Stronger, More Systematic Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Affecting the Public
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，西安市召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰出席并讲话，部署高标准农田建设、农村集体“三资”管理、医保基金、老年群体权益保障等民生领域整治重点。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Xi'an held a meeting to advance the rectification of misconduct and corruption affecting the public. Municipal Party Secretary Hao Huijie called for systematic efforts in livelihood areas including farmland construction, rural collective asset management, medical insurance funds and protection of the elderly.
keywords: 群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治

articles.title_zh: “聚力民企谋发展 投资西安启新程”知名民企商会助力西安高质量发展招商推介会举行
articles.title_en: Xi'an Hosts Investment Promotion Conference to Draw Private Enterprise Investment
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，陕西省工商联与西安市政府在西安共同举办知名民企商会助力西安高质量发展招商推介会，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Shaanxi's Federation of Industry and Commerce and Xi'an's city government co-hosted an investment promotion conference in Xi'an to draw private investment; Party Secretary Hao Huijie attended.

articles.title_zh: 市政府第82次常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Xinxiang Municipal Government Holds 82nd Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，新乡市市长陈维忠主持召开市政府第82次常务会议，学习习近平总书记重要文章精神，研究经济运行、安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Xinxiang Mayor Chen Weizhong chaired the 82nd executive meeting of the municipal government, studying Xi Jinping's article on Party governance and reviewing economic performance and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议开幕
articles.title_en: 25th Session of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议在南京开幕，常务副主任樊金龙主持会议，会议听取湖泊保护条例执法检查、多部地方性法规草案审议及政府专项工作报告。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the 25th session of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee opened in Nanjing, chaired by Executive Vice Chairman Fan Jinlong, hearing a law-enforcement inspection report on lake protection and reviews of several draft local regulations.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“数据要素×”大赛江苏分赛颁奖仪式暨高质量数据集建设环省行活动在盐城举行
articles.title_en: 2026 "Data Elements ×" Competition Jiangsu Division Awards Ceremony and High-Quality Dataset Construction Tour Held in Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，2026年“数据要素×”大赛江苏分赛颁奖仪式暨高质量数据集建设环省行活动在盐城举行，省数据局局长刘世虎、盐城市代市长吴炜出席并为获奖队伍颁奖。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the awards ceremony of the 2026 "Data Elements ×" Competition Jiangsu Division and a provincial tour on high-quality dataset construction were held in Yancheng, attended by Liu Shihu, head of the Jiangsu Provincial Data Bureau, and acting mayor Wu Wei.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平主持召开全市汽车产业高质量发展座谈会
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Chairs Citywide Symposium on High-Quality Development of the Auto Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，盐城市委书记严汉平主持召开全市汽车产业高质量发展座谈会，听取重点汽车企业意见建议，部署政企协同推动产业提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping chaired a citywide symposium on the high-quality development of the auto industry, gathering views from major automakers and pledging government-enterprise cooperation to upgrade the sector.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市与西北大学举行校地合作交流会并签订战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Yancheng City and Northwest University Hold School-Locality Cooperation Meeting and Sign Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日至28日，西北大学一行来盐城调研，市委书记严汉平、西北大学党委书记蒋林出席校地合作交流会并致辞，代市长吴炜与校长孙庆伟代表双方签订战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 27 to 28, a Northwest University delegation visited Yancheng. City Party Secretary Yan Hanping and NWU Party Secretary Jiang Lin addressed the school-locality cooperation meeting, and acting mayor Wu Wei and NWU president Sun Qingwei signed a strategic cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神 信长星主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Recent Important Speeches, Xin Changxing Presides
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，江苏省委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，调度全省落实总书记对江苏工作重要讲话精神进展，并审议江苏省大运河生态环境保护工作方案（2026—2028年）。省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee met to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, review progress in implementing his guidance on Jiangsu's work, and deliberate a 2026-2028 ecological protection plan for the Grand Canal. Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市八届人大常委会第三十六次会议召开
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 36th Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，阳江市八届人大常委会第三十六次会议召开，审议《阳江市现代化海洋牧场发展促进条例（草案）》，并表决通过有关人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the Standing Committee of the 8th Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress held its 36th session, reviewing a draft regulation on modern marine ranching development and approving personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江宣讲市第九次党代会精神并调研生态环保、安全生产、社会稳定等工作
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Promotes Spirit of City Party Congress, Inspects Eco-Environmental Protection, Work Safety and Social Stability
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江在岳阳楼区、岳阳经开区、市公安局等地宣讲市第九次党代会精神，并调研生态环保、安全生产、社会稳定等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Xie Weijiang, deputy secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Yueyang Party secretary, promoted the spirit of the city's ninth Party congress and inspected eco-environmental protection, work safety and social stability across Yueyang.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市人大常委会传达学习市第九次党代会精神
articles.title_en: Yueyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Conveys and Studies Spirit of Ninth Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，岳阳市人大常委会机关召开全体干部职工大会，专题传达学习市第九次党代会精神，研究部署贯彻落实举措，赵岳平主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the Yueyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a staff meeting to convey and study the spirit of the city's Ninth Party Congress and plan implementation measures, chaired by Zhao Yueping.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 研究宏观政策发力提效、促进有效投资有关工作等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Macro Policy and Effective Investment
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，研究宏观政策发力提效、促进有效投资，听取新污染物治理进展汇报，审议通过《事业单位登记管理条例（草案）》。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing on macro policy, effective investment and new pollutant control, and approved a draft regulation on public institution registration.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 研究做好我市纪检监察工作 徐晓霞主持会议
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Discipline Inspection and Supervision Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日上午，云浮市委书记徐晓霞主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平党建思想，研究部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治及纪检监察工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 28, Yunfu Municipal Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's Party-building thought and plan the campaign against corruption and misconduct around the public.

articles.title_en: Xu Xiaoxia Inspects Luoding City on the "Hundreds, Tens of Thousands" Project
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日下午，云浮市委书记徐晓霞赴罗定市调研督导红色资源保护利用、绿美生态建设、典型镇村培育等“百千万工程”工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 28, Yunfu Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia inspected Luoding City, overseeing work on the "Hundreds, Tens of Thousands" Project including red-resource protection, ecological construction and model town and village cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国到市人民来访接待中心接待来访群众、研判重点信访事项
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Receives Petitioners and Reviews Key Petition Cases in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，周口市委书记黄玉国到市人民来访接待中心接待来访群众，研判重点信访事项，强调依法依规解决群众合理诉求。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo visited the city's petition reception center to meet petitioners and review key cases, urging lawful resolution of public grievances.

articles.title_zh: 周口市委常委会召开会议 研究全面从严治党和灾后恢复重建等工作
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting on Party Governance and Post-Disaster Reconstruction
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习中共中央政治局会议精神和全省领导干部会议精神，部署全面从严治党、秋粮生产、灾后恢复重建及基层减负等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a meeting of the municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to convey the spirit of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting and provincial leaders' meeting, and to deploy work on strict Party governance, autumn grain production, post-disaster reconstruction and reducing burdens on grassroots levels.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”开好局起好步：推动国资央企实现新发展
articles.title_en: SASAC: Driving Central SOEs Toward New Development Under the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，国务院国资委在国新办发布会上介绍中央企业落实“十五五”规划情况，截至8月末央企资产总额达99.3万亿元，同比增长4.2%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, SASAC officials briefed at a State Council Information Office press conference on how central SOEs will implement the 15th Five-Year Plan; their total assets reached 99.3 trillion yuan by end-August, up 4.2%.

articles.title_zh: 赵龙在福州调研
articles.title_en: Zhao Long Conducts Inspection Tour in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，福建省委书记赵龙在福州调研，考察“3820”战略工程成就展、市政务服务中心、苍霞新城及福州软件园，强调传承弘扬习近平总书记在福建的重要理念与实践。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, 2026, Fujian Party Secretary Zhao Long inspected Fuzhou's '3820' strategy exhibition, city service center, Cangxia community and software park, urging officials to carry on Xi Jinping's Fujian legacy.

articles.title_zh: 福建省第五届“个体工商户服务月”在福州启动
articles.title_en: Fujian Launches Fifth "Individual Business Service Month" in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，福建省第五届“个体工商户服务月”启动仪式在福州举行，省市场监管局等部门集中发布平台赋能、普惠金融等助企举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Fujian launched its fifth "Individual Business Service Month" in Fuzhou, with provincial regulators and partners rolling out measures on platform empowerment and inclusive finance for small businesses.

articles.title_zh: 福州“就业大礼包”暖心上线
articles.title_en: Fuzhou's "Employment Gift Package" Warmly Launched
articles.summary_zh: 9月，人社部部署的“就业政策宣传月”在福州展开，福州市人社部门聚焦失业人员和就业困难人员，集中开展政策宣传和就业帮扶。
articles.summary_en: In September, Fuzhou's human resources authorities carried out employment policy outreach and assistance for unemployed and disadvantaged job seekers under a nationwide campaign.

articles.title_zh: 朴朴将收取“订单打包费”每单0.45元 10月5日起实施
articles.title_en: Pupu to Charge 0.45 Yuan Packaging Fee per Order Starting October 5
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，生鲜电商平台朴朴宣布自10月5日起对订单收取0.45元/单的打包费，整箱水等自带原厂包装的大件商品自动免收。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, fresh grocery e-commerce platform Pupu announced it will charge a 0.45 yuan packaging fee per order from Oct 5, with bulky items in original packaging exempted.

articles.title_zh: 福州：“含绿量”持续化为“含金量”
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Turns 'Green Content' into 'Gold Content'
articles.summary_zh: 福州推进产业绿色低碳转型，通过绿色工厂、资源循环利用、海上风电等举措，把产业的“含绿量”转化为发展的“含金量”。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou is advancing green, low-carbon industrial upgrading through green factories, resource recycling and offshore wind power, turning its industries' 'green content' into 'gold content' for growth.

articles.title_zh: 中美八点成果共识，这一点为何居首？
articles.title_en: Why 'Constructive Strategic Stability' Tops the Eight-Point China-US Consensus
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日至25日，国家主席习近平对美国进行国事访问，两国元首达成八点成果共识，首条为构建基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping visited the US from Sept 23-25, 2026; both presidents reached an eight-point consensus, led by building a constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_en: Political Documentary: Forging the Right Path for Major-Country Relations — Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 时政纪录片记述习近平主席对美国进行国事访问，倡导开辟大国相处正确之道，书写中美关系历史新篇。
articles.summary_en: A political documentary recounts President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States, highlighting the right way for major countries to get along and a new chapter in China-US relations.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组召开扩大会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Jinan Municipal Government Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，济南市政府党组召开扩大会议，市长于海田主持，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，部署全面从严治党、社会救助及国庆假期安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Jinan's municipal government Party group held an expanded meeting chaired by Mayor Yu Haitian to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and arrange work on Party discipline, social assistance and holiday safety.

articles.title_zh: 于海田主持召开市政府常务会议 研究大气污染防治等事项
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting on Air Pollution Prevention and Fireworks Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田主持召开市政府常务会议，研究烟花爆竹全链条安全监管和大气污染防治等事项。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian chaired a municipal government executive meeting to study full-chain safety oversight of fireworks and air pollution prevention and control.

articles.summary_en: The 9th Congress of the Qingdao Federation of Literary and Art Circles opened on the morning of Sept 29, 2026, with Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong delivering a speech and Mayor Ren Gang in attendance.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 28-29, the 2026 "Refute Rumors Together" salon (Season 3) and Jiangsu's "Clear Cyberspace, Protect Business" campaign were held in Suzhou to safeguard enterprises' online rights.

articles.title_en: Thai-Language Station Announcements Debut in Chongqing as More Southeast Asian Tourists Visit

articles.summary_en: Starting Sept 29, 2026, Chongqing Rail Transit began piloting Thai-language station announcements at three stations to make travel easier for foreign visitors.

articles.title_zh: 吴晓军当选甘肃省人大常委会主任 孔绍逊当选甘肃省省长
articles.title_en: Wu Xiaojun Elected Director of Gansu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, Kong Shaoxun Elected Gansu Governor
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，甘肃省第十四届人民代表大会第五次会议在兰州举行第二次全体会议，以无记名投票方式选举吴晓军为省人大常委会主任、孔绍逊为省人民政府省长，两人随后进行宪法宣誓。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the 5th session of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress in Lanzhou elected Wu Xiaojun as director of the provincial people's congress standing committee and Kong Shaoxun as provincial governor via secret ballot; both took a constitutional oath.

articles.title_zh: 遵义会议会址基本完成保护性修缮
articles.title_en: Zunyi Conference Site Basically Completes Protective Renovation
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，遵义会议会址保护修缮工作媒体开放日活动披露，历时半年的保护性修缮工程基本完成，主楼一楼已正常开放。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, organizers said the six-month protective renovation of the Zunyi Conference Site is basically complete, with the main building's first floor now open to visitors.

articles.title_zh: 农业农村部：践行大农业观、大食物观，加快构建多元化食物供给体系
articles.title_en: Ministry of Agriculture: Building a Diversified Food Supply System Under the 'Greater Agriculture and Greater Food' Approach
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”主题新闻发布会，农业农村部负责人表示将稳面积、增单产抓好粮食生产，并加快构建多元化食物供给体系。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Sept 29 on the 15th Five-Year Plan, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs pledged to keep grain output stable while building a diversified food supply system.

articles.title_en: Ministry of Agriculture: Targeted Assistance Delivered to All 2.562 Million People at Risk of Returning to Poverty

articles.summary_en: At a Sept 29 State Council Information Office briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs said monitoring, policy and working mechanisms for targeted assistance are basically in place, with all 2.562 million people at risk of returning to poverty receiving help.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan, where the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs said China will deepen pilot programs extending second-round rural land contracts by 30 years after expiry, driven by sci-tech and reform.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, Anhui's provincial government information office held a briefing in Hefei on the 2026 World Manufacturing Convention held Sept 20-23, reporting 790 signed projects worth 363.4 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 《2026年人民币东盟国家使用报告》发布
articles.title_en: Guangxi Financial Society Releases 2026 Report on RMB Use in ASEAN Countries
articles.summary_zh: 近日，广西金融学会在南宁发布《2026年人民币东盟国家使用报告》，该报告已连续7年编制，聚焦人民币在东盟国家使用及中国—东盟金融合作新机遇。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi Financial Society recently released the 2026 Report on RMB Use in ASEAN Countries in Nanning, its seventh consecutive edition, highlighting new opportunities in China-ASEAN financial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 白龙核电2号机组开工建设
articles.title_en: Unit 2 of Guangxi Bailong Nuclear Power Project Begins Construction
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日，国家电投集团广西白龙核电2号机组核岛开始第一罐混凝土浇筑，标志着一期工程由单机组建设转入双机组全面建设新阶段。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 27, the nuclear island of Unit 2 of the Bailong nuclear power project in Guangxi began its first concrete pour, moving phase one into full two-unit construction.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼王陆进走访省人大常委会省政府省政协省军区机关
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi and Wang Lujin Visit Henan Provincial People's Congress, Government, CPPCC and Military Command
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进分别走访省人大常委会、省政府、省政协、省军区机关并看望机关干部，强调抓实各项重点工作，奋力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and Acting Governor Wang Lujin visited the provincial People's Congress, government, CPPCC and military command, urging solid delivery on key tasks for a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 河北省推动政策性金融资金支持城市更新
articles.title_en: Hebei Promotes Policy-Based Financial Funding for Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 河北省深化政银企合作，由省住房城乡建设厅联合国家开发银行、中国农业发展银行河北省分行，以政策性金融资金支持城市更新行动。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province is deepening government-bank-enterprise cooperation, with the provincial housing department working with China Development Bank and Agricultural Development Bank branches to fund urban renewal through policy-based finance.

articles.title_zh: 冲天的音符——写在海南商发二期项目合练启动之际
articles.title_en: Soaring Notes: Hainan Commercial Spaceport Phase II Begins Joint Training
articles.summary_zh: 海南商业航天发射场二期项目合练启动。该发射场用两年建成，截至2026年9月23日已连续成功发射23次，并带动文昌航天产业集聚。
articles.summary_en: Joint training for Phase II of the Hainan Commercial Spacecraft Launch Site has begun; built in two years, the site has logged 23 straight successful launches as of Sept 23, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞调研国庆假期琼州海峡保通保畅工作
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Qiongzhou Strait Traffic Guarantee for National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，海南省委书记冯飞在海口新海港码头调研国庆假期琼州海峡保通保畅工作，部署运力统筹与安全监管。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei inspected the Qiongzhou Strait holiday traffic and transport guarantee work at Haikou's New Hai Port, pledging stronger safety oversight and capacity coordination.

articles.title_zh: 《新型电池产业发展“十五五”规划》发布
articles.title_en: China Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for New-Type Battery Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，工业和信息化部等7部门联合印发《新型电池产业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年全固态电池初步实现规模化应用。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and six other departments jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for the new-type battery industry, aiming for initial large-scale application of all-solid-state batteries by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 《南京都市圈发展规划（2026—2035）》实施
articles.title_en: Nanjing Metropolitan Area Development Plan (2026-2035) Implemented
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，《南京都市圈发展规划（2026—2035）》由南京都市圈城市发展联盟印发实施，规划覆盖南京、镇江、扬州等8市全域，明确到2030年地区生产总值超7万亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the Nanjing Metropolitan Area Development Plan (2026-2035) was issued, covering eight cities including Nanjing, Zhenjiang and Yangzhou, and targeting GDP of over 7 trillion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 库布其400万千瓦新能源送出工程冲刺年内投运
articles.title_en: Kubuqi 4-Million-Kilowatt New Energy Transmission Project Races Toward Year-End Operation
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，库布其沙漠基地鄂尔多斯400万千瓦新能源送出工程完成呼准鄂电气化铁路跨越施工，大路—布尔陶线路段全线贯通，为年内竣工投运奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On September 26, the 4-million-kW new energy transmission project in Ordos, based at the Kubuqi Desert base, completed its crossing of the Hohhot-Junggar-Ordos electrified railway, fully connecting the Dalu-Bu'ertao line section and paving the way for year-end operation.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区政协召开新闻发布会
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region CPPCC Holds Press Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，内蒙古自治区政协召开新闻发布会，介绍自治区政协十三届常委会第十八次会议筹备情况，会议将于10月8日至9日在呼和浩特召开。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the CPPCC of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region held a press conference on preparations for the 18th meeting of its 13th Standing Committee, set for October 8-9 in Hohhot.

articles.title_zh: 包钢主持召开自治区人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Chairs Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢主持召开政府常务会议，传达贯彻发展先进制造业重要指示，部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治，并审议自治区“十五五”相关规划。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Inner Mongolia Chairman Bao Gang chaired a government executive meeting on developing advanced manufacturing, rectifying misconduct and corruption around the public, and the region's 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 闽宁山海同心研究院揭牌成立
articles.title_en: Minning Shanhai Tongxin Research Institute Unveiled in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，闽宁山海同心研究院共建启动活动在厦门大学举行，厦门大学与宁夏大学签署共建协议并为研究院揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, a launch event for the Minning Shanhai Tongxin Research Institute was held at Xiamen University, where Xiamen University and Ningxia University signed a co-building agreement and unveiled the institute.

articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，中央军委副主席张升民在北京人民大会堂会见“时代楷模”王戟同志先进事迹报告团成员并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Central Military Commission Vice Chairman Zhang Shengmin met with members of the report team on the advanced deeds of "Model of the Times" Wang Ji at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 青海推动深化扫黑除恶专项斗争工作走深走实
articles.title_en: Qinghai Deepens Campaign Against Organized Crime
articles.summary_zh: 青海省委、省政府部署深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，重点打击村霸、沙霸等传统黑恶势力及网络软暴力犯罪，玉树、海西、海东等地同步推进专项整治。
articles.summary_en: Qinghai's provincial party committee and government are deepening a campaign against organized crime, targeting both traditional gangs and new online extortion networks, with prefectures such as Yushu, Haixi and Haidong rolling out tailored crackdown measures.

articles.title_zh: @广大网友，来和新任青海省委书记罗东川聊聊您的期盼
articles.title_en: Netizens Invited to Share Expectations with New Qinghai Party Secretary Luo Dongchuan
articles.summary_zh: 中央决定罗东川任青海省委书记，人民网即日起启动为期一个月的“来和新任青海省委书记罗东川聊聊您的期盼”群众建言征集活动，邀各界为青海发展建言。
articles.summary_en: After the CPC Central Committee appointed Luo Dongchuan as Party Secretary of Qinghai, People's Daily Online launched a one-month public suggestion campaign inviting netizens to share expectations for the province's development.

articles.title_zh: 第六届四川省文创大会在成都启幕 首次发布《巴蜀IP创新转化计划》
articles.title_en: Sixth Sichuan Cultural and Creative Industry Conference Opens in Chengdu, Debuts Bashu IP Innovation and Transformation Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，第六届四川省文创大会暨2026四川文创周在成都天府国际会议中心启动，会上四川首次发布《巴蜀IP创新转化计划》，推动巴蜀文创高质量发展与文旅资源产业化。
articles.summary_en: The sixth Sichuan Cultural and Creative Industry Conference and 2026 Sichuan Cultural and Creative Week opened on Sept 28 in Chengdu, where Sichuan released its first Bashu IP Innovation and Transformation Plan to develop cultural tourism resources.

articles.title_zh: 山东持续释放消费潜能
articles.title_en: Shandong Continues to Unlock Consumption Potential
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报“活力中国调研行”报道，山东通过产业升级、文化创意和产业融合持续激发消费潜能，消费品以旧换新带动销售额1157亿元。
articles.summary_en: A People's Daily field report shows Shandong unlocking consumption potential via industrial upgrading, cultural creativity and cross-sector integration, with trade-in subsidies driving 115.7 billion yuan in sales.

articles.title_zh: 年末委员视察设置12个专题
articles.title_en: Shanghai CPPCC Meeting Sets 12 Topics for Year-End Committee Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，上海市政协主席胡文容主持召开十四届七十三次主席会议，审议文化创新重点课题调研报告和2026年度年末委员视察工作方案，视察将设4方面12个专题。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Shanghai CPPCC Chairman Hu Wenrong chaired the 73rd chairpersons' meeting, reviewing a cultural innovation research report and the 2026 year-end inspection plan covering 12 topics in four areas.

articles.title_zh: 持续提升超大城市本质安全水平
articles.title_en: Shanghai Vows to Raise Megacity Intrinsic Safety Level
articles.summary_zh: 国务院9月28日召开全国安全生产视频会议，上海市政府随后召开贯彻落实会议，代市长朱忠明部署重点领域安全整治和国庆假期安保工作。
articles.summary_en: The State Council held a national work safety video conference on Sept 28; Shanghai then met to implement it, with Acting Mayor Zhu Zhongming pledging tighter safety steps for the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 上海市进一步深化国资国企改革工作会议举行 陈吉宁出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Addresses Shanghai Meeting on Deepening Reform of State-Owned Assets and Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日，上海市进一步深化国资国企改革工作会议举行，市委书记陈吉宁讲话部署《实施方案（2026—2029年）》，代市长朱忠明主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, 2026, Shanghai held a meeting on deepening reform of state-owned assets and enterprises; Party Secretary Chen Jining urged stronger core competitiveness, with acting mayor Zhu Zhongming presiding.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界设计之都大会开幕 “上海设计100+”年度大奖公布
articles.title_en: 2026 World Design Capital Conference Opens; 'Shanghai Design 100+' Annual Awards Announced
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日，上海市政府与联合国教科文组织共同主办的2026世界设计之都大会在沪开幕，市委副书记、代市长朱忠明致辞并公布“上海设计100+”年度大奖。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Design Capital Conference, co-hosted by the Shanghai municipal government and UNESCO, opened in Shanghai on Sept 28; acting mayor Zhu Zhongming addressed it and the "Shanghai Design 100+" annual awards were announced.

articles.title_zh: 上海发布商品住房销售改革细则，引导理性置业
articles.title_en: Shanghai Issues Detailed Rules for Commercial Housing Sales Reform to Guide Rational Home Buying
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日，上海市住建委等四部门联合发布商品住房销售制度改革实施细则，全面加强预售资金全额全过程监管，推行现房定金制度，定金一般不超总价3%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, 2026, four Shanghai departments jointly issued detailed rules reforming commercial housing sales, placing presale funds under full-process escrow and capping deposits for completed-home sales at 3% of price.

articles.title_zh: 吕梁全力推动制造业攀高向新
articles.title_en: Lüliang Pushes Manufacturing Toward Higher-End, Innovation-Driven Growth
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，山西吕梁以5G网络和数字基础设施为支撑，推动煤铝焦化等传统制造业数字化转型，梯度培育智能工厂，高端铝材等新材料制造加快发展。
articles.summary_en: Lüliang in Shanxi is using 5G and digital infrastructure to upgrade its coal, aluminum and coking industries, building a tiered system of smart factories and boosting high-end new materials output.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀生态环境志愿服务活动在津启动
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Ecological Environment Volunteer Service Activity Launched in Tianjin
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，京津冀生态环境志愿服务活动在天津举行主场活动，由三地生态环境部门主办，200余名志愿者参与水质监测、岸线清洁等行动。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei ecological environment volunteer service activity held its main event in Tianjin, hosted by the three regions' environment authorities, with over 200 volunteers joining water quality monitoring and shoreline cleanup.

articles.title_zh: 滇南首个大型抽水蓄能工程开工
articles.title_en: First Large Pumped-Storage Hydropower Project in Southern Yunnan Begins Construction
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国家抽水蓄能规划重点项目云南西畴抽水蓄能电站开工建设，这是滇南首个大型抽水蓄能工程，装机规模120万千瓦，总投资约80亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Yunnan's Xichou pumped-storage station, the first large project of its kind in southern Yunnan, started construction with 1.2 GW of capacity and about 8 billion yuan in investment.

articles.title_zh: 王予波在云南省安全生产视频会议上强调从严从实从细抓好安全生产
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Stresses Rigorous Safety Production Work at Yunnan Provincial Video Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，全国安全生产视频会议后，云南省接着召开会议，省长王予波出席并讲话，要求从严从实从细抓好安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, after the national video conference on workplace safety, Yunnan Province held a follow-up meeting where Governor Wang Yubo urged strict and thorough implementation of safety production measures.

articles.title_zh: 海洋经济 源源不断的“蓝色动力”（高质量发展故事汇·第23期）
articles.title_en: Maritime Economy: An Endless “Blue Engine” (High-Quality Development Story Series, No. 23)
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月29日，《人民日报》刊发“高质量发展故事汇”第23期，系统阐述建设海洋强国、推动海洋经济高质量发展的部署与成效，2025年我国海洋生产总值超11万亿元，同比增长5.5%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, 2026, People's Daily published the 23rd installment of its high-quality development story series on China's maritime economy, detailing policy plans and results; the 2025 ocean economy topped 11 trillion yuan, up 5.5 percent year on year.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给四川大学全体师生回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from All Faculty and Students of Sichuan University
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平给四川大学全体师生回信，在该校建校130周年之际表示祝贺，并希望学校发挥文理工医交叉融合优势，服务新时代国家战略。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, State President and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, recently replied to a letter from all faculty and students of Sichuan University, congratulating the university on its 130th anniversary and urging it to leverage its interdisciplinary strengths in serving national strategy.

articles.title_zh: 中美元首会晤为世界注入稳定性预期
articles.title_en: China-U.S. Summit Injects Stability Expectations into the World
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，新加坡学者顾清扬在接受新华社专访时表示，中美元首同意共同构建建设性战略稳定关系，为动荡的世界注入稳定性预期。
articles.summary_en: Singapore scholar Gu Qingyang told Xinhua on Sept 29 that the China-U.S. leaders' agreement to build a constructive strategic stability relationship injects stability into a turbulent world.

articles.title_zh: 中秋假期全国消费市场需求旺供给足
articles.title_en: Mid-Autumn Holiday Sees Robust Demand and Ample Supply in National Consumer Market
articles.summary_zh: 商务部数据显示，中秋假期全国重点零售和餐饮企业日均销售额同比增长6.1%，以旧换新带动销售额115.3亿元，生活必需品供应充足价格平稳。
articles.summary_en: Commerce Ministry data show daily sales at key retail and catering firms rose 6.1% y/y over the Mid-Autumn holiday, with trade-ins driving 11.53 bln yuan and staple goods prices stable.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给四川大学全体师生的回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Reply Letter to All Faculty and Students of Sichuan University
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月29日，习近平给四川大学全体师生回信，祝贺建校130周年，勉励师生赓续红色血脉、服务国家战略，为建设教育强国、科技强国、人才强国作贡献。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, 2026, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to the faculty and students of Sichuan University, congratulating the school on its 130th anniversary and urging them to serve national strategy and help build a strong education, science and talent nation.

articles.title_zh: 中国长安汽车重大项目集中签约暨总部办公场地启用活动举行 陈新武出席
articles.title_en: Changan Automobile Signs Major Projects and Opens Headquarters Office in Chongqing; Mayor Chen Xinwu Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，中国长安汽车重大项目集中签约暨总部办公场地启用活动在重庆举行，市长陈新武出席，6个重大项目集中签约。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Changan Automobile held a ceremony in Chongqing to sign six major projects and inaugurate its headquarters office, with Mayor Chen Xinwu attending.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会举行会议 研究部署全面从严治党和创新强市建设等工作
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on Strict Party Governance and Building an Innovation-Driven City
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日上午，重庆市委书记袁家军主持召开市委常委会会议，研究部署全面从严治党、创新强市建设、乡村振兴及财政科学管理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 28, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun chaired a meeting of the municipal Party Standing Committee to plan work on strict Party governance, building an innovation-driven city, rural revitalization and fiscal management.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼王陆进走访省人大常委会省政府省政协省军区机关
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi and Wang Lujin Visit Henan Provincial People's Congress, Government, CPPCC and Military Command
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进分别走访省人大常委会、省政府、省政协、省军区机关并看望干部，强调牢记总书记嘱托、履职尽责，奋力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and acting Governor Wang Lujin visited the provincial people's congress, government, CPPCC and military command, urging dutiful work for a strong start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 河南：现代流通体系推动农产品快速融入全国市场
articles.title_en: Henan's Modern Distribution System Brings Agricultural Products to the National Market
articles.summary_zh: 河南依托周口港、万邦物流城及中欧班列等枢纽，构建“公铁水空”立体交通网络下的农产品现代流通体系，打通国内国际双向流通通道，助力全国统一大市场建设。
articles.summary_en: Henan is building a modern agricultural distribution system anchored by Zhoukou Port, the Wanbang logistics market and China-Europe freight trains, opening two-way domestic and international channels for farm products and supporting the unified national market.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明在湘江新区调研
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Inspects Xiangjiang New Area in Hunan
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在湘江新区调研，走访航空航天、人工智能、先进计算等企业和园区，强调推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合，为全省高质量发展作出更大贡献。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming inspected Xiangjiang New Area, visiting aerospace, AI and advanced computing firms and parks, and urged deeper integration of technological and industrial innovation to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省安委会全体（扩大）会议召开 刘小涛出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Work Safety Committee Holds Expanded Meeting; Governor Liu Xiaotao Attends and Addresses It
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日下午，江苏省安委会全体（扩大）会议召开，省长刘小涛出席讲话，部署国庆假期安全防范和下一阶段安全生产重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 28, Jiangsu's Provincial Work Safety Committee held an expanded meeting, where Governor Liu Xiaotao spoke on National Day holiday safety precautions and upcoming work safety priorities.

articles.title_zh: 问道盐湖：中国盐湖产业的改革、技术与环保转型
articles.title_en: Inquiring into the Salt Lake: Reform, Technology and Green Transition in China's Salt Lake Industry
articles.summary_zh: 2025年中国五矿与青海省组建中国盐湖工业集团，盐湖产业从地方国企跨越为央企，在国企改革、技术自主与生态治理上推进世界级盐湖产业基地建设。
articles.summary_en: In 2025 China Minmetals and Qinghai formed China Salt Lake Industry Group, upgrading the sector from a local to a central SOE and pursuing reform, self-reliant technology and green development.

articles.title_zh: 国新办发布会聚焦“十五五”“三农”工作重点
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Briefing Focuses on Agriculture, Rural Areas and Farmers in the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，农业农村部部长张柱等介绍“十五五”时期加快农业农村现代化、扎实推进乡村全面振兴有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On September 29, the State Council Information Office held a briefing at which Minister of Agriculture and Rural Affairs Zhang Zhu presented plans to accelerate agricultural and rural modernization and advance rural revitalization during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《文化遗产保护传承“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee General Office and State Council General Office Issue the 15th Five-Year Plan for Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《文化遗产保护传承“十五五”规划》并发出通知，要求各地区各部门结合实际认真贯彻落实。规划提出到2030年基本形成文化遗产大保护格局。
articles.summary_en: The General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance, asking all regions and departments to implement it in light of local conditions. The plan aims to basically form a broad cultural heritage protection framework by 2030.

tags.name_en: General Office of the CPC Central Committee
General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the CPC Central Committee
General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 老区启新程 红土焕新貌——福建龙岩建设革命老区高质量发展示范区观察
articles.title_en: Old Base Area Sets Off on a New Journey: Longyan of Fujian Builds a Demonstration Zone for High-Quality Development of Former Revolutionary Base Areas
articles.summary_zh: 福建龙岩统筹推进生态文明建设、工业强市、城乡融合与民生保障，建设革命老区高质量发展示范区，综合经济竞争力跻身全国百强。
articles.summary_en: Longyan in Fujian is advancing a demonstration zone for high-quality development of former revolutionary base areas, reporting progress in ecology, industry, urban-rural integration and public services.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Former Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Revitalization of Former Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: “十五五”央企布局优化方向明晰 新兴产业扩能提质
articles.title_en: SASAC Sets Clearer Direction for Central SOE Layout in 15th Five-Year Plan, Emerging Industries to Expand and Upgrade
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国务院国资委在国新办发布会上介绍中央企业“十五五”规划，明确到2030年战略性新兴产业增加值占比再提升5个百分点。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, SASAC briefed a press conference on central SOEs' 15th Five-Year Plan, targeting a 5-point rise in the value-added share of strategic emerging industries by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 没有名字的墓碑——铭记长征路上无名红军烈士
articles.title_en: Nameless Gravestones: Remembering the Unnamed Red Army Martyrs of the Long March
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者走访闽西松毛岭、桂北湘江战役遗址等地，寻访无名红军烈士墓，讲述群众世代守墓与政府修缮保护烈士遗骸的故事。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters visit Songmaoling in Fujian and Xiangjiang battlefield sites in Guangxi, telling of the unmarked graves of unnamed Red Army martyrs and government restoration efforts.

articles.title_zh: 一片试验海，何以成为高端海工装备“摇篮”
articles.title_en: How a Test Sea Became a Cradle for High-End Marine Engineering Equipment
articles.summary_zh: 国家海洋综合试验场（威海）已承接100多项重大试验任务，为50多种海洋仪器设备提供研发测试，助推山东高端海工装备产业发展。
articles.summary_en: The National Marine Comprehensive Test Site in Weihai, Shandong has hosted 100-plus major test missions for over 50 types of marine equipment, boosting high-end marine engineering.

articles.title_zh: 国务院安委办部署下阶段全国烟花爆竹安全监管重点工作
articles.title_en: State Council Work Safety Committee Office Deploys Next-Phase National Fireworks Safety Supervision
articles.summary_zh: 9月29日，国务院安委会办公室在北京召开全国烟花爆竹安全生产工作视频会议，部署旺季安全监管重点工作，要求扎实开展“打非治违”专项行动。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 29, the State Council Work Safety Committee Office held a national video conference on fireworks safety, deploying key supervision tasks for the peak season and calling for a crackdown on illegal production and operation.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔张工到“117项目”片区调研
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er and Zhang Gong Inspect the "117 Project" Area
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工到“117项目”片区调研，并召开市盘活利用“117项目”工作领导小组会议，部署工程建设、产业招商与区域配套工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong inspected the "117 Project" area and chaired a municipal leadership meeting on revitalizing the project, covering construction, investment promotion and regional facilities.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：纵深推进全省安全生产风险隐患排查整治 以高水平安全护航全省经济社会高质量发展
articles.title_en: Liu Jie: Deepen Province-wide Safety Hazard Inspections to Safeguard High-Quality Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日下午，全国安全生产视频会议结束后，浙江省长、省安委会主任刘捷在浙江分会场部署全省安全生产风险隐患排查整治工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 28, Zhejiang Governor Liu Jie deployed province-wide safety hazard inspections and rectification at the Zhejiang sub-venue after a national video meeting on work safety.

articles.title_zh: 中国考虑投票支持哪位联合国秘书长候选人？外交部回应
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds on China's Consideration of UN Secretary-General Candidate Support
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上回应中方在新任联合国秘书长选举中的投票立场，表示中方将以负责任态度参与选举过程。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing that China will take a responsible part in the selection of the next UN Secretary-General in accordance with the UN Charter.

articles.title_zh: 北京汽车集团有限公司原党委书记、董事长徐和谊一审被判死缓
articles.title_en: Former BAIC Group Party Secretary and Chairman Xu Heyi Sentenced to Death with Reprieve in First Instance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日，北京市第三中级人民法院一审宣判，北汽集团原党委书记、董事长徐和谊因受贿、洗钱罪被判死刑缓期二年执行，并处没收个人全部财产。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, 2026, Beijing No. 3 Intermediate People's Court sentenced Xu Heyi, former Party Secretary and Chairman of BAIC Group, to death with a two-year reprieve for bribery and money laundering, with all personal assets confiscated.

tags.name_zh: 北京市第三中级人民法院

tags_zh: 北京市第三中级人民法院

articles.title_zh: 公安部网安局发布拒不履行信息网络安全管理义务典型案例
articles.title_en: MPS Cybersecurity Bureau Releases Typical Cases of Refusing to Fulfill Information Network Security Management Obligations
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，公安部网安局披露江苏盐城卢某斌案、河南三门峡张某东案两起拒不履行信息网络安全管理义务典型案例。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the Cybersecurity Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security disclosed two typical cases of refusing to fulfill information network security management obligations, involving Lu Moubin in Yancheng, Jiangsu, and Zhang Moudong in Sanmenxia, Henan.
keywords: 信息网络安全管理义务

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部针对重庆、陕西启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Activates Level IV National Geological Disaster Emergency Response for Chongqing and Shaanxi
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日，应急管理部针对重庆、陕西启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应，要求强化风险监测、隐患排查和转移避险，做好抢险救援准备。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, 2026, China's Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level IV national geological disaster emergency response for Chongqing and Shaanxi, ordering intensified risk monitoring, hazard inspections and evacuation preparations.

articles.title_zh: 《开闽世家闽台源流志》第三期编纂工作在福州启动
articles.title_en: Compilation of Third Volume of Min-Tai Clan Lineage Records Launched in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，两岸宗亲代表在福州共同启动《开闽世家闽台源流志》第三期编纂工作，该期将在台湾编撰，预计明年5月发行。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, cross-strait clan representatives in Fuzhou jointly launched compilation of the third volume of the Min-Tai Clan Lineage Records, to be compiled in Taiwan and published next May.

articles.title_zh: 长春市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Changchun Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Expanded) and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日，长春市市长顾刚主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，部署农业农村、生态环保、交通保畅、安全稳定等工作，并原则通过长期护理保险制度实施方案。
articles.summary_en: On September 27, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang chaired the municipal government's expanded Party group meeting and executive meeting, arranging work on agriculture, ecological protection, transport and safety, and approving in principle a long-term care insurance plan.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行等8部门发文强化服务业金融支持
articles.title_en: People's Bank of China and Seven Other Departments Issue Guidelines to Boost Financial Support for Services Sector
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月28日，中国人民银行等8部门印发《关于金融支持服务业扩能提质的指导意见》，提出19项举措强化服务业金融支持。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, 2026, the People's Bank of China and seven other departments issued guidelines on financial support for upgrading the services sector, setting out 19 measures.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟会见意大利驻华大使安博思
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Meets Italian Ambassador to China Massimo Ambrosetti
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟在沈阳会见来辽访问并参加辽洽会的意大利驻华大使安博思，双方就深化经贸产业合作与人文交流交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with Italian Ambassador to China Massimo Ambrosetti, who was visiting for the Liaoning International Fair, to discuss deeper trade, industrial and cultural cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟会见蒙古国库苏古尔省代表团一行
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Meets with Delegation from Mongolia's Khuvsgul Province
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，辽宁省省长王新伟在沈阳会见蒙古国库苏古尔省省长图穆尔巴特尔率领的代表团，双方就深化经贸、能源矿产、基础设施及人文等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with a delegation led by Tumerbaatar, Governor of Mongolia's Khuvsgul Province, to discuss cooperation in trade, energy and minerals, infrastructure and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席对美国进行国事访问纪实
articles.title_en: Record of President Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月23日至25日，习近平主席对美国进行国事访问，与特朗普总统会谈并宣布构建基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系。
articles.summary_en: From September 23 to 25, 2026, President Xi Jinping made a state visit to the United States, holding talks with President Trump and announcing the building of a constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_zh: 亢永强到松山区调研经济社会发展和党的建设情况
articles.title_en: Kang Yongqiang Inspects Songshan District on Economic Development and Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，赤峰市委书记亢永强到松山区调研经济社会发展和党的建设情况，走访社区、物流转运中心及多家企业。
articles.summary_en: On September 26, Chifeng Municipal Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang inspected Songshan District, visiting a community, a courier logistics hub and several local enterprises to review economic development and Party building.

articles.title_zh: 今年以来金融市场总体运行平稳 货币政策将加大逆周期调节力度
articles.title_en: PBOC: Financial Markets Stable This Year, Monetary Policy to Step Up Countercyclical Adjustment
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行货币政策委员会2026年第三季度例会指出，今年以来金融市场总体运行平稳，货币政策将加大逆周期调节力度。
articles.summary_en: The PBOC's Monetary Policy Committee said after its Q3 2026 regular meeting that financial markets have been stable this year and monetary policy will step up countercyclical adjustment.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，研究宏观政策发力提效、促进有效投资，听取新污染物治理进展汇报，审议通过《事业单位登记管理条例（草案）》。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to study macro policy effectiveness and investment promotion, review progress on new pollutant control, and approve the draft Regulation on Public Institution Registration and Management.

articles.title_zh: 41金11银4铜 中国创参加世界技能大赛最好成绩
articles.title_en: China Wins 41 Golds at WorldSkills, Its Best-Ever Result
articles.summary_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛9月27日晚在上海闭幕，中国代表团获41金11银4铜及6个优胜奖，第五次位居金牌榜和团体总分世界第一。
articles.summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition closed in Shanghai on the evening of Sept 27, with China's delegation taking 41 gold, 11 silver and 4 bronze medals and ranking first in both gold count and team score for the fifth time.

articles.title_zh: 李强在全国安全生产视频会议上强调抓实抓细安全生产各项工作
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Stresses Solid Safety Measures at National Work Safety Video Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国务院召开全国安全生产视频会议，总理李强强调压实责任、防范遏制重特大事故，张国清主持，王小洪、吴政隆出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the State Council held a national video conference on work safety, where Premier Li Qiang urged tighter accountability and prevention of major accidents. Zhang Guoqing chaired it, with Wang Xiaohong and Wu Zhenglong attending.

articles.title_zh: 推动国资央企实现新发展
articles.title_en: SASAC Promotes New Development of Central State-Owned Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办9月28日举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，国务院国资委介绍落实“十五五”规划、推动中央企业高质量发展情况，截至8月末中央企业资产总额达99.3万亿元。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council Information Office held a briefing on Sept 28 where SASAC outlined plans to implement the 15th Five-Year Plan and boost high-quality development of central SOEs, whose assets reached 99.3 trillion yuan by end-August.

tags.name_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC)

tags_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC)

articles.title_zh: 大国正确相处的新路，就在脚下——习近平主席对美国进行国事访问纪实
articles.title_en: A New Path for Major Powers to Get Along: Chronicle of President Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月23日至25日，习近平主席对美国进行国事访问，同特朗普总统会谈，双方同意构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系”。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 23 to 25, 2026, President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States and held talks with President Trump; the two sides agreed to build a constructive strategic stability relationship.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛在上海圆满闭幕
articles.title_en: 48th WorldSkills Competition Concludes in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛9月27日晚在上海世博文化中心闭幕，中国代表团夺得41金11银4铜，名列金牌榜、奖牌榜和团体总分第一。
articles.summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition closed on the evening of Sept 27 in Shanghai, with China topping the gold, medal and overall standings with 41 golds, 11 silvers and 4 bronzes.

articles.title_zh: 现代综合交通运输体系铺就高质量发展“快车道”
articles.title_en: Modern Integrated Transport System Paves a "Fast Lane" for High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 中国政府网刊文综述交通运输发展：“十四五”成就显著，2026年1至7月全国交通固定资产投资完成1.82万亿元，“十五五”锚定2030年基本建成现代化综合交通运输体系。
articles.summary_en: China's transport sector reports historic 14th Five-Year Plan gains, with fixed-asset investment reaching 1.82 trillion yuan in January-July 2026; the 15th Five-Year Plan targets a modern integrated transport system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式9月30日上午举行 习近平等党和国家领导人将出席
articles.title_en: Martyrs' Day Flower Basket Ceremony Set for Morning of Sept 30; Xi Jinping and Other Party and State Leaders to Attend
articles.summary_zh: 据新华社9月28日报道，9月30日烈士纪念日当天上午，习近平等党和国家领导人将同各界代表在天安门广场向人民英雄敬献花篮。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 28 that on the morning of Sept 30, Martyrs' Day, Xi Jinping and other Party and state leaders will join representatives at Tiananmen Square to lay flower baskets to the people's heroes.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协办公厅、中共中央统战部、国务院侨办、国务院港澳办、国务院台办、中国侨联联合举行国庆招待会 王沪宁致辞
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Addresses National Day Reception Held Jointly by CPPCC and United Front Departments
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，全国政协办公厅、中共中央统战部等六家单位在北京人民大会堂联合举行国庆招待会，庆祝新中国成立77周年，王沪宁出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, six central bodies including the CPPCC General Office held a National Day reception at Beijing's Great Hall of the People for the PRC's 77th anniversary; Wang Huning delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 王沪宁会见全国少数民族参观团
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Meets National Ethnic Minorities Visiting Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁在北京会见全国少数民族参观团，强调铸牢中华民族共同体意识、推进中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Wang Huning, Standing Committee member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, met the national ethnic minorities visiting delegation in Beijing, urging efforts to forge a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation.

articles.title_zh: 大通县聚力打造“青海绿铝·高原铝谷”推动铝产业高端化绿色化转型
articles.title_en: Datong County Builds "Qinghai Green Aluminum · Plateau Aluminum Valley" to Advance High-End, Green Aluminum Industry Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 青海大通县依托绿电优势推进铝产业延链补链强链，打造“青海绿铝·高原铝谷”，推动铝产业高端化、绿色化转型。
articles.summary_en: Datong County in Qinghai is leveraging green electricity to extend the aluminum industry chain and build the "Qinghai Green Aluminum · Plateau Aluminum Valley," advancing a greener, higher-end aluminum sector.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰调研督导“双节”安全保障和文旅服务工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Inspects Holiday Safety and Tourism Service Work in Dandong
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日，丹东市委书记蒋冰调研督导中秋、国庆假期交通保畅、文旅保障、客运服务和安全生产等工作，并看望慰问一线公安干警和干部职工。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 27, Dandong Party Secretary Jiang Bing inspected transport, tourism and workplace safety preparations for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, and visited frontline police and staff.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱调研督导县乡人大换届选举选民登记工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects Voter Registration for County and Township People's Congress Elections
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，市委书记王兴柱赴南山区、宝泉岭、向阳区等地社区调研督导县乡人大换届选举选民登记工作，要求应登尽登、不漏不错不重。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Municipal Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu visited communities in Nanshan, Baoquanling and Xiangyang districts to inspect voter registration for county and township people's congress elections, urging full, accurate registration.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协办公厅等六部门联合举行国庆招待会 王沪宁致辞
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Addresses National Day Reception Held by CPPCC General Office and Five Other Departments
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，全国政协办公厅、中共中央统战部等六部门在北京人民大会堂联合举行国庆招待会，庆祝新中国成立77周年，王沪宁出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the CPPCC General Office and five other departments held a National Day reception at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing marking the PRC's 77th anniversary; Wang Huning attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁在甘丹寺调研强调提升宗教工作法治化水平
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Inspects Ganden Monastery, Stresses Raising Rule-of-Law Standards in Religious Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，西藏自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁深入甘丹寺调研，强调坚持我国宗教中国化方向，依法加强宗教事务管理，提升宗教工作法治化水平。
articles.summary_en: On September 25, Dawa Tsering, member of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Standing Committee and Lhasa Party Secretary, inspected Ganden Monastery, urging law-based management of religious affairs and the Sinicization of religion.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开拉萨市委常委会（扩大）会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting on Implementing Xi Jinping's Guidelines
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，安排部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Dawa Tsering, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Standing Committee member and Lhasa Party Secretary, chaired an expanded meeting of the Lhasa Municipal Party Standing Committee to convey Xi Jinping's key speeches and instructions and arrange implementation work.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升在日喀则市调研：坚守为民初心 强化使命担当
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Shigatse, Vowing to Meet People's Aspirations for a Better Life
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日至27日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在日喀则市吉隆、聂拉木、定日等县区调研，强调建强基层党组织、推进乡村振兴和民生保障。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 24 to 27, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected several counties in Shigatse, urging stronger grassroots Party organizations, rural revitalization and better public services.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升:坚守为民初心强化使命担当不断满足人民群众对美好生活的向往
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Shigatse, Urges Meeting People's Aspirations for a Better Life
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日至27日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在日喀则市调研，强调加强基层党建、保障民生、推进乡村振兴与对外开放。
articles.summary_en: From Sept. 24 to 27, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected Shigatse, urging stronger grassroots Party building, livelihood support, rural revitalization and opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要论述指引平安中国建设砥砺前行
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Important Expositions Guide the Building of a Higher-Level Safe China
articles.summary_zh: 综述党的十八大以来，在习近平总书记重要论述指引下，平安中国建设在国家安全、基层社会治理、扫黑除恶等领域持续推进并取得成效。
articles.summary_en: A review of China's progress in building a higher-level Safe China under Xi Jinping's guidance since the 18th Party Congress, covering national security, grassroots governance and anti-crime work.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市八届人大八次会议召开 范德繁当选市长
articles.title_en: Fan Defan Elected Mayor of Shanwei at 8th Session of Municipal People's Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，汕尾市第八届人民代表大会第八次会议在马思聪艺术中心召开，选举范德繁为汕尾市人民政府市长，市委书记、市人大常委会主任逯峰主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the eighth session of the 8th Shanwei Municipal People's Congress was held at the Mascagni Arts Center, electing Fan Defan as Mayor of Shanwei. Municipal Party Secretary and NPC Standing Committee Director Lu Feng presided over the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市八届人大八次会议召开 范德繁当选市长
articles.title_en: Fan Defan Elected Mayor of Shanwei at Municipal People's Congress Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，汕尾市第八届人民代表大会第八次会议在马思聪艺术中心召开，范德繁当选汕尾市人民政府市长并进行宪法宣誓，市委书记逯峰主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the 8th session of the 8th Shanwei Municipal People's Congress was held at the Ma Sicong Art Center, where Fan Defan was elected mayor of the Shanwei Municipal People's Government and took the constitutional oath. Municipal Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired the meeting and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞与列席人大常委会会议的自治区人大代表座谈
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Meets with Ningxia People's Congress Deputies Attending Standing Committee Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记、人大常委会主任李邑飞与列席自治区人大常委会会议的人大代表座谈，强调履行好代表职责、发挥好代表作用，并对各级人大支持保障代表履职提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of Ningxia and Director of the Regional People's Congress Standing Committee, met with regional people's congress deputies attending the committee session, urging them to fulfill their duties and calling on people's congresses at all levels to support deputies' work.

articles.title_zh: 李强在全国安全生产视频会议上强调 抓实抓细安全生产各项工作 坚决防范遏制重特大事故发生
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Stresses Solid Safety Work at National Video Conference on Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国务院召开全国安全生产视频会议，李强出席并讲话，要求压紧压实责任、严格监管执法，坚决防范遏制重特大事故发生。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the State Council held a national video conference on workplace safety, at which Premier Li Qiang urged tighter accountability and stricter supervision to resolutely prevent major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 自治区十三届人大常委会第二十七次会议闭幕 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Chairs Closing of 27th Session of 13th Ningxia Regional People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，宁夏回族自治区十三届人大常委会第二十七次会议在银川闭幕，自治区党委书记、人大常委会主任李邑飞主持会议并讲话。会议表决通过多部地方性法规、代表资格审查报告及人事任免议案。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the 27th session of the 13th Ningxia People's Congress Standing Committee closed in Yinchuan, chaired by regional Party secretary and committee director Li Yifei, who also delivered remarks. The session passed several local regulations, a delegate qualification report and personnel appointment motions.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 研究宏观政策发力提效、促进有效投资有关工作等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Strengthening Macro Policy and Boosting Effective Investment
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，研究宏观政策发力提效、促进有效投资有关工作，听取新污染物治理进展汇报，并审议通过《事业单位登记管理条例（草案）》。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing to study stronger macro policy and effective investment, hear a report on new pollutant control, and approve draft regulations on public institution registration.

articles.title_zh: 黄强到中共长春支部纪念馆调研
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Inspects CPC Changchun Branch Memorial Hall
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，吉林省委书记黄强到中共长春支部纪念馆调研，参观“火种·1926”专题展，强调发掘好研究好宣传好吉林革命历史。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, Jilin Provincial Party Secretary Huang Qiang inspected the Memorial Hall of the CPC Changchun Branch, viewing an exhibition on its 100th anniversary and calling for better preservation and promotion of Jilin's revolutionary history.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党芜湖市第十二次代表大会隆重开幕
articles.title_en: 12th CPC Wuhu Municipal Congress Opens; Xu Zhi Delivers Report on Behalf of 11th Municipal Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日，中国共产党芜湖市第十二次代表大会在芜湖市政务文化中心开幕，徐志代表十一届市委作报告，陈东主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 27, the 12th CPC Wuhu Municipal Congress opened at the Wuhu Government Affairs and Culture Center, where Xu Zhi delivered a report on behalf of the 11th Municipal Committee and Chen Dong presided over the session.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就建设更高水平平安中国作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Building a Higher-Level Peaceful China
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，平安中国建设工作会议在京召开，会上传达习近平重要指示，强调坚定不移贯彻总体国家安全观，以更高水平平安中国建设保障中国式现代化行稳致远。
articles.summary_en: On September 28, the Work Conference on Building a Peaceful China was held in Beijing, conveying Xi Jinping's important instructions to uphold the holistic approach to national security and safeguard Chinese modernization with a higher-level Peaceful China.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平督导检查安全稳定、市场保供工作
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Inspects Safety, Stability and Market Supply Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，新乡市委书记魏建平深入凤泉区、牧野区、卫滨区督导检查安全稳定、市场保供等工作，看望慰问一线公安干警和消防救援队伍。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping inspected safety, stability and market supply work in Fengquan, Muye and Weibin districts, and visited frontline police and firefighters.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组举行集体学习 深入践行习近平法治思想 加快建设更高水平法治新乡
articles.title_en: Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee Study Group Holds Collective Session on Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，新乡市委理论学习中心组举行集体学习，深入学习《习近平法治文选》第一卷，市委书记魏建平主持并讲话，市长陈维忠出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee's theoretical study group held a collective study session on Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law; Party Secretary Wei Jianping presided and spoke, Mayor Chen Weizhong attended.

articles.title_zh: 许昌市交通运输局局长张军旺暗访督导安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Xuchang Transport Bureau Chief Zhang Junwang Conducts Unannounced Safety Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日中秋假期首日，许昌市交通运输局党组书记、局长张军旺带队以“四不两直”方式暗访客运企业、火车站公交接驳场站和客运东站，督导假期道路运输安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 25, the first day of the Mid-Autumn holiday, Zhang Junwang, head of the Xuchang Municipal Transport Bureau, led unannounced inspections of bus operators, the railway station transit hub and the East Coach Station to oversee holiday transport safety work.

articles.title_zh: 建安区区长刘建伟调研督导“双节”期间安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Jian'an District Head Liu Jianwei Inspects Workplace Safety Ahead of Mid-Autumn and National Day Holidays
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，许昌市建安区区长刘建伟带队调研督导中秋、国庆“双节”期间安全生产工作，检查商超、医药化工企业和区社会福利中心，要求压实责任、排查隐患。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 25, Jian'an District head Liu Jianwei inspected workplace safety in Xuchang ahead of the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, visiting a shopping mall, pharmaceutical and optical firms and a welfare center, urging tighter risk checks.

articles.title_zh: 张雨浦：从严从实抓好治本攻坚 有力有效提升安全水平
articles.title_en: Zhang Yupu Urges Rigorous Implementation of Root-Cause Safety Campaign to Raise Safety Standards
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，全国安全生产视频会议后，宁夏自治区主席张雨浦主持召开全区安全生产视频会议暨自治区安委会2026年第八次全体会议，部署治本攻坚三年行动收官及重点行业领域安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu chaired a regional video conference and the 2026 eighth plenary meeting of the regional work safety committee, urging completion of the three-year root-cause safety campaign and tighter risk control in key industries.

articles.title_zh: 银川市委常委会召开会议 部署发展先进制造业、经济运行和“双节”期间安全生产等工作 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Advanced Manufacturing, Economic Work and Holiday Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，银川市委常委会召开会议，部署发展先进制造业、经济运行及“双节”期间安全生产等工作，市委书记赵旭辉主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to deploy advanced manufacturing development, economic work and holiday safety measures. Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui presided.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议 部署全面从严治党与国庆前后安全发展稳定工作
articles.title_en: Ningxia Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Full and Strict Party Governance and Holiday Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月28日，宁夏自治区党委常委会召开会议，李邑飞主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示，部署全面从严治党和国庆前后经济发展、安全生产、社会稳定工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 28, the Standing Committee of the Ningxia Party Committee met, chaired by Li Yifei, to convey Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions and to arrange economic, safety and social stability work around the National Day holiday.

articles.title_zh: 银川市集中整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题工作领导小组会召开 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Leading Group Meets on Rectifying Misconduct and Corruption Around the People; Zhao Xuhui Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 近日，银川市集中整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题工作领导小组会议召开，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，要求聚焦高标准农田建设、农村集体“三资”管理等民生领域推动整治见效。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan held a meeting of its leading group on rectifying misconduct and corruption around the people.
