articles.title_zh: 韩正出席第81届联合国大会一般性辩论并发表讲话
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Attends General Debate of 81st UN General Assembly and Delivers a Speech
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月26日，国家副主席韩正在纽约联合国总部出席第81届联合国大会一般性辩论并发表讲话，就维护国际秩序、促进共同发展等提出四点建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 26, 2026, Vice President Han Zheng attended the general debate of the 81st UN General Assembly at UN Headquarters in New York and delivered a speech setting out four proposals on safeguarding international order and promoting common development.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

articles.title_zh: 西康高铁遇上国庆！安康双重惠民福利来了
articles.title_en: Ankang Rolls Out Dual Public-Benefit Campaigns as Xikang High-Speed Rail Meets National Day Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 安康市政府推出西康高铁票根促消费活动（9月28日至12月31日），并于10月1日至7日通过支付宝、美团发放惠民消费券。
articles.summary_en: Ankang's municipal government launched a ticket-stub spending promotion for the Xikang high-speed rail from Sept 28 to Dec 31, and will issue public consumption vouchers via Alipay and Meituan from Oct 1 to 7.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚检查节日期间安全生产、城市运行及文旅发展工作
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Inspects Holiday Safety Production, Urban Operations and Cultural Tourism Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，长春市市长顾刚实地检查燃气安全、校园安全及文旅运营工作，部署节日期间安全防范、服务保障与提振消费等任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 26, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang inspected gas safety, campus safety and cultural tourism operations, urging stronger holiday safety measures and efforts to boost consumption.

articles.title_zh: 第五届全球数字贸易博览会在杭州闭幕
articles.title_en: Fifth Global Digital Trade Expo Closes in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日，第五届全球数字贸易博览会在浙江杭州闭幕，2008家企业线下参展，超5万名专业客商到会采购，较上届增长20%。
articles.summary_en: The Fifth Global Digital Trade Expo closed in Hangzhou, Zhejiang on Sept 27, with 2,008 offline exhibitors and over 50,000 professional buyers, up 20 percent from the previous edition.

articles.title_zh: 中秋假期交通出行需求保持高位 短途出行活跃
articles.title_en: Transport Demand Stays High During Mid-Autumn Holiday as Short-Distance Travel Booms
articles.summary_zh: 为期三天的中秋假期于9月27日结束，交通运输部数据显示，假期全社会跨区域人员流动量预计超6.5亿人次，全国铁路返程客流高峰预计发送旅客1686万人次。
articles.summary_en: China's three-day Mid-Autumn Festival holiday ended on Sept 27, with cross-regional trips expected to top 650 million, the Ministry of Transport said, as railways handled a return-trip peak.

articles.title_zh: 具有里程碑意义的历史性访问——国际社会高度评价习近平主席美国之行
articles.title_en: A Landmark Historic Visit: International Community Praises Xi Jinping's Trip to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日至25日，国家主席习近平应邀对美国进行国事访问，两国元首就构建中美建设性战略稳定关系及重大国际地区问题深入交换意见并达成一系列新共识，多国人士高度评价此访。
articles.summary_en: From September 23 to 25, President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States, where the two heads of state held in-depth talks on building a constructive strategic stability relationship and major international issues, reaching a series of new consensus that drew wide international praise.

articles.title_zh: 美国各界高度评价习近平主席历史性访问
articles.title_en: U.S. Figures Hail Xi Jinping's Historic State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 习近平9月26日结束对美国的国事访问回到北京，访美期间与特朗普总统就中美建设性战略稳定关系达成八点成果共识，美国各界高度评价此访。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping returned to Beijing on Sept. 26 after a state visit to the United States, during which he and President Trump reached an eight-point consensus on a constructive strategic stability relationship. Americans widely praised the visit.

articles.title_zh: 厚植中国式现代化的平安底色——习近平总书记重要论述指引平安中国建设砥砺前行谱写新篇
articles.title_en: Laying the Peaceful Foundation of Chinese Modernization: Xi Jinping's Key Expositions Guide Peaceful China Building to New Heights
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月27日播发长篇报道，系统梳理党的十八大以来习近平总书记关于建设更高水平平安中国的重要论述，展现国家安全、社会治理、扫黑除恶等领域成效。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a lengthy report on Sept 27 reviewing Xi Jinping's expositions since the 18th CPC National Congress on building a higher-level Peaceful China, highlighting progress in national security, social governance and crime crackdowns.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席向全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会致贺信引发热烈反响
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter to High-Level Dialogue on 5th Anniversary of Global Development Initiative Draws Warm Response
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，全球发展倡议5周年高级别对话会在纽约联合国总部举行，国家主席习近平致贺信，与会各国代表及国际人士高度评价倡议5年来成果。
articles.summary_en: On September 25, the High-Level Dialogue on the 5th Anniversary of the Global Development Initiative was held at UN Headquarters in New York, where President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter that drew wide praise from international participants.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席对美国进行国事访问引领中美建设性战略稳定关系取得新发展
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's State Visit to the US Advances China-US Constructive Strategic Stability Relationship
articles.summary_zh: 9月，习近平主席时隔11年再次对美国进行国事访问并同特朗普总统会晤，双方同意构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系”。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping made his first state visit to the US in 11 years in September, meeting President Trump; both agreed to build a constructive strategic stability relationship on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_zh: 习近平结束对美国的国事访问回到北京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing After Concluding State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日下午，国家主席习近平圆满结束对美国的国事访问回到北京，彭丽媛、蔡奇、王毅、何立峰等陪同人员同机返回。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 26, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after successfully concluding his state visit to the United States, accompanied by Peng Liyuan, Cai Qi, Wang Yi, He Lifeng and other officials on the same flight.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党淮北市第十次代表大会开幕 蒋曦代表第九届市委作报告
articles.title_en: 10th CPC Huaibei City Congress Opens; Jiang Xi Delivers Report on Behalf of 9th Municipal Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日上午，中国共产党淮北市第十次代表大会在淮北矿业会议中心开幕，蒋曦代表第九届市委作工作报告，黄韡主持大会，381名代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 27, the 10th Congress of the CPC Huaibei Municipal Committee opened at the Huaibei Mining Convention Center, where Jiang Xi delivered the work report for the 9th municipal committee; Huang Wei presided and 381 delegates attended.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党淮北市第十次代表大会隆重开幕
articles.title_en: 10th CPC Huaibei City Congress Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日上午，中国共产党淮北市第十次代表大会在淮北矿业会议中心开幕，蒋曦代表第九届市委向大会作报告。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 27, the 10th Congress of the CPC Huaibei City Committee opened at the Huaibei Mining Conference Center, with Jiang Xi delivering a report on behalf of the 9th city committee.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖赴步步高天地怀化店调研消费情况
articles.title_en: Wei Chaohui Inspects Consumption at Bubugao Tiandi Huaihua Store
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日上午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖赴9月24日开业的步步高天地怀化店调研消费情况，强调丰富消费业态和场景、推动消费提质升级。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 26, Huaihua Party Secretary Wei Chaohui inspected the Bubugao Tiandi Huaihua store, which opened Sept 24, urging richer consumption formats and upgraded consumption.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新到佛山（云浮）产业转移工业园调研 推动佛云对口帮扶协作再出新成果
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Inspects Foshan (Yunfu) Industrial Transfer Park to Advance Paired Assistance Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，云浮市市长李庆新到佛山（云浮）产业转移工业园调研，走访园区企业、察看项目建设，并看望慰问佛山派驻帮扶干部，推动佛云对口帮扶协作深化。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Yunfu Mayor Li Qingxin inspected the Foshan (Yunfu) Industrial Transfer Park, visiting firms and construction sites and meeting Foshan-assigned aid officials to deepen paired assistance cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市安全防范工作调度会召开 徐晓霞出席会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Yunfu Holds Safety Prevention Work Coordination Meeting; Xu Xiaoxia Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日下午，云浮市召开安全防范工作调度会，市委书记徐晓霞出席并讲话，市长李庆新主持，研究部署中秋、国庆假期前后全市安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 24, Yunfu City held a safety prevention work coordination meeting, where Party Secretary Xu Xiaoxia spoke and Mayor Li Qingxin presided, to arrange work safety measures around the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明调研督导国庆假期保供和城市运行安全
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Inspects Holiday Supply and Urban Operation Safety
articles.summary_zh: 10月1日国庆假期第一天，湖南省委书记沈晓明在长沙调研督导节日市场保供和城市运行安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On October 1, the first day of the National Day holiday, Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming inspected holiday market supply and urban operation safety in Changsha.

articles.title_zh: 习主席的华盛顿时间：书写中美关系历史新篇
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Time in Washington: Writing a New Chapter in China-US Relations
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月23日下午，国家主席习近平应美国总统特朗普邀请抵达华盛顿，对美国进行国事访问，双方同意构建基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 23 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington at the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump for a state visit, during which the two sides agreed to build a constructive China-US strategic relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_zh: 共同构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系”
articles.title_en: Jointly Building a Constructive Strategic Stability Relationship Based on Respect, Fairness and Reciprocity
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日至25日，习近平应特朗普邀请对美国进行国事访问，两国元首深入交流，同意共同构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系”。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States on Sept 23-25 at President Trump's invitation; the two leaders agreed to jointly build a constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_zh: 习近平宣布未来5年邀请10万名美国青少年来华，为中美友好合作厚植民意基础
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Announces Invitation for 100,000 American Youth to Visit China Over Next Five Years, Deepening Public Support for China-US Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 对美国进行国事访问期间，习近平在特朗普举行的欢迎宴会上提及中美民间治沙友谊故事，并宣布未来5年邀请10万名美国青少年来华等人文交流新举措。
articles.summary_en: During his state visit to the United States, Xi Jinping recalled a China-US friendship story at a welcome banquet hosted by Donald Trump and announced new people-to-people measures, including inviting 100,000 American youth to China over the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 中美元首历史性会晤，多国专家点赞访美成果
articles.title_en: Historic China-US Summit: Experts Praise Outcomes of Xi's State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平圆满结束对美国的国事访问，两国元首同意共同构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系”，多国专家积极评价此访成果。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping concluded his state visit to the United States, where the two heads of state agreed to build a constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity, drawing praise from experts.

articles.title_zh: 中美成果共识丰富双边关系内涵 提振国际社会信心
articles.title_en: China-US Consensus Enriches Bilateral Ties, Boosts International Confidence
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月23日至25日，国家主席习近平对美国进行国事访问，两国元首就中美建设性战略稳定关系及重大国际地区问题深入交换意见，达成重要成果共识。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23-25, President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States, where the two heads of state exchanged views on a constructive strategic stability relationship and reached important consensus.

articles.title_zh: 习近平宣布未来5年邀请10万名美国青少年来华交流学习
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Announces Invitation to 100,000 American Youth to Study in China
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日，正在对美国进行国事访问的习近平主席在白宫欢迎仪式上宣布，未来5年中方将邀请10万名美国青少年来华交流学习。
articles.summary_en: During his state visit to the United States, President Xi Jinping announced at a White House welcome ceremony that China will invite 100,000 American youth to study and exchange in China over the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 国际人士高度评价习近平主席对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: International Figures Praise Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席对美国进行国事访问，两国元首同意共同构建“基于尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系”，国际人士高度评价此访意义重大。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States drew wide praise from international figures after the two heads of state agreed to build a constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_zh: “鼓岭之友”召集人穆言灵：期待中美青年继续友好交流、促进理解
articles.title_en: Guling Friends Convener Mu Yanling Hopes Chinese and US Youth Will Continue Friendly Exchanges to Boost Mutual Understanding
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月26日，美国“鼓岭之友”召集人穆言灵表示，中美元首会晤是历史性时刻，期待两国青年继续友好交流，并欢迎新一对大熊猫落户亚特兰大。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 26, 2026, Mu Yanling, convener of the Guling Friends in the United States, said the China-US leaders' meeting was a historic moment and voiced hope for continued friendly exchanges between young people of the two countries.

articles.title_zh: 中国工程建设标准化协会：请相关企业把违规制发的铜牌寄过来，邮费到付
articles.title_en: China Association for Engineering Construction Standardization Asks Firms to Return Illegally Issued Bronze Plaques
articles.summary_zh: 中国工程建设标准化协会声明从未授权任何单位或个人开展创建示范、评比达标表彰活动，要求收到违规制发“工程建设安全生产标准化示范项目”铜牌的企业将铜牌收缴寄回，邮费由协会承担。
articles.summary_en: The China Association for Engineering Construction Standardization said it never authorized any demonstration or award-rating activities, and asked firms that received illegally issued bronze plaques to mail them back at the association's expense.

articles.title_zh: 89年前《红军二万五千里西引记》"炸响"上海滩
articles.title_en: 89 Years Ago, "The Red Army's 25,000-Li Westward Trek" Caused a Sensation in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 1937年7月5日，上海文史半月刊《逸经》刊登署名"幽谷"的《红军二万五千里西引记》，首次在国民党统治区公开介绍红军长征完整历程。
articles.summary_en: On July 5, 1937, Shanghai's literary-historical magazine Yijing published the first open account of the Red Army's Long March in Nationalist-ruled China.

articles.title_zh: 荆门市委书记陈家伟假期暗访伪新能源加注站整治工作
articles.title_en: Jingmen Party Secretary Chen Jiawei Makes Unannounced Holiday Inspection of Fake New-Energy Fuel Station Cleanup
articles.summary_zh: 国庆假期期间，荆门市委书记陈家伟赴钟祥市胡集镇暗访已取缔伪新能源加注站原址，要求逐站复核、严防死灰复燃。
articles.summary_en: During the National Day holiday, Jingmen Party Secretary Chen Jiawei made an unannounced visit to Huji Town in Zhongxiang to inspect shuttered fake new-energy fuel stations, demanding station-by-station reviews to prevent their revival.

articles.title_zh: 全国铁路迎来中秋假期返程客流高峰：9月27日预计发送旅客1686万人次
articles.title_en: China's Railways Hit Mid-Autumn Holiday Return-Travel Peak: 16.86 Million Passengers Expected on September 27
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日，全国铁路迎来中秋假期返程客流高峰，预计发送旅客1686万人次，计划加开旅客列车1398列。
articles.summary_en: On September 27, 2026, China's railway network entered its Mid-Autumn holiday return-travel peak, expecting 16.86 million passengers, with 1,398 additional trains scheduled.

articles.title_zh: 国务院安委办、应急管理部调度抽查5省市中秋假期安全防范暗访检查工作
articles.title_en: State Council Work Safety Committee Office and MEM Review Holiday Safety Spot Checks in Five Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，国务院安委办副主任、应急管理部副部长宋元明视频抽查北京、辽宁、山东、四川、陕西5省市中秋假期安全防范暗访检查工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 26, Song Yuanming, deputy head of the State Council Work Safety Committee Office and vice minister of emergency management, video-inspected unannounced holiday safety checks in Beijing, Liaoning, Shandong, Sichuan and Shaanxi.

articles.title_zh: 全国首个量子技术赋能政务移动端规模化应用成果「量子＋皖政通」正式发布
articles.title_en: China's First Large-Scale Quantum-Enabled Government Mobile Application 'Quantum + Wan Zhengtong' Released
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省数据资源局发布全国首个量子技术赋能政务移动端规模化应用成果「量子＋皖政通」，将量子安全能力融入全省统一政务办公平台，覆盖移动政务全业务场景。
articles.summary_en: Anhui's Provincial Data Resources Bureau released 'Quantum + Wan Zhengtong,' China's first large-scale quantum-secured government mobile application, embedding quantum encryption across the province's unified official office platform.

articles.title_zh: 做好“海”的文章 挖掘“游”的潜力（活力中国调研行）
articles.title_en: Fujian Deepens Marine-Tourism Integration to Turn Its Coastline into a Growth Engine
articles.summary_zh: 福建推动海洋文旅深度融合，把海洋生态优势转化为文旅消费新活力，今年以来促成117个重点文旅项目达成合作意向，总投资额832.26亿元。
articles.summary_en: Fujian is deepening marine-tourism integration to turn coastal resources into consumer spending power, with 117 key cultural tourism projects attracting 83.2 billion yuan in intended investment this year.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省出台首批高标准农田建设地方标准
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues First Local Standards for High-Standard Farmland Construction
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省农业农村厅9月24日发布三项高标准农田建设地方标准，系甘肃首批，填补该领域地方标准体系空白，并将于12月24日起实施。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Province released its first three local standards for high-standard farmland construction on Sept 24, filling a gap in the provincial standards system; they take effect on Dec 24.

tags_en: Gansu Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 黑河（步行）口岸对外开放通过国家验收
articles.title_en: Heihe (Pedestrian) Port Passes National Acceptance for Opening to Foreign Traffic
articles.summary_zh: 国家口岸管理办公室、外交部、海关总署、国家移民管理局、军委联合参谋部等单位组成验收组，对黑河（步行）口岸对外开放准备工作实地查验并封闭评审，正式同意其通过国家验收。
articles.summary_en: A joint inspection team from China's national port authorities, foreign ministry, customs, immigration and military bodies carried out on-site checks and a closed-door review in Heihe, Heilongjiang, and formally approved the Heihe (pedestrian) port for opening to foreign traffic.

articles.title_zh: 江苏“双节”高速充电保障升级 部署移动充电终端60余个
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Upgrades Holiday Highway EV Charging, Deploys Over 60 Mobile Charging Units
articles.summary_zh: 国网江苏电力将中秋国庆高速充电保障周期延长至16天（9月24日至10月9日），在京沪、沈海等30个繁忙服务区部署移动充电终端60余个并新增300余个充电枪。
articles.summary_en: State Grid Jiangsu extended its holiday highway EV charging support to 16 days, from Sept 24 to Oct 9, deploying over 60 mobile charging units and 300-plus new charging guns at 30 busy service areas.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏启动第九个五年法治宣传教育
articles.title_en: Ningxia Launches Ninth Five-Year Legal Publicity and Education Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏回族自治区党委、政府印发实施意见，明确2026年至2030年在全区开展第九个五年法治宣传教育，部署七大专项行动。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Ningxia Regional Committee and the regional government issued an implementation guideline to carry out the ninth five-year legal publicity and education campaign across the region from 2026 to 2030, with seven special action programs.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对美国进行国事访问 拓展中美建设性战略稳定关系内涵
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's State Visit to the U.S. Expands China-U.S. Constructive Strategic Stability Relationship
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月23日至25日，习近平主席对美国进行国事访问，同特朗普总统会谈，双方同意构建基于尊重、公平、对等的中美建设性战略稳定关系。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 23 to 25, 2026, Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the U.S. and met President Trump; the two sides agreed to build a China-U.S. constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect, fairness and reciprocity.

articles.title_zh: 2026年青海省“诚信兴商宣传月”正式启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Qinghai "Integrity in Business" Promotion Month Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，2026年青海省“诚信兴商宣传月”启动仪式在西宁市举办，由省商务厅牵头、14家省直及中直驻青单位共同主办，近百家企业和200名代表参加。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Qinghai launched its 2026 "Integrity in Business" Promotion Month in Xining, led by the provincial Commerce Department and co-hosted by 14 other units, with nearly 100 firms attending.

articles.title_zh: 促消费“上新”不断 揽新客“破圈”不停
articles.title_en: Sichuan Consumer Market Gains New Vitality as First Stores, New Cars and Fresh Spending Scenes Multiply
articles.summary_zh: 中秋假期前后，四川成都多个商圈集中亮相首店首展，新车密集上市，小瓶酒、异宠消费等新场景兴起，叠加促消费政策，市场提前升温。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the Mid-Autumn Festival, Sichuan's consumer market warmed up as Chengdu shopping districts rolled out first stores and exhibitions, carmakers launched new models, and small-bottle liquor and exotic-pet spending grew.

articles.title_zh: 山东出台意见大力发展智慧农业
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues Guidelines to Boost Smart Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 山东省政府办公厅印发《关于大力发展智慧农业的实施意见》，提出实施“人工智能+农业”行动，到2030年农业生产信息化率达60%以上。
articles.summary_en: Shandong Provincial Government General Office issued guidelines on developing smart agriculture, launching an "AI plus agriculture" initiative targeting over 60 percent informatization in agricultural production by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 我国启动研制商业航天育种专用卫星
articles.title_en: China Launches Development of First Dedicated Commercial Space Breeding Satellite
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，陕西省航天育种工程技术研究中心与中科卫星科技集团在西安签署合作协议，共建太空生物空间诱变联合实验室，并启动我国首个商业航天育种专用卫星研制。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, the Shaanxi Aerospace Breeding Engineering Technology Research Center and Zhongke Satellite Technology Group signed a cooperation agreement in Xi'an to build a joint space biological mutation laboratory and launch China's first dedicated commercial space breeding satellite.

articles.title_zh: 西安发布城市更新片区存量资产盘活蓝皮书
articles.title_en: Xi'an Releases Blue Book on Revitalizing Idle Assets in Urban Renewal Areas
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，西安市发布《城市更新片区存量资产盘活蓝皮书（2026—2028年）》，梳理57个城市更新片区108处存量资产资源，总面积53万平方米，预估价值45亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Xi'an released a blue book on revitalizing idle assets in urban renewal areas, covering 108 sites across 57 areas, totaling 530,000 square meters and valued at 4.5 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 绍兴发布城市机会清单
articles.title_en: Shaoxing Releases City Opportunity List
articles.summary_zh: 2026绍兴人才周在绍兴启动，绍兴市面向企业和人才发布“5+N”城市机会清单，并推出人工智能人才支持行动和产教融合机制。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Shaoxing Talent Week opened in Shaoxing, where the city released a "5+N" city opportunity list along with an AI talent support initiative and a school-enterprise integration mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 浙江义乌下好人工智能产业“先手棋”
articles.title_en: Yiwu in Zhejiang Takes the Lead in Building Its AI Industry
articles.summary_zh: 据义乌市经信局消息，义乌人工智能核心产业规上工业企业达15家，2025年产值同比增长152.2%，当地通过要素保障、政策扶持和精准招商布局AI产业生态。
articles.summary_en: Yiwu's 15 core AI industrial firms saw output jump 152.2% year-on-year in 2025, as the city builds an AI ecosystem through land supply, policy support and targeted investment promotion.

articles.title_zh: 系统谋划夯实金融强国根基
articles.title_en: Systematic Planning to Consolidate the Foundations of a Financial Power
articles.summary_zh: 《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》近期出台，对未来5年金融改革发展作出系统谋划，明确服务实体经济、防范金融风险、深化改革开放等任务。
articles.summary_en: China has released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Power, setting out a systematic roadmap for financial reform and development over the next five years, centered on serving the real economy, guarding against financial risks and deepening reform and opening up.

articles.title_zh: 陈新武赴赛力斯集团调研
articles.title_en: Chen Xinwu Visits Seres Group for Research
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市委副书记、市长陈新武赴赛力斯集团调研，强调聚焦智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，政企协同推动企业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Chen Xinwu, Deputy Secretary of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee and Mayor of Chongqing, visited Seres Group, urging government-enterprise coordination to advance the company's high-quality development in smart, green and integrated manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席访美难忘瞬间意义深远
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's State Visit to the US: Unforgettable Moments of Historic Significance
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日至25日，应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平对美国进行国事访问，两国元首同意进一步丰富中美关系定位内涵，构建基于尊重、公平、对等的建设性战略稳定关系。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 23-25, President Xi Jinping made a state visit to the US at President Trump's invitation; the two leaders agreed to enrich the bilateral relationship and build a constructive strategic stability relationship based on respect and fairness.

articles.title_zh: 第一观察丨感悟中美人民友好深沉持久的力量
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends White House State Banquet, Hailing the Deep and Enduring Strength of China-US People-to-People Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日晚，习近平和夫人彭丽媛出席特朗普夫妇在白宫举行的欢迎国宴，习近平在祝酒辞中强调中美两国人民友好事业前景广阔。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 24 local time, Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan attended a White House state banquet hosted by Donald and Melania Trump, where Xi stressed the enduring strength and broad prospects of China-US people-to-people friendship.

articles.title_zh: 白洋淀畔建设创新高地——雄安新区标志性未来产业成长记
articles.title_en: Building an Innovation Hub by Baiyangdian: Xiong'an New Area's Landmark Future Industries Take Root
articles.summary_zh: 雄安新区率先培育空天信息、人工智能、新材料三大标志性未来产业，已汇聚近70家空天信息企业、110余家人工智能生态企业和680多家高新技术企业。
articles.summary_en: Xiong'an New Area is cultivating three landmark future industries — aerospace information, artificial intelligence and new materials — now home to nearly 70 aerospace firms, over 110 AI companies and more than 680 high-tech enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 中国蝉联世界技能大赛金牌榜榜首
articles.title_en: China Tops WorldSkills Competition Gold Medal Table for Fifth Consecutive Time
articles.summary_zh: 9月27日晚，第48届世界技能大赛在上海闭幕，中国代表团登顶金牌榜，连续5届位居榜首。
articles.summary_en: China topped the gold medal table at the 48th WorldSkills Competition, which closed in Shanghai on the evening of Sept 27, marking its fifth consecutive first-place finish.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：关于人工智能表述问题，中方重视美方立场也尊重美方提法
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Values US Position and Respects Its Wording on AI
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，中国外交部发言人在北京就人工智能表述问题答记者问，表示中方重视美方立场，也尊重美方提法，并称中美元首会晤曾就人工智能深入讨论。
articles.summary_en: On September 26, a Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson in Beijing said China values the U.S. position and respects its wording on AI terminology, noting the two presidents discussed AI in depth at their summit.

articles.title_zh: 厦金大桥关键工程刘五店悬索桥合龙
articles.title_en: Key Section of Xiamen-Jinmen Bridge Completes Closure
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，厦金大桥（厦门段）关键控制性工程刘五店悬索桥顺利合龙，桥面结构实现贯通，为海上主线通车创造条件。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the Liuwudian suspension bridge, a key control project of the Xiamen-Jinmen Bridge (Xiamen section), completed closure, linking the deck structure and paving the way for the sea-crossing main line to open to traffic.

articles.title_zh: 在美国总统特朗普举行的欢迎宴会上的祝酒辞
articles.title_en: Toast at the Welcome Banquet Hosted by U.S. President Trump
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月24日，国家主席习近平在华盛顿出席美国总统特朗普举行的欢迎宴会并致祝酒辞，表示中美元首不到半年实现互访，为两国关系提供了新的战略指引。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, 2026, President Xi Jinping attended a welcome banquet hosted by U.S. President Donald Trump in Washington and delivered a toast, saying the reciprocal visits by the two heads of state within half a year have provided new strategic guidance for bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 王毅谈习近平主席对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Wang Yi on President Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京谈习近平主席对美国进行国事访问，称此访拓展了中美建设性战略稳定关系内涵，是一次历史性访问。
articles.summary_en: On September 26, Foreign Minister Wang Yi briefed on President Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States, calling it a historic trip that broadened the China-US constructive strategic stability relationship.

articles.title_zh: 为中美关系提供新的战略指引——美国各界高度评价习近平主席对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: New Strategic Guidance for China-US Relations: US Figures Praise Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日至25日，国家主席习近平应邀对美国进行国事访问，24日在华盛顿出席系列国事活动并与特朗普总统坦诚深入交流，美国各界高度评价此访为中美关系提供新的战略指引。
articles.summary_en: At President Trump's invitation, Xi Jinping made a state visit to the US on Sept 23-25, meeting Trump in Washington on Sept 24; US figures praised the visit for giving new strategic guidance to bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 增进中美人民福祉 促进人类发展进步——中美元首会晤引发热烈国际反响
articles.title_en: Advancing China-U.S. Wellbeing and Global Development: Xi-Trump Summit Draws Wide International Response
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日，国家主席习近平同美国总统特朗普在白宫举行会晤，就中美关系发展作出一系列重要论述，引发国际社会热烈反响。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24 local time, President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump met at the White House. Xi's remarks on developing China-U.S. ties drew wide positive reaction internationally.

articles.title_zh: 为中美关系提供新的战略指引——国际社会高度评价习近平主席美国之行
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's US Visit Offers New Strategic Guidance for China-US Relations, Widely Praised Internationally
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日至25日，国家主席习近平对美国进行国事访问，两国元首达成新的共识，国际社会对此访给予高度评价。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 23 to 25, President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States, where the two heads of state reached new consensus; the international community praised the visit highly.

articles.title_zh: 全国秋粮收获有序推进
articles.title_en: China's Autumn Grain Harvest Progresses Steadily
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部农情调度显示，全国秋粮收获近两成，湖北、河南、黑龙江等主产区抢抓晴好天气加快抢收，确保粮食颗粒归仓。
articles.summary_en: China's autumn grain harvest is nearly 20 percent complete, with Hubei, Henan and Heilongjiang stepping up harvesting to bring in crops before rain, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs said.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对美国进行国事访问，中美达成八点成果共识
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's State Visit to the U.S. Yields Eight-Point Consensus
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月23日至25日，习近平对美国进行国事访问，两国元首就中美建设性战略稳定关系及重大国际地区问题深入交换意见，达成八点成果共识。
articles.summary_en: From September 23 to 25 local time, Xi Jinping made a state visit to the United States, where the two heads of state held in-depth exchanges on a constructive China-U.S. strategic stability relationship and major international and regional issues, reaching an eight-point consensus.

articles.title_zh: 陈文清主持召开专题会议强调依法从严查处危害食品安全违法犯罪
articles.title_en: Chen Wenqing Chairs Special Meeting on Strictly Cracking Down on Food Safety Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，中央政法委书记陈文清在北京主持召开专题会议，强调依法从严查处危害食品安全违法犯罪，全链条惩处相关犯罪并加快修订食品安全法。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 24, Chen Wenqing, head of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, chaired a special meeting in Beijing, urging strict law enforcement against food safety crimes and faster revision of the Food Safety Law.

tags.name_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

tags_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示重要回信精神 许昆林主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets on Implementing Xi Jinping's Instructions; Xu Kunlin Presides
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，辽宁省委常委会召开会议，省委书记许昆林主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话、重要指示、重要回信精神和中央有关会议部署，审议全省法治宣传教育第九个五年规划。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the Liaoning Provincial Party Standing Committee met under Party Secretary Xu Kunlin to study Xi Jinping's speeches, instructions and reply letters and central directives, and reviewed the province's ninth five-year plan for legal education.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记顾坤、代市长杨新忠走访看望节日期间一线人员
articles.title_en: Huaian Party Secretary Gu Kun and Acting Mayor Yang Xinzhong Visit Frontline Workers Over the Holiday
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日中秋节，淮安市委书记顾坤、代市长杨新忠走访企业和项目现场、市社会福利院及市公安局，慰问坚守岗位的一线人员，部署安全生产与民生保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 25, Mid-Autumn Festival, Huaian Party Secretary Gu Kun and acting mayor Yang Xinzhong visited industrial project sites, a welfare institute and the city police command center to greet frontline workers on duty.

articles.title_zh: 习近平结束对美国的国事访问回到北京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing After Concluding State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日下午，国家主席习近平圆满结束对美国的国事访问回到北京，彭丽媛、蔡奇、王毅、何立峰等陪同人员同机返回。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 26, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after concluding a successful state visit to the United States, accompanied by Peng Liyuan, Cai Qi, Wang Yi, He Lifeng and others.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升：深入调研督导吉隆泥石流灾害善后处置工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects Aftermath Response to Gyirong Mudslide Disaster
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日至25日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在日喀则市吉隆镇、萨勒乡调研督导泥石流灾害善后处置工作，看望慰问受灾群众和一线救援人员。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 24 to 25, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng inspected mudslide disaster aftermath work in Gyirong, Shigatse, and visited affected residents and rescue workers.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持召开西藏自治区人民政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Chairs Expanded Meeting of Tibet Autonomous Region Government Party Leadership Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，西藏自治区主席、自治区政府党组书记嘎玛泽登在拉萨主持召开自治区人民政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究防灾减灾救灾和整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题等贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Gama Zedeng, chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region and secretary of the regional government's Party leadership group, chaired an expanded meeting in Lhasa to convey Xi Jinping's remarks and discuss disaster prevention and relief and anti-corruption work.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党林芝市第三次代表大会举行第二次全体会议
articles.title_en: CPC Linzhi City Third Congress Holds Second Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日上午，中国共产党林芝市第三次代表大会举行第二次全体会议，选举产生新一届市委委员、候补委员、市纪委委员及出席西藏自治区第十一次党代会代表。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 25, the third CPC Linzhi City Congress held its second plenary session, electing new municipal Party committee members and delegates to Tibet's 11th Party congress.

articles.title_zh: 三届市委常委会第1次会议召开
articles.title_en: First Meeting of Third Nyingchi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Convenes
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，林芝市委书记巴塔主持召开三届市委常委会第1次会议，传达学习党章及新时代党的治藏方略，部署国庆期间工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 25, Nyingchi Party Secretary Ba Ta chaired the first meeting of the third Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee, studying the Party Constitution and Tibet governance strategy and arranging National Day work.

tags.name_en: Party's Tibet Governance Strategy for the New Era

articles.title_zh: 林芝市召开两会新闻发布会
articles.title_en: Linzhi City Holds Press Conference for Two Sessions
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日下午，林芝市人大常委会、市政协分别就市三届人大一次会议和市政协三届一次会议筹备情况举行新闻发布会，并回答记者提问。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 25, Linzhi's municipal people's congress standing committee and CPPCC committee held a press conference on preparations for the city's third people's congress session and third CPPCC session, taking reporters' questions.

articles.title_zh: 副省长、省公安厅厅长任开斌来盘督导检查安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Vice Governor and Public Security Chief Ren Kaibin Inspects Panjin on Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月26日，辽宁省副省长、省公安厅厅长任开斌赴盘锦督导检查安全生产工作并巡林，实地检查危化品企业、森林防火及道路隐患整治。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 26, Liaoning Vice Governor and Public Security Department Chief Ren Kaibin inspected Panjin on work safety and forest protection, covering a chemical firm, forest fire prevention and road hazard rectification.

articles.title_zh: 中美达成八点成果共识
articles.title_en: China and the US Reach Eight-Point Consensus on Outcomes
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月23日至25日，习近平对美国进行国事访问，两国元首就中美建设性战略稳定关系及重大国际地区问题深入交换意见，达成八点成果共识。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping made a state visit to the United States from Sept 23 to 25, and the two heads of state reached an eight-point consensus on a constructive China-US strategic stability relationship and major international and regional issues.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋、蔡剑峰开展中秋节安全生产检查
articles.title_en: Jiang Feng and Cai Jianfeng Conduct Mid-Autumn Festival Work Safety Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日中秋节当天，无锡市委书记蒋锋、代市长蔡剑峰分两路赴制造企业、重大交通基础设施和文旅景区，宣讲市第十五次党代会精神并检查调研安全生产工作。

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛同美国总统特朗普夫妇茶叙

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研检查节日市场保供和安全生产工作

articles.summary_en: On September 25, Mid-Autumn Festival, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping inspected holiday market supply and work safety in Tinghu District, visiting an elderly care center and retail stores and urging solid livelihood support and safety safeguards.

articles.title_zh: 在白宫，习近平提到了一棵树和一片林

articles.summary_en: At a Sept 24 White House welcome banquet during his US state visit, President Xi Jinping told two stories of China-US friendship: a Nixon-gifted redwood and the Mu Us "Saycos Forest".

articles.title_zh: 一轮中秋月，照见中美两国的友好交往

articles.summary_en: On Sept 25, 2026, during his visit to Washington, President Xi Jinping attended President Trump's welcome banquet, held on the Mid-Autumn Festival, saying China and the US should be partners, not rivals.

articles.title_zh: 从人海检查到智能预警 湖北孝感工贸企业给安全“上锁”
articles.title_en: From Mass Inspections to Smart Alerts: Xiaogan Industrial Firms in Hubei 'Lock Down' Safety

articles.summary_en: Xiaogan's emergency management authorities in Hubei have targeted over 200 key industrial firms, shifting safety oversight from mass manual inspections to smart alerts and closed-loop governance.

articles.summary_en: The 2026 National Inspection and Testing Institution Open Day launched in Suzhou, Jiangsu, with 2,663 testing institutions nationwide opening to the public.

articles.summary_en: A Sept 23 coordination meeting in Jingdezhen, Jiangxi, on the national ceramic culture inheritance and innovation pilot zone drew NDRC Deputy Director Zheng Bei and Executive Vice Governor Ren Zhufeng to plan next-stage tasks.

articles.title_zh: 上海推出200场双节消费盛宴，16区联动点燃金秋消费热
articles.title_en: Shanghai Launches 200 Holiday Consumption Events, Mobilizing All 16 Districts

articles.summary_en: On September 24, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told a regular press briefing that China and the United States are maintaining communication on arrangements for interactions between the two heads of state within the year.

articles.summary_en: A seminar group of leaders from international peace organizations and security think tanks of 17 countries, led by Malaysian Senate Deputy Speaker Nur Jazlan, concluded a four-day visit to Sichuan on Sept 25, exploring cooperation in science, agriculture and education.

articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept. 24 local time, Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan attended a welcome banquet hosted by Donald and Melania Trump at the White House, where Xi delivered remarks.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the State Council Information Office hosted a briefing where the Ministry of Culture and Tourism unveiled five measures to deepen culture-tourism integration and boost cultural programs, the cultural industry and tourism during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 中国对外投资存量连续9年保持全球前三

articles.summary_en: China's commerce, statistics and forex authorities reported 2025 outbound direct investment flows of $213.58 billion, up 11.1%, with a $3.4 trillion stock, ranking top three globally for nine straight years.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席美国总统特朗普在白宫举行的欢迎仪式

articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 24 local time, U.S. President Donald Trump held a ceremony at the White House welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping on his state visit to the United States; Xi and his wife Peng Liyuan posed for a photo with Trump and his wife Melania.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示重要回信精神 许昆林主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Key Speeches and Directives; Xu Kunlin Presides
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，辽宁省委书记许昆林主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话、重要指示和中央会议部署，审议全省法治宣传教育第九个五年规划。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin chaired a meeting of the provincial Party Standing Committee to study Xi Jinping's key speeches and central directives and to review the province's ninth five-year plan for legal education.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市十七届人大常委会举行第六十五次主任会议 范继英主持
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 65th Council of Chairpersons Meeting, Chaired by Fan Jiying
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，沈阳市十七届人大常委会举行第六十五次主任会议，主任范继英主持，决定市十七届人大常委会第三十五次会议于9月28日举行。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the Standing Committee of the 17th Shenyang Municipal People's Congress held its 65th Council of Chairpersons meeting, chaired by Fan Jiying, deciding to convene the 35th session of the Standing Committee on September 28.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同美国总统特朗普在白宫举行会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with U.S. President Trump at the White House
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日上午，国家主席习近平在白宫同美国总统特朗普举行会谈，双方就中美关系、经贸合作、人工智能及台湾问题等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 24 local time, President Xi Jinping held talks with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House, discussing bilateral ties, trade, AI cooperation and the Taiwan question.

articles.title_zh: 彭丽媛同美国总统特朗普夫人梅拉尼娅参观国立亚洲艺术博物馆
articles.title_en: Peng Liyuan and Melania Trump Visit the National Museum of Asian Art
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日中午，习近平主席夫人彭丽媛在华盛顿与美国总统特朗普夫人梅拉尼娅共同参观国立亚洲艺术博物馆，并表示希望中美继续加强文化交流和文化遗产保护合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Peng Liyuan, wife of President Xi Jinping, and Melania Trump visited the National Museum of Asian Art in Washington, where Peng called for continued China-US cooperation on cultural exchange and heritage protection.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席美国总统在白宫举行的欢迎仪式
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcoming Ceremony Hosted by U.S. President at the White House
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日上午，美国总统特朗普在白宫举行隆重仪式，欢迎习近平对美国进行国事访问，两国元首分别致辞并共同检阅仪仗队。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 24 local time, U.S. President Trump held a grand ceremony at the White House welcoming Xi Jinping on his state visit to the United States; the two leaders delivered remarks and reviewed the honor guard together.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开全市节日期间安全防范工作调度会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs Citywide Meeting on Holiday Safety Precautions
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开全市节日期间安全防范工作调度会议，对中秋、国庆假期安全生产和社会稳定工作再安排、再部署。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 25, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu chaired a citywide meeting on holiday safety, redeploying work on production safety and social stability for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开全市县乡人大换届选举调度会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs City Meeting on County and Township People's Congress Elections
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开全市县乡人大换届选举调度会议，要求扎实做好选民登记、投票选举等工作，确保选举依法有序、风清气正。
articles.summary_en: On September 25, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu chaired a city meeting on county and township people's congress elections, urging solid voter registration and orderly, lawful voting.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党淮安市第九次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: Ninth Congress of the CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，中国共产党淮安市第九次代表大会在淮安闭幕，顾坤主持闭幕会并讲话。大会选举产生新一届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员，并选出出席省第十五次党代会代表。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the Ninth Congress of the CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee closed in Huai'an, chaired by Gu Kun. Delegates elected new municipal Party committee and discipline inspection committee members and representatives to the provincial Party congress.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委常委会召开会议 部署市第九次党代会精神学习宣传贯彻
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Implementing Party Congress Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，淮安市委书记顾坤主持九届市委常委会第一次会议，部署市第九次党代会精神学习宣传贯彻、先进制造业发展和节日安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Huai'an Party Secretary Gu Kun chaired the first meeting of the ninth Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee, deploying work on the city Party congress spirit, advanced manufacturing and holiday safety.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党淮安市第九届委员会举行第一次全体会议
articles.title_en: First Plenary Session of the 9th CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日下午，中国共产党淮安市第九届委员会举行第一次全体会议，选举顾坤为市委书记，杨新忠、胡毅为市委副书记，并产生新一届市委常委。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 24, the 9th CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee held its first plenary session, electing Gu Kun as municipal party secretary and Yang Xinzhong and Hu Yi as deputy secretaries, along with the new standing committee members.

articles.title_zh: 怀化农村产权交易“三个一”工程落地发布仪式在鹤城区举行
articles.title_en: Huaihua Launches "Three Ones" Project for Rural Property Rights Trading
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，怀化农村产权交易“三个一”工程落地发布仪式在鹤城区举行，全市“数字农交”一张网等三项平台同步上线。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Huaihua held a launch ceremony in Hecheng District for its "Three Ones" rural property rights trading project, bringing three digital platforms online simultaneously.

articles.title_zh: “购在怀化·乐享消费”2026金秋消费季系列促消费活动启动
articles.title_en: Huaihua Launches 2026 Autumn Consumption Season to Boost Spending
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日下午，“购在怀化·乐享消费”2026金秋消费季促消费活动在怀化启动，代市长高靖生出席并宣布启动，活动持续至10月底。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Huaihua Autumn Consumption Season kicked off on the afternoon of Sept 24, with acting mayor Gao Jingsheng announcing the launch; the campaign runs through the end of October.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同美国总统特朗普会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with U.S. President Trump
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日上午，国家主席习近平在华盛顿白宫同美国总统特朗普举行会谈，双方就中美关系、经贸合作、人工智能及台湾问题等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 24 local time, President Xi Jinping held talks with U.S. President Donald Trump at the White House in Washington, exchanging views on bilateral ties, trade, AI and Taiwan.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队检查安全生产、消防安全、食品安全等工作
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Inspection of Workplace Safety, Fire Safety and Food Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰带队赴企业、护理院、加油站和市场检查中秋国庆期间安全生产、消防及食品安全工作，副市长李晋龙参加。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 24, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie led an inspection of enterprises, a nursing home, a gas station and a market to check workplace, fire and food safety ahead of the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays; Vice Mayor Li Jinlong joined.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森调研检查中秋、国庆期间市场供应和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Inspects Market Supply and Work Safety Ahead of Mid-Autumn and National Day Holidays
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，盘锦市委书记王炳森赴居民小区、化工企业、市场等地调研检查中秋、国庆期间市场供应和安全生产工作，要求抓好安全生产、保障市场供应，让群众度过平安祥和的假期。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 25, Panjin Party Secretary Wang Bingsen inspected market supply and work safety at residential, chemical and market sites ahead of the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, urging solid safety measures and stable supplies.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰范德繁调研督导安全稳定和假日经济等工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng and Fan Defan Inspect Holiday Safety, Stability and Holiday Economy Work in Shanwei
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日上午，汕尾市委书记逯峰、代理市长范德繁带队到市城区，调研督导中秋假期安全稳定和假日经济工作，并慰问值班值守人员。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 25, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng and Acting Mayor Fan Defan led an inspection in the city's urban districts on Mid-Autumn holiday safety, stability and holiday economy work, and visited on-duty staff.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰范德繁调研督导安全稳定和假日经济等工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng and Fan Defan Inspect Safety, Stability and Holiday Economy Work in Shanwei
articles.summary_zh: 9月25日，汕尾市委书记逯峰、代市长范德繁带队到市城区调研督导中秋假期安全稳定和假日经济工作，并看望慰问值班值守人员。
articles.summary_en: On September 25, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng and acting Mayor Fan Defan led an inspection in the city's urban district on holiday safety, stability and the holiday economy, and met on-duty staff.

articles.title_zh: 朔州市政府召开第63次常务会议 研究安全生产和国资国企改革等工作
articles.title_en: Shuozhou Municipal Government Holds 63rd Executive Meeting on Safety Production and SOE Reform
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，朔州市市长吴秀玲主持召开市政府第63次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究安全生产、国资国企改革和群众身边腐败问题集中整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Mayor Wu Xiuling chaired Shuozhou's 63rd municipal government executive meeting, studying Xi Jinping's speeches and work on safety production, SOE reform and anti-corruption.
keywords: 群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治

articles.title_zh: 泰州市政府召开常务会议 部署节假日安全防范与政府投资项目
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Government Holds Executive Meeting on Holiday Safety and Government Investment Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，泰州市市长李晖主持召开市政府常务会议，部署中秋、国庆假期安全防范工作，研究市级政府投资项目计划调整方案，并审议《泰州市化工重点监测点认定管理实施细则》。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui chaired a municipal government executive meeting to arrange safety measures for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, review adjustments to municipal government investment project plans, and deliberate rules on recognizing key chemical monitoring sites.

articles.title_zh: 李晖主持召开市政府党组会议 突出重点推动党代会精神落细落实
articles.title_en: Li Hui Chairs Municipal Government Party Leadership Group Meeting on Implementing Party Congress Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，泰州市政府党组书记、市长李晖主持召开市政府党组会议，传达学习市第七次党代会精神，研究部署政府系统贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui chaired a municipal government Party leadership group meeting to convey the spirit of the city's 7th Party Congress and plan its implementation.

articles.title_zh: 七届市委常委会召开第一次会议
articles.title_en: Seventh Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Its First Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，泰州市七届市委常委会召开第一次会议，市委书记姜冬冬主持并讲话，部署学习贯彻习近平总书记对江苏工作重要讲话精神和加强新一届常委班子自身建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the seventh Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held its first meeting, chaired by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong, to implement Xi Jinping's remarks on Jiangsu and strengthen the new leadership team's self-building.

articles.title_zh: 全市民营企业座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Weihai Holds Citywide Symposium on Private Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，威海市召开全市民营企业座谈会，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，市长孔凡萍主持，强调优化涉企服务、构建亲清政商关系。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Weihai held a citywide private enterprise symposium; Party Secretary Zhang Haibo urged better business services and cleaner government-business ties, with Mayor Kong Fanping presiding.

articles.title_zh: 芜湖市人大常委会党组召开理论学习中心组学习（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Enlarged Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，芜湖市人大常委会党组及机关党组召开理论学习中心组学习扩大会议，主任张峰主持并讲话，深入学习习近平生态文明思想及考察安徽重要讲话精神。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the Party group of the Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held an enlarged theoretical study session, chaired by director Zhang Feng, focusing on Xi Jinping's thought on ecological civilization and his remarks during his inspection of Anhui.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党无锡市第十五次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 15th CPC Wuxi Municipal Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，中国共产党无锡市第十五次代表大会在无锡闭幕，差额选举产生新一届市委、市纪委及出席省党代会代表，蒋锋作闭幕讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the 15th CPC Wuxi Municipal Congress closed in Wuxi, electing a new municipal Party committee, discipline inspection commission and delegates to the provincial congress; Jiang Feng gave the closing speech.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党无锡市第十五届委员会举行第一次全体会议
articles.title_en: First Plenary Session of the 15th CPC Wuxi Municipal Committee Elects New Leadership
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日下午，中共无锡市第十五届委员会举行第一次全体会议，差额选举产生11名市委常委，蒋锋当选市委书记，蔡剑峰、李秋峰当选市委副书记。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 24, the 15th CPC Wuxi Municipal Committee held its first plenary session, electing 11 Standing Committee members and naming Jiang Feng as Party Secretary, with Cai Jianfeng and Li Qiufeng as deputy secretaries.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见中国银行党委副书记、行长张辉一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets with Bank of China President Zhang Hui
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见中国银行行长张辉一行，双方商定建立常态化对接机制，在科技金融、跨境金融、民生金融及风险防范等领域深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met Bank of China President Zhang Hui, agreeing to set up a regular dialogue mechanism and deepen cooperation in tech finance, cross-border finance, livelihood finance and risk prevention.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见香港贸易发展局主席马时亨一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Hong Kong Trade Development Council Chairman Frederick Ma and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见香港贸易发展局主席马时亨一行，双方就深化经贸、科技、金融、文旅等领域合作及推动西安企业出海进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met with Hong Kong Trade Development Council Chairman Frederick Ma and his delegation to discuss deeper cooperation in trade, technology, finance and tourism, and to help Xi'an firms expand overseas.

articles.title_zh: 九届市委常委会召开第一次会议
articles.title_en: First Meeting of the Ninth Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Convenes
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，盐城市九届市委常委会召开第一次会议，市委书记严汉平主持，学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究党代会任务分解及经济、安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the ninth Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held its first meeting, chaired by Party Secretary Yan Hanping, to study Xi Jinping's directives and take up task division from the Party congress, economic work and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组传达学习市第九次党代会精神
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Party Group Conveys Spirit of 9th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，盐城市人大常委会党组（扩大）会议召开，传达学习市第九次党代会精神，市人大常委会主任、党组书记王荣主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the Party Group of the Yancheng Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held an expanded meeting to convey the spirit of the city's 9th Party Congress. Wang Rong chaired and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市委外办应邀出席沙特国庆招待会
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Foreign Affairs Office Attends Saudi National Day Reception
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，沙特驻广州总领馆在广州举办国庆招待会，广东省委常委、常务副省长张虎致辞，湛江市委外办主任王敦滟应邀出席并与沙特总领事哈吉交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Saudi Arabia's consulate in Guangzhou hosted a National Day reception; Guangdong Executive Vice Governor Zhang Hu spoke, and Zhanjiang Foreign Affairs Office Director Wang Dunyan attended and met the Saudi Consul General.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅到坡头区开展中秋、国庆节前安全生产和消防安全检查
articles.title_en: Li Yongyi Inspects Work Safety and Fire Safety in Potou District Ahead of Mid-Autumn and National Day Holidays
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日上午，湛江市委副书记、市长李勇毅到坡头区检查“九小”场所、船舶修造企业和非煤矿山企业的安全生产与消防安全工作，要求压实责任、排查整治风险隐患。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 24, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi inspected work safety and fire safety at small business venues, a ship repair yard and a non-coal mining company in Potou District, urging tighter risk screening ahead of the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛出席特朗普总统夫妇举行的欢迎国宴
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Attend Welcome State Banquet Hosted by President Trump and His Wife
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日晚，美国总统特朗普和夫人梅拉尼娅在白宫为中国国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛举行欢迎国宴，两国元首分别致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24 local time, President Trump and first lady Melania hosted a welcome state banquet at the White House for President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan; both leaders delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 市纪委监委理论学习中心组举行集体学习研讨
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Discipline Inspection Commission Holds Group Study Session on Economic Thought
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，周口市纪委监委理论学习中心组举行集体学习研讨，深入学习贯彻习近平经济思想，市委常委、市纪委书记、市监委主任杜道泉主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Zhoukou's discipline inspection commission held a group study session on Xi Jinping Thought on the Economy, chaired by Du Daoquan, city Party standing committee member and discipline inspection chief.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开全市爱国卫生运动工作会议并督导检查疫情防控和安全防范工作
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Citywide Patriotic Health Campaign Meeting, Inspects Disease Control and Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐主持召开全市爱国卫生运动工作会议，部署虫媒传染病疫情防控和爱国卫生运动，并赴各区督导检查疫情防控与安全防范工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong chaired a citywide patriotic health campaign meeting to deploy vector-borne disease prevention and inspected epidemic control and safety work across the city's districts.

articles.title_zh: 「赛考斯」回应被习近平主席提及：太不可思议了
articles.title_en: American "Saiksaosi" Responds to Being Mentioned by Xi Jinping: Unbelievable
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日晚，习近平和夫人彭丽媛出席特朗普夫妇在白宫举行的欢迎宴会，习近平在致辞中讲述了美国人「赛考斯」与中国治沙人殷玉珍的故事，赛考斯随后回应称激动不已。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 24 local time, Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan attended a welcome banquet hosted by Donald and Melania Trump at the White House; in his speech Xi told the story of American "Saiksaosi" and Chinese desert-fighter Yin Yuzhen, who responded that he was thrilled.

articles.title_zh: 漳州持续推进城市适儿化改造：用“一米高度”量城市温度
articles.title_en: Zhangzhou Advances Child-Friendly Urban Renovation, Measuring City Warmth from a Child's 'One-Meter Height'
articles.summary_zh: 漳州持续推进城市适儿化改造，其公园绿地适儿化改造经验入选住建部、国家发改委、国务院妇儿工委办公室发布的第三批城市儿童友好空间建设可复制经验清单。
articles.summary_en: Zhangzhou is pressing ahead with child-friendly urban renovation, with its park green-space renovation experience selected for the third batch of replicable practices for child-friendly urban space issued by three national bodies.

articles.title_zh: 习近平应邀对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Makes a State Visit to the United States at Trump's Invitation
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月23日下午，习近平主席应特朗普总统邀请抵达华盛顿近郊安德鲁斯空军基地，对美国进行国事访问，特朗普总统到场迎接。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 23 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived at Andrews Air Force Base near Washington for a state visit to the United States at President Trump's invitation, and was welcomed by President Trump.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同特朗普白宫会谈：把中美建设性战略稳定关系愿景转化为行动
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Trump at the White House, Urging Action to Turn China-U.S. Strategic Stability Vision into Reality
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日，习近平在华盛顿白宫同特朗普举行会谈并出席欢迎仪式，就落实中美建设性战略稳定关系新定位、经贸、人工智能及台湾等问题深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 24 local time, Xi Jinping held talks and attended a welcome ceremony with Donald Trump at the White House in Washington, discussing the new China-U.S. strategic stability relationship, trade, AI and Taiwan.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在美国致辞讲起“赛考斯”和殷玉珍的故事
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Tells Story of 'Cycas' and Yin Yuzhen at U.S. Welcome Banquet
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日晚，习近平在特朗普举行的欢迎宴会上致辞，讲述美国教师“赛考斯”资助殷玉珍治沙造林、26年后重逢的故事。
articles.summary_en: At a Sept 24 welcome banquet hosted by Trump, Xi Jinping told the story of US teacher 'Cycas', whose donation helped Yin Yuzhen plant trees in the Mu Us Desert, and their reunion 26 years later.

articles.title_zh: 国际人士表示习近平主席书面讲话推动中美相向而行 为全球发展注入确定性
articles.title_en: International Figures Say President Xi's Written Speech Steers China and the US Toward Each Other, Adding Certainty to Global Development
articles.summary_zh: 多国人士点评习近平主席对美国国事访问及抵美书面讲话，认为讲话推动中美相向而行，为世界和平发展注入确定性。
articles.summary_en: Commentators from several countries praised Xi Jinping's state visit to the United States and his written speech on arrival, saying it steers China and the US toward mutual accommodation and injects certainty into global peace and development.

articles.title_zh: 中美应该成为伙伴而不是对手
articles.title_en: China and the US Should Be Partners, Not Rivals
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月24日，美国总统特朗普在白宫举行仪式欢迎习近平主席对美国进行国事访问，习近平发表致辞，强调中美要加强沟通、真诚合作、和平共处。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, President Trump hosted a White House welcome ceremony for Xi Jinping's state visit to the US, where Xi urged stronger communication, sincere cooperation and peaceful coexistence.

articles.title_zh: 长江经济带高质量发展调研行：一条船，扬起“上游担当”的绿帆
articles.title_en: Yangtze Economic Belt High-Quality Development Tour: A Ship Raises the Green Sail of 'Upstream Responsibility'
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日至22日，长江经济带主流媒体泸州调研行启动，记者探访船舶污染治理、LNG清洁能源船舶制造和航道整治，展现四川长江上游生态治理与绿色航运成效。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21-22, a Yangtze Economic Belt media tour in Luzhou, Sichuan, highlighted ship pollution control, LNG-powered vessels and waterway upgrades.

articles.summary_zh: 中国插花花艺协会与中国花卉协会联合发出通知，撤销2006年共同评选的13人“中国插花花艺大师”“资深大师”称号，原证书即刻失效。
articles.summary_en: The China Flower Arrangement Association and the China Flower Association jointly issued a notice revoking the 'Chinese Flower Arrangement Master' and 'Senior Master' titles awarded to 13 people in 2006, with the certificates immediately invalidated.

articles.summary_zh: 国铁集团宣布，宜昌至兴山高铁将于9月28日开通运营，形成沪渝蓉高铁与郑渝高铁的联络通道，武汉至重庆最快3小时54分钟可达。
articles.summary_en: China Railway announced that the Yichang-Xingshan high-speed railway will open on September 28, linking the Shanghai-Chongqing-Chengdu and Zhengzhou-Chongqing lines and cutting Wuhan-Chongqing travel time to 3 hours 54 minutes.

articles.summary_en: Xiamen's Natural Resources and Planning Bureau held a press conference on Sept 24 to explain interim rules on three-dimensional layered land use rights for state-owned construction land, effective Oct 1, allowing separate rights and registration for above-ground, surface and underground layers.

articles.title_zh: 河南省十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议闭幕：王陆进任河南省代省长
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes Session; Wang Lujin Appointed Acting Governor of Henan
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，河南省十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议在郑州闭幕，会议接受王凯辞去河南省省长职务，决定任命王陆进为河南省副省长、代理省长。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress closed its 26th session in Zhengzhou, accepting Wang Kai's resignation as Henan governor and appointing Wang Lujin as vice governor and acting governor.

articles.title_zh: 河南省委常委会召开会议 重温习近平总书记关于河南工作的重要讲话和重要指示批示精神

articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi chaired a Standing Committee meeting to review Xi Jinping's key speeches and instructions on Henan's work and to map out implementation measures.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi chaired a Standing Committee meeting to review Xi Jinping's key speeches and instructions on Henan's work and to study the Politburo meeting's decisions.

articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi and Wang Lujin Inspect Zhengzhou, Vow to Speed Up National Central City Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，河南省委书记周祖翼、代省长王陆进在郑州惠济区和郑州经济技术开发区调研黄河生态保护治理、制造业高质量发展和节假日安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Henan Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and acting Governor Wang Lujin inspected Huiji District and the Zhengzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone, focusing on Yellow River ecological protection, advanced manufacturing and holiday safety.

articles.summary_en: On September 23, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei visited Hikvision and H3C in Hangzhou, discussing deeper digital economy cooperation between Hainan and Zhejiang.

articles.title_en: Sharing Free Trade Port Opportunities, Jointly Exploring the Blue Ocean of Digital Economy

articles.summary_en: On September 24, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei promoted digital economy opportunities of the Hainan Free Trade Port at the Global Digital Trade Expo in Hangzhou and unveiled a Zhejiang-Hainan cooperation enterprise.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在浙江省杭州市分别与有关企业负责人会谈
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Meets with Enterprise Executives in Hangzhou, Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，海南省委书记冯飞在浙江杭州分别与多家企业负责人会谈，推动数字经济等领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei met with executives of several companies in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, to promote cooperation in the digital economy and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 省委农村工作领导小组2026年第4次全体会议召开

articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Hainan's Party Committee Rural Work Leading Group held its 4th 2026 meeting in Haikou, chaired by Deputy Secretary Yang Jinbo, to redeploy rural revitalization and poverty-alleviation rectification.

articles.title_zh: 国新办举行发布会：统筹推动文化事业、文化产业和旅游业高质量发展
articles.title_en: China to Coordinate High-Quality Development of Cultural Programs, Cultural Industry and Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，文化和旅游部介绍推进文旅高质量发展有关情况，提出以文旅深度融合为主线等五方面举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on culture and tourism development under the 15th Five-Year Plan, with the Ministry of Culture and Tourism outlining five policy priorities led by deeper integration of culture and tourism.

articles.summary_en: At a Sept 24 press conference held by the State Council Information Office, Vice Minister of Transport Li Yang and other officials outlined transport service plans for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, forecasting 650 million and 2.13 billion cross-regional trips respectively.

articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，银川市应急管理局赴国家能源集团宁夏煤业双马一矿、双马二矿开展煤矿安全专项检查，并组织井下人员应急逃生演练。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the Yinchuan Emergency Management Bureau carried out a special coal mine safety inspection at two mines of Ningxia Coal Industry under CHN Energy, and organized an underground emergency escape drill.

articles.title_en: Qinghai Provincial People's Congress Approves Express Delivery Market Regulation for Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture

articles.summary_en: From Sept 21 to 23, the 24th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th Qinghai Provincial People's Congress approved the Express Delivery Market Management Regulation for Hainan Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, aiming to regulate the market and ease industry bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: 三方合作建设世界技能创新中心

articles.summary_en: On September 24, 2026, China's Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the Shanghai municipal government and WorldSkills signed a letter of intent in Shanghai to jointly build a World Skills Innovation Center.

articles.title_en: Shanghai Financial Regulator Issues 16 New Measures to Explore Customer-Facing AI Models in Controlled Environment

articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau issued 16 measures to promote AI use in banking and insurance, exploring a pilot that lets financial institutions offer customer-facing large-model services in a controlled environment.

articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，赤峰市委书记亢永强主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习9月21日中共中央政治局会议精神和习近平总书记近期重要指示精神，并部署中秋国庆假期安全生产、森林草原防灭火及廉洁过节等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang chaired an expanded meeting of the Municipal Party Standing Committee to convey the spirit of the Sept 21 CPC Politburo meeting and Xi Jinping's recent instructions, and to arrange work for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达华盛顿对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Washington for State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月23日下午，国家主席习近平乘专机抵达华盛顿，应美国总统特朗普邀请对美国进行国事访问，特朗普夫妇到机场迎接。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept. 23 local time, President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington aboard his special plane for a state visit to the United States at the invitation of U.S. President Trump, who greeted him at the airport with his wife Melania.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见吉尔吉斯斯坦总理卡瑟马利耶夫
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Kyrgyz Prime Minister Kasymaliev
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，国务院总理李强在杭州会见吉尔吉斯斯坦总理卡瑟马利耶夫，双方就落实元首共识、共建“一带一路”及深化经贸、互联互通合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Chinese Premier Li Qiang met Kyrgyz Prime Minister Kasymaliev in Hangzhou to discuss implementing leaders' consensus, high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and deeper trade, connectivity and cultural ties.

articles.title_zh: 推进文化和旅游高质量发展
articles.title_en: China to Advance High-Quality Development of Culture and Tourism in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会，文化和旅游部介绍“十五五”时期统筹推动文化事业、文化产业和旅游业高质量发展的重点举措。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the State Council Information Office held a press conference at which the Ministry of Culture and Tourism outlined key measures to advance high-quality development of culture, the cultural industry and tourism during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 李强出席第五届全球数字贸易博览会启动仪式并致辞
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends Launch Ceremony of the 5th Global Digital Trade Expo and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国务院总理李强在杭州出席第五届全球数字贸易博览会启动仪式并致辞，马来西亚总理安瓦尔等外国领导人及1200多名代表出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, Premier Li Qiang attended and addressed the launch ceremony of the 5th Global Digital Trade Expo in Hangzhou, joined by Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar and over 1,200 delegates.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布修订后的《中华人民共和国审计法实施条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree Promulgating Revised Audit Law Implementation Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月19日，国务院总理李强签署第847号国务院令，公布修订后的《中华人民共和国审计法实施条例》，自2026年12月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 19, 2026, Premier Li Qiang signed State Council Decree No. 847, promulgating the revised Regulations on Implementing the Audit Law of the PRC, effective Dec 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在白宫欢迎仪式上的致辞（全文）
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Remarks at White House Welcome Ceremony (Full Text)
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月24日，国家主席习近平在华盛顿白宫欢迎仪式上致辞，表示愿同特朗普总统一道引领中美关系行稳致远，并宣布未来5年邀请10万名美国青少年来华交流学习。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, 2026, President Xi Jinping delivered remarks at a White House welcome ceremony in Washington, pledging to work with President Trump to keep China-U.S. relations on a steady course and announcing that China will invite 100,000 American youth to study in China over the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 商务部门加强中秋国庆生活必需品市场供应保障
articles.title_en: Commerce Departments Strengthen Market Supply of Daily Necessities for Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day
articles.summary_zh: 商务部近日召开电视电话会议，部署各地商务主管部门加强中秋国庆期间生活必需品市场供应保障，并会同相关部门在少数民族地区投放中央储备冻牛羊肉5100吨。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce recently held a teleconference directing local commerce authorities to secure supplies of daily necessities for the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holidays, releasing 5,100 tonnes of central frozen beef and mutton reserves in ethnic minority regions.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见马来西亚总理安瓦尔
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国务院总理李强在杭州会见马来西亚总理安瓦尔，双方就深化中马命运共同体建设、共建“一带一路”及新兴产业合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, Premier Li Qiang met Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar in Hangzhou, discussing deeper China-Malaysia community building, Belt and Road cooperation and emerging industries.

tags.name_en: China-Malaysia Community with a Shared Future

tags_en: China-Malaysia Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见出席第七届辽洽会的外资企业港资企业民营企业嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Business Representatives Attending the 7th Liaoning International Economic and Trade Fair
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见出席第七届辽洽会的外资、港资和民营企业嘉宾代表，欢迎其深度参与辽宁全面振兴、扩大投资布局。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin met in Shenyang with foreign, Hong Kong and private enterprise representatives attending the 7th Liaoning International Economic and Trade Fair, inviting them to invest more in the province's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 王庆海参加市第十四次党代会新宾代表团讨论
articles.title_en: Wang Qinghai Attends Discussion of Xinbin Delegation at the 14th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，王庆海到抚顺市第十四次党代会新宾代表团参加讨论，围绕生态保护、文旅融合、乡村振兴、冰雪经济等共商落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Wang Qinghai joined the Xinbin delegation at Fushun's 14th Party Congress to discuss the municipal and discipline reports and local development measures.

articles.title_zh: 赵龙调研节日安全稳定和生产生活保障工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Long Inspects Holiday Safety, Stability and Livelihood Support Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，福建省委书记赵龙在福州调研中秋国庆假期安全稳定、生产生活保障和文旅市场供给等工作，要求抓实安全生产和民生保障。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Fujian Party Secretary Zhao Long inspected holiday safety, stability, livelihood support and tourism supply in Fuzhou ahead of the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, urging solid work on work safety and public wellbeing.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界航海装备大会省市联席会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial-Municipal Joint Meeting Held for the 2026 World Marine Equipment Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，2026世界航海装备大会省市联席会在福州召开，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁主持并讲话，部署大会冲刺阶段各项筹备工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, a provincial-municipal joint meeting on the 2026 World Marine Equipment Conference was held in Fuzhou, chaired by Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party Secretary, to finalize preparations for the event.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布修订后的《中华人民共和国审计法实施条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree to Publish Revised Regulations on Implementing the Audit Law
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布修订后的《中华人民共和国审计法实施条例》，自2026年12月1日起施行，共7章64条。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree promulgating the revised Regulations on Implementing the Audit Law of the People's Republic of China, effective Dec 1, 2026, comprising 7 chapters and 64 articles.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市第九次党代会主席团举行第二次第三次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of Huai'an 9th Party Congress Holds 2nd and 3rd Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，淮安市第九次党代会主席团举行第二、三次会议，顾坤作提名讲话，通过选举办法并确定市委、市纪委及省党代会代表候选人名单。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the presidium of the 9th CPC Huai'an City Congress held its second and third meetings, adopting election rules and confirming candidate lists for municipal Party and discipline committees.

articles.title_zh: 顾坤参加淮阴区淮安区代表团审议
articles.title_en: Gu Kun Joins Huaiyin and Huai'an District Delegations in Deliberations
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日、23日，顾坤分别到淮阴区、淮安区代表团，与代表们一起审议淮安市委报告和市纪委工作报告，强调以正确政绩观引领高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 22 and 23, Gu Kun joined the Huaiyin and Huai'an district delegations to review the municipal party committee report and the discipline inspection commission work report, urging high-quality development guided by a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 杨新忠参加盱眙县代表团、市直代表一团审议
articles.title_en: Yang Xinzhong Joins Panel Discussions with Xuyi County and Municipal Delegations
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日至23日，杨新忠在淮安市第九次党代会上先后参加盱眙县代表团和市直代表一团审议，强调落实党代会部署、推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22-23, Yang Xinzhong joined panel discussions with the Xuyi County delegation and the first municipal delegation at Huai'an's 9th Party Congress, urging implementation of the congress's plans and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在全市招商引资工作调度会上强调推动招商引资工作提质增效
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Stresses Improving Quality and Efficiency of Investment Attraction at Citywide Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日上午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡主持召开全市1至9月招商引资工作调度会，分析存在问题并部署下一阶段招商引资工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 24, Huang Wei, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Huaibei, chaired a citywide meeting reviewing investment attraction work for January-September and outlining next steps.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡主持召开全市1至9月招商引资工作调度会
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Chairs Citywide Investment Promotion Work Meeting for January-September
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日上午，市委副书记、代市长黄韡在淮北主持召开全市1至9月招商引资工作调度会，听取汇报、分析问题，推动招商引资工作再提速再提质。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 24, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the municipal party committee and acting mayor, chaired a citywide meeting in Huaibei on investment promotion work for January to September, reviewing reports and pressing for faster, higher-quality investment attraction.

articles.title_zh: 淮南市纪委十一届七次全会召开
articles.title_en: Huainan City Discipline Inspection Commission Holds 7th Plenary Session of 11th Term
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，淮南市纪委十一届七次全会在市政务中心召开，审议通过向市第十二次党代会的工作报告和全会决议，市纪委书记李家保主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, the 11th Huainan City Commission for Discipline Inspection held its 7th plenary session in Huainan, approving its work report to the city's 12th Party Congress; city discipline inspection chief Li Jiabao presided and spoke.

articles.title_en: Resolution of the 13th Plenary Session of the 11th Huainan Municipal Committee of the CPC
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月23日，中国共产党淮南市第十一届委员会第十三次全体会议在市政务中心举行，决定市第十二次党代会于9月26日召开，并审议通过相关工作报告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, 2026, the 13th plenary session of the 11th Huainan Municipal Committee of the CPC decided to convene the city's 12th Party Congress on Sept 26 and approved related work reports.

articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Autumn Agricultural Production, Stressing Solid Work to Secure a Bumper Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田赴章丘区调研督导“三秋”农业生产，要求抓紧抓实秋收秋种秋管，扛牢粮食安全责任。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian inspected autumn farming in Zhangqiu District, urging solid progress in autumn harvest, planting and field management to safeguard grain security.

articles.title_zh: 2026山东金秋消费季启动

articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，2026山东金秋消费季在济南市章丘区启动，省委书记林武出席，省长周乃翔致辞，将举办近2000场促消费活动。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, the 2026 Shandong Golden Autumn Consumption Season launched in Zhangqiu District, Jinan, with Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu attending and Governor Zhou Naixiang delivering a speech; nearly 2,000 consumption promotion events are planned.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保出席香港揭阳同乡社团总会中秋返乡活动
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Attends Mid-Autumn Homecoming Event of Hong Kong Jieyang Fellow Townsmen Association
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，香港揭阳同乡社团总会参访团在揭阳举行“潮侨聚故里 情义揭阳行”中秋返乡活动，市委书记曾风保出席并介绍揭阳经济社会发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, a delegation from the Hong Kong Jieyang Fellow Townsmen Association held a Mid-Autumn homecoming event in Jieyang, where Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao welcomed them and outlined the city's economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Jieyang Municipal Government Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组2026年第29次会议和七届市政府第158次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署中秋、国庆期间安全生产和消防安全等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 23, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie chaired the municipal government's 2026 Party Group meeting and the 158th Executive Meeting, relaying Xi Jinping's instructions and deploying safety production and fire safety work for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保出席香港揭阳同乡社团总会中秋返乡活动
articles.title_en: Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao Attends Mid-Autumn Homecoming Event of Hong Kong Jieyang Fellow Townsmen Association
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，揭阳市委书记曾风保出席香港揭阳同乡社团总会“潮侨聚故里 情义揭阳行”中秋返乡活动，与会长黄意生一行畅叙乡情、共话侨乡发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao attended a Mid-Autumn homecoming event held in Jieyang by the Hong Kong Jieyang Fellow Townsmen Association, meeting with its president Huang Yisheng and other members.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开揭阳市政府党组会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Jieyang Municipal Government Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组2026年第29次会议及七届市政府第158次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示批示精神，部署中秋国庆期间安全生产和消防安全等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 23, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie chaired the municipal government's 29th Party group meeting of 2026 and the 158th executive meeting, conveying instructions from Xi Jinping and deploying work on workplace safety and fire prevention for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 广东省产业园区标准化建设暨产业协作对接片区会在揭阳召开
articles.title_en: Guangdong Provincial Industrial Park Standardization and Industrial Collaboration Matchmaking Meeting Held in Jieyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，由广东省工业和信息化厅主办的2026年省产业园区标准化建设暨产业协作对接片区会（第二场）在揭阳召开，市长曲晓杰致辞，省工信厅一级巡视员吴红讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the second 2026 provincial meeting on industrial park standardization and industrial collaboration, hosted by Guangdong's Department of Industry and Information Technology, was held in Jieyang, with Mayor Qu Xiaojie speaking.

articles.summary_zh: 9月24日上午，国务院总理李强在杭州出席第五届全球数字贸易博览会启动仪式并致辞，就数字贸易开放合作提出主张。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 24, Premier Li Qiang attended the launch ceremony of the 5th Global Digital Trade Expo in Hangzhou and delivered a speech on open cooperation in digital trade.

articles.title_zh: 巴塔参加米林市代表团、巴宜区代表团讨论
articles.title_en: Bata Attends Discussions with Milin City and Bayi District Delegations
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，巴塔先后来到米林市、巴宜区代表团，与出席林芝市第三次党代会的代表互动交流并参加讨论。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Bata visited the Milin City and Bayi District delegations, joining discussions with representatives at the third Linzhi Municipal Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升看望慰问帕巴拉·格列朗杰等老同志
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Visits and Consoles Veteran Comrades Including Pagbalha Geleg Namgyai
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日上午，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨看望慰问全国政协副主席帕巴拉·格列朗杰和省级老领导巴桑，通报全区经济社会发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Tibet Party Secretary Hu Changsheng visited CPPCC Vice Chairman Pagbalha Geleg Namgyai and veteran leader Pasang in Lhasa to extend greetings and discuss regional development.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升出席西藏自治区党委组织部干部大会，徐芝文任自治区党委组织部部长
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Attends Tibet Party Committee Organization Department Cadre Meeting; Xu Zhiwen Appointed Department Head
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升在拉萨出席自治区党委组织部干部大会，宣读中央组织部文件，宣布徐芝文任自治区党委组织部部长。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Hu Changsheng attended a cadre meeting of the regional Party Committee's Organization Department in Lhasa, reading out a Central Organization Department document appointing Xu Zhiwen as its head.
