articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Presides as 12th Tibet People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes 25th Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，西藏自治区十二届人大常委会第二十五次会议在拉萨闭幕，严金海主持，会议表决通过多部地方性法规，并任命龚会才、李富忠为自治区人民政府副主席。
articles.summary_en: The 12th Tibet People's Congress Standing Committee closed its 25th session in Lhasa on Sept 23, chaired by Yan Jinhai, passing local regulations and appointing two regional government vice chairmen.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党林芝市第三次代表大会开幕
articles.title_en: Third Congress of the CPC Linzhi Municipal Committee Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日上午，中国共产党林芝市第三次代表大会在巴宜区开幕，巴塔代表二届市委作工作报告，总结过去五年成就并部署今后五年工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 23, the third congress of the CPC Linzhi Municipal Committee opened in Bayi District, where Bata delivered a work report reviewing the past five years and setting tasks for the next five.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅印发《“高效办成一件事”2026年度第二批重点事项清单》的通知
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues 2026 Second Batch List of Key Items for "Efficiently Handling One Matter"
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅印发通知，部署《“高效办成一件事”2026年度第二批重点事项清单》实施，要求在优化政务服务基础上向全国统一大市场、营商环境等领域拓展。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council General Office issued a notice on implementing the 2026 second batch of key items under the "Efficiently Handling One Matter" reform, urging broader rollout in government services, market integration and the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市人大常委会决定范德繁为代理市长
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Appoints Fan Defan as Acting Mayor
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，汕尾市八届人大常委会第四十九次会议决定任命范德繁为副市长并代理市长职务，逯峰主持会议并颁发任命书。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the Standing Committee of the 8th Shanwei Municipal People's Congress appointed Fan Defan as vice mayor and acting mayor at its 49th session, chaired by Lu Feng, who presented the appointment letter.

articles.title_zh: 朔州市委常委会召开会议 传达学习中央政治局会议精神
articles.title_en: Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Central Political Bureau Meeting Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，朔州市委书记王帅红主持市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，并部署全面从严治党、安全生产和社会稳定工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Shuozhou Party Secretary Wang Shuaihong chaired a municipal Party committee standing committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's remarks at the Central Political Bureau meeting and to deploy work on full and rigorous Party governance, workplace safety and social stability.

articles.title_zh: 泰安市委理论学习中心组举办习近平外交思想专题辅导报告会
articles.title_en: Tai'an Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Group Holds Special Report on Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月23日上午，泰安市委理论学习中心组举办习近平外交思想专题辅导报告会，邀请外交部政策规划司参赞刘振勇作报告，市委书记杨洪涛等出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, 2026, Tai'an's municipal Party Committee study group held a report on Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy, delivered by Foreign Ministry counselor Liu Zhenyong; Party Secretary Yang Hongtao attended.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党泰州市第七届委员会举行第一次全体会议
articles.title_en: CPC Taizhou Municipal Committee Holds First Plenary Session of Its 7th Term
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，中共泰州市第七届委员会举行第一次全体会议，选举姜冬冬为市委书记，李晖、周恒新为市委副书记，并产生新一届市委常务委员会委员。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 23, the 7th CPC Taizhou Municipal Committee held its first plenary session, electing Jiang Dongdong as Party secretary and Li Hui and Zhou Hengxin as deputy secretaries, along with new Standing Committee members.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党泰州市第七次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 7th CPC Taizhou Municipal Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，中国共产党泰州市第七次代表大会在泰州闭幕，姜冬冬主持闭幕式，大会选举产生新一届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员，并表决通过相关决议。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 23, the 7th CPC Taizhou Municipal Congress concluded in Taizhou, presided over by Jiang Dongdong. The congress elected new municipal Party committee and discipline inspection committee members and adopted related resolutions.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党泰州市第七次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 7th CPC Taizhou Municipal Congress Concludes Successfully
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，中国共产党泰州市第七次代表大会在泰州闭幕，差额选举产生新一届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员，姜冬冬主持闭幕式并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 23, the 7th Congress of the CPC Taizhou Municipal Committee closed in Taizhou, electing new municipal Party committee and discipline inspection commission members, with Jiang Dongdong presiding and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党泰州市第七届委员会举行第一次全体会议
articles.title_en: First Plenary Session of the 7th CPC Taizhou Municipal Committee Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，中共泰州市第七届委员会举行第一次全体会议，选举姜冬冬为市委书记，李晖、周恒新为市委副书记，并产生新一届市委常委。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 23, the 7th CPC Taizhou Municipal Committee held its first plenary session, electing Jiang Dongdong as party secretary and Li Hui and Zhou Hengxin as deputy secretaries.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍会见泰国驻青岛总领事商唐
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Meets Thai Consul General in Qingdao Shang Tang
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，威海市委副书记、市长孔凡萍会见泰国驻青岛总领事商唐一行，双方就经贸、文旅、城市交流等务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping met with Thai Consul General in Qingdao Shang Tang to discuss deeper cooperation in trade, tourism and city exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 芜湖市委十一届十二次全会召开 决定市第十二次党代会9月27日召开
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal Party Committee Holds 12th Plenary Session, Sets 12th Party Congress for Sept 27
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，中共芜湖市第十一届委员会第十二次全体会议举行，市委书记徐志讲话。全会审议通过市委、市纪委工作报告，决定市第十二次党代会于9月27日召开。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the 12th plenary session of the 11th Wuhu Municipal Party Committee was held with Party Secretary Xu Zhi speaking. It approved work reports and set the city's 12th Party Congress for Sept 27.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰主持市委专题会议 部署对口援疆工作
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Chairs Municipal Party Committee Meeting on Pairing Assistance to Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰主持召开市委专题会议，听取援疆工作汇报，部署产业、民生、智力、文化援疆等下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie chaired a special municipal Party committee meeting to review aid-to-Xinjiang work and plan next steps in industrial, livelihood, talent and cultural assistance.

articles.title_zh: 2026新乡市文化旅游发展大会召开
articles.title_en: 2026 Xinxiang Cultural Tourism Development Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，2026新乡市文化旅游发展大会召开，市委书记魏建平出席并讲话，市长陈维忠主持，部署加快建设文旅强市、把文旅产业培育为支柱产业。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Xinxiang held its 2026 Cultural Tourism Development Conference, where Party Secretary Wei Jianping spoke and Mayor Chen Weizhong presided, vowing to build the city into a cultural tourism hub.

articles.title_zh: 徐光华到延津县宣讲市第十三次党代会精神并调研
articles.title_en: Xu Guanghua Visits Yanjin County to Explain Party Congress Spirit and Conduct Research
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，新乡市委常委、组织部部长徐光华到延津县宣讲市第十三次党代会精神，并就信访稳定、“三秋”生产、经济运行和“四下基层”党建联系点等工作开展调研。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee member and Organization Department head Xu Guanghua visited Yanjin County to explain the spirit of the city's 13th Party Congress and inspect work on petition stability, autumn production, economic operations and grassroots Party building.

articles.title_zh: 高新区召开城市社区建设运行座谈会
articles.title_en: High-tech Zone Holds Symposium on Urban Community Construction and Operation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，高新区召开城市社区建设运行座谈会，党工委委员、纪工委书记宋志强主持并讲话，部署党建引领基层治理等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Xuchang High-tech Zone held a symposium on urban community construction and operation, chaired by discipline inspection chief Song Zhiqiang, to plan Party-led grassroots governance tasks.

articles.title_zh: 高新区召开安全生产暨强基固本“六项机制”工作推进会
articles.title_en: Xuchang High-tech Zone Holds Meeting on Work Safety and the 'Six Mechanisms' for Strengthening Foundations
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日上午，许昌高新区召开安全生产暨强基固本“六项机制”工作推进会，部署双节期间安全隐患排查整治与基层安全治理责任落实。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 23, Xuchang High-tech Zone held a meeting on work safety and the 'six mechanisms' for strengthening foundations, deploying hazard inspections for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 范耀江到部分企业调研安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Fan Yaojiang Inspects Enterprises on Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，县委书记范耀江到县开发区部分企业调研安全生产工作，宣讲市、县党代会精神，强调压实各方责任、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, county party secretary Fan Yaojiang inspected enterprises in the county development zone on work safety, urging strict accountability and firm safety bottom lines.

articles.title_zh: 烟台市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究经济运行情况
articles.title_en: Yantai Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on Economic Performance and Key Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，烟台市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究经济运行情况，部署冲刺四季度重点工作，市委书记江成主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the Yantai Municipal Party Standing Committee met to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and directives, review economic performance and arrange key tasks for the fourth quarter, with Party Secretary Jiang Cheng presiding.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市召开科技创新“十五五”规划专家论证会
articles.title_en: Yangjiang City Holds Expert Review Meeting on 15th Five-Year Plan for Science and Technology Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，阳江市科技局召开《阳江市科技创新“十五五”规划》专家论证会，专家组原则同意通过论证。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 22, the Yangjiang Municipal Science and Technology Bureau held an expert review meeting on the city's 15th Five-Year Plan for science and technology innovation, with the expert panel approving the plan in principle.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委常委会会议研究经济、安全生产与教育工作
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Studies Economy, Safety and Education
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，阳江市委书记卢一先主持召开市委常委会会议，研判前三季度经济运行，部署安全生产、蚊媒传染病防控和基础教育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Yangjiang Party Secretary Lu Yixian chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee to review economic performance for the first three quarters and deploy work on safety, mosquito-borne disease control and basic education.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研“三农”及农民丰收节有关工作开展情况
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Agriculture, Rural Areas and Farmers Work and Farmers' Harvest Festival Activities
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，银川市委书记赵旭辉赴贺兰县调研“三农”及农民丰收节工作开展情况，强调发展现代都市农业、扎实推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui inspected agriculture, rural areas and farmers work and Farmers' Harvest Festival activities in Helan County, urging modern urban agriculture and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 营口市35家企业携百余种展品亮相第七届中国辽宁国际投资贸易洽谈会
articles.title_en: Yingkou's 35 Companies Showcase Products at 7th China Liaoning International Investment and Trade Fair
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，第七届中国辽宁国际投资贸易洽谈会在沈阳开幕，营口市组织35家企业携百余种展品参展，并与比亚迪、苏商建设集团签署合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, the 7th China Liaoning International Investment and Trade Fair opened in Shenyang, where Yingkou organized 35 companies to exhibit products and signed cooperation agreements with BYD and Sushang Construction Group.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会召开第四十二次会议
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 42nd Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，营口市十七届人大常委会召开第四十二次会议，审议政府债务管理、主城区交通管理、文旅体商融合发展等报告，并表决通过人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the Standing Committee of the Yingkou Municipal People's Congress held its 42nd meeting, reviewing reports on government debt, urban traffic and tourism-commerce integration, and approving personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 李强出席2026年世界技能大会开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends Opening Ceremony of 2026 World Skills Conference and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日上午，国务院总理李强在上海出席2026年世界技能大会开幕式并致辞，强调培育劳动者技能优势、深化国际技能交流合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Skills Conference in Shanghai and delivered remarks on building workers' skills and deepening international skills cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 市第九次党代会主席团举行第四次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of the 9th Yueyang Municipal Party Congress Holds Fourth Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日晚，中国共产党岳阳市第九次代表大会主席团举行第四次会议，由谢卫江主持，通过了新一届市委委员、候补委员、市纪委委员及出席省第十三次党代会代表的正式选举名单和相关决议草案。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 23, the presidium of the 9th CPC Yueyang Municipal Congress held its fourth meeting, chaired by Xie Weijiang, approving the final candidate lists for the new municipal Party committee, discipline commission and provincial congress delegates, as well as related draft resolutions.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市第九次党代会主席团举行第三次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of Ninth Yueyang Municipal Party Congress Holds Third Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，中国共产党岳阳市第九次代表大会主席团举行第三次会议，谢卫江主持，通过市委委员、市纪委委员及省党代会代表候选人预选名单。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the presidium of the 9th CPC Yueyang Municipal Congress held its third meeting, chaired by Xie Weijiang, approving candidate lists for municipal and provincial party posts.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江参加云溪区、岳阳临港高新区代表团和岳阳楼区代表团讨论
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Joins Panel Discussions with Yunxi District, Yueyang Port High-Tech Zone and Yueyanglou District Delegations
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日上午，谢卫江到岳阳市第九次党代会云溪区、岳阳临港高新区代表团和岳阳楼区代表团，与代表们一同讨论市委报告和市纪委工作报告。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 23, Xie Weijiang joined delegations from Yunxi District, the Yueyang Port High-Tech Zone and Yueyanglou District at the 9th Yueyang Municipal Party Congress to discuss the municipal Party committee report and the discipline inspection commission report.

articles.title_zh: 广东省2026年水生生物增殖放流活动在湛江举行
articles.title_en: Guangdong's 2026 Aquatic Stock Enhancement and Release Event Held in Zhanjiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，广东省2026年水生生物增殖放流活动在湛江坡头区丰收海岸举行，放流鱼虾及珍稀物种，助力现代化海洋牧场建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Guangdong's 2026 aquatic stock enhancement and release event was held in Potou District, Zhanjiang, releasing fish, shrimp and rare species to support modern marine ranching.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅主持湛江经开区、海关特殊监管区域高质量发展工作会议
articles.title_en: Li Yongyi Chairs Meeting on High-Quality Development of Zhanjiang Economic Development Zones and Customs-Supervised Areas
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，湛江市委副书记、市长李勇毅主持召开湛江经开区、海关特殊监管区域高质量发展工作会议，部署推动全市对外开放平台提质增效、扩能升级。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired a meeting on high-quality development of the city's economic development zones and customs-supervised areas, aiming to upgrade its opening-up platforms.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开全市中秋、国庆假期安全防范工作会议并赴香洲区督导检查
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Citywide Meeting on Holiday Safety Precautions, Inspects Xiangzhou District
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，珠海市市长吴泽桐主持召开全市中秋、国庆假期安全防范工作会议，并赴香洲区督导检查安全生产措施落实情况。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong chaired a citywide meeting on safety precautions for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays and inspected Xiangzhou District for workplace safety compliance.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委常委会召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日上午，山东省委常委会召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究审议全面深化改革等事项，省委书记林武主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 24, the Shandong Provincial Party Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and review reform matters, chaired by Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Implementing Xi Jinping's Key Speech Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，福州市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究金砖合作、平安福州建设与节日文旅促消费等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning chaired a municipal standing committee meeting to implement Xi Jinping's recent speeches, covering BRICS cooperation, public security and holiday spending.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委常委会召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日上午，山东省委常委会召开扩大会议，省委书记林武主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示和全国先进制造业大会精神，审议产业工人队伍建设改革、国资国企改革等实施方案。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 24, the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting chaired by Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions and the spirit of the National Conference on Advanced Manufacturing, and reviewing reform plans on industrial workers and state-owned enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研督导安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Workplace Safety in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日下午，青岛市委书记曾赞荣以“四不两直”方式赴装饰城、码头、住宅小区调研督导安全生产工作，要求压实责任、防范安全事故，营造平安祥和节日环境。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 24, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong made unannounced inspections of workplace safety at a decoration market, a wharf and a residential community, urging stricter accountability and accident prevention ahead of the holidays.

articles.title_zh: 文旅部：将大力繁荣互联网条件下的新大众文艺
articles.title_en: Culture and Tourism Ministry: China to Boost New Mass Arts in the Internet Era
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，文旅部新闻发言人陈彬斌在国新办发布会上表示，“十五五”时期将优化文化设施布局、丰富公共文化服务，大力繁荣互联网条件下的新大众文艺。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Culture and Tourism Ministry spokesperson Chen Binbin said at a State Council Information Office briefing that China will improve public cultural services and boost new mass arts online in the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 中秋假期预计全社会跨区域人员流动量将达6.5亿人次
articles.title_en: Mid-Autumn Holiday Cross-Region Travel Expected to Reach 650 Million Trips
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国务院新闻办公室举行新闻发布会，交通运输部副部长李扬表示，中秋假期预计全社会跨区域人员流动量将达6.5亿人次，以返乡探亲、周边出游为主。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing on Sept 24, Vice Minister of Transport Li Yang said cross-region travel during the Mid-Autumn holiday is expected to reach 650 million trips, mainly family visits and nearby trips.

articles.title_zh: 文旅部：将支持稀有剧种创作演出，建立中小型剧目专项扶持机制
articles.title_en: Culture and Tourism Ministry to Support Rare Opera Genres, Create Special Funding for Smaller Productions
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，文旅部新闻发言人陈彬斌表示，“十五五”时期将支持稀有剧种创作演出，建立中小型剧目专项扶持机制，并完善艺术人才选拔培养激励机制。
articles.summary_en: At a Sept. 24 State Council Information Office briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan, Culture and Tourism Ministry spokesperson Chen Binbin said the ministry will support the creation and staging of rare opera genres, set up dedicated funding for small and mid-sized productions, and improve selection and training incentives for arts talent.

articles.title_zh: 整顿“僵尸型”社会组织，浙江温州推出行业协会商会强制注销政策
articles.title_en: Wenzhou, Zhejiang Introduces Mandatory Deregistration Policy for Defunct Trade Associations
articles.summary_zh: 温州市民政局与市委社会工作部联合印发《温州市行业协会商会强制注销登记实施指引（试行）》，自2026年10月15日起施行，明确强制注销的条件、程序与责任单位。
articles.summary_en: Wenzhou's Civil Affairs Bureau and Party social work department issued trial guidelines for the mandatory deregistration of trade associations, effective Oct. 15, 2026, setting conditions, procedures and responsible bodies.

tags.name_en: Social Work Department of the Wenzhou Municipal Party Committee
Trade Associations and Chambers of Commerce

tags_en: Social Work Department of the Wenzhou Municipal Party Committee
Trade Associations and Chambers of Commerce

articles.title_zh: 隆平高科：已终止授予隆平米业的“袁隆平”商标使用许可
articles.title_en: Longping High-Tech: "Yuan Longping" Trademark License Granted to Longping Rice Has Been Terminated
articles.summary_zh: 隆平高科发表声明称，自2023年起不再向任何主体授予大米业务领域的“袁隆平”商标使用许可，并已退出隆平米业全部股权，双方不存在股权或关联关系。
articles.summary_en: Longping High-Tech said in a statement that since 2023 it has granted no license for the "Yuan Longping" trademark in the rice business, has exited all equity in Longping Rice, and that the two companies have no equity or affiliated relationship.

articles.title_zh: 新任青海省委书记罗东川首次调研：要讲好“生命树”故事
articles.title_en: New Qinghai Party Secretary Luo Dongchuan's First Inspection: Tell the 'Tree of Life' Story
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，新任青海省委书记罗东川开展首次调研，走访省生态环境监测中心、黄河上游水电公司科创中心及互助县班彦村，强调守护生态、发展清洁能源与推进乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: In his first inspection tour as Qinghai Party Secretary, Luo Dongchuan visited an ecological monitoring center, a hydropower and clean energy research hub and Ban'yan Village, urging stronger protection of the 'Chinese Water Tower' and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 哈工大党委原书记、机器人技术专家吴林逝世，享年92岁
articles.title_en: Wu Lin, Robotics Expert and Former HIT Party Secretary, Dies at 92
articles.summary_zh: 我国著名焊接专家、机器人技术专家、哈尔滨工业大学党委原书记吴林，于2026年9月23日在苏州因病逝世，享年92岁，曾为神舟系列飞船等国家重大工程作出贡献。
articles.summary_en: Wu Lin, a renowned welding and robotics expert and former Party secretary of Harbin Institute of Technology, died in Suzhou on Sept 23, 2026, aged 92; he contributed to the Shenzhou spacecraft program.

articles.title_zh: 文旅部：将加强人工智能应用、数字文化等重点标准制定
articles.title_en: Ministry of Culture and Tourism to Strengthen Standards for AI Applications and Digital Culture
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”新闻发布会，文旅部产业发展司司长缪沐阳表示，“十五五”时期将推进文旅与科技深度融合，加强人工智能应用、数字文化等重点标准制定，并支持国内单位参与国际标准制修订。
articles.summary_en: At a Sept 24 State Council Information Office briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan, Ministry of Culture and Tourism official Miao Muyang said the ministry will deepen culture-tourism-technology integration and strengthen standards for AI applications and digital culture, while backing Chinese participation in international standards setting.

articles.title_zh: 王沪宁主持召开全国政协主席会议
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Chairs CPPCC National Committee Chairpersons' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，全国政协主席王沪宁在北京主持召开政协第十四届全国委员会第五十六次主席会议并讲话，会议决定11月上旬在京召开常委会第十九次会议。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, Wang Huning, Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, chaired the 56th Chairpersons' Meeting of the 14th CPPCC National Committee in Beijing and delivered remarks; the meeting decided to convene the 19th Standing Committee session in Beijing in early November.

articles.title_zh: 文旅部介绍“十五五”时期推动旅游业发展的重点举措
articles.title_en: China's Culture and Tourism Ministry Outlines Measures to Boost Tourism in the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”新闻发布会，文化和旅游部资源开发司司长满宏卫介绍《旅游强国建设“十五五”规划》的重点任务举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, the State Council Information Office held a press briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan, where Man Hongwei of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism outlined key measures in the plan to build China into a tourism powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 文旅部：将深入实施中国传统节日振兴工程，让老百姓过节有滋有味
articles.title_en: Culture and Tourism Ministry to Deepen Traditional Chinese Festival Revitalization Program
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，文化和旅游部副部长王建华在国新办发布会上介绍“十五五”非遗保护举措，将开展第二次全国非遗普查并实施中国传统节日振兴工程。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 24, Vice Minister Wang Jianhua told a State Council briefing that China will launch a second national intangible heritage survey and deepen its traditional festival revival program.

articles.title_zh: 重庆将实施“十大行动”提升巴蜀文化旅游走廊建设能级
articles.title_en: Chongqing to Launch "Ten Actions" to Upgrade Bashu Cultural Tourism Corridor
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，重庆市六届人大常委会第二十七次会议分组审议市政府关于巴蜀文化旅游走廊特色创新发展情况的报告，重庆将实施能级提升“十大行动”。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Chongqing's municipal people's congress reviewed a government report on the Bashu Cultural Tourism Corridor, with the city set to roll out "Ten Actions" to upgrade it.

articles.title_zh: “商业信用指数1.0”编制说明发布会在渝召开
articles.title_en: Briefing on 'Commercial Credit Index 1.0' Released in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，商业信用中心在重庆发布“商业信用指数1.0”编制说明，解读指数七个维度、数据来源及应用场景，服务全国统一大市场与社会信用体系建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the Commercial Credit Center unveiled the compilation explanation for 'Commercial Credit Index 1.0' in Chongqing, detailing its seven dimensions, data sources and uses in support of China's unified market and social credit system.

articles.title_zh: 广西实施漓江山水工程 擦亮绿色生态底色
articles.title_en: Guangxi Implements Lijiang Landscape Project to Enhance Green Ecological Foundation
articles.summary_zh: 2022年6月入选国家山水林田湖草沙一体化保护修复工程的漓江山水工程总投资54.91亿元，涉及12个县（市、区），布局83个子项目，目前所有子项目均已完工，漓江流域生态功能整体提升。
articles.summary_en: The Lijiang landscape, forest, farmland, lake, grassland and desert integrated protection and restoration project in Guilin, Guangxi, selected in June 2022 as a national pilot, has completed all 83 sub-projects under a total investment of 5.491 billion yuan, markedly improving the ecological condition of the Lijiang River basin.
keywords: 山水林田湖草沙一体化治理

tags.name_zh: 山水林田湖草沙一体化治理

tags_zh: 山水林田湖草沙一体化治理

articles.title_zh: 广西面向东盟脑机接口科研平台开工建设
articles.title_en: Guangxi Breaks Ground on ASEAN-Facing Brain-Computer Interface Research Platform
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，广西科学院脑机接口东盟实验室开工暨中国—东盟脑机接口产业总部基地筹建启动仪式在南宁五象新区举行，标志广西在脑机接口前沿科技领域实现布局。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, the Guangxi Academy of Sciences launched construction of its ASEAN Brain-Computer Interface Laboratory and the China-ASEAN BCI Industry Headquarters Base in Nanning, marking a breakthrough layout in the frontier field.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中出席2026年中国农民丰收节全国主场活动
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Attends National Main Event of 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中9月21日至23日到湖北调研，出席2026年中国农民丰收节全国主场活动，强调抓好秋粮生产、推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: Liu Guozhong, Political Bureau member and Vice Premier, inspected Hubei from Sept 21-23 and attended the national main event of the 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, urging efforts on autumn grain production and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 罗文在2026空天信息和卫星互联网创新发展大会上强调：推动空天信息和卫星互联网产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Stresses High-Quality Development of Aerospace Information and Satellite Internet Industries at 2026 Innovation Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，河北省委书记罗文在雄安新区出席2026空天信息和卫星互联网创新发展大会并讲话，强调培育符合新区实际的现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Luo Wen, Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, addressed the 2026 Aerospace Information and Satellite Internet Innovation Conference in Xiongan New Area, urging high-quality industrial development and a modern industrial system suited to the area.

articles.title_zh: 一批优质产业项目签约落地海南
articles.title_en: Batch of Quality Industrial Projects Signed and Landed in Hainan
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，2026世界新能源汽车大会新闻发布会在海南举行，海南依托大会平台推动一批新能源汽车项目集中签约落地，覆盖制造、测试、氢能应用、数据跨境等领域。
articles.summary_en: At a Sept 23 press conference for the 2026 World New Energy Vehicle Congress in Hainan, a batch of new energy vehicle projects were signed, covering manufacturing, testing, hydrogen applications and cross-border data.

articles.title_zh: 省纪委发布节前提醒：持之以恒正风肃纪 确保中秋国庆期间风清气正
articles.title_en: Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection Issues Pre-Holiday Notice on Upholding Discipline and Integrity During Mid-Autumn and National Day Festivals
articles.summary_zh: 日前，海南省纪委发布通知，要求持之以恒正风肃纪，严防节日期间“四风”问题反弹，确保中秋国庆期间风清气正，为海南自由贸易港建设提供作风保障。
articles.summary_en: The Hainan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection issued a notice urging persistent efforts to enforce discipline and curb the "four forms of decadence" during the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, to support the Hainan Free Trade Port's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 2026年中国农民丰收节海南庆祝活动在乐东启幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival Celebration Opens in Hainan's Ledong
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，2026年中国农民丰收节海南庆祝活动在乐东黎族自治县启幕，省委副书记杨晋柏出席并宣读习近平总书记节日祝贺，随后调研农业产业与高标准农田建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival celebration in Hainan opened in Ledong, where provincial deputy party secretary Yang Jinbo read Xi Jinping's festive greetings and inspected farm projects.

articles.title_zh: 我国在文昌成功发射卫星互联网低轨26组卫星
articles.title_en: China Successfully Launches 26th Group of Low-Orbit Satellite Internet Satellites in Wenchang
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日21时32分，我国在海南商业航天发射场用长征八号甲运载火箭成功发射卫星互联网低轨26组卫星，卫星顺利入轨，任务圆满成功。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23 at 21:32, China launched the 26th group of low-orbit satellite internet satellites from the Hainan Commercial Space Launch Site via a Long March-8A rocket, successfully placing them in orbit.

articles.title_zh: 中国少年先锋队黑龙江省第九次代表大会开幕
articles.title_en: Ninth Congress of the Heilongjiang Provincial Young Pioneers of China Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，中国少年先锋队黑龙江省第九次代表大会在哈尔滨开幕，省委书记许勤致贺信，省委副书记刘惠出席并讲话，大会为优秀少先队员、辅导员和集体代表颁奖。
articles.summary_en: On September 24, the ninth congress of the Heilongjiang Provincial Young Pioneers of China opened in Harbin, where provincial Party Secretary Xu Qin sent a congratulatory letter and Deputy Party Secretary Liu Hui attended and spoke; awards were given to outstanding Young Pioneers, counselors and collectives.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省政府召开党组（扩大）会议暨常务会议
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Holds Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月24日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府党组（扩大）会议暨常务会议，传达学习习近平关于发展先进制造业重要指示，审议通过省教育发展“十五五”规划，研究低空经济工作。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a Sept 24 provincial government meeting on Xi Jinping's advanced manufacturing instructions and education and low-altitude economy plans.

articles.title_zh: 促进能源绿色转型与供应保障
articles.title_en: Promoting Green Energy Transition and Supply Security
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，5名能源领域代表围绕促进能源绿色转型与供应保障与中外记者交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the State Council Information Office held a press conference in Beijing where five energy-sector representatives met Chinese and foreign journalists to discuss green energy transition and supply security.

articles.title_zh: 第七届中国辽宁国际投资贸易洽谈会开幕
articles.title_en: 7th China Liaoning International Investment and Trade Fair Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，以“开放新动能 振兴新篇章”为主题的第七届中国辽宁国际投资贸易洽谈会在沈阳开幕，全国政协副主席周强宣布开幕并讲话，辽宁省委书记许昆林等致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, the 7th China Liaoning International Investment and Trade Fair opened in Shenyang under the theme "New Momentum for Opening Up, A New Chapter for Revitalization," with CPPCC National Committee Vice Chairman Zhou Qiang declaring it open and Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin delivering remarks.

tags.name_en: National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

tags_en: National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

articles.title_zh: 辽宁江苏产业合作交流对接会在沈阳举行
articles.title_en: Liaoning-Jiangsu Industrial Cooperation Matchmaking Conference Held in Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，辽宁江苏产业合作交流对接会在沈阳举行，江苏省省长刘小涛、辽宁省省长王新伟出席，现场签约协议投资金额超20亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the Liaoning-Jiangsu industrial cooperation conference was held in Shenyang, attended by Governors Liu Xiaotao and Wang Xinwei, with projects worth over 2 billion yuan signed.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古“十五五”铁路发展规划印发
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Railway Development
articles.summary_zh: 经内蒙古自治区人民政府同意，内蒙古交通运输厅印发《内蒙古自治区“十五五”铁路发展规划》，提出到2030年高铁里程达1200公里以上、所有盟市通动车等目标。
articles.summary_en: With the approval of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Government, the region's Transport Department issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for railway development, targeting over 1,200 km of high-speed rail and rail access for all league cities by 2030.

tags.name_en: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Transport Department

tags_en: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Transport Department

articles.title_zh: 青海出台机关事务管理条例 规范办公用房、公务用车与经费管理
articles.title_en: Qinghai Enacts Regulation on Government Office Affairs Management
articles.summary_zh: 青海省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议审议通过《青海省机关事务管理条例》，共七章三十九条，自2027年1月1日起施行，规范办公用房、公务用车、资产与经费管理。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th Qinghai Provincial People's Congress approved the Qinghai Provincial Regulation on Government Office Affairs Management, a seven-chapter, 39-article rule taking effect on Jan 1, 2027, covering office space, official vehicles, assets and funding.

articles.title_zh: 纪念长征胜利90周年实践教育活动在班玛启动
articles.title_en: Educational Events Marking 90th Anniversary of Long March Victory Launch in Baima
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年“六个一”系列实践教育活动在青海果洛藏族自治州班玛县启动，党员干部、红军后代与青年学生开展沉浸式红色研学。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, a "six-in-one" series of educational events marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory launched in Baima County, Golog Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Qinghai, with officials, Red Army descendants and students attending immersive red-education sessions.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致第48届世界技能大赛贺信激励广大技能劳动者
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter to 48th WorldSkills Competition Inspires Skilled Workers
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，习近平主席向第48届世界技能大赛致贺信，勉励更多劳动者特别是青年人走技能成才之路，在参赛人员和广大技能劳动者中引发热烈反响。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 48th WorldSkills Competition, urging more workers, especially young people, to pursue careers through skills, drawing warm responses from participants and skilled workers.

articles.title_zh: 促进能源绿色转型与供应保障
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Briefing on Green Energy Transition and Supply Security
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，5名能源领域代表围绕能源绿色转型与供应保障与中外记者交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where five energy-sector representatives discussed China's green energy transition and energy supply security with Chinese and foreign journalists.

articles.title_zh: 国务院新闻办发布会介绍加快推进教育强国建设情况
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Briefing on Accelerating Education Powerhouse Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，教育部副部长王光彦等介绍加快推进教育强国建设有关情况，涉及“双一流”高校本科扩容等举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on implementing the 15th Five-Year Plan and accelerating China's development as an education powerhouse, with Vice Minister of Education Wang Guangyan outlining goals including expanded undergraduate enrollment at Double First-Class universities.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”民政事业有这些重点
articles.title_en: China Outlines Key Priorities for Civil Affairs in the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列发布会，民政部部长李常官等介绍“十五五”时期养老服务、社会救助、儿童福利与慈善监管等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, China's State Council Information Office held a briefing on civil affairs priorities for the 15th Five-Year Plan, covering elderly care, social assistance, child welfare and charity oversight.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升出席西藏自治区党委组织部干部大会 徐芝文任组织部部长
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Attends Tibet Party Committee Organization Department Cadre Meeting; Xu Zhiwen Appointed Department Head
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，西藏自治区党委书记胡昌升出席自治区党委组织部干部大会并讲话，会议宣布经中央组织部同意，徐芝文任西藏自治区党委组织部部长。

articles.summary_en: Henan is advancing its 'three-chain synergy' approach — extending the grain industrial chain, raising product value and connecting production with sales — to upgrade deep processing of wheat and peanuts and better integrate into China's unified national market.

articles.title_zh: 我国将培育更多旅游名县和“宝藏小城”

articles.summary_en: Vice Minister of Culture and Tourism Wang Jianhua said China's cultural industry revenue hit 20.8 trillion yuan in 2025, up 8.4% yearly on average under the 14th Five-Year Plan, with 6.52 billion domestic trips.

articles.summary_en: Responding to an annual report by the European Commission and the EU High Representative that criticized Hong Kong's freedoms, human rights and rule of law, a spokesperson for the Chinese Foreign Ministry's Commissioner's Office in the HKSAR expressed strong dissatisfaction and firm opposition, stressing that Hong Kong affairs are purely China's internal matters.

articles.summary_en: At a regular press conference in Beijing on September 23, Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson Zhu Fenglian addressed cross-strait youth exchanges, mainland policies benefiting Taiwan, and the Chinese Taipei delegation at the World Skills Competition.

articles.title_en: Kunming's 13th Party Congress Opens, Laying Out a 2035 Development Vision
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，中国共产党昆明市第十三次代表大会在昆明开幕，市委书记刘洪建作报告，提出到2035年昆明国际影响力、周边辐射力显著增强，在全省率先基本实现社会主义现代化。
articles.summary_en: The 13th Party Congress of Kunming opened on Sept 22, where municipal Party secretary Liu Hongjian delivered a report setting the goal of markedly boosting the city's international influence and regional reach by 2035 and taking the lead in Yunnan in basically achieving socialist modernization.

articles.title_zh: 中国警队赴塞尔维亚执行警务联合巡逻任务
articles.title_en: Chinese Police Team Departs for Serbia on Joint Patrol Mission
articles.summary_zh: 应塞尔维亚内务部邀请，中国公安部组建中塞警务联合巡逻警队，9月22日赴塞执行为期三周的联合巡逻任务，系中方第3次赴塞开展此类任务。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Serbia's Interior Ministry, China's Ministry of Public Security dispatched a joint police patrol team to Serbia on Sept 22 for a three-week mission, the third such deployment.

articles.title_zh: 2026北京文化论坛开幕 李书磊出席并发表主旨演讲
articles.title_en: 2026 Beijing Culture Forum Opens; Li Shulei Attends and Delivers Keynote Speech
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，北京文化论坛在京开幕，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并发表主旨演讲，北京市委书记尹力致辞。论坛以“文化遗产与文明互鉴”为主题，由中宣部和北京市委、市政府共同主办，44个国家和地区的600多位嘉宾出席。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Beijing Culture Forum opened in Beijing on Sept 22, 2026. Li Shulei, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and head of the Publicity Department, delivered a keynote speech, and Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li also addressed the forum, which focuses on cultural heritage and mutual learning among civilizations.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向全国广大农民和工作在“三农”战线上的同志们致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Festive Greetings to Farmers Nationwide and Workers on the Agriculture, Rural Areas and Farmers Front
articles.summary_zh: 在第九个中国农民丰收节到来之际，习近平代表党中央于9月22日向全国农民和“三农”战线工作者致以节日祝贺，强调扎实推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the ninth Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, Xi Jinping, on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, sent festive greetings on September 22 to farmers nationwide and workers on the agriculture, rural areas and farmers front, stressing steady progress in all-round rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 西藏等3省区党委主要负责同志职务调整
articles.title_en: Party Chief Positions Adjusted in Tibet and Two Other Provincial-Level Regions
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央决定调整西藏、甘肃、青海三省区党委主要负责人：胡昌升任西藏自治区党委书记，吴晓军任甘肃省委书记，罗东川任青海省委书记。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee adjusted the top Party posts in three provincial-level regions: Hu Changsheng becomes Party Secretary of Tibet, Wu Xiaojun of Gansu, and Luo Dongchuan of Qinghai.

articles.title_zh: “伟大的远征——纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年主题展览”开幕式在京举行
articles.title_en: Cai Qi Attends Opening of Exhibition Marking 90th Anniversary of the Long March Victory in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，纪念中国工农红军长征胜利90周年主题展览开幕式在北京中国人民革命军事博物馆举行，蔡奇出席发表讲话并宣布展览开幕。
articles.summary_en: Cai Qi, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Secretariat of the CPC Central Committee, spoke and declared open an exhibition marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory at the Military Museum of the Chinese People's Revolution in Beijing on the morning of Sept 22.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥会见哈萨克斯坦第一副总理纳利巴耶夫
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Kazakh First Deputy Prime Minister Nalibayev
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在北京会见哈萨克斯坦第一副总理纳利巴耶夫，双方就落实两国元首共识、深化贸易投资、人工智能、绿色矿产等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 22, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Vice Premier of the State Council, met in Beijing with Kazakh First Deputy Prime Minister Nalibayev to discuss implementing their leaders' consensus and deepening cooperation in trade, investment, AI and green minerals.

articles.title_zh: 李强在上海调研时强调：加快培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业，持续做大做强先进制造业
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Stresses Faster Development of Emerging and Future Industries and a Stronger Advanced Manufacturing Sector During Shanghai Inspection Tour
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国务院总理李强在上海调研，走访上海电气国家人工智能应用中试基地和上海未来启点社区，强调推进“人工智能+制造”、培育新兴产业和未来产业。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Premier Li Qiang inspected Shanghai, visiting an AI application pilot base and a future-industry incubation community, urging deeper integration of AI with manufacturing and faster cultivation of emerging and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 8月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题29171起
articles.title_en: China Disciplines 29,171 Cases of Violating the Central Eight-Point Regulation in August
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委9月22日通报，8月全国共查处违反中央八项规定精神问题29171起，批评教育和处理35901人，其中党纪政务处分24494人。
articles.summary_en: The Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission reported on Sept 22 that 29,171 cases of violating the Central Eight-Point Regulation were investigated nationwide in August, with 35,901 people reprimanded or handled and 24,494 given Party or administrative punishment.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见柬埔寨国王西哈莫尼和太后莫尼列
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets Cambodian King Sihamoni and Queen Mother Monineath
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见柬埔寨国王西哈莫尼和太后莫尼列，双方表示将推动新时代全天候中柬命运共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Vice President Han Zheng met in Beijing with Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Queen Mother Monineath, with both sides pledging to advance the China-Cambodia community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 答好保障粮食安全这个“永恒课题”
articles.title_en: Answering Well the “Eternal Task” of Safeguarding Food Security
articles.summary_zh: 秋分将至，新华社刊文回顾习近平总书记多次深入田间地头考察粮食生产，强调保障国家粮食安全是永恒课题，任何时候这根弦都不能松。
articles.summary_en: With the autumn equinox approaching, Xinhua reviews Xi Jinping's repeated field inspections of grain production, stressing that food security is an eternal task and the issue must never be taken lightly.

articles.title_zh: 陈晓勇牛恺会见陕旅集团董事长刘小强一行
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaoyong and Niu Kai Meet with Shaanxi Tourism Group Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，宝鸡市委书记陈晓勇、市长牛恺会见陕旅集团董事长刘小强、总经理陈小军一行，就推动文旅产业高质量发展座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Baoji Party Secretary Chen Xiaoyong and Mayor Niu Kai met with Shaanxi Tourism Group Chairman Liu Xiaoqiang and General Manager Chen Xiaojun to discuss high-quality development of the cultural tourism industry.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议闭幕 许昆林出席并讲话
articles.title_en: 25th Session of Liaoning Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes; Xu Kunlin Attends and Addresses Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，辽宁省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议在沈阳闭幕，省委书记、省人大常委会主任许昆林出席并讲话，会议表决通过多项地方性法规，并决定任命任开斌为省政府副省长。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the 25th session of the Liaoning Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee closed in Shenyang. Xu Kunlin attended and spoke as local regulations were adopted and Ren Kaibin was appointed vice governor.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚到沈北新区调研航空航天产业发展时强调 发挥产业基础优势 打造国际先进航空产业基地
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Inspects Aerospace Industry Development in Shenbei New District, Urging Efforts to Build an Internationally Advanced Aviation Industry Base
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，辽宁省委副书记、沈阳市委书记霍步刚到沈北新区调研航空航天产业发展，走访重点企业并强调强链补链延链、发展低空经济、强化要素保障。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Huo Bugang, Deputy Secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee and Party Secretary of Shenyang, inspected aerospace industry development in Shenbei New District, visiting key firms and urging supply-chain upgrading, low-altitude economy growth and stronger resource support.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市委召开“6+1”重点产业工作专班会议
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on the "6+1" Key Industry Task Forces
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，沈阳市委召开专题会议，听取航空航天、装备制造等“6+1”重点产业工作专班推进情况汇报，省委副书记、市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话，代市长马珊珊出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to review progress of the "6+1" key industry task forces, including aerospace, equipment manufacturing and other sectors. Party Secretary Huo Bugang chaired the meeting, with acting mayor Ma Shanshan attending.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向全国广大农民和工作在“三农”战线上的同志们致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Festive Greetings to Farmers and Agricultural Workers Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 在第九个“中国农民丰收节”到来之际，习近平代表党中央向全国广大农民和“三农”战线上的同志致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候，强调扎实推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On the ninth Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, Xi Jinping extended festive greetings to farmers and agricultural workers nationwide on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, urging solid progress in rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中出席2026年中国农民丰收节全国主场活动
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Attends National Main Event of 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中9月21日至23日到湖北调研，出席在湖北举行的2026年中国农民丰收节全国主场活动，强调抓好秋粮生产、推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: Chinese Vice Premier Liu Guozhong visited Hubei from Sept 21 to 23 and attended the national main event of the 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, stressing autumn grain production and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向第48届世界技能大赛致贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to 48th WorldSkills Competition
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国家主席习近平向在上海开幕的第48届世界技能大赛致贺信，表示中国将鼓励更多劳动者特别是青年走技能成才之路。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter on Sept 22 to the 48th WorldSkills Competition, which opened in Shanghai, saying China will encourage more workers, especially youth, to pursue skilled careers.

articles.title_zh: 第七届全国少数民族文艺会演在京闭幕 王沪宁出席闭幕式
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Attends Closing Ceremony of 7th National Ethnic Minority Art Festival in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日晚，历时一个多月的第七届全国少数民族文艺会演在北京民族剧院闭幕，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁出席闭幕式文艺晚会。
articles.summary_en: Wang Huning attended the closing ceremony of the 7th National Ethnic Minority Art Festival in Beijing on Sept 23, concluding a month-long event with 48 productions and 114 performances.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛在上海隆重开幕 李强出席并宣布开幕
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends and Declares Open the 48th WorldSkills Competition in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日晚，第48届世界技能大赛在上海世博文化中心开幕，国务院总理李强出席并宣布开幕，开幕式上宣读了国家主席习近平的贺信。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 22, the 48th WorldSkills Competition opened in Shanghai, with Premier Li Qiang attending and declaring it open. A congratulatory letter from President Xi Jinping was read out at the ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛在上海隆重开幕 李强出席并宣布开幕
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends and Declares Open the 48th WorldSkills Competition in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日晚，第48届世界技能大赛在上海世博文化中心开幕，国务院总理李强出席并宣布开幕，开幕式上宣读了国家主席习近平的贺信。
articles.summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition opened at the Shanghai Expo Cultural Center on the evening of Sept 22, with Premier Li Qiang attending and declaring the event open; a congratulatory letter from President Xi Jinping was read out.

articles.title_zh: 李强出席2026年世界技能大会开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends Opening Ceremony of 2026 World Skills Conference and Delivers a Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日上午，国务院总理李强在上海出席2026年世界技能大会开幕式并致辞，强调深化产教融合、加强国际技能交流合作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 23, Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Skills Conference in Shanghai and delivered a speech, calling for deeper industry-education integration and stronger international skills cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 前8个月工业经济稳步增长 新质生产力加快培育
articles.title_en: Industrial Economy Grows Steadily in First Eight Months as New Quality Productive Forces Accelerate
articles.summary_zh: 国家税务总局发票数据显示，今年前8个月全国工业销售收入同比增长7.3%，装备制造业增长10.1%，高技术产业销售收入同比增长15.7%。
articles.summary_en: Invoice data from China's State Taxation Administration shows national industrial sales revenue rose 7.3% year on year in the first eight months of the year, with equipment manufacturing up 10.1% and high-tech industry sales up 15.7%.

articles.title_zh: 李强出席2026年世界技能大会开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Attends Opening Ceremony of 2026 World Skills Conference and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强9月23日在上海出席2026年世界技能大会开幕式并致辞，强调中国注重产业与技能深度融合、强化终身职业培训，并愿同各方推动全球技能合作。
articles.summary_en: Chinese Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 2026 World Skills Conference in Shanghai on Sept 23 and delivered a speech, stressing deeper integration of industry and skills, lifelong vocational training and global cooperation on skills development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席引领推进中美人民友好事业的故事
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads Efforts to Advance China-US People-to-People Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月22日播发长篇通讯，记述习近平主席多年来亲自谋划推动中美人文交流与民间友好，为中美关系行稳致远厚植民意根基。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a feature on Sept 22 recounting President Xi Jinping's years-long personal efforts to advance China-US people-to-people and cultural exchanges and build public support for bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 张丹参加市第十四次党代会代表团分组审议
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Joins Delegation Deliberation at Dandong Municipal 14th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，张丹到丹东市第十四次党代会凤城代表团参加分组审议，与代表们共同审议市委报告和市纪委工作报告，并就振兴发展提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, Zhang Dan joined the Fengcheng delegation at Dandong's 14th Municipal Party Congress to deliberate the municipal Party committee report and the discipline inspection commission report, urging further revitalization efforts.

articles.title_zh: 陈福茂参加丹东市第十四次党代会宽甸代表团分组审议
articles.title_en: Chen Fumao Joins Kuandian Delegation Deliberations at Dandong's 14th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，中国共产党丹东市第十四次代表大会分组审议市委报告和市纪委工作报告，陈福茂到宽甸代表团参加审议，并就县域发展与兴边富民提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 22, Chen Fumao joined the Kuandian delegation in group deliberations at the 14th Dandong Municipal Party Congress, reviewing the municipal Party committee and discipline commission work reports and urging high-quality county development.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见刘小涛率领的江苏省代表团一行 霍步刚参加会见
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Jiangsu Delegation Led by Liu Xiaotao; Hu Bugang Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见江苏省省长刘小涛率领的江苏省代表团，双方就深化辽苏对口合作、推动产业共链等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with a Jiangsu delegation led by Governor Liu Xiaotao to discuss deeper cooperation and industrial links.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁赴闽侯县调研村（社区）"两委"换届工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Inspects Village and Community "Two Committees" Election Work in Minhou County
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁赴闽侯县调研基层党建和村（社区）"两委"换届工作，要求选优配强基层班子、严肃换届纪律。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee, inspected Minhou County to review grassroots Party building and village (community) "two committees" election work, urging strong grassroots leadership teams and strict election discipline.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁赴闽侯县调研村（社区）“两委”换届工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Inspects Village and Community Committee Election Work in Minhou County
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁赴闽侯县上街镇、南屿镇调研基层党建和村（社区）“两委”换届工作，强调选优配强基层班子、严肃换届纪律。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee, inspected grassroots Party building and village and community committee election work in Minhou County, stressing strong grassroots teams and strict election discipline.

articles.title_zh: 2026年世界城市日全球主场活动暨第四届全球可持续发展城市奖（上海奖）颁奖活动新闻发布会举行
articles.title_en: Press Conference Held for 2026 World Cities Day Global Main Event and 4th Global Sustainable Development City Award (Shanghai Award)
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，世界城市日全球主场活动暨第四届全球可持续发展城市奖（上海奖）颁奖活动新闻发布会在北京举行，活动将于10月31日至11月2日在福州举办。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22 a press conference in Beijing announced the 2026 World Cities Day global main event and the 4th Shanghai Award ceremony, to be held in Fuzhou from Oct 31 to Nov 2.

articles.title_zh: 市委九届十三次全会召开 市委常委会主持 蒋曦讲话 黄韡出席
articles.title_en: Huaibei Municipal Committee Holds 13th Plenary Session of Its 9th Term, Chaired by the Standing Committee, with Jiang Xi Speaking
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，中共淮北市第九届委员会第十三次全体会议召开，市委书记蒋曦讲话，会议审议通过市委和市纪委工作报告，并决定市第十次党代会于9月26日至29日召开。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 23, the 13th plenary session of the 9th CPC Huaibei Municipal Committee was held, with Party Secretary Jiang Xi speaking. The meeting approved work reports and set the city's 10th Party congress for Sept 26-29.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Huainan Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，市委常委会召开会议，市委书记朱艾勇主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示、贺信精神，部署中秋国庆安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the Huainan Municipal Party Standing Committee met under Party Secretary Zhu Aiyong to convey Xi Jinping's instructions and letters and arrange safety work for the holidays.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市委常委会召开会议 研究部署教育、安全生产和人大工作
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Education, Safety and People's Congress Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署教育发展、安全生产和人大工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao chaired a municipal Party committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's directives and plan education, workplace safety and people's congress work.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保检查中秋、国庆节前安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects Safety Production Ahead of Mid-Autumn and National Day Holidays
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，揭阳市委书记、市人大常委会主任曾风保带队检查中秋、国庆节前安全生产工作，实地查看加油站、再生资源企业和农产品交易中心，强调压实责任、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 22, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao led an inspection of workplace safety, food safety and market supply ahead of the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays, urging tighter accountability and firm safety safeguards.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委机构编制委员会会议，强调践行正确政绩观
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Institutional Organization Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市委机构编制委员会召开会议，达娃次仁主持，强调牢固树立和践行正确政绩观，不断提升机构编制资源使用效益。
articles.summary_en: Dawa Tsering chaired a meeting of the Lhasa Municipal Party Committee's Institutional Organization Committee, calling for a correct view of political achievements and better use of institutional staffing resources.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨市全面启动2026年度综合性法治督察工作
articles.title_en: Lhasa Fully Launches 2026 Comprehensive Rule-of-Law Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市全面启动2026年度综合性法治督察工作，覆盖各区县，重点督察法治政府建设与依法治理任务落实情况。
articles.summary_en: Lhasa has fully launched its 2026 comprehensive rule-of-law inspection, covering all districts and counties to check progress on law-based governance and government building.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见吉尔吉斯斯坦总理卡瑟马利耶夫
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Kyrgyz Prime Minister Kasymaliev
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日下午，国务院总理李强在杭州会见来华出席第五届全球数字贸易博览会的吉尔吉斯斯坦总理卡瑟马利耶夫，双方就深化中吉合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 23, Premier Li Qiang met in Hangzhou with Kyrgyz Prime Minister Kasymaliev, who was in China for the 5th Global Digital Trade Expo, to discuss deepening China-Kyrgyzstan cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席引领推进中美人民友好事业的故事
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads the Advancement of China-US People-to-People Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月22日播发报道，习近平主席在对美国事访问前夕复信美国10所高校青年学生，回顾其长期推动中美人文交流与人民友好的历程。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 22 that ahead of his US state visit, Xi Jinping wrote back to students from 10 US universities, underscoring his long push for China-US people-to-people friendship.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区十二届人大常委会第二十五次会议在拉萨开幕
articles.title_en: 25th Session of Tibet Autonomous Region People's Congress Standing Committee Opens in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，西藏自治区十二届人大常委会第二十五次会议在拉萨开幕，严金海主持会议，会议审议人事任免事项及多部地方性法规草案。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the 25th session of the 12th Tibet Autonomous Region People's Congress Standing Committee opened in Lhasa, chaired by Yan Jinhai, reviewing personnel appointments and multiple local regulation drafts.

articles.title_zh: 中央决定：胡昌升任西藏自治区党委书记 王君正不再担任
articles.title_en: Central Decision: Hu Changsheng Appointed Party Secretary of Tibet, Wang Junzheng Steps Down
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日下午，西藏自治区召开全区领导干部会议，中央组织部副部长郝军辉宣布中央决定：胡昌升任西藏自治区党委委员、常委、书记，王君正不再担任自治区党委书记等职务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, 2026, at a regional leadership meeting in Lhasa, central authorities announced Hu Changsheng's appointment as Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, replacing Wang Junzheng.

tags.name_en: Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 刘江在林芝市调研时强调：坚持共建共治和美共融不断提高基层治理现代化水平
articles.title_en: Liu Jiang Stresses Co-Governance and Harmony in Push to Modernize Grassroots Governance During Nyingchi Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，西藏自治区党委常务副书记、政法委书记刘江赴林芝市调研基层治理工作，走访米林市搬迁居民点、基层公安站所和觉木街道社区。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Liu Jiang, Tibet's deputy party secretary and political-legal chief, inspected grassroots governance in Nyingchi, visiting relocated residents, frontline police and a community.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市公安机关“岩盾”立体巡防体系启动
articles.title_en: Longyan Police Launch "Yandun" Three-Dimensional Patrol System
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，龙岩市公安局举行“岩盾”立体巡防体系建设启动仪式，市委常委、政法委书记邱开养和副市长、市公安局局长戴伟荣出席，该体系正式投入运行。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 22, the Longyan Public Security Bureau launched its "Yandun" three-dimensional patrol system, with municipal officials Qiu Kaiyang and Dai Weirong attending the ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国农民丰收节辽宁城乡群众庆祝丰收联欢暨金秋消费季活动在盘锦启幕
articles.title_en: 2026 China Farmers' Harvest Festival Celebration and Autumn Consumption Season Opens in Panjin, Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，2026中国农民丰收节辽宁庆祝活动暨金秋消费季在盘山县胡家镇启幕，副省长白英、市委书记王炳森、市长邢鹏出席，现场发布多项惠农政策与农业品牌成果。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, the 2026 China Farmers' Harvest Festival and autumn consumption season opened in Panjin, Liaoning, with Vice Governor Bai Ying and city leaders attending; farm policies and brands were released.

articles.title_zh: 中央决定：胡昌升任西藏自治区党委书记，王君正不再担任
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Appointed Tibet Party Secretary, Wang Junzheng Steps Down
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，西藏自治区召开全区领导干部会议，中央组织部副部长郝军辉宣布中央决定：胡昌升任西藏自治区党委委员、常委、书记，王君正不再担任西藏自治区党委书记等职务。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, 2026, at a regional leadership meeting in Lhasa, central authorities announced that Hu Changsheng will serve as Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, with Wang Junzheng no longer holding the post.

articles.title_zh: 习近平复信美国青年学生 为中美友好合作汇聚青春力量
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Reply Letter Conveys Youth Strength for China-US Friendship and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平主席复信来华参加中美青年主题交流活动的美国10所高校近百名青年学生，鼓励他们做中美友好合作的传承者、维护者、发展者。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently replied to nearly 100 students from 10 US universities who joined China-US youth exchange activities in China, urging them to become inheritors and promoters of friendship and cooperation between the two countries.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区十二届人大常委会第二十五次会议开幕 严金海主持
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Chairs Opening of 25th Session of 12th Tibet People's Congress Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，西藏自治区十二届人大常委会第二十五次会议在拉萨开幕，严金海主持，会议听取人事任免说明及多项地方性法规草案审议报告。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 22, the 12th Tibet Autonomous Region People's Congress Standing Committee opened its 25th session in Lhasa, chaired by Yan Jinhai, reviewing personnel appointments and several local legislative bills.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升任西藏自治区党委书记
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Appointed Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央日前决定调整三省区党委主要负责人：胡昌升任西藏自治区党委书记，吴晓军任甘肃省委书记，罗东川任青海省委书记。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee announced a reshuffle of provincial-level party chiefs: Hu Changsheng becomes party secretary of Tibet, Wu Xiaojun of Gansu and Luo Dongchuan of Qinghai.

articles.title_zh: 推动中美关系迈向更美好未来——美国各界对习近平主席国事访问充满期待
articles.title_en: Pushing China-US Relations Toward a Better Future: US Voices Expectation for Xi Jinping's State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于2026年9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，美国各界人士对此表示热烈欢迎并充满期待。
articles.summary_en: At President Trump's invitation, President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from Sept 23 to 25, 2026, with Americans welcoming the trip and expecting it to steady bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴潮阳区开展节前安全生产督导检查
articles.title_en: Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Pre-Holiday Safety Production in Chaoyang District
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴潮阳区督导检查节前安全生产，检查企业、项目及景区安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 22, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected pre-holiday safety production in Chaoyang District, checking enterprises, projects, and scenic areas.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群会见美国硅谷科技咨询委员会主席丁洪一行
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Meets Ding Hong, Chairman of the US Silicon Valley Science and Technology Advisory Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群在汕头会见中国科学院院士、美国硅谷科技咨询委员会主席丁洪一行，双方围绕深化科技创新、加强产业协作深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn met Ding Hong, chairman of the US Silicon Valley Science and Technology Advisory Committee, to discuss deeper tech innovation and industrial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党朔州市第八次代表大会胜利闭幕
articles.title_en: 8th CPC Shuozhou Municipal Congress Concludes, Elects New Municipal Committee
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党朔州市第八次代表大会在朔州闭幕，选举产生第八届市委和市纪委，并确立今后五年工作的指导思想与主要任务。
articles.summary_en: The 8th CPC Shuozhou Municipal Congress concluded in Shuozhou, Shanxi, electing a new municipal committee and discipline inspection commission and setting the priorities for the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党朔州市第八次代表大会批准七届市委报告
articles.title_en: Shuozhou City's 8th CPC Congress Approves Report of 7th Municipal Committee
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，中国共产党朔州市第八次代表大会第三次全体会议在朔州通过决议，批准王帅红代表七届市委所作的报告，明确未来五年围绕高质量发展与全方位转型的总体思路。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, 2026, the third plenary session of the 8th CPC Shuozhou City Congress approved the report delivered by Wang Shuaihong on behalf of the 7th Municipal Committee, setting out a five-year roadmap centered on high-quality development and all-round transformation.

articles.title_zh: 李国强主持召开市人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Chairs Tai'an Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强主持召开市政府常务会议，研究全市经济运行形势，部署假日旅游和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang chaired a municipal government executive meeting to review the city's economic performance and arrange holiday tourism and workplace safety work.

articles.title_zh: 江苏电商创新发展大会开幕 刘小涛出席
articles.title_en: Jiangsu E-Commerce Innovation and Development Conference Opens, Liu Xiaotao Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，江苏电商创新发展大会在南京开幕，省长刘小涛出席，副省长马士光致辞，现场签约落地合作项目110余个。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the Jiangsu E-Commerce Innovation and Development Conference opened in Nanjing, attended by Governor Liu Xiaotao, with Vice Governor Ma Shiguang delivering remarks and over 110 cooperation projects signed.

articles.title_zh: 威海市统筹发展和安全工作推进会议召开
articles.title_en: Weihai Holds Meeting on Coordinating Development and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，威海市召开统筹发展和安全工作推进会议，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，市长孔凡萍主持，研究部署经济运行、产业链建设和安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Weihai held a meeting on coordinating development and safety, where Party Secretary Zhang Haibo spoke and Mayor Kong Fanping presided, to plan economic growth, industrial chains and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党无锡市第十五次代表大会开幕
articles.title_en: 15th CPC Wuxi Municipal Congress Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，中国共产党无锡市第十五次代表大会在无锡开幕，蒋锋代表十四届市委作报告，总结过去五年工作并部署未来五年目标任务，同时选举新一届市委和市纪委。
articles.summary_en: The 15th CPC Wuxi Municipal Congress opened in Wuxi on Sept 22, 2026, where Jiang Feng delivered a report reviewing the past five years, outlining goals for the next five, and electing new municipal committee and discipline bodies.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅印发《“高效办成一件事”2026年度第二批重点事项清单》
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Second Batch of 2026 Key Items List for "Efficiently Completing One Matter"
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅印发国办函〔2026〕84号通知，公布《“高效办成一件事”2026年度第二批重点事项清单》，要求各地区各部门结合实际组织实施，推动在建设全国统一大市场、优化营商环境等领域扩大政务服务改革成效。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the State Council issued Circular No. 84 of 2026, releasing the second batch of 2026 key items for the "Efficiently Completing One Matter" government service reform, urging all regions and departments to implement them and extend the reform to areas such as building a unified national market and improving the business environment.
