articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见京东集团战略执行委员会委员、京东产发集团首席执行官陈若煜一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets JD Property CEO Chen Ruoyu and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见京东产发集团首席执行官陈若煜一行，双方表示将深化机器人产业、智慧物流、智慧园区等领域战略合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met JD Property CEO Chen Ruoyu, with both sides pledging deeper cooperation in robotics, smart logistics and smart industrial parks.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市第九次党代会主席团举行第三次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of the 9th Yancheng Municipal Party Congress Holds Third Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，盐城市第九次党代会主席团举行第三次会议，严汉平主持，决定将选举办法（草案）及市委、市纪委委员等候选人建议名单提交选举大会。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, the presidium of the 9th Yancheng Municipal Party Congress held its third meeting, chaired by Yan Hanping, deciding to submit the electoral rules and candidate lists to the congress for a vote.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平参加响水代表团审议
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Joins Xiangshui Delegation Deliberation at Yancheng Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，严汉平参加盐城市党代会响水代表团审议市委报告和市纪委工作报告，强调坚定信心、追赶超越，在产业培育、项目招引、民生保障等方面持续发力。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Yan Hanping joined the Xiangshui delegation at the Yancheng Party Congress to review the municipal party and discipline reports, urging efforts in industry, investment and livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 省领导赴扬州开展安全生产检查
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Official Zhang Wenbing Inspects Yangzhou on Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，江苏省委常委、省政府党组副书记张文兵赴扬州开展安全生产检查，深入企业厂区车间督导责任落实。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Zhang Wenbing, Standing Committee member of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee and deputy secretary of the provincial government's Party group, inspected workplaces in Yangzhou to press for stronger work-safety enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 听取老龄工作情况汇报等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Aging Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，李强主持国务院常务会议，听取老龄工作情况汇报，研究体育赛事健康发展，部署医疗康复护理扩容提升工程，审议通过《中医药传统知识保护条例（草案）》。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on aging work, sports events and rehabilitation care, approving a draft regulation on traditional Chinese medicine knowledge protection.

articles.title_zh: 陶少华主持召开银川市第十六届人民政府第120次常务会议
articles.title_en: Tao Shaohua Chairs 120th Executive Meeting of Yinchuan Municipal People's Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，银川市市长陶少华主持召开市政府第120次常务会议，部署先进制造业发展、中秋国庆假期安全生产及群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Yinchuan Mayor Tao Shaohua chaired the 120th executive meeting of the municipal government, deploying work on advancing manufacturing, holiday safety production, and rectifying misconduct and corruption affecting the public.

articles.title_zh: 张雨浦调研粮食安全和农业生产工作 聚力兴农富农 确保丰收增收
articles.title_en: Zhang Yupu Inspects Grain Security and Agricultural Production, Vowing to Boost Agriculture and Farmers' Income
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，宁夏回族自治区主席张雨浦到永宁县、青铜峡市调研粮食安全和农业生产工作，强调抓好秋收稳粮保供，聚力兴农富农、确保丰收增收。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu inspected grain security and agricultural production in Yongning County and Qingtongxia City, urging solid autumn harvest work to secure grain supply and boost farmers' income.

articles.title_zh: 李军在沈阳会见受我市邀请参加2026辽宁国际投资贸易洽谈会重点企业嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Li Jun Meets Business Representatives Invited to 2026 Liaoning International Investment and Trade Fair in Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，营口市委副书记、市长李军在沈阳会见受邀参加2026辽宁国际投资贸易洽谈会的重点企业嘉宾代表，围绕产业赋能、项目深化、经贸拓展开展交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Yingkou Mayor Li Jun met in Shenyang with business representatives invited to the 2026 Liaoning International Investment and Trade Fair to discuss industrial upgrading and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”首个丰收节，习近平指引“三农”启新程
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Charts Course for Agriculture, Rural Areas and Farmers as China Marks First Harvest Festival of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日“十五五”首个中国农民丰收节到来之际，习近平向全国农民和“三农”战线工作者致以节日祝贺，并围绕稳产保供、农民增收、宜居乡村建设细化“三农”工作部署。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, as China marked the first Farmers' Harvest Festival of the 15th Five-Year Plan, Xi Jinping sent festive greetings to farmers nationwide and detailed rural work on grain output, farm incomes and livable villages.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然参加湘阴县代表团和华容县代表团讨论
articles.title_en: Tang Haoran Joins Xiangyin and Huarong Delegations' Discussions at Yueyang Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，唐浩然先后参加岳阳市第九次党代会湘阴县、华容县代表团讨论，要求拼经济稳增长、兴产业惠民生。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, Tang Haoran joined the Xiangyin and Huarong delegations at Yueyang's 9th Party Congress to discuss the municipal committee report, urging growth, industry upgrading and better livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江参加平江县代表团讨论
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Joins Pingjiang County Delegation Discussion at Yueyang Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，谢卫江到岳阳市第九次党代会平江县代表团参加讨论，审议市委、市纪委工作报告，并就县域经济发展和全面从严治党提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, Xie Weijiang joined the Pingjiang County delegation at the 9th Yueyang Party Congress to discuss the municipal party committee and discipline inspection reports and set out requirements on county economic development and party governance.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市第九次党代会主席团举行第二次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of Yueyang's 9th Party Congress Holds Second Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日晚，中国共产党岳阳市第九次代表大会主席团举行第二次会议，谢卫江主持，通过九届市委委员、候补委员和市纪委委员候选人建议名单及大会选举办法。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 22, the presidium of the 9th CPC Yueyang City Congress held its second meeting, chaired by Xie Weijiang, approving candidate lists for the new city party committee and discipline commission and the election method.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新主持召开市政府常务会议 专题研究安全生产和社会稳定等工作
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting on Workplace Safety and Social Stability
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，云浮市市长李庆新主持召开市政府常务会议，专题研究安全生产和社会稳定工作，部署中秋国庆假期安全防范。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Yunfu Mayor Li Qingxin chaired a municipal government executive meeting on workplace safety and social stability, deploying safety measures for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 县委书记罗红霞主持召开县委常委会（扩大）会议部署中秋国庆及安全生产等工作
articles.title_en: County Party Secretary Luo Hongxia Chairs County Party Committee Meeting on Mid-Autumn and National Day Holiday Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，徐闻县委书记罗红霞主持召开县委十四届第115次常委会（扩大）会议，传达中央关于思想政治工作和安全生产的重要精神，部署中秋国庆及第四季度安全生产防范和生态环保督察整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Xuwen County Party Secretary Luo Hongxia chaired the county Party committee's 115th expanded standing committee meeting, conveying central directives on ideological work and work safety, and deploying safety measures for the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays and fourth-quarter ecological inspection rectification.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开湛江市委常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Expanded Meeting of Zhanjiang Municipal Party Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市委十二届第214次常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记对青岛货轮火灾事故的重要指示精神，并研究部署安全生产和下一步经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 22, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired an expanded municipal Party Standing Committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on a cargo ship fire in Qingdao and to plan work on workplace safety and the local economy.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国到沈丘县调研项目建设和基层社会治理
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Inspects Shenqiu County on Project Development and Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，周口市委书记黄玉国到沈丘县调研，走访多家企业和项目现场，并了解基层综治中心运行、网格化管理与矛盾纠纷化解工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo inspected Shenqiu County, visiting enterprises and project sites and reviewing grassroots governance, grid management and dispute resolution work.

articles.title_zh: 增资扩产势头猛 高端产能迭代快 富山工业园PCB产业焕新提质
articles.title_en: Fushan Industrial Park's PCB Industry Upgraded as Firms Expand Capacity and Iterate Toward High-End Output
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，珠海富山工业园多家PCB企业增资扩产、技改升级，抢抓AI算力风口；1—8月园区工业投资同比增长90%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, PCB makers in Zhuhai's Fushan Industrial Park were reported to be expanding and upgrading capacity to seize AI computing opportunities, with park industrial investment up 90% year-on-year in January-August.

articles.title_zh: 2026山东金秋消费季启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Shandong Golden Autumn Consumption Season Launches
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，2026山东金秋消费季在济南市章丘区启动，省委书记林武出席，省长周乃翔致辞，省委副书记、济南市委书记刘强出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, the 2026 Shandong Golden Autumn Consumption Season was launched in Zhangqiu District, Jinan, with Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu attending, Governor Zhou Naixiang delivering a speech and Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang present.

articles.title_zh: 50项新食品安全国家标准发布 重点关注哪些领域？
articles.title_en: 50 New National Food Safety Standards Released: What Areas Are the Focus?
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委、市场监管总局日前联合印发公告，发布50项新食品安全国家标准和修改单，聚焦污染物控制、检验方法、牛乳蛋白和儿童营养补充品等领域。
articles.summary_en: China's health and market regulators released 50 new national food safety standards, covering pollutant controls, testing methods, milk protein and children's nutrition supplements.

articles.title_zh: 福州港江阴港区今年已出口整车6.8万辆 同比增长28倍
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Port's Jiangyin Area Exports 68,000 Vehicles This Year, Up 28-Fold
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，一批极氪9X汽车从福州港江阴港区启航发往阿联酋，为该车型首次大批量出海。江阴港区今年整车出口已达6.8万辆，同比增长28倍，全年有望达10万辆。
articles.summary_en: A batch of Zeekr 9X vehicles set sail from Fuzhou Port's Jiangyin area for the United Arab Emirates on Sept 22, the model's first large-scale export shipment. The area has exported 68,000 vehicles so far this year, a 28-fold year-on-year increase, with 100,000 expected for the full year.

articles.title_zh: 刘强到市纪委监委机关调研：纵深推进全面从严治党
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Inspects Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection, Vows to Advance Full and Rigorous Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，济南市委书记刘强到市纪委监委机关调研，强调纵深推进全面从严治党，为经济社会高质量发展提供保障。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Ji'nan Party Secretary Liu Qiang inspected the municipal discipline inspection commission, stressing deeper full and rigorous Party governance to support high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 于海田督导调研重点项目建设和产业发展
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Key Projects and Industrial Development in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田赴多家企业和项目现场督导调研重点项目建设和产业发展，强调推动项目建设提速增效、提升产业发展能级。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian inspected key project sites and enterprises, urging faster, higher-quality project construction and stronger industrial development to support the provincial capital's growth.

articles.title_zh: 习近平复信美国高校青年学生 鼓励促进中美相知相亲
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young US Students, Urging Them to Promote China-US Mutual Understanding
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席复信美国哈佛大学等10所高校近百名青年学生，勉励他们成为中美友好合作的传承者、维护者、发展者，促进两国人民相知相亲。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping replied to nearly 100 students from 10 US universities, including Harvard, urging them to carry forward China-US friendship and deepen mutual understanding between the two peoples.

articles.title_zh: 从人民中找到根基：习近平谈中美相处之道
articles.title_en: Finding Roots in the People: Xi Jinping on How China and the US Should Get Along
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，中美元首半年内实现互访；习近平多次以“人民”阐释中美相处之道。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping paid a state visit to the United States from Sept 23 to 25, the two heads of state exchanging visits within half a year. Xi repeatedly invoked "the people" in explaining how China and the US should get along.

articles.title_zh: 优化“区直管社区”行政架构，三亚市海棠区筹备设立藤桥街道
articles.title_en: Haitang District in Sanya Prepares to Establish Tengqiao Subdistrict to Optimize 'District Directly Managing Communities' Administrative Structure
articles.summary_zh: 三亚市海棠区筹备设立藤桥街道，作为市委、市政府优化基层治理体系的决策部署，目前机构优化方案与街道管理体制改革方案已完成起草，办公场所改造、资产移交等工作有序推进。
articles.summary_en: Sanya's Haitang District is preparing to set up Tengqiao Subdistrict as part of the city's push to improve grassroots governance; drafting of institutional reform plans is complete and office renovation and asset transfers are under way.

articles.title_zh: 五方面重点发力，我国将进一步优化婚姻管理服务
articles.title_en: Five Key Areas: China to Further Optimize Marriage Registration and Management Services
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，民政部副部长舒惠好在国新办发布会上介绍新修订《婚姻登记条例》实施成效，并表示“十五五”期间将从五方面优化婚姻管理服务。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Sept 23, Vice Minister of Civil Affairs Shu Huihao reported progress under the revised Marriage Registration Regulation and outlined five priority areas for improving marriage management services during the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 铁路中秋国庆假期运输今日启动，16天预计发送旅客2.84亿人次
articles.title_en: Railway Transport for Mid-Autumn and National Day Holiday Begins, 284 Million Passenger Trips Expected in 16 Days
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，铁路中秋国庆假期运输启动，至10月8日为期16天，全国铁路预计发送旅客2.84亿人次，10月1日将迎来客流最高峰。
articles.summary_en: China's railway holiday transport for the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day began on Sept 23 and runs 16 days through Oct 8, with 284 million passenger trips expected and a peak on Oct 1.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期民政部将推动制定养老服务法
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs to Push for Elderly Care Services Law in 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，民政部部长李常官在国新办发布会上表示，“十五五”时期将推动修订老年人权益保障法、制定养老服务法，健全养老服务体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Minister of Civil Affairs Li Changguan said at a State Council Information Office briefing that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period China will revise the law on protecting the rights of the elderly and enact an elderly care services law.

tags.name_en: Protection of the Rights of the Elderly

tags_en: Protection of the Rights of the Elderly

articles.title_zh: 河南省召开全省领导干部会议，新任省委书记周祖翼作表态讲话
articles.title_en: Henan Holds Provincial Leadership Meeting; New Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，河南省召开全省领导干部会议，中央组织部宣布中央决定：周祖翼任河南省委书记，刘宁不再担任；王陆进任河南省委副书记，王凯不再担任。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, Henan held a provincial leadership meeting where the Central Organization Department announced a reshuffle: Zhou Zuyi became Party secretary, succeeding Liu Ning, and Wang Lujin deputy secretary.

articles.title_zh: 全国过半猴头菇产量，为何出自黑龙江海林
articles.title_en: Why More Than Half of China's Lion's Mane Mushrooms Come from Hailin, Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江海林猴头菇产量约占全国55%；当地靠合作社、冷链鲜销与深加工延伸产业链，并以2026—2030年产业规划破解保鲜、加工等短板。
articles.summary_en: Hailin, Heilongjiang grows over half of China's lion's mane mushrooms (annual output value about 450 million yuan), using cooperatives, cold-chain fresh sales and a 2026-2030 plan to extend the value chain.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省部署“三秋”机械化生产工作
articles.title_en: Anhui Province Deploys Mechanized Production for Autumn Harvest, Plowing and Sowing
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省农业农村厅近日印发通知，部署2026年“三秋”机械化生产工作，要求保障秋粮丰收到手、颗粒归仓，并落实农机跨区作业免费通行等政策。
articles.summary_en: Anhui's Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs issued a notice deploying mechanized production for the 2026 autumn harvest, plowing and sowing, requiring measures to ensure grain is harvested fully and to guarantee free passage for cross-region agricultural machinery.

articles.title_zh: 如何应对人工智能安全漏洞 院士专家来渝论道
articles.title_en: Academicians Gather in Chongqing to Discuss AI Security Vulnerabilities
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，第十六届网络安全漏洞分析与风险评估大会在重庆科学会堂举行，陈左宁、黄殿中、吴世忠等院士专家围绕人工智能发展与安全展开研讨。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the 16th Cybersecurity Vulnerability Analysis and Risk Assessment Conference was held in Chongqing, where academicians including Chen Zuoning, Huang Dianzhong and Wu Shizhong discussed AI development and security.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃开展量贩零食门店计量专项检查
articles.title_en: Gansu Launches Special Inspection of Weighing at Bulk Snack Stores
articles.summary_zh: 近期，甘肃省市场监管局部署对全省连锁量贩零食门店开展计量称重和定量包装专项检查，赴兰州、白银两市实地抽查门店与电子秤，现场督促整改计量管理薄弱问题。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's market regulators launched special inspections of weighing and packaged goods at chain bulk-snack stores, spot-checking outlets in Lanzhou and Baiyin and ordering fixes for weak measurement controls.

articles.title_zh: 第二届甘肃省“甘味”直播大赛启动
articles.title_en: Second Gansu "Ganwei" Livestream Competition Kicks Off
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日晚，第二届甘肃省“甘味”直播大赛暨天水花牛苹果品牌推介活动在天水市启动，旨在推动“甘味出陇”“甘味出海”。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 22, the second Gansu "Ganwei" livestream competition and Tianshui Huaniu apple brand promotion event opened in Tianshui, aiming to boost Gansu farm produce brands nationwide and overseas.

articles.title_zh: 今年1—8月，广西共立案检查打击虚开骗税企业3062户
articles.title_en: Guangxi Files Cases Against 3,062 Firms for Fake Invoicing and Tax Fraud in January-August
articles.summary_zh: 广西税务部门今年1—8月共立案检查打击虚开骗税企业3062户，查补税款、滞纳金及罚款合计3.62亿元，并公开曝光6起涉税违法典型案件。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi tax authorities said they investigated 3,062 firms for fake invoicing and tax fraud in January-August, recovering 362 million yuan in taxes, late fees and fines, and publicly exposed six typical tax violation cases.

tags.name_en: Fake Invoicing and Tax Refund Fraud

tags_en: Fake Invoicing and Tax Refund Fraud

articles.title_zh: 2026中国民营企业500强发布
articles.title_en: 2026 China Top 500 Private Enterprises List Released
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，全国工商联与天津市人民政府在天津共同主办2026中国民营企业500强发布会，全国政协副主席、全国工商联主席高云龙出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and the Tianjin Municipal People's Government co-hosted the 2026 China Top 500 Private Enterprises release conference in Tianjin, where Gao Yunlong, Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee and Chairman of the Federation, attended and addressed the event.

tags.name_en: All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce

tags_en: All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce

articles.title_zh: 中国特色自由贸易港主流价值语料库在京签约共建
articles.title_en: Hainan Daily Press Group and People's Daily Online Sign Deal in Beijing to Build Free Trade Port Value Corpus
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，海南日报报业集团与人民网股份有限公司在北京签署战略合作框架协议，携手共建中国特色自由贸易港主流价值语料库。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Hainan Daily Press Group and People's Daily Online signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement in Beijing to jointly build a mainstream value corpus for the Hainan Free Trade Port.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee

articles.title_zh: 2026世界新能源汽车大会在海口开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 World New Energy Vehicle Congress Opens in Haikou
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，以“转型升级·韧性增长”为主题的2026世界新能源汽车大会在海口开幕，万钢作主旨报告，海南省委书记冯飞致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the 2026 World New Energy Vehicle Congress opened in Haikou, where Wan Gang delivered a keynote report and Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei gave a speech.

articles.title_zh: 从"苏大强"到"苏智强"
articles.title_en: From Manufacturing Powerhouse to AI Powerhouse: Jiangsu Advances Its "AI Plus" Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月21日，江苏省政府举行"人工智能+应急管理"路演；江苏全面实施"人工智能+"行动，推动智能制造、基层数字治理与县域医共体建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, 2026, Jiangsu staged an "AI plus emergency management" demonstration as the province rolls out its "AI Plus" initiative across smart manufacturing, grassroots digital governance and county medical consortiums.

articles.title_zh: 宿迁农村地区“一老一小”流感疫苗免费接种工作启动
articles.title_en: Suqian Launches Free Flu Vaccination for Rural Elderly and Children
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月21日，江苏宿迁启动农村地区“一老一小”流感疫苗免费接种，对象为65周岁及以上老年人和义务教育阶段中小学生。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, 2026, Suqian, Jiangsu launched free flu shots for rural residents aged 65 and above and compulsory-education students, per a national eight-department notice.

tags.name_en: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration

tags_en: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration

articles.title_zh: 推动构建更加开放、包容、更具韧性的多边贸易体制
articles.title_en: China Urges Building a More Open, Inclusive and Resilient Multilateral Trading System at WTO Public Forum
articles.summary_zh: 世界贸易组织2026年公共论坛期间，中方在日内瓦举办多场专题研讨会及“机遇中国·创享未来”文化推介活动，中国常驻世贸组织代表李詠箑出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: During the WTO 2026 Public Forum in Geneva, China held several seminars and cultural promotion events, with its permanent representative Li Yongsha urging a more open, inclusive and resilient multilateral trading system.

articles.title_zh: 江西召开全省设区市委政法委视频调度会
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Holds Video Coordination Meeting of Municipal Political and Legal Affairs Commissions
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，江西召开全省设区市委政法委视频调度会，省委副书记、省委政法委书记陈永奇出席并讲话，部署中秋国庆维稳安保、扫黑除恶及优化法治化营商环境等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Jiangxi held a video coordination meeting of municipal political and legal affairs commissions, where Chen Yongqi, deputy party secretary and head of the provincial political and legal affairs commission, spoke and outlined work on holiday security, crackdowns on organized crime, and improving the rule-of-law business environment.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘在江西调研宗教工作：始终坚持我国宗教中国化方向
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Inspects Religious Work in Jiangxi, Stressing Adherence to the Sinicization of Religion in China
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江西省委书记尹弘先后深入九江、南昌专题调研宗教工作，强调坚持我国宗教中国化方向，提高宗教事务治理法治化水平。
articles.summary_en: Jiangxi Party Secretary Yin Hong recently conducted inspections of religious work in Jiujiang and Nanchang, stressing adherence to the Sinicization of religion in China and raising the rule-of-law standard of religious affairs governance.

articles.title_zh: 2026年民族团结进步宣传周内蒙古主场活动举办，隋青出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Hosts Main Event of 2026 Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week; Sui Qing Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，2026年民族团结进步宣传周内蒙古自治区主场活动在内蒙古博物院举办，自治区党委常委、统战部部长隋青出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 22, the Inner Mongolia main event of the 2026 Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week was held at the Inner Mongolia Museum, with Sui Qing, member of the regional Party committee standing committee and head of the united front work department, attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 包钢在巴彦淖尔市调研
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Conducts Inspection Tour in Bayannur City
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日至22日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢在巴彦淖尔市调研口岸建设、秋粮稳产增收和民族团结进步工作。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 20 to 22, Bayannur, Inner Mongolia, hosted an inspection by regional government chairman Bao Gang focusing on port construction, autumn grain production and ethnic unity.

articles.title_zh: “石榴花开 籽籽同心”网络主题传播活动启动
articles.title_en: 'Pomegranate Flowers Bloom, Seeds United' Online Ethnic-Unity Media Campaign Launched in Guyuan, Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日至24日，宁夏党委网信办、统战部主办的“石榴花开 籽籽同心”网络主题传播活动在固原市举办，聚焦民族团结、乡村振兴等领域。
articles.summary_en: Sept 21-24: a themed online ethnic-unity media campaign organized by Ningxia's cyberspace and united front authorities drew cross-provincial media to Guyuan, focusing on solidarity and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 艾奥瓦州“老朋友”热烈欢迎习近平主席访美
articles.title_en: Iowa "Old Friends" Warmly Welcome President Xi Jinping's Visit to the US
articles.summary_zh: 美国艾奥瓦州马斯卡廷市的“老朋友”热烈欢迎习近平主席即将访美，重温40余年跨洋情谊，称赞“5年5万”倡议推动中美青少年交流。
articles.summary_en: Old friends in Muscatine, Iowa, welcomed President Xi Jinping's upcoming US visit, recalling four decades of friendship and praising the "50,000 in Five Years" youth exchange plan.

articles.title_zh: 《中华民族交往交流交融史》出版座谈会在京召开
articles.title_en: Symposium in Beijing Marks Publication of the History of Exchange, Communication and Integration of the Chinese Nation
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，《中华民族交往交流交融史》出版座谈会在北京召开，中共中央政治局委员、中央统战部部长李干杰出席会议并讲话，强调深化中华民族共同体理论研究。
articles.summary_en: A symposium marking the publication of the History of Exchange, Communication and Integration of the Chinese Nation was held in Beijing on Sept 23, where Li Ganji, Political Bureau member and head of the CPC Central Committee's United Front Work Department, delivered a speech.

articles.title_en: 2026 International Day of Peace Commemoration Held in Hubei
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日至22日，2026年国际和平日纪念活动在湖北武汉、汉川举办，来自60个国家的300余名代表参加。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 International Day of Peace commemoration was held on Sept 20-22 in Wuhan and Hanchuan, Hubei, drawing over 300 participants from 60 countries.

articles.title_zh: 2026青海省消费品以旧换新市州行（海东站）促消费活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Qinghai Consumer Goods Trade-In Tour (Haidong Stop) Kicks Off to Boost Spending
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，青海省商务厅在互助县启动消费品以旧换新市州行（海东站）暨地质灾害避险搬迁专项惠民促消费活动，为期两天，通过政府补贴、商家让利、金融助力拉动城乡消费。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the Qinghai Provincial Department of Commerce launched a two-day consumer goods trade-in promotion in Huzhu County, Haidong, combining government subsidies, merchant discounts and bank support to boost rural and urban spending.

articles.title_zh: 第五届中国（四川）国际熊猫消费节在成都启动
articles.title_en: Fifth China (Sichuan) International Panda Consumption Festival Kicks Off in Chengdu
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日晚，第五届中国（四川）国际熊猫消费节在成都启动，四川省委书记王晓晖、省长施小琳出席，现场发布消费指南和2026年“蜀里安逸”消费新场景，并推出多项促消费举措。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 22, the 5th China (Sichuan) International Panda Consumption Festival launched in Chengdu, attended by Sichuan Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui and Governor Shi Xiaolin, who announced a consumption guide, new 2026 consumption scenarios and other pro-consumption measures.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖在四川农业大学作形势政策报告 强调为推进四川农业农村现代化贡献更多力量
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui Delivers Policy Report at Sichuan Agricultural University, Urging Greater Contributions to Agricultural and Rural Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，四川省委书记王晓晖在四川农业大学成都校区作形势政策报告，就加快推进四川农业农村现代化作出部署，并祝贺学校建校120周年。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Sichuan Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui delivered a policy report at Sichuan Agricultural University's Chengdu campus, outlining steps to accelerate agricultural and rural modernization and marking the school's 120th anniversary.

articles.title_zh: 四川拟出台条例推动三星堆—金沙遗址系统性保护
articles.title_en: Sichuan Moves to Legislate Systematic Protection of Sanxingdui-Jinsha Sites
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，四川省第十四届人大常委会第二十九次会议首次审议《四川省三星堆—金沙遗址保护条例（草案）》，提出构建保护管理与活化利用两大体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the 29th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th Sichuan Provincial People's Congress reviewed for the first time a draft regulation on protecting the Sanxingdui-Jinsha sites, establishing protection and utilization systems.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向第48届世界技能大赛致贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to 48th WorldSkills Competition
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国家主席习近平向在上海开幕的第48届世界技能大赛致贺信，强调中国将鼓励更多劳动者特别是青年走技能成才之路。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 48th WorldSkills Competition opening in Shanghai, saying China will encourage more workers, especially young people, to pursue careers through skills.

articles.title_zh: 上海启动首个民族团结进步宣传周 将推出36项主题活动
articles.title_en: Shanghai Launches First Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week with 36 Activities
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，上海市学习贯彻民族团结进步促进法座谈会在徐汇区举行，同步启动2026年民族团结进步宣传周，将推出36项主题活动。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Shanghai held a symposium on the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law and launched the 2026 Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week with 36 activities.

articles.title_zh: 我国将推动北斗产业规模5年内超万亿元
articles.title_en: China to Push Beidou Industry Scale Past 1 Trillion Yuan Within Five Years
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，记者从国家发展改革委获悉，「十五五」时期我国将推动北斗产业规模5年内突破1万亿元，2025年北斗产业总体产值已突破6290亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, reporters learned from the National Development and Reform Commission that China will push its Beidou industry past 1 trillion yuan within five years, after total output topped 629 billion yuan in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 上海“家政服务员之家”来了，推出安居、保险、亮码三项举措
articles.title_en: Shanghai Opens First 'Domestic Worker Home' with Housing, Insurance and Service-Code Measures
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，上海首家“家政服务员之家”在普陀揭牌，并同步推出安居保障、普惠意外伤害保险和“家政服务码”三项举措，推动家政服务业提质扩容。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, 2026, Shanghai unveiled its first 'Domestic Worker Home' in Putuo District, alongside inclusive accident insurance and a pilot 'domestic service code' to upgrade the domestic service industry.

articles.title_zh: 2026明日城市·上海大会开幕，160余项全球城市需求发布
articles.title_en: 2026 Tomorrow City Shanghai Summit Opens, Releasing Over 160 Global City Needs
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，2026明日城市·上海大会在上海开幕，发布《2026全球城市挑战与机遇清单》，汇集160余项城市发展与合作需求，首日签署3份合作备忘录。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Tomorrow City Shanghai Summit opened in Shanghai on Sept 22, releasing a list of over 160 global urban development and cooperation needs and signing three cooperation memoranda on its first day.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛在上海隆重开幕 李强出席并宣布开幕
articles.title_en: 48th WorldSkills Competition Opens in Shanghai; Li Qiang Attends and Declares It Open
articles.summary_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛9月22日晚在上海开幕，国务院总理李强出席并宣布开幕，开幕式上宣读了国家主席习近平的贺信。
articles.summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition opened in Shanghai on the evening of Sept 22, with Premier Li Qiang attending and declaring it open; a congratulatory letter from President Xi Jinping was read at the ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 陕西联合多地发布中秋国庆假期消费提示
articles.title_en: Shaanxi and Multiple Regions Issue Mid-Autumn and National Day Holiday Consumption Tips
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，陕西省消保委联合内蒙古、重庆、四川等地消协组织发布中秋国庆假期消费提示，提醒消费者理性消费并防范预付式消费等风险。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Shaanxi's consumer council, with peers in Inner Mongolia, Chongqing and Sichuan, issued Mid-Autumn and National Day holiday consumption tips, warning of prepaid spending risks.

articles.title_zh: 我国将推动北斗产业规模5年内超万亿元
articles.title_en: China to Push BeiDou Industry Scale Past 1 Trillion Yuan Within Five Years
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委披露，2025年我国北斗产业总体产值突破6290亿元，“十五五”时期将推动北斗产业规模5年内突破1万亿元。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission said China's BeiDou industry output topped 629 billion yuan in 2025, and aims to exceed 1 trillion yuan within five years under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 国新办发布会介绍促进自然资源安全高效永续利用情况
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Briefing on Efficient, Sustainable Use of Natural Resources
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国务院新闻办举行「开局起步'十五五'」系列新闻发布会，自然资源部介绍促进自然资源安全高效永续利用情况，涉及用地保障、生态保护、耕地保护立法和找矿突破。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where the Ministry of Natural Resources outlined sustainable resource use plans, covering land supply, ecology and mining.

articles.title_zh: 丽水经开区推出危废应急预案免费专家评审服务
articles.title_en: Lishui Development Zone Offers Free Expert Review of Hazardous Waste Emergency Plans
articles.summary_zh: 丽水经开区面向年产危险废物1吨以下的小微产废单位，免费提供危废应急预案模板及专家评审服务，已有20家企业完成评审，累计节省费用约10万元。
articles.summary_en: Lishui Economic and Technological Development Zone launched free expert reviews of hazardous waste emergency plans for small generators producing under 1 ton a year; 20 firms have completed reviews, saving about 100,000 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇会见克罗地亚萨格勒布市市长并签署合作意向书
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Meets Zagreb Mayor and Signs Letter of Intent on Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 日前，北京市市长殷勇会见克罗地亚萨格勒布市市长托马舍维奇，双方就城市治理、绿色转型、科技创新等交流合作交换意见，并共同签署两市合作意向书。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong met with Zagreb Mayor Tomislav Tomasevic to discuss cooperation on urban governance, green transition and technological innovation, and the two cities signed a letter of intent on cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 守红线、保发展、惠民生——国新办发布会聚焦“十五五”时期自然资源保护利用
articles.title_en: Guarding Red Lines, Supporting Development, Benefiting Livelihoods: SCIO Briefing on Natural Resource Protection in the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室9月22日在北京举行“开局起步‘十五五’”新闻发布会，自然资源部负责人介绍守牢18亿亩耕地红线、新一轮找矿突破战略行动及“两山”转化等部署。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council Information Office held a briefing in Beijing on Sept 22 on natural resource protection for the 15th Five-Year Plan, with Ministry of Natural Resources officials outlining farmland red-line safeguards, a new round of mineral exploration and ecological development plans.

articles.title_zh: 以实干实绩推动乡村全面振兴
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Harvest Festival Greetings, Urging Solid Work to Advance All-Round Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，第九个“中国农民丰收节”到来之际，习近平总书记代表党中央向全国广大农民和“三农”战线同志致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, ahead of the 9th Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, Xi Jinping sent festive greetings to farmers on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, urging solid work to advance rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 教育部：学位跟着人口走 资源跟着需求走
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education: School Seats Follow Population, Resources Follow Demand
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月23日，教育部基础教育司司长田祖荫在国务院新闻办“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会上介绍“十五五”基础教育高质量发展重点工作，包括公办幼儿园学位供给、县中振兴与建设千所以上优质高中等。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, 2026, Tian Zuyin, head of the Ministry of Education's basic education department, outlined '15th Five-Year Plan' priorities at a State Council Information Office briefing, including more public kindergarten seats, county high school revitalization and over 1,000 quality high schools.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军赴张雪机车调研并召开座谈会 陈新武参加
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Visits Zhangxue Motorcycle and Chairs Symposium; Chen Xinwu Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武赴重庆张雪机车工业有限公司调研并召开座谈会，强调支持企业做强做大，加快建设世界领先摩托车企业。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu visited Zhangxue Motorcycle in Chongqing for research and a symposium, pledging support to build a world-leading motorcycle enterprise.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武会见出席第二十届重庆市市长国际经济顾问团会议的重要嘉宾
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Meet Guests Attending 20th Chongqing Mayor's International Economic Advisory Council Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武会见出席第二十届重庆市市长国际经济顾问团会议的安道拓、奥特斯、康宁等企业负责人。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu met executives from Adient, AT&S and Corning attending the 20th Chongqing Mayor's International Economic Advisory Council meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开第92次常务会议 陈新武主持
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Government Holds 92nd Executive Meeting, Chaired by Chen Xinwu
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，重庆市市长陈新武主持召开市政府第92次常务会议，研究“203060”重点攻坚突破体系相关工作，并审议人工智能赋能人力资源服务业高质量发展的若干措施。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu chaired the 92nd executive meeting of the municipal government, which studied the "203060" key breakthrough system and reviewed measures on using AI to boost high-quality development of the human resources service industry.

articles.title_zh: 河南：农业社会化服务推动小农户融入现代农业
articles.title_en: Henan: Agricultural Socialized Services Help Smallholders Enter Modern Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 河南农业社会化服务组织已达12.7万家，河南农投集团旗下三家企业通过数字平台、土地托管和智慧农业等方式，将分散小农户引入现代农业轨道。
articles.summary_en: Henan now has 127,000 agricultural socialized service organizations; three units of Henan Agricultural Investment Group use digital platforms, land trusteeship and smart farming to bring smallholders into modern agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明主持召开省政府第100次常务会议
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Chairs 100th Executive Meeting of Hunan Provincial Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，湖南省省长毛伟明主持召开省政府第100次常务会议，研究部署先进制造业、煤矿安全生产、碳达峰、农业农村现代化、数字湖南建设等“十五五”专项规划。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 22, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming chaired the 100th executive meeting of the provincial government, approving "15th Five-Year Plan" programs on advanced manufacturing, coal mine safety, carbon peaking, agricultural modernization and digital Hunan.

articles.title_zh: 中共江苏省委召开民主协商会 信长星主持会议
articles.title_en: CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee Holds Democratic Consultation Meeting, Chaired by Xin Changxing
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，中共江苏省委召开民主协商会，省委书记信长星主持，省委组织部部长胡立杰就有关人事安排事项作说明，各民主党派省委会、省工商联负责人和无党派人士代表一致赞同有关人事安排意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee held a democratic consultation meeting chaired by Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing, at which personnel arrangements were explained and endorsed by representatives of democratic parties and personages without party affiliation.

articles.title_zh: 江苏电商创新发展大会开幕 刘小涛出席
articles.title_en: Jiangsu E-Commerce Innovation and Development Conference Opens; Governor Liu Xiaotao Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，江苏电商创新发展大会在南京开幕，省长刘小涛出席，副省长马士光致辞，大会签约落地合作项目110余个。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the Jiangsu E-Commerce Innovation and Development Conference opened in Nanjing; Governor Liu Xiaotao attended and more than 110 cooperation projects were signed.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Make State Visit to the United States from September 23 to 25
articles.summary_zh: 应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，中美两国元首半年内实现互访。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25, with the two heads of state exchanging visits within half a year.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨科技“润”塞上 碱滩绘“丰”景
articles.title_en: Field Report: Technology Turns Ningxia's Saline-Alkali Land into Fertile Fields
articles.summary_zh: 9月，记者随“活力中国调研行”走访宁夏吴忠市红寺堡区永新村，当地高效智能光伏大棚与节水灌溉技术使盐碱地变丰收田，番茄、辣椒等喜获丰收。
articles.summary_en: In September, reporters toured Yongxin Village in Ningxia's Hongsibao District, where solar-powered greenhouses and smart water-saving irrigation have turned saline-alkali land into productive farmland.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫生健康委：“急速暴瘦”“不瘦退款”不可信
articles.title_en: National Health Commission: "Rapid Weight Loss" and "No Loss, Refund" Claims Are Not Credible
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，国家卫生健康委新闻发言人胡强强在北京新闻发布会上表示，减肥训练营“急速暴瘦”“不瘦退款”宣传不可信，健康体重管理应以合理膳食、适量运动和健康生活方式为基础。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 23, National Health Commission spokesperson Hu Qiangqiang said in Beijing that diet-camp claims such as "rapid weight loss" or "no loss, refund" are not credible, urging science-based weight management.

articles.title_zh: 民政部：我国养老服务保障水平持续提升
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs: China's Elderly Care Service Provision Continues to Improve
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”新闻发布会，民政部部长李常官介绍，基本养老服务制度全面建立，5300多万老年人享受补贴，养老服务机构设施达39.5万个。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, the State Council Information Office held a press conference on civil affairs development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period. Civil Affairs Minister Li Changguan said basic elderly care systems are fully established, with over 53 million seniors receiving subsidies and 395,000 care facilities nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 公安机关打掉一跨国民族资产解冻类诈骗团伙
articles.title_en: Chinese Police Bust Cross-Border 'Ethnic Asset Unfreezing' Fraud Ring
articles.summary_zh: 今年7月以来，在公安部指挥下，吉林公安机关打掉一个跨国民族资产解冻类诈骗团伙，境内抓获犯罪嫌疑人101名，并与老挝、新加坡、柬埔寨警方合作抓获156名，涉案金额超60亿元。
articles.summary_en: Since July, under Ministry of Public Security direction, Jilin police broke up a cross-border 'ethnic asset unfreezing' fraud ring, arresting 101 suspects in China and, with police in Laos, Singapore and Cambodia, 156 more, with over 6 billion yuan involved.

articles.title_zh: 三部门发布《轻工纺织产业发展“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: MIIT and Two Other Departments Release 15th Five-Year Plan for Light Industry and Textiles
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，工业和信息化部等三部门对外发布《轻工纺织产业发展“十五五”规划》，提出提升产业创新能力、推进智能化绿色化转型、增强供需适配性等主要任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, 2026, MIIT and two other departments released the 15th Five-Year Plan for light industry and textiles, focusing on innovation, green and smart upgrading, and supply-demand fit.

articles.title_zh: 2025年全国共查办各类价格违法案件4.1万件
articles.title_en: China Handles 41,000 Price Violation Cases Nationwide in 2025
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局近日发布《中国价格监督检查和反不正当竞争执法年度报告（2025）》，显示2025年全国市场监管系统共查办各类价格违法案件4.1万件，罚没款24.8亿元。
articles.summary_en: China's State Administration for Market Regulation released its 2025 annual report on price supervision and anti-unfair competition enforcement, showing 41,000 price violation cases handled nationwide with 2.48 billion yuan in fines and confiscations.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部：加快信息通信网络和行业智能化升级
articles.title_en: MIIT: Accelerate Intelligent Upgrading of Information and Communication Networks and Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月23日，工业和信息化部副部长余晓晖在北京举行的2026年中国国际信息通信展览会开幕式上表示，要推进人工智能与信息通信融合创新，加快网络和行业智能化升级。
articles.summary_en: On September 23, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Yu Xiaohui said at the opening of the 2026 China International Information and Communication Exhibition in Beijing that AI-integrated innovation should be advanced to accelerate intelligent upgrading of networks and the industry.

articles.title_zh: 新华鲜报｜文脉落京华 全国文化中心建设年度大事揭晓
articles.title_en: Xinhua Feature: Top 10 Events of National Cultural Center Construction Unveiled in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，2026北京文化论坛在京发布“全国文化中心建设2025年度十件大事”，涵盖文化遗产保护、新大众文艺、精神文明建设等领域。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the 2026 Beijing Cultural Forum released the top 10 events of 2025 in building the national cultural center, covering heritage protection, new mass arts and civic culture.

articles.title_zh: 青海省召开全省领导干部会议 罗东川任青海省委书记
articles.title_en: Qinghai Holds Provincial Leadership Meeting as Luo Dongchuan Appointed Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，青海省召开全省领导干部会议，中央组织部副部长吴浩宣布中央决定：罗东川任青海省委书记，吴晓军不再担任。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Qinghai held a provincial leadership meeting where Wu Hao of the Central Organization Department announced that Luo Dongchuan is appointed Qinghai Party secretary, replacing Wu Xiaojun.

articles.title_zh: 林武在淄博调研
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Conducts Research Tour in Zibo
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日至22日，山东省委书记林武在淄博调研先进制造业、重点项目建设和文旅促消费工作，强调做大做强先进制造业、确保完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 21 to 22, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu toured Zibo, inspecting advanced manufacturing, key projects and consumption-boosting work, and urging stronger industry and full-year economic goals.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国民营企业500强发布会在天津举行
articles.title_en: 2026 China Top 500 Private Enterprises Release Conference Held in Tianjin
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，2026中国民营企业500强发布会在天津举行，全国政协副主席、全国工商联主席高云龙，天津市委副书记、市长张工出席并致辞，会上发布500强榜单及调研分析报告。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the 2026 China Top 500 Private Enterprises release conference was held in Tianjin, where Gao Yunlong, Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee and Chairman of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce, and Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong delivered speeches and the 2026 rankings and research report were released.

articles.title_zh: 第二届中国—中亚气象合作论坛在乌鲁木齐开幕
articles.title_en: Second China-Central Asia Meteorological Cooperation Forum Opens in Urumqi
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，第二届中国—中亚气象合作论坛在乌鲁木齐开幕，新疆自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜、中国气象局局长陈振林及中亚多国气象部门负责人出席并致辞，会上签署中塔气象科技合作谅解备忘录并发布“妈祖”智能预警行动计划。
articles.summary_en: The Second China-Central Asia Meteorological Cooperation Forum opened in Urumqi on Sept 22, with Xinjiang Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz and China Meteorological Administration head Chen Zhenlin attending; a China-Tajikistan meteorological cooperation memorandum was signed and the "Mazu" early-warning action plan released.

articles.title_zh: 台媒曝光“战时盾牌”机密选址：台北故宫等多处民用设施在列
articles.title_en: Taiwan Media Exposes Classified "Wartime Shield" Site List Including Taipei Palace Museum
articles.summary_zh: 近日，台湾媒体曝光一份疑似“台湾联合应变中心”内部机密选址简报，台北故宫、儿童未来馆等民用设施被列入战时备选清单，引发岛内舆论声讨。
articles.summary_en: Taiwan media have exposed a classified site-selection briefing that lists civilian sites such as the Taipei Palace Museum as wartime shelters, sparking public outrage on the island.

articles.title_zh: 2026年8月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题29171起
articles.title_en: China Reports 29,171 Cases of Violating the Central Eight-Point Regulation in August 2026
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，中央纪委国家监委公布2026年8月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题情况，当月共查处问题29171起，批评教育和处理35901人，其中党纪政务处分24494人。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, China's Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission announced that 29,171 cases of violating the Central Eight-Point Regulation were handled nationwide in August 2026, with 35,901 people reprimanded or dealt with and 24,494 given Party or administrative disciplinary punishment.

articles.title_zh: 比了76年！全世界都来上海比"手艺活"，比的到底是啥
articles.title_en: After 76 Years, the World Comes to Shanghai to Test Its Skills: What Is WorldSkills All About?
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，第48届世界技能大赛在上海开幕，来自68个国家和地区的1385名选手参赛，这是该赛事首次在中国大陆举办，中国队在64个项目全项参赛。
articles.summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition opened in Shanghai on Sept 22 with 1,385 competitors from 68 countries and regions — the first time the event is held in mainland China, with China entering all 64 skill categories.

articles.title_zh: 习近平复信美国10所高校青年学生
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Young Students of 10 U.S. Universities
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平复信来华参加中美青年主题交流活动的美国10所高校青年学生，希望他们成为中美友好合作的传承者、维护者、发展者。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping replied to a letter from young students of 10 U.S. universities who took part in China-U.S. youth exchange activities, urging them to carry forward, safeguard and advance friendly China-U.S. cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 讨论拟提请二十届五中全会审议的文件
articles.title_en: CPC Politburo Meets on Document to Be Submitted to Fifth Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，中共中央政治局在北京召开会议，研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党重大问题，习近平总书记主持会议，会议决定二十届五中全会于10月26日至29日召开。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the CPC Politburo met in Beijing, chaired by Xi Jinping, to study advancing full and rigorous Party self-governance and decided to convene the Fifth Plenary Session on Oct 26-29.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Pay State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆9月21日在北京宣布，应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，中美两国元首半年内实现互访。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun announced in Beijing on Sept 21 that President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from Sept 23 to 25 at the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, with the two heads of state exchanging visits within half a year.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党保山市第六次代表大会举行第二次全体会议
articles.title_en: Second Plenary Session of the 6th CPC Baoshan City Congress Convened
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，中国共产党保山市第六次代表大会举行第二次全体会议，杨军主持，通过大会选举办法并宣布新一届市委委员、市纪委委员及省党代会代表预选候选人名单。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, the 6th CPC Baoshan City Congress held its second plenary session, chaired by Yang Jun, adopting election rules and announcing preliminary candidate lists for the new city Party committee, discipline commission and provincial congress delegates.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠顾刚到市青少年足球训练中心调研 夯实青少年足球后备人才根基
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui and Gu Gang Inspect Municipal Youth Football Training Center to Strengthen Youth Football Talent Pipeline
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，长春市委书记张恩惠、市长顾刚到市青少年足球训练中心调研，强调夯实青少年足球后备人才培养根基，推动体育产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui and Mayor Gu Gang inspected the city's Youth Football Training Center, stressing the need to strengthen youth football talent development and boost the high-quality growth of the sports industry.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚会见出席2026创投长春产业交流会嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Meets Guests Attending 2026 Changchun Venture Capital Industry Exchange Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚会见出席2026创投长春产业交流会的创投及金融机构负责人，围绕资本赋能产业、培育新质生产力深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang met with venture capital and financial executives attending the 2026 Changchun VC Industry Exchange Conference to discuss capital-driven industrial growth and cultivating new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，辽宁省省长王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议，审议综合交通运输、住房城乡建设等领域“十五五”规划及要素市场化配置改革举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei chaired a provincial government executive meeting, reviewing 15th Five-Year Plan drafts on transport and housing and measures on factor market reform.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见东北育才校友青年科创领军企业家考察团一行
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet with Delegation of Young Sci-Tech Entrepreneur Alumni from Northeast Yucai School
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见东北育才校友青年科创领军企业家考察团一行，欢迎他们到辽宁对接合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with a delegation of young sci-tech entrepreneur alumni from Northeast Yucai School, welcoming their cooperation in Liaoning.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见第七届辽洽会主宾国蒙古国代表团
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Mongolian Delegation as Guest Country of Honor at 7th Liaoning Trade Fair
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见由蒙古国经济发展部副部长斯·达瓦苏仁率领的代表团，蒙古国担任第七届辽洽会主宾国。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with a Mongolian delegation led by Deputy Minister of Economy and Development S. Davaasuren, as Mongolia serves as guest country of honor at the 7th Liaoning International Investment and Trade Fair.

articles.title_zh: 赤峰市委书记亢永强到喀喇沁旗调研
articles.title_en: Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang Inspects Harqin Banner
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，赤峰市委书记亢永强到喀喇沁旗调研经济社会发展和党的建设情况，强调坚持生态优先、绿色发展，建强农村基层党组织并规范管理集体“三资”。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang inspected Harqin Banner, calling for ecological protection, green development, stronger grassroots Party building and transparent management of rural collective assets.

articles.title_zh: 赤峰市委常委会（扩大）会议传达学习习近平总书记对内蒙古系列重要讲话精神并部署贯彻落实工作
articles.title_en: Chifeng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Conveys and Studies Xi Jinping's Important Speeches on Inner Mongolia, Deploys Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，赤峰市委书记亢永强主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记对内蒙古系列重要讲话和重要指示精神，安排部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang chaired an expanded standing committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's key Inner Mongolia speeches and instructions and arrange implementation.

articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，内蒙古赤峰市委书记亢永强登门看望斯日古楞、朱景田两位正厅级退休老同志，征求他们对市委工作和赤峰高质量发展的意见建议，并要求做好老干部服务保障。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, Chifeng Party Secretary Kang Yongqiang visited two retired senior officials at their homes and sought their views on municipal work and high-quality development, urging better services for retired cadres.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，国务委员、公安部部长王小洪在全国公安机关视频会议上强调，要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要回信精神，坚决扛牢守百姓幸福、护家国平安的重任。

articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets WorldSkills President and CEO
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国务院总理李强在上海会见世界技能组织主席乌汉和首席执行官霍伊。陈吉宁、吴政隆、谌贻琴参加会见。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Premier Li Qiang met in Shanghai with WorldSkills President Uhan and CEO Hoy. Chen Jining, Wu Zhenglong and Shen Yiqin also attended.

articles.title_zh: 推动中美关系迈向更美好未来——美国各界对习近平主席国事访问充满期待
articles.title_en: Advancing China-U.S. Relations Toward a Better Future: American Circles Look Forward to President Xi Jinping's State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，美国各界人士表示热烈欢迎并期待访问取得积极成果。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25, with American figures welcoming the trip and expecting positive results.

articles.title_zh: 各地秋粮收获陆续展开
articles.title_en: Autumn Grain Harvest Gets Underway Across China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，我国西南、东北及黄淮海地区秋粮陆续进入收获季，各地调度农机、抢收抢烘，确保粮食颗粒归仓。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, the autumn grain harvest began across southwest, northeast and Huang-Huai-Hai regions of China, with local authorities deploying machinery, emergency teams and drying facilities to ensure the crop is fully gathered in.

articles.title_zh: 国新办举行「开局起步'十五五'」系列主题新闻发布会：自然资源部、国家林草局介绍自然资源安全高效永续利用情况
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Briefing on Natural Resources: Ministry of Natural Resources and National Forestry and Grassland Administration Outline Plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国务院新闻办公室举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，自然资源部、国家林草局相关负责人介绍“十五五”期间自然资源安全高效永续利用有关安排。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the State Council Information Office held a briefing in its "Starting the 15th Five-Year Plan" series, where officials from the Ministry of Natural Resources and the National Forestry and Grassland Administration outlined plans for the safe, efficient and sustainable use of natural resources.

articles.title_zh: 李强在上海调研
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Conducts Inspection Tour in Shanghai

articles.summary_en: On September 22, Premier Li Qiang inspected Shanghai, visiting an AI application pilot base and a future-industries incubator, and called for deeper integration of AI with manufacturing to strengthen advanced and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见世界技能组织主席乌汉和首席执行官霍伊
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets WorldSkills President Uhan and CEO Hoey
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，国务院总理李强在上海会见来华出席第48届世界技能大赛的世界技能组织主席乌汉和首席执行官霍伊，表示愿深化双方技能领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 22, Premier Li Qiang met in Shanghai with WorldSkills President Uhan and CEO Hoey, who are in China for the 48th WorldSkills Competition, voicing readiness to deepen skills cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 张国清出席2026年全国食品安全宣传周主场活动强调深化食品安全全链条监管
articles.title_en: Zhang Guoqing Attends 2026 National Food Safety Week Main Event, Urges Deeper Whole-Chain Food Safety Regulation
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，2026年全国食品安全宣传周主场活动在北京举办，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理张国清出席并讲话，强调深化食品安全全链条监管、以严管严治提升监管质效。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the main event of 2026 National Food Safety Week was held in Beijing, where Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing called for deeper whole-chain food safety regulation and stricter oversight to improve regulatory effectiveness.

articles.title_zh: 推动中美关系这艘巨轮沿着正确航道平稳前行
articles.title_en: Advancing China-U.S. Relations Steadily Along the Right Course
articles.summary_zh: 应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，两国元首半年内实现互访。
articles.summary_en: At U.S. President Trump's invitation, President Xi Jinping will make a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25, the two leaders' second meeting within half a year.

articles.title_zh: 王小洪在全国公安机关视频会议上强调 坚决扛牢守百姓幸福护家国平安重任
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohong Stresses Safeguarding Public Wellbeing and National Security at National Public Security Video Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，全国公安机关视频会议在北京召开，中共中央书记处书记、公安部部长王小洪出席并讲话，要求深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要回信精神，抓好防风险、保安全、护稳定各项工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, a national public security video conference was held in Beijing. Wang Xiaohong, Secretary of the CPC Central Committee Secretariat and Minister of Public Security, addressed the meeting, urging thorough implementation of Xi Jinping's important reply letter and effective work on risk prevention, security and stability.

articles.title_zh: 国家发展改革委向民营企业推介36个项目 拟引入民间资本156亿元
articles.title_en: NDRC Promotes 36 Projects to Private Enterprises, Seeking 15.6 Billion Yuan in Private Capital
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国家发展改革委新闻发布会介绍，聚焦交通、物流领域向民营企业推介36个项目，拟引入民间资本156亿元，正在有序推进。
articles.summary_en: At a Sept. 22 press conference, the National Development and Reform Commission said it has promoted 36 transport and logistics projects to private enterprises, aiming to draw 15.6 billion yuan in private capital, with work now under way.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记引领提升粮食安全保障能力
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads Efforts to Strengthen National Food Security Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记引领提升粮食安全保障能力，强调14亿多人的饭碗必须主要装中国粮、坚持自力更生，并推动藏粮于地藏粮于技战略和大食物观落地。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping leads efforts to boost China's food security, stressing self-reliance in grain supply and promoting 'storing grain in land and technology' and the greater food approach.

tags.name_en: Storing Grain in Land and Technology

tags_en: Storing Grain in Land and Technology

articles.title_zh: 锚定新定位，推动中美建设性战略稳定关系行稳致远
articles.title_en: Anchoring the New Positioning to Steady the Constructive and Strategically Stable China-U.S. Relationship
articles.summary_zh: 应特朗普邀请，习近平主席将于2026年9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，此文称此访将为中美建设性战略稳定关系行稳致远提供战略引领。
articles.summary_en: At U.S. President Trump's invitation, President Xi Jinping will make a state visit to the U.S. from Sept 23-25, 2026, a trip described as providing strategic guidance for constructive and strategically stable China-U.S. ties.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同德国外长瓦德富尔通电话
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Speaks by Phone with German Foreign Minister Wadephul
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅应约同德国外长瓦德富尔通电话，就中德关系、中欧经贸及伊朗局势、乌克兰危机等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi took a phone call from German Foreign Minister Wadephul, discussing China-Germany ties, China-EU trade issues, the Iran situation and the Ukraine crisis.

articles.title_zh: 共同擘画中美关系新篇章——写在习近平主席对美国进行国事访问之际
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's State Visit to the US: Jointly Charting a New Chapter in China-US Relations
articles.summary_zh: 应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，这是中美元首半年内实现互访，具有历史性、里程碑意义。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from Sept 23 to 25, a historic milestone marking the two leaders' exchange of visits within six months.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥会见哈萨克斯坦第一副总理
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets with Kazakh First Deputy Prime Minister
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在北京会见哈萨克斯坦第一副总理纳利巴耶夫，双方就深化贸易投资、人工智能等领域务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, Ding Xuexiang, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met in Beijing with Kazakh First Deputy Prime Minister Nalibayev to discuss deeper practical cooperation in trade, investment and AI.

articles.title_zh: 李生潜主持召开五届市政府第119次常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Shengqian Chairs 119th Executive Meeting of Dingxi Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，定西市委副书记、代市长李生潜主持召开五届市政府第119次常务会议，部署安全生产、防汛减灾及1—8月经济运行等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Dingxi Acting Mayor Li Shengqian chaired the 119th executive meeting of the municipal government, deploying work on workplace safety, flood control and economic performance for January-August.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见第七届辽洽会主宾国蒙古国代表团一行
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Mongolian Delegation as Guest of Honor at 7th Liaoning Investment Fair
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见蒙古国经济发展部副部长斯·达瓦苏仁一行，欢迎其作为第七届辽洽会主宾国代表团参会。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with a Mongolian delegation led by Deputy Economy Minister S. Davasuren, guest of honor at the 7th Liaoning Investment Fair.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Economic Development of Mongolia

tags_en: Ministry of Economic Development of Mongolia

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 讨论拟提请二十届五中全会审议的文件 习近平主持会议
articles.title_en: CPC Politburo Meets on Documents for Fifth Plenary Session, Xi Jinping Presides
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，中共中央政治局在北京召开会议，研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党重大问题，习近平主持会议，并决定二十届五中全会于10月26日至29日在北京召开。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau met in Beijing to study sustained full and rigorous Party self-governance, with Xi Jinping presiding; it decided the 20th Central Committee's Fifth Plenary Session will be held in Beijing from Oct 26 to 29.

articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Holiday Market Supply, Tourism Consumption Promotion and Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，福州市委书记郭宁宁、市长吴贤德赴下沙海滨度假村、长乐国际机场T2航站楼、永辉超市等地，调研检查中秋国庆假期市场保供稳价、文旅促消费和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected sites including Xiasha seaside resort, the new Terminal 2 at Changle International Airport and a Yonghui supermarket, urging stable holiday supply, tourism consumption and safety.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市第九次党代会举行预备会议和主席团第一次会议
articles.title_en: Preparatory Meeting and First Presidium Meeting Held for Huaian's 9th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，中国共产党淮安市第九次代表大会举行预备会议，481名代表中467名出席，顾坤主持，通过大会议程、主席团及秘书长名单等，随后主席团举行第一次会议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the preparatory meeting of the 9th CPC Huaian Municipal Congress was held with 467 of 481 delegates present, chaired by Gu Kun, approving the agenda, presidium and secretary-general lists; the presidium then held its first meeting.

articles.summary_en: At the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25, with the two heads of state exchanging visits within half a year.

articles.title_en: Dawa Ciren Inspects Doilungdeqen District on Grassroots Governance, Industry and Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，西藏自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁深入堆龙德庆区调研基层治理、产业发展和党的建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: Dawa Ciren, Lhasa Party Secretary and Tibet Autonomous Region Party Standing Committee member, inspected Doilungdeqen District on grassroots governance, industry and Party building on Sept 20.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥接见“向国旗敬礼”港澳青少年升旗队代表访京团
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets Hong Kong and Macao Youth Flag-Raising Delegation in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在北京人民大会堂接见“向国旗敬礼”港澳青少年升旗队代表访京团，转达习近平主席问候并勉励青少年爱国爱港爱澳。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang met a Hong Kong and Macao youth flag-raising delegation at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing and conveyed Xi Jinping's greetings.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森参加盘山代表团讨论
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Joins PanShan Delegation Discussion at Panjin Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日下午，王炳森在盘锦市第九次党代会盘山代表团参加讨论，就县域经济、项目建设等与代表交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 22, Wang Bingsen joined the Panshan delegation at the 9th Panjin Municipal Party Congress, discussing county-level economy and project construction with delegates.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将对美国进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Make State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 外交部9月21日宣布，应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，期间将与特朗普就中美关系和世界和平发展重大问题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry announced on September 21 that President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from September 23 to 25 at the invitation of U.S. President Donald Trump, during which the two leaders will exchange views on major issues concerning bilateral ties and world peace and development.

articles.title_zh: 金平区召开区委常委会会议 研究安全生产与教师队伍建设等工作
articles.title_en: Jinping District Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting on Workplace Safety and Teacher Workforce Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，汕头市金平区召开区委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署安全生产、教师队伍建设、交通秩序治理和基层治理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the Jinping District Committee of Shantou held a standing committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions and plan work on workplace safety, teacher development, traffic governance and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市人民政府与粤检集团签订战略合作框架协议
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Government Signs Strategic Cooperation Framework Agreement with Yuejian Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日下午，汕头市人民政府与粤检集团签订战略合作框架协议，双方将在检验检测、质量基础设施建设、产业技术赋能等领域深化合作，市长陈涛、粤检集团董事长张志华分别致辞。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 21, the Shantou Municipal Government and Yuejian Group signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement to deepen cooperation in testing, quality infrastructure and industrial technology; Mayor Chen Tao and Yuejian chairman Zhang Zhihua spoke at the event.

articles.title_zh: 孟凡利到汕头、潮州、揭阳调研 强调扎实做好当前和四季度经济社会发展各项工作
articles.title_en: Meng Fanli Inspects Shantou, Chaozhou and Jieyang, Urging Solid Work on Current and Fourth-Quarter Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日至21日，广东省省长孟凡利先后赴汕头、潮州、揭阳三市，深入企业、园区、社区、村庄和海洋牧场专题调研，强调扎实做好当前和四季度各项工作，努力完成全年目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On September 20-21, Guangdong Governor Meng Fanli inspected Shantou, Chaozhou and Jieyang, visiting enterprises, industrial parks, communities and marine ranches, and urged solid efforts on current and fourth-quarter work to meet the year's development targets.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰督导推进中央生态环境保护督察反馈问题整改工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Supervises Rectification of Central Ecological Environmental Protection Inspection Feedback Issues
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到市城区督导中央生态环境保护督察反馈问题整改工作，强调抓好污水收集处理与水环境治理，持续改善生态环境质量。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng supervised rectification of issues flagged by the central ecological inspection in urban areas, urging better sewage treatment and water environment governance.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰督导推进中央生态环境保护督察反馈问题整改工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Inspects Rectification of Issues Raised by Central Ecological Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到市城区督导中央生态环境保护督察反馈问题整改，强调立行立改、标本兼治，提升污水收集处理与水环境治理效能。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng inspected urban areas to press for rectification of issues flagged by the central ecological inspection, urging swift fixes and better sewage treatment and water quality.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委召开理论学习中心组学习会 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Ningxia Regional Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Session, Li Yifei Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，宁夏回族自治区党委召开理论学习中心组学习会，自治区党委书记李邑飞主持并讲话，要求深入学习贯彻习近平经济思想，确保完成全年经济社会发展目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the CPC Ningxia Regional Committee held a theoretical study session. Party Secretary Li Yifei presided and urged deeper study of Xi Jinping's economic thought and fulfillment of this year's economic goals.

articles.title_zh: 徐龙：深谋细研实化项目储备 聚力夯实基建防灾根基
articles.title_en: Xu Long Urges Deeper Project Planning to Bolster Infrastructure and Disaster Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，石嘴山市委副书记、市长徐龙主持召开2027年基础设施和防灾减灾领域项目谋划实化推进会，要求深化研究对接，抓好城市更新改造与项目储备。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Shi Zuishan Mayor Xu Long chaired a meeting on planning infrastructure and disaster-prevention projects for 2027, urging deeper research and stronger project reserves for urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政府召开常务会议专题研究民生保障工作
articles.title_en: Autonomous Region Government Holds Executive Meeting on Livelihood Security
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，宁夏自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府2026年第23次常务会议，专题研究民生保障，决定提高最低工资、城乡低保等4项标准。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, regional chairman Zhang Yupu chaired the 23rd executive meeting of the regional government in 2026, focusing on livelihood security and deciding to raise four standards including the minimum wage and urban-rural subsistence allowances.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党泰州市第七次代表大会隆重开幕
articles.title_en: 7th CPC Taizhou Municipal Congress Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，中国共产党泰州市第七次代表大会在泰州开幕，姜冬冬代表第六届市委作工作报告，484名代表到会。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, the 7th Congress of the CPC Taizhou Municipal Committee opened in Taizhou, Jiangsu, where Jiang Dongdong delivered a work report on behalf of the 6th Municipal Committee.

articles.title_zh: 无锡市第十五次党代会举行预备会议
articles.title_en: Wuxi Holds Preparatory Meeting for 15th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日下午，中国共产党无锡市第十五次代表大会预备会议举行，蒋锋主持并报告筹备工作情况，会议通过主席团、代表资格审查委员会名单及大会议程。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 21, the preparatory meeting of the 15th Wuxi Municipal Party Congress was held, chaired by Jiang Feng, who reported on preparations; the meeting approved the presidium, credential committee roster and agenda.

articles.title_zh: 李强在上海调研时强调 加快培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业 持续做大做强先进制造业
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Stresses Faster Development of Emerging and Future Industries, Stronger Advanced Manufacturing, During Shanghai Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国务院总理李强在上海调研，考察人工智能应用中试基地和未来产业孵化平台，强调推进“人工智能+制造”，加快培育壮大新兴产业和未来产业，做大做强先进制造业。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Premier Li Qiang inspected AI and future-industry pilot bases in Shanghai, urging deeper AI-manufacturing integration and faster growth of emerging industries.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见国家开发银行党委委员、副行长王克冰一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Wang Kebing, Vice President of China Development Bank
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见国家开发银行副行长王克冰一行，双方就防范化解债务风险、融资平台市场化转型、“十五五”重大项目等深化合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met China Development Bank Vice President Wang Kebing, with the two sides agreeing to deepen cooperation on debt risk resolution, market-oriented reform of financing platforms and major projects.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见太古地产全球行政总裁彭国邦一行
articles.title_en: Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie Meets Swire Properties CEO Tim Blackburn
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰在西安会见太古地产全球行政总裁彭国邦一行，双方就推进西安太古里项目、深化互利合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, Hao Huijie, Party Secretary of Xi'an and a Standing Committee member of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, met in Xi'an with Tim Blackburn, Global CEO of Swire Properties, to discuss the Xi'an Taikoo Li project and deeper cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会召开会议 研究安排先进制造业发展、稳增长和安全稳定等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Advanced Manufacturing, Growth Stabilization and Security
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，西安市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话指示精神，研究部署先进制造业发展、稳增长及中秋国庆假期安全稳定等工作，蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's instructions and plan work on advanced manufacturing, growth stabilization and holiday security, chaired by Hao Huijie.

articles.title_zh: 第八届亚太经合组织人力资源开发部长会在南京举行 谌贻琴出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Attends 8th APEC Human Resources Development Ministerial Meeting in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，第八届亚太经合组织人力资源开发部长会在南京举行，国务委员谌贻琴出席开幕式并致辞，会议由人力资源社会保障部部长王晓萍主持。
articles.summary_en: The 8th APEC Human Resources Development Ministerial Meeting was held in Nanjing on Sept 21, with State Councilor Chen Yiqin attending the opening ceremony and delivering a speech; the meeting was chaired by Human Resources and Social Security Minister Wang Xiaoping.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党盐城市第九次代表大会开幕
articles.title_en: 9th CPC Yancheng Municipal Congress Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日上午，中国共产党盐城市第九次代表大会在盐城市人民大会堂开幕，严汉平代表第八届市委作报告，吴炜主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 21, the 9th CPC Yancheng Municipal Congress opened at the city's People's Great Hall, with Yan Hanping delivering the work report on behalf of the 8th municipal committee and Wu Wei presiding.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党玉溪市第七次代表大会开幕
articles.title_en: 7th Yuxi Municipal Congress of the CPC Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日上午，中国共产党玉溪市第七次代表大会在玉溪聂耳大剧院开幕，杨政昆代表第六届市委作工作报告，胡江辉主持大会。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 21, the 7th Yuxi Municipal Congress of the Communist Party of China opened at the Nie Er Grand Theater, where Yang Zhengkun delivered the work report on behalf of the 6th Municipal Committee and Hu Jianghui presided over the session.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党岳阳市第九次代表大会举行预备会议
articles.title_en: Preparatory Meeting Held for the 9th CPC Yueyang Municipal Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日下午，中国共产党岳阳市第九次代表大会举行预备会议，谢卫江讲话，唐浩然主持，462名代表出席并通过主席团名单及大会议程。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 21, the 9th CPC Yueyang Municipal Congress held its preparatory meeting, addressed by Xie Weijiang and chaired by Tang Haoran, with 462 delegates approving the presidium list and congress agenda.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市举行庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Holds Reception Marking 77th Anniversary of the Founding of the People's Republic of China
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日晚，湛江市政府在海滨宾馆举行庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会，市长李勇毅出席并致辞，近200位中外各界人士参加。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept 21, the Zhanjiang municipal government held a reception at Haibin Hotel marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, with Mayor Li Yongyi delivering remarks to nearly 200 Chinese and foreign guests.

articles.title_zh: 余钢李勇毅到麻章区调研督导红树林保护修复工作并召开现场办公会
articles.title_en: Yu Gang and Li Yongyi Inspect Mangrove Protection and Restoration Work in Mazhang District, Hold On-Site Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，湛江市委书记余钢、市长李勇毅赴麻章区调研督导红树林保护修复工作并召开现场办公会，部署中央环保督察整改与生态价值转化。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang and Mayor Li Yongyi inspected mangrove protection and restoration work in Mazhang District and held an on-site meeting on rectifying central environmental inspection findings.

articles.title_zh: 余钢李勇毅会见外国驻穗领馆官员
articles.title_en: Yu Gang and Li Yongyi Meet with Foreign Consuls General Stationed in Guangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日下午，湛江市委书记余钢、市长李勇毅会见老挝、法国、印度三国驻穗总领事一行，就深化经贸、产业、港口物流等领域交流合作举行友好会谈。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 21, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang and Mayor Li Yongyi met with the consuls general of Laos, France and India in Guangzhou for friendly talks on deepening cooperation in trade, industry and port logistics.

articles.title_zh: 全市重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会召开
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Holds Weekly Meeting on Key Projects and Enterprise Appeals
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，周口市召开重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会，市委书记黄玉国出席并讲话，市长詹鹏主持，部署纺织服装千亿级产业集群建设与企业诉求办理工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Zhoukou held its weekly meeting on key projects and enterprise appeals, with Party Secretary Huang Yuguo speaking and Mayor Zhan Peng presiding, deploying work on a 100-billion-yuan textile and garment cluster.

articles.title_zh: 周口市委书记黄玉国调研历史街区运营、市政项目建设工作
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo Inspects Historic District Operations and Municipal Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，周口市委书记黄玉国调研中心城区历史街区运营与市政项目建设，要求推进文化街区活化利用、加快城市基础设施补短板。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo inspected historic districts and municipal projects in the city center, urging cultural revitalization and faster infrastructure upgrades.

articles.title_zh: 前八月江苏经济观察：四大亮点，见证经济提质向好
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Economy in the First Eight Months: Four Highlights Show Improving Quality and Growth
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，江苏省统计局公布1—8月经济运行数据，工业、服务业、投资、消费四大结构性亮点显现，全省经济总体平稳、稳中有进。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, the Jiangsu Provincial Bureau of Statistics released economic data for January-August, showing four structural highlights in industry, services, investment and consumption, with the provincial economy stable and improving.

articles.title_zh: 铜陵“智造”亮相2026世界制造业大会
articles.title_en: Tongling's Smart Manufacturing Shines at 2026 World Manufacturing Convention
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，2026世界制造业大会在合肥开幕，铜陵市组团参展并签约34个项目，总投资160.7亿元。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Manufacturing Convention opened in Hefei on Sept 20, where Tongling's delegation exhibited and signed 34 projects with total investment of 16.07 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省民族团结进步宣传周启动
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week Launches
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，甘肃省民族团结进步宣传周启动仪式在兰州举行，省委常委、省委统战部部长孙雪涛出席并讲话，省人大常委会副主任丁巨胜、省政协副主席何伟出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, the launch ceremony of Gansu Province's Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week was held in Lanzhou, with Sun Xuetao, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and head of the United Front Work Department, attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 南宁市举行2026投资贸易洽谈会暨重大项目签约仪式
articles.title_en: Nanning Hosts 2026 Investment and Trade Fair and Major Project Signing Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 第23届中国—东盟博览会期间，2026南宁投资贸易洽谈会暨重大项目签约仪式在南宁举行，现场签约项目36个，涵盖向海经济、人工智能、制造业及文旅大健康等领域。
articles.summary_en: During the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo, Nanning held its 2026 Investment and Trade Fair and Major Project Signing Ceremony, with 36 projects signed on site covering the seaward economy, AI, manufacturing and cultural tourism.

articles.title_zh: 第23届东博会推动中国—东盟全方位互联互通
articles.title_en: 23rd China-ASEAN Expo Promotes All-Round China-ASEAN Connectivity
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，第23届中国—东盟博览会闭幕新闻发布会在南宁举行，本届东博会以经贸为主线、AI为主角，通过平陆运河考察专线、青年领军者成长计划等推动中国—东盟全方位互联互通。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, a closing press conference for the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo was held in Nanning, highlighting trade, AI and people-to-people exchanges, including Pinglu Canal tours and youth leadership programs, to advance all-round China-ASEAN connectivity.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台“人工智能+电商”专项政策 到2028年建成300个高质量电商数据集
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Special Policy on "AI Plus E-commerce", Targeting 300 High-Quality E-commerce Datasets by 2028
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，江苏电商创新发展大会在南京开幕，会上发布《江苏省“人工智能+电商”创新发展行动方案（2026—2028年）》，提出12条举措并首批发布163个高质量电商数据集。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22 the Jiangsu E-commerce Innovation and Development Conference opened in Nanjing, releasing a 2026-2028 action plan for "AI plus e-commerce" with 12 measures and a first batch of 163 high-quality e-commerce datasets.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中深入兴安盟调研
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong Inspects Hinggan League
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日至21日，内蒙古自治区党委书记、人大常委会主任王伟中深入兴安盟调研，实地察看高标准农田建设、村集体“三资”管理、绿能化工项目和自然保护区，部署乡村振兴与农牧业高质量发展工作。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 19 to 21, Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong toured Hinggan League, inspecting high-standard farmland, village collective asset management, green energy chemical projects and a nature reserve, urging rural revitalization and high-quality agriculture and animal husbandry.

articles.title_zh: 滇川藏甘青五省区野生冬虫夏草保护行动宣言发布
articles.title_en: Five Provinces Release Declaration on Protecting Wild Cordyceps in Qinghai-Tibet Plateau
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，青海省林业和草原局在西宁发布《五省（区）野生冬虫夏草保护行动宣言》，滇川藏甘青五省区将协同推进资源保护、跨区域执法联动和产业规范治理。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 22, Qinghai's Forestry and Grassland Bureau released a joint declaration with Gansu, Sichuan, Yunnan and Tibet to protect wild Cordyceps, covering resource conservation, cross-regional law enforcement and industry regulation.

articles.title_zh: 四川省纪委监委：6人被查、2人被“双开”
articles.title_en: Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection: Six Officials Under Investigation, Two Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，四川省纪委监委通报，南充、成都、乐山、甘孜、内江等地6名干部接受纪律审查和监察调查，另有江海、杨正堂2人被开除党籍和公职。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, the Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced that six officials in Nanchong, Chengdu, Leshan, Ganzi and Neijiang are under investigation, while two others, Jiang Hai and Yang Zhengtang, were expelled from both the Party and public office.

articles.title_zh: 四川启动旅游市场“雷霆”行动 全力冲刺“百日攻坚”
articles.title_en: Sichuan Launches "Thunder" Campaign to Overhaul Tourism Market
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，四川通过视频会议召开全省集中整治工作调度会，宣布启动旅游市场“雷霆”行动百日攻坚，聚焦乱象整治、安全生产防控和服务提质。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Sichuan convened a video conference to launch a 100-day "Thunder" campaign targeting tourism market misconduct, safety risks and service quality across the province.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国民营企业500强榜单在天津发布
articles.title_en: 2026 China Top 500 Private Enterprises List Released in Tianjin
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日上午，全国工商联与天津市人民政府在天津共同主办2026中国民营企业500强发布会，发布500强等榜单及调研分析报告，京东、阿里巴巴、恒力集团位居前三。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 22, the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and the Tianjin Municipal People's Government co-hosted the release of the 2026 China Top 500 Private Enterprises list in Tianjin, issuing the ranking and a research report, with JD.com, Alibaba and Hengli Group in the top three.
