articles.title_zh: 第169次中老缅泰湄公河联合巡逻执法行动启动
articles.title_en: 169th China-Laos-Myanmar-Thailand Mekong Joint Patrol Law Enforcement Operation Launched
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，第169次中老缅泰湄公河联合巡逻执法行动在云南景洪启动，四国执法部门召开指挥官联席会，随后组成编队开展全线联合巡逻执法。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the 169th China-Laos-Myanmar-Thailand Mekong joint patrol law enforcement operation was launched in Jinghong, Yunnan, after the four countries' law enforcement agencies held a commanders' meeting and formed a joint patrol flotilla.

articles.title_zh: 2026华商聚云南活动在昆明开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Overseas Chinese Businessmen Gathering Opens in Kunming
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，“2026华商聚云南”活动在昆明开幕，来自30多个国家和地区的约150名华商侨领参会，云南省委书记王宁等出席并致辞，省长王予波作推介。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 "Overseas Chinese Businessmen Gathering in Yunnan" opened in Kunming on Sept 21, drawing about 150 overseas Chinese business leaders from over 30 countries and regions; Yunnan Party Secretary Wang Ning and Governor Wang Yubo spoke at the event.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向全国广大农民和工作在“三农”战线上的同志们致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Festive Greetings to Farmers and Agricultural Workers Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月22日，在第九个“中国农民丰收节”到来之际，习近平代表党中央向全国广大农民和“三农”战线同志致以节日祝贺，强调扎实推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, 2026, ahead of the ninth Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, Xi Jinping extended festive greetings on behalf of the CPC Central Committee to farmers and agricultural workers nationwide, stressing solid progress in all-round rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向第48届世界技能大赛致贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter to the 48th WorldSkills Competition
articles.summary_zh: 9月22日，国家主席习近平向在上海开幕的第48届世界技能大赛致贺信，表示中国将以举办大赛为契机鼓励劳动者特别是青年走技能成才之路。
articles.summary_en: On September 22, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 48th WorldSkills Competition opening in Shanghai, saying China will use the event to encourage workers, especially young people, to pursue skills-based careers.

articles.title_zh: 王清宪：四位一体 以强促大 打造智能汽车创新生态
articles.title_en: Wang Qingxian: Integrated Four-in-One Approach to Build an Innovation Ecosystem for Smart Vehicles
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，2026世界制造业大会智能网联新能源汽车产业集群建设对接会在合肥召开，安徽省省长王清宪出席讲话，强调走研发、整车、零部件、后市场“四位一体”之路，打造具有全球竞争力的智能汽车创新生态。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, the 2026 World Manufacturing Convention's intelligent connected new energy vehicle industry cluster matchmaking meeting was held in Hefei, where Anhui Governor Wang Qingxian called for an integrated approach across R&D, complete vehicles, parts and aftermarket to build a globally competitive smart vehicle innovation ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大北京团代表在京开展专题调研 李秀领参加
articles.title_en: NPC Beijing Delegation Deputies Conduct Field Research in Beijing; Li Xiuling Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日至18日，北京市人大常委会组织全国人大北京团部分代表开展专题调研，围绕城市更新、创新发展、绿色发展等了解“十五五”落实及民生保障情况，李秀领参加。
articles.summary_en: Beijing's municipal legislature organized NPC Beijing delegation deputies on Sept 17-18 to research urban renewal, innovation and green development under the 15th Five-Year Plan; Li Xiuling took part.

articles.title_zh: 2026国际生物医药产业创新北京论坛全体大会举行 雷海潮殷勇致辞
articles.title_en: Plenary Session of 2026 International Biopharmaceutical Industry Innovation Beijing Forum Held; Lei Haichao and Yin Yong Deliver Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日下午，以“汇聚全球创新，探究生命前沿”为主题的2026国际生物医药产业创新北京论坛全体大会举行，国家卫生健康委员会主任雷海潮、北京市市长殷勇出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 19, the plenary session of the 2026 International Biopharmaceutical Industry Innovation Beijing Forum was held, with National Health Commission Director Lei Haichao and Beijing Mayor Yin Yong delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 尹力在昌平区调研合成生物制造产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects Synthetic Biology Manufacturing Industry Development in Changping District
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，北京市委书记尹力赴昌平区调研合成生物制造产业发展工作，强调大力推动技术创新和产业应用，打造创新引领的产业高地，市长殷勇一同调研。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li inspected the development of the synthetic biology manufacturing industry in Changping District, calling for stronger technological innovation and industrial application, with Mayor Yin Yong joining the inspection.

articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，重庆市委副书记、市长陈新武调研上海交通大学重庆人工智能研究院、嘉陵江实验室、北京大学重庆碳基集成电路研究院等科创平台，强调推动资源整合与科产融合，以高能级平台产出高水平科研成果。

articles.title_en: Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Second Plenary Session of 26th Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，河南省十四届人大常委会第二十六次会议第二次全体会议在郑州举行，李亚主持会议，听取科技创新平台、国有资产管理等多项报告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, the Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee held the second plenary session of its 26th meeting in Zhengzhou, chaired by Li Ya, hearing reports on sci-tech platforms and state assets.

articles.title_zh: 鼓励民间资本参与重点项目 推动北斗规模应用——国家发展改革委解析近期经济热点
articles.title_en: NDRC Explains Recent Economic Hot Topics: Encouraging Private Capital in Key Projects and Promoting Large-Scale BeiDou Applications

articles.title_zh: 国家粮食和物资储备局：中国粮食市场保持总体平稳
articles.title_en: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration: China's Grain Market Remains Generally Stable
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，国家粮食和物资储备局局长刘焕鑫在国务院新闻办发布会上表示，面对国际粮价波动，中国粮食市场保持总体平稳，粮食安全有可靠保障。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Liu Huanxin, head of China's National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, said at a State Council Information Office briefing that despite global grain price fluctuations, China's grain market remains generally stable and food security is reliably guaranteed.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中方一贯致力于维护关键矿产全球产供链稳定与安全
articles.title_en: Chinese FM Spokesperson: China Committed to Stability and Security of Global Critical Minerals Supply Chains
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上回应美媒关于稀土供应的提问，表示中方一贯致力于维护关键矿产全球产供链稳定与安全，中美应共同落实两国元首重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told a regular briefing in Beijing that China is committed to keeping global critical minerals supply chains stable and secure, urging both sides to implement the leaders' consensus.

articles.title_zh: 吉林省农安县委原书记白松巍接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Former Nong'an County Party Secretary Bai Songwei Under Disciplinary Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据吉林省纪委监委9月21日消息，吉林省农安县委原书记白松巍涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动向组织交代问题，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Bai Songwei, former Party secretary of Nong'an County in Jilin Province, is under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations, and has voluntarily reported his problems to the organization, the Jilin Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection said on Sept 21.

tags.name_en: Jilin Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Jilin Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 中国最高法发布审理涉刑事犯罪民事纠纷案件规定
articles.title_en: China's Supreme People's Court Issues Rules on Civil Disputes Involving Criminal Offenses
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，中国最高人民法院发布关于审理涉及刑事犯罪的民事纠纷案件若干问题的规定，共24条，自9月22日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, China's Supreme People's Court released 24 provisions on handling civil disputes involving criminal offenses, effective September 22.

articles.title_zh: 我国牵头编制的IEC抽水蓄能趋势白皮书正式发布
articles.title_en: China-Led IEC White Paper on Pumped Storage Trends Officially Released
articles.summary_zh: 近日，由我国牵头编制的首项以抽水蓄能为主题的IEC社会与技术趋势白皮书正式发布，标志着我国在抽水蓄能国际前沿技术与标准化研究中实现新突破。
articles.summary_en: China has led the drafting of the first IEC social and technology trends white paper on pumped storage, marking a new breakthrough in international frontier technology and standardization research in the field.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见澳大利亚联邦议会众议长迪克
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets Australian House of Representatives Speaker Dick
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见澳大利亚联邦议会众议长迪克，双方就增进战略沟通、深化互利合作、推进中澳全面战略伙伴关系交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, Vice President Han Zheng met in Beijing with Australian House of Representatives Speaker Dick, with both sides pledging to deepen communication, cooperation and the China-Australia comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界公众科学素质促进大会在北京开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 World Conference on Science Literacy for the Public Opens in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026世界公众科学素质促进大会9月20日在北京开幕，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊，全国政协副主席、中国科协主席王光谦出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Conference on Science Literacy for the Public opened in Beijing on Sept 20, with Li Shulei, Politburo member and head of the Publicity Department, and Wang Guangqian, vice chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 李鸿忠在辽宁调研时强调 以良法促进发展保障善治
articles.title_en: Li Hongzhong Stresses Good Legislation to Promote Development and Good Governance During Liaoning Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日至20日，中共中央政治局委员、全国人大常委会副委员长李鸿忠在辽宁沈阳、鞍山、大连调研，强调以高质量立法保障改革发展、促进社会公平正义。
articles.summary_en: From September 17 to 20, Li Hongzhong, member of the CPC Central Political Bureau and Vice Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, inspected Shenyang, Anshan and Dalian in Liaoning, stressing high-quality legislation to support reform, development and social fairness.

articles.title_zh: 推动平台经济创新和健康发展
articles.title_en: Promoting Innovation and Healthy Development of the Platform Economy
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，市场监管总局介绍“十五五”时期市场监管高质量发展部署，聚焦平台经济、反垄断与全国统一大市场建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where the State Administration for Market Regulation outlined market regulation priorities for the 15th Five-Year Plan, covering the platform economy, antitrust enforcement and the unified national market.

articles.title_zh: 中办国办印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council General Offices Issue Opinions on Advancing Classified Reform of Universities
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月20日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》，对分类推进高校改革作出系统部署。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, 2026, the general offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued the Opinions on Advancing Classified Reform of Universities, setting out systematic plans for the reform.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际同澳大利亚联邦议会众议长迪克会谈
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Holds Talks with Australian House of Representatives Speaker Milton Dick
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际在北京人民大会堂同澳大利亚联邦议会众议长迪克举行会谈，就深化中澳关系、加强立法机构交往和各领域务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, NPC Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji held talks at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing with Australian House of Representatives Speaker Milton Dick on deepening bilateral ties, legislative exchanges and practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 长春市政府召开党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Changchun Municipal Government Holds Enlarged Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，长春市市长顾刚主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，部署中秋国庆假期安全生产、文旅消费及经济运行、招商引资、民生保障等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang chaired an enlarged Party group meeting of the municipal government, arranging holiday safety production, tourism consumption, economic operations and investment promotion.

articles.title_zh: 胡玉亭调研农业工作：以发展现代化大农业为主攻方向，推动农业大省向农业强省迈进
articles.title_en: Hu Yuting Inspects Agricultural Work, Stressing Modern Large-Scale Agriculture to Build Jilin into an Agricultural Powerhouse
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，吉林省省长胡玉亭到农安县、德惠市调研农业工作，强调扛稳粮食安全责任、发展农产品精深加工，推动农业大省向农业强省迈进。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Jilin Governor Hu Yuting inspected agricultural work in Nong'an County and Dehui City, urging solid grain-security duties and deeper processing of farm products to turn the major agricultural province into a strong one.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在中央第一生态环境保护督察组督察辽宁省情况反馈会上作表态发言 全力以赴抓好督察反馈问题整改
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Pledges Full Rectification at Central Ecological Inspection Feedback Meeting on Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，中央第一生态环境保护督察组督察辽宁省情况反馈会在沈阳召开，辽宁省委书记许昆林作表态发言，表示全力抓好督察反馈问题整改，推动美丽辽宁建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, the central ecological inspection team gave feedback on Liaoning in Shenyang; Liaoning party chief Xu Kunlin pledged to fully rectify the problems found and advance a greener Liaoning.

articles.title_zh: 中央第一生态环境保护督察组督察辽宁省情况反馈会在沈阳召开
articles.title_en: Central Environmental Inspection Team Gives Feedback on Liaoning Inspection in Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，中央第一生态环境保护督察组督察辽宁省情况反馈会在沈阳召开，组长蔡名照通报督察报告，省委书记许昆林作表态发言，省长王新伟主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, the Central No. 1 Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection Team held a feedback meeting in Shenyang on its inspection of Liaoning, with team leader Cai Mingzhao delivering the report and provincial party secretary Xu Kunlin pledging full rectification.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee General Office and State Council General Office Issue Opinions on Promoting Categorized Reform of Universities
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》，就优化分类布局结构、激发分类发展动能、健全分类发展机制等作出系统部署。
articles.summary_en: The General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued opinions on promoting categorized reform of universities, setting out systematic plans on layout, development momentum, evaluation and resource allocation.

articles.title_zh: 中美经贸磋商在美国纽约举行
articles.title_en: China-U.S. Economic and Trade Consultations Held in New York
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月20日，国务院副总理何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔在纽约举行中美经贸磋商，就落实历次磋商共识、促进双边贸易投资及人工智能问题深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 20 local time, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met with U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer in New York for China-U.S. economic and trade consultations, discussing trade, investment and AI issues.

articles.title_zh: 发票数据显示前8个月全国企业销售收入呈现四个亮点
articles.title_en: Invoice Data Shows Four Highlights in National Enterprise Sales Revenue in First Eight Months
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，国家税务总局发布最新发票数据，显示今年前8个月全国企业销售收入在工业经济、新质生产力、数实融合、统一大市场四方面表现突出。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, China's State Taxation Administration released invoice data showing four highlights in national enterprise sales revenue in the first eight months of the year, covering industrial growth, new quality productive forces, digital-real integration and the unified market.

articles.title_zh: 为了共同繁荣的梦想——习近平主席引领全球发展倡议造福世界
articles.title_en: For the Dream of Common Prosperity: Xi Jinping Leads Global Development Initiative to Benefit the World
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道，全球发展倡议提出5年来，在习近平主席引领下已开展2000多个合作项目，惠及120多个国家，获130多个国家和国际组织支持。
articles.summary_en: Five years after Xi Jinping proposed the Global Development Initiative, China has carried out over 2,000 cooperation projects benefiting more than 120 countries, backed by 130-plus nations and organizations.

articles.title_zh: 中央第一生态环境保护督察组向辽宁省反馈督察情况
articles.title_en: Central Environmental Inspection Team No. 1 Gives Feedback to Liaoning Province
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月20日，中央第一生态环境保护督察组向辽宁省委、省政府反馈第三轮生态环境保护督察情况，组长蔡名照通报督察报告，省委书记许昆林作表态发言，省长王新伟主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, 2026, the Central Environmental Inspection Team No. 1 gave feedback to Liaoning's party committee and government on its third-round inspection, with team head Cai Mingzhao delivering the report.

articles.title_zh: 福州持续加强巡察工作：把巡察利剑磨得更光更亮
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Continues to Strengthen Party Inspection Work
articles.summary_zh: 五年来福州市委巡察机构深化政治巡察，十二届市委巡察已实现全覆盖，市县两级累计巡察党组织4070个，推动整改问题4.6万余个。
articles.summary_en: Over five years, Fuzhou's municipal Party inspection bodies have deepened political inspections, covering 4,070 Party organizations and prompting more than 46,000 rectifications.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市政府党组会议召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Government Party Group Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，淮安市政府党组书记、代市长杨新忠主持召开市政府党组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示重要文章精神，研究推进政府班子自身建设。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Yang Xinzhong, Party Secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Government Party Group and Acting Mayor, chaired a party group meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions and to strengthen the government leadership team.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦主持召开淮北市委常委会会议 研究安全生产、先进制造业和审计工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Chairs Huaibei Municipal Party Committee Meeting on Safety Production, Advanced Manufacturing and Audit Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日下午，淮北市委书记蒋曦主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神和中央政治局会议精神，研究安全生产、先进制造业发展及审计等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi chaired a municipal Party standing committee meeting to relay Xi Jinping's instructions and the Aug 28 Politburo meeting, focusing on safety production, advanced manufacturing and audit work.

articles.title_zh: 2026年淮北市暨杜集区民族团结进步宣传周启动仪式举行 蒋曦出席并宣布活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Huaibei City and Duji District Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week Kicks Off; Jiang Xi Attends and Declares It Open
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，2026年淮北市暨杜集区民族团结进步宣传周启动仪式在杜集区开渠广场举行，市委书记蒋曦宣布启动并向民族团结宣传员代表颁发证书。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, the 2026 Huaibei City and Duji District Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Week launched at Kaiqu Square in Duji District, with Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Xi declaring it open and presenting certificates to ethnic unity promoters.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生在洪江市调研督导溶洞污染整治、秸秆焚烧管控、乡村振兴工作
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Inspects Hongjiang City on Cave Pollution Remediation, Straw Burning Control and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，怀化市委副书记、代市长高靖生赴洪江市安江镇，调研督导溶洞污染整治、秸秆焚烧管控和乡村振兴工作，强调统筹推进生态保护与乡村发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Huaihua Deputy Party Secretary and Acting Mayor Gao Jingsheng inspected Anjiang Town in Hongjiang City to supervise cave pollution remediation, straw burning control and rural revitalization, urging coordinated ecological protection and rural development.

articles.title_zh: 中国气象局联合湖南省气象局赴怀化调研杂交水稻制种气象服务
articles.title_en: China Meteorological Administration and Hunan Provincial Meteorological Bureau Survey Hybrid Rice Seed Production Weather Services in Huaihua
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日上午，中国气象局联合湖南省气象局组成专家调研组，赴怀化市溆浦县调研指导杂交水稻制种气象服务工作，并部署深化核心技术研究等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 19, a joint expert team from the China Meteorological Administration and the Hunan Provincial Meteorological Bureau visited Xupu County in Huaihua to survey and guide meteorological services for hybrid rice seed production and to set out next steps.

articles.title_zh: 2026年驻济高校座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Jinan Hosts 2026 Symposium with Universities Based in the City
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，2026年驻济高校座谈会在济南召开，市委书记刘强出席并讲话，市长于海田主持，会议聚焦校地融合与教育科技人才发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Jinan held the 2026 symposium with universities based in the city, where Party Secretary Liu Qiang urged deeper city-university integration in education, technology and talent development.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保到榕城区调研古城保育活化工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects Ancient City Conservation and Revitalization in Rongcheng District
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日上午，揭阳市委书记曾风保赴榕城区调研古城保育活化工作，实地察看潮侨堂、望江北路跨线桥等项目，要求抢工期、保质量，提升古城风貌品质。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 20, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao inspected ancient-city conservation projects in Rongcheng District, urging faster, quality construction and an improved cityscape.

articles.title_zh: 李强将出席第五届全球数字贸易博览会启动仪式及相关活动
articles.title_en: Li Qiang to Attend Launch Ceremony of Fifth Global Digital Trade Expo
articles.summary_zh: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东9月21日宣布，第五届全球数字贸易博览会将于9月23日至27日在浙江省杭州市举办，国务院总理李强将出席启动仪式及相关活动并致辞。
articles.summary_en: China announced the Fifth Global Digital Trade Expo will be held in Hangzhou, Zhejiang from Sept 23 to 27, 2026, with Premier Li Qiang attending the launch ceremony and delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰与广东广播电视台党委书记、台长李宜航座谈
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Holds Talks with Guangdong Radio and Television Party Secretary and President Li Yihang
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日上午，汕尾市委书记逯峰与广东广播电视台党委书记、台长李宜航座谈，就借力2026粤港澳大湾区中秋晚会加强汕尾城市形象品牌宣介等深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 21, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng held talks with Guangdong Radio and Television Party Secretary and President Li Yihang on using the 2026 Greater Bay Area Mid-Autumn Gala to promote Shanwei's city image.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市委召开党外人士情况通报会
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Committee Holds Briefing for Non-CPC Personages
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日上午，中共泰州市委召开党外人士情况通报会，市委书记姜冬冬通报市委换届人事安排及代表产生等情况，并主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 20, the CPC Taizhou Municipal Committee held a briefing for non-CPC personages, at which Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong reported on personnel arrangements for the municipal Party committee's leadership reshuffle and related matters.

articles.title_zh: 国际（江苏）人力资源服务业发展大会在南京开幕
articles.title_en: International (Jiangsu) Human Resources Service Development Conference Opens in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，国际（江苏）人力资源服务业发展大会在南京开幕，江苏省委书记信长星、人社部部长王晓萍致辞，省长刘小涛主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, the International (Jiangsu) Human Resources Service Development Conference opened in Nanjing, with Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Human Resources Minister Wang Xiaoping delivering remarks and Governor Liu Xiaotao presiding.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬李晖周恒新带队看望出席市第七次党代会代表
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong, Li Hui and Zhou Hengxin Visit Delegates to Taizhou's 7th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日上午，泰州市领导姜冬冬、李晖、周恒新分别带队前往各代表团驻地，看望出席市第七次党代会的代表，勉励大家履职尽责、严守纪律，确保大会圆满成功。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 20, Taizhou leaders Jiang Dongdong, Li Hui and Zhou Hengxin visited delegations to the city's 7th Party Congress, urging delegates to fulfill their duties, observe discipline and ensure the meeting's success.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市第七次党代会举行预备会议和主席团第一次会议
articles.title_en: Taizhou's 7th Party Congress Holds Preparatory Meeting and First Presidium Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日下午，中国共产党泰州市第七次代表大会举行预备会议和主席团第一次会议，姜冬冬主持，通过大会议程、主席团名单等事项，并强调严明换届纪律。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Taizhou's 7th Party Congress held its preparatory and first presidium meetings, chaired by Jiang Dongdong, approving the agenda and stressing strict election discipline.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬看望出席市第七次党代会的老领导
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Visits Veteran Leaders Attending Taizhou's 7th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日上午，泰州市委书记姜冬冬看望出席市第七次党代会的老领导，向他们致以崇高敬意和诚挚问候，感谢其为泰州发展作出的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 20, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong visited veteran leaders attending the city's 7th Party Congress, expressing respect and gratitude for their contributions to Taizhou's development.

articles.title_zh: 威海召开高层次专家人才座谈会 张海波出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Weihai Holds Symposium with High-Level Expert Talents, Zhang Haibo Attends and Addresses
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，威海市召开高层次专家人才座谈会，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，多位院士专家围绕产业升级、校地合作、人才引育等建言献策。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Weihai held a symposium with high-level experts and academicians. Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and called for cooperation on industrial upgrading, talent recruitment and research commercialization.

articles.title_zh: 张海波督导安全生产工作并调研船舶与海工装备产业链重点企业
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Workplace Safety and Surveys Key Shipbuilding and Marine Engineering Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，威海市委书记张海波到经开区督导安全生产工作，并调研船舶与海工装备产业链重点企业，要求压实安全责任、推动产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo inspected workplace safety in the Economic Development Zone and surveyed key shipbuilding and marine engineering enterprises, urging tighter safety measures and high-quality industrial growth.

articles.title_zh: 张海波参观第十八届威海国际渔具博览会
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Visits the 18th Weihai International Fishing Tackle Expo
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，威海市委书记张海波参观第十八届威海国际渔具博览会，强调以展促产、以产带展，赋能钓具产业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo visited the 18th Weihai International Fishing Tackle Expo, calling for using exhibitions to boost industry and drive the transformation of the fishing tackle sector.

articles.title_zh: 张海波参观第十八届威海国际渔具博览会
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Visits the 18th Weihai International Fishing Tackle Expo
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，威海市委书记张海波参观第十八届威海国际渔具博览会，强调以展促产、以产带展，推动钓具产业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo visited the 18th Weihai International Fishing Tackle Expo, urging the expo to boost the local tackle industry's upgrading and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 陈东赴湾沚区、无为市开展调研
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Conducts Research Visit in Wanzhi District and Wuwei City
articles.summary_zh: 芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东率队赴湾沚区、无为市调研产业发展与项目建设，并以“四不两直”方式暗访督导安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: Chen Dong, deputy secretary of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, led a team to Wanzhi District and Wuwei City to study industrial development and project construction, and carried out unannounced inspections of workplace safety.

tags.name_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 无锡市人大常委会会议决定蔡剑峰任代市长
articles.title_en: Wuxi People's Congress Standing Committee Appoints Cai Jianfeng as Acting Mayor
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，无锡市十七届人大常委会举行第四十一次会议，接受蒋锋辞去市长职务，任命蔡剑峰为副市长并代理市长，同时接受杜小刚、王凯辞职。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, the Standing Committee of the 17th Wuxi Municipal People's Congress held its 41st session, accepting Jiang Feng's resignation as mayor and appointing Cai Jianfeng as vice mayor and acting mayor, while also accepting resignations from Du Xiaogang and Wang Kai.

articles.title_zh: 蓝京新能源新型圆柱电池项目在锡签约落地
articles.title_en: LanJing New Energy's New Cylindrical Battery Project Signed in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，总投资55亿元的蓝京新能源新型圆柱电池项目在无锡签约落地，市委书记蒋锋、代市长蔡剑峰与公司董事长何伟会谈并共同见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, LanJing New Energy's new cylindrical battery project, with total investment of 5.5 billion yuan, was signed in Wuxi, where Party Secretary Jiang Feng and Acting Mayor Cai Jianfeng met company chairman He Wei and witnessed the signing.

articles.title_zh: 外交部介绍习近平主席访美有关安排和中方期待
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Briefs on Arrangements and China's Expectations for President Xi Jinping's State Visit to the United States
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上介绍，应美国总统特朗普邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月23日至25日对美国进行国事访问，两国元首将就中美关系和世界和平发展重大问题深入交换意见。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press briefing in Beijing on Sept 21, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the United States from Sept 23 to 25 at the invitation of U.S. President Trump, with the two leaders set to exchange views on major issues concerning China-U.S. relations and world peace and development.

articles.title_zh: 新乡市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Xinxiang Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，新乡市委书记魏建平主持召开市委常委会会议，研究部署安全生产、全面从严治党和发展先进制造业等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping chaired a Municipal Party Standing Committee meeting on workplace safety, strict Party governance, and advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 建安区委书记高雁调研指导“三秋”生产、秸秆禁烧及重点项目建设工作
articles.title_en: Jian'an District Party Secretary Gao Yan Inspects Autumn Harvest, Straw Burning Ban and Key Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，河南许昌市建安区委书记高雁赴桂村乡、灵井镇等地，调研“三秋”生产、秸秆禁烧及省道227改建等重点项目建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 19, Gao Yan, Party Secretary of Jian'an District in Xuchang, Henan, inspected autumn harvest production, straw-burning controls and key projects including the S227 road upgrade.

articles.title_zh: 市第九次党代会代表团召集人会议召开
articles.title_en: Meeting of Delegation Conveners for the 9th Municipal Party Congress Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日上午，盐城市第九次党代会代表团召集人会议召开，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话，就大会议程草案及主席团建议名单等进行酝酿安排。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 20, convener meetings for delegations to the 9th Yancheng Municipal Party Congress were held, chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Yan Hanping, to deliberate on the congress agenda draft and proposed presidium名单.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市第九次党代会举行预备会议
articles.title_en: Yancheng City Holds Preparatory Meeting for 9th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日下午，中共盐城市第九次代表大会预备会议在市人民大会堂举行，严汉平主持并讲话，通过主席团、秘书长及代表资格审查委员会名单和大会议程。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 20, the preparatory meeting of the 9th Yancheng Municipal Party Congress was held at the city's People's Great Hall, chaired by Yan Hanping, approving the presidium, secretary-general, credential committee and agenda.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市第九次党代会主席团举行第一次会议
articles.title_en: Presidium of Yancheng's 9th Party Congress Holds First Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月20日下午，中国共产党盐城市第九次代表大会主席团举行第一次会议，通过主席团常务委员会名单、副秘书长名单及代表资格审查报告等，大会于9月21日开幕。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 20, 2026, the presidium of the 9th Party Congress of Yancheng City held its first meeting, approving the standing committee and deputy secretary-general lists and a report on delegate qualifications; the congress opened on Sept 21.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示 李强出席全国先进制造业大会并讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Advanced Manufacturing; Li Qiang Addresses National Conference
articles.summary_zh: 全国先进制造业大会9月16日至17日在北京召开，会上传达习近平就发展先进制造业作出的重要指示，国务院总理李强出席会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, conveyed at the National Advanced Manufacturing Conference in Beijing on Sept 16-17; Premier Li Qiang attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Developing Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 习近平近日就发展先进制造业作出重要指示，全国先进制造业大会9月16日至17日在北京召开，李强出席会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing. The National Conference on Advanced Manufacturing was held in Beijing on September 16-17, where Premier Li Qiang attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 2026年市委书记·政协委员共商高质量发展座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Party Secretary and CPPCC Members Hold Symposium on High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，2026年阳江市市委书记·政协委员共商高质量发展座谈会召开，市委书记卢一先与政协委员代表面对面交流，听取推动阳江高质量发展的意见建议，市政协主席杨文龙主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, 2026, Yangjiang held a symposium where Party Secretary Lu Yixian met CPPCC members face to face to hear proposals on high-quality development; CPPCC Chairman Yang Wenlong chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研银川市政协重点工作 强调坚持党的领导凝聚智慧力量
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Yinchuan CPPCC Key Work, Stresses Party Leadership and Pooling Wisdom
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，银川市委书记赵旭辉调研市政协重点工作，强调坚持党的领导、统一战线、协商民主有机结合，在服务中心大局中彰显政协担当作为。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui inspected key work of the municipal CPPCC, urging integration of Party leadership, the united front and consultative democracy to better serve the overall development agenda.

articles.title_zh: 五年笃行，中国坚定做全球发展合作的行动派——习近平主席引领推进落实全球发展倡议
articles.title_en: Five Years of Action: China Remains a Committed Actor in Global Development Cooperation as Xi Jinping Leads Implementation of the Global Development Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，全球发展倡议提出五周年之际，报道回顾在习近平主席引领下，倡议已获130多个国家和国际组织支持，成为广受欢迎的国际公共产品。
articles.summary_en: Marking five years since Xi Jinping proposed the Global Development Initiative in 2021, China says the plan has become a widely welcomed international public good supported by over 130 countries and international organizations.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开传统产业高质量发展专题辅导报告会
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Special Report Meeting on High-Quality Development of Traditional Industries
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江在岳阳主持召开传统产业高质量发展专题辅导报告会，广东省政协副主席袁宝成作专题辅导报告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Xie Weijiang, Hunan deputy party secretary and Yueyang party chief, chaired a Yueyang meeting on high-quality development of traditional industries, with a report by Yuan Baocheng of the Guangdong CPPCC.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江唐浩然等分赴各县市区督导检查溶洞垃圾污染整治、秸秆禁限烧管控、安全生产、信访维稳等工作
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang, Tang Haoran Inspect Counties on Cave Waste Cleanup, Straw Burning Control, Safety and Petition Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日至19日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江和市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然分赴平江、湘阴等县市区，督导溶洞垃圾污染整治、秸秆禁限烧管控、安全生产和信访维稳工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18-19, Yueyang party chief Xie Weijiang and acting mayor Tang Haoran inspected Pingjiang and Xiangyin counties on cave garbage cleanup, straw burning control, workplace safety and petition work.

articles.title_zh: 中央第四生态环境保护督察组向广东省反馈督察情况
articles.title_en: Fourth Central Eco-Environmental Inspection Team Gives Feedback to Guangdong Province
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月18日，中央第四生态环境保护督察组在广州向广东省委、省政府反馈第三轮生态环境保护督察情况，组长宋秀岩通报督察报告，省委书记黄坤明作表态发言，省长孟凡利主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, 2026, the Fourth Central Eco-Environmental Inspection Team gave feedback in Guangzhou to Guangdong's provincial authorities on its third-round inspection; team head Song Xiuyan delivered the report, Party Secretary Huang Kunming responded, and Governor Meng Fanli chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开常委会会议 研究做好全市教育工作 卢荣春主持会议
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting on Education Work, Chaired by Lu Rongchun
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日上午，云浮市委书记卢荣春主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于基础教育的重要指示精神，研究部署全市教育高质量发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 18, Yunfu Party Secretary Lu Rongchun chaired a standing committee meeting of the municipal Party committee to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on basic education and plan high-quality development of local education.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅到湛江经开区检查督导蚊媒传染病疫情防控和爱国卫生运动
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi Inspects Mosquito-Borne Disease Prevention and Patriotic Health Campaign in Economic Development Zone
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日上午，湛江市市长李勇毅到湛江经开区实地检查督导蚊媒传染病疫情防控和爱国卫生运动，要求聚焦薄弱环节、压实网格化防控责任。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 20, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi inspected mosquito-borne disease control and the patriotic health campaign in the city's Economic Development Zone, urging grid-based accountability and tighter sanitation efforts.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Mayor Zhan Peng Chairs Zhoukou Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，周口市市长詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究新兴业态监管职责清单并学习行政复议法实施条例。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions and study regulatory duty lists and administrative review rules.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开书记专题会
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs Special Meeting on Consolidating Education on Correct Political Achievement Outlook
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开书记专题会，听取巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果工作汇报，部署整改整治下步重点工作，市长詹鹏出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 19, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a special meeting on consolidating education on a correct political achievement outlook and ordered follow-up rectification work; Mayor Zhan Peng attended.

articles.title_zh: 詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Zhan Peng Chairs Zhoukou Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，周口市市长詹鹏主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要回信和指示精神，研究工业强市建设、行业监管职责清单及行政复议法实施条例。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Zhoukou Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a municipal government executive meeting on industrial upgrading, regulatory duties for new business forms, and implementing the revised administrative reconsideration rules.

articles.title_zh: 珠海市领导参加所在选区人大代表换届选举投票
articles.title_en: Zhuhai Leaders Cast Ballots in District and Township People's Congress Elections
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，珠海市委书记陈勇、市长吴泽桐、市人大常委会主任潘江、市政协主席王开洲、市委副书记杨川分别在各自选区参加区、镇两级人大代表换届选举投票。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong, Mayor Wu Zetong, People's Congress Standing Committee Director Pan Jiang, CPPCC Chairman Wang Kaizhou and Deputy Party Secretary Yang Chuan cast their ballots in their respective constituencies for the city's district and township people's congress elections.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开珠海市政府党组会议、常务会议 部署安全生产和下阶段经济工作
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Zhuhai Municipal Government Meetings on Work Safety and Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，珠海市市长吴泽桐主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议，部署安全生产隐患排查整治和下阶段稳增长、扩投资、促消费等经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong chaired municipal government party group and executive meetings to deploy work safety inspections and next-stage economic measures on growth, investment and consumption.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇开展节前安全生产检查 以“时时放心不下”的责任感守牢安全底线
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Conducts Pre-Holiday Workplace Safety Inspection, Urging Firm Hold on Safety Bottom Line
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日上午，珠海市委书记陈勇到香洲区企业、商业综合体和在建工地开展节前安全生产检查，要求落实落细安全措施，守护群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 20, Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong inspected enterprises, a commercial complex and a construction site in Xiangzhou District ahead of the holidays, urging full implementation of safety measures to protect residents' lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 锚定“智能化、绿色化、融合化” 挺起先进制造业“硬脊梁”
articles.title_en: Anchoring 'Intelligent, Green and Integrated' Development to Bolster Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平总书记就发展先进制造业作出重要指示，强调坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，持续做大做强先进制造业，提升产业链自主可控水平。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, stressing intelligent, green and integrated development to build a modern industrial system with advanced manufacturing as its backbone.

articles.title_zh: 不沿边不靠海的宁夏闯出开放新赛道
articles.title_en: Landlocked Ningxia Forges a New Path to Opening Up
articles.summary_zh: 近日，“活力中国调研行”宁夏站情况介绍会在银川举行，展示宁夏高水平建设内陆开放型经济试验区的成效；今年1至8月宁夏外贸进出口177.2亿元，同比增长23.9%。
articles.summary_en: A briefing in Yinchuan for the "Vibrant China Research Tour" showcased Ningxia's progress in building a high-level inland open-economy pilot zone, with foreign trade up 23.9% year on year to 17.72 billion yuan in January-August.

articles.title_zh: 新能源加速发展，油气还重要吗？
articles.title_en: New Energy Accelerates: Is Oil and Gas Still Essential?
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局印发《石油天然气发展“十五五”规划》，锚定能源安全与绿色低碳，提出到2030年形成现代油气产业体系、国内供给4.4亿吨油当量。
articles.summary_en: China's NDRC and National Energy Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for oil and gas, aiming for a modern oil and gas system and 440 million tonnes of oil equivalent of domestic supply by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 磁悬浮的“中国式突围”
articles.title_en: The 'Chinese-Style Breakthrough' of Magnetic Levitation

articles.summary_en: On September 20, Fujian Province held its Ethnic Unity and Progress Commendation Conference in Fuzhou, where Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi spoke, Governor Zhao Long presided, and CPPCC Provincial Committee Chairman Teng Jiacai attended; model groups and individuals were honored.

articles.summary_zh: 沿黄各省区坚持量水而行、精打细算用好水资源，把黄河生态优势转化为发展优势和富民优势，山东东营大闸蟹、河套灌区节水、甘肃庆阳算力等项目成效显现。
articles.summary_en: Provinces along the Yellow River are conserving water and turning ecological gains into economic benefits, with gains seen in Dongying crab farming, water-saving irrigation and data centers in Gansu.

articles.title_zh: 2026年驻济高校座谈会召开
articles.title_en: 2026 Jinan University Symposium Held

articles.summary_en: On September 20, the 2026 Jinan-based universities symposium was held in Jinan, with Party Secretary Liu Qiang attending and speaking and Mayor Yu Haitian presiding; officials from the provincial education department and 36 universities attended.

articles.title_zh: 中国中化集团有限公司原党组成员、副总经理冯志斌一审获刑19年
articles.title_en: Feng Zhibin, Former Vice General Manager of Sinochem Holdings, Sentenced to 19 Years in First Instance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，黑龙江大庆市中级人民法院一审宣判，中国中化集团原党组成员、副总经理冯志斌因受贿、利用影响力受贿及国有公司人员滥用职权，数罪并罚获刑19年。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, the Daqing Intermediate People's Court sentenced Feng Zhibin, former vice general manager of Sinochem Holdings, to 19 years in prison on charges of bribery, influence-based bribery and abuse of power.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席引领全球发展倡议造福世界
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Global Development Initiative Brings Benefits to the World
articles.summary_zh: 全球发展倡议提出5年来，在习近平主席引领推动下已同各方开展2000多个合作项目、惠及120多个国家；9月13日他在金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤上介绍相关成果。
articles.summary_en: Five years after Xi Jinping proposed the Global Development Initiative, more than 2,000 cooperation projects have been carried out with partners, benefiting over 120 countries, he said at the BRICS leaders' summit on September 13.

articles.title_zh: 著名石油地质专家、中国工程院院士邱中建逝世，曾参与发现大庆油田
articles.title_en: Renowned Petroleum Geologist and CAE Academician Qiu Zhongjian Dies at 93
articles.summary_zh: 中国工程院院士、著名石油地质专家邱中建2026年9月17日逝世，享年93岁。他参与发现大庆、胜利等油田，并提出“复式油气聚集区”理论。
articles.summary_en: Qiu Zhongjian, a renowned petroleum geologist and academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering who helped discover the Daqing and Shengli oilfields, died on Sept 17, 2026, aged 93.

articles.title_zh: 国家版权局原专职副局长、原国家新闻出版总署党组成员沈仁干逝世
articles.title_en: Shen Rengan, Former Deputy Director of the National Copyright Administration, Dies at 83
articles.summary_zh: 国家版权局原专职副局长、原国家新闻出版总署党组成员沈仁干同志（副部长级）因病于2026年9月1日在北京逝世，享年83岁。中央有关领导同志表示哀悼。
articles.summary_en: Shen Rengan, former full-time deputy director of the National Copyright Administration and former Party member of the General Administration of Press and Publication (vice-ministerial level), died of illness in Beijing on September 1, 2026, at the age of 83. Relevant central leaders expressed condolences.

articles.title_zh: 第四十八届世界技能大赛将在上海举办 新增7个赛项

articles.summary_en: The 48th WorldSkills Competition will be held in Shanghai from Sept 22 to 27, 2026, with 64 skill events including seven new ones; a 220-member Chinese delegation will compete in all of them.

articles.title_zh: 破解世纪工程难题，吴澎讲述平陆运河背后的大国水运思考

articles.summary_en: Wu Peng, chief design engineer of the Pinglu Canal, recounts the survey and design of the 134.2-km, 72.72-billion-yuan waterway, which opened to navigation on Sept 16.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, during the 2026 World Manufacturing Conference, China Mobile Anhui held a special conference in Hefei, unveiling a national engineering research center branch and the "Mobile Tiangong" platform.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 20, a Gansu Province carbon peaking training program opened in Lanzhou, where Provincial Standing Committee member and Vice Governor Wang Bing spoke, urging focus on energy reform, industrial transition and systemic decarbonization to meet national assessment targets.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行：湖北石首芦苇变形记

articles.summary_en: In Shishou, Hubei, local reeds are being turned into specialty paper and bio-refined chemicals, transforming a former 'ecological burden' along the Yangtze into a green industry worth tens of billions of yuan.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, the 2026 Yichun forest food industry conference saw the release of a province-wide birch sap nutrition database and authentication fingerprint library covering 1,717 samples, led by Heilongjiang's forestry bureau and Northeast Forestry University.

articles.title_en: Haidong Relay Cropping Boosts Upgrade of Highland Cold-Vegetable Industry

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 20, Shanghai's Municipal Party Committee held a central group study session chaired by Party Secretary Chen Jining, hearing a report by Ecology and Environment Minister Huang Runqiu on speeding up the building of a Beautiful Shanghai.

articles.title_zh: 云南：五级责任链拧紧防汛「安全阀」

articles.summary_en: Since this year's flood season began, Yunnan has built a five-tier flood-control responsibility system spanning province, city, county, township and village, with top party and government officials directing operations on the front line and successfully handling multiple reservoir and flash-flood hazards.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, NEVs were shipped from Ningbo-Zhoushan Port's Meishan area. Customs data show the port exported 301,000 NEVs worth 34.22 billion yuan in the first eight months, nearly doubling year on year.

articles.title_en: Video: Joining Forces to Build a Prosperous World
articles.summary_zh: 新华社发布微视频，回顾习近平2021年9月在第七十六届联合国大会上提出全球发展倡议五年来的进展：倡议已获130多个国家和国际组织支持，近100个国家同中方签署合作文件。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua released a short video reviewing five years of the Global Development Initiative, proposed by Xi Jinping at the UN General Assembly in September 2021, noting support from over 130 countries and organizations.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 李强将出席第五届全球数字贸易博览会启动仪式及相关活动
articles.title_en: Li Qiang to Attend Launch Ceremony of Fifth Global Digital Trade Expo
articles.summary_zh: 商务部9月21日宣布，第五届全球数字贸易博览会将于9月23日至27日在浙江杭州举办，国务院总理李强将出席启动仪式及相关活动并致辞。
articles.summary_en: China's Commerce Ministry announced on Sept 21 that the fifth Global Digital Trade Expo will be held in Hangzhou, Zhejiang from Sept 23 to 27, with Premier Li Qiang attending the launch ceremony and delivering remarks.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解厚德载物、明德弘道的精神追求
articles.title_en: Deeply Understanding the Spiritual Pursuit of 'Great Virtue Sustains All Things, Bright Virtue Advances the Way'
articles.summary_zh: 新华社《瞭望》刊发“第一学习”文章，阐释中华优秀传统文化中“厚德载物、明德弘道”的精神追求，指出其对新时代道德建设、社会治理和全球治理的重要启发。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's Outlook Weekly published a study article interpreting the Chinese traditional ideal of 'great virtue sustaining all things and bright virtue advancing the Way,' arguing it offers guidance for moral building, governance and global order in the new era.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部将优化无线电频谱资源布局
articles.title_en: MIIT to Optimize Radio Spectrum Resource Layout
articles.summary_zh: 2026中国无线电大会9月21日在河北雄安新区开幕，工业和信息化部有关负责人表示将优化无线电频谱资源布局，支撑先进制造业发展和新型工业化。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China Radio Conference opened on Sept 21 in Xiong'an New Area, Hebei, where the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology said it will optimize radio spectrum resource allocation to support advanced manufacturing and new industrialization.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 三声叩问启征途 长征薪火耀三湘
articles.title_en: Three Rousing Questions Launch a Journey: Long March Flame Lights Up Hunan
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道湖南汝城、通道、桑植等长征沿线老区以红色文化传承为引领，发展红色文旅与特色产业，推动革命老区高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports how Hunan's old revolutionary areas along the Long March route, including Rucheng, Tongdao and Sangzhi, are carrying forward the Long March spirit while developing red tourism and specialty industries to drive high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 一粒良种激活产业发展新动能
articles.title_en: A Single Good Seed Activates New Momentum for Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者近日随“活力中国调研行”采访团在宁夏石嘴山市平罗县调研，当地以水稻制种和蔬菜良种繁育为抓手，构建现代种业体系，带动2.2万户农户增收。
articles.summary_en: Reporters joined the "Vital China Research Tour" in Pingluo County, Ningxia, where a modern seed-breeding system for rice and vegetables is boosting the local seed industry and raising incomes for 22,000 farming households.

articles.title_zh: 龙乐豪院士：一生只干一件事 见证中国运载火箭新长征
articles.title_en: Academician Long Lehao: A Lifetime Devoted to One Cause, Witnessing the New Long March of China's Launch Vehicles
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，国务院新闻办公室在北京举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，中国工程院院士龙乐豪表示自己一生只致力于运载火箭研制。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, the State Council Information Office held a press briefing in Beijing where Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Long Lehao said he has devoted his life to developing launch vehicles.

articles.title_zh: 我国发放首批数据产权“身份证”
articles.title_en: China Issues First Batch of Data Property Rights Certificates
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，国家数据局发放我国首批数据产权登记凭证，56家企业和机构获得数据有效证明，涵盖医疗、交通、科研等10余个行业领域。
articles.summary_en: On September 21, the National Data Administration issued China's first batch of data property rights registration certificates, with 56 enterprises and institutions receiving proof of data rights across more than 10 sectors including healthcare, transport and research.

articles.title_zh: 《非物质文化遗产保护传承“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: Ministry of Culture and Tourism Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Intangible Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，文化和旅游部印发《非物质文化遗产保护传承“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年初步形成非遗系统性保护新格局，并部署六方面重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Culture and Tourism issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Intangible Cultural Heritage Protection and Inheritance, aiming for a new systematic protection framework by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 17个试点县2939个建制村实现“快递进村”邮政兜底
articles.title_en: Express Delivery Reaches 2,939 Villages in 17 Pilot Counties Under Postal Fallback Program
articles.summary_zh: 国家邮政局9月21日在北京举行新闻发布会介绍，截至今年8月底，中西部17个“快递进村”邮政兜底专项试点县已有2939个建制村实现快递进村，基本完成年初试点目标。
articles.summary_en: China's State Post Bureau said at a Beijing press conference on Sept 21 that as of the end of August, 2,939 administrative villages in 17 central and western pilot counties had gained express delivery service under a postal fallback program, meeting the year's pilot target.

articles.title_zh: 两部门拨付2亿元支持4省做好自然灾害应急抢险救灾工作
articles.title_en: Two Departments Allocate 200 Million Yuan for Emergency Disaster Relief in Four Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 9月21日，财政部、应急管理部紧急拨付2亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持四川、海南、浙江、福建4省开展洪涝、地质灾害应急抢险救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 21, China's Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated 200 million yuan in central natural-disaster relief funds to support emergency flood and geological disaster response in Sichuan, Hainan, Zhejiang and Fujian.

articles.title_zh: 张工带队在京走访中信集团
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Leads Delegation to Visit CITIC Group in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，天津市委副书记、市长张工带队在北京走访中信集团，推动深化合作，并就“117项目”盘活利用与中信集团董事长奚国华交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong led a delegation to visit CITIC Group in Beijing to deepen cooperation, discussing the revitalization of the "117 Project" with CITIC Chairman Xi Guohua.

articles.title_zh: 刘同山：以归集经营重塑品牌公信力
articles.title_en: Liu Tongshan: Rebuilding Brand Credibility Through Consolidated Operations
articles.summary_zh: 首期云南三农智库研讨会在昆明举行，云南农业大学经济管理学院院长刘同山提出以“归集经营”重塑“绿色云品”品牌公信力。
articles.summary_en: At the inaugural Yunnan agriculture think-tank seminar in Kunming, Liu Tongshan of Yunnan Agricultural University proposed "consolidated operations" to rebuild credibility for the province's agricultural brands.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：推动“双碳”工作加快破局成势取得更大进展实效
articles.title_en: Liu Jie: Accelerate Breakthroughs in Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutrality Work for Greater Progress
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日下午，浙江省“双碳”工作推进会在杭州召开，省委副书记、省长刘捷出席讲话，部署碳账户、新能源重卡、低零碳园区、光伏利用等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 20, Zhejiang held a provincial meeting in Hangzhou on carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, where Governor Liu Jie laid out tasks on carbon accounts, new-energy heavy trucks, low-carbon parks and solar power.

articles.title_zh: 世界市长“对话”武汉 共拓友好合作新机遇
articles.title_en: World Mayors Dialogue in Wuhan Expands Friendship City Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，2026世界市长对话暨武汉国际友好城市合作大会在武汉开幕，来自22个国家26座友好城市的代表与会，武汉与仰光、图尔克斯坦等市签署合作协议。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Mayors Dialogue and Wuhan International Friendship City Cooperation Conference opened in Wuhan on Sept 20, drawing delegates from 26 friendship cities in 22 countries; Wuhan signed cooperation agreements with Yangon and Turkistan.

articles.title_zh: 中国2025年科普人员超225万人 筹集科普经费近244亿元
articles.title_en: China's 2025 Science Popularization Workforce Tops 2.25 Million, Funding Nears 24.4 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 科技部9月20日发布2025年度全国科普统计数据：全国科普专兼职人员225.07万人，经费筹集额243.98亿元，同比增长1.72%和9.80%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20 China's Ministry of Science and Technology released 2025 science popularization data: 2.2507 million communicators and 24.398 billion yuan in funding, up 1.72% and 9.80% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee General Office and State Council General Office Issue Opinions on Advancing Classified Reform of Universities
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《关于分类推进高校改革的意见》，从优化分类布局结构、激发分类发展动能、健全分类发展机制等方面对分类推进高校改革作出系统部署。
articles.summary_en: The General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council have issued Opinions on Advancing Classified Reform of Universities, setting out systematic plans on layout, development momentum and management mechanisms for higher education reform.

General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议 研究当前经济形势和经济工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting on Economic Situation and Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，辽宁省省长王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议，分析前8个月全省经济运行情况，部署下步重点工作，并审议文旅融合、疾病预防控制等领域“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei chaired a provincial government executive meeting to review economic performance in the first eight months and outline priorities, while reviewing 15th Five-Year Plan drafts on cultural tourism and disease control.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 坚决拥护党中央对戴玉林涉嫌严重违纪违法进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Backs Central Discipline Review of Dai Yulin
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，辽宁省委常委会召开会议，通报中央纪委国家监委对戴玉林涉嫌严重违纪违法进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定，省委书记许昆林主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee met to hear the decision by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and the National Supervisory Commission to place Dai Yulin under disciplinary and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations. Party Secretary Xu Kunlin chaired the meeting.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 到2026年底全国省级层面均应开设罕见病门诊
articles.title_en: All Provincial-Level Regions to Have Rare Disease Clinics by End of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委9月20日公布通知，要求到2026年底各省区市及新疆生产建设兵团至少依托1家省属及以上医院开设罕见病门诊，并部署罕见病预防与诊疗体系建设。
articles.summary_en: China's National Health Commission published a notice on Sept 20 requiring every provincial-level region to open at least one rare disease clinic by the end of 2026, along with measures to strengthen prevention and diagnosis.

tags.name_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

tags_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

articles.title_zh: 今年前8个月国家铁路发送货物26.9亿吨
articles.title_en: National Railway Freight Volume Hits 2.69 Billion Tons in First Eight Months of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，中国国家铁路集团发布数据，今年1至8月国家铁路累计发送货物26.9亿吨，其中煤炭13.89亿吨，中欧班列开行14842列。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, China State Railway Group reported national rail freight reached 2.69 billion tons in January-August 2026, including 1.389 billion tons of coal and 14,842 China-Europe train trips.

tags.name_zh: 中国国家铁路集团有限公司
tags.name_en: China State Railway Group Co., Ltd.

articles.title_zh: 为了共同繁荣的梦想——习近平主席引领全球发展倡议造福世界
articles.title_en: For the Dream of Common Prosperity: Xi Jinping Leads Global Development Initiative to Benefit the World
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月20日报道，习近平主席提出全球发展倡议5年来，中国已同各方开展2000多个合作项目，培训人才超20万名，获130多个国家和国际组织支持。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 20 that five years after Xi Jinping proposed the Global Development Initiative, China has carried out over 2,000 cooperation projects and trained more than 200,000 people, with support from over 130 countries and international organizations.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

articles.title_zh: 前八个月高技术产业实际使用外资同比增长35.1%
articles.title_en: High-Tech Industry FDI Up 35.1% Year-on-Year in First Eight Months
articles.summary_zh: 商务部数据显示，今年1—8月全国新设立外商投资企业42582家，实际使用外资4799.5亿元，其中高技术产业实际使用外资2002.6亿元，同比增长35.1%。
articles.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce data show that in the first eight months of the year, 42,582 foreign-invested enterprises were newly established in China, with actual FDI of 479.95 billion yuan; high-tech industry FDI reached 200.26 billion yuan, up 35.1 percent year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 董建华先生公祭仪式在香港举行
articles.title_en: Public Memorial Ceremony for Mr. Tung Chee-hwa Held in Hong Kong
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，董建华先生公祭仪式在香港殡仪馆举行，治丧委员会主任委员石泰峰致悼词；习近平等中央领导同志此前对董建华逝世表示哀悼并向其亲属慰问。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, a public memorial ceremony for Mr. Tung Chee-hwa was held at the Hong Kong Funeral Home, where Shi Taifeng delivered the eulogy; Xi Jinping and other central leaders earlier expressed condolences to his family.

articles.title_zh: 加快提高市场综合监管能力和水平
articles.title_en: China to Step Up Comprehensive Market Regulation Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”主题发布会，市场监管总局介绍“十五五”时期推动市场监管高质量发展的举措。
articles.summary_en: On September 20, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where the State Administration for Market Regulation outlined measures to advance high-quality market regulation during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 国务院任免国家工作人员
articles.title_en: State Council Announces Appointments and Removals of State Functionaries
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月20日，国务院任免一批国家工作人员，任命余晓晖、潘文博、李成钢等，免去徐青森、胡卫列、牛一兵、廖志伟职务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, 2026, China's State Council announced appointments and removals of state functionaries, including appointing Li Chenggang as international trade representative and removing several vice ministers.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省委常委会召开会议 坚决拥护党中央对戴玉林进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial Party Standing Committee Backs Decision to Investigate Dai Yulin for Serious Disciplinary and Legal Violations
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，辽宁省委常委会召开会议，通报中央纪委国家监委对戴玉林涉嫌严重违纪违法进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定，省委书记许昆林主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, the Liaoning Provincial Party Standing Committee met to endorse the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission's decision to investigate Dai Yulin for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations; Party Secretary Xu Kunlin chaired the meeting.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 吴贤德赴晋安区调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Wu Xiande Inspects Jin'an District on Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 9月20日，福州市市长吴贤德赴晋安区调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，并实地察看高标准农田建设项目与乡村振兴推进情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande inspected Jin'an District to supervise the rectification of misconduct and corruption around the people, and to check high-standard farmland construction and rural revitalization work.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委常委会召开会议 研究部署贯彻落实举措
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Implementation Measures
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，淮安市委常委会召开会议，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话、重要指示和重要贺信精神，市委书记顾坤主持会议并讲话，会议还研究了市第九次党代会有关事宜。
articles.summary_en: On September 19, the Standing Committee of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee met to study recent speeches, instructions and congratulatory letters from Xi Jinping, with Municipal Party Secretary Gu Kun presiding. The meeting also discussed preparations for the city's ninth Party congress.

articles.title_zh: 顾坤任淮安市委书记，杨新忠任淮安市委副书记
articles.title_en: Gu Kun Appointed Huai'an Party Secretary, Yang Xinzhong Appointed Deputy Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日上午，淮安市召开全市领导干部会议，宣布江苏省委决定：顾坤任淮安市委书记，杨新忠任淮安市委委员、常委、副书记。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 19, Huai'an held a city leadership meeting where the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee announced that Gu Kun was appointed Huai'an Party Secretary and Yang Xinzhong was named a member, standing committee member and deputy secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 顾坤任淮安市委书记 杨新忠任市委副书记
articles.title_en: Gu Kun Appointed Huai'an Party Secretary, Yang Xinzhong Appointed Deputy Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，淮安市召开全市领导干部会议，宣布省委决定：顾坤任淮安市委书记，杨新忠任市委委员、常委、副书记。省委常委、组织部部长胡立杰出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 19, Huai'an held a city leadership meeting where the provincial party committee's decision was announced: Gu Kun was appointed Huai'an Party Secretary and Yang Xinzhong became a standing committee member and deputy secretary.

articles.title_zh: 中共淮安市委召开民主协商会
articles.title_en: CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee Holds Democratic Consultation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，中共淮安市委召开民主协商会，就有关人事安排事项与各民主党派市委会、市工商联负责人和无党派人士代表进行协商，市委书记顾坤主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 19, the CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee held a democratic consultation meeting with leaders of local democratic parties, the Federation of Industry and Commerce and non-party representatives on personnel arrangements. Municipal Party Secretary Gu Kun chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市九届人大常委会第三十六次会议召开
articles.title_en: 36th Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 9th Huai'an Municipal People's Congress Convened
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，淮安市九届人大常委会第三十六次会议召开，通过有关人事任免事项并举行宪法宣誓仪式。
articles.summary_en: On September 19, the 36th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 9th Huai'an Municipal People's Congress was held, passing personnel appointments and removals and holding a constitutional oath ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 为了共同繁荣的梦想——习近平主席引领全球发展倡议造福世界
articles.title_en: For the Dream of Shared Prosperity: Xi Jinping Leads Global Development Initiative to Benefit the World
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月20日报道，习近平主席引领的全球发展倡议提出5年来，已同各方开展2000多个合作项目，惠及120多个国家，获130多个国家和国际组织支持。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 20 that five years after Xi Jinping proposed the Global Development Initiative, more than 2,000 cooperation projects have been carried out and benefited over 120 countries.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市人大常委会党组（扩大）会议传达学习贯彻省委人大工作会议精神
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal People's Congress Party Group Meeting Conveys and Studies Spirit of Provincial People's Congress Work Conference

articles.title_zh: 林芝市二届人大常委会召开第四十次会议

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 18, the Standing Committee of the 2nd Nyingchi Municipal People's Congress held its 40th session, chaired by director Nyima Tashi, reviewing fiscal final accounts and audit reports and approving resolutions and matters for the 3rd congress's first session.

articles.title_zh: 严金海在拉萨调研氢氧产业与数字经济发展

articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Yan Jinhai, deputy party secretary of Tibet and director of the regional people's congress standing committee, inspected the hydrogen-oxygen industry and digital economy in Lhasa, urging locally tailored growth of new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市六届人大常委会第八十二次主任会议召开

articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Chen Xiasheng chaired the 82nd chairpersons' meeting of the Longyan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, which set its 33rd session for Sept 24 to review forestry, business environment and workplace safety reports.

articles.summary_en: The CPC Shuozhou Municipal Committee recently held a symposium with non-CPC personages, chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Wang Shuaihong, to solicit views on the draft report for the city's 8th Party Congress.

articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 18, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang chaired a municipal government executive meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions on the Qingdao shipyard cargo ship fire and to advance work on upgrading the service sector.

articles.title_zh: 黄强胡玉亭会见国家能源局党组书记、局长王宏志

articles.summary_en: On Sept 20, Jilin Party Secretary Huang Qiang and Governor Hu Yuting met in Changchun with Wang Hongzhi, head of the National Energy Administration, to discuss accelerating Jilin's green energy transition and safeguarding national energy security.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 19, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping chaired a meeting on safety and stability work, urging solid efforts in workplace safety, petition handling and public opinion guidance ahead of the city's 9th Party congress and the Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示 强调“创新”这个关键词

articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, saying China has made solid progress in building a manufacturing powerhouse and stressing technological breakthroughs and independent innovation.

articles.title_zh: 著名外科学家、医学教育家、湖南省政协原副主席韩明逝世
articles.title_en: Renowned Surgeon and Medical Educator Han Ming, Former Hunan CPPCC Vice Chairman, Dies at 98
articles.summary_zh: 我国著名外科学家、医学教育家、湖南省政协原副主席韩明教授于2026年9月19日在湖南逝世，享年98岁，中南大学湘雅医院发布讣告。
articles.summary_en: Han Ming, a renowned Chinese surgeon, medical educator and former vice chairman of the Hunan Provincial CPPCC, died on Sept 19, 2026 at the age of 98, according to an obituary from Xiangya Hospital of Central South University.

articles.title_zh: 考生佩戴智能眼镜参加检验师资格考试，中国特种设备检验协会通报
articles.title_en: China Special Equipment Inspection Association Notifies on Candidate Wearing Smart Glasses at Inspector Qualification Exam
articles.summary_zh: 中国特种设备检验协会通报称，有考生佩戴智能眼镜参加检验师资格考试，协会强调严禁携带、佩戴具有拍照、传输功能的智能设备进入考场，作弊者将依规处理并记入诚信记录。
articles.summary_en: The China Special Equipment Inspection Association reported that a candidate wore smart glasses during an inspector qualification exam, stressing that camera- or transmission-capable smart devices are banned in exam rooms and cheaters will be penalized.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省部署2026年法治建设实地督察工作

articles.summary_en: A mobilization meeting was held recently in Lanzhou to deploy Gansu Province's 2026 on-site inspections of rule-of-law construction, focusing on implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on the rule of law and law-based governance by officials.

articles.summary_en: In September 2026, the China-Europe Railway Express marked 10 years of unified branding, with cumulative trips exceeding 130,000 and annual trips rising 10.8-fold from 1,702 in 2016 to 20,022 in 2025.

articles.summary_en: Hubei Pilot FTZ is building full-chain IP protection, with courts giving firms on-site legal "checkups" and fast-tracking simple IP cases. By June 2026 the province held 208,600 invention patents.

articles.title_en: TCM Boosts China's Manned Spaceflight, to Provide All-Round Health Support for Astronauts

articles.summary_en: The first Aerospace Medical Engineering Conference was held in Tianjin on Sept 19-20, where China's space station 'space garden' was showcased; over 20 varieties of 14 plant species have been cultivated in orbit.

articles.summary_en: The Pinglu Canal recently opened to navigation. Adding 4 cubic meters per second to the existing 20 cubic meters per second diversion, alongside water-saving ship locks and basin-wide scheduling, supports 5,000-tonne vessels.

articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Inspects Fire Safety Work, Urges Constant Vigilance to Protect Lives and Property
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，济南市委书记刘强到市中区酒店、加油站、社区及应急物资储备库调研督导消防安全工作，要求全面排查风险隐患、压实各方责任。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang inspected fire safety work at a hotel, a gas station, a community and an emergency supply depot, urging thorough risk screening and strict accountability.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰与省政务服务和数据管理局党组书记、局长王天广座谈交流 深化政务服务和数据领域改革创新 以数智赋能汕尾高质量发展
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Holds Talks with Wang Tianguang on Deepening Reform in Government Services and Data Fields to Empower Shanwei's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，汕尾市委书记逯峰与广东省政务服务和数据管理局党组书记、局长王天广在汕尾座谈交流，就城市全域数字化转型、数据要素市场化配置改革、人工智能应用场景建设等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 19, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng held talks with Wang Tianguang, head of Guangdong's government services and data administration, on citywide digital transformation, market-based data reform and AI application scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰与王天广座谈交流 深化政务服务和数据领域改革创新 以数智赋能汕尾高质量发展
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Holds Talks with Wang Tianguang on Deepening Reform in Government Services and Data, Empowering Shanwei's High-Quality Development with Digital Intelligence
articles.summary_zh: 9月19日，汕尾市委书记逯峰与广东省政务服务和数据管理局党组书记、局长王天广在汕尾座谈，就城市全域数字化转型、政务服务增值化改革、数据要素市场化配置改革等深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 19, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng held talks in Shanwei with Wang Tianguang, head of Guangdong's government services and data administration, on city-wide digital transformation, government service reform and market-based data allocation.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市八届人大常委会第四十八次会议召开
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 48th Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，汕尾市八届人大常委会第四十八次会议召开，林军主持，传达学习省委人大工作会议精神，批准2025年市级决算并审议多项调研报告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Shanwei's 8th Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 48th session, chaired by Lin Jun, conveying provincial directives on people's congress work, approving the 2025 municipal final accounts and reviewing several research reports.

articles.title_zh: 全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds Party Committee Theoretical Study Session on Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，泰州市委理论学习中心组学习会召开，专题学习《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》，市委书记姜冬冬主持学习会。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Taizhou held a municipal Party committee theoretical study session on China's Ecological Environment Code, presided over by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会举行第三十九次会议
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 39th Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，芜湖市十七届人大常委会举行第三十九次会议，听取生活垃圾分类执法检查、智能网联汽车与全民健康促进立法、政府债务管理等报告，通过议事规则和人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, the Standing Committee of the 17th Wuhu Municipal People's Congress held its 39th session, hearing reports on waste-sorting enforcement, smart connected vehicle and public health legislation, and government debt management, and approving rules of procedure and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 中科曙光高层来锡考察 无锡市长蒋锋会谈深化战略合作
articles.title_en: Sugon Executives Visit Wuxi as Mayor Jiang Feng Holds Talks on Deepening Strategic Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，无锡市市长蒋锋与来锡考察的中科曙光董事长、总裁历军一行举行工作会谈，双方围绕半导体、先进计算等领域深化战略合作洽谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng held talks with Sugon Chairman and President Li Jun during a visit to Wuxi, discussing deeper strategic cooperation in semiconductors and advanced computing.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市委召开党外人士民主协商会 通报市委换届人事安排
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Holds Democratic Consultation Meeting with Non-Party Figures on Leadership Reshuffle
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，中共盐城市委召开党外人士民主协商会，通报市委换届人事安排工作并征求意见，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, the CPC Yancheng Municipal Committee held a democratic consultation meeting with non-party figures to brief them on the municipal party leadership reshuffle and seek opinions, chaired by Party Secretary Yan Hanping.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治暨集中化解信访问题专项行动攻坚决战推进会
articles.title_en: Ningxia Holds Meeting on Rectifying Misconduct and Corruption Around the Public and Resolving Petition Issues
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，宁夏召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治暨集中化解信访问题专项行动攻坚决战推进会，自治区党委书记李邑飞出席并讲话，自治区主席张雨浦主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Ningxia held a meeting on rectifying misconduct and corruption around the public and on resolving petition issues, with regional Party Secretary Li Yifei delivering a speech and Chairman Zhang Yupu presiding.

articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Meets Malaysian Deputy Minister of Agriculture and Food Security Chan Foong Hin
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，马来西亚农业及粮食安全部副部长陈泓缣率农业代表团到广东云浮考察交流，市委书记卢荣春会见代表团，双方就深化农业经贸合作、共建合作平台交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Malaysian Deputy Minister of Agriculture and Food Security Chan Foong Hin led an agricultural delegation to Yunfu, Guangdong, where municipal Party Secretary Lu Rongchun met the group and discussed deepening agricultural trade and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新到郁南县调研基层治理工作
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Inspects Grassroots Governance Work in Yunan County
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，云浮市市长李庆新到郁南县调研基层治理工作，走访派出所、综合行政执法队和多个村庄，强调提升基层治理效能、推进人居环境整治与“百千万工程”。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Yunfu Mayor Li Qingxin inspected grassroots governance in Yunan County, visiting a police station, an administrative enforcement team and several villages, urging stronger governance, better rural living conditions and progress on the "Hundreds of Thousands" project.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开市人大代表重点建议和市政协重点提案督办推进会
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Meeting to Advance Key NPC Deputy Suggestions and CPPCC Proposals
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日上午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市人大代表重点建议和市政协重点提案督办推进会，推动低空经济赋能农业、优化海洋产业结构等建议提案落地见效。
articles.summary_en: Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired a Sept 18 meeting to advance key NPC deputy suggestions and CPPCC proposals on low-altitude economy for agriculture and marine industry upgrades.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市召开会议贯彻落实中央第四生态环境保护督察组督察广东省情况反馈会精神
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Holds Meeting to Implement Feedback from Central Fourth Ecological Inspection Team on Guangdong
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日下午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开贯彻落实中央第四生态环境保护督察组督察广东省情况反馈会精神会议，部署环保督察整改与绿美湛江建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 18, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired a meeting to implement feedback from the Central Fourth Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection Team on Guangdong, deploying rectification and green development work.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇督导检查爱国卫生运动并调研食品安全工作
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Inspects Patriotic Health Campaign and Food Safety Work in Zhuhai
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，珠海市委书记陈勇到金湾区督导检查爱国卫生运动开展情况并调研食品安全工作，强调压实责任、细化措施，保障人民群众生命安全和身体健康。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong inspected the patriotic health campaign and food safety work in Jinwan District, urging tighter responsibility and measures to safeguard public health and safety.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐率队赴湖北安徽推进招商合作对接
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Leads Delegation to Hubei and Anhui to Promote Investment Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐率队赴湖北武汉、安徽合肥走访中国信通科技、京东方等企业，围绕重点项目合作进行精准对接。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong led a delegation to Wuhan, Hubei and Hefei, Anhui, visiting enterprises such as China Information and Communication Technologies Group and BOE Technology to advance cooperation on key investment projects.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记就发展先进制造业作出的重要指示引发热烈反响
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Instructions on Developing Advanced Manufacturing Draw Enthusiastic Response
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日就发展先进制造业作出重要指示，强调持续做大做强先进制造业，为推进中国式现代化提供有力支撑，在广大干部群众中引发热烈反响。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, stressing the need to keep strengthening the sector to support Chinese modernization, drawing enthusiastic responses from officials and the public.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河建成通航 打造优质绿色廉洁工程
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Opens to Navigation, Built as Quality, Green and Clean Project
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，平陆运河建成通航，这是江铁海多式联运重大基础设施和西部陆海新通道骨干工程，习近平总书记多次就建设作出重要指示批示。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the Pinglu Canal opened to navigation as a major multimodal infrastructure project and a backbone of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, with Xi Jinping issuing repeated instructions on its construction.

articles.title_zh: 第23届东博会合作项目集中签约 首次搭建机制性供需对接平台
articles.title_en: 23rd China-ASEAN Expo Inks Cooperation Projects, Debuts Mechanism-Based Supply-Demand Matching Platform
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，第23届中国—东盟博览会在南宁举行签约活动，促成平陆运河经济带8市41个项目及19个国际合作项目签约，并首次搭建机制性供需对接平台。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo held a signing event in Nanning, inking 41 projects along the Pinglu Canal economic belt and 19 international cooperation deals, while debuting a mechanism-based supply-demand matching platform.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示，强调智能化、绿色化、融合化方向
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Instructions on Developing Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平总书记就发展先进制造业作出重要指示，强调坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，加快构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系，巩固壮大实体经济根基。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, stressing intelligent, green and integrated development to build a modern industrial system and strengthen the real economy.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on Jilin University's 80th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，习近平总书记致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年，希望该校传承红色基因、聚焦国家战略需求，为东北全面振兴和中国式现代化作出更大贡献。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Xi Jinping sent a letter congratulating Jilin University on its 80th anniversary, urging it to focus on national strategic needs and contribute to Northeast China's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布职业资格跨境互认目录 383项资质实现无缝衔接
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Releases Catalogue for Cross-Border Mutual Recognition of Professional Qualifications, Covering 383 Credentials
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省人社厅近日公布《江苏省境内外职业资格比照认定及双向互认目录（2026年版）》，覆盖10余个国家和地区383项资质，境外职业资格可直接比照认定职称或技能等级。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's Human Resources and Social Security Department released a 2026 catalogue covering 383 credentials from over 10 countries and regions, letting overseas qualifications be recognized as equivalent domestic titles or skill levels.

articles.title_en: Hangzhou Moves to Repeal Measures Supporting High-Quality Development of Low-Altitude Economy, Opens Public Comment
articles.summary_zh: 杭州市财政局就废止《杭州市支持低空经济高质量发展的若干措施》公开征求意见，征求意见期为2026年9月8日至10月7日。
articles.summary_en: Hangzhou's Finance Bureau is seeking public comment from Sept 8 to Oct 7, 2026 on a notice to repeal the measures supporting high-quality development of the low-altitude economy.

articles.title_zh: 2026佛教论辩会举行，论辩“人工智能能否替代法师答疑解惑”等辩题
articles.title_en: 2026 Buddhist Debate Conference Held in Hangzhou, Debating Whether AI Can Replace Monks in Answering Questions
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日至18日，2026佛教论辩会在杭州灵隐寺举行，全国16所佛教院校的19支代表队围绕“践行佛教中国化”等主题展开论辩。
articles.summary_en: Nineteen teams from 16 Buddhist academies debated the sinicization of Buddhism and whether AI can replace monks in answering questions at a conference held in Hangzhou's Lingyin Temple on Sept 15-18, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 国家网信办曝光第二批整治恶意炒作涉企信息典型案例
articles.title_en: Cyberspace Administration of China Exposes Second Batch of Typical Cases in Crackdown on Malicious Speculation on Enterprise Information
articles.summary_zh: 国家网信办开展“清朗·优化营商网络环境”专项行动，清理涉企侵权信息156万余条，处置违规账号2.6万余个，并通报第二批典型案例。
articles.summary_en: China's Cyberspace Administration carried out a campaign to improve the online business environment, clearing over 1.56 million infringing posts about enterprises and punishing more than 26,000 violating accounts, and released its second batch of typical cases.

articles.title_zh: 淮北颁发首批土地承包经营权不动产权证书
articles.title_en: Huaibei Issues First Batch of Property Rights Certificates for Land Contract Management Rights
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，安徽淮北市相山区渠沟镇张楼村农民刘德安领到全市首批土地承包经营权不动产权证书，标志着当地农村土地承包经营权正式纳入不动产统一登记。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, farmer Liu De'an in Zhanglou Village, Xiangshan District, Huaibei, Anhui, received the city's first batch of property rights certificates for rural land contract management rights, marking the formal inclusion of such rights in the unified real estate registration system.
