articles.title_en: Zhangzhou Launches 19th Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Month
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，以“福籽同心爱中华”为主题的漳州市第十九个民族团结进步宣传月活动在芗城区启动，现场为8支“民族团结进步促进法宣讲队”授旗。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Zhangzhou launched its 19th Ethnic Unity and Progress Publicity Month in Xiangcheng District, flagging off eight teams tasked with publicizing the law on promoting ethnic unity and progress.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委理论学习中心组学习会在福州召开
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Group Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，福建省委理论学习中心组学习会在福州召开，省委书记周祖翼主持并讲话，强调深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于思想政治工作的重要论述，准确把握《中国共产党思想政治工作条例》要求。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, the Fujian Provincial Party Committee held a theoretical study group session in Fuzhou, chaired by Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi, stressing implementation of Xi Jinping's expositions on ideological and political work and the CPC regulations on the topic.

articles.title_zh: 1至8月甘肃新能源装机占比超65% 外送电量同比增长近三成
articles.title_en: Gansu's New Energy Capacity Share Tops 65% in First Eight Months as Outbound Power Rises Nearly 30%
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，甘肃省政府新闻办举行新闻发布会，国网甘肃电力通报1至8月全省用电量达1257亿千瓦时、同比增长6.29%，累计外送电量662.09亿千瓦时、同比增长29.84%，新能源装机占比达65.85%。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, the Gansu provincial government information office held a press briefing where State Grid Gansu Electric Power reported that in January-August provincial electricity consumption reached 125.7 billion kWh, up 6.29%, outbound power transmission rose 29.84% to 66.2 billion kWh, and new energy accounted for 65.85% of installed capacity.

articles.title_zh: 南宁获批建设国家人工智能产业创新应用先导区
articles.title_en: Nanning Approved to Build National AI Industry Innovation and Application Pilot Zone
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部批复同意南宁建设国家人工智能产业创新应用先导区，南宁成为全国第19个获批城市，将聚焦人工智能与实体经济深度融合并打造面向东盟的合作高地。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology has approved Nanning to build a national pilot zone for AI industry innovation and application, making it the country's 19th such city and positioning it as a hub for AI cooperation with ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 国新办举行退役军人代表中外记者见面会
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Hosts Meeting with Veteran Representatives
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，国务院新闻办在北京举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，4名退役军人代表围绕“永葆军人本色 退役再续荣光”与中外记者交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, the State Council Information Office held a press meeting in Beijing with four veteran representatives on how they continue serving the country after leaving the military.

articles.title_zh: 十一届河南省委第十轮巡视完成反馈
articles.title_en: 11th Henan Provincial Party Committee Completes Feedback for 10th Inspection Round
articles.summary_zh: 河南省委第十轮巡视反馈工作全部完成，11个省委巡视组向省纪委监委机关、省委组织部及3个常规巡视单位、33个“回头看”单位反馈巡视情况，要求压实整改主体责任。
articles.summary_en: Feedback for the 10th inspection round of the Henan Provincial Party Committee has been fully completed, with 11 inspection teams reporting findings to the provincial discipline inspection commission, the organization department and 36 other units, demanding solid rectification.

articles.title_zh: 一条“难养”的鱼，何以带富10多万人？
articles.title_en: How a "Hard-to-Raise" Fish Brings Prosperity to Over 100,000 People
articles.summary_zh: “活力中国调研行”采访团走进湖北仙桃，探访当地黄鳝网箱养殖、苗种繁育与加工产业，其全产业链发展已带动就业创业12万人。
articles.summary_en: A reporting team toured Xiantao, Hubei, to see how the local eel industry — from cage farming and breeding to processing — now supports over 120,000 jobs and businesses.

articles.title_zh: 河北进一步优化服务推动“标准地”出让
articles.title_en: Hebei Further Optimizes Services to Promote "Standard Land" Transfer
articles.summary_zh: 河北省将工业用地“标准地”出让纳入2026年营商环境优化提升行动方案和“十五五”规划纲要，推动土地要素向优质项目精准配置，石家庄高新区一重点项目从拿地到竣工仅用一年半。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province has included "standard land" transfer for industrial land in its 2026 business environment improvement plan and its 15th Five-Year Plan, aiming to allocate land resources to high-quality projects; a key project in Shijiazhuang Hi-Tech Zone took only 18 months from land acquisition to completion.

articles.title_zh: 河北省首张县级人工智能OPC算力券在邯郸成安发布
articles.title_en: Hebei Issues Its First County-Level AI Computing-Power Voucher in Cheng'an, Handan
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，河北邯郸成安县发布全省首张县级人工智能OPC算力券，同步上线信息谷·成安OPC综合服务平台，首批额度200万元，5家企业签约入驻。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Cheng'an County in Handan, Hebei released the province's first county-level AI computing-power voucher and launched the OPC service platform, with 2 million yuan in first-batch funds.

articles.title_zh: 河北省全面开展2026年下半年新兵起运工作
articles.title_en: Hebei Fully Launches Departure of New Recruits for Second Half of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河北省全面展开2026年下半年新兵起运工作，石家庄、邯郸、张家口、唐山等地陆续举行新兵入伍欢送仪式，燕赵大地掀起崇军拥军热潮。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province recently launched the departure of new recruits for the second half of 2026, with send-off ceremonies held in Shijiazhuang, Handan, Zhangjiakou and Tangshan.

articles.title_zh: 河北省将培育人工智能应用服务商
articles.title_en: Hebei to Cultivate AI Application Service Providers
articles.summary_zh: 河北省近日开展人工智能应用服务商培育专项行动，建立省级资源池，力争到2026年底入池企业超60家，提升面向制造业复杂场景的落地交付能力。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province has launched a special program to cultivate AI application service providers, building a provincial resource pool that aims to include over 60 firms by the end of 2026 and boost delivery capacity for complex manufacturing scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议 研究部署先进制造业发展和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Expanded Meeting on Advanced Manufacturing and Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，省委书记罗文主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署发展先进制造业、安全生产和公安工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, the Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee held an expanded meeting chaired by Party Secretary Luo Wen to study instructions on developing advanced manufacturing and ensuring work safety.

articles.title_zh: 深化体制机制改革 推动产业结构转型升级 加快推动重点园区高质量发展
articles.title_en: Hainan Convenes Provincial Meeting on Reform and Upgrading of Key Industrial Parks
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，海南省重点园区发展建设现场会在三亚崖州湾科技城召开，省委书记冯飞讲话，省长刘小明主持，部署深化园区体制机制改革与产业结构转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Hainan held a provincial conference on key industrial parks in Sanya, where Party Secretary Feng Fei urged deeper institutional reform and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 江西省外贸保持量稳质升良好态势
articles.title_en: Jiangxi's Foreign Trade Maintains Steady Volume and Improving Quality
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，南昌海关介绍，今年1至8月江西省外贸进出口3631.2亿元，同比增长17.8%，出口增长12.7%，进口增长27%。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Nanchang Customs reported that Jiangxi's foreign trade reached 363.12 billion yuan in the first eight months of 2026, up 17.8% year-on-year, with exports up 12.7% and imports up 27%.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘主持专题会议研究"六张网"规划建设
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Chairs Special Meeting on Planning and Construction of Jiangxi's "Six Networks"
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，江西省委书记尹弘在南昌主持召开专题会议，研究水网、新型电网、算力网、新一代通信网、城市地下管网、物流网"六张网"规划建设，强调抢抓政策窗口期、扩大有效投资。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Jiangxi Party Secretary Yin Hong chaired a meeting in Nanchang on planning the province's "Six Networks" — water, power, computing, communications, urban underground pipelines and logistics — urging faster construction to boost investment and high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets to Implement Xi Jinping's Key Speeches and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，江西省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，省委书记尹弘主持会议，研究贯彻落实意见并审议《江西省“十五五”金融业发展规划》。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, the Jiangxi Provincial Party Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and instructions. Party Secretary Yin Hong chaired the meeting, which reviewed implementation measures and the province's 15th Five-Year Plan for the financial sector.

articles.title_zh: 勿忘九一八撞钟鸣警仪式在沈阳举行
articles.title_en: Ceremony Tolling Bell and Sounding Sirens to Mark September 18 Incident Held in Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日上午，勿忘九一八撞钟鸣警仪式在辽宁省沈阳市“九·一八”历史博物馆举行，中共中央政治局委员、全国人大常委会副委员长李鸿忠出席并发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 18, a bell-tolling and air-raid siren ceremony marking the 95th anniversary of the September 18 Incident was held at the September 18 Historical Museum in Shenyang, Liaoning, where Politburo member and NPC Standing Committee Vice Chairman Li Hongzhong attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 中集储能装备制造项目在包头竣工
articles.title_en: CIMC Energy Storage Equipment Manufacturing Project Completed in Baotou
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，内蒙古中集新能源装备有限公司年产10000台全集成储能及数据装备制造项目在包头市昆都仑区竣工投产，成为中集集团储能业务第五大生产基地。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Inner Mongolia CIMC New Energy Equipment Co., Ltd. completed and put into operation a project in Baotou's Kundulun District capable of producing 10,000 integrated energy storage and data equipment units a year, the fifth major production base of CIMC Group's energy storage business.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见中粮集团董事长李国强
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet COFCO Chairman Li Guoqiang in Hohhot
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区政府主席包钢在呼和浩特会见中粮集团董事长李国强一行，双方就深化农牧业、乳业全产业链及科研攻关等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong and regional government Chairman Bao Gang met COFCO Chairman Li Guoqiang in Hohhot to discuss deeper cooperation in agriculture, dairy and grain processing.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖会见四川省援外医疗队员代表
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui Meets Representatives of Sichuan's Medical Aid Teams Abroad
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，四川省委书记王晓晖在成都会见四川省援外医疗队员代表，纪念四川援外医疗队派遣50周年，并向全体援外医疗队员致以问候。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Sichuan Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui met in Chengdu with representatives of Sichuan's medical aid teams overseas, marking 50 years of such missions and extending greetings to all members.

articles.title_zh: 四川出台气象信息服务办法
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues Measures for Meteorological Information Services
articles.summary_zh: 四川省政府出台《四川省气象信息服务办法》，明确公众气象预报和灾害预警信息实行统一发布制度，推动气象数据要素市场化配置，办法自2026年12月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The Sichuan Provincial Government issued measures on meteorological information services, requiring unified release of public weather forecasts and disaster warnings and promoting market-based allocation of meteorological data, effective December 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 山东印发“十五五”应急管理体系建设规划
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Emergency Management System Development
articles.summary_zh: 日前，山东省人民政府印发《山东省“十五五”应急管理体系建设规划》，提出到2030年全省应急管理体系现代化建设取得重要阶段性成效，并部署危化品、矿山、基层应急能力及“人工智能+应急管理”等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial People's Government has issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for emergency management system development, aiming for major progress by 2030 and outlining tasks in hazardous chemicals, mining, grassroots emergency capacity and AI-enabled emergency management.

articles.title_zh: 山东省“人工智能+”工作推进现场会在青岛举行
articles.title_en: Shandong Province Holds On-Site Meeting on "AI Plus" Initiative in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，山东省“人工智能+”工作推进现场会在青岛举行，省委书记林武出席并讲话，省长周乃翔主持，部署人工智能赋能千行百业重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Shandong Province held an on-site meeting in Qingdao to advance its "AI Plus" initiative, with Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu speaking and Governor Zhou Naixiang presiding, to deploy tasks for AI-driven industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 上海市委常委会传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神并听取巡视情况汇报
articles.title_en: Shanghai Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Conveys and Studies Xi Jinping's Important Instructions, Hears Inspection Reports
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月18日上午，上海市委常委会举行会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，听取十二届市委第八轮巡视及巡视"回头看"综合情况汇报，市委书记陈吉宁主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 18, 2026, the Shanghai Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to convey and study Xi Jinping's important instructions and hear reports on the 12th municipal committee's eighth round of inspections and inspection "look-backs," with Party Secretary Chen Jining presiding.

articles.title_zh: 上海市十六届人大五次会议9月30日召开，华源被任命为上海市副市长
articles.title_en: Shanghai's 16th Municipal People's Congress to Convene Sept 30; Hua Yuan Appointed Vice Mayor
articles.summary_zh: 上海市人大常委会会议9月18日闭会，黄莉新主持，决定任命华源为上海市副市长，表决通过5件法规和决定，市十六届人大五次会议定于9月30日召开。
articles.summary_en: Chaired by Huang Lixin, the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee ended its 34th session on Sept 18, appointing Hua Yuan as vice mayor and passing five regulations.

articles.title_en: All New Passenger Stations on Xi'an–Ankang High-Speed Railway Pass Completion Acceptance
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，西康高铁牛背梁、柞水西、镇安西、安康西4座新建客站完成各项验收，全线开通运营进入最后冲刺阶段。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, four new passenger stations on the Xi'an–Ankang high-speed railway completed acceptance inspections, putting the line's opening into its final stage.

articles.title_zh: 陕西秋季统筹统招自主就业退役士兵职业技能培训工作启动
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Launches Fall Vocational Skills Training for Self-Employed Demobilized Soldiers
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，陕西省退役军人事务厅宣布启动秋季统筹统招自主就业退役士兵职业技能培训，报名时间为9月21日至10月9日，在6市18个学校开办20个专业培训班。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, the Shaanxi Provincial Department of Veterans Affairs announced the launch of fall vocational skills training for self-employed demobilized soldiers, with registration from Sept 21 to Oct 9 at 20 programs in 18 schools across six cities.

articles.summary_zh: 9月18日国务院新闻办举行发布会介绍，第140届广交会将于10月15日至11月4日在广州分三期举办，首次实现十大类生产性服务业全覆盖。
articles.summary_en: At a Sept 18 briefing, the State Council Information Office announced that the 140th Canton Fair will run in three phases in Guangzhou from Oct 15 to Nov 4, covering all ten categories of producer services for the first time.

articles.summary_en: From September 16 to 18, 2026, a Shaanxi provincial Party and government delegation visited Xinjiang for pairing-assistance and cooperation talks, with a joint symposium held in Urumqi on September 17 attended by Zhao Yide and Chen Xiaojiang.

articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and nine other departments released the 15th Five-Year Plan for the Pharmaceutical Industry on Sept 18, setting 25 tasks across eight areas including innovation, supply-chain security and digital transformation, targeting over 200 new medical devices approved by 2030.

articles.summary_zh: 9月17日至18日，云南省委书记王宁在红河哈尼族彝族自治州调研，考察云锡集团、蒙自经开区及石榴产业，强调推进产业升级与产业富民。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 17 to 18, Yunnan Party Secretary Wang Ning inspected Honghe Hani and Yi Autonomous Prefecture, visiting Yuntin Group, Mengzi development zone and pomegranate farms, stressing industrial upgrading and raising rural incomes.

articles.summary_en: Yunnan Province recently released its second batch of 2026 provincial major project lists, covering 189 projects with total investment of 55.702 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 云南省人大常委会决议决定和任免名单
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Adopts Resolutions and Personnel Appointments
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月18日，云南省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议在昆明通过多项地方性法规批准决议，并决定任命陈春平为副省长，接受赵俊民辞去副省长职务。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, 2026, the Standing Committee of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress held its 25th meeting in Kunming, approving several local regulations and appointing Chen Chunping as vice governor while accepting Zhao Junmin's resignation from the post.

articles.title_en: Zhejiang AI Theory Theater Creation and R&D Center Established in Jinhua
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，浙江省AI理响剧场创作研发中心在金华成立，并同步发布全省AI理论短剧共创计划，推动理论宣讲进入短剧流量端。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, the Zhejiang AI Theory Theater Creation and R&D Center was established in Jinhua, alongside a province-wide plan to co-create AI-powered theory short dramas for public outreach.

articles.title_zh: 尹力会见两岸企业家峰会台湾方面理事长刘兆玄一行
articles.title_en: Yin Li Meets Liu Chao-shiuan, Taiwan-side Chairman of the Cross-Strait Entrepreneurs Summit
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，中共中央政治局委员、北京市委书记尹力在北京会见两岸企业家峰会台湾方面理事长刘兆玄一行，郭金龙出席会见。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li met in Beijing with Liu Chao-shiuan, Taiwan-side chairman of the Cross-Strait Entrepreneurs Summit; Kuo Chin-lung also attended.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇出席首都产业一线科技人才走进高校系列宣讲北京大学专场并作辅导报告
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Attends Peking University Session of Capital Industry Frontline Tech Talent Campus Lecture Series and Delivers Guidance Report
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日下午，首都产业一线科技人才走进高校系列宣讲北京大学专场举行，北京市委副书记、市长殷勇出席并作辅导报告，强调弘扬实干奋斗精神、支持青年人才成长。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 18, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong attended the Peking University session of a lecture series featuring frontline industrial tech talent, delivering a guidance report on hard work and support for young talent.

articles.title_zh: 文化和旅游部发布《文化产业发展“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Ministry of Culture and Tourism Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Cultural Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 文化和旅游部近日发布《文化产业发展“十五五”规划》，提出力争到2030年文化产业规模、整体实力和综合效益实现跃升，并明确七方面重点任务。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Culture and Tourism released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Cultural Industry Development, aiming for a leap in the sector's scale and competitiveness by 2030 and setting out seven key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 共享3.0机遇，中国开放红利持续释放

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市贯彻落实第三轮中央生态环境保护督察整改工作部署会召开 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Holds Meeting on Rectifying Third-Round Central Ecological and Environmental Inspection; Lu Feng Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日下午，汕尾市召开贯彻落实第三轮中央生态环境保护督察整改工作部署会，市委书记逯峰主持会议并讲话，部署全市督察反馈问题整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 18, Shanwei City held a meeting to deploy rectification of issues from the third round of central ecological and environmental inspection, with municipal Party Secretary Lu Feng chairing and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市政府党组会议、常务会议召开 研究部署安全稳定、经济发展等工作
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings on Safety, Stability and Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，汕尾市政府召开党组会议、常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署安全生产、社会稳定和三、四季度经济发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, the Shanwei Municipal Government held party group and executive meetings to implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's instructions and plan work on safety, stability and economic development.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰到市城区调研基层党建工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Inspects Grassroots Party-Building Work in Shanwei Urban District
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到市城区调研基层党建工作，要求做深做实“党员就在身边”活动，发挥基层党组织战斗堡垒作用。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng inspected grassroots Party-building work in the city's urban district, urging deeper implementation of the "Party Members by Your Side" campaign.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市贯彻落实第三轮中央生态环境保护督察整改工作部署会召开 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Holds Meeting on Rectifying Third-Round Central Ecological Inspection Findings, Chaired by Lu Feng
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日下午，汕尾市召开贯彻落实第三轮中央生态环境保护督察整改工作部署会，市委书记逯峰主持会议并讲话，对全市督察整改工作进行动员部署。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 18, Shanwei City held a meeting to mobilize and deploy rectification work for the third round of central ecological and environmental protection inspections, chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Lu Feng.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰调研2026粤港澳大湾区中秋晚会筹备及节前安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Inspects Preparations for 2026 Greater Bay Area Mid-Autumn Gala and Pre-Holiday Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，汕尾市委书记逯峰在市体育中心调研2026粤港澳大湾区中秋晚会筹备及节前安全生产工作，要求高标准推进筹备、落实落细安全防范措施。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng inspected preparations for the 2026 Greater Bay Area Mid-Autumn Gala and pre-holiday safety work, urging high-standard organization and strict safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 四平市委常委会会议传达学习习近平总书记重要文章精神
articles.title_en: Siping Municipal Party Committee Meeting Studies Xi Jinping's Article on Party Governance Responsibility
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，四平市委书记王相民主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在《求是》发表的重要文章《坚持落实管党治党政治责任》精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Siping Party Secretary Wang Xiangmin chaired a meeting of the municipal Party committee standing committee to study Xi Jinping's article on upholding Party governance responsibility and discuss implementation.

articles.title_zh: 泰州市2026年下半年新兵出征暨“全民国防教育月”启动仪式举行
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds Send-off for 2026 Second-Half Recruits and Launches National Defense Education Month
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，泰州市2026年下半年新兵出征暨“全民国防教育月”启动仪式在姜堰区体育馆举行，市委书记姜冬冬出席并讲话，500多名新兵启程入伍。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, Taizhou held a send-off ceremony for over 500 new recruits and launched its National Defense Education Month at the Jiangyan District Gymnasium, with Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong speaking.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开市第七次党代会报告征求意见座谈会
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Symposium to Seek Opinions on Seventh Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬主持召开座谈会，就市第七次党代会报告征求老领导老同志、人大代表、政协委员意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong chaired a symposium to solicit opinions from former officials, lawmakers and political advisors on the report for the city's seventh Party congress.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省出台零碳园区建设实施方案
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Implementation Plan for Zero-Carbon Park Construction
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省发展改革委、省工信厅近日联合印发《江苏省零碳园区建设实施方案》，提出到2030年培育建成10个左右省级零碳园区，并同步启动省级零碳园区组织申报。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's Development and Reform Commission and Department of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued an implementation plan for zero-carbon parks, targeting about 10 provincial-level zero-carbon parks by 2030 while opening applications.

articles.title_zh: 通化市委常委会会议传达学习中央政治局会议精神
articles.title_en: Tonghua Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Conveys Spirit of Politburo Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，副省长、通化市委书记孙简主持市委常委会会议，传达学习中共中央政治局会议精神及习近平、李强相关指示要求，研究贯彻落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Vice Governor and Tonghua Party Secretary Sun Jian chaired a standing committee meeting to study the CPC Politburo meeting's spirit and instructions from Xi Jinping and Premier Li Qiang.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚在西安调研港贸产融合发展工作 强调高质量建设中欧班列经济圈
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Inspects Xi'an on Port-Trade-Industry Integration, Calls for High-Quality China-Europe Railway Express Economic Circle
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，陕西省省长赵刚在西安市调研港贸产融合发展工作并主持召开座谈会，强调高质量建设中欧班列经济圈，推动陕西开放发展取得新成效。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Shaanxi Governor Zhao Gang inspected Xi'an on port-trade-industry integration and chaired a symposium, urging high-quality development of the China-Europe Railway Express economic circle to advance Shaanxi's opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平为市委党校秋季主体班作专题辅导报告
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Gives Special Guidance Report to Xinxiang Municipal Party School Autumn Cohort
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日上午，新乡市委书记魏建平到市委党校为2026年秋季学期主体班学员作专题辅导报告，强调争做“一脚泥、一肩扛、一身正、一生情”的优秀干部。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 17, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping delivered a special guidance report to the municipal Party school's autumn 2026 cohort, urging cadres to meet the standards of outstanding officials.

articles.title_zh: 建安区召开全区“三资”清查整治工作调度会 高雁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Jian'an District Holds Meeting on Rectification of Rural Collective Assets, Chaired by Gao Yan
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，许昌市建安区委书记高雁主持召开全区农村集体“三资”清查整治工作调度会，部署问题摸排整改与从严追责问责工作，区长刘建伟等出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Gao Yan, Party Secretary of Jian'an District in Xuchang, chaired a meeting on rectifying rural collective assets, urging thorough problem screening, timely rectification and strict accountability.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平听取全市“六张网”项目谋划及政策性资金争取情况
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Reviews City's "Six Networks" Project Planning and Policy Funding Efforts
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，盐城市委书记严汉平主持会议，听取全市“六张网”项目谋划及政策性资金争取情况汇报，部署下一阶段重点任务，代市长吴炜出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Yan Hanping, Party Secretary of Yancheng, chaired a meeting to review the city's "six networks" project planning and policy funding efforts and set priorities for the next stage, with acting mayor Wu Wei attending.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜领衔督办政协重点提案
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Leads Supervision of Key CPPCC Proposal on Private Economy
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，盐城市委副书记、代市长吴炜领衔督办市政协「降低市场准入准营门槛，优化民营经济发展环境」重点提案，市政协主席羊维达主持督办会。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Yancheng Acting Mayor Wu Wei led supervision of a key CPPCC proposal on lowering market access barriers and improving the environment for private business, with CPPCC Chairman Yang Weida chairing the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市与中国电信江苏公司签署战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Yancheng City Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement with China Telecom Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，盐城市政府与中国电信江苏公司在盐城签署共建“智云盐城”战略合作协议，代市长吴炜出席并见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, the Yancheng city government and China Telecom Jiangsu signed a strategic cooperation agreement in Yancheng to jointly build the "Smart Cloud Yancheng" digital infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 广东海洋大学阳江校区启用五周年高质量发展大会举行
articles.title_en: Conference Held to Mark Fifth Anniversary of Guangdong Ocean University's Yangjiang Campus
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，广东海洋大学阳江校区启用五周年高质量发展大会举行，市委书记卢一先、市长余金富等出席，共谋校地协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, a high-quality development conference marking the fifth anniversary of Guangdong Ocean University's Yangjiang campus was held, with city leaders attending to advance university-local cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市政府常务会议研究经济运行和蚊媒传染病防控
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Government Executive Meeting Studies Economic Performance and Mosquito-Borne Disease Control
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，阳江市市长余金富主持召开八届市政府第143次常务会议，研究全市1-8月经济运行情况，并听取基孔肯雅热等蚊媒传染病疫情防控工作汇报。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, Mayor Yu Jinfu chaired the 143rd executive meeting of the Yangjiang Municipal Government, reviewing economic performance for January-August and hearing a report on dengue and chikungunya mosquito-borne disease prevention and control.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在彭阳县原州区调研时强调聚力抓好乡村全面振兴重点任务落实
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Stresses Rural Revitalization Tasks in Pengyang County and Yuanzhou District Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日至17日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞赴彭阳县、原州区部分乡镇调研，强调抓好乡村全面振兴重点任务，在城乡融合发展中推动共同富裕。
articles.summary_en: From September 16 to 17, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, inspected townships in Pengyang County and Yuanzhou District, urging solid implementation of rural revitalization tasks and common prosperity through urban-rural integration.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏自治区政府召开常务会议 研究安全生产和先进制造业等工作
articles.title_en: Ningxia Autonomous Region Government Holds Executive Meeting on Work Safety and Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，宁夏自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府2026年第22次常务会议，研究部署安全生产、发展先进制造业和经济运行等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu chaired the regional government's 22nd executive meeting of 2026, reviewing work safety, advanced manufacturing and economic performance.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞会见非洲友好人士考察团
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Meets African Friendly Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记、人大常委会主任李邑飞在银川会见毛里塔尼亚国民议会议长麦盖特率领的非洲友好人士考察团，双方就深化生态、农业、经贸等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei met in Yinchuan with an African delegation led by Mauritanian National Assembly Speaker Mohamed Bamba Meguett to discuss cooperation in ecology, agriculture and trade.

articles.title_zh: 银川市委理论学习中心组集体学习会召开 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Holds Collective Theoretical Study Session on Ethnic Unity, Chaired by Zhao Xuhui
articles.summary_zh: 近日，银川市委理论学习中心组召开集体学习会，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，主题为深化“多民族居民亲如一家”实践、推动民族团结进步事业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee recently convened a collective theoretical study session chaired by Zhao Xuhui, Party Secretary of Yinchuan, focusing on deepening ethnic unity practices and advancing high-quality development of ethnic solidarity efforts.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市代理市长唐浩然主持召开市政府第58次常务会议
articles.title_en: Yueyang Acting Mayor Tang Haoran Chairs 58th Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，岳阳市代理市长唐浩然主持召开市政府第58次常务会议，传达学习中央有关精神，听取支持三荷机场临时航空口岸国际航线发展、市本级政府固定资产投资项目立项等工作汇报。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, Yueyang Acting Mayor Tang Haoran chaired the 58th executive meeting of the municipal government, conveying central directives and hearing reports on international routes at Sanhe Airport's temporary air port and on government fixed-asset investment projects.

articles.title_zh: 余钢到遂溪县调研滨海旅游开发、海洋牧场和渔港建设工作
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Inspects Coastal Tourism, Marine Ranching and Fishing Port Development in Suixi County
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日至17日，湛江市委书记余钢到遂溪县调研滨海旅游开发、海洋牧场和渔港建设工作，强调把海洋资源优势转化为发展胜势。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 16 to 17, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang inspected coastal tourism, marine ranching and fishing port development in Suixi County, urging that marine resource advantages be turned into growth momentum.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇主持召开省委横琴工委2026年度第24次会议 部署合作区安全生产与开发建设
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Chairs 24th Meeting of Hengqin Party Working Committee on Safety and Cooperation Zone Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，省委横琴工委书记陈勇主持召开省委横琴工委2026年度第24次会议，部署中秋、国庆节前合作区安全生产、三防森防工作，并推进横琴粤澳深度合作区建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Chen Yong chaired the 24th meeting of the Hengqin Party Working Committee in 2026, deploying pre-holiday workplace safety, flood and fire prevention work and advancing the Guangdong-Macao Deep Cooperation Zone.
keywords: 横琴粤澳深度合作区建设

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐赴香洲区调研先进制造业发展情况
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Visits Xiangzhou District to Inspect Advanced Manufacturing Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐赴香洲区调研先进制造业，走访三家机电企业，强调推动智能化、绿色化、融合化发展，加快打造产业新支柱。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong inspected advanced manufacturing in Xiangzhou District, visiting three electromechanical firms and urging smarter, greener and more integrated industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议 研究部署先进制造业和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting on Advanced Manufacturing and Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，省委书记罗文主持并讲话，研究部署发展先进制造业、安全生产及公安工作。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, the Hebei Provincial Party Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting chaired by provincial party secretary Luo Wen, deploying work on advanced manufacturing, workplace safety and public security.

articles.title_zh: 青山多忠烈 薪火照征程——长征精神在粤北的历史回响
articles.title_en: Heroes Abound in the Green Hills: The Long March Spirit's Echoes in Northern Guangdong
articles.summary_zh: 粤北韶关、清远等地依托红军长征遗址遗迹等红色资源，发展红色旅游与特色产业，推动乡村振兴与老区发展。
articles.summary_en: Shaoguan and Qingyuan in northern Guangdong are tapping Long March red heritage sites to develop red tourism and specialty industries, spurring rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 全省“人工智能+”工作推进现场会在青岛举行
articles.title_en: Shandong Holds On-Site Meeting in Qingdao to Advance AI Plus Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，山东省“人工智能+”工作推进现场会在青岛举行，省委书记林武出席并讲话，省长周乃翔主持，部署以更大力度实施“人工智能+”行动、赋能千行百业。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Shandong Province held an on-site meeting in Qingdao to advance its AI Plus initiative, with Party Secretary Lin Wu speaking and Governor Zhou Naixiang presiding over plans to empower industries with AI.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁主持召开福州市委常委会会议 研究安全生产与投洽会成果落实
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Chairs Fuzhou Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting on Safety and Investment Outcomes
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，福州市委书记郭宁宁主持召开市委常委会会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究安全生产、投洽会成果落实和防灾减灾等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning chaired a meeting of the municipal Party standing committee to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's instructions and work on workplace safety, investment follow-up and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 福州市与天津大学签署合作协议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Signs Cooperation Agreement with Tianjin University
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，福州市与天津大学签署共建高校区域技术转移转化中心合作协议，市委书记郭宁宁与天津大学校长柴立元座谈交流并见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Fuzhou and Tianjin University signed an agreement to jointly build a regional technology transfer and commercialization center, witnessed by Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning and university president Chai Liyuan.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能重塑网络安全治理格局
articles.title_en: AI Reshapes the Cybersecurity Governance Landscape
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日至20日，2026年国家网络安全宣传周在全国开展，中央网信办副主任王京涛指出，AI驱动的网络攻击正深刻重塑网络安全治理格局。
articles.summary_en: China held its 2026 National Cybersecurity Week from Sept 14 to 20. Wang Jingtao, deputy head of the Cyberspace Administration of China, said AI-driven attacks are reshaping cybersecurity governance.

articles.title_zh: 全省“人工智能+”工作推进现场会在青岛举行
articles.title_en: Provincial On-Site Meeting on Advancing the "AI Plus" Initiative Held in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，山东省“人工智能+”工作推进现场会在青岛举行，省委书记林武出席并讲话，省长周乃翔主持，部署以更大力度实施“人工智能+”行动、赋能千行百业。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, Shandong Province held an on-site meeting in Qingdao on advancing the "AI Plus" initiative, with Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu speaking and Governor Zhou Naixiang presiding, to step up AI-driven upgrading across industries.

articles.title_zh: 省城闲置公车开到乡镇“上岗”，山东为公车改革提供新范例
articles.title_en: Idle Official Cars From Provincial Capital Put to Work in Townships as Shandong Sets New Example for Official Vehicle Reform
articles.summary_zh: 山东启动公务用车公物仓试点，将超编、闲置公车跨层级调拨至基层一线，首批向5个县（市、区）下拨20辆车，探索省市县一体化公车管理体系。
articles.summary_en: Shandong has launched a pilot 'public warehouse' program for official vehicles, reallocating idle and over-quota cars from higher levels to grassroots units, with 20 vehicles sent to five pilot counties.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市高质量城市更新工作推进会召开 袁家军出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Attends Chongqing Meeting on High-Quality Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，重庆市高质量城市更新工作推进会召开，市委书记袁家军出席并讲话，市长陈新武主持，部署构建“1580”城市更新工作体系。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Chongqing held a meeting on high-quality urban renewal. Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun spoke, Mayor Chen Xinwu presided, and a "1580" urban renewal framework was deployed.

articles.title_zh: 第23届中国—东盟博览会签约活动在南宁举办
articles.title_en: Signing Event of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo Held in Nanning
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，第23届中国—东盟博览会签约活动在南宁举办，首次搭建机制性供需对接平台，发布254个向海经济场景清单，并集中签约一批国际合作与产业投资项目。
articles.summary_en: On September 18, the signing event of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo was held in Nanning, launching a mechanism-based supply-demand matching platform, releasing 254 marine-economy scenario lists, and signing a batch of international cooperation and industrial investment projects.

articles.title_zh: 5位驻村第一书记与中外记者见面交流
articles.title_en: Five Village First Secretaries Meet Chinese and Foreign Journalists
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会，5位驻村第一书记代表围绕乡村振兴一线实干与中外记者交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, the State Council Information Office hosted a press conference where five village first secretaries shared their work on rural revitalization with Chinese and foreign journalists.

articles.title_zh: 2026年国家网络安全宣传周河南省活动推进会在南阳召开
articles.title_en: Henan Holds Promotion Meeting for 2026 National Cybersecurity Week
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，2026年国家网络安全宣传周河南省活动推进会在南阳召开，省委常委安伟出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Henan held a promotion meeting in Nanyang for the 2026 National Cybersecurity Week, with An Wei, member of the provincial Party Committee Standing Committee, attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 湖北种猪新品种发布 “鄂通两头乌”获国家审定
articles.title_en: Hubei Unveils New Pig Breed "Etong Liangtouwu," Approved by the State
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日至17日，2026黑猪产业发展大会在华中农业大学举行，“鄂通两头乌”猪新品种产业化发布，该品种由华中农业大学刘榜团队与通城县农业农村局等单位历时18年选育，2026年通过国家审定。
articles.summary_en: On September 16-17, the 2026 Black Pig Industry Development Conference was held at Huazhong Agricultural University, where the new pig breed "Etong Liangtouwu" was launched for industrialization. The breed, developed over 18 years by a Huazhong Agricultural University team and the Tongcheng County Agriculture Bureau, passed national certification in 2026.

tags_en: Tongcheng County Agriculture and Rural Affairs Bureau

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行：鄂州武昌鱼全产业链产值突破200亿元
articles.title_en: Vitality China Research Tour: Ezhou Wuchang Fish Industry Chain Output Tops 20 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月15日，“活力中国调研行”采访团走进湖北鄂州，探访武昌鱼原产地三山村；当地经生态治理与产业融合，2025年武昌鱼全产业链产值突破200亿元。
articles.summary_en: A "Vitality China" research tour visited Ezhou, Hubei on Sept 15, home of the Wuchang fish. Ecological restoration and industry integration lifted its full industry chain output past 20 billion yuan in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 三亚将推动一批旗舰型文旅综合体建成运营
articles.title_en: Sanya to Advance Construction and Operation of Flagship Cultural Tourism Complexes
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，三亚市商务局在新闻发布会上介绍，将高标准推进太古里、超级万象城等海棠湾标志性商业项目建成运营，推动旅游消费从打卡式流量转向体验式留量。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Sanya's commerce bureau said at a press conference that the city will advance the construction and operation of flagship commercial complexes such as Taikoo Li and the Super MixC in Haitang Bay, upgrading tourism consumption.

articles.title_zh: 沈跃跃出席2026上海合作组织传统医学论坛开幕式并发表主旨讲话
articles.title_en: Shen Yueyue Attends Opening Ceremony of 2026 SCO Traditional Medicine Forum and Delivers Keynote Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，2026上海合作组织传统医学论坛在江西南昌开幕，全国政协副主席、上合组织睦邻友好合作委员会主席沈跃跃出席开幕式并发表主旨讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, the 2026 SCO Traditional Medicine Forum opened in Nanchang, Jiangxi. Shen Yueyue, Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee and Chair of the SCO Good-Neighborliness, Friendship and Cooperation Commission, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a keynote speech.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区党委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Recent Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，内蒙古自治区党委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要指示精神，听取全区食品安全、质量、知识产权工作情况汇报并研究部署相关工作，自治区党委书记王伟中主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Inner Mongolia's regional Party Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's recent instructions and hear reports on food safety, quality and IP work, chaired by Party Secretary Wang Weizhong.

articles.title_zh: 二〇二六年“铸牢共同体 中华一家亲”主题宣传活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Forge a Strong Community, One Chinese Family' Themed Publicity Campaign Launched
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，中央宣传部会同中央统战部、国家民委在京启动2026年“铸牢共同体 中华一家亲”主题宣传活动。
articles.summary_en: China launched the 2026 'One Chinese Family' ethnic unity publicity campaign in Beijing on Sept 17, organized by the CPC Publicity and United Front Work departments and the National Ethnic Affairs Commission.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏启动“举杯贺兰山 庆中秋 迎国庆”系列促消费活动
articles.title_en: Ningxia Launches 'Raise a Glass to Helan Mountain' Consumption Promotion Campaign for Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，宁夏回族自治区政府新闻办公室在银川召开新闻发布会，介绍“举杯贺兰山 庆中秋 迎国庆”文旅体商农系列促消费活动，共策划249项重点活动，统筹安排资金1.1亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Ningxia's government information office held a press briefing in Yinchuan on its 'Raise a Glass to Helan Mountain' consumption promotion campaign, planning 249 events with 110 million yuan in coordinated funding.

articles.title_zh: 成都理工大学成立专项工作组调查考试作弊问题
articles.title_en: Chengdu University of Technology Sets Up Task Force to Investigate Exam Cheating
articles.summary_zh: 9月18日，就媒体反映个别课程考试期间存在社会人员组织作弊问题，成都理工大学成立由校领导牵头的专项工作组全面核查，并称对考试作弊零容忍、从严从重处理。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 18, Chengdu University of Technology set up a task force led by university leaders to fully investigate media reports that outsiders organized cheating in some course exams, vowing zero tolerance and strict punishment.

articles.title_zh: 加快推动广电视听高质量发展
articles.title_en: China Moves to Accelerate High-Quality Development of Broadcasting and Audiovisual Services
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，国家广播电视总局介绍“十五五”时期加快推动广播电视和网络视听高质量发展的有关部署。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where the National Radio and Television Administration outlined plans to accelerate high-quality development of broadcasting and online audiovisual services under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 新疆政协召开对口协商会
articles.title_en: Xinjiang CPPCC Holds Consultation Meeting on Youth Football Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，新疆自治区政协召开对口协商会，围绕深化体教融合、助推青少年足球高质量发展协商议政，8位政协委员和专家学者发言并提出建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the Xinjiang Regional CPPCC convened a consultation meeting on deepening the integration of sports and education and promoting high-quality youth football development, with eight committee members and experts offering proposals.

articles.title_zh: 嘉兴：2026平湖人工智能产业推介会举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Pinghu AI Industry Promotion Conference Held in Jiaxing
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，2026金平湖投资合作暨人工智能产业推介会在浙江平湖举行，多个机器人与算力项目公布进展，平湖西瓜灯群众文化系列活动同步启幕。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, 2026, Pinghu in Zhejiang hosted an investment and AI industry promotion conference showcasing robotics and computing-power projects, alongside the launch of its watermelon-lantern cultural festival.

articles.title_zh: 三部门联合印发方案 部署四大任务保护农业品牌
articles.title_en: Three Departments Jointly Issue Plan to Protect Agricultural Brands with Four Major Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 近日，农业农村部、市场监管总局和国家知识产权局联合印发《农业品牌保护专项行动实施方案（2026—2027年）》，部署质量安全监管执法、打击不正当竞争、涉农知识产权保护、完善品牌管理制度四大重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, the State Administration for Market Regulation and the National Intellectual Property Administration jointly issued a 2026-2027 action plan to protect agricultural brands, setting out four major tasks covering quality supervision, cracking down on unfair competition, agricultural IP protection and brand management systems.

articles.title_zh: 邢台抢滩新赛道 培育壮大战略性新兴产业
articles.title_en: Xingtai Seizes New Track to Cultivate Strategic Emerging Industries
articles.summary_zh: 河北邢台市锚定工业立市战略，以新能源装备、数字信息产业为支柱，加快培育战略性新兴产业，推动全面绿色转型。
articles.summary_en: Xingtai in Hebei is anchoring its industrial strategy on new energy equipment and digital information sectors, accelerating strategic emerging industries to drive a green transition.

articles.title_zh: 跨越85年的两次会议
articles.title_en: Two Meetings Across 85 Years
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾1929年古田会议与2014年习近平在古田出席全军政治工作会议，并采访老区群众，强调红色基因传承。
articles.summary_en: The article revisits the 1929 Gutian Meeting and Xi Jinping's 2014 military political work conference in Gutian, interviewing local residents about red heritage.

articles.title_zh: 以人为本，让城市更有温度
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: A People-Centered Approach Makes Cities Warmer
articles.summary_zh: 新华社19日播发“习近平总书记关切事”报道，聚焦福州、威海、青岛、雄安等地以人为本的城市建设、精细化治理与智慧城市服务实践。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua feature on Xi Jinping's concerns highlights people-centered urban development, fine-grained city governance and smart-city services in Fuzhou, Weihai, Qingdao and Xiongan.

articles.title_zh: 中国“十五五”规划，为世界提供新机遇
articles.title_en: China's 15th Five-Year Plan Offers New Opportunities for the World
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月17日播发报道，围绕“十五五”规划纲要阐述中国大市场、创新合作、外商投资与共建“一带一路”为世界带来的新机遇。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 17 that China's 15th Five-Year Plan offers new opportunities for the world through its large market, innovation cooperation, foreign investment opening and Belt and Road cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 《医药工业发展“十五五”规划》发布
articles.title_en: China Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Pharmaceutical Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等十部门9月18日在北京公布《医药工业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年生物医药研发应用稳居世界前列，并明确10项预期性指标与25项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Ten Chinese government departments, led by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, released the 15th Five-Year Plan for the pharmaceutical industry on September 18, aiming for world-leading biomedical R&D by 2030 with 10 targets and 25 key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办印发通知加强涉企侵权信息管理
articles.title_en: Cyberspace Administration of China Issues Notice to Strengthen Management of Infringing Information Involving Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办秘书局近日印发通知，明确涉企侵权信息处置范围，要求网站平台主动清理处置个人信息类、侮辱贬损类、假冒仿冒类、虚假误导类等涉企侵权信息。
articles.summary_en: The Secretary Bureau of the Cyberspace Administration of China recently issued a notice defining the scope of infringing information involving enterprises, requiring website platforms to proactively clean up and handle such content, including personal information leaks, insults, impersonation and misleading material.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在青岛调研
articles.title_en: Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang Inspects Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，山东省省长周乃翔在青岛调研，考察海洋装备国家大学科技园筹建及重点项目，强调培育新质生产力、优化营商环境、抓好安全生产。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang inspected Qingdao, reviewing a marine equipment science park and company projects, and urging innovation and safer production.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔会见英国驻华大使魏磊
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er Meets with UK Ambassador to China Peter Wilson
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，天津市委书记陈敏尔在天津会见英国驻华大使魏磊一行，双方就经贸金融、教育医疗、人工智能、绿色低碳等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er met in Tianjin with UK Ambassador to China Peter Wilson and his delegation, discussing cooperation in trade, finance, education, healthcare, AI and green development.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府召开第116次常务会议 张工主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 116th Executive Meeting Chaired by Zhang Gong
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日下午，天津市市长张工主持召开市政府第116次常务会议，研究部署安全生产隐患排查整治、智慧城市建设“十五五”规划及多部地方性法规草案审议等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 17, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong chaired the 116th executive meeting of the municipal government, deploying workplace safety hazard inspections and reviewing the smart city plan for the 15th Five-Year Plan period along with several draft local regulations.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：在“一国两制”下，香港的国际金融、航运、贸易中心地位持续巩固
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Under "One Country, Two Systems," Hong Kong's Status as an International Financial, Shipping and Trade Hub Keeps Consolidating
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，“一国两制”下香港经济蓬勃发展，今年上半年港股IPO融资额达2033亿港元，位居全球第二。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing that Hong Kong's economy is thriving under "One Country, Two Systems," with IPO fundraising of HK$203.3 billion in the first half of the year, second globally.

articles.title_zh: 中方接收美国国土安全调查局返还的58件文物艺术品和古生物化石
articles.title_en: China Receives 58 Cultural Relics, Artworks and Fossils Returned by US Homeland Security Investigations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月16日，中国驻美国大使馆举办文物返还交接仪式，接收美方返还的58件文物艺术品和古生物化石，谢锋大使出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, 2026, the Chinese Embassy in the United States held a handover ceremony to receive 58 cultural relics, artworks and paleontological fossils returned by US Homeland Security Investigations. Ambassador Xie Feng attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 学习进行时丨让新兴技术照亮共同繁荣之路
articles.title_en: In-Depth Study: Let Emerging Technologies Light the Path to Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日至13日，习近平主席出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤并发表重要讲话，强调金砖国家要加强人工智能合作、构建开放生态、坚持开源普惠。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit on Sept 12-13, 2026 and delivered key speeches urging BRICS members to strengthen AI cooperation, build open ecosystems and pursue inclusive open-source development.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：反对没有国际法依据、没有经过联合国安理会授权的长臂管辖
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Opposes Long-Arm Jurisdiction Without International Law Basis or UN Security Council Authorization
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆表示，中国在平等互利基础上同各国开展正常经贸合作，一贯反对没有国际法依据、未经联合国安理会授权的长臂管辖。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China conducts normal trade cooperation on an equal and mutually beneficial basis and opposes long-arm jurisdiction lacking international law basis or UN Security Council authorization.

articles.title_zh: 中国国家广电总局：抓“一剧之本” 破除对流量明星的依赖
articles.title_en: China's National Radio and Television Administration: Prioritize Scripts and Break Reliance on Traffic Stars
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国家广电总局电视剧司司长冯胜勇在北京表示，“十五五”期间将推出约100部优秀电视剧、网络剧，抓“一剧之本”，破除对流量明星的依赖。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, NRTA TV drama chief Feng Shengyong said in Beijing that China plans about 100 quality TV and online dramas in the 15th Five-Year Plan period, prioritizing scripts over traffic stars.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：中美经贸团队正就降税等议题保持密切交流
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry: China-U.S. Trade Teams Maintain Close Communication on Tariff Reduction and Other Issues
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，商务部在北京举行例行新闻发布会，新闻发言人何亚东表示，中美经贸团队正就300亿美元相互降低关税安排等议题保持密切交流，后续将适时发布进展。
articles.summary_en: At a routine press conference in Beijing on September 17, Commerce Ministry spokesperson He Yadong said Chinese and U.S. trade teams are maintaining close communication on issues including a mutual $30 billion tariff-reduction arrangement, with progress to be announced in due course.

articles.title_zh: 沈跃跃出席2026上海合作组织传统医学论坛开幕式并发表主旨讲话
articles.title_en: Shen Yueyue Attends Opening of 2026 SCO Traditional Medicine Forum and Delivers Keynote Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，2026上海合作组织传统医学论坛在江西南昌开幕，全国政协副主席、上合组织睦邻友好合作委员会主席沈跃跃出席开幕式并发表主旨讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, the 2026 SCO Traditional Medicine Forum opened in Nanchang, Jiangxi. Shen Yueyue, Vice Chairperson of the CPPCC National Committee and Chair of the SCO Good-Neighborliness Committee, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a keynote speech.

articles.title_zh: 中国成功发射天仪51、52星
articles.title_en: China Successfully Launches Tianyi-51 and Tianyi-52 Satellites
articles.summary_zh: 北京时间9月17日10时40分，中国在酒泉卫星发射中心使用快舟十一号遥三运载火箭成功发射天仪51、52星，卫星顺利进入预定轨道。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, China launched the Tianyi-51 and Tianyi-52 satellites from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center using a Kuaizhou-11 Y3 rocket, and they entered their planned orbits.

articles.title_zh: 中国成功发射卫星互联网低轨25组卫星
articles.title_en: China Successfully Launches 25th Batch of Low-Orbit Satellite Internet Satellites
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日8时32分，中国在海南商业航天发射场用长征十二号运载火箭成功发射卫星互联网低轨25组卫星，卫星进入预定轨道。
articles.summary_en: At 8:32 a.m. on September 17, China successfully launched the 25th batch of low-orbit satellite internet satellites from the Hainan Commercial Spacecraft Launch Site using a Long March-12 rocket, placing them in their planned orbits.

tags.name_en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

tags_en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation

articles.title_zh: 公安部公布网络安全行政执法10起典型案例
articles.title_en: Ministry of Public Security Releases 10 Typical Cases of Cybersecurity Administrative Law Enforcement
articles.summary_zh: 公安部公布网络安全行政执法10起典型案例，涉及数据安全、网络安全和个人信息保护，江苏、安徽、江西、山东、四川、甘肃、宁夏等地公安机关依法对违规企业和个人作出行政处罚。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Public Security released 10 typical cases of administrative law enforcement in cyberspace, covering data security, network security and personal information protection, with local police in multiple provinces punishing violators.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国将向联合国人权理事会再次主提无障碍决议
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China to Again Table Accessibility Resolution at UN Human Rights Council
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上表示，中国将向联合国人权理事会再次主提无障碍决议，并推动完善全球人权治理。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press briefing in Beijing on September 17, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China will once again submit an accessibility resolution to the UN Human Rights Council and work to improve global human rights governance.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳着力为群众打造高品质生活空间
articles.title_en: Shenyang Strives to Create High-Quality Living Spaces for Residents
articles.summary_zh: 沈阳市以老旧小区改造为抓手推进城市更新与基层治理现代化，“十五五”期间计划改造不少于400个老旧小区，聚焦便民、利民、安民。
articles.summary_en: Shenyang is advancing urban renewal through old residential community renovation, planning to upgrade at least 400 more communities during the 15th Five-Year Plan to improve residents' lives.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Developing Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日至17日，全国先进制造业大会在北京召开，会上传达习近平关于发展先进制造业的重要指示，李强出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on advancing advanced manufacturing, which were conveyed at the National Conference on Advanced Manufacturing held in Beijing on September 16-17, where Premier Li Qiang delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on Jilin University's 80th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，中共中央总书记习近平致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年，希望学校聚焦国家战略需求，为东北全面振兴和中国式现代化作出更大贡献。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Xi Jinping sent a letter congratulating Jilin University on its 80th anniversary, urging it to focus on national strategic needs and contribute to Northeast China's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 有力有序协调推进全面依法治国任务落实
articles.title_en: China to Advance Rule of Law Tasks in Orderly Manner, Ministry of Justice Says
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，国务院新闻办举行新闻发布会，司法部副部长李明征等介绍“十五五”时期推进全面依法治国任务落实和司法行政工作、服务保障高质量发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where the Ministry of Justice detailed how it will advance rule-of-law tasks and judicial administration work under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

tags.name_en: Office of the Central Commission for Comprehensive Law-Based Governance

tags_en: Office of the Central Commission for Comprehensive Law-Based Governance

articles.title_zh: 矿业“含绿量”提升发展“含金量”
articles.title_en: Green Mining Raises the Value of Development: China Has Built Over 5,600 Green Mines
articles.summary_zh: 我国已建成省级以上绿色矿山5600余家，“十四五”时期修复治理历史遗留矿山335万亩，勘查、开发、修复全生命周期的绿色转型持续推进。
articles.summary_en: China has built more than 5,600 green mines at or above the provincial level and restored 3.35 million mu of legacy mines during the 14th Five-Year Plan, advancing a green transformation across the mining life cycle.

articles.title_zh: 黄强在长春调研时强调 强力推进项目建设 持续扩大有效投资 更好为高质量发展注入新动能
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Stresses Advancing Project Construction and Expanding Effective Investment During Changchun Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，吉林省委书记黄强在长春调研，试乘地铁5号线并察看生物医药产业创新园、中医药大学永春校区等项目，强调强力推进项目建设、持续扩大有效投资。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Jilin Provincial Party Secretary Huang Qiang inspected Changchun, riding Metro Line 5 and touring a biopharma innovation park and a TCM university campus project, urging stronger project construction and expanded effective investment.

articles.title_zh: 长春市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要贺信精神 张恩惠主持
articles.title_en: Changchun Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets, Conveys Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter on Jilin University's 80th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记致吉林大学建校80周年贺信等重要讲话精神，部署市校合作、对外开放、公安队伍建设及节日安全生产保障等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter on Jilin University's 80th anniversary and other remarks, deploying city-university cooperation, opening-up, public security and holiday safety work.

articles.title_zh: “十五冬”省筹委会召开会议 王新伟主持会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Meeting of Liaoning Provincial Preparatory Committee for 15th National Winter Games
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，第十五届全国冬季运动会辽宁省筹备委员会召开会议，省委副书记、省长王新伟主持会议并讲话，要求高质高效推进各项筹备工作并放大赛事红利、撬动冰雪经济。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, the Liaoning provincial preparatory committee for the 15th National Winter Games held a meeting chaired by Governor Wang Xinwei, who urged high-quality preparation work and leveraging the event to boost the ice-and-snow economy.

tags.name_en: Liaoning Provincial Preparatory Committee for the 15th National Winter Games

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开 霍步刚主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting and Party Building Leading Group Meeting Held; Huo Bugang Presides and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，沈阳市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话，总结学习教育情况，部署巩固拓展正确政绩观学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee meeting and Party Building Leading Group meeting was held, chaired by Municipal Party Secretary Huo Bugang, who summarized the education campaign and laid out steps to consolidate its outcomes on the correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 市政协党组召开扩大会议 于学利主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Shenyang CPPCC Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting, Chaired by Yu Xueli
articles.summary_zh: 沈阳市政协党组召开扩大会议，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，研究巩固拓展学习教育成果，市政协主席、党组书记于学利主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The Party Group of the Shenyang Municipal CPPCC held an expanded meeting to review its education campaign on the correct view of political achievements, chaired by CPPCC Chairman and Party Group Secretary Yu Xueli.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市与国铁集团沈阳局举行工作会商 深化路地融合发展
articles.title_en: Shenyang and China Railway Shenyang Group Hold Work Meeting on Rail-City Integration
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，沈阳市与中国铁路沈阳局集团有限公司举行工作会商，市委书记霍步刚主持，双方就“十五五”深化路地融合、提升沈阳交通枢纽功能等深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Shenyang and China Railway Shenyang Group held a work meeting chaired by Party Secretary Huo Bugang to deepen rail-city integration and upgrade the transport hub.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组（扩大）会议暨履行全面从严治党主体责任领导小组会议召开 范继英主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Fan Jiying Chairs Shenyang People's Congress Party Group Meeting on Full and Rigorous Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 沈阳市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议暨履行全面从严治党主体责任领导小组会议，党组书记、主任范继英主持并讲话，部署巩固拓展学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: The Party group of the Shenyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held an expanded meeting on full and rigorous Party governance, chaired by Fan Jiying, to consolidate the results of the education campaign.

articles.title_zh: 我国物流数字化水平明显提升
articles.title_en: China's Logistics Digitalization Level Improves Significantly
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国物流行业数字化研发投入持续加码、智能化场景加速落地，前七个月重点物流企业数字化转型经费投入同比增长近30%。
articles.summary_en: China's logistics sector has ramped up digital R&D and intelligent applications this year, with key firms' digital transformation spending up nearly 30% year on year in the first seven months.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥出席第23届中国—东盟博览会开幕式并会见与会外国政要
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Opening of 23rd China-ASEAN Expo and Meets Foreign Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，第23届中国—东盟博览会暨商务与投资峰会在广西南宁开幕，国务院副总理丁薛祥出席致辞并宣布开幕，其间会见缅甸、越南、老挝等国政要。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo opened in Nanning, Guangxi. Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang delivered a speech, declared the expo open and met with leaders of Myanmar, Vietnam and Laos.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅印发《关于进一步加强烟花爆竹全链条安全监管的意见》
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Opinions on Strengthening Whole-Chain Safety Supervision of Fireworks and Firecrackers
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅日前印发《关于进一步加强烟花爆竹全链条安全监管的意见》，就生产、储存、经营、运输、燃放等环节安全监管作出部署，压实各方责任，防范化解重大安全风险。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council General Office has issued a document requiring stronger whole-chain safety supervision of fireworks and firecrackers, covering production, storage, sales, transport and displays, while tightening responsibility at all levels to prevent major accidents.

tags.name_en: General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥在第23届中国－东盟博览会暨中国－东盟商务与投资峰会开幕式上的致辞
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Delivers Speech at Opening Ceremony of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo and China-ASEAN Business and Investment Summit
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月17日，国务院副总理丁薛祥在广西南宁出席第23届中国－东盟博览会开幕式并致辞，就中国－东盟自贸区3.0版建设提出建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, 2026, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang delivered a speech at the opening ceremony of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo in Nanning, Guangxi, proposing steps to advance the China-ASEAN FTA 3.0.

articles.title_zh: 8000亿元新型政策性金融工具资金加快投放
articles.title_en: 80 Billion Yuan of New Policy-Based Financial Instruments Disbursed at Faster Pace
articles.summary_zh: 近日，今年新型政策性金融工具首批资金启动投放，进出口银行等支持浙江瑞安智能悬架等项目，总规模增至8000亿元。
articles.summary_en: The first batch of this year's new policy-based financial instruments has been disbursed, backing projects such as the smart suspension project in Ruian, Zhejiang, with the total scale raised to 800 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴会见越南妇联主席黎氏水
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Meets with Vietnamese Women's Union President Le Thi Thuy
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国务委员、全国妇联主席谌贻琴在北京会见越南妇联主席黎氏水，双方就落实两国领导人共识、深化妇女领域交流合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, State Councilor and All-China Women's Federation President Chen Yiqin met in Beijing with Le Thi Thuy, President of the Vietnam Women's Union, to discuss implementing leaders' consensus and deepening cooperation on women's affairs.

articles.title_zh: 总书记为持续做大做强先进制造业指明方向
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Charts Course for Sustaining and Strengthening Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 全国先进制造业大会9月16日至17日在北京召开，会上传达习近平总书记重要指示，为“十五五”时期持续做大做强先进制造业、巩固壮大实体经济根基指明方向。
articles.summary_en: The National Advanced Manufacturing Conference was held in Beijing on Sept 16-17, 2026, where Xi Jinping's important instructions charted the course for strengthening advanced manufacturing and the real economy.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在丹东市调研
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects Dandong City in Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日至16日，辽宁省委书记许昆林赴丹东市调研，考察企业智能化改造、县域经济与文旅融合、防洪及应急救援等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15-16, 2026, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin inspected Dandong, examining industrial upgrading, county economy, tourism integration, and flood control and emergency response.

articles.title_zh: 东港市：“双班齐开” 为党员干部“充电蓄能”
articles.title_en: Donggang City Opens Two Concurrent Training Classes for Party Members and Cadres
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，2026年东港市中青年干部培训班和两企三新党组织书记进修班（第一期）在市委党校同步开班，百余名中青年干部和新兴领域党务骨干集中参训。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Donggang City simultaneously opened a young and middle-aged cadre training class and the first training session for Party organization secretaries in emerging sectors at the Municipal Party School, with over 100 participants.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开定西市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Dingxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日下午，定西市委书记汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示重要贺信精神，安排部署安全生产、教育和中医药产业等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Dingxi Party Secretary Wang Shangxue chaired a municipal Party committee meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions and deploying work on safety, education and traditional Chinese medicine.

articles.title_zh: 中共抚顺市委十三届十六次全会召开
articles.title_en: 13th Fushun Municipal Party Committee Holds 16th Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，中共抚顺市委十三届十六次全会在抚顺召开，市委书记高键讲话，审议通过市委和市纪委工作报告草案及第十四届委员会候选人预备人选名单，部署市第十四次党代会筹备工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the 13th Fushun Municipal Party Committee held its 16th plenary session in Fushun, where Party Secretary Gao Jian spoke. The session approved draft work reports of the municipal Party committee and discipline inspection commission, candidate lists for the 14th committee, and preparations for the city's 14th Party congress.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在丹东市调研
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Conducts Inspection Tour in Dandong
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日至16日，辽宁省委书记许昆林赴丹东市调研，考察企业智能化生产线、文旅融合、防洪设施和乡村振兴等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 15-16, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, inspected Dandong, reviewing smart production lines, culture-tourism integration, flood-control facilities and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁赴永泰县调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Inspects Yongtai County on Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Around the Public
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁赴永泰县调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治，检查校园食品安全、农村集体“三资”管理和高标准农田建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Guo Ningning, deputy party secretary of Fujian and party secretary of Fuzhou, inspected Yongtai County to oversee the rectification of misconduct and corruption affecting the public, checking school food safety, rural collective asset management and high-standard farmland.

articles.title_zh: 中共淮安市委举行“季季谈”活动
articles.title_en: CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee Holds "Quarterly Discussion" Event
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，中共淮安市委举行“季季谈”活动，就市第九次党代会报告征求意见稿向各民主党派、工商联和无党派人士代表征求意见，市委副书记、市长顾坤主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, the CPC Huai'an Municipal Committee held a "Quarterly Discussion" event to solicit views from democratic parties, the federation of industry and commerce and non-party figures on the draft report for the city's ninth Party congress; Mayor Gu Kun presided.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡赴安徽高等研究院淮北分院和淮北师范大学调研
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Visits Huaibei Branch of Anhui Advanced Research Institute and Huaibei Normal University
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡赴安徽高等研究院淮北分院和淮北师范大学调研，强调深化校企、校地合作，推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 17, Huang Wei, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Huaibei, visited the Huaibei branch of the Anhui Advanced Research Institute and Huaibei Normal University, calling for deeper university-enterprise and university-local cooperation to integrate technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在安徽高等研究院淮北分院和淮北师范大学调研时强调深化校地协同 赋能转型发展
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Urges Deeper University-Local Coordination to Boost Transformation on Visit to Anhui Advanced Research Institute Huaibei Branch and Huaibei Normal University
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡赴安徽高等研究院淮北分院和淮北师范大学调研，强调深化校地协同，推动科技创新与产业创新融合。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Huaibei acting mayor Huang Wei visited the Anhui Advanced Research Institute's Huaibei branch and Huaibei Normal University, urging deeper university-local collaboration and tech-industry integration.
