articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会开展《黄石市养犬管理条例》执法检查
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Enforcement Inspection of Huangshi Dog Management Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，黄石市人大常委会主任俞远汉带队开展《黄石市养犬管理条例》执法检查，赴社区、犬只留检所等地了解犬只免疫、登记及违规养犬查处情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Huangshi People's Congress Standing Committee Director Yu Yuanhan led an inspection of enforcement of the city's dog management regulations, visiting communities and dog shelters.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保到普宁市调研“潮侨聚故里”百千万寻根行精品线路打造情况
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects Puning on the "Overseas Chinese Returning Home" Root-Seeking Route Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保到普宁市调研“潮侨聚故里”百千万寻根行精品线路打造工作，强调打磨特色线路、提升城乡风貌、做实“一老一小”民生服务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 16, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao inspected Puning on building the "Overseas Chinese Returning Home" root-seeking route, urging better routes, upgraded urban-rural looks and better welfare services.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示 李强出席全国先进制造业大会并讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Key Instructions on Advanced Manufacturing; Li Qiang Attends National Advanced Manufacturing Conference
articles.summary_zh: 全国先进制造业大会9月16日至17日在北京召开，会上传达习近平关于持续做大做强先进制造业的重要指示，国务院总理李强出席会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The National Advanced Manufacturing Conference was held in Beijing on Sept 16-17, where Xi Jinping's instructions on strengthening advanced manufacturing were conveyed and Premier Li Qiang addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保会见泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金一行
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Meets with Chairman Chen Yunjin of the Thai Chaozhou Association
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日上午，揭阳市委书记曾风保会见来访的泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金一行，双方畅叙乡情，并就经贸文化交流与侨胞回乡投资合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 16, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao met with Chen Yunjin, chairman of the Thai Chaozhou Association, to strengthen hometown ties and discuss economic, trade and cultural cooperation as well as overseas Chinese investment in the city.

articles.title_zh: 二届市委常委会第139次会议召开
articles.title_en: Linzhi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds 139th Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，林芝市委书记巴塔主持召开二届市委常委会第139次会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署对外开放、安全生产、民族团结及市党代会筹备等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Linzhi Party Secretary Ba Ta chaired the 139th Standing Committee meeting, studying Xi Jinping's directives and arranging work on opening-up, safety, ethnic unity and Party congress preparations.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市领导赴永定区调研督导防灾减灾救灾和“矿业+”经济发展
articles.title_en: Longyan Mayor Cai Lin Visits Yongding District to Inspect Disaster Relief and 'Mining Plus' Economy
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，龙岩市市长蔡琳赴永定区督导防灾减灾救灾工作，走访洪山镇尚径村受灾群众，并调研推进“矿业+”经济高质量发展，市领导罗剑参加。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Longyan Mayor Cai Lin inspected disaster relief and reconstruction work in Yongding District, visiting flood-hit residents of Hongshan Town, and surveyed progress on the city's 'mining plus' economic development drive.

articles.title_zh: 让新兴技术照亮共同繁荣之路
articles.title_en: Let Emerging Technologies Light the Path to Common Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日至13日，习近平出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，多次强调加强人工智能合作，提出构建开放生态、坚持开源普惠等倡议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12-13, Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting, urging stronger AI cooperation and proposing an open, inclusive AI ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会法工委调研组莅汕开展立法调研
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Legislative Affairs Commission Research Team Visits Shantou for Legislative Research
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，全国人大常委会法工委研究室主任黄海华带队莅汕开展立法调研，听取红色精神文化保护传承地方立法及汕潮揭区域协同立法情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, a research team led by Huang Haihua, head of the Legislative Affairs Commission Research Office of the NPC Standing Committee, visited Shantou to research local legislation on protecting revolutionary heritage and regional coordinated legislation among Shantou, Chaozhou and Jieyang.

tags.name_zh: 全国人大常委会法工委
tags.name_en: Legislative Affairs Commission of the NPC Standing Committee

tags_zh: 全国人大常委会法工委
tags_en: Legislative Affairs Commission of the NPC Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到汕头供电局开展调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Inspects Shantou Power Supply Bureau and Holds Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴汕头供电局调研并召开座谈会，强调扛牢电力安全保供和能源绿色转型责任，以“满格电力”助力汕头建设“数智特区”。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 16, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected the Shantou Power Supply Bureau and held a symposium, urging solid power supply security and green energy transition.

articles.title_zh: 汕头国际纺织城综治中心揭牌启用
articles.title_en: Shantou International Textile City Comprehensive Governance Center Inaugurated
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，汕头国际纺织城综治中心揭牌启用，整合多方政务资源构建一体化联动治理阵地，护航潮阳纺织服装产业集群发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, the comprehensive governance center of Shantou International Textile City was inaugurated, pooling government resources to safeguard the Chaoyang textile and garment industry cluster.

articles.title_zh: 石嘴山市人民政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Shizuishan Municipal People's Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，石嘴山市市长徐龙主持市政府2026年第22次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记回信精神，听取经济运行汇报，部署保增长、安全生产与生态环保等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Mayor Xu Long chaired Shizuishan's 22nd executive meeting in 2026, reviewing economic performance and deploying work on growth, safety and environmental protection.

articles.title_zh: 李国强到新泰市调研重点项目建设和秋收秋种工作
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Inspects Xintai City on Key Projects and Autumn Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强到新泰市调研重点项目建设、秋种秋收和安全生产工作，要求抓实产业提质升级与粮食生产。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Tai'an Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor Li Guoqiang inspected Xintai City, reviewing key projects, autumn planting and harvest, and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 杨洪涛武林中率泰安市党政代表团赴新疆考察调研
articles.title_en: Yang Hongtao and Wu Linzhong Lead Taian Delegation to Xinjiang for Inspection and Pairing Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 9月13日至16日，泰安市委书记杨洪涛、市政协主席武林中率党政代表团赴新疆考察调研，在岳普湖县对接对口支援工作，并见证与特变电工签署合作协议。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 13-16, Taian Party Secretary Yang Hongtao and CPPCC Chairman Wu Linzhong led a delegation to Xinjiang to advance paired assistance in Yuepuhu County and sign cooperation agreements with TBEA.

articles.title_zh: 黄强在长春调研时强调 强力推进项目建设 持续扩大有效投资
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Stresses Strong Push on Project Construction and Expansion of Effective Investment During Changchun Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，吉林省委书记黄强在长春调研，试乘地铁5号线并考察中科生物医药产业创新园等项目，强调扩大有效投资、推进重大项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Jilin Provincial Party Secretary Huang Qiang inspected Changchun, riding Metro Line 5 and visiting the Zhongke biomedical industrial park, stressing expanded effective investment and major project construction.

articles.title_zh: 北京交通大学威海校区办学十周年高质量发展大会举行
articles.title_en: Beijing Jiaotong University Weihai Campus Marks 10th Anniversary at High-Quality Development Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，北京交通大学威海校区办学十周年高质量发展大会举行，威海市政府与北京交通大学签署全面深化校地合作框架协议，并揭牌产业技术创新平台、推进校区二期工程奠基。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the 10th anniversary high-quality development conference of Beijing Jiaotong University's Weihai Campus was held, where the Weihai municipal government and the university signed a framework agreement deepening cooperation, unveiled an industrial technology innovation platform, and broke ground on phase two of the campus.

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见青岛海事法院院长戚军一行
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Meets Delegation from Qingdao Maritime Court Led by President Qi Jun
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，威海市委书记张海波会见青岛海事法院党组书记、院长戚军一行，双方就深化涉外海事司法服务、打造法治化营商环境等合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo met with Qi Jun, Party Secretary and President of the Qingdao Maritime Court, to discuss deepening maritime judicial services and building a law-based business environment.

articles.title_zh: 药明生物商业化高端制造平台项目在锡签约落地
articles.title_en: WuXi Biologics Commercial High-End Manufacturing Platform Project Signed in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，药明生物商业化高端制造平台项目在无锡签约落地，无锡市长蒋锋会见药明生物首席执行官陈智胜并共同见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, WuXi Biologics' commercial high-end manufacturing platform project was signed in Wuxi, with Mayor Jiang Feng meeting CEO Chen Zhisheng and witnessing the signing.

articles.title_zh: 液化空气（中国）投资有限公司高层来锡考察
articles.title_en: Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng Meets Air Liquide (China) Investment Chairman Lu Yuebing
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，无锡市市长蒋锋会见来锡考察的液化空气（中国）投资有限公司董事长路跃兵一行，双方围绕推进项目建设、拓展产业合作深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng met with Lu Yuebing, chairman of Air Liquide (China) Investment, to discuss advancing project construction and expanding industrial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见中国进出口银行党委委员、副行长王康一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Wang Kang, Vice President of the Export-Import Bank of China
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰在西安会见中国进出口银行党委委员、副行长王康一行，双方就深化政银合作、支持西安先进制造业和开放型经济发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Xi'an party secretary Hao Huijie met Wang Kang, vice president of the Export-Import Bank of China, on deepening government-bank cooperation in advanced manufacturing and opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见秦商总会会长崔荣华一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Qin Chamber of Commerce President Cui Ronghua and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见秦商总会会长崔荣华一行，欢迎来陕参加“投资中国·选择陕西”产贸融通对接活动的企业家，并就扩大投资合作、优化营商环境等交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met with Qin Chamber of Commerce president Cui Ronghua and a business delegation, welcoming entrepreneurs attending the "Invest in China, Choose Shaanxi" matchmaking event and discussing expanded investment cooperation and a better business environment.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平开展“信访接待日”活动
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Holds Public Petitions Reception Day in Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，盐城市委书记严汉平在市信访局接待来访群众，倾听房屋维修、房产证办理、医保补缴等诉求，要求属地和职能部门依法解决群众合理诉求。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping met petitioners at the city letters-and-visits bureau, hearing housing, property-certificate and medical-insurance grievances and urging timely resolution.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市委常委会召开会议 研究市第九次党代会有关事项
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Ninth Party Congress Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，盐城市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要指示重要文章精神，研究市第九次党代会有关事项，决定市委八届十四次全会于9月18日在盐城召开，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the Standing Committee of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee met to study recent instructions from Xi Jinping and prepare for the city's Ninth Party Congress, deciding that the 14th Plenary Session of the 8th Municipal Party Committee will convene in Yancheng on September 18. Party Secretary Yan Hanping chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会开展人民防空建设情况专题调研
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Special Investigation into Civil Air Defense Construction
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日至16日，阳江市人大常委会副主任黄秀军率调研组开展人民防空建设情况专题调研，实地察看人防工程并听取汇报，提出整改意见。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 15 to 16, Huang Xiujun, deputy director of the Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, led a research team on a special investigation into civil air defense construction, inspecting projects and hearing reports.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 更好统筹高质量发展和高水平安全 系统推进“六张网”基础设施体系建设 赵旭辉主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Coordinating High-Quality Development with High-Level Security and Advancing the "Six Networks" Infrastructure System
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，银川市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示重要贺信精神和中央有关文件精神，听取全市“六张网”规划建设情况汇报，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the Standing Committee of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee met to study recent speeches and instructions of Xi Jinping and related central documents, and to review the city's planning and construction of the "Six Networks" infrastructure system. Zhao Xuhui, Party Secretary of Yinchuan, chaired the meeting and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 2026湖南（岳阳）石化・纺织产业耦合发展推进活动举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Hunan (Yueyang) Petrochemical-Textile Industry Coupling Promotion Event Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，2026湖南（岳阳）石化・纺织产业耦合发展推进活动举行，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江出席并讲话，活动还举行了项目签约仪式。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, the 2026 Hunan (Yueyang) petrochemical-textile industry coupling promotion event was held. Yueyang Party Secretary Xie Weijiang addressed it, and project agreements were signed.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组举办国防教育专题报告会
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Study Group Holds Special Report on National Defense Education
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日下午，云浮市委理论学习中心组举办国防教育专题报告会，邀请国防教育专家徐小林作辅导报告，市委书记卢荣春等出席。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 16, the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee's theoretical study group held a national defense education report by expert Xu Xiaolin, attended by Party Secretary Lu Rongchun.

articles.title_zh: “南粤大地写论文”广东省哲社雷州市县域发展调查团中期汇报会召开
articles.title_en: Mid-Term Report Meeting Held for Guangdong Social Sciences Research Team on Leizhou County Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，广东省哲社雷州市县域发展调查团中期汇报会在雷州召开，听取阶段性成果汇报并研讨调研成果转化，为雷州县域经济发展提供智力支撑。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Guangdong's social sciences research team on Leizhou county development held a mid-term report meeting in Leizhou, reviewing findings and discussing their application to local economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市委工作会议召开，专题研究招商引资工作
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee Meeting Focuses on Investment Attraction
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日上午，湛江市委工作会议召开，专题研究招商引资工作，市委书记余钢主持会议并讲话，市长李勇毅出席并部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 16, the CPC Zhanjiang Municipal Committee held a work meeting on investment attraction, chaired by Party Secretary Yu Gang with Mayor Li Yongyi attending and outlining tasks.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市政府常务会议研究基层消防与高层建筑消防安全工作
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal Government Executive Meeting Studies Grassroots and High-Rise Fire Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日上午，湛江市市长李勇毅主持召开十五届市政府第135次常务会议，传达学习国务院办公厅及广东省关于加强基层消防和高层建筑消防安全管理的文件精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 15, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired the 135th executive meeting of the 15th municipal government, conveying and studying State Council and Guangdong provincial documents on grassroots and high-rise building fire safety and discussing implementation measures.

tags.name_en: General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 罗红霞夜访龙塘木棉村现场协调处置邻里宅基地权属纠纷
articles.title_en: County Party Secretary Luo Hongxia Makes Night Visit to Longtang Mumian Village to Mediate Neighbors' Homestead Dispute
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日晚，湛江市徐闻县委书记罗红霞率队赴龙塘镇木棉村下沉接访，现场督办调解村民宅基地权属纠纷，要求依法依规、公平公正推动矛盾就地化解。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 15, Luo Hongxia, county party secretary, led a team to Mumian Village in Longtang Town to hold an on-site mediation session over a homestead land ownership dispute between villagers, urging lawful and fair resolution of the conflict at the grassroots level.

articles.title_zh: 周口市人大常委会召开党组（扩大）会议暨第五十八次主任会议
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting and 58th Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日上午，周口市五届人大常委会召开党组（扩大）会议暨第五十八次主任会议，主任郭力铭主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，并部署安全生产专项调研、人大换届选举等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 16, the Standing Committee of the 5th Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress held a Party group (enlarged) meeting and its 58th director meeting, chaired by Guo Liming, to study instructions on workplace safety and arrange safety inspections and election preparations.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国文化科技卫生“三下乡”河南集中示范活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National 'Three to the Countryside' Culture, Science and Health Demonstration Activity Launches in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，2026年全国文化科技卫生“三下乡”河南集中示范活动在周口市扶沟县启动，全国妇联党组书记黄晓薇出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, the 2026 national 'Three to the Countryside' culture, science and health demonstration activity was launched in Fugou County, Zhoukou, Henan, with All-China Women's Federation leader Huang Xiaowei attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国文化科技卫生“三下乡”河南集中示范活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Culture, Science, Technology and Health "Three Rural Services" Demonstration Event Launched in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，2026年全国文化科技卫生“三下乡”河南集中示范活动在周口市扶沟县启动，全国妇联党组书记黄晓薇出席启动仪式并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, 2026, the national "Three Rural Services" culture, science, technology and health demonstration event was launched in Fugou County, Zhoukou, Henan; Huang Xiaowei of the All-China Women's Federation spoke.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇会见新疆生产建设兵团第三师四十八团代表团
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Meets Delegation from 48th Regiment of XPCC Third Division
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日下午，珠海市委书记陈勇在珠海会见新疆生产建设兵团第三师四十八团党委书记、政委龙义兵率领的代表团，双方就对口援疆与产业援疆等合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 16, Chen Yong, Party Secretary of Zhuhai, met in Zhuhai with a delegation led by Long Yibing, Party Secretary and Political Commissar of the 48th Regiment of the Third Division of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, to discuss pairing assistance to Xinjiang and industrial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐带队赴长三角开展招商引资对接活动
articles.title_en: Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong Leads Delegation on Yangtze River Delta Investment Promotion Tour
articles.summary_zh: 近日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐带队赴上海市及江苏无锡、苏州开展招商引资，推介珠海产业基础与营商环境，推动优质项目落地增资扩产。
articles.summary_en: Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong recently led a delegation to Shanghai, Wuxi and Suzhou to court investment, pitching Zhuhai's industrial base and business environment and seeking quality projects.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁赴永泰县调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Inspects Yongtai County on Rectifying Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁赴永泰县调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治，检查校园食品安全、农村集体“三资”管理与高标准农田建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning inspected Yongtai County on the campaign against misconduct and corruption around the people, checking school food safety and rural collective asset management.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记回信激励广大公安干警奋发有为再立新功
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Reply Letter Inspires Police Officers to Serve the Public and Safeguard Stability
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月15日报道，习近平总书记近日给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信，予以勉励并提出殷切期望，广大公安干警表示将深入学习回信精神，为基层社会治理现代化贡献力量。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 15 that Xi Jinping recently sent a reply letter to the "Zhangzhou 110" police team in Fujian, encouraging them and urging police nationwide to serve the people and modernize grassroots social governance.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：持续做大做强先进制造业
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Continue to Strengthen and Expand Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记习近平近日就发展先进制造业作出重要指示，指出党的十八大以来我国先进制造业不断壮大，制造强国建设迈出坚实步伐。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, saying China's advanced manufacturing sector has kept growing and the building of a manufacturing powerhouse has made solid progress since the 18th Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 学习进行时丨让新兴技术照亮共同繁荣之路
articles.title_en: Learning in Progress: Let Emerging Technologies Light the Path to Shared Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日至13日，习近平主席出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤并发表重要讲话，多次谈及人工智能，提出加强合作、构建开放生态、坚持开源普惠。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12-13, President Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit and delivered speeches, repeatedly highlighting AI cooperation, an open ecosystem and open-source inclusiveness.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研产业发展时强调 加快产业高质量发展 推动经济运行稳中向好
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Industrial Development, Urges Faster High-Quality Industrial Growth
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田深入集成电路、人工智能、航空航天暨低空经济、新能源装备等企业一线调研，强调精准服务企业、完善产业配套体系、加快产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian inspected firms in integrated circuits, AI, aerospace and low-altitude economy, and new energy equipment, urging targeted services for enterprises and faster high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 刘强到市生态环境局调研强调：扎实推进美丽济南建设，以高品质生态环境支撑高质量发展
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Inspects Jinan Ecological Environment Bureau, Pledges to Advance 'Beautiful Jinan' Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，济南市委书记刘强到市生态环境局调研，察看生态环境执法装备与空气质量预报工作并召开座谈会，强调协同推进降碳、减污、扩绿、增长。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang inspected the Jinan Ecological Environment Bureau, reviewing enforcement equipment and air-quality forecasting, and urged coordinated progress on carbon reduction, pollution control, greening and growth.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅印发《关于进一步加强烟花爆竹全链条安全监管的意见》
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Guidelines on Strengthening Full-Chain Safety Supervision of Fireworks and Firecrackers
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅日前印发《关于进一步加强烟花爆竹全链条安全监管的意见》，对生产、储存、经营、运输、燃放等环节提出全链条安全监管措施，压实各方责任。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council General Office issued a guideline to tighten full-chain safety supervision of fireworks and firecrackers, covering production, storage, sales, transport and discharge while assigning clear responsibilities.

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨以科技之力供给14亿人的餐桌
articles.title_en: Vitality of China Research Tour: Technology Supplies the Dinner Tables of 1.4 Billion People
articles.summary_zh: 湖北嘉鱼县依托蔬菜科技示范园推进甘蓝育种与数字农业，国产越冬甘蓝品种占比超七成，带动7.5万名农民增收。
articles.summary_en: Using a vegetable science park in Jiayu County, Hubei, Chinese breeders have lifted domestic winter cabbage varieties above 70 percent of the core growing area, raising incomes for 75,000 farmers.

articles.title_zh: 江苏警方发布5起涉网犯罪典型案例
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Police Release Five Typical Cases of Cybercrime Crackdown
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，江苏省公安厅发布5起涉网犯罪典型案例，涉及木马盗刷、帮助信息网络犯罪、裸聊敲诈、网络侮辱及侵犯公民个人信息等，多名嫌疑人已被采取刑事强制措施。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Jiangsu's Public Security Department released five typical cybercrime cases, covering Trojan-enabled bank card theft, cyber fraud assistance, sextortion, online defamation and illegal acquisition of personal data, with multiple suspects under criminal coercive measures.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台零碳园区建设实施方案，同步启动省级零碳园区申报
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Implementation Plan for Zero-Carbon Park Construction, Launches Provincial Applications
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省发展改革委、省工业和信息化厅联合印发《江苏省零碳园区建设实施方案》，并同步启动省级零碳园区申报，提出到2030年培育建成10个左右省级零碳园区。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's Provincial Development and Reform Commission and Department of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued an implementation plan for zero-carbon park construction and launched provincial applications, aiming to build about 10 provincial-level zero-carbon parks by 2030.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial Development and Reform Commission

articles.title_zh: 广电总局：电视“套娃”收费治理成效显著，将推广一体化电视等新型终端
articles.title_en: NRTA: TV "Nested" Subscription Fee Governance Achieves Notable Results, Integrated TVs and Other New Terminals to Be Promoted
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国务院新闻办公室举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，国家广播电视总局介绍电视“套娃”收费和操作复杂治理成效，并提出推广一体化电视等新型终端。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, the State Council Information Office held a press conference on the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, where the National Radio and Television Administration reported results in curbing nested TV subscription fees and complex operations, and announced plans to promote integrated TVs and other new terminals.

articles.title_zh: 《太平年》《生命树》带火旅游线路，广电总局：好剧是超级流量入口
articles.title_en: Hit Dramas Drive Tourism Routes, NRTA Says Good Shows Are 'Super Traffic Gateways'
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”主题发布会，国家广电总局电视剧司司长冯胜勇表示，一部好剧就是超级流量入口，《太平年》《生命树》带火了相关旅游线路。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, 2026, Feng Shengyong, head of the NRTA's TV drama department, told a State Council Information Office briefing that a good drama is a 'super traffic gateway,' with hits like Taiping Nian and Tree of Life boosting tourism routes.

articles.title_zh: 打破行业专线壁垒，地方政务热线合并潮持续
articles.title_en: Local Government Service Hotlines Continue Merger Trend, Breaking Industry Line Barriers
articles.summary_zh: 7月17日，甘肃兰州市12333人社服务热线正式并入12345政务服务便民热线，此前那曲、辽宁、宁波等地也已整合各类政务热线，地方政务热线合并潮持续。
articles.summary_en: On July 17, Lanzhou's 12333 human resources hotline was merged into the 12345 government service hotline, following similar consolidations in Nagqu, Liaoning and Ningbo as local governments keep merging service hotlines.

articles.title_zh: 著名医学教育家、原北京医科大学副校长程伯基逝世
articles.title_en: Renowned Medical Educator Cheng Boji, Former Vice President of Beijing Medical University, Dies at 89
articles.summary_zh: 著名医学教育家、原北京医科大学副校长、党委副书记程伯基教授因病于2026年9月14日在北京逝世，享年89岁；他是我国临床医学专业认证体系的主要奠基人。
articles.summary_en: Cheng Boji, a renowned medical educator and former vice president and deputy party secretary of Beijing Medical University, died of illness in Beijing on Sept 14, 2026, aged 89. He was a chief founder of China's clinical medicine accreditation system.

articles.title_zh: 广电总局：将推进广电主流媒体系统性变革和新型媒体建设
articles.title_en: NRTA: China to Advance Systemic Reform of Mainstream Broadcasting Media and Build New-Type Media
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国新办举行新闻发布会，国家广播电视总局副局长刘建国介绍“十五五”时期推动广播电视和网络视听高质量发展情况，表示将推进广电主流媒体系统性变革和新型媒体建设。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on September 17, NRTA Deputy Director Liu Jianguo outlined plans to advance systemic reform of mainstream broadcasting media and build new-type media during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 广电总局：“十五五”期间计划推出100部左右优秀电视剧、网络剧
articles.title_en: NRTA Plans About 100 Outstanding TV and Online Dramas for the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国新办举行新闻发布会，国家广播电视总局电视剧司司长冯胜勇介绍，“十五五”期间计划推出100部左右优秀电视剧、网络剧，并突出“五个抓”。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Sept 17, NRTA drama department chief Feng Shengyong said the administration plans to roll out about 100 outstanding TV and online dramas during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 广电总局：使用AI的广电视听节目必须添加标识，严禁AI魔改
articles.title_en: NRTA: AI-Generated Audiovisual Programs Must Carry Labels, AI Tampering Strictly Prohibited
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”新闻发布会，国家广播电视总局表示将规范人工智能在广电视听领域应用，要求AI生成节目添加标识、成片坚持人工审核，严禁AI魔改。
articles.summary_en: At a September 17 State Council Information Office press conference on the 15th Five-Year Plan, China's National Radio and Television Administration said AI-generated audiovisual programs must carry content labels, key production stages and final cuts must be manually reviewed, and AI tampering is strictly prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 福建省政府党组会议和省政府常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Government Holds Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，福建省省长赵龙主持召开省政府党组会议和省政府常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要回信精神，审议台风灾后恢复重建工作方案，研究高标准农田建设突出问题整治。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Fujian Governor Zhao Long chaired the provincial government's Party group meeting and executive meeting to study Xi Jinping's reply letter, review a post-disaster reconstruction plan for typhoon damage, and push forward rectification of high-standard farmland construction issues.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼赴漳州市古雷经济开发区、台商投资区调研
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi Inspects Gulei Economic Development Zone and Taiwanese Investment Zone in Zhangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日至16日，福建省委书记周祖翼赴漳州古雷经济开发区、台商投资区调研，察看中沙古雷乙烯项目，部署安全生产、灾后恢复重建和侨乡资源利用等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15-16, Fujian Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi inspected the Gulei Economic Development Zone and the Taiwanese Investment Zone in Zhangzhou, reviewing the Saudi-China Gulei ethylene project and directing work on safety, post-typhoon recovery and diaspora resources.

articles.title_zh: 福建印发美丽中国先行区建设实施方案
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues Implementation Plan for Building a Beautiful China Pioneer Zone
articles.summary_zh: 福建省政府近日印发《福建省美丽中国先行区建设实施方案》，提出到2027年生态环境质量持续引领全国、到2030年碳排放总量实现达峰等目标。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial Government has issued an implementation plan to build a Beautiful China pioneer zone, setting goals such as continued national leadership in environmental quality by 2027 and peaking carbon emissions by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 广东省委人大工作会议在广州召开
articles.title_en: Guangdong Provincial Party Committee Holds People's Congress Work Conference in Guangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，广东省委人大工作会议在广州召开，省委书记黄坤明出席讲话，部署打造全过程人民民主省域样板，为广东增创新优势提供制度保障。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee held a People's Congress work conference in Guangzhou, where Party Secretary Huang Kunming spoke on building a provincial model of whole-process people's democracy to provide institutional support for Guangdong's development.

articles.title_zh: 贵州高速集团总经理陈虎：擦亮桥旅融合名片 释放山地交通潜能
articles.title_en: Guizhou Expressway GM Chen Hu: Burnishing the Bridge-Tourism Brand to Unlock Mountain Transport Potential
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，2026年交通产业经济年会暨第八届交通投融资学术年会在贵阳开幕，贵州高速集团总经理陈虎发表主旨演讲，介绍贵州桥梁智慧管养与桥旅融合模式，提出深化多业态融合。
articles.summary_en: On September 17, Chen Hu, general manager of Guizhou Expressway Group, delivered a keynote speech at the 2026 Transport Industry Economic Annual Meeting in Guiyang, outlining Guizhou's smart bridge maintenance and bridge-tourism integration models.

articles.title_zh: 做党和人民的忠诚卫士
articles.title_en: Loyal Guardians of the Party and the People: Xi Jinping's Reply Letter Inspires Police Officers
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平总书记给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信，予以亲切勉励并提出殷切期望。广大公安干警表示将坚守为民初心、担当奉献，做党和人民的忠诚卫士。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently replied to a letter from the "Zhangzhou 110" police team in Fujian, offering encouragement and expectations. Police officers nationwide pledged to stay true to serving the people and to be loyal guardians of the Party and the people.

articles.title_zh: 河南全域推行有奖发票促消费
articles.title_en: Henan Rolls Out Rewarded-Invoice Program Provincewide to Spur Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月16日，河南省商务厅宣布9月至12月在全省推广有奖发票活动，洛阳、三门峡、济源三地已率先启动。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, 2026, Henan's Commerce Department announced a provincewide rewarded-invoice lottery from September to December, following the Zhengzhou and Kaifeng pilot programs.

articles.title_zh: 2026年度“百模赋百景”揭榜挂帅工作启动
articles.title_en: Hebei Launches 2026 "Hundred Models, Hundred Scenarios" Program to Deploy Large Models in Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日至30日，河北省工信厅启动2026年度“百模赋百景”揭榜挂帅工作，面向钢铁、石化等145个制造业细分场景推动工业大模型应用落地。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 15 to 30, Hebei launched its 2026 "Hundred Models, Hundred Scenarios" program, inviting manufacturers to apply industrial AI models across 145 manufacturing scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞赴五指山市指导强降雨灾后恢复工作并看望慰问干部群众
articles.title_en: Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei Inspects Rainstorm Recovery Work in Wuzhishan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月15日晚至16日，海南省委书记冯飞赴受强降雨影响严重的五指山市指导灾后恢复工作，察看电力供水抢修，并慰问安置群众和一线工作人员。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15-16, 2026, Hainan Party Secretary Feng Fei visited rainstorm-hit Wuzhishan to guide post-disaster recovery, inspect power and water repairs, and meet displaced residents and frontline workers.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省2026年“药品安全宣传周”启动仪式在哈尔滨举行
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Launches 2026 Drug Safety Publicity Week in Harbin
articles.summary_zh: 近日，黑龙江省2026年“药品安全宣传周”启动仪式在哈尔滨举行，主题为“药监为民 创新引领”，聚焦药品、医疗器械、化妆品安全科普宣传。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province launched its 2026 Drug Safety Publicity Week in Harbin, themed "Drug Regulation for the People, Innovation-Led," focusing on public education on drugs, medical devices and cosmetics.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江发布2026年中国农民丰收节活动安排
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Releases Arrangements for 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，黑龙江省举行新闻发布会，省农业农村厅副厅长朱华生介绍2026年中国农民丰收节安排，主场活动9月23日在哈尔滨闫家岗农场举行。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 17, Heilongjiang held a press conference where agriculture official Zhu Huasheng outlined plans for the 2026 Chinese Farmers' Harvest Festival, whose main event opens Sept 23 at Yanjiagang Farm in Harbin.

articles.title_zh: 南京开展2026年第二轮汽车购新促消费活动 新能源车最高补贴7000元
articles.title_en: Nanjing Launches Second Round of 2026 Car Purchase Promotion, NEVs Eligible for Up to 7,000 Yuan Subsidy
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，南京市商务局发布公告，启动2026年第二轮汽车购新促消费活动，个人购买5万元以上新能源车最高补贴7000元、燃油车最高补贴6000元，活动持续至12月31日。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, the Nanjing Municipal Commerce Bureau announced the second round of its 2026 car purchase promotion, offering individual buyers subsidies of up to 7,000 yuan for new energy vehicles and 6,000 yuan for fuel vehicles priced above 50,000 yuan, running through Dec 31.

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布新一批公共数据“跑起来”实践案例
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Releases New Batch of Public Data Application Practice Cases
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省数据局近日发布2026年第7批公共数据“跑起来”场景县（市、区）实践案例，迄今江苏已推出13批共99个案例。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu recently released its seventh batch of 2026 county-level practice cases for putting public data to work, bringing the province's total to 99 cases across 13 batches.

articles.title_zh: 陈永奇在瑞金调研强调以农村消费提质扩容助推乡村全面振兴
articles.title_en: Chen Yongqi Stresses Rural Consumption Upgrading to Boost Rural Revitalization During Ruijin Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日至16日，江西省委副书记陈永奇赴瑞金市调研农村消费工作，强调落实以旧换新、家电下乡等政策，畅通农村流通网络，释放农村消费潜力。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 15 to 16, Chen Yongqi, Deputy Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, inspected rural consumption work in Ruijin, urging implementation of trade-in and home-appliance-to-rural policies and smoother rural distribution networks.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳着力为群众打造高品质生活空间
articles.title_en: Shenyang Strives to Build High-Quality Living Spaces for Residents
articles.summary_zh: 沈阳市聚焦“便民、利民、安民”，以“一拆五改三增加”为抓手推进老旧小区改造，问需于民、建管结合，“十五五”时期将改造不少于400个老旧小区。
articles.summary_en: Shenyang is pushing forward old residential community renovation focused on convenience and benefit for residents, with at least 400 communities to be upgraded during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.summary_zh: 9月16日下午，新加坡—天津经济贸易理事会第十二次会议在天津举行，新方主席徐芳达与津方主席张工出席并讲话，双方就绿色低碳、科技创新、开放合作等领域达成深化共识。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 16, the 12th Singapore-Tianjin Economic and Trade Council meeting was held in Tianjin, with co-chairs Chee Hong Tat and Mayor Zhang Gong attending and speaking on deepening cooperation in green development, technology and opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 江西省地质局党组成员、副局长赖晓军接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Geological Bureau Deputy Director Lai Xiaojun Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 据江西省纪委监委9月16日消息，江西省地质局党组成员、副局长赖晓军涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Lai Xiaojun, deputy director and Party member of the Jiangxi Provincial Geological Bureau, is under disciplinary and supervisory investigation for suspected serious violations, the provincial discipline watchdog said on Sept 16.

articles.title_zh: 重庆市政协原秘书长蓝庆华被“双开”
articles.title_en: Former Secretary-General of Chongqing CPPCC Lan Qinghua Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 据重庆市纪委监委9月16日消息，重庆市政协原秘书长蓝庆华因严重违纪违法被开除党籍、开除公职，涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing's discipline watchdog announced on Sept 16 that Lan Qinghua, former secretary-general of the Chongqing CPPCC, was expelled from the Party and dismissed from public office for serious disciplinary and legal violations, with his suspected crimes referred to prosecutors.

articles.title_en: Prosecutors File Bribery Charges Against Hu Chun, Yuan Zhijian, Sun Bin and Liu Jimin
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古、江西、山东检察机关分别对胡春、袁志坚、孙斌、刘纪民涉嫌受贿案提起公诉，四人非法收受财物数额特别巨大。
articles.summary_en: Prosecutors in Inner Mongolia, Jiangxi and Shandong filed bribery charges against four former officials — Hu Chun, Yuan Zhijian, Sun Bin and Liu Jimin — who are accused of accepting huge amounts of illegal payments.

articles.title_zh: 中秋将至 国台办发言人向两岸记者赠花灯
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Spokesperson Gives Mid-Autumn Lanterns to Cross-Strait Reporters
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，国务院台办发言人朱凤莲在北京例行新闻发布会后向两岸记者赠送花灯，称花灯展现两岸同胞同根同源、血脉相连、共祈团圆的期盼。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson Zhu Fenglian gave Mid-Autumn lanterns to reporters from both sides of the strait after a routine press briefing in Beijing, saying the lanterns reflect cross-strait kinship and the shared wish for reunion.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Fujian "Zhangzhou 110" Team Members
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平总书记给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信，肯定他们扎根警务一线、服务群众的付出，希望广大公安干警坚守为民初心，做党和人民的忠诚卫士。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently wrote back to the "Zhangzhou 110" team in Fujian, praising their frontline policing and service to the public, and urging police officers to stay true to serving the people as loyal guardians of the Party and the people.

articles.title_zh: 云南省委常委会召开会议 研究安全生产、生态文明建设、扫黑除恶等工作
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Party Standing Committee Meets on Work Safety, Ecological Progress and Anti-Crime Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，云南省委常委会在昆明召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究安全生产、生态文明建设、深化扫黑除恶专项斗争等工作，省委书记王宁主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, the Standing Committee of the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee met in Kunming, chaired by Party Secretary Wang Ning, to study work safety, ecological civilization construction and the campaign against organized crime.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠调研城市轨道交通建设及市容改造提升工作 坚持为民服务 强化统筹实施 全力打造展示长春形象的亮丽风景线
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Inspects Urban Rail Transit Construction and City Appearance Upgrade in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，长春市委书记张恩惠就城市轨道交通建设和市容改造提升开展调研，实地察看54路有轨电车、地铁5号线站点及南湖春屿片区。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui inspected urban rail transit construction and city appearance upgrades, visiting the No. 54 tram line, Metro Line 5 sites and the Nanhu Chunyu area.

articles.title_zh: 筑牢合作根基 共创美好未来——中国携手金砖国家共绘发展繁荣新画卷
articles.title_en: Consolidating the Foundation of Cooperation, Creating a Better Future: China and BRICS Countries Jointly Chart a New Chapter of Development and Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月15日播发特稿，综述习近平主席13日在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第二阶段会议并发表重要讲话，强调金砖国家要筑牢务实合作根基、推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a feature on Sept 15 reviewing President Xi Jinping's keynote address at the second session of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on Sept 13, where he urged BRICS nations to strengthen practical cooperation and pursue high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 今年前8月全国铁路完成固定资产投资5118亿元
articles.title_en: China's Railway Fixed-Asset Investment Hits 511.8 Billion Yuan in First Eight Months of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 中国国家铁路集团有限公司9月16日介绍，1至8月全国铁路完成固定资产投资5118亿元，同比增长1.5%，一批重点铁路工程取得积极进展。
articles.summary_en: China State Railway Group said on Sept 16 that national railway fixed-asset investment reached 511.8 billion yuan in the first eight months of 2026, up 1.5 percent year on year, with progress on several key projects.

articles.title_zh: 夏粮旺季收购基本结束 全国累计收购小麦1亿吨
articles.title_en: Summer Grain Peak Purchase Season Basically Over; 100 Million Tons of Wheat Purchased Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，国家粮食和物资储备局表示，夏粮旺季收购接近尾声，全国累计收购小麦1亿吨、早籼稻1200万吨，秋粮收购准备工作基本就绪。
articles.summary_en: Sept 16: China's National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration said 100 million tons of wheat and 12 million tons of early rice were purchased in the summer buying peak, with autumn procurement ready.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同伊朗外长阿拉格齐会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同伊朗外长阿拉格齐举行会谈，就中东海湾局势、伊美关系及中伊合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks in Beijing with Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi, discussing the Middle East and Gulf situation, Iran-US relations and China-Iran cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 8月份我国现代服务业发展向好
articles.title_en: China's Modern Services Sector Posts Solid Growth in August
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局数据显示，8月份全国服务业生产指数同比增长4.1%，信息传输、软件和信息技术服务业增长9.6%；1—8月服务零售额同比增长4.9%。
articles.summary_en: NBS data shows China's services production index rose 4.1% year-on-year in August, with information and software services up 9.6%; service retail sales grew 4.9% in Jan-Aug.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥将出席第23届中国—东盟博览会暨中国—东盟商务与投资峰会开幕式
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang to Attend Opening Ceremony of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo and China-ASEAN Business and Investment Summit
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥将于9月17日出席在广西南宁举行的第23届中国—东盟博览会暨中国—东盟商务与投资峰会开幕式并致辞，缅甸、越南、老挝等国领导人及东盟秘书长将出席。
articles.summary_en: Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang, also a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee, will attend and address the opening ceremony of the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo and China-ASEAN Business and Investment Summit in Nanning, Guangxi, on September 17, with leaders from Myanmar, Vietnam, Laos and the ASEAN Secretary-General also attending.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥出席平陆运河通航仪式
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Navigation Ceremony for the Pinglu Canal
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日上午，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在广西钦州出席平陆运河通航仪式，宣布运河通航并考察航道运行与生态保护情况。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 16, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau and Vice Premier, attended the navigation ceremony for the Pinglu Canal in Qinzhou, Guangxi, declaring the canal open and inspecting its operation and ecological protection.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元调研重点项目建设进展情况
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Inspects Progress of Key Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元赴绿色水产品深加工、独立储能、现代农业产业园等多个重点项目现场调研，要求加快建设进度、强化要素保障，推动项目早竣工早投产。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan inspected several key project sites, including a seafood processing plant, an energy storage facility and a modern agriculture park, urging faster construction and stronger resource support for early completion and operation.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开市委理论学习中心组第十次集体学习会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs 10th Collective Study Session of Hegang Municipal Party Committee Study Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开市委理论学习中心组第十次集体学习会议，强调深入学习贯彻习近平法治思想，推进全面依法治市，建设更高水平的平安鹤岗。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu chaired the municipal Party committee's 10th collective study session, urging deeper study of Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and advancing law-based governance in the city.

tags.name_en: Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law

tags_en: Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦调研乡村直播间及乡村产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Inspects Rural Livestreaming Studios and Rural Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦赴杜集区、烈山区调研乡村直播间及乡村产业发展工作，强调深耕直播助农、做强特色产业，激活乡村全面振兴新动能。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi inspected rural livestreaming studios and rural industry development in Duji and Lieshan districts, calling for e-commerce to boost farmers' incomes and specialty industries.

articles.title_zh: 胡劲军到揭阳调研：以文化赋能促进产城深度融合
articles.title_en: Hu Jinjun Visits Jieyang for Research: Cultural Empowerment to Boost Industry-City Integration
articles.summary_zh: 近日，广东省委常委、宣传部部长胡劲军到揭阳调研，走访惠来临港产业园、葵阳书院等地，强调以文化赋能促进产城深度融合。
articles.summary_en: Hu Jinjun, a Guangdong provincial standing committee member and head of the provincial publicity department, recently visited Jieyang, urging culture-driven industry-city integration and growth of the marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市出台促进纺织服装产业焕新升级行动方案
articles.title_en: Jieyang City Issues Action Plan to Renew and Upgrade Textile and Garment Industry
articles.summary_zh: 揭阳市出台《促进纺织服装产业焕新升级行动方案（2026-2030年）》，围绕补链强链、创新驱动、品牌建设、数智赋能和要素保障推出一揽子惠企政策。
articles.summary_en: Jieyang City issued a 2026-2030 action plan to upgrade its textile and garment industry, with measures on supply chains, innovation, branding, digitalization and factor support.

articles.title_zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想与广东实践·“百千万工程”研讨会在揭阳举行
articles.title_en: Seminar on Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era and Guangdong Practice · 'Hundred Thousand Ten Thousand' Project Held in Jieyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，广东省习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想研究中心在揭阳举办“百千万工程”研讨会，围绕城乡区域协调发展交流研讨，市委常委、宣传部部长刘波主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, the Guangdong research center for Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era held a seminar in Jieyang on the "Hundred Thousand Ten Thousand" project and coordinated urban-rural development.

articles.title_zh: 首届“院士西藏行”科普活动启动仪式在拉萨举行
articles.title_en: First Academicians' Tibet Tour Science Popularization Event Launches in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，首届“院士西藏行”科普活动启动仪式在拉萨举行，西藏自治区副主席罗梅出席讲话并宣布启动，多吉、尼玛扎西、汪双杰等中国工程院院士参加。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, the launch ceremony of the first Academicians' Tibet Tour science popularization event was held in Lhasa, where Tibet Vice Chairman Luo Mei spoke and declared it open, joined by Chinese Academy of Engineering academicians.

tags.name_en: Revitalizing the Nation through Science and Education

tags_en: Revitalizing the Nation through Science and Education

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市政协党组（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Longyan CPPCC Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，龙岩市政协党组书记陈金龙主持召开市政协党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示批示精神，并研究贯彻落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Chen Jinlong, Party secretary of the Longyan CPPCC, chaired an expanded Party group meeting to convey Xi Jinping's recent speeches and directives and to study implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 勇做时代先锋 汇聚团结力量——习近平主席赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤纪实
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, India
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日至13日，应印度总理莫迪邀请，习近平主席赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，并宣布中国将于明年接任金砖主席国、主办第十九次会晤。
articles.summary_en: On September 12-13, President Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Modi, and announced that China will take over the BRICS chairmanship and host the 19th summit next year.

articles.title_zh: 陈涛出席汕头市2026年下半年新兵欢送大会
articles.title_en: Chen Tao Attends Shantou's 2026 Second-Half New Recruit Send-Off Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日上午，汕头市在人民广场举行2026年下半年新兵欢送大会，市委副书记、市长陈涛出席并讲话，勉励新兵听党指挥、苦练本领、建功军营。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 15, Shantou held its 2026 second-half new recruit send-off ceremony at People's Square, where Mayor Chen Tao spoke and urged the recruits to follow the Party and hone their skills.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群会见泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金一行
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Meets Chen Yunjin, Chairman of the Thai Teochew Association
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群在市委迎宾厅会见泰国潮州会馆主席陈运金一行，双方就深化汕泰经贸人文融合、做好新时代“侨”的文章深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 15, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn met Chen Yunjin, chairman of the Thai Teochew Association, to discuss deeper Shantou-Thailand trade and cultural ties and overseas Chinese work.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰带队拜访省体育局、省残联 全力做好省运会和省残运会筹备工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Provincial Sports Bureau and Disabled Persons' Federation on Games Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，汕尾市委书记逯峰带队拜访广东省体育局、省残联，围绕省运会和省残运会筹备工作沟通对接。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng led a delegation to the Guangdong Provincial Sports Bureau and the Provincial Disabled Persons' Federation to coordinate preparations for the Provincial Games and Provincial Para Games.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰带队拜访省发展改革委 对接推进稳增长、促投资和重点项目建设
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Provincial Development and Reform Commission on Growth, Investment and Key Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日下午，汕尾市委书记逯峰带队拜访广东省发展改革委，与主任龚桢梽座谈，围绕“十五五”重大项目、稳增长促投资等争取指导支持。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 15, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng led a delegation to the Guangdong Provincial Development and Reform Commission for talks with director Gong Zhenzhi, seeking support on growth, investment and key projects under the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰带队拜访省财政厅 深化财政体制改革 服务推动高质量发展
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Provincial Finance Department to Deepen Fiscal Reform and Boost High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日下午，汕尾市委书记逯峰带队拜访广东省财政厅，与厅党组书记、厅长陈国煌座谈，就深化财政体制改革、争取债券资金和重点项目资金支持等深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 15, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng led a delegation to the Guangdong Provincial Finance Department for talks with its Party secretary and director Chen Guohuang on deepening fiscal reform and securing bond and key-project funding support.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 逯峰带队拜访省体育局、省残联 全力做好省运会和省残运会筹备工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Provincial Sports Bureau and Disabled Persons' Federation to Advance Games Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，汕尾市委书记逯峰带队拜访广东省体育局、省残联，围绕省运会和省残运会筹备工作加强沟通对接。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng led a delegation to visit Guangdong's provincial sports bureau and disabled persons' federation to coordinate preparations for the provincial games and provincial para games.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会会议暨党委金融委员会会议召开 李邑飞主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Chairs Ningxia Party Committee Standing Committee and Financial Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，宁夏自治区党委常委会会议暨党委金融委员会第七次会议召开，自治区党委书记李邑飞主持并讲话，审议《宁夏金融业发展“十五五”规划》。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the Ningxia Party Committee Standing Committee and the seventh meeting of its Financial Committee convened, chaired by regional Party Secretary Li Yifei, reviewing the region's 15th Five-Year Plan for the financial industry.

articles.title_zh: 杨青龙会见宁夏银行董事长吴琼、行长倪国梁一行
articles.title_en: Yang Qinglong Meets with Ningxia Bank Chairman Wu Qiong and President Ni Guoliang
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，石嘴山市委书记杨青龙会见宁夏银行党委书记、董事长吴琼和行长倪国梁一行，双方围绕深化政银企合作、加大信贷投放支持地方经济发展进行座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, Shizuishan Party Secretary Yang Qinglong met with Ningxia Bank Chairman Wu Qiong and President Ni Guoliang to discuss deepening government-bank-enterprise cooperation and increasing credit support for local economic development.

tags.name_en: Financial Services for the Real Economy

tags_en: Financial Services for the Real Economy

articles.title_zh: 李国强到汶河新区调研
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Inspects Wenhe New Area
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日下午，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强到汶河新区调研，强调加快重点项目建设、推动产城文旅深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 15, Li Guoqiang, Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Tai'an, inspected the Wenhe New Area, urging faster progress on key projects and deeper integration of industry, urban development, culture and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 省委举行学习报告会 信长星主持 刘小涛出席
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Holds Study Session on Cultural Heritage, Chaired by Xin Changxing with Liu Xiaotao Attending
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，江苏省委举行学习报告会，深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想及关于文化遗产保护传承的重要论述，省委书记信长星主持，省长刘小涛出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a study session on Xi Jinping's cultural thought and heritage protection, chaired by Party Secretary Xin Changxing with Governor Liu Xiaotao attending.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝吉林大学建校80周年大会在长春举行 黄强宣读习近平总书记贺信并致辞
articles.title_en: Jilin University Marks 80th Anniversary in Changchun; Huang Qiang Reads Xi Jinping's Congratulatory Letter
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，庆祝吉林大学建校80周年大会在长春举行，吉林省委书记、省人大常委会主任黄强宣读习近平总书记贺信并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, a ceremony marking the 80th anniversary of Jilin University was held in Changchun, where Jilin Party Secretary Huang Qiang read Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Chairs Weihai Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，威海市市长孔凡萍主持召开市政府第75次常务会议，研究公共机构节能降碳、群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治，并集体学习《行政执法监督条例》。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping chaired the 75th executive meeting of the municipal government, discussing public-sector carbon reduction, rectification of corruption and misconduct, and the study of administrative law enforcement oversight rules.

articles.title_zh: 芜湖市人大常委会召开第七十次主任会议
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 70th Council of Chairpersons Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，芜湖市人大常委会主任张峰主持第七十次主任会议，听取人事任免报告并讨论智能网联汽车、生活垃圾分类等条例草案，决定9月18日举行常委会第三十九次会议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Director Zhang Feng chaired the 70th Council of Chairpersons meeting, hearing personnel appointment reports and reviewing draft regulations on intelligent connected vehicles and waste sorting, and set the 39th standing committee session for Sept 18.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会召开会议研究安全生产和服务业扩能提质等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on Work Safety and Service Industry Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，西安市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，研究部署安全生产、学校思想政治教育和服务业扩能提质等工作，蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, the Standing Committee of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee met to implement Xi Jinping's directives, focusing on work safety, school ideological education and upgrading the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 西安市委理论学习中心组学习会议：深学笃行习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Group Meeting: Deepening Study of Xi Jinping's Important Expositions on Grassroots Work Methods
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，西安市委理论学习中心组举行会议，学习《习近平关于基层工作方法论述摘编》及习近平总书记在榆林、宝鸡考察时的重要讲话重要指示，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Group held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's expositions on grassroots work methods and his remarks during inspections in Yulin and Baoji; Hao Huijie, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and Party Secretary of Xi'an, presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 王笃波到部分驻新高校调研
articles.title_en: Wang Dubo Inspects Universities Based in Xinxiang
articles.summary_zh: 新乡市委副书记、政法委书记王笃波带领市教育局负责同志到河南师范大学、河南工学院等驻新高校调研校园安全、高校党建和思政教育工作，并就校地合作提出要求。
articles.summary_en: Wang Dubo, deputy secretary of the Xinxiang Municipal Party Committee, led an inspection of universities based in Xinxiang, including Henan Normal University and Henan Institute of Technology, focusing on campus safety, Party building and ideological education, and urging deeper university-local government cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 襄城县工商业联合会（总商会）第十三次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: Xiangcheng County Federation of Industry and Commerce (General Chamber of Commerce) Holds 13th Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，襄城县工商联（总商会）第十三次代表大会召开，县委书记范耀江讲话，县长张国平主持，李琼鹤当选县工商联主席、总商会会长。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, the 13th Congress of the Xiangcheng County Federation of Industry and Commerce (General Chamber of Commerce) opened; County Party Secretary Fan Yaojiang addressed it, County Mayor Zhang Guoping presided, and Li Qionghe was elected chair.

tags.name_en: Federation of Industry and Commerce Leadership Transition

tags_en: Federation of Industry and Commerce Leadership Transition

articles.title_zh: 襄城县：范耀江到王洛镇调研
articles.title_en: Xiangcheng County Party Secretary Fan Yaojiang Inspects Wangluo Town
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，河南省襄城县委书记范耀江到王洛镇开展经济发展与基层治理专题调研，强调做强特色产业、做实基层治理、增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Fan Yaojiang, Party Secretary of Xiangcheng County, Henan, inspected Wangluo Town on economic development and grassroots governance, urging stronger specialty industries and better public services.

articles.title_zh: 陶少华主持召开银川市第十六届人民政府第119次常务会议
articles.title_en: Tao Shaohua Chairs 119th Executive Meeting of Yinchuan Municipal People's Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，银川市市长陶少华主持召开市政府第119次常务会议，部署安全生产隐患排查、冲刺全年经济目标和生态环境保护督察整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Yinchuan Mayor Tao Shaohua chaired the municipal government's 119th executive meeting, urging safety hazard checks, efforts to hit annual economic targets and ecological inspection rectification.

articles.title_zh: 张雨浦在银川检查督办推进民生实事等工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Yupu Inspects Progress on Public Livelihood Programs in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，宁夏回族自治区主席张雨浦在银川市检查督办民生实事推进情况，察看全民健身设施、医疗保障、保障性住房和普惠托育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu inspected livelihood programs in Yinchuan, reviewing fitness facilities, medical insurance services, subsidized housing and affordable childcare.

tags.name_en: Equal Access to Basic Public Services

tags_en: Equal Access to Basic Public Services

articles.title_zh: 梁振英率港区全国政协委员考察团在宁夏考察
articles.title_en: Leung Chun-ying Leads Hong Kong CPPCC National Committee Members' Delegation to Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日至11日，全国政协副主席梁振英率港区全国政协委员考察团在宁夏考察，围绕宁港合作开展重点提案督办，李邑飞、崔玉英、陈雍等参加相关活动。
articles.summary_en: From September 7 to 11, CPPCC National Committee Vice Chairman Leung Chun-ying led a delegation of Hong Kong members of the CPPCC National Committee on an inspection tour in Ningxia, focused on deepening Ningxia-Hong Kong cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研督导银川市人大重点工作开展情况
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Key Work of Yinchuan Municipal People's Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，宁夏回族自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研督导市人大重点工作，督办人工智能先导区建议办理，并检查相关法规实施情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui inspected key work of the municipal People's Congress, including AI pilot zone proposals and enforcement of local regulations.

articles.title_zh: 闽宁协作暨东西部协作理论与实践研讨会在银川举行 李书磊出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Li Shulei Attends Symposium on Fujian-Ningxia and East-West Collaboration in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，闽宁协作暨东西部协作理论与实践研讨会在宁夏银川举行，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并致辞。研讨会由中宣部、中央农办、农业农村部及宁夏、福建党委联合举办。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, a symposium on Fujian-Ningxia and East-West collaboration was held in Yinchuan, Ningxia, with Li Shulei, Politburo member and head of the Publicity Department, attending and delivering remarks. The event was co-hosted by the Central Publicity Department, the Central Rural Work Office, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, and the Ningxia and Fujian party committees.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏自治区党委常委会会议暨党委金融委员会会议召开
articles.title_en: Ningxia Party Standing Committee and Party Financial Committee Hold Joint Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，宁夏自治区党委常委会会议暨党委金融委员会第七次会议召开，李邑飞主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示精神，审议《宁夏金融业发展“十五五”规划》。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the Standing Committee of the Ningxia Party Committee and the seventh meeting of the Party Financial Committee were held, chaired by Li Yifei, reviewing the 15th Five-Year Plan for Ningxia's financial sector and conveying Xi Jinping's recent remarks.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开座谈会 向老同志征求市第九次党代会报告意见
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Symposium to Seek Veteran Cadres' Views on Yueyang's Ninth Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持座谈会，听取退休老同志对市第九次党代会报告的意见建议，代理市长唐浩然出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Xie Weijiang, deputy provincial party secretary and Yueyang party chief, chaired a symposium in Yueyang to gather retired officials' opinions on the draft report for the city's ninth party congress; acting mayor Tang Haoran attended.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市九届人大常委会举行第四十一次会议
articles.title_en: Yueyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 41st Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，岳阳市九届人大常委会举行第四十一次会议，听取审议国防动员法等执法检查报告，审议城市二次供水管理条例议案，评议多个部门工作并表决通过人事事项。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Yueyang's municipal people's congress standing committee held its 41st meeting, reviewing law enforcement inspection reports, a water supply regulation, and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平关于青岛一货轮火灾事故的重要指示精神，并研究第四届岳阳市旅游发展大会筹备工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Yueyang Party Secretary Xie Weijiang chaired a standing committee meeting on Xi Jinping's instructions over a cargo ship fire in Qingdao and on hosting the city's 4th tourism conference.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市与北京师范大学召开校地合作座谈会 携手推动广东基础教育均衡优质发展
articles.title_en: Yunfu City and Beijing Normal University Hold School-Local Cooperation Symposium to Advance Balanced, High-Quality Basic Education in Guangdong
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，云浮市与北京师范大学召开校地合作座谈会，双方围绕深化校地合作、办好北师大云浮实验学校、推动广东基础教育均衡优质发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Yunfu City and Beijing Normal University held a school-local cooperation symposium, discussing deeper collaboration, the BNU Yunfu Experimental School, and balanced, high-quality basic education in Guangdong.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市委召开常委会会议 研究做好侨务和经济工作 卢荣春主持会议
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting on Overseas Chinese Affairs and Economic Work, Chaired by Lu Rongchun
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日上午，云浮市委书记卢荣春主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记对侨务工作的重要指示精神，研究部署全市侨务和经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 10, Yunfu Party Secretary Lu Rongchun chaired a Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on overseas Chinese affairs and to plan the city's overseas Chinese and economic work.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新主持召开市政府党组会议 研究巩固拓展学习教育成果、持续深化廉洁政府建设等工作
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting on Consolidating Learning Outcomes and Deepening Clean Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，云浮市市长李庆新主持召开市政府党组会议，研究巩固拓展学习教育成果、持续深化廉洁政府建设及政府系统党风廉政建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Yunfu Mayor Li Qingxin chaired a municipal government Party group meeting on consolidating learning outcomes, deepening clean government and improving Party conduct and integrity in the government system.

articles.title_zh: 张洋主持召开遂溪县委常委会（扩大）会议 部署安全生产、生态环保及群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Yang Chairs Expanded Standing Committee Meeting of Suixi County Party Committee on Workplace Safety, Ecological Protection and Anti-Corruption Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日下午，遂溪县委书记张洋主持召开县委十四届第174次常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，部署安全生产、生态环保及群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 14, Zhang Yang, Party Secretary of Suixi County, chaired the 174th expanded standing committee meeting of the county Party committee, conveying Xi Jinping's recent instructions and deploying work on workplace safety, ecological protection and rectification of corruption and misconduct affecting the public.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市政府党组召开2026年第12次（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal Government Party Group Holds 12th (Expanded) Meeting of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，湛江市长李勇毅主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于树立和践行正确政绩观的重要指示精神，部署下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired the municipal government Party group's 12th expanded meeting of 2026, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions on a correct view of political achievements and arranging follow-up work.

articles.title_zh: 国家网信办发布近期网络安全、数据安全、个人信息保护等领域执法典型案例
articles.title_en: Cyberspace Administration of China Releases Typical Enforcement Cases on Cybersecurity, Data Security and Personal Information Protection
articles.summary_zh: 国家网信办通报近期网络安全、数据安全、个人信息保护领域十起执法典型案例，涉网页篡改、恶意程序、数据泄露、违规收集人脸信息等，相关企业被责令改正并处罚款。
articles.summary_en: China's Cyberspace Administration released ten typical enforcement cases in cybersecurity, data security and personal information protection, involving website tampering, malware, data leaks and illegal facial-information collection; the companies were ordered to rectify and fined.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能安全治理，再升级！
articles.title_en: AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0 Released, Upgrading Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，《人工智能安全治理框架3.0》发布，梳理更新人工智能安全风险分类，并就技术应对和综合治理措施提出建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0 was released, updating AI risk classifications and proposing technical and governance measures.

articles.title_zh: 推动金砖国家合作增效 赋能全球南方共同发展——国际社会高度评价习近平主席南亚之行
articles.title_en: International Community Hails Xi Jinping's South Asia Trip for Advancing BRICS Cooperation and Global South Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月14日报道，国际社会高度评价习近平主席南亚之行，认为此行为金砖合作明确使命方向，为壮大全球南方力量贡献中国智慧，并为中印关系行稳致远领航定向。
articles.summary_en: In a Sept 14 report, Xinhua said the international community praised Xi Jinping's South Asia trip for setting BRICS cooperation's mission, boosting the Global South and charting the course for China-India ties.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给福建“漳州110”全体队员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Fujian "Zhangzhou 110" Police Team
articles.summary_zh: 近日，习近平总书记给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信，肯定他们扎根警务一线、服务群众护民安宁，寄语广大公安干警做党和人民的忠诚卫士。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently replied to a letter from the "Zhangzhou 110" police team in Fujian, praising their frontline service to the people and urging officers to be loyal guardians of the Party and the people.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年 强调传承红色基因发挥综合优势
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on Jilin University's 80th Anniversary, Urging Inheritance of 'Red Gene' and Comprehensive Strengths
articles.summary_zh: 在吉林大学建校80周年之际，习近平总书记致信祝贺，寄语学校立足新起点，传承红色基因、发挥综合优势，聚焦国家战略需求，培养更多高素质人才。
articles.summary_en: On the 80th anniversary of Jilin University, Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter urging the school to carry on its "red gene," leverage its comprehensive strengths, focus on national strategic needs and train more high-quality talent.

articles.title_zh: 文献里的党史密码：敢于斗争、敢于胜利
articles.title_en: Party History in Documents: Dare to Struggle, Dare to Win
articles.summary_zh: 新华网《理响中国》栏目推出第五期《文献里的党史密码》，中国人民大学杨凤城阐释中国共产党敢于斗争、敢于胜利的精神特质与新时代伟大斗争实践。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua's "Reasoning China" series released its fifth episode on Party history documents, with scholar Yang Fengcheng explaining the CPC's spirit of daring to struggle and to win, and its practice in the new era.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界制造业大会智能交通创新技术成果发布暨场景对接会在合肥举行
articles.title_en: Intelligent Transportation Innovation Results Release and Scenario Matchmaking Event of 2026 World Manufacturing Convention Held in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，2026世界制造业大会专项活动——智能交通创新技术成果发布暨场景对接会在合肥举行，现场发布长三角智能交通创新成果并开展项目路演与投资推介。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, a special event of the 2026 World Manufacturing Convention on intelligent transportation innovation results and scenario matchmaking was held in Hefei, releasing Yangtze River Delta innovation achievements and holding project roadshows and investment promotions.

articles.title_zh: 六次重大改革，只为“再快一秒”
articles.title_en: Zhangzhou 110 Police Marks Six Major Reforms in Pursuit of 'One Second Faster'
articles.summary_zh: 福建漳州110支队建队36年历经六次重大警务改革，以“再快一秒”为目标推进智慧巡防，今年上半年接处警3.4万余起，5分钟到场率93.2%。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's Zhangzhou 110 police unit has undergone six major policing reforms over 36 years to respond 'one second faster', handling over 34,000 cases in H1 2026 with a 93.2% five-minute arrival rate.

articles.title_zh: 2026广西国际消费季活动系列安排发布
articles.title_en: Guangxi Releases Arrangements for 2026 International Consumption Season
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，2026广西国际消费季暨汽车出海合作交流活动在南宁举行，自治区商务厅发布涵盖入境、商品、金融、住房等领域的系列促消费安排。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, the 2026 Guangxi International Consumption Season launched in Nanning, with the regional commerce department unveiling measures on inbound, goods, financial and housing consumption.

articles.title_en: China-ASEAN Expo Introduces Chain-Leader-Led "Big Bringing Small" Exhibition Model
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，记者从中国—东盟博览会秘书处获悉，第二十三届东博会创新推出链主企业“以大带小”参展新模式，超3400家企业参展，推动双边经贸合作从“卖单品”向“建生态链”升级。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15 the 23rd China-ASEAN Expo launched a new exhibition model in which chain-leader firms bring upstream and downstream partners, with over 3,400 exhibitors joining.

articles.title_en: Hainan Issues Guidelines to Advance Forest "Four Reservoirs" Development and Green Growth
articles.summary_zh: 海南省政府办公厅近日印发推进森林“四库”建设的实施意见，提出到2030年森林覆盖率超62%等目标，9月16日省新闻办召开新闻发布会介绍相关情况。
articles.summary_en: The Hainan provincial government has issued guidelines on building forest "four reservoirs", targeting over 62% forest coverage by 2030. A press briefing on the plan was held in Haikou on Sept 16.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台12项措施加力支持工业企业技术改造
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues 12 Measures to Boost Technological Upgrading of Industrial Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省政府办公厅近日印发《关于加力支持工业企业技术改造的若干措施》，通过给资金、优服务，支持工业企业增资扩产、技术改造和设备更新。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangsu Provincial Government Office recently issued measures to support technological upgrading of industrial enterprises, offering funding and improved services for capacity expansion, technical transformation and equipment renewal.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘在全省县域经济高质量发展大会上强调 坚定不移走好兴业强县富民之路
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Stresses High-Quality County Economy Development at Jiangxi Provincial Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，江西省县域经济高质量发展大会在修水县召开，省委书记尹弘出席并讲话，强调因地制宜、错位发展，坚定不移走好兴业强县富民之路。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Jiangxi held a provincial conference on high-quality county economy development in Xiushui County, where Party Secretary Yin Hong called for differentiated, cluster-based growth to strengthen the county economy.

articles.title_zh: 闽宁协作暨东西部协作理论与实践研讨会在银川举行
articles.title_en: Li Shulei Attends Seminar on Fujian-Ningxia and East-West Cooperation in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，闽宁协作暨东西部协作理论与实践研讨会在宁夏银川举行，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, a seminar on Fujian-Ningxia and East-West cooperation was held in Yinchuan, Ningxia, with Li Shulei, Politburo member and head of the Publicity Department, attending and delivering remarks.

articles.title_zh: 青铜峡水库启动2026年联合排沙调度运行
articles.title_en: Qingtongxia Reservoir Launches 2026 Joint Sediment-Flushing Operation
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，宁夏青铜峡水库启动2026年联合排沙调度运行，以敞泄排沙集中冲刷库区淤积泥沙，恢复水库调节能力并保障黄河沿线安全。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, 2026, Qingtongxia Reservoir in Ningxia began its joint sediment-flushing operation, releasing water to scour silt, restore reservoir regulation capacity and protect the Yellow River.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏启动第五届“全区个体工商户服务月”活动
articles.title_en: Ningxia Launches 5th Regional Individual Business Service Month
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏回族自治区市场监管厅联合发展改革委、人社厅等13个部门近日启动第五届“全区个体工商户服务月”活动，9月集中开展，主题为“触网赋能，共赢发展”。
articles.summary_en: Ningxia's market regulation department, together with 13 other provincial departments, recently launched the 5th Regional Individual Business Service Month, running through September under the theme "Empowerment via Online Business, Win-Win Development."

articles.title_en: Sichuan Discipline Inspection Commission: Two Officials Under Investigation for Serious Violations
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，四川省纪委监委通报，四川蜀道城乡投资集团副总经理蒲邦彦主动投案，洪雅县人大常委会副主任廖建如被查，二人均涉嫌严重违纪违法。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, the Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced that Pu Bangyan, deputy general manager of Sichuan Shudao Urban-Rural Investment Group, turned himself in, while Liao Jianru, deputy director of the Hongya County People's Congress Standing Committee, is under investigation for serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 新疆出台新一轮棉花目标价格政策实施方案
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Issues Implementation Plan for New Round of Cotton Target Price Policy
articles.summary_zh: 新疆自治区发展改革委联合财政厅印发2026—2028年棉花目标价格政策实施方案，目标价格为每吨18600元，按固定产量510万吨补贴。
articles.summary_en: Xinjiang's development and reform commission and finance department jointly issued a 2026-2028 cotton target price policy plan, setting the target price at 18,600 yuan per tonne with subsidies based on a fixed output of 5.1 million tonnes.

articles.title_zh: 一条大黄鱼扛起海岛共富梦
articles.title_en: A Yellow Croaker Lifts Islanders' Dream of Shared Prosperity
articles.summary_zh: 9月17日，温州大黄鱼产业高质量发展推介会将在北京举办。2025年温州大黄鱼产量2.3万吨、一产产值超19亿元，均居浙江首位，带动海岛渔旅融合与渔民共富。
articles.summary_en: Wenzhou will hold a large yellow croaker industry promotion event in Beijing on Sept 17. In 2025 the city produced 23,000 tonnes worth over 1.9 billion yuan in primary output value, ranking first in Zhejiang and boosting island incomes.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Letter Congratulating Jilin University on Its 80th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平9月16日致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年，希望学校聚焦国家战略需求、培养更多高素质人才，为新时代东北全面振兴和中国式现代化作出更大贡献。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Chinese president and chairman of the Central Military Commission, sent a letter on September 16 congratulating Jilin University on its 80th anniversary, urging it to focus on national strategic needs and cultivate more high-quality talent for the revitalization of Northeast China and Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致吉林大学建校80周年的贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on Jilin University's 80th Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，习近平致信祝贺吉林大学建校80周年，向全体师生员工和广大校友致以祝贺，并希望学校聚焦国家战略需求、培养更多高素质人才。
articles.summary_en: On September 16, Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to Jilin University on its 80th anniversary, urging it to focus on national strategic needs and cultivate more high-quality talent.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军会见巴布亚新几内亚米尔恩湾省省长威斯利一行
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Meets Milne Bay Province Governor Wesley of Papua New Guinea
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，贵州省长李炳军在贵阳会见巴布亚新几内亚米尔恩湾省省长威斯利一行，双方就深化经贸、农业、文旅、基础设施等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun met in Guiyang with Milne Bay Province Governor Wesley of Papua New Guinea to discuss deeper cooperation in trade, agriculture, tourism and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟李炳军会见中国工程院院士专家一行
articles.title_en: Xu Lin and Li Bingjun Meet with CAE Academicians and Experts in Guiyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，贵州省委书记徐麟、省长李炳军在贵阳会见来黔开展绿色能源院士行活动的中国工程院院士专家一行，双方就科技创新、绿色能源与矿产资源开发合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Guizhou Party Secretary Xu Lin and Governor Li Bingjun met in Guiyang with academicians and experts from the Chinese Academy of Engineering during a green energy tour, discussing cooperation on science and technology innovation, green energy and mineral resource development.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军在贵阳市调研旅居产业
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Inspects Residential Tourism Industry in Guiyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，贵州省委副书记、省长李炳军到贵阳市花溪区调研旅居产业，强调聚焦市场需求优化产品服务供给，推动旅居产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun inspected the residential tourism industry in Huaxi District, Guiyang, urging market-driven improvement of products and services to boost high-quality growth of the sector.

articles.title_zh: 省委网络安全和信息化委员会会议召开 刘宁主持并讲话 王凯出席
articles.title_en: Henan Holds Meeting of Provincial Cyberspace Security and Informatization Commission
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委网络安全和信息化委员会会议，省长王凯出席，部署网络安全与网络生态治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Henan Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a meeting of the provincial cyberspace security and informatization commission, with Governor Wang Kai attending, to plan cybersecurity and internet governance work.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府召开第六代移动通信产业高质量发展专题推进会 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government Holds Meeting on High-Quality Development of 6G Industry, Chaired by Liu Xiaotao
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，江苏省政府召开第六代移动通信（6G）产业高质量发展专题推进会，省长刘小涛主持，部署关键核心技术攻坚和场景应用等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Jiangsu's provincial government held a meeting on 6G industry development, chaired by Governor Liu Xiaotao, to plan key technology breakthroughs and application scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语：总书记强调“基础研究必须搞上去”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses That Basic Research Must Be Advanced
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日出版的《求是》杂志第18期刊发习近平总书记重要文章《在加强基础研究座谈会上的讲话》，强调基础研究必须搞上去。
articles.summary_en: The 18th issue of Qiushi Journal, published on September 16, carried Xi Jinping's article from his speech at a symposium on strengthening basic research, stressing that basic research must be pushed forward.

articles.title_zh: 夏粮旺季收购基本结束 全国累计收购小麦1亿吨
articles.title_en: Summer Grain Procurement Peak Season Nears End, 100 Million Tonnes of Wheat Purchased Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日，国家粮食和物资储备局表示夏粮旺季收购接近尾声，全国累计收购小麦1亿吨、早籼稻1200万吨，秋粮收购各项准备已基本就绪。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 16, the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration said the summer grain procurement peak season is ending, with 100 million tonnes of wheat and 12 million tonnes of early rice purchased nationwide, and autumn grain procurement preparations essentially complete.

articles.title_en: China Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Statistical Reform and Development
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局9月16日在北京发布《统计改革发展“十五五”规划》，部署健全统计制度方法体系、完善国民经济核算制度、严查数据造假等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: China's National Bureau of Statistics released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Statistical Reform and Development on September 16 in Beijing, outlining steps to improve statistical systems, national accounting, and crack down on data falsification.

articles.title_en: Ministry of Culture and Tourism Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Culture and Tourism Development
articles.summary_zh: 文化和旅游部近日印发《文化和旅游发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年推进文化强国、旅游强国建设，部署八个方面重点任务和54个重点工程项目。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Culture and Tourism has issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Culture and Tourism Development, aiming to advance the building of a strong culture and tourism nation by 2030, with eight key tasks and 54 major projects.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在聊城调研
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Conducts Research Visit in Liaocheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，山东省省长周乃翔在聊城市调研，走访合成生物、半导体、低空产业等企业，强调发展新质生产力、优化营商环境并抓好安全生产。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang visited Liaocheng to inspect firms in synthetic biology, semiconductors and low-altitude industries, urging innovation-driven growth, a better business environment and workplace safety.

articles.title_en: Chen Min'er and Zhang Gong Meet Singapore's Minister for National Development Chee Hong Tat
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工在天津会见新加坡国家发展部部长徐芳达一行，就中新天津生态城建设及绿色低碳、经贸合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong met Singapore's National Development Minister Chee Hong Tat in Tianjin to discuss the China-Singapore Tianjin Eco-City and green, trade ties.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：“中国服务”是中国高水平对外开放的一张崭新名片
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: "China Services" Is a New Calling Card for China's High-Standard Opening-Up
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，“中国服务”是中国高水平对外开放的一张崭新名片，本届服贸会达成1200余项成果。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, MFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press briefing that "China Services" is a new calling card for China's high-standard opening-up, with the services trade fair yielding over 1,200 outcomes.
