articles.title_zh: 国家统计局回应中国内需和外需状况
articles.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics Responds on China's Domestic and External Demand
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，国新办举行新闻发布会介绍2026年8月国民经济运行情况，国家统计局新闻发言人付凌晖回应称，我国经济增长主要还是靠内需拉动。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on China's August 2026 economic performance, where NBS spokesman Fu Linghui said growth is still driven mainly by domestic demand.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：8月份经济运行呈现“三稳两快”特点
articles.title_en: NBS: August Economy Shows 'Three Stabilities, Two Fast Growths'
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，国新办举行新闻发布会，国家统计局新闻发言人付凌晖介绍2026年8月份国民经济运行情况，称经济运行呈现“三稳两快”特点。
articles.summary_en: At a Sept 15 State Council Information Office briefing, NBS spokesperson Fu Linghui said China's economy in August showed 'three stabilities and two fast growths,' citing steady output, employment and prices, and rapid growth in emerging industries and trade.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：前8月固定资产投资规模可观，结构和质量不断优化
articles.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: Fixed-Asset Investment in First Eight Months Remains Substantial, Structure and Quality Keep Improving
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日国新办发布会上，国家统计局发言人王冠华介绍，1-8月全国固定资产投资同比下降7.2%，规模近30万亿元，结构与质量持续优化。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office briefing on Sept 15, NBS spokesperson Wang Guanhua said China's fixed-asset investment fell 7.2% year on year in January-August, totaling nearly 30 trillion yuan, with structure and quality continuing to improve.

articles.title_zh: 中方：南沙群岛从来不在菲领土范围内，菲方应立即停止侵权挑衅
articles.title_en: China: Nansha Islands Never Within Philippine Territory, Manila Should Immediately Stop Provocations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月15日，中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上表示，南沙群岛是中国固有领土，从来不在菲律宾领土范围内，菲方应立即停止侵权挑衅和煽宣炒作。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press briefing in Beijing on September 15, 2026, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said the Nansha Islands are China's inherent territory and never fell within Philippine territory, urging Manila to immediately stop its infringing provocations.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：高市早苗涉台错误言行是当前中日关系面临严重困难的最大症结
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Takaichi Sanae's Erroneous Taiwan-Related Remarks Are the Biggest Obstacle in China-Japan Relations
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，日本首相高市早苗涉台错误言行是当前中日关系严重困难的最大症结，敦促日方恪守中日四个政治文件精神。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said Japanese PM Takaichi Sanae's erroneous Taiwan-related remarks are the biggest obstacle in China-Japan relations, urging Japan to honor the four political documents.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国在本国领土开展建设等活动是主权范围内的事 正当合法
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China's Construction Activities on Its Own Territory Are Within Its Sovereignty, Legitimate and Lawful
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，包括美济礁、渚碧礁、中业岛在内的南沙群岛是中国固有领土，中国在本国领土开展建设活动正当合法，菲方主张非法。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told a regular press briefing that the Nansha Islands, including Mischief Reef, Subi Reef and Zhongye Island, are China's inherent territory, and that China's construction activities there are legitimate and lawful.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：期待同各国坚定反对外空武器化、战场化
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Expects Joint Efforts to Oppose Weaponization of Outer Space
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京例行记者会上表示，中国已将嫦娥六号采集的月球背面月壤捐赠联合国，期待同各国共同反对外空武器化、战场化。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular briefing in Beijing that China has donated Chang'e-6 lunar far-side samples to the UN and expects all countries to oppose the weaponization of outer space.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤 开启金砖合作第三个“金色十年”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit, Opening Third 'Golden Decade' of BRICS Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月12日至13日，金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤在印度新德里举行，国家主席习近平出席两阶段会议并发表重要讲话，提出争做“四个先锋”主张。
articles.summary_en: On September 12-13 local time, the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit was held in New Delhi, India. President Xi Jinping attended both sessions and delivered key speeches, proposing the 'four pioneers' initiative.

articles.title_zh: 马珊珊任沈阳市副市长、代理市长

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学等市领导参加安定区人大代表选举投票

articles.summary_zh: 9月15日上午，定西市委书记汪尚学等市四大班子领导以普通选民身份，在安定区福台路街道第一选区市行政中心投票站参加区第十九届人大代表选举投票。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 15, Dingxi Party Secretary Wang Shangxue and other city leaders voted as ordinary electors at a polling station in Anding District for the 19th District People's Congress election.

articles.title_zh: 始终把人民生命安全放在首位——以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导科学指挥2026年防汛抗洪救灾纪实
articles.title_en: Putting People's Lives First: CPC Central Committee with Xi Jinping at Its Core Leads 2026 Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 2026年汛期，在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导和科学指挥下，各地各部门协同作战，全力开展防汛抗洪抢险救灾，守护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: In the 2026 flood season, under the CPC Central Committee led by Xi Jinping, Chinese departments and localities coordinated flood control and disaster relief to protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟在鞍山调研
articles.title_en: Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei Conducts Inspection Tour in Anshan
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟在鞍山调研，考察尾矿综合利用、矿山生态修复和菱镁矿深加工企业，强调坚持绿色低碳、智能化转型与产业升级。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Liaoning Governor Wang Xinwei inspected tailings recycling, mine ecological restoration and magnesite processing sites in Anshan, urging green, low-carbon and smart industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱调研统战工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects United Front Work in Hegang
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱调研统战工作，走访新的社会阶层人士实践创新基地、民营企业项目和宗教活动场所，部署新时代爱国统一战线工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu inspected united front work, visiting a practice base for new social strata, private enterprise projects and religious venues, and urging stronger patriotic united front efforts.

articles.title_zh: “扎实推进先进制造业高质量发展”——习近平总书记引领我国加快向制造强国迈进
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads China's Push to Build a Manufacturing Powerhouse, Advancing High-Quality Development of Advanced Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月15日播发报道，梳理习近平总书记把制造业高质量发展置于党和国家发展全局突出位置、引领我国加快向制造强国迈进的战略部署与实践成效。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua report on Sept. 15 reviews how Xi Jinping has placed high-quality development of manufacturing at the top of the Party and state agenda, steering China's drive to become a manufacturing powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市市长顾坤调研推进安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Huaian Mayor Gu Kun Inspects and Advances Workplace Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月13日，淮安市市长顾坤以“四不两直”方式赴淮安工业园区、清江浦区、淮阴区现场调研推进安全生产工作，要求深入排查整治风险隐患。
articles.summary_en: On September 13, Huaian Mayor Gu Kun made unannounced inspections in Huaian Industrial Park, Qingjiangpu District and Huaiyin District to advance workplace safety work, calling for thorough screening and rectification of risks and hazards.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市市长顾坤调研推进安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun Inspects and Advances Workplace Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月13日，淮安市市长顾坤以“四不两直”方式赴淮安工业园区、清江浦区、淮阴区调研安全生产工作，检查危化品、船舶修造、消防等领域隐患排查整治。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 13, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun made unannounced visits to an industrial park and districts to advance workplace safety work, urging hazard checks in chemicals, shipbuilding and fire safety.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡在调研职业教育工作时强调深化产教融合 赋能高质量转型发展
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Stresses Deepening Industry-Education Integration to Boost High-Quality Transformation During Vocational Education Tour
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡赴淮北工业和艺术学校、淮北职业技术学院调研职业教育工作，并主持召开座谈会，部署深化产教融合、校企对接等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 15, Huang Wei, deputy party secretary and acting mayor of Huaibei, inspected vocational schools in Huaibei and chaired a meeting on deepening industry-education integration and school-enterprise cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持市委理论学习中心组集体学习
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Huaihua Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日下午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖主持市委理论学习中心组2026年第十次集体学习，深入学习贯彻习近平经济思想，加快推动经济社会高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Huaihua Party Secretary Wei Zhaohui chaired the municipal Party committee's 2026 theoretical study session on Xi Jinping Thought on the Economy and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 尹李峰主持召开林芝市国土空间总体规划修编工作专题会
articles.title_en: Yin Lifeng Chairs Special Meeting on Revision of Nyingchi Territorial Space Master Plan
articles.summary_zh: 近日，林芝市委副书记、代理市长尹李峰主持召开政府专题会议，听取林芝市国土空间总体规划（2021-2035年）实施评估情况汇报，并安排部署修编具体工作。
articles.summary_en: Acting Mayor Yin Lifeng of Nyingchi chaired a government special meeting to review the implementation assessment of the city's Territorial Space Master Plan (2021-2035) and arrange the plan's revision work.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅关于加强中小企业回款难问题治理有关工作的通知
articles.title_en: General Office of the State Council Issues Notice on Curbing Payment Delays for SMEs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅印发通知，要求分行业明确合理账期，引导大型企业对中小企业60日内现金付款，并规范商业汇票、电子凭证等非现金支付工具。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the State Council issued a notice requiring industry-specific payment deadlines, guiding large firms to pay SMEs in cash within 60 days, and tightening rules on commercial bills and electronic payment certificates.

articles.title_zh: 始终把人民生命安全放在首位——以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导科学指挥2026年防汛抗洪救灾纪实
articles.title_en: Always Put People's Lives and Safety First: A Record of 2026 Flood Control and Disaster Relief Under the Strong Leadership and Scientific Command of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at Its Core

articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, 2026, Xinhua reported that the CPC Central Committee under Xi Jinping led China's 2026 flood control and disaster relief, with local authorities rescuing people and safeguarding lives.

articles.title_zh: 汕头召开会议专题研究部署交通规划建设工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Meeting on Transport Planning and Construction
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开专题会议，研究部署交通规划建设，提出加快建设高水平全国性综合交通枢纽。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 14, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a special meeting to study and advance transport planning and construction, aiming to build a high-level national comprehensive transport hub.

articles.title_zh: 泰安市市长李国强到宁阳县调研农业农村工作
articles.title_en: Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang Inspects Ningyang County on Agriculture and Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，泰安市委副书记、市长李国强到宁阳县调研，强调抓实秋粮生产、扛牢粮食安全责任，发展绿色循环农业，推进乡村振兴落地见效。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang inspected Ningyang County, urging solid autumn grain production, food security, green circular agriculture and effective rural revitalization.

articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds Meeting to Advance Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Affecting the Public
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，泰州市召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治推进会，市委书记姜冬冬出席并讲话，市长李晖主持，部署攻坚收官阶段整治任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Taizhou held a meeting to advance its campaign against misconduct and corruption affecting the public, with Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong speaking and Mayor Li Hui presiding as the drive enters its final stage.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Taizhou held a meeting on elections for its city, county and township people's congresses. Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong urged lawful and clean polls, with Zhang Yusong chairing.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Taizhou held a meeting to push forward rectification of misconduct and corruption affecting the public, with Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong speaking and Mayor Li Hui presiding, deploying case handling, livelihood-sector rectification and long-term grassroots oversight.

articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Attends 2026 Fall Opening Ceremony of Weihai Party School and Shandong Weihai Cadre Academy
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，中共威海市委党校、山东威海干部学院举行2026年秋季学期开学典礼，威海市委副书记、市长孔凡萍出席并为学员作辅导报告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping delivered a guidance report at the 2026 fall opening ceremony of the CPC Weihai Party School and Shandong Weihai Cadre Academy.

articles.title_zh: 全市安全生产和社会稳定工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Wuxi Holds Citywide Meeting on Workplace Safety and Social Stability
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，无锡市市长蒋锋主持召开全市安全生产和社会稳定工作会议，部署隐患排查整治、消防风险防控和信访问题化解等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng chaired a citywide meeting on workplace safety and social stability, ordering tighter hazard inspections, fire risk controls and complaint resolution.

articles.title_zh: 全市人大换届选举工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Wuxi Holds Citywide Meeting on People's Congress Election Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，无锡市召开全市人大换届选举工作会议，市委副书记、市长蒋锋出席讲话，部署市、市（县）区、镇三级人大换届选举工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Wuxi held a citywide meeting on People's Congress election work, where Mayor Jiang Feng spoke and laid out plans for the three-tier election at city, district and township levels.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席赴印度出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，为全球南方聚力启金砖合作新程
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in India, Rallying the Global South and Opening a New Chapter for BRICS Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席赴印度出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤并会见莫迪总理，提出“四大先锋”等主张，为金砖合作与全球南方赋能。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in India and met Prime Minister Modi, proposing the "four pioneers" and pledging to empower BRICS cooperation and the Global South.

articles.title_zh: 魏建平到基层一线宣讲市第十三次党代会精神
articles.title_en: Wei Jianping Visits Grassroots Frontline to Explain Spirit of 13th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，新乡市委书记魏建平深入新乡县、辉县市宣讲市第十三次党代会精神，并调研交通强市、文旅强市建设情况。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping visited Xinxiang County and Huixian City to explain the spirit of the 13th Municipal Party Congress and inspect transport and tourism development.

articles.title_zh: 青海省海南州同德县党政代表团来盐城考察
articles.title_en: Party and Government Delegation from Tongde County, Hainan Prefecture, Qinghai Visits Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，青海省海南州同德县党政代表团来盐城考察，盐城市委书记严汉平与同德县委书记谢康勇共同出席对口支援协作工作座谈会并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, a Party and government delegation from Tongde County, Hainan Prefecture, Qinghai Province visited Yancheng, where Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Tongde County Party Secretary Xie Kangyong jointly attended a symposium on paired assistance and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 盐城（大连）海洋经济投资环境说明会举行
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Marine Economy Investment Briefing in Dalian

articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Yancheng Acting Mayor Wu Wei led a delegation to Dalian for a marine economy investment briefing, visiting key firms and signing a batch of marine industry projects.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市第九次党代会报告党外人士征求意见座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Symposium with Non-Party Figures on Report to 9th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，盐城市委书记严汉平主持召开座谈会，就中共盐城市第九次党代会报告征求党外人士意见建议，市委副书记黄华出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping chaired a symposium to solicit non-Party figures' views on the report to the city's 9th CPC Congress; Deputy Secretary Huang Hua attended.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委常委会会议研究基孔肯雅热等蚊媒传染病防控工作
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Chikungunya and Mosquito-Borne Disease Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日晚，阳江市委常委会会议召开，同时套开基孔肯雅热等蚊媒传染病联防联控工作机制会议，市委书记卢一先主持，研究部署疫情防控工作。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 14, the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting combined with a joint prevention and control work mechanism meeting on chikungunya and other mosquito-borne infectious diseases, chaired by Party Secretary Lu Yixian.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市委召开座谈会征求市第九次党代会报告意见
articles.title_en: Yueyang Municipal Committee Holds Symposium to Seek Opinions on Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，受岳阳市委书记谢卫江委托，市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然主持召开座谈会，听取基层代表对市第九次党代会报告的意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, acting mayor Tang Haoran, entrusted by Yueyang Party Secretary Xie Weijiang, chaired a symposium to gather grassroots opinions on the report for the city's 9th Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 坡头区委工作会议召开，专题研究全国、全省性整治项目和民生实事阶段性工作进展情况
articles.title_en: Liu Jian Chairs Potou District Committee Meeting on Rectification Projects and Livelihood Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，湛江市坡头区委书记刘剑主持召开区委工作会议，研究部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治及民生实事推进工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Potou District Party Secretary Liu Jian chaired a district committee meeting in Zhanjiang to review and plan rectification of misconduct and corruption around the public, plus livelihood projects.

articles.title_en: Zhoukou Holds Weekly Meeting on Key Projects and Enterprise Appeals Handling

articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a weekly meeting on key projects and enterprise appeals, deploying post-disaster reconstruction and project planning. Mayor Zhan Peng attended.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记教师节问候及安全生产重要指示精神，部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治、扫黑除恶等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a Standing Committee meeting on Xi Jinping's Teachers' Day greetings, workplace safety, anti-corruption and the crackdown on organized crime.

articles.title_zh: 马晓磊“四不两直”暗访检查安全生产和消防工作
articles.title_en: Ma Xiaolei Makes Unannounced Inspection of Workplace Safety and Fire Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日下午，淄博市委书记马晓磊以“四不两直”方式深入养老机构、企业和酒店，暗访检查安全生产和消防工作，要求排查整治风险隐患。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 14, Ma Xiaolei, Party Secretary of Zibo, made unannounced inspections of elderly care homes, enterprises and hotels to check workplace safety and fire prevention work, urging thorough risk screening and rectification.

articles.title_zh: 2026年国家网络安全宣传周在济南开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 National Cybersecurity Week Opens in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，2026年国家网络安全宣传周在济南开幕，庄荣文、阿东讲话，林武致辞，刘强主持，会上发布人工智能安全治理框架3.0等成果。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the 2026 National Cybersecurity Week opened in Jinan, where Zhuang Rongwen and A Dong spoke, Lin Wu addressed the event and Liu Qiang presided; the AI Security Governance Framework 3.0 was released.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在德州调研时强调持续深耕先进制造业筑牢高质量发展坚实支撑
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Stresses Deepening Advanced Manufacturing to Underpin High-Quality Development During Dezhou Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在德州市调研，走访石油装备、电机、体育产业及调味品企业，强调深耕先进制造业、发展实体经济并抓好安全生产。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Shandong Provincial Governor Zhou Naixiang inspected Dezhou, visiting oil equipment, motor, sports goods and condiment enterprises, urging deeper work in advanced manufacturing, the real economy and workplace safety.

articles.title_zh: 「漳州110」：永当「人民的保护神」
articles.title_en: Zhangzhou 110: Forever the 'Guardians of the People'
articles.summary_zh: 新华社9月14日报道，福建漳州110报警服务台建队三十余年来累计处置警情求助70余万起，持续推进智慧警务改革，成为全国公安机关的一面旗帜。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 14 that Zhangzhou 110 in Fujian, founded over three decades ago, has handled more than 700,000 police calls and keeps advancing smart-policing reforms, making it a model for public security organs nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 商务部等8部门印发《促进智能家居消费行动方案》
articles.title_en: China's Commerce Ministry and Seven Other Departments Issue Action Plan to Boost Smart Home Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 商务部等8部门印发《促进智能家居消费行动方案》，从扩大优质供给、完善标准体系、支持消费、适老化改造、废旧回收、社区便民服务及财政金融支持等七方面促进智能家居消费。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce and seven other departments issued an action plan to boost smart home consumption, covering supply, standards, consumer subsidies, elderly-friendly products, recycling and financial support.

articles.title_zh: 全球首个人工智能+脑机接口标准 中国首发！
articles.title_en: China Releases World's First AI-Enabled Brain-Computer Interface Medical Device Standard
articles.summary_zh: 国家药监局9月14日批准发布全球首个采用人工智能技术处理脑电数据的脑机接口医疗器械标准，新标准将于2027年9月1日起实施。
articles.summary_en: China's National Medical Products Administration approved on Sept 14 the world's first brain-computer interface medical device standard using AI to process EEG data, effective Sept 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能解锁公共机构降碳新路径
articles.title_en: AI Unlocks New Path for Carbon Reduction in Public Institutions
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，公共机构节能降碳论坛举行，发布2027年绿色低碳技术征集通知，院士专家就AI赋能公共机构节能降碳提出建议。
articles.summary_en: A forum on energy saving and carbon reduction in public institutions was held in September 2026, releasing a call for green low-carbon technologies for 2027, with academicians and experts offering proposals on AI-driven decarbonization.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议，周祖翼主持并研究贯彻落实措施
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting Chaired by Zhou Zuyi
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，福建省委常委会召开会议，省委书记周祖翼主持，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署安全生产、教育、金砖合作、投洽会及防汛救灾恢复重建等工作。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, the Fujian Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee met under Secretary Zhou Zuyi to implement Xi Jinping's instructions, covering workplace safety, education, BRICS cooperation, the CIFIT investment fair and disaster recovery.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席引领“大金砖合作”开启新篇章
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads "Greater BRICS Cooperation" into a New Chapter
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日至13日，国家主席习近平应邀赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，密集出席近10场活动，并宣布中国将于明年接任金砖主席国。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12-13, President Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, India, taking part in nearly 10 events and announcing that China will host the next summit as BRICS chair.

articles.title_zh: 金砖峰会，习近平为何强调“坚定站在历史正确一边”
articles.title_en: At BRICS Summit, Xi Jinping Stresses 'Standing Firm on the Right Side of History'
articles.summary_zh: 9月13日，习近平结束出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤返回北京，他在峰会上提出五项合作倡议，强调金砖国家要坚定站在历史正确一边。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 13, Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit, where he put forward five cooperation initiatives and urged BRICS nations to stand firm on the right side of history.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育总结会议召开
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Party Group Meeting Summarizes Education on Correct Views of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，青岛市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育总结会议召开，市人大常委会党组书记、主任梅建华主持并讲话，部署巩固拓展学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 15, the Party group of the Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a meeting summarizing education on the correct view of political achievements, chaired by Mei Jianhua.

articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Convey and Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日上午，青岛市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在上合组织元首理事会第二十六次会议、金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤等场合的重要讲话精神，市委书记曾赞荣主持并讲话，会议审议了安全生产整治、创新型产业生态等方案。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 15, the Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to convey and study Xi Jinping's speeches at the 26th SCO Heads of State Council and the 18th BRICS Summit. Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong chaired the meeting, which reviewed plans on workplace safety rectification and innovation-driven industrial ecosystems.

articles.title_en: Qingdao CPPCC Party Group Holds Collective Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，青岛市政协党组理论学习中心组围绕深入学习贯彻习近平法治思想、严格遵守换届纪律要求开展集体学习研讨，党组书记、主席孟庆斌主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the Qingdao CPPCC Party Group study group held a collective session on Xi Jinping's rule-of-law thought and discipline for the leadership transition, chaired by Party Secretary and Chairman Meng Qingbin.

articles.title_zh: 国防部新闻发言人就近期涉军问题发布消息并答记者问
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry Spokesperson Releases Military News and Takes Questions from Reporters
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，国防部新闻发言人蒋斌在北京就近期涉军问题发布消息并答记者问，内容涉及北京香山论坛、学生军训、中新联演及中俄蒙边防联合演练等。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Defense Ministry spokesperson Jiang Bin released military news and answered reporters' questions in Beijing, covering the Beijing Xiangshan Forum, student military training, China-Singapore naval drills and China-Russia-Mongolia border exercises.

articles.title_zh: 从战略高度和长远角度看待和发展中印关系
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Indian PM Modi in New Delhi, Stressing Long-Term View of China-India Ties
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月12日，国家主席习近平在印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤期间会见印度总理莫迪，就中印关系提出四点看法，强调从战略高度和长远角度发展双边关系。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met Indian Prime Minister Modi in New Delhi during the 18th BRICS Summit, laying out four points on China-India relations and stressing a strategic, long-term approach to bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 十四届全国政协原常委、经济委员会原副主任毕井泉受贿案一审宣判
articles.title_en: First-Instance Verdict in Bribery Case of Bi Jingquan, Former Standing Committee Member of the 14th CPPCC National Committee
articles.summary_zh: 济南市中级人民法院对十四届全国政协原常委、经济委员会原副主任毕井泉受贿案作出一审宣判，认定其非法收受财物折合人民币5742万余元。
articles.summary_en: The Jinan Intermediate People's Court issued a first-instance verdict in the bribery case of Bi Jingquan, former Standing Committee member of the 14th CPPCC National Committee, finding he illegally accepted over 57.42 million yuan in bribes.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委安排3000万元支持海南暴雨洪涝灾害灾后应急恢复
articles.title_en: NDRC Allocates 30 Million Yuan to Support Post-Disaster Recovery in Hainan After Rainstorm and Flooding
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委紧急安排3000万元中央预算内投资，支持海南省暴雨洪涝灾害灾后应急恢复，重点用于受损道路、水利等基础设施及学校、医院等公共服务设施恢复建设。
articles.summary_en: China's National Development and Reform Commission urgently allocated 30 million yuan from the central budget to support post-disaster recovery in Hainan Province after rainstorm and flooding, focusing on damaged roads, water infrastructure, schools and hospitals.

articles.title_zh: 日媒：冲绳县知事选举暴露“日本本土对冲绳战后最严重歧视”
articles.title_en: Japanese Media: Okinawa Gubernatorial Election Exposes "Worst Postwar Discrimination Against Okinawa by Mainland Japan"
articles.summary_zh: 9月13日，古谢玄太击败寻求连任的玉城丹尼当选日本冲绳县知事；日媒称选举期间本土舆论猛烈抨击反对美军基地的冲绳民众，暴露战后最严重歧视。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 13, Kojya Genta defeated incumbent Tamaki Denny in Okinawa's gubernatorial election; Japanese media said mainland attacks on Okinawans opposing US bases exposed the worst postwar discrimination.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省长刘小涛在南京会见16家上市公司考察团
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao Meets Delegation of 16 Listed Companies in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日下午，江苏省长刘小涛在南京会见由长三角、粤港澳大湾区16家上市公司组成的企业考察团，并与曹德旺等企业家交流，鼓励其加大在苏投资布局。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 11, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met in Nanjing with a delegation of 16 listed companies from the Yangtze River Delta and Greater Bay Area, urging them to expand investment in the province.

articles.title_zh: 部分高校就“过紧日子”下发细则文件，提醒“把钱花在该花的地方”
articles.title_en: Chinese Universities Issue Detailed Rules on “Tightening Belts,” Urging Spending Where It Matters
articles.summary_zh: 近期，北京林业大学、安徽建筑大学等部分高校陆续下发“过紧日子”细则文件，从严管控差旅、会议、餐费、办公用品等开支。
articles.summary_en: Several Chinese universities, including Beijing Forestry University and Anhui Jianzhu University, have issued detailed rules on “tightening belts,” tightening controls on travel, meetings, receptions and office spending.

articles.title_zh: 石排如何成为“中国潮玩之都”核心区
articles.title_en: How Shipai Became the Core Zone of China's Designer Toy Capital
articles.summary_zh: 报道称，广东东莞石排镇依托数十年玩具代工积累的完整产业链，正从代工小镇转型为原创潮玩IP策源地，并加速布局海外市场。
articles.summary_en: A report on how Shipai town in Dongguan, Guangdong, is shifting from a toy OEM base to a hub for original designer-toy IPs, backed by a complete supply chain and a push overseas.

articles.title_zh: 电子信息制造业发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: China Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Electronic Information Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部、国家发展改革委近日联合印发《电子信息制造业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年规模以上企业营业收入突破30万亿元、研发投入强度达3.5%。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for the electronic information manufacturing industry, targeting over 30 trillion yuan in revenue for above-scale firms and R&D intensity of 3.5% by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 中新互联互通项目签约15个项目
articles.title_en: China-Singapore Connectivity Project Signs 15 Cooperation Projects
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，中新（重庆）战略性互联互通示范项目联合实施委员会第十一次会议在重庆举行，双方签署15个政府与商业合作项目，涵盖金融服务、交通物流、信息通信等领域。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the 11th meeting of the Joint Implementation Committee of the China-Singapore (Chongqing) Strategic Connectivity Demonstration Project saw 15 government and commercial cooperation projects signed, covering finance, transport and logistics, ICT and more.

articles.title_zh: 《福建省美丽中国先行区建设实施方案》正式印发 明确2027年、2030年阶段性目标
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues Implementation Plan for Building Beautiful China Pioneer Zone, Setting 2027 and 2030 Milestones
articles.summary_zh: 福建省政府近日印发《福建省美丽中国先行区建设实施方案》，围绕“12345”模式部署，明确2027年底前美丽系列建成进度过半、2030年底前基本建成美丽中国先行区。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian provincial government has issued an implementation plan for building a Beautiful China pioneer zone, aiming to complete more than half of its "beautiful" projects by end-2027 and basically finish the zone by end-2030.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市2026年全国药品安全宣传周活动启动
articles.title_en: Xiamen Launches 2026 National Drug Safety Awareness Week
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，厦门市2026年“全国药品安全宣传周”主题日活动在同安区举行，现场举行药品安全检查员颁证、两岸中药材标准共通签约及“美妆产业服务中心”揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Xiamen launched its 2026 National Drug Safety Awareness Week in Tong'an District, with inspector certification, cross-strait TCM standards signings and a beauty industry center.

articles.title_zh: 河南省十四届人大常委会第87次主任会议召开
articles.title_en: 87th Chairpersons' Meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress Convened

articles.summary_en: On September 14, the 87th chairpersons' meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress was held in Zhengzhou, chaired by Li Ya, reviewing multiple draft local regulations and setting the committee's 26th session for September 20-23.

articles.title_zh: 科技服务搭桥 深海产业扎根
articles.title_en: Tech Services Bridge the Gap as Deep-Sea Industry Takes Root in Sanya
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，海南三亚崖州湾科技城高新区发布首期“深海科创积分”，海南大学凭科研贡献兑换下半年共享航次席位，当地以专业化科技服务培育深海产业。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Yazhou Bay Science and Technology City in Sanya, Hainan released its first batch of "deep-sea innovation points," letting Hainan University trade research contributions for shared research-voyage slots and deep-sea test facilities.

articles.title_zh: 李殿勋主持召开省政府常务会议 研究深入实施“人工智能+”行动等工作
articles.title_en: Li Dianxun Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting on the "AI Plus" Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，湖北省省长李殿勋主持召开省政府常务会议，研究深入实施“人工智能+”行动、推动服务业健康发展和加快新型能源体系建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun chaired a provincial government executive meeting to study the "AI Plus" initiative, service industry growth and a new energy system.

articles.title_zh: 刘小明会见联合国粮农组织高级别南南合作考察团
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaoming Meets UN FAO High-Level South-South Cooperation Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，海南省省长刘小明在海口会见联合国粮农组织高级别南南合作考察团，就热带农业、粮食安全等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Hainan Governor Liu Xiaoming met in Haikou with a high-level UN FAO South-South cooperation delegation, discussing cooperation in tropical agriculture and food security.

articles.title_zh: 海南召开全省防御强降雨视频部署会 冯飞刘小明作批示
articles.title_en: Hainan Holds Provincial Video Meeting on Heavy Rain Defense, Feng Fei and Liu Xiaoming Issue Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日下午，海南省召开全省防御强降雨视频部署会，研判本轮强降雨形势，部署风险防控和灾后恢复工作，省委书记冯飞、省长刘小明分别作批示。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 14, Hainan Province held a provincial video meeting on heavy rainfall defense to assess the situation and redeploy risk control and post-disaster recovery work, with instructions issued by Party Secretary Feng Fei and Governor Liu Xiaoming.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省部署未来五年松材线虫病防控工作
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Deploys Five-Year Plan to Prevent and Control Pine Wilt Disease

articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang's forest chief office issued a five-year action plan to prevent and control pine wilt disease, aiming to keep the province outbreak-free through 2030.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省航空航天检验检测认证联盟在无锡成立 首批共92家联盟单位
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Aerospace Inspection, Testing and Certification Alliance Established in Wuxi with 92 Founding Members

articles.summary_en: On September 14, the Jiangsu Aerospace Inspection, Testing and Certification Alliance was launched in Wuxi with 92 founding members from research institutes, enterprises and industry associations, releasing version 1.0 of its service capability map.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台新措施加力支持工业企业技术改造
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues New Measures to Boost Technological Upgrading of Industrial Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省政府办公厅印发《关于加力支持工业企业技术改造的若干措施》，共出台12条举措，单个重大技改项目最高可获1500万元支持。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Jiangsu Provincial Government has issued new measures to support technological upgrading at industrial enterprises, rolling out 12 policies with up to 15 million yuan in support for major upgrading projects.

articles.title_zh: 江西省发布涉外仲裁员共享名册
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Releases Shared Roster of Foreign-Related Arbitrators
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，中国仲裁周江西专场活动暨“商法护航企业出海”交流会在南昌举办，会上发布《江西省涉外仲裁员共享名册》，80名涉外仲裁专家入册。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the Jiangxi session of China Arbitration Week was held in Nanchang, where the Jiangxi Shared Roster of Foreign-Related Arbitrators was released, listing 80 experts to support local firms going global.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中会见香港科技大学教授李泽湘一行
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets HKUST Professor Li Zexiang and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见香港科技大学教授李泽湘一行，双方就科技创新、产业升级与产学研合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, met with HKUST professor Li Zexiang and his delegation in Hohhot to discuss sci-tech innovation, industrial upgrading and industry-academia-research cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中会见越南国会代表团一行
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets Vietnamese National Assembly Delegation

articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, met in Hohhot with a Vietnamese National Assembly delegation led by Vu Hai Ha to discuss cooperation in trade, clean energy and cultural exchange.

articles.title_zh: 包钢主持召开自治区人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Chairs Executive Meeting of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢主持召开政府常务会议，研究城乡居民基本养老保险资金保障事宜，审议“十五五”应急体系、消防事业、新型工业化等规划。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Chairman Bao Gang chaired a government executive meeting to study funding guarantees for urban and rural residents' basic old-age insurance and review 15th Five-Year Plan programs on emergency response, fire safety and new industrialization.

articles.title_zh: 自治区十四届人大常委会第三十次会议开幕
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of Inner Mongolia's 14th People's Congress Opens 30th Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，内蒙古自治区十四届人大常委会第三十次会议举行第一次全体会议，听取多项地方性法规草案审议结果、执法检查报告及专项工作报告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the Standing Committee of Inner Mongolia's 14th People's Congress opened its 30th session, hearing reports on draft local regulations, enforcement inspections and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏盐池县2026年国家网络安全宣传周暨网络文明大会启动
articles.title_en: Yanchi County of Ningxia Launches 2026 National Cybersecurity Awareness Week and Internet Civilization Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，宁夏盐池县启动2026年国家网络安全宣传周暨网络文明大会，推出普法驿站、辟谣歌曲及六大主题日活动，推动网安宣传进社区、农村、校园、家庭。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Yanchi County in Ningxia launched its 2026 National Cybersecurity Awareness Week and Internet Civilization Conference, rolling out a legal-education station, an anti-rumor song and six themed days to bring cybersecurity outreach into communities, villages, schools and households.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《在加强基础研究座谈会上的讲话》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Publishes Xi Jinping's Article on Strengthening Basic Research
articles.summary_zh: 9月16日出版的第18期《求是》杂志将发表习近平总书记重要文章《在加强基础研究座谈会上的讲话》，强调以更大力度加强基础研究、加快实现高水平科技自立自强。
articles.summary_en: The 18th issue of Qiushi, to be published on September 16, will carry an important article by Xi Jinping on strengthening basic research, stressing greater efforts to boost original innovation and achieve high-level scientific and technological self-reliance.

articles.title_zh: 从事出境入境中介服务的机构和人员今起备案管理
articles.title_en: New Filing Rules Take Effect for Exit-Entry Intermediary Agencies and Personnel
articles.summary_zh: 国家移民管理局与国家市场监督管理总局制定的《从事出境入境中介服务的机构和人员备案管理办法》自9月15日起施行，明确由县级以上公安机关出入境管理机构实施备案管理。
articles.summary_en: Rules jointly issued by China's National Immigration Administration and the State Administration for Market Regulation took effect on Sept 15, requiring exit-entry intermediary agencies and personnel to file records with county-level exit-entry authorities.

articles.title_zh: 勇做时代先锋 汇聚团结力量——习近平主席赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤纪实
articles.title_en: Brave the Times as Pioneers, Pool Strength for Unity: Xi Jinping Attends 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi, India
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日至13日，习近平主席应邀赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，并宣布中国将于明年接任金砖主席国、主办第十九次会晤。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12-13, President Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi, India, and announced that China will take over the BRICS chairmanship next year and host the 19th summit.

articles.title_zh: 闽宁协作暨东西部协作理论与实践研讨会在银川举行 李书磊出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Li Shulei Attends Seminar on Fujian-Ningxia and East-West Cooperation in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，闽宁协作暨东西部协作理论与实践研讨会在宁夏银川举行，中共中央政治局委员、中宣部部长李书磊出席并致辞。会议由中宣部、中央农办、农业农村部及宁夏、福建党委联合举办。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, a seminar on Fujian-Ningxia and East-West cooperation was held in Yinchuan, Ningxia, with Li Shulei, Political Bureau member and head of the Publicity Department, attending and delivering remarks. The seminar was co-hosted by the Publicity Department, the Central Rural Work Office, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, and the Ningxia and Fujian party committees.

articles.title_zh: 吴晓军罗东川会见布隆迪基特加省代表团一行
articles.title_en: Wu Xiaojun and Luo Dongchuan Meet with Delegation from Burundi's Gitega Province
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，青海省委书记吴晓军、省长罗东川在西宁会见布隆迪基特加省省长比吉里马纳率领的代表团，双方愿在生态环保、民生、产业等领域深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Qinghai Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun and Governor Luo Dongchuan met in Xining with a delegation led by Gitega Province Governor Liboire Bigirimana of Burundi, with both sides pledging deeper cooperation in ecology, livelihood and industry.

articles.title_zh: 2026年青海省网络安全宣传周在海北启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Qinghai Cybersecurity Awareness Week Launches in Haibei
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，2026年青海省网络安全宣传周在青海海北藏族自治州海晏县西海镇启动，由国家网络安全宣传周同步开展，省内13家省直单位联合主办，近500人参加。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the 2026 Qinghai Cybersecurity Awareness Week was launched in Xihai Town, Haiyan County, Haibei Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, running in parallel with the national campaign and jointly hosted by 13 provincial-level departments, with nearly 500 participants.

articles.title_zh: 青海省政府与中国五矿举行工作座谈
articles.title_en: Qinghai Provincial Government and China Minmetals Hold Work Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，青海省政府与中国五矿集团在西宁举行工作座谈，省长罗东川、中国五矿总经理朱可炳出席并讲话，共推世界级盐湖产业基地建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the Qinghai Provincial Government and China Minmetals held a work symposium in Xining, with Governor Luo Dongchuan and Minmetals GM Zhu Kebing attending, to advance a world-class salt-lake industry base.

articles.title_zh: 2026年国家网络安全宣传周在济南开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 National Cybersecurity Week Opens in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，2026年国家网络安全宣传周在济南开幕，中央网信办主任庄荣文出席并讲话，山东省委书记林武致辞，会上发布《人工智能安全治理框架3.0》等成果。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the 2026 National Cybersecurity Week opened in Jinan, with Cyberspace Administration of China head Zhuang Rongwen speaking and Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu addressing the event; AI security governance results were released.

articles.title_zh: 朱忠明主持上海市政府常务会议，部署安全生产与虹桥国际开放枢纽建设
articles.title_en: Zhu Zhongming Chairs Shanghai Municipal Government Executive Meeting on Safety and Hongqiao Hub
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，上海市委副书记、代市长朱忠明主持召开市政府常务会议，部署安全生产工作，并研究提升虹桥国际开放枢纽辐射能级。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Shanghai Acting Mayor Zhu Zhongming chaired a municipal government executive meeting to deploy workplace safety measures and boost the Hongqiao International Open Hub's radiating capacity.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁：全面加强金融系统党的建设，增强上海国际金融中心竞争力影响力
articles.title_en: Chen Jining: Strengthen Party Building in the Financial System to Boost Shanghai's International Financial Center
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月14日下午，上海市委书记陈吉宁在市金融工作党委调研，要求全面加强金融系统党的建设，增强上海国际金融中心竞争力和影响力。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining inspected the municipal financial work Party committee on Sept 14, 2026, urging stronger Party building to boost the city's international financial center competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 陕西发布两项古籍保护地方标准
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues Two Local Standards for Ancient Book Protection
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，经陕西省市场监管局批准，由陕西省图书馆牵头编制的《古籍书库存藏环境建设要求》《古籍存藏服务规范》两项省级地方标准发布，将于10月4日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, two provincial-level standards for ancient book protection drafted by the Shaanxi Provincial Library were approved by the Shaanxi Provincial Administration for Market Regulation and released, taking effect on Oct 4.

articles.title_zh: 2026年国家网络安全宣传周天津地区活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Cybersecurity Week Tianjin Regional Activities Launched
articles.summary_zh: 9月15日，2026年国家网络安全宣传周天津地区活动在天津大学北洋园校区启动，天津市网络安全公共服务平台上线，数据合规服务中心（天津）同期揭牌。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, the Tianjin regional activities of the 2026 National Cybersecurity Week were launched at Tianjin University's Beiyangyuan Campus, with the Tianjin Cybersecurity Public Service Platform going online and the Data Compliance Service Center (Tianjin) unveiled.

articles.title_zh: 兵团党委常委会召开会议 研究推进安全生产工作
articles.title_en: XPCC Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，新疆生产建设兵团党委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记对青岛货轮火灾事故重要指示精神，研究部署安全生产工作，何忠友主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the XPCC Party Committee Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's instructions on the Qingdao cargo ship fire and to plan workplace-safety measures. He Zhongyou chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜会见吉尔吉斯斯坦国务秘书科伊奇耶夫
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Meet with Kyrgyz State Secretary Koichiev
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐会见来疆出席2026上合组织数字经济论坛的吉尔吉斯斯坦国务秘书科伊奇耶夫一行，双方就经贸、互联互通、数字合作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz met in Urumqi with Kyrgyz State Secretary Koichiev, who was in Xinjiang for the 2026 SCO Digital Economy Forum, to discuss trade, connectivity and digital cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 云南省出台八条措施加强技术经理人（经纪人）队伍建设
articles.title_en: Yunnan Issues Eight Measures to Strengthen Technology Manager (Broker) Workforce
articles.summary_zh: 云南省出台《关于加强技术经理人（经纪人）队伍建设的八条措施》，从培养、引进、使用、评价、激励、服务等环节系统施策，推动更多创新成果从“书架”走上“货架”。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Province issued eight measures to build up its technology manager (broker) workforce, covering training, recruitment, evaluation, incentives and services, to speed the commercialization of research results.

articles.title_zh: 绍兴建成消费维权服务站216个
articles.title_en: Shaoxing Builds 216 Consumer Rights Protection Service Stations
articles.summary_zh: 绍兴市已建成216个消费维权服务站，实现全域覆盖，其中越城区建成35个，推动构建“事前预防、事中干预、事后处置”全链条治理模式。
articles.summary_en: Shaoxing has established 216 consumer rights protection service stations for citywide coverage, including 35 in Yuecheng District, advancing a full-chain governance model of prevention, intervention and resolution.

articles.title_zh: 第二十一次中欧圆桌会议在杭州召开
articles.title_en: 21st China-EU Round Table Meeting Convened in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，第二十一次中欧圆桌会议在杭州召开，37位中欧代表围绕减贫与社会包容、中欧贸易投资、人工智能等议题交流，全国政协副主席王东峰出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the 21st China-EU Round Table meeting was held in Hangzhou, where 37 Chinese and EU delegates discussed poverty reduction, trade and investment, and AI. CPPCC Vice Chairman Wang Dongfeng attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 中国向联合国捐赠“嫦娥六号”月壤样品
articles.title_en: China Donates Chang'e-6 Lunar Samples to the United Nations
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，中国向联合国赠送“嫦娥六号”月壤样品仪式在维也纳联合国总部举行，国家航天局局长单忠德代表中国政府与联合国签署月壤赠送协议。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, China donated Chang'e-6 lunar samples to the United Nations at the UN headquarters in Vienna, where CNSA Administrator Shan Zhongde signed the donation agreement on behalf of the Chinese government.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫健委发布通知加快推进托育综合服务中心建设
articles.title_en: National Health Commission Issues Notice to Accelerate Construction of Comprehensive Childcare Service Centers
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委2026年9月15日发布《关于加强托育综合服务中心有关工作的通知》，就建设运营进度、服务引领、培训指导、质量管理等作出部署，以支撑“1+N”普惠托育服务体系。
articles.summary_en: China's National Health Commission issued a notice on September 15, 2026, on strengthening comprehensive childcare service centers, setting requirements on construction, operations, training, and quality management to support the "1+N" inclusive childcare system.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局：8月份各线城市商品住宅销售价格同比降幅继续收窄
articles.title_en: NBS: Year-on-Year Declines in Commercial Housing Prices Narrow Further Across All City Tiers in August
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局发布8月70个大中城市房价数据，一线城市新建商品住宅价格环比转涨0.1%，一二三线城市同比降幅继续收窄。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics said new home prices in first-tier cities rose 0.1 percent month-on-month in August, with year-on-year declines continuing to narrow across all city tiers.

articles.title_zh: 借鉴“义乌发展经验” 因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Drawing on Yiwu's Development Experience to Advance High-Quality County Economy Growth
articles.summary_zh: 中共福建省委政策研究室在《求是》撰文，总结“义乌发展经验”的时代价值，提出福建因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展的路径。
articles.summary_en: The Policy Research Office of the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee outlines in Qiushi how Fujian can draw on Yiwu's development experience to promote high-quality county-level economic growth tailored to local conditions.

articles.title_zh: 8月金融数据出炉，释放哪些信息
articles.title_en: August Financial Data Released: What Signals Does It Send?
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行9月14日发布8月金融统计数据：8月末社会融资规模存量464.8万亿元，同比增长7.2%；M2余额356.81万亿元，同比增长7.5%，融资结构持续优化。
articles.summary_en: China's central bank released August financial statistics on Sept 14: outstanding social financing reached 464.8 trillion yuan, up 7.2% year on year, while M2 stood at 356.81 trillion yuan, up 7.5%, with the financing mix continuing to improve.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给福建省“漳州110”全体队员的回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Reply Letter to All Members of Fujian's "Zhangzhou 110"
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月15日，习近平给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信，肯定其扎根警务一线、服务群众护民安宁的付出，勉励广大公安干警坚守为民初心、做党和人民的忠诚卫士。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, 2026, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to the "Zhangzhou 110" police team in Fujian, praising their frontline work in serving the public and safeguarding people's safety, and urging public security officers to stay true to their original mission of serving the people.

articles.title_zh: 立足优势着力破解供强需弱矛盾
articles.title_en: Leveraging Advantages to Address the Imbalance of Strong Supply and Weak Demand
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月15日，求是刊文指出我国供强需弱矛盾仍较明显，应发挥超大规模市场和完整产业体系优势，扩大内需并提高供需适配性。
articles.summary_en: On September 15, 2026, Qiushi said China's supply-demand imbalance remains notable, urging use of its huge market and complete industrial system to expand domestic demand and improve matching.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from All Members of Fujian's "Zhangzhou 110"
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记习近平近日给福建省“漳州110”全体队员回信，勉励公安干警坚守为民初心、做党和人民的忠诚卫士。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping, general secretary of the CPC Central Committee, recently replied to a letter from all members of the "Zhangzhou 110" police unit in Fujian, encouraging officers to stay true to serving the people and be loyal guardians of the Party and the people.

articles.title_zh: 如何认识人民政协界别特色优势
articles.title_en: Understanding the Distinctive Strengths of the CPPCC's Sectoral System
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民政协理论研究会秘书处撰文，系统阐述人民政协界别的形成沿革、特色优势，以及加强和改进界别工作的路径。
articles.summary_en: An article by the secretariat of the CPPCC Theory Research Society explains the origins and distinctive strengths of the CPPCC's sectoral system and how to improve sector-based work.

articles.title_zh: 以更大力度更实举措加强基础研究
articles.title_en: Strengthen Basic Research with Greater Intensity and More Concrete Measures
articles.summary_zh: 科技部党组书记、部长阴和俊在《求是》发表署名文章，提出以更大力度、更实举措加强基础研究，着力破解体系协同、人才、经费保障和科研生态等短板。
articles.summary_en: Yin Hejun, China's Minister of Science and Technology, published a signed article in Qiushi urging stronger basic research and fixes to weak spots in coordination, talent, funding and the research ecosystem.

articles.summary_en: On April 30, 2026, Xi Jinping addressed a symposium on strengthening basic research, calling for stronger original innovation, improved talent cultivation, stable funding support and expanded international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 着力破解民间投资发展的卡点堵点
articles.title_en: Removing Bottlenecks Restricting Private Investment Development
articles.summary_zh: 《求是》杂志专访国家发展改革委投资研究所研究员杨萍、国务院发展研究中心企业研究所研究员许英杰，围绕民间投资的卡点堵点、市场准入、要素保障和营商环境展开分析。
articles.summary_en: Qiushi magazine interviews researchers Yang Ping and Xu Yingjie on removing bottlenecks in private investment, covering market access, factor supply, financing and the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：新德里会晤是中印领导人对两国关系发展的“再确认”
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: New Delhi Meeting Is a "Reaffirmation" of China-India Ties by Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在北京表示，习近平主席同莫迪总理9月12日新德里会晤是中印关系的“再确认”，双方共识是中印要做伙伴。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said in Beijing that Xi Jinping's Sept 12 New Delhi meeting with Narendra Modi reaffirmed China-India ties, with both sides agreeing to be partners.

articles.title_zh: 风展红旗物华新——福建长征出发地的故事与新章

articles.title_zh: 《中国供应链发展报告（2025—2026）》发布
articles.title_en: China Supply Chain Development Report (2025-2026) Released
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会日前发布《中国供应链发展报告（2025—2026）》，显示物流供应链领域人工智能应用渗透率超37%，智能采购可使采购效率提升30%以上。
articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics and Purchasing released the China Supply Chain Development Report (2025-2026), showing AI penetration in logistics supply chains exceeds 37% and smart procurement can raise purchasing efficiency by over 30%.

articles.title_zh: 今年将新增1000家基层医疗卫生机构提供儿科诊疗服务
articles.title_en: China to Add 1,000 Primary Health Facilities Offering Pediatric Care This Year
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委主任雷海潮9月14日在北京介绍，今年将新增1000家社区卫生服务中心和乡镇卫生院提供儿科诊疗服务，已向基层下沉派驻3100名儿科医生。
articles.summary_en: China will add 1,000 community and township health centers offering pediatric care this year, with 3,100 pediatricians deployed to grassroots clinics, health chief Lei Haichao said Sept 14.

articles.title_zh: 多部门合力治理中小企业回款难
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Join Forces to Tackle Payment Delays Facing SMEs
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，国务院新闻办公室举行政策例行吹风会，多部门表示将健全行业账款支付规则、明确合理账期，并加强对大型企业支付行为的监管，治理中小企业回款难问题。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office policy briefing on September 14, multiple Chinese departments said they will improve payment rules and reasonable payment terms across industries and tighten oversight of large firms' payment behavior to ease payment delays faced by small and medium-sized enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 推动健康中国建设取得决定性进展
articles.title_en: China Pushes for Decisive Progress in Building a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，国家卫生健康委等介绍推动健康中国建设情况，提出实施健康优先发展战略。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the State Council Information Office briefed on Healthy China progress, with the National Health Commission outlining the health-first development strategy and the 2035 goal.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅 中央军委办公厅印发《退役军人服务和保障“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: General Offices of the CPC Central Committee, State Council and Central Military Commission Issue the 15th Five-Year Plan for Veterans' Services and Support
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅、中央军委办公厅印发《退役军人服务和保障“十五五”规划》，对“十五五”时期退役军人接收安置、服务保障、就业创业等工作作出部署，并明确一批重点任务和工程项目。
articles.summary_en: The general offices of the CPC Central Committee, the State Council and the Central Military Commission have issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Veterans' Services and Support, setting out priorities for veterans' resettlement, services, employment and support projects through 2030.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席指引“大金砖”筑牢务实合作根基
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Guides "Greater BRICS" to Strengthen Foundation of Practical Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月13日上午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第二阶段会议并发表重要讲话，就深化金砖合作提出人工智能开源普惠等5项倡议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 13 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the second session of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi and delivered a speech, proposing five initiatives to deepen BRICS cooperation, including one on open and inclusive AI.

articles.title_zh: 金融总量合理增长 有力支撑经济向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Steady Growth in Financial Aggregates Supports Economy's Upward Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行9月14日公布数据，8月末广义货币M2余额356.81万亿元，同比增长7.5%，人民币贷款余额超280万亿元，贷款利率保持历史低位。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China said on Sept 14 that M2 stood at 356.81 trillion yuan at end-August, up 7.5% year on year, with outstanding yuan loans exceeding 280 trillion yuan and loan rates at historic lows.

articles.title_zh: 金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤新德里宣言（全文）
articles.title_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit (Full Text)
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月12日至13日，金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤在印度新德里举行并通过《新德里宣言》，重申维护多边主义、改革全球治理、深化金砖战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: BRICS leaders met in New Delhi on Sept 12-13, 2026 for their 18th summit and issued the New Delhi Declaration, reaffirming multilateralism, global governance reform and deeper strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 始终把人民生命安全放在首位——以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导科学指挥2026年防汛抗洪救灾纪实
articles.title_en: Always Putting People's Lives and Safety First: 2026 Flood Control and Disaster Relief Under the Strong Leadership and Scientific Command of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at Its Core
articles.summary_zh: 2026年汛期，我国多地遭遇极端强降水与台风袭击，在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导下，各地各部门协同作战，全力防汛抗洪、抢险救灾，守护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: In the 2026 flood season, Chinese regions hit by extreme rainfall and typhoons coordinated disaster relief efforts under the CPC Central Committee led by Xi Jinping to protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 为全球南方聚力 启金砖合作新程——习近平主席赴印度出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤取得圆满成功
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends 18th BRICS Summit in India, Visit Concludes with Success
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日至13日，国家主席习近平应邀赴印度出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，提出金砖合作「四大先锋」等主张，并同莫迪就中印关系达成重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On September 12-13, President Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Summit in India, where he proposed the "four pioneers" for BRICS cooperation and reached key consensus with Modi on China-India relations.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见出席中国超级稻三十年暨种业高质量发展大会嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Guests Attending China Super Rice 30th Anniversary and Seed Industry Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见出席中国超级稻三十年暨种业高质量发展大会的院士专家和企业代表。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with academicians and business guests attending the China Super Rice 30th Anniversary and Seed Industry Conference.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱检查城市环境卫生工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects Urban Sanitation Work in Hegang
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱以“四不两直”方式深入居民小区、主次干道和背街小巷，检查城市环境卫生工作，要求立即整治整改卫生死角、私搭乱建等问题。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu made unannounced inspections of residential communities, main roads and back alleys to check urban sanitation, ordering immediate rectification of sanitation blind spots and illegal structures.

articles.title_zh: 飞灰资源化利用专题调研座谈会在淮北召开
articles.title_en: Symposium on Fly Ash Resource Utilization Held in Huaibei
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日上午，飞灰资源化利用专题调研座谈会在淮北召开，中国工程院院士武强出席，市委副书记、代市长黄韡介绍该市固废治理情况。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 14, a symposium on fly ash resource utilization was held in Huaibei. Academician Wu Qiang attended, and acting mayor Huang Wei briefed on the city's solid waste management.

articles.title_zh: 贯彻落实《中部崛起安徽省“十五五”实施方案》工作推进会召开，蒋曦主持并讲话，黄韡出席
articles.title_en: Huaibei Meeting on Implementing Anhui's 15th Five-Year Plan for the Rise of Central China; Jiang Xi Chairs and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日下午，淮北市委书记蒋曦主持召开贯彻落实《中部崛起安徽省“十五五”实施方案》工作推进会，代市长黄韡等出席，研究细化落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 14, Huaibei Party Secretary Jiang Xi chaired a meeting on implementing Anhui's 15th Five-Year Plan for the Rise of Central China, with Acting Mayor Huang Wei and other officials attending to refine local measures.

articles.title_zh: 贴心服务打造制造业产业集群
articles.title_en: Full-Cycle Services Build Up Huainan High-Tech Zone's Manufacturing Cluster
articles.summary_zh: 淮南高新区以全周期服务推动制造业发展，1—6月制造业投资同比增长121.8%，今年以来累计引进27家制造业企业。
articles.summary_en: Huainan High-tech Industrial Development Zone reported 121.8% year-on-year growth in manufacturing investment in the first half of the year and has attracted 27 manufacturing firms so far this year.

articles.title_zh: 淮南市人大常委会开展优化营商环境工作专题询问
articles.title_en: Huainan Municipal People's Congress Holds Special Inquiry on Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，淮南市人大常委会第三十七次会议举行联组会议，就优化营商环境开展专题询问，市委书记朱艾勇到会指导，市人大常委会主任陈儒江主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, the Huainan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a joint session on improving the business environment, with Party Secretary Zhu Aiyong attending and director Chen Rujiang chairing.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保出席揭阳市2026年下半年新兵入伍欢送仪式
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Attends Jieyang Farewell Ceremony for 2026 Second-Half New Military Recruits
articles.summary_zh: 9月13日上午，揭阳市在揭阳学宫广场举行2026年下半年新兵入伍欢送仪式，市委书记曾风保出席并讲话，新兵巡游古城后踏上军旅征程。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 13, Jieyang held a farewell ceremony at Jieyang Xuegong Square for new recruits joining the military in the second half of 2026; Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 王君正：认真学习贯彻《中华人民共和国民族团结进步促进法》 扎实推进中华民族共同体建设
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng: Study and Implement the Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress, Advance the Building of a Community for the Chinese Nation
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨主持召开自治区党委理论学习中心组学习会，强调学习贯彻民族团结进步促进法，推进中华民族共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: Tibet Party Secretary Wang Junzheng chaired a regional Party Committee study session in Lhasa on Sept 11, calling for implementation of the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森在辽河石油职业技术学院调研并讲授思政课
articles.title_en: Panjin Party Secretary Wang Bingsen Inspects Liaohe Petroleum Vocational College and Delivers Ideological Lecture
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，盘锦市委书记王炳森到辽河石油职业技术学院调研实训教学，并以强国建设、民族复兴为主题为约400名师生讲授思政课。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Panjin Party Secretary Wang Bingsen inspected training facilities at Liaohe Petroleum Vocational and Technical College and gave an ideological lecture on national rejuvenation to about 400 teachers and students.

articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng: Study and Implement the Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress, Advance the Building of a Chinese National Community
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨主持召开自治区党委理论学习中心组学习会，强调学习贯彻《民族团结进步促进法》，扎实推进中华民族共同体建设。

articles.title_zh: 习近平将赴印度出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 18th BRICS Summit in India
articles.summary_zh: 应印度总理莫迪邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月12日至13日赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，擘画“大金砖合作”高质量发展蓝图。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Modi, President Xi Jinping will attend the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi on Sept 12-13, aiming to advance high-quality "Greater BRICS" cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王君正在拉萨市调研：扎实推进中华民族共同体建设
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Inspects Lhasa, Stressing Efforts to Build the Community for the Chinese Nation
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨市调研，走访社区家史馆、古建大院和寺庙，强调全面贯彻新时代党的治藏方略，扎实推进中华民族共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Wang Junzheng inspected Lhasa, visiting a community history hall, a restored heritage courtyard and a monastery, urging full implementation of the Party's Tibet policy and steady progress in building the community for the Chinese nation.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市人民政府与东北电力大学举行签约仪式 携手共建东北电力大学汕尾研究院
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Government and Northeast Electric Power University Sign Agreement to Build Shanwei Research Institute
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，汕尾市人民政府与东北电力大学签署合作协议，共建东北电力大学汕尾研究院，逯峰、李书研、蔡国伟、李英峰共同见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the Shanwei Municipal Government and Northeast Electric Power University signed an agreement to jointly build the university's Shanwei Research Institute, witnessed by local and university leaders.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市人民政府与东北电力大学签署共建汕尾研究院合作协议
articles.title_en: Shanwei City Government and Northeast Electric Power University Sign Agreement to Build Shanwei Research Institute
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，汕尾市人民政府与东北电力大学举行共建东北电力大学汕尾研究院合作协议签约仪式，逯峰、李书研、蔡国伟、李英峰共同见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, the Shanwei Municipal People's Government and Northeast Electric Power University signed a cooperation agreement to jointly build the Northeast Electric Power University Shanwei Research Institute, with Lu Feng and university leaders witnessing the signing.

articles.title_zh: 徐龙在全市金融企业座谈会上强调 凝聚金融发展合力 助推全市高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xu Long Stresses Pooling Financial Strength to Boost Shizuishan's High-Quality Development at City Financial Enterprises Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，石嘴山市委副书记、市长徐龙主持召开全市金融企业座谈会，听取10余家金融和保险企业意见，强调凝聚金融合力、服务实体经济与高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Shizuishan Mayor Xu Long chaired a city symposium with more than 10 financial and insurance enterprises, urging coordinated efforts to serve the real economy and boost high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府召开常务会议 刘小涛主持研究交通运输、财政改革、青年社区等工作
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting Chaired by Liu Xiaotao on Transport, Fiscal Reform and Youth Communities
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开省政府常务会议，审议江苏省“十五五”综合交通运输体系发展规划和关于支持青年社区建设的若干措施，并研究财政改革等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired an executive meeting of the provincial government, reviewing the province's 15th Five-Year Plan for integrated transport and measures to support youth community development, and studying fiscal reform.

articles.title_zh: 住济南市全国、省人大代表来威开展专题调研
articles.title_en: National and Provincial People's Congress Deputies Based in Jinan Conduct Thematic Research in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日至11日，济南市人大常委会主任韩金峰带领部分住济南市全国、省人大代表来威海，围绕精致城市建设和重点项目建设情况开展专题调研，并实地查看多个重点项目。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 10 to 11, Han Jinfeng, director of the Jinan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, led national and provincial people's congress deputies based in Jinan on a thematic research trip to Weihai focused on refined urban development and key project construction.

articles.title_zh: 张海波安排部署安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Deploys Safety Production Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，威海市领导张海波等在威海分会场参加省委常委会会议暨省人民政府安全生产委员会扩大会议，会后张海波对当前安全生产工作作出安排部署。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Zhang Haibo attended a provincial safety production meeting in Weihai and then deployed local safety work, urging fire, maritime, traffic and workplace risk inspections.

articles.title_zh: 陈东赴北交所考察交流
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Visits Beijing Stock Exchange for Cooperation Talks
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东率队赴北京证券交易所考察交流，希望建立常态化合作机制，助力更多芜湖优质企业进入资本市场。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Chen Dong, deputy secretary of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, led a delegation to the Beijing Stock Exchange to discuss building a regular cooperation mechanism and helping more Wuhu firms access capital markets.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council General Offices Issue Measures for Accountability of Party and Government Leading Cadres for Ecological and Environmental Damage
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅近日印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》，明确党政同责、失职追责、终身追究，要求各地区各部门遵照执行。
articles.summary_en: The General Offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued newly revised measures holding party and government leading cadres accountable for ecological and environmental damage, stressing shared party-government responsibility and lifelong accountability.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见印度总理莫迪
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Indian Prime Minister Modi
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤期间会见印度总理莫迪，双方就中印要做伙伴而不是对手达成重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi during the 18th BRICS Summit, with both sides agreeing that China and India should be partners rather than rivals.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends First Session of 18th BRICS Summit and Delivers Keynote Speech
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间2026年9月12日，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议并发表重要讲话，强调金砖国家要勇做时代先锋。
articles.summary_en: On September 12, 2026, President Xi Jinping attended the first session of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi and delivered a keynote speech urging BRICS nations to lead as pioneers of the times.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先督导基孔肯雅热疫情防控工作
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Supervises Chikungunya Fever Prevention and Control Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，阳江市委书记卢一先到江城区督导基孔肯雅热疫情防控工作，要求压实责任、加强排查消杀和宣传，筑牢公共卫生防线。
articles.summary_en: On September 12, Yangjiang Party Secretary Lu Yixian inspected Jiangcheng District for chikungunya fever prevention and control, urging stronger measures to protect public health.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市召开安全生产紧急视频调度会 李劲松出席
articles.title_en: Yueyang City Holds Emergency Video Meeting on Workplace Safety; Li Jinsong Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日下午，岳阳市召开全市安全生产紧急视频调度会，市委常委、常务副市长李劲松出席并要求强化船舶制造等重点领域安全监管。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 11, Yueyang City held an emergency video meeting on workplace safety, attended by Li Jinsong, member of the municipal Party standing committee and executive vice mayor, who urged stronger safety oversight in shipbuilding and other key sectors.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅 中央军委办公厅印发《退役军人服务和保障“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Central Offices Issue 15th Five-Year Plan for Veterans' Services and Support
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅、中央军委办公厅印发《退役军人服务和保障“十五五”规划》，对“十五五”时期退役军人工作作出部署，涵盖安置就业、拥军优属和服务保障等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, the General Offices of the CPC Central Committee, the State Council and the Central Military Commission issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for veterans' services and support, setting out key tasks on resettlement, employment, and support for service members and their families.

articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council General Offices Issue Measures on Accountability for Ecological and Environmental Damage by Leading Party and Government Officials
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅近日印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》并发出通知，要求各地区各部门遵照执行，明确党政同责、失职追责、终身追究。
articles.summary_en: The general offices of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council issued revised measures on holding leading Party and government officials accountable for ecological and environmental damage, requiring all regions and departments to comply.

articles.title_zh: 市委就市第十三次党代会报告（征求意见稿）广泛征求意见建议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Seeks Comments on Draft Report for 13th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，福州市委书记郭宁宁、市长吴贤德等市领导先后召开22场座谈会，就市第十三次党代会报告（征求意见稿）向各界广泛征求意见建议。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning and Mayor Wu Xiande held 22 symposia to solicit opinions from various sectors on the draft report for the city's 13th Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 福州市政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，福州市市长吴贤德主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，研究侨务工作贯彻落实措施，并审议应急体系、能源发展、数字福州三项“十五五”专项规划。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired a municipal government Party group meeting and executive meeting to implement directives on overseas Chinese affairs and review three 15th Five-Year Plan special plans on emergency response, energy and digital Fuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 福州市政府召开党组（扩大）会议 深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于社会工作和基层工作方法的重要论述
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Expanded Party Group Meeting on Social Work and Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，福州市政府召开党组（扩大）会议，市长吴贤德主持并发言，集中学习研讨习近平总书记关于社会工作和基层工作方法的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired an expanded Party group meeting of the municipal government to study Xi Jinping's expositions on social work and grassroots governance methods.

articles.title_zh: 市政协党组扩大会议召开，孟庆斌主持会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Qingdao CPPCC Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting, Meng Qingbin Presides and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日下午，青岛市政协党组扩大会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章和重要讲话精神，市政协党组书记、主席孟庆斌主持并讲话。会后接续召开主席会议研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 14, the Party Group of the Qingdao CPPCC held an enlarged meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important articles and speeches, chaired by CPPCC Chairman Meng Qingbin; a chairpersons' meeting followed.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就深化金砖合作提出5项倡议
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Proposes Five Initiatives to Deepen BRICS Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月13日上午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第二阶段会议，就深化金砖合作提出人工智能开源普惠、贸易投资便利化等5项倡议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 13 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the second session of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi, where he proposed five initiatives to deepen BRICS cooperation, including AI open-source accessibility and trade and investment facilitation.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台12条措施加力支持工业企业技术改造
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues 12 Measures to Boost Technological Upgrading of Industrial Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省政府办公厅印发《关于加力支持工业企业技术改造的若干措施》，共出台12条举措，单个企业重大技改项目最高可获1500万元支持，协同攻关项目最高支持3000万元。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Jiangsu Provincial Government issued 12 measures to step up support for technological upgrading of industrial enterprises, with up to 15 million yuan for major projects and 30 million yuan for collaborative research.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国—东盟人工智能部长圆桌会议将在南宁举办
articles.title_en: 2026 China-ASEAN AI Ministers' Roundtable to Be Held in Nanning
articles.summary_zh: 2026中国—东盟人工智能部长圆桌会议将于9月17日在南宁举办，中国与东盟11国主管部门官员及企业、科研、金融机构代表将围绕AI安全伦理、区域协同治理与产业合作深入交流。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China-ASEAN AI Ministers' Roundtable will be held in Nanning on September 17, bringing together officials from China and 11 ASEAN countries plus business, research and financial representatives to discuss AI safety ethics, regional governance and industrial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 2026年国家网络安全宣传周驻马店市活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Cybersecurity Awareness Week Kicks Off in Zhumadian
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，2026年国家网络安全宣传周驻马店市活动在驻马店职业技术学院启动，市委常委、宣传部部长宋庆林出席启动仪式并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, Zhumadian launched its 2026 National Cybersecurity Awareness Week activities, with municipal propaganda chief Song Qinglin speaking at the ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府常务会议，审议通过《黑龙江省扩大消费“十五五”规划》，研究人口发展和农村公路有关工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a provincial government executive meeting, approving the 15th Five-Year Plan for expanding consumption and studying population development and rural road work.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省成立特色产业科技小院集群 聚链赋能乡村振兴
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Establishes Cluster of Science and Technology Backyards for Specialty Industries to Boost Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 2026年黑龙江省全国科普月主场活动上，黑龙江省整合水稻、大豆、食用菌、甜菜四大产业23个科技小院，正式成立4个特色产业科技小院集群，助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Heilongjiang National Science Popularization Month launch event, Heilongjiang Province formally established four specialty-industry science and technology backyard clusters by integrating 23 backyards across rice, soybean, edible fungi and sugar beet industries to boost rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 《数字乡村高质量发展行动计划（2026—2030年）》发布
articles.title_en: China Releases Action Plan for High-Quality Development of Digital Villages (2026-2030)
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办、农业农村部、工业和信息化部联合印发《数字乡村高质量发展行动计划（2026—2030年）》，明确到2030年的8项主要发展指标，部署5个方面24项工作举措。
articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued a 2026-2030 action plan for high-quality digital village development, setting 8 targets for 2030 and 24 measures across 5 areas.

articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，“石榴花开·籽籽同心”网络主题传播活动启动仪式在呼和浩特举行，活动由中央网信办网络传播局指导、内蒙古自治区党委网信办主办，将持续至2026年11月。
articles.summary_en: The launch ceremony of the "Pomegranate Flowers Bloom, Seeds United" online communication campaign was held in Hohhot on Sept 14, guided by the Cyberspace Administration of China and hosted by Inner Mongolia's regional cyberspace office, running through November 2026.

articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，2026年宁夏网络安全宣传周在银川启动，活动持续至9月20日，聚焦网络安全普及与智能风险防范。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the 2026 Ningxia Cybersecurity Awareness Week opened in Yinchuan, running through September 20 and focusing on cybersecurity education and smart risk prevention.

articles.title_zh: 青海省人大常委会主要领导与在宁退休省级老领导座谈交流
articles.title_en: Qinghai Provincial People's Congress Leaders Meet Retired Provincial Officials in Xining
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，青海省人大常委会党组书记、副主任杨逢春等与在宁退休省级老领导座谈，就老干部服务管理、医疗保障、活动组织等征求意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, senior leaders of the Qinghai Provincial People's Congress, including Yang Fengchun, met retired provincial officials in Xining to seek their views on services, medical care and activities for retired cadres.

articles.title_zh: 杨逢春带队赴新疆学习调研
articles.title_en: Yang Fengchun Leads Delegation to Xinjiang for Study and Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月6日，青海省人大常委会党组书记、副主任杨逢春带队赴新疆，围绕民族团结进步、生态文明建设和人大自身建设开展学习调研。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 31 to Sept 6, Yang Fengchun, a senior Qinghai provincial legislature official, led a delegation to Xinjiang to study ethnic unity, ecological governance and people's congress work.

articles.title_zh: 以税助“绿”，成都激活新能源产业新质生产力
articles.title_en: Chengdu Tax Authorities Support Green Growth, Boosting New Quality Productive Forces in New Energy Industry
articles.summary_zh: 成都市税务部门聚焦新能源领域专精特新与高新技术企业，搭建全生命周期税费服务体系，精准推送留抵退税、研发费用加计扣除等政策，助力绿色低碳产业发展。
articles.summary_en: Chengdu tax authorities have built a full-lifecycle tax service system for new energy firms, delivering VAT credit refunds and R&D expense deductions to support green, low-carbon industry growth.

articles.title_en: China Releases AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，全国网络安全标准化技术委员会在2026年国家网络安全宣传周开幕式上发布《人工智能安全治理框架3.0》，更新人工智能风险分类与治理措施。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, the National Technical Committee 260 on Cybersecurity released AI Safety Governance Framework 3.0 at the opening of 2026 National Cybersecurity Week, updating AI risk categories and governance measures.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府召开常务会议 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Jiangsu Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，江苏省政府召开常务会议，省长刘小涛主持，研究优化交通运输、财政改革、青年社区等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired a provincial government executive meeting to study transport optimization, fiscal reform and youth community development.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解修齐治平、兴亡有责的家国情怀
articles.title_en: Deeply Understanding the Family-Country Sentiment of "Self-Cultivation, Family Harmony, State Governance, World Peace" and "Everyone Shares Responsibility for the Nation's Rise and Fall"
articles.summary_zh: 《瞭望》刊发理论文章，阐释修齐治平、兴亡有责的家国情怀的历史底蕴与时代内涵，强调将其融入新时代家风建设和爱国主义教育。
articles.summary_en: Outlook Weekly published a theoretical article on the historical roots and modern meaning of China's family-country sentiment, urging its integration into family tradition building and patriotic education.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 国家卫健委：进一步营造生育友好环境
articles.title_en: National Health Commission: Further Building a Fertility-Friendly Environment
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，国家卫健委主任雷海潮在国新办“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会上表示，将推进托幼一体化，支持社区和用人单位办托育，降低家庭生育养育教育成本。
articles.summary_en: On September 14, National Health Commission Director Lei Haiqing said at a State Council Information Office briefing on the 15th Five-Year Plan that China will advance integrated childcare and preschool services, support community- and employer-run nurseries, and cut family costs of childbearing and rearing.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部：健全行业账款支付规则
articles.title_en: MIIT to Improve Industry Rules on Payment of Accounts
articles.summary_zh: 9月14日，工业和信息化部副部长柯吉欣在国务院政策例行吹风会上表示，将健全行业账款支付规则，分行业明确合理账期，推动龙头企业率先践行60日付现承诺。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 14, MIIT Vice Minister Ke Jixin said at a State Council briefing that industry payment rules will be improved, with reasonable payment terms set by sector and leading firms urged to pay within 60 days.

articles.title_en: National Healthcare Security Administration Releases Medical Procurement Commercial Bribery Cases
articles.summary_zh: 国家医保局公布医药购销领域商业贿赂案源，河北医科大学第二医院工作人员收受30余家药企贿赂，累计涉案金额1.84亿元，相关线索已通报河北省医保局。
articles.summary_en: China's National Healthcare Security Administration disclosed commercial bribery cases in medical procurement, saying staff at the Second Hospital of Hebei Medical University took bribes from over 30 drug and device firms totaling 184 million yuan; the leads were referred to Hebei's healthcare security bureau.
