articles.title_zh: 20年再出发，习近平强调金砖国家要做四个“先锋”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Stresses BRICS Should Be Four "Pioneers" as Cooperation Marks 20 Years
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，习近平在印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤并会见印度总理莫迪，提出金砖要做四个“先锋”，并宣布中国将于2027年接任金砖主席国。
articles.summary_en: On September 12, Xi Jinping attended the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi and met Indian Prime Minister Modi, calling on BRICS to serve as four "pioneers" and announcing China will chair BRICS in 2027.

articles.title_zh: 检察机关公益诉讼守护绿色生态与红色根脉 四川宝兴探索特色保护路径
articles.title_en: Procuratorial Public Interest Litigation Guards Ecology and Red Heritage as Sichuan's Baoxing Explores Distinctive Protection Path
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，最高人民检察院“新时代法律监督工作巡礼”专题采访活动走进四川雅安宝兴县，采访团实地了解当地生态环境与红色资源保护公益诉讼工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, a Supreme People's Procuratorate media tour visited Baoxing County in Ya'an, Sichuan, to learn about local public interest litigation protecting the ecology and Red Army heritage sites.

articles.title_zh: 携手开启金砖合作新的“金色十年”——国际社会对中国明年接任金砖主席国满怀期待
articles.title_en: China to Take Over BRICS Chairmanship Next Year, Opening a New "Golden Decade" for BRICS Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤时宣布，中国将于明年接任金砖主席国并主办第十九次会晤，国际社会对此充满期待。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, Xi Jinping announced in New Delhi at the 18th BRICS Summit that China will take over the BRICS chairmanship next year and host the 19th summit, drawing broad international expectations.

articles.title_zh: 立足港澳实践 学者探讨“两制”台湾方案制度设计及有效治理
articles.title_en: Scholars Discuss Institutional Design and Governance of 'Two Systems' Taiwan Plan Based on Hong Kong-Macau Practice
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，“一国两制”港澳实践与“两制”台湾方案制度设计及有效治理座谈会在北京举行，与会学者围绕台湾方案的制度探索与治理问题展开探讨。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, scholars met in Beijing to discuss the institutional design and governance of the 'Two Systems' Taiwan plan, drawing on Hong Kong and Macau practice.

articles.title_en: Beijing Cross-Strait Calligraphers and Painters Association Holds 9th First Member Meeting in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日下午，北京海峡两岸书画家联谊会第九届第一次会员大会在北京召开，选举产生新一届理事会，王强当选第九届理事长，北京市台办主任霍光峰出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, the Beijing Cross-Strait Calligraphers and Painters Association held its 9th first member meeting in Beijing, electing Wang Qiang as its new chairman; Beijing Taiwan affairs chief Huo Guangfeng attended and spoke.

articles.summary_zh: 习近平指出，中方始终从战略高度和长远角度看待和发展中印关系，从喀山、天津到新德里，中印领导人连续三年双边会晤中，习主席均提到“发展”这一最大“公约数”。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping said China views and develops China-India relations from a strategic and long-term perspective, stressing "development" as the biggest common denominator across three consecutive years of bilateral summits in Kazan, Tianjin and New Delhi.

articles.title_zh: 习近平宣布中国明年接任金砖主席国并主办第十九次会晤
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Announces China Will Chair BRICS and Host 19th BRICS Summit Next Year
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤时宣布，中国明年将接任金砖主席国并主办第十九次会晤。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 12, President Xi Jinping announced at the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit in New Delhi that China will take over the BRICS chairmanship next year and host the 19th summit.

articles.title_zh: 4人编造传播税率调整虚假信息被证监会处罚
articles.title_en: CSRC Penalizes Four Individuals for Fabricating and Spreading False Information
articles.summary_zh: 证监会公布4份行政处罚决定书，对编造、传播税率调整虚假信息的宗建树、马星瑞、卢润凯、陈广华分别作出市场禁入和罚款处罚。
articles.summary_en: China's securities regulator published four administrative penalty decisions against four individuals for fabricating and spreading false information about tax rate adjustments, imposing a five-year market ban and fines of up to 300,000 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 专访｜葡共中央委员洛佩斯：延安精神是共产主义的基石，中国式现代化为世界提供示范
articles.title_en: Interview: Portuguese Communist Party Official Lopes Says Yan'an Spirit Is the Cornerstone of Communism and Chinese-Style Modernization Offers a Model to the World
articles.summary_zh: 在中联部于延安举办的“两个结合开辟中国式现代化之路”宣介会期间，葡共中央政治执行委员会委员洛佩斯接受澎湃新闻专访，称延安精神是共产主义基石，中国式现代化为世界提供示范。
articles.summary_en: Portuguese Communist Party official João Pedro do Carmo Lopes told The Paper that the Yan'an spirit is communism's cornerstone and that Chinese-style modernization offers the world a model.

articles.title_zh: 海南省社会科学界联合会第六次代表大会开幕 冯飞讲话
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Speaks at Opening of Hainan Federation of Social Sciences' Sixth Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，海南省社会科学界联合会第六次代表大会在海口开幕，省委书记冯飞出席并讲话，强调谱写构建中国哲学社会科学自主知识体系的海南篇章。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, the sixth congress of the Hainan Federation of Social Sciences opened in Haikou, where provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei urged building Hainan's own knowledge system for philosophy and social sciences.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省遥感学会正式成立
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Remote Sensing Society Officially Established
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，黑龙江省遥感学会成立大会暨第一次会员代表大会在东北农业大学召开，选举产生首届理事会和监事会，标志该省遥感领域首个省级学术社会团体成立。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, the founding congress of the Heilongjiang Remote Sensing Society was held at Northeast Agricultural University, where its first council and supervisory board were elected, marking the province's first provincial-level academic body in remote sensing.

articles.summary_en: Lu Xiaoqing, a member of the CPC Jiangxi Provincial Standing Committee and head of its publicity department, inspected Ganzhou on Sept 8-9, calling for deeper integration of commerce, agriculture, culture, tourism and sports.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古电力交易市场新能源交易领跑全国省级市场
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Power Trading Market Leads Provincial Markets in New Energy Trading
articles.summary_zh: 据内蒙古电力集团消息，9月9日，内蒙古电力多边交易市场新能源交易累计结算电量达5095.8亿千瓦时，突破5000亿千瓦时，领跑全国省级市场。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, cumulative settled new energy trading on Inner Mongolia's multilateral power market topped 500 billion kWh, reaching 509.58 billion kWh and leading all provincial markets in China.

articles.summary_en: The Central Organization Department, together with the publicity, education, science and technology, and health authorities, revised and issued five measures governing leaders of public institutions in culture, schools, research and hospitals.

articles.summary_en: The Central Organization Department, together with the Publicity, Education, Science and Technology, and Health Commissions, has revised five sets of rules for leaders of public institutions, with officials answering reporters' questions.

articles.summary_zh: 9月8日至12日，全国政协副主席、九三学社中央常务副主席邵鸿在青海出席九三学社全国机关建设工作会议，并赴西宁、海西、海南等地调研文旅融合工作。
articles.summary_en: From September 8 to 12, Shao Hong, Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee and Executive Vice Chairman of the Jiusan Society Central Committee, attended the Jiusan Society's national institution-building meeting in Qinghai and surveyed cultural-tourism integration in Xining, Haixi and Hainan prefectures.

articles.summary_en: On September 12, Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan met in Xining with IRENA Director-General Francesco La Camera and signed a memorandum on solar thermal research and cooperation.

articles.title_en: 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum Opens in Shanghai, Deepening Open Cooperation to Build a Global Science and Technology Community
articles.summary_zh: 2026浦江创新论坛9月12日在上海开幕，上海市委书记陈吉宁出席致辞，科技部部长阴和俊、南非科技创新部长恩齐曼迪作主旨演讲，长三角科学数据共享服务平台启动共建。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum opened in Shanghai on Sept 12, with Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining delivering remarks, and ministers Yin Hejun and Blade Nzimande giving keynote speeches; the Yangtze River Delta science data sharing platform was launched.

articles.title_zh: 何报翔率队赴云南调研 推动高载能产业有序西移
articles.title_en: He Baoxiang Leads CPPCC Delegation to Yunnan on Orderly Westward Relocation of Energy-Intensive Industries
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日至11日，全国政协副主席、民革中央常务副主席何报翔率调研组赴云南曲靖、昭通、昆明，围绕推动高载能产业有序西移、促进能源就地消纳开展实地调研并在昆明座谈。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 8 to 11, He Baoxiang, Vice Chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, led a research team to Qujing, Zhaotong and Kunming in Yunnan to study the orderly westward relocation of energy-intensive industries and local energy consumption, holding a symposium in Kunming.

articles.title_zh: 千里沃野夺秋收
articles.title_en: Across Vast Farmlands, China Races to Secure the Autumn Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 2026年秋收前约20天，记者在吉林、黑龙江、河南、山东、四川、广西等地走访了解到，各地各部门抢抓秋粮生长最后窗口期，以精细田管、数字农技和农资保供全力夺取秋粮和全年粮食丰收。
articles.summary_en: About 20 days before the large-scale autumn harvest, reporters in Jilin, Heilongjiang, Henan, Shandong, Sichuan and Guangxi found localities stepping up field management, agricultural technology and farm-input supply to secure the autumn and full-year grain harvest.

articles.title_zh: 从“京交会”到“服贸会” 中国服务贸易开放合作“朋友圈”持续扩容
articles.title_en: From CIFTIS to the Services Trade Fair: China's Opening-Up in Services Trade Continues to Expand
articles.summary_zh: 2026年中国国际服务贸易交易会9月在北京举行，90个国家和国际组织、1830余家企业线下参展，服贸会与广交会、进博会并称中国对外开放三大展会平台。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services is being held in Beijing, with 90 countries, regions and international organizations and over 1,830 companies exhibiting offline, as the fair joins the Canton Fair and CIIE as one of China's three major opening-up platforms.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第二阶段会议的讲话（全文）
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the Second Session of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月13日，国家主席习近平在印度新德里举行的金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第二阶段会议上发表讲话，提出人工智能开源普惠等五项合作倡议。
articles.summary_en: On September 13, 2026, President Xi Jinping addressed the second session of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi, India, proposing five cooperation initiatives including AI open-source inclusiveness.

articles.title_zh: 习近平圆满结束出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Concludes Attendance at 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月13日中午，国家主席习近平圆满结束出席在印度新德里举行的金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，启程返回北京，印度政府高级官员到机场送行。
articles.summary_en: At noon local time on September 13, President Xi Jinping concluded his attendance at the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit in New Delhi, India, and departed for Beijing, seen off at the airport by senior Indian government officials.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺与来皖院士专家举行工作座谈
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Holds Working Discussion with Academicians and Experts Visiting Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日下午，安徽省委书记梁言顺在合肥与来皖指导董铺水库、大房郢水库等老旧水库改造提升的院士专家举行工作座谈，强调统筹推进老旧水库改造提升、筑牢水库安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 11, Anhui Party Secretary Liang Yanshun held a working discussion in Hefei with academicians and experts advising on the renovation of aging reservoirs including Dongpu and Dafangying, urging coordinated upgrades to secure reservoir safety.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚在柳州调研
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Conducts Research Tour in Liuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日至11日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚在柳州调研，走访地震灾后安置区、基层派出所、机器人工厂和农业基地，强调做强特色产业、推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 9-11, Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang inspected Liuzhou, visiting quake resettlement housing, a grassroots police station, a humanoid robot factory and farm bases, urging stronger specialty industries.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁会见澳门特别行政区第十四届全国人大代表视察组一行
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Meets NPC Deputy Inspection Delegation from the Macao SAR
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，河南省委书记、省人大常委会主任刘宁在郑州会见以刘艺良为组长的澳门特别行政区第十四届全国人大代表视察组，双方就深化豫澳经贸、文旅、科技等领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, Henan Party Secretary Liu Ning met in Zhengzhou with an inspection delegation of NPC deputies from the Macao SAR led by Liu Yiliang, discussing deeper Henan-Macao cooperation in trade, culture, tourism and technology.

articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，2026腾冲科学家论坛·生物制造与食品产业创新发展专题活动在云南省红河州弥勒市开幕，约400名院士专家和代表参加，现场举行“双招双引”合作项目签约。

articles.title_zh: “红通人员”曾能贵被引渡回国
articles.title_en: Red Notice Fugitive Zeng Nenggui Extradited to China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月，在中央反腐败协调小组国际追逃追赃工作办公室统筹协调下，外逃职务犯罪嫌疑人、“红通人员”曾能贵经国际执法司法合作被引渡回国。其原任江西瑞金市扶贫和移民办主任，涉嫌在扶贫项目中收受贿赂。
articles.summary_en: In September 2026, Zeng Nenggui, a fugitive former official on Interpol's Red Notice list, was extradited to China through international law enforcement and judicial cooperation coordinated by the central anti-corruption fugitive-repatriation office. He is suspected of taking bribes in poverty-alleviation projects while serving as head of Ruijin City's poverty alleviation and resettlement office in Jiangxi.

articles.title_zh: 共同谱写“大金砖合作”高质量发展新篇章——国际社会热切期待习近平主席出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤
articles.title_en: International Community Expects Xi Jinping's Attendance at 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit to Open a New Chapter in High-Quality "Greater BRICS Cooperation"
articles.summary_zh: 应印度总理莫迪邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月12日至13日赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，国际社会对此充满期待。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Modi, President Xi Jinping will travel to New Delhi on September 12-13 to attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit, with the international community expecting new momentum for cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 多项先行指标释放积极信号 经济内生动力持续增强
articles.title_en: Multiple Leading Indicators Signal Positive Momentum as China's Economic Vitality Strengthens
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委国家信息中心最新数据显示，8月份重大项目建设提速、算力等前沿领域投资大幅增长、线下消费持续改善，经济发展内生动力持续增强。
articles.summary_en: The latest data from the National Information Center under the National Development and Reform Commission show that in August major project construction accelerated, investment in cutting-edge fields such as computing power surged, and offline consumption continued to improve, pointing to stronger endogenous momentum in China's economy.

articles.title_zh: 习近平离京赴新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Departs for New Delhi to Attend 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日上午，国家主席习近平乘专机离开北京赴新德里，应印度总理莫迪邀请出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，蔡奇、王毅等陪同出访。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 12, President Xi Jinping left Beijing by special plane for New Delhi at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Modi to attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit, accompanied by Cai Qi and Wang Yi.

articles.title_zh: 共同建设普惠、创新、协同的亚太能源共同体——第十六次亚太经合组织能源部长会议形成重要共识成果
articles.title_en: Building an Inclusive, Innovative and Coordinated Asia-Pacific Energy Community: 16th APEC Energy Ministers' Meeting Reaches Key Consensus
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日至11日，第十六次亚太经合组织能源部长会议在北京召开，形成“1+3+5”成果体系，首次提出并阐释“亚太能源共同体”概念。
articles.summary_en: APEC energy ministers met in Beijing on Sept 10-11, producing a "1+3+5" outcome package and a joint statement that first put forward the concept of an Asia-Pacific Energy Community.

articles.title_zh: 我国对其他金砖国家直接投资稳步增长
articles.title_en: China's Direct Investment in Other BRICS Countries Grows Steadily
articles.summary_zh: 商务部数据显示，截至2025年末中国对其他金砖国家直接投资存量达820亿美元，今年1—7月直接投资约40亿美元，主要投向制造、建筑、电力等领域。
articles.summary_en: Data from China's Ministry of Commerce show that by end-2025 China's direct investment stock in other BRICS countries reached US$82 billion, with about US$4 billion invested in January-July this year, mainly in manufacturing, construction and power.

articles.title_zh: 大连市召开领导干部大会 宣布中央关于大连市委主要领导调整的决定

articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，大连市召开领导干部大会，宣布中央决定：李强任辽宁省委常委、大连市委书记，免去熊茂平相关职务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, Dalian held a leadership meeting where Beijing's decision was announced: Li Qiang became Liaoning Party Standing Committee member and Dalian Party Secretary, replacing Xiong Maoping.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛在淮安宿迁调研
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao Inspects Huai'an and Suqian

articles.summary_en: From Sept 9 to 10, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao inspected Huai'an and Suqian, urging tailored growth of county-level industries and coordinated urban-rural development.

articles.title_zh: 于海田主持召开市政府常务会议 研究安全生产等事项

articles.summary_en: On September 11, Jinan Mayor Yu Haitian chaired a municipal government executive meeting to address workplace safety and the management of motor vehicle parking fees.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met jointly with the municipal Party building leading group to study Xi Jinping's important instructions on cultivating a correct view of political achievements, review the education campaign and plan long-term mechanisms; Party Secretary Lu Feng presided.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 逯峰主持

articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Shanwei Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired a municipal Party committee meeting on the "Hundred-Thousand-Ten Thousand Project", reviewing work in Lufeng City and Jieshi Town and planning county-level economic development.

articles.title_zh: 省人大常委会副主任魏国强带队赴泰州调研

articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Yancheng hosted the 2026 Multinational Companies Jiangsu Tour zero-carbon industrial park cooperation conference, where 25 cooperation projects were signed.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Yancheng signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Datang Jiangsu Power Generation, deepening cooperation in offshore wind, solar power and green low-carbon energy.

articles.summary_en: On September 11, Zhanjiang held a meeting to advance safe city construction. Party Secretary Yu Gang spoke, and Mayor Li Yongyi presided over the session, outlining plans for a higher-level Safe Zhanjiang.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 11, the Standing Committee of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee met to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's speeches and review the province's 15th Five-Year Plan for the marine economy. Party Secretary Lin Wu chaired the meeting.

articles.summary_zh: 在第四十二个教师节到来之际，习近平代表党中央向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺，希望广大教师大力弘扬教育家精神、落实立德树人根本任务。
articles.summary_en: On China's 42nd Teachers' Day, Xi Jinping extended holiday greetings to teachers and educators nationwide on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, urging them to carry forward the educators' spirit and fulfill the mission of fostering virtue through education.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 12, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong made unannounced inspections of workplace safety in Qingdao, checking hazard screening and safety measures at a shipbuilding firm and a fishing port.

articles.title_en: Yin Li: Keep Advancing "Two Zones" Development at a High Standard to Boost Beijing's New Momentum for Opening Up
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，北京市委书记尹力在北京经济技术开发区和大兴区调研“两区”建设，强调深化改革创新、高标准推进“两区”建设，增强北京开放发展新动能，市长殷勇一同调研。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li inspected the Beijing E-Town development area and Daxing District, urging high-standard "Two Zones" construction to boost the capital's opening-up momentum.

articles.title_zh: 福建省文明乡风建设现场交流活动在惠安举行
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial On-Site Meeting on Civilized Rural Culture Held in Hui'an
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日至11日，2026年福建省文明乡风建设现场交流活动在泉州惠安县举行，主题为“文明有象·和美乡村”，福建省委常委、宣传部部长张彦出席并就农村精神文明建设提出要求。
articles.summary_en: Fujian held a provincial on-site exchange meeting on civilized rural culture in Hui'an County, Quanzhou on Sept 10-11, under the theme 'Civilized and Beautiful Countryside,' with provincial publicity chief Zhang Yan attending.

articles.title_zh: 海峡两岸（厦门）短剧交流汇将于10月在集美举行
articles.title_en: Cross-Strait (Xiamen) Short Drama Exchange to Be Held in Jimei in October
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，2026海峡两岸（厦门）短剧交流汇新闻发布会在厦门举行，宣布交流汇将于10月下旬在集美举办，推动两岸短剧产业深度合作。
articles.summary_en: A Sept 11 press conference in Xiamen announced the 2026 Cross-Strait (Xiamen) Short Drama Exchange will be held in Jimei in late October, aiming to deepen cross-strait short drama industry cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 2026年两岸媒体人甘肃行活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Cross-Strait Media Tour of Gansu Launches
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，2026年两岸媒体人甘肃行活动在兰州启动，20余位两岸及香港媒体人将开展为期8天的联合采访。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 cross-strait media tour of Gansu launched on Sept 10 in Lanzhou, with over 20 journalists from the mainland, Taiwan and Hong Kong beginning an eight-day joint reporting trip.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国算力大会在河北廊坊开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 China Computing Power Conference Opens in Langfang, Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日，2026中国算力大会在河北省廊坊市开幕，河北省省长王正谱出席，会上举行中国算力平台全国一体化算力统筹监测发布仪式。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, the 2026 China Computing Power Conference opened in Langfang, Hebei, with Governor Wang Zhengpu attending as the national integrated computing-power monitoring platform was launched.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲主持召开黑龙江省高端装备制造产业工作专班调度会议
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Chairs Heilongjiang Work Group Meeting on High-End Equipment Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲主持召开省高端装备制造产业工作专班调度会议，听取工作汇报并部署下一步工作，强调坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，推动高端装备制造业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a provincial work group meeting on high-end equipment manufacturing, hearing progress reports and outlining next steps, stressing intelligent, green and integrated development.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台十项举措促进入境旅游消费
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Unveils Ten Measures to Boost Inbound Tourism Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省文化和旅游厅联合省财政厅等10个部门印发促进入境旅游消费的若干政策措施，推出十项举措提升入境旅游国际化、便利化水平。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's culture and tourism department and nine other provincial bodies issued a package of ten measures to boost inbound tourism consumption, covering marketing, flights, services, payments and tax refunds.

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 南昌市委网信办调研互联网行业党建工作
articles.title_en: Nanchang Cyberspace Administration Surveys Party Building in the Internet Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，南昌市委网信办主任熊中高率队赴青山湖区调研互联网行业党建工作，走访江西恒创汽车集团、江西贝肽斯母婴用品有限公司并听取工作汇报。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Xiong Zhonggao, director of the Nanchang Cyberspace Administration, led a team to Qingshanhu District to survey Party building work in the internet industry, visiting two local firms and hearing a work report.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古印发“十五五”循环经济发展规划
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy Development
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区发展改革委会同生态环境厅等部门印发《内蒙古自治区“十五五”循环经济发展规划》，提出到2030年大宗固废综合利用率达62%以上等目标。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia issued its 15th Five-Year circular economy plan, setting goals including over 62% comprehensive use of bulk solid waste and a 10% cut in water use per unit of GDP by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区党委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Party Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Recent Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，内蒙古自治区党委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要指示精神，自治区党委书记王伟中主持，会议部署了教育工作和秋粮生产等事项。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Inner Mongolia's Party Standing Committee met to convey and study Xi Jinping's recent important instructions, chaired by Party Secretary Wang Weizhong, also covering education and autumn grain production.

articles.title_zh: 山东省委常委会会议暨省人民政府安全生产委员会扩大会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Standing Committee Meeting and Provincial Government Work Safety Committee Expanded Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日上午，山东省委常委会会议暨省人民政府安全生产委员会扩大会议在青岛召开，传达学习习近平总书记对中国船舶集团青岛北海造船有限公司火灾事故的重要指示，部署全省安全生产重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 11, the Shandong Provincial Party Standing Committee and Provincial Government Work Safety Committee held an expanded meeting in Qingdao to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on a fire at Qingdao Beihai Shipbuilding and deploy provincial work safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 新疆政协召开重点关切问题情况通报会
articles.title_en: Xinjiang CPPCC Holds Briefing on Key Concerns
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，新疆自治区政协召开重点关切问题情况通报会，聚焦推进天山北坡城市群能源绿色低碳转型发展，通报有关情况并回应委员关切。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, the Xinjiang regional CPPCC held a briefing on key concerns, focusing on advancing green, low-carbon energy transition in the Tianshan North Slope urban cluster and responding to committee members' concerns.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区政府召开常务会议 研究财政科学管理工作等
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Government Holds Executive Meeting on Fiscal Management, Safety and Ecology
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日下午，新疆维吾尔自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究财政科学管理、安全生产和信访工作，并审议通过生态环境保护与大气污染防治条例草案。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 11, Xinjiang Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz chaired a regional government executive meeting on fiscal management, workplace safety and petition work, approving draft regulations on ecological protection and air pollution control.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大社会委来疆召开立法研讨会
articles.title_en: NPC Social Development Committee Holds Legislative Seminar in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月6日至11日，全国人大社会建设委员会主任委员杨振武率队赴新疆，主持召开见义勇为人员奖励和保障法立法研讨会并开展立法调研。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 6 to 11, Yang Zhenwu, chairman of the NPC Social Development Committee, led a team to Xinjiang to chair a legislative seminar on a law rewarding and protecting good Samaritans, and conducted legislative research.

articles.title_zh: 武维华率全国人大常委会调研组到疆调研 提升粮食安全保障能力
articles.title_en: Wu Weihua Leads NPC Standing Committee Delegation to Xinjiang on Food Security
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日至11日，全国人大常委会副委员长武维华率调研组赴新疆，就高标准农田建设、耕地保护及农业机械化促进法修改开展调研。
articles.summary_en: From September 8 to 11, Wu Weihua, Vice Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, led a delegation to Xinjiang to study high-standard farmland construction, farmland protection and the revision of the Agricultural Mechanization Promotion Law.

articles.title_zh: 第六届"携手圆梦——两岸同胞交流研讨活动"在新疆举行
articles.title_en: Sixth "Joining Hands to Realize Dreams" Cross-Strait Exchange Seminar Held in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 第六届"携手圆梦——两岸同胞交流研讨活动"9月11日在新疆乌鲁木齐开幕，宋涛、陈小江、洪秀柱等出席致辞，两岸各界代表120余人参加。
articles.summary_en: The sixth "Joining Hands to Realize Dreams" cross-strait exchange seminar opened on Sept 11 in Urumqi, Xinjiang, with over 120 representatives from both sides of the Taiwan Strait attending.

articles.title_zh: 新疆出台知识产权“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Intellectual Property
articles.summary_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区近日印发知识产权“十五五”规划，提出到2030年基本建成丝绸之路经济带知识产权强区，并部署7方面25项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region recently issued its 15th Five-Year Plan for intellectual property, aiming to basically build a strong IP region along the Silk Road Economic Belt by 2030 through 25 key tasks in seven areas.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣督导检查安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Workplace Safety in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 9月12日下午，青岛市委书记曾赞荣以“四不两直”方式到青岛船舶企业和沙子口国家中心渔港，督导检查安全生产工作，要求深化隐患排查整治。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 12, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong made unannounced inspections of a shipyard and the Shazikou national fishing port to check workplace safety, urging deeper hazard screening and tighter precautions.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见印度总理莫迪
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets Indian Prime Minister Modi
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月12日，国家主席习近平在印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤期间会见印度总理莫迪，双方就中印要做伙伴达成重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi during the 18th BRICS Summit, with the two sides reaching important consensus on China and India being partners.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议的讲话（全文）
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Speech at the First Session of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit (Full Text)
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月12日，习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议并发表讲话，提出金砖国家勇做时代先锋，并宣布中国明年接任金砖主席国。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 12, 2026, Xi Jinping addressed the first session of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, urging members to pioneer innovation, peace and governance reform, and said China will chair BRICS next year.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总结金砖20年发展成就
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Reviews BRICS' 20 Years of Development
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议并发表重要讲话，总结金砖合作20年发展成就。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the first session of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi and delivered a speech reviewing the bloc's 20 years of cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平宣布中国将于明年接任金砖主席国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Announces China Will Take Over BRICS Chairmanship Next Year
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议，宣布中国将于明年接任金砖主席国，主办第十九次会晤。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 12 local time, President Xi Jinping, attending the first session of the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, announced that China will assume the BRICS chairmanship next year and host the 19th summit.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委常委会召开会议 陈刚主持
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs Meeting of Guangxi Autonomous Region Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署教师队伍建设、安全生产和面向东盟开放合作等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions and plan work on teachers, work safety and ASEAN cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁：提高首位度塑造新优势增强辐射力 以实干实绩加快郑州中心城市建设
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Urges Zhengzhou to Raise Its Primacy and Radiating Power to Accelerate Central City Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，郑州市召开领导干部会议，宣布省委决定：王崧任郑州市委书记，安伟不再担任；省委书记刘宁出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, a Zhengzhou leadership meeting announced the Henan Provincial Party Committee's decision appointing Wang Song as Zhengzhou Party Secretary, replacing An Wei; Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Chaired by Liu Ning
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，研究部署安全生产、教师节相关指示落实、群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治、发展规划条例草案及档案工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Henan Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a meeting of the Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee to address workplace safety, education, anti-corruption efforts, draft development planning regulations and archival work.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组扩大会议召开 孔昌生主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Henan CPPCC Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting, Chaired by Kong Changsheng
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，河南省政协主席、党组书记孔昌生主持召开省政协党组扩大会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神和中央、省委有关会议精神，研究贯彻落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Kong Changsheng, chairman and party group secretary of the Henan Provincial CPPCC, chaired an expanded party group meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent speeches and the directives of central and provincial authorities, and to decide on implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 毛万春在上汽大众长沙分公司调研
articles.title_en: Mao Wanchun Inspects SAIC Volkswagen Changsha Branch
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日下午，湖南省政协主席毛万春率队到上汽大众长沙分公司调研，了解企业生产经营与新能源汽车项目情况，强调以科技创新引领汽车产业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 11, Mao Wanchun, chairman of the Hunan Provincial CPPCC, led a team to inspect SAIC Volkswagen's Changsha branch, reviewing production and new energy vehicle projects and urging sci-tech innovation to upgrade the auto industry.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明赴省委军民融合办调研
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Visits Provincial Party Committee Military-Civilian Integration Office
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日上午，湖南省委副书记、省长毛伟明赴省委军民融合发展委员会办公室调研，强调整合创新资源、加速成果转化，持续培育壮大新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 11, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming visited the provincial Party Committee's military-civilian integration office, calling for better integration of innovation resources and faster transfer of research results to foster new quality productive forces.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月11日，2026浦江创新论坛文化科技融合专题论坛在上海张江科学会堂举行，湖南省委书记沈晓明出席。该专题论坛首次由主宾省湖南主办。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, 2026, the culture-technology integration forum of the Pujiang Innovation Forum was held in Shanghai, with Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming attending. It was the first such forum hosted by guest province Hunan.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府党组（扩大）会议召开 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government Party Group Holds Expanded Meeting Chaired by Liu Xiaotao
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，江苏省政府党组（扩大）会议召开，省政府党组书记、省长刘小涛主持，研究部署安全生产专项检查、对上合组织国家经贸合作及清洁能源合作等贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, the Jiangsu Provincial Government Party Group held an expanded meeting chaired by Governor Liu Xiaotao to plan workplace safety inspections and expand trade and clean energy cooperation with SCO countries.

articles.title_zh: 驻华使节代表团来江苏访问 信长星会见代表团一行
articles.title_en: Foreign Diplomatic Envoys Visit Jiangsu; Xin Changxing Meets Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，江苏省委书记信长星在南京会见参加外交部“走进人民城市”活动的驻华使节代表团一行，驻华使节们就深化交流合作、城市治理互鉴等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Xin Changxing, Party Secretary of Jiangsu, met in Nanjing with a delegation of foreign diplomatic envoys taking part in a Foreign Ministry program on China's people-centered urban governance.

articles.title_zh: 省政协召开发展·民生专题协商座谈会 张义珍出席
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Holds Special Consultation Symposium on Development and Livelihoods, Zhang Yizhen Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，江苏省政协在南京召开发展·民生专题协商座谈会，围绕全面激发文化创新创造活力、以文化赋能经济社会发展协商讨论，省政协主席张义珍出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, the Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC held a special consultation symposium on development and livelihoods, discussing ways to boost cultural innovation and empower economic and social development through culture, with CPPCC Chair Zhang Yizhen attending and speaking.

articles.title_en: Localities and Departments Learn from Ship Fire, Tighten Safety Responsibilities to Prevent Major Accidents
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，一艘外籍货轮在山东青岛靠港维修期间发生火灾致重大人员伤亡，习近平总书记作出重要指示，各地各部门迅速部署排查整治安全隐患。
articles.summary_en: A foreign cargo ship caught fire during repairs in Qingdao, Shandong on Sept 10, causing heavy casualties; Xi Jinping ordered nationwide screening of safety hazards.

articles.title_zh: 央行、金融监管总局、证监会、国家外汇局介绍金融领域落实“十五五”规划情况
articles.title_en: PBOC, NFRA, CSRC and SAFE Brief on Financial Sector Implementation of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，国务院新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”发布会，央行、金融监管总局、证监会、国家外汇局负责人介绍金融领域贯彻落实“十五五”规划、建设金融强国有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, China's central bank, financial regulator, securities watchdog and foreign exchange regulator briefed the press on implementing the 15th Five-Year Plan and building a financial powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 国务院港澳办发言人：香港特区依法审判“支联会”案 有力捍卫宪制秩序
articles.title_en: Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office Spokesperson: SAR Court's Lawful Trial of the Alliance Case Firmly Defends Constitutional Order
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，国务院港澳事务办公室发言人发表谈话，称香港特区法院对“支联会”及李卓人、何俊仁、邹幸彤煽动颠覆国家政权案作出量刑裁决，有力捍卫宪制秩序。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, a State Council Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office spokesperson said the Hong Kong SAR court's sentencing of the Alliance and three defendants for subversion firmly upholds the constitutional order.

tags.name_en: Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 商务部：中方正告美方立即停止对中国包括中国企业的间谍活动
articles.title_en: Commerce Ministry: China Urges US to Immediately Stop Espionage Against China and Chinese Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，商务部新闻发言人就美国中情局高官公开表示对中国开展间谍活动答记者问，表示坚决反对并正告美方立即停止相关行为。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, a Commerce Ministry spokesperson responded to a CIA official's public statement about spying on China, expressing firm opposition and urging the US to immediately halt such activities against China and Chinese enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 2030年我国将全面建成新一代通信网
articles.title_en: China to Complete Next-Generation Communications Network by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部日前发布《信息通信行业发展“十五五”规划》，明确到2030年全面建成新一代通信网，并提出信息基础设施累计投资3.8万亿元、5G用户普及率达95%等13项具体指标。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released the 15th Five-Year Plan for the information and communications industry, aiming to fully build a next-generation communications network by 2030, with 13 targets including 3.8 trillion yuan in cumulative infrastructure investment and 95 percent 5G penetration.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 中方：愿同金砖各方一道努力，助力“大金砖合作”行稳致远
articles.title_en: China Ready to Work with BRICS Partners to Advance "Greater BRICS Cooperation"
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京表示，习近平主席将出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤并发表讲话，中方愿同金砖各方一道努力，助力“大金砖合作”行稳致远。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said in Beijing that President Xi Jinping will attend the 18th BRICS Summit and deliver a speech, vowing to work with BRICS partners for "Greater BRICS Cooperation".

articles.title_zh: 追忆牺牲于长征湘江战役中的红军将士
articles.title_en: Remembering the Red Army Soldiers Who Fell in the Xiangjiang Campaign of the Long March
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者走访广西全州的湘江战役纪念园与渡口遗址，追忆1934年湘江战役中为掩护中央红军渡江而牺牲的红军将士。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters visit memorial sites and ferry crossings in Quanzhou, Guangxi, recalling the Red Army soldiers who died in the 1934 Xiangjiang Campaign covering the Central Red Army's river crossing.

articles.title_zh: 中印正在安排习近平主席同印度总理莫迪举行双边会晤
articles.title_en: China and India Arranging Bilateral Meeting Between Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Modi
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京例行记者会上表示，中印双方正在安排习近平主席同印度总理莫迪举行双边会晤，这将是两国领导人连续第三年会晤。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said in Beijing that China and India are arranging a bilateral meeting between President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Modi, which would be their third consecutive annual meeting.

articles.title_zh: 金砖峰会将启 “大金砖合作”再迎重要时刻
articles.title_en: BRICS Summit to Open as 'Greater BRICS Cooperation' Reaches Key Moment
articles.summary_zh: 中国国家主席习近平将于9月12日至13日应邀赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，今年恰逢金砖合作机制成立20周年。
articles.summary_en: Chinese President Xi Jinping will attend the 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi, India on September 12-13 at the invitation of Prime Minister Modi, as the bloc marks 20 years of cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中国驻日本大使馆：9月14日起调整日本公民赴华签证规费
articles.title_en: Chinese Embassy in Japan to Adjust Visa Fees for Japanese Citizens Starting September 14
articles.summary_zh: 中国驻日本大使馆9月11日发布通知，根据签证费对等安排，自2026年9月14日起调整日本公民赴华签证规费。
articles.summary_en: China's Embassy in Japan issued a notice on September 11 stating that, under reciprocal visa fee arrangements, visa fees for Japanese citizens traveling to China will be adjusted from September 14, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 镜观·回响｜擦亮全球南方合作的“金字招牌”
articles.title_en: Photo Essay: Polishing the 'Golden Signboard' of Global South Cooperation — A Look at the BRICS New Development Bank
articles.summary_zh: 新华社图文报道聚焦设于上海浦东的金砖国家新开发银行，该行成立十余年来已批准百余个项目、融资总额超400亿美元，支持成员国基础设施与清洁能源建设。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua photo feature highlights the BRICS New Development Bank, headquartered in Shanghai's Pudong district, which has approved over 100 projects worth more than $40 billion in financing since 2015 to support infrastructure and clean energy in member states.

articles.title_zh: 第六届“携手圆梦——两岸同胞交流研讨活动”在新疆举行
articles.title_en: Sixth "Joining Hands for a Shared Dream" Cross-Strait Exchange Event Held in Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，第六届“携手圆梦——两岸同胞交流研讨活动”在乌鲁木齐开幕，宋涛、陈小江、洪秀柱等致辞，两岸120余名代表参加。
articles.summary_en: The sixth "Joining Hands for a Shared Dream" cross-strait exchange event opened in Urumqi, Xinjiang on Sept 11, with Song Tao, Chen Xiaojiang and Hung Hsiu-chu speaking to over 120 participants from both sides of the strait.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：一中原则是中意关系、中欧关系的政治基础
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: One-China Principle Is the Political Foundation of China-Italy and China-EU Relations
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京例行记者会上表示，中方已就“台独”政客赴意大利出席有关会议向意方、欧方提出严正交涉，并敦促有关方面恪守一个中国原则。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said in Beijing that China has lodged solemn representations with Italy and the EU over a "Taiwan independence" politician attending a meeting in Italy, urging them to uphold the one-China principle.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致教师节祝贺：努力培养担当民族复兴大任的时代新人
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Teachers' Day Greetings, Urging Cultivation of a New Generation to Shoulder National Rejuvenation
articles.summary_zh: 在第四十二个教师节到来之际，习近平代表党中央向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候，勉励其落实立德树人根本任务、培养担当民族复兴大任的时代新人。
articles.summary_en: On the 42nd Teachers' Day, Xi Jinping sent festive greetings to teachers and educators nationwide on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, urging them to cultivate a new generation capable of shouldering national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: “中国共产党的故事——习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想在陕西的实践”专题宣介会在延安举行
articles.title_en: Themed Promotion Event on Xi Jinping Thought's Shaanxi Practice Held in Yan'an
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，中共中央对外联络部与中共陕西省委在陕西延安共同举办“中国共产党的故事”专题宣介会，50多个国家的200多名政党领导人及学者等与会。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, the CPC International Department and the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee co-hosted a themed promotion event in Yan'an, Shaanxi, with over 200 party leaders, scholars and business figures from more than 50 countries attending.

tags.name_en: International Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: International Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 国办印发《关于加强中小企业回款难问题治理有关工作的通知》
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Notice on Curbing Late Payments to SMEs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅日前印发通知，对依法治理中小企业回款难问题作出部署，从健全行业账款支付规则、加强大型企业支付行为监管、规范非现金支付工具、强化资金传导与融资支持四方面提出举措。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council General Office issued a notice to tackle late payments to small and medium-sized enterprises, setting industry payment rules, tightening oversight of large firms' payment behavior, regulating non-cash payment instruments and boosting financing support.

tags.name_en: General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 加快建设金融强国 服务经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Building a Financial Powerhouse to Serve High-Quality Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，介绍中央金融办会同各金融单位制定的《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》，人民银行、金融监管总局、证监会、外汇局通报落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on the financial sector's 15th Five-Year Plan, with the PBOC, NFRA, CSRC and SAFE outlining steps to build a financial powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 军队开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育取得明显成效
articles.title_en: PLA's Education Campaign on Upholding a Correct View of Political Achievements Yields Notable Results
articles.summary_zh: 据新华社9月10日电，全军开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育取得明显成效，各级一体推进学查改，坚持为人民出政绩、以实干出政绩。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on Sept 10 that the PLA-wide campaign on upholding a correct view of political achievements has yielded notable results, with all levels combining study, review and rectification.

tags.name_en: Modernization of National Defense and the Military

tags_en: Modernization of National Defense and the Military

articles.title_zh: 商务部回应约谈在华法企、中美对等降税等经贸热点
articles.title_en: MOFCOM Responds on Meetings with French Firms in China, China-US Reciprocal Tariff Cuts
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，商务部举行例行新闻发布会，新闻发言人黄玲就约见在华法国企业、法国“反超快时尚”法以及中美300亿美元对等降税框架安排等经贸热点答问。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press conference on September 10, MOFCOM spokesperson Huang Ling addressed issues including talks with French firms in China, France's anti-fast-fashion law and the China-US reciprocal tariff cut framework.

articles.title_zh: 宝鸡市委理论学习中心组集体学习 重温习近平总书记来宝考察重要讲话重要指示
articles.title_en: Baoji Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group Holds Collective Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，宝鸡市委理论学习中心组集体学习，重温习近平总书记来宝考察重要讲话重要指示，市委书记陈晓勇主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, the Baoji Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group held a collective study, revisiting Xi Jinping's important speeches from his Baoji inspection, chaired by Party Secretary Chen Xiaoyong.

articles.title_zh: 推动金砖合作实现大发展、展现大作为——写在习近平主席出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤之际
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting: Advancing Greater BRICS Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 应印度总理莫迪邀请，国家主席习近平将于2026年9月12日至13日赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，各方期待中国引领“大金砖合作”提质升级。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Modi, President Xi Jinping will attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi on Sept 12-13, 2026, with parties expecting China to advance greater BRICS cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 对加强安全生产工作作出进一步部署
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Strengthening Workplace Safety
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，进一步部署加强安全生产工作，并研究算力网建设、老旧水库改造提升、教育强国建设等工作，审议通过《基金会管理条例（修订草案）》。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing, further deploying work on workplace safety and studying computing network construction, old reservoir upgrades, education strength, and approving the revised Regulations on Foundation Administration.

articles.title_zh: 贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神专题调研成果交流会召开 许昆林主持并讲话 王新伟周波出席
articles.title_en: Liaoning Holds Meeting on Research Outcomes for Implementing Xi Jinping's Key Speech; Xu Kunlin Presides
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，辽宁省贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神专题调研成果交流会在沈阳召开，省委书记许昆林主持并讲话，省长王新伟、省政协主席周波出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Liaoning Province held a meeting in Shenyang to review research findings on implementing Xi Jinping's key speeches. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin presided and spoke, with Governor Wang Xinwei and CPPCC Chairman Zhou Bo attending.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府党组会议 总结正确政绩观学习教育
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Provincial Government Party Group Meeting on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，辽宁省省长、省政府党组书记王新伟主持召开省政府党组会议，总结全省政府系统树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，研究巩固拓展学习教育成果工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Liaoning Governor and provincial government Party group secretary Wang Xinwei chaired a Party group meeting to review the campaign on upholding a correct view of political achievements and to consolidate its outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在辽宁大学、沈阳航空航天大学调研
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects Liaoning University and Shenyang Aerospace University
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，辽宁省委书记许昆林到辽宁大学、沈阳航空航天大学调研并向教师致以节日问候，强调一体推进教育科技人才发展，更好服务国家战略和辽宁全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin inspected Liaoning University and Shenyang Aerospace University, greeting teachers on the upcoming holiday and urging integrated development of education, science and technology and talent to serve national strategy and Liaoning's revitalization.

tags.name_en: Integrated Development of Education, Science and Technology, and Talent

tags_en: Integrated Development of Education, Science and Technology, and Talent

articles.title_zh: 习近平对山东青岛北海造船厂一货轮火灾事故作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Cargo Ship Fire at Beihai Shipyard in Qingdao, Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日11时15分许，山东青岛市北海造船有限公司一艘外籍货轮靠港维修期间起火，造成重大人员伤亡。习近平作出重要指示，要求抓紧搜救失联人员、查明原因并严肃追责，李强作出批示。
articles.summary_en: A foreign cargo ship caught fire during repair at Beihai Shipbuilding Co. in Qingdao, Shandong on Sept 10, causing heavy casualties. Xi Jinping ordered urgent search and rescue, a swift investigation and strict accountability, while Li Qiang issued follow-up instructions.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥出席第十六次亚太经合组织能源部长会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Opening Ceremony of the 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，第十六次亚太经合组织能源部长会议在北京开幕，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席开幕式并致辞，就加强普惠共享、创新合作、协同共治提出三点建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, the 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting opened in Beijing. Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the opening ceremony and delivered remarks, proposing three suggestions on inclusive sharing, innovation cooperation and coordinated governance.

articles.title_zh: 外交部介绍习近平主席出席金砖国家领导人会晤安排
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Briefs on Xi Jinping's Attendance at BRICS Leaders' Summit
articles.summary_zh: 应印度总理莫迪邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月12日至13日赴新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤，外交部发言人毛宁9月11日介绍相关安排。
articles.summary_en: At India's invitation, President Xi Jinping will attend the 18th BRICS leaders' summit in New Delhi on Sept 12-13, the Chinese Foreign Ministry announced on Sept 11.

articles.title_zh: 我国正式推行数据产权登记制度
articles.title_en: China Formally Launches Data Property Rights Registration System
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，国家数据局宣布我国正式推行数据产权登记制度，国家数据产权登记服务系统同日启动试运行，北京国际大数据交易所等率先成为登记机构。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, the National Data Administration announced that China has formally launched a data property rights registration system, with the national registration service system beginning trial operation the same day and the Beijing International Big Data Exchange among the first designated registrars.

articles.title_zh: 中国与其他金砖成员国贸易指数连续10年向上攀升
articles.title_en: China's Trade Index with Other BRICS Members Climbs for 10th Consecutive Year
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署发布2025年中国与其他金砖成员国贸易指数，升至334.14，连续10年攀升；双边进出口7.47万亿元，占中国外贸总值16.4%。
articles.summary_en: China's General Administration of Customs released the 2025 trade index for China and other BRICS members, which rose to 334.14, marking a 10th straight annual increase, with trade reaching RMB 7.47 trillion, or 16.4% of China's total foreign trade.

articles.title_zh: 第三次中国－东非执法安全部长级对话举行
articles.title_en: Third China-East Africa Law Enforcement and Security Ministerial Dialogue Held
articles.summary_zh: 第三次中国－东非执法安全部长级对话10日在江苏连云港举行，国务委员、公安部部长王小洪与卢旺达内政部部长比鲁塔共同主持。
articles.summary_en: The third China-East Africa law enforcement and security ministerial dialogue was held on Sept 10 in Lianyungang, Jiangsu, co-chaired by State Councilor and Public Security Minister Wang Xiaohong and Rwanda's Interior Minister Biruta.

tags.name_en: China-Africa Community with a Shared Future

tags_en: China-Africa Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布《市场监督管理所条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree to Publish Regulation on Market Supervision Offices
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布《市场监督管理所条例》，自2026年11月1日起施行，共19条，规范市场监管所建设管理与执法服务。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree promulgating the Regulation on Market Supervision Offices, effective Nov 1, 2026. The 19-article regulation governs the offices' management, law enforcement and services.

articles.title_zh: 今年全国新增84个重点外资项目
articles.title_en: China Adds 84 Major Foreign-Invested Projects Nationwide This Year
articles.summary_zh: 商务部11日表示，今年以来全国新增84个重点外资项目，总投资额194.6亿美元，涉及机电装备、化工能源、汽车、医疗健康等领域。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce said that 84 major foreign-invested projects have been added across China this year, with total investment of US$19.46 billion, spanning machinery, chemicals and energy, automobiles and healthcare.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，部署加强安全生产工作，研究算力网建设、老旧水库改造提升，并审议通过《基金会管理条例（修订草案）》。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting that further deployed work on workplace safety, studied computing power network development and the renovation of aging reservoirs, and approved the revised draft Regulations on the Administration of Foundations.

articles.title_zh: 丹东市政府召开第90次常务会议 张丹主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Dandong Municipal Government Holds 90th Executive Meeting, Chaired by Mayor Zhang Dan
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，丹东市政府召开第90次常务会议，市长张丹主持并讲话，研究部署基础教育、侨务、防灾减灾、海洋经济等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, the Dandong Municipal Government held its 90th executive meeting, chaired by Mayor Zhang Dan, to deploy work on basic education, overseas Chinese affairs, disaster prevention and marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 丹东市政府召开第90次常务会议
articles.title_en: Dandong Municipal Government Holds 90th Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，丹东市市长张丹主持市政府第90次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署基础教育、防灾减灾、海洋经济等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan chaired the municipal government's 90th executive meeting, deploying work on basic education, disaster prevention and the marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神专题调研成果交流会在沈阳召开 许昆林主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Holds Meeting on Special Research Findings to Implement Xi Jinping's Speech; Xu Kunlin Presides
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，辽宁省贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神专题调研成果交流会在沈阳召开，省委书记许昆林主持并讲话，省长王新伟、省政协主席周波出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Liaoning Province held a meeting in Shenyang to exchange findings from special research on implementing Xi Jinping's important speech. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin presided and spoke; Governor Wang Xinwei and CPPCC Chairman Zhou Bo attended.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱会见中国移动黑龙江公司党委书记、董事长金巍一行
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Meets with China Mobile Heilongjiang Chairman Jin Wei
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱会见中国移动黑龙江公司党委书记、董事长金巍一行，双方就深化数字经济、算力网建设等地企合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Hegang Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu met with Jin Wei, Chairman of China Mobile Heilongjiang, to discuss deeper cooperation in the digital economy, computing networks and smart city development.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元到市财政局调研
articles.title_en: Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan Inspects Municipal Finance Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，鹤岗市委副书记、市长邓维元到市财政局调研，了解财政运行、预算管理、资金拨付和民生保障情况，并就“零基预算”改革、过紧日子、财政风险防控等提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan inspected the municipal finance bureau, reviewing fiscal operations, budget management and livelihood spending, and urging zero-based budgeting reform, fiscal discipline and risk control.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市市长顾坤调研推进“两创融合”发展
articles.title_en: Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun Inspects Push for Integration of Sci-Tech and Industrial Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，淮安市市长顾坤赴清江浦区、淮安工业园区调研科技创新和产业创新融合发展，要求强化项目引培与科技创新双轮驱动，加快培育新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun visited Qingjiangpu District and Huai'an Industrial Park to advance integrated sci-tech and industrial innovation, urging dual drives of project attraction and R&D to foster new quality productive forces.

tags.name_en: Integration of Sci-Tech and Industrial Innovation

tags_en: Integration of Sci-Tech and Industrial Innovation

articles.title_zh: 黄韡调研城市地下综合管廊管理运营工作
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Inspects Urban Underground Utility Tunnel Management and Operation
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡调研东部新城等地地下综合管廊管理运营工作，要求抓实管廊运营、增强城市安全韧性。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 11, Huang Wei, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Huaibei, inspected underground utility tunnel management and operation, urging better operation to strengthen urban safety and resilience.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡调研城市地下综合管廊管理运营工作
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Inspects Urban Underground Utility Tunnel Management and Operations
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日下午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡调研城市地下综合管廊管理运营工作，强调统筹推进管廊管理运营、提升城市综合承载力，副市长刘家宏参加。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 11, Huang Wei, deputy party secretary and acting mayor of Huaibei, inspected the city's underground utility tunnel management and operations, urging coordinated efforts to improve urban carrying capacity; Vice Mayor Liu Jiahong joined.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生专题调研太平溪流域水环境系统治理工作
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Inspects Systematic Water Environment Treatment of Taiping Creek Basin
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日上午，怀化市委副书记、代市长高靖生专题调研太平溪流域水环境系统治理工作，要求抓好截污控源、生态修复和长效管护，推动流域水质全面提升。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 10, Gao Jingsheng, deputy party secretary and acting mayor of Huaihua, inspected systematic water environment treatment in the Taiping Creek basin, urging stronger pollution-source control, ecological restoration and long-term management to improve water quality.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖高靖生在中方县调研高产油茶基地建设情况
articles.title_en: Wei Chaohui and Gao Jingsheng Inspect High-Yield Oil Tea Base in Zhongfang County
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日上午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖、市委副书记兼代市长高靖生赴中方县调研高产油茶基地建设情况。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 11, Huaihua Party Secretary Wei Chaohui and Acting Mayor Gao Jingsheng inspected the construction of a high-yield oil tea base in Zhongfang County.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Jieyang Municipal Government Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 10日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组2026年第28次会议和七届市政府第157次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，部署践行正确政绩观、推动高质量发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 10, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie chaired the municipal government's 28th Party group meeting and 157th executive meeting of 2026, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions and deploying work on correct performance views and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Jieyang Municipal Government Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组2026年第28次会议和七届市政府第157次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于树立和践行正确政绩观的重要指示精神，部署高质量发展各项工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 10, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie chaired the municipal government Party group's 28th meeting of 2026 and the 157th executive meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions on upholding a correct view of political achievements and deploying work for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保调研督导国道G206线揭阳新亨至地都段改建工程
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Inspects G206 Highway Reconstruction Project in Jieyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保实地调研督导国道G206线揭阳新亨至地都段改建工程，要求攻坚征拆难点堵点、推动项目建设提速增效。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 10, Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao inspected the G206 highway reconstruction project in Jieyang, urging faster progress and resolution of land acquisition bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁在教师节前夕看望慰问教师代表并致以节日祝贺
articles.title_en: Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Ciren Visits Teacher Representatives Ahead of Teachers' Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁到拉萨江苏实验中学看望慰问教师代表，代表市四大班子向全市教师致以节日祝贺，并就思政教育、校园食品安全等提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Ciren visited Lhasa Jiangsu Experimental Middle School to greet teacher representatives ahead of Teachers' Day, urging stronger ideological education and campus food safety.

articles.title_zh: 国际打击电信网络诈骗联盟成立大会举行 王小洪出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Founding Conference of International Alliance Against Telecom and Online Fraud Held, Wang Xiaohong Attends and Addresses the Event
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，国际打击电信网络诈骗联盟成立大会在江苏连云港举行，国务委员、公安部部长王小洪出席并致辞，并会见多国代表团负责人。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, the founding conference of the International Alliance Against Telecom and Online Fraud was held in Lianyungang, Jiangsu. State Councilor and Public Security Minister Wang Xiaohong attended, addressed the event and met foreign delegations.

tags.name_en: International Law Enforcement and Security Cooperation

tags_en: International Law Enforcement and Security Cooperation

articles.title_zh: 王君正在拉萨调研强调扎实推进中华民族共同体建设
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Stresses Building a Strong Sense of Community for the Chinese Nation During Lhasa Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨市调研，强调全面贯彻新时代党的治藏方略，扎实推进中华民族共同体建设，共建中华民族共有精神文化家园。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, inspected Lhasa, urging full implementation of the Party's Tibet strategy and steady progress in building a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在拉萨看望慰问教师并调研教育工作
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Visits Teachers and Inspects Education Work in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日第42个教师节，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区主席嘎玛泽登在拉萨市看望慰问教师并调研教育工作，强调全面贯彻党的教育方针、弘扬教育家精神。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, the 42nd Teachers' Day, Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman Gama Zedeng visited schools in Lhasa to greet teachers and inspect education work, urging full implementation of the Party's education policy.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将赴印度出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit in India
articles.summary_zh: 外交部9月10日宣布，应印度总理莫迪邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月12日至13日赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤。
articles.summary_en: The Foreign Ministry announced on September 10 that, at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, President Xi Jinping will attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit in New Delhi, India, on September 12-13.

articles.title_zh: 福建省人大常委会赴龙岩开展安全生产“一法一例”执法检查
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Workplace Safety Law Enforcement Inspection in Longyan
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日至9日，福建省人大常委会副主任庄稼汉带队赴龙岩及长汀、上杭等地，开展安全生产“一法一例”执法检查，龙岩市人大常委会同步开展三级联动检查。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 7 to 9, Fujian Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Deputy Director Zhuang Jiahan led a workplace safety law enforcement inspection in Longyan, visiting Changting and Shanghang counties.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市人大常委会开展“聚力工业经济提质增量行动 助力工业强市建设”代表视察活动
articles.title_en: Longyan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Inspection on Industrial Economy Growth
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日至10日，龙岩市人大常委会开展工业经济提质增量代表视察活动，主任陈厦生等参加，并召开座谈会听取副市长王波关于工业发展情况的汇报。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 8-10, the Longyan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee ran an inspection tour on industrial economy growth; director Chen Xiasheng took part and a symposium heard Vice Mayor Wang Bo's report.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在拉萨看望慰问教师并调研教育工作
articles.title_en: Tibet Chairman Gama Zedeng Visits Teachers in Lhasa and Inspects Education Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日第42个教师节，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区主席嘎玛泽登在拉萨看望慰问教师并调研教育工作，强调全面贯彻党的教育方针、弘扬教育家精神。
articles.summary_en: On the 42nd Teachers' Day (Sept 10), Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman Gama Zedeng visited and thanked teachers and inspected education work in Lhasa, urging full implementation of the Party's education policy.

articles.title_zh: 广东省海上风电建设劳动和技能竞赛总结暨“十五五”启动仪式在汕头举行
articles.title_en: Guangdong Offshore Wind Power Labor and Skills Competition Review and Launch Ceremony Held in Shantou
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，广东省总工会与汕头市政府在汕头国际风电创新港举行广东省海上风电建设劳动和技能竞赛“十四五”总结暨“十五五”启动仪式，黄宁生、庄悦群等出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, the Guangdong Provincial Federation of Trade Unions and the Shantou municipal government held a ceremony in Shantou to review the 14th Five-Year Plan offshore wind power labor and skills competition and launch its 15th Five-Year Plan edition.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰到陆河县调研督导“百千万工程”推进情况
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Inspects Luhe County on Progress of the "Hundreds of Thousands" Rural Revitalization Project
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到陆河县调研督导“百千万工程”推进情况，实地察看产业园区和省级森林公园，强调聚力产业发展、强化项目赋能、坚持绿色生态优先。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Lu Feng, Party Secretary of Shanwei, inspected Luhe County on progress of the rural revitalization project, visiting an industrial park and a provincial forest park and stressing industrial growth, project support and green development.

articles.title_zh: 叶贞琴到汕尾开展调研
articles.title_en: Ye Zhenqin Conducts Research Tour in Shanwei
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日至11日，广东省人大常委会副主任叶贞琴率调研组到汕尾市，围绕直接联系企业、刑罚执行与监督、法治化营商环境建设开展专题调研。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 10 to 11, Ye Zhenqin, deputy director of the Guangdong Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, led a research team to Shanwei to study judicial enforcement supervision, community correction and the law-based business environment.

articles.title_zh: 国际打击电信网络诈骗联盟在连云港成立 王小洪出席成立大会并致辞
articles.title_en: International Alliance Against Telecom and Online Fraud Established in Lianyungang; Wang Xiaohong Attends and Addresses Founding Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，国际打击电信网络诈骗联盟成立大会在江苏连云港举行，国务委员、公安部部长王小洪出席并致辞，46个创始国及联合国、国际刑警组织等代表参会。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, the founding conference of the International Alliance Against Telecom and Online Fraud was held in Lianyungang, Jiangsu, with State Councilor and Public Security Minister Wang Xiaohong attending and speaking; representatives of 46 founding countries and international organizations took part.

articles.title_zh: 全国养老服务体系建设座谈会暨三级养老服务网络建设会议在威海召开
articles.title_en: National Symposium on Elderly Care Service System and Three-Tier Elderly Care Network Meeting Held in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，全国养老服务体系建设座谈会暨三级养老服务网络建设会议在山东威海召开，民政部副部长孙硕鹏出席，副省长王桂英、市委书记张海波致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, a national symposium on the elderly care service system and a meeting on building the three-tier elderly care service network were held in Weihai, Shandong, attended by Vice Minister of Civil Affairs Sun Shuopeng, with speeches by Vice Governor Wang Guiying and Party Secretary Zhang Haibo.

articles.title_zh: 孔凡萍主持召开昆嵛山机场建设专班专题工作会议
articles.title_en: Kong Fanping Chairs Special Meeting of Kunyu Mountain Airport Construction Task Force
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，威海市委副书记、市长孔凡萍主持召开昆嵛山机场建设专班专题工作会议，总结前期工作并部署下步重点任务，推动机场建设落地落实。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Weihai Mayor Kong Fanping chaired a special meeting of the Kunyu Mountain Airport construction task force to review progress and set key tasks for advancing the project.

articles.title_zh: 无锡市政府召开第88次常务会议 审议太湖综合治理行动方案
articles.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Government Holds 88th Executive Meeting to Review Taihu Lake Governance Action Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，无锡市市长蒋锋主持召开市政府第88次常务会议，审议《无锡市太湖综合治理“1+8”行动方案》，并听取科技、粮食和物资储备领域安全生产工作汇报。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng chaired the 88th executive meeting of the municipal government, reviewing the "1+8" action plan for comprehensive Taihu Lake governance and hearing reports on workplace safety in science and technology, and grain and materials reserves.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见渣打银行（中国）有限公司行长兼副董事长鲁静一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets with Lu Jing, President and Deputy Chair of Standard Chartered Bank (China)
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰在西安会见渣打银行（中国）有限公司行长兼副董事长鲁静一行，双方就金融服务实体经济、支持企业走出去和招商引资等合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Hao Huijie, Party Secretary of Xi'an, met in Xi'an with Lu Jing, President and Deputy Chair of Standard Chartered Bank (China), to discuss financial services, outbound expansion by local firms and foreign investment.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研西安教育教学工作并开展教师节慰问活动
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Education Work and Extends Teachers' Day Greetings in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日教师节，西安市委书记蒿慧杰走访西航一中、西航三校等学校调研教育教学并慰问教师，强调落实立德树人、坚持教育优先发展。
articles.summary_en: On Teachers' Day, September 10, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie visited local schools including Xihang No.1 Middle School, inspected education work and greeted teachers, stressing moral education and prioritizing education development.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚在西安调研教育强省推进工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Inspects Education Development in Xi'an, Pledges to Build a Strong Education Province
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，陕西省省长赵刚在西安调研教育强省推进工作并看望慰问教师，强调深化教育综合改革、构建高质量教育体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Shaanxi Governor Zhao Gang inspected education work in Xi'an and greeted local teachers, calling for deeper education reform and a high-quality education system.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见影石创新科技股份有限公司联合创始人、执行总裁陈金尧一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets Insta360 Co-Founder and Executive President Chen Jinyao
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见影石创新执行总裁陈金尧一行，影石创新西部地区首个研发中心落户西安高新区。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie met Insta360 co-founder and executive president Chen Jinyao, whose company is setting up its first western China R&D center in Xi'an High-tech Zone.

articles.title_zh: 第四期“牧野讲堂”专题报告会举行
articles.title_en: Xinxiang Party Secretary Wei Jianping Chairs Fourth 'Muye Forum' on Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，第四期“牧野讲堂”专题报告会在河南新乡举行，市委书记魏建平主持，全国市长研修学院党委书记全河就落实“十五五”部署、推动城市高质量发展作辅导报告。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Xinxiang, Henan hosted the fourth 'Muye Forum', presided over by Party Secretary Wei Jianping, at which Quan He gave a report on implementing the 15th Five-Year Plan and advancing high-quality urban development.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平会见机械工业第六设计研究院顾晓山一行
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Meets Gu Xiaoshan of the Sixth Design and Research Institute of the Machinery Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，盐城市委书记严汉平在盐城会见机械工业第六设计研究院董事长顾晓山一行，双方就绿色低碳、智能制造等领域深化合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping met Gu Xiaoshan, chairman of the Sixth Design and Research Institute of the Machinery Industry, to discuss deeper cooperation in green low-carbon and smart manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平听取民生领域基层工作者意见建议
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Hears Suggestions from Grassroots Workers in Livelihood Sectors

articles.summary_en: On September 10, Yan Hanping, Party Secretary of Yancheng, chaired a symposium to hear suggestions from 13 grassroots workers in education, health, employment and elderly care, with Deputy Party Secretary Huang Hua attending.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Yancheng held a meeting to advance its campaign against misconduct and corruption affecting ordinary residents. Party Secretary Yan Hanping spoke, acting mayor Wu Wei presided, and a provincial inspection team attended.

articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 8, President Xi Jinping took a phone call from UK Prime Minister Burnham, exchanging views on the China-UK comprehensive strategic partnership, bilateral cooperation and multilateral coordination.

articles.title_zh: 烟台高新区以“软服务”锻造“硬支撑”，打造全市服务经济发展高地
articles.title_en: Yantai High-Tech Zone Turns Services into Strong Support to Build a Hub for the Service Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月27日，烟台高新区召开服务业高质量发展会议，提出构建“5+N”服务业矩阵，力争到2028年服务业增加值突破99亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 27, Yantai High-Tech Zone held a meeting on high-quality service sector development, unveiling a "5+N" service industry plan that aims for value-added output of over 9.9 billion yuan by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Holiday Greetings to Teachers and Educators Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 在第四十二个教师节到来之际，习近平代表党中央向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺，强调弘扬教育家精神、加强教师队伍建设。
articles.summary_en: On the 42nd Teachers' Day, Xi Jinping, on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, sent festive greetings to teachers and educators nationwide, urging efforts to strengthen the teaching workforce.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Standing Committee Meeting Convenes
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，阳江市委书记卢一先主持召开市委常委会会议，听取侨务工作、深化扫黑除恶专项斗争和公安工作等情况汇报，并研究下一步工作意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, 2026, Yangjiang Party Secretary Lu Yixian chaired a meeting of the municipal Party Standing Committee to review overseas Chinese affairs, the anti-organized-crime campaign and public security work, and set follow-up tasks.

articles.title_zh: 李勇毅主持召开湛江市外资企业圆桌会议
articles.title_en: Li Yongyi Chairs Zhanjiang Roundtable Meeting with Foreign-Funded Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，湛江市市长李勇毅主持召开外资企业圆桌会议，听取巴斯夫等外资企业诉求，要求市商务局牵头闭环跟进解决，推动高水平对外开放。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired a roundtable meeting with foreign-funded enterprises, hearing requests from firms including BASF and ordering closed-loop follow-up by the municipal commerce bureau to boost high-level opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 市委工作会议召开，专题研究部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作

articles.summary_zh: 9月10日上午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市委工作会议，专题研究部署群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，市长李勇毅出席并提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept. 10, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired a municipal Party committee meeting to plan the campaign against misconduct and corruption affecting ordinary people; Mayor Li Yongyi attended and set out requirements.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting on Implementing Xi Jinping's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，山东省省长周乃翔主持召开省政府常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记对青岛北海造船火灾事故的重要指示精神，部署安全生产和应急处置工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang chaired a provincial government meeting to implement Xi Jinping's instructions on the Qingdao Beihai Shipbuilding fire and deploy safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 林武在日照调研时强调 强化科技创新加快数字赋能 更大力度推动产业提质升级
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Inspects Rizhao, Urging Tech Innovation and Digital Empowerment to Upgrade Industries
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日至10日，山东省委书记林武在日照市调研，强调强化科技创新、加快数字赋能，推动产业提质升级，并看望慰问教育工作者致以教师节祝福。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 9 to 10, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu inspected Rizhao, urging stronger tech innovation and digital empowerment to upgrade industries, and visited educators ahead of Teachers' Day.

articles.title_zh: 国家对成品油价格实施调控
articles.title_en: China Implements Temporary Regulation of Refined Oil Prices
articles.summary_zh: 9月11日，国家发展改革委对国内成品油价格实施临时调控，汽、柴油每吨实际上调260元、250元，低于机制测算幅度，并部署保障市场稳定供应。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, the National Development and Reform Commission applied temporary regulation to domestic refined oil prices, raising gasoline and diesel by 260 and 250 yuan per ton—less than the mechanism would require—and pledged stable market supply.

articles.title_zh: 福州市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Standing Committee Meets on SCO Summit Speech, Opening-Up

articles.summary_en: On September 10, Fuzhou Party Secretary Guo Ningning chaired a municipal Party Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's SCO summit speeches and plan foreign affairs and opening-up measures.

articles.title_zh: 刘强会见瑞典斯凯孚集团客人

articles.summary_en: On September 10, Jinan Party Secretary Liu Qiang met with Hakan Busk, Vice Chairman of Sweden's SKF Group, in Jinan to discuss deeper cooperation in smart manufacturing and the automotive industry.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示重要文章精神 研究绿色低碳高质量发展等事项

articles.summary_en: Jinan's Party Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's instructions, green low-carbon development, Party theory promotion and mass organization work; Party Secretary Liu Qiang presided.

articles.title_zh: 习近平代表党中央向全国广大教师致以教师节祝贺
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Teachers' Day Greetings to Educators Nationwide on Behalf of CPC Central Committee
articles.summary_zh: 在第四十二个教师节到来之际，习近平代表党中央向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺，强调弘扬教育家精神、加强教师队伍建设。
articles.summary_en: As China marked the 42nd Teachers' Day, Xi Jinping extended festive greetings to teachers and educators nationwide, stressing the need to promote the educator spirit and strengthen the teaching workforce.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept. 10, Guan Zhi'ou, Party Secretary of Hubei Province, met Baidu founder Robin Li in Wuhan to discuss deeper cooperation in artificial intelligence and other fields.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 11, Shandong's provincial Party standing committee and the provincial government's work safety committee held an expanded meeting in Qingdao to convey Xi Jinping's instructions after a deadly fire at Qingdao Beihai Shipbuilding and to deploy province-wide work safety measures.

articles.title_zh: 安庆“十百千”产业集群培育三年行动方案出台

articles.summary_en: Anqing City recently issued a three-year action plan (2026-2028) for cultivating its "Ten-Hundred-Thousand" industrial clusters, aiming for over 300 billion yuan in above-scale industrial output of leading industries by 2028, with two main clusters in autos and parts and in chemicals and new materials.

articles.summary_en: Gansu's publicity, agriculture and culture departments held a 2026 provincial exchange event on civilized rural customs in Qingyang, releasing 10 model cases of such work.

articles.summary_en: Gansu's Provincial Meteorological Bureau and Development and Reform Commission jointly issued the province's 15th Five-Year Plan for meteorological development, setting eight core indicators and goals through 2030, including keeping meteorological science and technology capacity among the national leaders.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞向海南高校师生代表讲授思政课
