articles.title_zh: 南京推出三方协同“网约公交” 系全国首创
articles.title_en: Nanjing Launches China's First Three-Party Collaborative On-Demand Bus Service
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，南京公交集团在浦口大学城推出全国首个由公交企业、数字平台与车企三方协同打造的“网约公交”项目，推动公交数智化转型。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Nanjing Public Transport Group launched China's first three-party on-demand bus service in Pukou University Town, jointly built by the bus operator, a digital platform and an automaker to advance digitalized public transport.

articles.title_zh: 庄兆林在宜春市接访并主持信访包联工作调度会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Zhaolin Handles Petitions in Yichun and Chairs Coordination Meeting on Petition Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，江西省委常委、省委组织部部长庄兆林在宜春市接访，并主持召开信访包联工作调度会，研究化解信访积案、依法维护群众合法权益。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Zhuang Zhaolin, member of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Standing Committee and head of the Provincial Organization Department, received petitioners in Yichun and chaired a coordination meeting on petition-related work, urging resolution of long-pending cases and protection of citizens' lawful rights.

tags.name_en: Protecting Rights in Accordance with Law

tags_en: Protecting Rights in Accordance with Law

articles.title_zh: 全国革命文物保护利用片区建设工作会在赣州召开
articles.title_en: National Work Conference on Revolutionary Cultural Relics Protection and Utilization Zones Held in Ganzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，全国革命文物保护利用片区建设工作会在江西赣州召开，国家文物局局长饶权出席讲话，江西省委常委、宣传部部长卢小青致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, a national work conference on building revolutionary cultural relics protection and utilization zones was held in Ganzhou, Jiangxi. Rao Quan, head of the National Cultural Heritage Administration, spoke, and Lu Xiaoqing, a Jiangxi provincial Party standing committee member, addressed the meeting.

tags.name_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Revitalization of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见中国华能白勇钟国东
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet with China Huaneng's Bai Yong and Zhong Guodong
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区主席包钢在呼和浩特会见中国华能集团董事长白勇、总经理钟国东，双方就新能源开发与能源科技创新合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong and Chairman Bao Gang met in Hohhot with China Huaneng Chairman Bai Yong and General Manager Zhong Guodong to discuss cooperation on new energy development and energy technology innovation.

articles.title_zh: 包钢调研“十五五”时期新型电网建设及电力工作
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Inspects New-Type Power Grid Construction and Power Work for the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，内蒙古自治区政府主席包钢调研“十五五”时期新型电网建设及电力工作，强调优化电网结构、推进绿电消纳与多能并举。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Inner Mongolia Chairman Bao Gang inspected new-type power grid construction and power work for the 15th Five-Year Plan, urging grid upgrades and green power development.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏启动文旅产业创新人才培育专项行动
articles.title_en: Ningxia Launches Cultural Tourism Innovation Talent Development Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，宁夏回族自治区文化和旅游厅在银川启动文旅产业创新人才培育专项行动，聚焦文化创意与数字文旅，首期培训200余人参加。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Ningxia's Culture and Tourism Department launched a cultural tourism innovation talent development program in Yinchuan, focusing on cultural creativity and digital tourism, with over 200 participants.

articles.title_zh: 退役军人服务保障先进单位及个人表彰大会在京召开 谌贻琴出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Commendation Conference for Outstanding Veterans-Service Units and Individuals Held in Beijing; Chen Yiqin Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，退役军人服务保障先进单位及个人表彰大会在北京召开，国务委员谌贻琴出席并讲话，会上表彰299个先进单位和396名先进个人。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, a commendation conference for outstanding veterans-service units and individuals was held in Beijing. State Councilor Chen Yiqin attended and spoke; 299 units and 396 individuals were honored.

articles.title_zh: 国际打击电信网络诈骗联盟成立大会举行 王小洪出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Founding Conference of International Alliance Against Telecom and Online Fraud Held; Wang Xiaohong Attends and Addresses the Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，国际打击电信网络诈骗联盟成立大会在江苏连云港举行，国务委员、公安部部长王小洪出席并致辞，并会见多国执法安全部门负责人。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, the founding conference of the International Alliance Against Telecom and Online Fraud was held in Lianyungang, Jiangsu. State Councilor and Public Security Minister Wang Xiaohong attended and addressed the meeting, and met with foreign law enforcement and security officials.

articles.title_zh: 成都将启动三项全国农村改革试验区拓展试验
articles.title_en: Chengdu to Launch Three Expanded Pilot Tasks in National Rural Reform Pilot Zones
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部办公厅等10部门联合印发批复，同意在全国农村改革试验区启动拓展试验任务，成都承担完善农业生产设施抵押贷款模式等三项任务。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs and nine other departments approved new expanded pilot tasks for the national rural reform pilot zones, with Chengdu taking on three tasks including improving mortgage lending on agricultural production facilities.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 四川省灌区量水设施设备建设指南发布
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases Guidelines for Water Measurement Facilities in Irrigation Districts
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月10日，四川省都江堰水利发展中心牵头编制的四川省地方标准《四川省灌区量水设施设备建设指南》获批发布，将于10月4日起实施。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, 2026, Sichuan's local standard "Guidelines for the Construction of Water Measurement Facilities in Irrigation Districts," led by the Dujiangyan Water Conservancy Development Center, was approved and will take effect on October 4.

articles.title_zh: 四川省委组织部发布一批干部任前公示
articles.title_en: Organization Department of Sichuan Provincial Party Committee Issues Public Notice on Pre-Appointment of Cadres
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月11日，中共四川省委组织部发布干部任前公示，白淼等18名同志拟任县（市、区）人民法院院长、人民检察院检察长。
articles.summary_en: On September 11, 2026, the Organization Department of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee issued a public notice on cadre appointments, proposing 18 officials, including Bai Miao, for posts as county-level court presidents and chief procurators.

tags.name_en: Organization Department of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee
Public Notice on Pre-Appointment of Cadres

tags_en: Organization Department of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee
Public Notice on Pre-Appointment of Cadres

articles.title_zh: 何维在四川出席农工党中央“推动西部大开发形成新格局”专题调研座谈会
articles.title_en: He Wei Attends CPPWDP Central Committee Symposium on Western Development in Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，农工党中央“推动西部大开发形成新格局”专题调研座谈会在成都召开，全国人大常委会副委员长、农工党中央主席何维出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, the CPPWDP Central Committee held a research symposium in Chengdu on forming a new pattern of western development, with He Wei, vice chair of the NPC Standing Committee, attending and speaking.

tags.name_en: Central Committee of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party

tags_en: Central Committee of the Chinese Peasants' and Workers' Democratic Party

articles.title_zh: 记者探访服贸会四川馆：数字技术与文化叙事成服务贸易新趋势
articles.title_en: Sichuan Pavilion at CIFTIS Spotlights Digital Technology and Cultural Storytelling in Trade in Services
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，2026年中国国际服务贸易交易会在北京首钢园开幕，记者探访四川馆，30余家参展企业展示数字技术渗透服务业与文化IP出海的新趋势。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services opened at Shougang Park in Beijing, where more than 30 Sichuan exhibitors showcased digital services and cultural IP going global.

articles.title_zh: 山东出台水预算管理试行办法 用水前先“算账”用完后要“决算”
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues Trial Measures for Water Budget Management
articles.summary_zh: 山东省水利厅、省发展改革委、省住房城乡建设厅联合印发《山东省水预算管理办法（试行）》，提出29条措施，建立省、市、县三级水预算管理体系。
articles.summary_en: Three Shandong provincial departments jointly issued trial measures for water budget management, setting out 29 rules and a provincial, municipal and county three-tier water budget system.

articles.title_zh: 上海召开对口支援与合作交流工作会议
articles.title_en: Shanghai Holds Meeting on Paired Assistance and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月10日，上海市对口支援与合作交流工作会议举行，市委书记陈吉宁讲话，代市长朱忠明主持，部署巩固脱贫成果、公共服务帮扶和区域合作等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, 2026, Shanghai held its paired-assistance and east-west cooperation meeting, where Party Secretary Chen Jining spoke and acting mayor Zhu Zhongming presided, vowing rural revitalization and public-service aid.

articles.title_zh: 每平方米涨了两毛钱，这个小区物业费调价方案高票通过
articles.title_en: Property Fee Up 0.2 Yuan per Square Meter: Shanghai Community Overwhelmingly Approves Adjustment Plan
articles.summary_zh: 上海普陀区真如镇街道曹杨新苑居民区党总支以党建引领、专业指导、志愿者包干到户的方式，推动物业费每平方米上调0.2元，调价方案高票通过。
articles.summary_en: The Party general branch of Caoyang Xinyuan community in Zhenru Town, Putuo District, Shanghai, used party-led mobilization, professional guidance and door-to-door volunteers to win overwhelming approval for a 0.2 yuan per square meter property fee increase.

articles.title_zh: 陕西发布“三秋”防灾减灾机械化技术指导意见
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues Technical Guidance on Mechanized Disaster Prevention for Autumn Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，陕西省农业机械鉴定推广总站印发《陕西省2026年“三秋”防灾减灾机械化技术指导意见》，围绕强降雨渍涝、大风倒伏、高温干旱三类灾害提出机械化生产技术路线，指导各地保障“三秋”农机化生产。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, the Shaanxi Agricultural Machinery Appraisal and Extension Station issued technical guidance on mechanized disaster prevention for the 2026 autumn harvest season, setting out mechanized production measures against heavy rain, lodging and drought to keep autumn farm machinery operations on track.

articles.title_zh: 加快建设新型能源体系 推动山西向能源强省跨越
articles.title_en: Shanxi Moves to Build a New-Type Energy System and Leap from Coal Hub to Energy Powerhouse
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，中共山西省委宣传部、山西省政府新闻办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列新闻发布会省能源局专场，省能源局局长张翔等介绍山西“十五五”能源转型与新型能源体系建设部署。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Shanxi held a press conference where the Provincial Energy Bureau set out plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan to build a new-type energy system and turn the coal hub into an energy powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江会见中国国民党前主席洪秀柱
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Meets Former KMT Chairman Hung Hsiu-chu
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江在乌鲁木齐会见中国国民党前主席、中华青雁和平教育基金会董事长洪秀柱，双方就推动台湾与新疆交流合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang met in Urumqi with Hung Hsiu-chu, former chairman of the Kuomintang and chairman of the Chinese Qingyan Peace Education Foundation, to discuss boosting exchanges between Taiwan and Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 王君正在拉萨市调研时强调：扎实推进中华民族共同体建设
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Inspects Lhasa, Stresses Advancing the Building of a Community for the Chinese Nation
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨市调研，强调全面贯彻新时代党的治藏方略，扎实推进中华民族共同体建设，共建中华民族共有精神文化家园。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Wang Junzheng inspected Lhasa, stressing full implementation of the Party's Tibet strategy and advancing the building of a community for the Chinese nation.

articles.title_zh: 浙江“十五五”综合交通规划发布
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Comprehensive Transportation
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省政府新闻办9月10日举行新闻发布会，介绍《浙江省“十五五”综合交通运输发展规划》，明确到2030年基本建成现代化高水平交通强省，并首次提出培育低空经济。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang's government information office held a press briefing on Sept 10 to present the province's 15th Five-Year Plan for comprehensive transportation, which aims to build a modern, high-level transportation powerhouse by 2030 and for the first time proposes cultivating the low-altitude economy.

articles.title_zh: 北京市人大常委会召开会议 审议噪声污染防治条例草案等议题 李秀领主持
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Meets on Noise Pollution Prevention Regulations, Chaired by Li Xiuling
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日上午，北京市十六届人大常委会召开第二十六次会议，审议噪声污染防治条例草案、无人驾驶航空器管理规定修订草案、民营经济促进条例草案等议题，主任李秀领主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 10, the Standing Committee of the 16th Beijing Municipal People's Congress held its 26th session, chaired by Li Xiuling, reviewing draft regulations on noise pollution prevention, unmanned aircraft management and the private economy.

tags.name_en: Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress

tags_en: Standing Committee of the Beijing Municipal People's Congress

articles.title_zh: 殷勇会见美国标普全球集团总裁兼首席执行官
articles.title_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong Meets S&P Global CEO Martina Cheung
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日上午，北京市市长殷勇会见美国标普全球集团总裁兼首席执行官玛蒂娜·张，双方就深化绿色经济、科技创新、证券交易等领域务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 10, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong met with Martina Cheung, President and CEO of S&P Global, to discuss deeper cooperation in green economy, technological innovation and securities trading.

articles.title_zh: 住得安心、睡得踏实！青岛公安部门开展流动人口出租房屋管理专项督导检查
articles.title_en: Qingdao Police Carry Out Special Inspection on Migrant Population and Rental Housing Management
articles.summary_zh: 近日，青岛市公安局崂山分局开展流动人口、出租房屋服务管理专项督导检查，走访核查登记报备情况，排查日租房、群租房治安与居住安全隐患，压实出租主体责任。
articles.summary_en: The Laoshan branch of the Qingdao Public Security Bureau recently conducted a special inspection of migrant population and rental housing management, verifying registration and checking daily-rental and group-rental housing for safety hazards.

articles.title_zh: 我国首个地球系统数据国际交换中心启动建设
articles.title_en: China's First Earth System Data International Exchange Center Begins Construction
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，中国气象局、澳门特别行政区与横琴粤澳深度合作区三方在横琴签署共建协议，启动建设我国首个地球系统数据国际交换中心（澳门）。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, the China Meteorological Administration, the Macao SAR and the Hengqin Guangdong-Macao cooperation zone signed an agreement to build China's first Earth System Data International Exchange Center.

articles.title_zh: 中方敦促推动伊核问题重回政治外交解决轨道
articles.title_en: China Urges Return of Iran Nuclear Issue to Political and Diplomatic Track
articles.summary_zh: 中国常驻联合国副代表孙磊9月10日在安理会伊朗核问题公开会上发言，敦促各方摒弃武力，推动伊核问题重回政治外交解决轨道，并支持俄方反对安理会开会的立场。
articles.summary_en: Sun Lei, China's deputy permanent representative to the UN, spoke at the Security Council's open meeting on the Iran nuclear issue on September 10, urging parties to abandon the use of force and return the issue to a political and diplomatic track.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit in New Delhi
articles.summary_zh: 应印度总理莫迪邀请，国家主席习近平将于9月12日至13日赴印度新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Modi, President Xi Jinping will travel to New Delhi on September 12-13 to attend the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺王清宪在合肥看望慰问教师代表并调研教育工作
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun and Wang Qingxian Visit Teachers and Inspect Education Work in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日教师节当天，安徽省委书记梁言顺、省长王清宪在合肥看望慰问教师代表并调研教育工作，向全省教师致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Teacher's Day, Anhui Party Secretary Liang Yanshun and Governor Wang Qingxian visited teachers and inspected schools in Hefei, greeting educators provincewide.

articles.title_zh: 湖南出台财金协同支持大学生创业“1+5”系列政策
articles.title_en: Hunan Launches "1+5" Fiscal-Financial Policy Package to Support College Student Entrepreneurship
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省财政厅联合省委金融办、省人社厅等部门推出财政金融协同支持大学生创业“1+5”系列政策，打造总规模12亿元的省级大学生创业投资基金矩阵，并配套担保、贴息、保险等支持。
articles.summary_en: Hunan's Department of Finance, together with the provincial financial office and human resources authorities, rolled out a "1+5" fiscal-financial policy package to support college student entrepreneurship, including a 1.2 billion yuan provincial fund matrix plus guarantees, interest subsidies and insurance.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省出台措施支持存量土地盘活增效
articles.title_en: Hunan Issues Measures to Support Revitalization of Existing Land
articles.summary_zh: 近日，湖南省出台《支持存量土地盘活增效促进高质量发展的若干措施》，从规划优化、开发建设、供应方式创新等18个方面推动批而未供、闲置、低效土地盘活利用。
articles.summary_en: Hunan Province recently issued measures to revitalize existing land, rolling out 18 policy steps covering planning, development and land supply to unlock idle and inefficiently used land.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明调研湖南财信金融控股集团有限公司
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Inspects Hunan Caixin Financial Holding Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，湖南省委书记沈晓明赴湖南财信金融控股集团有限公司调研，强调强化国企使命担当、发挥金融工具协同效能，服务现代化产业体系建设。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming inspected Hunan Caixin Financial Holding Group, urging the state-owned financial firm to strengthen its mission and better serve the province's modern industrial system.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛在淮安宿迁调研
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao Inspects Huai'an and Suqian
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日至10日，江苏省省长刘小涛赴淮安、宿迁调研，强调因地制宜培育壮大县域富民产业，推动城乡融合与区域协调发展。
articles.summary_en: From September 9 to 10, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao inspected Huai'an and Suqian, calling for county-level industries that enrich residents and for coordinated urban-rural and regional development.

articles.title_zh: 信长星在连云港调研
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Conducts Inspection Tour in Lianyungang
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，江苏省委书记信长星到连云港调研，走访科技装备展及企业，强调推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，因地制宜发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing inspected Lianyungang, visiting a public security technology exhibition and local firms, and urged deeper integration of technological and industrial innovation to develop new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛会见同济大学党委书记郑庆华校长杨金龙
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing and Liu Xiaotao Meet with Tongji University Leaders Zheng Qinghua and Yang Jinlong
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛在南京会见同济大学党委书记郑庆华、校长杨金龙，当天江苏省与同济大学签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Tongji University Party Secretary Zheng Qinghua and President Yang Jinlong in Nanjing, and Jiangsu signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Tongji University the same day.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就朝鲜国庆78周年向金正恩致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Kim Jong Un on DPRK's 78th National Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平就朝鲜国庆78周年向朝鲜劳动党总书记、国务委员会委员长金正恩致贺电，强调维护好、巩固好、发展好中朝关系是中国党和政府坚定不移的方针。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and Chinese President, sent a congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un on the 78th anniversary of the DPRK's founding, stressing that upholding and developing China-DPRK relations is an unswerving policy of the Chinese Party and government.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Festive Greetings to Teachers and Educators Across China
articles.summary_zh: 在第四十二个教师节到来之际，习近平代表党中央于9月9日向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候，希望广大教师落实立德树人根本任务。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 42nd Teachers' Day, Xi Jinping, on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, extended festive greetings on September 9 to teachers and educators nationwide, urging them to fulfill the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝东北师范大学建校80周年大会举行 黄强致辞 胡玉亭出席
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Speaks at Northeast Normal University's 80th Anniversary Celebration; Hu Yuting Attends
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日教师节，庆祝东北师范大学建校80周年大会在长春举行，吉林省委书记黄强出席并致辞，省长胡玉亭出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Teachers' Day, a ceremony marking the 80th anniversary of Northeast Normal University was held in Changchun, where Jilin Party Secretary Huang Qiang delivered a speech and Governor Hu Yuting attended.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠教师节前夕到教育系统调研并看望慰问教师代表
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Inspects Education System and Meets Teachers Ahead of Teachers' Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，长春市委书记张恩惠在教师节前夕赴德惠市第六小学、长春职业技术大学调研并慰问教师代表，随后在市教育局座谈，强调深化教育综合改革。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui visited schools and met teacher representatives ahead of Teachers' Day, chairing a symposium on education reform.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠到德惠市调研 坚持因地制宜 聚力改革突破 有力有效推动县域经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Inspects Dehui City, Urging County Economy Growth via Reform
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日，长春市委书记张恩惠到德惠市调研，实地考察开发区改革、重点企业经营和热电项目建设，强调因地制宜推动县域经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, 2026, Changchun Party Secretary Zhang Enhui visited Dehui City to inspect development-zone reform, key enterprises and a thermal power project, urging high-quality county economic growth suited to local conditions.

articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，以“智改数转AI兴工”为主题的2026全球工业互联网大会在沈阳开幕，辽宁省委书记许昆林出席，省长王新伟、工信部副部长谢远生等致辞，并启动辽宁省首届“智改数转”系列活动。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, the 2026 Global Industrial Internet Conference, themed "AI-Driven Industrial Digital Transformation," opened in Shenyang. Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin attended, while Governor Wang Xinwei and MIIT Vice Minister Xie Yuansheng delivered speeches and launched Liaoning's first digital transformation campaign.

articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met CSCEC Chairman Zheng Xuexuan in Shenyang to deepen central-local cooperation on infrastructure, urban renewal and smart construction.

articles.title_zh: 《金融强国建设“十五五”规划》正式出台

articles.summary_en: On September 10, China announced the official release of the 15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Financial Power, aiming to form the overall framework of a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics by 2030.

articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 42nd Teachers' Day, Xi Jinping sent festive greetings to teachers and educators nationwide, urging them to stay dedicated and help build a strong education nation.

articles.title_zh: 2026年APEC工商领导人峰会将于11月17日至18日在深圳举办

articles.summary_en: The China Council for the Promotion of International Trade said on Sept 10 that the 2026 APEC CEO Summit will be held in Shenzhen on Nov 17-18 under the theme "Promoting Prosperity, Sharing the Future".

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥出席第十六次亚太经合组织能源部长会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Opening Ceremony of 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting and Delivers Remarks
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，第十六次亚太经合组织能源部长会议在北京开幕，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席并致辞，就加强普惠共享、创新合作、协同共治提出三点建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, the 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting opened in Beijing, where Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang delivered remarks and proposed stronger sharing, innovation and coordination in regional energy cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学、李生潜会见中国建设银行甘肃省分行行长徐宏一行
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue and Li Shengqian Meet with Xu Hong of China Construction Bank Gansu Branch
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日下午，定西市委书记汪尚学、代市长李生潜在定西会见中国建设银行甘肃省分行行长徐宏一行，双方就深化政银合作座谈交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 9, Dingxi Party Secretary Wang Shangxue and Acting Mayor Li Shengqian met with Xu Hong, head of China Construction Bank's Gansu Branch, to discuss deeper government-bank cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元会见中国移动黑龙江公司董事长金巍

articles.summary_en: On September 10, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan met Jin Wei, Chairman of China Mobile Heilongjiang, to discuss deeper cooperation in computing infrastructure, dual-gigabit city construction and smart tourism.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡调研科技服务业发展情况：做强科技服务 激活创新动能
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Stresses Stronger Tech Services and Innovation Momentum in Research Visit on Technology Service Industry

articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Huaibei Acting Mayor Huang Wei visited sci-tech platforms and firms to research the city's technology services industry, urging stronger services and innovation momentum.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡会见中国再生资源开发集团客人
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Meets China Renewable Resources Development Group Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日上午，淮北市委副书记、代市长黄韡会见来淮考察的中国再生资源开发集团副总经理陈倬岳一行，就再生资源领域“两网融合”合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, Huaibei acting mayor Huang Wei met a China Renewable Resources Development Group delegation led by vice GM Chen Zhuoyue to discuss 'two-network integration' cooperation in renewable resources.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队到揭东区调研并走访重点企业

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 9, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie led a team to Jiedong District to visit key enterprises and inspect a National Highway G206 renovation project, urging precise services to support enterprise growth.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保主持召开揭阳市委书记专题会议 研究“潮侨聚故里”主题活动筹备工作

articles.summary_en: Jieyang Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao chaired a special municipal Party committee meeting on Sept 9 to review preparations for the "Overseas Chaoshan Natives Returning Home" event; Mayor Qu Xiaojie attended.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对山东青岛市北海造船厂一货轮火灾事故作出重要指示

articles.summary_en: A foreign cargo ship caught fire during repairs at Qingdao Beihai Shipyard, Shandong, on Sept 10, causing heavy casualties. Xi Jinping ordered rescue, investigation and accountability; Li Qiang also issued instructions.

articles.title_zh: 退役军人服务保障先进单位及个人表彰大会在京召开 谌贻琴出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Commendation Conference for Outstanding Units and Individuals in Veterans Service and Support Held in Beijing; Shen Yiqin Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，退役军人服务保障先进单位及个人表彰大会在北京召开，国务委员谌贻琴出席并讲话，会上表彰299个先进单位和396名先进个人。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, a commendation conference for outstanding units and individuals in veterans service and support was held in Beijing. State Councilor Shen Yiqin attended and delivered a speech, and 299 advanced units and 396 individuals were commended.

articles.title_zh: 第七次全国体育系统对口支援西藏工作会议在拉萨召开
articles.title_en: Seventh National Sports System Meeting on Paired Assistance to Tibet Held in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 近日，第七次全国体育系统对口支援西藏工作会议在拉萨召开，自治区党委书记王君正、国家体育总局局长高志丹出席并讲话，部署“十五五”时期体育援藏工作。
articles.summary_en: The seventh national sports system meeting on paired assistance to Tibet was held in Lhasa, where Tibet Party Secretary Wang Junzheng and sports chief Gao Zhidan spoke on aid work for the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

tags.name_en: General Administration of Sport of China

tags_en: General Administration of Sport of China

articles.title_zh: 严金海在拉萨市达孜区、林周县调研乡村振兴与产业培育
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Inspects Rural Revitalization and Industry Development in Lhasa's Dagze District and Lhunzhub County
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区人大常委会主任严金海在拉萨市达孜区、林周县调研乡村振兴、产业培育和乡村文旅融合发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Yan Jinhai, Deputy Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee and Director of the Regional People's Congress Standing Committee, inspected rural revitalization, industry cultivation and rural cultural tourism integration in Dagze District and Lhunzhub County of Lhasa.

articles.title_zh: “做党和人民满意的好老师”——习近平总书记的重要论述指引教师工作开创新局面
articles.title_en: "Good Teachers Who Satisfy the Party and the People": Xi Jinping's Key Expositions Guide New Progress in Teacher Workforce Development
articles.summary_zh: 2026年教师节之际，习近平总书记向全国广大教师致以节日祝贺，强调“教师是立教之本、兴教之源”，勉励广大教师做党和人民满意的好老师。
articles.summary_en: On Teachers' Day 2026, Xi Jinping extended festive greetings to teachers nationwide, stressing that teachers are the foundation of education and urging them to be good teachers who satisfy the Party and the people.

articles.title_zh: 第七次全国体育系统对口支援西藏工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Seventh National Sports System Conference on Paired Assistance to Tibet Held in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日，第七次全国体育系统对口支援西藏工作会议在拉萨召开，西藏自治区党委书记王君正、国家体育总局局长高志丹出席并讲话，部署“十五五”体育援藏工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, 2026, the 7th national sports system conference on paired assistance to Tibet was held in Lhasa, where Wang Junzheng and Gao Zhidan spoke and set out sports aid tasks for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 严金海在拉萨市达孜区、林周县调研乡村振兴与产业培育
articles.title_en: Yan Jinhai Inspects Rural Revitalization and Industry Development in Lhasa's Dazi District and Linzhou County
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区人大常委会主任严金海在拉萨市达孜区、林周县调研乡村振兴、产业培育和乡村文旅融合发展情况，强调做大做强特色优势产业。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Yan Jinhai, Deputy Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee and Director of the Regional People's Congress Standing Committee, inspected rural revitalization, industry cultivation and rural cultural tourism integration in Dazi District and Linzhou County of Lhasa, urging stronger distinctive industries.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到潮南区召开市安委会全体会议暨消防安全问题整治推进会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Chairs Shantou Work Safety Committee Meeting on Fire Safety Rectification in Chaonan District
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日上午，汕头市委书记庄悦群到潮南区实地督导消防治理工作，并召开市安委会全体会议暨消防安全问题整治推进会，部署隐患排查与基层消防治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sept 9, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn inspected fire safety rectification work in Chaonan District and chaired a municipal work safety committee meeting on deepening fire safety problem rectification.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群赴市委党校为2026年秋季学期学员作专题辅导
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Gives Special Lecture to Autumn 2026 Students at Shantou Municipal Party School
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群赴市委党校为2026年秋季学期学员作专题辅导，强调弘扬特区精神、在汕头迎头赶上征程中担当作为。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 9, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn gave a special lecture at the municipal Party school, urging autumn 2026 students to carry forward the special economic zone spirit and help Shantou catch up.

articles.title_zh: 李国强主持召开泰安市人民政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Chairs Tai'an Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日上午，泰安市市长李国强主持召开市政府常务会议，研究化工行业安全生产和促进“多日游”发展等工作，并审议通过相关措施。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 9, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang chaired a municipal government executive meeting to review chemical industry safety production and measures to boost multi-day tourism, approving the relevant policy document.

articles.title_zh: 泰安市人民政府第五次全体会议召开 李国强主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Tai'an Municipal Government Holds Fifth Plenary Meeting, Chaired by Li Guoqiang
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日上午，泰安市人民政府第五次全体会议召开，市委副书记、市长李国强主持并讲话，对全年工作进行再部署、再推进。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 9, the Tai'an Municipal People's Government held its fifth plenary meeting, chaired by Mayor Li Guoqiang, to redeploy and advance work for the full year.

articles.title_zh: 市委就市第七次党代会报告征求意见建议
articles.title_en: Taizhou Municipal Party Committee Solicits Opinions on Report for City's 7th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 近日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬主持召开专题座谈会，就市第七次党代会报告分别征求市人大常委会、市政府、市政协党组及各民主党派、工商联等意见建议。
articles.summary_en: Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong recently chaired a symposium to solicit opinions from the city's people's congress, government, CPPCC and other sectors on the report for the city's 7th Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬走访调研部分在泰高校
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Visits and Surveys Universities in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬走访调研泰州学院等在泰高校，强调深化校地合作与产教融合，办好人民满意的高等教育。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Taizhou Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong visited several universities in the city, calling for deeper university-locality cooperation and industry-education integration to improve higher education.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝东北师范大学建校80周年大会在长春举行 黄强致辞 胡玉亭出席
articles.title_en: Huang Qiang Speaks at 80th Anniversary Celebration of Northeast Normal University in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日，庆祝东北师范大学建校80周年大会在长春举行，吉林省委书记黄强出席并致辞，省长胡玉亭出席。
articles.summary_en: On September 10, Northeast Normal University's 80th anniversary was celebrated in Changchun, with Jilin Party Secretary Huang Qiang delivering a speech and Governor Hu Yuting attending.

articles.title_zh: 张海波调研教育工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects Education Work in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日教师节前夕，威海市委书记张海波到威海一中、哈工大（威海）、山东大学（威海）调研教育工作并看望慰问教师，强调推进教育科技人才一体发展、深化校地合作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, ahead of Teachers' Day, Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo inspected schools and universities in Weihai, greeting teachers and urging deeper school-local cooperation and talent recruitment.

articles.title_zh: 芜湖市人大常委会党组召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Wuhu Municipal People's Congress Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，芜湖市人大常委会党组召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育的重要指示，部署巩固学习教育成果，张峰主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Wuhu's Municipal People's Congress Party Group held an enlarged meeting on upholding a correct view of political achievements and building long-term mechanisms, chaired by Zhang Feng.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行芜湖市分行与湾沚区政府签订战略合作协议
articles.title_en: PBOC Wuhu Branch Signs Strategic Cooperation Agreement with Wanzhi District Government
articles.summary_zh: 日前，中国人民银行芜湖市分行与芜湖市湾沚区人民政府签署战略合作协议，聚焦金融支持低空经济高质量发展，助力打造通用航空产业基地。
articles.summary_en: The Wuhu branch of the People's Bank of China signed a strategic cooperation agreement with the Wanzhi District government in Wuhu to boost the high-quality development of the low-altitude economy and build a general aviation industry base.

articles.title_zh: 陈东主持召开市政府第129次常务会议
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Chairs 129th Executive Meeting of Wuhu Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东主持召开市政府第129次常务会议，审议现代物流产业能级提升行动计划和全民健康促进条例草案等。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Chen Dong, Deputy Party Secretary and Acting Mayor of Wuhu, chaired the 129th executive meeting of the municipal government, reviewing an action plan to upgrade the modern logistics industry and a draft public health promotion regulation.

articles.title_zh: 国务院办公厅关于加强中小企业回款难问题治理有关工作的通知
articles.title_en: State Council General Office Issues Notice on Strengthening Governance of Payment Arrears to SMEs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院办公厅印发国办发〔2026〕24号通知，要求分行业明确合理账期，推动大型企业对中小企业付款期限压至60日内、以现金支付，并规范电子凭证等非现金支付工具。
articles.summary_en: China's State Council General Office issued a notice requiring industry-specific payment terms, capping large firms' payments to SMEs at 60 days in cash, and tightening regulation of non-cash payment instruments such as electronic vouchers.

tags.name_en: General Office of the State Council

tags_en: General Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会召开会议 研究安排高水平对外开放等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets on High-Level Opening Up
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，西安市委常委会召开会议，学习习近平总书记在上合组织峰会上的重要讲话精神，研究安排高水平对外开放等工作，市委书记蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's SCO summit speech and plan high-level opening-up work, chaired by Party Secretary Hao Huijie.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚调研气象工作时强调：推进气象科技能力现代化和社会服务现代化
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Inspects Meteorological Work, Urging Modernization of Meteorological Technology and Public Services
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，陕西省省长赵刚在西安市调研气象工作，强调推进气象科技能力现代化和社会服务现代化，为陕西高质量发展提供有力气象保障。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Shaanxi Governor Zhao Gang inspected meteorological work in Xi'an, urging modernization of meteorological technology and public services to support the province's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 陈维忠赴封丘县宣讲市第十三次党代会精神
articles.title_en: Chen Weizhong Visits Fengqiu County to Promote Spirit of City's 13th Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，新乡市市长陈维忠到封丘县宣讲市第十三次党代会精神，并调研主导产业发展、信访约访、水污染治理等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Xinxiang Mayor Chen Weizhong visited Fengqiu County to promote the city's 13th Party Congress spirit and inspect industry, petition work and water pollution control.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜到市人民来访接待中心接待来访群众
articles.title_en: Yancheng Acting Mayor Wu Wei Meets Petitioners at Municipal Reception Center
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，盐城市委副书记、代市长吴炜到市人民来访接待中心开展信访接待日活动，现场听取群众诉求，要求依法依规及时有效解决。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Wu Wei, deputy Party secretary and acting mayor of Yancheng, held a petition reception day at the city's public reception center, hearing residents' complaints and urging timely, law-based resolution.

articles.title_zh: 盐城市委书记严汉平会见中铁二十四局支卫清一行
articles.title_en: Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping Meets China Railway 24th Bureau Delegation Led by Zhi Weiqing
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，盐城市委书记严汉平会见中铁二十四局董事长支卫清、世纪互联集团总裁鲍益一行，就项目落地、基础设施建设和数字经济合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping met China Railway 24th Bureau chairman Zhi Weiqing and 21Vianet president Bao Yi to discuss project investment, infrastructure and digital economy cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉等调研教育资源优化布局工作并开展教师节前慰问活动
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Education Resource Optimization and Visits Teachers Ahead of Teachers' Day
articles.summary_zh: 第42个教师节来临之际，银川市委书记赵旭辉与市长陶少华等市领导分别调研教育资源优化布局工作，看望慰问一线教师，强调弘扬教育家精神、办好人民满意的教育。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 42nd Teachers' Day, Yinchuan Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui and other city leaders inspected education resource planning work and visited frontline teachers, calling for better and more balanced education.

articles.title_zh: 银川市庆祝第42个教师节表彰大会召开 赵旭辉出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Holds Commendation Meeting for 42nd Teachers' Day, Zhao Xuhui Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，银川市召开庆祝第42个教师节表彰大会，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉出席并讲话，部署教育强市建设与教师队伍建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Yinchuan held a commendation meeting marking the 42nd Teachers' Day, where Municipal Party Secretary Zhao Xuhui spoke on building a strong education city and supporting teachers.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究防灾减灾、县域经济、消防安全等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the municipal Party committee's standing committee to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speeches and directives, and to review work on disaster prevention and relief, county-level economic development, and fire safety.

articles.title_zh: 福建推出“尊师惠师大礼包” 全省教师可享多项专属优惠
articles.title_en: Fujian Rolls Out "Teacher Appreciation Package" with Exclusive Benefits for Educators Provincewide
articles.summary_zh: 第42个教师节期间，福建省教育厅上线“中国教师”福建专区并推出“尊师惠师大礼包”，全省教师凭电子教师证可享医疗健康、交通出行、文旅等专属优惠。
articles.summary_en: Around the 42nd Teachers' Day, Fujian's education authorities launched a dedicated "China Teacher" mini-program zone and a teacher-benefit package, giving educators provincewide discounts in healthcare, transport, culture and housing.

articles.title_zh: 人民领袖｜此情不忘是师恩
articles.title_en: People's Leader: Never Forgetting the Kindness of Teachers
articles.summary_zh: 文章记述习近平多年来在教师节等场合看望、致信昔日恩师，尤其是其八一学校语文老师陈秋影，表达尊师重教之情。
articles.summary_en: The article recounts how Xi Jinping has over the years visited and written to his former teachers, especially his middle-school Chinese teacher Chen Qiuying, expressing respect for educators.

articles.title_zh: 算力价格中枢上移 人工智能行业亟需深度转型
articles.title_en: Computing Power Prices Shift Upward, AI Industry Urgently Needs Deep Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 报道指出，算力价格持续攀升推高人工智能企业经营成本，行业正从算力驱动转向效率驱动，竞争格局面临重构。
articles.summary_en: Rising computing power prices are driving up AI firms' operating costs, pushing China's industry from scale-driven to efficiency-driven development and reshaping competition.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研教育高质量发展工作并看望慰问教师代表
articles.title_en: Zeng Zhanrong Inspects Education Development Work and Visits Teacher Representatives
articles.summary_zh: 9月10日第42个教师节，青岛市委书记曾赞荣调研教育高质量发展工作，先后到中国海洋大学、青岛第五十八中学、青岛电子学校看望慰问教师代表。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 10, the 42nd Teachers' Day, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zhanrong inspected high-quality education development and visited teacher representatives at Ocean University of China, Qingdao No. 58 High School and Qingdao Electronics School.

articles.title_zh: 外媒聚焦：服贸会推动国际务实合作 世界共享中国市场机遇
articles.title_en: Global Media Spotlight: CIFTIS Drives Practical International Cooperation as World Shares China's Market Opportunities
articles.summary_zh: 2026年服贸会首次设立中国服务案例展区，津巴布韦副总统奇温加等多国人士表示，服贸会是全球合作重要平台，助力各方共享中国市场机遇。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services, a China services case exhibition debuted, with Zimbabwean Vice President Chiwenga and others saying the fair is a key platform for global cooperation and sharing China's market opportunities.

articles.title_zh: 抢占AI漫剧新赛道：郑州支持高校增设AI漫剧相关专业方向
articles.title_en: Zhengzhou Backs Universities in Adding AI Comic-Drama Majors to Seize New Track
articles.summary_zh: 郑州市文化广电和旅游局答复政协委员提案，提出支持高校增设AI漫剧相关专业方向，设立专项基金并加大高端人才引进，加快打造“微短剧创作之都”。
articles.summary_en: Zhengzhou's culture and tourism bureau, replying to a political consultative conference proposal, said it will support universities in adding AI comic-drama majors, create a special fund and attract top talent to build a "capital of micro-drama creation".

articles.title_zh: 三峡水库2026年度蓄水启动
articles.title_en: Three Gorges Reservoir Begins 2026 Annual Impoundment
articles.summary_zh: 水利部长江水利委员会10日宣布三峡水库2026年度蓄水启动，长江上游控制性水库群蓄水同步有序推进，以应对来水偏枯形势。
articles.summary_en: The Yangtze River Water Resources Commission of the Ministry of Water Resources announced on the 10th that the Three Gorges Reservoir has begun its 2026 annual impoundment, with controlled reservoirs in the upper Yangtze River basin filling in a coordinated manner amid below-average inflows.

tags.name_en: Yangtze River Water Resources Commission of the Ministry of Water Resources

articles.title_zh: 广西壮族自治区主席韦韬"带货""三碗粉"：吃一碗粉只能说"及格"
articles.title_en: Guangxi Chairman Wei Tao Promotes the "Three Bowls of Noodles" at CIFTIS
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，2026年中国国际服务贸易交易会在北京举办，广西壮族自治区主席韦韬出席面向东盟服务贸易合作推介会并巡展，推介广西"三碗粉"等特色产品与开放合作机遇。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Guangxi Chairman Wei Tao attended the ASEAN-oriented service trade promotion conference at CIFTIS 2026 in Beijing, promoting Guangxi's signature rice noodles and cooperation opportunities.

articles.title_zh: 第三届新时代青年“重走长征路”活动在贵州遵义启动
articles.title_en: Third "Re-walking the Long March" Event for New-Era Youth Kicks Off in Zunyi, Guizhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，纪念红军长征胜利90周年之际，第三届新时代青年“重走长征路”活动在贵州遵义会议纪念馆启动，300余人参加。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, the third "Re-walking the Long March" event for new-era youth was launched at the Zunyi Conference Memorial Hall in Guizhou, marking the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, with over 300 participants.

articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，北京市委书记尹力到北京多所学校调研并看望慰问教师，在第42个教师节来临之际向广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li visited several schools in the city and met with teachers, extending Teachers' Day greetings to educators ahead of the 42nd Teachers' Day.

articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Urges US to Stop Baseless Accusations and Smearing on AI
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，外交部发言人毛宁表示，中国AI发展是高水平科技自立自强的成果，应加强合作，并呼吁美方落实元首共识，不要进行不实指责和抹黑。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Mao Ning called on the US to stop baseless accusations and smearing, emphasizing China's AI development as a result of high-level self-reliance and openness to cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 国务院港澳办：对董建华先生逝世表示沉痛哀悼
articles.title_en: State Council's HKMO Office Mourns Death of Tung Chee-hwa
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，国务院港澳事务办公室致唁电，对董建华先生逝世表示沉痛哀悼，并对其亲属表示深切慰问。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council sent condolence messages to express deep grief over the death of Mr. Tung Chee-hwa and extend sympathy to his family.

articles.summary_en: On September 7, a symposium for enterprise representatives of CDNCA members was held in Harbin. CDNCA Vice Chairman Li Zhongmin spoke, Liu Zhenguo of the CPC Heilongjiang Provincial Committee presided, and Vice Governor Han Shengjian attended.

articles.title_zh: 吉林省松原市委原常委、政法委原书记宋耀伟被“双开”
articles.title_en: Song Yaowei, Former Party and Political Legal Affairs Official in Jilin, Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 宋耀伟严重违纪违法，被开除党籍和公职，涉嫌受贿犯罪问题移送检察机关依法审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: Song Yaowei, former Standing Committee member and Political and Legal Affairs Secretary of Songyuan Municipal Party Committee, was expelled from the Party and dismissed from public office for serious disciplinary and legal violations, and his suspected bribery case was transferred to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 中央统战部：从四方面发力 引导民营经济人士把握“十五五”发展大势
articles.title_en: United Front Work Department to Guide Private Economy on Four Fronts for 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日，国新办举行发布会，中央统战部副部长马利怀表示将从四方面发力，引导民营经济人士把握“十五五”发展大势，助力高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sep 9, 2026, at a State Council Information Office press conference, Ma Lihuai, deputy head of the United Front Work Department, outlined four measures to guide private entrepreneurs in aligning with the 15th Five-Year Plan for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省泗县原副县长仝昆鹏被“双开”
articles.title_en: Anhui Sixian Former Deputy County Head Tong Kunpeng Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 据安徽纪检监察网9日消息，宿州市纪委监委对泗县原副县长仝昆鹏严重违纪违法问题立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍、开除公职处分，并移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: Anhui disciplinary authorities investigated Tong Kunpeng, former deputy head of Sixian County, for serious discipline and law violations, and expelled him from the Party and public office, referring the case to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中美都是人工智能大国 应加强合作
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Both China and US are AI Powers, Should Strengthen Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，外交部发言人毛宁在例行记者会上表示，中方愿与美方加强人工智能合作，希望美方停止不实指责。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Foreign Ministry spokesman Mao Ning said at a regular briefing that China is willing to strengthen AI cooperation with the US and hopes Washington stops baseless accusations.

articles.title_zh: 中国内河骨干水运网络基本成形
articles.title_en: China's Inland Waterway Backbone Network Basically Takes Shape
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，内河航运高质量发展论坛（2026）在武汉开幕，宣布“十四五”以来中国内河骨干水运网络基本成形，并成立长江航运数据联盟。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, the Inland Waterway High-Quality Development Forum (2026) opened in Wuhan, announcing that China's backbone inland waterway network has basically taken shape and launching the Yangtze River Shipping Data Alliance.

articles.title_zh: 台学者讨论“一国两制”台湾方案 国台办：乐见台胞正视统一
articles.title_en: Mainland Welcomes Taiwan Scholars' Discussion of 'One Country, Two Systems' Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人在北京举行的例行发布会上表示，乐见台湾同胞正视统一并讨论“一国两制”方案，驳斥台方对大陆海警执法的不实指控。
articles.summary_en: At a regular press conference in Beijing, spokesperson Chen Binhua welcomed Taiwan compatriots facing up to reunification and discussing the 'one country, two systems' plan, while dismissing false accusations over coast guard law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会：将聚焦群众关心的教育、就业等问题，统筹做好工作
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee to Focus on Education, Employment and Other Concerns
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会发言人宋锐9日表示，'十五五'时期将聚焦教育、就业、医疗、养老等群众关心的问题，统筹做好立法和监督工作。
articles.summary_en: Song Rui, spokesperson for the NPC Standing Committee, said on Sept. 9 that during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, the NPC will focus on education, employment, medical care and elderly care to coordinate legislation and supervision.

articles.title_zh: 2026服贸之约：共享、共促的世界交响
articles.title_en: 2026 CIFTIS: A Global Symphony of Sharing and Mutual Advancement
articles.summary_zh: 2026年中国国际服务贸易交易会9月9日至13日在北京首钢园举行，90个国家设展，1800余家企业参展，展示中国服务贸易创新成果。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS) is held at Shougang Park in Beijing from September 9 to 13, featuring exhibitions from 90 countries and over 1,800 enterprises, showcasing China's innovative achievements in services trade.

articles.title_zh: 科研团队共建共享共立共治 中国智能天文生态社区呼之欲出
articles.title_en: Research Teams Join Forces to Build China's Intelligent Astronomy Ecosystem
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院国家天文台联合十余家高校及科研院所发布倡议，建设“智能天文计算与发现生态社区”，打造国家级天文数据处理基础设施。
articles.summary_en: The National Astronomical Observatories of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, together with over a dozen universities and research institutes, issued an initiative to build an Intelligent Astronomy Computing and Discovery Ecosystem Community as a national astronomy data infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 台湾海基会增编预算宣传所谓赴大陆“风险” 国台办劝“多干正事”
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Urges Taiwan's SEF to Do Real Work after Budget Hike for 'Risk' Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人陈斌华9日表示，台湾海基会增编预算宣传所谓“赴大陆风险”是卑劣伎俩，奉劝其“莫忘初衷，多干正事”，并重申大陆依法保障台胞权益。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 9, Chen Binhua, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, criticized the Straits Exchange Foundation for using added budget to hype alleged 'risks' of traveling to the mainland, calling it a crude trick and urging it to do real work.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协：从三个层面推进落实“发挥人民政协作为专门协商机构作用”
articles.title_en: CPPCC Advances Implementation of Its Role as a Specialized Consultative Body from Three Levels
articles.summary_zh: 全国政协副秘书长胡衡庐在国新办发布会上介绍，全国政协将从理论研究、制度建设、工作实践三个层面落实“十五五”规划纲要关于发挥政协作为专门协商机构作用的部署。
articles.summary_en: Hu Henglü, Deputy Secretary-General of the CPPCC National Committee, said at a State Council Information Office press conference that the CPPCC will implement the 15th Five-Year Plan's requirement on its role as a specialized consultative body through theoretical research, institutional improvement, and practical work.

articles.summary_zh: 江西省农业农村厅党组成员、副厅长曹爱珍涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受江西省纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Cao Aizhen, deputy director of Jiangxi Provincial Agriculture and Rural Affairs Department, is under investigation for serious disciplinary and legal violations by the provincial discipline commission.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应美方涉中国人工智能言论：望美方不要对中国进行不实指责和抹黑
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to US Remarks on China's AI, Urges No Unfair Accusations
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京例行记者会上回应美方涉华AI言论，表示中国AI发展是高水平科技自立自强的成果，望美方不要不实指责并加强合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Mao Ning responded to US remarks on China's AI at a regular press conference in Beijing, stating China's AI development stems from self-reliance and openness, urging the US to refrain from unfair accusations and enhance cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 红色+古韵 宁化老区焕新生
articles.title_en: Red and Ancient Charm Revitalize Ninghua, an Old Revolutionary Base
articles.summary_zh: 福建宁化县依托红色文化和客家古韵发展文旅产业，2025年接待游客474.58万人次，实现旅游总收入36.79亿元，老区焕发新生。
articles.summary_en: Fujian Ninghua County leverages red culture and Hakka heritage to boost tourism, receiving 4.7458 million visitors and 3.679 billion yuan in revenue in 2025, rejuvenating the old revolutionary base.

articles.title_zh: 关键节点，‘虫口夺粮’——湖南益阳资阳区病虫害防治一线见闻
articles.title_en: Pest Control Intensifies in Hunan’s Autumn Harvest Battle
articles.summary_zh: 湖南益阳资阳区晚稻抽穗期，植保人员利用测报灯、无人机等加强稻飞虱防治，推广绿色防控，力争‘虫口夺粮’保丰收。
articles.summary_en: In Ziyang District, Yiyang, Hunan, as late rice enters the heading stage, plant protection personnel are using light traps and drones to combat rice planthoppers, promoting green control to safeguard the autumn harvest.

articles.title_zh: 启智润心 弘扬教育家精神当好学生引路人
articles.title_en: Inspire Wisdom and Enlighten Hearts: Carry Forward Educator Spirit to Guide Students
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报发文回顾习近平总书记对教师队伍的重要指示，报道全国高校已累计认定三批591个黄大年式教师团队，并推动加强教师队伍建设、弘扬教育家精神。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports Xi Jinping's call to promote educator spirit; 591 university teacher teams have been created in 3 batches to strengthen education.

articles.title_zh: 赣南山乡启新程（赓续长征精神 奋进复兴征程）
articles.title_en: Southern Jiangxi Mountain Villages Set Off on a New Journey in the Spirit of the Long March
articles.summary_zh: 江西赣州弘扬伟大长征精神，依托红色资源和生态优势，发展红色旅游与特色产业，推进乡村全面振兴，老区农村居民人均可支配收入较五年前增长超五成。
articles.summary_en: Ganzhou, Jiangxi, is advancing rural revitalization by promoting red tourism and specialty agriculture in the spirit of the Long March. Rural per capita incomes have risen by more than 50% over the past five years.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同英国首相伯纳姆通电话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Speaks by Phone with UK Prime Minister Burnham
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日晚，国家主席习近平应约同英国首相伯纳姆通电话，祝贺其就任，并就中英全面战略伙伴关系及各领域合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of Sept. 8, President Xi Jinping took a phone call from UK Prime Minister Burnham, congratulating him on taking office and discussing the China-UK comprehensive strategic partnership and bilateral cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 开放合作，培育更多“中国服务”品牌
articles.title_en: Open Cooperation to Cultivate More "China Service" Brands
articles.summary_zh: 2026年中国国际服务贸易交易会于9月9日至13日在北京举办，90个国家和国际组织设展办会，1800余家企业线下参展，旨在推动服务业高水平开放与高质量发展，培育“中国服务”品牌。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services is held in Beijing from September 9 to 13, with 90 countries and international organizations and over 1,800 enterprises participating, aiming to promote high-level opening-up and high-quality development of the service industry and cultivate "China Service" brands.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部原党委书记、部长王祥喜严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职
articles.title_en: Former Emergency Management Minister Wang Xiangxi Expelled from Party and Public Office for Serious Violations
articles.summary_zh: 经中共中央批准，中央纪委国家监委对应急管理部原党委书记、部长王祥喜严重违纪违法问题立案审查调查，决定开除其党籍和公职，并移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: Wang Xiangxi, former Party secretary and minister of emergency management, was expelled from the Party and public office over serious disciplinary and legal violations, and his case was referred to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 韩正出席第二十六届中国国际投资贸易洽谈会开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Attends and Addresses Opening of 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，国家副主席韩正出席在福建厦门举行的第二十六届中国国际投资贸易洽谈会开幕式并致辞，提出扩大高水平对外开放、培育创新增长新动能等三点建议。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Vice President Han Zheng attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade in Xiamen, Fujian, proposing three suggestions including expanding high-level opening-up and fostering new growth drivers.

articles.title_zh: 坚持以党的政治建设为统领（深入学习贯彻习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想）
articles.title_en: Adhere to the Party's Political Construction as the Leading Principle (Deeply Study and Implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era)
articles.summary_zh: 本文阐述以党的政治建设为统领是新时代党的建设的根本要求，论述其理论内涵、历史性成就及提高党员干部政治能力的实践路径。
articles.summary_en: This article expounds that adhering to the Party's political construction as the leading principle is the fundamental requirement for Party building in the new era, discussing its theoretical connotation, historic achievements, and practical ways to enhance officials' political capability.

articles.title_zh: 习近平就朝鲜国庆78周年向朝鲜最高领导人金正恩致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Kim Jong Un on DPRK's 78th National Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平就朝鲜国庆78周年向朝鲜劳动党总书记、国务委员会委员长金正恩致贺电，强调维护发展好中朝关系。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and Chinese President, sent a congratulatory message to Kim Jong Un on the 78th anniversary of the DPRK's founding, stressing the commitment to bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 紧紧围绕立德树人根本任务 加快构建中国特色高质量教材体系
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Stresses Building High-Quality Textbook System Centered on Moral Education
articles.summary_zh: 全国教材工作会议9月8日在北京召开，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席并讲话，强调加快构建中国特色高质量教材体系。
articles.summary_en: The National Textbook Work Conference was held in Beijing on Sept 8. Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang stressed building a high-quality textbook system with Chinese characteristics.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：台湾从来不是一个国家，今后也绝无可能
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Taiwan Has Never Been a Country and Never Will Be
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，外交部发言人毛宁在北京表示，台湾从来不是一个国家，赖清德当局歪曲联大2758号决议暴露“台独”分裂本质。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Mao Ning said in Beijing that Taiwan has never been a country and never will be, condemning Lai Ching-te's distortion of UNGA Resolution 2758 as exposing 'Taiwan independence' nature.

articles.title_zh: 2026年8月份CPI温和回升 PPI同比涨幅扩大
articles.title_en: CPI Rises Moderately and PPI Growth Expands in August 2026
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局发布数据，2026年8月CPI同比上涨0.8%，PPI同比上涨3.8%，环比均由降转涨。
articles.summary_en: China's CPI rose 0.8% year-on-year and PPI rose 3.8% in August 2026, both rebounding on a monthly basis.

articles.title_zh: 宝鸡市委召开县区换届新任职领导干部集体谈话会
articles.title_en: Baoji Municipal Party Committee Holds Collective Talk with Newly Appointed County-District Cadres
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，宝鸡市委召开县区换届新任职领导干部集体谈话会，市委书记陈晓勇讲话，市长牛恺主持，要求新任职干部忠诚履职、担当尽责，推动县域高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Baoji Municipal Party Committee convened a collective talk with newly appointed leading cadres for county-district transitions. Party Secretary Chen Xiaoyong delivered a speech and Mayor Niu Kai presided, urging the cadres to be loyal, pragmatic, and responsible in pursuing high-quality county development.

articles.title_zh: 云南召开全省农村集体“三资”专项工作推进会暨第二批启动部署会
articles.title_en: Yunnan Holds Meeting on Rural Collective "Three Assets" Special Work and Launch of Second Batch
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，云南省农村集体“三资”专项工作推进会暨第二批启动部署会在昆明召开，省委书记王宁作出批示，黄祎出席讲话，王显刚主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, Yunnan held a meeting in Kunming to advance its special work on rural collective "three assets" and launch the second batch, with Party Secretary Wang Ning issuing written instructions.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开市第六次党代会报告征求意见座谈会
articles.title_en: Baoshan Municipal Party Committee Holds Symposium on Draft Report for Sixth Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，保山市委召开市第六次党代会报告征求意见座谈会，市委书记杨军主持，听取各界代表意见建议，为谋划今后五年发展汇聚智慧。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, the Baoshan Municipal Party Committee held a symposium to solicit opinions on the draft report for the city's sixth Party congress, chaired by Party Secretary Yang Jun, gathering suggestions from representatives of various sectors for the coming five years' development.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠在全市群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治重点工作推进会上强调 推动集中整治不断走向深入 以求真务实的工作成效取信于民造福于民
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Stresses Further Progress in Special Rectification of Unhealthy Tendencies and Corruption Around People
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，长春市委书记张恩惠在全市群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治重点工作推进会上强调，要推动集中整治不断走向深入，以求真务实的成效取信于民、造福于民。市长顾刚出席。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 8, Zhang Enhui, Changchun Party chief, urged deepening the city-level campaign against misconduct and corruption affecting the people, stressing pragmatic results to win public trust. Mayor Gu Gang attended.

articles.title_zh: 泰国苏商总会企业代表团来访
articles.title_en: Governor Liu Xiaotao Meets Thai Jiangsu Chamber of Commerce Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，江苏省省长刘小涛在南京会见泰国苏商总会主席陈柱率领的企业代表团，双方表示将加强经贸合作，深化新能源、数字经济等领域交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met in Nanjing with a business delegation led by Chen Zhu, chairman of the Thai Jiangsu Chamber of Commerce. Both sides expressed willingness to strengthen economic ties and cooperation in new energy and digital economy.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见出席2026全球工业互联网大会嘉宾代表
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Guests of 2026 Global Industrial Internet Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见出席2026全球工业互联网大会的嘉宾代表，介绍辽宁工业互联网发展情况并欢迎合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Xu Kunlin, Liaoning Provincial Party Secretary, and Wang Xinwei, Governor, met with guests of the 2026 Global Industrial Internet Conference in Shenyang, welcoming cooperation and highlighting industrial internet development.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林在沈阳辽中区、新民市调研
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Inspects in Liaozhong and Xinmin, Shenyang
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日至8日，辽宁省委书记许昆林到沈阳市辽中区、新民市调研，强调壮大县域特色产业、增进民生福祉，并要求补齐防灾减灾短板。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7-8, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin visited Liaozhong and Xinmin in Shenyang, urging improvements in county industries, people's livelihood, and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同英国首相伯纳姆通电话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Speaks by Phone with UK Prime Minister Burnham
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日晚，国家主席习近平应约同英国首相伯纳姆通电话，祝贺其就任，并就中英关系、扩大对外开放和多边协作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 8, President Xi Jinping took a phone call from UK Prime Minister Burnham, congratulating him on taking office and discussing bilateral ties, opening-up and multilateral cooperation.

articles.title_zh: “做党和人民满意的好老师”——习近平总书记的重要论述指引教师工作开创新局面
articles.title_en: "Be a Good Teacher Who Satisfies the Party and the People": Xi Jinping's Key Expositions Guide New Progress in Teacher Work
articles.summary_zh: 在第42个教师节到来之际，新华社9月9日播发报道，梳理党的十八大以来习近平总书记围绕教师队伍建设的重要论述，要求弘扬教育家精神、培养高素质专业化教师队伍，并提高教师地位待遇。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 42nd Teachers' Day, Xinhua reported on Sept 9 on Xi Jinping's expositions since the 18th Party Congress guiding teacher workforce development, urging the promotion of the educator spirit and better pay and status for teachers.

articles.title_zh: 我国计划打造5000个全国放心消费集聚区
articles.title_en: China Plans to Create 5,000 National Assured-Consumption Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局近日印发通知，计划到2030年打造5000个以上全国放心消费集聚区，优化消费生态，提振消费信心。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation issued a plan to cultivate over 5,000 national assured-consumption clusters by 2030, aiming to optimize the consumption ecosystem and boost consumer confidence.

tags.name_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局

tags_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥出席2026年全球服务贸易峰会并会见与会外国政要
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends 2026 Global Services Trade Summit and Meets Foreign Dignitaries
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月9日，2026年全球服务贸易峰会在北京举行，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席并作主旨讲话，提出三点建议，并会见普列夫、奇温加等外国政要。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, 2026, the 2026 Global Services Trade Summit was held in Beijing, where Ding Xuexiang, member of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Standing Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, delivered a keynote speech with three proposals and met with foreign dignitaries including Plamen Plamenov and Constantino Chiwenga.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰会见加拿大加中贸易理事会名誉主席安德烈·德马雷
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Meets Honorary Chairman of the Canada-China Business Council Andre Desmarais
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日下午，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理何立峰在人民大会堂会见加拿大加中贸易理事会名誉主席安德烈·德马雷，双方就推动中加经贸关系发展交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 9, Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met in Beijing with Andre Desmarais, Honorary Chairman of the Canada-China Business Council, to discuss advancing bilateral trade and economic ties.

articles.title_zh: 张丹赴国测集团和湘恒基金考察洽谈
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Visits Guoce Group and Xiangheng Fund for Talks
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，丹东市长张丹赴国测集团和湘恒私募基金管理（北京）有限公司考察洽谈，就产业园区、矿产开发及金融合作等事项进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Dandong Mayor Zhang Dan visited Guoce Group and Xiangheng Private Equity Fund Management (Beijing) Co., Ltd. for talks on industrial parks, mineral development, and financial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Liaoning Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议，审议辽宁省“十五五”对外开放规划，研究推进基本公共服务均等化、组建辽宁种业实验室等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Wang Xinwei, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to review the 15th Five-Year Plan for opening-up, discuss equalization of basic public services, and establish the Liaoning Seed Industry Laboratory.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席中亚中东之行推动全球治理倡议走深走实
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Central Asia and Middle East Trip Deepens the Global Governance Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月3日，习近平出席上海合作组织比什凯克峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，围绕改革完善全球治理提出一系列主张，推动全球治理倡议走深走实。
articles.summary_en: From August 30 to September 3, Xi Jinping attended the SCO summit in Bishkek and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, advancing proposals on reforming global governance and deepening the Global Governance Initiative.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元调研“打非治违”专项行动推进情况
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Inspects Hegang's Campaign Against Illegal and Unlawful Production
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，鹤岗市市长邓维元调研“打非治违”专项行动，实地检查农机安全、道路治超、危化品储存和高层建筑消防等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan inspected the city's campaign against illegal and unlawful production, checking farm machinery safety, road overloading enforcement, hazardous chemicals storage and high-rise fire safety.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市人大常委会党组会议召开
articles.title_en: Huaian Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，淮安市人大常委会党组会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记关于正确政绩观学习教育的重要指示精神，研究建立长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the Party Group of the Huaian Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee met to convey President Xi Jinping's important instructions on study and education for establishing and practicing a correct view on political achievements, and to explore establishing a long-term mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研推进招商选资和增资扩产工作
articles.title_en: Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun Inspects Investment Attraction and Capacity Expansion Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，淮安市市长顾坤赴淮安经开区等三地调研，强调强化招商选资和增资扩产协同发力，推动产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 7, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun visited three development zones to promote investment attraction and capacity expansion, stressing coordinated efforts for high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦任淮北军分区党委第一书记
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Appointed First Secretary of the Huaibei Military Sub-district Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日上午，淮北军分区党委第一书记任职大会召开，省军区党委书记、政治委员王金良宣读任职通知，蒋曦任淮北军分区党委委员、常委、第一书记。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 9, a meeting was held to announce the appointment of the first secretary of the Huaibei Military Sub-district Party Committee; Wang Jinliang, political commissar of the provincial military district, read the notice appointing Jiang Xi to the post.

articles.title_zh: 怀化市人社部门精准送岗助企纾困 破解企业用工难题
articles.title_en: Huaihua HR Department Holds Targeted Job Fairs to Address Enterprise Labor Shortage
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日、7日，怀化市人社部门在中方县和洪江市举办企业专场招聘会，提供1500余个岗位，助力破解企业用工难题。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 2 and 7, Huaihua's HR department held targeted job fairs in Zhongfang County and Hongjiang City, offering over 1,500 posts to ease enterprise labor shortage.

articles.title_zh: 揭阳市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Jieyang Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究部署防汛救灾及正确政绩观学习教育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 8, Jieyang Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Fengbao chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploy flood prevention, disaster relief, and education on a correct view of political achievements.

tags_en: Education on Correct View of Political Achievements

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，强调铸牢中华民族共同体意识，推进民族团结进步。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Dawa Tsering, secretary of Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, chaired a theoretical study session, emphasizing fostering a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开拉萨市委理论学习中心组集体学习会
articles.title_en: Dawa Ciren Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于加强和改进民族工作的重要思想。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 8, Dawa Ciren, standing committee member of CPC Tibet Regional Committee and Lhasa Party chief, hosted a study session calling for implementing Xi Jinping's thought on ethnic work.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持国务院第二十一次专题学习
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council's 21st Special Study Session on Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，国务院围绕“高质量推进城市更新、促进城市内涵式发展”举行第二十一次专题学习，国务院总理李强主持并讲话，强调建立可持续的城市更新模式。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the State Council held its 21st special study session on high-quality urban renewal and connotative urban development, chaired by Premier Li Qiang, who called for a sustainable urban renewal model.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在第六届中国西藏旅游文化国际博览会巡馆并调研
articles.title_en: Garma Tseden Visits 6th China Tibet Tourism & Culture Expo
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在拉萨巡馆调研第六届藏博会，强调释放展会平台效应，助力经济社会高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Garma Tseden, chairman of Tibet Autonomous Region, toured the 6th Tibet Tourism & Culture Expo in Lhasa, urging to leverage the expo for high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 王君正在教师节前夕看望慰问教师代表并致以节日祝贺
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Visits Teacher Representatives Ahead of Teachers' Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨看望慰问教师代表，代表自治区党委、政府向全区广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺，并强调要努力办好人民满意的教育。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Region Committee, visited teacher representatives in Lhasa, extended festival greetings to teachers and educators on behalf of the regional Party committee and government, and stressed efforts to run education to the people's satisfaction.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登到第六届中国西藏旅游文化国际博览会巡馆并调研
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Inspects 6th China Tibet Tourism and Culture International Expo
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登到拉萨第六届中国西藏旅游文化国际博览会巡馆调研，强调释放展会平台效应，聚人气、促消费、兴产业、惠民生。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman Gama Zedeng inspected the 6th China Tibet Tourism and Culture International Expo in Lhasa, urging the event to boost consumption, industry and people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 王君正在教师节前夕看望慰问教师代表并致以节日祝贺
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Visits Teachers Ahead of Teachers' Day in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正在拉萨看望慰问教师代表，向全区教师和教育工作者致以第42个教师节祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Region, visited teachers in Lhasa and extended Teachers' Day greetings to educators across the region.

articles.title_en: Jointly Advancing an Equal and Orderly Multipolar World: Xi Jinping's Central Asia and Middle East Trip Deepens the Global Governance Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月3日，习近平主席出席上海合作组织比什凯克峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，在双多边场合推动全球治理倡议走深走实。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 30 to Sep 3, President Xi Jinping attended the SCO Bishkek summit and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, advancing the Global Governance Initiative through bilateral and multilateral engagements.

articles.title_zh: 全市基孔肯雅热疫情防控工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Citywide Meeting on Chikungunya Fever Prevention and Control
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，汕头市召开全市基孔肯雅热疫情防控工作会议，市委书记庄悦群讲话，市长陈涛主持，部署协同防控，守护群众健康。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Shantou held a citywide meeting on chikungunya prevention. Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn spoke, Mayor Chen Tao presided, and deputy mayor Zhu Chaorong briefed on measures.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市委常委会召开会议部署巩固拓展正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Shantou Party Committee Meeting on Correct Performance View Education
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日上午，汕头市委常委会召开会议，套开市委党的建设工作领导小组会议，传达学习上级精神，总结学习教育情况并部署建立长效机制。市委书记庄悦群主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Sep 8, the Standing Committee of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey higher-level directives, summarize the learning and education campaign on a correct view of performance, and arrange for long-term mechanisms. Secretary Zhuang Yuequn presided and spoke.

tags.name_en: Education on Correct View of Performance

articles.title_zh: 逯峰会见广州好迪集团有限公司董事长黄家武
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Meets Chairman of Guangzhou Haodi Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，汕尾市委书记逯峰会见广州好迪集团董事长黄家武，就发挥乡亲优势、推动汕尾高质量发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Lu Feng, Secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, met with Huang Jiawu, Chairman of Guangzhou Haodi Group, to exchange views on leveraging fellow-townsman advantages to promote Shanwei's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰开展教师节慰问活动 聚焦立德树人根本任务 用心用情用力办好人民满意的教育
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Visits Teachers for Teachers' Day, Stressing Moral Education and Quality Education
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，汕尾市委书记逯峰到林伟华中学慰问一线教师，强调办好人民满意的教育，加快推动教育高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Lu Feng, Secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, visited teachers at Lin Weihua Middle School, stressing the need to run education that satisfies the people and accelerate high-quality education development.

articles.title_zh: 李晖接待信访群众会办信访事项
articles.title_en: Li Hui Receives Petitioners to Address Complaints
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，泰州市市长李晖到市信访局接待信访群众，会办供水管网等民生问题，要求推动从解决一件事向办好一类事转变。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Li Hui, Mayor of Taizhou, received petitioners at the municipal complaint office to address livelihood issues like water pipe repairs, urging systematic solutions to improve public satisfaction.

articles.title_zh: 李晖接待信访群众会办信访事项
articles.title_en: Taizhou Mayor Li Hui Meets Petitioners and Resolves Grievance Cases
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，泰州市市长李晖到市信访局接待信访群众代表并会办信访事项，要求举一反三解决供水管网老化等民生问题。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui received petitioners at the city petition office and reviewed their cases, urging systematic fixes for aging water supply networks and other livelihood issues.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛主持召开就业工作座谈会 多措并举推动高质量充分就业
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Employment Symposium on Promoting High-Quality Full Employment
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日上午，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开就业工作座谈会，围绕加强重点群体就业服务、促进高质量充分就业听取意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 7, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired an employment symposium, seeking views on improving job services for key groups and promoting high-quality full employment.

articles.title_zh: 高山主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Tonghua Mayor Gao Shan Chairs Municipal Government Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，通化市市长高山主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治、安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Gao Shan, mayor of Tonghua, chaired the municipal government's party group (enlarged) meeting and executive meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and study work on rectifying corruption and ensuring safety.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组召开会议
articles.title_en: Wuxi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Party Group Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，无锡市人大常委会党组召开第114次会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要文章和指示精神，研究部署巩固拓展学习教育成果及全市人大换届选举工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the Party Leadership Group of the Standing Committee of Wuxi Municipal People's Congress held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's important article on party governance, and to arrange for consolidating education results and local people's congress election work.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰调研西安人工智能（大数据）产业发展并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Xi'an AI and Big Data Industry, Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰调研人工智能（大数据）产业发展情况并主持召开座谈会，强调做强产业链、拓展应用场景，推动人工智能深度赋能千行百业。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie inspected AI and big data companies and chaired a symposium, calling for stronger industrial chains and wider AI applications across industries.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 研究讨论市第九次党代会有关事项
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting on Preparations for 9th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，盐城市委常委会召开会议，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话，研究讨论市第九次党代会有关事项，并部署防灾减灾、生态环保、民生实事等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting, chaired by Party Secretary Yan Hanping, to discuss matters related to the 9th Municipal Party Congress and review work on disaster prevention, ecological protection, and livelihood projects.

articles.title_zh: 市委审计委员会召开会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Audit Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，盐城市委审计委员会召开会议，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话，强调聚焦审计重点、深化监督协同、强化整改实效。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, the Municipal Audit Committee met, chaired by Yan Hanping, Yancheng Party Secretary, emphasizing focused audits, coordinated supervision, and stronger rectification.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先督导“两热”防控工作
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Inspects Vector-Borne Disease Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，市委书记卢一先到阳东区督导“两热”防控工作，检查蚊虫防制措施，强调科学精准防控，守护群众健康。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Lu Yixian, party secretary of Yangjiang, inspected vector-borne disease prevention in Yangdong District, emphasizing scientific and precise measures to safeguard public health.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研持之以恒推进全面从严治党工作情况 坚持和加强党的全面领导 驰而不息正风肃纪反腐
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Efforts to Uphold Strict Party Governance
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研全面从严治党工作，强调坚持和加强党的全面领导，驰而不息正风肃纪反腐。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, inspected work on comprehensive Party governance, emphasizing upholding the Party's overall leadership and continuing to improve conduct and fight corruption.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在吴忠银川调研教育工作并看望慰问教师代表
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Inspects Education Work in Wuzhong and Yinchuan, Visits Teacher Representatives
articles.summary_zh: 第42个教师节到来之际，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞赴吴忠市、银川市调研教育工作，看望慰问教学科研一线教师代表，并就基础教育均衡发展、产教融合和教师队伍建设提出要求。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 42nd Teachers' Day, Li Yifei, Party Secretary of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, inspected education work in Wuzhong and Yinchuan and met frontline teachers, urging balanced basic education, industry-education integration and stronger teacher teams.

articles.title_zh: 张雨浦开展教师节慰问并调研教育提质扩优工程
articles.title_en: Zhang Yupu Visits Teachers on Teachers' Day and Inspects Education Quality Expansion Program
articles.summary_zh: 第42个教师节到来之际，宁夏自治区主席张雨浦到银川慰问教育工作者和退休教师，并调研教育提质扩优工程推进情况，强调全面推进教育强区建设。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 42nd Teachers' Day, Ningxia Chairman Zhang Yupu visited educators and retired teachers in Yinchuan and inspected progress on the education quality expansion program, stressing building Ningxia into a strong education region.

articles.title_zh: 李军主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Li Jun Chairs Municipal Government Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，营口市委副书记、市长李军主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，传达辽宁省省长王新伟调研指示精神，研究部署渔业船舶安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Li Jun, Deputy Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, chaired an enlarged Party Group meeting of the municipal government to convey Governor Wang Xinwei's research guidance and arrange fishery vessel safety production work.

articles.title_zh: 姚华明主持召开市级老同志座谈会征求市第十四次党代会报告意见
articles.title_en: Yao Huaming Chairs Symposium with Retired Cadres to Seek Opinions on 14th Municipal Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，营口市委书记姚华明主持召开座谈会，就市第十四次党代会报告向市级老同志征求意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Yingkou Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yao Huaming chaired a symposium to seek opinions from retired cadres on the report for the 14th Municipal Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 岳阳市庆祝第42个教师节座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Yueyang Holds Symposium to Celebrate the 42nd Teachers' Day
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，岳阳市庆祝第42个教师节座谈会召开，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江出席并讲话，强调优先发展教育、建设教育强市。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Yueyang held a Teachers' Day symposium. Xie Weijiang, deputy party secretary of Hunan and party secretary of Yueyang, spoke, stressing education priority and building a strong education city.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开市委书记专题会议
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Special Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Secretaries
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日上午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市委书记专题会议，听取十二届市委第九轮巡察情况汇报，研究部署巡察整改和成果运用工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 8, Zhanjiang Municipal Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired a special meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Secretaries, hearing reports from the 9th round of inspections of the 12th Municipal Party Committee and studying inspection rectification and results application.
