articles.title_zh: 市总工会四届十五次常委（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Federation of Trade Unions Holds 15th Session of Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，周口市总工会四届十五次常委（扩大）会议召开，市人大常委会副主任、市总工会主席杨雪芹主持并讲话，部署学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，推进工会工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the Zhoukou Municipal Federation of Trade Unions held its 15th session of the 4th Standing Committee (enlarged) meeting. Yang Xueqin, deputy director of the Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee and chairman of the federation, presided over the meeting and emphasized studying Xi Jinping's important speeches and advancing union work.

articles.title_en: Chen Yong Visits Xiangzhou District to Survey New Quality Productive Forces Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日下午，珠海市委书记陈勇到香洲区调研新质生产力发展情况，强调以应用为导向、以场景为抓手，加快推动人工智能全域全时全行业高水平赋能。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 8, Chen Yong, Secretary of Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee, visited Xiangzhou District to inspect new quality productive forces development, stressing an application- and scenario-oriented approach to accelerating high-level AI empowerment across all domains.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐赴高新区调研新型机电一体化产业 主动拥抱新技术新机遇 争取更多新成果新进展
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Visits High-tech Zone to Research New Electromechanical Integration Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，珠海市长吴泽桐赴高新区调研新型机电一体化产业，强调主动拥抱新技术，加快构建先进制造业现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong visited the High-tech Zone to research the new electromechanical integration industry, emphasizing proactive adoption of new technologies to accelerate the modern industrial system led by advanced manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在枣庄调研时强调 因地制宜培育壮大新质生产力 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Emphasizes Developing New Quality Productive Forces During Survey in Zaozhuang
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在枣庄市调研，强调因地制宜培育壮大新质生产力，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Zhou Naixiang, deputy secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee and governor, surveyed Zaozhuang City, stressing the need to cultivate new quality productive forces according to local conditions to drive sustained economic improvement.

articles.title_zh: 全国新的社会阶层人士“科创中国”服务团山东服务考察启动
articles.title_en: New Social Strata 'Innovation China' Service Group Launches Shandong Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，全国新的社会阶层人士“科创中国”服务团山东服务考察在济南启动，中央统战部副部长王瑞军、省委统战部部长邓云锋致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the national new social strata 'Innovation China' service group started its inspection in Jinan, Shandong. Wang Ruijun, deputy head of the CPC Central Committee's United Front Work Department, and Deng Yunfeng, head of Shandong's United Front Work Department, addressed the event.

articles.title_zh: 香港特区首任行政长官董建华逝世，享年89岁
articles.title_en: Tung Chee-hwa, First Chief Executive of Hong Kong SAR, Dies at 89
articles.summary_zh: 著名爱国人士、全国政协原副主席、香港特区首任行政长官董建华因病于2026年9月8日在香港逝世，享年89岁。
articles.summary_en: Tung Chee-hwa, renowned patriot, former Vice Chairman of CPPCC and first Chief Executive of Hong Kong SAR, passed away in Hong Kong on September 8, 2026, at the age of 89.

articles.title_zh: AIT谷立言又发“恐吓”言论：台海冲突对全球经济影响超二战
articles.title_en: AIT Director Gu Liyan Again Issues 'Threatening' Remarks: Taiwan Strait Conflict Would Exceed WWII Impact on Global Economy
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，美国在台协会处长谷立言在台北安全对话上妄称台海冲突将影响全球经济超二战，国台办发言人陈斌华严词驳斥其破坏台海和平的言论。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, 2026, AIT Director Gu Liyan claimed at Taipei Security Dialogue that a Taiwan Strait conflict would impact global economy more than WWII. Chen Binhua, Taiwan Affairs Office spokesperson, refuted his remarks.

articles.title_zh: 统筹推进“五位一体”总体布局落地见效
articles.title_en: Coordinated Implementation of the 'Five-in-One' Overall Layout
articles.summary_zh: 在河北省委举办的读书班上，省委书记罗文作专题报告，强调统筹推进“五位一体”总体布局在河北落地见效，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: At a study class held by the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, Secretary Luo Wen gave a special report emphasizing the coordinated implementation of the 'Five-in-One' overall layout in Hebei to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 千年文脉何以新
articles.title_en: How Can a Millennium-old Cultural Heritage Be Renewed?
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等六部门发布《关于推动历史经典产业高质量发展的意见》。人民日报记者分赴苏州、武夷山、景德镇，探访丝绸、茶叶、瓷器产业如何通过文化创新实现人文经济共生共荣。
articles.summary_en: Six ministries issued a plan to promote high-quality development of classic heritage industries. Reporters traveled to Suzhou, Wuyishan and Jingdezhen to see how silk, tea and porcelain are innovating.

articles.title_zh: 福州高新区入选中国开发区改革创新典型案例 连续三年获此荣誉
articles.title_en: Fuzhou High-Tech Zone Selected as Reform & Innovation Model of China's Development Zones for Third Year
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，2026中国开发区高质量发展大会在厦门举办，福州高新区报送的科创金融案例入选年度改革创新典型案例，连续三年获此荣誉。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7, at the 2026 China Development Zones High-Quality Development Conference in Xiamen, Fuzhou High-Tech Zone's case was selected as an annual reform and innovation model for the third consecutive year.

articles.title_zh: 2246件！未申报的switch游戏卡带等在福州海关被查！
articles.title_en: 2,246 Undeclared Switch Game Cards Seized by Fuzhou Customs
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福州长乐机场海关查获一名旅客将2246件未申报的switch游戏卡带等藏匿于茶叶盒和饼干盒中，意图代购谋利，目前物品已移交缉私部门。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Fuzhou Changle Airport Customs seized 2,246 undeclared Switch game cards concealed in food boxes from a passenger who admitted to buying them for resale. The items were handed over to anti-smuggling authorities.

articles.title_zh: 法治护航 人工智能健康有序发展
articles.title_en: Rule of Law Safeguards Sound, Orderly Development of AI
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院9月7日发布关于依法审理涉人工智能纠纷案件的意见，明确AI换脸拟声、仿冒名人带货等行为的侵权责任，强化数字时代民事权益司法保障。
articles.summary_en: China's Supreme People's Court issued opinions on Sept 7 for hearing AI-related disputes, clarifying liability for AI face-swapping, voice cloning and celebrity impersonation to protect civil rights.

articles.title_zh: 福州市双向投资合作对接会举行
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Bilateral Investment Cooperation Matchmaking Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，福州市双向投资合作对接会在厦门举行，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the Fuzhou Bilateral Investment Cooperation Matchmaking Meeting was held in Xiamen. Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Committee and secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Committee, attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 闽企出海综合服务港线上平台上线
articles.title_en: Online Platform for Fujian Enterprises Going Global Launched
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，在厦门举行的福州双向投资合作对接会上，闽企出海综合服务港线上平台正式上线，标志着福州企业走出去公共服务迈入线上线下融合发展新阶段。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 8, Fuzhou launched an online platform for Fujian enterprises going global at a CIFIT investment promotion event in Xiamen, marking an integration of online-offline public services for outbound enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 第八届“丝路海运”国际合作论坛开幕
articles.title_en: 8th Silk Road Maritime International Cooperation Forum Opens
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，第八届“丝路海运”国际合作论坛在厦门开幕，福建省长赵龙出席并致辞，多国及国内部委代表参会。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the 8th Silk Road Maritime International Cooperation Forum opened in Xiamen, where Fujian Governor Zhao Long attended and delivered a speech, joined by representatives from multiple countries and domestic ministries.

articles.title_zh: 福州印发“十五五”生态文明建设专项规划 提出5个领域重点任务
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Issues Special Plan for Ecological Civilization in 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 福州市政府办公厅近日印发“十五五”生态文明建设专项规划，提出20项指标和5大领域重点任务，目标到2030年基本建成现代化生态文明福州。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of Fuzhou Municipal Government recently issued the special plan for ecological civilization construction during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, setting 20 indicators and key tasks in five areas, aiming to basically build a modern ecological civilization city in Fuzhou by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 永泰全力救灾减损推动复工复产
articles.title_en: Yongtai Goes All Out for Disaster Relief and Work Resumption
articles.summary_zh: 受台风“沙德尔”影响，永泰县发生山体滑坡等灾害，当地全力抢险救援，并开展灾后清淤消杀和农业指导，推动复工复产。
articles.summary_en: After Typhoon Sader hit Yongtai, landslides and flooding caused damage. Local officials led emergency rescues, cleanup and disinfection, and agricultural guidance to resume production.

articles.title_zh: 刘强看望慰问教师时强调：落实好立德树人根本任务 推动教育强市建设不断取得新成效
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Visits Teachers, Stresses Implementing Fundamental Task of Fostering Virtue and Cultivating Talent and Promoting Education City Construction
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，济南市委书记刘强到起步区起航实验幼儿园、起航实验小学看望慰问教师，强调落实立德树人根本任务，推动教育强市建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 8, Liu Qiang, Secretary of Jinan Municipal Party Committee, visited Qihang Experimental Kindergarten and Qihang Experimental Primary School to greet teachers ahead of Teachers' Day, stressing the fundamental task of moral education and building an educationally strong city.

articles.title_zh: 济南市委党校（济南行政学院）、济南市社会主义学院2026年秋季学期开学典礼举行 于海田出席并进行开班授课
articles.title_en: Jinan Party School Holds Fall 2026 Opening Ceremony; Mayor Yu Haitian Attends and Lectures
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，济南市委党校（济南行政学院）、济南市社会主义学院举行2026年秋季学期开学典礼，市委副书记、市长于海田出席并以把握‘十五五’历史方位、开创强省会建设新局面为主题授课。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 8, Jinan Party School held its fall 2026 opening ceremony, where Mayor Yu Haitian delivered a lecture on grasping the historical position of the 15th Five-Year Plan and building a strong provincial capital.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研机器人、现代医药产业时强调：强化为企精准服务 优化产业发展生态 为强省会建设提供坚实支撑
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Robotics and Modern Pharmaceutical Industries in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田调研机器人、现代医药产业时强调，要强化为企精准服务，优化产业发展生态，为强省会建设提供坚实支撑。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Yu Haitian, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Jinan Municipal Committee and Mayor of Jinan, inspected robotics and modern pharmaceutical industries, emphasizing precise services for enterprises and optimizing the industrial ecology to support the construction of a strong provincial capital.

articles.title_zh: 刘强到济南新旧动能转换起步区调研时强调：用心用情服务群众企业 推动经济社会高质量发展
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Inspects Jinan New & Old Kinetic Energy Conversion Pilot Zone, Stressing High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，济南市委书记刘强到济南新旧动能转换起步区调研，强调以项目赋能年推动经济社会高质量发展，并考察社区和产业项目。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Liu Qiang, Party chief of Jinan, inspected the Jinan New & Old Kinetic Energy Conversion Pilot Zone and stressed high-quality development, covering community governance and industrial projects.

articles.title_zh: 习近平向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Extends Festival Greetings to Teachers and Educators Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，在第四十二个教师节到来之际，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平代表党中央，向全国广大教师和教育工作者致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, on the occasion of the 42nd Teachers' Day, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Chinese President and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, on behalf of the CPC Central Committee, extended festive greetings and sincere regards to teachers and educators nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣任刚调研创新型产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong and Ren Gang Inspect Innovative Industry Development Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，青岛市委书记曾赞荣、市长任刚到胶州市、城阳区、高新区调研创新型产业发展工作，强调推动产业向新向优向智发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong and Mayor Ren Gang inspected innovative industry development in Jiaozhou, Chengyang and the High-tech Zone, urging efforts to push industry toward new, higher-quality and smarter development.

articles.title_zh: 投洽会主宾省青海向全球发出“投资青海”邀约
articles.title_en: Qinghai, Guest Province of CIFIT, Issues 'Invest in Qinghai' Invitation
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日至8日，第二十六届投洽会主宾省青海在厦门举办重点产业推介会、青海馆开馆等活动，青海省省长罗东川出席并推介青海投资环境，现场促成六大类合作项目签约。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 7 to 8, Qinghai, guest province of the 26th CIFIT, held investment promotion events and opened its pavilion in Xiamen. Governor Luo Dongchuan attended and promoted Qinghai's investment environment, with cooperation deals signed in six major fields.

articles.title_zh: 未来投资大会高级别开幕式在厦门举行 赵龙出席并致辞

articles.title_zh: 单项冠军县，何以扛打｜培育钻石独占全国六成，为何是柘城

articles.summary_en: On September 8, the provincial conference of presidents of party schools (academies of governance) was held in Zhengzhou. Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning attended and delivered a speech, stressing adherence to the Party's principles for party schools and advancing party building.

articles.title_zh: 全省“六张网”规划建设暨稳投资工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Meeting on 'Six Networks' Planning and Investment Stability Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，全省“六张网”规划建设暨稳投资工作推进会召开，省长王凯出席并讲话，强调扎实推进“六张网”建设，全力做好稳投资工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the provincial meeting on 'Six Networks' planning and investment stability was held, with Governor Wang Kai attending and stressing solid progress in the Six Networks and investment.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明调度第五届北斗峰会筹备情况
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Chairs Preparatory Meeting for 5th BeiDou Summit
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，湖南省省长毛伟明主持召开会议调度第五届北斗规模应用国际峰会筹备工作，强调精益求精、把握市场化产业化国际化方向，提升峰会影响力。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming chaired a preparatory meeting for the 5th International Summit on BeiDou Scale Application, urging meticulous organization and market-oriented, industrialized, and international approaches to boost the summit's impact.

articles.title_zh: 毛万春在长沙永讯科技有限公司调研
articles.title_en: Mao Wanchun Conducts Research at Changsha Yongxun Technology Co., Ltd.
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省政协主席毛万春近日率队到长沙永讯科技有限公司调研，了解企业技术创新等情况，强调落实“企业服务年”行动，助力科创企业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Mao Wanchun, chairman of the Hunan Provincial Committee of the CPPCC, recently led a team to Changsha Yongxun Technology Co., Ltd. to survey technological innovation and urged implementing the "Enterprise Service Year" initiative to boost high-quality development of sci-tech enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛主持召开就业工作座谈会
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Symposium on Employment Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日上午，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开就业工作座谈会，听取各方意见，强调多措并举推动高质量充分就业。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 7, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu Province chaired a symposium on employment, listening to opinions and emphasizing measures to promote high-quality and full employment.

articles.title_zh: 北京城市绿心森林公园——工业重地绿色新生
articles.title_en: Beijing City Green Heart Forest Park: Industrial Site Reborn Green
articles.summary_zh: 讲述北京城市绿心森林公园（原东方化工厂旧址）通过土壤污染风险管控实现生态修复，成为净土保卫战典型案例，现已成为市民休闲好去处。
articles.summary_en: Tells how Beijing's Green Heart Forest Park, former site of Dongfang Chemical Plant, achieved ecological restoration through soil pollution risk control, exemplifying the campaign to protect clean soil.

articles.title_zh: 第三届新时代青年“重走长征路”活动在贵州遵义启动
articles.title_en: Third New Era Youth 'Retracing the Long March' Event Kicks Off in Zunyi, Guizhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日上午，纪念长征胜利90周年之际，第三届新时代青年“重走长征路”活动在贵州遵义启动，300余人参加，将通过徒步、现场教学等方式感悟长征历史。
articles.summary_en: On September 9, the third 'Retracing the Long March' event for young people commenced in Zunyi, Guizhou, with over 300 participants to honor the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March.

articles.title_zh: 世界最大直径高铁盾构机完成二次始发
articles.title_en: World's Largest-Diameter High-Speed Rail Shield Machine Completes Second Launch
articles.summary_zh: 9月9日，世界最大直径高铁盾构机“领航号”在崇太长江隧道2号竖井完成二次始发，开启陆域段掘进任务，该隧道预计2026年底全线贯通。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 9, the world's largest-diameter high-speed rail tunnel boring machine, Linghang, completed its second launch at Shaft No. 2 of the Chongtai Yangtze River Tunnel, starting boring on the land section. The tunnel is due for full completion by the end of 2026.

articles.title_zh: 天山南北，传统产业向新向智
articles.title_en: Xinjiang's Traditional Industries Move Toward Innovation and Intelligence
articles.summary_zh: 从数字棉田到无人矿卡，从煤化工废气制乙二醇到氢能重卡，文章展示新疆以数字、智能、绿色技术推动传统产业升级，发展新质生产力的实践。
articles.summary_en: From smart cotton fields to driverless trucks, Xinjiang's traditional industries adopt digital, intelligent and green technologies, boosting new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 中国快递按下转型升级'换挡键'
articles.title_en: China's Express Industry Shifts Gears for Transformation and Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 上半年主要快递上市公司半年报显示，利润增速跑赢件量增速，行业加速数智化转型、推进'反内卷'并开拓新场景，迈向高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: H1 reports from major listed courier firms showed profit growth outpacing parcel volumes, as the sector accelerates digitalization, curbs price wars, and explores new growth scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 天津市委理论学习中心组举行集体学习
articles.title_en: Tianjin Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Holds Collective Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，天津市委理论学习中心组举行集体学习，深入学习贯彻习近平生态文明思想，陈敏尔主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Tianjin Party Committee's theoretical learning center held a group study on Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization; Chen Min'er presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 国际知名人士新疆友好交流会在乌鲁木齐举行
articles.title_en: International Friends Exchange Meeting on Xinjiang Held in Urumqi
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，国际知名人士新疆友好交流会在乌鲁木齐举行，来自33个国家和国际组织的嘉宾围绕新疆治理经验及国际意义进行探讨。自治区党委书记陈小江出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the International Friends Exchange Meeting on Xinjiang was held in Urumqi, with guests from 33 countries and international organizations discussing Xinjiang's governance experience and its international significance. Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang attended and delivered remarks.

articles.title_zh: 中国羽毛球协会负责人届中调整 张新当选中国羽毛球协会主席 李论当选副主席
articles.title_en: Zhang Xin Elected Chairman of Chinese Badminton Association, Li Lun Elected Vice Chairman
articles.summary_zh: 中国羽毛球协会举行届中调整，张新当选主席，李论当选副主席，会议罢免夏煊泽副主席职务。
articles.summary_en: The Chinese Badminton Association made mid-term leadership changes: Zhang Xin was elected chairman, Li Lun vice chairman, and Xia Xuanze was removed as vice chairman.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部原党委书记、部长王祥喜严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职
articles.title_en: Wang Xiangxi, Former Emergency Management Minister, Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委对应急管理部原党委书记、部长王祥喜严重违纪违法问题立案审查，决定给予其开除党籍、开除公职处分。
articles.summary_en: The CCDI and National Supervisory Commission investigated Wang Xiangxi, former Party Secretary and Minister of Emergency Management, for serious disciplinary violations and expelled him from the Party and public office.

articles.title_zh: 三部门发文加快提供优质高效眼健康服务
articles.title_en: Three Departments Issue Document to Accelerate High-Quality Eye Health Services
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家卫生健康委、国家中医药局、国家疾控局联合印发《加快提供优质高效眼健康服务工作方案(2026—2030年)》，提出到2030年提高儿童及中小学生屈光筛查率、白内障手术率、眼科医师配置等目标。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the National Health Commission, the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and the National Disease Control and Prevention Administration jointly issued a work plan (2026-2030) to accelerate high-quality eye health services, setting targets for refractive screening, cataract surgery coverage, and ophthalmic workforce by 2030.

tags.name_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine
National Disease Control and Prevention Administration

tags_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

articles.title_zh: 陈晓勇在宝鸡高新区调研文物保护与产业发展
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaoyong Inspects Cultural Relic Protection and Industrial Development in Baoji High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，宝鸡市委书记陈晓勇到宝鸡高新区调研文物保护、产业发展等工作，强调加强文物保护利用，做强产业支撑。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Chen Xiaoyong, Secretary of Baoji Municipal Party Committee, inspected cultural relic protection and industrial development in Baoji High-tech Zone, stressing better preservation and use of cultural relics and stronger industrial support.

tags.name_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 陈春平调研应急消防工作时强调 守牢安全底线 夯实发展根基
articles.title_en: Chen Chunping Urges Safety Bottom Line During Inspection of Emergency and Firefighting Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，云南省委常委、省政府党组副书记陈春平到省应急管理厅、省消防救援总队调研安全生产和应急指挥等工作，强调守牢不发生重特大事故灾害底线。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Chen Chunping, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Yunnan Provincial Committee and deputy Party secretary of the provincial government, inspected the provincial emergency management department and fire rescue brigade, urging a firm bottom line against major accidents.

articles.title_zh: "昆蒙框架"实施进展全球审议昆明对话会开幕
articles.title_en: Kunming Dialogue Opens on Global Review of Kunming-Montreal Framework Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，"昆蒙框架"实施进展全球审议昆明对话会开幕，生态环境部部长黄润秋、云南省省长王予波出席开幕式并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, the Kunming Dialogue on the Global Review of the Kunming-Montreal Framework Implementation opened, with Ecology and Environment Minister Huang Runqiu and Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo attending and addressing the opening ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅栾天猛会见重庆市博赛矿业（集团）有限公司董事长袁志伦并共同见证签约
articles.title_en: Tang Yi and Luan Tianmeng Meet Chairman of Chongqing Bosai Mining Group and Witness Signing
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，赤峰市委书记唐毅、市长栾天猛会见重庆市博赛矿业（集团）有限公司董事长袁志伦，并共同见证副市长赵志刚与博赛集团签署项目投资合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Chifeng Party Secretary Tang Yi and Mayor Luan Tianmeng met with Yuan Zhilun, Chairman of Chongqing Bosai Mining Group, and witnessed the signing of an investment cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 携手推进平等有序的世界多极化——习近平主席中亚中东之行推动全球治理倡议走深走实
articles.title_en: Working Together for an Equal and Orderly Multipolar World: Xi Jinping's Central Asia and Middle East Trip Advances Global Governance Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月3日，习近平主席出席上合组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，倡导平等有序的世界多极化，推动全球治理倡议走深走实。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 30 to Sep 3, President Xi Jinping attended the SCO summit and made state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, advocating an equal and orderly multipolar world and advancing the Global Governance Initiative.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同卡塔尔首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Mohammed
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同卡塔尔首相兼外交大臣穆罕默德举行会谈，双方就战略伙伴关系及中东海湾地区形势交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Politburo Member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks with Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Mohammed in Beijing, exchanging views on strategic partnership and regional situation.

articles.title_zh: 前8个月我国外贸同比增长17.6% 延续快速增长态势
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Trade Up 17.6% in First Eight Months, Maintaining Rapid Growth
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署9月8日公布，今年前8个月我国货物贸易进出口总值34.78万亿元，同比增长17.6%，出口结构持续升级，机电产品占出口总值64%。
articles.summary_en: China's total goods imports and exports reached 34.78 trillion yuan in the first eight months of this year, up 17.6% year-on-year, with electromechanical products accounting for 64% of exports, according to the General Administration of Customs on Sept. 8.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥在全国教材工作会议上强调 紧紧围绕立德树人根本任务 加快构建中国特色高质量教材体系
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Stresses Building High-Quality Textbook System at National Textbook Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，全国教材工作会议在北京召开。中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席会议并讲话，强调要紧紧围绕立德树人根本任务，加快构建中国特色高质量教材体系。
articles.summary_en: Ding Xuexiang, Chinese vice premier, addressed the National Textbook Conference in Beijing on Sept. 8, urging efforts to build a high-quality textbook system with Chinese characteristics.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持国务院第二十一次专题学习
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council's 21st Thematic Study Session on Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，国务院举行第二十一次专题学习，总理李强主持并强调高质量推进城市更新、促进城市内涵式发展，建立可持续城市更新模式。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 8, Premier Li Qiang chaired the State Council's 21st thematic study session on high-quality urban renewal and connotative development, stressing sustainable urban renewal models.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同墨西哥外长贝拉斯科会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Mexican Foreign Minister Belasco
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月7日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同墨西哥外长贝拉斯科会谈，双方就深化中墨全面战略伙伴关系等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, 2026, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks with Mexican Foreign Minister Belasco in Beijing. Both sides exchanged views on deepening the comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟在营口调研并出席全省海洋渔业船舶安全生产工作推进会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Investigates Yingkou and Attends Provincial Marine Fishery Vessel Safety Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟在营口调研渔船安全生产，并出席全省海洋渔业船舶安全生产工作推进会议，强调深化专项整治，推进渔船“木改钢”。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Wang Xinwei, Deputy Secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected fishing vessel safety in Yingkou and attended the provincial work conference on marine fishery vessel safety, emphasizing special rectification and promoting wooden-to-steel fishing vessel replacement.

articles.title_zh: 第二十六届投洽会福州市双向投资合作对接会在厦门举行
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Two-Way Investment Matchmaking Meeting Held in Xiamen at 26th CIFIT
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，第二十六届投洽会期间，福州市双向投资合作对接会在厦门举行，市委书记郭宁宁出席并讲话，市长吴贤德推介投资环境。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, during the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade, Fuzhou held a two-way investment matchmaking meeting in Xiamen, where Party Secretary Guo Ningning spoke and Mayor Wu Xiande promoted the city's investment environment.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁率福州市代表团访问香港
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Leads Fuzhou Delegation to Visit Hong Kong
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日至7日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁率福州市代表团访问香港，拜会梁振英、李家超等，出席闽港合作研讨会，推进闽港榕港交流合作。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 5 to 7, Guo Ningning, Deputy Party Secretary of Fujian and Party Secretary of Fuzhou, led a delegation to Hong Kong, meeting with Leung Chun-ying and Li Ka-chiu to promote Fujian-Hong Kong and Fuzhou-Hong Kong cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁率福州市代表团访问香港
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Leads Fuzhou Delegation on Visit to Hong Kong
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日至7日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁率福州市代表团访问香港，拜会梁振英、李家超、周霁，推动闽港榕港全方位多领域交流合作并签订相关合作框架协议。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 5 to 7, Guo Ningning, Deputy Party Secretary of Fujian and Party Secretary of Fuzhou, led a Fuzhou delegation to Hong Kong, meeting Leung Chun-ying, John Lee and Zhou Ji to deepen Fujian-Hong Kong cooperation and sign cooperation framework agreements.

articles.title_zh: 市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开
articles.title_en: Huaibei Municipal Party Committee Holds Party Building Work Leading Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦主持召开市委党的建设工作领导小组会议，学习习近平党建论述，研究部署党建领域重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 8, Jiang Xi, Secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting of the Municipal Party Building Work Leading Group to study Xi Jinping's discourse on party building and deploy key party building tasks.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持国务院第二十一次专题学习
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs 21st State Council Special Study Session on Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，国务院以“高质量推进城市更新、促进城市内涵式发展”为主题进行第二十一次专题学习，国务院总理李强主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the State Council held its 21st special study session on high-quality urban renewal and connotative urban development, chaired by Premier Li Qiang.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持召开自治区人民政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Chairs Meeting of Tibet Government Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登主持召开政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Gama Zedeng, chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, chaired a meeting of the regional government's Party group to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and study implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省党政代表团来藏考察并座谈
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Provincial Party and Government Delegation Visits Tibet and Holds Talks
articles.summary_zh: 近日，陕西省党政代表团来西藏考察，两省区举行工作座谈会。王君正和赵一德分别讲话，强调深化对口支援与区域合作。
articles.summary_en: Recently, a Shaanxi Party and government delegation visited Tibet. The two regions held a work symposium, with Wang Junzheng and Zhao Yide delivering speeches, emphasizing deeper counterpart support and regional cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市“新新有机”产业招商推介会在厦门举行
articles.title_en: Longyan Holds 'New New Organic' Industrial Investment Promotion Conference in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，龙岩市在厦门举行“新新有机”产业招商推介会，市委书记胡盛、市长蔡琳出席并会见客商，推介新兴产业，邀请企业家投资龙岩。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Longyan held an investment promotion conference in Xiamen, where Party Secretary Hu Sheng and Mayor Cai Lin met with business leaders to showcase emerging industries and invite investment.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森到双台子区调研项目建设情况并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Inspects Project Construction in Shuangtaizi District and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，盘锦市委书记王炳森到双台子区调研三力中科、启辰半导体等项目现场，随后主持召开座谈会，部署项目建设、产业升级与安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Panjin Party Secretary Wang Bingsen inspected project sites in Shuangtaizi District and chaired a symposium, urging faster project construction, new-industry development and strict safety oversight.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省党政代表团来藏考察并座谈
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Party and Government Delegation Visits Tibet for Inspection and Talks
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月7日，西藏·陕西工作座谈会在拉萨举行，自治区党委书记王君正主持，陕西省委书记赵一德讲话，双方就深化对口援藏、产业协作等达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7, 2026, Tibet and Shaanxi held a work symposium in Lhasa, with Tibet's Party chief Wang Junzheng presiding and Shaanxi Party chief Zhao Yide speaking on deepening pairing-assistance cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持召开西藏自治区人民政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Karma Tseten Chairs Enlarged Meeting of Tibet Autonomous Region Government Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在拉萨主持召开自治区人民政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署抢险救援、灾后重建和经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7, Tibet Autonomous Region Chairman Karma Tseten chaired an enlarged meeting of the regional government's Party group in Lhasa to convey Xi Jinping's recent speeches and plan disaster relief, reconstruction and economic work.

articles.title_zh: 2026年汕尾市党外人士座谈会召开 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Chairs 2026 Shanwei Meeting with Non-Party Personages
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，2026年汕尾市党外人士座谈会在汕尾召开，市委书记逯峰主持并讲话，通报全市经济社会发展情况，听取各民主党派、工商联、无党派人士意见建议，推动“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Shanwei held its 2026 meeting with non-Party personages. Municipal Party secretary Lu Feng presided and delivered remarks, briefing participants on the city's economic and social development and gathering proposals from democratic parties, the business federation and non-Party figures to support a strong start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 2026年汕尾市党外人士座谈会召开 逯峰主持
articles.title_en: Shanwei Holds Symposium with Non-CPC Personages, Lu Feng Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，2026年汕尾市党外人士座谈会召开，市委书记逯峰主持并讲话，听取各民主党派意见建议，强调凝聚共识推动“十五五”开局。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, Shanwei held a symposium with non-CPC personages. Municipal Party Secretary Lu Feng chaired and stressed unity to kick off the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 徐龙调研全市绿电园区建设管理情况
articles.title_en: Xu Long Inspects Construction and Management of Green Power Parks
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，石嘴山市市长徐龙调研全市绿电园区建设管理情况，强调抓实建管运营，激活绿色低碳发展动能。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Xu Long, mayor of Shizuishan, inspected the construction and management of green power parks across the city, emphasizing solid operations to boost green and low-carbon development.

articles.title_zh: 四平市委常委会会议传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Siping Party Committee Meeting Studies Xi Jinping's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，四平市委书记王相民主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7, Siping Party Secretary Wang Xiangmin chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's speech at the memorial conference for the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth and discuss implementation.

articles.title_zh: 全市重点园区月度例会召开
articles.title_en: Monthly Meeting of Key Industrial Parks Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，泰州市市长李晖出席全市重点园区月度例会，强调狠抓招商引资、优化环境，推动园区高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui attended the monthly meeting of key industrial parks, emphasizing investment promotion and environment optimization to drive high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 山东财金集团与威海战略合作恳谈会举行
articles.title_en: Shandong Caijin Group and Weihai Hold Strategic Cooperation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，山东财金集团与威海战略合作恳谈会在威海举行，威海市政府与山东财金集团、德邦证券签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, a strategic cooperation meeting between Shandong Caijin Group and Weihai was held in Weihai, where the Weihai municipal government signed strategic cooperation agreements with Shandong Caijin Group and Debon Securities.

articles.title_zh: “聚势共赢·链动未来”——山东财金集团与威海战略合作恳谈会举行
articles.title_en: Shandong Finance Group and Weihai Hold Strategic Cooperation Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，山东财金集团与威海市举行战略合作恳谈会，市政府与企业签署战略合作协议，市委书记张海波出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, the strategic cooperation symposium between Shandong Finance Group and Weihai was held, during which the municipal government signed a strategic cooperation agreement with the enterprises. Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在全市信访工作推进会上强调加力推进信访积案化解和源头治理
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Urges Greater Efforts to Resolve Petition Backlogs and Address Root Causes at City Petition Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，西安召开全市信访工作推进会，市委书记蒿慧杰出席讲话，要求加力推进信访积案化解和源头治理。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7, Xi'an held a citywide petition work meeting. Municipal Party Secretary Hao Huijie urged greater efforts to resolve backlogged cases and address root causes.

articles.title_zh: 在中国共产党新乡市第十三届委员会第一次全体会议上的讲话
articles.title_en: Speech at the First Plenary Session of the 13th Xinxiang Municipal Committee of the CPC
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月3日，新乡市委书记魏建平在市委十三届一次全会上发表讲话，强调政治建设、实干担当、为民服务、团结协作和纪律作风。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, 2026, Xinxiang Municipal Party Secretary Wei Jianping delivered a speech at the first plenary session of the 13th Municipal Party Committee, stressing political loyalty, practical work, serving the people, unity, and discipline.

articles.title_zh: 襄城县职业技术教育中心举行开学典礼 范耀江出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Fan Yaojiang Attends Opening Ceremony of Xiangcheng County Vocational and Technical Education Center
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，襄城县职业技术教育中心举行开学典礼，县委书记范耀江出席并讲话，强调深化产教融合、建设现代职业教育体系，为产业升级提供人才支撑。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Xiangcheng County Vocational and Technical Education Center held its opening ceremony. County Party Secretary Fan Yaojiang attended and spoke, stressing deeper industry-education integration and a modern vocational education system to support industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 盐城（上海）长三角招商周活动举行
articles.title_en: Yancheng (Shanghai) Yangtze River Delta Investment Promotion Week Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月6日至7日，盐城市委书记严汉平率队赴上海开展长三角招商周活动，出席相关推介会并现场签约28个重大项目，涵盖新能源、人工智能等领域。
articles.summary_en: From September 6 to 7, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to Shanghai for the Yangtze River Delta investment promotion week, attended a promotion conference, and witnessed the signing of 28 major projects covering new energy, AI and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜调研光伏国家先进制造业集群建设情况
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Inspects Construction of National Advanced Manufacturing Cluster for Photovoltaic Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，盐城市委副书记、代市长吴炜调研光伏国家先进制造业集群建设，深入多家企业和研究院，强调做优产业生态，培育壮大新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Wu Wei, Deputy Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee and Acting Mayor, inspected the construction of the national advanced manufacturing cluster for photovoltaics, emphasizing green and low-carbon development and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见俄罗斯总统普京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Russian President Vladimir Putin
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月31日下午，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会期间会见俄罗斯总统普京，就中俄关系及共同关心的国际地区问题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 31, local time, President Xi Jinping met with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the 2026 SCO summit in Bishkek, exchanging views on bilateral ties and international issues.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先主持召开市委书记专题会议部署绿美广东生态建设整改工作
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Chairs Municipal Party Committee Meeting on Ecological Construction Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，阳江市委书记卢一先主持召开市委书记专题会议，部署2025年绿美广东生态建设考核反馈问题整改，强调压实责任、挂图作战。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Lu Yixian, secretary of the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a special meeting to arrange rectification of issues from the 2025 assessment feedback on Guangdong's green ecological construction, emphasizing accountability and task mapping.

tags.name_en: Green and Beautiful Guangdong Ecological Construction

tags_en: Green and Beautiful Guangdong Ecological Construction

articles.title_zh: 姚华明主持召开专家学者座谈会征求对市第十四次党代会报告意见建议
articles.title_en: Yao Huaming Chairs Symposium of Experts and Scholars to Solicit Opinions on the 14th Municipal Party Congress Report
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，营口市委书记姚华明主持召开座谈会，就市第十四次党代会报告征求专家学者意见建议，强调报告要凝聚共识、引领未来五年发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Yingkou municipal Party Secretary Yao Huaming chaired a symposium to solicit opinions from experts and scholars on the report for the 14th Municipal Party Congress, emphasizing that the report should build consensus and guide development in the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 全市大气污染防治工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Yueyang Work Meeting on Air Pollution Prevention and Control Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江督导检查大气污染防治工作并出席全市大气污染防治工作会议，强调确保完成年度目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 7, Xie Weijiang, deputy secretary of the CPC Hunan Provincial Committee and secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, inspected air pollution control work and chaired a citywide meeting, urging solid efforts to meet annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江与长三角等地企业家座谈
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Holds Talks with Entrepreneurs from Yangtze River Delta and Other Regions
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江与来岳考察投资的长三角等地企业家座谈，就绿色生态产业、人工智能、对非经贸等领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Party Secretary of Yueyang, held talks with entrepreneurs from the Yangtze River Delta and other regions, discussing cooperation in green industries, AI, and trade with Africa.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国到中心城区调研灾后恢复重建工作
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Inspects Post-Disaster Recovery in Zhoukou Central Urban Area
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，周口市委书记黄玉国到中心城区调研灾后恢复重建工作，实地察看景区、学校和堤防工程，强调高质高效推进灾后恢复。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7, Huang Yuguo, secretary of CPC Zhoukou Municipal Committee, visited the central urban area to inspect post-disaster recovery at a scenic spot, a college and a levee, urging efficient restoration and public safety.

articles.title_zh: 林武会见全国新的社会阶层人士“科创中国”服务团一行
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Meets Delegation of "Sci-Tech China" Service Group for New Social Strata
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日下午，山东省委书记林武在济南会见中央统战部副部长王瑞军及“科创中国”服务团一行，双方就科技创新与产业合作交流。
articles.summary_en: Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu met with Central United Front Work Department Deputy Head Wang Ruijun and the "Sci-Tech China" service delegation in Jinan on Sept. 7 to discuss sci-tech innovation and industrial cooperation.

tags.name_en: United Front Work Department of CPC Central Committee

tags_en: United Front Work Department of CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔在淄博调研时强调加力强产业扩消费增动能
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Visits Zibo, Emphasizes Boosting Industry, Consumption and Growth Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔在淄博调研，强调加力强产业、扩消费、增动能，推动经济持续稳健向好、进中提质。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of Shandong Provincial CPC Committee and Governor, inspected Zibo, stressing efforts to strengthen industry, expand consumption and boost growth drivers for sustained economic improvement.

articles.title_zh: 第四十期山东干部讲堂开讲
articles.title_en: The 40th Session of Shandong Cadre Lecture Hall Kicks Off
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日上午，第四十期山东干部讲堂在济南开讲，省委书记林武出席，中国人民银行行长潘功胜作报告，省长周乃翔主持，强调金融服务实体经济与防范金融风险。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 7, the 40th session of the Shandong Cadre Lecture Hall opened in Jinan. Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu attended, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng gave a report, and Governor Zhou Naixiang presided, stressing financial services for the real economy and risk prevention.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Government Party Group Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，山东省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持召开省政府党组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果，研究巩固拓展工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a meeting of the provincial government's Party Leadership Group to study and implement important instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping, summarize the achievements of education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, and plan further consolidation.

articles.title_zh: 招商局集团原副总经理李百安被提起公诉
articles.title_en: Li Bai'an, Former Deputy General Manager of China Merchants Group, Indicted
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，最高检发布消息，招商局集团原副总经理李百安因涉嫌受贿被提起公诉，检察机关指控其敛财数额特别巨大。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the Supreme People's Procuratorate announced that Li Bai'an, former deputy general manager of China Merchants Group, was indicted on suspicion of accepting bribes of especially large amounts.

articles.title_zh: 受贿1.48亿余元，山西省原省长金湘军被判死缓
articles.title_en: Jin Xiangjun, Former Governor of Shanxi, Sentenced to Death with Reprieve for Bribery of 148 Million Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月8日，河南省信阳市中级人民法院一审宣判山西省委原副书记、原省长金湘军受贿案，以受贿罪判处其死刑，缓期二年执行。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, 2026, the Xinyang Intermediate People's Court of Henan sentenced Jin Xiangjun, former deputy secretary of the Shanxi Provincial Committee and former governor, to death with a two-year reprieve for bribery.

articles.title_zh: 香港“支联会”煽动颠覆案，9月11日判刑
articles.title_en: Hong Kong 'Alliance' Subversion Case Sentencing Set for Sept 11
articles.summary_zh: 香港“支联会”及其前主席李卓人、前副主席何俊仁和邹幸彤涉煽动颠覆国家政权罪，法庭定于9月11日判刑。
articles.summary_en: The dissolved Hong Kong Alliance and former officials Lee Cheuk-yan, Ho Chun-yan and Chow Hang-tung, convicted of subversion, will be sentenced on September 11.

articles.title_zh: 国安部：唐某专程在飞机试验场旁小区高楼层偷拍尚未公开战机细节，上传网络后快速扩散
articles.title_en: State Security Ministry: Man Photographed Undisclosed Fighter Jet Details from High-Rise Near Test Site and Uploaded Online, Sparks Rapid Spread
articles.summary_zh: 国家安全部通报，唐某在飞机试验场旁小区高层偷拍尚未公开的战机细节，上传网络后快速扩散，危害国家安全。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of State Security (MSS) disclosed that a man surnamed Tang photographed undisclosed fighter jet details from a high-rise beside an aircraft test site and uploaded them online, causing rapid spread and endangering national security.

articles.title_zh: 罗文在石家庄市看望慰问教师和教育工作者
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Visits Teachers and Educators in Shijiazhuang
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月8日，罗文到石家庄市部分中小学看望慰问教师和教育工作者，强调牢记为党育人为国育才初心使命，努力办好人民满意的教育。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, 2026, Luo Wen visited teachers and educators at schools in Shijiazhuang, stressing their mission to educate students for the Party and the country and to provide satisfactory education.

articles.title_zh: 福州市双向投资合作对接会在厦门举行
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Holds Two-Way Investment Cooperation Meeting in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，第二十六届投洽会开幕之际，福州市在厦门举行双向投资合作对接会，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁出席并讲话，市长吴贤德推介投资环境。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 8, during the 26th CIFIT, Fuzhou held a two-way investment cooperation meeting in Xiamen. Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party secretary, attended and spoke; Mayor Wu Xiande presented the investment environment.

articles.title_zh: 全市科技创新大会召开
articles.title_en: Qingdao Holds Municipal Sci-Tech Innovation Conference
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日下午，青岛市科技创新大会召开，市委书记曾赞荣出席并讲话，强调以科技创新引领产业创新，加快建设科技强市。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 8, Qingdao held its Municipal Sci-Tech Innovation Conference. Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong attended and stressed leading industrial innovation with sci-tech innovation to build a strong sci-tech city.

articles.title_zh: 以主体功能区战略塑造发展新优势
articles.title_en: Shaping New Development Advantages with the Main Functional Zone Strategy
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”开局之年，我国推进主体功能区战略，福建、陕西榆林、上海松江等地细化国土空间规划，统筹粮食安全、生态保护与能源开发。
articles.summary_en: In the first year of the 15th Five-Year Plan, China is implementing its main functional zone strategy. Fujian, Yulin (Shaanxi), and Songjiang (Shanghai) are refining spatial plans to balance food security, ecological protection, and energy development.

articles.title_zh: 推进中吉乌铁路建设 习近平特别强调“高质量”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes 'High Quality' in Advancing China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway Construction
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席亲自关心推动中吉乌铁路建设，强调高质量打造“一带一路”标志性工程，促进中亚互联互通与共同发展。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping personally oversees the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, stressing high-quality construction of a flagship Belt and Road project to boost regional connectivity and shared development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事｜育好时代新苗
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concern: Nurturing New Generation of the Era
articles.summary_zh: 全国基础教育工作会议举行，传达习近平总书记重要指示，强调开创基础教育高质量发展新局面。各地推进思政教育、健康教育和城乡教育资源均衡，办好人民满意教育。
articles.summary_en: The National Basic Education Conference conveyed Xi Jinping's instructions to open a new chapter of high-quality basic education. Localities advance ideological education, health education, and balanced urban-rural resources for people's satisfaction.

articles.title_zh: 招标公告出现多处瑕疵，四川黑水县科协：深刻吸取教训
articles.title_en: Sichuan Heishui County Science Association Learns Lesson from Flawed Tender Notice
articles.summary_zh: 黑水县纪委监委督查发现县科协项目采购存在公告瑕疵，科协主动作废挂网信息并重新规范采购，强调已整改到位。
articles.summary_en: After the discipline inspection body spotted flaws in a procurement notice by Heishui County Science and Technology Association, the association voided the original notice and reorganized procurement procedures in compliance with regulations.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部：坚决拥护党中央对王祥喜的处分决定
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Firmly Supports Party Central Committee's Punishment Decision on Wang Xiangxi
articles.summary_zh: 9月8日，应急管理部党委召开会议，通报中央纪委国家监委给予王祥喜开除党籍、开除公职的处分决定，并表示坚决拥护党中央决定。
articles.summary_en: On September 8, the Party Committee of the Ministry of Emergency Management held a meeting to convey the decision by the CCDI and the National Supervisory Commission to expel Wang Xiangxi from the Party and public office, expressing firm support for the Party Central Committee's decision.

articles.title_zh: 深入学思践悟习近平经济思想 扎扎实实做好广东经济工作 坚定扛牢经济大省挑大梁的责任担当

articles.summary_en: Yuncheng, Shandong hosts 500+ packaging firms, making 2.1B bottles and 8.2B caps yearly (30% of China's caps). Full supply chain and government aid help it thrive despite costs and green rules.

articles.title_zh: 福建省建筑业协会发布积极投身灾后重建的倡议

articles.title_zh: 2026年中国农民丰收节金秋消费季全面启动

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Golden Autumn Consumption Season of China's Farmers' Harvest Festival was recently launched in Shanghai, co-initiated by multiple ministries including the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs. It features activities to boost agricultural product sales, having driven cumulative sales of over 160 billion yuan.

articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order to promulgate the revised Regulation on Emergency Response, Investigation and Handling of Electric Power Safety Accidents, effective from January 1, 2027.

articles.title_en: Guidelines for Tiered Protection of Animal Specimens in Museum Exhibitions Approved for Initiation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国自然科学博物馆学会公布2026年度第二批团体标准立项，《博物馆动物标本展陈分级防护指南》通过立项，建议国家一级保护动物标本禁止裸展。
articles.summary_en: The Chinese Society of Natural Science Museums recently approved the project for 'Guidelines for Tiered Display Protection of Animal Specimens in Museums', recommending that national first-class protected animal specimens not be exhibited openly.

articles.title_zh: 我国启动国际地月立方星座大科学计划
articles.title_en: China Launches International Earth-Moon Cube Constellation Science Program
articles.summary_zh: 我国在2026年深空探测国际会议上启动国际地月立方星座大科学计划，将联合多国部署卫星群，开展环境监测、伽马射线暴探测和月球资源勘探，计划2030年左右完成部署。
articles.summary_en: China launched an international Earth-Moon Cube Constellation program at a 2026 deep-space conference, with partners deploying satellites for cislunar monitoring, gamma-ray burst detection, and lunar resource exploration by around 2030.

articles.title_zh: 云南省公布2026年度安全生产重大隐患挂牌督办名单
articles.title_en: Yunnan Releases List of Major Work Safety Hazards Under Provincial Supervision for 2026
articles.summary_zh: 云南省政府办公厅印发名单，对全省36项安全生产重大隐患实施省级挂牌督办，要求限期整改，防范重特大生产安全事故。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan provincial government has issued a list of 36 major work safety hazards for provincial-level supervision, requiring rectification within deadlines to prevent serious accidents.

tags.name_en: General Office of Yunnan Provincial Government

tags_en: General Office of Yunnan Provincial Government

articles.title_zh: 《习近平生态文明思想概论》出版发行
articles.title_en: Introduction to Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization Published
articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部、生态环境部组织编写的《习近平生态文明思想概论》由高等教育出版社、人民出版社出版，系统阐述习近平生态文明思想。
articles.summary_en: The textbook "Introduction to Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization," compiled by the Central Propaganda Department and the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, has been published by Higher Education Press and People's Publishing House.

articles.title_zh: 伊朗称将在霍尔木兹海峡之外设立禁区
articles.title_en: Iran Says It Will Set Up No-Go Zone Outside Strait of Hormuz
articles.summary_zh: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊9月6日表示，伊朗将宣布在霍尔木兹海峡之外设立禁区，进入船只将受到制裁。
articles.summary_en: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, said on September 6 that Iran will announce a no-go zone outside the Strait of Hormuz and impose sanctions on ships entering it.

articles.title_zh: 第二届习近平文化思想国际学术研讨会在深圳举行
articles.title_en: Second International Symposium on Xi Jinping Thought on Culture Held in Shenzhen
articles.summary_zh: 第二届习近平文化思想国际学术研讨会9月6日在深圳举行，约130名中外学者围绕“巩固文化主体性推进中国式现代化”展开研讨。中央宣传部副部长洪大用等出席开幕式并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 2nd international symposium on Xi Jinping Thought on Culture, focused on consolidating cultural subjectivity for Chinese modernization, was held in Shenzhen Sept. 6 with about 130 experts. Central publicity official Hong Dayong addressed the opening.

articles.title_zh: “姜健”号驱逐舰正式入列朝鲜海军
articles.title_en: "Kang Gon" Destroyer Officially Commissioned into DPRK Navy
articles.summary_zh: 据朝中社9月7日报道，朝鲜“姜健”号驱逐舰入列仪式6日在元山港举行，金正恩出席并发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: According to a KCNA report on Sept. 7, the commissioning ceremony of the DPRK's destroyer "Kang Gon" was held at Wonsan Port on Sept. 6, with Kim Jong Un attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明在益阳调研电子信息产业发展情况
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Visits Yiyang to Inspect Electronic Information Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月6日，湖南省委副书记、省长毛伟明赴益阳市调研电子信息产业发展情况，走访多家高新技术企业，强调培育产业集群、强化科技创新。
articles.summary_en: On September 6, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming visited Yiyang to inspect the electronic information industry, touring high-tech enterprises and emphasizing industrial cluster cultivation and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛主持召开第九期政企恳谈会
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs the 9th Government-Enterprise Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开第九期政企恳谈会，听取汽车企业意见建议，强调推动汽车产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu Province chaired the 9th government-enterprise symposium to hear opinions from automakers and promote high-quality development of the automobile industry.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事丨育好时代新苗
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Care: Cultivating the New Generation
articles.summary_zh: 综述习近平总书记对基础教育的关怀，各地推进思政课建设、守护青少年身心健康、促进优质均衡发展。
articles.summary_en: This feature reviews Xi Jinping's care for basic education, highlighting efforts across China to strengthen ideological education, safeguard youth physical and mental health, and promote balanced and high-quality development of compulsory education.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 瑞金至延安“长征高铁”首发
articles.title_en: Ruijin-Yan'an High-Speed Railway Launches First Train
articles.summary_zh: 9月6日，G3998次复兴号列车从江西瑞金站首发，当晚抵达陕西延安站，标志着连接两座红色地标的“长征高铁”开通。
articles.summary_en: On September 6, the Fuxing bullet train G3998 departed from Ruijin Station in Jiangxi and arrived at Yan'an Station in Shaanxi that evening, marking the opening of the 'Long March High-Speed Railway' linking two red landmarks.

articles.title_zh: 而今迈步从头越——写在瑞金至延安高铁开行之际
articles.title_en: High-Speed Rail Opens Between Revolutionary Cities Ruijin and Yan'an
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月6日，瑞金至延安首次开行直达高铁G3998次列车，长征出发地与落脚点实现高铁直达，将促进沿线革命老区红色旅游和区域发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 6, 2026, the G3998 train departed from Ruijin to Yan'an, marking the first direct high-speed rail link between the starting point and destination of the Long March. The new route is expected to boost red tourism and regional development in old revolutionary bases.

tags.name_en: Development of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

tags_en: Development of Old Revolutionary Base Areas

articles.title_zh: 国家卫健委：夸大血浆置换、三氧疗法等治疗效果属违法违规
articles.title_en: National Health Commission: Exaggerating Effects of Plasma Exchange, Ozone Therapy Is Illegal
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，国家卫健委新闻发言人胡强强在新闻发布会上提醒，将血浆置换、三氧疗法用于健康人群抗衰老、调理属违法违规行为。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 7, 2026, Hu Qiangqiang, spokesperson of the National Health Commission, warned at a press conference that using plasma exchange or ozone therapy on healthy people for anti-aging or health conditioning is illegal.

articles.title_zh: 国家发展改革委运行局组织安排提高疆煤外运规模
articles.title_en: NDRC Arranges to Expand Coal Transport from Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委运行局组织新疆发展改革委、国铁集团、乌鲁木齐铁路局召开专题会议，安排稳定疆煤产量、强化运力保障，提高疆煤外运规模。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC Operations Bureau held a meeting with Xinjiang's DRC, China Railway Group and Urumqi Railway Bureau to stabilize Xinjiang coal output and boost outbound coal transport.

articles.title_zh: 院士解读西藏吉隆泥石流：真正危险的不止是冰川
articles.title_en: Academician Explains Mudslide in Gyirong, Xizang: The Real Danger Is More Than Glaciers
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，尼泊尔一侧泥石流造成西藏吉隆口岸重大人员伤亡和失联。中国工程院院士殷跃平接受新华社采访，剖析灾害成因，提示风险不止冰川。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, a mudslide from Nepal caused major casualties and missing persons at Gyirong Port, Xizang. Yin Yueping, academician of Chinese Academy of Engineering, explained the disaster mechanism, warning risks are not limited to glaciers.

articles.title_zh: 财政部积极支持有关中央金融企业补充核心一级资本
articles.title_en: Ministry of Finance Actively Supports Core Tier-1 Capital Supplement for Central Financial Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 财政部近期将发行特别国债3000亿元，支持工行、农行等8家中央金融企业补充核心一级资本，按市场化法治化原则稳妥推进。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance will issue 300 billion yuan of special treasury bonds to support 8 central financial enterprises, including ICBC and ABC, in replenishing core tier-1 capital, progressing steadily on a market-based and law-based principle.

articles.title_zh: 专家学者共话社会主义学院办学发展
articles.title_en: Experts Discuss Development of Institutes of Socialism
articles.summary_zh: 9月7日，社会主义学院办学路子研讨会在福州举行，120余位代表围绕统一战线人才教育培养等展开研讨。
articles.summary_en: On September 7, a symposium on the development path of socialist colleges was held in Fuzhou, with over 120 representatives discussing united front talent cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 工信部等六部门联合印发意见推动历史经典产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Six Ministries Including MIIT Issue Plan to Boost High-Quality Development of Classic Historical Industries
articles.summary_zh: 工信部等六部门近日联合印发《关于推动历史经典产业高质量发展的意见》，提出到2028年培育50家百亿规模龙头企业和100个中国消费名品，打造千亿级特色产业集群。
articles.summary_en: Six ministries including MIIT issued a guideline to boost high-quality development of classic historical industries such as silk, tea and porcelain, aiming to cultivate 50 billion-yuan champions and 100 renowned Chinese consumer brands by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 《版权工作“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: National Copyright Administration Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Copyright Work
articles.summary_zh: 国家版权局近日印发《版权工作“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年完善版权法律制度，加强版权保护与执法，推动产业高质量发展及国际合作。
articles.summary_en: National Copyright Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for copyright, aiming to improve laws, protection, and international cooperation by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 五问+一图，读懂《关于推动历史经典产业高质量发展的意见》
articles.title_en: Understanding the Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of Historical Classic Industries
articles.summary_zh: 经国务院同意，工信部等六部门联合印发《关于推动历史经典产业高质量发展的意见》，提出到2028年培育50家百亿规模龙头企业等目标。
articles.summary_en: With State Council approval, six ministries including MIIT issued the Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Development of Historical Classic Industries, setting goals such as cultivating 50 billion-yuan leading enterprises by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 张工主持召开市政府专题会议 研究全市经济运行与财政和投资重点工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Chairs Municipal Government Special Meeting on Economic Operation, Fiscal and Investment
articles.summary_zh: 9月6日下午，天津市市长张工主持召开市政府专题会议，研究经济运行、财政和投资重点工作，要求全力以赴完成全年发展目标任务。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept. 6, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong chaired a municipal government special meeting on key economic, fiscal and investment work, urging efforts to fulfill annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 办好高等教育 提供人才支撑
articles.title_en: Ensure Quality Higher Education and Provide Talent Support
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，新疆维吾尔自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在喀什调研高等教育和重点产业，强调办好高等教育、发展新质生产力，要求培育壮大新动能。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, Erkin Tuniyaz, chairman of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, inspected higher education and key industries in Kashgar, stressing quality higher education and new productive forces to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 落实“健康第一”：新学期校园新气象观察
articles.title_en: Implementing 'Health First': New Campus Atmosphere for the New Semester
articles.summary_zh: 新学期开学，各地中小学落实“健康第一”理念，通过体育课改革、智慧操场、营养餐和心理健康活动，促进青少年身心健康。
articles.summary_en: As the new semester begins, primary and secondary schools nationwide implement the 'Health First' philosophy through sports course reforms, smart playgrounds, nutritious meals, and mental health activities to promote students' physical and mental well-being.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇在海淀区调研未来产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Inspects Future Industry Development in Haidian District
articles.summary_zh: 日前，北京市市长殷勇在海淀区调研未来产业，强调构建全生命周期服务体系，推动核心技术突破和转化应用。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong inspected future industries in Haidian District, emphasizing building a full-lifecycle service system to promote technological breakthroughs and commercial application.

articles.title_zh: 一名中国游客的尼泊尔泥石流脱困之路
articles.title_en: Chinese Tourist's Escape from Nepal Landslide
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，在尼泊尔蓝塘山区因泥石流被困多日的中国游客张宁，经使馆协调与尼泊尔友人乘尼军直升机脱困，并被接至加德满都。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 4, Chinese tourist Zhang Ning, trapped by landslides in Nepal's Langtang, was airlifted by Nepalese army helicopter after Chinese Embassy coordination, and brought to Kathmandu.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，长春市市长顾刚主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，部署经济运行、项目投资、城市更新、生态环保等工作，原则通过相关投资项目决策程序管理暂行办法。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, Changchun Mayor Gu Gang chaired the city government's Party group and executive meetings to arrange economic, investment, urban renewal and environmental tasks, and pass interim investment decision rules.

articles.title_zh: 我国已建成高效完备的动力电池产业体系
articles.title_en: China Has Built an Efficient and Complete Power Battery Industry System
articles.summary_zh: 工信部数据显示，2026年1—7月我国动力电池销量达790.4吉瓦时，同比增长37.1%；我国已建成涵盖全环节的产业链，并拓展至船舶、飞机等领域。
articles.summary_en: According to MIIT, China's power battery sales totaled 790.4 GWh from January to July 2026, up 37.1% year-on-year. China has built a complete industrial chain, expanding to ships, aircraft and more.

articles.title_zh: 时代·人民·文明——中国元首外交的思想启迪
articles.title_en: Era, People, Civilization: The Intellectual Inspiration of China's Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京9月5日电 文章回顾习近平主席出席上合组织比什凯克峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及，阐释世界多极化、以人民为中心和文明互鉴等外交理念，为变乱交织的世界提供中国智慧。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua review of Xi Jinping's recent SCO summit and visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt elaborates on multipolarity, people-centered governance, and civilizational exchanges to inspire a turbulent world.

articles.title_zh: 共绘上海合作组织更高质量发展新图景——国际社会高度评价习近平主席出席2026年上海合作组织峰会
articles.title_en: New Blueprint for Higher-Quality SCO Development — Intl Community Hails Xi Jinping's Attendance at 2026 SCO Summit
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，习近平主席出席在吉尔吉斯斯坦比什凯克举行的2026年上海合作组织峰会并发表重要讲话，国际社会高度评价，认为讲话凝聚了上合组织更高质量发展的共识与合力。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, President Xi Jinping attended the 2026 SCO Summit in Bishkek and delivered an important speech, which was highly praised by the international community as building consensus for higher-quality SCO development and advancing multipolarity and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 我国物流业景气水平进一步提升
articles.title_en: China's Logistics Industry Prosperity Level Further Improves
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会公布8月中国物流业景气指数为50.9%，较上月上升0.5个百分点，继续处于扩张区间，显示物流业景气水平进一步提升。
articles.summary_en: China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing reported the August logistics prosperity index at 50.9%, up 0.5 points month-on-month, remaining in expansion and indicating further improvement.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁率福州市代表团访问澳门
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Leads Fuzhou Delegation to Macao
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日至5日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁率福州市代表团访问澳门，拜会澳门中联办，考察交流，深化榕澳合作。
articles.summary_en: From September 4 to 5, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee, led a Fuzhou delegation to Macao to deepen Fuzhou-Macao exchanges and cooperation.

tags.name_en: Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in Macao

tags_en: Liaison Office of the Central People's Government in Macao

articles.title_zh: 李国强会见意大利卢戈市客人
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Meets Delegation from Italian City of Lugo
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日上午，泰安市长李国强会见意大利卢戈市市长埃莱娜·赞诺尼一行，双方就深化经贸、教育人文及文化旅游合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 5, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang met with Elena Zanoni, Mayor of Lugo, Italy, and her delegation to discuss cooperation in trade, education, culture, and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬到兴化市走访调研重点企业
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Visits Key Enterprises in Xinghua for Research
articles.summary_zh: 近日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到兴化市走访调研多家重点企业，强调强化创新驱动、优化营商环境，支持企业做大做强。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of the Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, visited key enterprises in Xinghua, emphasizing innovation-driven development and a better business environment to support enterprise growth.

articles.title_zh: 美国驻上海总领事访问无锡
articles.title_en: U.S. Consul General in Shanghai Visits Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，无锡市长蒋锋会见美国驻上海总领事马志安一行，双方就深化友好互信和拓展多领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng met with U.S. Consul General in Shanghai Ma Zhi'an and his delegation, exchanging views on deepening mutual trust and expanding cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在周至县调研督导稳增长等工作 强调加力稳增长聚力防风险着力惠民生强力转作风
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Zhouzhi County on Stable Growth and Key Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，西安市委书记蒿慧杰到周至县调研督导稳增长、扫黑除恶、群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治等工作，强调加力稳增长、聚力防风险、着力惠民生、强力转作风。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, Hao Huijie, Secretary of the CPC Xi'an Municipal Committee, visited Zhouzhi County to inspect and promote stable growth, anti-crime efforts, and the campaign against corruption and misconduct around the people, emphasizing stability, risk prevention, livelihood improvement, and work style.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜调研防灾减灾救灾体系建设情况
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Inspects Construction of Disaster Prevention and Relief System
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，盐城市代市长吴炜赴阜宁县调研防灾减灾救灾体系建设情况，强调提高预警和应急能力，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 5, acting mayor Wu Wei of Yancheng inspected disaster prevention and emergency systems in Funing County, calling for stronger early warning and response to safeguard people's lives.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Attends 2026 SCO Summit and Pays State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 习近平于2026年8月30日至9月2日对吉尔吉斯斯坦和埃及进行国事访问，并出席上海合作组织比什凯克峰会，签署中吉永久睦邻友好合作条约等文件。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 30 to Sep 2, 2026, President Xi Jinping paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt and attended the SCO Bishkek Summit, signing the China-Kyrgyzstan treaty on permanent friendship and cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中国建筑：副总裁陈勇因涉嫌严重违纪违法离任
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Removed as Vice President of China State Construction Over Serious Discipline Violations
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，中国建筑股份有限公司董事会通过议案，副总裁陈勇因涉嫌严重违纪违法接受中央纪委国家监委审查调查，离任副总裁职务。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, 2026, the board of China State Construction Engineering Corporation approved Chen Yong's removal as vice president after he was placed under disciplinary review by the CCDI for suspected serious violations.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Commission of Supervision

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Commission of Supervision

articles.title_zh: 日喀则市代理市长：将深入研究口岸功能恢复等事宜
articles.title_en: Acting Mayor of Shigatse: Deep Research on Port Function Restoration Underway
articles.summary_zh: 9月6日，日喀则市代理市长罗布次仁在吉隆县泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部媒体见面会上表示，将深入研究吉隆口岸功能恢复等事宜。
articles.summary_en: On September 6, acting mayor of Shigatse Luo Buren said at a press conference that restoration of Gyirong Port functions would be studied in depth after the mudslide disaster.

articles.title_zh: 多地严查赵一鸣、好想来等
articles.title_en: Multiple Regions Crack Down on Snack Chains Like Zhao Yiming and Haoxianglai for Short-Weighting
articles.summary_zh: 近期，多地市场监管部门对赵一鸣、好想来等量贩式零食店开展计量专项整治，严查缺斤短两行为，已检查多家门店及电子秤。
articles.summary_en: Recently, market regulators in multiple regions launched special inspections on bulk snack stores such as Zhao Yiming and Haoxianglai, cracking down on short-weighting. They have inspected many stores and electronic scales.

articles.title_zh: 紫金矿业就半年报将政府名称写错致歉
articles.title_en: Zijin Mining Apologizes for Misnaming County Government in Semi-Annual Report
articles.summary_zh: 紫金矿业9月5日发布公告，就2026年半年度报告及前期公告中3家单位名称文字错误致歉，称错误不影响财务数据。
articles.summary_en: Zijin Mining on Sept. 5 apologized for name typos in its 2026 interim report and previous filings, saying the errors do not affect financial data.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席上合组织+会议并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends SCO Plus Meeting and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日，国家主席习近平在比什凯克出席上海合作组织+会议，发表题为《共同倡导平等有序的世界多极化 实现更加公正合理的全球治理》的重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, local time, President Xi Jinping attended the SCO Plus meeting in Bishkek and delivered an important speech titled 'Jointly Advocate an Equal and Orderly Multipolar World and Realize More Just and Equitable Global Governance'.

articles.title_zh: 着力构建新型电力系统 能源安全底气更足
articles.title_en: Striving to Build a New-Type Power System for Stronger Energy Security
articles.summary_zh: 今年夏季我国用电负荷创新高，新型电力系统建设保障电力供应平稳有序，支撑经济社会发展和产业用电需求。
articles.summary_en: This summer, China's power load hit record highs, yet the new-type power system ensured stable electricity supply, supporting economic and social development and industrial demand.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇在海淀区调研未来产业发展工作时强调 构建全生命周期服务体系 推动技术突破和转化应用
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Stresses Full-lifecycle Services for Future Industries during Haidian Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 近日，北京市市长殷勇到海淀区调研未来产业发展，强调构建全生命周期服务体系，推动核心技术突破和转化应用，培育新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong visited Haidian District to research future industries, emphasizing a full-lifecycle service system to promote core technological breakthroughs and commercialization, boosting new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 湖北多措并举强化产业就业协同
articles.title_en: Hubei Takes Multiple Measures to Strengthen Coordination Between Industry and Employment
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月初，湖北实施“技兴荆楚”工程，通过项目化培训、补贴政策等促进产业就业协同，已累计帮助解决用工8.44万人，完成补贴性技能培训27.85万人次。
articles.summary_en: In early September 2026, Hubei implemented the 'Skills Revitalize Jingchu' project to coordinate industry and employment through project-based training and subsidy policies, helping fill 84,400 jobs and completing 278,500 subsidized skill trainings.

articles.title_zh: 海南出台医疗器械委托生产监管新政
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues New Regulations on Commissioned Production of Medical Devices
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省药监局印发若干措施，划清政企权责，细化监管标准，构建医疗器械委托生产全生命周期闭环监管体系。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Hainan Provincial Drug Administration issued measures to clarify responsibilities, refine supervision standards, and build a closed-loop lifecycle supervision system for commissioned production of medical devices.

articles.title_zh: 2026年黑龙江省全国科普月主场活动启动仪式在哈尔滨举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Heilongjiang National Science Popularization Month Launch Ceremony Held in Harbin
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，2026年黑龙江省全国科普月主场活动启动仪式在哈尔滨举行，现场发布科普研学路线，启动系列科普活动。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, the launch ceremony for the 2026 Heilongjiang National Science Popularization Month was held in Harbin, featuring new science study routes and a series of science activities.

articles.title_zh: 星塘750千伏变电站1号主变压器通过检验
articles.title_en: No.1 Main Transformer at Xingtang 750kV Substation Passes Testing
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，宁夏吴忠市星塘750千伏变电站1号主变压器及750千伏HGIS设备通过局部放电、交流耐压等专项试验，标志着关键设备通过投运前最重要检验，工程预计11月建成。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the No.1 main transformer and 750kV HGIS equipment at Xingtang 750kV substation in Wuzhong, Ningxia, passed partial discharge and AC withstand tests, marking a key pre-operation milestone. The project is expected to be completed by November.

articles.title_zh: 天津下大气力盘活城市存量资源
articles.title_en: Tianjin Makes Major Efforts to Revitalize Urban Stock Resources
articles.summary_zh: 天津通过保护式开发、业态升级等措施盘活城市存量资源，累计盘活房产超1600万平方米，2025年实现盘活收入超660亿元。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin has revitalized urban stock resources through protective renovation and business upgrading, revitalizing over 16 million square meters of property and generating over 66 billion yuan in revenue in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 中宣部召开党报党刊理论版改进文风经验交流会
articles.title_en: CPC Publicity Department Holds Meeting on Improving Writing Style in Party Newspapers and Journals
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，中宣部在浙江杭州召开党报党刊理论版改进文风经验交流会，强调改进文风、提高理论宣传质量。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department held a meeting in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, to improve the writing style of theoretical pages in party newspapers and journals.

articles.title_zh: 让真善美种子在孩子们心中生根发芽
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter Marking 70th Anniversary of 'Little Trumpet' Program
articles.summary_zh: 在中央广播电视总台《小喇叭》节目开播70周年之际，习近平总书记发来贺信，勉励少儿工作者落实立德树人根本任务，创作更多优秀少儿作品。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter on the 70th anniversary of the 'Little Trumpet' program, encouraging children's cultural workers to uphold moral education and create more excellent works.

articles.title_zh: 第八届中国粮食交易大会在长沙开幕
articles.title_en: 8th China Grain Trade Conference Opens in Changsha
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，第八届中国粮食交易大会在长沙开幕，毛伟明、刘焕鑫致辞并共同启幕，吸引3100余家企业参展。
articles.summary_en: The 8th China Grain Trade Conference opened in Changsha on Sept. 5, with Mao Weiming and Liu Huanxin addressing the ceremony and jointly inaugurating the event, attracting over 3,100 enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 新华社国家高端智库发布《新大众文艺的繁荣发展与世界影响》智库报告
articles.title_en: Xinhua National High-end Think Tank Releases Report on New Popular Literature and Art
articles.summary_zh: 2026年9月6日，新华社国家高端智库在深圳发布中英文智库报告《新大众文艺的繁荣发展与世界影响》，梳理新大众文艺发展态势，阐释其世界意义。
articles.summary_en: On September 6, 2026, Xinhua's National High-end Think Tank released a bilingual think tank report titled 'The Prosperity and Global Influence of New Popular Literature and Art' in Shenzhen, analyzing its trends and global significance.

articles.title_zh: 让新大众文艺在数智时代更好绽放光彩
articles.title_en: Let New Popular Literature and Art Shine Brighter in the Digital-Intelligence Era
articles.summary_zh: 9月6日，新华社国家高端智库在深圳发布《新大众文艺的繁荣发展与世界影响》报告，系统阐释新大众文艺在数智时代的意义与全球影响。
articles.summary_en: On September 6, Xinhua's National High-end Think Tank released its report 'The Flourishing and Global Influence of New Popular Literature and Art' in Shenzhen, elaborating on its significance in the digital-intelligence age.

articles.title_zh: 边境线上的“绿色戍边答卷”
articles.title_en: A Green Border-Defense Report from the Frontier
articles.summary_zh: 新华社乌鲁木齐9月6日电：新疆兵团边境团场护林员张涛等坚守26年植树造林、防沙治沙，已建成3万多亩林带，为边防筑起绿色屏障。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua from Urumqi, Sept. 6: Forest ranger Zhang Tao and others in a Xinjiang corps border farm have stuck to afforestation and desert control for 26 years, building over 30,000 mu of shelterbelts as a green barrier for border defense.

articles.title_zh: 尹力在市委党校调研，要求发挥党校干部教育培训主阵地作用，提升党员干部统筹高质量发展和高水平安全能力
articles.title_en: Yin Li Inspects Beijing Party School, Urges Strengthening Cadre Training for Development and Security
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日下午，北京市委书记尹力在市委党校调研，要求发挥党校干部教育培训主阵地作用，提升党员干部统筹高质量发展和高水平安全能力。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Sept 4, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li inspected the Municipal Party School, urging full use of its role as a main base for cadre education and training to improve officials' ability to balance high-quality development and high-level security.

articles.title_zh: 中国建筑副总经理陈勇任上被查
articles.title_en: Chen Yong, Vice President of China State Construction, Put under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，中国建筑集团有限公司党组成员、副总经理陈勇因涉嫌严重违纪违法，接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 5, Chen Yong, Party member and vice president of CSCEC, is under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 中建集团党组：坚决拥护党中央决定
articles.title_en: China State Construction Group Party Group Firmly Supports CPC Central Committee Decision
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，中建集团党组召开会议，通报中央纪委国家监委对党组成员、副总经理陈勇进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定，一致表示坚决拥护。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, the Party Group of China State Construction Group held a meeting to announce the decision by the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission to investigate Chen Yong, a member of the Party Group and deputy general manager, for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, and unanimously expressed firm support.

articles.title_zh: 能源大省山西求解煤与煤层气共采的“绿色方程式”
articles.title_en: Shanxi Tackles Green Equation of Coal and Coalbed Methane Co-mining
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，煤与煤层气共采创新发展论坛在山西举行，聚焦将煤矿瓦斯转化为清洁能源，实现安全与绿色双赢。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 4, the Coal and Coalbed Methane Co-mining Innovation Forum was held in Shanxi, focusing on converting coal mine gas into clean energy for dual wins in safety and green transition.

articles.title_zh: 中加举行第五次国防部工作会晤
articles.title_en: China, Canada Hold 5th Defense Ministry Working Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，中加第五次国防部工作会晤在加拿大举行，双方就国际和地区问题坦诚交换意见，表达加强两军务实合作意愿。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 4, the fifth China-Canada defense ministry working meeting was held in Canada. Both sides exchanged views on shared issues and expressed willingness to enhance military cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部调度江西遂川泥石流灾害救援 派出工作组赶赴现场
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Mobilizes Mudslide Rescue in Jiangxi's Suichuan, Sends Work Team to Scene
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，江西遂川发生泥石流和山体滑坡。应急管理部立即调度部署抢险救援，启动四级应急响应并派工作组赴现场指导。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, a mudslide and landslide hit Suichuan, Jiangxi. The Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level IV response and dispatched a work team to guide rescue operations.

articles.title_zh: 两部门针对福建提升国家自然灾害救助应急响应级别至三级
articles.title_en: Two Departments Upgrade National Disaster Relief Emergency Response to Level III in Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 9月5日，国家防减救灾委、应急管理部针对台风及强降雨对福建造成的严重影响，将国家自然灾害救助应急响应级别提升至三级，并派工作组赴灾区指导救助。
articles.summary_en: On September 5, two national departments upgraded the natural disaster relief emergency response to Level III in Fujian due to typhoon and extreme rainfall, sending a work team to guide local relief.
