articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登在吉隆泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部调度抢险救援工作
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Directs Rescue Work at Jilong Mudslide Disaster Emergency Command
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日晚，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在吉隆泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部调度抢险救援工作，强调全力以赴保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 2, Gama Zedeng, chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, directed rescue operations at the Jilong mudslide disaster emergency command, emphasizing all-out efforts to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开西藏自治区党委常委会会议 传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Meeting of CPC Tibet Regional Committee to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Speech Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成效，研究部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches, sum up the achievements of education on correct views of political achievements, and plan related work.

articles.title_zh: 学习进行时丨巩固拓展学习教育成果，总书记提出明确要求
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Gives Instructions on Consolidating and Expanding Achievements of Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日作出重要指示，强调要经常性开展政绩观教育，巩固拓展学习教育成果。中央党的建设工作领导小组8月24日召开会议研究部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping recently made important instructions on consolidating and expanding the achievements of the education on the correct view of political achievements, emphasizing regular education. The Central Leading Group for Party Building held a meeting on August 24 to arrange follow-up work.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登：用心用情周密细致做好各项工作 全力以赴推进抢险救援
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng: Make Meticulous Efforts to Advance Rescue and Relief Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日晚，西藏自治区主席嘎玛泽登在吉隆泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部调度抢险救援工作，并赴核心区实地检查，要求科学高效搜救，确保道路电力通信畅通。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 2, Gama Zedeng, chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, directed rescue operations at the emergency headquarters for the Gyirong mudslide and inspected the core area, calling for efficient search and rescue and stable infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，市长陈涛主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示，部署网络餐饮食品安全和制售假劣肉制品治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, Mayor Chen Tao chaired the municipal government's Party group (expanded) meeting and executive meeting, studying the spirit of an important instruction from General Secretary Xi Jinping and deploying work on food safety in online catering and crackdown on fake and substandard meat products.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到汕头市政协机关调研并召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Visits Shantou CPPCC Office for Research and Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，市委书记庄悦群到市政协机关调研并召开座谈会，强调发挥专门协商机构作用，为汕头在新时代经济特区建设中迎头赶上作出政协贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of the Shantou Municipal Party Committee, visited the CPPCC office for research and held a symposium, stressing the role of the CPPCC as a specialized consultative body in contributing to Shantou's development.

articles.title_zh: 汕尾市政府党组会议研究部署灾害防范应对、经济运行和招商引资等工作
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Government Party Group Meeting Arranges Work on Disaster Prevention, Economic Operation, and Investment Attraction
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，广东省汕尾市政府召开党组会议、常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署灾害防范应对、经济运行、招商引资等工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Shanwei municipal government held a party group meeting and executive meeting to convey General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, and to arrange work on disaster prevention, economic operation, and investment attraction.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰主持召开工作专题会议研究推进中秋晚会暨文旅周活动筹备工作
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Chairs Special Work Meeting on Preparations for Mid-Autumn Gala and Culture-Tourism Week
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，汕尾市委书记逯峰主持召开专题会议，研究推进广东卫视2026年粤港澳大湾区中秋晚会暨汕尾中秋文旅周筹备工作，强调高标准高质量做好各项筹备，确保活动圆满成功。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Lu Feng, secretary of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, chaired a special meeting on preparations for the 2026 Guangdong TV Mid-Autumn Gala and Shanwei Culture-Tourism Week, calling for high-standard, quality work to ensure the event's success.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Party Group Holds Theoretical Learning Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，市政府党组理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，市长李晖主持。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Municipal Government Party Group held a theoretical learning session to study Xi Jinping's important statements on grassroots work methods, chaired by Mayor Li Hui.

articles.title_zh: 民族舞剧《傲雪长白》举行长春首场汇报演出 黄强朱国贤出席观看
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Attend Premiere of Ethnic Dance Drama 'Aoxue Changbai' in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日晚，民族舞剧《傲雪长白》在长春举行首场汇报演出，吉林省委书记黄强、省政协主席朱国贤等出席观看并慰问演职人员。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the ethnic dance drama 'Aoxue Changbai' held its premiere performance in Changchun. Jilin Provincial Party Secretary Huang Qiang and CPPCC Provincial Committee Chairman Zhu Guoxian attended and greeted the cast afterwards.

articles.title_zh: 上海市浙江商会走进威海恳谈会举行
articles.title_en: Shanghai Zhejiang Chamber of Commerce Symposium Held in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，上海市浙江商会走进威海恳谈会举行。威海市委书记张海波出席并讲话，表示希望深化合作，推动项目落地。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, a symposium of the Shanghai Zhejiang Chamber of Commerce was held in Weihai. Weihai Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and spoke, expressing hopes for deeper cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 宣布芜湖军分区党委第一书记任职大会召开
articles.title_en: Meeting Held to Announce Appointment of First Secretary of Wuhu Military Subdistrict Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，芜湖军分区党委第一书记任职大会召开，省军区政委王金良宣读决定，市委书记徐志任军分区党委第一书记。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, a meeting in Wuhu announced the appointment of Xu Zhi as First Secretary of the Wuhu Military Subdistrict Party Committee; Provincial Military Region Political Commissar Wang Jinliang read the decision.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends SCO Summit and Pays State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席出席在比什凯克举行的上海合作组织峰会，并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问，签署多项合作文件，推动构建人类命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping attended the SCO Summit in Bishkek and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, signing documents to promote the building of a community with a shared future for mankind.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见新华三集团总裁兼首席执行官王竑弢一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets H3C Group President and CEO Wang Hongtao and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见新华三集团总裁兼首席执行官王竑弢一行，双方就推进数字政府建设与数字经济产业发展等务实合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: Xi'an Party Secretary Hao Huijie on Sept. 2 met with Wang Hongtao, President and CEO of H3C, to discuss cooperation on digital government and digital economy.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党新乡市第十三次代表大会关于中共新乡市第十二届委员会工作报告的决议
articles.title_en: The 13th CPC Xinxiang Municipal Congress Approves Resolution on the 12th Municipal Committee's Work Report
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党新乡市第十三次代表大会批准魏建平代表十二届市委所作的报告，总结过去五年成就，部署今后五年主要任务和全面从严治党等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: The 13th CPC Xinxiang Municipal Congress approved a work report delivered by Wei Jianping on behalf of the 12th Municipal Committee, summarizing achievements and outlining key tasks for the next five years.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平率队赴中国一汽考察洽谈
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Leads Delegation to Visit China FAW for Cooperation Talks
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，市委书记严汉平率队赴吉林长春，拜访中国一汽集团，与董事长邱现东座谈，共商深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to Changchun, Jilin, to visit China FAW Group and held talks with Chairman Qiu Xiandong on deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 烟台市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开 研究部署巩固拓展正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Yantai Municipal Party Committee Meeting Deploys Consolidation of Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，烟台市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结全市树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署巩固拓展工作。市委书记江成主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Yantai Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions, summarize the city's education on correct view of political achievements, and deploy consolidation efforts. Party Secretary Jiang Cheng presided.

articles.title_zh: 烟台市委常委会传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Yantai Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Convey Xi's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，烟台市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见，部署防汛抗旱等防灾减灾工作。市委书记江成主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the Standing Committee of the Yantai Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the August 28 Political Bureau meeting, deploying flood and drought disaster prevention work. Jiang Cheng, Deputy Director of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee and Party Secretary of Yantai, presided over and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 阳江市委常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，阳江市委常委会会议召开，市委书记卢一先主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和中央、省委部署，研究防灾减灾、生态文明建设及“百千万工程”等工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, the CPC Yangjiang Municipal Committee held a Standing Committee meeting chaired by Secretary Lu Yixian to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and decisions on disaster prevention, ecological civilization, and rural development.

articles.title_zh: 中共银川市委十五届十六次全会举行
articles.title_en: CPC Yinchuan Municipal Committee Holds 16th Plenary Session of 15th Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，中共银川市委十五届十六次全会在银川举行，审议通过工业转型升级实施意见和召开市第十六次党代会决议，赵旭辉讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, 2026, the 16th Plenary Session of the 15th CPC Yinchuan Municipal Committee was held in Yinchuan, approving opinions on industrial transformation and the resolution to convene the 16th Municipal Party Congress, with Zhao Xuhui speaking.

articles.title_zh: 银川市兴庆区举行第六届人民代表大会代表换届选举 张雨浦陈雍分别参加所在选区投票选举
articles.title_en: Xingqing District Holds People's Congress Election, Leaders Zhang Yupu and Chen Yong Cast Votes
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，银川市兴庆区举行第六届人民代表大会代表换届选举，自治区主席张雨浦、自治区政协主席陈雍分别在所在选区投票。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Xingqing District of Yinchuan held the election of deputies to its 6th People's Congress. Regional government chairman Zhang Yupu and CPPCC chairman Chen Yong voted in their respective constituencies.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在西吉县调研并主持召开座谈会 强调统筹推进‘两化一振兴’促进城乡融合发展
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Investigates Xiji County, Chairs Symposium on Urban-Rural Integration and People's Livelihoods
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至3日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞在西吉县调研常态化帮扶、特色产业发展、防汛防灾等工作，并主持召开座谈会，强调统筹推进‘两化一振兴’、促进城乡融合发展。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 3, Li Yifei, Party Chief of Ningxia, visited Xiji County to inspect regular assistance, featured industries, and flood control, and chaired a symposium urging integrated urban-rural development and improved livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 开创工业经济高质量发展新局面
articles.title_en: Creating a New Prospect for High-Quality Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，银川市委十五届十六次全会召开，审议通过《关于加快推进工业转型升级的实施意见》，并决定市第十六次党代会于2026年11月召开。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the 16th Plenary Session of the 15th Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee was held, approving implementation opinions on accelerating industrial transformation and upgrading and deciding that the 16th Municipal Party Congress will convene in November 2026.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见美中贸易全国委员会董事会代表
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with Representatives of US-China Business Council Board

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1, Premier Li Qiang met with a delegation led by McCain, Chairman of the Board of the US-China Business Council, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, emphasizing mutually beneficial economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 全市农村临违建筑和危旧房屋清理整治工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Yuxi City Holds Meeting on Cleanup of Illegal Rural Buildings and Dilapidated Houses
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，玉溪市召开农村临违建筑和危旧房屋清理整治工作推进会，市委书记杨政昆强调要精准施策、建立长效机制，推动整治工作取得实效。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Yuxi City held a meeting on cleaning up rural illegal and dilapidated buildings. Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun stressed targeted measures and long-term mechanisms to achieve effective results.

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆在玉溪家园公司调研国资国企运营情况
articles.title_en: Yang Zhengkun Surveys State-Owned Enterprise Operations at Yuxi Homeland Company
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，云南玉溪市委书记杨政昆到玉溪市家园建设投资有限公司调研国资国企运营，强调解放思想、改革创新，进一步深化国资国企改革。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Yang Zhengkun, Party Secretary of Yuxi City, Yunnan, visited Yuxi Homeland Construction Investment Co., Ltd. to survey SOE operations, urging reform and innovation to deepen state-owned enterprise reform.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江在湘阴县调研樟树港辣椒产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Investigates Zhangshugang Chili Pepper Industry in Xiangyin County
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江到湘阴县调研樟树港辣椒产业，要求实施《岳阳市樟树港辣椒保护条例》，做强做优产业。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of Hunan CPC Committee and Yueyang Municipal Party Secretary, visited Xiangyin County to study the Zhangshugang chili pepper industry, calling for implementation of local protection regulations to strengthen the sector.

articles.title_zh: 唐浩然调研县域经济高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Tang Haoran Surveys County Economy Development Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，岳阳市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然赴岳阳经开区调研县域经济高质量发展工作，强调抓产业、强实体、促倍增。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Tang Haoran, deputy secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, visited Yueyang Economic Development Zone to survey county-level economy high-quality development, emphasizing industry and real economy growth.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市委召开常委会会议学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究防灾减灾救灾和学习教育总结工作
articles.title_en: Yunfu Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Instructions on Disaster Prevention and Education Work
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，云浮市委常委会会议传达学习习近平关于西藏泥石流灾害和正确政绩观学习教育的重要指示精神，研究防灾减灾救灾与学习教育总结工作，卢荣春主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Yunfu Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions on disaster relief and education on political achievements, focusing on disaster prevention, relief and education summary.

articles.title_zh: 十五届市政府第九次全体（扩大）会议召开
articles.title_en: The 9th Plenary (Enlarged) Meeting of the 15th Municipal Government Convened
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，湛江市市长李勇毅主持召开市政府全体会议，分析1至7月经济运行情况，部署下一阶段重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Zhanjiang Mayor Li Yongyi chaired a plenary government meeting to analyze economic performance from January to July and arrange key tasks for the next stage.

articles.title_zh: 省领导带头参加2026年“慈心一日捐”活动
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Lead 2026 Compassionate One-Day Donation Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 山东省四套班子机关近日举行2026年“慈心一日捐”活动，省委书记林武、省长周乃翔、省政协主席葛慧君等领导带头捐款，干部职工踊跃参加。
articles.summary_en: Shandong's top party and government organs recently held the 2026 Compassionate One-Day Donation activity, with Party Secretary Lin Wu, Governor Zhou Naixiang, and CPPCC Chairman Ge Huijun leading donations.

articles.title_zh: 全省低碳减排专题工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Meeting on Low-Carbon and Emission Reduction Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日下午，全省低碳减排专题工作会议在济南召开，省委书记林武讲话，强调坚决打赢低碳减排硬仗，推动绿色低碳高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3 afternoon, the provincial meeting on low-carbon and emission reduction was held in Jinan. Party Secretary Lin Wu stressed efforts to win the battle and promote green, low-carbon, high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Zibo Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，山东省淄博市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在8月28日中央政治局会议上的重要讲话精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, the Standing Committee of the CPC Zibo Municipal Committee met to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the August 28 Politburo meeting.

articles.title_zh: 省政府第八次全体会议召开 周乃翔主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Holds Eighth Plenary Session, Zhou Naixiang Chairs and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，山东省政府第八次全体会议召开，省长周乃翔主持并讲话，部署下半年经济社会发展工作，强调抓好“十五五”规划落地、稳定经济运行、保障改善民生。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the eighth plenary session of the Shandong Provincial Government was held, chaired by Governor Zhou Naixiang, to plan economic and social development for the latter half of the year, stressing implementation of the 15th Five-Year Plan, stable economic performance, and improved people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 国务院安委会推进“伪新能源加注站”排查整治
articles.title_en: State Council Work Safety Committee Advances Crackdown on Fake "New Energy" Fuel Stations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院安委会办公室于9月3日召开视频调度推进会，部署深化“伪新能源加注站”排查整治，副部长胡明朗出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The Office of the State Council Work Safety Committee held a video conference on Sept 3 to intensify the campaign against fake "new energy" fuel stations, with Vice Minister Hu Minglang attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 新校区气味刺鼻，全班56名学生41人请假，官方通报
articles.title_en: Official Notice: Pungent Smell at New Campus Causes 41 of 56 Students to Take Leave
articles.summary_zh: 新校区气味刺鼻致全班56名学生中41人请假，官方已通报回应，具体情况有待调查。
articles.summary_en: A new campus was found to have a pungent smell, causing 41 out of 56 students in a class to take leave. Official notice has been issued.

articles.title_zh: 朱忠明任上海市副市长、代理市长
articles.title_en: Zhu Zhongming Appointed Vice Mayor and Acting Mayor of Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，上海市第十六届人大常委会第三十三次会议决定，接受龚正辞去上海市市长职务的请求，任命朱忠明为上海市副市长、代理市长。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the 33rd session of the Standing Committee of the 16th Shanghai Municipal People's Congress accepted Gong Zheng's resignation as Mayor and appointed Zhu Zhongming as Vice Mayor and Acting Mayor.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，深入学习贯彻中央政治局会议精神，研究部署防灾减灾、安全生产和社会稳定等工作。罗文主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting to study and implement the spirit of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting and arrange for disaster prevention, work safety, and social stability. Luo Wen presided and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 读懂“千里同好”之道
articles.title_en: Understanding the Way of "Friendship Across a Thousand Miles"
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日至2日，习近平主席对埃及进行国事访问，在署名文章中引用古语阐释中埃“千里同好”之道，同埃及总统塞西会谈并参观大埃及博物馆，双方发表联合声明并签署合作文件。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping visited Egypt on Sept 1-2, citing an ancient saying in a signed article, met President el-Sisi, and visited the Grand Egyptian Museum. Both sides issued a joint statement and signed documents.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同埃及总统塞西共同参观大埃及博物馆
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Egyptian President Sisi Visit Grand Egyptian Museum Together
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日下午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及国事访问期间，同埃及总统塞西夫妇共同参观大埃及博物馆，强调文明交流互鉴。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2 local time, during a state visit to Egypt, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, together with Egyptian President Sisi and his wife, visited the Grand Egyptian Museum, emphasizing mutual learning among civilizations.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市人大常委会将举行《青岛市民营经济促进条例（草案）》立法听证会
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress to Hold Legislative Hearing on Private Economy Promotion Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 青岛市人大常委会定于9月23日举行《青岛市民营经济促进条例（草案）》立法听证会，公开征求社会各界意见。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of Qingdao Municipal People's Congress will hold a legislative hearing on Sept 23 on the draft regulations to promote the private economy, soliciting public opinions.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal Party Committee Meeting Conveys Xi Jinping's Important Remarks and Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日下午，青岛市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在中央政治局会议上的重要讲话和对西藏泥石流灾害的重要指示精神，市委书记曾赞荣主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 4, the Standing Committee of the CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at a CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and his instructions on the mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Tibet. Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国国际消费电子博览会在青开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 China International Consumer Electronics Expo Opens in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，2026中国国际消费电子博览会在青岛国际会展中心开幕，全国人大常委会副委员长彭清华出席并宣布开幕。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the 2026 China International Consumer Electronics Expo opened at the Qingdao International Convention Center, with Peng Qinghua, Vice Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, attending and announcing the opening.

articles.title_zh: 省政协督办促进我省跨境电商高质量发展重点提案
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Supervises Key Proposal on High-Quality Cross-Border E-Commerce Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，江苏省政协组织督办跨境电商高质量发展重点提案，副主席方伟参加调研并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC organized supervision research on a key proposal for high-quality development of cross-border e-commerce, with Vice Chairman Fang Wei attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 多地推进整治婚介机构乱象，包括仅凭口头陈述建档、放任失信人员相亲等
articles.title_en: Multiple Regions Advance Crackdown on Marriage Agency Malpractices
articles.summary_zh: 云南大理、内蒙古临河等地民政部门推进婚介乱象整治，自9月1日起征集线索，重点针对关键信息审核流于形式、仅凭口头陈述建档等问题。
articles.summary_en: Civil affairs authorities in Dali, Yunnan and Linhe, Inner Mongolia have since Sept 1 launched campaigns to rectify marriage agency malpractices, targeting lax verification of key information and enrolling clients based only on verbal statements.

articles.title_zh: 从河南万岁山武侠城、陕西袁家村等考察归来，湖南吉首政协调研组开“药方”
articles.title_en: Hunan Jishou CPPCC Group Proposes Tourism Reforms After Study Tours in Henan and Shaanxi
articles.summary_zh: 吉首市政协赴河南、陕西考察现象级文旅项目后，近日在《湘西工作》刊发调研报告，指出当地文旅产业存在运营机制不灵活等问题并提出改革建议。
articles.summary_en: After studying top cultural tourism projects in Henan and Shaanxi, the Jishou CPPCC recently published a research report in Xiangxi Work, identifying problems in local tourism operations and proposing reforms.

articles.title_zh: 促进数字化绿色化协同转型发展，七部门联合印发实施方案
articles.title_en: Seven Ministries Jointly Issue Implementation Plan to Promote Coordinated Digital-Green Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办等七部门联合印发《促进数字化绿色化协同转型发展实施方案（2026-2030年）》，明确到2030年目标，部署4方面14项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and six other departments jointly issued the Implementation Plan for Promoting Coordinated Digital-Green Transformation (2026-2030), setting goals for 2030 and deploying 14 key tasks in four areas.

articles.title_zh: 中央广播电视总台《小喇叭》节目开播70周年座谈会在京举行
articles.title_en: Seminar Marks 70th Anniversary of CMG's 'Little Trumpet' Program in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 4日，中央广播电视总台《小喇叭》节目开播70周年座谈会在北京举行，李书磊宣读习近平总书记贺信并讲话。
articles.summary_en: A seminar marking the 70th anniversary of CMG's 'Little Trumpet' program was held in Beijing on Sept. 4. Li Shulei read Xi Jinping's congratulatory letter and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 产业向“新” 发展提质
articles.title_en: Industries Embrace Innovation for Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 安徽持续向新而行，推动传统产业升级和新兴、未来产业培育，在脑机接口、商业航天、量子科技等前沿赛道加速布局，2025年新增高新技术企业3200家。
articles.summary_en: Anhui keeps pursuing innovation-driven development, upgrading traditional industries and nurturing emerging and future industries. It accelerates in brain-computer interfaces, commercial spaceflight, and quantum technology, adding 3,200 high-tech enterprises in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 黄坤明孟凡利会见中国建设银行董事长张金良
articles.title_en: Huang Kunming and Meng Fanli Meet with China Construction Bank Chairman Zhang Jinliang
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，广东省委书记黄坤明、省长孟凡利在广州会见中国建设银行董事长张金良，双方就深化“十五五”时期政银合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, Guangdong Provincial Party Secretary Huang Kunming and Governor Meng Fanli met with China Construction Bank Chairman Zhang Jinliang in Guangzhou to discuss deepening government-bank cooperation during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国科普月八桂科普大行动百色活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Science Popularization Month & Bagui Science Action Launched in Baise
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日上午，2026年全国科普月八桂科普大行动百色启动仪式在百色市科技馆举行，百色市委副书记郑胜景出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Sep 2 morning, the 2026 National Science Month & Bagui Science Action kicked off at Baise Science & Technology Museum. Zheng Shengjing, Baise Deputy Party Secretary, attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 湖北利川：以硬核监督推动民生难题落地见效
articles.title_en: Lichuan, Hubei: Hardcore Supervision Promotes Resolution of People's Livelihood Problems
articles.summary_zh: 利川市纪委监委聚焦龙船调公园风雨桥失修问题，向市城管局下发督办函，推动整改并完成正式移交；今年以来以监督推动解决民生实事49件。
articles.summary_en: Lichuan's disciplinary inspection commission focused on the disrepair of the Fengyu Bridge in Longchuandiao Park, issued a supervision letter to the urban management bureau, and pushed for rectification and formal handover; this year it has helped resolve 49 livelihood issues.

articles.title_zh: “一亩田”，如何“种”出85%的增长？
articles.title_en: How Can "One Mu of Farmland" Deliver an 85% Increase?
articles.summary_zh: 截至2026年6月底，黑龙江省定制农业主体达445家，基地面积179.9万亩，签约销售额55.5亿元，同比增长85%。本文介绍该省通过“我在龙江有亩田”等模式推动农业增收。
articles.summary_en: As of June 2026, Heilongjiang's customized agriculture had 445 entities and 1.799m mu, with contracted sales of RMB 5.55b, up 85% YoY. The story highlights "I Have a Mu in Heilongjiang" models.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省委常委会召开会议 许勤主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要文章精神，研究贯彻意见，并部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and articles, and deploy related work.

articles.title_zh: 工信部印发通知开展人工智能应用服务商培育专项行动
articles.title_en: MIIT Issues Notice to Launch Special Campaign for Cultivating AI Application Service Providers
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部近日印发通知，开展人工智能应用服务商培育专项行动，部署建立服务商资源池、提升服务供给能力等四项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently issued a notice to launch a special campaign for cultivating AI application service providers, outlining four key tasks including building a service provider resource pool and improving service supply capabilities.

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 坚持办人民群众可感可及的体育
articles.title_en: Build Sports That People Can Feel and Benefit From
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，国务院新闻办举办发布会，国家体育总局局长高志丹介绍“十五五”体育强国建设目标，提出到2030年人均体育场地面积达4平方米左右，体育产业总规模超7万亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, China's top sports official Gao Zhidan pledged about 4 sqm of sports facilities per person and over 7-trillion-yuan sports industry by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 7部门联合推动商品消费扩容升级
articles.title_en: Seven Ministries Jointly Promote Expansion and Upgrading of Commodity Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 商务部等7部门近日印发《关于推动商品消费扩容升级的实施意见》，提出到2030年社会消费品零售总额达60万亿元左右，推动汽车、家电等商品消费扩容升级。
articles.summary_en: Seven departments, led by the Ministry of Commerce, recently issued implementation opinions to promote commodity consumption expansion and upgrading, targeting total retail sales of consumer goods of about 60 trillion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 江西部署开展大中小学同上一堂“长征大课”
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Deploys 'Long March Class' for All School Levels
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，江西部署开展2026年秋季学期开学第一课，全省大中小学生同上一堂“长征大课”，以长征历史故事和伟大精神引导学生。
articles.summary_en: Jiangxi launched a 'Long March Class' as the first lesson of the 2026 fall semester, where primary, middle and university students across the province learn about the Long March's history and spirit.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中在通辽市调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作并接待来访群众
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Inspects Grassroots Anti-Corruption Campaign in Tongliao and Receives Petitioners
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至3日，自治区党委书记、人大常委会主任王伟中深入通辽市调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，并接待来访群众。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 3, Wang Weizhong, Party chief and chairman of the regional people's congress, inspected Tongliao's campaign against misconduct and corruption at grassroots and met with petitioners.

articles.title_en: Ningxia's Zhongwei City Advances Demonstration Zone for Fostering a Strong Sense of Community for the Chinese Nation
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，宁夏中卫市召开民族团结进步创建工作新闻发布会，介绍铸牢中华民族共同体意识示范区建设及旅游促进各民族交往交流交融试点城市创建进展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Zhongwei City, Ningxia held a press conference on ethnic unity and progress, introducing progress on the demonstration zone for forging a strong sense of community for the Chinese nation and the pilot city for tourism promoting interethnic exchanges and integration.

articles.title_zh: 山东省政府第八次全体会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Holds Eighth Plenary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，山东省政府第八次全体会议召开，省委副书记、省长周乃翔主持并讲话，部署下半年经济社会发展工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Shandong Provincial Government held its eighth plenary meeting. Governor Zhou Naixiang presided and addressed the meeting, outlining work for economic and social development in the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 陕西印发2026年成人高校招生工作实施办法
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues Implementation Measures for 2026 Adult College Enrollment
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，陕西省教育考试院印发《2026年陕西省成人高校招生工作实施办法》，明确成人高考报名时间为9月14日至18日，全国统考于10月17、18日进行。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Shaanxi Provincial Education Examination Authority issued the Implementation Measures for 2026 Adult College Enrollment, specifying registration from September 14 to 18 and national exam on October 17-18.

articles.title_zh: 今年已发布新兴产业国家标准1400余项
articles.title_en: Over 1,400 National Standards for Emerging Industries Issued This Year
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局（国家标准委）9月3日透露，今年以来已发布国家标准2800余项，其中新兴产业国家标准1400余项，约占半数，涵盖信息技术、新材料、高端装备等领域，有力支撑新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation said on September 3 that over 1,400 of the 2,800-plus national standards issued this year target emerging industries, covering IT, new materials and high-end equipment, boosting new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 天津居民期望寿命达82.80岁 保持国内先进水平
articles.title_en: Tianjin Residents' Average Life Expectancy Reaches 82.80 Years, Maintaining Advanced Domestic Level
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，天津市卫生健康委发布2025年度居民健康状况报告，户籍居民期望寿命达82.80岁，保持国内先进水平。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Tianjin Municipal Health Commission released the 2025 Tianjin Resident Health Report, showing that the average life expectancy of registered residents reached 82.80 years, maintaining a leading level in China.

articles.title_zh: 上半年云南省规模以上服务业平稳增长
articles.title_en: Yunnan's Above-Scale Service Industry Sees Steady Growth in H1
articles.summary_zh: 云南省统计局数据显示，今年上半年全省规模以上服务业企业营业收入1837.99亿元，同比增长1.3%，数字经济、现代物流等重点行业增长较快。
articles.summary_en: According to Yunnan Provincial Bureau of Statistics, revenue of above-scale service enterprises in Yunnan reached 183.799 billion yuan in H1, up 1.3% year-on-year, with rapid growth in digital economy and modern logistics sectors.

articles.title_zh: 2026浙江省“质量月”活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Zhejiang 'Quality Month' Activities Kick Off
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，2026浙江省“质量月”活动启动仪式暨第九届长三角G60科创走廊质量标准大会在杭州举行，发布系列报告与倡议，聚焦质量技术基础与质量安全。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the launch ceremony of Zhejiang's 2026 'Quality Month' and the 9th Yangtze River Delta G60 Science and Innovation Corridor Quality Standards Conference were held in Hangzhou, releasing reports and initiatives on quality infrastructure and safety.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达开罗对埃及进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Cairo for State Visit to Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月1日，国家主席习近平抵达埃及开罗，对埃及进行国事访问。此访正值中埃建交70周年，两国元首在尼罗河畔擘画合作新蓝图。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, President Xi Jinping arrived in Cairo, Egypt, for a state visit at the invitation of President Sisi. The visit marks the 70th anniversary of China-Egypt diplomatic ties.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致中央广播电视总台《小喇叭》节目开播70周年的贺信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Letter on 70th Anniversary of CMG's 'Little Trumpet' Program
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，习近平致信祝贺中央广播电视总台《小喇叭》节目开播70周年，勉励少儿文艺工作者落实立德树人根本任务，创作更多优秀作品。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter on the 70th anniversary of the 'Little Trumpet' program of China Media Group, urging children's literary and art workers to fulfill the fundamental task of fostering virtue and create more excellent works.

articles.title_zh: 管党治党怎样从宽松软走向严紧硬
articles.title_en: How to Tighten Party Governance from Loose to Strict
articles.summary_zh: 本文阐述落实管党治党政治责任是全面从严治党的关键，强调健全责任体系、完善党内法规，推动管党治党从宽松软走向严紧硬。
articles.summary_en: This article explains that implementing political responsibility for party governance is key to strict governance, emphasizing the improvement of accountability systems and party regulations.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开第90次常务会议 陈新武主持
articles.title_en: Chen Xinwu Chairs 90th Executive Meeting of Chongqing Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，重庆市市长陈新武主持召开市政府第90次常务会议，研究民生保障、深化国资国企改革，审议重庆都市圈建设“十五五”实施方案等。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Chongqing Mayor Chen Xinwu chaired the 90th executive meeting, focusing on livelihood security, SOE reform, and reviewing the Chongqing metropolitan area's 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到省市场监管局调研
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Visits Provincial Market Regulation Administration for Research
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，河南省省长王凯到省市场监管局调研，强调强化质量意识、安全监管和服务理念，优化营商环境，助力高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Governor Wang Kai of Henan visited the Provincial Market Regulation Administration, calling for stronger quality awareness, safety regulation, and service concepts to optimize the business environment and drive high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国科普月河北主场活动在秦皇岛启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Science Popularization Month Hebei Main Event Launches in Qinhuangdao
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，2026年全国科普月河北主场活动在东北大学秦皇岛分校启动。活动由河北省科协与秦皇岛市委、市政府共同主办，为期一个月，覆盖全省。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, 2026, the Hebei main event of the 2026 National Science Popularization Month opened at Northeastern University at Qinhuangdao. Co-hosted by the Hebei Association for Science and Technology and the Qinhuangdao municipal government, it features month-long activities across the province.

articles.title_zh: 第二届“一带一路”民心相通论坛在南京举行
articles.title_en: Second Belt and Road People-to-People Connectivity Forum Held in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，第二届“一带一路”民心相通论坛在南京举行，全国政协副主席杨震出席并致辞，江苏省委书记信长星致辞。
articles.summary_en: The Second Belt and Road People-to-People Connectivity Forum was held in Nanjing on September 3, with CPPCC Vice Chairman Yang Zhen and Jiangsu Party Secretary Xin Changxing delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 省政府召开常务会议 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting Chaired by Liu Xiaotao
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，江苏省政府召开常务会议，省长刘小涛主持，听取“十五五”省级专项规划编制进展，审议科技创新、海洋经济等多项规划文件。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Jiangsu Provincial Government held an executive meeting chaired by Governor Liu Xiaotao to review progress on provincial 15th Five-Year special plans and deliberate multiple plans including sci-tech innovation and marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 新中国中医药高等教育70年：从守住根脉到走向世界
articles.title_en: 70 Years of TCM Higher Education in New China: From Preserving Roots to Going Global
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾新中国成立70年来中医药高等教育从院校初建到规模化发展历程，强调读经典、跟名师、重实践，并展望“十五五”时期人才培养改革。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews 70 years of TCM higher education in New China, from the founding of schools to large-scale development, emphasizing classical reading, mentorship, and practice, and looks ahead to talent training reforms in the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 全省低碳减排专题工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Special Work Conference on Low-Carbon Emission Reduction Held
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日下午，全省低碳减排专题工作会议在济南召开。省委书记林武出席并讲话，省长周乃翔主持，部署打赢低碳减排硬仗，推动绿色低碳高质量发展先行区建设。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, the province's low-carbon reduction work meeting was held in Jinan; Secretary Lin Wu spoke, stressing efforts to promote green low-carbon transition.

articles.title_zh: 携手推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合 为新疆经济社会高质量发展提供有力支撑
articles.title_en: Deepening Sci-Tech and Industrial Innovation Integration to Support Xinjiang's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，新疆维吾尔自治区与中国工程院在乌鲁木齐举行院士新疆行恳谈会，自治区党委书记陈小江、中国工程院院长张玉卓出席并讲话，强调深化科技创新与产业创新融合，助推新疆高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Xinjiang and Chinese Academy of Engineering held an academician symposium in Urumqi. Chen Xiaojiang and Zhang Yuzhuo called for deeper sci-tech and industrial innovation for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江主持召开自治区党委常委会会议 研究应急管理和防灾减灾等工作
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Party Committee Meeting Focuses on Emergency Management and Disaster Reduction
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，新疆自治区党委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻中央政治局会议精神，研究应急管理、防灾减灾、碳达峰碳中和及自然资源资产管理部署。自治区党委书记陈小江主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, the Standing Committee of the CPC Xinjiang Regional Committee met to study the Political Bureau's spirit, focusing on emergency management, disaster prevention, carbon goals, and natural resources asset management. Chen Xiaojiang presided.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国科普月云南省主场活动启动
articles.title_en: Yunnan Launches Main Event of 2026 National Science Popularization Month
articles.summary_zh: 9月4日，以“科技改变生活 创新赢得未来”为主题的2026年全国科普月云南省主场活动启动仪式在昭通市镇雄县举行。
articles.summary_en: On September 4, the 2026 National Science Popularization Month Yunnan main event kicked off in Zhenxiong County, Zhaotong, under the theme 'Technology Changes Life, Innovation Wins the Future'.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在杭州调研人工智能产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Inspects AI Industry Development in Hangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在杭州专题调研人工智能产业发展工作，强调加快促进创新链和产业链深度融合，推动人工智能相关产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor, visited Hangzhou to inspect AI industry development, urging faster integration of innovation and industrial chains for high-quality development of AI-related industries.

tags.name_en: Integration of Innovation and Industrial Chains

tags_en: Integration of Innovation and Industrial Chains

articles.title_zh: 王浩：稳扎稳打 久久为功 持续推动山区海岛县高质量发展
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Steady Progress in High-Quality Development of Mountain and Island Counties
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，浙江省委书记王浩在衢州调研，强调要稳扎稳打、久久为功，持续推动山区海岛县高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Wang Hao, Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee, inspected Quzhou, emphasizing steady and sustained high-quality development of mountainous and island counties.

articles.title_zh: 墨西哥外长贝拉斯科将访华 外交部介绍中方期待
articles.title_en: Mexican Foreign Minister Velasco to Visit China; MFA Outlines Expectations
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆宣布，应王毅外长邀请，墨西哥外长贝拉斯科将于9月6日至7日访华，中方期待深化中墨关系。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, MFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun announced that Mexican Foreign Minister Velasco will visit China from Sept 6-7 at the invitation of Foreign Minister Wang Yi, expecting to deepen bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国在委内瑞拉的合法权益必须得到保护
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China's Legitimate Rights in Venezuela Must Be Protected
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，中委合作受国际法和两国法律保护，中国在委内瑞拉的合法权益必须得到保护。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press conference that China-Venezuela cooperation is protected by international law and that China's legitimate rights in Venezuela must be protected.

articles.title_zh: 抢险救援第八天，深层次搜救如何进行？
articles.title_en: Rescue Day 8: How to Conduct Deep-Level Search and Rescue?
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，通往西藏吉隆口岸的G216国道救援通道打通，救援进入深层次搜救阶段；应急管理部与自然资源部专家分析搜救难点及地质灾害监测措施。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the rescue passage to Gyirong Port in Tibet was cleared, entering deep-level search and rescue. Experts from emergency management and natural resources departments discussed challenges and monitoring strategies.

articles.title_zh: 消防救援队伍在吉隆泥石流受灾区域纵深推进全域精细化搜寻
articles.title_en: Fire Rescue Teams Conduct Detailed Searches in Jilong Mudslide Area
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，国家综合性消防救援队伍在西藏吉隆泥石流受灾区域持续救援，打通G216国道核心受灾段通道，并分批次深入核心区开展精细化搜寻。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, national fire and rescue teams continued rescue operations in the mudslide-hit Jilong area, clearing the key section of G216 and conducting detailed searches in the core zone.

articles.title_zh: 学习新语｜人类和平与发展的崇高事业必将胜利
articles.title_en: The Noble Cause of Human Peace and Development Will Surely Triumph
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日抗战胜利纪念日之际，回顾习近平总书记关于伟大抗战精神的重要论述，号召在民族复兴新征程上砥砺奋进。
articles.summary_en: On the 81st anniversary of China's victory in the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression, President Xi Jinping's remarks on the great spirit of resistance are revisited, calling for renewed dedication to national rejuvenation and world peace.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！黄海部分海域将进行军事演练 禁止驶入
articles.title_en: Navigation Warning: Military Exercise to Be Held in Parts of Yellow Sea, Entry Prohibited
articles.summary_zh: 日照海事局9月3日发布航行警告：9月5日8时至8日8时，黄海部分海域将进行军事演练，禁止驶入。
articles.summary_en: Rizhao Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning on Sept. 3: A military exercise will be held in parts of the Yellow Sea from 8:00 Sept. 5 to 8:00 Sept. 8, 2026. Entry is prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 青海省国有资产投资管理有限公司原总经理姚洪仲被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Yao Hongzhong, Former General Manager of Qinghai State-owned Assets Investment Management Co., Ltd., Expelled from CPC
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，经青海省委批准，青海省纪委监委通报，对原总经理姚洪仲严重违纪违法问题立案审查，决定给予其开除党籍处分，并移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, the Qinghai Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced that Yao Hongzhong, former general manager, was expelled from the CPC for serious disciplinary violations and transferred to prosecutors for review and prosecution.

tags.name_en: Qinghai Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Qinghai Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 民政部：到年底前实现养老机构从业人员消防技能培训全覆盖
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs: Full Coverage of Fire Safety Training for Elderly Care Staff by Year End
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，民政部养老服务司副司长张军在北京表示，民政部会同国家消防救援局推进养老机构消防培训，年底前实现从业人员全覆盖。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 3, Zhang Jun, deputy director of the Ministry of Civil Affairs' elderly care department, said in Beijing that the ministry, with the National Fire and Rescue Administration, will provide full fire-safety training for elderly care staff by year-end.

tags.name_en: Fire Safety in Elderly Care Facilities

tags_en: Fire Safety in Elderly Care Facilities

articles.title_zh: 国际月球村中心（中国）及4个深空探测联合实验室在合肥揭牌
articles.title_en: International Lunar Village Center (China) and Four Joint Deep-Space Exploration Laboratories Inaugurated in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 2026年深空探测（天都）国际会议9月3日在合肥开幕，国际月球村中心（中国）及4个深空探测联合实验室在会上揭牌，将推动深空探测国际合作。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 Deep Space Exploration (Tiandu) International Conference held in Hefei on Sept. 3, the International Lunar Village Center (China) and four joint deep-space exploration laboratories were inaugurated to boost international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中国对尼泊尔第三批紧急援助物资今天上午已经启运
articles.title_en: China's Third Batch of Emergency Aid to Nepal Delivered, Foreign Ministry Says
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上表示，中国对尼泊尔第三批紧急援助物资当天上午已启运，包括帐篷、毛毯等。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said at a regular press conference that China's third batch of emergency aid to Nepal had been shipped that morning, including tents and blankets.

articles.title_zh: 中国化工装备有限公司原党委书记蔡挺接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Cai Ting, Former Party Secretary of China Chemical Equipment Co., Ltd., Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委驻中国中化控股纪检监察组与湖南省纪委监委通报，中国化工装备原党委书记、董事长、总经理蔡挺涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Cai Ting, former Party Secretary, Chairman and General Manager of China Chemical Equipment Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of Sinochem Holdings, is under disciplinary and supervisory investigation for alleged serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

tags_en: Hunan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

articles.title_zh: 西藏吉隆：全力打通灾害核心区道路电力通信“生命线”
articles.title_en: Gyirong, Xizang: Efforts to Restore Lifelines of Roads, Power and Communications in Disaster-Hit Core Area
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西藏吉隆口岸核心区域救援通道基本打通，应急管理部等部门正全力恢复电力通信，保障救援深入。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 2, rescue routes to the core area of Gyirong port in Xizang were basically opened, with authorities racing to restore power and communications after a mudslide.

articles.title_en: Zhongnanhai Monthly: August 2026
articles.summary_zh: 央视网月刊回顾习近平2026年8月重要活动：出席纪念江泽民诞辰100周年大会、主持召开政治局会议部署救灾、出访吉尔吉斯斯坦并出席上合峰会等。
articles.summary_en: CCTV's monthly review covers Xi Jinping's key activities in August 2026, including attending the centenary of Jiang Zemin, chairing a Politburo meeting on disaster relief, and visiting Kyrgyzstan for the SCO summit.

articles.title_zh: 中埃两国元首夫妇共同参观的大埃及博物馆，是一座什么馆？
articles.title_en: What Kind of Museum Is the Grand Egyptian Museum, Jointly Visited by the Two Countries' Heads of State and Their Spouses?
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日下午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及总统塞西和夫人陪同下参观大埃及博物馆。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2 local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, accompanied by Egyptian President Sisi and his wife, visited the Grand Egyptian Museum.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：坚决遏制日本“新型军国主义”祸乱地区危害世界
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Resolutely Curb Japan's 'New-Style Militarism' Harming the Region and the World
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上回应日本防卫白皮书及创纪录防卫预算，表示坚决遏制日本“新型军国主义”祸乱地区、危害世界。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Foreign Ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun responded to Japan's defense white paper and record-high military budget at a regular press conference, vowing to curb Japan's 'new-style militarism' from destabilizing the region and the world.

articles.title_zh: 上海发布加快国际贸易中心建设“十五五”规划 提出22项重点任务
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating International Trade Center Construction, Outlining 22 Key Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，上海市政府新闻办举行发布会，发布《上海市加快国际贸易中心建设“十五五”规划》，提出22项重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Shanghai municipal government held a press conference to release the 15th Five-Year Plan for accelerating international trade center construction, outlining 22 key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 2026年暑运两岸“小三通”运送旅客近44万人次
articles.title_en: Nearly 440,000 Passengers Traveled via Cross-Strait Mini-Three-Links During 2026 Summer
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日至8月31日暑运期间，福建口岸查验闽台往来旅客约57万人次，其中约43.8万人次经两岸“小三通”客运航线往来，同比增长超两成。
articles.summary_en: During 2026 summer travel (Jul 1-Aug 31), Fujian ports recorded about 570,000 cross-strait passengers; some 438,000 used mini-three-links routes, up over 20% YoY.

articles.title_zh: 王毅谈习近平出席上合组织峰会并访问吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Briefs on Xi Jinping's SCO Summit Attendance and Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅向媒体介绍习近平主席出席上合组织比什凯克峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问相关情况，强调弘扬‘上海精神’，推动全球治理改革。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 3, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, briefed on Xi Jinping's attendance at the SCO Bishkek Summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt, calling for upholding the Shanghai Spirit and improving global governance.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同埃及总统塞西会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Egyptian President Sisi
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日，国家主席习近平在开罗同埃及总统塞西举行会谈，就中埃关系及中东局势等交换意见，并见证多项合作文件签署。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Xi Jinping held talks with Egypt's President Sisi in Cairo on bilateral ties and the Middle East, witnessing cooperation deals.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委、交通运输部联合印发《物流网建设实施方案》
articles.title_en: NDRC and MOT Jointly Issue Implementation Plan for Logistics Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、交通运输部近日联合印发《物流网建设实施方案》，提出到2030年物流网建设取得明显成效，推动社会物流总费用与GDP比率降至13.1%，促进物流基础设施成链成网。
articles.summary_en: NDRC and MOT jointly issued the Implementation Plan for Logistics Network Construction, aiming to upgrade logistics infrastructure into integrated networks and cut social logistics costs to 13.1% of GDP by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺挪威国王哈康八世即位
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Congratulates Norway's King Haakon VIII on His Accession to Throne
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，国家主席习近平致电挪威新任国王哈康八世，对其即位表示祝贺，表示愿同其一道努力，书写中挪友好交往新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Norway's new King Haakon VIII on his accession, expressing readiness to write a new chapter of China-Norway friendship.

articles.title_zh: 山西省人大常委会原党组成员、副主任岳普煜严重违纪违法被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Yue Puyu, Former Deputy Director of Shanxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, Expelled from CPC for Serious Disciplinary Violations
articles.summary_zh: 经中共中央批准，中央纪委国家监委对山西省人大常委会原副主任岳普煜严重违纪违法问题立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍处分，涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关依法审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: Upon CPC Central Committee approval, the CCDI and National Commission of Supervision investigated Yue Puyu, former deputy director of Shanxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, for serious disciplinary violations and corruption. He was expelled from the CPC and his case transferred to procuratorates for prosecution.

tags.name_en: CCDI and National Commission of Supervision

tags_en: CCDI and National Commission of Supervision

articles.title_zh: 三部门发布《汽车行业境外竞争行为与合规建设指引》
articles.title_en: Three Ministries Issue Guidelines on Overseas Competition and Compliance for Auto Industry
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，商务部、工业和信息化部、市场监管总局联合发布《汽车行业境外竞争行为与合规建设指引》，旨在规范汽车企业境外竞争行为，加强合规建设，促进产业链国际合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, 2026, the Ministry of Commerce, MIIT, and SAMR jointly issued the Guidelines on Overseas Competition and Compliance for the Auto Industry to regulate overseas competition and enhance compliance.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办深入整治AI应用乱象
articles.title_en: Central Cyberspace Administration Intensifies Crackdown on AI Application Chaos
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办近期组织开展“清朗·整治AI应用乱象”专项行动第二阶段工作，截至9月2日累计清理违法违规信息561万余条，查处账号4.9万余个。
articles.summary_en: The Central Cyberspace Administration launched the second phase of its campaign against AI application malpractices, clearing over 5.61 million pieces of illegal information and handling 49,000 accounts as of September 2.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥会见俄罗斯总统普京
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Meets with Russian President Putin
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日晚，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在符拉迪沃斯托克会见俄罗斯总统普京，双方就深化中俄关系与务实合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of September 2 local time, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, met with Russian President Putin in Vladivostok to exchange views on deepening bilateral ties and practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会修订通过国防动员法 习近平签署主席令公布
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Revises National Defense Mobilization Law; Xi Jinping Signs Presidential Order
articles.summary_zh: 第十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议于2026年8月28日修订通过《中华人民共和国国防动员法》，国家主席习近平签署主席令予以公布，自2026年10月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee passed the revised National Defense Mobilization Law on August 28, 2026. President Xi Jinping signed a presidential order to promulgate it, effective October 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛同埃及总统塞西夫妇共同参观大埃及博物馆
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Visit Grand Egyptian Museum with Egyptian President and First Lady
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间9月2日下午，国家主席习近平和夫人彭丽媛在埃及总统塞西和夫人陪同下参观大埃及博物馆，强调文明交流互鉴。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 2, local time, President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan, accompanied by Egyptian President El-Sisi and his wife, visited the Grand Egyptian Museum, underscoring exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations.

articles.title_zh: 2026年《开学第一课》播出：赓续伟大精神 走好我们的长征路
articles.title_en: 2026 'First Lesson at School' Aired: Carry Forward the Great Spirit and Walk Our Long March
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，由中央宣传部、教育部、中央广播电视总台联合主办的2026年《开学第一课》播出，以“我们的长征路”为主题，讲述红军长征故事，引导青少年树立正确历史观。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, the 2026 'First Lesson at School' program, co-hosted by the Central Propaganda Department, the Ministry of Education, and China Media Group, aired under the theme 'Our Long March', telling stories of the Red Army to guide youth in forming a correct view of history.

articles.title_zh: 王宁在昭通市调研时强调 加快发展壮大资源经济园区经济 毫不放松抓好群众持续增收
articles.title_en: Wang Ning Emphasizes Resource Economy, Industrial Parks, and Income Growth During Zhaotong Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至3日，云南省委书记王宁在昭通市调研，走访光伏企业、苹果庄园和花椒基地，强调加快发展资源经济和园区经济，持续促进群众增收。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Party Secretary Wang Ning inspected Zhaotong on Sept 2-3, calling for a stronger resource- and industrial-park economy and sustained rural income growth.

articles.title_zh: 王予波在文山州调研时强调 全力以赴稳增长稳产业稳企业稳投资
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Inspects Wenshan Prefecture, Stresses Efforts to Stabilize Growth, Industry, Enterprises and Investment
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日至3日，云南省委副书记、省长王予波在文山州调研，强调全力稳增长、稳产业、稳企业、稳投资，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 2 to 3, Wang Yubo, Deputy Secretary of Yunnan Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected Wenshan Prefecture, stressing efforts to stabilize growth, industry, enterprises and investment for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省领导到辽宁考察对接对口合作工作
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Leaders Visit Liaoning for Counterpart Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月31日至9月2日，江苏省委常委、常务副省长马欣率队赴辽宁考察，与辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟会见，深化对接对口合作。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 31 to Sep 2, Ma Xin, Executive Vice Governor of Jiangsu, led a delegation to Liaoning and met with Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei to deepen inter-provincial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见江苏省代表团一行
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Jiangsu Provincial Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见江苏省委常委、常务副省长马欣率领的江苏省代表团一行，就深化辽苏对口合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, and Governor Wang Xinwei met in Shenyang with a Jiangsu delegation led by Ma Xin, Executive Vice Governor of Jiangsu, to discuss deepening Liaoning-Jiangsu counterpart cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省推进招商引资工作视频会议召开 王新伟出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Holds Provincial Video Conference on Investment Promotion; Governor Wang Xinwei Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，辽宁省推进招商引资工作视频会议在沈阳召开，省委副书记、省长王新伟出席并讲话，强调着力提高招商引资实效性，以高质量项目支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Liaoning held a provincial video conference on investment promotion in Shenyang. Governor Wang Xinwei attended and spoke, emphasizing the need to improve the effectiveness of investment attraction and support high-quality development with high-quality projects.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚在皇姑区调研重大项目建设时强调 着力谋项目招项目推项目 为高质量发展注入新动力
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Visits Huanggu District to Inspect Major Projects, Stressing Vigorous Planning, Attraction and Promotion of Projects to Boost High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，沈阳市委书记霍步刚在皇姑区调研重大项目建设，强调要贯彻习近平总书记对辽宁、沈阳的指示精神，着力谋划、招引、推动项目，为高质量发展注入新动力。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Huo Bugang, Party Secretary of Shenyang, inspected major project construction in Huanggu District, stressing the need to plan, attract and promote projects to inject new momentum into high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组召开2026年第10次（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Chifeng Municipal Government Party Group Holds 10th (Enlarged) Meeting in 2026
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，赤峰市市长栾天猛主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记对西藏泥石流灾害的重要指示和李强总理批示精神，部署防灾减灾及基层减负工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Chifeng Mayor Luan Tianmeng chaired the municipal government party group meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's instructions on Tibet mudslide and Li Qiang's directives, and deploying disaster prevention and bureaucracy reduction.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委党建工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Tang Yi Chairs Municipal Party Committee Meetings on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，赤峰市委书记唐毅主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨市委党建工作领导小组会议，传达习近平总书记重要指示精神，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育情况，部署贯彻落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Tang Yi, Chifeng's party secretary, chaired an enlarged municipal party committee meeting and party building group meeting to convey Xi's directives and review political-achievement education.

articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to King Haakon VIII of Norway on His Accession
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，国家主席习近平致电祝贺挪威新任国王哈康八世即位，表示愿同其一道努力，书写中挪友好新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Norway's new King Haakon VIII on his accession, expressing willingness to write a new chapter in China-Norway friendship.

articles.title_zh: 促进中小企业发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan for Promoting SME Development Released
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等10部门印发《促进中小企业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年中小企业研发投入年均增长8%以上、专精特新“小巨人”企业达2.2万家等目标。
articles.summary_en: MIIT and nine other departments issued a plan to boost SME development in the 15th Five-Year Plan period, targeting over 8% annual R&D growth and 22,000 'little giant' firms by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席总结中埃关系70年鲜明特征
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Summarizes Distinctive Features of 70 Years of China-Egypt Relations
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，国家主席习近平在开罗同埃及总统塞西会谈，总结中埃关系70年鲜明特征，双方发表联合声明并签署20余份合作文件。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, President Xi Jinping held talks with Egyptian President Sisi in Cairo, summarizing the distinctive features of 70 years of China-Egypt relations, issuing a joint statement and signing over 20 cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席的“比什凯克时间”：主动引领历史航向的大国担当
articles.title_en: President Xi's 'Bishkek Time': A Major Power's Responsibility to Steer History
articles.summary_zh: 8月30日至9月1日，习近平主席出席上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦进行国事访问，分别与吉、乌总统会谈，签署多项合作文件，强调共同发展。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 30 to Sep 1, President Xi Jinping attended the SCO summit and paid a state visit to Kyrgyzstan, holding talks with leaders and signing cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 59项强制性国家标准9月起实施
articles.title_en: 59 Mandatory National Standards Take Effect from September
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局披露，9月1日起59项强制性国家标准和375项推荐性国家标准实施，涉及家电健康节能、劳动护肤剂、城轨适老化等。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation announced that from Sept 1, 59 mandatory and 375 recommended national standards took effect, covering home appliance health, energy conservation, skin protectants, and aging-friendly urban rail.

articles.title_zh: 锚定体育强国建设 推动体育高质量发展
articles.title_en: Anchoring Sports Powerhouse Construction and Promoting High-Quality Sports Development
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，国家体育总局介绍“十五五”时期体育强国建设情况，将完善全民健身公共服务体系、改革竞技体育管理体制、推动体育产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: At a press conference on Sept. 3, the General Administration of Sport outlined plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period to build a sporting powerhouse, including improving public fitness services, reforming competitive sports management, and boosting the sports industry.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局部署新型电网建设重大任务
articles.title_en: National Energy Administration Deploys Major Tasks for New-Type Power Grid Construction
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家能源局召开新型电网建设工作部署会，部署“十五五”时期新型电网建设任务，强调夯实基础设施、创新引领、多元支撑和安全运行。
articles.summary_en: The National Energy Administration held a meeting to deploy major tasks for new-type power grid construction during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, focusing on infrastructure, innovation, support, and safety.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在内蒙古调研时强调 切实抓好农业防灾减灾 全力夺取秋粮丰产丰收
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Stresses Agricultural Disaster Prevention and Autumn Grain Harvest During Inner Mongolia Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中9月1日至3日在内蒙古调研，要求切实抓好农业防灾减灾，全力夺取秋粮丰产丰收。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong inspected Inner Mongolia from Sept 1 to 3, urging effective disaster prevention and reduction in agriculture to ensure a bumper autumn grain harvest.

articles.title_zh: 习近平结束出席2026年上海合作组织峰会和对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问回到北京
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Returns to Beijing After Attending 2026 SCO Summit and State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日上午，国家主席习近平圆满结束出席2026年上海合作组织峰会和对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及的国事访问，回到北京。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of September 3, President Xi Jinping returned to Beijing after successfully attending the 2026 SCO Summit and state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt.

articles.title_zh: 张丹到市数据和政务服务局调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Inspects Municipal Data and Government Services Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹到市数据和政务服务局调研，强调用好12345热线平台，提升政务服务质效，优化营商环境。

Governor Wang Xinwei attended and delivered a speech, stressing the need to improve investment promotion effectiveness and support high-quality development with high-quality projects.

articles.title_zh: 张海波到高区调研新一代信息技术产业链发展情况
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Inspects New-Generation IT Industry Chain in High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 9月3日，威海市委书记张海波到高区调研新一代信息技术产业链，强调实施工业经济“头号工程”，强化科技创新和数字赋能。
articles.summary_en: On September 3, Zhang Haibo, Secretary of the Weihai Municipal Party Committee, visited the high-tech zone to inspect the new-generation information technology industry chain, emphasizing science and technology innovation and digital empowerment.
keywords: 新一代信息技术产业链

tags_zh: 新一代信息技术产业链

articles.title_zh: 张海波会见新西兰客人
articles.title_en: Zhang Haibo Meets New Zealand Guests
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，威海市委书记张海波会见新西兰驻华大使乔文博一行，双方就深化经贸、教育、人文等领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Zhang Haibo, Party Secretary of Weihai, met with New Zealand Ambassador to China and his delegation to discuss deepening cooperation in trade, education and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 全市安全稳定专题会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Meeting on Safety and Stability Held in Weihai
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，威海市召开全市安全稳定专题会议，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，市长孔凡萍主持，部署下步重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Weihai held a municipal meeting on safety and stability. Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and spoke, while Mayor Kong Fanping presided over the meeting to arrange key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 陈东赴高新区（弋江区）开展调研
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Conducts Investigation in High-tech Zone (Yijiang District)
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东赴高新区（弋江区）调研产业园区和重点企业，了解半导体、新能源汽车等产业发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Chen Dong, deputy secretary of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee and acting mayor, visited the High-tech Zone to inspect industrial parks and key enterprises, focusing on semiconductors and NEVs.

articles.title_zh: 陈东赴鸠江区开展调研
articles.title_en: Chen Dong Conducts Research in Jiujiang District
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，芜湖市委副书记、代市长陈东赴鸠江区调研科创平台建设和重点企业发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Chen Dong, Deputy Secretary of the Wuhu Municipal Party Committee and Acting Mayor, visited Jiujiang District to inspect sci-tech innovation platforms and key enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Wuxi Party Secretary Inspects Rectification of Misconduct and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，无锡市委书记杜小刚调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，强调强化食品安全和农产品质量安全监管，维护群众“舌尖上的安全”。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Wuxi Party Secretary Du Xiaogang inspected the rectification of misconduct and corruption affecting the people, stressing stronger food safety and agricultural product quality supervision.
keywords: 群众身边腐败问题整治

tags.name_en: Rectification of corruption around the people

articles.title_zh: AI+全域康养产业融合发展试验区启动
articles.title_en: AI + Integrated Health and Wellness Industry Pilot Zone Launches
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，AI+全域康养产业融合发展试验区启动仪式在无锡举行。该项目由无锡市医疗健康集团与新吴区江溪街道联合打造，规划床位180张，将构建机构、社区、居家三位一体的医养服务体系。
articles.summary_en: The launch ceremony of the AI + integrated health and wellness industry pilot zone was held in Wuxi on Sept 1. Jointly built by Wuxi Medical Health Group and Jiangxi Subdistrict, it plans 180 beds.

tags.name_en: Integration of Medical Care and Eldercare

tags_en: Integration of Medical Care and Eldercare

articles.title_zh: 西安市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开 强调巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Standing Committee Meeting Emphasizes Consolidating Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西安市委常委会会议暨市委党的建设工作领导小组会议召开，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成效，部署巩固拓展工作。省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Standing Committee Meeting of the Xi'an Municipal CPC Committee and the Meeting of the Municipal Party Building Leading Group were held to summarize the education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements and to plan further consolidation. Hao Huijie, member of the Provincial Standing Committee and Secretary of the Municipal CPC Committee, presided over and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神研究安排防汛减灾和联动巡视整改等工作
articles.title_en: Xi'an Municipal Party Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Instructions and Arrange Flood Control and Inspection Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，西安市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害的重要指示精神和中央政治局会议精神，听取“保回迁”问题整改进展汇报，市委书记蒿慧杰主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, the CPC Xi'an Municipal Standing Committee met to convey and study Xi Jinping's instructions on the Tibet mudslide and the Political Bureau meeting spirit, and heard rectification progress on 'Baohuiqian' resettlement. Hao Huijie, municipal party secretary, presided.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰会见中兴通讯董事长方榕一行
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Meets ZTE Chairman Fang Rong and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰会见中兴通讯董事长方榕一行，双方就加强战略合作、促进数字经济和人工智能融合发展等进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, met with Fang Rong, Chairman of ZTE, and her delegation to discuss enhancing strategic cooperation and promoting integrated development of digital economy and AI.

articles.title_zh: 高新区召开铁路沿线安全环境治理联席会议暨“双段长”培训会议
articles.title_en: High-Tech Zone Holds Joint Meeting on Railway Safety Governance and 'Dual Section Chief' Training
articles.summary_zh: 近日，高新区党工委委员、管委会副主任薛伟洲主持召开铁路沿线安全环境治理联席会议暨“双段长”培训会，部署综合治理工作，通报典型事故案例。
articles.summary_en: Xue Weizhou, deputy director of the High-tech Zone, chaired a joint meeting on railway safety governance and 'dual section chief' training to deploy safety rectification and cited typical accidents.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平督办市政协重点提案
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Supervises Key Proposals of Municipal CPPCC
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，盐城市委书记严汉平督办市政协重点提案，强调加快人工智能发展，市政协主席羊维达主持。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Yan Hanping, Yancheng Municipal Party Secretary, supervised key proposals of the Municipal CPPCC, stressing faster AI development; CPPCC Chairman Yang Weida hosted the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 全市市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Yancheng Holds Work Meeting on Three-Level People's Congress Election
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，盐城市召开市县乡三级人大换届选举工作会议。市委书记严汉平出席并讲话，市人大常委会主任王荣部署整体工作。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Yancheng held a meeting to arrange elections for municipal, county and township people's congresses. Party Secretary Yan Hanping spoke, and Wang Rong, director of the Standing Committee, explained the plan.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会开展文旅融合发展情况专题调研
articles.title_en: Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress Conducts Special Research on Cultural and Tourism Integration
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日至2日，阳江市人大常委会调研组赴阳春、阳西等地，通过实地察看了解文旅融合发展情况，强调挖掘本土文化资源，赋能乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: From Sept 1 to 2, a research group of the Yangjiang Municipal People's Congress visited Yangchun and Yangxi to inspect cultural and tourism integration, stressing local cultural resources to boost rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 市委党校（市行政学院）举行2026年秋季学期开学典礼
articles.title_en: Party School of Yangjiang Municipal Committee Holds Autumn Semester Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，阳江市委党校举行秋季学期开学典礼，市委书记卢一先出席并作专题辅导，强调年轻干部树立正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Party School of Yangjiang Municipal Committee held its autumn semester opening ceremony; Party Secretary Lu Yixian attended and delivered a special lecture on the correct view of political achievements for young cadres.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到阳西县调研
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Visits Yangxi County for Research
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，阳江市委副书记、市长余金富到阳西县调研农文旅融合发展、片区组团培育和专项整治情况，强调要推动城乡融合、区域协同再上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, Yu Jinfu, Deputy Secretary of the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, visited Yangxi County to research agricultural-cultural-tourism integration, cluster cultivation, and special rectification, stressing urban-rural and regional coordination.

articles.title_zh: 银川市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议 赵旭辉强调以正确政绩观引领人大工作
articles.title_en: Yinchuan People's Congress Party Leadership Group Meeting Stresses Correct Political Achievement Outlook
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，银川市人大常委会党组召开（扩大）会议，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话，强调以正确政绩观引领人大工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the Party Leadership Group of the Yinchuan Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held an enlarged meeting. Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Ningxia Regional Committee and Yinchuan Municipal Party Secretary, presided over and stressed high-quality development of people's congress work guided by a correct outlook on political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 银川市金凤区人大代表选举举行 赵旭辉等市领导参加投票
articles.title_en: Voting Held for People's Congress Election in Yinchuan's Jinfeng District; Municipal Leaders Cast Ballots
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，银川市金凤区第六届人民代表大会代表选举第二十五选区选举大会举行，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉等市领导参加投票。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, 2026, the election meeting for the 25th electoral district of the 6th Jinfeng District People's Congress was held in Yinchuan. Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Autonomous Region Committee and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, and other municipal leaders voted.

articles.title_zh: 玉溪市与五矿新能举行座谈
articles.title_en: Yuxi City Holds Talks with Minmetals New Energy
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，玉溪市委书记杨政昆、市长胡江辉与五矿新能董事长胡柳泉座谈，双方就新能源全产业链发展、深化互利合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Yuxi Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun and Mayor Hu Jianghui met with Minmetals New Energy's Chairman Hu Liuquan to discuss cooperation on the new energy industry chain.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开第46次党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds 46th Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，岳阳市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然主持召开市政府第46次党组（扩大）会议，学习贯彻中央有关精神，专题调度群众身边腐败问题整治工作。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 2, Acting Mayor Tang Haoran chaired the municipal government's 46th Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting to study central directives and coordinate a special campaign against corruption.

articles.title_zh: 全市消防安全专项整治行动推进会议召开
articles.title_en: Meeting Held to Advance City-wide Fire Safety Special Rectification Action
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，岳阳市召开消防安全专项整治行动推进会议，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江出席，市委副书记、代理市长唐浩然讲话，强调压实责任、保障安全。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Yueyang held a meeting on advancing the city-wide fire safety rectification. Xie Weijiang, deputy provincial party secretary and Yueyang party secretary, attended; acting mayor Tang Haoran delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春赴新兴县调研督导“百千万工程”及秋季开学等工作
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Inspects Xinxing County on 'Baiqianwan Project' and School Opening
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，云浮市委书记卢荣春赴新兴县调研督导“百千万工程”及秋季开学等工作，强调办好人民满意的教育，推动城乡区域协调发展。
articles.summary_en: On Sept. 1, Lu Rongchun, Secretary of the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee, visited Xinxing County to supervise the "Baiqianwan Project" and school opening, urging quality education and coordinated urban-rural development.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春到市信访局接访群众
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Meets Petitioners at Yunfu Municipal Petition Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日上午，云浮市委书记卢荣春到市信访局接访群众，现场协调解决村内桥梁被毁、涵洞排水不畅等问题，强调用心用情为民解忧。
articles.summary_en: On Sept 2, Lu Rongchun, Yunfu Party chief, met petitioners at the city petition bureau, addressing bridge and drainage issues and urging earnest service to the people.

articles.title_zh: 张洋率队调研督导国有资产资源使用管理突出问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Yang Leads Inspection on State-owned Asset Management Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日下午，遂溪县委书记张洋率队调研督导国有资产资源使用管理突出问题集中整治工作，强调摸清资产底数、盘活闲置资源。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of September 1, Zhang Yang, Party secretary of Suixi County, led a team to inspect the rectification of prominent issues in state-owned asset management, emphasizing the need to inventory assets and revitalize idle resources.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市十五届人大常委会召开第五十次会议
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 50th Session
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，湛江市十五届人大常委会召开第五十次会议，审议电动自行车管理条例、2025年决算及2026年上半年预算执行等报告，任命黄映霄为市检察院副检察长。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, the 15th Zhanjiang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 50th session to review reports on e-bike regulations, 2025 final accounts, and 2026 H1 budget execution, and appointed Huang Yingxiao as deputy prosecutor general.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Enlarged Meeting of Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示批示精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Yu Gang, Secretary of the Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to study implementation measures.

articles.title_en: Mayor Wu Zetong Inspects Rural Development in Doumen
articles.summary_zh: 近日，珠海市长吴泽桐赴斗门区调研督导“百县千镇万村高质量发展工程”，强调推进城乡区域协调、整治农村集体“三资”管理、发展壮大农村集体经济。
articles.summary_en: Zhuhai Mayor Wu Zetong recently visited Doumen District to supervise the 'Hundreds, Thousands, Tens of Thousands' High-Quality Development Project, calling for coordinated urban-rural growth and sound management of rural collective assets.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇主持召开市委常委会会议和省委横琴工委会议
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Chairs Meetings of Municipal Party Committee and Hengqin Working Committee
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，珠海市委书记陈勇主持召开市委常委会会议和省委横琴工委会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，研究政绩观教育、灾害防范等事项。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Chen Yong, Secretary of Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee, chaired meetings of the Municipal Party Committee and the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee Hengqin Working Committee to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, discussing education on correct views on achievements, disaster prevention, and other matters.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇主持召开2026年珠海市党外人士暑期座谈会
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Chairs 2026 Zhuhai Non-Party Personages Summer Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，珠海市委书记陈勇主持召开党外人士暑期座谈会，强调勠力同心推动“十五五”开好局起好步。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, Zhuhai Party Secretary Chen Yong chaired a summer symposium with non-party personages, urging unity to ensure a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想理论研讨会在泰安召开
articles.title_en: Seminar on Deeply Studying and Implementing Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building Held in Tai'an
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想理论研讨会在泰安召开，求是杂志社社长陈扬勇、山东省副省长温暖分别致辞。
articles.summary_en: On September 2, a seminar on thoroughly studying and implementing Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building was held in Tai'an. Chen Yangyong, President of Qiushi Magazine, and Wen Nuan, Vice Governor of Shandong Province, delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 亚太民间社会会议在济南开幕
articles.title_en: Asia-Pacific Civil Society Conference Opens in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 9月2日，由中国民间组织国际交流促进会和山东省人民政府共同主办的亚太民间社会会议在济南开幕，全国人大常委会副委员长肖捷出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The Asia-Pacific Civil Society Conference, co-hosted by China NGO Network for International Exchanges and Shandong Provincial People's Government, opened in Jinan on September 2, with NPC Standing Committee Vice Chairperson Xiao Jie attending and addressing.

articles.title_zh: 中国海警位中国台湾岛以东海域依法开展常态化执法巡查
articles.title_en: China Coast Guard Conducts Routine Patrols East of Taiwan Island
articles.summary_zh: 中国海警在中国台湾岛以东海域依法开展常态化执法巡查，维护国家主权和海洋权益。
articles.summary_en: China Coast Guard conducts routine law enforcement patrols in waters east of China's Taiwan Island to safeguard national sovereignty and maritime rights.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席为践行全球治理倡议凝心聚力
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Unites Efforts for Global Governance Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 9月1日，习近平主席出席2026年上海合作组织峰会，呼吁各方携手践行全球治理倡议，中方支持上合组织开展示范性合作。
articles.summary_en: On September 1, President Xi Jinping attended the 2026 SCO Summit, urging joint implementation of the Global Governance Initiative and supporting SCO demonstration cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 明年立什么法？监督什么？省人大常委会邀你提建议
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial People's Congress Asks Public for 2027 Legislative and Oversight Proposals
articles.summary_zh: 福建省人大常委会办公厅自9月2日至30日公开征集2027年度立法工作计划建议和监督议题建议，单位和个人可通过邮箱或邮寄提交。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's provincial legislature is soliciting proposals for its 2027 legislative plan and supervisory topics from Sept. 2 to Sept. 30 via email or mail.
