articles.title_zh: 城市C位留给国士：河南江西湖北多地跟进在户外大屏滚动播放科学家海报
articles.title_en: City Centers Honor National Heroes: Henan, Jiangxi, Hubei Follow Up with Scientist Posters on Outdoor Screens
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河南郑州、江西南昌、湖北襄阳等地跟进在户外大屏播放科学家海报，将‘城市C位’留给钱学森、袁隆平、邓稼先等功勋科学家。
articles.summary_en: Recently, cities including Zhengzhou, Nanchang, and Xiangyang followed suit by displaying scientist posters on outdoor screens, honoring national heroes like Qian Xuesen, Yuan Longping, and Deng Jiaxian.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武在武隆区彭水县调研并召开现场会
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Visit Wulong and Pengshui, Hold On-Site Meeting on Grassroots Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日至25日，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武赴武隆区、彭水县调研，并召开全市群防群治提升基层除险固安实战能力百日攻坚行动现场会。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 24 to 25, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu visited Wulong and Pengshui, and held an on-site meeting on grassroots safety and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 南宁出台快递用工指引及劳动合同范本
articles.title_en: Nanning Issues Employment Guidelines and Labor Contract Template for Express Delivery Industry
articles.summary_zh: 南宁市邮政管理局、市总工会、市人社局日前联合印发快递行业劳动用工管理指引及劳动合同示范文本，围绕劳动报酬、休息休假等6方面规范用工，保障从业人员权益。
articles.summary_en: Nanning's Postal Administration, Federation of Trade Unions, and Human Resources Bureau jointly issued employment guidelines and a labor contract template for the express delivery industry, covering six aspects including wages and rest leaves to protect workers' rights.

articles.title_zh: 巩固拓展学习教育成果 以正确政绩观推动支点建设取得新突破
articles.title_en: Hubei Provincial Party Committee Consolidates Learning Education Results for New Breakthroughs in Pivot Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日下午，湖北省委常委会（扩大）会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署巩固拓展成果、建立长效机制。中央指导组组长蒋卓庆、省委书记关志鸥出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, Hubei Provincial Party Committee held an expanded meeting to study Xi Jinping's instructions and summarize education on correct political achievement view, deciding to consolidate results. Jiang Zhuoqing and Guan Zhiou spoke.

articles.title_zh: 始终以正确政绩观担当作为、履职尽责
articles.title_en: Always Acting with a Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 全国开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，广大党员干部以正确政绩观推动发展、造福群众，取得明显成效。
articles.summary_en: The nationwide education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements has achieved notable results, guiding officials to promote development and benefit the people.

articles.title_zh: 海南发布第四批生态产品价值实现典型案例
articles.title_en: Hainan Releases Fourth Batch of Typical Cases of Eco-Product Value Realization
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省国家生态文明试验区建设和生态环境保护督察工作领导小组办公室公布第四批生态产品价值实现典型案例，共6个案例入选，展示各市县在生态产品价值转化方面的创新实践。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the leading group office for Hainan's national ecological civilization pilot zone and ecological environment protection supervision released the fourth batch of typical cases of eco-product value realization, with six cases selected, showcasing innovative practices in eco-product value transformation.

articles.title_zh: 选对赛道，赋予汽车新定义
articles.title_en: Choosing the Right Track: Giving Cars a New Definition
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报与中国汽车报调研组刊发系列报道，回顾我国新能源汽车产业在顶层设计引领下实现换道超车，产销量连续11年居世界第一，并推动智能网联化新定义。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily and China Automotive News research group review the development of China's new energy vehicle industry, which has ranked first in production and sales for 11 consecutive years, driven by top-level design of electrification, intelligence, and connectivity.

articles.title_zh: 南京溧水等多地推动暑期休闲转向深度体验
articles.title_en: Nanjing Lishui and Other Places Promote Deep-Experience Summer Leisure
articles.summary_zh: 暑期文旅消费旺季，南京溧水、武汉、云南昭通等地推出短途度假、户外溯溪、康养旅居等深度体验项目，推动休闲消费从“到此一游”转向深度体验。
articles.summary_en: During the summer tourism peak, places including Lishui (Nanjing), Wuhan, and Zhaotong (Yunnan) promote short-break vacations, outdoor stream hiking, and wellness stays, shifting leisure from sightseeing to deep experience.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁新能源汽车“换挡加速”
articles.title_en: Liaoning's New Energy Vehicle Industry Accelerates
articles.summary_zh: 1月至7月，辽宁新能源汽车产量达13.24万辆，同比增长29.4%，吉利、宝马、奇瑞等龙头车企和产业链项目助推产业加速发展。
articles.summary_en: From January to July, Liaoning's NEV output reached 132,400 units, up 29.4% year-on-year, driven by projects from Geely, BMW, and Chery.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁推动行政复议从单一窗口向全域服务转变
articles.title_en: Liaoning Promotes Transformation of Administrative Reconsideration from Single Window to Full-Service
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，辽宁省政府新闻办召开新闻发布会，通报新修订行政复议法实施以来全省新收行政复议案件7.2万余件，行政复议化解行政争议主渠道作用不断显现。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the Information Office of Liaoning Provincial Government held a press conference, reporting over 72,000 new administrative reconsideration cases since the revised law took effect, highlighting its growing role as the main channel for resolving administrative disputes.

articles.title_zh: 始终以正确政绩观担当作为、履职尽责
articles.title_en: Always Act with a Correct View of Political Achievements and Fulfill Duties
articles.summary_zh: 中央部署在全党开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，各级党组织和党员干部通过学查改取得明显成效。
articles.summary_en: The Party-wide education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements has achieved notable results, with party organizations and officials improving through study, inspection, and rectification.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中主持召开全区防汛救灾工作视频调度会
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Chairs Regional Video Conference on Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日晚，自治区党委书记王伟中主持召开全区防汛救灾工作视频调度会，强调全面细致抓好防汛救灾，保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 25, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, chaired a regional video conference on flood control and disaster relief, emphasizing thorough implementation to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 自治区人民政府召开重点工作推进会议
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Regional Government Holds Key Work Promotion Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，自治区人民政府召开重点工作推进会议，自治区主席包钢部署“两重”建设、“两新”工作和“六张网”规划及财政风险防控等任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the regional government held a key work meeting; Chairman Bao Gang deployed tasks on major projects, new initiatives, six networks planning, and fiscal risk prevention.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏银川市全面推进中央安全生产考核巡查二季度明查暗访反馈问题整改工作
articles.title_en: Yinchuan City Promotes Rectification of Problems Found in Central Work Safety Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏银川市针对中央安全生产考核巡查组二季度明查暗访反馈的问题，全面推进整改，已实现15项重大事故隐患清零，对19家企业、18名责任人罚款共计1029.99万元。
articles.summary_en: Yinchuan, Ningxia, has pushed forward rectification of problems found by the central work safety inspection in Q2, eliminating 15 major hidden dangers and fining 19 enterprises and 18 individuals a total of 10.2999 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 这座硬核“超级充电宝”，正在硬控川西新能源
articles.title_en: Hardcore 'Super Power Bank' Bolsters New Energy in Western Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 四川省甘孜州道孚县正建设全球海拔最高的抽水蓄能电站，总装机210万千瓦，已进入主体施工前攻坚期，建成后日储电量达1260万千瓦时，将助力川西新能源消纳。
articles.summary_en: Daofu pumped-storage power station, the world's highest-altitude such facility in Sichuan, is entering the critical pre-construction phase. With 2.1 GW capacity and daily storage of 12.6 GWh, it will support new energy consumption in western Sichuan.

articles.title_zh: 同心同行——两岸青年交流季上海站活动在沪举行
articles.title_en: Shanghai Hosts Cross-Strait Youth Exchange Season Event
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，“同心同行——两岸青年交流季上海站”活动在上海开幕，约1000名两岸各界人士和青年代表参加，国台办主任宋涛、上海市长龚正等出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Shanghai leg of the Cross-Strait Youth Exchange Season opened in Shanghai, attended by about 1,000 people. Song Tao, head of the Taiwan Affairs Office, and Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng delivered remarks.

tags.name_en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

tags_en: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 鲁迅文学周在沪启动
articles.title_en: Lu Xun Literature Week Kicks Off in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 2026中国文学盛典·鲁迅文学周启动仪式8月25日在上海鲁迅公园举办，鲁迅文学奖首次落地上海，颁奖典礼将永久在上海举行。
articles.summary_en: The launch ceremony of the 2026 Lu Xun Literature Week was held on August 25 in Shanghai's Lu Xun Park, marking the first time the Lu Xun Literature Prize has come to Shanghai. The award ceremony will be permanently held in Shanghai.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部绿色低碳标准化技术委员会成立
articles.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Establishes Green and Low-Carbon Standardization Technical Committee
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部近日成立绿色低碳标准化技术委员会，由71名委员组成，秘书处设在中国电子技术标准化研究院，将推动节能降碳等领域标准制修订。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently established a Green and Low-Carbon Standardization Technical Committee, comprising 71 members from government, research institutes, universities, associations, and leading enterprises. It will promote standards development in energy conservation, carbon reduction, and cleaner production.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 十二届省委第九轮巡视完成反馈
articles.title_en: Twelfth Provincial Party Committee Inspection Round Completes Feedback
articles.summary_zh: 近日，山西省委部署的十二届省委第九轮巡视反馈工作全部完成，8月19日召开集中反馈会议，8月20日至24日各巡视组向被巡视单位逐一反馈，部署整改工作。
articles.summary_en: The feedback for the 12th Provincial Party Committee inspection round has been fully completed. On August 19, a centralized feedback meeting was held, and from August 20-24, inspection teams provided individual feedback to inspected units and deployed rectification work.

articles.title_zh: 天津滨海机场联合东方航空推出“津沪快线”产品
articles.title_en: Tianjin Binhai Airport and China Eastern Airlines Launch 'Tianjin-Shanghai Express' Service
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，天津滨海机场联合中国东方航空举办“津沪快线”产品发布会，推出一体化空中快线服务，加密津沪航线班次，提升出行效率。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, Tianjin Binhai Airport and China Eastern Airlines held a launch event for the 'Tianjin-Shanghai Express,' introducing an integrated air shuttle service with increased flight frequency.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜东海“捕风者”
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Trip: 'Wind Catchers' of the East China Sea
articles.summary_zh: 记者走进金风科技温州总装厂，探访全球首台16兆瓦漂浮式风机的总装过程，了解温州以“链主+链群”模式打造海上风电产业链，海外订单已占一半以上。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visited Goldwind's Wenzhou assembly plant to see the world's first 16MW floating wind turbine, and learned how Wenzhou builds its offshore wind industry chain with the 'chain leader + cluster' model. Overseas orders account for over half.

articles.title_zh: 坪山区人大代表王寿群：期待坪山推动法商资源转化为产业生产力
articles.title_en: Pingshan District People's Congress Rep Wang Shouqun Expects Legal and Business Resources to Boost Industrial Productivity
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，深圳市坪山区第三届人民代表大会第一次会议开幕，区人大代表王寿群期待推动法商资源转化为产业生产力。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the first session of the third Pingshan District People's Congress opened; deputy Wang Shouqun expects legal and business resources to be transformed into industrial productivity.

articles.title_zh: 坪山区人大代表彭风雷：做强先进制造业，推动坪山制造走向世界
articles.title_en: Pingshan District NPC Deputy Peng Fenglei: Strengthen Advanced Manufacturing and Promote Pingshan Manufacturing to the World
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，深圳市坪山区第三届人民代表大会第一次会议开幕，区人大代表彭风雷表示期待坪山做强先进制造业，推动坪山制造走向世界。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the first session of the Third People's Congress of Pingshan District, Shenzhen, opened. District deputy Peng Fenglei expressed expectations for Pingshan to strengthen advanced manufacturing and promote local manufacturing globally.

tags.name_en: Manufacturing as the Foundation of the District

tags_en: Manufacturing as the Foundation of the District

articles.title_zh: 袁家军陈新武赴武隆彭水调研并召开群防群治百日攻坚现场会
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun and Chen Xinwu Visit Wulong and Pengshui, Hold On-site Meeting on Mass Prevention Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日至25日，重庆市委书记袁家军、市长陈新武赴武隆区、彭水县调研，并召开全市群防群治提升基层除险固安实战能力百日攻坚行动现场会。袁家军强调要深化群防群治“162”工作体系，夯实基层风险防控基础。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 24 to 25, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and Mayor Chen Xinwu visited Wulong and Pengshui districts and chaired an on-site meeting on the 100-day campaign to enhance grassroots disaster prevention and response capabilities. Yuan urged deepening the "162" mass prevention system.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁以人大代表身份到郑州市中原区人大代表联络站参加活动
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Attends Activity at Deputies' Liaison Station in Zhengzhou as NPC Deputy
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，河南省委书记刘宁以人大代表身份到郑州市中原区人大代表联络站参加活动，强调践行全过程人民民主，推动基层治理提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, participated in an activity at a deputies' liaison station in Zhengzhou as a people's congress deputy, emphasizing whole-process people's democracy and improving grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 强基础、拓应用，人工智能如何打开发展新空间
articles.title_en: Strengthening Foundations and Expanding Applications: How AI Opens New Development Space
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，工业和信息化部副部长辛国斌在国新办发布会上介绍“十五五”时期推动人工智能产业发展的举措，强调技术攻关、生态培育和场景应用。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 26, Vice Minister of MIIT Xin Guobin outlined plans at a State Council Information Office press conference to promote AI industry development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 信长星在江苏交控和省农垦集团调研时强调 为建设交通强省农业强省再立新功
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Visits Jiangsu Transportation and Agricultural Reclamation Groups, Urges Building Strong Transportation and Agricultural Province
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，江苏省委书记信长星到江苏交通控股有限公司和省农垦集团调研，强调深化改革创新，为建设交通强省、农业强省再立新功。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Party Secretary Xin Changxing of Jiangsu visited Jiangsu Communications Holding and Jiangsu Agricultural Reclamation Group, urging reform and innovation to build a strong transportation province and agricultural province.

articles.title_zh: 从预算执行报告看更加积极的财政政策精准发力
articles.title_en: Budget Execution Report Shows More Proactive Fiscal Policy
articles.summary_zh: 财政部副部长林泽昌8月25日向全国人大常委会会议报告今年以来预算执行情况，显示财政政策更加积极，预算执行总体平稳。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Vice Finance Minister Lin Zechang reported to the NPC Standing Committee on budget execution this year, showing more proactive fiscal policy and stable budget performance.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局协调指导西藏吉隆县泥石流灾害抢修复电
articles.title_en: National Energy Administration Coordinates Power Restoration after Landslide in Gyirong County, Tibet
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，国家能源局就西藏日喀则市吉隆县泥石流灾害协调指导抢修复电，已派出发电车和应急照明设备赶赴灾区。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, the National Energy Administration coordinated power restoration after a landslide in Gyirong County, Tibet, dispatching generator vehicles and emergency lighting equipment.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”，中国制造业这样争“先”
articles.title_en: China's Manufacturing Sector Strives for 'Leading Edge' During 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列新闻发布会，工信部副部长辛国斌介绍加快发展先进制造业、优化产业结构的部署。
articles.summary_en: On August 26, at a State Council Information Office press conference on the '15th Five-Year Plan', Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology Xin Guobin outlined measures to accelerate advanced manufacturing and optimize industrial structure.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔：扎实做好新时代新征程我市人大工作 为全面建设社会主义现代化大都市提供重要制度保障
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er Stresses Solid Work on People's Congress in New Era to Provide Institutional Guarantee for Building Modern Socialist Metropolitan
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，天津市委人大工作会议召开，市委书记陈敏尔出席并讲话，强调坚持和完善人民代表大会制度，做好新时代人大工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the Tianjin Municipal Party Committee held a work conference on people's congress affairs. Party Secretary Chen Min'er attended and stressed upholding and improving the system of people's congresses.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：高度重视 迅速行动 科学应对 坚决守护好人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Wang Hao: Attach Great Importance, Act Quickly, Respond Scientifically to Safeguard People's Lives and Property
articles.summary_zh: 25日下午，浙江省委书记王浩主持召开省委专题会议，研判台风“沙德尔”走势并部署防御工作，强调坚持人民至上、生命至上，坚决守护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of the 25th, Zhejiang Provincial Party Secretary Wang Hao chaired a special meeting to assess Typhoon Shadel and deploy defense efforts, stressing people-first and life-first principles to safeguard lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 王浩：勇于创新 抢抓机遇 在融入创新浙江建设中实现更好更快发展
articles.title_en: Wang Hao: Innovate Bravely, Seize Opportunities, Achieve Better and Faster Development in Building an Innovative Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 25日上午，浙江省委书记王浩在杭州调研企业创新发展，强调支持企业聚力科技创新、因地制宜发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of the 25th, Wang Hao, Secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee, visited enterprises in Hangzhou to promote innovation-driven development and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 律师法修改拟明确鼓励支持律师依法提供法律援助
articles.title_en: Lawyers Law Amendment to Encourage Pro Bono Legal Aid
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，律师法修正草案提请十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议二次审议，鼓励和支持律师参与公益法律服务。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the draft amendment to the Lawyers Law was submitted for second review at the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee, encouraging lawyers to participate in public interest legal services.

articles.title_zh: 耕地保护和质量提升法草案三审 进一步加大对黑土地保护力度
articles.title_en: Draft Law on Farmland Protection and Quality Improvement Passes Third Review, Strengthening Black Soil Protection
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，耕地保护和质量提升法草案提请十四届全国人大常委会三次审议，三审稿加大对黑土地保护和高标准农田建设资金监管力度。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the draft law on farmland protection and quality improvement was submitted for its third review to the Standing Committee of the 14th NPC, with the revised draft strengthening black soil protection and supervision of high-standard farmland construction funds.

articles.title_zh: 道路交通安全法拟修订 明确“暴走团”治理措施
articles.title_en: Draft Amendment to Road Traffic Safety Law Targets 'Walking Groups'
articles.summary_zh: 道路交通安全法修订草案8月25日提请十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议审议，明确对“暴走团”等违法占用道路行为的治理措施。
articles.summary_en: A draft amendment to the Road Traffic Safety Law was submitted for review at the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee on Aug 25, specifying measures to regulate illegal road occupation by 'walking groups'.

articles.title_zh: 《“十五五”时期三级医院对口帮扶县级医院工作方案》发布
articles.title_en: Work Plan Released for County-Level Hospital Assistance in 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委等五部门8月25日联合发布《“十五五”时期三级医院对口帮扶县级医院工作方案》，要求支援医院向县级医院派驻至少5名管理和专业技术人员，提升县级医院服务能力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the National Health Commission and four other departments released a work plan for tertiary hospitals to assist county hospitals in the 15th Five-Year Plan period, requiring at least five personnel be dispatched.

tags.name_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

tags_en: National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine

articles.title_zh: 水法修订草案二审 明确国家建立完善与用水户承受能力相适应的水价形成机制
articles.title_en: Water Law Amendment Draft Undergoes Second Review, Clarifying Water Pricing Mechanism Adapted to Users' Affordability
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，水法修订草案提请十四届全国人大常委会二次审议，明确建立与用水户承受能力相适应的水价形成机制，促进水资源节约集约利用。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the revised Water Law draft was submitted for second review to the NPC Standing Committee, clarifying a water pricing mechanism adapted to users' affordability to promote water conservation and intensive use.

articles.title_zh: 武陵深处“红土地” 振兴路上“再出发”
articles.title_en: Red Land in Deep Wuling Mountains: Setting Off Again on the Road to Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 报道重庆酉阳县南腰界镇依托长征国家文化公园建设，修缮革命文物，发展红色旅游，带动乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: A report on Youyang County, Chongqing, where the town of Nanyaojie has renovated revolutionary relics and developed red tourism under the Long March National Cultural Park project, boosting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 国家公共数据资源登记平台已登记量超30万项
articles.title_en: National Public Data Registration Platform Exceeds 300,000 Items
articles.summary_zh: 国家数据局介绍，国家公共数据资源登记平台登记量已超30万项，覆盖国民经济97个大类，促进供需对接。
articles.summary_en: The National Data Administration said the national public data registration platform has logged over 300,000 items, covering all 97 categories of the national economy, facilitating supply-demand matching.

articles.title_zh: 农业法修订草案二审 拟完善农民权益保护
articles.title_en: Agricultural Law Revision Draft Undergoes Second Review, Aiming to Improve Protection of Farmers' Rights
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，农业法修订草案提请十四届全国人大常委会二次审议，拟完善农民权益保护内容，并规定建立健全整治形式主义为基层减负长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the revised draft of the Agricultural Law was submitted to the 14th NPC Standing Committee for a second review, aiming to improve protection of farmers' rights and establish a long-term mechanism to reduce burdens at the grassroots level.

articles.title_zh: 反跨境腐败法草案首次提请审议 中国拟完善反腐败涉外法律体系
articles.title_en: Draft Law Against Cross-Border Corruption Submitted for First Review; China to Enhance Foreign-Related Anti-Corruption Legal System
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，反跨境腐败法草案提请十四届全国人大常委会会议首次审议，草案共六章四十七条，旨在完善反腐败涉外法律体系。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the draft law against cross-border corruption was submitted for first review to the 14th NPC Standing Committee. The draft has 6 chapters and 47 articles, aiming to improve China's foreign-related anti-corruption legal system.

articles.title_zh: 国家数据局发布新一批50个公共数据“跑起来”示范场景
articles.title_en: National Data Administration Releases New Batch of 50 Demonstration Scenarios for Public Data "Get Moving"
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国家数据局举办发布会，发布第五批50个公共数据“跑起来”示范场景，副局长陈荣辉介绍相关情况，旨在释放公共数据价值。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the National Data Administration held a press conference to release the fifth batch of 50 demonstration scenarios for public data "getting moving". Deputy Director Chen Ronghui introduced the details, aiming to unlock the value of public data.

articles.title_zh: 山东省人大监察和司法委员会原副主任委员苏立科被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Su Like, Former Deputy Director of Shandong Provincial People's Congress Committee, Expelled from Party
articles.summary_zh: 据山东省纪委监委消息，山东省人大监察和司法委员会原副主任委员苏立科因严重违纪违法被开除党籍，涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关。
articles.summary_en: Su Like, former deputy director of the Shandong Provincial People's Congress Supervision and Judicial Committee, was expelled from the Party for serious disciplinary violations, and suspected crimes were transferred to prosecutors.

tags.name_en: Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

tags_en: Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision

articles.title_zh: 交付“满月”！世界航运巨头达飞首购“绿船”选择武汉设计
articles.title_en: CMA CGM's First Pure Electric Inland Vessel, Designed by Wuhan Team, Marks One Month of Delivery
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，法国达飞集团订购的首条纯电内河船“达飞182TEU”交付满月，停泊越南盖梅港，该船由武汉理工大学团队牵头设计。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the first pure electric inland vessel 'CMA CGM 182TEU' ordered by France's CMA CGM, designed by Wuhan University of Technology, completed one month since delivery at Gemalink Port, Vietnam.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with King Abdullah II of Jordan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日上午，国务院总理李强在北京人民大会堂会见来华进行国事访问的约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世，双方就深化合作、共建“一带一路”等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 24, Premier Li Qiang met with Jordan's King Abdullah II at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. They exchanged views on deepening cooperation and jointly building the Belt and Road.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见科威特外交大臣杰拉赫
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Abdullah Ali Al-Yahya
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见科威特外交大臣杰拉赫，双方就中科关系及共同关心的问题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Vice President Han Zheng met with Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Abdullah Ali Al-Yahya in Beijing to discuss bilateral ties and issues of mutual concern.

articles.title_zh: 陈武同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Chen Wu Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 全国政协副主席陈武因病医治无效，于2026年8月24日15时05分在北京逝世，享年72岁。
articles.summary_en: Chen Wu, Vice Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, passed away from illness in Beijing on August 24, 2026, at the age of 72.

articles.title_zh: 全国小麦收购量超9000万吨
articles.title_en: National Wheat Purchases Exceed 90 Million Tons
articles.summary_zh: 国家粮食和物资储备局数据显示，全国累计收购小麦超9000万吨，并在江西、湖南、河南、安徽启动最低收购价预案，保护种粮农民利益，稳定市场预期。
articles.summary_en: The National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration reported that wheat purchases nationwide have exceeded 90 million tons. Minimum purchase price plans were activated in Jiangxi, Hunan, Henan and Anhui to support farmers and stabilize the market.

tags.name_en: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration

articles.title_zh: 以树立和践行正确政绩观新成效开创中国式现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Achieving New Progress in Correct View of Political Achievements to Open New Prospects for Chinese Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中央党的建设工作领导小组召开会议，总结树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，部署建立长效机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Central Leading Group for Party Building held a meeting to summarize the education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements and to plan long-term mechanisms.

articles.title_zh: 推动高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: Promoting High-Quality Development for Steady Progress
articles.summary_zh: 钟才文发表评论，强调贯彻落实中央政治局会议部署，加大逆周期调节，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: Zhong Caiwen comments on the implementation of the Central Political Bureau's deployment, emphasizing counter-cyclical adjustments to promote sustained high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世举行会谈，双方见证签署多项合作文件并发表联合声明。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks with Jordan's King Abdullah II, who was on a state visit, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. They witnessed the signing of cooperation documents and issued a joint statement.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺阿拉姆吉尔就任孟加拉国总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulations to Alamgir on His Inauguration as Bangladesh President
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国家主席习近平致电阿拉姆吉尔，祝贺他就任孟加拉国总统，表示愿赓续传统友谊，推进共建“一带一路”，深化合作，引领新时代中孟命运共同体建设走深走实。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Alamgir on his inauguration as President of Bangladesh, expressing willingness to enhance traditional friendship, advance Belt and Road cooperation, and deepen the China-Bangladesh community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: “清朗·网络娱乐团播乱象整治”专项行动取得成效
articles.title_en: Special Campaign Against Online Variety Show Chaos Achieves Results
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办8月24日通报，自专项行动启动以来，已处置违规直播间7200余个，严惩违规账号2200余个，并清退问题严重的团播MCN机构。
articles.summary_en: The CAC reported on Aug 24 that since the campaign began, it has handled over 7,200 illegal livestream rooms, punished over 2,200 accounts, and removed problematic MCN agencies.

articles.title_zh: 多台风对我国造成持续强降雨影响
articles.title_en: Multiple Typhoons Bring Persistent Heavy Rain to China
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日中国气象局通报，西北太平洋同时有4个台风活动，需防范持续性强降水和次生灾害。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, China Meteorological Administration warned of four simultaneous typhoons in the Western Pacific, requiring precautions against persistent heavy rain and secondary disasters.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠顾刚会见中国工程院院士贲德一行
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui and Gu Gang Meet with CAE Academician Ben De
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，长春市委书记张恩惠、市长顾刚会见中国工程院院士贲德一行，祝贺其荣获2025年度国家最高科学技术奖，并就长春科技创新与光电产业发展交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of Changchun Municipal Party Committee, and Mayor Gu Gang met with Ben De, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, congratulating him on winning the 2025 National Highest Science and Technology Award and discussing sci-tech innovation and optoelectronic industry development.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》
articles.title_en: General Offices of CPC Central Committee and State Council Issue Measures for Accountability for Ecological Damage
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》，要求各地区各部门遵照执行，对生态环境损害实行党政同责、终身追究。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council recently issued the Measures for Accountability of Party and Government Leading Cadres for Ecological Environment Damage, requiring all regions and departments to implement them, with lifelong accountability and joint responsibility of party and government.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府与圆通速递签署战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government and YTO Express Sign Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，江苏省政府与圆通速递签署战略合作协议，省长刘小涛会见圆通速递董事局主席喻渭蛟并见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Jiangsu provincial government signed a strategic cooperation agreement with YTO Express. Governor Liu Xiaotao met with YTO chairman Yu Weijiao and witnessed the signing.

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市政府召开第二十一届十次全体（扩大）会议 吕志成主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal Government Holds Its 21st Plenary (Enlarged) Meeting; Lv Zhicheng Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，沈阳市市长吕志成主持召开市政府全体（扩大）会议，部署下半年经济工作，要求咬定全年目标，努力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Shenyang Mayor Lv Zhicheng chaired the municipal government plenary meeting to deploy H2 economic work, urging full-year targets and a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚在中国科学院金属研究所主持召开座谈会时指出 强化产学研融通创新 携手打造院地合作典范
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Chairs Symposium at Institute of Metal Research, Emphasizing Industry-Academia-Research Integration and Institute-Local Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，沈阳市委书记霍步刚在中国科学院金属研究所主持召开座谈会，强调强化产学研融通创新，打造院地合作典范。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Huo Bugang, Secretary of Shenyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a symposium at the Institute of Metal Research, CAS, emphasizing stronger industry-academia-research integration and exemplary institute-local cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见中国中检董事长许增德总经理李永吉
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet with CCIC Chairman Xu Zengde and General Manager Li Yongji
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见中国检验认证集团董事长许增德、总经理李永吉一行，就深化合作、助力辽宁振兴发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Liaoning Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met with CCIC Chairman Xu Zengde and General Manager Li Yongji in Shenyang to discuss deepening cooperation and supporting Liaoning's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见中国中检董事长许增德总经理李永吉
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet China Inspection & Certification Group Leadership
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见中国检验认证集团董事长许增德、总经理李永吉一行，双方就深化央地合作、推动质量强省建设等交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin and Governor Wang Xinwei met with CCIC Chairman Xu Zengde and GM Li Yongji in Shenyang, discussing cooperation on quality infrastructure and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 习近平作出重要指示强调 巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果 努力创造经得起实践人民历史检验的实绩
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Consolidating Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记习近平就巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果作出重要指示，中央党建工作领导小组24日召开会议部署落实。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on consolidating education on correct view of political achievements. The Central Party Building Work Leading Group held a meeting on Aug 24 to implement them.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中出席第十一届亚太经合组织粮食安全部长级会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Attends and Addresses 11th APEC Food Security Ministerial Meeting Opening Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中8月25日在浙江杭州出席第十一届亚太经合组织粮食安全部长级会议开幕式并致辞，提出共建粮食安全体系四点建议。
articles.summary_en: Liu Guozhong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 11th APEC Food Security Ministerial Meeting in Hangzhou, Zhejiang on August 25, proposing four suggestions for building a food security system.

articles.title_zh: 努力实现“十五五”良好开局——从计划执行报告看下半年经济工作重点
articles.title_en: Striving for a Good Start to the 15th Five-Year Plan: Key Economic Work for H2 from Plan Execution Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国家发展改革委副主任王昌林受国务院委托向全国人大常委会报告上半年计划执行情况，称上半年GDP增长4.7%，下半年将实施更积极财政政策和适度宽松货币政策，努力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, NDRC Deputy Director Wang Changlin, on behalf of the State Council, reported to the NPC Standing Committee on H1 plan execution, citing 4.7% GDP growth and outlining H2 policies including more proactive fiscal and moderately loose monetary measures.

articles.title_zh: 报告显示：脱贫攻坚成果持续巩固拓展 常态化帮扶有序推进
articles.title_en: Report: Poverty Alleviation Achievements Consolidated, Routine Assistance Progressing
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国务院关于巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果的报告提请全国人大常委会审议，显示脱贫攻坚成果持续巩固，常态化帮扶有序推进。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the State Council's report on consolidating poverty alleviation achievements was submitted to the NPC Standing Committee for review, showing steady progress and orderly routine assistance.

articles.title_zh: 我国加快推进公共数据开放共享 赋能千行百业
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Public Data Sharing to Empower Various Industries
articles.summary_zh: 今年我国加快推进公共数据开放共享，强化数据安全技术试点和跨部门数据整合，已发布150个示范场景，赋能气象、交通、医疗等领域。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, China has accelerated public data sharing, strengthening pilot security technologies and cross-department integration, releasing 150 demonstration scenarios across meteorology, transportation, healthcare and more.

articles.title_zh: 全国政协十四届常委会第十八次会议开幕
articles.title_en: 18th Session of CPPCC Standing Committee Opens
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，全国政协十四届常委会第十八次会议在北京开幕，围绕加大保障和改善民生力度、扎实推进全体人民共同富裕协商议政。王沪宁出席，何立峰作报告。
articles.summary_en: The 18th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th CPPCC National Committee opened in Beijing on the morning of Aug 25, focusing on improving people's livelihood and advancing common prosperity. Wang Huning attended and He Lifeng delivered a report.

articles.title_zh: 推动高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: Promoting High-Quality Development Steadily
articles.summary_zh: 文章解读7月30日中央政治局会议部署，强调加大逆周期调节、扩大内需、推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The article interprets the July 30 CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting's arrangements, emphasizing counter-cyclical adjustment, expanding domestic demand, and promoting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央办公厅 国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee General Office and State Council General Office Issue Measures for Accountability of Party and Government Leading Cadres for Ecological Environment Damage
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《党政领导干部生态环境损害责任追究办法》，要求各地区各部门遵照执行，明确生态环境损害责任追究情形、方式及终身追究制。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council recently issued the Measures for Accountability of Party and Government Leading Cadres for Ecological Environment Damage, requiring all regions and departments to implement them, specifying accountability scenarios, methods, and lifetime accountability.

articles.title_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议在京举行
articles.title_en: 14th NPC Standing Committee Holds 24th Session in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日上午，十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议在北京人民大会堂举行第一次全体会议，赵乐际委员长主持，审议多项法律草案并听取有关报告。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 25, the 24th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee held its first plenary meeting at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, chaired by Chairman Zhao Leji, deliberating several draft laws and hearing reports.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Important Instructions on Learning and Practicing Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日就树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育作出重要指示，中央党的建设工作领导小组24日在京召开会议，部署巩固拓展学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently issued important instructions on the learning and education of establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements. The Central Party Building Work Leading Group held a meeting in Beijing on August 24 to consolidate and expand the results.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟主持召开省政府常务会议，审议自然资源、林草、市场监管等领域“十五五”规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Wang Xinwei, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee and Governor, chaired a provincial government executive meeting to review the 15th Five-Year Plan on natural resources, forestry and market regulation.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开西露天矿综合治理专题会议
articles.title_en: Fushun Municipal Government Holds Special Meeting on Comprehensive Treatment of West Open-Pit Mine
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，抚顺市政府召开西露天矿综合治理专题会议，市长王庆海主持，研究地灾治理、生态修复和产业导入等议题。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, Fushun municipal government held a special meeting on comprehensive treatment of the West Open-pit Mine, chaired by Mayor Wang Qinghai, to discuss disaster management, ecological restoration and industrial introduction.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱调研营商环境建设工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Inspects Business Environment Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱调研营商环境建设工作，实地走访企业、政务服务中心和法院，强调打造一流营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Hegang Municipal Party Secretary Wang Xingzhu inspected business environment construction, visiting enterprises, government service center and court, emphasizing creating a first-class business environment.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元调研鹤岗市民营经济发展情况
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Investigates Private Economy Development in Hegang
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，鹤岗市市长邓维元调研民营经济发展情况，走访多家企业，强调优化营商环境、支持民营企业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan visited private enterprises and emphasized improving the business environment to support high-quality development of the private economy.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，淮安市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话和文章精神，研究巡视整改、人大换届选举等工作。市委书记史志军主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting to study important speeches by General Secretary Xi Jinping and discuss inspection rectification and people's congress elections. Shi Zhijun, the municipal party secretary, presided.

articles.title_zh: 市长顾坤调研推进省市重大产业项目建设
articles.title_en: Mayor Gu Kun Promotes Construction of Key Provincial and Municipal Industrial Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，淮安市市长顾坤赴盱眙县、洪泽区调研推进省市重大产业项目建设，强调要高效推进项目，带动扩投资稳增长。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Mayor Gu Kun of Huai'an visited Xuyi and Hongze to inspect and advance key provincial and municipal industrial projects, emphasizing efficient implementation to boost investment and growth.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市市长顾坤调研推进省市重大产业项目建设
articles.title_en: Huaian Mayor Gu Kun Inspects Provincial and Municipal Major Industrial Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，淮安市市长顾坤赴盱眙县、洪泽区调研省市重大产业项目建设，强调加快项目建设、壮大产业集群、优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Huaian Mayor Gu Kun visited Xuyi County and Hongze District to inspect provincial and municipal major industrial projects, emphasizing accelerating construction, strengthening industrial clusters, and improving the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组召开学习会
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Theory Study Group Holds Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，淮安市委理论学习中心组召开学习会，市委书记史志军主持会议，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee Theory Study Group held a study session chaired by Party Secretary Shi Zhijun to thoroughly study Xi Jinping's important expositions on grassroots work methods.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持市委理论学习中心组集体学习
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Collective Study of Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月26日上午，怀化市委理论学习中心组开展2026年第九次集体学习，市委书记韦朝晖主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 26, the Theoretical Learning Center Group of Huaihua Municipal Party Committee held its 9th collective study session in 2026, chaired by Wei Zhaohui.

articles.title_zh: 市政协党组理论学习中心组学习(扩大)会议召开

articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping emphasizes the integration of culture and tourism, making tourism a process of experiencing Chinese culture and enhancing cultural confidence.

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Standing Committee of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee met to study Xi Jinping's important speech and review plans for county economy high-quality development and Safe Jinan construction, chaired by Secretary Liu Qiang.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会2026年调研成果交流会召开 刘强主持 于海田孙开连出席

articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Standing Committee of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee held its 2026 research achievement exchange meeting. Secretary Liu Qiang presided and spoke; Mayor Yu Haitian and CPPCC Chairman Sun Kailian attended, sharing research findings to support a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记重要指示激励全党树立和践行正确政绩观
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Important Instructions Inspire Whole Party to Establish Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日作重要指示，要求巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果。中央党的建设工作领导小组24日召开会议部署长效机制工作。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently made important instructions on consolidating the education campaign on establishing a correct view of political achievements. The Central Party Building Work Leading Group held a meeting on Aug 24 to deploy long-term mechanism work.

articles.title_zh: 成都市出台房地产市场新政，鼓励发放购房补贴
articles.title_en: Chengdu Issues New Real Estate Policies, Encouraging Home Purchase Subsidies
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月25日起，成都市住建局等四部门联合发布房地产市场新政，鼓励发放购房补贴，将公积金贷款最低首付比例降至15%。
articles.summary_en: Effective August 25, 2026, Chengdu's housing authority and three other departments issued new real estate policies, encouraging home purchase subsidies and lowering the minimum down payment for provident fund loans to 15%.

articles.title_zh: 成都出台新规：今年底前买新房，公积金贷款首付低至15%
articles.title_en: Chengdu Cuts Housing Provident Fund Down Payment to 15% for New Homes
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，成都市住建局等4部门联合印发通知，从供给、消费、存量、环境四方面推出十条举措，将购买新建商品住房的公积金贷款最低首付比例降至15%，并给予利息补贴，以促进房地产市场平稳健康发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, Chengdu housing authority and three departments issued a notice, cutting minimum down payment for housing provident fund loans on new homes to 15% and offering interest subsidies to stabilize the real estate market.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. This is the king's ninth visit to China since his accession.

articles.summary_en: The demonstration project for centralized contiguous protection and utilization of traditional villages in Ding'an County has been completed, with an investment of 50 million yuan, linking 8 traditional villages in 6 towns and completing conservation and digital archiving.

articles.title_zh: 创造经得起实践、人民、历史检验的实绩
articles.title_en: Creating Achievements That Stand the Test of Practice, People, and History
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，全党深入开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，在习近平总书记亲自指导下，教育引导党员干部为民造福、以实干出政绩，有效防范和纠治政绩观偏差。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the whole Party carried out an education campaign to establish and practice a correct view of political achievements, under Xi Jinping's personal guidance, urging officials to serve the people and produce real results while preventing deviations.

articles.title_zh: 中国支付清算协会发布《智能体支付应用自律公约》
articles.title_en: China Payment and Clearing Association Issues Self-Regulatory Convention on Agent Payment Applications
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中国支付清算协会发布《智能体支付应用自律公约》，对智能体管理、授权管理、防范风险等作出安排，旨在促进智能体支付安全合规发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, the China Payment and Clearing Association issued the Self-Regulatory Convention on Agent Payment Applications, setting arrangements on agent management, authorization, and risk prevention to promote safe and compliant development.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁：持续营造公平正义法治环境 加快建设更高水平法治河南
articles.title_en: Liu Ning: Foster Fair Legal Environment, Accelerate Rule of Law in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，河南省委书记刘宁到省法院、省检察院、省司法厅调研，强调持续营造公平正义法治环境，加快建设更高水平法治河南。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee, visited the provincial courts, procuratorate, and justice department, urging a fair and just legal environment and a higher-level rule of law in Henan.

articles.title_zh: 三部门发文 推进家庭医生签约服务
articles.title_en: Three Departments Issue Document to Advance Family Doctor Contract Services
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委等三部门近日印发通知，部署深化“六个拓展”、做实家庭医生签约服务，明确到2026年底基层相关医师均应开展签约服务。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission and two other departments issued a notice to deepen family doctor contract services, requiring relevant grassroots doctors to provide such services by the end of 2026.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛主持召开第八期政企恳谈会
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs 8th Government-Enterprise Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开今年第八期政企恳谈会，围绕海洋经济听取企业和科创平台意见，强调提升海洋开发能力，打造蓝色增长极。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Governor Liu Xiaotao of Jiangsu chaired the 8th government-enterprise symposium to hear opinions on marine economy, emphasizing enhancing marine development capacity and building a blue growth engine.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解天下为公、天下大同的社会理想
articles.title_en: Deeply Understanding the Social Ideal of a World for All and Great Harmony
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐释中华优秀传统文化中天下为公、天下大同的社会理想，探讨其时代价值及对构建人类命运共同体的启示。
articles.summary_en: This article elaborates on the social ideal of a world for all and great harmony in Chinese traditional culture, exploring its contemporary value and implications for building a community with a shared future for mankind.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 努力实现“十五五”良好开局——从计划执行报告看下半年经济工作重点
articles.title_en: Striving for a Good Start to the 15th Five-Year Plan: Key Economic Priorities for H2 from the Plan Implementation Report
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国家发展改革委副主任王昌林受国务院委托，向全国人大常委会报告今年以来国民经济和社会发展计划执行情况，介绍上半年GDP增长4.7%，并部署下半年经济工作重点。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, Wang Changlin, deputy director of the National Development and Reform Commission, reported to the NPC Standing Committee on behalf of the State Council on the implementation of the national economic and social development plan, noting 4.7% GDP growth in H1 and outlining H2 economic priorities.

tags.name_en: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

tags_en: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress

articles.title_zh: 人大常委会丨报告显示：脱贫攻坚成果持续巩固拓展 常态化帮扶有序推进
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Report: Achievements in Poverty Alleviation Consolidated, Regular Assistance Progressing
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，国务院关于持续巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果的报告提请全国人大常委会会议审议。报告显示，脱贫县农村居民人均可支配收入5年增长至18627元，常态化帮扶有序推进。
articles.summary_en: On August 25, the State Council submitted a report on consolidating poverty alleviation achievements to the NPC Standing Committee for review. Per capita disposable income in ex-poverty counties rose to 18,627 yuan over five years.

articles.title_zh: 我国交通强国指数稳步增长位列世界第五
articles.title_en: China Ranks Fifth Globally in Transport Power Index
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部8月25日在湖北武汉举行加快建设交通强国大会，发布交通强国指数为90.8，较上年提升0.9，位列全球第五。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Ministry of Transport released the Transport Power Index of 90.8 at a conference in Wuhan, Hubei, ranking fifth globally, up 0.9 from last year.

articles.title_zh: 8.2万家助餐点 守护长者幸福“食”光
articles.title_en: 82,000 Meal Assistance Sites Safeguard Seniors' Dining Happiness
articles.summary_zh: 8月25日，民政部在湖北武汉举行主题活动，宣布全国共有8.2万家老年助餐点，每天为400万余人次老年人提供助餐服务。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Ministry of Civil Affairs held an event in Wuhan, Hubei, announcing 82,000 senior meal assistance sites nationwide serve over 4 million seniors daily.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解天下为公、天下大同的社会理想
articles.title_en: Profoundly Understanding the Social Ideal of a World for All and Great Harmony
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐释天下为公、天下大同社会理想的内涵与时代价值，强调其与马克思主义的契合性，倡导构建人类命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: The article explains the connotation and contemporary value of the social ideal of a world for all and great harmony, emphasizing its compatibility with Marxism and advocating building a community with a shared future for mankind.

tags.name_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

tags_en: Community with a Shared Future for Mankind

articles.title_zh: 道路交通安全法修订草案提请审议
articles.title_en: Road Traffic Safety Law Amendment Draft Submitted for Review
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会提请审议道路交通安全法修订草案，共9章170条，明确自动驾驶车行驶条件、违章处理原则等，并聚焦醉驾、盲驾、僵尸车等治理问题。
articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee submitted a draft amendment to the Road Traffic Safety Law for review, with 9 chapters and 170 articles, clarifying conditions for autonomous driving, violation handling principles, and addressing drunk driving, blind driving, and abandoned vehicles.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对5省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level-IV Emergency Response for Flood Control in 5 Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 水利部8月25日对河北、山西、内蒙古、陕西、青海启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，应对新一轮强降雨过程。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 25, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood control in Hebei, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Shaanxi and Qinghai in response to heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 树立和践行正确政绩观是一项长期任务
articles.title_en: Establishing and Practicing the Correct View on Political Achievements Is a Long-term Task
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日就树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育作出重要指示，强调这是一项长期任务，必须久久为功。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping recently gave important instructions on the education campaign for establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, emphasizing that it is a long-term task requiring sustained effort.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔：对标对表 因地制宜 统筹兼顾 在推动高质量发展上见行见效
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er Urges High-Quality Development in Hedong District Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，天津市委书记陈敏尔赴河东区调研，强调对标对表、因地制宜、统筹兼顾，因地制宜发展新质生产力，推动高质量发展、创造高品质生活。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Chen Min'er, Secretary of Tianjin Municipal Party Committee, inspected Hedong District, urging benchmarking, local adaptation and overall planning to develop new quality productive forces and promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江会见香港特别行政区政府律政司司长林定国
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Meets with Hong Kong Secretary for Justice Paul Lam
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江在乌鲁木齐会见香港特别行政区政府律政司司长林定国一行，双方就深化法治合作、融入共建“一带一路”等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Chen Xiaojiang, Party Secretary of Xinjiang, met with Paul Lam, Secretary for Justice of the HKSAR Government, in Urumqi, discussing cooperation in rule of law and the Belt and Road Initiative.

articles.title_zh: 美方个别官员攻击中方科技企业 外交部：捏造事实、颠倒黑白
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Slams US Officials' Attacks on Chinese Tech Firms as 'Fabricated and Unfair'
articles.summary_zh: 中国外交部发言人林剑8月24日在例行记者会上表示，美方个别官员攻击中方科技企业的言论捏造事实、颠倒黑白，是科技霸凌和单边胁迫，中方坚决反对。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesman Lin Jian said at a routine press conference on Aug 24 that US officials' attacks on Chinese tech firms are fabricated and unfair, constituting tech bullying and unilateral coercion, which China firmly opposes.

articles.title_zh: “北京没有冰箱”背后，台湾“名嘴”为何一味炮制“大陆穷酸剧本”？
articles.title_en: Behind 'No Refrigerators in Beijing': Why Taiwan Pundits Keep Fabricating 'Mainland Poverty' Claims?
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，台湾某绿营“名嘴”再抛“北京没有冰箱”反智言论；国台办此前已依法对黄世聪等5名散布谣言的“名嘴”及家属实施惩戒。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, a Taiwan pro-green pundit again made the absurd claim that 'Beijing has no refrigerators.' The State Council's Taiwan Affairs Office had previously punished five such pundits for spreading rumors.

articles.title_zh: 国家体育总局体育基金管理中心副主任罗建彬被查
articles.title_en: Luo Jianbin, Deputy Director of Sports Fund Management Center, Investigated
articles.summary_zh: 国家体育总局体育基金管理中心副主任、纪委书记罗建彬涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受中央纪委国家监委驻国家体育总局纪检监察组纪律审查和广东省韶关市监委监察调查。
articles.summary_en: Luo Jianbin, deputy director of the Sports Fund Management Center, is under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations.

tags.name_en: Shaoguan Municipal Supervision Commission of Guangdong Province

tags_en: Shaoguan Municipal Supervision Commission of Guangdong Province

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！南海部分水域进行军事训练 禁止驶入
articles.title_en: Navigation Warning! Military Training in Parts of South China Sea, Entry Forbidden
articles.summary_zh: 清澜海事局发布航行警告，8月24日12时至8月26日18时，南海部分水域进行军事训练，禁止驶入。
articles.summary_en: Qinglan Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning: from 12:00 on Aug 24 to 18:00 on Aug 26, military training is conducted in parts of the South China Sea, and entry is prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 习近平作出重要指示强调巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Makes Important Instructions on Consolidating Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 习近平近日作出重要指示，强调巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果。中央党的建设工作领导小组24日召开会议，蔡奇主持并讲话，李希出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping made important instructions emphasizing consolidating achievements of education on the correct view of political achievements. The Central Party Building Work Leading Group held a meeting, chaired by Cai Qi, with Li Xi attending and speaking.

tags.name_en: Education on Correct View of Political Achievements

tags_en: Education on Correct View of Political Achievements

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on New-Generation Communication Network
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报，部署清欠企业账款、改善空气质量等工作，并审议通过两项条例草案。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to hear reports on new-generation communication network construction, deploy efforts to clear enterprise arrears and improve air quality, and approve two draft regulations.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚会见一批知名企业家洽谈产业合作
articles.title_en: Gu Gang Meets with Well-Known Entrepreneurs for Industrial Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 近日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚会见一批知名企业家，围绕现代化产业体系开展招商引资，达成多项合作意向。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gu Gang, Deputy Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee and Mayor of Changchun, met with a group of well-known entrepreneurs to discuss investment and industrial cooperation, reaching several cooperation intentions.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见上海电气集团董事长吴磊
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets with Shanghai Electric Group Chairman Wu Lei
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见上海电气集团董事长吴磊一行，就深化清洁能源、智能制造等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Liaoning Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin met with Wu Lei, Chairman of Shanghai Electric Group, in Shenyang to discuss cooperation in clean energy and smart manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Delegation of German Chamber of Commerce in China
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团，双方就深化经贸合作、优化营商环境等议题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee, met with a delegation of the German Chamber of Commerce in China in Shenyang to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation and improving the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同科威特外交大臣杰拉赫会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Jarrah
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京同科威特外交大臣杰拉赫举行会谈，就双边关系和地区局势交换看法。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Kuwaiti Foreign Minister Jarrah in Beijing to exchange views on bilateral ties and regional situation.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见约旦国王
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets with King Abdullah II of Jordan
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国务院总理李强在北京会见来华进行国事访问的约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世，双方就深化合作、推动中阿关系发展等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Premier Li Qiang met with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who was on a state visit to China, in Beijing. They exchanged views on deepening cooperation and advancing China-Arab relations.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和约旦哈希姆王国关于深化中约战略伙伴关系的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement of the People's Republic of China and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan on Deepening the China-Jordan Strategic Partnership
articles.summary_zh: 约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世于2026年8月18日至24日对中国进行国事访问，习近平主席同其会谈，双方发表联合声明，深化中约战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: Jordan's King Abdullah II paid a state visit to China from Aug 18 to 24, 2026. President Xi Jinping held talks with him, and the two sides issued a joint statement to deepen the China-Jordan strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 我国加速形成全链条科技服务体系
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Building Full-Chain Sci-Tech Service System
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国加快建设科技成果转化全链条服务体系，新成立2家国家制造业创新中心，认定首批卓越级和标准级孵化器，并加紧建设统一技术交易服务平台。
articles.summary_en: Since the start of this year, China has accelerated building a full-chain service system for commercializing sci-tech achievements, including new national manufacturing innovation centers, pilot platforms, incubators, and a unified technology trading platform.

tags.name_en: Commercialization of Scientific and Technological Achievements

tags_en: Commercialization of Scientific and Technological Achievements

articles.title_zh: 创造经得起实践、人民、历史检验的实绩——习近平总书记引领全党深入开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leads Party-wide Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 在习近平总书记亲自指导推动下，全党深入开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，紧扣总要求一体推进学查改，引导党员干部为民造福、实干出政绩。
articles.summary_en: Under Xi Jinping's personal guidance, the whole Party has carried out education on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, promoting learning, inspection, and rectification to better serve the people.

articles.title_zh: 习近平举行仪式欢迎约旦国王访华
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Ceremony to Welcome King of Jordan for State Visit
articles.summary_zh: 国家主席习近平24日下午在人民大会堂举行仪式，欢迎约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世访华。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping held a ceremony at the Great Hall of the People on the afternoon of August 24 to welcome King Abdullah II of Jordan on a state visit.

articles.title_zh: 前7个月我国交通出行397.9亿人次
articles.title_en: China's Cross-Regional Passenger Trips Reach 39.79 Billion in First 7 Months
articles.summary_zh: 今年前7个月，我国跨区域人员流动量397.9亿人次，同比增长0.8%；营业性货运量329.7亿吨，同比增长2.8%；港口货物吞吐量105.6亿吨，同比增长1.3%。
articles.summary_en: In the first 7 months, China's cross-regional passenger trips reached 39.79 billion, up 0.8% YoY; freight volume hit 32.97 billion tons, up 2.8%; port cargo throughput was 10.56 billion tons, up 1.3%.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Deep Affection for the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述习近平总书记关于营造风清气正政治生态的重要论述，强调全面从严治党、反腐倡廉，树立和践行正确政绩观，为推进中国式现代化汇聚力量。
articles.summary_en: The article elaborates on General Secretary Xi Jinping's important remarks on fostering a clean political ecosystem, emphasizing full and rigorous Party self-governance, anti-corruption, and correct views on performance, to gather strength for Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 上半年经济增长4.7%说明了什么？
articles.title_en: What Does the 4.7% GDP Growth in H1 Mean?
articles.summary_zh: 上半年中国GDP同比增长4.7%，符合预期，展现经济韧性，新动能贡献突出，长期向好态势不变。
articles.summary_en: In H1, China's GDP grew 4.7% year-on-year, meeting expectations, showing resilience, with new drivers contributing significantly and long-term positive trends unchanged.

articles.title_zh: 张丹赴东港市调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Conducts Research in Donggang
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日至22日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹赴东港市调研海岛建设发展、文旅资源开发和渔业安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: From August 21 to 22, Zhang Dan, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Dandong Municipal Committee and Mayor, visited Donggang City to inspect island construction, cultural tourism development, and fishery safety production.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Delegation of German Chamber of Commerce in China
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团，就深化经贸合作等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, met with a delegation of member enterprises of the German Chamber of Commerce in China in Shenyang to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德赴基层调研社会工作开展情况
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Visit Communities to Inspect Social Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德赴台江、晋安调研社会工作，强调党建引领基层治理，服务新就业群体。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Guo Ningning, deputy Party secretary of Fujian and Party secretary of Fuzhou, and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected social work in Taijiang and Jin'an, stressing Party-led community governance and services for new employment groups.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 朱艾勇主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting, Zhu Aiyong Presides

articles.title_zh: 王沪宁主持召开全国政协主席会议
articles.title_en: Wang Huning Chairs CPPCC Chairpersons' Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 全国政协第十四届委员会第五十四次主席会议24日在北京召开，王沪宁主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话，审议通过撤销顾学明等四人委员资格。
articles.summary_en: The 54th Chairpersons' Meeting of the 14th CPPCC National Committee was held in Beijing on Aug 24, chaired by Wang Huning. The meeting conveyed Xi Jinping's recent speeches and approved revoking the membership of four members.

articles.title_zh: 中国工程院院士、歼轰7飞机总设计师陈一坚逝世
articles.title_en: Chen Yijian, CAS Member and Chief Designer of JH-7, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 中国工程院院士、歼轰7飞机总设计师陈一坚因病医治无效，于2026年8月24日在西安逝世，享年96岁。
articles.summary_en: Chen Yijian, academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering and chief designer of the JH-7 fighter-bomber, passed away in Xi'an on August 24, 2026, at the age of 96.

articles.title_zh: 城市增韧性 家园更宜居
articles.title_en: Cities Boost Resilience for More Livable Homes
articles.summary_zh: 报道衡水、天津、重庆等地推进海绵城市建设、智慧防汛和数字管线管理，增强城市安全韧性。
articles.summary_en: This report highlights sponge city construction in Hengshui, smart flood control in Tianjin, and digital pipeline management in Chongqing to enhance urban resilience and safety.

articles.title_zh: 国铁南宁局启动应急响应防御台风“紫檀”
articles.title_en: China Railway Nanning Group Activates Emergency Response for Typhoon Zitan
articles.summary_zh: 国铁南宁局针对台风“紫檀”启动应急响应，对受影响线路采取降速、封锁、停运等措施，并做好旅客退改签及接驳保障。
articles.summary_en: China Railway Nanning Group activated emergency response for Typhoon Zitan, implementing speed restrictions, line inspections, and train suspensions to ensure safety, while assisting passengers with refunds and transfers.

articles.title_zh: “人工智能赋能千行百业一线调研行”主题采访活动在南宁启动
articles.title_en: Thematic Interview Activity Kicks Off in Nanning to Explore AI Empowering All Industries
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日上午，“人工智能赋能千行百业一线调研行”主题采访活动在南宁启动，50多名记者和专家学者参加。活动为期5天，将深入广西6市调研AI赋能产业案例。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 24, a themed interview activity on AI empowering all industries was launched in Nanning, with over 50 journalists and experts. The 5-day event will visit 6 cities in Guangxi to explore AI application cases.

tags.name_en: Publicity Department of Guangxi Regional Party Committee

tags_en: Publicity Department of Guangxi Regional Party Committee

articles.title_zh: 多部门联合会商部署防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Hold Joint Consultation to Deploy Flood and Typhoon Prevention Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，国家防总办公室、应急管理部等多部门会商部署防汛防台风工作，并向广西调拨中央救灾物资。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, the Office of the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and the Ministry of Emergency Management held a joint consultation with multiple departments to deploy flood and typhoon prevention work and allocated central disaster relief materials to Guangxi.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能蓬勃发展，会提供哪些就业机会
articles.title_en: AI Boom: What Job Opportunities Will It Create?
articles.summary_zh: 文章探讨人工智能发展带来的就业机遇与挑战，引用中共中央政治局“人工智能+”行动部署，指出将新增大量岗位并降低创业门槛，鼓励劳动者主动适应变化。
articles.summary_en: The article explores job opportunities and challenges from AI development, citing the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau's 'AI+' action, noting new jobs and lower entrepreneurship barriers, and encouraging workers to adapt.

articles.title_zh: “能源的饭碗必须端在自己手里”——能源强国建设见闻
articles.title_en: “The Energy Rice Bowl Must Be Held in Our Own Hands” – Notes on Building an Energy Powerhouse
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报记者走访山东、宁夏、陕西等地能源生产一线，报道中国能源供需总体平衡、新能源快速发展及煤炭清洁高效利用成就，体现习近平总书记“能源的饭碗必须端在自己手里”的战略思想。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reporters visit energy facilities in Shandong, Ningxia and Shaanxi, highlighting China's balanced energy supply, rapid new energy growth and clean coal use under Xi Jinping's energy security strategy.

articles.title_zh: 河北首次启动自然科学基金非共识项目申报
articles.title_en: Hebei Launches First Application for Non-consensus Projects of Natural Science Fund
articles.summary_zh: 日前，河北启动2026年度河北省自然科学基金非共识项目申报，首次设立专项通道，支持高风险高价值原创研究。
articles.summary_en: Hebei has launched the application for 2026 non-consensus projects of its Natural Science Fund, the first special funding channel for high-risk, high-value original research.

articles.title_zh: 河北省成立涉外法律服务团
articles.title_en: Hebei Province Establishes Foreign-Related Legal Service Team
articles.summary_zh: 河北省召开涉外法律服务工作座谈会，部署专项行动方案，成立由66名专家组成的涉外法律服务团，服务企业“走出去”。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province held a meeting on foreign-related legal services, establishing a 66-expert legal service team and deploying an action plan to support enterprises going global.

articles.title_zh: 项目总投资6.59亿元！英派斯在海口国家高新区落地开工
articles.title_en: Impulse Starts Construction of 659 Million Yuan Project in Haikou National High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，英派斯智能健身康养设备研发制造基地在海口国家高新区美安科技新城启动，项目总投资约6.59亿元，并举行全球健康科技生态联盟签约。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, Impulse launched its smart fitness and health equipment R&D and manufacturing base in Haikou National High-tech Zone with a total investment of 659 million yuan, and signed strategic cooperation agreements.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 24日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府常务会议，研究美丽中国先行区建设工作，审议通过《黑龙江省地震预警管理办法》。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Governor Liang Huiling of Heilongjiang chaired a provincial government executive meeting to study the building of a Beautiful China pilot zone and approve the Heilongjiang Earthquake Early Warning Management Measures.

articles.title_zh: 哈尔滨推动产业集群高质量发展（“十五五”开好局起好步）
articles.title_en: Harbin Promotes High-Quality Development of Industrial Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 哈尔滨市深入贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神，聚焦航空航天、高端装备等千亿元级产业集群，推动智能制造、协同创新，加快新型工业化发展。
articles.summary_en: Harbin is promoting high-quality development of industrial clusters, focusing on aerospace and high-end equipment industries, advancing smart manufacturing and collaborative innovation to accelerate new industrialization.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江出台政策措施支持创业带动就业
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Introduces Policy Measures to Boost Entrepreneurship and Employment
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省人社厅出台10条政策措施，聚焦高校毕业生、农民工等重点群体，支持创业带动就业。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province introduced 10 policy measures to support entrepreneurship and employment, targeting college graduates and migrant workers.

tags.name_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security

articles.title_zh: 《噪声源分类指导目录》发布 推动噪声治理迈向精细化
articles.title_en: Noise Source Classification Guidance Catalogue Released to Promote Refined Noise Governance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，生态环境部印发《噪声源分类指导目录》，构建全国统一的噪声源三级分类体系，推动噪声治理精细化。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment recently released the Catalogue of Noise Source Classification Guidance, establishing a unified three-level classification system for noise sources to advance refined noise pollution control.

articles.title_zh: 能源的饭碗必须端在自己手里
articles.title_en: China Must Hold the Energy Rice Bowl Firmly in Its Own Hands
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报报道我国能源强国建设成就，在习近平总书记能源安全新战略指引下，我国能源供需总体平衡，新能源发展迅速，煤炭清洁高效利用，端牢能源饭碗。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports on China's energy security achievements under Xi Jinping's new energy strategy, with balanced supply and demand, rapid new energy growth, and clean coal utilization.

articles.title_zh: 自治区第七届残疾人运动会暨特奥会开幕 时光辉宣布开幕
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia's 7th Disabled Persons' Games and Special Olympics Opens; Shi Guanghui Declares It Open
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日晚，自治区第七届残疾人运动会暨特奥会在包头开幕，自治区党委副书记时光辉宣布开幕，苏和致开幕词。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of August 23, the 7th Regional Games for Persons with Disabilities and Special Olympics opened in Baotou. Shi Guanghui, deputy secretary of the regional Party committee, declared the games open, and Su He delivered an opening speech.

articles.title_zh: 石嘴山市整合29个领域213项检查事项
articles.title_en: Shizuishan Integrates 213 Inspection Items Across 29 Fields
articles.summary_zh: 石嘴山市今年整合29个领域213项检查事项，推行‘721’工作法，办理免罚案件843件，以规范执法优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: This year, Shizuishan integrated 213 inspection items across 29 fields and adopted the '721' work method, handling 843 penalty-free cases to improve the business environment through standardized law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 山东印发指导意见规范基层议事协商
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues Guidelines to Standardize Grassroots Deliberation
articles.summary_zh: 山东省委社会工作部近日印发指导意见，健全党组织主导的基层议事协商制度体系，推动基层治理效能提升。
articles.summary_en: Shandong Provincial Party Committee's Social Work Department issued guidelines to improve the party-led deliberation system at the grassroots level, enhancing governance efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 陕西出台若干措施推进服务业扩能提质
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Issues Measures to Boost Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省人民政府日前印发《陕西省推进服务业扩能提质若干措施》，从壮大科技服务业、发展软件和信息服务业、规范平台经济等方面促进服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Shaanxi Provincial Government issued measures to promote high-quality development of the service industry, covering technology services, software and information services, and platform economy.

articles.title_zh: 云南启动中药材种业创新发展科技计划项目
articles.title_en: Yunnan Launches Science and Technology Program for Innovation and Development of Traditional Chinese Medicine Seed Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，云南省中药材种业创新发展科技计划项目启动会在云南农业大学举行，18个项目全面启动，聚焦种质资源保护、育种技术创新等关键环节。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, the launch meeting of Yunnan's science and technology program for innovative development of traditional Chinese medicine seed industry was held at Yunnan Agricultural University, with 18 projects fully initiated, focusing on key areas such as germplasm resource conservation and breeding technology innovation.

articles.title_zh: 超强台风“沙德尔”登陆我国？专家解析今年台风缘何偏多
articles.title_en: Super Typhoon Shadel to Hit China? Experts Explain Why Typhoons Are More Frequent This Year
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，台风“沙德尔”加强为超强台风，预计27日前后影响华东沿海；中央气象台首席预报员张玲解析今年台风偏多与厄尔尼诺有关。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, Typhoon Shadel intensified into a super typhoon and is expected to affect the East China coast around August 27; chief forecaster Zhang Ling of the Central Meteorological Observatory attributes the frequent typhoons to El Niño.

articles.title_zh: 习近平作出重要指示强调巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes Consolidating Education on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，中共中央总书记习近平就巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果作出重要指示，中央党的建设工作领导小组召开会议，蔡奇主持，李希出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, Xi Jinping made important instructions on consolidating the outcomes of the study and education on the correct view of political achievements. The Central Leading Group for Party Building held a meeting chaired by Cai Qi, with Li Xi attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 我国钢铁产业发展如何实现转型蝶变？
articles.title_en: How Has China's Steel Industry Achieved a Transformational Leap?
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾我国钢铁产业从规模领先到高质量发展的转型历程，涵盖产能优化、布局集中、产品升级、智能化和绿色革命，强调中国钢铁已深刻改变全球产业格局。
articles.summary_en: This article reviews the transformation of China's steel industry from scale leadership to high-quality development, covering capacity optimization, layout consolidation, product upgrades, smart manufacturing, and green revolution, highlighting its global impact.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺阿拉姆吉尔就任孟加拉国总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulations to Alamgir on Assuming Presidency of Bangladesh
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，国家主席习近平致电阿拉姆吉尔，祝贺他就任孟加拉国总统，表示愿推进中孟命运共同体建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Alamgir on his assumption of the presidency of Bangladesh, expressing willingness to advance the China-Bangladesh community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Jordan's King Abdullah II
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的约旦国王阿卜杜拉二世举行会谈，并为其举行欢迎仪式。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 24, President Xi Jinping held talks with King Abdullah II of Jordan, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, followed by a welcoming ceremony.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 中国语言资源保护工程成果展示馆开馆
articles.title_en: China Language Resource Protection Project Achievement Hall Opens
articles.summary_zh: 8月24日，位于湖南长沙的中国语言资源保护工程成果展示馆开馆，展出全国汉语方言、少数民族语言和语言文化1800余点语料，标志语保工程成果实现从“数据库”向“活态展”的跨越。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 24, China's Language Resource Protection Project Achievement Hall opened in Changsha, displaying 1,800+ language and culture items, marking a leap from database to living display.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对福建省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level-IV Flood Emergency Response for Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 水利部8月24日对福建省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，并派出工作组赴台风暴雨洪水防御一线。
articles.summary_en: On August 24, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level-IV flood emergency response for Fujian and dispatched a work team to the front line.

articles.title_zh: 学习快评丨树立和践行正确政绩观必须久久为功
articles.title_en: Commentary: Cultivating and Practicing Correct View on Political Achievements Requires Long-term Persistence
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近日就树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育作出重要指示，强调树立和践行正确政绩观是一项长期任务，必须久久为功，巩固拓展学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping recently made important instructions on learning and education on establishing and practicing the correct view on political achievements, emphasizing that it is a long-term task that requires sustained effort to consolidate and expand the achievements.

articles.title_zh: 美国友人“赛考斯”时隔20余年重返中国：我回到了我的第二个家
articles.title_en: American Friend 'Saikos' Returns to China After Over 20 Years: I'm Back in My Second Home
articles.summary_zh: 应中国教育国际交流协会邀请，支持中国治沙事业的美国友人赛考斯8月23日凌晨抵达北京，将于8月23日至9月1日访问北京、内蒙古、河南三地，与治沙英雄殷玉珍重逢。
articles.summary_en: At the invitation of the China Education Association for International Exchange, American friend 'Saikos', who supported China's desertification control, arrived in Beijing early on Aug 23. He will visit Beijing, Inner Mongolia and Henan from Aug 23 to Sep 1 to reunite with desertification fighter Yin Yuzhen.

articles.title_zh: 发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用
articles.title_en: Give Full Play to the Role of Party Branches as Battle Fortresses
articles.summary_zh: 2006年8月超强台风“桑美”袭击浙江苍南，时任浙江省委书记习近平深入灾区慰问，强调“一个党员一面旗，发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用”。文章回顾了党的十八大以来党员队伍建设成就。
articles.summary_en: In August 2006, when Typhoon Saomai struck Cangnan, Zhejiang, Xi Jinping, then Zhejiang Provincial Party Secretary, visited the disaster area and stressed that every Party member should be a banner and Party branches should play their role as battle fortresses. The article reviews Party building achievements since the 18th CPC National Congress.
