tags_en: Fighting Fortress Role of Primary-Level Party Organizations

articles.title_zh: 全国多个城市密集出台新政 你的住房公积金有这些新用途→
articles.title_en: Multiple Cities Roll Out New Housing Provident Fund Policies with Expanded Uses
articles.summary_zh: 全国多个城市密集出台住房公积金优化政策，将装修、物业费等纳入提取范围，并放宽灵活就业人员缴存门槛；新修订的《住房公积金管理条例》将于9月20日施行。
articles.summary_en: Cities across China have rolled out optimized housing provident fund policies, expanding withdrawal uses to include renovation and property fees, and easing contribution access for flexible workers. The revised Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management will take effect on September 20.

articles.title_zh: 美国友人“赛考斯”抵北京：美中两国可以携手共建美好世界
articles.title_en: American Friend 'Sakolsky' Arrives in Beijing: US and China Can Jointly Build a Better World
articles.summary_zh: 应中国教育国际交流协会邀请，支持中国治沙事业的美国友人赛考斯8月23日凌晨抵达北京，开启10天中国之旅，将看望治沙英雄殷玉珍并见证治沙成果。
articles.summary_en: American friend Sakolsky, invited by the Chinese Education Association for International Exchange, arrived in Beijing early on Aug 23 to start a 10-day tour, planning to visit desertification hero Yin Yuzhen and witness afforestation achievements.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨拓展共建“一带一路”合作新空间 铺就共赢之路
articles.title_en: New Thought Leads New Journey | Expanding New Space for Belt and Road Cooperation, Paving a Win-Win Road
articles.summary_zh: 本文报道今年我国与共建“一带一路”国家深化合作，中欧班列提速、新三样出口增长，绿色数字合作拓展，强调共商共建共享，铺就共赢之路。
articles.summary_en: China deepens BRI cooperation: faster China-Europe freight trains, rising new-energy exports, and expanded green/digital projects, pursuing win-win outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 中阿启动干旱、荒漠化和土地退化防治五年行动计划
articles.title_en: China and Arab Nations Launch Five-Year Action Plan to Combat Drought, Desertification and Land Degradation
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，中阿干旱、荒漠化和土地退化国际研究中心指导委员会第二次会议在乌兰巴托召开，正式发布五年行动计划，深化荒漠化防治合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the second meeting of the Steering Committee of the China-Arab Research Center on Drought, Desertification and Land Degradation was held in Ulaanbaatar, officially launching a five-year action plan to deepen cooperation in desertification control.

articles.title_zh: “能演示”走向“能干活”——从两场世界级大会看中国机器人产业新气象
articles.title_en: From 'Demonstration' to 'Real Work': China's Robot Industry Shows New Vitality at Two Global Conferences
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，第二届世界人形机器人运动会在北京开幕，2026世界机器人大会同期举办，展现中国机器人产业从演示走向规模化应用的新趋势。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 22, the 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games opened in Beijing alongside the 2026 World Robot Conference, showcasing China's robot industry moving from demonstrations to large-scale applications.

articles.title_zh: 消费品以旧换新政策惠及1.78亿人次
articles.title_en: Consumer Trade-in Policy Benefits 178 Million People
articles.summary_zh: 财政部今年下达消费品以旧换新资金1875亿元，带动相关商品销售额约1.32万亿元，惠及1.78亿人次。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance allocated 187.5 billion yuan for consumer trade-ins, driving sales of about 1.32 trillion yuan and benefiting 178 million people.

articles.title_zh: 加快现代化产业体系建设
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Construction of a Modern Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述我国加快现代化产业体系建设进展：前7月规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.3%，新动能贡献率50.9%；7月30日中央政治局会议部署加快现代化产业体系建设和'人工智能+'行动。
articles.summary_en: China's industrial value-added grew 5.3% year-on-year in the first seven months, with new drivers contributing 50.9% to growth. The CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting on July 30 called for accelerating the modern industrial system and AI+ actions.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能进课堂，如何学得更好（解码“十五五”专项规划）
articles.title_en: AI in Classrooms: How to Learn Better (Decoding the 15th Five-Year Plan Special Program)
articles.summary_zh: 教育部等五部门印发《“人工智能+教育”行动计划》，推动人工智能全学段教育，各地中小学和高校开设相关课程，提升学生人工智能素养。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education and four other departments issued an action plan for AI-plus-education, promoting AI education across all schooling stages, with schools and universities offering relevant courses to improve students' AI literacy.

articles.title_zh: 站在新起点 “一规引未来”
articles.title_en: Standing at a New Starting Point: A Plan Leads the Future
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，澳门特区政府正式发布《经济和社会发展第三个五年规划（2026—2030年）》，主动对接国家“十五五”规划，旨在推动经济适度多元发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Macao SAR Government officially released its Third Five-Year Plan for Economic and Social Development (2026-2030), aligning with the national 15th Five-Year Plan to promote moderate economic diversification.

articles.title_zh: 一“出”一“进”，看高水平开放落地生根（深入实施自由贸易试验区提升战略）
articles.title_en: China's High-Level Opening-Up Gains Momentum Through Beijing Free Trade Zone Innovations
articles.summary_zh: 北京自贸试验区通过制度创新，在数据出境、跨境投融资和罕见病药品进口等方面取得突破，促进高水平开放。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Pilot Free Trade Zone has made breakthroughs in data outflow, cross-border investment, and rare-disease drug imports through institutional innovation, advancing high-level opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 搭台铺路，让青春光彩绽放
articles.title_en: Building Stages and Paving Roads to Let Youth Shine
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，澳门特区政府聚焦青年就业创业，多部门协作推出岗位配对、就业+培训、内地实习等系列措施，全力推动青年发展。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, the Macao SAR Government has focused on youth employment and entrepreneurship, implementing a series of measures such as job matching, employment-plus-training, and internship programs in the mainland to promote youth development.

articles.title_zh: 师徒三代创新“夺冠”记
articles.title_en: Three Generations of Mentors and Apprentices Win Innovation Crown
articles.summary_zh: 报道中车长客李万君劳模创新工作室师徒三代焊接工人，传承技能报国精神，攻克高铁转向架焊接难题，推动中国制造创新。
articles.summary_en: Three generations of welders at CRRC Changchun, led by Li Wanjun, mastered key bogie welding for high-speed trains, showing skill-driven patriotism and boosting China's manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 中国是世界经济增长的积极贡献者和强大稳定锚
articles.title_en: China Is an Active Contributor and Anchor of Stability for Global Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报发表评论指出，中国经济顶压前行、持续向新向优发展，对世界经济增长贡献率保持在30%左右，是全球产供链的稳定锚和互利共赢的实践者。
articles.summary_en: A People's Daily commentary says China's economy progresses steadily despite pressure, contributing about 30% to global growth, serving as a stabilizer of supply chains and a practitioner of win-win cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Delegation of German Chamber of Commerce in China
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见中国德国商会会员企业代表团，就深化中德经贸合作、推动辽宁全面振兴等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee, met with a delegation of the German Chamber of Commerce in China in Shenyang to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation and promoting Liaoning's comprehensive revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 中国是世界经济增长的积极贡献者和强大稳定锚
articles.title_en: China Is a Positive Contributor and Strong Stabilizer to Global Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来中国经济顶压前行，上半年增长4.7%，是世界经济增长的主要引擎和稳定锚，为全球发展提供确定性。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, China's economy has advanced against pressure, growing 4.7% in H1, serving as the main engine and stabilizer of world economic growth and providing certainty for global development.

articles.title_zh: 今年以来消费品以旧换新政策惠及1.78亿人次
articles.title_en: Consumer Goods Trade-in Policy Benefits 178 Million People This Year
articles.summary_zh: 财政部下达消费品以旧换新资金1875亿元，带动相关商品销售额约1.32万亿元，惠及1.78亿人次；同时加快超长期特别国债发行使用，支持重大项目建设。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance allocated 187.5 billion yuan for consumer goods trade-ins, driving sales of about 1.32 trillion yuan and benefiting 178 million people. It also accelerated ultra-long-term special treasury bond issuance for major projects.

articles.title_zh: 网上商品和服务零售额前7月增4.8%
articles.title_en: Online Retail Sales of Goods and Services Up 4.8% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 1-7月全国网上商品和服务零售额增长4.8%，对社会零售总额增长贡献率超五成，电子商务稳定发展，线上线下融合激发消费潜能。
articles.summary_en: In the first seven months, online retail sales of goods and services in China grew 4.8%, contributing over half of the growth in total social retail sales. E-commerce remains stable and innovative, integrating online and offline channels to unleash consumption potential.

articles.title_zh: 我国矿山生态保护修复向绿向新
articles.title_en: China's Mine Ecological Restoration Moves Toward Green and New Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，国家发展改革委表示，我国262个资源型城市持续推进矿山绿色转型，已建成国家级绿色矿山699个。下一步将加快形成“治理—增值—反哺”良性循环。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 23, the National Development and Reform Commission said China's 262 resource-based cities are advancing green transformation of mines, with 699 national-level green mines built. It will speed up a virtuous cycle of governance-value-reinvestment.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见约旦副首相兼外交大臣萨法迪
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Jordanian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Safadi
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅8月23日在北京会见陪同约旦国王访华的约旦副首相兼外交大臣萨法迪。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, met in Beijing with Jordanian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Safadi, who accompanied King Abdullah II on his visit to China.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见上海电气集团董事长吴磊
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Wu Lei, Chairman of Shanghai Electric
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见上海电气集团董事长吴磊，双方就深化合作、清洁能源、智能制造等展开交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Liaoning Party Secretary Xu Kunlin met with Wu Lei, Chairman of Shanghai Electric, in Shenyang to discuss cooperation in clean energy and intelligent manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市组织开展县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部廉政教育活动
articles.title_en: Huai'an Organizes Integrity Education for County-Level Party Committee Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，淮安市组织县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部赴江苏省廉政教育中心和周恩来纪念馆开展廉政教育活动，市委书记史志军与全体人员集体谈话。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Huai'an organized an integrity education activity for county-level party committee leaders, visiting Jiangsu Provincial Integrity Education Center and Zhou Enlai Memorial Hall. Party Secretary Shi Zhijun had a collective talk with participants.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市组织开展县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部廉政教育活动
articles.title_en: Huaian Holds Integrity Education Activity for Party Committee Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，淮安市组织县区（园区）党（工）委领导干部廉政教育活动，市委书记史志军与全体人员集体谈话，强调推进党风廉政建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Huaian organized an integrity education activity for party committee leaders of counties and parks. Party Secretary Shi Zhijun held a collective talk, emphasizing strict party discipline and anti-corruption efforts.

articles.title_zh: 逯峰带队赴茂名市考察学习
articles.title_en: Lu Feng Leads Delegation to Maoming for Study Tour
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日上午，汕尾市委书记逯峰率团赴茂名考察，学习“百千万工程”、省运会筹办等经验，茂名市委书记王雄飞陪同。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 23, Shanwei Party chief Lu Feng led a delegation to Maoming to learn experiences in the "Baiqianwan" project and provincial games preparation, with Maoming Party chief Wang Xiongfei accompanying.

articles.title_zh: 第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: Eighth 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for Leading Cadres Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，泰州市举办第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，专家安冉就具身智能产业作专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬等参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Taizhou held the eighth session of the 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for leading cadres. Expert An Ran lectured on the embodied intelligence industry, attended by Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong and others.

articles.title_zh: 第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: 8th Frontier Lecture for Leading Cadres Held in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，泰州市举行第八期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，邀请专家安冉作人工智能（具身智能）产业专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬等市领导参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Taizhou held its 8th Frontier Lecture for leading cadres, featuring expert An Ran lecturing on embodied AI industry; Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong attended.

articles.title_zh: 2026集成电路（无锡）创新发展大会筹备工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Preparatory Work Meeting for 2026 Wuxi Integrated Circuit Innovation Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，市长蒋锋主持召开2026集成电路（无锡）创新发展大会筹备工作会议，强调精益求精做好各项筹备工作，努力办成高水平行业盛会。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Mayor Jiang Feng chaired the preparatory meeting for the 2026 Wuxi Integrated Circuit Innovation and Development Conference, emphasizing meticulous preparations to host a high-level industry event.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Ye Niuping Chairs Municipal Government Party Group (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，西安市市长叶牛平主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记在上海考察时的重要讲话精神，研究推进城市更新和基层治理工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xi'an Mayor Ye Niuping chaired the municipal government party group (expanded) meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech during his Shanghai inspection and to advance urban renewal and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Ye Niuping Chairs Xi'an Municipal Government Standing Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，西安市市长叶牛平主持召开市政府常务会议，研究国土空间规划动态维护、政务服务“一网通办”、算力网建设等事项，部署提升城市智慧化水平和职业教育发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Xi'an Mayor Ye Niuping chaired a municipal government standing meeting to discuss dynamic maintenance of territorial planning, integrated online government services, computing network construction, and vocational education development.

articles.title_zh: 襄阳市委书记调整，关志鸥：这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的
articles.title_en: Xiangyang Party Secretary Adjusted; Guan Zhi'ou: Decision Made After Deliberation by Provincial Committee
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月23日，湖北省委宣布调整襄阳市委书记，省委常委关志鸥表示这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, 2026, Hubei Provincial Committee announced the adjustment of Xiangyang's Party Secretary, with provincial official Guan Zhi'ou stating it was made after repeated deliberation.

articles.title_zh: 襄阳市委书记调整：彭勇接任
articles.title_en: Peng Yong Appointed Xiangyang Party Secretary, Replacing Wu Haitao
articles.summary_zh: 8月23日，湖北襄阳市召开领导干部会议，宣布省委决定：彭勇任襄阳市委书记，吴海涛不再担任。省委书记关志鸥称这是省委反复酝酿、慎重研究决定的。
articles.summary_en: On August 23, Xiangyang held a cadre meeting announcing the provincial committee's decision to appoint Peng Yong as Xiangyang party secretary, replacing Wu Haitao. Hubei Party Secretary Guan Zhi'ou said the decision was made after careful deliberation.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！南海部分海域进行实弹射击，禁止驶入
articles.title_en: Navigation Warning: Live-Fire Exercise in Parts of South China Sea, Entry Prohibited
articles.summary_zh: 湛江海事局发布航行警告，8月24日至28日每天8时至18时，南海部分海域进行实弹射击，禁止驶入。
articles.summary_en: Zhanjiang Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that live-fire exercises will be held in parts of the South China Sea from August 24 to 28, 0800-1800 daily, and entry is prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 两部门对福建启动防汛防台风四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Two Departments Activate Level-IV Emergency Response for Flood and Typhoon in Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，国家防总、应急管理部针对第20号台风“简拉维”影响，对福建启动防汛防台风四级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 22, China's State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters and Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood and typhoon in Fujian due to Typhoon Janavi.

articles.title_zh: 福建“十五五”商务发展规划出台
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues 15th Five-Year Commercial Development Plan
articles.summary_zh: 日前，福建省人民政府印发《福建省“十五五”商务发展规划》，提出推动数智赋能商务发展，建设消费大省、贸易强省、引资大省、开放强省。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial People's Government issued the 15th Five-Year Commercial Development Plan, aiming to boost digitalized commerce and build a strong province in consumption, trade, investment attraction, and openness.

articles.title_zh: 发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用
articles.title_en: Give Full Play to the Combat Fortress Role of Party Branches
articles.summary_zh: 2006年8月，时任浙江省委书记习近平在超强台风“桑美”袭击浙江苍南时，深入重灾区察看灾情，强调要发挥好支部的战斗堡垒作用。
articles.summary_en: In August 2006, Xi Jinping, then Party Secretary of Zhejiang, visited the disaster area hit by Typhoon Saomai in Cangnan, Zhejiang, and stressed the role of Party branches as battle fortresses.

articles.title_zh: 从工厂车间到高速服务区，济南绿色低碳转型再提速
articles.title_en: From Factory Workshops to Highway Service Areas: Jinan Accelerates Green Low-Carbon Transition
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，山东省委书记林武赴济南调研，走访中国重汽和章丘服务区重卡充电示范站，强调绿色低碳转型全链条推进。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu inspected Jinan, visiting Sinotruk and a truck charging demo station, emphasizing whole-chain green transition.

articles.title_zh: 加拿大宣布对美等额反制关税将于9月8日生效
articles.title_en: Canada Announces Retaliatory Tariffs on US to Take Effect Sept 8
articles.summary_zh: 加拿大总理卡尼22日宣布，鉴于美国对200亿美元加拿大商品征收50%关税，加方将于9月8日实施等额报复性关税，涵盖乳制品、钢铁、家电等领域。
articles.summary_en: Canadian PM Carney announced on Aug 22 that Canada will impose matching retaliatory tariffs on Sept 8 in response to US 50% tariffs on C$20 billion of Canadian goods, covering dairy, steel, appliances and more.

articles.title_zh: 多部门联合会商部署防汛防台风工作
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Hold Joint Consultation on Flood and Typhoon Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，国家防办、应急管理部组织多部门及省份联合会商，研判台风“沙德尔”“紫檀”及强降雨形势，部署防汛防台风工作，并维持或启动多项应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the National Flood Control Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management convened a joint consultation with multiple departments and provinces to assess typhoons 'Saudel' and 'Zitan' and heavy rainfall, deploying flood and typhoon prevention measures and maintaining or activating emergency responses.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇：创新管理体制机制 提升园区运营服务水平和综合效益
articles.title_en: Yin Yong: Innovate Management Systems to Improve Park Operations and Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 北京市市长殷勇日前到大兴区调研市管企业产业园区，强调创新管理体制机制，提升园区运营服务水平和综合效益，培育新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: Yin Yong, Mayor of Beijing, recently visited Daxing District to inspect state-owned enterprise industrial parks, emphasizing innovative management systems to enhance operations and foster new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜这是不是你向往的“慢充”闽生活？
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Trip: Is This the 'Slow-Charge' Fujian Life You Yearn For?
articles.summary_zh: 报道福建文旅消费持续升温，深度游兴起，福建通过活化老城、山海赋能等举措打造“闽式”生活体验，释放消费潜力。
articles.summary_en: Reports on Fujian's booming cultural tourism consumption, with deep travel rising. Fujian is enhancing old cities and coastal resources to create the 'Fujian-style' life and unleash consumption potential.

articles.title_zh: 罗文主持召开河北省委理论学习中心组学习会
articles.title_en: Luo Wen Chairs Hebei Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，河北省委书记罗文主持召开省委理论学习中心组学习会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平经济思想，推动全省经济持续向新向优向好发展，努力实现“十五五”良好开局。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Luo Wen, Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, chaired the theoretical learning center group meeting, emphasizing implementation of Xi Jinping's economic thought to promote sustained, high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 太空算力技术创新中心在雄安成立
articles.title_en: Space Computing Technology Innovation Center Established in Xiong'an
articles.summary_zh: 由北京邮电大学、中国星网数科、蓝箭鸿擎共建的太空算力技术创新中心在雄安新区揭牌成立，推动太空算力产学研深度融合。
articles.summary_en: The Space Computing Technology Innovation Center, co-founded by Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, China SatNet Digital Technology, and Landspace Hongqing, was inaugurated in Xiong'an New Area to deepen integration of industry, academia, research, and application.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对海南等三地启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Hainan and Two Other Regions
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，水利部对广东、广西、海南启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，应对台风“紫檀”带来的强降雨和洪水风险。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hainan in response to heavy rain and flood risks from Typhoon "Zitan".

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在省发展改革委调研时强调
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Surveys Provincial DRC, Stresses Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，省委书记冯飞调研省发展改革委并召开座谈会，强调要树立和践行正确政绩观，统筹谋划经济发展和项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei visited the Provincial Development and Reform Commission and chaired a symposium, stressing the need to establish a correct view of political achievements and coordinate economic development and project construction.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台12项金融举措赋能城市更新
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Rolls Out 12 Financial Measures to Boost Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省地方金融管理局、省住建厅等五部门近日联合发布《江苏省金融支持城市更新工作若干措施》，推出12项举措优化城市更新项目金融服务。

articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬到靖江市专题调研政法工作，强调坚持新时代枫桥经验，提升基层社会治理现代化水平。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of Taizhou Municipal CPC Committee, conducted a special survey of political and legal work in Jingjiang, emphasizing the Fengqiao Experience and improving grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 我市召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会
articles.title_en: Wuxi Holds Meeting on Rectification of Malpractices and Corruption Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，无锡市长蒋锋主持召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作推进会，听取汇报并部署下阶段重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Mayor Jiang Feng of Wuxi chaired a meeting on rectifying misconduct and corruption around the people, hearing reports and deploying key tasks for the next stage.

articles.title_zh: 联合国人工智能与人类发展全球对话在西安举办
articles.title_en: UN Global Dialogue on AI and Human Development Held in Xi'an
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日至21日，联合国人工智能与人类发展系列全球对话第三场活动在陕西西安举办，联合国常务副秘书长阿明娜、陕西省省长赵刚致辞。
articles.summary_en: From August 20 to 21, the third global dialogue on AI and human development was held in Xi'an, Shaanxi, with UN Deputy Secretary-General Amina Mohammed and Governor Zhao Gang addressing the event.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平会见奥地利维也纳州联邦商会副主席安德烈·施托尔茨莱希纳
articles.title_en: Ye Niuping Meets Vice Chairman Andreas Stolzlechner of Austrian Vienna State Federal Chamber of Commerce
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，西安市市长叶牛平会见奥地利维也纳州联邦商会副主席安德烈·施托尔茨莱希纳一行，双方就深化友好交流与经贸合作交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Xi'an Mayor Ye Niuping met with Andreas Stolzlechner, Vice Chairman of the Vienna State Federal Chamber of Commerce, and his delegation to discuss deepening friendly exchanges and cooperation in trade, technology, and culture.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见长三角国创中心主任刘庆
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet Director of Yangtze Delta National Innovation Center
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日下午，市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜在盐会见长三角国家技术创新中心主任刘庆，双方就科技创新、产业协同等合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 21, Municipal Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Acting Mayor Wu Wei met with Liu Qing, Director of the Yangtze Delta National Innovation Center, in Yancheng to discuss cooperation in technological innovation and industrial synergy.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见建行江苏省分行行长邹致师
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet with CCB Jiangsu Branch President Zou Zhishi
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜会见建行江苏省分行行长邹致师一行，双方就重大项目、科技创新、民营企业等开展务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 21, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Acting Mayor Wu Wei met with President Zou Zhishi of CCB Jiangsu Branch to discuss practical cooperation on major projects, technological innovation, and private enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 风电国创中心技术委员会会议在盐召开
articles.title_en: Wind Power National Innovation Center Technical Committee Meeting Held in Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，风力发电国家技术创新中心第一届技术委员会第二次会议在盐城召开。市委书记严汉平致辞，院士陈学庚、侯保荣出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the second meeting of the first technical committee of the National Innovation Center for Wind Power was held in Yancheng. Secretary Yan Hanping delivered a speech, attended by academicians Chen Xuegeng and Hou Baorong.

articles.title_zh: 姚华明到盖州市调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作
articles.title_en: Yao Huaming Visits Gaizhou to Review Campaign Against Corruption and Misconduct Around the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，营口市委书记姚华明深入盖州市调研群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作，强调要坚决纠治基层“蝇贪蚁腐”，以实际成效取信于民。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, Yingkou Party chief Yao Huaming visited Gaizhou to inspect the campaign against corruption and misconduct around the people, stressing resolute action against grassroots corruption.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on New-Generation Communication Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报，部署清理拖欠企业账款、改善空气质量等工作，并审议通过两项条例草案。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to hear reports on new-generation communication network construction, deploy efforts to clear overdue payments to enterprises and improve air quality, and approve two draft regulations.

articles.title_zh: 余钢到赤坎区调研督导
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Conducts Research and Supervision in Chikan District
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，湛江市委书记余钢到赤坎区调研督导群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治及蚊媒传染病防控工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Yu Gang, Secretary of the Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee, visited Chikan District to supervise the rectification of misconduct and corruption around the people and the prevention of mosquito-borne diseases.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研时强调 以扎实举措推进绿色低碳转型 推动高质量发展不断取得新成效
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Emphasizes Solid Measures for Green Low-Carbon Transition During Jinan Research Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研，强调推进绿色低碳转型和高质量发展，考察新能源重卡企业和示范站，并走访文明村。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Shandong Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu inspected Jinan, stressing green low-carbon transition and high-quality development, visiting new energy truck firms and a demonstration station, plus a model village.

articles.title_zh: 属相和董事长不合就要被裁？民生人寿回应
articles.title_en: Minsheng Life Responds to Rumors of Layoffs Based on Zodiac Signs
articles.summary_zh: 8月22日，民生人寿回应网传裁员消息，称已对造谣内容证据保全，将追究法律责任。此前有爆料称董事长将所有与自身生肖不合的员工裁掉。
articles.summary_en: On August 22, Minsheng Life responded to online layoff rumors, saying it had preserved evidence of the false content and would pursue legal liability. Earlier reports alleged the chairman laid off employees whose zodiac signs clashed with his own.

articles.title_zh: 无惧风浪 中国经济高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: Fearless of Wind and Waves, China's Economy Advances Steadily in High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 报道习近平总书记强调统筹发展和安全，中国经济上半年同比增长4.7%，展现强大韧性，并列举能源、粮食、科技创新等领域的应对举措与成就。
articles.summary_en: The report highlights Xi Jinping's emphasis on coordinating development and security. China's H1 GDP grew 4.7% year-on-year, showing resilience, with achievements in energy, food security, and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨新渔光曲 闽东大黄鱼游出大产业
articles.title_en: New Fishery Ode: Large Yellow Croaker Industry Thrives in East China's Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 福建宁德发展深水抗风浪网箱，科技赋能大黄鱼养殖，并延伸加工、文旅等产业链，带动30多万人就业。
articles.summary_en: Ningde, Fujian develops deep-water anti-wave cages, boosts large yellow croaker farming with technology, and extends the industry chain to processing and cultural tourism, employing over 300,000 people.

articles.title_zh: “兰州拉面”改换“青海拉面”后，国家统计局青海调查总队算经济账
articles.title_en: Qinghai Survey Team Calculates Economic Impact of Rebranding 'Lanzhou Lamian' as 'Qinghai Lamian'
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局青海调查总队发布分析显示，青海拉面产业规模庞大，带动牦牛藏羊等高原畜产品发展，成为畜牧市场“稳定器”，助力农牧民增收。
articles.summary_en: The Qinghai Survey Team of the National Bureau of Statistics published an analysis showing the Qinghai lamian industry's large scale, driving highland livestock products like yak and Tibetan sheep and acting as a stabilizer for the livestock market, boosting farmers' incomes.

articles.title_zh: 经自查整顿，中华儿童文化艺术促进会撤销43个二级单位
articles.title_en: China Children's Culture and Arts Promotion Association Revokes 43 Subsidiary Units After Self-Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 中华儿童文化艺术促进会根据中央社会工作部、文化和旅游部、民政部有关精神，经第七届理事会会议决定，分两批撤销43个二级单位。
articles.summary_en: The China Children's Culture and Arts Promotion Association, following the guidance of the Central Social Work Department, Ministry of Culture and Tourism, and Ministry of Civil Affairs, resolved to revoke 43 subsidiary units in two batches.

articles.title_zh: 纠错有奖：湖北孝感市博物馆邀请观众给展陈内容“找茬”
articles.title_en: Xiaogan Museum Invites Visitors to 'Find Faults' in Exhibits with Rewards
articles.summary_zh: 湖北孝感市博物馆推出纠错有奖活动，邀请观众反馈展陈问题。此前国家文物局发文要求加强博物馆陈列展览内容审核，多地博物馆已开展自查。
articles.summary_en: Xiaogan Museum in Hubei launches a reward campaign inviting visitors to report exhibit errors, following a National Cultural Heritage Administration notice on strengthening content review. Museums nationwide have begun self-inspections.

articles.title_zh: 多地博物馆启动陈列展览内容自查校对：展板内容逐字通读，及时修正
articles.title_en: Multiple Museums Launch Self-Checks on Exhibition Content: Reading Panels Word by Word, Timely Corrections
articles.summary_zh: 近日，为落实国家文物局通知，福建泰宁、新疆塔城等地博物馆启动陈列展览内容自查，逐字核对展板，及时修正问题。
articles.summary_en: Recently, to implement the National Cultural Heritage Administration's notice, museums in Taining, Fujian and Tacheng, Xinjiang initiated self-checks of exhibition content, reading panels word by word and correcting issues promptly.

articles.title_zh: “不得以本会文化顾问对外宣传”，又一商会与假总编张龙切割
articles.title_en: Another Chamber of Commerce Cuts Ties with Fake Editor-in-Chief Zhang Long
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省四川南部商会宣布与假总编张龙切割，禁止其以文化顾问名义对外宣传；此前已有多家商会与张龙撇清关系。
articles.summary_en: The Shaanxi Sichuan Southern Chamber of Commerce announced cutting ties with fake editor-in-chief Zhang Long, prohibiting him from using his cultural adviser title. Several other chambers had already distanced themselves from Zhang.

articles.title_zh: 理顺部门职责边界，辽宁多地组建数据和政务服务局
articles.title_en: Liaoning Sets Up Data and Government Service Bureaus in Multiple Cities
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁省数据局更名后，朝阳、盘锦、锦州等多地组建数据和政务服务局，进一步理顺职责，提升政务服务效能。
articles.summary_en: After Liaoning Provincial Data Bureau was renamed, multiple cities including Chaoyang, Panjin, and Jinzhou established Data and Government Service Bureaus to streamline responsibilities and improve administrative efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 守护自然资源 建设美丽中国（权威发布）
articles.title_en: Safeguard Natural Resources, Build a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国务院新闻办举行中外记者见面会，5位自然资源领域代表围绕“守护自然资源，建设美丽中国”交流，分享测绘、防灾、深潜、耕地保护、治沙等经验。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the State Council Information Office held a press meeting where five representatives from the natural resources sector exchanged views on "Safeguarding Natural Resources, Building a Beautiful China," sharing experiences in surveying, disaster prevention, deep-sea diving, farmland protection, and desertification control.

articles.title_zh: 天津市代表团来甘对接东西部协作工作
articles.title_en: Tianjin Delegation Visits Gansu for East-West Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日至21日，天津市代表团来甘对接东西部协作工作，两省市在兰州举行工作交流座谈会，胡昌升、张工讲话，任振鹤主持。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 20-21, a Tianjin delegation visited Gansu to discuss East-West cooperation. A forum was held in Lanzhou with leaders Hu Changsheng and Zhang Gong speaking, chaired by Ren Zhenhe.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃出台羊皮筏子旅游运营安全管理试行办法
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues Trial Measures for Safety Management of Sheepskin Raft Tourism Operations
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省交通运输厅与文化和旅游厅联合印发管理办法，规范全省羊皮筏子旅游运营，明确载客限额、救生设备等安全要求。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's transport and culture departments jointly issued trial measures to regulate sheepskin raft tourism operations, specifying safety rules, passenger limits, and rescue equipment.

tags_en: Gansu Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 甘肃将启动新一轮农村公路提升五年行动 让和美乡村“因路而兴”
articles.title_en: Gansu to Launch New Five-Year Rural Road Improvement Plan to Boost Beautiful Villages
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，甘肃省推动“四好农村路”高质量发展现场会在临夏州召开，宣布启动新一轮农村公路提升五年行动，推动农村公路从规模扩张转向内涵式发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Gansu Province held a provincial on-site meeting in Linxia Prefecture to promote high-quality development of rural roads, announcing a new five-year rural road improvement initiative to shift from scale expansion to connotative development.

articles.title_zh: 贵州主动融入全面开放格局
articles.title_en: Guizhou Takes Initiative to Integrate into Comprehensive Opening-up Pattern
articles.summary_zh: 贵州用好西部陆海新通道建设机遇，对接粤港澳大湾区和成渝地区双城经济圈，发展特色开放型产业，上半年陆港吞吐量和特色产品出口增长显著。
articles.summary_en: Guizhou leverages the Western Land-Sea New Corridor, links with the Greater Bay Area and Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone, and develops an open economy, with port throughput and specialty exports growing in H1.

articles.title_zh: 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神 研究部署经济运行、中央巡视反馈问题整改等工作
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Convenes to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Study Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署经济运行、中央巡视反馈问题整改、安全生产等工作，省委书记关志鸥主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and arrange economic operations, rectification of central inspection feedback, work safety, etc., chaired and addressed by Secretary Guan Zhi'ou.

articles.title_zh: 武汉算力公共服务平台3.0版发布 可调度算力1465P
articles.title_en: Wuhan Computing Power Public Service Platform 3.0 Released with 1465P Schedulable Computing Power
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，武汉算力公共服务平台3.0版上线，汇聚全国45家算力服务机构，可调度算力达1465P，并接入全国一体化算力网。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the Wuhan Computing Power Public Service Platform 3.0 was launched, aggregating 45 computing service providers nationwide with 1465P schedulable computing power, and connected to the national integrated computing network.

articles.title_zh: 全国“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布 黑龙江1名同学1个集体入选
articles.title_en: National Ceremony for 'Good Teenagers of New Era' Held; Heilongjiang Student and Volleyball Team Honored
articles.summary_zh: 中央文明办等部门在沈阳举办2026年全国“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布仪式，黑龙江学生宋睿诚和铁力市第一中学校女排入选。
articles.summary_en: The Central Civilization Office and other departments held the 2026 national ceremony for 'Good Teenagers of New Era' in Shenyang, with a student and a volleyball team from Heilongjiang honored.

articles.title_zh: 党建调研行｜湖南湘江新区：从“项目一线”到“产业前沿” 看红色动能如何破圈？
articles.title_en: Party Building Research Trip | Hunan Xiangjiang New Area: From 'Project Frontline' to 'Industry Frontier' – How Red Momentum Breaks Boundaries?
articles.summary_zh: 近日，人民网党建调研行深入湖南长沙、岳阳等地，报道湘江新区以党建引领企业发展、技术攻关和产业协同的实践路径。
articles.summary_en: Recently, People's Daily Online's Party building research team visited Changsha, Yueyang, and other places in Hunan, reporting on Xiangjiang New Area's path of using Party leadership to drive enterprise development, technological breakthroughs, and industrial synergy.

articles.title_zh: 江苏五部门联手出台城市更新金融“政策包”
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Financial Policy Package for Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省地方金融管理局等五部门近日联合发布金融支持城市更新若干措施，推出十二项具体举措，优化城市更新项目金融服务。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu's five departments jointly issued measures to support urban renewal with 12 specific policies, improving financial services for urban renewal projects.

articles.title_zh: 南丰县多部门联合开展重点场所安全检查
articles.title_en: Nanfeng County Multi-Department Joint Safety Inspection of Key Places
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江西抚州南丰县多部门对超市、回收公司、加油站等重点场所开展安全大检查，发现安全隐患10处并限期整改。
articles.summary_en: Recently, multiple departments in Nanfeng County, Fuzhou, Jiangxi, conducted safety inspections at key places such as supermarkets, recycling companies, and gas stations, found 10 hidden dangers and ordered rectification within a time limit.

articles.title_zh: 总投资42亿元高性能芳纶纤维项目在定南县开工
articles.title_en: High-Performance Aramid Fiber Project with 4.2 Billion Yuan Investment Breaks Ground in Dingnan County
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，总投资42亿元的博林高性能间位芳纶纤维项目在江西赣州定南县开工，建成后将形成年产9000吨产能，旨在实现高端芳纶材料国产替代。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the 4.2-billion-yuan Bolin high-performance meta-aramid fiber project broke ground in Dingnan County, Ganzhou, Jiangxi, aiming at domestic substitution of high-end aramid materials with an annual capacity of 9,000 tons.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中包钢会见华为公司副董事长、轮值董事长徐直军
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet with Xu Zhijun, Huawei Rotating Chairman
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、政府主席包钢在呼和浩特会见华为公司轮值董事长徐直军，双方就绿色算力、人工智能等领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Regional Party Committee, and Bao Gang, Chairman of the Regional Government, met with Xu Zhijun, Rotating Chairman of Huawei in Hohhot, to discuss cooperation in green computing power and AI.

articles.title_zh: 自治区党委召开常委会会议暨理论学习中心组学习会
articles.title_en: Autonomous Regional Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting and Theoretical Study Group Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，自治区党委召开常委会会议暨理论学习中心组学习会，传达学习习近平总书记在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上的重要讲话等，研究部署相关工作。自治区党委书记王伟中主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region held a standing committee meeting and a theoretical study group session, conveying and studying General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech at the centenary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, and researching related work. Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Regional Party Committee, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 青海出台“三书一函”制度实施办法
articles.title_en: Qinghai Issues Implementation Measures for 'Three Documents and One Letter' System
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，青海省市场监督管理局印发“三书一函”制度实施办法，以提醒敦促函、整改通知书、约谈通知书、挂牌督办通知书为抓手，统筹柔性监管与刚性执法。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Qinghai Provincial Market Supervision Administration issued the implementation measures for the 'Three Documents and One Letter' system, using reminder letters, rectification notices, interview notices, and supervision notices to integrate flexible supervision with rigid law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 社会消费商品和服务零售总额前7月同比增2.6%
articles.title_en: Retail Sales of Consumer Goods and Services Up 2.6% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 商务部介绍，1—7月社会消费商品和服务零售总额同比增长2.6%，社会消费品零售总额28.77万亿元，增长1.2%。服务零售额增长5.0%，暑期消费潜力释放。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce reported retail sales of consumer goods and services rose 2.6% year-on-year in the first seven months. Total retail sales of consumer goods reached 28.77 trillion yuan, up 1.2%; service retail sales grew 5.0%.

articles.title_zh: 我国与APEC其他经济体进出口前7月同比增21%
articles.title_en: China's Imports and Exports with Other APEC Economies Up 21% in First 7 Months
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日召开的2026年APEC海关与商界对话会披露，1—7月我国与APEC其他经济体进出口总额达18.03万亿元，同比增长21%，增速高于货物贸易整体水平。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 APEC Customs and Business Dialogue on Aug 20, it was reported that China's trade with other APEC economies reached 18.03 trillion yuan in Jan-Jul, up 21% year-on-year, outpacing overall growth.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴在北京市调研时强调 加快建设足球青训体系 提升竞技体育后备人才培养水平
articles.title_en: State Councilor Shen Yiqin Urges Acceleration of Football Youth Training System on Beijing Visit
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，国务委员谌贻琴在北京调研足球青训体系建设，强调要加快建设青训体系，提升竞技体育后备人才培养水平。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, State Councilor Shen Yiqin visited Beijing to inspect the football youth training system, emphasizing the need to accelerate its construction and improve the cultivation of reserve talents for competitive sports.

articles.title_zh: 促内需 财政金融协同政策“组合拳”迎来优化
articles.title_en: China Optimizes Fiscal and Financial Policy Mix to Boost Domestic Demand
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，财政部、中国人民银行、金融监管总局联合发布通知，优化财政金融协同促内需政策，扩大贴息范围、增加经办机构、提高额度上限。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, China's MOF, PBOC and NFRA issued a notice to optimize fiscal-financial policies to boost domestic demand, expanding subsidy coverage, adding banks and raising loan caps.

articles.title_zh: 积极财政政策助推经济社会高质量发展
articles.title_en: Proactive Fiscal Policy Boosts High-Quality Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办8月21日举行发布会，财政部介绍今年实施更加积极的财政政策，支出预算首超30万亿元，支持内需、民生与新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on Aug 21, the Ministry of Finance said China's proactive fiscal policy includes a budget exceeding 30 trillion yuan, boosting domestic demand, people's wellbeing and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 中国印尼外长防长“2+2”对话机制举行第二次部长级会议
articles.title_en: China-Indonesia 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue on Foreign and Defense Affairs Held in Jakarta
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，中国印尼外长防长“2+2”对话机制第二次部长级会议在雅加达举行，王毅、董军同印尼外长、防长共同主持，达成一系列重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, Defense Minister Dong Jun co-chaired the second ministerial meeting of the China-Indonesia 2+2 dialogue with their Indonesian counterparts in Jakarta, reaching important consensus.

articles.title_zh: 中国印尼全面战略对话机制举行首次会议
articles.title_en: China-Indonesia Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue Mechanism Holds First Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，王毅在雅加达同印尼外长苏吉约诺共同主持中印尼全面战略对话机制首次会议，就构建命运共同体达成广泛共识。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Indonesian Foreign Minister Sugiyono co-chaired the first China-Indonesia Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue meeting in Jakarta, reaching broad consensus on building a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报等
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on New-Generation Communication Network
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强8月21日主持召开国务院常务会议，听取新一代通信网建设情况汇报，部署清理拖欠企业账款、改善空气质量等工作，并审议通过两项条例草案。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on August 21, hearing reports on new-generation communication network construction, deploying efforts to clear overdue payments to enterprises and improve air quality, and approving two draft regulations.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 国务院 中央军委关于给张陆颁发“二级航天功勋奖章” 授予武飞、张洪章“英雄航天员”荣誉称号并颁发“三级航天功勋奖章”的决定
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee, State Council and CMC Decide to Award Medals to Astronauts Zhang Lu, Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月20日，中共中央、国务院、中央军委决定给张陆颁发“二级航天功勋奖章”，授予武飞、张洪章“英雄航天员”荣誉称号并颁发“三级航天功勋奖章”。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, 2026, the CPC Central Committee, the State Council and the CMC decided to award Zhang Lu the Second-Class Space Flight Merit Medal and grant Wu Fei and Zhang Hongzhang the title of Hero Astronaut with Third-Class Space Flight Merit Medals.

articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Economic Operation Scheduling Meeting

articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, the Huai'an Municipal Government held an economic scheduling meeting, where Mayor Gu Kun stressed implementing the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and advancing high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Huai'an Municipal Government held an economic operation scheduling meeting. Mayor Gu Kun stressed implementing the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and promoting high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦在濉溪县调研时强调深化党建引领基层治理 培育壮大乡村特色产业
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Emphasizes Deepening Party Building Leadership in Grassroots Governance and Cultivating Rural Specialty Industries During Inspection in Suixi County
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日上午，淮北市委书记蒋曦到濉溪县调研基层治理和乡村产业发展，强调深化党建引领基层治理，培育壮大乡村特色产业。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 21, Jiang Xi, Secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee, visited Suixi County to inspect grassroots governance and rural industry development, stressing the need to deepen party building leadership and foster rural specialty industries.

articles.title_zh: 从春申湖公园看采煤沉陷区“变身”
articles.title_en: Transformation of Coal Mining Subsidence Area Seen from Chunshen Lake Park
articles.summary_zh: 淮南市通过综合治理将采煤沉陷区变为春申湖公园，水质提升至Ⅲ类，实现生态修复与民生改善。
articles.summary_en: Huainan City transformed a coal mining subsidence area into Chunshen Lake Park through comprehensive treatment, improving water quality to Class III and achieving ecological restoration and livelihood improvement.

articles.title_zh: 全市深化扫黑除恶专项斗争会议召开
articles.title_en: City Convening Meeting on Deepening Special Campaign Against Gang Crime
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，黄石市召开深化扫黑除恶专项斗争会议，市委常委、政法委书记李文波出席并讲话，副市长、公安局局长黄志勇主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Huangshi held a meeting to deepen the special campaign against gang crime. Li Wenbo, member of the Standing Committee and head of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission, attended and spoke; Huang Zhiyong, vice mayor and public security bureau chief, presided.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保：一鼓作气乘势而上 攻坚征拆难点堵点
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao: Press Forward to Tackle Demolition and Relocation Bottlenecks
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保调研国道G206线改建工程，强调要一鼓作气攻坚征拆难点，推动项目建设提速。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, inspected the reconstruction project of National Highway G206, urging concerted efforts to overcome demolition and relocation difficulties and accelerate construction.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保：一鼓作气乘势而上 攻坚征拆难点堵点

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of the Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, inspected the G206 reconstruction project and urged removing land expropriation bottlenecks to accelerate construction.

articles.summary_en: On August 20, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, visited Huilai County and Dananhai Petrochemical Industrial Zone to emphasize food security and industrial development.

articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Congratulates Hakainde Hichilema on Re-election as Zambian President
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，国家主席习近平致电哈凯恩德·希奇莱马，祝贺他当选连任赞比亚共和国总统，并表示愿共同推动中赞关系发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Hakainde Hichilema, congratulating him on his re-election as President of Zambia and expressing willingness to advance bilateral ties.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队到惠来县、大南海石化工业区调研
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Research Visit to Huilai County and Dainanhai Petrochemical Industrial Zone
articles.summary_zh: 20日，揭阳市长曲晓杰赴惠来县、大南海石化工业区调研，检查晚稻种植及重点企业生产，强调守牢粮食安全底线，做强绿色石化与海洋经济。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Jieyang Mayor Qu Xiaojie visited Huilai County and the Dainanhai Petrochemical Industrial Zone to inspect rice planting and key enterprises, stressing food security, green petrochemicals, and marine economy.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨市第三届人才周活动举行 达娃次仁徐春和出席致辞
articles.title_en: Lhasa Hosts Third Talent Week; Dawa Tsering and Xu Chunhe Attend
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，拉萨市第三届人才周活动举行，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁等出席并致辞，活动签约多个项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the third Lhasa Talent Week was held. Dawa Tsering, a member of the regional Party committee standing committee and Lhasa Party chief, attended and delivered a speech. The event signed multiple projects.

articles.title_zh: 2026全球数字经济大会拉萨分会场活动举行

articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Lhasa sub-forum of the 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference was held, with Dawa Tsering, member of the Standing Committee of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee and Party Secretary of Lhasa, attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中安排部署秋粮生产和农业防灾减灾工作
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Arranges Autumn Grain Production and Agricultural Disaster Prevention and Reduction
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，中共中央政治局委员、国务院副总理刘国中到农业农村部召开视频调度会，安排部署秋粮生产和农业防灾减灾工作，强调全力以赴夺取全年粮食丰收。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, Liu Guozhong, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, held a video conference at the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs to arrange autumn grain production and agricultural disaster prevention and reduction, stressing efforts to achieve a full-year grain harvest.

articles.summary_en: On Aug. 20, Lu Feng, Secretary of Shanwei Municipal Party Committee, met business reps at a software supply-chain event to discuss manufacturing digitalization.

articles.title_zh: 石嘴山市委常委会召开会议 学习崇高风范 汲取奋进力量 全力以赴防风险保安全促发展
articles.title_en: Shizuishan Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Learn Lofty Character and Ensure Safety and Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，石嘴山市委书记杨青龙主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记在纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会上的重要讲话精神，并审议突发事件总体应急预案。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Yang Qinglong, secretary of Shizuishan Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's speech at the centenary memorial of Jiang Zemin, and reviewed the city's emergency response plan.

articles.title_zh: 徐龙主持召开全市铁合金及燃煤自备电厂机组节能降碳科学改造推进会
articles.title_en: Xu Long Chairs Meeting on Energy-Saving and Carbon-Reduction Retrofit for Ferroalloy and Coal-Fired Captive Power Plants
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，石嘴山市委副书记、市长徐龙主持召开推进会，部署铁合金及燃煤自备电厂机组节能降碳科学改造工作，强调落实“双碳”战略，推动产业绿色转型。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Xu Long, mayor of Shizuishan, chaired a meeting on energy-saving and carbon-reduction retrofits for ferroalloy and coal-fired captive power plants, emphasizing green industrial transformation.

articles.title_zh: 李国强主持召开市人民政府常务会议 研究经济社会发展形势等工作
articles.title_en: Li Guoqiang Chairs Municipal Government Standing Meeting on Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，泰安市长李国强主持召开市政府常务会议，研究经济社会发展形势和泰山国际登山节筹备等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, Tai'an Mayor Li Guoqiang presided over a standing meeting of the municipal government to discuss the economic and social development situation and preparations for the Mount Tai International Mountaineering Festival.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年座谈会举行
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Holds Symposium to Mark Centenary of Jiang Zemin's Birth
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，江苏省纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年座谈会在扬州举行，省委书记信长星讲话，省长刘小涛主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Jiangsu Province held a symposium in Yangzhou to mark the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth. Party Secretary Xin Changxing delivered a speech, and Governor Liu Xiaotao presided.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Weihai Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，威海市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究经济运行、全面从严治党等工作，市委书记张海波主持会议。
articles.summary_en: Weihai Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met on August 20 to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and discuss economic operation and full and strict party governance. Zhang Haibo, Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，无锡市委书记杜小刚主持召开市委常委会第198次会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要文章精神，研究部署相关工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Du Xiaogang, Secretary of the Wuxi Municipal Party Committee, chaired the 198th meeting of the Standing Committee to study and implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and articles, and deploy related work.

articles.title_zh: 以正确政绩观扎实细致做好基层工作
articles.title_en: To Do Solid Grassroots Work with Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，无锡市委理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，市委书记杜小刚主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Wuxi Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group held a study session on Xi Jinping's important discourses on grassroots work methods, chaired by Party Secretary Du Xiaogang.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开防汛防台工作推进会
articles.title_en: Wuxi Government Holds Meeting on Flood and Typhoon Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，无锡市长蒋锋主持召开防汛防台工作推进会，强调压实责任，提升监测预警和应急能力，保障群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Mayor Jiang Feng chaired a flood and typhoon prevention meeting in Wuxi, urging enhanced monitoring, early warning, and emergency response to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组（扩大）会议暨理论学习中心组学习会召开
articles.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Government Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，无锡市政府党组（扩大）会议召开，传达学习中央政治局会议和国务院全体会议精神，研究部署经济工作。市长蒋锋主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, Wuxi Municipal Government Party Group held a meeting to convey the spirit of the Central Political Bureau meeting and State Council plenary meeting, deploying economic work. Mayor Jiang Feng chaired and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 全省稳增长工作调度会召开 凝心聚力 加压奋进 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Holds Provincial Economic Stabilization Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，全省稳增长工作调度会在西安召开。省委书记赵一德主持并讲话，省长赵刚作部署，强调稳增长、推动经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the province's economic stabilization work conference was held in Xi'an. Provincial Party Secretary Zhao Yide presided over and spoke, Governor Zhao Gang deployed tasks to boost growth and high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 2026农业装备产业发展大会召开
articles.title_en: 2026 Agricultural Equipment Industry Development Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，2026农业装备产业发展大会在盐城市建湖县召开，代市长吴炜、省政府副秘书长刘建等出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the 2026 Agricultural Equipment Industry Development Conference was held in Jianhu County, Yancheng, with Acting Mayor Wu Wei and Deputy Secretary-General Liu Jian attending and delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平赴安徽省拜访重点企业
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Leads Delegation to Visit Key Enterprises in Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，市委书记严汉平率队赴安徽省拜访阳光电源、皖维集团等重点企业，推进合作项目。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Yan Hanping, secretary of the CPC Yancheng Municipal Committee, led a delegation to Anhui Province to visit key enterprises such as Sungrow Power and Wanwei Group to advance cooperation projects.

articles.title_zh: 省人大常委会来盐调研
articles.title_en: Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Conducts Research in Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日至20日，省人大常委会副主任魏国强率队来盐，调研南北共建园区高质量发展、宜居宜业和美乡村建设和湖泊保护工作。
articles.summary_en: From August 19 to 20, Wei Guoqiang, Vice Chairman of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, led a team to Yancheng to inspect the high-quality development of north-south co-built industrial parks, livable and beautiful villages, and lake protection.

articles.title_zh: 省政府召开常务会议暨经济运行调度会 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting and Economic Operation Dispatch Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，江苏省省长刘小涛主持召开省政府常务会议暨经济运行调度会，研究部署经济工作，审议提质增效政策措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired the Jiangsu provincial government executive meeting and economic operation dispatch meeting to study key tasks and review policy measures for quality and efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 2026江苏—德国经贸合作交流会在苏州太仓举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Jiangsu-Germany Economic and Trade Cooperation Exchange Held in Taicang, Suzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月20日，2026江苏—德国经贸合作交流会在苏州太仓举行，商务部副部长凌激视频致辞，省委常委、苏州市委书记范波及副省长赵岩出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Jiangsu-Germany Economic and Trade Cooperation Exchange was held in Taicang, Suzhou on August 20, 2026. Vice Commerce Minister Ling Ji delivered a video speech, while Fan Bo, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and Suzhou Party Secretary, and Vice Governor Zhao Yan attended and addressed the event.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省举行纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年座谈会
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Holds Symposium to Mark 100th Anniversary of Jiang Zemin's Birth
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，江苏省纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年座谈会在扬州举行，省委书记信长星出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Jiangsu held a symposium in Yangzhou to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth, with provincial Party secretary Xin Changxing attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 八届市政府第141次常务会议召开
articles.title_en: The 141st Executive Meeting of the 8th Municipal Government Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，阳江市市长余金富主持召开八届市政府第141次常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究经济运行并部署下一步工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Yu Jinfu, Mayor of Yangjiang, chaired the 141st executive meeting of the municipal government to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, study economic operation, and deploy next steps.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先余金富会见阿里云及高德地图高管一行
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian and Yu Jinfu Meet with Executives from Alibaba Cloud and AutoNavi
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，阳江市委书记卢一先、市长余金富会见阿里云、高德地图高管，就加快推动绿色智算、低空经济产业发展进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Yangjiang Municipal Party Secretary Lu Yixian and Mayor Yu Jinfu met with executives from Alibaba Cloud and AutoNavi to discuss accelerating green intelligent computing and low-altitude economy development.

articles.title_zh: 银川市服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Holds Service Industry Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，银川市服务业大会召开，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉出席并讲话，强调推动服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Yinchuan Service Industry Conference was held, attended by Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, who emphasized high-quality development of the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 杨政昆在玉溪抚投公司调研国资国企运营情况
articles.title_en: Yang Zhengkun Inspects Yuxi Foutou Company on SOE Operations
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，玉溪市委书记杨政昆到玉溪抚投公司调研国资国企运营情况，强调明确发展目标、突出效益导向，加快建设现代国有企业。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Yuxi Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun visited Yuxi Foutou Company to inspect state-owned enterprise operations, emphasizing clear development goals, efficiency orientation, and building modern SOEs.

articles.title_zh: 全市扫黑除恶专项斗争会议召开
articles.title_en: Municipal Meeting on Special Campaign Against Gang Crime Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月19日，全市扫黑除恶专项斗争会议召开，市领导谢运策出席并讲话，强调深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，增强群众安全感。
articles.summary_en: On August 19, the city-wide meeting on the special campaign against gang crime was held; city leader Xie Yunce attended and spoke, emphasizing deepening the campaign to enhance public security.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开专题会议听取市第九次党代会课题调研情况汇报
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Meeting on Ninth Municipal Party Congress Research
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开专题会议，听取市第九次党代会课题调研情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a special meeting to hear reports on research for the Ninth Municipal Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 坡头区召开“百千万工程”2026年上半年工作总结分析会
articles.title_en: Potou District Holds Work Review Meeting for H1 2026 of Bai Qian Wan Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，坡头区召开“百千万工程”2026年上半年工作总结分析会，区委书记刘剑出席并讲话，强调压实责任、攻坚克难，确保如期实现“五年显著变化”目标。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Potou District held a work review meeting for the first half of 2026 under the Bai Qian Wan Project; District Party Secretary Liu Jian attended and stressed responsibility and overcoming difficulties to achieve the five-year goal.

articles.title_zh: 郭力铭杨雪芹带领调研组到郸城县调研
articles.title_en: Guo Liming and Yang Xueqin Lead Research Team to Dancheng County
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，周口市人大常委会主任郭力铭、副主任杨雪芹带队赴郸城县调研“人大代表在行动”主题活动，走访代表并座谈。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, Guo Liming, Director of the Zhoukou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, and Vice Director Yang Xueqin led a research team to Dancheng County to inspect the "People's Congress Representatives in Action" campaign and met with representatives.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议暨十届七十三次主席会议 为人工智能高质量发展贡献政协智慧和力量
articles.title_en: Zhuhai CPPCC Meeting Pushes for High-Quality AI Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，市政协召开党组会议暨十届七十三次主席会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，围绕人工智能调研建言。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 20, Zhuhai Municipal CPPCC held a Party Group and Chairman's meeting to study Xi's speech and advise on AI high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 全省高标准农田建设突出问题整治百日攻坚行动工作部署会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Work Deployment Meeting on 100-Day Campaign to Rectify Outstanding Issues in High-Standard Farmland Construction Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日，全省高标准农田建设突出问题整治百日攻坚行动工作部署会议召开，省委副书记、省长周乃翔出席并讲话，强调保障国家粮食安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 20, a provincial work deployment meeting was held to launch a 100-day campaign to rectify outstanding issues in high-standard farmland construction. Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Governor, attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing national food security.

articles.title_zh: 省委理论学习中心组进行集体学习 高质量打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板 不断开创农业农村现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Conducts Collective Study for Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，山东省委理论学习中心组集体学习，省委书记林武主持，强调高质量打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, the Shandong Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group held a collective study session, chaired by Secretary Lin Wu, emphasizing high-quality rural revitalization in Qilu.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日上午，山东省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究经济运行、大气污染防治等事项，省委书记林武主持。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 20, the Standing Committee of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech, and to discuss economic performance and air pollution prevention and control. Lin Wu, Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee, presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 林武会见国家能源集团客人
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Meets National Energy Group Guests
articles.summary_zh: 8月20日下午，山东省委书记林武在济南会见国家能源集团董事长邹磊一行，双方就深化能源合作、推动能源转型和绿色低碳高质量发展等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 20, Shandong Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu met with Zou Lei, Chairman of National Energy Group, in Jinan to deepen energy cooperation and promote green, low-carbon high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: "支联会"煽动颠覆国家政权罪名成立，驻港国家安全公署：支持严惩
articles.title_en: "Alliance" Found Guilty of Subversion, National Security Office Supports Severe Punishment
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，香港特区高等法院裁定"支联会"及李卓人、邹幸彤煽动颠覆国家政权罪名成立，驻港国家安全公署表示支持严惩。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 21, the High Court of HKSAR convicted the Alliance and Li Zhuoren, Zou Xintong of subverting state power. The National Security Office supports severe punishment.

articles.title_zh: 应急机械拉手存在安全隐患，多品牌集中召回超427万辆车
articles.title_en: Multiple Brands Recall Over 4.27 Million Vehicles Over Emergency Handle Safety Hazards
articles.summary_zh: 8月21日，国家市场监管总局发布多家车企召回信息，因应急机械拉手等安全隐患，特斯拉、吉利、小米等品牌合计召回超427万辆车。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, China's State Administration for Market Regulation published recalls from multiple automakers over emergency handle safety hazards, involving over 4.27 million vehicles including Tesla, Geely, Xiaomi, etc.

articles.title_zh: 安以轩取丈夫陈荣炼在台4422万存款遭拒，银行称涉洗钱
articles.title_en: An Yixuan Fails to Withdraw 44.22 Million Yuan Deposit of Husband Chen Ronglian; Bank Cites Money Laundering
articles.summary_zh: 台湾艺人安以轩的丈夫陈荣炼因非法赌博、洗钱入狱，其在台北富邦银行的约4422万元存款遭银行以涉洗钱为由拒绝提取，陈荣炼起诉银行败诉，台湾高等法院仍判其败诉。
articles.summary_en: Taiwanese actress An Yixuan's husband Chen Ronglian, imprisoned for illegal gambling and money laundering, had his deposit of about 44.22 million yuan in Taipei Fubon Bank refused by the bank citing money laundering. Chen's lawsuit against the bank failed in both first instance and appeal.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局：7月城乡居民生活用电量同比下降5.1%
articles.title_en: National Energy Administration: Urban and Rural Residential Electricity Consumption Fell 5.1% Year-on-Year in July
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局8月21日发布7月全社会用电量数据，7月全社会用电量10400亿千瓦时，同比增长1.7%；城乡居民生活用电量同比下降5.1%。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, the National Energy Administration released July electricity consumption data, showing total consumption of 1,040 TWh, up 1.7% year-on-year, while residential consumption fell 5.1%.

articles.title_zh: 受贿6344万，国家中医药管理局原局长于文明一审获刑十五年
articles.title_en: Former TCM Administration Head Yu Wenming Sentenced to 15 Years for Bribery
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月21日，天津市第一中级人民法院一审公开宣判国家中医药管理局原局长于文明受贿案，判处有期徒刑十五年，并处罚金人民币六百万元。
articles.summary_en: On August 21, 2026, Tianjin First Intermediate People's Court sentenced Yu Wenming, former head of the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, to 15 years in prison and a fine of 6 million yuan for bribery.
