articles.title_zh: 王崧到周口市督导调研防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Wang Song Inspects Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，河南省委常委、宣传部部长王崧到周口市督导调研防汛救灾工作，察看积水点、安置点等，慰问受灾群众和一线人员。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Wang Song, member of the Standing Committee of the Henan Provincial Party Committee and head of the Propaganda Department, inspected flood control and disaster relief work in Zhoukou, visiting waterlogging sites and resettlement points.

articles.title_zh: 全省审计查出问题整改工作视频会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Video Conference on Rectification of Audit-Discovered Issues Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，全省审计查出问题整改工作视频会议召开，省委副书记、省长周乃翔出席并讲话，部署中央和省级预算执行审计查出问题整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, a provincial video conference on rectifying audit-discovered issues was held. Zhou Naixiang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee and Governor, attended and delivered a speech, deploying rectification work for central and provincial budget execution audit findings.

articles.title_zh: 非洲多国限制“台湾护照”
articles.title_en: African Countries Restrict 'Taiwan Passports'
articles.summary_zh: 近期乌干达、南非、摩洛哥、肯尼亚等多个非洲国家奉行一个中国政策，对持台湾旅行证件人员入境做出限制。
articles.summary_en: Several African countries, including Uganda, South Africa, Morocco, and Kenya, have recently restricted entry for holders of Taiwan travel documents, citing the One-China policy.

articles.title_zh: 香港宏福苑火灾报告延期至10月底前完成
articles.title_en: Hong Kong Hong Fu Yuan Fire Report Delayed to End of October
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，香港大埔宏福苑火灾独立调查委员会表示已获行政长官同意，将提交报告期限延至10月底。委员会已举行30场听证会，听取80名证人证言。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the independent committee investigating the Hong Fu Court fire in Tai Po said it has obtained the Chief Executive's approval to extend the report deadline to end of October. The committee has held 30 hearings and heard 80 witnesses.

articles.title_zh: 四部门联合发布意见加强医院法治建设
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Opinions to Strengthen Hospital Legal System
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家卫生健康委、教育部、国家中医药局、国家疾控局联合印发《关于加强医院法治建设的意见》，部署医院法治体系建设，明确提出到2030年基本建成完善的医院法治工作体系。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the National Health Commission, Ministry of Education, National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine and National Disease Control Bureau jointly issued Opinions on Strengthening Hospital Legal System, deploying hospital rule-of-law construction and aiming to build a complete legal framework by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 一汽车顶着停车场收费员开行，广东佛山通报
articles.title_en: Guangdong Foshan Reports Car Driving Toward Parking Attendant
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，广东佛山通报一起汽车顶着停车场收费员开行的事件，引发社会关注。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Foshan, Guangdong reported an incident where a car drove toward a parking attendant, drawing public attention.

articles.title_zh: 内地媒体人冒充港中大客座教授走穴近三年，校方打假：从未聘用
articles.title_en: Mainland Media Person Impersonated CUHK Visiting Professor for Three Years; University Denies Employment
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，香港中文大学发布声明，否认曾聘用自称“客座教授”的内地媒体人张龙，称其与校方无任何雇佣、教学或授权关系。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Chinese University of Hong Kong issued a statement denying that it had ever employed a mainland media person named Zhang Long, who claimed to be a CUHK visiting professor, saying there is no relationship with him.

tags.name_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

tags_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

articles.title_zh: 国务院修改《住房公积金管理条例》
articles.title_en: State Council Amends Regulations on Housing Provident Fund
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布修改后的《住房公积金管理条例》，自2026年9月20日起施行，拓宽提取范围，支持灵活就业人员缴存。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to amend regulations on the housing provident fund, effective Sept. 20, 2026, expanding withdrawal uses and allowing flexible employment workers to contribute.

articles.title_zh: 受贿数额特别巨大，宁夏回族自治区政府原主席刘慧被提起公诉
articles.title_en: Liu Hui, Former Chairwoman of Ningxia Government, Indicted for Bribery of Especially Huge Amount
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民检察院通报，宁夏回族自治区政府原主席刘慧涉嫌受贿，数额特别巨大，已由菏泽市人民检察院提起公诉。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate announced that Liu Hui, former chairwoman of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region, was indicted for bribery with an especially huge amount. The Heze Municipal People's Procuratorate filed the public prosecution.

articles.title_zh: 从前7个月数据看中国经济向新向优
articles.title_en: Interpreting China's Economy in First 7 Months: Moving Toward Innovation and Quality
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局17日发布数据显示，今年1至7月中国经济运行总体平稳，新动能成长壮大，延续向新向好态势。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the National Bureau of Statistics on Aug 17 show China's economy remained stable in the first seven months, with new growth drivers expanding and the trend toward innovation and quality continuing.

articles.title_zh: 福建历史文化街区激活文旅新热潮
articles.title_en: Fujian Historical and Cultural Blocks Revitalize Cultural Tourism Boom
articles.summary_zh: 福建福州上下杭等历史文化街区以“非遗+国潮+夜游”激活文旅新热潮，2025年三大街区接待超5500万人次，推动“古厝经济”发展。
articles.summary_en: Historical blocks in Fujian, such as Shangxiahang in Fuzhou, are thriving with intangible heritage, national trend, and night tours, receiving over 55 million visits in 2025 and boosting the ancient building economy.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组（扩大）会议 深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Enlarged) Meeting to Study Xi Jinping Thought on Culture
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，福州市政府党组（扩大）会议召开，深入学习贯彻习近平文化思想及关于文化和自然遗产保护传承利用的重要指示精神，市长吴贤德主持并发言。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Fuzhou Municipal Government held a Party Group (Enlarged) meeting to study Xi Jinping Thought on Culture and his important instructions on cultural and natural heritage protection, chaired by Mayor Wu Xiande.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组会议和常务会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，福州市市长吴贤德主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，研究贯彻落实中央及省市委全会精神，审议新兴产业和未来产业发展专项规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande chaired the municipal government's Party group and executive meetings to implement central and provincial committee directives and review plans for emerging and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记指引企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Enterprises Along the Path of High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 文章综述习近平总书记高度重视企业发展，强调坚持两个毫不动摇，指引各类企业走高质量发展道路，聚焦创新与实体经济。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's emphasis on supporting enterprises of all ownership types, guiding them toward high-quality development with focus on innovation and the real economy.

articles.title_zh: 青岛科创大走廊融合发展座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Qingdao Holds Symposium on Integrated Development of Science and Innovation Corridor
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日上午，青岛科创大走廊融合发展座谈会召开，市委书记曾赞荣出席并讲话，强调整合资源要素，强化科技引领，推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Qingdao held a symposium on integrated development of the Science and Innovation Corridor. Municipal Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong attended and spoke, emphasizing resource integration and technology-led deep integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 任刚会见国家能源集团客人
articles.title_en: Ren Gang Meets Guest from China Energy Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，青岛市市长任刚会见国家能源集团副总经理傅振邦一行，双方就新能源领域合作洽谈，并签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Mayor Ren Gang of Qingdao met with Fu Zhenbang, Vice President of China Energy Group, to discuss new energy cooperation and signed a strategic cooperation agreement.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，青岛市委书记曾赞荣到崂山区调研创新型产业发展，强调强化企业创新主体地位，加快发展新赛道、壮大新动能。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Zeng Zanrong, Party Secretary of Qingdao, inspected innovative industry development in Laoshan District, stressing the role of enterprises as innovation leaders and the need to accelerate new tracks and momentum.

articles.title_zh: 中船集团国企开放日暨品牌宣传周在“爱达·花城号”正式启动 第二艘国产邮轮冲刺11月交付
articles.title_en: CSSC SOE Open Day and Brand Promotion Week Launches on 'Adora Flora City', Second Domestic Cruise Ship Targets November Delivery
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，中船集团国企开放日暨品牌宣传周在上海外高桥造船公司的第二艘国产大型邮轮“爱达·花城号”上启动，该邮轮计划11月交付。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, CSSC launched its SOE Open Day and Brand Promotion Week aboard the second domestically-built cruise ship "Adora Flora City" in Shanghai, which is scheduled for delivery in November.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在全省政协主席暑期读书会上作经济形势报告 高质量完成全年目标任务 为实现“十五五”良好开局作出新贡献
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Delivers Economic Report at Provincial CPPCC Chairmen's Summer Reading Session
articles.summary_zh: 18日上午，浙江省省长刘捷在全省政协主席暑期读书会上作经济形势报告，强调高质量完成全年目标任务，为实现“十五五”良好开局作出新贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 18, Governor Liu Jie of Zhejiang gave a report on economic situation at the provincial CPPCC chairmen's summer reading session, urging high-quality fulfilment of annual targets and a good start for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组第99次会议暨省政府第122次常务会议召开 刘捷主持
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Zhejiang Provincial Government Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 18日下午，浙江省省长刘捷主持省政府党组会议暨常务会议，传达学习中央精神，听取经济运行汇报，部署经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, Zhejiang Governor Liu Jie chaired provincial government party group and executive meetings to convey central directives, review economic performance, and arrange economic work.

articles.title_zh: 浙江经济保持韧性增长：“415X”集群成增长引擎 人工智能爆发式增长
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Economy Maintains Resilient Growth: '415X' Clusters as Growth Engine, AI Surges
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，浙江工业企业销售收入同比增长9.7%，高技术产业增长20%，人工智能产业集群销售收入同比增长27.9%。
articles.summary_en: In H1 this year, Zhejiang's industrial enterprise sales revenue grew 9.7% YoY, high-tech industry by 20%, and AI industry cluster by 27.9%.

articles.title_zh: 封关催热海南维修产业 加速对接全球市场
articles.title_en: Hainan's Maintenance Industry Heats Up After Customs Closure, Accelerating Global Market Integration
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，海南自贸港首单油田装备保税维修业务正式开展，海南龙盘进口的15台油田压裂车发动机运抵澄迈工厂。全岛封关后，海南维修产业加速对接全球市场。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, Hainan Free Trade Port launched its first bonded maintenance business for oilfield equipment as Hainan Longpan imported 15 fracturing truck engines. The industry is accelerating global market integration after island-wide customs closure.

articles.title_zh: 全省各级人大常委会主任暑期读书班开班 王浩讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Speaks at Provincial People's Congress Summer Study Class
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日下午，全省各级人大常委会主任暑期读书班在杭州开班，省委书记、省人大常委会主任王浩出席并讲话，强调坚定信心、服务大局，助力高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, the summer study class for directors of provincial and local people's congress standing committees opened in Hangzhou. Wang Hao, Party secretary and director of the provincial people's congress standing committee, attended and spoke, emphasizing confidence, serving the overall situation, and supporting high-quality development of a common prosperity demonstration zone.

articles.title_zh: 浩吉铁路累计发运货物列车突破10万列
articles.title_en: Haoji Railway's Cumulative Freight Trains Exceed 100,000
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，浩吉铁路累计发运货物列车突破10万列，累计运输货物5.5亿吨，标志着国家北煤南运大通道运量规模再上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Haoji Railway's cumulative dispatched freight trains exceeded 100,000, transporting 550 million tons of cargo, marking a new milestone for the northern coal-to-south transport corridor.

articles.title_zh: 被港中大打假的“客座教授”张龙，还有哪些虚假头衔
articles.title_en: Zhang Long, Exposed by CUHK as Fake Visiting Professor, Has More Bogus Titles
articles.summary_zh: 香港中文大学2026年8月13日声明称无张龙受聘记录，其“客座教授”系冒充。澎湃新闻调查发现张龙还以多个虚假头衔公开活动。
articles.summary_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong stated on August 13, 2026, that it had no employment record of Zhang Long and his "visiting professor" title was false. The Paper found Zhang also used multiple other fake titles.

tags.name_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

tags_en: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

articles.title_zh: 提取范围有哪些重大变化？两部门就公积金管理条例修改答问
articles.title_en: What Major Changes in Withdrawal Scope? Two Departments Answer Questions on Housing Provident Fund Regulation Amendment
articles.summary_zh: 国务院公布修改《住房公积金管理条例》的决定，司法部、住房城乡建设部负责人就提取范围、服务效能、风险防控等答记者问。
articles.summary_en: The State Council published a decision to amend the Regulations on Housing Provident Fund Management. Officials from the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development answered questions on withdrawal scope, service efficiency, and risk prevention.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development

tags_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development

articles.title_zh: 国务院安委办部署进一步加强道路交通安全工作
articles.title_en: State Council Work Safety Committee Deploys Further Strengthening Road Traffic Safety
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国务院安委会办公室通报近期重点地区道路交通典型事故，部署进一步加强道路交通安全工作，督促各地区有效防控风险。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Office of the State Council Work Safety Committee reported typical road traffic accidents in key regions and deployed further efforts to strengthen road traffic safety, urging all regions to effectively prevent and control risks.

articles.title_zh: 厦门出台全省首个外卖配送行业公约
articles.title_en: Xiamen Issues Province's First Delivery Industry Convention
articles.summary_zh: 近日，厦门市市场监督管理局等部门指导发布全省首个外卖配送行业公约，美团、淘宝闪购、京东外卖现场签约，推动行业自律与规范发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Xiamen's market regulator and other departments guided the issuance of the province's first food delivery industry convention, with Meituan, Taobao Flash Purchase, and JD Express signing on to promote self-discipline and standardized development.

tags.name_zh: 厦门市市场监督管理局
tags.name_en: Xiamen Municipal Administration for Market Regulation

tags_zh: 厦门市市场监督管理局
tags_en: Xiamen Municipal Administration for Market Regulation

articles.title_zh: 厦门发布促进对台交流合作十二条措施
articles.title_en: Xiamen Issues 12 Measures to Promote Cross-Strait Exchanges and Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，厦门市发布《促进对台交流合作十二条措施》，涵盖经贸、文化、青年、平台建设等，着力打造台胞休闲旅游、就医康养、居住就业“第一目的地”。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Xiamen issued 12 measures to promote cross-strait exchanges and cooperation, covering trade, culture, youth, and platform construction, aiming to become the top destination for Taiwanese compatriots.

articles.title_zh: 河南省出台联农带农富农评价指标体系
articles.title_en: Henan Issues Evaluation Index System for Farmer-Income Linkage Mechanisms
articles.summary_zh: 近日，河南省农业农村厅发布联农带农富农评价指标体系，以“5+14”量化考评推动经营主体与农户利益联结，助力农民增收和乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Henan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs issued a '5+14' quantitative evaluation system to strengthen stable and mutually beneficial linkages between business entities and farmers, aiming to boost rural income and revitalization.

tags.name_en: Henan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Henan Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 最高法发布海洋生态环境司法保护典型案例
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Judicial Protection of Marine Ecological Environment
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院日前发布6件海洋生态环境司法保护典型案例，涵盖船舶污染、陆源污染等重点领域，展示海事审判作用。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court recently released six typical cases of judicial protection of marine ecological environment, covering ship pollution, land-based pollution and other key areas, showcasing the role of maritime trials.

articles.title_zh: 司法部发布规范涉企行政执法典型案例
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice Releases Typical Cases on Enterprise-Related Administrative Law Enforcement
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，司法部发布规范涉企行政执法为民办实事典型案例，涵盖海南、浙江、山东、江苏、山西等地，涉及权责边界规范、执法模式创新等。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the Ministry of Justice released typical cases of standardized administrative law enforcement for enterprises, covering Hainan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Jiangsu, and Shanxi, involving rights and responsibility boundaries, and enforcement innovation.

articles.title_zh: 许勤到伊春市调研生态环境保护和林区转型发展
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Visits Yichun to Inspect Ecological Protection and Forest Area Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，黑龙江省委书记许勤到伊春市调研生态环境保护和林区转型发展，强调牢记嘱托，书写新时代林区发展新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, Heilongjiang Party Secretary Xu Qin visited Yichun to inspect ecological protection and forest area transformation, stressing the importance of fulfilling the mandate and writing a new chapter for the forest region.

articles.title_zh: 湖南出台智能机器人产业新政 力争突破2000亿元
articles.title_en: Hunan Issues New Policy for Intelligent Robot Industry, Aiming to Exceed 200 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，湖南省政府新闻办在长沙举行新闻发布会，解读加快智能机器人产业发展的实施意见，提出到2030年产业链营收力争突破2000亿元。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, Hunan provincial government held a press conference in Changsha to interpret its implementation opinions on accelerating the intelligent robot industry, targeting revenue over 200 billion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 信长星：把江泽民同志家乡建设得更加美好
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing: Building Comrade Jiang Zemin's Hometown Even Better
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月18日，《人民日报》刊发江苏省委书记信长星署名文章，纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年，表示要把他家乡建设得更加美好。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, 2026, People's Daily published a signed article by Xin Changxing, Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee, commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth and pledging to build his hometown even better.

articles.title_zh: 司法部发布规范涉企行政执法典型案例
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice Releases Typical Cases on Regulating Administrative Law Enforcement Involving Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 近日，司法部发布规范涉企行政执法为民办实事典型案例，共6个案例，涵盖海南、浙江、山东、江苏、山西等地，涉及权责边界规范、执法模式创新等。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Justice recently released typical cases on regulating administrative law enforcement for public benefit, covering six cases from Hainan, Zhejiang, Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanxi, etc., involving clarification of powers and responsibilities and innovation in enforcement models.

tags.name_en: Convenience for the Public and Enterprises

tags_en: Convenience for the Public and Enterprises

articles.title_zh: “新”“智”“绿”，促动能转换提速（权威发布）
articles.title_en: "New", "Smart", "Green": Accelerating Transformation of Growth Drivers
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局8月17日发布数据显示，前7月规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.3%，国民经济运行总体平稳，动能向新、结构向优，高技术产业和智能产品增长较快。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics released data on Aug 17 showing a 5.3% year-on-year increase in industrial output for the first seven months, with stable economic performance and rapid growth in high-tech and smart industries.

articles.title_zh: 《综合交通运输标准化发展“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: Plan for Comprehensive Transport Standardization during 15th Five-Year Period Issued
articles.summary_zh: 近日，交通运输部会同市场监管总局等部门联合印发《综合交通运输标准化发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年发布实施标准800项以上，国际标准转化率达90%以上。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Ministry of Transport, together with the State Administration for Market Regulation and other departments, issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Comprehensive Transport Standardization Development, setting targets of publishing over 800 standards and reaching over 90% international standard conversion rate by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 国内首个批量退役风电机组梯次利用项目正式启动
articles.title_en: China Launches First Batch Retired Wind Turbine Cascade Utilization Project
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国资环旗下资环新能源所属新源酒泉公司启动25台退役风电机组再制造工作，标志着国内首个批量退役风电机组梯次利用项目落地。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Xinyuan Jiuquan Company under China Resources Environment launched remanufacturing of 25 retired wind turbines, marking the first batch cascade utilization project in China.

articles.title_en: Wang Yi, Former Party Secretary of Tianjin Haihe Media Center, Under Investigation for Discipline Violations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月18日，据天津市纪委监委消息，天津海河传媒中心原党委书记王奕涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, 2026, Wang Yi, former Party Secretary of Tianjin Haihe Media Center, is under disciplinary review and supervision investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law, according to Tianjin disciplinary authorities.

articles.title_zh: 兵团召开行政常务会议 研究兵团交通运输“十五五”专项规划等工作
articles.title_en: XPCC Holds Administrative Executive Meeting to Review Transport Plans
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，兵团召开2026年第十六次行政常务会议，研究现代综合交通运输体系发展“十五五”规划等工作，司令员薛斌主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the XPCC held its 16th administrative executive meeting in 2026 to review the 15th Five-Year plan for modern comprehensive transport system, chaired by Commander Xue Bin.

articles.title_zh: 新疆党委常委会召开 研究推进中央巡视反馈意见常态化长效化整改工作
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Advance Long-term Rectification of Central Inspection Feedback
articles.summary_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区党委常委会8月17日召开会议，自治区党委书记陈小江主持，研究国家安全工作和中央巡视反馈意见整改工作。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Xinjiang Regional Party Committee met on August 17, chaired by Secretary Chen Xiaojiang, to discuss national security and the long-term rectification of Central inspection feedback.

articles.title_zh: 云南省人大常委会召开主任会议
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Directors Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，云南省十四届人大常委会第七十八次主任会议在昆明召开，李小三主持，讨论多项议程。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the 78th directors meeting of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee was held in Kunming, chaired by Li Xiaosan, discussing multiple agenda items.

articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism Reports on Handling of 'Low-price Tour' Issues
articles.summary_zh: 云南省文旅厅统筹督导昆明、大理、丽江、西双版纳四州市文旅部门，对央视财经报道的“低价团”相关问题涉事旅行社和导游立案调查，拟吊销多家旅行社经营许可证和导游证。
articles.summary_en: Under the coordination of Yunnan Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism, cultural and tourism authorities in four prefectures investigated travel agencies and guides involved in 'low-price tour' issues reported by CCTV, proposing revocation of licenses.

articles.title_zh: 第168次中老缅泰湄公河联合巡逻执法行动启动
articles.title_en: 168th Joint Patrol on Mekong River Launched by China, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，第168次中老缅泰湄公河联合巡逻执法行动在云南西双版纳启动，四国共出动106名执法人员，历时12天。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the 168th joint patrol on the Mekong River was launched in Xishuangbanna, Yunnan, with 106 law enforcement officers from China, Laos, Myanmar, and Thailand for 12 days.

articles.title_zh: 干部增技能 发展添动能
articles.title_en: Lishui Trains Skilled Cadres to Empower Mountainous Development

articles.summary_en: Lishui, Zhejiang has deepened its reform to cultivate skilled cadres and build a skills-based government, improving the full-chain mechanism to empower high-quality development in mountainous areas.

articles.title_zh: 舟山虾蟹壳的“锂”想
articles.title_en: Zhoushan's Lithium Dream from Shrimp and Crab Shells
articles.summary_zh: 浙江舟山企业利用虾蟹壳提取壳聚糖，制成锂电池水性粘结剂，2025年营收突破1.1亿元，产品批量配套国内头部锂电企业。
articles.summary_en: A Zhoushan-based enterprise uses chitosan from shrimp and crab shells to produce water-based binders for lithium batteries, with revenue exceeding 110 million yuan in 2025, supplying major domestic battery makers.

articles.title_zh: 公安部网安局公布14起涉企网络谣言典型案例
articles.title_en: Public Security Ministry's Cyberspace Security Bureau Releases 14 Typical Cases of Enterprise-Related Online Rumors
articles.summary_zh: 公安部网安局公布14起涉企网络谣言典型案例，多人编造谣言诋毁企业被依法行政处罚。
articles.summary_en: The Public Security Ministry's Cyberspace Security Bureau released 14 typical cases of online rumors targeting enterprises; several individuals were administratively penalized for fabricating rumors.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industry Development

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, Zeng Zanrong, Secretary of Qingdao Municipal Party Committee, visited Laoshan District to inspect innovative industry development, emphasizing the role of enterprises as main innovators.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Ecuadorian President Noboa
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同厄瓜多尔总统诺沃亚举行会谈，就双边关系等交换意见，并见证多项合作文件签署。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 18, President Xi Jinping held talks with Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, exchanging views on bilateral ties and witnessing the signing of cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志遗体在京火化 习近平等到八宝山革命公墓送别
articles.title_en: Zhu Rongji's Body Cremated in Beijing; Xi Jinping Pays Last Respects
articles.summary_zh: 朱镕基同志遗体8月18日在北京八宝山革命公墓火化，习近平等党和国家领导人前往送别，胡锦涛送花圈哀悼。
articles.summary_en: The body of Comrade Zhu Rongji was cremated on August 18 at Babaoshan Revolutionary Cemetery in Beijing. Xi Jinping and other leaders paid their respects, and Hu Jintao sent a wreath.

articles.title_zh: 省政协召开党组扩大会议暨十三届六十四次主席会议
articles.title_en: Anhui Provincial CPPCC Holds Enlarged Party Group Meeting and 64th Chairman's Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，安徽省政协召开党组扩大会议暨十三届六十四次主席会议，省政协党组书记、主席张西明主持并讲话，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和指示精神，研究部署贯彻落实举措。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, the Anhui Provincial Committee of CPPCC held an enlarged Party group meeting and the 64th session of the 13th Standing Committee, chaired by Zhang Ximing, Party Secretary and Chairman, conveying and studying Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and deploying implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会举行会议 研究部署群防群治除险固安百日攻坚行动等工作
articles.title_en: Chongqing Party Committee Holds Meeting to Deploy 100-Day Campaign for Community-Based Risk Elimination and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，重庆市委常委会举行会议，研究部署群防群治除险固安百日攻坚行动等工作，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 17, the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to deploy the 100-day campaign for community-based risk elimination and safety assurance, chaired by Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组举行专题学习会 袁家军主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Holds Thematic Study Session, Yuan Jiajun Chairs and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，重庆市委理论学习中心组举行专题学习会，市委书记袁家军主持并讲话，强调树立大抓基层导向，开创“十五五”开局之年基层工作新局面。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 17, the theoretical study center group of the Chongqing Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to study excerpts from Xi Jinping's discourses on grassroots work methods. Yuan Jiajun, municipal party secretary, presided over the meeting and stressed strengthening grassroots work.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚到南宁调研AI+文化产业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Visits Nanning to Research AI-Enabled Cultural Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚到南宁市调研AI+文化产业高质量发展，强调推动AI赋能，形成商业闭环，开展面向东盟的AI+文化交流合作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, visited Nanning to research AI-enabled cultural industry development, urging AI empowerment and ASEAN-oriented cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 全省群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治攻坚决战工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Conference Held on Intensified Campaign against Corruption and Misconduct around the People
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，河南省召开群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治攻坚决战工作推进会，省委书记刘宁出席并讲话，中央纪委国家监委第五督导组组长王荣军到会指导。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Henan Province held a conference to intensify the campaign against corruption and misconduct affecting the people. Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning attended and spoke, while Wang Rongjun, head of the fifth supervision group of the CCDI and NSS, provided guidance.

articles.title_zh: 湖南实施智能机器人十大重点工程
articles.title_en: Hunan Launches Ten Key Projects for Intelligent Robot Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，湖南举行新闻发布会，解读智能机器人产业发展实施意见，提出到2030年产业链营收突破2000亿元，进入全国第一梯队。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Hunan held a press conference to explain its implementation opinions on the intelligent robot industry, aiming for over 200 billion yuan in revenue by 2030 and entry into the national first tier.

articles.title_zh: 赵乐际主持召开十四届全国人大常委会第七十一次委员长会议 决定十四届全国人大常委会第二十四次会议8月25日至28日在京举行
articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Chairs 71st Chairmen's Meeting of 14th NPC Standing Committee, Decides 24th Session to Be Held Aug 25-28 in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 十四届全国人大常委会第七十一次委员长会议18日上午在北京举行，赵乐际主持，决定第二十四次常委会会议8月25日至28日在京召开。
articles.summary_en: The 71st Chairmen's Meeting of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held in Beijing on Aug 18, chaired by Zhao Leji, deciding the 24th session of the committee to convene from Aug 25 to 28 in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 我们的“十五五”丨未来五年，大好河山添新绿
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year: Greener Land for the Future
articles.summary_zh: “十五五”开局之年，生态环境部等部门联合印发《生态保护“十五五”规划》，提出完善城市绿地系统、提升生态质量指数等目标。
articles.summary_en: At the start of the 15th Five-Year period, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other departments jointly issued the Plan for Ecological Protection during the 15th Five-Year Plan, setting targets to improve urban green spaces and raise the ecological quality index.

articles.title_zh: 两部门预拨6000万元支持河南应急抢险救灾
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Allocate 60 Million Yuan for Emergency Relief in Henan
articles.summary_zh: 8月18日，财政部、应急管理部预拨6000万元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持河南防汛应急抢险救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 18, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management allocated 60 million yuan in central disaster relief funds to support flood emergency response and rescue in Henan.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在调研服务业发展并主持召开座谈会时强调 全力促进服务业优质高效发展 为高质量发展现代化建设提供有力支撑
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Emphasizes High-Quality Development of Service Industry at Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安调研服务业发展并主持召开座谈会，强调要促进服务业优质高效发展，为高质量发展提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Shaanxi Party Secretary Zhao Yide visited Xi'an to inspect service industry development and chaired a symposium, emphasizing high-quality development of the service sector to support modernization.

articles.title_zh: 赵刚主持召开省政府党组会议
articles.title_en: Zhao Gang Chairs Shaanxi Provincial Government Party Group Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，陕西省省长赵刚主持召开省政府党组会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署国防和军队建设及侨务工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Shaanxi Governor Zhao Gang chaired a Party Group meeting of the provincial government to study Xi Jinping's important speeches and deploy national defense and overseas Chinese affairs work.

articles.title_zh: 张工赴津南区调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Inspects Jinnan District
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，天津市长张工赴津南区调研，走访多家高新技术企业，强调坚持创新引领、深化产教融合，增强发展动力。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 17, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong visited Jinnan District, inspecting several high-tech enterprises and stressing innovation-driven development and industry-education integration.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔：坚持“四个以文” 推进城市更新 进一步提升城市业态功能品质
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er: Uphold 'Four Advances' to Promote Urban Renewal and Improve City Functions and Quality
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，天津市委书记陈敏尔调研城市特色建筑焕新利用，强调坚持“四个以文”，推进城市更新，提升城市业态功能品质。
articles.summary_en: On August 17, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er toured historic buildings and commercial districts, stressing cultural preservation and urban renewal to improve city functions and quality.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在绍兴调研强调集中精力抓好项目谋划招引建设
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Project Planning and Attraction During Shaoxing Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日，浙江省委书记王浩在绍兴调研，强调集中精力抓好项目谋划招引建设，深入企业了解科技创新，要求加快创新浙江建设，为高质量发展注入新动力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, Wang Hao, Party Secretary of Zhejiang, inspected Shaoxing, urging focused efforts on project planning and attraction, and visited tech firms to boost innovation-driven development.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江发生2026年第2号洪水
articles.title_en: Flood No.2 of 2026 Hits Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日8时，黑龙江漠河水文站水位涨至警戒水位，洪水编号为2026年第2号。水利部维持Ⅳ级应急响应，派组协助防汛。
articles.summary_en: At 08:00 on August 17, the water level at Mohe Hydrological Station in Heilongjiang reached the warning level, triggering the designation of Flood No.2 of 2026. The Ministry of Water Resources maintained a Level-IV emergency response and dispatched work groups to assist flood control.

articles.title_zh: 遵义市仁怀市委原常委、茅台镇党委原书记王远强被“双开”
articles.title_en: Former Renhuai Official Wang Yuanqiang Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 据遵义市纪委监委消息，经遵义市委批准，对仁怀市委原常委、茅台镇党委原书记王远强严重违纪违法问题立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍和公职处分，并移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: According to the Zunyi Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection, Wang Yuanqiang, former Standing Committee member of Renhuai Municipal Party Committee and former Party Secretary of Moutai Town, was expelled from the Party and public office for serious disciplinary violations and suspected bribery, with his case transferred to prosecutors.

articles.title_zh: 阿塞拜疆语版《习近平的文化情缘》亮相阿国家台
articles.title_en: Azerbaijani Version of "Xi Jinping's Cultural Bonds" Debuts on Azerbaijan's National TV
articles.summary_zh: 当地时间8月14日，中央广播电视总台译制的阿塞拜疆语版《习近平的文化情缘》在巴库启播，并在阿国家电视台和ARB24电视台播出，促进中阿文化交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Azerbaijani version of "Xi Jinping's Cultural Bonds", produced by China Media Group, premiered in Baku and aired on Azerbaijan's national TV and ARB24, boosting cultural exchange.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：江泽民同志的一生，是光辉的一生、战斗的一生
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Comrade Jiang Zemin's Life Was Glorious and Militant
articles.summary_zh: 8月17日上午，纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行，习近平出席并发表重要讲话，高度评价江泽民同志的一生。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 17, a ceremony for the 100th anniversary of Jiang Zemin's birth was held in Beijing. Xi Jinping attended and praised Jiang's glorious life.

articles.title_zh: 1至7月全国铁路完成固定资产投资4406亿元
articles.title_en: Railway Fixed Asset Investment Reaches 440.6 Billion Yuan in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 今年1至7月，全国铁路完成固定资产投资4406亿元，多个重点工程取得积极进展。
articles.summary_en: China's railway fixed asset investment reached 440.6 billion yuan from January to July, with steady progress on key projects.

articles.title_zh: 习近平牵挂的那片林海
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerned Forest Sea
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平总书记对塞罕坝林场建设者的重要指示和实地考察，讲述三代人荒原变林海的生态奇迹，强调传承塞罕坝精神。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's important instructions and field inspection of the Saihanba forest farm, highlighting the ecological miracle of turning wasteland into forest sea and the spirit of Saihanba.

articles.title_zh: 神二十三乘组在轨80余天 多项空间科学实（试）验有序推进
articles.title_en: Shenzhou-23 Crew Completes 80+ Days in Orbit, Space Experiments Progress
articles.summary_zh: 神舟二十三号乘组三名航天员已在轨驻留80余天，空间科学实验和在轨训练有序推进。

articles.summary_en: On August 20, the Malanshan Audio-Video Equipment Industrial Park officially opened, with Chen Jing and Chen Bozhang unveiling the plaque and witnessing contract signings.

articles.title_zh: “好年华 聚福州”第六届人才大会举行

articles.title_zh: 一见·山水间的三重对话

articles.summary_en: On July 17, President Xi Jinping announced at the 2026 World AI Conference that China's meteorological intelligent early warning solution "Mazu" will be deployed in 30 countries. The article reviews Mazu culture and Fujian's "OTS" forecasting technology and "1262" mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在京隆重举行

articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 17, a grand memorial meeting for the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing.

articles.summary_en: The article reviews Saihanba Forest Farm's transformation from wasteland to forest, highlighting Xi Jinping's 2017 instructions and 2021 visit, encouraging the Saihanba spirit and the 'Two Mountains' concept.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨水润莲城“新”意足

articles.summary_en: A report on Xiangtan's riverside cultural-tourism projects, such as Yangmeizhou eco-park and Wanlou youth pier, which boost new consumption scenes and urban economic vitality.

articles.title_zh: “好玩好燃 乐购八桂”体育赛事促消费活动在北海正式启动

articles.summary_en: Shaanxi is building a team of technology managers to facilitate commercialization of research, aiming to add 1,000 certified technology transfer professionals.

articles.title_zh: 河北省构建“中试+”体系推动创新和产业深度融合

It is the first provincial games after the Hainan Free Trade Port's independent customs operation.

articles.title_zh: 包钢在呼伦贝尔市调研

articles.title_zh: 青港两地签署《关于加强农渔业合作的协议》

articles.summary_en: On August 15 afternoon, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun visited the Party School of Jieshou, emphasizing adherence to the Party's principles and improving the school's governance and education.

articles.title_zh: “十四五”期间市场监管部门部署开展专项行动 促进优化营商环境
articles.title_en: Market Regulatory Authorities Launch Special Campaign to Improve Business Environment During 14th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: “十四五”时期，市场监管部门开展滥用行政权力排除限制竞争执法专项行动，查处案件290件，促进优化营商环境和服务全国统一大市场。
articles.summary_en: During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, market regulators carried out special enforcement actions against administrative abuse to exclude or restrict competition, handling 290 cases to optimize the business environment and support the national unified market.

articles.title_zh: 两部门发文提出2030年国内油气供应量目标
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Set Target for Domestic Oil and Gas Supply by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 国家发改委、国家能源局近日印发《石油天然气发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年国内油气供应量达4.4亿吨油当量，并部署管道建设、绿色转型等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Oil and Gas Development, setting a target of 440 million tons of oil equivalent in domestic supply by 2030, along with key tasks in pipeline construction and green transition.

articles.title_zh: 多部门发文进一步保障农业灌溉用水安全
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Issue Notice to Further Ensure Safety of Agricultural Irrigation Water
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部会同工信部、农业农村部等部门近日联合印发通知，加强工业、畜禽养殖等企业污水污染风险防范，保障农业灌溉用水安全。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other departments have jointly issued a notice to strengthen pollution risk prevention from industrial and livestock enterprises, ensuring the safety of agricultural irrigation water.

articles.title_zh: 国家防办、应急管理部向新疆增调中央抗旱物资
articles.title_en: National Flood Control Office and Emergency Management Ministry Send Drought Relief Supplies to Xinjiang
articles.summary_zh: 应新疆防汛抗旱总指挥部请求，国家防总办公室、应急管理部会同国家粮食和储备局向新疆增调抗旱水泵等中央抗旱物资，支持抗旱减灾。
articles.summary_en: At Xinjiang's request, the National Flood Control Office and Emergency Management Ministry, with the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, sent drought relief supplies including pumps and generators.

articles.title_zh: 文献纪录片《江泽民》丨 第12集 《大道行歌》
articles.title_en: Documentary 'Jiang Zemin' Episode 12: 'Song of the Great Way'
articles.summary_zh: 为纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年，中共中央宣传部等联合摄制的十二集文献纪录片《江泽民》播出。本集回顾1985年江泽民主持马克思、恩格斯雕像揭幕及推动马克思主义中国化的历程。
articles.summary_en: To commemorate the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth, the 12-episode documentary 'Jiang Zemin' was co-produced by the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee and others. This episode reviews Jiang's unveiling of the Marx and Engels statues in 1985 and his promotion of the Sinicization of Marxism.

articles.title_zh: 提高防灾减灾救灾能力
articles.title_en: Enhancing Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capabilities
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日出版的第16期《求是》杂志发表中共中央总书记习近平的重要文章《提高防灾减灾救灾能力》，强调坚持党的全面领导，提升防灾减灾救灾能力水平。
articles.summary_en: The 16th issue of Qiushi magazine, issued on August 16, publishes an important article by CPC General Secretary Xi Jinping on enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capabilities, stressing Party leadership and improving disaster response.

articles.title_zh: “推动企业发展更上一层楼，为国家作出更大贡献”——习近平总书记指引企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Enterprises to Pursue High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日，新华社发表综述，回顾习近平总书记深入企业调研、部署支持各类企业发展的系列论述，引领企业走自主创新和高质量发展之路。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, Xinhua published a review of Xi Jinping's important speeches and deployments on supporting enterprise development, guiding enterprises to pursue innovation and high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志遗体18日火化 天安门等地将下半旗志哀
articles.title_en: The Body of Comrade Zhu Rongji to Be Cremated on the 18th; Flags to Fly at Half-Mast in Tiananmen and Other Places
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京8月16日电，朱镕基同志遗体将于18日在北京火化，天安门、新华门等地将下半旗志哀。
articles.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, Aug. 16 - The body of Comrade Zhu Rongji will be cremated in Beijing on the 18th, and flags will fly at half-mast at Tiananmen, Xinhua Gate and other places.

articles.title_zh: 织密农村物流网 释放乡村新活力
articles.title_en: Rural Logistics Networks Enhanced, Unleashing New Rural Vitality
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，各地持续升级农村物流体系，通过冷链直达田间、客货邮融合等方式，补齐城乡流通短板，7月份电商物流农村业务量同比增长超20%。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, regions have been upgrading rural logistics networks through cold-chain direct delivery and passenger-freight bus integration, bridging urban-rural gaps, with rural e-commerce logistics volume growing over 20% year-on-year in July.

articles.title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会17日上午在京隆重举行 习近平将出席大会并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping to Attend Grand Meeting Commemorating 100th Anniversary of Jiang Zemin's Birth
articles.summary_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会将于8月17日上午10时在人民大会堂举行，习近平将出席并发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: A grand meeting commemorating the 100th anniversary of Comrade Jiang Zemin's birth will be held at 10 a.m. on August 17 at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Xi Jinping will attend and deliver an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 以源头创新激发产业发展新动能
articles.title_en: Original Innovation Drives New Impetus for Industrial Development
articles.summary_zh: 全国重点实验室聚焦产业链关键环节，集中攻关核心技术，推动油气采收率提升、氢能防爆涂料等成果落地，促进新质生产力加速形成。
articles.summary_en: The national key laboratories focus on key links of industrial chains, tackling core technologies, and promoting application of innovations like enhanced oil recovery and hydrogen safety coatings, accelerating new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Shantou Municipal Government Holds Party Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日下午，汕头市市长陈涛主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，传达学习上级精神，部署城乡区域协调发展、学习“义乌发展经验”等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 14, Chen Tao, Secretary of the Party Group and Mayor of Shantou, chaired the expanded Party Group meeting and executive meeting to convey higher-level directives and deploy work on urban-rural coordination and learning from Yiwu's development experience.

articles.title_zh: 2026年汕尾开渔文旅活动举行
articles.title_en: 2026 Shanwei Fishing Season Cultural Tourism Event Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日，2026年汕尾开渔文旅活动在汕尾市城区海港文旅码头举行，市委书记逯峰出席并讲话，启动开渔。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, the 2026 Shanwei Fishing Season Cultural Tourism Event was held at the Harbor Cultural Tourism Pier in Shanwei's urban area. Municipal Party Secretary Lu Feng attended, delivered a speech, and launched the fishing season.

articles.title_zh: 全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会暨第七期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: Taizhou Holds Leadership Study Session Featuring Lecture on Embodied Intelligent Robots
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，泰州市举行全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会暨第七期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，华中科技大学教授陈学东作专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬等参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Taizhou held a Party committee theoretical study session featuring a lecture by Professor Chen Xuedong on embodied intelligent robots, attended by municipal leaders.

articles.title_zh: 绿发中科锂电容量产线项目签约
articles.title_en: Green Development Zhongke Lithium Capacitor Production Line Project Signed
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，姜堰经济开发区与北京绿发中科锂电容科技有限公司签约，总投资30亿元建设锂电容量产线项目，市委书记姜冬冬出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Jiangyan Economic Development Zone signed an agreement with Beijing Green Development Zhongke Lithium Capacitor Technology Co., Ltd. for a 3 billion yuan lithium capacitor production line project, attended by Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong.

articles.title_en: Green Development Zhongke Lithium Capacitor Production Line Project Signed
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，姜堰经济开发区与北京绿发中科锂电容科技有限公司签约，建设总投资30亿元的锂电容量产线，年产900万支全碳型锂离子电容器。市委书记姜冬冬、中国绿发董事长孙瑜出席。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Jiangyan Economic Development Zone signed a 3-billion-yuan lithium-capacitor project with Beijing GD Zhongke. Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong and GD Chairman Sun Yu attended.

articles.title_zh: 全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会暨第七期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: City-Wide Party Committee (Party Group) Theoretical Learning Center Group Session and 7th Leading Cadres' 'Frontier Lecture Hall' Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，泰州举行全市党委（党组）理论学习中心组学习会暨第七期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，陈学东作具身智能机器人专题授课，市委书记姜冬冬等参加。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Taizhou held its municipal Party committee (Party group) theoretical learning center group session and the 7th Leading Cadres' Frontier Lecture Hall, where Chen Xuedong lectured on embodied intelligent robots, with Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong attending.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰督导检查“保回迁”项目建设进展并主持召开专题会
articles.title_en: Hao Huijie Inspects Resettlement Housing Projects and Chairs Special Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，陕西省委常委、西安市委书记蒿慧杰督导检查“保回迁”项目建设情况并主持召开专题会，强调确保群众如期回迁安居。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of Xi'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected resettlement housing projects and chaired a special meeting, stressing that residents must be relocated and housed on time with satisfaction.

articles.title_zh: 四胎能休产假吗？四川崇州人社局：生育第四孩不能享受90天延长产假
articles.title_en: Chongzhou HR Bureau: No 90-Day Extended Maternity Leave for Fourth Child
articles.summary_zh: 四川崇州网民询问四孩产假问题，崇州人社局回应称生育第四孩可享受98天基础产假，但不能享受四川省规定的90天延长产假。
articles.summary_en: In response to a netizen's query, Chongzhou HR Bureau in Sichuan stated that a fourth child is entitled to the basic 98-day maternity leave but not the 90-day extended leave under provincial regulations.

articles.title_zh: 航行警告！南海部分海域进行军事训练，禁止驶入
articles.title_en: Navigation Warning! Military Training in Parts of South China Sea, Entry Prohibited
articles.summary_zh: 江门海事局发布航行警告，8月16日至17日每日0时至12时，南海部分海域进行军事训练，禁止驶入。
articles.summary_en: Jiangmen Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that military training will be conducted in parts of the South China Sea from 0000 to 1200 on Aug 16-17, with entry prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 多地官方纠偏：别把社会工作部叫成“社工部”
articles.title_en: Officials in Multiple Regions Correct Misnomer: Don't Call the Social Work Department 'Shegongbu'
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，陕西韩城市委社会工作部发文指出，不应将“社会工作部”简称为“社工部”，以免混淆党的职能部门与专业服务人员。河南淇县等地也已作出类似纠偏。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, the Social Work Department of the CPC Hancheng Municipal Committee warned against abbreviating 'Social Work Department' as 'Shegongbu', as it confuses Party functions with professional social workers.

articles.title_zh: 从四张成绩单看美丽中国建设新图景
articles.title_en: Beautiful China: Four Report Cards Show Green Development Progress
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月，在《生态环境法典》施行之际，文章以四张成绩单展示我国在降碳、减污、扩绿、增长方面的绿色发展成就，强调生态文明建设成效。
articles.summary_en: In August 2026, as the Ecological Environment Code took effect, the article uses four report cards to showcase China's achievements in carbon reduction, pollution control, greening, and growth, highlighting progress in ecological civilization.

articles.title_zh: 习言道丨良好生态环境是最普惠的民生福祉
articles.title_en: Xi's Words: Good Ecological Environment Is the Most Inclusive Public Wellbeing
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记指出良好生态环境是最公平的公共产品和最普惠的民生福祉，强调越是发展任务重越要重视生态环境保护。全国生态日之际，重温其重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping pointed out that a good ecological environment is the most equitable public product and the most inclusive public wellbeing, stressing that ecological protection must be enhanced as development tasks grow. His important remarks are reviewed on China's National Ecological Day.

articles.title_zh: 洪秀柱：一湾浅浅的海峡隔不开血脉 国家统一是历史大势
articles.title_en: Hung Hsiu-chu: The Shallow Strait Cannot Separate Blood Ties; National Reunification Is the Historical Trend
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，中国国民党前主席洪秀柱在广东阳江表示，海峡隔不开血脉，国家统一是历史大势，和平统一需依靠民间交流与文化联结。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, Hung Hsiu-chu, former chairman of the Chinese Kuomintang, said in Yangjiang, Guangdong that the Strait cannot separate blood ties, national reunification is the historical trend, and peaceful reunification relies on people-to-people exchanges and cultural bonds.

articles.title_zh: 从造梦到造物：AI科研实验室助力新材料创新
articles.title_en: From Dream to Reality: AI Research Lab Drives Innovation in New Materials
articles.summary_zh: 在安徽合肥，中国科大科学智能物质创制中心依托全球首个AI全链条驱动科研实验室，在新材料、新农药等领域取得突破，并推动产学研深度融合。
articles.summary_en: At the AI-driven research lab in Hefei, Anhui, the USTC Center for Scientific Intelligence and Material Creation has achieved breakthroughs in new materials and pesticides, promoting deep integration of industry, academia, and research.

articles.title_zh: 深化拓展“AI+” 江苏制造加速拥抱智能时代
articles.title_en: Deepen and Expand 'AI+': Jiangsu Manufacturing Accelerates to Embrace the Intelligent Era
articles.summary_zh: 近日，“活力中国调研行”采访团探访江苏多地，人工智能正与制造业深度融合，推动江苏制造智能化转型，上半年规上工业增加值同比增长6.7%。
articles.summary_en: Recently, a "Vibrant China Research Tour" team visited multiple places in Jiangsu. AI is deeply integrating with manufacturing, driving Jiangsu's smart transformation. In H1, value-added industrial output grew 6.7% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 严禁臆造“非遗大师”，福建惠安呼吁石雕从业者摒弃虚假噱头
articles.title_en: Fujian Hui'an Bans Fake 'Intangible Heritage Master' Titles in Stone Carving Industry
articles.summary_zh: 惠安县文旅局近日向石雕从业者发出倡议，严禁臆造“非遗大师”等荣誉，整治违规使用非遗标识等乱象。
articles.summary_en: Hui'an County tourism authority issued a proposal urging stone carving practitioners to stop using fake 'intangible heritage master' titles and regulate the use of heritage logos.

articles.summary_zh: 近期，多地党委社会工作部密集发文，强调规范简称为“社会工作部”或“中社部”，避免使用“社工部”，以免混淆党委职能部门与专业社工。

articles.summary_en: From August 14 to 15, the Gansu Property Industry Vocational Skills Competition was held in Lanzhou New Area, attracting over 500 contestants to enhance professional standards in property services.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台方案加强旅游市场综合监管
articles.title_en: Guangxi Issues Plan to Strengthen Comprehensive Tourism Market Regulation
articles.summary_zh: 广西壮族自治区人民政府办公厅近日印发方案，从六方面加强旅游市场综合监管，纠治导游乱象和强制消费等问题，提升旅游服务质量。
articles.summary_en: The People's Government of Guangxi issued a plan to strengthen tourism market regulation, targeting guide misconduct and forced consumption to improve service quality.

articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，黑龙江省委书记许勤、省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨会见中国能建董事长倪真一行，双方就深化能源领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, and Liang Huiling, Governor, met with Ni Zhen, Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group, in Harbin to discuss deepening cooperation in energy and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 山东出台主要秋收作物防灾减灾机械化技术指导意见
articles.title_en: Shandong Issues Technical Guidance on Mechanized Disaster Prevention for Major Autumn Harvest Crops
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，山东省农业农村厅印发指导意见，针对强降雨、渍涝、大风、高温干旱等不利天气，提出机械排涝、应急抢收等防灾减灾机械化技术措施。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, Shandong Provincial Department of Agriculture issued technical guidance proposing mechanized measures such as drainage and emergency harvesting to mitigate disasters for corn, soybean, and peanut production.

articles.title_zh: 切实维护人民群众生命财产安全和社会稳定
articles.title_en: Effectively Safeguard People's Lives and Property and Maintain Social Stability
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《提高防灾减灾救灾能力》，总书记多次就防汛抗洪救灾作出指示，强调全力维护人民群众生命财产安全和社会稳定。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, Qiushi magazine published an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation, and relief capabilities. Xi has repeatedly instructed on flood control and relief, emphasizing the protection of people's lives and property and maintaining social stability.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺在阜阳市调研检查防汛工作
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun Inspects Flood Control Work in Fuyang
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，安徽省委书记梁言顺在阜阳市调研检查防汛工作，强调筑牢防汛救灾坚固防线。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, Liang Yanshun, Secretary of the Anhui Provincial Party Committee, inspected flood control work in Fuyang City, emphasizing a solid flood prevention and disaster relief line.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚韦韬深入钦州市调研并召开平陆运河建成通航倒计时30天推进会
articles.title_en: Chen Gang, Wei Tao Inspect Qinzhou and Convene Meeting on 30-Day Countdown to Pinglu Canal Opening
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日至15日，自治区党委书记陈刚、自治区主席韦韬在钦州调研，并召开平陆运河建成通航倒计时30天推进会，强调确保安全高质量通航。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 14 to 15, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, and Wei Tao, Chairman of the Autonomous Region, inspected Qinzhou and convened a meeting on the 30-day countdown to the completion and opening of the Pinglu Canal, stressing ensuring safe and high-quality navigation on time.

articles.title_zh: 李国英刘宁在周口许昌漯河指导调度防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Li Guoying and Liu Ning Direct Flood Control in Zhoukou, Xuchang, Luohe
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日至15日，国家防总副总指挥、水利部部长李国英和河南省委书记刘宁赴周口、许昌、漯河指导调度防汛救灾，强调坚持人民至上、生命至上，打好防汛救灾硬仗。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 14 to 15, Li Guoying, Vice Commander of the National Flood Control Headquarters and Minister of Water Resources, and Liu Ning, Henan Provincial Party Secretary, visited Zhoukou, Xuchang and Luohe to direct flood control and disaster relief, stressing a people-first approach.

articles.title_zh: 湖南怀化：箱包“出海记”
articles.title_en: Luggage 'Goes Global' in Huaihua, Hunan
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，记者团在湖南怀化国际陆港调研了解到，当地箱包皮具产业依托铁海联运‘聚链出海’，总产值突破60亿元，上半年出口总额达2.1亿元。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, a reporter team visited Huaihua International Land Port in Hunan, finding that the local luggage and leather goods industry, benefiting from rail-sea intermodal transport, saw total output exceed 6 billion yuan and export 210 million yuan in H1.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记指引企业坚定不移走高质量发展之路
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Enterprises to Firmly Follow the Path of High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社综述回顾习近平总书记对各类企业高质量发展的重要指引，强调创新驱动、做强实业，支持国企民企外企共同发展，为企业注入信心和方向。
articles.summary_en: This Xinhua review highlights Xi Jinping's guidance for enterprises to pursue high-quality development, emphasizing innovation, real economy, and equal support for state-owned, private, and foreign firms.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 多地新发现一批日军侵华史料实物
articles.title_en: Multiple Locations Uncover New Historical Materials on Japanese Invasion of China
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，侵华日军南京大屠杀遇难同胞纪念馆公布上半年新征集文物史料；哈尔滨、广州等地也相继公布和接受多批日军侵华相关史料，揭露侵华罪行。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 15, the Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre announced newly collected artifacts, while Harbin and Guangzhou also released and accepted historical materials exposing Japanese invasion crimes.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部调派13支排涝队伍赴周口开展排涝作业
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Dispatches 13 Drainage Teams to Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日，应急管理部调派13支排涝力量紧急赶赴河南周口，于上午9时全部抵达并投入排涝作业，总排涝能力约每小时22万立方米。
articles.summary_en: On August 16, the Ministry of Emergency Management dispatched 13 drainage teams to Zhoukou, Henan, all arriving by 9 a.m. and starting operations with a total capacity of about 220,000 cubic meters per hour.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在省水利厅主持召开防汛工作视频调度会议
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Chairs Flood Control Video Conference at Provincial Water Resources Department
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日上午，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在省水利厅主持召开防汛工作视频调度会议，部署防汛救灾工作，要求坚决维护群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 15, Liu Jie, deputy secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and governor, presided over a flood control video conference at the Provincial Water Resources Department to arrange flood prevention and disaster relief, urging protection of people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 最高检发布检察公益诉讼服务保障美丽中国建设典型案例
articles.title_en: SPP Releases Model Cases on Public Interest Litigation for Building a Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日全国生态日，最高人民检察院发布检察公益诉讼服务保障美丽中国建设典型案例，并答记者问，介绍2025年以来办理生态环境公益诉讼案件7.3万件及贯彻实施生态环境法典举措。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, 2026, the Supreme People's Procuratorate released model cases on public interest litigation for a Beautiful China, reporting 73,000 environmental cases since 2025 and answering questions on implementing the Ecological Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区人大财政经济委员会主任委员冯玉臻接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Feng Yuzhen, Director of Financial and Economic Committee of Inner Mongolia People's Congress, Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，据内蒙古自治区纪委监委消息，内蒙古自治区人大财政经济委员会主任委员冯玉臻涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, according to the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision, Feng Yuzhen, director of the Financial and Economic Committee of the Regional People's Congress, is suspected of serious disciplinary and legal violations and is under investigation.

articles.title_zh: 推动生态环境损害赔偿制度改革进程的十大案例发布
articles.title_en: Ten Major Cases Promoting Reform of Ecological Environment Damage Compensation System Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，生态环境部联合最高人民法院、最高人民检察院发布推动生态环境损害赔偿制度改革进程的十大案例，聚焦长江、黄河流域和青藏高原等重点生态区域。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, together with the Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate, released ten major cases to promote the reform of the ecological environment damage compensation system, focusing on the Yangtze River, Yellow River and Qinghai-Tibet Plateau.

articles.title_zh: 生态环境法典正式施行
articles.title_en: Ecological Environment Code Officially Takes Effect
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，继民法典后我国第二部以“法典”命名的法律《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》正式施行，标志着生态环境法治建设迈入新境界。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China, the second law named "Code" after the Civil Code, officially took effect, marking a new stage in ecological environment legal construction.

articles.title_zh: 外交部发言人就日本政要参拜供奉甲级战犯的靖国神社答记者问
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Responds on Japanese Politicians' Visit to Yasukuni Shrine
articles.summary_zh: 外交部发言人强烈谴责日本政要参拜靖国神社，已向日方提出严正交涉和强烈抗议。
articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson strongly condemned Japanese politicians' visit to Yasukuni Shrine and lodged solemn representations and strong protest with Japan.

articles.title_zh: 拒绝遗忘日本罪行的“马库斯”们：无论国籍，真相是唯一的立场
articles.title_en: The 'Marcuses' Who Refuse to Forget Japan's Crimes: Truth Is the Only Stance Regardless of Nationality
articles.summary_zh: 法国青年马库斯与中国青年钟灏松在东京涩谷街头呼吁日本正视侵华历史，马库斯曾捐赠外祖父拍摄的日军侵华照片。文章批评日本首相高市早苗在长崎纪念仪式上的表态及修改历史表述的行为。
articles.summary_en: French youth Marcus and Chinese youth Zhong Haosong rallied in Tokyo's Shibuya to urge Japan to face its wartime aggression. The article criticizes Japanese PM Takaichi Sanae's stance and attempts to revise historical narratives.

articles.title_zh: 把伟大抗战精神一代代传下去
articles.title_en: Carry Forward the Great Spirit of the Anti-Japanese War from Generation to Generation
articles.summary_zh: 2025年7月7日，习近平总书记在山西阳泉参观百团大战纪念馆，缅怀抗战烈士，强调讲好抗战故事，把伟大抗战精神一代代传下去。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, 2025, General Secretary Xi Jinping visited the Memorial Hall of the Hundred Regiment Campaign in Yangquan, Shanxi, to honor fallen heroes and called for carrying forward the great spirit of the Anti-Japanese War.

articles.title_zh: 习近平生态文明思想引领美丽中国建设谱新篇
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization Leads New Chapter in Building Beautiful China
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，第四个全国生态日到来之际，《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》正式施行，以习近平生态文明思想为魂和纲，开启生态环境保护法典化时代。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 15, the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China took effect on the 4th National Ecology Day, marking a new era of codified ecological protection guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization.

articles.title_zh: 中国人民银行将发行江泽民诞辰100周年纪念币
articles.title_en: China's Central Bank to Issue Commemorative Coins for Jiang Zemin's 100th Birthday
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行8月14日发布公告，定于8月17日起发行江泽民诞辰100周年纪念币，共4枚，均为法定货币。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China announced on August 14 that it will issue commemorative coins for the 100th birthday of Jiang Zemin starting from August 17, 2026, including 4 coins as legal tender.

articles.title_zh: 追火箭带火滨海小城文旅
articles.title_en: Rocket Launch Boosts Coastal Town's Cultural Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，山东海阳成功发射捷龙三号火箭，吸引5万余名航天迷观光，带动文旅关联消费同比增长40%。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 5, a rocket launch in Haiyang, Shandong attracted over 50,000 space fans, boosting local cultural tourism consumption by 40% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 让中国式现代化的底色更加亮丽
articles.title_en: Making the Foundation of Chinese Modernization More Beautiful
articles.summary_zh: 文章从降碳、减污、扩绿、增长四方面展现美丽中国建设新图景，强调《生态环境法典》8月15日施行，推动绿色低碳转型。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews China's ecological progress in carbon reduction, pollution control, greening, and green growth, highlighting the implementation of the Ecological Environment Code and the green transition.

articles.title_zh: 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Promoting Sustained Economic Innovation, Optimization, and Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报评论文章分析上半年GDP增长4.7%，强调下半年经济工作要向‘向新、向优、向好’发展，加快新旧动能转换，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily commentary analyzes 4.7% GDP growth in H1, emphasizing H2 work should focus on innovation, quality, and improvement, accelerating the shift in growth drivers for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 中央宣传部等部门联合印发通知要求开展生态环境法典学习宣传工作
articles.title_en: Central Propaganda Department and Others Issue Notice on Promoting Ecological Environment Code Study
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中央宣传部等19部门联合印发通知，部署开展《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》学习宣传工作，要求纳入“九五”普法重点内容。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Central Propaganda Department and other 18 departments jointly issued a notice to promote the study and publicity of the Ecological Environment Code, incorporating it into the 9th Five-Year Plan for legal awareness.

articles.title_zh: 多部门支持河南应对洪涝灾害
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Support Henan in Flood Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会针对河南严重洪涝灾害启动国家四级救灾应急响应，多部门调拨中央救灾和防汛物资及资金，支持河南抗洪抢险。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 14, the National Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Committee activated a Level-IV emergency response for Henan's severe floods; multiple departments dispatched central relief and flood-control supplies and funds.

articles.title_zh: 雷锋精神代代传承
articles.title_en: Lei Feng Spirit Inherited Generation by Generation
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁抚顺持续推动学雷锋活动融入日常、化作经常，涌现出大量志愿者和“百姓雷锋”，让雷锋精神代代传承。
articles.summary_en: Fushun, Liaoning, continues to integrate Lei Feng spirit into daily life, with over 250,000 volunteers and 1,700 service teams, passing on the spirit from generation to generation.

articles.title_zh: 市政府专题调度经济稳增长工作
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Special Meeting on Steady Economic Growth
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚主持召开经济稳增长工作调度会议，分析经济运行情况，安排三季度和下半年重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Gu Gang, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Changchun Municipal Committee and Mayor, chaired a coordination meeting on steady economic growth, analyzing the economic situation and arranging key tasks for Q3 and the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠会见欧摩威集团执行董事会成员鲍里斯·梅格尔一行
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Meets Oumowei Group Executive Board Member Boris Maegel
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，吉林省委常委、长春市委书记张恩惠会见欧摩威集团高管鲍里斯·梅格尔一行，就深化汽车产业合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Zhang Enhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Jilin Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Committee, met with Boris Maegel, executive board member of Oumowei Group, to discuss deepening cooperation in the automobile industry.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林会见浦发银行董事长张为忠、行长谢伟
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin Meets Chairman Zhang Weizhong and President Xie Wei of SPD Bank
articles.summary_zh: 8月14日，辽宁省委书记许昆林在沈阳会见浦发银行董事长张为忠、行长谢伟，双方就深化金融合作、支持辽宁振兴发展等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 14, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee, met with Zhang Weizhong and Xie Wei, Chairman and President of SPD Bank, in Shenyang to discuss deepening financial cooperation and supporting Liaoning's revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《提高防灾减灾救灾能力》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Magazine Publishes Important Article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on Enhancing Disaster Prevention, Mitigation and Relief Capabilities
articles.summary_zh: 8月16日出版的《求是》杂志将发表习近平总书记重要文章，强调坚持党的全面领导，提高防灾减灾救灾能力。
articles.summary_en: The Qiushi magazine issue published on August 16 will carry an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping, stressing Party leadership and enhancing disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 截至6月底电动汽车充电基础设施总数同比增长43.2%
articles.title_en: EV Charging Infrastructure Grows 43.2% YoY to 23.057 Million by End of June
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局数据显示，截至6月底我国电动汽车充电基础设施总数达2305.7万个，同比增长43.2%；县域充电设施覆盖率达98.61%。
articles.summary_en: According to the National Energy Administration, China's EV charging infrastructure reached 23.057 million units by end of June, up 43.2% year-on-year; county coverage reached 98.61%.

articles.title_zh: 多地出现强降雨天气 防汛救灾加紧进行
articles.title_en: Heavy Rains Hit Multiple Regions, Flood Control and Disaster Relief Underway
articles.summary_zh: 近期我国多地出现强降雨，河南周口堤防溃口正在封堵，浙江发生内涝，国家防总等部门调拨物资并提升防汛应急响应。
articles.summary_en: Heavy rains hit multiple regions in China. A levee breach in Henan is being repaired; Zhejiang faces flooding. Authorities have sent supplies and raised emergency response levels.

articles.title_zh: 今年前7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次
articles.title_en: Passenger Trips on National Railways Reach 2.8 Billion in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日从国铁集团获悉，1至7月全国铁路发送旅客28亿人次，同比增长4.1%，创历史同期新高。
articles.summary_en: China's national railways carried 2.8 billion passenger trips in the first seven months of this year, up 4.1% year on year, setting a record high for the period, according to China State Railway Group on August 15.
