articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order to Amend and Repeal Some Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》，自8月15日起施行，涉及修改12部、废止3部行政法规以贯彻生态环境法典。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order announcing the decision to amend and repeal some administrative regulations, effective August 15, to implement the Ecological Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 许昆林王新伟会见出席新辽经贸理事会第十一次会议的新加坡客人
articles.title_en: Xu Kunlin and Wang Xinwei Meet Singapore Guests at 11th Singapore-Liaoning Economic and Trade Council Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，辽宁省委书记许昆林、省长王新伟在沈阳会见新加坡社会及家庭发展部部长马善高一行，就深化双方经贸合作等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Xu Kunlin, Secretary of Liaoning Provincial Committee, and Governor Wang Xinwei met with Masagos Zulkifli, Singapore's Minister for Social and Family Development, in Shenyang to discuss deepening economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月12日11时06分，国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病医治无效在北京逝世，享年98岁。中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协发布讣告。
articles.summary_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council, passed away in Beijing at 11:06 on August 12, 2026, at the age of 98. The CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee issued an obituary.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱主持召开市委常委会会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, Wang Xingzhu, secretary of the Hegang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions.

articles.title_zh: 史志军调研淮安海关工作
articles.title_en: Shi Zhijun Inspects Huai'an Customs Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，淮安市委书记史志军调研淮安海关，强调提升监管效能和服务水平，助推外贸稳量提质，服务枢纽经济与营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Shi Zhijun, secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected Huai'an Customs, urging better regulation and services to boost foreign trade and business environment.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研淮安海关工作
articles.title_en: City Leaders Inspect Huai'an Customs Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，淮安市委书记史志军调研淮安海关，强调提升监管效能和服务水平，助推外贸稳量提质。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Shi Zhijun, Party Secretary of Huai'an, inspected Huai'an Customs, stressing improving regulation and service to boost foreign trade.

articles.title_zh: 黄韡调研城市更新工作并主持召开专题会强调高水平推进城市更新
articles.title_en: Huang Wei Inspects Urban Renewal Work and Chairs Special Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，市委副书记、市长候选人黄韡到杜集区调研城市更新工作并主持召开专题会，强调点线面一体提质，高水平推进城市更新。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Huang Wei, deputy secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee and mayoral candidate, inspected urban renewal work in Duji District and chaired a special meeting, emphasizing coordinated quality improvement and high-level urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖调研㵲水大型灌区项目建设
articles.title_en: Wei Chaohui Visits Construction of Wushui Large Irrigation District
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日下午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖调研㵲水大型灌区项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 11, Wei Chaohui, Secretary of the Huaihua Municipal Party Committee, inspected the construction of the Wushui Large Irrigation District project.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组举行学习会议
articles.title_en: Chen Rujiang Chairs Study Meeting of Municipal People's Congress Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组举行学习会议，市人大常委会党组书记、主任陈儒江主持并讲话，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神及中央政治局会议精神。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, the Party Leadership Group of the Municipal People's Congress held a study meeting chaired by Chen Rujiang to convey recent important speeches by General Secretary Xi Jinping and the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting.

articles.title_zh: 深入学习贯彻中央政治局会议精神 奋力完成全年经济社会发展目标任务
articles.title_en: Wu Zhiling Chairs Huangshi Government Standing Meeting on Economic Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，黄石市市长吴之凌主持召开市政府常务会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神，研究农业农村、港口物流、应急体系等'十五五'发展规划。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Huangshi Mayor Wu Zhiling chaired a government standing meeting to convey the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and discuss the 15th Five-Year Plan for agriculture, port logistics, and emergency response.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰调研重点项目及古城保育活化工作
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Inspects Key Projects and Ancient City Conservation Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，揭阳市委副书记、市长曲晓杰赴榕城区调研重点项目及古城保育活化工作，强调保护与发展并重，补齐民生短板。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Mayor Qu Xiaojie of Jieyang inspected key projects and ancient city conservation in Rongcheng, stressing protection-development balance and livelihood improvement.

articles.title_zh: 中共揭阳市委七届十一次全会召开 决定今年12月召开市第八次党代会
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Party Committee Holds 11th Plenary Session, Decides to Convene 8th Party Congress in December
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，中共揭阳市委七届十一次全会召开，审议通过关于召开市第八次党代会的决议，并追认开除黄锐亮党籍的处分决定。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the 11th Plenary Session of the CPC Jieyang Municipal Committee was held, approving the resolution to convene the 8th Municipal Party Congress and ratifying the expulsion of Huang Ruiliang from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定
articles.title_en: State Council Decision on Amending and Repealing Certain Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日国务院常务会议通过决定，修改12部行政法规、废止3部，以贯彻实施生态环境法典，自8月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the State Council executive meeting approved a decision to amend 12 and repeal 3 administrative regulations, effective August 15, to implement the Ecological Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree on Amending and Repealing Administrative Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布《国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定》，自2026年8月15日起施行，修改12部、废止3部行政法规。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to amend and repeal some administrative regulations, effective Aug 15, 2026, revising 12 and repealing 3 regulations to support the Eco-Environment Code.

articles.title_zh: 学习宣传贯彻《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Symposium on Studying and Implementing the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China Convened
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，学习宣传贯彻《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》座谈会在拉萨召开，自治区领导旦巴、肖友才等出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, a symposium on studying and implementing the Ecological Environment Code of the People's Republic of China was held in Lhasa, with regional leaders Danba and Xiao Youcai attending and delivering speeches.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 全国人大常委会 国务院 全国政协讣告朱镕基同志逝世
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council, and CPPCC National Committee Announce the Passing of Comrade Zhu Rongji
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党中央委员会等机构沉痛宣告，国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病医治无效，于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年98岁。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee and other national institutions announced with deep sorrow that Comrade Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council, passed away at 11:06 on August 12, 2026 in Beijing at the age of 98.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委审计委员会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Meeting of Regional Party Committee Audit Commission
articles.summary_zh: 近日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委审计委员会会议，强调提高审计工作质量和水平，为高质量发展提供保障。
articles.summary_en: Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, chaired a meeting of the Regional Party Committee Audit Commission, stressing higher audit quality to support high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 波密县易贡乡：甜蜜西瓜铺就乡村振兴共富路
articles.title_en: Sweet Watermelon Harvest Paves Way for Rural Revitalization in Bomi County's Yigong Township
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月13日，波密县易贡乡发展西瓜种植，带动村民增收，为乡村振兴铺就甜蜜共富路。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, 2026, Yigong Township in Bomi County developed watermelon farming to increase villagers' incomes, paving a sweet road to rural revitalization and common prosperity.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区首届牦牛产业发展大会开幕
articles.title_en: First Yak Industry Development Conference of Tibet Autonomous Region Opens
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，西藏自治区首届牦牛产业发展大会在那曲市开幕，自治区主席嘎玛泽登出席并致辞，强调推动牦牛产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the first yak industry development conference of Tibet Autonomous Region opened in Nagqu, with regional chairman Gamagzedeng attending and delivering a speech emphasizing high-quality development of the yak industry.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市委市政府向老同志通报上半年工作情况
articles.title_en: Longyan Municipal Party Committee and Government Brief Retired Cadres on First Half-Year Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，龙岩市委、市政府召开2026年上半年工作情况通报会，市委书记胡盛主持，市长蔡琳通报，并听取老同志意见建议。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Longyan Municipal Party Committee and Government held a briefing on the first half of 2026 work. Party Secretary Hu Sheng presided, Mayor Cai Lin reported, and opinions from retired cadres were solicited.

articles.title_zh: 那曲市组织集中收看庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会
articles.title_en: Nagqu City Organizes Centralized Viewing of 105th Anniversary of CPC Celebration
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，那曲市组织集中收看庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会直播，市委书记张海波出席并讲话，强调坚定理想信念、强化使命担当等。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, Nagqu City organized a centralized viewing of the live broadcast of the 105th anniversary celebration of the CPC. Municipal Party Secretary Zhang Haibo attended and emphasized firm ideals and mission.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委审计委员会会议

articles.summary_en: Hebei has been earnestly implementing important instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping, applying the 'Ten Million Project' experience to promote rural revitalization, ensure food security, develop distinctive industries, and build livable and beautiful villages.

articles.title_zh: 王正谱在石家庄市衡水市调研
articles.title_en: Wang Zhengpu Visits Shijiazhuang and Hengshui for Research
articles.summary_zh: 河北省省长王正谱在石家庄、衡水调研，强调发挥科创平台作用，加快产业转型升级，培育经济发展新动能。
articles.summary_en: Governor Wang Zhengpu of Hebei visited Shijiazhuang and Hengshui, emphasizing the role of sci-tech innovation platforms to accelerate industrial transformation and foster new economic drivers.

articles.title_zh: 本周日 福州迎来开渔季
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Fishing Season Opens This Sunday
articles.summary_zh: 福建省北纬26度30分以北海域8月11日开捕，福州海域将于8月16日12时开渔，近1700艘渔船结束休渔出海。
articles.summary_en: Fishing in waters north of 26°30′N in Fujian started on Aug 11; Fuzhou's season opens at noon Aug 16, with nearly 1,700 boats leaving port.

articles.title_zh: 福州大健康智造产业园10月投用
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Health-Tech Manufacturing Park to Open in October
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，记者从闽侯经济技术开发区获悉，岁金智谷二期福州大健康智造产业园建设进入收尾阶段，预计10月投用，已引进14家企业。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, the Minhou Economic and Technological Development Zone said the second phase of Suijin Zhigu Fuzhou Health-Tech Manufacturing Park is in final construction and expected to open in October, with 14 companies signed.

articles.title_zh: 福州市人大常委会向社会公开征集立法项目建议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Calls for Public Suggestions on Legislative Projects
articles.summary_zh: 福州市人大常委会自即日起至9月15日向社会公开征集五年立法规划和2027年立法工作计划建议项目，以推进科学立法、民主立法、依法立法。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress is publicly soliciting proposals for its 2027-2031 five-year legislative plan and 2027 work plan from now until Sept 15, 2026, to advance scientific, democratic, and law-based legislation.

tags.name_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Fuzhou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 福州鼓楼核心商务区信和片区交通整治见成效
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Gulou Business District Traffic Improvement Shows Results
articles.summary_zh: 福州市人大代表陈勇牵头推动鼓楼信和片区交通整治，缓解停车难、行车难，白领和外卖骑手受益。
articles.summary_en: Fuzhou people's congress deputy Chen Yong led traffic improvements in the Gulou Xinhe business area, easing parking and traffic congestion for office workers and delivery riders.

articles.title_zh: 福州有个工会“就业超市”
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Has a Union 'Employment Supermarket'
articles.summary_zh: 福州市总工会打造“工会稳岗就业创业服务超市”，将就业服务从“送岗位”延伸至“育能力”，累计发布岗位逾10万个，惠及职工超20万人次。
articles.summary_en: The Fuzhou Federation of Trade Unions has built an 'employment supermarket' that extends services from job placement to skill training, posting over 100,000 positions and benefiting over 200,000 workers.

articles.title_zh: 市人民政府开展服务业经济运行督导调研 于海田参加
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Government Conducts Supervision and Research on Service Industry Economic Operation; Yu Haitian Participates
articles.summary_zh: 近日，济南市人民政府领导带队到各区县督导调研服务业经济运行，市长于海田参加，强调推动服务业扩能提质，冲刺三季度目标。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Municipal People's Government led teams to various districts and counties to supervise and investigate service industry economic operation. Mayor Yu Haitian participated, emphasizing expansion and quality improvement to achieve annual targets.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作时强调：加强产业技术攻关和新赛道培育 因地制宜加快发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industries, Urges Tech Breakthroughs and New Growth Tracks
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日下午，青岛市委书记曾赞荣到西海岸新区调研创新型产业，强调加强技术攻关和新赛道培育，加快发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 13, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong visited West Coast New Area to research innovative industries, urging enhanced technological breakthroughs and new track cultivation to accelerate new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨党组理论学习中心组集体学习举行
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Party Group Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日上午，青岛市人大常委会党组扩大会议暨理论学习中心组集体学习举行，传达学习中央政治局会议和市委全会精神，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 13, the Party Group meeting of the Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee was held to convey and study the spirit of the Political Bureau meeting and the municipal party committee plenum.

tags.name_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 中共厦门市第十四次代表大会10月召开
articles.title_en: CPC Xiamen Municipal 14th Congress to Convene in October
articles.summary_zh: 厦门市委十三届十一次全会决定，中国共产党厦门市第十四次代表大会定于2026年10月召开。大会将总结工作、选举新一届市委和市纪委等。
articles.summary_en: The 14th CPC Xiamen Municipal Congress is scheduled for October 2026, as decided at the 11th Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Xiamen Municipal Committee. It will review work and elect new municipal party committee and disciplinary commission.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：中方敦促有关国家停止滥用多边军控机制
articles.title_en: Chinese FM Urges Relevant Countries to Stop Abusing Multilateral Arms Control Mechanism
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在记者会上表示，美国等国在日内瓦裁军谈判会议搞所谓共同发言纯属政治目的，中方敦促其停止滥用多边军控机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun stated that the so-called joint statement by the US and others at the Geneva Conference on Disarmament is purely for political purposes, urging them to stop abusing the multilateral arms control mechanism.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在全省检察工作会议上强调坚定践行“三个监督” 忠实履行职责使命
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Stresses Firmly Implementing 'Three Supervisions' at Provincial Procuratorial Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，第十八次全省检察工作会议在杭州召开，浙江省委书记王浩出席并讲话，强调坚定践行“三个监督”，为高质量发展建设共同富裕示范区提供司法保障。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the 18th Provincial Procuratorial Work Conference was held in Hangzhou. Zhejiang Party Secretary Wang Hao attended and stressed firmly implementing the 'Three Supervisions' to provide judicial support for building a common prosperity demonstration zone.

articles.title_zh: 做大“蛋糕”缩小差距 浙江扎实推进共同富裕示范区建设
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Promotes Common Prosperity Demonstration Zone by Enlarging 'Cake' and Narrowing Gaps
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省深入实施‘八八战略’，通过山海协作和‘千万工程’推进共同富裕示范区建设，持续缩小城乡、地区、收入差距，城乡居民收入倍差降至1.81。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang has implemented the 'Double-Eight Strategy' and advanced the common prosperity demonstration zone through mountain-sea collaboration and the 'Ten Million Project', narrowing urban-rural, regional, and income gaps, with the urban-rural income ratio falling to 1.81.

articles.title_zh: 长沙消费，活力全开
articles.title_en: Changsha Consumption in Full Swing
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日至11日，大河财立方记者随调研团走访长沙零食王国、渔人码头、东茅街茶馆等消费地标，展现长沙沉浸式消费、夜经济等新场景。长沙夜间消费占全天消费比重达64%。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 10-11, reporters toured Changsha landmarks like Snack Kingdom, Yuren Wharf, and Dongmaojie Teahouse, highlighting immersive consumption and night economy. Night spending accounts for 64% of daily consumption.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人大常委会开放公民旁听会议报名
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Opens Registration for Citizens to Observe Session
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，江苏省人大常委会办公厅发布公告，开放公民申请旁听省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议，会议9月下旬在南京举行，设15个旁听名额。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the General Office of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee announced that citizens can apply to observe the 24th session in late September in Nanjing, with 15 seats available.

tags.name_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee

tags_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事：实干笃行绘新绿
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concern: Down-to-Earth Efforts Paint a New Green
articles.summary_zh: 在第4个全国生态日来临之际，记者深入黑龙江、湖北、山东等地，记录各地践行习近平生态文明思想、推进污染防治与绿色转型的实践。
articles.summary_en: As the 4th National Ecological Day approaches, reporters visited Heilongjiang, Hubei, Shandong and other provinces to document local practices in pollution control and green transformation under Xi Jinping's ecological civilization thought.

articles.title_zh: 兰州大学原校长、著名磁学及磁性材料专家李发伸逝世
articles.title_en: Li Fashen, Former Lanzhou University President and Magnetic Materials Expert, Dies
articles.summary_zh: 兰州大学原校长、著名磁学及磁性材料专家李发伸因病医治无效，于2026年8月13日在兰州逝世，享年86岁。
articles.summary_en: Li Fashen, former president of Lanzhou University and renowned magnetic materials expert, died of illness in Lanzhou on August 13, 2026, at the age of 86.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古五当召回应“售卖开光奥特曼”：与寺院无关，责令运营公司整改
articles.title_en: Wudangzhao Monastery Denies Blessing Ultraman Merchandise, Demands Operator Rectify
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古五当召教务管理委员会回应网传“售卖开光奥特曼”：系景区运营公司独立商业行为，与寺院无关，已责令整改。
articles.summary_en: The Wudangzhao Monastery Administrative Committee in Inner Mongolia responded to rumors about selling 'blessed Ultraman' toys, stating it's a commercial act by the scenic area operator and unrelated to the temple, and has ordered rectification.

tags.name_zh: 五当召教务管理委员会

tags_zh: 五当召教务管理委员会

articles.title_zh: 国家“两弹一星功勋奖章”获得者王希季院士逝世，享年105岁
articles.title_en: Wang Xiji, 'Two Bombs, One Satellite' Meritorious Medal Winner and Academician, Dies at 105
articles.summary_zh: 中国共产党优秀党员、中国科学院院士王希季因病医治无效，于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年105岁。
articles.summary_en: Wang Xiji, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and a pioneer of China's space industry, passed away in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at the age of 105.

articles.title_zh: 灾后横州茉莉花仍守住全球五成份额
articles.title_en: After Typhoon, Hengzhou Jasmine Still Holds Half of Global Market Share
articles.summary_zh: 台风"美莎克"导致广西横州11万亩茉莉花田受灾，但凭借完整产业链和花农自救，横州茉莉花产量逐步恢复，仍守住全球五成市场份额。
articles.summary_en: After Typhoon Maysak damaged 110,000 mu of jasmine fields in Hengzhou, Guangxi, the industry's resilience and farmers' self-rescue efforts helped maintain its half share of global jasmine production.

articles.title_zh: 两部门预拨8000万元支持河南、湖北、安徽应急抢险救灾
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Pre-allocate 80 Million Yuan to Support Emergency Disaster Relief in Henan, Hubei and Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨8000万元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持河南、湖北、安徽3省开展洪涝、地质灾害应急抢险救灾。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management pre-allocated 80 million yuan in central disaster relief funds to support Henan, Hubei, and Anhui in flood and geological disaster rescue operations.

articles.title_zh: 中国证监会原党委委员马忠智逝世，享年82岁
articles.title_en: Ma Zhongzhi, Former Party Committee Member of CSRC, Passes Away at 82
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，中国证监会办公厅发布讣告，原党委委员马忠智因病在北京逝世，享年82岁。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the General Office of the China Securities Regulatory Commission issued an obituary announcing that Ma Zhongzhi, former Party Committee member, passed away due to illness in Beijing at the age of 82.

articles.title_zh: 非必要不设立名誉职务，江西鹰潭作协宣布废止“名誉主席”
articles.title_en: Yingtan Writers Association Abolishes Honorary Chairman Positions
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月，江西鹰潭市作家协会宣布废止“名誉主席”，落实社会组织专项整顿，坚持非必要不设立名誉职务原则。
articles.summary_en: In August 2026, Yingtan Writers Association in Jiangxi abolished honorary chairman positions to implement special rectification of social organizations, adhering to the principle of not setting up honorary posts unless necessary.

articles.title_zh: 二〇二六“十大重庆经济年度人物”评选启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Selection of 'Top Ten Chongqing Economic Figures' Kicks Off
articles.summary_zh: 2026“十大重庆经济年度人物”评选活动在重庆启动，设五大奖项，聚焦新质生产力与成渝双城经济圈，面向全行业征集案例。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 selection for Chongqing's top ten economic figures was launched, featuring five awards focusing on new quality productive forces and the Chengdu-Chongqing economic circle.

articles.title_zh: 福建创新实施食品经营许可评审承诺制
articles.title_en: Fujian Innovates Food Business License Review Commitment System
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省市场监管局发布食品连锁经营企业食品经营许可评审承诺制首批评审公告，百胜餐饮、金拱门、瑞幸等企业入选，新增直营门店可免现场核查、直接发证。
articles.summary_en: Fujian Provincial Market Supervision Administration recently announced the first batch of food chain enterprises under the new review commitment system for food business licenses, including Yum China, McDonald's and Luckin Coffee. Qualified new stores can get licenses without on-site inspection.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河实船试验正式启动
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Real-ship Trial Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，西部陆海新通道骨干工程平陆运河实船试验正式启动，为9月通航做好准备。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the real-ship trial of the Pinglu Canal, a key project of the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, was officially launched to prepare for its opening in September.

articles.title_zh: 新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首超60%
articles.title_en: New Energy Vehicle Monthly Sales Share Exceeds 60% for First Time
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会数据显示，7月新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首次超过60%，累计占比超50%；汽车出口连续两月突破百万辆。
articles.summary_en: According to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, NEV monthly sales share exceeded 60% for the first time in July, and automobile exports surpassed 1 million units for two consecutive months.

articles.title_zh: 河南省宣传贯彻实施生态环境法典座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Henan Holds Symposium on Implementing Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，河南省宣传贯彻实施生态环境法典座谈会在郑州召开，省人大常委会党组书记、副主任李亚出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Henan Province held a symposium in Zhengzhou on promoting the implementation of the Ecological Environment Code; Li Ya, Party Secretary and Deputy Director of the Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee, attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 李殿勋到襄阳市指导防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Li Dianxun Inspects Flood Control and Disaster Relief in Xiangyang
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，湖北省省长李殿勋到襄阳市检查指导防汛救灾工作，实地察看内涝点、水文站和水库，强调加强监测预警，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun inspected flood control and disaster relief in Xiangyang, visiting waterlogged areas and reservoirs, and urged enhanced monitoring and early warning to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 中国全方位推动人工智能全球治理走深走实
articles.title_en: China Pushes Forward Global AI Governance in All Aspects
articles.summary_zh: 中国全方位推动人工智能全球治理，习近平在2026世界人工智能大会上强调以人类智慧引领AI发展，中国通过技术突破、制度保障和国际合作践行治理责任。
articles.summary_en: China is advancing global AI governance comprehensively. At the 2026 WAIC, President Xi Jinping stressed guiding AI with human wisdom. China promotes innovation, security and international cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 河北构建服务业发展“1+15”政策体系
articles.title_en: Hebei Builds '1+15' Policy System for Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，河北省政府新闻办召开新闻发布会，介绍全省构建服务业发展“1+15”政策体系，推动服务业扩能提质。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Hebei provincial government held a press conference to introduce the '1+15' policy system for service industry development, aiming to enhance capacity and quality.

articles.title_zh: 琼州海峡新一轮跨海运输能力升级启动
articles.title_en: Qiongzhou Strait Launches New Round of Cross-Sea Transport Capacity Upgrade
articles.summary_zh: 海南启动琼州海峡新一轮跨海运输能力升级，从港区改造、运力提升、智能调度等七大维度推进，以应对自贸港封关后增长的运输需求。
articles.summary_en: Hainan launches a new round of cross-sea transport capacity upgrade for Qiongzhou Strait, advancing port renovation, capacity expansion, and intelligent dispatch to meet growing demand after the free trade port closure.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在五指山市调研学习教育和经济社会发展并巡河
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Learning Education and Economic Development in Wuzhishan and Patrols River
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，海南省委书记冯飞在五指山市调研学习教育和经济社会发展情况，并巡河检查生态修复，强调守牢生态底线，推进“两山”转化。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Feng Fei, Secretary of Hainan Provincial Party Committee, visited Wuzhishan City to inspect learning education and economic development, patrolled the river, and emphasized protecting the ecological bottom line and promoting the "Two Mountains" transformation.

articles.title_zh: 《“十五五”海南国际旅游消费中心规划》发布 明确“13526”发展框架
articles.title_en: Hainan Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for International Tourism Consumption Center, Defining '13526' Framework
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，海南省新闻办发布《“十五五”海南国际旅游消费中心规划》，提出到2030年接待国内外游客1.54亿人次，并明确“13526”发展框架。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, Hainan released its 15th Five-Year Plan for an international tourism consumption center, targeting 154M tourists by 2030 under a '13526' framework.

articles.title_zh: 海南省重点实施69个交通干线重大工程
articles.title_en: Hainan to Implement 69 Major Transportation Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，海南省交通运输厅宣布，“十五五”期间将重点实施69个交通干线重大工程，包括国道、省道和铁路项目，提升路网连通效能。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Hainan Provincial Department of Transport announced 69 key transportation projects for the 15th Five-Year Plan, including national/provincial highways and railways, to enhance network connectivity.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省委党的建设工作领导小组召开会议
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee's Party Building Leading Group Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 13日，黑龙江省委党的建设工作领导小组召开会议，省委书记许勤主持并讲话，强调坚持学查改建一体推进，持续巩固拓展学习教育成果。
articles.summary_en: On August 13, the Party Building Leading Group of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee held a meeting, chaired by Secretary Xu Qin, emphasizing integrated progress in learning, investigation, reform and construction to consolidate educational achievements.

articles.title_zh: 湖南岳阳：“党建红”领航“司法蓝”
articles.title_en: Yueyang, Hunan: 'Party Building Red' Guides 'Judicial Blue'
articles.summary_zh: 岳阳市司法局打造“红心筑梦·法润岳阳”党建品牌，以党建引领法治服务，开展涉企法治体检、化解纠纷，今年前7月调解矛盾纠纷13322件。
articles.summary_en: The Yueyang Municipal Justice Bureau creates the 'Red Heart Dream, Law Run Yueyang' party building brand, using party building to lead legal services, conducting corporate legal check-ups and resolving disputes, mediating 13,322 conflicts in the first 7 months of this year.

articles.title_zh: 化妆品领域首个强制性国家标准发布
articles.title_en: China Issues First Mandatory National Standard for Cosmetics
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局批准发布《化妆品 安全通用要求》强制性国家标准，将于2028年1月1日实施，这是中国化妆品领域首个强制性国家标准。
articles.summary_en: China's State Administration for Market Regulation approved the first mandatory national standard for cosmetics, effective Jan 1, 2028, replacing the 1987 hygiene standard.

articles.title_zh: 江苏部署推进政务服务“三化”改革
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Advances Reform of Government Services with Standardization, Integration, and Digitalization
articles.summary_zh: 近日，江苏省数据局召开工作推进会，部署推动政务服务标准化、集成化、数智化“三化”改革，在全省政务系统全面启动改革。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Jiangsu Provincial Data Bureau held a meeting to deploy the reform of government services toward standardization, integration, and digitalization, launching the reform across the province's administrative system.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘在赣江新区调研强调抢占产业新赛道打造新增长点
articles.title_en: Yin Hong Stresses Seizing New Industrial Tracks and Creating New Growth Points in Ganjiang New Area
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，江西省委书记尹弘深入赣江新区调研，强调要抢占产业新赛道，打造新增长点，加快培育新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Yin Hong, Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, visited Ganjiang New Area and stressed seizing new industrial tracks to create new growth points and accelerate new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 南昌推动金融赋能实体经济
articles.title_en: Nanchang Promotes Financial Empowerment of Real Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，南昌举办产融对接会，促成27家企业与21家金融机构签约513.29亿元，以金融赋能实体经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Nanchang held a production-finance matchmaking meeting, where 27 enterprises signed agreements with 21 financial institutions totaling 51.329 billion yuan to empower the real economy.

articles.title_zh: 村里有了“家乡推荐官”
articles.title_en: Village Gains 'Hometown Recommenders'
articles.summary_zh: 江西上饶广信区百余名村干部、返乡大学生等担任“家乡推荐官”，通过直播3年售出农产品6700余万元，带动农户增收。
articles.summary_en: In Guangxin District, Shangrao, Jiangxi, over 100 village officials and returning college students act as 'hometown recommenders', selling agricultural products worth over 67 million yuan via livestreaming in 3 years, boosting farmers' income.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古启动建设生物天然气千吨级示范线
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Launches Construction of 1,000-Ton Bio-Natural Gas Demonstration Line
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，内蒙古在呼和浩特启动科技重大专项，建设生物天然气千吨级示范线，由企业牵头、蒋剑春院士负责，推动农林剩余物高值化利用。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Inner Mongolia launched a key science and technology project in Hohhot to build a 1,000-ton bio-natural gas demonstration line, led by a local company with academician Jiang Jianchun as project leader.

articles.title_zh: 以学铸魂 以查纠偏 以改惠民
articles.title_en: Learning to Strengthen the Soul, Investigating to Rectify Errors, and Reforming to Benefit the People
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区开展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育，坚持学查改一体推进，聚焦民生难题，取得惠民实效。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region carried out an education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, integrating learning, inspection, and reform to address public concerns and deliver tangible benefits.

articles.title_zh: 2026年上半年“青海好人”发布仪式在囊谦举行

articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，2026年上半年“青海好人”发布仪式在玉树州囊谦县举行，集中表彰五大类道德模范。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Qinghai Good People ceremony for H1 2026 was held in Nangqian, Yushu Prefecture, honoring five categories of moral models.

tags_en: Publicity Department of CPC Qinghai Provincial Committee

articles.title_zh: 全省科学技术奖励大会召开
articles.title_en: Qinghai Holds Provincial Science and Technology Award Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，全省科学技术奖励大会在西宁召开，省委书记吴晓军讲话，省长罗东川主持，表彰科技人员与团队。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the provincial science and technology award conference was held in Xining; Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun spoke and Governor Luo Dongchuan presided, honoring scientific personnel and teams.

articles.title_zh: 海东出台全省首个市级数据安全应急预案
articles.title_en: Haidong Issues Province's First Municipal Data Security Emergency Plan
articles.summary_zh: 日前，海东市正式印发《海东市数据安全应急预案》，成为全省首个市级层面数据安全突发事件专项应急预案，填补了制度空白。
articles.summary_en: Haidong City has issued its Data Security Emergency Plan, the first municipal-level special emergency plan for data security incidents in the province, filling a system gap.

articles.title_zh: 环青海湖旅游公路品质提升工程开工
articles.title_en: Qinghai Lake Tourist Highway Quality Improvement Project Kicks Off
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，青海省道207、208环湖东西路改扩建工程开工，标志着环青海湖旅游公路品质提升工程全面实施。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the reconstruction projects of Provincial Roads 207 and 208 around Qinghai Lake started, marking the full implementation of the tourist highway quality improvement project.

articles.title_zh: 葛慧君在临沂市调研
articles.title_en: Ge Huijun Conducts Research in Linyi
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日至12日，山东省政协主席葛慧君到临沂市走访调研民营企业和项目，实地考察金锣集团、罗庄工业博览中心等，并召开座谈会。
articles.summary_en: From August 11 to 12, Ge Huijun, chairwoman of the Shandong CPPCC, visited Linyi to survey private enterprises and projects, including Jinluo Group and the Luozhuang Industrial Expo Center.

articles.title_zh: 简报丨上海人工智能产业上半年增速达21.8%
articles.title_en: Shanghai AI Industry Grows 21.8% in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月，上海人工智能产业上半年增速达21.8%；世界人工智能大会举办，32个重点项目签约409亿元；市委通过建设AI发展和治理创新高地意见。
articles.summary_en: In July 2026, Shanghai's AI industry grew 21.8% in H1; the World AI Conference was held with 32 key projects signed worth 40.9 billion yuan; the municipal party committee approved a plan to build an AI innovation hub.

articles.title_zh: 上海社科院发布全球重要城市群文化产业发展指数：长三角入选前三
articles.title_en: Shanghai Academy Releases Cultural Industry Index for Global City Clusters; Yangtze River Delta Ranks Third
articles.summary_zh: 日前，上海社科院发布《融合赋能：世界级文创产业高地的上海方案》新书及全球重要城市群文化产业发展指数，长三角城市群综合排名第三。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Shanghai Academy of Social Sciences released a new book and a global cultural industry development index for major city clusters, with the Yangtze River Delta ranking third.

articles.title_zh: 西康高铁启动试运行
articles.title_en: Xi'an-Ankang High-Speed Railway Starts Trial Operation
articles.summary_zh: 8月13日，西康高铁正式进入试运行阶段，预计通车后西安至安康运行时间将缩短至1小时以内。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 13, the Xi'an-Ankang high-speed railway entered trial operation, cutting travel time to under 1 hour upon opening.

articles.title_zh: 陕西好商标评价工作启动
articles.title_en: Shaanxi's 'Good Trademark' Evaluation Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，陕西省品牌建设促进中心启动2026年“陕西好商标”评价工作，企业可自愿申报，8月31日截止。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Shaanxi Provincial Brand Building Promotion Center launched the 2026 'Good Trademark of Shaanxi' evaluation, with applications open until August 31.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在自治区民政厅调研座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Visit and Hold Talks at Regional Civil Affairs Department
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江、主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在自治区民政厅调研座谈，强调加强民生建设、养老服务和社会救助等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Chen Xiaojiang, Party Secretary of Xinjiang, and Erkin Tuniyaz, Chairman of the region, visited the Regional Civil Affairs Department for a research symposium, emphasizing improvements in livelihood construction, elderly care, and social assistance.

articles.title_zh: 这部法典实施对西藏意味着什么？
articles.title_en: What Does the Implementation of This Code Mean for Tibet?
articles.summary_zh: 8月15日，《中华人民共和国生态环境法典》将正式施行，为西藏生态环境治理提供更完善法律依据，推动绿色发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 15, the Ecological Environment Code of the PRC will take effect, providing legal basis for Tibet's ecological governance and promoting green development.

articles.title_zh: 西藏持续深化民族团结进步促进法落地实施
articles.title_en: Tibet Continues to Deepen Implementation of Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，西藏自治区政府新闻办举行新闻发布会，介绍学习宣传贯彻民族团结进步促进法情况。西藏已累计开展宣传活动1882场，受教育群众25.8万余人次。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Information Office of the Tibet Autonomous Region Government held a press conference on the implementation of the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law. Tibet has held 1,882 promotional events reaching over 258,000 people.

articles.title_zh: 西藏自治区首届牦牛产业发展大会开幕
articles.title_en: Tibet's First Yak Industry Development Conference Opens
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，西藏自治区首届牦牛产业发展大会在那曲市开幕，自治区主席嘎玛泽登出席并致辞，强调推动牦牛产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the first Yak Industry Development Conference of Tibet Autonomous Region opened in Nagqu. Chairman Garma Tseden attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing high-quality development of the yak industry.

articles.title_zh: 浙江发布脑机接口产学研联动18条支持举措
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Releases 18 Support Measures for Brain-Computer Interface Industry-Academia-Research Collaboration
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，浙江省政府办公厅发布《关于推进脑机接口产学研联动的若干措施》，提出18条支持举措，构建产学研联动机制。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the General Office of the Zhejiang Provincial Government issued measures to promote brain-computer interface industry-academia-research collaboration, proposing 18 supporting measures.

articles.title_zh: 浙江推出外卖聚集区管理模式
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Introduces Management Model for Food Delivery Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，浙江省市场监管局推出外卖聚集区管理模式，采取证照校验、电子证照公示、AI非现场监管等措施，治理无堂食外卖乱象。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the Zhejiang Provincial Market Supervision Administration introduced a management model for food delivery clusters, featuring license verification, electronic license display, and AI-based off-site supervision to tackle irregularities in delivery-only restaurants.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研创新型产业发展工作时强调：加强产业技术攻关和新赛道培育 因地制宜加快发展新质生产力
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Innovative Industrial Development, Stressing Tech Breakthroughs and New Tracks
articles.summary_zh: 今天下午，市委书记曾赞荣到西海岸新区调研创新型产业发展，强调加强技术攻关和新赛道培育，因地制宜发展新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: This afternoon, Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong visited West Coast New Area to inspect innovative industrial development, emphasizing technological breakthroughs and fostering new tracks to develop new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 以深化周边发展融合推动构建周边命运共同体
articles.title_en: Deepening Neighborhood Development Integration to Build a Community with a Shared Future for Neighboring Countries
articles.summary_zh: 《十五五规划纲要》提出深化周边发展融合，文章从硬联通、软联通、心相通等维度阐释构建周边命运共同体的路径与意义。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Five-Year Plan proposes deepening neighborhood development integration. This article elaborates on paths to build a community with a shared future for neighboring countries through infrastructure connectivity, institutional connectivity, and people-to-people bonds.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行｜人工智能从“浙”里起飞
articles.title_en: Vibrant China Research Tour: AI Takes Off from Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月17日习近平总书记在世界人工智能大会发表主旨讲话后，记者深入浙江调研，报道人工智能在技术研发、产业转化、场景应用等方面的发展成效。
articles.summary_en: After President Xi Jinping's keynote speech at the World AI Conference on July 17, reporters visited Zhejiang to report on AI progress in R&D, industrial transformation, and application scenarios.

articles.title_zh: 王清宪与尤政等院士专家座谈
articles.title_en: Wang Qingxian Holds Talks with You Zheng and Other Academicians
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，安徽省长王清宪在合肥与尤政等院士专家座谈，围绕仪器仪表产业合作与创新生态进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, Anhui Governor Wang Qingxian met with academician You Zheng and other experts in Hefei to discuss cooperation and innovation in the instrumentation industry.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚韦韬在南宁调研并召开台风灾后恢复重建推进会
articles.title_en: Chen Gang and Wei Tao Inspect Hengzhou and Chair Typhoon Recovery Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚、自治区主席韦韬在南宁横州市调研并召开台风“美莎克”灾后恢复重建推进会，强调加快重建，提升防灾减灾能力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 12, Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang and Governor Wei Tao visited Hengzhou and chaired a meeting on typhoon 'Maysak' recovery, urging accelerated reconstruction and improved disaster resilience.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到省水利厅调度水库安全运行
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Coordinates Reservoir Safety at Provincial Water Resources Department
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日下午，河南省省长王凯到省水利厅调度水库安全运行，强调抓实抓细水库、河道全链条防御工作，确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 12, Henan Governor Wang Kai went to the Provincial Water Resources Department to coordinate reservoir safety operations, emphasizing comprehensive flood prevention measures.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Holds Party Group Enlarged Meeting and Chairman's Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，省政协主席孔昌生主持召开党组扩大会议和主席会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话和文章精神，研究部署正确政绩观学习教育工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, CPPCC Provincial Chairman Kong Changsheng chaired the Party Group Enlarged Meeting and Chairman's Meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speeches and articles, and to deploy education on correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁在郑州市督导调研防汛工作
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Flood Control Work in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 受台风影响河南多地出现强降雨，8月12日省委书记刘宁在郑州市督导调研防汛工作，强调坚决打赢防汛救灾攻坚战，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: Amid heavy rainfall triggered by Typhoon Baidujuan, Henan Party Secretary Liu Ning visited Zhengzhou on August 12 to inspect flood control efforts, urging a firm fight to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁会见中国能源建设集团董事长倪真
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Meets Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，河南省委书记刘宁在郑州会见中国能源建设集团董事长倪真，双方就加强新型能源体系等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, met with Ni Zhen, Chairman of China Energy Engineering Group in Zhengzhou, discussing cooperation in new energy systems and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 河南省防指调度强降雨防范应对工作
articles.title_en: Henan Provincial Flood Control Headquarters Coordinates Heavy Rainfall Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，河南省防汛抗旱指挥部调度强降雨防范应对工作，省委书记刘宁作出批示，省长王凯现场调度，要求落实防汛措施，确保人民安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of Aug 12, Henan Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters coordinated heavy rainfall prevention. Party Secretary Liu Ning gave instructions, and Governor Wang Kai directed on-site, urging implementation of flood control measures to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 智涌雄安 未来已来——雄安新区人工智能产业聚势勃发
articles.title_en: AI Industry Thrives in Xiong'an New Area
articles.summary_zh: 近日，雄安人工智能实训基地在雄安新区启动区科学园片区正式投运，首届人工智能实训班同步开班，标志着雄安人工智能产业“一院一园一平台一基地”发展格局全面形成。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Xiong'an AI Training Base was officially put into operation in the Science Park of the Xiong'an New Area startup zone, with the first AI training class launching simultaneously, marking the full formation of the 'one institute, one park, one platform, one base' AI industry pattern.

articles.title_zh: 新能源汽车迎来两个“首次”突破，怎么看
articles.title_en: New Energy Vehicles Achieve Two 'Firsts' in Market Share, What Does It Mean?
articles.summary_zh: 7月新能源汽车国内销量占比达68.1%，出口占比连续两月超50%，首次双双突破半壁江山，标志其成为市场主流。
articles.summary_en: In July, NEVs accounted for 68.1% of domestic sales and over 50% of exports for two consecutive months, marking their first-ever majority share and cementing their mainstream status.

articles.title_zh: 长沙：小剧场激活演艺新空间
articles.title_en: Changsha: Small Theaters Activate New Performing Arts Spaces
articles.summary_zh: 长沙小剧场《长沙》等演艺新空间发展迅速，2025年长沙市政府与省文旅厅联合印发“演艺新空间十条”支持建设演艺名城，今年上半年已建成111个项目，演出1.4万场。
articles.summary_en: Changsha's small theaters like "Changsha" are booming. In 2025, the city government and provincial culture department issued ten measures to support new performance spaces. In H1 this year, 111 projects were built with 14,000 shows.

articles.title_zh: 省政府与上海国投公司举行工作会谈
articles.title_en: Hunan Provincial Government Holds Working Talks with Shanghai State Investment Company
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日上午，湖南省政府与上海国有资本投资有限公司在长沙举行工作会谈，省长毛伟明与上海国投公司董事长袁国华出席，会后三方签署“十五五”战略合作框架协议。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 12, the Hunan Provincial Government held talks with Shanghai State Investment Company in Changsha. Governor Mao Weiming and Chairman Yuan Guohua attended, and a strategic cooperation framework agreement for the 15th Five-Year Plan period was signed.

articles.title_zh: 长沙宁乡市：内陆县城何以“出海”
articles.title_en: Ningxiang: How an Inland County Town Goes Global
articles.summary_zh: 2025年宁乡对外实际投资15.08亿美元，占长沙市的59.46%、湖南省的45.89%，通过政策赋能、产业抱团，实现内陆县城“出海”转型。
articles.summary_en: Ningxiang's outbound investment reached $1.508 billion in 2025, accounting for 45.89% of Hunan's total. Through policy support and industrial clustering, the inland county transformed from exporting products to investing globally.

articles.title_zh: 中国全方位推动人工智能全球治理走深走实
articles.title_en: China Promotes Global AI Governance in Depth
articles.summary_zh: 2026世界人工智能大会在上海开幕，习近平主席发表讲话，强调以人类智慧和国际共识引领AI发展，中国全方位推动AI全球治理走深走实。
articles.summary_en: At the 2026 World AI Conference in Shanghai, President Xi Jinping stressed guiding AI with human wisdom and consensus, as China pushes forward global AI governance.

articles.title_zh: 我国正抓紧制定新一轮空气质量持续改善行动方案

articles.title_zh: “十五五”开局之年各地培育壮大新兴产业观察

articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters toured over a dozen provinces, finding emerging industries such as new energy, new materials, intelligent robots, and biomedicine advancing and clustering, boosting high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于修改和废止部分行政法规的决定
articles.title_en: Decision of the State Council on Amending and Repealing Certain Administrative Regulations

articles.summary_en: The State Council decided to amend 12 administrative regulations and repeal 3, to implement the Ecological Environment Code, effective from August 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 持续加强普惠性基础性兜底性民生建设 不断增强各族群众获得感幸福感安全感

articles.summary_en: On August 12, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz visited the regional Department of Civil Affairs to stress enhancing inclusive, basic, and bottom-line livelihood programs, including elderly care, social assistance, and welfare services.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷：持续构建开放融合的优质产业生态 不断提升新能源汽车产业核心竞争力

articles.title_zh: 中国海军第49批护航编队起航赴亚丁湾

articles.title_zh: 国家防总、应急管理部将针对河南的防汛应急响应提升至三级

articles.title_zh: 上半年互联网业务收入同比增10.1%
articles.title_en: Internet Business Revenue Up 10.1% in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 工信部数据显示，上半年我国互联网企业业务收入10675亿元，同比增长10.1%，利润总额和研发经费投入均实现两位数增长。
articles.summary_en: According to MIIT data, China's internet business revenue reached 1.0675 trillion yuan in H1, up 10.1% year-on-year, with both profits and R&D spending growing by double digits.

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 全国蔬菜供应总体形势平稳
articles.title_en: Overall Stable Vegetable Supply across China
articles.summary_zh: 全国在田蔬菜面积达1.06亿亩，各产区统筹调度、错峰上市，保障市场充足供应。受高温影响，高原和北方产区成为保供主力，价格运行稳健。
articles.summary_en: China has 106 million mu of vegetables in fields. Coordinated scheduling and staggered listings ensure sufficient supply. Highland and northern areas are key suppliers amid heat, with stable prices.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 全国人大常委会 国务院 全国政协讣告朱镕基同志逝世
articles.title_en: Obituary: Zhu Rongji, Former Premier, Passes Away at 98
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协沉痛宣告，国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年98岁。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee announced with deep sorrow that Comrade Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council, died of illness in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at the age of 98.

articles.title_zh: 各地各部门积极应对强降雨天气
articles.title_en: Regions and Departments Actively Respond to Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 受“白海豚”残余环流影响，中东部出现强降雨，河南、湖北、北京等地积极应对，国家防总将河南防汛应急响应提升至三级。
articles.summary_en: Heavy rain caused by the residual circulation of Typhoon Baiting hit central and eastern China. Henan, Hubei and Beijing took active measures including rescue, drainage and evacuation; China's national flood control authority raised the emergency response for Henan to Level III.

articles.summary_en: On August 11, the Fushun Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee convened a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and Provincial Party Secretary Xu Kunlin's research speech.

articles.summary_en: On August 12, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Party Secretary of Fuzhou, and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected major projects in Taijiang, Cangshan, and Jin'an, and launched a river protection campaign.

articles.summary_en: On August 12, Hegang Mayor Deng Weiyuan visited rural areas to inspect rural revitalization, stressing farmland protection and high-standard farmland construction.

articles.summary_en: On August 10, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to hear a report from the regional public security department, stressing law-based performance of duties to contribute to Tibet's stability and high-quality development.

Gong Huicai, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee and Secretary-General, attended and stressed higher standards and stricter requirements.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 10, Shantou Municipal Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn visited several state-owned enterprises, emphasizing deepened SOE reform to boost the state-owned economy's competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 全市转作风提效能抓落实工作推进会召开

articles.summary_en: On August 11, Yang Qinglong, Party Secretary of Shizuishan, inspected the city's equipment manufacturing industry, emphasizing high-end, intelligent, and green development.

articles.title_zh: 蒿慧杰在全市河湖长制林长制工作会议上强调呵护绿水青山

articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，西安召开全市河湖长制林长制工作会议，省委常委、市委书记蒿慧杰出席并讲话，强调顺应群众期盼，呵护绿水青山，推进治水治林。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, the work conference on river chief and forest chief systems in Xi'an was held. Hao Huijie, member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Municipal Party Committee, attended and delivered a speech, stressing the need to respond to public expectations and protect the environment.

articles.title_zh: 赵一德在调研文物保护和考古工作时强调坚定文化自信 勇担使命责任 让更多文化遗产活起来传下去
articles.title_en: Zhao Yide Emphasizes Cultural Confidence and Responsibility in Cultural Relics and Archaeology Work
articles.summary_zh: 近日，陕西省委书记赵一德在西安市、咸阳市调研文物保护和考古工作，强调坚定文化自信，让更多文化遗产活起来传下去。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, inspected cultural relics protection and archaeological work in Xi'an and Xianyang, emphasizing cultural confidence and the preservation of cultural heritage.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见哈电集团董事长黄伟
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Meets Huang Wei, Chairman of Harbin Electric Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江苏省省长刘小涛会见哈尔滨电气集团董事长黄伟，并共同见证镇江市与哈电集团签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Liu Xiaotao, Governor of Jiangsu Province, met with Huang Wei, Chairman of Harbin Electric Group, and witnessed the signing of a strategic cooperation agreement between Zhenjiang City and Harbin Electric Group.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平到盐城港控股集团调研
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Conducts Research at Yancheng Port Holdings Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，盐城市委书记严汉平到盐城港控股集团调研，强调要抢抓淮河生态经济带发展机遇，不断做大做强提升综合竞争力。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Yan Hanping, municipal party secretary, inspected Yancheng Port Holdings Group and urged seizing Huaihe River Eco-Economic Belt opportunities to boost competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见现代汽车集团副社长李赫埈一行
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet Hyundai Motor Vice Chairman Lee Hyuk-jun
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜在盐会见现代汽车集团副社长李赫埈一行，双方就深化汽车产业及新兴领域合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and Acting Mayor Wu Wei met Hyundai Motor Group Vice Chairman Lee Hyuk-jun in Yancheng to strengthen cooperation on automobiles and emerging sectors.

articles.title_zh: 中共烟台市委十四届十一次全体会议举行 市委常委会主持会议 江成讲话
articles.title_en: The 11th Plenary Session of the 14th Yantai Municipal Party Committee Held, Standing Committee Presides, Jiang Cheng Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月12日，中共烟台市委十四届十一次全体会议举行，审议通过关于全面推进农业农村现代化的实施意见，市委书记江成讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, 2026, the 11th Plenary Session of the 14th Yantai Municipal Party Committee was held, approving an implementation plan on comprehensively advancing agricultural and rural modernization, with Party Secretary Jiang Cheng delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到阳西县开展督导调研
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Leads Supervision and Research in Yangxi County
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，阳江市委副书记、市长余金富到阳西县督导征兵、蚊媒传染病防控及农文旅融合工作。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 11, Yu Jinfu, deputy secretary of the Yangjiang Municipal Committee and mayor, led supervision and research in Yangxi County, emphasizing military recruitment, mosquito-borne disease prevention, and agricultural-culture-tourism integration.

tags.name_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

tags_en: Integration of Agriculture, Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 卢一先开展“提质服务年”企业走访调研
articles.title_en: Luo Yixian Visits Enterprises for Service Quality Improvement Year
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，阳江市委书记卢一先走访多家企业，强调优化营商环境，助力制造业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Yangjiang Party Secretary Luo Yixian visited enterprises, emphasizing better business environment and high-quality manufacturing development.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研银川东线文旅融合发展和文创产品开发工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Investigates Cultural Tourism Integration and Cultural Creative Products Development in Yinchuan
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研东线文旅融合发展和文创产品开发工作，强调加快打造国际旅游目的地。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Party Committee of the Autonomous Region and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, investigated the integrated development of cultural tourism and cultural creative products along the eastern route, emphasizing the goal of building an international tourism destination.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在红寺堡区同心县调研时强调促进城乡融合发展
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Inspects Hongsibao District and Tongxin County, Emphasizing Urban-Rural Integration
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞到红寺堡区、同心县调研，强调学习运用‘千万工程’经验，以正确政绩观优帮扶、兴产业、惠民生、保安全，促进城乡融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Li Yifei, Secretary of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Regional Party Committee, inspected Hongsibao District and Tongxin County, stressing the need to apply the '10 Million Projects' experience, promote urban-rural integration, and improve assistance, industries, livelihoods, and safety.

articles.title_zh: 玉溪市与中城世纪考察团座谈会举行 洽谈水利农业林草等方面合作
articles.title_en: Yuxi City Holds Talks with Zhongcheng Century Delegation on Cooperation in Water, Agriculture and Forestry
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，玉溪市与中城世纪考察团座谈，市委书记杨政昆与四家企业负责人就水利、农业科技、森林草原防灭火等领域合作深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Yuxi City held a symposium with the Zhongcheng Century delegation. Party Secretary Yang Zhengkun and leaders of four enterprises exchanged views on cooperation in irrigation district construction, agricultural technology, and forest and grassland fire prevention.

articles.title_zh: 国际“朋友圈”再扩容！湛江对外交流合作迈出新步伐
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Expands International 'Circle of Friends' in Foreign Exchanges
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日至8日，湛江市市长李勇毅率经贸代表团访问印尼和澳大利亚，与史卓菲市签署备忘录缔结友城，并拜访印尼经济统筹部部长。目前湛江国际友城达28个。
articles.summary_en: Mayor Li led a Zhanjiang delegation to Indonesia and Australia (Aug 2-8), signing a friendship-city memo with Strathfield and meeting Indonesia's economy minister. Sister cities total 28.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，研究巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Huang Yuguo, secretary of the Zhoukou Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important article on accelerating the building of a healthy China and discuss consolidating education achievements on establishing a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 全市重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会召开
articles.title_en: Zhoukou Holds Weekly Meeting on Key Projects and Enterprise Demands
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，市长詹鹏主持召开全市重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会，听取益海嘉里等企业汇报，部署产业链建设与绿色低碳发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Mayor Zhan Peng chaired a weekly meeting on key projects and enterprise demands, hearing reports from companies like Yihai Kerry and deploying industrial chain and green low-carbon initiatives.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开市第六次党代会报告征求意见座谈会
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs Symposium on Draft Report for 6th Municipal Party Congress
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开市第六次党代会报告征求意见座谈会，听取市厅级领导意见建议，市长詹鹏出席。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a symposium to solicit opinions on the draft report for the 6th Municipal Party Congress, attended by Mayor Zhan Peng.

articles.title_zh: 全市重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会召开
articles.title_en: Weekly Meeting on Key Projects and Enterprise Appeals Held in Zhoukou
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，市长詹鹏主持召开全市重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会，会商解决企业发展难题，部署下一阶段重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Mayor Zhan Peng chaired the weekly meeting on key projects and enterprise appeals, addressing development difficulties and deploying priorities.

articles.title_zh: 副省长王桂英来淄博调研现代医药产业
articles.title_en: Vice Governor Wang Guiying Investigates Modern Pharmaceutical Industry in Zibo
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，山东省副省长王桂英到淄博市调研现代医药产业创新发展，强调要加强科技研发，推动医药大省向医药强省迈进。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Vice Governor Wang Guiying visited Zibo to inspect modern pharmaceutical innovation, urging enhanced R&D to boost industrial competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 朱镕基同志逝世，享年98岁
articles.title_en: Comrade Zhu Rongji Passes Away at 98
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央、全国人大常委会、国务院、全国政协沉痛宣告：国务院原总理朱镕基同志因病医治无效，于2026年8月12日在北京逝世，享年98岁。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee, NPC Standing Committee, State Council and CPPCC National Committee announced with deep sorrow that Comrade Zhu Rongji, former Premier of the State Council, died of illness in Beijing on August 12, 2026, at the age of 98.

articles.title_zh: 出身腾讯、眼望美国，富途证券为何被罚18亿？
articles.title_en: Futu Securities Fined 1.8 Billion Yuan: From Tencent Roots to US Ambitions
articles.summary_zh: 中国证监会对富途证券等跨境券商处以罚款，其中富途被罚18.5亿元，以整治跨境证券业务和资本外流。
articles.summary_en: China's securities regulator fined Futu Securities and other cross-border brokers, with Futu penalized 1.85 billion yuan, in a crackdown on cross-border securities business and capital outflows.

articles.title_zh: 中国汽车出口，连续两个月破百万辆
articles.title_en: China's Auto Exports Surpass One Million Units for Two Consecutive Months
articles.summary_zh: 中国汽车工业协会8月12日发布数据显示，7月新能源汽车销量占比首超60%，汽车出口连续两月破百万辆。
articles.summary_en: Data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on August 12 showed NEV sales exceeded 60% of monthly new car sales in July, with exports topping one million units for two straight months.

articles.title_zh: 游客自驾遭奔驰堵路后冲突受伤，警方通报：行拘2人
articles.title_en: Tourist Injured in Conflict After Mercedes Blocks Road; Police Detain 2
articles.summary_zh: 警方通报，游客自驾途中遭奔驰车堵路引发冲突受伤，两名涉事人员被行政拘留。
articles.summary_en: Police reported that a tourist was injured in a conflict after a Mercedes blocked the road, and two people were administratively detained.

articles.title_zh: 男子直播淫秽内容获利0.1元被判刑
articles.title_en: Man Sentenced for Livestreaming Pornography, Earning Only 0.1 Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 男子江某深夜直播淫秽视频获利0.1元，被寿县人民法院以传播淫秽物品牟利罪判处拘役4个月，缓刑6个月，并处罚金2000元。
articles.summary_en: Jiang was sentenced to 4 months' detention (suspended for 6 months) and fined 2,000 yuan for livestreaming pornographic content, netting only 0.1 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 醉酒后智驾系统“代驾”？广东法院判了：构成危险驾驶罪
articles.title_en: Drunk Driver Using Driver-Assist Function Sentenced for Dangerous Driving in Guangdong
articles.summary_zh: 广东深圳宝安区法院审结一起危险驾驶案，郭某醉酒后开启智能驾驶辅助系统上路，被判处拘役二个月并处罚金6000元。
articles.summary_en: The Bao'an District Court in Shenzhen, Guangdong concluded a dangerous driving case, sentencing Guo, who drove with driver-assist activated while intoxicated, to two months' detention and a 6,000 yuan fine.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁吴贤德调研推动重点项目建设并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning and Wu Xiande Inspect Key Projects and Launch River Protection Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，福建省委副书记、福州市委书记郭宁宁和市长吴贤德赴台江、仓山、晋安调研重点项目建设，并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee and Fuzhou Party chief, and Mayor Wu Xiande inspected key projects and launched a river protection campaign in Fuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 福州公开征集十类黑恶犯罪线索
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Police Solicit Tips on Ten Types of Gang-Related Crimes
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福州市公安局发布公告，即日起至2027年7月向社会公开征集十类涉黑涉恶违法犯罪线索。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Fuzhou Public Security Bureau issued a notice soliciting tips on ten types of gang-related crimes from the public until July 2027.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组会议和省政府常务会议召开
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Government Holds Party Group and Executive Meetings
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福建省省长赵龙主持召开省政府党组会议和常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，部署下半年经济、安全生产、科技创新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Zhao Long, Governor of Fujian, chaired the provincial government party group and executive meetings to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to arrange work on economy, work safety, and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 职工AI创作成果有奖征集活动启动
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Launches AI Creation Contest for Workers
articles.summary_zh: 8月，福州市职工产业互联网工匠学院启动全市职工AI创作成果有奖征集活动，面向掌握AI技能的职工征集短视频和智能体作品，截至本月20日。
articles.summary_en: In August, Fuzhou Workers' Industrial Internet Craft Academy launched an AI creation contest for local workers, calling for AI videos and AI agent works by the 20th.

articles.title_zh: 福州二手燃油豪车价格一个多月跌近3万元
articles.title_en: "Nearly 30,000 Yuan Drop in a Month": Used Luxury Fuel Car Prices in Fuzhou Plunge
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福州二手车市场二手燃油豪车价格两个月内普遍下跌20%，宝马、保时捷等车型降价明显，新能源渗透率上升及新车降价是主要原因。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, prices of used luxury fuel cars in Fuzhou fell about 20% in two months, with BMW and Porsche models declining sharply due to new car price cuts and rising EV penetration.

articles.title_zh: 织就更密更暖的社会保障安全网
articles.title_en: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
articles.summary_zh: 面对“十五五”新挑战，我国持续深化社会保障制度改革，新就业形态人员职业伤害保障试点全面推开，首部社会救助法出台，长期护理保险制度进入全面推行阶段。
articles.summary_en: Facing new challenges in the 15th Five-Year Plan period, China is deepening social security reforms, expanding pilot occupational injury insurance for new employment forms, issuing the first social assistance law, and rolling out long-term care insurance nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 中共青岛市委十三届十次全体会议举行
articles.title_en: CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee Holds 10th Plenary Session
articles.summary_zh: 中共青岛市委十三届十次全会8月12日举行，市委书记曾赞荣作讲话，全会审议通过给予潘峰开除党籍的处分。
articles.summary_en: The 10th plenary session of the 13th CPC Qingdao Municipal Committee was held on August 12, 2026. Zeng Zanrong, municipal party secretary, delivered a speech. The session approved the expulsion of Pan Feng from the Party.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市委常委会召开会议研究贯彻意见
articles.title_en: Xiamen Municipal Party Committee Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，厦门市委书记林涛主持召开市委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话指示精神，研究贯彻意见，并审议教育规划等事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Xiamen Municipal Party Committee Secretary Lin Tao chaired a Standing Committee meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, discuss implementation opinions, and review the education plan.

articles.title_zh: 织就更密更暖的社会保障安全网
articles.title_en: Weaving a Denser and Warmer Social Security Safety Net
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调织密社会保障安全网。我国持续深化社保改革，新就业形态职业伤害保障试点全国推开，首部社会救助法出台，长护险制度全面推行。
articles.summary_en: China expands occupational injury protection to new employment forms, enacts its first social assistance law, and rolls out long-term care insurance nationwide, after Xi Jinping's call for a dense social security net.

articles.title_zh: 最高法发布7件特许经营典型案例 明确被特许人享有“冷静期”单方解除权
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases 7 Typical Franchise Cases Clarifying Franchisees' Cooling-off Rescission Right
articles.summary_zh: 今天，最高人民法院发布7件特许经营典型案例，明确被特许人享有“冷静期”单方解除权，规范特许经营市场。
articles.summary_en: Today, the Supreme People's Court released seven typical franchise cases, clarifying franchisees' unilateral rescission right during the cooling-off period.

articles.title_zh: 刘捷在杭州专题调研新能源汽车企业发展情况时强调 持续构建开放融合的优质产业生态 不断提升新能源汽车产业核心竞争力
articles.title_en: Liu Jie Emphasizes Building Open and Integrated Industrial Ecosystem for NEV Industry During Hangzhou Research Tour
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，浙江省委副书记、省长刘捷在杭州调研新能源汽车企业，强调构建开放融合的产业生态，提升核心竞争力。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Liu Jie, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee and Governor of Zhejiang, visited new energy vehicle companies in Hangzhou, emphasizing the need to build an open and integrated industrial ecosystem and enhance core competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 马斯克：强烈推荐大家去中国看看
articles.title_en: Musk: Strongly Recommends People Visit China
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，特斯拉CEO马斯克在社交媒体发文称赞中国，强烈推荐大家去看看，其母亲梅耶·马斯克也发文赞同，国际民众对中国好感度上升。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Tesla CEO Elon Musk praised China on social media and strongly recommended visiting. His mother Maye Musk agreed, citing cities' charm and safety.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见哈电集团董事长黄伟
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao Meets with Huang Wei, Chairman of Harbin Electric Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江苏省省长刘小涛会见哈电集团董事长黄伟，并共同见证镇江市与哈电集团签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Huang Wei, Chairman of Harbin Electric Group, and witnessed the signing of a strategic cooperation agreement between Zhenjiang and Harbin Electric Group.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河实船试验正式启动，工程进度超98%
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Full-scale Ship Trial Officially Launched, Project Progress Exceeds 98%
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，平陆运河实船试验正式启动，首次进行全航道、全船型试验，工程整体进度已超98%，预计9月正式通航。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the full-scale ship trial of the Pinglu Canal was officially launched, marking the first all-channel, all-vessel-type test. The project progress has exceeded 98%, with official navigation expected in September.

articles.title_zh: 避免“新官不理旧账”，衡阳市探索党政正职离任交接工作新机制
articles.title_en: Hengyang Explores New Mechanism for Handover of Party and Government Officials
articles.summary_zh: 衡阳市探索党政正职离任交接新机制，通过标准化清单、交心谈话和联合监督，确保交接规范有序，避免“新官不理旧账”。
articles.summary_en: Hengyang explores a new mechanism for handover between outgoing and incoming Party and government officials, using standardized checklists, heart-to-heart talks, and joint supervision to ensure orderly transitions.

articles.title_zh: 旅游客运车辆扎堆列队占道、低速压车，乌鲁木齐呼吁规范驾驶
articles.title_en: Tourist Buses Lining Up and Occupying Lanes, Urumqi Calls for Standardized Driving
articles.summary_zh: 正值文旅出行旺季，乌鲁木齐针对旅游客运车辆在高速公路列队占道、低速压车等危险驾驶行为发出倡议，呼吁企业和驾驶员规范驾驶、落实安全责任。
articles.summary_en: During the peak tourism season, Urumqi issued an initiative against dangerous driving behaviors such as tourist buses lining up and occupying lanes, calling on companies and drivers to drive safely and fulfill safety responsibilities.

articles.title_zh: 尹力调度部署防汛防台风工作 强调抓实抓细各项防御措施
articles.title_en: Yin Li Directs Flood and Typhoon Prevention Efforts, Stresses Detailed Defense Measures
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日上午，北京市委书记尹力调度部署防汛防台风工作，强调抓实抓细各项防御措施，确保人民群众生命财产安全。市长殷勇一同调度。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 11, Beijing Party Secretary Yin Li deployed flood and typhoon prevention work, stressing detailed defensive measures to protect people's lives and property. Mayor Yin Yong attended.

articles.title_zh: 周祖翼在福州调研社会工作
articles.title_en: Zhou Zuyi Inspects Social Work in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，福建省委书记周祖翼赴福州调研社会工作，强调以党建引领基层治理，推动社会工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, visited Fuzhou to inspect social work, stressing party leadership in community governance.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省出台失业保险稳岗扩岗新政
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues New Policies for Unemployment Insurance Stability and Expansion
articles.summary_zh: 近日，甘肃省人社厅等四部门联合印发通知，2026年全年推行稳岗返还、一次性扩岗补助等政策，优化技能提升补贴，并夯实失业人员生活保障，以稳就业惠企利民。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gansu's Human Resources and Social Security Department and three other departments jointly issued a notice to implement stable job return and one-time expansion subsidies for 2026, optimize skill upgrade subsidies, and strengthen unemployment insurance benefits to stabilize employment.

tags.name_en: Gansu Provincial Human Resources and Social Security Department

tags_en: Gansu Provincial Human Resources and Social Security Department

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河实船试验正式启动
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Real-ship Test Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月12日，平陆运河实船试验正式启动，将分阶段完成通航验证与航标效能检测，为2026年9月如期通航奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, the real-ship test of the Pinglu Canal was officially launched to verify navigation and beacon effectiveness in stages, laying a solid foundation for the canal to open to navigation in September 2026.

articles.title_zh: 湖北出台指导意见规范民间河湖长工作
articles.title_en: Hubei Issues Guidance to Regulate Civil River and Lake Chiefs
articles.summary_zh: 湖北省河湖长制办公室联合省委社工部等部门印发《指导意见》，规范民间河湖长选育、履职、管理、保障全链条体系，推动河湖管护提质增效。
articles.summary_en: Hubei's River and Lake Chief Office, together with provincial social work departments, issued guidelines to standardize the selection, performance, management, and support of civil river and lake chiefs, improving water management.

articles.title_zh: 雄安人工智能实训基地正式投运
articles.title_en: Xiong'an AI Training Base Officially Put into Operation
articles.summary_zh: 河北雄安新区人工智能实训基地正式投运，并举办首届人工智能实训班开班仪式，将服务北京非首都功能疏解和新区人工智能产业发展。
articles.summary_en: The AI training base in Xiong'an New Area, Hebei, officially started operation with the first training class, supporting the relocation of non-capital functions and AI industry development.

articles.title_zh: 办好民生实事，提升幸福成色
articles.title_en: Handle People's Livelihood Matters Well to Boost Happiness
articles.summary_zh: 河北省今年加大民生保障力度，财政民生支出占比超80%，推进20项民生工程，在就业、养老、托育等方面提升群众幸福感。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province has intensified livelihood security this year, with fiscal spending on people's livelihood exceeding 80% and 20 livelihood projects advancing, improving residents' well-being in employment, elderly care, and childcare.

articles.title_zh: 坚持向海图强 打造深海科技创新策源地和产业聚集高地
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Inspects Sanya, Vows to Build Deep-Sea Tech Innovation Hub
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，海南省委书记冯飞在三亚调研，强调坚持向海图强，打造深海科技创新策源地和产业聚集高地，并听取学习教育和经济社会发展汇报。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Hainan Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei inspected Sanya, stressing building a deep-sea tech innovation source and industrial highland, and heard reports on study education and economic development.

articles.title_zh: 正式开工！储能技术（海南）共享实验室落地海口国家高新区
articles.title_en: Construction Officially Starts for Energy Storage Technology (Hainan) Shared Laboratory in Haikou National High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，储能技术（海南）共享实验室装修工程开工仪式在海口国家高新区举行，标志着这一面向海南全省储能产业的公共技术服务平台进入实质性建设阶段。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the renovation commencement ceremony for the Energy Storage Technology (Hainan) Shared Laboratory was held in Haikou National High-tech Zone, marking the platform's substantive construction phase.

articles.title_zh: 许勤梁惠玲会见中国石油天然气集团党组书记、董事长戴厚良
articles.title_en: Xu Qin and Liang Huiling Meet with CNPC Chairman Dai Houliang
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，黑龙江省委书记许勤、省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨会见中国石油天然气集团党组书记、董事长戴厚良一行，双方就深化战略合作、保障能源安全等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, and Liang Huiling, Governor, met with Dai Houliang, Party Secretary and Chairman of CNPC, in Harbin to discuss strategic cooperation and energy security.

articles.title_zh: 党建引领幸福来 老旧社区焕新颜
articles.title_en: Party Building Leads to Happiness, Old Community Gets New Look
articles.summary_zh: 人民网党建调研行近日深入湖南长沙、岳阳等地，报道咸嘉新村社区以党建引领基层治理，通过民情联络室、红色物业等举措提升治理效能。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily Online's Party Building research trip visited Changsha and Yueyang in Hunan, highlighting Xianjia Xincun community's party-led governance through people's liaison offices and red property management.

articles.title_zh: 江苏“人工智能+”培训全面开花 每年计划培训超20万人次
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Launches Comprehensive "AI+" Training, Aiming Over 200,000 Trainees Annually
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省全面开展“人工智能+”技术技能专项培训行动，计划每年培训超20万人次，以补齐群众AI技能短板、打通就业堵点。
articles.summary_en: Jiangsu has launched a comprehensive "AI+" technical skills training initiative, aiming to train over 200,000 people annually to address AI skill gaps and employment bottlenecks.

articles.title_zh: 8月11日太湖水位持续上涨 江苏启动防汛三级应急响应
articles.title_en: Taihu Lake Water Level Rises, Jiangsu Activates Level III Emergency Response
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，太湖受台风影响水位持续上涨，达警戒水位并编号为2026年第1号洪水，江苏省启动防汛三级应急响应，调度水利工程排水。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Taihu Lake water level kept rising above warning level due to typhoon, prompting Jiangsu to activate a Level III flood-control emergency response and dispatch water conservancy projects for drainage.

articles.title_zh: 江西省政府召开第137次常务会议
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Government Holds 137th Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，江西省省长叶建春主持召开第137次省政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和指示精神，审议通过2025年度江西省科学技术奖拟授奖名单。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun chaired the 137th executive meeting of the provincial government, which deliberated and approved the proposed list of 2025 Jiangxi Science and Technology Awards.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中会见非洲国家驻华使节
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets African Ambassadors to China
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见出席“2026非洲国家驻华大使巡讲·内蒙古”活动的多国驻华使节。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, Wang Weizhong, Party Secretary of Inner Mongolia, met in Hohhot with ambassadors from Mauritania, Malawi, Kenya, Mozambique, Nigeria and other countries attending the 2026 Africa Ambassadors' Tour in Inner Mongolia.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古能源集团新一代煤电示范项目开工
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Energy Group Starts Construction of New-Generation Coal Power Demonstration Project
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，总投资25.44亿元的内蒙古能源集团包头喜桂图二期新一代煤电示范项目在包头市石拐区开工，建成后将提升蒙西电网调峰能力，年节约标准煤约15万吨。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Inner Mongolia Energy Group's Xigui Phase II new-generation coal power demonstration project with a total investment of 2.544 billion yuan started construction in Shiguai District, Baotou. It will enhance peak regulation and save about 150,000 tons of standard coal annually.

articles.title_zh: 美国俄勒冈州艺术体操代表团到内蒙古交流访问
articles.title_en: Oregon Rhythmic Gymnastics Delegation Visits Inner Mongolia for Exchange
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，美国俄勒冈州艺术体操代表团24名成员到内蒙古交流访问，参观博物院和非遗小镇，体验非遗技艺，并将与当地进行艺术交流。活动持续至8月13日。
articles.summary_en: On August 11, a 24-member rhythmic gymnastics delegation from Oregon, US, visited Inner Mongolia for cultural exchange, touring museums and intangible heritage towns. The visit lasts until August 13.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏出台民办职校管理新规
articles.title_en: Ningxia Issues New Regulations for Private Vocational Schools
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏人社厅修订印发民办职业技能培训学校管理办法，通过分类审批、分级权责、闭环监管、暖心扶持四大举措，优化审批服务，强化全链条监管，为产业转型升级提供高技能人才支撑。
articles.summary_en: Ningxia's Department of Human Resources and Social Security has revised and issued regulations on private vocational training schools, featuring classified approval, tiered responsibilities, closed-loop supervision, and supportive measures to optimize service and strengthen oversight.

articles.title_zh: 扩大高水平对外开放 青海大有可为更要大有作为
articles.title_en: Wu Xiaojun Stresses Expanding High-Level Opening-Up in Qinghai
articles.summary_zh: 8月11日，青海省委书记吴晓军专题调研进出口岸管理和对外开放工作，强调在“十五五”时期积极融入全国发展大局，扩大高水平对外开放，促进高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 11, Wu Xiaojun, Qinghai Party chief, surveyed port management and opening-up, urging deeper integration into national development and expanding high-level opening-up for high-quality growth in the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 中央预算内投资推动城市更新惠及民生
articles.title_en: Central Budget Investment Promotes Urban Renewal Benefiting People's Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 8月10日，青海省发展改革委称，2026年落实中央预算内投资5.42亿元，支持西宁、海东、海西州63个老旧小区配套基础设施项目建设，惠及4.25万余户居民。
articles.summary_en: On August 10, the Qinghai Provincial Development and Reform Commission announced that 542 million yuan of central budget investment in 2026 will support infrastructure renovation of 63 old residential communities in Xining, Haidong, and Haixi, benefiting over 42,500 households.

articles.title_en: Sichuan Discipline Inspection Commission: Two Officials Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 四川省纪委监委8月12日发布消息，乐山市人民医院原院长庞波主动投案，四川省第一建筑工程有限公司原副总经理陈胜接受审查调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 12, Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection announced that Pang Bo, former president of Leshan People's Hospital, voluntarily surrendered, and Chen Sheng, former deputy general manager of Sichuan First Construction Engineering Co., Ltd., is under investigation.
