articles.title_zh: 总书记引经据典话廉政（一）
articles.title_en: General Secretary Quotes Classics on Clean Governance (I)
articles.summary_zh: 文章梳理习近平总书记关于廉政文化的经典引用，推出系列学习内容第一期，引导党员干部正心修身。
articles.summary_en: The article compiles General Secretary Xi Jinping's classic quotes on clean governance, launching the first part of a learning series to guide officials in self-cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 中国东方电气集团原党组副书记、董事宋致远被查
articles.title_en: Song Zhiyuan, Former Deputy Party Secretary of Dongfang Electric, under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委8月8日通报，中国东方电气集团原党组副书记、董事宋致远涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On Aug. 8, the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission announced that Song Zhiyuan, former deputy Party secretary and director of Dongfang Electric Group, is under review and investigation for suspected serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 杭州欧美同学会聚力浙西发展 海归人才共话创新创业
articles.title_en: Hangzhou Western Returned Scholars Association Boosts Development of Western Zhejiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日至7日，杭州欧美同学会在杭州建德举行工作交流暨浙西海归创新创业推进活动，旨在凝聚海归人才力量，推动区域交流合作。会长叶鉴铭出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 6 to 7, the Hangzhou Western Returned Scholars Association held a working exchange and innovation event in Jiande, Hangzhou, to rally overseas returnees for regional development. President Ye Jianming attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 新思想引领新征程丨服务消费扩容升级 激发内需新活力
articles.title_en: New Ideas Lead New Journey | Service Consumption Expands and Upgrades to Stimulate New Vitality in Domestic Demand
articles.summary_zh: 服务消费持续扩容升级，今年上半年服务零售额同比增长5.3%，居民服务性消费支出占比达45.7%，成为拉动内需重要引擎。
articles.summary_en: Service consumption continues to expand and upgrade, with service retail sales up 5.3% year-on-year in H1 and service spending accounting for 45.7% of residents' consumption, becoming a key engine for domestic demand.

articles.title_zh: 健康中国建设综述：全民健身与全民健康深度融合
articles.title_en: Overview of Healthy China Initiative: Deep Integration of National Fitness and Public Health
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日迎来第十八个全民健身日，文章综述健康中国建设成就，涵盖公共卫生、医疗服务、健康生活方式等，强调全民健身与全民健康深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the 18th National Fitness Day, this article reviews achievements in the Healthy China initiative, covering public health, medical services, and healthy lifestyles, emphasizing deep integration of national fitness and public health.

articles.title_zh: 共享制造，生产也能“拼单”
articles.title_en: Shared Manufacturing: Production Can Also 'Pool Orders'
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局会议强调发展新兴支柱产业后，共享制造模式在北京、四川眉山、山东新泰等地兴起，通过共享工厂、检验检测平台和喷涂中心等助力产业降本增效。
articles.summary_en: Following a CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting emphasizing new pillar industries, shared manufacturing is emerging in Beijing, Sichuan's Meishan, and Shandong's Xintai, using shared factories, testing platforms, and coating centers to boost efficiency and cut costs.

articles.title_zh: 规上文化企业营收同比增长4.6%
articles.title_en: Revenue of Large Cultural Enterprises Up 4.6% Year on Year
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局数据显示，上半年全国规模以上文化及相关产业企业实现营业收入72026亿元，同比增长4.6%。
articles.summary_en: According to the National Bureau of Statistics, revenue of large cultural and related enterprises reached 7.2026 trillion yuan in H1, up 4.6% year on year.

articles.title_zh: 上半年规上轻工业实现营收11.2万亿元
articles.title_en: Light Industry Above Designated Size Achieves Revenue of 11.2 Trillion Yuan in H1
articles.summary_zh: 中国轻工业联合会发布数据显示，上半年规模以上轻工业增加值同比增长5.0%，营业收入11.2万亿元，可穿戴智能设备零售额增速超一倍。
articles.summary_en: China Light Industry Council data shows H1 value-added output above designated size grew 5.0% YoY, revenue reaching 11.2 trillion yuan, with wearable device retail sales more than doubling.

articles.title_zh: 努力提升粮食能源资源安全保障能力（总书记的人民情怀）
articles.title_en: Striving to Enhance Food, Energy and Resource Security: The General Secretary's Devotion to the People
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记7月30日主持中共中央政治局会议，要求统筹发展和安全、抓好农业生产，并回顾其在多地考察时强调粮食和能源安全的重要性。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Political Bureau meeting, urging coordinated development and security and ensuring a good autumn harvest, while recalling his inspections stressing the importance of food and energy security.

articles.title_zh: 我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Exchange Reserves Hit $3.4188 Trillion
articles.summary_zh: 截至7月末，我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元，较6月末上升25亿美元，升幅0.07%，经济展现韧性和活力。
articles.summary_en: As of end-July, China's foreign exchange reserves reached $3,418.8 billion, up $2.5 billion from end-June, reflecting economic resilience.

articles.title_zh: 前7月我国货物贸易进出口同比增长17.3%
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Trade Up 17.3% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 据海关统计，今年前7月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%，其中出口增长14%，进口增长22%。
articles.summary_en: According to customs statistics, China's total goods trade in the first seven months reached 30.13 trillion yuan, up 17.3% year-on-year, with exports rising 14% and imports 22%.

articles.title_zh: 紧紧抓住那些惠及面广、牵一发而动全身的工作——突出重点推进健康中国建设观察
articles.title_en: Focus on Key Tasks with Broad Benefits to Advance Healthy China Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日全民健身日，文章观察我国健康中国建设成效，强调健全公共卫生体系、建设优质高效医疗服务体系、倡导健康文明生活方式等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On China's National Fitness Day, this article reviews progress in building a Healthy China, highlighting priorities in public health systems, high-quality medical services, and healthy lifestyles.

articles.title_zh: 让古老的“砖石”讲述中国故事
articles.title_en: Ancient 'Bricks and Stones' Tell China's Story at Berlin Exhibition
articles.summary_zh: 8月，“天府乐土·四川汉代画像艺术展”在德国柏林中国文化中心举行，通过画像砖、拓片、民乐等展示汉代巴蜀文化，促进中德文化交流。
articles.summary_en: In August, the 'Sichuan Han Dynasty Art Exhibition' is held at the Chinese Cultural Center in Berlin, featuring brick reliefs, rubbings and folk music to showcase Han-era Bashu culture and boost Sino-German cultural exchange.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠就深化走遍长春行动做好城市更新工作开展调研
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Surveys Urban Renewal Work in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，长春市委书记张恩惠调研城市更新工作，实地查看大冬会场馆改造、供热、净水和加装电梯等民生项目，强调问需于民、问计于民、问效于民，推动城市建设管理再上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee, inspected urban renewal work, visiting projects including Winter Universiade venues, heating supply, water purification, and elevator installations, emphasizing a people-centered approach to improve urban management.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Devotion to the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章阐述习近平总书记对扩大内需的重视，强调扩大内需是战略之举，并回顾其在各地考察及政策部署，指出内需拉动经济增长，增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: The article expounds on General Secretary Xi Jinping's emphasis on expanding domestic demand as a strategic move, reviewing his inspections and policy deployments, and noting that domestic demand drives economic growth and improves people's wellbeing.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚主持召开市委专题会议时强调 着力谋实高质量项目 扎实推进“六张网”等规划建设
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Chairs Municipal Party Committee Special Meeting on High-Quality Projects and 'Six Networks' Planning
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，沈阳市召开专题会议，听取“六张网”等项目汇报，市委书记霍步刚主持并讲话，强调谋划高质量项目，推进规划建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Shenyang held a special meeting to review projects like the "Six Networks". Municipal Party Secretary Huo Bugang presided and stressed planning high-quality projects.

articles.title_zh: 上半年我国医药工业创新加速突破
articles.title_en: China's Pharmaceutical Industry Accelerates Innovation in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，我国医药工业创新加速突破，38款创新药获批上市，其中国产31款，11个新靶点药品全部自主研，产业动能持续增强。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of this year, China's pharmaceutical industry accelerated innovation with 38 innovative drugs approved, 31 being domestically developed, and all 11 new-target drugs independently researched, boosting industrial momentum.

articles.title_zh: 上半年我国经营主体结构持续优化
articles.title_en: China's Business Entities Structure Continues to Optimize in H1
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，市场监管总局公布数据显示，上半年我国经营主体结构持续优化，新兴产业和未来产业企业保持增长，高技术制造业增势强劲。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, the State Administration for Market Regulation released data showing China's business entity structure continued to optimize in H1, with emerging and future industries growing and high-tech manufacturing booming.

articles.title_zh: 各美其美，美美与共——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派
articles.title_en: Beauty in Diversity, Harmony in Sharing: The Global Vision and Magnanimity of China's Head-of-State Diplomacy
articles.summary_zh: 新华社综述回顾习近平主席在联合国教科文组织、墨西哥奇琴伊察等地关于文明交流互鉴的重要论述，展现中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派。
articles.summary_en: An Xinhua review recalls President Xi Jinping's remarks on civilizational exchanges and mutual learning at UNESCO headquarters, Chichen Itza and other places, demonstrating the global vision and broad-mindedness of China's head-of-state diplomacy.

articles.title_zh: 前7月我国货物贸易进出口同比增长17.3%
articles.title_en: China's Foreign Trade Up 17.3% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 据海关统计，今年前7月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%，其中出口增长14%，进口增长22%。
articles.summary_en: China's total goods trade reached 30.13 trillion yuan in Jan-Jul, up 17.3% year-on-year, with exports up 14% and imports up 22%, according to customs data.

articles.title_zh: 新订单指数回升 物流业景气指数保持在扩张区间
articles.title_en: New Orders Index Rebounds, Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Stays in Expansion Zone
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会数据显示，7月物流业景气指数为50.4%，保持在扩张区间，新订单指数连续5个月回升。
articles.summary_en: China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing data shows July logistics prosperity index at 50.4%, remaining in expansion territory, with new orders index rising for fifth consecutive month.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's People-first Sentiment
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调坚持高质量发展和高水平安全相互促进，多次考察调研并部署粮食和能源安全工作，确保粮食和能源供给稳定。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping stresses promoting both high-quality development and high-level security, conducting inspections and deployments to safeguard food and energy supply stability.

articles.title_zh: 上半年规上轻工业实现营收11.2万亿元
articles.title_en: Above-Scale Light Industry Achieves 11.2 Trillion Yuan Revenue in H1
articles.summary_zh: 中国轻工业联合会发布数据显示，上半年规模以上轻工业增加值同比增长5.0%，实现营业收入11.2万亿元；轻工商品出口4870.4亿美元，同比增长6.7%，消费升级趋势明显。
articles.summary_en: The China Light Industry Federation reported a 5.0% year-on-year growth in value-added output of above-scale light industry in H1 2026, with operating revenue reaching 11.2 trillion yuan. Exports of light industrial goods rose 6.7% to $487.04 billion.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市长顾坤接待信访群众
articles.title_en: Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun Receives Petitioners
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，淮安市市长顾坤到市人民来访接待中心开展接访活动并调研信访工作，强调要用心用情用力解决群众急难愁盼。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun visited the city's petition reception center to receive petitioners and inspect petition work, stressing efforts to resolve people's urgent concerns.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市委书记史志军到金湖县调研
articles.title_en: Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, Investigates Jinhu County
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，淮安市委书记史志军到金湖县调研，走访企业项目，召开座谈会，强调经济运行稳中有进、提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, visited Jinhu County to inspect enterprises and projects, chaired a symposium, and emphasized stable and high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 高靖生赴部分县（区）调研经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Gao Jingsheng Surveys Economic and Social Development in Several Counties (Districts)
articles.summary_zh: 8月4日至7日，怀化市委副书记、市政府党组书记高靖生赴沅陵、辰溪等县区调研经济社会发展，强调加强经济调度、谋划产业、守牢安全底线。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 4 to 7, Gao Jingsheng, Deputy Secretary of Huaihua Municipal Party Committee and Party Secretary of the Municipal Government, visited counties including Yuanling and Chenxi to survey economic and social development, stressing economic operations, industrial planning, and safety.

articles.title_zh: 于海田主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，济南市委副书记、市长于海田主持召开市政府常务会议，研究安全生产、深化市校融合发展等事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Yu Haitian, deputy secretary of the Jinan Municipal Party Committee and mayor, chaired a municipal government executive meeting to discuss work safety and deepening city-university integration.

articles.title_zh: 市政府党组召开扩大会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话重要文章精神
articles.title_en: Jinan Municipal Government Party Group Holds Enlarged Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Article
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，济南市政府党组召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和重要文章精神，并研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Party Group of Jinan Municipal Government held an enlarged meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and article, and discussed implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 于海田调研规上服务业运行，强调持续深化精准为企服务
articles.title_en: Yu Haitian Inspects Service Industry Enterprises in Jinan High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，济南市市长于海田到济南高新区调研规上服务业运行，强调深化为企服务，推动服务业扩能提质。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Yu Haitian, Mayor of Jinan, visited Jinan High-tech Zone to inspect the operation of service industries, emphasizing improved services to boost quality and efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 曾风保到榕城调研：抢抓工期保进度 厚植情怀惠民生
articles.title_en: Zeng Fengbao Visits Rongcheng to Urge Urban Renewal and Livelihood Projects
articles.summary_zh: 7日下午，揭阳市委书记曾风保到榕城区调研城市更新和古城保育项目，强调抢抓工期、保障进度，增进民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of the 7th, Zeng Fengbao, Secretary of Jieyang Municipal Party Committee, inspected urban renewal and ancient city preservation projects in Rongcheng District, stressing schedule and public welfare.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群带队赴揭阳市学习考察
articles.title_en: Shantou Party Secretary Leads Delegation to Jieyang for Study
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，汕头市委书记庄悦群带队到揭阳市学习考察，与揭阳市委书记曾风保交流，共同推动汕潮揭都市圈高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Zhuang Yuequn, Secretary of Shantou Municipal Party Committee, led a delegation to Jieyang City for study and inspection, exchanging views with Jieyang officials to boost the Shantou-Chaozhou-Jieyang metropolitan area development.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬专题调研体育工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Conducts Special Research on Sports Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬专题调研体育工作，实地察看市体育运动学校、运动馆及“苏超”泰州队驻地，强调推动体育强市建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Jiang Dongdong, Secretary of Taizhou Municipal Party Committee, conducted special research on sports work, visiting the sports school, gymnasium and the Taizhou team base, emphasizing building a strong sports city.

articles.title_zh: 李晖参加五级人大代表回选区访选民活动，调研重点处理建议办理工作
articles.title_en: Mayor Li Hui Attends Voter Visit Activity and Investigates Key Proposal Handling
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，泰州市市长李晖以人大代表身份到海陵区参加“你点我督惠民生”活动，调研养老服务中心和企业，并召开座谈会听取代表建议。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Li Hui, mayor of Taizhou, participated in a deputies activity in Hailing District as a people's congress deputy, inspected a senior care center and enterprises, and chaired a symposium to hear suggestions.

articles.title_zh: 李晖调度全市防御台风“白海豚”工作
articles.title_en: Li Hui Chairs Citywide Meeting on Typhoon 'Baituhai' Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，泰州市长李晖主持全市防御台风“白海豚”工作部署会，强调落实防汛防台风措施，全力保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Li Hui, mayor of Taizhou, chaired a citywide deployment meeting on Typhoon 'Baituhai' defense, stressing thorough preparedness and protective measures.

articles.title_zh: 省安全生产第1巡查组巡查无锡市动员会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Work Safety Inspection Team No.1 Holds Mobilization Meeting in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，省安全生产第1巡查组巡查无锡市动员会召开，组长王汉春作动员讲话，市委书记杜小刚作表态发言，市长蒋锋主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the mobilization meeting for the first provincial work safety inspection team's inspection of Wuxi was held. Team leader Wang Hanchun delivered a speech, Party Secretary Du Xiaogang made a statement, and Mayor Jiang Feng presided.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平主持召开市政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Ye Niuping Chairs Municipal Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，西安市市长叶牛平主持召开市政府常务会议，研究扫黑除恶重点行业整治、经济稳增长、生态资源管理等事项。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Mayor Ye Niuping of Xi'an chaired a municipal government executive meeting to discuss special campaigns against organized crime, economic growth measures, and ecological resource management.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀 | “努力提升粮食能源资源安全保障能力”
articles.title_en: General Secretary's People-Centered Vision: Striving to Enhance Food, Energy and Resource Security
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调统筹发展和安全，提升粮食能源资源安全保障能力；7月30日主持中央政治局会议，要求抓好农业生产、夺取秋粮丰收。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping stressed coordinating development and security and enhancing food, energy and resource security; he chaired a Politburo meeting on July 30, requiring solid agricultural work and a good autumn harvest.

articles.title_zh: 叶牛平主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Ye Niuping Chairs Enlarged Meeting of Municipal Party Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，西安市市长叶牛平主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，学习中央政治局会议精神，部署防汛减灾和教育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Xi'an Mayor Ye Niuping chaired an enlarged meeting of the Municipal Government Party Group to study the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and arrange flood control and education work.

articles.title_zh: 信阳市农业强市建设现场推进会议召开 张宏伟出席并讲话 卢希望主持
articles.title_en: Xinyang City Holds On-site Meeting on Building Strong Agricultural City; Zhang Hongwei Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，信阳市农业强市建设现场推进会议在淮滨县召开，市委书记张宏伟出席并讲话，市长卢希望主持，部署乡村振兴和粮食安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Xinyang City held an on-site meeting in Huaibin County to promote the building of a strong agricultural city. Party Secretary Zhang Hongwei attended and spoke, and Mayor Lu Xiwang presided.

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组召开学习交流会
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group Holds Learning Exchange Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，盐城市委理论学习中心组召开学习交流会，市委书记严汉平主持并讲话，强调深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee's Theoretical Learning Center Group held a learning exchange meeting, chaired by Party Secretary Yan Hanping, emphasizing in-depth study of Xi Jinping's Party building thought.

articles.title_zh: 省政府与华为签署深化战略合作协议 刘小涛会见徐直军一行
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government and Huawei Sign Deepening Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，江苏省政府与华为在南京签署深化战略合作协议，省长刘小涛会见华为轮值董事长徐直军，双方将在人工智能等领域深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Jiangsu Provincial Government signed a deepening strategic cooperation agreement with Huawei in Nanjing. Governor Liu Xiaotao met Huawei's rotating chairman Xu Zhijun to advance cooperation in AI and other fields.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，盐城市委常委会召开会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究安全生产、生态环境保护、高质量发展考核等工作。市委书记严汉平主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to implement Xi Jinping's recent speech spirit, focusing on work safety, ecological protection, and high-quality development assessment. Secretary Yan Hanping presided.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委理论学习中心组学习习近平总书记关于基层工作方法重要论述
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Study Group Learns Xi's Discourses on Grassroots Work Methods
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省委理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's important discourses on grassroots work methods. Xin Changxing, Secretary of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee, presided over and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平会见国家能源集团氢能事业部总经理刘玮
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Meets Liu Wei, General Manager of Hydrogen Division of National Energy Group
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平会见国家能源集团氢能事业部总经理刘玮，双方就清洁能源开发利用、算电协同等领域深化合作交流。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 6, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, met with Liu Wei, General Manager of Hydrogen Division of National Energy Group, to discuss cooperation in clean energy development and digital-power synergy.

articles.title_zh: 余红胜在岳阳和长沙调研
articles.title_en: Yu Hongsheng Investigates in Yueyang and Changsha
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日至6日，湖南省副省长余红胜在岳阳、长沙调研“千百十”龙头企业培育及产融结合工作，深入多家企业了解情况。
articles.summary_en: From Aug 5 to 6, Hunan Vice Governor Yu Hongsheng visited Yueyang and Changsha for research on cultivating leading enterprises and integrating industry with finance.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国主持召开书记专题会
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Chairs Special Meeting on Transport Planning
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，周口市委书记黄玉国主持召开书记专题会，听取“十五五”现代综合交通运输体系、内河航运高质量发展规划编制情况汇报，部署下步重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhoukou Party Secretary Huang Yuguo chaired a special meeting to hear reports on the 15th Five-Year Plan for comprehensive transport and inland waterway development and arrange next steps.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议暨十届七十二次主席会议 发挥政协职能优势 服务珠海现代化建设
articles.title_en: Zhuhai CPPCC Holds Party Group Meeting and 72nd Chairman's Meeting to Serve Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，珠海市政协召开党组会议暨主席会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，强调发挥政协职能优势服务珠海现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Zhuhai CPPCC held its Party Group and Chairman's meetings to study Xi Jinping's important speech and emphasize serving Zhuhai's modernization through CPPCC functions.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐主持召开市政府党组会议 巩固拓展树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育成果
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting to Consolidate Educational Achievements on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐主持召开市政府党组会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记关于树立和践行正确政绩观的重要论述，研究部署巩固拓展学习教育成果等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Wu Zetong, deputy secretary of the Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee and mayor, chaired a Party group meeting of the municipal government to study and implement Xi Jinping's important discourse on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, and to consolidate the achievements of the learning and education campaign.

articles.title_zh: 林武会见国家电投集团客人
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Meets Guests from SPIC
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日下午，山东省委书记林武在济南会见国家电投集团董事长刘明胜一行，双方就核能、海上风电等合作交换意见，会后山东省政府与国家电投签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 7, Lin Wu, Secretary of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee, met with Liu Mingsheng, Chairman of SPIC, in Jinan. They exchanged views on nuclear energy, offshore wind, and other cooperation. After the meeting, the Shandong Provincial Government signed a strategic cooperation agreement with SPIC.

articles.title_zh: 王兴兴回答超300个问题，谈美国禁令、DeepSeek
articles.title_en: Wang Xingxing Answers Over 300 Questions, Discusses US Restrictions and DeepSeek
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，宇树科技举办科创板上市网上投资者交流会，王兴兴回答超300个问题，谈及美国FCC限制措施及与DeepSeek合作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Unitree Technology held an online investor briefing for its STAR Market IPO. Wang Xingxing answered over 300 questions, addressing US FCC restrictions and cooperation with DeepSeek.

articles.title_zh: 北京市教委发布中小学教育惩戒规则实施细则
articles.title_en: Beijing Education Commission Issues Rules on Disciplinary Measures for Primary and Secondary Schools
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，北京市教委发布《中小学教育惩戒规则实施细则（试行）》，明确七类可实施教育惩戒的情形及教师禁止行为。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Beijing Education Commission issued implementation rules for disciplinary measures in primary and secondary schools, specifying seven situations and prohibited teacher behaviors.

articles.title_zh: 周末打虎！中国东方电气集团原党组副书记、董事宋致远被查
articles.title_en: Weekend Anti-Corruption: Song Zhiyuan, Former Dongfang Electric Deputy Party Secretary, Investigated
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，中国东方电气集团有限公司原党组副书记、董事宋致远因涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受中央纪委国家监委纪律审查和监察调查。
articles.summary_en: On August 8, Song Zhiyuan, former Deputy Party Secretary and Director of Dongfang Electric Group, was placed under disciplinary review and supervision investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 2026年河北省委议军会议在石家庄召开
articles.title_en: 2026 Hebei Provincial Party Committee Military Affairs Meeting Held in Shijiazhuang
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，河北省委议军会议在石家庄召开，省委书记罗文出席并讲话，强调扎实做好新时代人民武装工作，开创国防动员和后备力量建设新局面。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the Hebei Provincial Party Committee held its military affairs meeting in Shijiazhuang, where Secretary Luo Wen stressed solid people's armed forces work and opening new prospects for national defense mobilization and reserve forces.

articles.title_zh: 国家级试点连落七子 洛阳释放发展乘数效应
articles.title_en: Seven National Pilot Programs Land in Luoyang, Unleashing Multiplier Effects
articles.summary_zh: 洛阳入选全国第三批城市一刻钟便民生活圈先行区试点，一年多来已有7项国家级试点落地，涵盖产业转型、消费升级、城市更新、医疗卫生等领域，释放发展乘数效应。
articles.summary_en: Luoyang has been selected for the third batch of national pilots for 15-minute convenient living circles, marking the seventh national pilot program in over a year, covering industrial transformation, consumption upgrade, urban renewal, and medical care, unleashing multiplier effects.

articles.title_zh: 林武会见国家电投集团客人
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Meets Chairman of State Power Investment Corporation
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日下午，山东省委书记林武在济南会见国家电投集团董事长刘明胜，双方就核能、海上风电等合作交换意见，随后山东省政府与国家电投签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 7, Shandong Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu met with Liu Mingsheng, Chairman of State Power Investment Corporation, in Jinan to discuss cooperation on nuclear energy and offshore wind. The provincial government then signed a strategic cooperation agreement with SPIC.

articles.title_zh: 赵龙会商调度台风“白海豚”防御工作
articles.title_en: Zhao Long Convenes Meeting on Typhoon 'White Dolphin' Defense
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月7日下午，福建省省长赵龙在省应急指挥中心主持召开视频会议，会商调度第13号台风“白海豚”防御工作，强调确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of August 7, 2026, Fujian Governor Zhao Long chaired a video conference at the provincial emergency command center to coordinate defense against Typhoon White Dolphin, stressing the protection of people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 学习进行时丨人民的健康、体质、幸福一脉相承
articles.title_en: People's Health, Physique, and Happiness Are Interconnected
articles.summary_zh: 国务院印发《全民健身计划（2026—2030年）》，部署全民健身事业高质量发展。文章回顾习近平总书记推动全民健身的历程，强调人民健康是幸福生活的基础。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the National Fitness Plan (2026-2030) to promote high-quality development of public fitness. The article reviews Xi Jinping's efforts in promoting fitness for all, emphasizing health as the foundation of people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 任刚到平度市调研时强调：抓实问题整改 塑强特色优势 努力推动县域经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Ren Gang Investigates in Pingdu, Stressing Rectification and High-Quality County Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，青岛市委副书记、市长任刚到平度市调研高标准农田建设、经济运行和重点项目建设，强调抓实问题整改，推动县域经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Ren Gang, mayor of Qingdao, visited Pingdu to inspect high-standard farmland construction, economic operations and key projects, urging problem rectification for high-quality county economy.

articles.title_zh: 人民领袖丨登山道上的办公会
articles.title_en: People's Leader: Office Meeting on the Mountain Trail
articles.summary_zh: 2001年，时任福建省省长习近平在福州鼓山登山途中现场办公，听取群众意见后决定新建两条登山道、安装路灯，并拨款修建淋浴室，解决群众登山困难。
articles.summary_en: In 2001, Xi Jinping, then Fujian Governor, held an on-site meeting on Gushan Mountain, deciding to build new trails, install lights, and add showers for hikers.

articles.title_zh: 习言道丨健康是1 其他是后面的0
articles.title_en: Xi's Quotes: Health is 1, All Else is 0
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调'健康是幸福生活最重要的指标'，全民健身日之际重温讲话，倡导健康生活方式。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping stressed that health is the most important indicator of happiness. On National Fitness Day, his remarks are revisited to promote healthy lifestyles.

articles.title_zh: 日本在南鸟岛部署反舰导弹 暴露怎样“再军事化”野心？
articles.title_en: Japan Deploys Anti-Ship Missiles on Minami-Tori-shima, Revealing 'Remilitarization' Ambition?
articles.summary_zh: 日本在南鸟岛部署反舰导弹，外交部发言人林剑批评日方加速‘再军事化’。文章分析该岛位置及日本扩张野心。
articles.summary_en: Japan deploying anti-ship missiles on Minami-Tori-shima; MFA spokesperson Lin Jian criticizes Japan's accelerated remilitarization. Article analyzes the island's location and Japan's expansionist ambitions.

articles.title_zh: 创新涌动，坚韧向前——解读前7个月我国外贸成绩单
articles.title_en: Innovation Surges, Resilience Endures: Interpreting China's Foreign Trade Performance in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署8月7日发布数据显示，今年前7个月我国货物贸易进出口30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%，机电产品出口占比超六成，外贸向高端化、智能化、绿色化转型。
articles.summary_en: Customs data on Aug 7 showed China's goods trade reached 30.13 trillion yuan in the first seven months, up 17.3% year on year, with mechanical and electrical products accounting for over 60% of exports.

articles.title_zh: 让内需成为经济发展的主动力
articles.title_en: Let Domestic Demand Become the Main Driver of Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调扩大内需是战略之举，今年中央政治局会议部署加力扩大内需、优化供给，内需已成为拉动经济增长的主动力。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping emphasized that expanding domestic demand is a strategic move. The CPC Central Committee Politburo meeting deployed measures to boost domestic demand and improve supply, making it a major driver of economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 国际奥委会发布报告 聚焦网络恶意攻击与体育
articles.title_en: IOC Issues Report on Cyber Abuse and Sport
articles.summary_zh: 国际奥委会发布报告《网络恶意攻击与体育》，聚焦2024年巴黎奥运会和2026年米兰-科尔蒂纳冬奥会，甄别出近2.5万条攻击性内容。
articles.summary_en: IOC issues report "Cyber Abuse and Sport" focusing on Paris 2024 and Milan-Cortina 2026, identifying nearly 25,000 abusive posts.

articles.title_zh: 坚持民生优先 推动学习教育成果落到实处
articles.title_en: Prioritizing People's Livelihood to Turn Learning Education Achievements into Practice
articles.summary_zh: 学习开展以来，吉林长春、内蒙古兴安盟一体推进学查改，聚焦群众急难愁盼问题，推动整改落实。
articles.summary_en: Since launching the campaign, Changchun and Hinggan League have advanced study, investigation, and rectification together, solving pressing problems and delivering tangible results.

articles.title_zh: “人工智能+”，解锁更多新可能
articles.title_en: 'AI+' Unlocks New Possibilities
articles.summary_zh: 光明日报报道，人工智能正深入融入经济社会各领域，应用场景加速拓展，自主创新步伐加快。国家发展改革委表示将统筹高质量发展和高水平安全，加快人工智能法立法进程。
articles.summary_en: Guangming Daily reports AI is deeply integrating into economy and society, with expanding applications and faster independent innovation. NDRC pledges balanced development and safety, accelerating AI legislation.

articles.title_zh: 王浩在全省防御应对13号台风“白海豚”工作视频调度会上强调 狠抓落实一贯到底 以工作确定性应对台风不确定性 确保交出防汛防台高分答卷
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Emphasizes Solid Implementation at Provincial Video Conference on Typhoon 'White Dolphin' Defense
articles.summary_zh: 8月8日，浙江省委省政府召开防御台风“白海豚”视频调度会，省委书记王浩强调狠抓落实，确保防汛防台安全。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 8, Zhejiang provincial party committee and government held a video conference on typhoon 'White Dolphin' defense; Party Secretary Wang Hao stressed implementation to ensure flood and typhoon safety.

articles.title_zh: 上半年新能源重卡销量再创新高
articles.title_en: New Energy Heavy Truck Sales Hit New High in H1
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年全国新能源重卡累计销量约14万辆，同比增长78.6%，国家安排220亿元超长期特别国债支持老旧营运货车报废更新。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of this year, sales of new energy heavy trucks in China reached about 140,000 units, up 78.6% year-on-year, with 22 billion yuan in ultra-long-term special treasury bonds supporting scrapping and renewal of old trucks.

articles.title_zh: 活力中国调研行丨弯道超车 如何“皖”美提速
articles.title_en: Vitality China Survey: How Anhui's Auto Industry Overtakes on the Curve
articles.summary_zh: 央视“活力中国调研行”走进安徽，报道其汽车产业五年间从全国第八跃居第一，2025年产量、新能源汽车产量和出口量均居全国首位。
articles.summary_en: CCTV's Vitality China Survey visits Anhui, reporting that its auto industry rose from 8th to 1st in China in five years, leading the country in production, NEV output, and exports in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府与华为签署深化战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government and Huawei Sign Deepened Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，江苏省政府与华为在南京签署深化战略合作协议，双方将以人工智能为核心深化全方位合作，省长刘小涛会见华为轮值董事长徐直军并见证签约。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, Jiangsu and Huawei signed a deepening strategic cooperation agreement in Nanjing, focusing on AI. Governor Liu Xiaotao met Huawei's rotating chairman Xu Zhijun and witnessed the signing.

articles.title_zh: 江苏部署防御台风“白海豚”工作
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Deploys Defensive Work Against Typhoon "Baitun"
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省政府部署防御台风“白海豚”工作，要求加强预警、排查隐患、转移人员，确保人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Jiangsu provincial government deployed measures against Typhoon "Baitun," emphasizing early warning, hazard inspection, and evacuation to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 原北京军区副司令员兼北京军区空军司令员李永金逝世，享年84岁
articles.title_en: Li Yongjin, Former Deputy Commander of Beijing Military Region and Commander of Beijing Military Region Air Force, Dies at 84
articles.summary_zh: 原北京军区副司令员兼北京军区空军司令员李永金因病医治无效，于2026年8月6日在北京逝世，享年84岁。
articles.summary_en: Li Yongjin, former deputy commander of Beijing Military Region and commander of its air force, died of illness in Beijing on August 6, 2026, at age 84.

articles.title_zh: 抗美援朝老战士、著名沉积地质学家郭云麟逝世
articles.title_en: Guo Yunlin, Veteran of War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea and Renowned Sedimentary Geologist, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 抗美援朝老战士、著名沉积地质学家、原地质矿产部地质研究所党委书记兼所长郭云麟因病医治无效，于2026年8月6日在北京逝世，享年94岁。
articles.summary_en: Guo Yunlin, veteran of the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea, renowned sedimentologist, and former Party chief of the Institute of Geology, passed away in Beijing at 94 on Aug 6, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 央视中文国际频道迎来新主播孙亚鹏、李秋莹
articles.title_en: CCTV-4 Welcomes New Anchors Sun Yapeng and Li Qiuying
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日至7日，央视中文国际频道的《中国新闻》栏目迎来新主播孙亚鹏和李秋莹，两人均为2025年中央广播电视总台主持人大赛（新闻主播季）的参与者。
articles.summary_en: On August 6-7, CCTV-4's China News program welcomed new anchors Sun Yapeng and Li Qiuying, both participants of the 2025 CMG Host Competition (News Anchor Season).

articles.title_zh: 北京获评2029年“世界建筑之都”称号
articles.title_en: Beijing Named 2029 World Capital of Architecture
articles.summary_zh: 联合国教科文组织5日正式授予北京2029年“世界建筑之都”称号，北京成为全球第四座获此殊荣的城市，将主办2029年第30届世界建筑师大会。
articles.summary_en: UNESCO officially designated Beijing as the World Capital of Architecture for 2029, making it the fourth city to receive this honor and host of the 30th World Congress of Architects.

articles.title_zh: 全国数标委明确：所谓“数据国家标准编制费”系冒名收取
articles.title_en: National Data Standards Committee Clarifies: 'Data National Standard Compilation Fee' Is Fraudulent
articles.summary_zh: 全国数据标准化技术委员会秘书处发表声明，否认以“标准挂名”“参编署名”等名义收取费用，提醒公众警惕冒名收费诈骗。
articles.summary_en: The Secretariat of the National Data Standardization Technical Committee issued a statement denying any fees under the guise of standard listing or compilation, warning against fraudulent collection.

articles.title_en: Qinghai Issues Three Local Standards for Lamian Noodles to Boost Industrial Standardization and Branding
articles.summary_zh: 近日，青海省市场监督管理局发布三项青海拉面地方标准，涵盖品质、赛事和区域品牌，旨在推动拉面产业标准化、品牌化发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Qinghai Provincial Administration for Market Regulation issued three local standards for Qinghai lamian noodles, covering quality, events, and regional branding, to promote standardized and branded development of the industry.

articles.title_en: Four Martyrs Posthumously Conferred with 'Loyal Guard of Chinese Armed Police' Title
articles.summary_zh: 武警部队追授衣昕玉、苗鉴、程龙、谯禾林4名烈士“中国武警忠诚卫士”称号。
articles.summary_en: The Armed Police Force posthumously conferred the title of 'Loyal Guard of Chinese Armed Police' on four martyrs: Yi Xinyu, Miao Jian, Cheng Long, and Qiao Helin.

articles.title_zh: 江淮新能源EZ6全新上市
articles.title_en: JAC New Energy EZ6 Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江淮新能源EZ6在合肥正式上市，举行大客户战略签约仪式，该车为城配纯电轻卡，主打低能耗与高性价比。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, JAC's new energy EZ6 was officially launched in Hefei, with a strategic signing ceremony for key customers. The pure electric light truck targets urban delivery with low energy consumption and high cost performance.

articles.title_zh: 222个服务业项目签约
articles.title_en: 222 Service Industry Projects Signed in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日记者从合肥市投资促进局获悉，上半年全市新签约重点服务业项目222个，其中生产性服务业项目153个。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the Hefei Investment Promotion Bureau reported that 222 key service industry projects were signed in the first half of the year, including 153 producer service projects.

articles.title_zh: 重庆野生动物保护新规11月1日起实施
articles.title_en: Chongqing Wildlife Protection Regulations to Take Effect Nov 1
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市人大常委会通过新修订的野生动物保护规定，将于2026年11月1日施行，明确禁止利用无人机等科技手段猎捕，并强化放生规范和信用惩戒。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing's newly revised wildlife protection regulations, passed by the municipal people's congress, take effect on Nov 1, 2026, banning high-tech hunting tools and strengthening release and credit penalties.

articles.title_zh: 福建省召开赓续实施新时代“堡垒工程”推进会
articles.title_en: Fujian Holds Meeting to Advance the New Era "Fortress Project"
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，福建省深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想、赓续实施新时代“堡垒工程”推进会在福州召开。省委书记周祖翼出席并讲话，强调夯实基层党建，做好村（社区）“两委”换届工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, a meeting to study Xi Jinping's thought on Party building and advance the new-era "Fortress Project" was held in Fuzhou, Fujian Province. Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi attended and stressed strengthening grassroots Party organizations and village-level leadership transitions.

articles.title_zh: 台青走进政协：从“受益者”到“建言者”
articles.title_en: Taiwan Youth Engage with CPPCC: From "Beneficiaries" to "Advisors"

articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Sichuan High People's Court held a press conference on the 10th anniversary of environmental resource trials, reporting 30,737 such cases heard from 2016 to 2026, with two cases selected as typical cases by UNEP.

articles.title_zh: 山东启动团体标准化“省市区”三级联动工作

articles.title_zh: 云南省防汛减灾和安全生产工作调度会议召开

articles.summary_en: On August 7, Yunnan held a scheduling meeting in Kunming on flood control, disaster reduction and work safety. Provincial Party Secretary Wang Ning gave instructions and Governor Wang Yubo presided and delivered a speech, deploying work on flood control, earthquake resistance and production safety.

articles.summary_en: On August 7, Beijing issued a blue rainstorm warning and activated a Level IV flood response. Mayor Yin Yong deployed measures at the emergency command center to address heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 公安部发布《公安机关网络空间安全监督检查办法》

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security issued the Measures for Supervision and Inspection of Cyberspace Security by Public Security Organs on August 7, effective October 1, 2026, specifying inspection targets, methods, and contents.

articles.title_zh: 大路穿沙——内蒙古“以路治沙”一线探访
articles.title_en: Roads Through the Desert: A Frontline Look at Inner Mongolia's 'Desert Control via Roads' Initiative
articles.summary_zh: 截至2026年6月，内蒙古已建设穿沙公路4334公里，带动治沙606.1万亩。“以路治沙”模式从地方探索上升为全区战略，推动生态、民生、能源协同发展。
articles.summary_en: As of June 2026, Inner Mongolia has built 4,334 km of roads through sandy areas, driving desertification control over 6.061 million mu. The 'desert control via roads' model has risen from local practice to a regional strategy, promoting coordinated development of ecology, livelihoods, and energy.

articles.summary_en: During his May 2024 inspection of Shandong, President Xi Jinping called for building a world-class marine port cluster. Through port integration, Shandong's cargo throughput exceeded 1.9 billion tonnes in 2025, ranking first globally.

articles.summary_en: A team led by Professor Xiao Long at China University of Geosciences (Wuhan), together with scholars from Hong Kong University and Macau University of Science and Technology, reconstructed the complete evolution history of lunar soil at the Chang'e-5 landing site, providing direct support for future lunar exploration and resource development.

articles.title_zh: 从理念到设备 台湾业者体验大陆康复中心

articles.summary_en: About 30 Taiwan healthcare professionals visited China Rehabilitation Research Center to learn about smart rehabilitation practices and exchange cross-strait care experiences.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：中国军队坚决反制任何闹海挑衅图谋

articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Defense Ministry spokesman Chen Xi said the Chinese military will resolutely counter any provocative attempts at sea, urging the Philippines to stop infringing on China's sovereignty.

articles.title_zh: 在中国，参观未来
articles.title_en: In China, Visiting the Future
articles.summary_zh: 外国游客来华兴起“科技游”，在深圳、上海、海南等地体验机器人、无人出租车、火箭发射等前沿科技，感受“中国智造”魅力。
articles.summary_en: Foreign tourists in China are increasingly taking 'tech tours,' experiencing robots, driverless taxis, rocket launches and other cutting-edge technology in Shenzhen, Shanghai, Hainan and elsewhere, appreciating the charm of 'Created in China.'

articles.title_zh: 交通运输部海事局就《水上交通事故责任认定复核办法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见

articles.summary_en: Currently, all regions, departments, and units are deepening the education campaign on establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements, integrating learning, investigation, and rectification to deliver tangible benefits to the people.

articles.title_zh: “先投后股”何以促进科技成果转化

articles.summary_en: This article investigates the 'invest first, convert later' model in Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Shandong, exploring how fiscal funds support tech commercialization by converting grants into equity.

articles.title_zh: 柔性制造，高效匹配差异化需求

articles.summary_en: People's Daily reports on flexible manufacturing, showing how Quanzhou-based Pengtai Apparel and Chongqing's Avatr achieve fast delivery of small-batch and customized products, reflecting digital transformation in manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 真心向党 道路光明——纪念陈叔通先生诞辰150周年

articles.title_zh: 家事与国事

articles.summary_en: The article cites Xi Jinping's remarks on people's livelihood during his Shanghai visit, discussing the dialectical relationship between family matters and state affairs, and emphasizing the need to address people's concerns one by one, referencing the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau's requirement to strengthen livelihood guarantees.

articles.title_zh: 中共宝鸡市委十三届十次全会召开

articles.summary_en: Recently, Gu Gang, deputy secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee and mayor, inspected grain security and integrated development of agriculture, emphasizing stable grain supply and value chain extension.

articles.title_zh: 东方之约，相约未来——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派

articles.title_zh: 以心相交，成其久远——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派

articles.title_zh: 我国外贸进出口规模连续5个月超过4万亿元

articles.title_zh: 《民用航空发展“十五五”规划》发布

articles.title_zh: 最是真情暖人心——中国元首外交的世界情怀与大国气派

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment released an assessment showing that 98.9% of the 452 national nature reserves rate excellent or good, and the ecological environment within the ecological protection red line is generally improving.

articles.title_zh: 大面积单产提升持续加力 夯实秋粮稳产基础

The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs continued to advance large-scale yield enhancement, with new technologies and equipment consolidating the foundation for stable production.

articles.title_zh: 信长星会见乌兹别克斯坦客人
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Meets Uzbek Ambassador in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，江苏省委书记信长星在南京会见乌兹别克斯坦驻华大使法尔霍德·阿尔济耶夫，双方就深化经贸合作、人文交流等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing met with Uzbek Ambassador to China Farhod Arziev in Nanjing, discussing deepening economic cooperation and cultural exchanges.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平吴炜会见金鹰集团中国纤维业务总裁张文涛
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping and Wu Wei Meet with Zhang Wentao, President of RGE's China Fiber Business
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜会见金鹰集团中国纤维业务总裁张文涛，双方就深化产业合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and acting Mayor Wu Wei met with Zhang Wentao, President of RGE's China Fiber Business, to discuss deepening industrial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛专题调研就业创业工作 以更实举措稳就业更优服务促创业
articles.title_en: Governor Liu Xiaotao Visits Nanjing to Promote Employment and Entrepreneurship
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，省长刘小涛在南京市专题调研就业创业工作，强调实施就业优先战略，以更实举措稳就业、更优服务促创业。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao visited Nanjing to inspect employment and entrepreneurship work, stressing the employment-first strategy with solid measures.

articles.title_zh: 张明康在全市人工智能产业工作座谈会议上强调奋力推动人工智能产业加快崛起 为全市高质量发展注入强劲动能
articles.title_en: Zhang Mingkang Stresses Accelerating AI Industry at City Forum
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日下午，烟台市召开人工智能产业工作座谈会议，市长张明康出席并讲话，强调实施“人工智能+”三年行动，推动产业加快崛起。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of Aug 7, Yantai held a forum on AI industry. Mayor Zhang Mingkang attended and stressed implementing an AI+ three-year action plan to accelerate the industry's rise.

articles.title_zh: 江成在市政协十四届常委会第二十三次会议上强调发扬优良传统扎实履职尽责广泛凝聚共识 以更高站位更强担当助力烟台高质量发展
articles.title_en: Jiang Cheng Stresses Fostering Fine Traditions and Fulfilling Duties at CPPCC Yantai Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日上午，烟台市政协召开十四届常委会第二十三次会议，市委书记江成出席并讲话，强调发扬优良传统、扎实履职尽责，助力烟台高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 7, the 23rd meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of Yantai CPPCC was held. Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Cheng attended and spoke, urging efforts to serve high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先到阳东区调研
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Visits Yangdong District for Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，阳江市委书记卢一先到阳东区调研，强调生态优先、绿色发展，推进环保督察整改和文旅融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Lu Yixian, Secretary of the CPC Yangjiang Municipal Committee, visited Yangdong District, emphasizing ecological priority, green development, and the integration of culture and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 余金富到江城区、阳江海陵湾新区（阳江高新区）调研企业生产经营情况
articles.title_en: Yu Jinfu Inspects Enterprise Production and Operations in Jiangcheng and Yangjiang High-tech Zone
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，阳江市委副书记、市长余金富率队到江城区、阳江海陵湾新区（阳江高新区）调研企业生产经营情况，强调实体经济为本、制造业当家。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Yu Jinfu, deputy secretary and mayor of Yangjiang, led a team to inspect enterprise production and operations in Jiangcheng District and the Yangjiang High-tech Zone, emphasizing the real economy and manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 全市经济高质量发展工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Yuxi City Holds Economic High-Quality Development Work Conference
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，玉溪市召开经济高质量发展工作会议，部署下半年工作，确保“十五五”开好局起好步。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Yuxi City held a work conference on high-quality economic development to arrange tasks for the second half of the year and ensure a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 余红胜在岳阳调研
articles.title_en: Vice Governor Yu Hongsheng Conducts Research in Yueyang
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，副省长余红胜赴岳阳调研集体林权制度改革、洞庭湖生态保护修复情况，并开展巡河工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Vice Governor Yu Hongsheng visited Yueyang to investigate collective forest tenure reform, ecological protection of Dongting Lake, and inspect river management.

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江与长三角等地企业家座谈
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Holds Talks with Entrepreneurs from Yangtze River Delta and Other Regions
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，湖南省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江与长三角等地企业家座谈，共商合作，表示将持续优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, Xie Weijiang, deputy secretary of Hunan Provincial Committee, held talks with entrepreneurs from the Yangtze River Delta and other areas in Yueyang, pledging to optimize the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 中国物流集团董事长刘敬桢到云浮考察调研
articles.title_en: Liu Jingzhen, Chairman of China Logistics Group, Visits Yunfu for Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，中国物流集团董事长刘敬桢率队到云浮考察调研，市委书记卢荣春陪同，双方就深化央地合作、物流设施建设等交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Liu Jingzhen, Chairman of China Logistics Group, led a team to Yunfu for inspection, accompanied by city Party secretary Lu Rongchun, discussing deepening central-local cooperation and logistics infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 市委全面依法治市工作会议召开 全力建设更高水平法治云浮 卢荣春出席会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Yunfu Holds City-Wide Meeting on Law-Based Governance; Lu Rongchun Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，云浮市委全面依法治市工作会议召开，市委书记卢荣春出席并讲话，部署当前和今后一个时期全面依法治市工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Yunfu held a municipal meeting on comprehensive law-based governance; Party Secretary Lu Rongchun attended and delivered a speech, deploying work for the current and future periods.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议全力推动经济持续向新向优向好 以科技创新驱动湛江高质量发展
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Enlarged Standing Committee Meeting to Promote Sustained Economic Improvement and High-Quality Development in Zhanjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，湛江市委书记余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署经济、防汛、基础教育、科技创新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Yu Gang, Secretary of the Zhanjiang Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions, and to deploy work on the economy, flood control, basic education, and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Chairs Enlarged Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，市委书记余钢主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，研究经济、防汛、教育、科技等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, Municipal Party Secretary Yu Gang chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee of the Municipal Party Committee, conveying and studying General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and guiding principles, and arranging for economic, flood control, education, and technology work.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会召开2026年上半年经济运行监督座谈会
articles.title_en: Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Symposium on H1 2026 Economic Operation
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日上午，珠海市人大常委会召开2026年上半年经济运行监督座谈会，强调以人大高质量履职助推经济向好向优。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 6, the Zhuhai Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a symposium on supervising the economic operation in the first half of 2026, emphasizing high-quality performance of the people's congress.

articles.title_zh: 陈勇主持召开市委常委会会议和省委横琴工委会议 研究部署多项重点工作
articles.title_en: Chen Yong Chairs Municipal Party Committee Meeting and Hengqin Working Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，珠海市委书记陈勇主持召开市委常委会会议和省委横琴工委会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署正确政绩观学习教育、人工智能、城市更新等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Chen Yong, Secretary of the Zhuhai Municipal Party Committee, chaired meetings to convey Xi Jinping's important speeches and arrange work on political achievements, AI, and urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 1：500万，我国科研团队编制完成最新版《月球地质图》
articles.title_en: Chinese Research Team Completes 1:5,000,000 Lunar Geological Map
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中国地质科学院地质研究所牵头联合多所高校完成1:500万《月球地质图》编制，首次以中国数据锚定月球地质年代表。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Institute of Geology, CAGS, led a team to complete a 1:5,000,000 lunar geological map, anchoring a new lunar stratigraphic time scale with Chinese data.

articles.title_zh: 规范千万级大型个人信息处理者，国家网信办拟出新规
articles.title_en: National Cyberspace Administration Proposes New Rules to Regulate Large Personal Information Processors
articles.summary_zh: 国家网信办8月7日发布通知，将前期两份征求意见稿整合完善为《大型个人信息处理者个人信息保护规定（征求意见稿）》，向社会公开征求意见。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Cyberspace Administration of China issued a notice to integrate two prior draft rules into the Draft Provisions on Personal Information Protection by Large Processors, soliciting public feedback.

articles.title_zh: 没接稳“圆明园展”大客流，浙江省博物馆致歉
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Museum Apologizes for Overwhelmed Crowd at Old Summer Palace Exhibition
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月6日，浙江省博物馆就之江馆区“再现圆明园”特展因客流集中导致观众入场受阻一事公开道歉，并公布分时预约等整改措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, 2026, the Zhejiang Provincial Museum apologized for entry delays at its 'Old Summer Palace' exhibition due to heavy crowds, and announced time-slot reservation and other improvements.

articles.title_zh: 超30万亿元！今年前7月我国货物贸易进出口同比增长17.3%
articles.title_en: China's Goods Trade Imports and Exports Up 17.3% to Over 30 Trillion Yuan in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署8月7日发布数据，今年前7个月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%。
articles.summary_en: The General Administration of Customs released data on Aug 7 showing China's goods trade imports and exports reached 30.13 trillion yuan in the first seven months of 2026, up 17.3% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，大力支持国防和军队现代化建设，罗文主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting to thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and vigorously support the modernization of national defense and the military. Luo Wen chaired and addressed the meeting.
keywords: 国防和军队现代化建设

articles.title_zh: 追光的你｜太行山上新愚公
articles.title_en: Chasing Light: The New Yugong of Taihang Mountain
articles.summary_zh: 本文追忆河北农业大学教授李保国，他扎根太行山30余年，致力于山区生态建设和科技富民，被习近平总书记誉为“太行山上的新愚公”。
articles.summary_en: This article recalls Li Baoguo, a professor at Hebei Agricultural University, who spent over 30 years in the Taihang Mountains on ecological development and poverty alleviation through technology. He was praised by President Xi Jinping as the 'new Yugong of Taihang Mountain'.

tags.name_en: Poverty Alleviation through Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 河南省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Chairs Henan Provincial Party Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，河南省委书记刘宁主持召开省委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，研究部署健康河南建设、集中整治群众身边不正之风和腐败问题等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a meeting of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee. The meeting conveyed and studied General Secretary Xi Jinping's important article 'Accelerating the Building of a Healthy China' and made arrangements for promoting health in Henan and intensifying the rectification of corruption and misconduct around the people.

articles.title_zh: 最新外贸数据公布 四个关键词解读中国经济韧性
articles.title_en: Latest Foreign Trade Data Released: Four Keywords Decode China's Economic Resilience
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署发布前7个月外贸数据，进出口总值30.13万亿元创同期新高，增速逐月提升，高端制造出口亮眼，中西部外贸异军突起。
articles.summary_en: The General Administration of Customs released foreign trade data for the first seven months, with total imports and exports reaching 30.13 trillion yuan, a record high, showing steady growth and strong performance in high-end manufacturing and central-western regions.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开8月份重大项目协调例会
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Government Holds Monthly Major Project Coordination Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，市长吴贤德主持召开市政府8月份重大项目协调例会，听取福银高速马尾亭江至晋安新店段建设等项目汇报，研究协调项目建设有关问题。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Mayor Wu Xiande chaired the August major project coordination meeting, hearing reports on projects including the Fuyin Expressway section and addressing construction issues.

articles.title_zh: 郭宁宁与来榕参加第十四届海峡青年荟的两岸嘉宾座谈
articles.title_en: Guo Ningning Holds Talks with Cross-Strait Guests at 14th Straits Youth Gathering
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁与来榕参加第十四届海峡青年荟的台湾嘉宾及两岸青年代表座谈，欢迎台胞台青来榕发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Committee and Secretary of the Fuzhou Municipal Committee, held talks with Taiwan guests and cross-strait youth representatives attending the 14th Straits Youth Gathering in Fuzhou, welcoming them to develop in Fuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 第四届“好年华 聚福州”闽台青年人才研习营在福州启动
articles.title_en: 4th Cross-Strait Youth Talent Study Camp Kicks Off in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，第四届“好年华 聚福州”闽台青年人才研习营在福州启动，近50名两岸青年将进行为期5天的研学交流。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 4th Cross-Strait Youth Talent Study Camp kicked off in Fuzhou, bringing together nearly 50 young people from both sides for a 5-day exchange.

articles.title_zh: 第十四届海峡青年连心汇在榕举办 周祖翼出席并致辞
articles.title_en: 14th Straits Youth Gathering Held in Fuzhou; Zhou Zuyi Attends and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，第十四届海峡青年连心汇在福州举办，福建省委书记周祖翼出席并致辞，强调深化闽台青年交流融合。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the 14th Straits Youth Gathering was held in Fuzhou, where Fujian Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi attended and spoke, emphasizing deeper youth exchanges and integration across the Strait.

articles.title_zh: 福建：筑强基层堡垒 凝聚争先力量
articles.title_en: Fujian Strengthens Grassroots Party Organizations to Rally Pioneering Strength
articles.summary_zh: 福建省委深化实施新时代“堡垒工程”，推进基层党建高质量发展，以高质量党建引领保障高质量发展，凝聚争先力量。
articles.summary_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee deepens the implementation of the new-era 'Fortress Project' to promote high-quality grassroots Party building, ensuring high-quality development through strong Party leadership.

articles.title_zh: 刘强看望慰问高温一线工作人员
articles.title_en: Liu Qiang Visits and Comforts Frontline Workers in High Temperature
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，济南市委书记刘强调研电力保供及防暑设施运行情况，看望慰问高温一线工作人员，要求落实防暑降温措施。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Liu Qiang, Secretary of Jinan Municipal Party Committee, inspected power supply and cooling facilities, and visited frontline workers, urging effective heat prevention measures.

articles.title_zh: 履职项目化 托起万家“老幼安暖”——全国人大代表卓长立的“项目赋能年”履职印记
articles.title_en: Project-Based Performance: NPC Deputy Zhuo Changli's Imprint in 'Year of Project Empowerment'
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，全国人大代表卓长立以“项目赋能年”为契机，在济南推动AI家政实训、养老托育调研及家政从业者保障等项目，将履职落到实处。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, NPC Deputy Zhuo Changli leveraged Jinan's 'Year of Project Empowerment' to advance AI-integrated home services, elderly and childcare research, and caregiver protection programs.

articles.title_zh: 全市区县、镇领导班子换届工作会议召开
articles.title_en: Leadership Succession Work Conference Held in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，济南市召开区县、镇领导班子换届工作会议，市委书记刘强出席并讲话，市长于海田主持。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Jinan held a leadership succession work conference for district, county and town governments; Party Secretary Liu Qiang spoke and Mayor Yu Haitian chaired.

articles.title_zh: 曾赞荣调研国际航运中心建设推进情况
articles.title_en: Zeng Zanrong Inspects Progress on International Shipping Center Construction
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日上午，青岛市委书记曾赞荣调研国际航运中心建设，强调加快培育现代航运服务业，市政协主席孟庆斌参加。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 7, Qingdao Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong inspected the construction of the international shipping center, emphasizing the need to accelerate the cultivation of modern shipping services. CPPCC Chairman Meng Qingbin accompanied.

articles.title_zh: 外交部发言人回应日本主流民意反核立场
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Responds to Japan's Anti-Nuclear Stance
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，外交部发言人林剑在记者会上就日本主流民意反核立场表示，日方应倾听民众呼声，停止在核问题上玩火，不要重蹈历史覆辙。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Lin Jian said at a press briefing that Japan should listen to its people and stop playing with fire on nuclear issues, warning against repeating past mistakes.

articles.title_zh: 海关总署：前7个月我国货物贸易进出口增长17.3%
articles.title_en: Customs Administration: China's Goods Trade Imports and Exports Grow 17.3% in First Seven Months
articles.summary_zh: 据海关发布，2026年前7个月我国货物贸易进出口总值30.13万亿元，同比增长17.3%；7月单月增长19.2%。
articles.summary_en: According to customs data, China's goods trade imports and exports totaled 30.13 trillion yuan in the first seven months of 2026, up 17.3% year-on-year; July alone grew 19.2%.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：作为千年古都，要把传统和现代有机融合在一起
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Beijing as Ancient Capital Should Integrate Tradition with Modernity
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调保护城市历史文化遗产，指出北京作为千年古都要把传统和现代有机融合，并肯定隆福寺街区“绣花织补”式更新改造。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping stresses preserving urban cultural heritage, citing Beijing's Longfu Temple renewal as an example of integrating tradition and modernity through meticulous renovation.

articles.title_zh: 东方之约 相约未来
articles.title_en: The Eastern Promise: Meeting the Future
articles.summary_zh: 新华社5日发文回顾新时代中国主场外交成就，展望2026年APEC深圳会议，强调中国与各方共创亚太美好明天。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, Xinhua published a review of China's major-power diplomacy, looking ahead to the 2026 APEC summit in Shenzhen and emphasizing joint efforts for a better Asia-Pacific future.

articles.title_zh: 热度高涨 纪念长征胜利90周年影像征集启动一周 已收作品800余件
articles.title_en: Commemoration of 90th Anniversary of Long March: Photo & Video Collection Receives Over 800 Works in First Week
articles.summary_zh: 纪念长征胜利90周年影像征集活动于7月31日在四川启动，一周内收到800余件作品，作品聚焦红色地标与老区新貌。
articles.summary_en: The photo and video collection event commemorating the 90th anniversary of the Long March kicked off in Sichuan on July 31, receiving over 800 works within a week, focusing on red landmarks and new look of old revolutionary areas.

articles.title_zh: 《中国金融租赁公司气候物理风险管理工具》正式发布
articles.title_en: China Financial Leasing Climate Physical Risk Management Tool Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月5日，在世界银行集团IFC支持下，湖州绿色金融与可持续发展研究院与江苏金租联合发布《中国金融租赁公司气候物理风险管理工具》。
articles.summary_en: On August 5, with support from IFC, Huzhou Green Finance Research Institute and Jiangsu Financial Leasing jointly released the Climate Physical Risk Management Tool for Chinese financial leasing companies.

articles.title_zh: 陕西全链条推动苹果产业转型升级
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Promotes Apple Industry Transformation with New Varieties
articles.summary_zh: 陕西近年来依托科研力量培育推广国育苹果新品种，推动苹果从“种得好”迈向“卖得好”，2025年全产业链产值超1470亿元。
articles.summary_en: Shaanxi has promoted apple industry upgrading by cultivating and promoting new domestically-bred varieties, moving from good cultivation to good sales, with total industry chain output over 147 billion yuan in 2025.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”开局之年传统产业转型焕新一线观察
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan Kickoff Year: Frontline Observations on Traditional Industry Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道组赴十多个省份调研传统产业转型升级，展示高附加值产品、智能装备、绿色工厂等新气象，强调以科技创新推动传统产业焕新。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reporters visited over ten provinces to observe traditional industry upgrading, highlighting high-value products, smart equipment, green factories, and innovation-driven revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省委理论学习中心组召开会议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee Holds Theoretical Study Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，江苏省委理论学习中心组召开学习会，深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于基层工作方法的重要论述，省委书记信长星主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 7, the Theoretical Learning Center Group of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a study session on General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on grassroots work methods. Secretary Xin Changxing presided over and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 多地志愿者协会更名为社会工作和志愿服务联合会
articles.title_en: Volunteer Associations in Multiple Regions Renamed as Social Work and Volunteer Service Federations
articles.summary_zh: 截至2026年8月，江西彭泽、新疆奎屯、安徽界首、广东韶关等多地志愿者协会、义工协会相继更名为社会工作和志愿服务联合会，业务主管单位调整为各地党委社会工作部，以推动社会工作与志愿服务融合发展。
articles.summary_en: As of August 2026, volunteer associations in Pengze, Kuitun, Jieshou, Shaoguan and other regions have been renamed as Social Work and Volunteer Service Federations, with supervisory units adjusted to local Party committees' social work departments to promote integrated development.

articles.title_zh: 新余文广旅局监制的文旅惠民卡权益缩水，官方：项目合作属市场行为
articles.title_en: Benefits of Xinyu Cultural Tourism Card Reduced; Official Cites Market Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 8月7日，新余市文广旅局回应文旅惠民卡权益缩水，称项目合作属市场行为，权益动态调整。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 7, Xinyu's cultural and tourism bureau responded to the reduced benefits of its tourism card, stating that project cooperation is market-driven with dynamic adjustments.

tags_en: Xinyu Municipal Bureau of Culture, Radio, TV and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 河南公安机关查实“三支一扶”招募笔试存在组织作弊犯罪行为
articles.title_en: Henan Police Confirm Organized Cheating in 'Three Supports and One Assistance' Recruitment Exam
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日接报案后，河南公安机关查实7月11日“三支一扶”招募笔试存在规模性组织作弊，已抓获团伙主要成员，案件进一步侦办中。
articles.summary_en: After receiving a report on August 2, Henan police confirmed organized cheating in the 'Three Supports and One Assistance' recruitment exam held on July 11, arrested key suspects, and continue investigation.

articles.title_zh: “重庆造”功率半导体项目优化工艺提产能
articles.title_en: Chongqing-Made Power Semiconductor Project Optimizes Process and Boosts Capacity
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，重庆涪陵区新陵微电子6英寸IGBT晶圆产线进行生产调试，该项目5月投产，现处于产能爬坡阶段，第一阶段目标月产6万片，将为汽车、新能源等领域提供功率半导体支持。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, technicians debugged the 6-inch IGBT wafer production line at Xinling Microelectronics in Fuling District, Chongqing. The project, which started production in May, is now ramping up to a first-phase capacity of 60,000 wafers per month, supporting fields such as automotive and new energy.

articles.title_zh: 第十四届海峡青年连心汇在榕举办
articles.title_en: 14th Cross-Strait Youth Heart-to-Heart Exchange Held in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，第十四届海峡青年连心汇在福州举办，福建省委书记周祖翼出席并致辞，强调深化两岸青年交流，推进融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, the 14th Cross-Strait Youth Heart-to-Heart Exchange was held in Fuzhou. Fujian Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing deepening cross-strait youth exchanges and integrated development.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省启动2026年度工伤保险费率调整业务
articles.title_en: Gansu Launches 2026 Work Injury Insurance Rate Adjustment
articles.summary_zh: 近日，甘肃省人社厅与国家税务总局甘肃省税务局联合通告，部署2026年度工伤保险费率调整业务，明确办理范围和流程，参保单位9月底前补缴可免滞纳金。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's human resources department and tax bureau jointly issued a notice to carry out the 2026 work injury insurance rate adjustment, clarifying procedures and deadlines, with late fee exemption for contributions made before end of September.

articles.title_zh: “村居融合”打通服务群众“最后一公里”
articles.title_en: 'Village-Community Integration' Opens the Last Mile of Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃景泰县一条山镇推行“村居融合”治理模式，通过“三联六步”工作法，解决城乡接合部管理难题，近期高效处理居民小区设施失修问题。
articles.summary_en: Yitiaoshan Town in Jingtai County, Gansu, promotes a 'village-community integration' governance model with the 'Three Links, Six Steps' method, resolving urban-rural fringe management issues and promptly fixing residential facility problems.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省宣传思想文化重点工作推进会在兰召开
articles.title_en: Gansu Holds Promotion Meeting on Key Cultural and Ideological Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日，甘肃省宣传思想文化重点工作推进会在兰州召开，省委常委、宣传部部长张永霞出席并讲话，强调推动宣传思想文化工作提质增效。
articles.summary_en: On August 6, Gansu Province held a promotion meeting on key cultural and ideological work in Lanzhou, where Zhang Yongxia, member of the Provincial Party Standing Committee and head of the Propaganda Department, attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃巨化项目（一期）三条电源全部投运
articles.title_en: Three Power Sources for Gansu Juhua Project (Phase I) Fully Operational
articles.summary_zh: 8月6日下午，甘肃巨化新材料有限公司高性能硅氟新材料一体化项目（一期）330千伏巨琮变及琮花Ⅰ线成功投运，至此该项目供电工程多电源全部投运。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 6, the 330kV Jucong Substation and line of Gansu Juhua's new materials project (Phase I) were commissioned, completing all power sources.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省跨境贸易高水平开放试点启动
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Launches High-Level Opening-Up Pilot for Cross-Border Trade
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，甘肃省跨境贸易高水平开放试点落地实施，在兰州、白银、金昌三市同步开展，已为15家企业办理28笔业务，总金额2752万美元。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Gansu Province launched a high-level opening-up pilot for cross-border trade, implemented in Lanzhou, Baiyin, and Jinchang, handling 28 transactions for 15 enterprises totaling $27.52 million.

articles.title_zh: 无人机有了“空中加油站”
articles.title_en: Drones Get 'Aerial Charging Stations'
articles.summary_zh: 哈尔滨工业大学郑州高等研究院研发无人机无线充电系统，可实现无人机自动降落充电，已在郑州龙子湖试点，正与中国铁塔推进产业化。
articles.summary_en: The Harbin Institute of Technology Zhengzhou Advanced Research Institute has developed a wireless charging system that allows drones to land and recharge automatically. Piloted in Zhengzhou's Longzihu area, it is being commercialized with China Tower.
