articles.title_zh: 中国共产党西藏自治区第十届委员会第十次全体会议在拉萨举行
articles.title_en: CPC Tibet Regional Committee Holds 10th Plenary Session in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，中国共产党西藏自治区第十届委员会第十次全体会议在拉萨举行。自治区党委书记王君正讲话，会议审议通过关于召开自治区第十一次党代会的决议。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 10th Plenary Session of the 10th CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee was held in Lhasa. Regional Party Secretary Wang Junzheng spoke at the meeting, which approved a resolution on convening the 11th Regional Party Congress.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组第二十二组向云南省反馈明查暗访情况
articles.title_en: The 22nd Central Work Safety Inspection Team Provides Feedback to Yunnan Province
articles.summary_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组第二十二组8月3日向云南省反馈明查暗访情况，组长王启铭通报问题，省委书记王宁作表态发言，强调全面整改。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 22nd Central Work Safety Inspection Team reported findings to Yunnan Province, pointing out problems and urging rectification. Party Secretary Wang Ning pledged full acceptance and thorough improvement.

articles.title_zh: 《新型电力系统建设“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: China Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for New Power System Construction
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局近日印发《新型电力系统建设“十五五”规划》，明确到2030年非化石能源发电量占比达50%，初步建成新型电力系统。
articles.summary_en: China's National Development and Reform Commission and National Energy Administration issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for new power system construction, aiming for non-fossil energy to account for 50% of power generation by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀企业家联盟机器人产业链联盟成立大会举行
articles.title_en: Founding Conference of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Robot Industry Chain Alliance Held
articles.summary_zh: 日前，京津冀企业家联盟机器人产业链联盟成立大会在京举行，市委常委、统战部部长马骏讲话，市政协副主席、市工商联主席燕瑛致辞。
articles.summary_en: Founding conference of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Robot Industry Chain Alliance held in Beijing. Ma Jun and Yan Ying delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 教育部：义务教育阶段每名学生每学期至少完成1项科学探究任务
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education Requires Compulsory Education Students to Complete at Least One Scientific Inquiry Task per Semester
articles.summary_zh: 今天（4日），教育部发布《义务教育阶段科学教育“做中学”领航行动指南》，要求4—9年级学生每学期至少完成1项科学探究任务。
articles.summary_en: On August 4, China's Ministry of Education issued guidelines for science education, requiring students in grades 4-9 to complete at least one scientific inquiry task per semester.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚主持召开自治区党委书记专题会议 研究调度平陆运河建成通航和向海经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs Special Meeting on Pinglu Canal Navigation and Maritime Economy
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开书记专题会议，研究平陆运河通航和向海经济发展，自治区主席韦韬出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Party Committee of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, chaired a special meeting on the navigation of the Pinglu Canal and the development of the maritime economy. Wei Tao, Chairman of the autonomous region, attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明会见刚果（布）副总理布亚一行

articles.summary_en: On August 3, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming met with Congo-Brazzaville Vice Prime Minister Jean-Jacques Bouya in Changsha, exchanging views on implementing cooperation consensus and advancing infrastructure projects.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛在南通调研时强调 激发企业活力增强产业动能 推动经济向新向优向好发展

articles.summary_zh: 7月29日至30日，江苏省省长刘小涛在南通市调研，强调激发企业活力、增强产业动能，深化人工智能创新应用，推动经济向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: From July 29 to 30, Jiangsu Governor Liu Xiaotao visited Nantong, stressing the need to boost enterprise vitality, strengthen industrial momentum, and expand AI applications to promote high-quality economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 中共江苏省委十四届十二次全会举行 省委常委会主持会议 信长星讲话

articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，中共江苏省委十四届十二次全会在南京举行，审议通过关于召开省第十五次党代会的决议，决定党代会于2026年第四季度在南京召开。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, the 12th Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Jiangsu Provincial Committee was held in Nanjing, approving a resolution to convene the province's 15th Party Congress in Q4 2026 in Nanjing.

articles.title_en: Communique of the 11th Plenary Session of the 13th Liaoning Provincial Committee of CPC
articles.summary_zh: 中共辽宁省委十三届十一次全会7月31日在沈阳举行，审议通过召开省第十四次党代会的决议，并追认给予王心宇留党察看二年处分。
articles.summary_en: The 11th Plenary Session of the 13th CPC Liaoning Provincial Committee was held in Shenyang on July 31, approving a resolution to convene the 14th Provincial Party Congress and confirming a two-year probationary party membership penalty for Wang Xinyu.

articles.title_zh: 王新伟走访慰问驻辽部队官兵
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节到来之际，辽宁省委副书记、省长王新伟走访慰问驻辽部队官兵，参观空军某旅和海军某支队，致以节日问候并勉励官兵提升战斗力。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the Army Day, Wang Xinwei, deputy secretary of the Liaoning Provincial Party Committee and governor, visited and greeted troops stationed in Liaoning, extending festival greetings and encouraging them to boost combat readiness.

articles.title_zh: 蔡奇看望慰问北戴河暑期休假专家
articles.title_en: Cai Qi Visits and Greets Experts on Summer Vacation in Beidaihe
articles.summary_zh: 受习近平总书记委托，蔡奇8月3日在北戴河看望暑期休假专家，代表党中央、国务院向广大专家人才致以诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: Entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, Cai Qi visited experts on summer vacation in Beidaihe on August 3, extending sincere greetings on behalf of the CPC Central Committee and the State Council.

articles.title_zh: 东风浩荡开新局——习近平经济思想指引中国经济高质量发展行稳致远
articles.title_en: New Chapter Unfolds with East Wind — Xi Jinping Thought on Economy Guides China's High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月3日发布综述，阐述习近平经济思想指引中国经济上半年顶压前行、向新向优，强调发展新质生产力与民生保障。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua published a review on Aug 3, expounding how Xi Jinping Thought on Economy guided China's economy to withstand pressure and improve quality in H1, with emphasis on new quality productive forces and people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记引领“十五五”开局之年中国经济破浪前行
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Steers China's Economy in Opening Year of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 上半年中国经济稳中向好，GDP同比增长4.7%。习近平总书记强调发展新质生产力，推动高质量发展，中共中央政治局会议肯定经济向新向优态势。
articles.summary_en: China's H1 GDP grew 4.7% with steady improvement. Xi Jinping emphasized new quality productive forces and high-quality development. The CPC Central Committee Politburo meeting affirmed the positive trend.

articles.title_zh: 国务院公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues Revised Regulations on Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》，自2026年10月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to promulgate the revised Regulations on the Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs, effective from October 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 西部多地持续强降雨 各地积极应对
articles.title_en: Heavy Rain Continues in Western China, Localities Respond Actively
articles.summary_zh: 连日来陕西、四川、重庆等地出现强降雨，多地提前转移群众并调拨救灾物资。国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室和应急管理部派出工作组赴陕西指导救灾。
articles.summary_en: Continuous heavy rain hit western China; local governments evacuated residents and dispatched relief supplies. A national work group was sent to Shaanxi to assist disaster relief.

tags.name_zh: 国家粮食和物资储备局
tags.name_en: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration

tags_zh: 国家粮食和物资储备局
tags_en: National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration

articles.title_zh: 《综合运输服务发展“十五五”规划》印发
articles.title_en: Comprehensive Transport Service Development Plan for the 15th Five-Year Period Issued
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部等四部门近日印发《综合运输服务发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年基本建成现代化综合运输服务体系。
articles.summary_en: Four departments including the Ministry of Transport issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for comprehensive transport services, aiming to build a modern system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 上半年全国生态环境质量持续改善
articles.title_en: National Ecological Environment Quality Continues to Improve in First Half of Year
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，全国生态环境质量持续改善，PM2.5平均浓度同比下降6.6%，地表水优良水质比例同比上升。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of this year, national ecological environment quality continued to improve, with PM2.5 concentration down 6.6% and surface water good quality ratio up.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order Promulgating Revised Regulations on Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布修订后的《集成电路布图设计保护条例》，自2026年10月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang has signed a State Council order to promulgate the revised Regulations on the Protection of Integrated Circuit Layout Designs, effective from October 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 《新型电力系统建设“十五五”规划》发布
articles.title_en: Fifteenth Five-Year Plan for New Power System Construction Released
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局日前印发《新型电力系统建设“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年初步建成新型电力系统的战略目标，部署重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the 'Fifteenth Five-Year Plan for New Power System Construction', setting the strategic goal of initially building a new power system by 2030 and deploying key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 蒋冰到驻丹某部和丹东军分区走访慰问
articles.title_en: Jiang Bing Visits Military Unit and Dandong Military Subarea
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，丹东市委书记蒋冰先后到驻丹某部和丹东军分区走访慰问，代表市委、市政府向广大官兵致以节日祝福和诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 1, Jiang Bing, Party Secretary of Dandong, visited a military unit and the Dandong Military Subarea, expressing festival greetings on behalf of the municipal committee and government.

articles.title_zh: 陈福茂走访慰问部队官兵
articles.title_en: Chen Fumao Visits and Greets Military Officers and Soldiers
articles.summary_zh: 近日，丹东市人大常委会主任陈福茂走访慰问某部队官兵，共叙军民鱼水深情，推动军地融合高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Chen Fumao, Director of the Standing Committee of the Dandong Municipal People's Congress, visited and extended regards to military officers and soldiers, emphasizing military-civilian integration and high-quality development.

tags.name_en: Supporting the Military and Their Families

tags_en: Supporting the Military and Their Families

articles.title_zh: 刘希明走访慰问武警丹东支队
articles.title_en: Liu Ximing Visits and Consoles Armed Police Dandong Detachment
articles.summary_zh: 近日，丹东市政协党组书记刘希明走访慰问武警丹东支队，致以节日问候，并强调深化军民融合与双拥工作。
articles.summary_en: Liu Ximing, Party secretary of the Dandong CPPCC, visited the Armed Police Dandong Detachment recently, extending holiday greetings and stressing deeper military-civilian integration.

articles.title_zh: 张丹走访慰问驻丹部队
articles.title_en: Zhang Dan Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Dandong
articles.summary_zh: 近日，丹东市委副书记、市长张丹走访慰问驻丹部队，向官兵致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候。
articles.summary_en: Zhang Dan, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Dandong Municipal Committee and Mayor, recently visited troops stationed in Dandong, extending holiday greetings and sincere regards to officers and soldiers.

tags.name_en: Mutual Support between Civilian and Military

tags_en: Mutual Support between Civilian and Military

articles.title_zh: 汪尚学主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Wang Shangxue Chairs Standing Committee Meeting of Municipal Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日上午，定西市委常委会召开会议，市委书记汪尚学主持，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，安排部署贯彻落实工作，并听取防汛救灾汇报。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 2, the Standing Committee of the Dingxi Municipal Party Committee met, chaired by Secretary Wang Shangxue, to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, arrange implementation work, and hear reports on flood prevention and disaster relief.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: General Secretary Xi's Affection for the People
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，习近平总书记主持中共中央政治局会议，强调巩固拓展正确政绩观学习教育成果。文章阐述以正确政绩观引领高质量发展，最终是为了造福人民。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, General Secretary Xi Jinping chaired a meeting of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau, stressing consolidation of the learning and education on the correct view of political achievements. The article elaborates on guiding high-quality development with a correct view of achievements, emphasizing that the ultimate goal is to benefit the people.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Affection for the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章强调以正确政绩观引领高质量发展，习近平总书记指出高质量发展是领导干部政绩观的重要内容，并强调为民造福是最大政绩。
articles.summary_en: The article emphasizes guiding high-quality development with a correct view of political achievements. Xi Jinping stresses that high-quality development should be a key part of officials' achievement view and that benefiting the people is the greatest achievement.

articles.title_zh: 邓维元主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Deng Weiyuan Chairs Hegang Municipal Government Party Group (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 8月3日，鹤岗市市长邓维元主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和重要指示精神，并部署人工智能、产业转型、民生保障等工作。
articles.summary_en: On August 3, Deng Weiyuan, mayor of Hegang, chaired an expanded municipal government party group meeting to convey Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and directives, and to deploy work on AI, industrial transformation, and people's livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 涟水县举行高端电子基材项目开工和签约仪式
articles.title_en: Lianshui County Holds Groundbreaking and Signing Ceremony for High-End Electronic Base Material Projects
articles.summary_zh: 8月2日，涟水县举行高端电子基材项目开工和签约仪式，市领导史志军等出席，该项目聚焦高端电子纱、电子薄布、高速覆铜板等核心赛道。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, Lianshui County held a groundbreaking and signing ceremony for high-end electronic base material projects, attended by city leaders including Shi Zhijun, focusing on advanced electronic yarn, thin cloth, and high-speed CCL sectors.

articles.title_zh: “沿着总书记足迹学思想”沉浸式宣讲走进寿县
articles.title_en: Immersive Lecture on Learning Xi Thought Along General Secretary's Footsteps Enters Shouxian
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日下午，淮南市“沿着总书记足迹学思想”沉浸式宣讲在寿县文化艺术中心举行，由市委宣传部、市委讲师团主办，推动党的创新理论入脑入心。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 31, an immersive lecture on 'Learning Xi Thought Along the General Secretary's Footsteps' was held at Shouxian Cultural and Art Center. Organized by the Municipal Propaganda Department, it aims to make the Party's innovative theory more accessible.

articles.title_zh: 李亦博慰问驻焦部队官兵
articles.title_en: Li Yibo Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Jiaozuo
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，焦作市委书记李亦博走访慰问驻焦部队官兵，致以节日祝贺，强调军地合力、同心发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Li Yibo, Secretary of the Jiaozuo Municipal Party Committee, visited and greeted officers and soldiers stationed in Jiaozuo, extending holiday congratulations and emphasizing military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰带队调研纺织服装、五金机电产业
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Leads Research on Textile, Garment, Hardware and Electromechanical Industries
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日至2日，揭阳市市长曲晓杰带队调研企业，强调实施产业"焕新工程"，推动传统产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From August 1 to 2, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, led a research visit to enterprises, emphasizing the implementation of the industry "renewal project" to promote high-quality development of traditional industries.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议分析全市上半年经济形势 研究部署下半年经济工作
articles.title_en: Dawa Ciren Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习中央和自治区党委会议精神，分析上半年经济形势，部署下半年经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Dawa Ciren, Secretary of Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged Standing Committee meeting to convey central and regional guidelines, analyze H1 economic performance, and arrange H2 work.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁“八一”前夕看望慰问驻市部队官兵
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Visits and Consoles Troops in Lhasa Before Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日上午，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁看望慰问驻市部队官兵，代表市四大班子致以节日祝贺，感谢他们为拉萨稳定发展作出的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 31, Dawa Tsering, member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, visited and greeted military officers and soldiers stationed in Lhasa, expressing gratitude for their contributions to the city's stability and development.

articles.title_zh: 拉萨市完成全区首批工会驿站嵌入便民警务站试点
articles.title_en: Lhasa Completes First Batch of Trade Union Service Stations Embedded in Police Service Stations Pilot
articles.summary_zh: 拉萨市完成全区首批工会驿站嵌入便民警务站试点，为户外劳动者提供便民服务。
articles.summary_en: Lhasa completed the first batch of pilot union service stations embedded in police service stations in the region, providing convenience services for outdoor workers.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记关于上半年经济形势和做好下半年经济工作的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强7月31日主持召开国务院常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取新型电网、物流网建设汇报，研究健康优先发展战略，审议通过多项行政法规草案，并核准四个核电项目。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on July 31 to study Xi Jinping's important speech on the economic situation, hear reports on new power grid and logistics network construction, discuss health-first development strategy, approve regulatory amendments, and approve four nuclear power projects.

articles.title_zh: 林芝市人民政府与2026中国产业转移发展对接活动（西藏）参会代表赴林芝考察调研座谈
articles.title_en: Linzhi Municipal Government Holds Discussion with Delegates of 2026 China Industrial Transfer Matchmaking Event (Tibet)
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，林芝市举办2026中国产业转移发展对接活动（西藏）参会代表考察调研座谈，市委副书记、常务副市长林科聪出席会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Linzhi held a discussion with delegates of the 2026 China Industrial Transfer Matchmaking Event (Tibet). Deputy Mayor Lin Kecong attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 王君正：2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛在拉萨开幕
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Attends Opening of 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛在拉萨布达拉宫广场开幕，西藏自治区党委书记王君正出席并宣布比赛开幕。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 1, the 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race opened at Potala Palace Square in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Regional Committee, attended and declared the race open.

articles.title_zh: 国务院公布《关于出境入境管理的规定》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月29日国务院常务会议通过《关于出境入境管理的规定》，以国务院令第841号公布，自9月15日起施行，建立出境安全风险防范制度并规范中介服务。
articles.summary_en: The State Council approved the Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration on June 29, 2026, published as Order No. 841, effective September 15, establishing exit risk prevention measures and regulating agency services.

articles.title_zh: 全市学习运用“千万工程”经验加快发展乡村特色产业推进乡村全面振兴现场会召开
articles.title_en: Longyan Holds On-site Meeting on Rural Revitalization and Specialty Industries
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，龙岩市在武平县召开现场会，市委书记胡盛出席并讲话，强调加快发展乡村特色产业，推动乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Longyan City held an on-site meeting in Wuping County. Party Secretary Hu Sheng emphasized accelerating rural specialty industries and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 王凯在南阳驻马店检查防汛工作
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Inspects Flood Control Work in Nanyang and Zhumadian
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，河南省省长王凯到南阳市、驻马店市检查防汛工作，实地察看水库施工、水源涵养及应急物资储备，强调压实责任、确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Henan Governor Wang Kai inspected flood control work in Nanyang and Zhumadian, visiting reservoir construction, water source conservation, and emergency material storage, urging responsibility and safety.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议研究部署下半年经济工作
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Chairs Meeting of Party Committee Standing Committee to Study and Deploy H2 Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议，分析上半年经济形势，部署下半年经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to analyze the first-half economic situation and arrange second-half work.

articles.title_zh: 王君正“八一”前夕看望慰问驻藏部队官兵
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Tibet on Eve of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，西藏自治区党委书记王君正看望慰问驻藏部队官兵，代表自治区党委和政府向他们致以节日祝贺，感谢其为西藏长治久安和高质量发展所作贡献，并勉励官兵练就过硬本领。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Wang Junzheng, Party chief of Tibet, visited stationed troops and extended festival greetings to servicemen and veterans on behalf of the regional Party committee and government.

tags.name_en: Unity Between Army and Government and People

tags_en: Unity Between Army and Government and People

articles.title_zh: 王君正出席2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛开幕式并宣布开幕
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Attends and Declares Opening of 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race in Lhasa
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，2026中国西藏第七届跨喜马拉雅国际公路自行车极限赛在拉萨布达拉宫广场开幕，自治区党委书记王君正出席并宣布开幕。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1 morning, the 7th Trans-Himalaya International Road Cycling Race opened at Potala Palace Square in Lhasa; Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Region Committee, attended and declared the race open.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞张雨浦陈雍走访慰问驻宁解放军和武警部队官兵
articles.title_en: Li Yifei, Zhang Yupu, Chen Yong Visit PLA and Armed Police Troops in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞、主席张雨浦、政协主席陈雍走访慰问驻宁解放军和武警部队官兵，致以节日祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Ningxia Party Secretary Li Yifei, Chairman Zhang Yupu, and CPPCC Chairman Chen Yong visited PLA and Armed Police troops in Ningxia to extend holiday greetings.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Ningxia Regional Government Holds Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，自治区主席张雨浦主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究防汛减灾、退役军人服务保障、人工智能、基础教育等事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Chairman Zhang Yupu of the autonomous region presided over a government executive meeting to discuss flood control, veteran services, AI, and basic education.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the National Development and Reform Commission held a briefing on H1 economic conditions, judging the economy as moving toward innovation and optimization, and emphasizing stronger macro policies and major projects.

articles.title_zh: 湖北宣恩县持续做好治水兴城文章
articles.title_en: Xuan'en County, Hubei Persists in Water Management and Urban Development
articles.summary_zh: 湖北宣恩县持续治水兴城，通过修建水库、治理污水、发展水上夜游，实现贡水河从水患扰民到水城同兴的转变，带动旅游产业蓬勃发展。
articles.summary_en: Xuan'en County in Hubei has persisted in water management, transforming the Gongshui River from a flood hazard to a scenic urban asset through reservoir construction, sewage treatment, and night tours, boosting local tourism revenue.

articles.title_zh: 《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》印发
articles.title_en: Measures for Administration of Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve Issued
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，自然资源部、国家林业和草原局、中国海警局、海南省人民政府联合印发《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》，就管理机制、管护措施、法律责任等作出规定。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, four Chinese agencies jointly issued management measures for the Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve, covering management, protection, and legal liability.

articles.title_zh: 国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部向吉林、黑龙江派出工作组并调拨中央救灾物资
articles.title_en: China Sends Work Groups and Allocates Relief Supplies to Jilin and Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部向吉林、黑龙江派出工作组并调拨1.1万件中央救灾物资；水利部和中国气象局联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, China's disaster relief authorities sent work groups to Jilin and Heilongjiang and allocated 11,000 central relief supplies. A red flash flood warning was issued.

articles.title_zh: 省心省事，早稻收储全托管
articles.title_en: Worry-Free Early Rice Harvesting and Storage with Full Outsourcing
articles.summary_zh: 浙江温州探索建设新型农事服务中心，为种粮大户提供早稻收割、烘干、除杂、储存等全程托管服务，提升收储效率，减少损耗。
articles.summary_en: Wenzhou, Zhejiang is piloting new agricultural service centers offering full outsourcing for early rice harvesting, drying, and storage, improving efficiency and reducing losses.

articles.title_zh: 上海稳步建设全球科创高地
articles.title_en: Shanghai Steadily Builds Global Sci-Tech Innovation Hub
articles.summary_zh: 2026年8月2日，《人民日报》报道，上海深化基础研究先行区建设，加速成果转化，联动长三角协同创新，稳步建设全球科技创新高地。
articles.summary_en: On August 2, 2026, People's Daily reported that Shanghai is deepening its pilot zone for basic research, accelerating technology transfer, and collaborating with the Yangtze River Delta to steadily build a global sci-tech innovation hub.

articles.title_zh: 在党的旗帜下书写强军兴军新荣光
articles.title_en: Writing New Glory of Strengthening the Military Under the Party's Flag
articles.summary_zh: 在建军99周年之际，习近平强调贯彻新时代强军思想，全军推进政治建军、改革强军等；8月1日南部战区在黄岩岛举行海空联合演训。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the 99th anniversary of the PLA, President Xi Jinping stressed implementing the Party's thinking on strengthening the military. On Aug 1, the Southern Theater Command conducted joint air-sea exercises near Huangyan Island.

articles.title_zh: 央行下半年将在提高金融服务实体经济质效等方面发力
articles.title_en: Central Bank to Focus on Improving Financial Services for Real Economy in H2
articles.summary_zh: 中国人民银行8月1日召开下半年工作会议，部署实施适度宽松的货币政策，提高金融服务实体经济质效，防范化解金融风险。
articles.summary_en: The People's Bank of China held its H2 work meeting on Aug 1, vowing to implement a moderately loose monetary policy, improve financial services for the real economy, and prevent financial risks.

articles.title_zh: 我国美丽乡村建设实现良好开局
articles.title_en: China Achieves Good Start in Beautiful Village Construction
articles.summary_zh: 自2025年1月《美丽乡村建设实施方案》发布以来，全国完成2.4万余个行政村环境整治，农村生活污水治理率提升至55%，近970万群众直接受益。
articles.summary_en: Since the Beautiful Village Construction Action Plan took effect in January 2025, over 24,000 villages have been renovated, rural sewage treatment rate reached 55%, benefiting nearly 9.7 million people.

articles.title_zh: 我国轻工业经济运行稳中有进
articles.title_en: China's Light Industry Posts Steady Growth in H1
articles.summary_zh: 中国轻工业联合会数据显示，上半年我国轻工业生产平稳，消费市场扩容，出口较快增长，结构持续优化。
articles.summary_en: According to China National Light Industry Council, H1 saw steady production, expanding consumption and faster export growth in the light industry, with optimized structure.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Calls for Correct View of Political Achievements to Drive High-quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记近期在中共中央政治局会议和集体学习中强调，要树立和践行正确政绩观，以正确政绩观引领高质量发展，并考察山东德州强调为民造福是最大政绩。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping stressed a correct view of political achievements to lead high-quality development at CPC Central Committee meetings and a study session, and urged people-centered governance during a Shandong visit.

tags.name_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 全省安全生产“打非治违”工作部署会议暨省安委会三季度工作会议召开 王新伟出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Xinwei Attends and Speaks at Provincial Work Deployment Meeting on Safety Production
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，辽宁省召开全省安全生产“打非治违”工作部署会议暨省安委会三季度工作会议，省长王新伟出席并讲话，部署重点行业领域打非治违工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Liaoning Province held a work deployment meeting on safety production and the Q3 meeting of the Provincial Safety Committee. Governor Wang Xinwei attended and spoke, deploying crackdowns on illegal activities in key industries.

articles.title_zh: 朔州市委召开议军会议研究部署党管武装工作
articles.title_en: Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Military Affairs Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，朔州市委召开议军会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于国防和军队建设的重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署党管武装工作。市委书记王帅红主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Shuozhou Municipal Party Committee held a military affairs meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech on national defense and military building, and to deploy party-led armed forces work. Wang Shuaihong, municipal party chief, presided and spoke.

tags.name_en: Support for Military and Veteran Affairs

tags_en: Support for Military and Veteran Affairs

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬率团慰问泰州舰官兵
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Leads Delegation to Greet Taizhou Ship Crew
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，在建军节前夕，泰州市委书记姜冬冬率团赴浙江舟山某军港，走访慰问海军泰州舰官兵，代表家乡人民致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Jiang Dongdong, Party Secretary of Taizhou, led a delegation to a naval port in Zhoushan, Zhejiang, to greet officers and soldiers of the naval vessel Taizhou ahead of Army Day.

articles.title_zh: 第五期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”举行
articles.title_en: The Fifth 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for Leading Cadres Held
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，泰州市举行第五期领导干部“前沿大讲堂”，邀请华东理工大学副校长阎海峰作“生物医药产业发展前沿态势”专题授课，市领导李晖、张余松等参加学习。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, Taizhou held the fifth 'Frontier Lecture Hall' for cadres. Yan Haifeng, a university professor, lectured on biomedical industry trends. Leaders Li Hui and Zhang Yusong attended.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬率团慰问泰州舰官兵
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Leads Delegation to Visit Crew of Taizhou Ship
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，市委书记姜冬冬率团赴浙江舟山慰问海军泰州舰官兵，致以节日问候，表示将深化双拥共建。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Municipal Party Secretary Jiang Dongdong led a delegation to Zhoushan, Zhejiang to greet the crew of naval ship Taizhou, expressing holiday greetings and commitment to strengthen military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 蒋锋调研集成电路产业重点企业
articles.title_en: Mayor Jiang Feng Inspects Key Integrated Circuit Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，无锡市长蒋锋调研集成电路重点企业，强调巩固“芯”优势，抢拓新赛道，做优做强地标产业。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Wuxi Mayor Jiang Feng visited key integrated circuit companies, urging consolidation of chip advantages and strengthening the benchmark industry.

articles.title_zh: 苏信合作工作座谈会在苏州召开
articles.title_en: Suzhou-Xinyang Cooperation Symposium Held in Suzhou
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，苏信对口合作座谈会在苏州举行，苏州市市长王维、信阳市市长卢希望出席并讲话，总结工作进展，谋划合作事宜，推动两地对口合作走深走实。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Suzhou-Xinyang counterpart cooperation symposium was held in Suzhou. Mayors Wang Wei and Lu Xiwang attended and spoke, summarizing progress and planning further cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研市区文博场馆
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Inspects Cultural and Museum Venues in Yancheng
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，盐城市委书记严汉平到市区文博场馆调研，强调要深耕文脉资源、提升功能品质，打造文化传承交流展示“会客厅”。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 1, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, visited cultural and museum venues in the city, emphasizing the need to deeply cultivate cultural resources and enhance functional quality to build a 'reception hall' for cultural inheritance, exchange, and display.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜调研促消费工作
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Inspects Consumption Promotion Work
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日上午，盐城市代市长吴炜在市区调研促消费工作，强调放大“苏超”效应，激发消费活力。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of August 1, Wu Wei, acting mayor of Yancheng, inspected consumption promotion work in the urban area, emphasizing leveraging the "Suchao" effect to boost consumption vitality.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春走访慰问驻云部队官兵
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Visits and Greets Troops Stationed in Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，云浮市委书记卢荣春率队到驻云部队走访慰问，向官兵致以节日祝贺，市政协主席梁丽娴参加。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 30, Lu Rongchun, Secretary of the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee, led a team to visit troops stationed in Yunfu and extended festive greetings, with CPPCC Chairman Liang Lixian also attending.

articles.title_zh: 云浮市装配式建筑产业对接交流会在北京举行 卢荣春出席并致辞
articles.title_en: Yunfu Prefabricated Building Industry Exchange Conference Held in Beijing; Lu Rongchun Attends and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日下午，云浮市装配式建筑产业对接交流会在北京举行，市委书记卢荣春出席并致辞，现场签约6个项目。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 28, the Yunfu Prefabricated Building Industry Exchange Conference was held in Beijing, attended by Yunfu Party Secretary Lu Rongchun, with six projects signed on site.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新到郁南县督导检查防汛备汛工作
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Inspects Flood Prevention in Yunan County
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，云浮市市长李庆新到郁南县督导检查防汛备汛工作，强调抓实抓细各项防御措施，确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Yunfu Mayor Li Qingxin visited Yunan County to inspect flood prevention work, urging detailed defensive measures to ensure safety during the flood season.

articles.title_zh: 卢荣春率队赴京开展拜访交流和招商推介活动
articles.title_en: Lu Rongchun Leads Delegation to Beijing for Exchange and Investment Promotion
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月27-28日，云浮市委书记卢荣春率队赴北京，拜访中国中医科学院、RCEP产业合作委员会、中国节能环保集团等单位，围绕开放合作、绿色发展等座谈交流，推进项目对接。
articles.summary_en: On July 27-28, 2026, Lu Rongchun, Party Secretary of Yunfu, led a delegation to Beijing to visit the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences, RCEP Industrial Cooperation Committee, and China Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Group for exchanges on opening-up and green development.

articles.title_zh: 李庆新走访慰问武警云浮支队官兵
articles.title_en: Li Qingxin Visits Officers and Soldiers of Yunfu Armed Police Detachment
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，云浮市委副书记、市长李庆新率队走访慰问武警云浮支队官兵，代表市委、市政府致以节日祝贺，并表示将继续支持部队建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Li Qingxin, Deputy Secretary of the Yunfu Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, visited officers and soldiers of the Yunfu Armed Police Detachment, conveying festival greetings and pledging continued support for military development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想与广东实践·绿美广东生态建设研讨会在云浮举行
articles.title_en: Seminar on Xi Jinping Thought and Green Guangdong Ecological Construction Held in Yunfu
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，由广东省习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想研究中心主办的绿美广东生态建设研讨会在云浮举行，市委书记卢荣春出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Seminar on Green and Beautiful Guangdong Ecological Construction hosted by the Guangdong Research Center for Xi Jinping Thought was held in Yunfu, where Party Secretary Lu Rongchun attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 重庆部署扫黑除恶：重点打击利用网络平台和“软暴力”手段有组织实施的黑恶犯罪
articles.title_en: Chongqing Deploys Crackdown on Organized Crime, Targeting Online Platforms and 'Soft Violence'
articles.summary_zh: 重庆近日召开深化扫黑除恶专项斗争部署会议，明确重点打击利用网络平台和‘软暴力’手段有组织实施的黑恶犯罪，并部署为期一年的专项斗争。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing recently held a meeting to deepen the special campaign against organized crime, focusing on cracking down on network-based and 'soft violence' organized criminal activities, and deploying a one-year campaign.

articles.title_zh: 王某破坏军婚：与现役军人配偶同居致其怀孕堕胎，被判2年
articles.title_en: Wang Sentenced to 2 Years for Destroying Military Marriage by Cohabiting with Active-Duty Soldier's Spouse
articles.summary_zh: 男子王某与现役军人配偶同居致其怀孕堕胎，构成破坏军婚罪，被判处有期徒刑2年。
articles.summary_en: A man named Wang was sentenced to 2 years in prison for living with the spouse of an active-duty soldier, causing pregnancy and abortion, in violation of military marriage protection.

articles.title_zh: 中国驻巴使馆证实一名中国公民在巴基斯坦遭遇雪崩失联
articles.title_en: Chinese Embassy in Pakistan Confirms Chinese Citizen Missing After Avalanche
articles.summary_zh: 中国驻巴基斯坦大使馆8月1日证实，一名中国公民7月30日在布洛阿特峰附近遭遇雪崩后失联，使馆已启动领事保护应急机制，敦促巴方全力搜救。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the Chinese Embassy in Pakistan confirmed that a Chinese citizen went missing after an avalanche near Broad Peak on July 30. The embassy has activated consular protection emergency mechanism and urged Pakistani authorities to search.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省委原副书记吴敏达逝世，参与研制摄影机记录了首枚氢弹试爆
articles.title_en: Wu Minda, Former Deputy Secretary of Zhejiang Provincial Committee, Passes Away; He Helped Develop Camera That Recorded First Hydrogen Bomb Test
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省委原副书记吴敏达因病于2026年8月1日在杭州逝世，享年98岁。他曾参与研制高速摄影机，记录我国首枚氢弹试爆。
articles.summary_en: Wu Minda, former deputy secretary of the Zhejiang Provincial Committee, died of illness in Hangzhou on August 1, 2026, at age 98. He helped develop a high-speed camera that recorded China's first hydrogen bomb test.

articles.title_zh: 安徽亳州城管局通报一公职人员涉嫌婚内出轨：已成立调查组
articles.title_en: Anhui Bozhou Urban Management Bureau Reports Public Official Suspected of Extramarital Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 安徽亳州城管局通报一名公职人员涉嫌婚内出轨，并称已成立调查组。
articles.summary_en: Anhui Bozhou Urban Management Bureau reported a public official suspected of extramarital affairs and said it has set up an investigation team.

articles.title_zh: 不开空调室温25℃，江苏徐州一地试点集中供冷
articles.title_en: Central Cooling Pilot in Xuzhou, Jiangsu Keeps Rooms at 25°C Without Air Conditioning
articles.summary_zh: 江苏徐州试点集中供冷，利用废弃矿井水为居民降温，室温保持25℃左右，能耗降低50%。
articles.summary_en: Xuzhou, Jiangsu pilots central cooling using abandoned mine water, keeping rooms around 25°C without AC, cutting energy use by 50%.

articles.title_zh: 创新引领 未来之城生机勃勃
articles.title_en: Innovation Leads a Flourishing City of the Future
articles.summary_zh: 3月23日，习近平总书记考察雄安新区并发表重要讲话，强调以改革创新为引领。雄安新区九年多建设取得重大成果，正打造新时代创新高地和高质量发展样板。
articles.summary_en: On March 23, General Secretary Xi Jinping visited Xiong'an New Area and delivered an important speech emphasizing innovation and reform. After nine years of development, Xiong'an has achieved major progress and is becoming a model of high-quality development and a new innovation hub.

articles.title_zh: 换道领跑的河南动力：培育壮大“新字号”
articles.title_en: Henan's Momentum for Lane-Changing Leapfrogging: Fostering the 'New Brand' Industrial Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 今年7月，2026河南省人工智能大会在郑州举行，全省人工智能产业规模突破千亿元；新能源汽车产量大幅增长，河南正加快打造5000亿级智能终端产业集群，建设全国领先的新能源汽车产业基地。
articles.summary_en: In July, the 2026 Henan Artificial Intelligence Conference was held in Zhengzhou, with the province's AI industry scale exceeding 100 billion yuan. NEV output has surged, and Henan is building a 500-billion-yuan intelligent terminal cluster and a leading NEV industry base.

articles.title_zh: 福建省发布“十五五”新型冶金产业集群行动方案
articles.title_en: Fujian Releases Action Plan for 15th Five-Year New Metallurgical Industry Cluster
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省出台“十五五”新型冶金产业集群高质量发展行动方案，明确到2030年集群规模力争达8800亿元，推动产业向高端化、智能化、绿色化转型。
articles.summary_en: Fujian recently issued its 15th Five-Year action plan for high-quality development of new metallurgical industry clusters, targeting 880 billion yuan by 2030 and advancing high-end, intelligent, and green transformation.

articles.title_zh: “十四五”福建海洋科技创新交出亮眼答卷
articles.title_en: Fujian's Marine Sci-Tech Innovation Delivers Impressive Results in 14th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: “十四五”期间，福建建成120个海洋科创平台，在海上风电、海水制氢、水产种业等领域取得标志性成果，为海洋经济高质量发展提供支撑。
articles.summary_en: During the 14th Five-Year Plan period, Fujian built 120 marine sci-tech innovation platforms, achieving landmark results in offshore wind power, seawater hydrogen production, and aquatic seed industry, supporting high-quality marine economy growth.

articles.title_zh: 金砖出海快线在厦启动
articles.title_en: BRICS Going-Global Express Lane Launches in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 当日，金砖出海快线首场活动在厦门举办，尼日利亚专场对接吸引近200人参加。
articles.summary_en: The first event of the BRICS Going-Global Express Lane, a Nigeria-themed matchmaking session, was held in Xiamen with nearly 200 participants.

articles.title_zh: 学习·故事丨古厝焕新生
articles.title_en: Learning Story: Ancient Houses Get New Life
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记强调政绩观关乎立党为公、执政为民，回顾其在福州任上叫停林觉民故居拆迁、保护三坊七巷历史街区的往事。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping emphasizes that the view on political achievements concerns serving the people, recalling his past actions in Fuzhou to stop the demolition of Lin Juemin's former residence and protect the Three Lanes and Seven Alleys historic district.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: 25th Session of Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，省十四届人大常委会第二十五次会议在郑州闭幕，省委书记、省人大常委会主任刘宁主持并讲话，表决通过多项地方性法规和人事任免。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the 25th session of the 14th Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee concluded in Zhengzhou. Liu Ning, Party Secretary of Henan and Chairman of the committee, presided and spoke, approving multiple local regulations and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 省政府党组（扩大）会议召开 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Provincial Government Party Group (Expanded) Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江苏省政府党组书记、省长刘小涛主持省政府党组（扩大）会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示精神，研究城市更新、人工智能、基础教育等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired the Jiangsu Provincial Government Party Group (expanded) meeting to study Xi Jinping's latest instructions, covering urban renewal, AI, and basic education.

articles.title_zh: 实业报国志 接力谱新篇
articles.title_en: Carrying Forward the Legacy of Industrial Patriotism
articles.summary_zh: 本文综述了中国企业家弘扬实业报国精神，坚守主业、创新驱动、勇担社会责任，在高质量发展中续写实业强国新篇。
articles.summary_en: This feature reviews how Chinese entrepreneurs carry forward the spirit of industrial patriotism, sticking to main business, driving innovation and fulfilling social responsibilities in high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: Xinhua's 'Learning New Words' column launches the 'Strengthening the Party with Soul' series, first focusing on upholding the Party's leadership and reviewing Xi Jinping's important discourses on Party building.

articles.title_zh: 哈尔滨从高校科研成果中寻找产业化潜力“种子”
articles.title_en: Harbin Seeks Industrialization Potential from University Research Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 新华社8月2日报道，哈尔滨依托哈工大等高校建设创新创业生态圈，推动科研成果产业化，工大卫星等企业快速成长，2025年就地转化重大科技成果453项。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 2, Xinhua reported that Harbin is building innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystems around universities like HIT to commercialize research results. Enterprises such as Gongda Satellite have grown rapidly, and 453 major tech achievements were commercialized locally in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 2026年江源综合科学考察启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Jiangyuan Comprehensive Scientific Expedition Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年江源综合科学考察2日在青海玉树启动，长江科学院牵头，科考队将深入江源高海拔腹地，摸清生态本底，为长江保护提供数据。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 comprehensive scientific expedition to the source of the Yangtze River was launched on August 2 in Yushu, Qinghai. Led by the Changjiang River Scientific Research Institute, the team will survey the high-altitude hinterland to assess ecological conditions and support river protection.

articles.title_zh: “喝酒协会”是假的！民政部门回应：从未登记，已经取缔！
articles.title_en: Fake 'Drinking Association' Banned: Civil Affairs Department Says It Was Never Registered
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省民政厅近日将“云贵川喝酒协会海盐分会”等8家非法社会组织列入2026年第二批名单，均未登记，已被取缔或责令解散。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Provincial Civil Affairs Department recently listed 8 illegal social organizations, including the 'Yunnan-Guizhou-Sichuan Drinking Association Haiyan Branch', as the second batch in 2026. They were never registered and have been banned or dissolved.

articles.title_zh: 商务部回应美国将中国企业列入所谓涉疆法案实体清单
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Responds to US Listing Chinese Companies on So-Called Xinjiang-Related Entity List
articles.summary_zh: 商务部新闻发言人就美国将中国企业列入所谓涉疆法案实体清单答记者问，强烈谴责美方单边制裁，并表示将采取必要措施维护中国企业合法权益。
articles.summary_en: MOFCOM spokesperson responded to the US listing of Chinese companies on the so-called Xinjiang-related entity list, strongly condemning unilateral sanctions and vowing necessary measures to protect Chinese enterprises' rights.

articles.title_zh: 《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》发布
articles.title_en: Management Measures for Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve Released
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，自然资源部等四部门联合印发《黄岩岛国家级自然保护区管理办法》，加强黄岩岛自然保护区的保护与管理。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, four departments jointly issued the Management Measures for Huangyan Island National Nature Reserve to enhance its protection and management.

articles.title_zh: 渔业法释义厘清调水用品六大类别 须完整记录信息且保存不少于两年
articles.title_en: Fisheries Law Interpretation Clarifies Six Categories of Water Conditioning Products, Requires Records for No Less Than Two Years
articles.summary_zh: 中国渔业协会近日出版《渔业法释义》，将调水用品分为六大类，并规定使用记录须保存至少两年，以明确监管边界。
articles.summary_en: The Fishery Law Interpretation classifies water-conditioning products into six categories and requires complete usage records kept for at least two years, clarifying regulatory boundaries.

articles.title_zh: 李涛卸任河南省副省长
articles.title_en: Li Tao Removed as Vice Governor of Henan Province
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，河南省人大常委会决定免去李涛的河南省人民政府副省长职务，此前他已任省委常委、秘书长。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the Standing Committee of Henan Provincial People's Congress decided to remove Li Tao from the post of vice governor, as he had earlier become a member of the Standing Committee and Secretary-General of the Provincial Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 习近平强党兴党的故事｜治国之要 首在用人
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Story of Strengthening the Party: The Key to Governance Lies in Personnel
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平1984年在河北正定县推动调整农村领导班子，强调建设高素质干部队伍，并提及2026年6月全国党建工作座谈会突出干部队伍建设的重要性。
articles.summary_en: This story reviews Xi Jinping's efforts in 1984 to adjust rural leadership in Zhengding County, emphasizing the importance of building high-caliber cadre teams, and cites the June 2026 national party building conference highlighting cadre development.

articles.title_zh: 海南构建多维度服务体系助力退役军人更好融入自贸港建设
articles.title_en: Hainan Builds Multi-Dimensional Service System to Help Veterans Integrate into Free Trade Port
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，海南省新闻办发布会透露，海南构建涵盖安置、培训、就业、创业、保障的多维度服务体系，助力退役军人融入自贸港建设。
articles.summary_en: At a July 31 press conference, Hainan outlined a multi-dimensional service system covering resettlement, training, employment, entrepreneurship, and social security to help veterans integrate into the Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 水利部针对黑龙江省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level IV Flood Response for Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，水利部针对黑龙江省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，应对松花江、嫩江支流可能发生的编号洪水。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level IV flood response for Heilongjiang Province to address potential numbered floods in tributaries of the Songhua and Nen rivers.

articles.title_zh: 领航丨矢志强军向复兴
articles.title_en: Charting the Course: Forging a Strong Military Toward National Rejuvenation
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平主席领导人民军队强军建设，强调党对军队的绝对领导，提出新时代政治建军方略，引领国防和军队现代化取得历史性成就。
articles.summary_en: A retrospective on President Xi Jinping's leadership in strengthening the People's Army, emphasizing the Party's absolute leadership over the military and the strategy of political army-building, achieving historic progress in national defense modernization.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Red Flash Flood Meteorological Warning
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，水利部和中国气象局联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警，预计黑龙江南部、四川东北部等地山洪灾害可能性很大；水利部向12省份发出靶向预警，应急管理部启动地质灾害四级应急响应。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Ministry of Water Resources and the China Meteorological Administration issued a red flash flood warning for parts of Heilongjiang and Sichuan. Targeted alerts were sent to 12 provinces, and a Level IV geological disaster response was activated.

articles.title_zh: “德耀中华·弘扬大庆精神（铁人精神）”专题活动举行
articles.title_en: Special Event Held to Promote Daqing Spirit and Iron Man Spirit
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，“德耀中华·弘扬大庆精神（铁人精神）”专题活动在黑龙江大庆举行，通过多种形式展现道德模范先进事迹，活动由中央精神文明建设办公室主办。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the special event 'Virtue Shines in China · Promoting Daqing Spirit (Iron Man Spirit)' was held in Daqing, Heilongjiang, showcasing the deeds of moral models through various forms. It was hosted by the Central Spiritual Civilization Development Office.

articles.title_zh: 浙江以考古前置机制破解文物保护与城市建设矛盾
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Uses Pre-Archaeological System to Balance Heritage Protection and Urban Construction
articles.summary_zh: 浙江全面推行考古前置机制，通过制度改革和数字化管理，实现文物保护与工程建设无缝衔接，大批珍贵遗存得以原址保护。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang has fully implemented a pre-excavation archaeological survey system, using institutional reform and digital management to seamlessly coordinate heritage protection with construction, preserving many valuable sites in situ.

articles.title_zh: 第五届链博会推介会在芝加哥举办
articles.title_en: 5th Chain Expo Promotion Conference Held in Chicago
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中美经贸合作论坛暨第五届链博会推介会在美国芝加哥举办，中美两国政商界代表180余人参会。
articles.summary_en: The China-US Economic and Trade Cooperation Forum and promotion conference for the 5th Chain Expo was held in Chicago on July 30, with over 180 representatives from political and business circles attending.

articles.title_zh: 国防部举办招待会庆祝建军99周年
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry Holds Reception for PLA's 99th Founding Anniversary
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国防部在人民大会堂举办招待会庆祝建军99周年，国防部长董军出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Ministry of National Defense held a reception at the Great Hall of the People to celebrate the 99th anniversary of the PLA, with Defense Minister Dong Jun attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 不断推动退役军人工作高质量发展
articles.title_en: Promoting High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，退役军人事务部部长裴金佳在国新办发布会上介绍“十五五”时期退役军人工作，包括高质量安置就业、提升服务保障效能等。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Minister of Veterans Affairs Pei Jinjia outlined plans for high-quality development of veterans affairs during the 15th Five-Year Plan period at a State Council Information Office press conference, covering job placement and service support.

articles.title_zh: 加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Building of a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日出版的《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》，强调到2035年建成健康中国，必须统筹谋划、加紧推进。
articles.summary_en: The Qiushi Journal published an important article by President Xi Jinping on August 1, emphasizing the strategic decision to build a Healthy China by 2035 and the need to make decisive progress during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主持中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Chairs 27th Group Study Session of CPC Central Committee Political Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日下午就高质量推进国防和军队现代化进行第二十七次集体学习，习近平主持并发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held its 27th group study session on high-quality advancement of national defense and military modernization. Xi Jinping presided and delivered an important speech.

articles.title_zh: 联合发布十二名“最美新时代革命军人”
articles.title_en: Twelve 'Most Beautiful New Era Revolutionary Soldiers' Jointly Announced
articles.summary_zh: 在中国人民解放军建军99周年之际，中央宣传部与中央军委政治工作部联合发布12名“最美新时代革命军人”，激励广大官兵忠诚奋斗。
articles.summary_en: On the 99th anniversary of the PLA, the CPC Central Committee's Publicity Department and the CMC Political Work Department jointly announced 12 'Most Beautiful New Era Revolutionary Soldiers' to inspire officers and soldiers.

articles.title_zh: 做好退役军人服务保障，让尊重关爱落地有声
articles.title_en: Better Services for Veterans to Make Respect and Care Tangible
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国新办举行发布会，退役军人事务部部长裴金佳表示“十五五”时期将做好退役军人接收安置、服务保障等工作，并推动服务“一件事”改革。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, at a State Council Information Office press conference, Minister of Veterans Affairs Pei Jinjia pledged improved resettlement and services for veterans during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 柯昌万主持安康市委常委会（扩大）会议 强调攻坚三季度决胜下半年
articles.title_en: Ke Changwan Chairs Ankang Municipal Party Committee Meeting, Stressing Q3 Offensive and H2 Victory
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，安康市委书记柯昌万主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议暨县（市、区）委书记工作汇报会，分析上半年经济，部署下半年重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Ke Changwan, secretary of the Ankang Municipal Party Committee, chaired an enlarged standing committee meeting to analyze H1 economy and arrange key H2 tasks.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 坚定信心 保持定力 提高质效 推动经济向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting to Promote High-Quality Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习中央政治局会议精神，部署全面从严治党及经济工作，强调推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of Changchun Municipal Party Committee, chaired a Standing Committee meeting to convey the spirit of the CPC Central Political Bureau meeting and deploy work on strict Party governance and economic development, emphasizing high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠主持召开市委审计委员会第九次全体会议
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Chairs 9th Plenary Meeting of Municipal Party Committee Audit Commission
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，长春市委书记张恩惠主持召开市委审计委员会第九次全体会议，强调做好审计监督“下半篇文章”，为长春高质量发展提供保障。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the CPC Changchun Municipal Committee, chaired the 9th plenary meeting of the Municipal Party Committee Audit Commission, emphasizing high-quality audit supervision to support Changchun's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省领导走访慰问驻苏部队官兵
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Visit and Greet Troops Stationed in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 在八一建军节前夕，省委常委、常务副省长马欣和省委常委、政法委书记李耀光分别走访慰问驻苏部队官兵，致以节日祝福。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Ma Xin and Li Yaoguang, Jiangsu provincial leaders, visited troops stationed in Jiangsu and conveyed festive greetings.

articles.title_zh: 中国民主促进会沈阳市第十五次代表大会召开
articles.title_en: Shenyang Congress of China Association for Promoting Democracy Convenes
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日至31日，中国民主促进会沈阳市第十五次代表大会召开，选举产生新一届委员会，原阳当选主任委员。
articles.summary_en: The 15th Congress of the Shenyang Municipal Committee of the China Association for Promoting Democracy was held on July 30-31, electing a new committee with Yuan Yang as chairman.

articles.title_zh: 超长期特别国债资金精准发力 加快补齐民生短板
articles.title_en: Ultra-long-term Special Treasury Bond Funds Precisely Target People's Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，2000亿元超长期特别国债资金支持设备更新，精准流向医疗设备、加装电梯等民生领域，加快补齐民生短板。
articles.summary_en: Since this year, 200 billion yuan of ultra-long-term special treasury bond funds for equipment updates have been precisely allocated to people's livelihood sectors such as medical devices and elevator installation, accelerating the improvement of living standards.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章《加快建设健康中国》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Journal Publishes Important Article by Xi Jinping on Accelerating Building a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日出版的《求是》杂志发表习近平总书记重要文章，强调到2035年建成健康中国，要求统筹谋划、加紧推进。
articles.summary_en: The 15th issue of Qiushi magazine published on August 1 carries an important article by Xi Jinping, emphasizing the strategic decision to build a Healthy China by 2035 and urging coordinated planning and accelerated progress.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联合印发“十五五”公共机构节能降碳工作方案
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Issue Work Plan for Energy Conservation and Carbon Reduction in Public Institutions during the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日消息，国管局和国家发展改革委联合印发《“十五五”公共机构节能降碳工作方案》，部署公共机构节能降碳工作，提出到2030年单位建筑面积碳排放下降8.5%等目标。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, the National Government Offices Administration and the National Development and Reform Commission issued a joint work plan to promote energy conservation and carbon reduction in public institutions during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, targeting an 8.5% cut in carbon emissions per unit of floor area by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 铁路暑运过半 消夏旅游列车激发消费活力
articles.title_en: Railway Summer Travel Reaches Midpoint, Tourist Trains Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 国铁集团数据显示，全国铁路暑运已发送旅客4.32亿人次；铁路部门加密开行避暑旅游专列，激发暑期消费新活力。
articles.summary_en: China State Railway Group reports 432 million passenger trips in summer travel. Railway authorities added tourist trains to boost consumption.

articles.title_zh: 我国现代化水网建设提速
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Modern Water Network Construction
articles.summary_zh: 记者从水利部了解到，今年1至6月全国实施水利项目3.3万个，完成投资5151亿元，南水北调引江补汉等重大工程加快建设。
articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Water Resources, China implemented 33,000 water projects with investment of 515.1 billion yuan in H1, accelerating key projects like the Hanjiang-to-Weihe River Water Diversion.

articles.title_zh: 谋发展——深刻认识“最本质的特征”和“最大优势”
articles.title_en: Seeking Development: Deeply Understanding the 'Essential Feature' and 'Greatest Strength'
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记主持中央政治局会议，强调坚持党的领导、推动高质量发展，指出中国共产党领导是中国特色社会主义最本质的特征和最大优势。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping chaired a CPC Central Committee Political Bureau meeting, emphasizing Party leadership and high-quality development, stating that CPC leadership is the most essential feature and greatest strength of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

articles.title_zh: 五年规划发布 全国供销合作社将全面升级为农服务
articles.title_en: Five-Year Plan Released: Supply and Marketing Cooperatives to Upgrade Agricultural Services Nationwide
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，中华全国供销合作总社发布《全国供销合作社“十五五”发展规划》，部署18项重点任务，提升农资流通与社会化服务能力，助力粮食安全与乡村振兴。

articles.title_zh: 南部战区位黄岩岛领海领空和周边海空域组织海空联合演训
articles.title_en: Southern Theater Command Conducts Joint Sea-Air Exercise in and around Huangyan Island
articles.summary_zh: 南部战区在黄岩岛领海领空及周边海空域组织海空联合演训，展示维护国家主权和海洋权益的决心。
articles.summary_en: The Southern Theater Command organized a joint sea-air exercise in and around Huangyan Island's territorial waters and airspace, demonstrating resolve to safeguard national sovereignty and maritime rights.

articles.title_zh: 国家电网：坚决拥护党中央决定
articles.title_en: State Grid Firmly Supports CPC Central Committee's Decision
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，国家电网公司党组召开会议，通报中央纪委国家监委对辛保安涉嫌严重违纪违法进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定，公司党组书记、董事长张智刚主持会议并讲话，与会同志坚决拥护党中央决定。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, State Grid Corporation's Party Group held a meeting to announce the decision of the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission to investigate Xin Bao'an for alleged serious disciplinary violations. Party Secretary and Chairman Zhang Zhigang chaired the meeting and expressed firm support for the decision.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省发布地质灾害气象风险红色预警
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues Red Alert for Geological Disaster Meteorological Risk
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省发布地质灾害气象风险红色预警，提醒相关地区加强防范。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Province issued a red alert for geological disaster meteorological risk, urging relevant areas to strengthen precautions.

articles.title_zh: 河北省委常委会召开扩大会议
articles.title_en: Hebei Provincial Party Committee Holds Enlarged Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，河北省委常委会召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和李强总理在唐山调研慰问时的讲话要求，研究贯彻落实意见，决定8月3日召开省委十届十一次全会。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting to convey and study Xi Jinping's important speeches and Li Qiang's remarks during his research visit to Tangshan, and decided to convene the 11th Plenary Session of the 10th Provincial Committee on August 3.

articles.title_zh: 保险机构投资或超50亿！河南做实养老金融“大文章”
articles.title_en: Henan's Elderly Care Finance: Insurance Investment May Exceed 5 Billion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，河南金融监管局召开通气会，通报养老金融发展成效：养老产业贷款余额54.2亿元，保险机构计划投资超50亿元，个人养老金开户超1600万人。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Henan's financial regulator announced achievements in elderly-care finance: pension industry loans reached 5.42 billion yuan, insurance investment plans exceed 5 billion yuan, and personal pension accounts surpassed 16 million.

articles.title_zh: 河南推动传统产业改造升级 走“老树新花”特色之路
articles.title_en: Henan Charts Distinctive Path to Upgrade Traditional Industries
articles.summary_zh: 河南统筹推进老设备更新、老产品迭代、老品牌焕新、老企业转型，走出一条传统产业改造升级的特色之路。
articles.summary_en: Henan is systematically upgrading traditional industries by renewing old equipment, iterating products, reviving brands, and transforming enterprises, charting a distinctive path of industrial revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 2026年福建省大学生创新大赛正式启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Fujian College Student Innovation Competition Officially Launched
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，福建省教育厅宣布启动2026年福建省大学生创新大赛，以“我敢闯，我会创”为主题，分三级赛制，优秀项目将推荐参加国赛。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Fujian Provincial Department of Education announced the launch of the 2026 Fujian College Student Innovation Competition under the theme "Dare to Innovate, I Can Create", featuring a three-tier format with outstanding projects recommended for the national competition.

articles.title_zh: 福建出台渔业法行政处罚自由裁量基准
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues Administrative Penalty Discretion Benchmark for Fisheries Law
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省海洋与渔业局出台《中华人民共和国渔业法》行政处罚自由裁量基准，梳理形成40项标准化裁量事项，以规范渔业执法。
articles.summary_en: Fujian's Ocean and Fisheries Bureau recently issued an administrative penalty discretion benchmark for the Fisheries Law, standardizing 40 items to regulate fishery law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 习言道｜习近平的强军号令
articles.title_en: Xi's Call to Strengthen the Military
articles.summary_zh: 习近平主席多次强调强国必须强军，军强才能国安，文章重温统帅的强军号令。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping has repeatedly stressed that a strong country must have a strong military, and only a strong military can ensure national security. This article revisits the commander's call.

articles.title_zh: 习近平强党兴党的故事｜治国之要 首在用人
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Stories of Building a Strong Party | The Key to Governance Lies in Selecting Talents
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平1984年在正定推动干部队伍调整，强调建设堪当民族复兴重任的高素质干部队伍，为高质量发展提供人才支撑。
articles.summary_en: The article recalls Xi Jinping's 1984 efforts in Zhengding to adjust the cadre team, emphasizing the building of a high-quality cadre team capable of national rejuvenation, providing talent support for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 林武在济南调研企业、科技大市场和山东大学
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Inspects Enterprises, Science and Technology Market, and Shandong University in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日至29日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研邦德激光、济南卫星、山东科技大市场和山东大学，强调推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: From July 28 to 29, Lin Wu, Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee, visited Bond Laser, Jinan Satellite, Shandong Science and Technology Market, and Shandong University in Jinan, stressing the integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 市领导参加“军事日”活动并走访慰问驻青部队
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal Leaders Attend 'Military Day' Event and Visit Garrison Troops
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，青岛市委书记曾赞荣、市长任刚等市领导集体参加“军事日”活动，并走访慰问驻青部队，代表市委市政府等向官兵致以节日祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On August 1, Qingdao municipal leaders, including Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong and Mayor Ren Gang, participated in the 'Military Day' event and visited troops stationed in Qingdao, extending festive greetings on behalf of the city.

articles.title_zh: 持之以恒推进全面从严治党 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Persistently Advance Party Self-Governance to Push Economy Towards New and Better Development
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定10月在北京召开二十届五中全会，研究持之以恒推进全面从严治党，并部署下半年经济工作，强调实施更加积极的财政政策和适度宽松的货币政策。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee Politburo met on July 30, deciding to hold the Fifth Plenary Session in October, addressing sustained party discipline, and outlining H2 economic work with more proactive fiscal and moderately loose monetary policies.

tags.name_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 外交部就菲律宾在黄岩岛划设所谓“领海基线”发表声明
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Statement on Philippines' Unlawful Baseline in Huangyan Island
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，中国外交部发表声明，坚决反对菲律宾在中国领土黄岩岛划设所谓“领海基线”，指出其严重侵犯中国主权，非法无效。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, China's Foreign Ministry issued a statement resolutely opposing the Philippines' unlawful baselines in Huangyan Island, calling them illegal and invalid and a serious violation of China's sovereignty.

articles.title_zh: 省政府召开常务会议
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Chairs Jiangsu Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江苏省政府召开常务会议，省长刘小涛主持，部署经济运行、产业发展、科技强农、食品安全等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Jiangsu Provincial Government held an executive meeting chaired by Governor Liu Xiaotao, deploying work on economic operation, industrial development, agricultural technology, and food safety.

articles.title_zh: 整合重组歌舞团、戏曲剧团、话剧团等，吉林市演艺集团揭牌
articles.title_en: Jilin City Performing Arts Group Unveiled After Restructuring of Local Art Troupes
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月31日，吉林市演艺集团揭牌，整合市歌舞团、戏曲剧团、话剧团等国有文艺资源，推动文旅融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Jilin City Performing Arts Group was inaugurated, integrating municipal song-and-dance, opera, and drama troupes and other state-owned cultural resources to boost cultural-tourism integration.

articles.title_zh: 中国烹饪协会：“中国烹饪大师”“之乡、之都”等称号全部作废
articles.title_en: China Cuisine Association Revokes All 'Culinary Master' and 'Hometown of Cuisine' Titles
articles.summary_zh: 中国烹饪协会近日连发公告，废止其历年评定的“中国烹饪大师”“名师”及“之乡、之都”等称号，以落实民政部等新规。
articles.summary_en: China Cuisine Association recently revoked all 'Culinary Master' and 'Hometown of Cuisine' titles it had awarded, to comply with new regulations on social organization commendations.

articles.title_zh: 10万人南昌八一广场观看升旗，建军百年将有更多期待
articles.title_en: 100,000 Attend Flag-Raising at Nanchang Bayi Square Ahead of PLA Centennial
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日，约10.2万群众在南昌八一广场观看升旗仪式。背景中的陆军博物馆计划于2027年8月1日前开放，将融入“八一”文化展示圈。
articles.summary_en: On Aug 1, about 102,000 people attended a flag-raising ceremony at Nanchang's Bayi Square. The Army Museum behind is scheduled to open by Aug 1, 2027, joining the Bayi cultural display circle.

articles.title_zh: AI浪潮下的传播新格局：变什么，守什么？
articles.title_en: New Communication Landscape in the AI Wave: What Changes, What Remains?
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，2026外滩新媒体学术交流会在上海举行，澎湃新闻主办总编圆桌研讨，多位主流媒体负责人探讨AI浪潮下媒体变革的变与不变。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 2026 Bund New Media Academic Exchange was held in Shanghai, where The Paper hosted a chief editors' roundtable discussing what changes and what remains in media amid the AI wave.

articles.title_zh: 湖南两所高校因学校情况有变临时调整录取通知书签发人
articles.title_en: Two Hunan Universities Adjust Admission Letter Signers Due to Changed Circumstances
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省教育厅近日公告，因学校情况变化，南华大学和益阳医学高等专科学校调整录取通知书签发人，改为党委书记签发。此前南华大学校长夏昆因涉嫌严重违纪违法被查。
articles.summary_en: Hunan Education Department adjusted admission letter signers at two universities to their Party secretaries after President Xia Kun of University of South China was investigated for serious discipline violations.

articles.title_zh: 首批全国生育友好城市创建已启动，哪些城市有意？
articles.title_en: First Batch of National Childbirth-Friendly City Program Launched, Which Cities Are Interested?
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫健委5月公布创建管理办法，启动全国生育友好城市创建；黑龙江穆棱、大兴安岭及湖北天门等地已宣布争创。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission published management rules in May to launch a national childbirth-friendly city program; cities like Muleng, Daxing'anling and Tianmen have announced bids to join.

articles.title_zh: 从发改委连续三场发布会看中国人工智能发展
articles.title_en: China's AI Development: Insights from Three Consecutive NDRC Press Conferences
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发展改革委举行发布会，强调发展国产算力，披露全国智能算力规模达去年同期2.8倍，首个全国产10万卡AI超集群投用。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the NDRC held a press conference emphasizing domestic computing power, disclosing that national intelligent computing power reached 2.8 times the previous year and the first fully domestic 100,000-card AI cluster is in operation.

articles.title_zh: 福建省“八一”军政座谈会举行
articles.title_en: Fujian Holds 'August 1st' Military-Political Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，福建省委书记周祖翼、省长赵龙走访慰问驻闽部队并出席省“八一”军政座谈会，共话军民鱼水深情。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Fujian Provincial Party Secretary Zhou Zuyi and Governor Zhao Long visited troops stationed in Fujian and attended the provincial military-political symposium to promote civil-military unity.

articles.title_zh: 林业总产值突破万亿元 福建林业“十五五”发展规划出台
articles.title_en: Fujian Issues 15th Five-Year Forestry Development Plan Aiming for Trillion-Yuan Output
articles.summary_zh: 近日，福建省林业局印发《福建省“十五五”林业发展规划》，提出到2030年森林覆盖率达65.88%、林业产业总产值突破1万亿元。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Fujian Provincial Forestry Bureau issued the 15th Five-Year Forestry Development Plan, setting targets of 65.88% forest coverage and over 1 trillion yuan in forestry output by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 广东省领导慰问驻粤部队官兵
articles.title_en: Guangdong Leaders Visit Military Units Stationed in Province
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节前夕，广东省委、省政府领导率省拥军慰问团走访慰问驻粤部队，致以节日祝贺和诚挚慰问。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of the 99th Army Day, leaders of the Guangdong Provincial Party Committee and Government led teams to visit and extend festive greetings to military personnel stationed in Guangdong.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省出台知识产权领域首部综合性地方性法规
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues First Comprehensive Local Regulation on Intellectual Property
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，甘肃省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议表决通过《甘肃省知识产权促进和保护条例》，系该省知识产权领域首部综合性地方性法规，将于2026年9月1日施行。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the 24th session of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee passed the Regulation on Promotion and Protection of Intellectual Property in Gansu, the province's first comprehensive local regulation on IP, effective from September 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃修订实施代表法办法
articles.title_en: Gansu Revises Implementation Measures for Deputies Law
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议表决通过《甘肃省实施〈代表法〉办法（修订）》，自2026年9月1日起施行，以保障代表依法履职。
articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress approved the revised measures for implementing the Deputies Law at its 24th session on July 30, effective September 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省年轻一代民营经济人士培育计划启动
articles.title_en: Gansu Launches Training Program for Young Private Entrepreneurs
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省委统战部、省工商联启动年轻一代民营经济人士培育计划，首期选拔约50名青年企业家进行一年期培训，提升其政治素养与经营能力。
articles.summary_en: Gansu's United Front Work Department and Federation of Industry and Commerce launched a program to cultivate young private entrepreneurs, selecting about 50 for a year-long training to enhance political literacy and business capabilities.

tags.name_en: United Front Work Department of Gansu Provincial CPC Committee

tags_en: United Front Work Department of Gansu Provincial CPC Committee

articles.title_zh: 广西四部门联合推出“复工复产贷”政策
articles.title_en: Guangxi Four Departments Jointly Launch "Work Resumption and Production Loan" Policy
articles.summary_zh: 广西四部门联合推出“复工复产贷”政策，提高贷款贴息和担保费补贴比例，为受灾地区经营主体恢复生产提供融资支持。自设立以来已入库1207户，19户获贷2.52亿元。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi's four departments jointly launched the "Work Resumption and Production Loan" policy, increasing subsidies for loan interest and guarantee fees to support business recovery in disaster-hit areas. Since its launch, 1,207 entities have been registered, and 19 have received subsidized loans totaling 252 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 广西跨境贸易高水平开放试点今起实施
articles.title_en: Guangxi Launches High-Level Open Pilot for Cross-Border Trade
articles.summary_zh: 8月1日起，广西在南宁、柳州、防城港、钦州、崇左五市实施跨境贸易高水平开放试点，深化面向东盟的金融开放门户建设，优化优质企业贸易外汇收支便利化政策。
articles.summary_en: Starting August 1, Guangxi implements a high-level opening-up pilot for cross-border trade in five cities, aiming to deepen financial opening toward ASEAN and optimize trade foreign exchange facilitation for quality enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 加快构建体现湖北优势的现代化产业体系
articles.title_en: Hubei Accelerates Building Modern Industrial System with Local Advantages
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日上午，湖北省委理论学习中心组举行集体学习，围绕加快构建体现湖北优势的现代化产业体系开展研讨，省委书记关志鸥主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 31, the Hubei Provincial Party Committee's theoretical study group held a collective session on building a modern industrial system with local advantages, chaired by Secretary Guan Zhiou.

articles.title_zh: 不断推动退役军人工作高质量发展（权威发布·开局起步“十五五”）
articles.title_en: Continuously Promoting High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会，退役军人事务部部长裴金佳介绍“十五五”时期推动退役军人工作高质量发展的有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where Minister of Veterans Affairs Pei Jinjia introduced plans for high-quality development of veterans affairs during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 河北省召开全省领导干部会议
articles.title_en: Hebei Holds Provincial Leaders Meeting; Luo Wen Appointed Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，河北省召开全省领导干部会议，中央组织部副部长黄建发宣布中央决定：罗文任河北省委书记，倪岳峰不再担任。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Hebei held a provincial leaders meeting. Huang Jianfa, deputy head of the Central Organization Department, announced that Luo Wen was appointed Hebei Party secretary, replacing Ni Yuefeng.

tags.name_en: Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee

tags_en: Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 冯飞率海南省“八一”拥军慰问团看望慰问驻琼部队官兵
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Leads Hainan Army Day Condolence Group to Visit Troops Stationed in Hainan
articles.summary_zh: 省委书记冯飞7月31日率海南省“八一”拥军慰问团在海口走访慰问驻琼部队，代表省委省政府致以节日祝贺，并强调军地合力支持自贸港建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Feng Fei, Secretary of Hainan Provincial Party Committee, led the Hainan 'August 1st' Army Day condolence delegation to visit troops stationed in Hainan in Haikou, conveying holiday greetings on behalf of the provincial party committee and government, and emphasizing military-civilian cooperation to support the free trade port construction.

tags.name_en: Supporting the Army and Honoring Military Families

tags_en: Supporting the Army and Honoring Military Families

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲：全力做好强降雨防范应对工作 切实保障人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Urges Full Preparedness for Heavy Rainfall to Protect People's Lives and Property
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，黑龙江省防汛抗旱指挥部召开防范应对近期强降雨视频调度会议，省长梁惠玲强调全力做好强降雨防范应对工作，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Heilongjiang Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters held a video conference on heavy rainfall response, where Governor Liang Huiling stressed full preparedness to protect lives and property.

tags.name_en: Heilongjiang Provincial Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters

articles.title_zh: 江苏市县乡三级人大换届选举时间确定
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Sets Dates for County, Township People's Congress Elections
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，江苏省人大常委会通过决定，明确全省市县乡三级人大换届选举时间，县乡两级代表将于2026年12月底前选出。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee passed a decision setting the timeline for the three-level people's congress elections, with county and township deputies to be elected by the end of December 2026.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘叶建春宋福龙陈永奇等分组走访慰问驻赣部队
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Leaders Visit Troops Stationed in Jiangxi Ahead of Army Day

articles.summary_en: From July 30 to 31, Yin Hong, Ye Jianchun and other provincial leaders visited troops stationed in Jiangxi, conveying festival greetings and emphasizing support for national defense and military modernization.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党内蒙古自治区第十一届委员会第十二次全体会议公报

articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the 12th Plenary Session of the 11th Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Committee of the CPC was held in Hohhot, deliberating and adopting a resolution on convening the region's 12th Party Congress and deploying work for the second half of the year.

articles.title_zh: 包钢会见出席2026年世界奶业大会的嘉宾代表

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Bao Gang, chairman of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, met with international guests attending the 2026 World Dairy Conference and expressed willingness to deepen dairy cooperation.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held its 27th group study on high-quality modernization of national defense and the military. Xi Jinping presided and stressed strengthening political guidance and deepening innovation.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the exhibition of outstanding stage art works celebrating the 105th anniversary of the CPC, hosted by the Publicity Department and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, opened in Beijing, featuring 12 works.

articles.summary_en: Officials from the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Public Security, and National Immigration Administration answered questions on the State Council regulations on exit-entry administration, explaining background and key provisions.

articles.title_zh: 中共山东省委十二届十一次全体会议举行
articles.title_en: 11th Plenary Session of CPC Shandong Provincial Committee Held

articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the 11th Plenary Session of the CPC Shandong Provincial Committee was held in Jinan, adopting a resolution on advancing agricultural and rural modernization.

articles.title_zh: 奋力开创农业农村现代化新局面
articles.title_en: Striving to Create a New Prospect for Agricultural and Rural Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 山东省委十二届十一次全体会议审议通过关于推进农业农村现代化的意见，部署打造乡村振兴齐鲁样板，扎实推动农业强省建设。
articles.summary_en: The 11th Plenary Session of the 12th CPC Shandong Provincial Committee deliberated and approved a plan to promote agricultural and rural modernization, aiming to build a model for rural revitalization in Qilu.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组第六组向上海市反馈明查暗访情况
articles.title_en: Sixth Central Work Safety Inspection Team Reports Findings to Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，中央安全生产考核巡查组第六组向上海市反馈明查暗访情况，组长周星通报，上海市委书记陈吉宁作表态发言，强调动真碰硬抓整改。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the sixth Central Work Safety Inspection Team gave feedback to Shanghai on its inspection findings; team leader Zhou Xing reported, and Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining pledged resolute rectification.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬双拥光荣传统 提升服务保障效能 推动退役军人工作高质量发展取得新成效
articles.title_en: Carry Forward the Fine Tradition of Supporting the Army and Prioritizing Benefits for Veterans to Promote High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 近日，陕西省委书记赵一德在省退役军人事务厅调研，强调要弘扬双拥光荣传统，提升服务保障效能，推动退役军人工作高质量发展取得新成效。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Zhao Yide, Secretary of the CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee, visited the Provincial Department of Veterans Affairs, emphasizing the need to carry forward the tradition of supporting the army and prioritizing benefits for veterans, improve service support efficiency, and promote high-quality development of veterans affairs.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of the Shaanxi Provincial Party Committee, chaired by Zhao Yide, held a military affairs meeting to deploy strengthening people's armed forces work.

articles.title_en: Half-Year Economic Reports of 31 Provincial Regions Released

articles.summary_en: Economic data for the first half of the year from 31 provincial regions has been released, with Guangdong and Jiangsu leading in GDP and Tibet, Zhejiang, and others posting the fastest growth. All regions reported positive GDP growth.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of Yunnan Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, analyze economic performance in H1, and deploy next steps, chaired by Wang Ning.

articles.title_en: Yunnan Achieves Notable Results in Three-Year Campaign to Optimize Business Environment
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，云南省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议审议优化营商环境报告，显示全省经营主体超684万户，民营经济增加值占GDP比重升至53.5%。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Yunnan provincial legislature reviewed a government report on business environment, showing over 6.84 million market entities and private economy contributing 53.5% of provincial GDP.

articles.title_zh: 黄荷凤：未来医院里，“瘦子”也可能来看肥胖症
articles.title_en: Huang Hefeng: Future Hospitals May See 'Thin' Patients with Obesity Risk
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院院士黄荷凤在2026精准医疗创新转化与数智化发展交流会上表示，医学模式正从“以病人为中心”向“以健康为中心”转变，未来医院将接诊更多表面健康但存在潜在风险的人群。
articles.summary_en: Academician Huang Hefeng stated at the 2026 Precision Medicine Innovation and Digitalization Development Conference that the medical model is shifting from patient-centered to health-centered care, and future hospitals will see more seemingly healthy individuals with potential health risks.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议 刘宁主持并讲话

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning chaired a meeting of the Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee to convey the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and deploy economic development, comprehensive Party discipline, and work safety.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Jiangsu Provincial Government held an executive meeting chaired by Governor Liu Xiaotao to arrange work on economic operation, industrial development, agricultural technology, food safety, petitions, and finance.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开会议学习贯彻中央政治局会议和习近平总书记近期重要讲话重要指示精神

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to study and implement the spirit of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and important speeches of General Secretary Xi Jinping, chaired by Secretary Xin Changxing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记指引加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Guides Accelerated Construction of Healthy China

articles.summary_en: On August 1, the Qiushi Journal published an important article by General Secretary Xi Jinping on accelerating the building of a Healthy China, emphasizing Party leadership and a development path with Chinese characteristics in health work.
