articles.summary_en: On Army Day, review the historic achievements in military development under President Xi Jinping's leadership since the 18th CPC National Congress, and reaffirm commitment to the path of building a powerful military with Chinese characteristics.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Wang Hao, Secretary of the CPC Zhejiang Provincial Committee, visited provincial departments including meteorology, water resources, natural resources, and marine economy, stressing reform and innovation for high-quality development and high-level security.

articles.title_en: Liu Jie Investigates Zhoushan, Stresses Endogenous Development of Island Counties

articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Governor Liu Jie conducted a special survey in Zhoushan from July 29 to 31, stressing comparative advantages and distinctive brands to continuously unleash the endogenous momentum for high-quality development of island counties.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委回应二季度GDP增速回落

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the National Development and Reform Commission held a press conference, responding to the Q2 GDP growth slowdown, saying indicators rebounded in May and June and the economy remains sound in the long run.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委：我国人工智能在全产业链多环节实现快速突破

articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发改委介绍上半年我国人工智能发展，算力规模达去年同期2.8倍，国产大模型下载量破100亿次，下一步抓好创新、应用、生态。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, NDRC said China's AI innovation accelerated in H1, with computing power at 2.8 times last year's level and domestic large-model downloads exceeding 10 billion. Next steps focus on innovation, application, and ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 国家税务总局发布首个跨境税收行业类指引

articles.summary_en: China's State Taxation Administration has recently issued its first cross-border tax industry guideline, the International Transport Tax Service Guideline, providing tax compliance references for enterprises in international maritime, aviation, and land transport.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委：今年7550亿元中央预算内投资已基本下达完毕
articles.title_en: NDRC: 755 Billion Yuan Central Budgetary Investment Basically Allocated This Year

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the NDRC said at a press conference that this year's 755 billion yuan of central budgetary investment has been basically allocated, with increased livelihood investment, including 39.5 billion yuan for work-relief programs.

articles.title_zh: 最高人民法院发布4件涉军维权司法典型案例

articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court released four typical judicial cases on protecting military-related rights, covering military land protection, restructuring of military enterprises, veterans' rights, and judicial assistance for military families.

articles.summary_en: The exhibition of outstanding stage art works celebrating the 105th anniversary of the CPC kicks off on July 31, 2026 in Beijing. Hosted by the Central Publicity Department and the Ministry of Culture and Tourism, 12 works will be performed through September.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the BeiDou-3 system marked its sixth anniversary, showcasing its positioning technology in road safety and cross-border farming, with products exported to over 140 countries.

articles.title_zh: 菲尔兹奖双星的数学人生
articles.title_en: Two Chinese Mathematicians Awarded Fields Medal

articles.summary_en: On July 23, 2026, at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Philadelphia, Chinese scholars Wang Hong and Deng Yu won the Fields Medal, the first time Chinese nationals received the award.

articles.title_en: Navigation Warning! Military Mission in Bohai Strait and Northern Yellow Sea, Entry Prohibited

articles.summary_en: Dalian Maritime Safety Administration issued a navigation warning that military missions will be held in parts of the Bohai Strait and northern Yellow Sea from 16:00 Aug 2 to 16:00 Aug 16, and entry is prohibited.

articles.title_zh: 北斗卫星导航系统已全面完成在轨升级
articles.title_en: BeiDou Navigation Satellite System Completes Full In-orbit Upgrade

articles.summary_en: China's Satellite Navigation System Administration announced on July 31 that the BeiDou system has completed its in-orbit upgrade, aiming to provide more stable and reliable positioning, navigation and timing services.

articles.title_zh: 中国专家手把手教我们过上好日子
articles.title_en: Chinese Experts Teach Us How to Live a Better Life
articles.summary_zh: 中埃塞农业合作减贫示范村首批试点项目实施一年多来，中国专家在埃塞俄比亚戈迪诺村手把手传授农业技术，帮助村民增收脱贫，取得切实成效。
articles.summary_en: The first pilot project of the China-Ethiopia agricultural cooperation poverty reduction demonstration village has made concrete progress over the past year, as Chinese experts taught local villagers farming skills and helped them increase income.

articles.title_zh: 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想 推动新时代新征程纪检监察工作高质量发展
articles.title_en: Deeply Study and Implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building to Promote High-Quality Development of Discipline Inspection and Supervision in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委机关在《人民日报》发表署名文章，强调深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，推动新时代新征程纪检监察工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The central disciplinary body published a signed article in People's Daily, stressing to fully implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building for high-quality discipline inspection and supervision in the new era.

articles.title_zh: 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作
articles.title_en: Politburo Meeting Decides to Convene Fifth Plenary Session, Analyzes Economic Situation
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月召开二十届五中全会，研究全面从严治党，分析经济形势，部署下半年经济工作。习近平主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee Politburo met on July 30, deciding to convene the Fifth Plenary Session in October to study full and rigorous Party self-governance, analyze the economic situation, and arrange H2 economic work. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 三个视角看电力供需新变化
articles.title_en: Three Perspectives on New Changes in Electricity Supply and Demand
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局数据显示，上半年全社会用电量同比增长5.3%，可再生能源发电量占比首次超四成，能源结构持续优化。
articles.summary_en: Data from the National Energy Administration shows first-half electricity consumption up 5.3% year on year, with renewable generation exceeding 40% of total for the first time, reflecting ongoing energy structure optimization.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会举办2026年第3期全国人大代表学习班
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Holds 2026 Third Session of Training for NPC Deputies

articles.summary_en: From July 27 to 29, the NPC Standing Committee held the 2026 third training session for NPC deputies in Hebei, with 187 deputies studying the Law on Promoting Ethnic Unity and Progress.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央召开党外人士座谈会
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Holds Symposium with Non-Party Personages

articles.summary_en: On July 24, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium with non-party personages in Zhongnanhai. Xi Jinping presided and delivered an important speech, listening to opinions on the current economic situation and H2 economic work.

articles.title_zh: 向着建军一百年奋斗目标阔步前行
articles.title_en: Striding Forward to the Centenary Goal of the People's Army
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节前夕，新华社综述回顾以习近平同志为核心的党中央引领人民军队强军兴军、推进国防和军队现代化建设的成就，强调打好实现建军一百年奋斗目标攻坚战。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Xinhua reviews the achievements of the Party Central Committee led by Xi Jinping in guiding the PLA's strengthening and modernization, stressing efforts to achieve the centenary goal of building a strong military.

articles.title_en: Innovative Formats Bring Policy Briefings to Life

articles.summary_en: Youjiang District in Baise, Guangxi integrates social sciences with folk arts to deliver party theory briefings, holding over 60 interactive sessions since 2025.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Accelerate Building a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记2026年3月6日在全国政协联组会上发表讲话，强调到2035年建成健康中国的战略目标，要求统筹谋划、加紧推进。
articles.summary_en: In a speech on March 6, 2026, Xi Jinping stressed the strategic goal of building a Healthy China by 2035 and called for coordinated planning and accelerated progress.

articles.title_zh: 红色研学热 转型动能足
articles.title_en: Red Study Tour Boom Drives Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江大庆赓续红色基因，发展红色研学游，上半年接待游客175万人次；同时加快页岩油开发与产业转型，油与非油产业比值调整至31.3:68.7。
articles.summary_en: Daqing, Heilongjiang, promotes red-tourism study tours, receiving 1.75 million visitors in H1, while accelerating shale oil development and industrial transformation, with non-oil industry value accounting for 68.7%.

articles.title_zh: 加快建设健康中国
articles.title_en: Accelerating the Construction of a Healthy China
articles.summary_zh: 7月21日，国家卫生健康委党组书记、主任雷海潮在形势政策系列报告会上作“加快建设健康中国”专题报告，总结历史成就并部署“十五五”重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On July 21, Lei Haichao, Secretary of the Party Leadership Group and Director of the National Health Commission, delivered a special report titled 'Accelerating the Construction of a Healthy China' at a series of policy briefings, summarizing achievements and outlining key tasks for the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 养老服务消费补贴惠及约200万名中度以上失能老年人
articles.title_en: Elderly Care Consumption Subsidies Benefit About 2 Million Disabled Seniors

articles.summary_en: At a July 30 press conference, the Ministry of Civil Affairs said the elderly care consumption subsidy program had redeemed 10.7992 million vouchers worth 6.512 billion yuan, benefiting about 2 million moderately or severely disabled seniors.

articles.title_zh: 人民军队永远跟党走
articles.title_en: People's Army Forever Follows the Party

articles.summary_en: The article highlights the stories of PLA model units and individuals awarded the national 'Two Excellent and One Advanced' titles, showcasing their loyalty to the Party and commitment to military strengthening.

articles.title_zh: 长春市委常委会召开会议 部署开发区改革和高质量发展

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of the Changchun Municipal Party Committee, chaired a meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and arrange reforms of development zones and public security work.

articles.title_zh: 顾刚走访慰问驻长部队和优抚对象

articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Gu Gang, Deputy Secretary of Changchun Municipal Committee and Mayor, visited troops stationed in Changchun and recipients of special care, conveying holiday greetings on behalf of the municipal party committee and government.

articles.title_zh: 张恩惠走访慰问驻长部队官兵和优抚对象代表
articles.title_en: Zhang Enhui Visits Troops and Veterans' Representatives in Changchun
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节前夕，长春市委书记张恩惠走访慰问驻长部队官兵和抗美援朝老战士，强调做好双拥工作。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Zhang Enhui, Secretary of Changchun Municipal Party Committee, visited officers and soldiers stationed in Changchun and a veteran of the Korean War, emphasizing the importance of supporting the military and caring for their families.

articles.summary_en: On July 29, Zhuang Jinsong, secretary of the CPC Changdu Municipal Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and Wang Huning's remarks during his research trip in Tibet, and to plan implementation.

articles.title_zh: 霍步刚“八一”前夕走访慰问武警部队和参战退役军人
articles.title_en: Huo Bugang Visits Armed Police and Veterans Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，沈阳市委书记霍步刚走访慰问武警部队和参战退役军人，强调传承军爱民民拥军传统，巩固军政军民团结。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Huo Bugang, Secretary of the Shenyang Municipal Party Committee, visited armed police and veterans, stressing military-civilian unity and honoring revolutionary heroes.

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记关于上半年经济形势和做好下半年经济工作的重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Chairs State Council Executive Meeting to Implement Xi Jinping's Guidance on Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国务院总理李强主持召开国务院常务会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，听取新型电网、物流网建设情况汇报，研究健康优先发展战略，审议通过多项行政法规草案，并核准辽宁庄河等四个核电项目。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to study Xi Jinping's important speech on the economic situation, review new power grid and logistics network plans, discuss health-first development, approve draft regulations, and greenlight four nuclear power projects including Zhuanghe Phase I.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令 公布《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Order Promulgating Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》，自2026年9月15日起施行，规范出境入境管理。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council order to promulgate the Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration, effective September 15, 2026, to regulate exit-entry management.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于出境入境管理的规定
articles.title_en: State Council Regulations on Exit and Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 国务院公布第841号令，通过《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》，自2026年9月15日起施行，规范出境入境秩序。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued Order No.841, adopting the Regulations on Exit and Entry Administration, effective September 15, 2026, to regulate exit-entry order.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《知识产权保护和运用“十五五”规划》

articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for IP Protection and Utilization, outlining tasks in IP creation, application, protection, management, and services, aiming for decisive progress in building an IP power by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 政策发力提效 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展
articles.title_en: Policy Efforts to Boost Economy for Sustained, High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委7月31日表示，下半年宏观政策将发力提效，确保完成全年预期目标；将协同推进重大工程和“两重”“两新”建设，稳定提振消费，加快人工智能产业布局等。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the National Development and Reform Commission said macro policies will be intensified in H2 to meet annual targets, advance major projects, boost consumption, and accelerate AI development.

articles.title_zh: 我国推动退役军人工作提质增效
articles.title_en: China Promotes Quality and Efficiency of Veterans Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室7月31日举行发布会，退役军人事务部介绍“十五五”时期推动退役军人工作提质增效情况，包括拓宽安置渠道、完善就业创业支持体系等。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the State Council Information Office hosted a press conference where the Ministry of Veterans Affairs introduced plans to enhance veterans work, including wider placement channels and better employment support.

articles.title_zh: 陈文清在全国扫黑除恶专项斗争视频会议上强调 扎实开展深化扫黑除恶专项斗争 努力建设更高水平的平安中国
articles.title_en: Chen Wenqing Stresses Deepening Campaign Against Organized Crime at National Video Conference

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Chen Wenqing, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, stressed at a national video conference to carry out a one-year campaign to deepen the special fight against organized crime and build a safer China.

Xi Jinping presided and delivered an important speech, emphasizing political leadership and innovative development to achieve the centenary goal of the People's Liberation Army.

articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on July 31 to study the spirit of President Xi's remarks on the economy, and approved amendments to regulations and four nuclear power projects.

articles.title_zh: 今年7550亿元中央预算内投资基本下达完毕

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee held a meeting to analyze the economic situation and arrange work for the second half of the year, emphasizing sustained progress towards new, quality, and favorable economic development.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Politburo Meets to Decide Fifth Plenary Session and Analyze Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月召开二十届五中全会，研究全面从严治党重大问题，分析当前经济形势并部署下半年经济工作。习近平主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The Politburo of the CPC Central Committee met on July 30, deciding to convene the Fifth Plenary Session in October, studying major issues of full and rigorous Party self-governance, analyzing the current economic situation, and deploying H2 economic work. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting.

Party Secretary Xu Kunlin chaired and spoke.

Zhao Zhenglan, Party Group Secretary and Chairman, presided over and delivered a speech, emphasizing a correct view of political achievements and deploying next-stage key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 市人大常委会党组理论学习中心组学习会、主任月度办公会召开

Zhou Qing chaired and addressed the meeting, conveying the spirit of Xi Jinping's Party building anthology and other documents, and deploying key tasks for the next stage.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Huai'an held an industry-academia-research matching event. Municipal Party Secretary Shi Zhijun addressed the meeting, academician Shen Zhengchang delivered a keynote speech, key cooperation projects were signed, and the Torch Sci-Tech Achievements Express was launched.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Huaian hosted an industry-university-research matchmaking event. City Party Secretary Shi Zhijun addressed the event, and CAE academician Shen Zhengchang delivered a keynote speech to promote tech transfer.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议 逯峰主持会议

articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，汕尾市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署人工智能发展、城市建设、地质灾害防范和党风廉政建设等工作。市委书记逯峰主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of the CPC Shanwei Municipal Committee met to study Xi Jinping's instructions and plan work on AI, urban construction, disaster prevention, and party discipline. Secretary Lu Feng presided.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议研究部署多项工作 逯峰主持会议
articles.title_en: Shanwei Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Held, Lu Feng Chairs
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，汕尾市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神，研究部署人工智能发展、城市建设、地质灾害防范和党风廉政建设等工作，市委书记逯峰主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Standing Committee of the Shanwei Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speeches and instructions, and to plan work on AI development, urban construction, geological disaster prevention, and Party conduct and integrity. Secretary Lu Feng chaired the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞调研国资国企改革并主持召开座谈会
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Investigates SOE Reform and Chairs Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日至30日，宁夏回族自治区党委书记李邑飞调研区属国有企业并召开座谈会，强调深化国资国企改革，推动做强做优做大。
articles.summary_en: From July 28 to 30, Li Yifei, Secretary of CPC Ningxia Regional Committee, inspected provincial SOEs and chaired a symposium, urging deeper reforms to strengthen state-owned assets and enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Tai'an Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，泰安市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记主旨讲话和重要指示精神，听取全面从严治党责任述职，研究高标准农田建设整治等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Standing Committee of Tai'an Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's keynote speech and important instructions, hear reports on strict party self-governance responsibilities, and discuss high-standard farmland construction rectification.

articles.title_zh: 姜冬冬会见中国建设银行江苏省分行党委书记邹致师
articles.title_en: Jiang Dongdong Meets with Zou Zhishi, CCB Jiangsu Branch Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，泰州市委书记姜冬冬会见建设银行江苏省分行党委书记邹致师一行，双方就深化合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Jiang Dongdong, Party Secretary of Taizhou, met with Zou Zhishi, Party Secretary of CCB Jiangsu Branch, to discuss deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议举行第二次全体会议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Second Plenary Meeting of 23rd Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议举行第二次全体会议，听取并审议预算调整、经济运行、人工智能发展等多项报告。
articles.summary_en: On July 30 morning, the 23rd session of the 14th Standing Committee of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress held its second plenary meeting to hear and deliberate reports on budget adjustment, economic performance, and AI development.

articles.title_zh: 市领导与部队官兵同过“军事日”
articles.title_en: Weihai Leaders Mark Military Day with Naval Troops
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，威海市领导张海波等走访慰问驻威海军某部，与官兵同过“军事日”，接受国防教育，强调军地团结。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Weihai city leaders led by Zhang Haibo visited a naval unit, participated in 'Military Day' activities, and emphasized military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 徐志主持召开市政府第126次常务会议
articles.title_en: Xu Zhi Chairs 126th Executive Meeting of Wuhu Municipal Government
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，芜湖市委副书记、市长徐志主持召开市政府第126次常务会议，审议人力资源服务业与制造业融合发展试点方案和培育“美好生活主理人”经济三年行动方案等。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Xu Zhi, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Wuhu Municipal Committee and Mayor, chaired the 126th executive meeting of the municipal government, reviewing pilot plans for integrating human resources services with manufacturing and a three-year action plan for nurturing the "better-life conductor" economy.

articles.title_zh: 无锡市委召开习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想季度研讨交流会
articles.title_en: Wuxi Municipal Party Committee Holds Quarterly Symposium on Xi Jinping Thought
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，无锡市委召开习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想季度研讨交流会，市委书记杜小刚主持并讲话，强调党建引领、走好群众路线、创新基层治理。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Wuxi Municipal Party Committee held a quarterly symposium on Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. Party Secretary Du Xiaogang presided and emphasized Party building and grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 中共陕西省委十四届十次全会在西安举行 审议通过区域发展战略意见
articles.title_en: 10th Plenary Session of CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee Held in Xi'an, Approves Regional Development Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共陕西省委十四届十次全会在西安举行，听取省委常委会工作报告，审议通过《关于全面实施“双极带动、多点支撑、三区协同”区域发展战略的意见》，赵一德讲话，赵刚安排经济工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the 10th Plenary Session of the 14th CPC Shaanxi Provincial Committee was held in Xi'an. It reviewed the work report of the Standing Committee and approved the Opinions on Implementing the "Dual-pole Drive, Multi-point Support, Three-zone Coordination" regional development strategy.
keywords: 双极带动多点支撑三区协同

articles.title_zh: 盐城市领导开展“八一”走访慰问活动
articles.title_en: Yancheng Leaders Conduct Army Day Visits to Troops and Firefighters
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，盐城市委书记严汉平、代市长吴炜等市领导分别走访慰问驻盐部队和消防救援队伍，致以节日问候和崇高敬意。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Yancheng Party Secretary Yan Hanping and acting Mayor Wu Wei visited troops and fire rescue teams stationed in Yancheng to extend festive greetings and high respect.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平到银宝集团调研
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Investigates Yinbao Group
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，盐城市委书记严汉平到银宝集团调研，强调围绕大农业做足大文章，争当科技强农主力军。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 30, Yan Hanping, Secretary of the Yancheng Municipal Party Committee, visited Yinbao Group, emphasizing efforts to strengthen agriculture and become a main force in agricultural technology.

tags.name_en: Strengthening Agriculture with Science and Technology

tags_en: Strengthening Agriculture with Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人工智能产业联盟成立暨2026人工智能赋能产业创新发展会议在宁召开
articles.title_en: Jiangsu AI Industry Alliance Inaugurated, 2026 AI-Empowered Industrial Innovation Conference Held in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，江苏省人工智能产业联盟成立暨2026人工智能赋能产业创新发展会议在南京召开，省委常委、常务副省长马欣出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Jiangsu AI Industry Alliance was inaugurated and the 2026 AI-Empowered Industrial Innovation Conference was held in Nanjing. Ma Xin, Standing Committee Member and Executive Vice Governor of Jiangsu, attended and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议举行第二次全体会议
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Second Plenary Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议举行第二次全体会议，听取并审议地方政府债务、预算调整、上半年经济计划执行、人工智能发展等多项报告。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 30, the 23rd Session of the 14th Standing Committee of Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress held its second plenary meeting, hearing reports on local government debt limits, budget adjustments, and AI development.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央召开党外人士座谈会 习近平主持并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Holds Symposium with Non-Party Personages, Xi Jinping Chairs and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，中共中央在中南海召开党外人士座谈会，就当前经济形势和下半年经济工作听取意见建议，习近平主持并发表重要讲话，李强通报有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium in Zhongnanhai with non-party personages to solicit opinions on the current economic situation and H2 economic work. Xi Jinping chaired and delivered an important speech; Li Qiang briefed on relevant situations.

articles.title_zh: 卢一先到阳春市督导检查防汛工作
articles.title_en: Lu Yixian Inspects Flood Control Work in Yangchun
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，阳江市委书记卢一先到阳春市督导检查防汛工作，强调压实责任、排查隐患、确保安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Lu Yixian, Secretary of the Yangjiang Municipal Party Committee, supervised flood control work in Yangchun, emphasizing responsibility and risk screening to ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 银川市委常委会召开会议 学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 部署防汛备汛和项目建设工作
articles.title_en: Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meets to Study Xi Jinping's Important Instructions and Arrange Flood Prevention and Project Construction
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，银川市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对基础教育工作的重要指示精神，听取防汛排涝及救灾情况汇报，部署防汛备汛、项目建设等工作。自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Standing Committee of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee held a meeting to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on basic education, hear reports on flood control, drainage and disaster relief, and arrange flood preparedness, project construction and other work. Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Ningxia Autonomous Region Committee and Secretary of the Yinchuan Municipal Party Committee, presided over and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 赵旭辉调研自治区第十七届运动会筹备推进情况
articles.title_en: Zhao Xuhui Inspects Preparations for the 17th Autonomous Regional Games
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，自治区党委常委、银川市委书记赵旭辉调研自治区第十七届运动会筹备工作，强调高标准高质量推进，展现城市形象。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Zhao Xuhui, member of the Standing Committee of the Autonomous Regional Party Committee and Party Secretary of Yinchuan, inspected preparations for the 17th Autonomous Regional Games, emphasizing high standards to showcase the city's image.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会召开第四十次会议
articles.title_en: Yingkou Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 40th Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，营口市十七届人大常委会召开第四十次会议，审议多项报告和法规，并任命胡哲为市监委代理主任，韩冰、高峰为副市长。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Yingkou's 17th Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held its 40th session, reviewing reports and regulations, and appointing Hu Zhe as acting head of the municipal supervision commission, and Han Bing and Gao Feng as vice mayors.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Holds Video Call with U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer
articles.summary_zh: 北京时间7月30日晚，国务院副总理何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔视频通话，就中美经贸关系等进行坦诚深入交流，中方就美对华经贸限制表达关切。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of July 30, Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer, conducting candid and in-depth exchanges on bilateral trade ties and expressing concerns over U.S. restrictions.

articles.title_zh: 推动经济持续向新向优向好发展——从中央政治局会议看下半年经济工作着力点
articles.title_en: Politburo Meeting Sets Economic Priorities for Second Half of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局召开会议，分析研究当前经济形势，部署下半年经济工作，强调推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met to analyze the economic situation and set priorities for H2 work, emphasizing sustained innovation, optimization, and sound development of the economy.

tags_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee

articles.title_zh: 王予波：锲而不舍抓好湖泊保护治理 放大优势加快产业转型升级
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Emphasizes Persistent Lake Protection and Accelerated Industrial Transformation during Yuxi Research Visit
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日至30日，云南省省长王予波在玉溪市调研，强调锲而不舍抓好湖泊保护治理，放大优势加快产业转型升级，并实地考察新能源、物流和农业企业。
articles.summary_en: From July 29 to 30, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo inspected Yuxi, stressing persistent lake protection and accelerated industrial transformation, and visited new energy, logistics, and agricultural enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 市九届人大常委会举行第86次主任会议
articles.title_en: Yueyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds 86th Director Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，岳阳市九届人大常委会举行第86次主任会议，听取多项报告并研究人事事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Standing Committee of the 9th Yueyang Municipal People's Congress held its 86th director meeting, hearing multiple reports and discussing personnel matters.

tags_en: Yueyang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee

articles.title_zh: 谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Xie Weijiang Chairs Meeting of Yueyang Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，省委副书记、岳阳市委书记谢卫江主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究部署城市更新、防汛和航空货运枢纽建设等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Xie Weijiang, Deputy Secretary of Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of Yueyang Municipal Party Committee, chaired a standing committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speech and discuss urban renewal, flood control, and airport cargo hub construction.

articles.title_zh: 余钢拜访中国气象局
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Visits China Meteorological Administration
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，湛江市委书记余钢赴北京拜访中国气象局，与局长陈振林座谈，双方就深化人工影响天气合作、气象赋能湛江高质量发展等深入交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang visited the China Meteorological Administration in Beijing and held talks with Director Chen Zhenlin on deepening weather modification cooperation and leveraging meteorology for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市雷州青年运河管理局第一党支部赴高州开展主题党日活动
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang Leizhou Youth Canal Administration Party Branch Holds Themed Party Day in Gaozhou
articles.summary_zh: 近日，湛江市雷州青年运河管理局第一党支部组织党员干部赴茂名高州开展主题党日活动，参观荔枝博物馆和贡园，重温总书记考察讲话，学习乡村振兴经验。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the First Party Branch of Leizhou Youth Canal Administration of Zhanjiang organized a themed party day in Gaozhou, Maoming, visiting the Lychee Museum and Gongyuan to study rural revitalization and the Party leader's directives.

articles.title_zh: 黄玉国调研平漯周高铁项目及高铁西站路网建设情况
articles.title_en: Huang Yuguo Inspects Ping-Luo-Zhou High-Speed Rail Project and West Station Road Network
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，市委书记黄玉国到中心城区和商水县调研平漯周高铁项目及高铁西站路网建设情况，强调要加快项目建设进度。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Huang Yuguo, Party Secretary of Zhoukou, inspected the Ping-Luo-Zhou high-speed rail project and the road network around the high-speed rail west station, urging accelerated construction.

articles.title_zh: 吴泽桐看望慰问驻珠部队官兵并检查海岛防风防汛工作
articles.title_en: Wu Zetong Visits Troops in Zhuhai and Inspects Wind and Flood Prevention Work on Islands
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，珠海市委副书记、市长吴泽桐赴高新区、万山区慰问驻珠部队官兵，并检查海岛防风防汛工作，强调防范地质灾害、加强海上安全管理。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Wu Zetong, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Zhuhai, visited troops stationed in Zhuhai in Gaoxin and Wanshan districts, and inspected island wind and flood prevention work, emphasizing geological disaster prevention and maritime safety.

articles.title_zh: 国务院关于出境入境管理的规定
articles.title_en: State Council Promulgates Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 国务院公布《出境入境管理规定》，李强签署国务院令，自2026年9月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the Regulations on Exit-Entry Administration, signed by Premier Li Qiang, effective from September 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会召开扩大会议传达学习习近平总书记重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Holds Enlarged Meeting to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，省委常委会召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记对侨务工作和基础教育工作的重要指示精神，研究审议有关工作事项，省委书记林武主持会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 30 morning, the provincial party committee held an enlarged meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions on overseas Chinese affairs and basic education, and discussed related work. Secretary Lin Wu chaired and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 全省退役军人代表座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Veterans Representatives Symposium Held in Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，山东省退役军人代表座谈会在济南召开，省委书记林武讲话，省长周乃翔主持，强调做好退役军人服务保障工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30 afternoon, Shandong held a veterans representatives symposium in Jinan. Party Secretary Lin Wu delivered a speech and Governor Zhou Naixiang presided, emphasizing support for veterans.

articles.title_zh: 商务部：拟确定32个城市为第二批全国零售业创新提升试点城市
articles.title_en: Ministry of Commerce Plans to Designate 32 Cities as Second Batch of Pilot Cities for Retail Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 商务部会同有关部门评审，拟确定32个城市为第二批全国零售业创新提升试点城市，并予以公示。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce and related departments selected 32 cities as the second batch of pilot cities for retail innovation and published the result for public comment.

articles.title_zh: 中疾控最新数据：新冠阳性率超20%，强度与前两年相当
articles.title_en: China CDC: COVID-19 Positivity Rate Exceeds 20%, Similar Intensity to Previous Two Years
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中国疾控中心发布第30周急性呼吸道传染病哨点监测数据，显示新冠阳性率超20%，属周期性波动，以轻型感染为主。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, China CDC released sentinel surveillance data for week 30, showing COVID-19 positivity rate over 20%, a periodic fluctuation with mostly mild cases.

articles.title_zh: 国家能源局：上半年中国煤电发电量占比首次低于50%
articles.title_en: China's Coal Power Share Drops Below 50% for First Time in First Half: NEA
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，国家能源局举行新闻发布会介绍上半年能源形势，煤电发电量占比降至49.7%，可再生能源发电量占比首超四成。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the National Energy Administration held a press conference on H1 energy situation: coal power share fell to 49.7%, while renewable power exceeded 40% for the first time.

articles.title_zh: 最高检发布典型案例：陈某破坏军婚，被判刑六个月
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate Releases Typical Case: Chen Sentenced to Six Months for Disrupting Military Marriage

articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, the Supreme People's Procuratorate released a typical case in which Chen was sentenced to six months in prison for disrupting a military marriage.

articles.summary_en: The CCDI announced on July 31 that Xin Bao'an, former Party Secretary and Chairman of State Grid Corporation, is under investigation for suspected serious disciplinary violations.

articles.title_zh: 关于已满十二周岁不满十四周岁未成年人严重暴力犯罪，两部门出新规

articles.summary_en: On July 31, two departments issued new rules specifying legal application and procedures for handling serious violent crimes committed by minors aged 12-14.

articles.summary_en: On July 31, 2026, Guiding County's Culture and Tourism Bureau announced a joint investigation with police and market regulators into the 'companion drifting' service at Luobei River, promising timely disclosure of results.

articles.title_zh: 中央军委主席习近平签署通令，给1名个人记功
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Signs CMC Order to Award First-Class Merit to Individual
articles.summary_zh: 中央军委主席习近平日前签署通令，给解放军91548部队杨勇记国防科技一等功。杨勇是福建舰舰载机试飞员，曾成功处置万米高空座舱失密险情。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, recently signed an order to award Yang Yong of Unit 91548 a first-class merit for national defense science and technology. Yang, a test pilot for carrier-based aircraft, previously handled a cockpit decompression emergency at 10,000 meters.

articles.title_zh: 我国将开展为期一年的深化扫黑除恶专项斗争
articles.title_en: China to Launch Year-long Special Campaign Against Organized Crime
articles.summary_zh: 我国宣布将开展为期一年的深化扫黑除恶专项斗争，进一步打击黑恶势力犯罪。
articles.summary_en: China has announced a year-long special campaign to deepen the fight against organized crime and local mafia-like gangs.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古中铁建一在建项目塌方，4人死亡
articles.title_en: Collapse at China Railway Construction Project in Inner Mongolia Kills 4
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古一由中国铁建承建的在建项目发生塌方事故，造成4人死亡。
articles.summary_en: A collapse at a China Railway Construction project under construction in Inner Mongolia killed 4 people.

articles.title_zh: 河北省召开全省领导干部会议 宣布中央关于河北省委主要领导调整的决定
articles.title_en: Hebei Holds Provincial Leaders Meeting to Announce Central Decision on Adjustment of Provincial Party Committee Leadership
articles.summary_zh: 河北省召开全省领导干部会议，中央组织部副部长黄建发宣布中央决定，罗文任河北省委书记，倪岳峰主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province held a meeting of leading cadres to announce the CPC Central Committee's decision on adjusting the provincial party committee's main leadership, with Luo Wen appointed as secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 王正谱在雄安新区走访慰问退役军人和优抚对象
articles.title_en: Wang Zhengpu Visits Veterans and Dependents in Xiong'an New Area
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，河北省省长王正谱在雄安新区走访慰问退役军人和优抚对象，代表省委、省政府致以节日问候，并调研防汛救援工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Wang Zhengpu, governor of Hebei Province, visited veterans and their families in Xiong'an New Area to extend holiday greetings, and inspected flood control and rescue teams.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能、“六张网”……这些产业澎湃中国经济新动能
articles.title_en: AI, 'Six Networks' and Other Industries Power New Momentum for China's Economy
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委举行7月份新闻发布会，介绍109项重大工程加快实施、人工智能产业增长超30%、7550亿元中央预算内投资基本下达等内容。
articles.summary_en: At the National Development and Reform Commission's July press conference, it was announced that 109 major projects are advancing, AI industry growth exceeds 30%, and 755 billion yuan of central budget investment has been basically allocated.

articles.title_zh: 斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼用“印象深刻”总结访华之行
articles.title_en: Slovak President Pellegrini Sums Up China Visit as 'Impressive'
articles.summary_zh: 斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼就任以来首次对中国进行国事访问，他在接受总台记者采访时表示，北京的城市面貌和基础设施建设令其印象深刻，与十年前相比中国变化巨大。
articles.summary_en: Slovak President Pellegrini made his first state visit to China since taking office. In an interview with CMG, he said he was deeply impressed by Beijing's urban landscape and infrastructure, and noted China's tremendous changes compared with ten years ago.

articles.title_zh: 我国加快形成扩大居民消费长效机制观察
articles.title_en: China Accelerates Building Long-Term Mechanism to Expand Resident Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 新华社7月30日报道，我国通过稳就业、促增收、完善社保等多举措，加快形成扩大居民消费长效机制，为“十五五”消费扩量提质奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Xinhua reported that China is taking multiple measures—stabilizing employment, boosting incomes, and improving social security—to build a long-term mechanism for expanding resident consumption, laying the foundation for consumption growth during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 福州市“八一”军政座谈会举行
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Holds 'August 1st' Military-Civilian Symposium
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，福州市举行“八一”军政座谈会，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁与市长吴贤德走访慰问驻榕部队并出席，共叙军民鱼水情，共商军地新发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Fuzhou held a military-civilian symposium for Army Day. Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Party Secretary of Fuzhou, and Mayor Wu Xiande visited stationed troops and attended the meeting to promote military-civilian unity.

articles.title_zh: 市委召开上半年工作会议
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Municipal Party Committee Holds Mid-Year Work Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，福州召开市委上半年工作会议，省委副书记、市委书记郭宁宁出席并讲话，强调坚定信心、攻坚三季度、决胜全年红，市长吴贤德主持并部署工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Fuzhou held its mid-year municipal party committee work meeting. Guo Ningning, deputy secretary of the provincial party committee and municipal party secretary, stressed confidence and striving for a strong second half, while Mayor Wu Xiande presided and outlined tasks.

articles.title_zh: 吴贤德在城区督导检查生态环境保护工作并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动
articles.title_en: Wu Xiande Inspects Eco-Environmental Protection Work in Urban Fuzhou and Launches 'River Care and Clean Home' Activity
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，福州市长吴贤德在晋安区、鼓楼区督导检查生态环保督察问题整改，并开展“护河爱水、清洁家园”活动，强调以高水平保护支撑高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Fuzhou Mayor Wu Xiande inspected rectification of ecological and environmental issues in Jin'an and Gulou districts and launched a 'River Care and Clean Home' campaign, stressing high-level protection to support high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: "博创八闽"绿色低碳与新能源专场在厦举行
articles.title_en: 'Bo Chuang Ba Min' Green Low-Carbon and New Energy Special Session Held in Xiamen
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日至30日，绿色低碳与新能源专场对接活动在厦门嘉庚创新实验室举行，100余人参会，征集31个优质项目，多家企业达成初步合作意向。
articles.summary_en: From July 29 to 30, the 'Bo Chuang Ba Min' monthly matchmaking event on green low-carbon and new energy was held at Jiageng Innovation Laboratory in Xiamen, attracting over 100 participants. 31 quality projects were collected, and several companies reached preliminary cooperation intentions.

articles.title_zh: 中斯友谊之树根深叶茂
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Slovak President, Vowing to Deepen Strategic Partnership
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，习近平主席在人民大会堂同斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼举行会谈，强调打造中斯战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, President Xi Jinping held talks with Slovak President Pellegrini at the Great Hall of the People, vowing to build a China-Slovakia strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 济滨、济枣高铁建设有序推进 济南“米字型”高铁网加快成形
articles.title_en: Jinan-Binzhou and Jinan-Zaozhuang High-Speed Rail Construction Advances, Jinan's 'Spoke-Shaped' Network Takes Shape
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，山东省省长周乃翔在济南、滨州调研铁路建设，要求保障济滨高铁年内通车，加快济枣等高铁项目建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang visited Jinan and Binzhou to inspect railway projects, urging timely opening of the Jinan-Binzhou HSR and faster progress on other lines.

articles.title_zh: 奔腾中国·质胜未来丨既要“放得活”，又要“管得好”
articles.title_en: Galloping China · Quality Wins the Future | A Balance of 'Letting Go' and 'Managing Well'
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局在7省市开展强制清算试点推动“僵尸企业”退出，文章阐述既要“放得活”又要“管得好”，构建高水平市场经济体制。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation launched a pilot in seven provinces to force liquidation of 'zombie companies', illustrating the balance between an effective market and a proactive government.

articles.title_zh: 趵眼丨一束光和一颗星，照见济南向上生长的力量
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Tours High-Tech, Satellite Firms and University in Jinan
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日至29日，山东省委书记林武在济南调研邦德激光、济南卫星、山东科技大市场、山东大学，强调产业、科技、创新一体化推进。
articles.summary_en: From July 28 to 29, Shandong Party Secretary Lin Wu visited Bond Laser, Jinan Satellite, Shandong S&T Market and Shandong University in Jinan, stressing integrated industrial and technological innovation.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能、“六张网”……这些产业澎湃中国经济新动能

articles.summary_en: At the July press conference, the NDRC said 109 major projects are accelerating, AI industry grew over 30%, and 755 billion yuan of central budget investment has been basically allocated.

articles.title_zh: 王晓晖施小琳于立军率省委省政府慰问团走访慰问驻川部队
articles.title_en: Wang Xiaohui, Shi Xiaolin, and Yu Lijun Lead Provincial Delegation to Visit Troops in Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 在建军99周年之际，四川省委书记王晓晖、省长施小琳、省委副书记于立军率慰问团走访驻川部队，向官兵致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On the occasion of the 99th anniversary of the PLA, Sichuan Provincial Party Secretary Wang Xiaohui, Governor Shi Xiaolin, and Deputy Party Secretary Yu Lijun led a delegation to visit troops stationed in Sichuan, extending holiday greetings.

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Land-Sea Financial and Economic Forum was held in Kuala Lumpur on July 30, where Chinese and Malaysian political, business, and academic representatives discussed AI-empowered industrial upgrading and new opportunities for economic and trade cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应日本设立“国家情报局”：日方应深刻汲取历史教训 慎重行事
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to Japan's Establishment of 'National Intelligence Agency': Japan Should Learn from History and Act with Caution

articles.summary_en: On July 31, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning responded to Japan's establishment of a 'National Intelligence Agency', saying Japan should learn from historical lessons and act prudently.

articles.title_zh: 用好机遇优势 克服困难挑战——国家发展改革委解读当前经济热点
articles.title_en: Seize Opportunities, Overcome Challenges: NDRC Interprets Current Economic Hotspots

articles.summary_en: The NDRC held a press conference on July 31 to interpret H1 economic performance and explain plans for infrastructure networks, domestic demand expansion, and energy development.

articles.title_zh: 国家发改委发布会：下半年经济工作释放重要信号
articles.title_en: NDRC Press Conference Signals Key Economic Priorities for H2
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国家发展改革委举行新闻发布会，表示我国经济长期向好趋势未变，将抓紧研究制定扩大内需战略实施方案，围绕提振消费、激发投资等发力。
articles.summary_en: At a July 31 press conference, NDRC said China's long-term economic fundamentals remain unchanged and will draft a strategy to boost domestic demand, focusing on consumption and investment.

articles.title_zh: 不断推动退役军人工作高质量发展——国新办发布会展望“十五五”时期退役军人工作发展前景
articles.title_en: Press Conference Outlines High-Quality Development of Veterans Affairs During 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国务院新闻办公室举行发布会，退役军人事务部部长裴金佳等介绍“十五五”时期退役军人工作高质量发展情况，涵盖安置就业、服务保障、优抚双拥等内容。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where veterans affairs officials outlined plans for high-quality development of veterans work during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, covering placement, employment, services, and support.

articles.title_zh: 金沙水拍云崖暖：云南推动长征精神与长江文化交融共生
articles.title_en: Yunnan Promotes Integration of Long March Spirit and Yangtze River Culture
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，云南依托金沙江沿线的红色遗址，推动长征精神与长江文化融合，建设长征国家文化公园，推出文旅研学路线。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, Yunnan promoted the integration of Long March spirit and Yangtze River culture along the Jinsha River, building a national cultural park and launching cultural tourism routes.

articles.title_zh: 柔性“电子皮肤”填补机器人“感知盲区”
articles.title_en: Flexible 'Electronic Skin' Bridges Robot Perception Gap
articles.summary_zh: 浙江清华柔性电子技术研究院研发柔性触觉感知末端，实现“电子皮肤”量产，填补机器人具身智能感知盲区，推动人工智能产业发展。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Tsinghua Flexible Electronics Technology Research Institute developed a flexible tactile sensing terminal, achieving mass production of 'electronic skin' that fills the perception gap in embodied AI robots, advancing the AI industry.

articles.summary_en: Slovak President Pellegrini made his first state visit to China, saying he was impressed by China's great changes over the past decade.

articles.title_zh: 00后“数采员”：给具身智能机器人当“老师”

articles.title_zh: 细读经济大省半年报：两省上半年GDP首次突破7万亿元

articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, six major economic provinces released data; Guangdong and Jiangsu's GDP exceeded 7 trillion yuan for the first time, with robust growth in emerging industries.

articles.title_zh: 信长星走访慰问驻苏部队子弟兵
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing Visits and Comforts Troops in Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 八一建军节来临之际，江苏省委书记信长星到东部战区空军某部走访慰问驻苏部队子弟兵，代表省委、省政府致以问候，并勉励官兵再立新功。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing visited an air force unit of the Eastern Theater Command to extend greetings to the troops on behalf of the provincial government and encourage them to achieve new merits.

articles.title_zh: AI时代，主流媒体如何孵化爆款IP？
articles.title_en: How Can Mainstream Media Cultivate Viral IPs in the AI Era?
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，由上海报业集团澎湃新闻主办的“逐浪·共生”2026外滩新媒体学术交流在上海举行，多家主流媒体代表探讨AI时代打造爆款IP的方法论。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 2026 Bund New Media Academic Exchange hosted by The Paper (Shanghai Media Group) was held in Shanghai, where representatives from major media outlets discussed methodologies for creating viral IPs in the AI era.

articles.title_zh: 锚定生态位、筑牢护城河，新传院长热议AI时代媒体变革

articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，上海报业集团澎湃新闻主办的2026外滩新媒体学术交流在上海举行，四所高校新闻学院院长围绕AI浪潮下的传播生态与媒体角色展开讨论。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the 2026 Bund New Media Academic Exchange hosted by The Paper (Shanghai United Media Group) was held in Shanghai, where deans from four universities discussed communication ecology and media roles amid the AI wave.

articles.title_zh: 三部门负责人就《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》答记者问
articles.title_en: Heads of Three Departments Answer Questions on State Council Regulation on Exit-Entry Administration
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署第841号国务院令，公布《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》，自2026年9月15日起施行，司法部、公安部、国家移民局负责人就规定答记者问。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed State Council Order No. 841, promulgating the Regulation on Exit-Entry Administration, effective September 15, 2026. Heads of the Ministry of Justice, Ministry of Public Security, and National Immigration Administration answered questions on the regulation.

articles.title_zh: 国防部举办盛大招待会，热烈庆祝中国人民解放军建军99周年
articles.title_en: Ministry of National Defense Holds Grand Reception to Celebrate 99th Anniversary of PLA
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，国防部在北京人民大会堂举行招待会庆祝建军99周年，国防部长董军出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Ministry of National Defense held a reception at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing to celebrate the 99th anniversary of the PLA, with Defense Minister Dong Jun attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 中央纪委国家监委对群众身边不正之风和腐败问题集中整治工作再调度
articles.title_en: CCDI and National Supervisory Commission Hold Further Meeting on Rectifying Misconduct and Corruption
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，中央纪委国家监委召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记关于集中整治工作的重要批示精神，对集中整治再调度再推动，刘金国出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the CCDI and National Supervisory Commission held a meeting to convey Xi Jinping's instructions on intensifying the campaign against misconduct and corruption, with Liu Jinguo attending and speaking.

articles.title_en: The Paper 2026 New Media Academic Exchange Held, Releases Four Key Strategies for Deepening Systemic Reform

articles.summary_en: On July 31, the "Wave-Chasing Symbiosis" 2026 Bund New Media Academic Exchange hosted by The Paper, a Shanghai Media Group subsidiary, was held in Shanghai, unveiling four key strategies for deepening systemic reform.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省科技与产业融合创新协会量子科技专委会成立
articles.title_en: Anhui Quantum Technology Committee Established under Provincial Science & Industry Innovation Association
articles.summary_zh: 7月31日，安徽省科技与产业融合创新协会量子科技专委会在合肥成立，并发布全国首个省域量子产业专属金融产品体系。
articles.summary_en: On July 31, the Quantum Technology Committee of Anhui Provincial Science and Industry Innovation Association was established in Hefei, releasing the first provincial-level financial product system for the quantum industry.

articles.title_zh: 重庆通过两项立法护航科技创新
articles.title_en: Chongqing Passes Two Laws to Support Scientific and Technological Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，重庆市人大常委会表决通过两项科技创新立法，分别于9月1日和10月1日起施行，以法治护航科技创新。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal People's Congress approved two laws on scientific and technological innovation, effective from September 1 and October 1, to support innovation through legislation.

articles.title_zh: 彭水山体崩塌灾害抢险救援纪实
articles.title_en: Chronicle of Pengshui Mountain Collapse Rescue
articles.summary_zh: 7月17日彭水汉葭街道发生山体崩塌，习近平作重要指示，李强批示，张国清现场指导，重庆全力救援并安全转移1100余人。
articles.summary_en: On July 17, a mountain collapse hit Hanjia Street, Pengshui County. Xi Jinping issued important instructions, Li Qiang made instructions, and Zhang Guoqing guided on site. Chongqing carried out rescue and safely evacuated over 1,100 people.

articles.title_zh: 福建惠安：力拼“四个再上新台阶” 推动海丝现代化工贸港口旅游城市建设
articles.title_en: Fujian Hui'an Strives for 'Four New Leaps' to Build a Modern Maritime Silk Road Industrial, Trade, Port and Tourism City
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，中国共产党惠安县第十五次代表大会召开，县委书记黄育奇作报告，提出未来五年建设海丝现代化工贸港口旅游城市，并部署“四个再上新台阶”重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Hui'an County held its 15th Party Congress. Secretary Huang Yuqi's report set goals for building a Maritime Silk Road industrial/trade/port/tourism city and 'Four New Leaps' tasks.

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood control in Shaanxi and Gansu at 21:00 on the 30th to address heavy rain and flash flood risks.

articles.title_en: Guangxi Continues to Promote Implementation of Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，自治区政府新闻办举行新闻发布会，介绍广西学习贯彻落实《中华人民共和国民族团结进步促进法》情况及民族工作成效。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Information Office of the Autonomous Region Government held a press conference on the implementation of the Law on the Promotion of Ethnic Unity and Progress, highlighting Guangxi's achievements in ethnic work.

articles.summary_en: On July 29, the cold slide test for the overhead contact system of the Yulin North-Cenxi East section of the Nanzhu High-Speed Railway officially started, laying the foundation for subsequent power transmission and joint commissioning.

articles.title_zh: 南宁推出住房公积金“组合拳”促消费
articles.title_en: Nanning Introduces Housing Provident Fund Measures to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，南宁住房公积金管理委员会发布新政策，推出装修提取、车位购买、贷款提额、租房支持等六大惠民举措，自8月1日起实施，支持刚性和改善性住房需求。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Nanning Housing Provident Fund Management Committee issued new policies covering decoration withdrawal, parking space purchase, loan limits, and rental support, effective from August 1, to support rigid and improved housing needs.

articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，黎平古城翘街举行“叮叮糖”主题音乐会，该县以此为契机推出系列夏季文旅体活动，涵盖音乐会、篮球赛、村歌展演、农博展销等，以激活县域消费活力。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, a "Dingdingtang" themed concert was held at Qiaojie Street in Liping ancient town. The county launched a series of summer cultural and sports activities, including concerts, basketball games, village song performances, and agricultural expos, to boost local consumption.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“奔跑吧·少年”全国青少年阳光体育大会在郑州开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 'Run, Youth' National Youth Sunshine Sports Conference Opens in Zhengzhou
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日晚，2026年“奔跑吧·少年”全国青少年阳光体育大会在郑州开幕，国家体育总局局长高志丹与河南省委书记刘宁共同启动开幕，省长王凯出席。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of July 30, the 2026 'Run, Youth' National Youth Sunshine Sports Conference opened in Zhengzhou. Gao Zhidan, Director of the General Administration of Sport, and Liu Ning, Secretary of the Henan Provincial Party Committee jointly launched the event; Governor Wang Kai attended.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Liu Ning, Secretary of Henan Provincial Party Committee, visited troops in Kaifeng, expressing holiday greetings and sincere regards on behalf of the provincial party committee and government.

articles.title_en: Two Departments Deploy Pilot Program for Building Cultural Relics List of Administrative Place Names

articles.summary_en: The General Office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the General Office of the National Cultural Heritage Administration recently issued a notice to carry out pilot work on building a list of cultural relics related to administrative divisions and place names, selecting about 15 pilot areas nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 点石成金的河南魔法
articles.title_en: Henan's Magic of Turning Stone into Gold
articles.summary_zh: 河南立足矿产资源优势，推动钨钛、铜基材料、先进钢铁等产业升级，多家上市企业半年报业绩大涨，实现“点石成金”的转型发展。
articles.summary_en: Henan leverages its mineral resources to upgrade industries such as tungsten, copper-based materials, and advanced steel. Several listed companies reported doubled profits in half-year results, showcasing a transformation from raw resources to high-value products.

articles.title_zh: 上海建设6G未来产业培育区，探索新一代通信网应用场景
articles.title_en: Shanghai Builds 6G Future Industry Cultivation Zone to Explore New-Generation Communication Network Applications
articles.summary_zh: 上海松江区建设6G未来产业培育区，以6G信通智谷为核心，集聚产业链企业，探索6G技术应用场景，推动万物智联落地。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai's Songjiang District is building a 6G future industry cultivation zone centered on the 6G Infocom Valley, gathering industry chain enterprises to explore 6G application scenarios and advance the Internet of Everything.

articles.title_zh: 牢固树立和践行正确政绩观在高标准建设海南自由贸易港新征程中奋勇前进
articles.title_en: Firmly Establish and Practice Correct View of Political Achievements to Strive Forward on New Journey of High-Standard Construction of Hainan Free Trade Port
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，海南省委八届九次全会在海口召开，审议通过关于民主集中制和建设生态环境友好型自由贸易港的意见，省委书记冯飞讲话，强调树立和践行正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: The 9th Plenary Session of the 8th Hainan Provincial Committee of the CPC was held in Haikou on July 30, reviewing and approving opinions on democratic centralism and building an eco-friendly free trade port. Secretary Feng Fei called for establishing a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲：坚定不移抓招商上项目 塑造发展新动能新优势
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Stresses Firm Commitment to Investment and Projects for New Growth Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，黑龙江省省长梁惠玲在双鸭山市宝清县召开的省招商引资领导小组调度会上强调，要坚定不移抓招商上项目，培育新质生产力，塑造发展新动能新优势。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Governor Liang Huiling of Heilongjiang stressed at a meeting in Baoqing County, Shuangyashan, firm commitment to investment and projects to foster new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省发布“龙江农知大模型”

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the 'Longjiang Agricultural Knowledge AI Model' was officially released in Harbin, jointly developed by Heilongjiang Academy of Agricultural Sciences and the Agricultural Information Institute of CAAS, aiming to support modern agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省召开食品安全突出问题整治会议

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Heilongjiang Province held a meeting on food safety rectification, summarizing work since the beginning of the year and deploying key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 淮安发布产业工人大轮训实施方案
articles.title_en: Huaian Issues Implementation Plan for Large-Scale Training of Industrial Workers
articles.summary_zh: 淮安市总工会等八部门联合印发《淮安产业工人大轮训实施方案（2026—2030年）》，每年培训产业工人不少于20万人次，成为江苏首个落地该任务的设区市。
articles.summary_en: Huaian's trade union and seven other departments issued a plan to train industrial workers, aiming at no less than 200,000 trainees annually, making Huaian the first city in Jiangsu to implement the provincial task.

articles.title_zh: 江苏人工智能产业上半年营收超2400亿元
articles.title_en: Jiangsu AI Industry Revenue Exceeds 240 Billion Yuan in H1
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，江苏省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议审议省政府关于全面推动人工智能创新发展情况的报告。上半年全省人工智能产业营业收入2431.13亿元，同比增长17.32%。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Jiangsu's 14th Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee reviewed a government report on AI development, showing H1 2026 revenue of 243.113 billion yuan, up 17.32% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省人工智能产业联盟在南京成立
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Establishes AI Industry Alliance in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，江苏省人工智能产业联盟在南京成立，由240余家单位共同发起，并发布重点服务商推荐目录。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Jiangsu Artificial Intelligence Industry Alliance was established in Nanjing, initiated by over 240 organizations, with a recommended service provider list released.

articles.title_zh: 江苏发布全国首个OPC知识产权合规指引
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues Nation's First OPC IP Compliance Guidelines
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，江苏省知识产权局等三部门联合发布全国首个省级OPC知识产权合规指引，为人工智能“一人公司”提供知识产权合规指南。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, three Jiangsu provincial departments jointly issued the nation's first provincial-level OPC IP compliance guidelines, providing IP compliance guidance for AI 'one-person companies'.

articles.title_zh: 江西省领导“军事日”活动暨省委理论学习中心组集体学习举行
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Leaders Hold Military Day Event and Party Committee Theory Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，江西省领导“军事日”活动暨省委理论学习中心组集体学习在南昌举行，省委书记尹弘主持并讲话，强调深入学习贯彻习近平强军思想。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Jiangxi provincial leaders held a 'Military Day' activity and the Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center group study in Nanchang. Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong presided and stressed implementing Xi Jinping's thought on strengthening the military.

articles.summary_en: China Agricultural University team released Shennong AI model 4.0 and agricultural world model 1.0, boosting AI-enabled agriculture and modernization.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Standing Committee of the CPC Autonomous Regional Committee held a meeting to convey the spirit of the national conference of party school principals and hear reports on full and strict party governance and public security work. Wang Weizhong, Party secretary of the region, presided.

articles.title_zh: 包钢向自治区人大常委会组成人员和部分人大代表通报上半年全区经济社会发展情况
articles.title_en: Bao Gang Briefs Autonomous Regional People's Congress Standing Committee Members and Deputies on H1 Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日下午，自治区党委副书记、政府主席包钢向自治区人大常委会组成人员和部分人大代表通报上半年全区经济社会发展情况，并提出下半年重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 29, Bao Gang, Deputy Secretary of the Regional Party Committee and Chairman of the Regional Government, briefed members of the Standing Committee of the Regional People's Congress and some deputies on the economic and social development in the first half of the year, outlining key tasks for the second half.

articles.title_en: Personnel Adjustment of Hebei Provincial Party Committee Leadership

articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee has decided that Luo Wen will serve as Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, succeeding Ni Yuefeng who has been transferred to another post.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在中共中央政治局第二十七次集体学习时强调 强化政治引领 深化创新发展 高质量推进国防和军队现代化
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Chairs 27th Collective Study Session of CPC Central Political Bureau on National Defense and Military Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，中共中央政治局就高质量推进国防和军队现代化进行第二十七次集体学习，习近平主持并发表重要讲话，强调强化政治引领、深化创新发展，如期实现建军一百年奋斗目标。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 30, the 27th collective study session of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee on high-quality advancement of national defense and military modernization was held, chaired by Xi Jinping, who stressed political guidance and innovative development.

articles.title_zh: 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作
articles.title_en: Political Bureau Decides to Convene Fifth Plenary Session, Analyzes Economic Situation
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月召开二十届五中全会，研究全面从严治党，并分析经济形势部署下半年经济工作。习近平主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met on July 30, deciding to hold the Fifth Plenary Session in October, studied full and strict party governance, and analyzed the economic situation to arrange work for H2. Xi Jinping presided over the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 吴晓军罗东川等省领导在“八一”前夕看望慰问驻青部队
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Wu Xiaojun and Luo Dongchuan Visit Troops in Qinghai before Army Day

articles.title_zh: 推进超大城市新型电力系统建设

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Shanghai Political and Legal Leading Cadre Seminar was held from July 30 to 31. Zhu Zhongming, Deputy Secretary of the Shanghai Municipal Committee and Secretary of the Political and Legal Affairs Commission, gave a lecture, emphasizing building a high-quality political and legal team with both integrity and ability.

articles.title_zh: 上海文旅大数据发布 多元客群叠加文旅活力持续释放

articles.summary_en: Several ministries including the Ministry of Ecology and Environment recently issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Addressing Climate Change, aiming to reduce CO2 emissions per unit of GDP by 17% by 2030 compared to 2025.

articles.summary_en: The Standing Committee of the Xinjiang Party Committee held a meeting on July 30, chaired by Chen Xiaojiang, to study and arrange work on sci-tech innovation and inspection rectification.

articles.title_zh: 王君正主持召开自治区党委常委会会议

articles.summary_en: In H1, China's total social logistics value reached 181.1 trillion yuan, up 5.1% year-on-year; total logistics costs as a share of GDP stood at 13.9%. Improved logistics efficiency supports industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 北京市政府召开常务会议 研究首都环境建设管理等事项 市长殷勇主持会议

articles.summary_en: This article reviews Volumes I and II of Xi Jinping's Selected Works on Party Building, highlighting the great practice of full and rigorous Party self-governance in the new era, emphasizing it as the defining theme of Party building, and elaborating on improving the Party self-governance system.

articles.title_zh: 工业绿色低碳发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: Plan for Green and Low-Carbon Industrial Development During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period Released
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部7月31日发布《工业绿色低碳发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年工业领域二氧化碳排放达峰、单位增加值能耗下降10%以上等目标。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Green and Low-Carbon Industrial Development on July 31, setting targets such as peaking CO2 emissions in industry and reducing energy intensity by over 10% by 2030.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部对陕西甘肃启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Emergency Management Ministry Activates Level-IV Geo-hazard Emergency Response for Shaanxi and Gansu
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部7月30日针对陕西、甘肃启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应，要求相关地区做好防范应对，确保人员安全。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Emergency Management activated a Level-IV national geo-hazard emergency response for Shaanxi and Gansu on July 30, urging local authorities to strengthen prevention and ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 超60城调整优化住房公积金政策
articles.title_en: Over 60 Cities Adjust and Optimize Housing Provident Fund Policies
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，全国超60个城市调整优化住房公积金政策，通过提升贷款额度、降低首付、拓宽提取范围等措施，覆盖购房、加装电梯、缴纳物业费等场景，释放住房消费潜力，保障民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: In H1 2026, 60+ Chinese cities adjusted housing provident fund policies, raising loan caps, lowering down payments, and expanding withdrawals to cover purchases, elevator retrofits, and property fees, easing housing burdens.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府召开第112次常务会议 张工主持
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 112th Executive Meeting Chaired by Zhang Gong
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，天津市市长张工主持召开市政府第112次常务会议，审议智能机器人产业创新发展行动方案和金融业发展“十五五”规划等。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 30, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong chaired the 112th executive meeting of the municipal government, reviewing the action plan for intelligent robot industry innovation and the 15th Five-Year Plan for financial development.

articles.title_zh: 自治区人大常委会召开学习贯彻实施民族团结进步促进法座谈会
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional People's Congress Holds Symposium on Implementing Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，自治区人大常委会召开学习贯彻实施民族团结进步促进法座谈会，主任祖木热提·吾布力出席并讲话，强调全面有效推动法律高质量实施。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Standing Committee of the Xinjiang Regional People's Congress held a symposium on implementing the Ethnic Unity and Progress Promotion Law, with Chairwoman Zumret Obul attending and stressing effective high-quality implementation.

articles.title_zh: 2026“新疆是个好地方”非物质文化遗产援疆主题展示活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Xinjiang is a Good Place' Intangible Cultural Heritage Aid-Xinjiang Themed Exhibition Launched
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，2026“新疆是个好地方”非物质文化遗产援疆主题展示活动在石河子市启动，全国人大常委会副委员长雪克来提·扎克尔宣布启动，自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜等致辞。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the 2026 'Xinjiang is a Good Place' Intangible Cultural Heritage Aid-Xinjiang Themed Exhibition was launched in Shihezi City. Shohrat Zakir, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, announced the launch, and Erkin Tuniyaz, Chairman of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能让通关跑出加速度
articles.title_en: AI Accelerates Customs Clearance
articles.summary_zh: 新华社7月31日报道，海关融合人工智能等新技术提升通关效率，如杭州海关用AI眼镜识别精神药品、白云机场智能监测通道等，海关总署提出到2030年90%以上口岸配备智能查验装备。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on July 31 that customs authorities are integrating AI to speed up clearance, including AI glasses detecting drugs and intelligent monitoring at airports, aiming to equip 90% of ports with smart inspection devices by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 市委常委会召开会议，研究部署基础教育和开发区高质量发展等工作
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party Committee Holds Meeting on Basic Education and Development Zones
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日下午，北京市委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记对基础教育工作的重要指示，研究部署基础教育、开发区问题整改、巡视整改及高校毕业生就业等工作。市委书记尹力主持会议。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee met to study Xi Jinping's instructions on basic education and discuss work on basic education, development zone rectification, inspection rectification, and graduate employment.

articles.title_zh: 国防部：今年军校报考热度与生源质量均创历史新高
articles.title_en: Defense Ministry: Military Academy Popularity and Quality Hit Record Highs
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，国防部例行记者会上，新闻发言人蒋斌介绍今年全国约19.2万人报考军校，22所军校录取1.75万余人，成绩排名平均各省前6%，报考热度与生源质量创历史新高。
articles.summary_en: At a routine press conference on July 30, Defense Ministry spokesman Jiang Bin said about 192,000 people applied to military academies this year, with 17,500 admitted from 22 schools, ranking top 6% on average, hitting record highs in popularity and quality.

articles.title_zh: 柯文哲妻子陈佩琪大陆“爽游一周” 台网友：戳破“去大陆会消失”谎言
articles.title_en: Ko Wen-je's Wife Chen Pei-chi's 'Joyful Week' in Mainland China, Taiwanese Netizens Say It Pokes Holes in the 'Disappear in Mainland' Lie
articles.summary_zh: 一周内，柯文哲妻子陈佩琪游览上海、北京，体验无人驾驶出租车，高铁上救助患儿，台湾网友称戳破“去大陆会消失”谎言。
articles.summary_en: In a week, Chen Pei-chi, wife of Ko Wen-je, toured Shanghai and Beijing, experienced self-driving taxis, aided a sick child on high-speed rail, and Taiwanese netizens say it debunks the 'disappear in Mainland' lie.

articles.title_zh: 上半年地方国企实现利润总额8126.8亿元
articles.title_en: Local State-Owned Enterprises Post 812.68 Billion Yuan Profit in H1
articles.summary_zh: 国务院国资委举办的地方国资委负责人研讨班披露，上半年地方监管企业实现利润总额8126.8亿元，同比增长7%。
articles.summary_en: At a seminar for local SASAC heads hosted by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission, data showed local regulatory enterprises achieved total profits of 812.68 billion yuan in H1, up 7% year-on-year.

tags.name_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission

tags_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺诺瓦当选连任圣多美和普林西比总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulations to Nova on Re-election as President of São Tomé and Príncipe
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家主席习近平致电卡洛斯·诺瓦，祝贺他当选连任圣多美和普林西比民主共和国总统，并表示愿推动中圣普战略伙伴关系不断迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, President Xi Jinping sent a message to Carlos Nova, congratulating him on his re-election as President of São Tomé and Príncipe, and expressing willingness to elevate the strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 市政府召开党组（扩大）会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Municipal Government Holds Party Leadership Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，长春市委副书记、市长顾刚主持召开市政府党组（扩大）会议、常务会议，部署科技创新、产业提质、城市更新等工作，原则通过支持光电信息产业发展若干措施。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Gu Gang, Deputy Party Secretary and Mayor of Changchun, chaired the municipal government's Party Leadership Group (Expanded) Meeting and Executive Meeting, deploying work on sci-tech innovation, industrial upgrading, urban renewal, and approving measures supporting optoelectronic information industry.

articles.title_zh: 唐毅调研科技创新工作
articles.title_en: Tang Yi Inspects Sci-Tech Innovation Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，赤峰市委书记唐毅调研科技创新工作，强调培育新质生产力，加快构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Tang Yi, Secretary of the Chifeng Municipal Party Committee, inspected sci-tech innovation, emphasizing cultivating new quality productive forces and accelerating modern industrial system.

articles.title_zh: 总书记的人民情怀
articles.title_en: The General Secretary's Bond with the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平总书记的人民情怀，强调党同人民群众的血肉联系，引用他在上海考察时的讲话，彰显为民造福的执政理念。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Xi Jinping's people-centered sentiment, emphasizing the Party's close ties with the people and quoting his remarks in Shanghai, highlighting governance for the people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 中国智造加速出海 人工智能产品远销全球
articles.title_en: China's Smart Manufacturing Accelerates Global Expansion as AI Products Sell Worldwide
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年我国人工智能产品出口高速增长，智能手表、智能玩具畅销170多个国家，激光雷达、3D打印装备、集成电路等出口大幅增长。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of this year, China's AI-related exports grew rapidly, with smartwatches and smart toys sold in over 170 countries, and exports of LiDAR, 3D printing equipment, and integrated circuits surging.

articles.title_zh: 我国物流总量稳步扩大 需求结构不断优化
articles.title_en: China's Logistics Volume Expands Steadily with Optimizing Demand Structure
articles.summary_zh: 上半年全国社会物流总额181.1万亿元，同比增长5.1%，高技术制造业物流需求增长13.3%，物流成本节约约700亿元。
articles.summary_en: In the first half, China's total social logistics value reached 181.1 trillion yuan, up 5.1% year-on-year. High-tech manufacturing logistics grew 13.3%, and logistics costs saved about 70 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势和经济工作 中共中央总书记习近平主持会议
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Political Bureau Holds Meeting to Convene Fifth Plenary Session and Study Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月在北京召开二十届五中全会，并分析研究当前经济形势，部署下半年经济工作，习近平总书记主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met on July 30, deciding to hold the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee in October, analyzing the economic situation and arranging H2 economic work, chaired by Xi Jinping.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Holds Video Call with U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer
articles.summary_zh: 北京时间7月30日晚，国务院副总理何立峰与美国财长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔视频通话，就中美经贸关系等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of July 30 Beijing time, Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer to discuss bilateral trade ties.

articles.title_zh: 就当前经济形势和下半年经济工作 中共中央召开党外人士座谈会 习近平主持并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Holds Symposium with Non-Party Personages on Economic Situation and H2 Work; Xi Jinping Chairs and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，中共中央在中南海召开党外人士座谈会，就当前经济形势和下半年经济工作听取意见建议。习近平主持并发表重要讲话，李强通报有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium in Zhongnanhai with non-party personages to seek opinions on the economic situation and H2 work. Xi Jinping chaired and delivered an important speech; Li Qiang briefed on the situation.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议闭幕 许昆林出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Liaoning Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes Session; Xu Kunlin Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，辽宁省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在沈阳闭幕，省委书记、省人大常委会主任许昆林出席并讲话，会议表决通过多项法规及人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the 24th session of the 14th Liaoning Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee concluded in Shenyang. Xu Kunlin, provincial party secretary and committee chairman, attended and spoke. The session passed several regulations and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 王兴柱“八一”前夕走访慰问驻鹤部队官兵和老战士
articles.title_en: Wang Xingzhu Visits Troops and Veterans Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，鹤岗市委书记王兴柱在八一建军节前夕走访慰问驻鹤部队官兵和老战士，代表市委、市政府致以节日祝贺和亲切慰问。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Wang Xingzhu, Party Secretary of Hegang, visited military troops and veterans ahead of Army Day, conveying festive greetings and warm regards on behalf of the municipal party committee and government.

articles.title_zh: 市领导调研淮安工业园区经济运行情况

articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，淮安市委书记史志军到淮安工业园区调研经济运行情况，强调要全力以赴抓好经济工作，确保“十五五”开好局、起好步。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Shi Zhijun, secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, inspected the economic operation of Huai'an Industrial Park, emphasizing efforts to ensure a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 全市安全生产工作专题调度会召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun Chairs Special Meeting on Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，淮安市市长顾坤主持召开安全生产工作专题调度会，强调排查整治风险隐患，提升本质安全水平。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Huai'an Mayor Gu Kun chaired a special work safety meeting, emphasizing risk investigation and improving intrinsic safety levels.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市安全生产工作专题调度会召开
articles.title_en: Huai'an Holds Special Work Meeting on Production Safety
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，淮安市市长顾坤主持召开安全生产工作专题调度会，强调落实安全生产“六化”闭环机制，提升本质安全水平。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Mayor Gu Kun chaired a special work safety meeting in Huai'an, emphasizing the implementation of the "six-oriented" closed-loop mechanism to enhance intrinsic safety.

articles.title_zh: 汪华东蒋曦会见淮北舰和“攻坚英雄连”官兵代表
articles.title_en: Wang Huadong and Jiang Xi Meet Representatives of Huaibei Ship and 'Heroic Assault Company'
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，淮北市委书记汪华东、市长蒋曦会见淮北舰和“攻坚英雄连”官兵代表，致以节日祝福并介绍经济社会发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 30, Huaibei Municipal Party Secretary Wang Huadong and Mayor Jiang Xi met with representatives of the Huaibei Ship and 'Heroic Assault Company,' extending greetings and introducing local economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 汪华东主持市委常委会会议 研究城市更新和安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Wang Huadong Chairs Municipal Party Committee Meeting on Urban Renewal and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日下午，淮北市委书记汪华东主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话和指示精神，部署城市更新和安全生产工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30 afternoon, Huaibei Municipal Party Committee Secretary Wang Huadong chaired a standing committee meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important speech and instructions, and arrange urban renewal and safety production work.

articles.title_zh: 市政协召开党组会议、十四届五十九次主席会议
articles.title_en: Municipal CPPCC Holds Party Group Meeting and 59th Chairperson Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，黄石市政协召开党组会议和十四届五十九次主席会议，传达学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话精神，研究部署相关工作。市政协主席何运平主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Huangshi Municipal CPPCC held its Party group meeting and 59th chairperson meeting, conveying the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and deploying related work. CPPCC Chairman He Yunping presided and spoke.

articles.title_en: Lhasa Holds Special Training on Labor Standardization, 555 Enterprise Representatives Attend
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，拉萨市举办劳动用工规范化专项培训，555家企业代表参加，旨在提升企业劳动用工管理水平。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Lhasa held a special training on labor standardization, attended by 555 enterprise representatives to improve labor management.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Holds Video Call with US Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日晚，国务院副总理何立峰与美国财长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔视频通话，就中美经贸关系等交流，中方关切美对华限制措施。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of July 30, Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with US Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer, exchanging views on China-US trade relations and expressing China's concerns over US restrictions.

articles.summary_en: On July 30, Linzhi City convened the 132nd meeting of the Standing Committee of the Second Municipal Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 自治区十二届人大常委会第二十四次会议开幕
articles.title_en: Tibet Autonomous Region's 12th People's Congress Standing Committee Opens 24th Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，西藏自治区十二届人大常委会第二十四次会议在拉萨开幕，严金海主持，听取审议多项法规草案及报告。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the 24th session of the Tibet Autonomous Region's 12th People's Congress Standing Committee opened in Lhasa, chaired by Yan Jinhai, reviewing multiple draft regulations and reports.

articles.title_zh: 2026中国产业转移发展对接活动（西藏）在拉萨举行

articles.summary_en: On July 29, the 2026 China Industrial Transfer Matchmaking Event (Tibet) was held in Lhasa. Vice Minister Xie Yuansheng and Vice Chairman Ren Wei attended and delivered speeches, with 20 projects signed totaling nearly 60 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 龙岩市领导调研创新驱动发展工作
