articles.summary_en: On July 29, Longyan Mayor Cai Lin visited sci-tech innovation platforms and high-tech enterprises, emphasizing technological innovation to lead industrial innovation and develop new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 扎西多吉深入色尼区、班戈县调研督导安全生产和消防安全工作
articles.title_en: Zhaxi Duoji Inspects Work Safety and Fire Safety in Seni and Baingoin
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月30日，扎西多吉深入色尼区、班戈县调研督导安全生产和消防安全工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, 2026, Zhaxi Duoji visited Seni District and Baingoin County to supervise work safety and fire safety work.

articles.title_zh: 扎西多吉主持召开市政府党组理论学习中心组学习会议
articles.title_en: Zhaxi Dorje Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Study Session
articles.summary_zh: 近日，那曲市政府党组理论学习中心组举行学习会，市长扎西多吉主持并讲话，强调系统学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神和习近平党建思想。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Theoretical Learning Center Group of Naqu Municipal Government held a study session. Mayor Zhaxi Dorje presided and emphasized systematic study of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and Party building thought.

articles.title_zh: 王炳森走访慰问驻盘部队官兵
articles.title_en: Wang Bingsen Visits and Greets Officers and Soldiers Stationed in Panjin

articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping made instructions on overseas Chinese affairs, urging unity. The National Conference on Overseas Chinese Affairs was held in Beijing July 27-28; Wang Huning attended and spoke.

articles.title_zh: 始终同人民同呼吸、共命运、心连心（总书记的人民情怀）
articles.title_en: Always Breathe the Same Breath, Share the Same Fate, and Stay Heart-to-Heart with the People (The General Secretary's Affection for the People)
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾习近平总书记的人民情怀，强调党始终同人民同呼吸、共命运、心连心，引用其在上海考察时的讲话，指出共产党就是为老百姓服务的，党的根基在人民。
articles.summary_en: Reviewing Xi Jinping's people-centered feelings, it stresses the Party's unity with the people, quoting his Shanghai remark that the Party serves the people and roots in them.

articles.title_zh: 一份40多年前的作风文件
articles.title_en: A Document on Work Style from Over 40 Years Ago
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾1983年习近平在正定县主持制定《关于改进领导作风的几项规定》的历程，强调其与中央八项规定一脉相承，体现鲜明问题导向。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews how Xi Jinping, then Party secretary of Zhengding County, introduced the 'Six Regulations' on improving work style in 1983, highlighting their continuity with the central Party's eight-point regulations.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市级领导走访慰问驻青部队
articles.title_en: Qingdao Leaders Visit Troops Stationed in City Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: “八一”建军节前夕，青岛市委书记曾赞荣、市长任刚等市领导分别率队走访慰问驻青部队，向官兵致以节日祝贺和诚挚问候，感谢他们为青岛改革发展稳定作出的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of Army Day, Qingdao leaders including Party Secretary Zeng Zanrong and Mayor Ren Gang visited troops stationed in Qingdao, extending holiday greetings and expressing gratitude for their contributions.

articles.title_zh: 走进茶园，习近平强调做好这篇“大文章”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Visits Tea Garden, Stresses Tea Culture, Industry and Technology
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾2021年3月习近平在福建武夷山燕子窠生态茶园考察，强调统筹做好茶文化、茶产业、茶科技这篇大文章，展现生态茶园带动乡村振兴的成效。
articles.summary_en: This article reviews Xi Jinping's 2021 visit to a Wuyishan tea garden, where he emphasized tea culture, industry and technology, and the benefits of ecological tea farming for rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 中国经济半年观察：“向新向优”成为关键词
articles.title_en: China's Economy in H1: 'New Momentum and Better Structure' Key Words
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局召开会议分析经济形势，指出中国经济动能向新、结构向优，上半年GDP同比增长4.7%。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met to assess the economy, noting new momentum and improved structure, with H1 GDP growing 4.7% YoY.

articles.title_zh: 夯实居民消费基础 提升消费意愿能力——我国加快形成扩大居民消费长效机制观察
articles.title_en: China Steps Up Efforts to Build Long-term Mechanism for Expanding Consumer Spending
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道，面向“十五五”我国加快形成扩大居民消费长效机制，通过稳就业、促增收、完善社会保障等措施增强居民消费能力与意愿。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that China is accelerating the formation of a long-term mechanism to expand household consumption, boosting consumer capacity and willingness through stable employment, income growth, and improved social security.

articles.title_zh: 走进茶园，习近平强调做好这篇“大文章”
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Visits Tea Garden, Emphasizes Making Tea Industry a 'Big Article'
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾2021年3月习近平考察福建武夷山燕子窠生态茶园，强调统筹做好茶文化、茶产业、茶科技‘大文章’，展现茶产业助力绿色发展与乡村振兴的成效。
articles.summary_en: The article revisits Xi Jinping's March 2021 visit to the Yanziwo Ecological Tea Plantation in Wuyishan, where he stressed coordinating tea culture, industry and technology, highlighting achievements in eco-friendly planting and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 陕西文旅厅：不存在“伪史论者”电话骚扰要求拆唐朝古迹情况，将调查追责
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Culture and Tourism Department Denies Harassment by 'Fake History' Callers, Vows Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省文旅厅回应媒体称，不存在“伪史论者”电话骚扰要求拆除唐朝古迹的情况，已联系原始发布媒体，将调查并追究相关责任。
articles.summary_en: Shaanxi Provincial Culture and Tourism Department denied reports of phone harassment by 'fake history' advocates demanding removal of Tang Dynasty relics, saying it has contacted the media outlet and will investigate and pursue legal responsibility.

tags.name_en: Shaanxi Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism

articles.title_zh: 《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》即将施行，民政部：将加强刚性执法
articles.title_en: Measures on Social Groups' Branches to Take Effect, Civil Affairs Ministry Vows Stricter Enforcement
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，民政部举行第三季度例行新闻发布会，解读8月1日施行的《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》，表示将加强刚性执法，规范社会组织管理。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs held a press conference to explain the Measures for Management of Branches and Representative Offices of Social Groups, effective Aug. 1, pledging stricter law enforcement.

articles.title_zh: 涉“最忙五人组”等不实内容，市场化活动违法违规行为专项整治典型案件公布
articles.title_en: Typical Cases of Illegal Activities in Market-Oriented Activities Involving False Content such as 'Busiest Five-Person Group' Published
articles.summary_zh: 2026年，市场监管总局开展市场化活动违法违规行为专项整治，公布六起虚假宣传典型案件，涉及虚构榜单、冒用国际组织名义等行为。
articles.summary_en: In 2026, the State Administration for Market Regulation launched a special campaign against illegal activities in market-oriented activities, publishing six typical cases of false publicity, involving fabricated rankings and unauthorized use of international organization names.

articles.title_zh: 《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》主要解决哪些问题？民政部答澎湃
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs Answers Questions on New Measures for Managing Social Organizations' Branches
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，民政部举行第三季度例行新闻发布会，解读《社会团体分支机构、代表机构管理办法》，围绕设立、管理、建设、使用、考核、退出全链条规范管理。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs held a press conference to explain the new Measures for Managing Branches and Representative Offices of Social Organizations, covering the full chain of establishment, management, construction, use, assessment, and exit.

articles.title_zh: 民政部：截至目前各地共办理婚姻登记“全国通办”79.8万对
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs: 798,000 Couples Nationwide Have Registered Marriages Under National Inter-provincial Service
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，民政部举行第三季度例行新闻发布会，介绍截至6月底全国低保、特困标准及上半年临时救助数据，并通报婚姻登记“全国通办”已办理79.8万对。
articles.summary_en: At a quarterly press conference on July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs reported that 798,000 marriage registrations had been completed under the nationwide inter-provincial service, and released data on subsistence allowances and temporary relief.

articles.title_zh: 中华全国律师协会原会长任继圣逝世，享年100岁
articles.title_en: Ren Jisheng, Former President of All China Lawyers Association, Dies at 100
articles.summary_zh: 中华全国律师协会原会长、司法部离休干部任继圣因病于2026年7月15日在北京逝世，享年100岁。
articles.summary_en: Ren Jisheng, former president of All China Lawyers Association and retired cadre of Ministry of Justice, died of illness in Beijing on July 15, 2026, at age 100.

articles.title_zh: 民政部：推动构建婚育友好社会，将开展整治婚介机构乱象专项行动
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs to Promote Marriage- and Child-Friendly Society and Launch Special Campaign Against Matchmaking Agency Malpractices
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，民政部举行第三季度例行新闻发布会，表示将推动构建婚育友好型社会，开展整治婚介机构乱象专项行动，并部署养老服务、儿童福利等民生工作。
articles.summary_en: At its routine Q3 press conference on July 30, the Ministry of Civil Affairs said it will promote a marriage- and child-friendly society, launch a special campaign against matchmaking agency irregularities, and deploy work on elderly care and child welfare.

articles.title_zh: 国网濉溪供电发布2025服务濉溪经济社会发展履责报告
articles.title_en: State Grid Suixi Power Releases 2025 Responsibility Report on Serving Local Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国网濉溪供电发布《2025年服务濉溪经济社会发展履责报告》，展示电网建设、绿色转型、营商环境等成效，这是连续第4年发布。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, State Grid Suixi Power released its 2025 responsibility report, showcasing achievements in grid construction, green transition, and business services. It is the fourth consecutive annual report.

articles.title_zh: 厦门市启动2026年减污降碳协同创新标杆项目申报
articles.title_en: Xiamen Launches Application for 2026 Pollution Reduction and Carbon Reduction Innovation Benchmark Projects
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，厦门市生态环境局启动2026年减污降碳协同创新标杆项目申报，面向全市企业和园区，获评项目可获资金补助和绿色融资支持。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Xiamen Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau launched the application for 2026 benchmark projects on coordinated pollution reduction and carbon reduction, targeting enterprises and parks, with funding and green financing incentives.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省“三抓三促”行动专项工作机制办公室主任会议召开
articles.title_en: Gansu Holds Office Director Meeting on Special Work Mechanism for 'Three Grasps, Three Promotions' Action
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，甘肃省“三抓三促”行动专项工作机制办公室主任会议召开，省委常委、省纪委书记靳国卫主持并讲话，强调提升观念、转变作风，推动行动提质增效。
articles.summary_en: The office director meeting for Gansu's special work mechanism on the 'Three Grasps, Three Promotions' action was held on July 29. Provincial Party Standing Committee member and Discipline Inspection Secretary Jin Guowei presided and stressed enhancing concepts and work style to improve effectiveness.

articles.title_zh: 用心用情做好事办实事解难事（基层治理新实践）
articles.title_en: With Heart and Effort: Improving Neighborhood Services (New Practice in Grassroots Governance)
articles.summary_zh: 记者走访甘肃兰州、湖南长沙、山东日照等地，报道社区党组织通过信义制、居民自治、村企合作等方式提升物业服务，解决居民急难愁盼问题。
articles.summary_en: Reporters visited Lanzhou, Changsha, and Rizhao to see how community Party organizations improve property services through trust-based management, resident self-governance, and village-enterprise cooperation, addressing residents' urgent concerns.

articles.title_zh: “四良”合力强根基 广西推动热区葡萄质量安全与品质提升
articles.title_en: Four Good Practices Strengthen Guangxi's Hot-Zone Grape Quality and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 广西依托南亚热带光热优势，以良种、良技、良土、良机破解热区葡萄种植难题，2025年葡萄种植面积48.97万亩，产量82.59万吨，产值突破100亿元。
articles.summary_en: Guangxi leverages its subtropical resources to promote hot-zone grape cultivation through improved varieties, techniques, soil, and machinery, achieving 825,900 tons of grapes and a production value exceeding 10 billion yuan in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 让职业选择跟上产业发展新趋势（稳就业·我的求职故事）
articles.title_en: Career Choices Keep Pace with New Industry Trends (Stable Employment: My Job-Hunting Story)
articles.summary_zh: 湖北宜昌通过发展大数据等新兴产业和特色培训，扩大就业容量，电工杨涛转型为数据标注师并晋升项目经理。
articles.summary_en: Yichang, Hubei, expands employment in emerging sectors and offers targeted training, helping electrician Yang Tao transition to a data annotator and rise to project manager.

articles.title_zh: 河北加快建设一体化算力网
articles.title_en: Hebei Accelerates Construction of Integrated Computing Network
articles.summary_zh: 河北省加快建设全国一体化算力网京津冀国家枢纽节点，推动算力资源互通共享，综合算力指数连续两年全国第一，赋能产业数字化发展。
articles.summary_en: Hebei is accelerating the construction of an integrated computing network in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, promoting shared computing resources. Its comprehensive computing index ranks first nationwide for two consecutive years, empowering industrial digitalization.

articles.title_zh: 绥化政校企战略合作签约仪式举行
articles.title_en: Suihua Holds Signing Ceremony for Government-University-Enterprise Strategic Cooperation
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，绥化市政校企战略合作签约暨绿色油田协同创新中心揭牌活动举行，确定多家企业为首批合作企业。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, a strategic cooperation signing ceremony between government, universities, and enterprises was held in Suihua, alongside the inauguration of the Green Oilfield Collaborative Innovation Center.

articles.title_zh: 自治区十四届人大常委会第二十九次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Regional People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes 29th Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，内蒙古自治区十四届人大常委会第二十九次会议闭幕，表决通过多项地方性法规和决议。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the 29th session of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Regional People's Congress Standing Committee concluded after passing multiple local regulations and resolutions.

articles.title_zh: 青海发布"3H高原认证"体系 填补全球极端环境质量认证空白
articles.title_en: Qinghai Launches '3H Plateau Certification' System, Filling Global Gap in Extreme Environment Quality Certification
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，青海省市场监督管理局发布全国首个针对青藏高原极端环境的'3H高原认证'体系，旨在将高原极端条件转化为质量标准制定优势。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, Qinghai Provincial Market Regulation Administration launched China's first '3H Plateau Certification' system for extreme environment quality, aiming to turn harsh plateau conditions into a standard-setting advantage.

articles.title_zh: 绵遂资内铁路遂宁至内江段开工建设
articles.title_en: Construction Starts on Suining-Neijiang Section of Miansui-Zinei Railway
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日上午，绵遂资内铁路建设推进活动在遂宁举行，宣布遂宁至内江段开工，线路全长244公里，总投资537亿元。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the construction of the Suining-Neijiang section of the Miansui-Zinei Railway was announced at a promotion event in Suining. The line spans 244 km with a total investment of 53.7 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 大运河上建起“超强大脑”：内河航运产业大脑上线
articles.title_en: "Super Brain" Built on the Grand Canal: Digital Platform for Inland Shipping
articles.summary_zh: 山东济宁建设内河航运“产业大脑”数字化平台，整合港口、船舶、货物数据，提升航运效率，降低物流成本。
articles.summary_en: Jining, Shandong, has built an "industry brain" digital platform for inland shipping, integrating port, vessel, and cargo data to improve efficiency and reduce logistics costs.

articles.title_zh: 用心用情做好事办实事解难事（基层治理新实践）
articles.title_en: Wholehearted Service: New Practices in Grassroots Governance
articles.summary_zh: 报道甘肃兰州、湖南长沙、山东日照等地社区党组织通过信义制、居民自治、村企合作等模式破解物业服务难题，提升基层治理效能。
articles.summary_en: This article highlights how community Party organizations in Lanzhou, Changsha, and Rizhao improve property management through trust-based digital platforms, resident autonomy, and village-enterprise cooperation, enhancing grassroots governance.

articles.title_zh: 全力巩固经济向优向新向好态势
articles.title_en: Efforts to Sustain Shanghai's Improving Economic Momentum
articles.summary_zh: 上海市市长龚正主持市政府常务会议，部署决战三季度、稳住重点行业、推进科技服务业和国际航空枢纽建设。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai Mayor Gong Zheng chaired a municipal government meeting to consolidate economic progress, stabilize key industries, and advance tech services and the international aviation hub.

articles.title_zh: 新疆今年计划实施重点项目523个
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Plans 523 Key Projects This Year
articles.summary_zh: 新疆今年计划实施重点项目523个，总投资3.1万亿元，年度计划完成投资4100亿元以上，涵盖基础设施、现代化产业和公共服务等领域。
articles.summary_en: Xinjiang plans 523 key projects this year with total investment of 3.1 trillion yuan and annual planned investment over 410 billion yuan, covering infrastructure, modern industries, and public services.

articles.title_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区十四届人大常委会第三十次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional People's Congress Standing Committee Concludes 30th Session
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，自治区十四届人大常委会第三十次会议闭幕，表决通过多项法规和决定，并举行宪法宣誓仪式。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the 30th session of the 14th Standing Committee of the Xinjiang Regional People's Congress concluded, voting on several regulations and decisions and holding a constitutional oath ceremony.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央召开党外人士座谈会 习近平主持并发表重要讲话
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Holds Symposium with Non-Party Personages; Xi Jinping Chairs and Delivers Important Speech
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，中共中央在中南海召开党外人士座谈会，就当前经济形势和下半年经济工作听取意见建议。习近平主持并讲话，李强通报有关情况。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium with non-party personages in Zhongnanhai to solicit opinions on the current economic situation and H2 economic work. Xi Jinping chaired and delivered an important speech, and Li Qiang briefed the attendees.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议 决定召开二十届五中全会 分析研究当前经济形势
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee Politburo Meets to Convene Fifth Plenum, Analyze Economy
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局7月30日召开会议，决定今年10月召开二十届五中全会，并分析当前经济形势，部署下半年经济工作。习近平总书记主持会议。
articles.summary_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met on July 30 and decided to convene the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee in October, analyzed the current economic situation and arranged work for the second half of the year. Xi Jinping chaired the meeting.

tags.name_en: Economic Work in Second Half of Year

articles.title_zh: 王清宪与刘桂清举行工作会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Qingxian Holds Working Talks with Liu Guiqing
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日上午，安徽省长王清宪与中国电信集团总经理刘桂清举行工作会谈，就量子技术、人工智能等领域合作展开交流。副省长李中参加。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 29, Anhui Governor Wang Qingxian held working talks with Liu Guiqing, General Manager of China Telecom, on cooperation in quantum technology and AI. Vice Governor Li Zhong attended.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚会见中国安能集团陈奕辉郭建和
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Meets China Anneng Group Leaders
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，自治区党委书记陈刚在南宁会见中国安能集团董事长陈奕辉、总经理郭建和一行，感谢其在台风“美莎克”抗洪抢险中的贡献，并希望深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Guangxi Regional Party Committee, met with leaders of China Anneng Group in Nanning, expressing gratitude for their flood relief efforts and seeking deeper cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 稳中求进每月看丨千帆竞发正逢时——7月全国各地经济社会发展观察
articles.title_en: Observations on China's Economic and Social Development in July
articles.summary_zh: 7月以来，全国在人工智能赋能、就业扩容、暑期消费和外贸增长等方面取得积极进展，新旧动能转换引领经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: In July, China saw progress in AI empowerment, employment expansion, summer consumption, and foreign trade, with new growth drivers promoting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 长沙市政协委员高质量履职助推高质量发展
articles.title_en: Changsha CPPCC Members Contribute to High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，长沙市政情通报会召开，常务副市长付旭明通报上半年经济社会发展情况，政协委员交流发言，共促高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Changsha held a municipal situation briefing where Vice Mayor Fu Xuming reported on H1 economic and social development, and CPPCC members exchanged views to boost high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 省政协召开助推改革专题协商会 张义珍出席

articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Provincial CPPCC held a special consultation meeting on building a unified data market, with Chairman Zhang Yizhen attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 近镜头·习近平的文化足迹丨“多姿多彩的地方特色传统文化，共同构成璀璨的中华文明”

articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping visited Changde River Street in Hunan, emphasizing that diverse local traditional cultures form the splendid Chinese civilization and boost economic and social development.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 习近平强党兴党的故事丨治国之要 首在用人
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Story of Strengthening the Party: The Key to Governance Lies in Selecting Talented Officials
articles.summary_zh: 本文讲述习近平同志重视干部队伍建设的故事。从1984年正定县调整农村班子，到2026年6月全国党建工作座谈会，强调建设堪当民族复兴重任的高素质干部队伍对党的事业的关键作用。
articles.summary_en: This article recounts Xi Jinping's consistent emphasis on building a high-caliber cadre team, from restructuring rural leadership in Zhengding in 1984 to the National Party Building Work Symposium in June 2026, highlighting its critical role in the Party's cause.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 自治区召开奶产业高质量发展专题会

articles.summary_en: On July 27, Li Yifei, Secretary of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Party Committee, chaired a special meeting on high-quality dairy development, urging innovation and whole-industry-chain advancement.

articles.title_zh: 浙江人形机器人加速多场景应用
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Humanoid Robots Accelerate Multi-Scenario Applications
articles.summary_zh: 浙江人形机器人创新中心研发的人形机器人在服装制造、物流搬运等场景落地应用，并加速推进产业化进程。
articles.summary_en: Humanoid robots developed by Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center have been applied in garment manufacturing, logistics, auto assembly, and retail, accelerating industrialization.

articles.title_zh: 西藏澜沧江上游曲孜卡水电站开工
articles.title_en: Construction of Qizika Hydropower Station on Upper Lancang River in Tibet Starts

articles.summary_en: On July 30, the Qizika Hydropower Station in Tibet officially started construction, with a total investment of 5.895 billion yuan and an installed capacity of 405 MW. It will generate about 1.869 billion kWh annually.

articles.title_zh: 跨越山海 让中国医疗方案惠及更多人
articles.title_en: Crossing Mountains and Seas: Bringing Chinese Medical Solutions to More People
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道，中国援非抗疫专家组在刚果（金）优化埃博拉检测方案，北京协和医院为“一带一路”国家培训放射科医生，推动中国医疗方案惠及世界。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that Chinese medical experts in DR Congo improved Ebola testing, while Peking Union Medical College Hospital trained radiologists from Belt and Road countries, bringing Chinese medical solutions to the world.

articles.title_zh: 从中央政治局会议看下半年经济工作着力点
articles.title_en: Central Political Bureau Meeting Sets Focus for H2 Economic Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月30日，中共中央政治局召开会议，分析研究当前经济形势，部署下半年经济工作，强调推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 30, the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau held a meeting to analyze the economic situation and arrange work for the second half of the year, stressing sustained high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对陕西、甘肃启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Initiates Level-IV Emergency Response for Flood Control in Shaanxi and Gansu
articles.summary_zh: 水利部7月30日21时对陕西、甘肃启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，指导地方做好山洪灾害防御，保障人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level-IV emergency response for flood control in Shaanxi and Gansu at 21:00 on July 30, guiding local efforts to prevent mountain torrent disasters and protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 拧紧“总开关”，政绩观不走偏
articles.title_en: Tighten the 'Master Switch' to Keep Political Performance Views from Going Astray
articles.summary_zh: 文章论述通过拧紧理想信念‘总开关’树立正确政绩观，强调党员干部要坚定信念、敢于斗争，并例举陈俊武等优秀共产党人的奉献精神。
articles.summary_en: Article argues for tightening the 'master switch' of ideals to keep political achievement views correct, citing Chen Junwu's dedication and urging officials to fight boldly.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔调研铁路规划建设并出席工作推进会议

articles.summary_en: On July 29, Governor Zhou Naixiang of Shandong visited railway projects in Jinan and Binzhou and attended a provincial work meeting, emphasizing high-speed rail development.

articles.title_zh: 天津市委常委会召开议军会议

articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Standing Committee of the Tianjin Municipal Party Committee held a military affairs meeting chaired by Chen Min'er, emphasizing service to national defense and military modernization.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜“八一”前夕走访慰问驻疆部队官兵和优抚对象
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erkin Tuniyaz Visit Troops in Xinjiang Ahead of Army Day
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在“八一”前夕走访慰问驻疆部队官兵和优抚对象，致以节日祝福。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Chen Xiaojiang, Party secretary of Xinjiang, and Erkin Tuniyaz, chairman of the regional government, visited troops stationed in Xinjiang and entitled recipients ahead of Army Day to extend festive greetings.

articles.title_zh: 商务部就美国防部将部分中国科研机构列入制裁清单答记者问
articles.title_en: Chinese Commerce Ministry Responds to US Defense Department Sanctions on Chinese Research Institutes
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，商务部新闻发言人就美国防部将部分中国科研机构列入制裁清单表示强烈不满和坚决反对。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the spokesperson of China's Ministry of Commerce expressed strong dissatisfaction and firm opposition to the US Department of Defense's inclusion of some Chinese research institutions on a sanctions list.

articles.title_zh: 受贿6253万余元 国家发展改革委原党组成员、副主任徐宪平一审获刑15年
articles.title_en: Xu Xianping, Former Deputy Director of NDRC, Sentenced to 15 Years for Bribery of 62.53 Million Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月29日，内蒙古赤峰市中级人民法院一审宣判国家发展改革委原副主任徐宪平受贿案，判处其有期徒刑15年，并处罚金500万元，追缴犯罪所得。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, 2026, Chifeng Intermediate People's Court in Inner Mongolia sentenced Xu Xianping, former deputy director of the NDRC, to 15 years in prison and a fine of 5 million yuan for bribery, with illicit gains confiscated.

articles.title_zh: 斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼访华 两国元首会谈
articles.title_en: Slovak President Pellegrini Visits China, Leaders Hold Talks
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日至29日，斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼对中国进行国事访问，7月28日两国元首在北京举行会谈，同意深化战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: Slovak President Peter Pellegrini paid a state visit to China from July 27 to 29, with leaders holding talks in Beijing on July 28, agreeing to deepen strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 国家知识产权局：我国商标领域立法从“局部修改”向“系统完善”转变升级
articles.title_en: China's Trademark Law Revision Marks Shift from Partial Amendment to Systematic Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国新办举行新闻发布会，国家知识产权局副局长芮文彪介绍，6月26日全国人大常委会审议通过新修订的商标法，这是该法自1983年施行以来首次全面修订。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where Rui Wenbiao, deputy director of the China National Intellectual Property Administration, announced the newly revised Trademark Law approved on June 26, marking its first comprehensive revision since 1983.

articles.title_zh: 截至6月底 我国新一代信息技术领域有效发明专利占总量16.5%
articles.title_en: By end of June, China's valid invention patents in new-generation IT sector account for 16.5% of total
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国新办举行发布会介绍“十五五”时期知识产权保护情况，新一代信息技术领域有效发明专利占总量16.5%。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the State Council Information Office held a press conference on intellectual property protection during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, stating that valid invention patents in new-generation IT account for 16.5% of total.

articles.title_zh: 国家知识产权局：目前83家国家级知识产权保护中心在建
articles.title_en: 83 National Intellectual Property Protection Centers Under Construction

articles.summary_en: On July 29, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where the National Intellectual Property Administration announced the construction of 83 national-level IP protection centers and 54 fast-track IP rights centers.

articles.title_zh: 国家知识产权局：完善新兴领域知识产权保护制度
articles.title_en: China's National IP Administration: Improving IP Protection for Emerging Industries

articles.summary_en: At a July 29 press conference, National IP Administration Deputy Director Rui Wenbiao outlined efforts to improve IP protection for emerging fields, including AI, quantum tech, and biopharmaceuticals, focusing on institutional innovation, conversion acceleration, and environment optimization.

articles.title_zh: 国台办引用乡愁诗句谈电影《回家之路》
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Cites Nostalgic Poem on Film "The Road Home"
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人陈斌华引用余光中《乡愁》诗句，表达对两岸统一的期盼，并承诺将继续协助老兵骨灰归乡等事务。
articles.summary_en: Chen Binhua, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, cited lines from Yu Guangzhong's poem "Nostalgia" to express hopes for cross-strait reunification, pledging continued assistance for veterans' ashes and family reunions.

articles.title_zh: 中国国家知识产权局：将指导建设人工智能领域专利池
articles.title_en: China's National Intellectual Property Administration to Guide Construction of AI Patent Pool
articles.summary_zh: 国家知识产权局副局长芮文彪7月29日在北京表示，将指导建设人工智能领域专利池，促进高质量专利转化。
articles.summary_en: Deputy Director Rui Wenbiao of China's National Intellectual Property Administration stated in Beijing on July 29 that the administration will guide the construction of an AI patent pool to facilitate the transfer of high-quality patents.

articles.title_zh: 国台办：“反中抗中”违背人性难以得逞
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office: 'Anti-China' Stance Against Human Nature, Doomed to Fail
articles.summary_zh: 国台办发言人陈斌华29日表示，台湾同胞赴大陆旅游热潮说明“反中抗中”违背人性难以得逞，并介绍两岸直航恢复情况。
articles.summary_en: Chen Binhua, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, said on July 29 that the tourism boom among Taiwanese to the mainland shows that 'anti-China' stance is against human nature and doomed to fail, and updated on cross-strait direct flights.

articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Ministry of Transport dispatched targeted instructions to transport departments in Sichuan, Henan, and Guangdong, demanding enhanced precautions against heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 国台办称根本不存在所谓“台海中线”
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Says No So-Called 'Taiwan Strait Median Line' Exists
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国台办发言人陈斌华在例行新闻发布会上表示，不存在所谓“台海中线”，解放军和海警在台岛周边行动旨在维护国家主权和领土完整。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, Chen Binhua, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council, stated at a regular press conference that there is no so-called 'median line' in the Taiwan Strait, and that the actions of the PLA and coast guard around Taiwan are aimed at safeguarding national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

articles.summary_en: Chen Binhua, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, criticized the DPP authorities for maliciously restricting the scope of Taiwan compatriots' visits to the mainland, calling it a step backwards and unpopular.

articles.summary_en: Lu Donglei, Party Secretary and Director of Rizhao Economic and Technological Development Zone, is under investigation for severe violations of discipline and law by Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection.

articles.title_zh: 深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想 不断开创机关党建工作新局面
articles.title_en: Deeply Study and Implement Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building, Continuously Create New Situation in Party Building of Organs

articles.title_zh: 全球发展倡议5周年高级别会议在京举行

articles.title_zh: 更好凝聚侨心侨力 促进海内外中华儿女团结奋斗
articles.title_en: Better Unite the Hearts and Strengths of Overseas Chinese to Promote the Unity and Struggle of Chinese People at Home and Abroad

The National Conference on Overseas Chinese Affairs was held in Beijing from July 27 to 28, with Wang Huning attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 去年全国累计资助学生近一点六亿人次

articles.title_zh: 市委理论学习中心组学习习近平党建思想 柯昌万主持
articles.title_en: City Party Committee Theory Study Center Group Studies Xi Jinping's Party Building Thought, Ke Changwan Chairs Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，市委理论学习中心组举行会议，认真学习习近平党建思想，市委书记柯昌万主持并讲话，市长张小平、市政协主席周建功等出席。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the City Party Committee Theory Study Center Group held a meeting to study Xi Jinping's thought on party building. Secretary Ke Changwan presided and delivered a speech, attended by Mayor Zhang Xiaoping and others.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央 国务院印发《关于加强新时代社会工作的意见》
articles.title_en: CPC Central Committee and State Council Issue Opinions on Strengthening Social Work in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央、国务院印发《关于加强新时代社会工作的意见》，对加强新时代社会工作作出部署，涵盖新兴领域党建、基层治理等。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee and the State Council recently issued the Opinions on Strengthening Social Work in the New Era, making arrangements for strengthening social work, including party building in emerging fields and grassroots governance.

tags.name_en: Social Work in the New Era

tags_en: Social Work in the New Era

articles.title_zh: 沈阳市人大常委会举办政绩观学习教育读书班
articles.title_en: Shenyang Municipal People's Congress Holds Study Class on Correct View of Political Performance
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，沈阳市人大常委会举办正确政绩观学习教育读书班，党组书记范继英主持并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the Standing Committee of Shenyang Municipal People's Congress held a study class on establishing and practicing a correct view of political performance. Fan Jiying, Party secretary and director, presided and delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对侨务工作作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Makes Important Instructions on Overseas Chinese Affairs Work
articles.summary_zh: 习近平近日对侨务工作作出重要指示，全国侨务工作会议7月27日至28日在京召开，王沪宁出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently made important instructions on overseas Chinese affairs work. The National Conference on Overseas Chinese Affairs was held in Beijing on July 27-28, with Wang Huning attending and delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席特使阴和俊出席秘鲁总统权力交接仪式
articles.title_en: Xi's Special Envoy Yin Hejun Attends Peruvian Presidential Power Transfer Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，习近平主席特使、科技部部长阴和俊在利马出席秘鲁总统权力交接仪式，并与当选总统藤森庆子举行会见，转达习近平主席问候。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Yin Hejun, special envoy of President Xi Jinping and Minister of Science and Technology, attended the Peruvian presidential power transfer ceremony in Lima and met with President-elect Keiko Fujimori, conveying President Xi's greetings.

articles.title_zh: 上半年全国社会物流总额为181.1万亿元
articles.title_en: First-half National Social Logistics Total Reaches 181.1 Trillion Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 上半年全国社会物流总额为181.1万亿元，同比增长5.1%；物流业总收入7.2万亿元，物流需求持续扩大。
articles.summary_en: In H1, China's total social logistics reached 181.1 trillion yuan, up 5.1% YoY; logistics industry revenue hit 7.2 trillion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 税收大数据勾勒经济向好图景
articles.title_en: Tax Big Data Portrays Positive Economic Outlook
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，国家税务总局局长胡静林在国新办发布会上介绍，上半年支持科技创新和制造业发展减税降费退税1.91万亿元，税收数据显示经济运行呈现向实、向新、向优、向绿特点。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, at a State Council Information Office press conference, SAT Director Hu Jinglin said tax cuts and rebates for tech innovation and manufacturing reached 1.91 trillion yuan in H1, with tax data showing a solid, innovative, and greener economy.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记对侨务工作重要指示激励海内外中华儿女团结奋斗
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Important Instructions on Overseas Chinese Affairs Inspire Chinese at Home and Abroad to Strive Together
articles.summary_zh: 全国侨务工作会议7月27日至28日在北京召开，传达习近平总书记对侨务工作的重要指示。与会代表备受鼓舞，表示将贯彻落实指示，促进海内外中华儿女团结奋斗。
articles.summary_en: The National Conference on Overseas Chinese Affairs was held in Beijing on July 27-28, conveying Xi Jinping's important instructions on the work. Attendees were inspired and pledged to implement the instructions to unite Chinese at home and abroad.

articles.title_zh: 2030年我国知识产权综合实力进一步增强
articles.title_en: China's Comprehensive IP Strength to Further Enhance by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办7月29日举行发布会，国家知识产权局介绍称，今年上半年授权发明专利45.3万件，高价值发明专利拥有量达236万件，知识产权大国地位巩固。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council Information Office press conference on July 29, CNIPA reported 453,000 invention patents granted in H1 and 2.36 million high-value invention patents, consolidating China's status as an IP power.

articles.title_zh: 李强会见斯洛伐克总统
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Meets Slovak President
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强29日下午在京会见来华进行国事访问的斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼，双方表示深化合作，推动中欧关系发展。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 29, Premier Li Qiang met with Slovak President Pellegrini in Beijing during his state visit, pledging to deepen cooperation and promote China-EU relations.

articles.title_zh: 市十七届人大常委会第三十四次会议召开
articles.title_en: The 34th Meeting of the 17th Hegang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，鹤岗市十七届人大常委会第三十四次会议召开，听取审议多项报告，通过人事任免，接受两名副市长辞职。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the 34th meeting of the 17th Hegang Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee convened, hearing and deliberating multiple reports, passing personnel appointments and removals, and accepting the resignations of two deputy mayors.

articles.title_zh: 市领导开展“八一”走访慰问活动
articles.title_en: City Leaders Conduct 'August 1st' Visit and Condolence Activities
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，淮安市委书记史志军、市长顾坤分别带队开展“八一”走访慰问活动，向驻淮部队官兵等致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Huai'an Party Secretary Shi Zhijun and Mayor Gu Kun led teams to conduct 'August 1st' visit and condolence activities, extending holiday greetings to stationed troops and others.

articles.title_zh: 淮安市领导开展“八一”走访慰问活动
articles.title_en: Huai'an Leaders Conduct August 1st Visit and Condolence Activities
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，淮安市委书记史志军、市长顾坤分别带队开展“八一”走访慰问，向驻淮部队官兵、消防指战员和军队离退休干部致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Huai'an Party Secretary Shi Zhijun and Mayor Gu Kun led teams to conduct August 1st visits, extending festive greetings to stationed troops, firefighters, and retired military cadres.

articles.title_zh: 市领导围绕树立和践行正确政绩观讲授专题党课
articles.title_en: City Leader Delivers Special Party Lecture on Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 近日，淮安市委副书记、市长顾坤为政府系统党员干部讲授专题党课，强调树立和践行正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gu Kun, Deputy Secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, delivered a special Party lecture to government cadres, emphasizing establishing and practicing a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 市九届人大六次会议科技创新和产业创新深度融合议案督办暨创新之核建设座谈会召开
articles.title_en: The Sixth Session of the Ninth Huai'an Municipal People's Congress Holds a Symposium on Supervising the Proposal for Deep Integration of Technological and Industrial Innovation and Building the 'Innovation Core'
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，淮安市委书记史志军主持召开市九届人大六次会议议案督办暨‘创新之核’建设座谈会，强调推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Shi Zhijun, Secretary of the Huai'an Municipal Party Committee, chaired a symposium on supervising the proposal of the sixth session of the ninth municipal people's congress and building the 'innovation core', emphasizing the deep integration of technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 市领导围绕树立和践行正确政绩观讲授专题党课
articles.title_en: City Leaders Give Special Party Lecture on Correct View of Political Performance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，淮安市委副书记、市长顾坤为政府系统党员干部讲授专题党课，强调树立和践行正确政绩观。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Gu Kun, Deputy Secretary of Huai'an Municipal Party Committee and Mayor, gave a special party lecture to government officials, emphasizing the establishment and practice of a correct view of political performance.

articles.title_zh: 蒋曦调研督导矿山和铸造企业生态环境保护工作
articles.title_en: Jiang Xi Inspects Ecological Environmental Protection at Mines and Foundry Enterprises
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日上午，淮北市委副书记、市长蒋曦前往杜集区和相山区，调研督导矿山和铸造企业生态环境保护工作，强调以整改实效推动绿色转型发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 29, Jiang Xi, Deputy Secretary and Mayor of Huaibei, inspected ecological environmental protection at mines and foundry enterprises in Duji and Xiangshan districts, urging green transformation through effective rectification.

articles.title_zh: 韦朝晖主持召开全市开发区（产业园区）党的建设工作暨巡视巡察反馈问题专项整治推进会
articles.title_en: Wei Zhaohui Chairs Citywide Conference on Party Building in Development Zones and Special Rectification of Inspection and巡察 Feedback Issues
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，怀化市委书记韦朝晖主持召开全市开发区党的建设工作暨巡视巡察反馈问题专项整治推进会，强调以高质量党建引领保障高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, Huaihua Municipal Party Secretary Wei Zhaohui chaired a citywide conference on party building in development zones and special rectification of inspection and巡察 feedback issues, emphasizing high-quality party building to lead high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 市政协专题情况通报会召开
articles.title_en: Municipal CPPCC Holds Special Briefing Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，济南市政协专题情况通报会召开，市长于海田通报全市上半年经济形势和下半年工作重点，市政协主席孙开连主持。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Jinan Municipal CPPCC held a special briefing meeting. Mayor Yu Haitian briefed on H1 economic situation and H2 work priorities, and CPPCC Chairman Sun Kailian chaired.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议 切实做好防灾减灾救灾工作 全力守护人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting, Stresses Disaster Prevention and Relief
articles.summary_zh: 28日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示，部署防灾减灾及人工智能发展等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, Qu Xiaojie, Mayor of Jieyang, chaired the municipal government party group meeting and executive meeting to convey Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploy disaster prevention, AI development, and other work.

articles.title_zh: 曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议、常务会议
articles.title_en: Qu Xiaojie Chairs Municipal Government Party Group Meeting and Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 28日上午，揭阳市市长曲晓杰主持召开市政府党组会议和常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示，部署防灾减灾和人工智能等工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, Qu Xiaojie, mayor of Jieyang, chaired the municipal government party group meeting and executive meeting to convey General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions and deploy disaster prevention, mitigation and AI-related work.

articles.title_zh: 市政协七届二十八次常委会会议召开 通过人事事项
articles.title_en: Jieyang Municipal Political Consultative Conference Holds 28th Standing Committee Meeting, Passes Personnel Matters
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，揭阳市政协七届二十八次常委会会议召开，传达学习习近平总书记讲话，听取经济通报，并通过人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the 28th meeting of the 7th Jieyang Municipal Political Consultative Conference Standing Committee was held. It studied Xi Jinping's speech, heard an economic report, and passed personnel changes.

articles.title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会（扩大）会议传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话重要指示精神
articles.title_en: Dawa Tsering Chairs Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting to Convey Xi Jinping's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 近日，拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委常委会会议，传达学习习近平总书记和王沪宁的重要讲话精神，部署人工智能、安全生产、教育及民族宗教等工作。
articles.summary_en: Recently, Lhasa Party Secretary Dawa Tsering chaired a municipal Party committee meeting to convey the spirit of President Xi Jinping's and Wang Huning's important speeches, deploying work on AI, safety, education, and ethnic/religious affairs.

articles.title_zh: 王强深入墨竹工卡县调研时强调立足特色资源 推动优势互补 办好民生实事 提升群众获得感幸福感安全感
articles.title_en: Wang Qiang Visits Mozhugongka County, Stresses Tourism Integration and Livelihood Improvement
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，拉萨市长王强到墨竹工卡县调研产业发展、项目建设和民生改善，强调做好旅游开发、产业延链补链和民生实事。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Lhasa Mayor Wang Qiang visited Mozhugongka County to inspect industrial development and livelihood projects, emphasizing tourism integration and industrial chain expansion.

articles.title_zh: 李强在河北唐山调研慰问时强调 持续提升防灾减灾救灾能力 切实保障人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Visits Tangshan to Stress Disaster Prevention and Relief Capabilities
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，受习近平总书记委托，国务院总理李强到河北唐山调研慰问，强调持续提升防灾减灾救灾能力，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, entrusted by General Secretary Xi Jinping, Premier Li Qiang visited Tangshan, Hebei to investigate and express condolences, stressing continuous improvement of disaster prevention, mitigation and relief capabilities to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 王君正对全区人大代表工作作出批示 严金海出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Makes Instructions on People's Congress Representatives Work, Yan Jinhai Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，全区人大代表工作会议在拉萨召开，王君正作出批示，严金海讲话，部署代表工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the regional people's congress representatives work conference was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng gave instructions and Yan Jinhai delivered a speech, deploying representative work.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持召开自治区政府党组理论学习中心组学习会
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Chairs Government Party Group Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，西藏自治区党委副书记、主席嘎玛泽登在拉萨主持召开政府党组会议，专题学习习近平党建思想。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Gama Zedeng, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Tibet Autonomous Regional Committee and Chairman of the Regional Government, chaired a study meeting of the Leading Party Group of the Regional Government in Lhasa, focusing on Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building.

articles.title_zh: 中央层面通报3起整治形式主义为基层减负典型问题
articles.title_en: Central Authorities Report 3 Typical Cases of Formalism
articles.summary_zh: 日前，中央层面整治形式主义为基层减负专项工作机制办公室会同中央纪委办公厅通报3起典型问题，涉及统计造假、盲目决策、违规收费等。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Office of the Special Working Mechanism for Combating Formalism and Reducing Burdens at the Grassroots Level, together with the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection, reported three typical cases of formalism, including statistical fraud, blind decision-making, and illegal fees.

articles.title_zh: 王智慧主持市委理论学习中心组2026年第五次集体学习研讨并讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Zhihui Chairs the Fifth Collective Study Seminar of the Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group in 2026
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，南阳市委书记王智慧主持市委理论学习中心组集体学习研讨，强调深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，以高质量党建引领现代化省域副中心城市建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Nanyang Municipal Party Committee Secretary Wang Zhihui chaired the collective study seminar of the Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Study Center Group, emphasizing in-depth study and implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on Party building to lead the construction of a modern provincial sub-center with high-quality Party building.

articles.title_zh: 王君正对全区人大代表工作作出批示 严金海出席全区人大代表工作会议并讲话
articles.title_en: Wang Junzheng Issues Instructions on Regional People's Congress Deputy Work; Yan Jinhai Attends and Speaks at Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，全区人大代表工作会议在拉萨召开。西藏自治区党委书记王君正作出批示，自治区人大常委会主任严金海出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the regional people's congress deputy work conference was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee, issued instructions, and Yan Jinhai, chairman of the regional people's congress standing committee, attended and gave a speech.

articles.title_zh: 嘎玛泽登主持西藏自治区政府党组学习会 深学细悟习近平党建思想
articles.title_en: Gama Zedeng Chairs Tibet Regional Government Party Group Study Session on Xi Jinping's Party Building Thought
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，西藏自治区党委副书记、自治区主席嘎玛泽登主持召开自治区政府党组理论学习中心组（扩大）学习会，专题学习习近平党建思想，强调以更高标准当好执行者、行动派、实干家。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Gama Zedeng, deputy secretary of the regional party committee and chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region, chaired a study session of the regional government's party leading group on Xi Jinping's thought on party building, emphasizing higher standards as executors and doers.

articles.title_zh: 第四次全国民政系统对口支援西藏工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Fourth National Conference on Civil Affairs Pairing Assistance to Xizang Held
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，第四次全国民政系统对口支援西藏工作推进会在拉萨召开。西藏自治区党委书记王君正、民政部党组书记李常官出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the Fourth National Conference on Civil Affairs Pairing Assistance to Xizang was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, Party Secretary of Xizang, and Li Changguan, Party Secretary of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, attended and addressed the meeting.

articles.title_zh: 汕头召开会议专题研究“百千万工程”“五年显著变化”攻坚工作
articles.title_en: Shantou Holds Meeting on 'Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands' Project's Five-Year Goals
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，汕头市委书记庄悦群主持召开专题会议，研究“百千万工程”五年显著变化攻坚工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired a special meeting to study the攻坚 work for the 'Five-Year Significant Change' goal of the 'Hundreds, Thousands, and Tens of Thousands' project.

articles.title_zh: 李晖带队开展夏季安康“三送”活动
articles.title_en: Li Hui Leads Summer Safety Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，泰州市市长李晖带队开展送清凉、送安全、送法律“三送”活动，走访慰问一线劳动者，强调保障健康安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui led a campaign to express care for frontline workers, visiting sanitation workers, power staff, firefighters, and builders, emphasizing health and safety.

articles.title_zh: 李晖带队开展夏季安康“三送”活动
articles.title_en: Mayor Li Hui Leads Summer Safety and Welfare Campaign in Taizhou
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，泰州市市长李晖带队开展夏季安康“三送”活动，慰问环卫工人、电力职工、消防指战员和高铁建设者。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Taizhou Mayor Li Hui led a summer safety and welfare campaign, visiting sanitation workers, power grid staff, firefighters, and high-speed rail construction workers.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛张义珍等省领导到省廉政教育中心参观展陈并开展警示教育
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Visit Jiangsu Integrity Education Center for Warning Education

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁向老同志通报全市改革发展重点工作
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Briefs Retired Officials on Shanghai's Reform and Development Priorities
articles.summary_zh: 陈吉宁昨日下午向老同志通报上海改革发展重点工作，强调贯彻习近平总书记考察上海重要讲话精神，落实市委全会部署，推进中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: Chen Jining yesterday afternoon briefed retired officials on Shanghai's reform and development priorities, emphasizing the implementation of General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspection speech and the city's party committee plans to advance Chinese-style modernization.

articles.title_zh: 吕梁市：布局数字产业推动全面转型
articles.title_en: Lvliang City: Deploying Digital Industry to Drive Comprehensive Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，吕梁市布局数字产业，以数字技术推动资源型城市全面转型，在医疗、工业等领域取得成效。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Lvliang City in Shanxi Province is deploying digital industry to drive comprehensive transformation of the resource-based city, with achievements in healthcare and industry.

articles.title_zh: 天津审批提速超50% 助力新能源汽车出口
articles.title_en: Tianjin Streamlines Approval for New Energy Vehicle Exports, Cutting Time by Over 50%
articles.summary_zh: 近日，天津海事局推出新能源汽车运输服务绿色通道，将申报审批时限压缩50%以上，首单快速审批业务已落地，助力京津冀外贸出口。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin Maritime Safety Administration launched a green channel for NEV shipping, cutting approval time by over 50%, with the first fast-track approval completed, boosting exports.

articles.title_zh: 天津今年新建改扩建10所中小学 秋季学期可投用
articles.title_en: Tianjin to Build or Expand 10 Primary and Secondary Schools by Fall Semester
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，天津市教委在民生实事吹风会上介绍，今年新建改扩建10所中小学，秋季学期全部投用，新增学位1.7万个。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Tianjin Municipal Education Commission announced at a press briefing that 10 primary and secondary schools will be built or expanded this year, all operational by fall, adding 17,000 seats.

articles.title_zh: 薛斌在兵团民政局和数据局调研时强调 高标准履行职能职责 让发展成果更多惠及职工群众
articles.title_en: Xue Bin Emphasizes High Standards in Civil Affairs and Data Bureau During Research Visit to XPCC
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，新疆自治区副主席、兵团党委副书记、司令员薛斌到兵团民政局、数据局调研，强调树立正确政绩观，推动民政和数字兵团建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Xue Bin, Vice Chairman of Xinjiang Autonomous Region and Commander of XPCC, visited the Civil Affairs Bureau and Data Bureau of XPCC, emphasizing correct performance view to advance civil affairs and digital XPCC construction.

articles.title_zh: 新疆实施工伤预防五年行动计划
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Implements Five-Year Action Plan for Work Injury Prevention
articles.summary_zh: 自治区人社厅等9部门联合印发《新疆维吾尔自治区工伤预防五年行动计划（2026—2030年）实施方案》，旨在降低工伤事故发生率。
articles.summary_en: The Xinjiang Human Resources and Social Security Department and 8 other departments jointly issued the implementation plan for the Work Injury Prevention Five-Year Action Plan (2026-2030), aiming to reduce work injury accident rates.

articles.title_zh: 兵团2026年城市体检工作全面启动
articles.title_en: XPCC Launches 2026 City Health Checkup Work
articles.summary_zh: 兵团住房和城乡建设局全面启动2026年城市体检工作，聚焦住房、社区、街区、城区四个维度，为城市更新赋能。
articles.summary_en: The Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau of XPCC launched the 2026 city health checkup, focusing on housing, communities, neighborhoods, and urban areas to empower urban renewal.

articles.title_zh: 兵团推动非遗保护传承成果更多惠及职工群众
articles.title_en: Bingtuan Promotes Intangible Cultural Heritage Preservation to Benefit the Masses
articles.summary_zh: 新疆兵团通过开设非遗课堂、举办活动等方式，推动非遗保护传承成果惠及各族职工群众。
articles.summary_en: Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps promotes intangible cultural heritage through classes and events to benefit workers and the public.

articles.title_zh: 西藏阿里联网工程2026年度检修正式启动
articles.title_en: Tibet Ngari Power Grid Interconnection Project Starts Annual Maintenance 2026
articles.summary_zh: 西藏阿里与藏中电网联网工程2026年度检修于7月30日启动，涉及范围最广、保供要求高，将全面消除设备隐患，保障民生用电。
articles.summary_en: The Tibet Ngari-Central Tibet Grid Interconnection Project started its 2026 annual maintenance on July 30, aiming to eliminate equipment defects and ensure reliable power supply for residents.

articles.title_zh: 第四次全国民政系统对口支援西藏工作推进会召开
articles.title_en: Fourth National Conference on Paired Assistance to Tibet by Civil Affairs System Held
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，第四次全国民政系统对口支援西藏工作推进会在拉萨召开，西藏自治区党委书记王君正、民政部党组书记李常官出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the fourth national conference on paired assistance to Tibet by the civil affairs system was held in Lhasa. Wang Junzheng, Secretary of the Tibet Autonomous Regional Party Committee, and Li Changguan, Party Secretary of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, attended and delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 王宁会见出席第四期太平洋岛国议员研讨班各国代表
articles.title_en: Wang Ning Meets Representatives of Fourth Pacific Island Countries Legislators Seminar
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，云南省委书记王宁在昆明会见来华出席第四期太平洋岛国议员研讨班的各国代表，各方表示将加强合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Wang Ning, Secretary of Yunnan Provincial Party Committee, met in Kunming with representatives of Pacific island countries attending the 4th Pacific Island Countries Legislators Seminar, with all sides pledging to strengthen cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 云南省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Session Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，云南省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在昆明闭幕，表决通过多项法规及人事任免。
articles.summary_en: The 24th session of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee concluded in Kunming on July 28, passing multiple local regulations and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 云南出台服务业扩能提质实施意见
articles.title_en: Yunnan Issues Implementation Opinions on Expanding and Improving Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，云南省在昆明举行新闻发布会，解读《关于推进服务业扩能提质的实施意见》，提出到2030年服务业增加值达2万亿元以上。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Yunnan held a press conference in Kunming to interpret the implementation opinions on promoting service industry expansion and quality improvement, aiming to increase the added value of the service industry to over 2 trillion yuan by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 宁波舟山港被纳入国家“十五五”口岸现代化规划
articles.title_en: Ningbo Zhoushan Port Included in National 15th Five-Year Port Modernization Plan
articles.summary_zh: 国新办发布会上，海关总署署长孙梅君介绍《口岸现代化“十五五”规划》，宁波舟山港三次被点名，纳入基础设施改造和智慧口岸工程。
articles.summary_en: At a State Council press conference, General Administration of Customs Director Sun Meijun introduced the '15th Five-Year Plan for Port Modernization', in which Ningbo Zhoushan Port was mentioned three times, included in infrastructure renovation and smart port projects.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委常委会召开会议 认真学习贯彻习近平总书记重要指示精神 研究部署基础教育和开发区高质量发展等工作
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Studies Basic Education and Development Zone Work
articles.summary_zh: 28日下午，北京市委常委会召开会议，由市委书记尹力主持，传达学习习近平总书记对基础教育和开发区工作的重要指示，研究部署相关落实意见，并听取巡视整改和高校毕业生就业情况汇报。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 28, the Beijing Municipal Party Committee Standing Committee held a meeting chaired by Secretary Yin Li to convey and study General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on basic education and development zones, and to deliberate on implementation opinions, as well as to hear reports on inspection rectification and graduate employment.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺诺瓦当选连任圣多美和普林西比总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Congratulates Carlos Vila Nova on Re-election as President of Sao Tome and Principe
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家主席习近平致电卡洛斯·诺瓦，祝贺他当选连任圣多美和普林西比民主共和国总统，并表示愿推动中圣普战略伙伴关系不断迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Carlos Vila Nova on his re-election as President of Sao Tome and Principe, expressing willingness to elevate the strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 中央宣传部授予王戟同志“时代楷模”称号
articles.title_en: Central Propaganda Department Awards Wang Ji the Title 'Role Model of the Times'
articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部向全社会宣传发布王戟同志先进事迹，授予他“时代楷模”称号。
articles.summary_en: The Central Propaganda Department publicized the exemplary deeds of Wang Ji and conferred on him the title 'Role Model of the Times'.

articles.title_zh: 深刻理解和把握新质生产力的理论价值与实践要求
articles.title_en: Deeply Understanding and Grasping the Theoretical Value and Practical Requirements of New Quality Productive Forces
articles.summary_zh: 文章系统阐述了新质生产力的理论内涵、价值取向和实践路径，强调要以科技创新为核心引擎推动生产力质态跃升。
articles.summary_en: The article systematically elaborates the theoretical connotation, value orientation, and practical path of new quality productive forces, emphasizing the need to drive a leap in productivity quality with technological innovation as the core engine.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚主持召开书记专题会议研究中央生态环境保护督察发现问题整改和调度“三大纠纷”排查化解工作
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Chairs Special Meeting on Central Eco-Environmental Protection Inspection Rectification and 'Three Major Disputes' Resolution
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚主持召开会议，研究中央环保督察整改和“三大纠纷”排查化解工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Chen Gang, Party Secretary of Guangxi, chaired a meeting to study rectification of central eco-environmental protection inspection issues and resolution of 'three major disputes'.

articles.title_zh: 徐麟李炳军会见海关总署署长、党委书记孙梅君一行
articles.title_en: Xu Lin and Li Bingjun Meet with Sun Meijun, Head of General Administration of Customs
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，贵州省委书记徐麟、省长李炳军在贵阳会见海关总署署长孙梅君一行，就深化开放合作、口岸建设等交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Guizhou Provincial Party Secretary Xu Lin and Governor Li Bingjun met with Sun Meijun, Director of the General Administration of Customs, in Guiyang to discuss opening-up cooperation and port construction.

articles.title_zh: 贵州省第十一届少数民族传统体育运动会开幕 徐麟宣布开幕
articles.title_en: Guizhou 11th Ethnic Minority Traditional Sports Games Opens, Xu Lin Declares Opening
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，贵州省第十一届少数民族传统体育运动会在凯里市开幕，省委书记徐麟宣布开幕，省长李炳军致辞，展现民族团结和体育风采。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 11th Guizhou Ethnic Minority Traditional Sports Games opened in Kaili. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Lin declared the opening, with Governor Li Bingjun delivering a speech, showcasing ethnic unity and sportsmanship.

articles.title_zh: 李炳军会见老挝甘蒙省省委副书记、行政管理委员会主席宋萨阿·恩喜达一行
articles.title_en: Li Bingjun Meets with Laos Khammouane Deputy Party Secretary Somsa'a Enxida
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，贵州省省长李炳军在贵阳会见老挝甘蒙省省委副书记宋萨阿·恩喜达一行，双方就深化友好省关系及经贸合作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Guizhou Governor Li Bingjun met with Somsa'a Enxida, Deputy Party Secretary of Laos' Khammouane Province, in Guiyang, discussing cooperation in trade, culture, and education.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，河南省长王凯主持召开省政府常务会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神，研究零碳园区建设、人工智能产业等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Governor Wang Kai of Henan chaired a provincial government executive meeting, conveying Xi Jinping's important speeches and discussing zero-carbon industrial parks, AI industry, and other matters.

articles.title_zh: 湖南发布2026年第2号总林长令
articles.title_en: Hunan Issues 2026 No.2 Chief Forest Chief Order
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，湖南省签发2026年第2号总林长令，聚焦林业产业高质量发展，目标到“十五五”末产值突破7400亿元。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Hunan Province issued the 2026 No.2 Chief Forest Chief Order, focusing on high-quality development of forestry industry, aiming to break through 740 billion yuan by the end of the 15th Five-Year Plan.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明赴省发展改革委调研
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Inspects Hunan Provincial Development and Reform Commission
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，湖南省委副书记、省长毛伟明赴省发展改革委调研，强调在高质量发展中展现更大作为。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Mao Weiming, Deputy Secretary of the Hunan Provincial Party Committee and Governor, visited the Provincial Development and Reform Commission to emphasize greater achievements in high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛张义珍等省领导到省廉政教育中心参观展陈并开展警示教育
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Visit Jiangsu Integrity Education Center for Warning Education
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，江苏省委书记信长星、省长刘小涛、省政协主席张义珍等到省廉政教育中心参观展陈，开展警示教育。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing, Governor Liu Xiaotao, and CPPCC Chairman Zhang Yizhen visited the Jiangsu Integrity Education Center for an exhibition and warning education.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事：康庄大道 山海偕行
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concern: A Broad Road Linking Mountains and Seas
articles.summary_zh: 今年是闽宁协作30年，习近平总书记6月就常态化做好东西部协作作出重要指示，强调总结闽宁协作经验推动共同富裕。30年来闽宁协作使“干沙滩”变“金沙滩”。
articles.summary_en: This year marks the 30th anniversary of Fujian-Ningxia collaboration. In June, Xi Jinping instructed to summarize experience and promote common prosperity. The collaboration turned a 'dry beach' into a 'golden beach' in 30 years.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 水利部对四川省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Activates Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Control in Sichuan
articles.summary_zh: 水利部7月29日对四川省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，以应对未来几天暴雨可能引发的洪水灾害。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Ministry of Water Resources activated a Level IV emergency response for flood control in Sichuan, as heavy rain is forecast to cause flooding in the coming days.

articles.title_zh: 凝心聚力共圆复兴之梦
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Issues Instructions on Overseas Chinese Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记对侨务工作作出重要指示，强调凝聚侨心侨力，共圆复兴之梦。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing uniting the hearts and strengths of overseas Chinese to realize the dream of national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 闽东宁德：“金娃娃”茁壮成长带动山海巨变
articles.title_en: Ningde's 'Golden Projects' Flourish, Driving Great Changes Across Mountains and Sea
articles.summary_zh: 新华社报道福建宁德依托青拓集团、宁德时代等龙头企业，形成四大主导产业，2025年青拓产值超2300亿元，产业带动山区与沿海协同发展。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports that Ningde, Fujian, led by Tsingshan Group and CATL, has formed four pillar industries. Tsingshan's output exceeded 230 billion yuan in 2025, driving coordinated development of mountainous and coastal areas.

articles.title_zh: 国家互联网信息办公室关于《中华人民共和国反网络暴力法（征求意见稿）》公开征求意见的通知
articles.title_en: CAC Seeks Public Comments on Draft Anti-Cyberbullying Law
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家互联网信息办公室会同有关部门起草《中华人民共和国反网络暴力法（征求意见稿）》，向社会公开征求意见，截止日期为8月28日。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the Cyberspace Administration of China released the draft Anti-Cyberbullying Law for public comment, with feedback accepted until August 28.

articles.title_zh: 三部门联合发布《邮政业发展“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Three Ministries Jointly Issue 15th Five-Year Plan for Postal Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国家邮政局、国家发展改革委、交通运输部联合发布《邮政业发展“十五五”规划》，提出到2030年邮政行业寄递业务量达2900亿件等目标。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, the State Post Bureau, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Transport jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Postal Industry Development, setting goals including 290 billion parcels by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 2026年工信领域创新任务揭榜挂帅工作启动
articles.title_en: Ministry Launches 2026 Open Competition for Industrial Innovation Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等七部门启动2026年工业和信息化领域创新任务揭榜挂帅工作，围绕未来产业、人工智能等6个方向设置24个专题，推动关键技术攻关。
articles.summary_en: The MIIT and six other departments launched the 2026 open competition for innovation tasks in industry and IT, setting 24 topics across six areas including future industries and AI to promote key technology breakthroughs.

articles.title_zh: 国新办发布会聚焦“十五五”时期知识产权工作新图景
articles.title_en: State Council Information Office Press Conference Focuses on New Vision for IP Work in 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 7月29日，国新办举行“开局起步‘十五五’”系列主题新闻发布会，国家知识产权局负责人介绍“十五五”时期知识产权工作部署，提出强化新兴领域知识产权保护、提升高价值发明专利指标等。
articles.summary_en: On July 29, at a State Council Information Office press conference, officials from the CNIPA detailed IP work plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan period, including strengthening protection in emerging fields and raising high-value invention patent targets.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期推进应对气候变化工作的总抓手——解读《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Interpretation of the 15th Five-Year Plan for Climate Change Response
articles.summary_zh: 近日，生态环境部等部门联合发布《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》，首次系统构建全领域应对气候变化目标体系，是“十五五”时期推进应对气候变化工作的总抓手。29日，生态环境部负责人解读规划重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other departments recently issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for Climate Change Response, the main lever for climate action during the period. Officials explained its key tasks on July 29.

articles.title_zh: 安徽铜陵：“智造”变革为老工业城市注入新动能
articles.title_en: Anhui Tongling: 'Smart Manufacturing' Transformation Injects New Momentum into Old Industrial City
articles.summary_zh: 新华社合肥7月29日电，铜陵作为老工业城市，通过智能制造推动产业升级，上半年高技术制造业增加值同比增长86.3%。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua reported on July 29 that Tongling, an old industrial city, is driving industrial upgrading through smart manufacturing, with high-tech manufacturing value-added up 86.3% in H1.

articles.title_zh: 天津市政府第11次专题学习暨全市政府系统领导干部大讲堂举行
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipal Government Holds 11th Thematic Study Session

articles.title_zh: 两部门公布5起烟花爆竹全链条“打非治违”典型案例

articles.title_zh: 生态环境部：今年上半年全国环境质量稳中向好
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment: National Environmental Quality Stable and Improving in First Half of Year

articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment held a press conference, reporting stable improvement in national environmental quality in the first half of the year, with PM2.5 average concentration down 6.6% year-on-year.

articles.title_zh: 台媒：柯文哲妻子到大陆旅游一周 称赞此行“惊喜、很棒”

articles.summary_en: Chen Peiqi, wife of Ko Wen-je, traveled to mainland China for a week, calling the trip 'surprising and great,' responding to Taiwan media criticism; Zhu Fenglian, spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office, said cross-strait exchanges represent mainstream public opinion.

articles.title_zh: 6月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题34700起
articles.title_en: 34,700 Violations of Central Eight-point Regulation Disciplined in June
articles.summary_zh: 中央纪委国家监委通报今年6月全国查处违反中央八项规定精神问题34700起，批评教育和处理43318人，给予党纪政务处分28426人。
articles.summary_en: In June, China's top anti-graft agency investigated 34,700 cases of violations of the Central Eight-point Regulation, involving 43,318 people, with 28,426 receiving party or administrative punishments.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在昆召开
articles.title_en: The 24th Session of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Convened in Kunming

articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 24th Session of the 14th Yunnan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee convened in Kunming to review multiple draft regulations, hear work reports, and consider personnel matters.

articles.title_zh: 《疾病预防控制“十五五”规划》发布 将健全社会广泛参与的传染病疫情防控工作格局
articles.title_en: China Releases '15th Five-Year Plan' for Disease Prevention and Control
articles.summary_zh: 国家疾控局会同有关部门起草的《疾病预防控制“十五五”规划》经国务院批复同意，已由7部门联合印发，提出到2030年建成现代化疾控体系。
articles.summary_en: The National Disease Control and Prevention Administration drafted the '15th Five-Year Plan' for Disease Prevention and Control, approved by the State Council and jointly issued by 7 departments, aiming to build a modern disease control system by 2030.

tags.name_en: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration

tags_en: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration

articles.title_zh: 李强在河北唐山调研慰问

articles.summary_en: Entrusted by President Xi Jinping, Premier Li Qiang visited Tangshan, Hebei on July 28 to offer condolences and inspect disaster prevention and relief work, stressing the need to enhance capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 上半年税收收入稳步增长 新质生产力发展成效明显
articles.title_en: Stable Growth in Tax Revenue in First Half of Year, New Quality Productive Forces Show Results

articles.summary_en: On July 28, the State Council Information Office held a press conference where the State Taxation Administration reported that tax revenue exceeded 10 trillion yuan in the first half of the year, up 4.9% year-on-year, with notable progress in new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 何立峰出席2026年亚太经合组织林业部长级会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: He Lifeng Attends and Addresses 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry

articles.summary_en: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 2026 APEC Ministerial Meeting on Forestry in Shenzhen on July 28.

articles.title_zh: 强化汛期保障，多地多部门多措并举确保民众平安出行
articles.title_en: Strengthen Flood Season Guarantee: Multiple Departments Take Measures to Ensure Safe Travel

articles.summary_en: During the critical flood season, the Ministry of Transport activated defense responses, and multiple departments strengthened patrols and controls to ensure safe travel for the public.

articles.title_zh: 习近平举行仪式欢迎斯洛伐克总统访华

articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping held a ceremony at the Great Hall of the People on the morning of July 28 to welcome Slovak President Peter Pellegrini on a state visit to China.

articles.title_zh: 王毅出席全球发展倡议5周年高级别会议

articles.title_zh: 全国政协召开"加快农业农村现代化"专题协商会 王沪宁出席并讲话

articles.summary_en: The National Committee of the CPPCC held a special consultation meeting on accelerating agricultural and rural modernization in Beijing on July 28, with Wang Huning attending and delivering a speech, stressing key issues to boost high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: APEC林业部长级会议通过联合声明

articles.summary_en: The 2026 APEC Forestry Ministers Meeting was held in Shenzhen on July 27-28, adopting a joint statement that focuses on biodiversity protection, combating illegal timber trade, and sustainable forest management.

articles.title_zh: 各地区各部门全力应对台风“红霞”

articles.summary_en: On July 27, the Central Meteorological Observatory issued multiple warnings including yellow rainstorm alert; the State Flood Control launched a Level IV emergency response; the Ministry of Finance allocated 180 million yuan for disaster relief.

articles.summary_en: A review of Xi Jinping's important expositions on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing uniting the hearts and strengths of overseas Chinese to promote new achievements in overseas Chinese work and contribute to national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 汕头市召开上半年经济形势分析会暨市委财经委会议

Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn chaired and delivered a speech, analyzing economic performance and deploying work for the second half.
