articles.title_en: Zhang Hongwei and Lu Xiwang Meet with Liu Jidong, Chairman of State Grid Henan Electric Power
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，信阳市委书记张宏伟、市长卢希望会见国网河南省电力公司董事长刘继东，双方围绕电网建设改造和清洁能源开发达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Xinyang Party Secretary Zhang Hongwei and Mayor Lu Xiwang met with Liu Jidong, Chairman of State Grid Henan Electric Power, reaching consensus on grid construction and clean energy development.

articles.title_zh: 吴炜调研人工智能产业发展工作
articles.title_en: Wu Wei Investigates AI Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日下午，盐城市委副书记、代市长吴炜调研人工智能产业发展工作，强调坚持创新引领、应用导向。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 27, Wu Wei, Deputy Secretary and Acting Mayor of Yancheng, investigated AI industry development, emphasizing innovation and application orientation.

articles.title_zh: 严汉平调研新闻宣传工作
articles.title_en: Yan Hanping Inspects News and Publicity Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，市委书记严汉平调研盐城市新闻宣传工作，强调把准方向、守正创新、讲好盐城故事。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Yancheng Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yan Hanping inspected the city's news and publicity work, emphasizing the need to keep the correct direction, uphold integrity and innovation, and tell Yancheng's stories well.

articles.title_zh: 十三届自治区党委第八轮巡视完成反馈
articles.title_en: 8th Round of Inspection by Ningxia Regional Party Committee Completed Feedback
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏自治区党委第八轮巡视反馈工作近日完成，李邑飞、张雨浦出席集中反馈会议，部署整改工作。
articles.summary_en: The 8th round of inspection feedback by Ningxia Regional Party Committee was recently completed. Li Yifei and Zhang Yupu attended the centralized feedback meeting and deployed rectification work.

articles.title_zh: 李邑飞在宁夏奶产业高质量发展专题会上强调坚定信心推动全产业链发展
articles.title_en: Li Yifei Chairs Ningxia Dairy Industry High-Quality Development Symposium, Stresses Confidence and Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，宁夏召开奶产业高质量发展专题会，自治区党委书记李邑飞主持会议并讲话，强调推动奶产业全产业链高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Ningxia held a symposium on high-quality development of the dairy industry. Party Secretary Li Yifei presided and emphasized full-chain development.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市坡头区委召开常委会（扩大）会议
articles.title_en: Potou District Committee of Zhanjiang Holds Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日上午，区委书记刘剑主持召开区委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神及多个中央文件，部署党建和扫黑除恶工作。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, District Party Secretary Liu Jian chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee, conveying the spirit of Xi Jinping's important speeches and multiple central documents, and deploying Party building and anti-crime work.

articles.title_zh: 余钢到湛江综合保税区调研并召开现场办公会
articles.title_en: Yu Gang Inspects Zhanjiang Comprehensive Bonded Zone and Holds On-Site Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日上午，市委书记余钢到湛江综合保税区调研并召开现场办公会，强调推动综保区提质进位、高水平开放。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, Municipal Party Secretary Yu Gang visited Zhanjiang Comprehensive Bonded Zone and chaired an on-site meeting, emphasizing high-level opening up and quality development.

articles.title_zh: 湛江市“八一”拥军慰问总团到南部战区海军走访慰问
articles.title_en: Zhanjiang August First Army Support Delegation Visits Southern Theater Command Navy
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，湛江市委书记余钢、市长李勇毅率拥军慰问总团走访慰问南部战区海军，双方座谈共商双拥发展大计。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Zhanjiang Party Secretary Yu Gang and Mayor Li Yongyi led the army support delegation to visit the Southern Theater Command Navy, discussing military-civilian unity and development.

articles.title_zh: 县委书记罗红霞主持召开县委常委会（扩大）会议部署防灾减灾基础教育等工作
articles.title_en: Luo Hongxia Chairs County Party Committee Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting to Deploy Disaster Prevention and Basic Education
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，县委书记罗红霞主持召开县委常委会（扩大）会议，传达学习习近平总书记重要指示，部署防灾减灾、基础教育等工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, County Party Secretary Luo Hongxia chaired an enlarged meeting of the Standing Committee of the County Party Committee, conveying and studying important instructions from General Secretary Xi Jinping, and deploying work on disaster prevention and reduction, basic education, etc.

tags.name_en: Full and Strict Governance of the Party

tags_en: Full and Strict Governance of the Party

articles.title_zh: 全市重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会召开
articles.title_en: Zhoukou City Holds Weekly Meeting on Key Projects and Enterprise Appeals
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，周口市召开重点项目建设暨企业诉求办理周例会，市委书记黄玉国出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Zhoukou City held a weekly meeting on key project construction and enterprise appeal handling, with Party Secretary Huang Yuguo attending and speaking.

articles.title_zh: 山东省政府党组会议召开 学习习近平总书记重要讲话
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Party Leadership Group Meeting Held to Study Xi Jinping's Important Speeches
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，山东省省长周乃翔主持召开省政府党组会议，学习习近平总书记近期重要讲话和指示精神。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Governor Zhou Naixiang chaired the Shandong Provincial Government Party Leadership Group meeting to study Xi Jinping's recent important speeches and instructions.

articles.title_zh: 中国法学会会员工作推进会在我市召开
articles.title_en: China Law Society Membership Work Promotion Meeting Held in Zibo
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日下午，中国法学会会员工作推进会在淄博召开，中国法学会副会长景汉朝出席并讲话，副省长夏凤俭、市委书记马晓磊致辞。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 27, the China Law Society Membership Work Promotion Meeting was held in Zibo. Jing Hanchao, Vice President of the China Law Society, attended and spoke; Vice Governor Xia Fengjian and Party Secretary Ma Xiaolei delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 受贿1.44亿余元，重庆市政协原副主席段成刚被判无期
articles.title_en: Former Chongqing CPPCC Vice Chairman Duan Chenggang Sentenced to Life for Bribery of Over 144 Million Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市政协原副主席段成刚因受贿1.44亿余元被判处无期徒刑。
articles.summary_en: Duan Chenggang, former vice chairman of Chongqing CPPCC, was sentenced to life imprisonment for bribery of over 144 million yuan.

tags.name_en: Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

tags_en: Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference

articles.title_zh: 中央军委后勤保障部等六部门发布通告：禁止涉军队退役报废装备销售活动
articles.title_en: Six Central Military Commission Departments Ban Sale of Retired and Scrapped Military Equipment
articles.summary_zh: 中央军委后勤保障部、装备发展部等六部门联合发布通告，禁止涉军队退役报废装备的销售活动。
articles.summary_en: Six departments under the Central Military Commission jointly issued a notice banning the sale of retired and scrapped military equipment.

articles.title_zh: 全国总工会原副主席张世平被开除党籍
articles.title_en: Former Vice Chairman of All-China Federation of Trade Unions Zhang Shiping Expelled from Party
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月27日，全国总工会原副主席张世平因安排亲属不实际工作而获取薪酬等违纪问题被开除党籍。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, 2026, former Vice Chairman of All-China Federation of Trade Unions Zhang Shiping was expelled from the Party for arranging relatives to receive salaries without actual work.

articles.title_zh: 任刚调研单人AI创业家（OPIE）平台建设 人工智能发展、科技创新等工作
articles.title_en: Ren Gang Inspects OPIE Platform and AI Development in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，青岛市委副书记、市长任刚到市北区、李沧区调研单人AI创业家平台建设、人工智能发展等工作，强调培育智能产业，为高质量发展注入新动能。
articles.summary_en: On July 28 morning, Ren Gang, Deputy Secretary of the Qingdao Municipal Committee and Mayor, visited Shibei and Licang districts to inspect the OPIE platform and AI development, stressing the need to cultivate intelligent industries for high-quality growth.

articles.title_zh: 全市人大常委会主任座谈会召开
articles.title_en: Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee Holds Symposium of Directors
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，青岛市人大常委会主任座谈会在市人大代表教育保障中心召开，市人大常委会党组书记、主任梅建华出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, the Qingdao Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee held a symposium of directors at the Municipal People's Congress Representative Education Support Center, attended by Mei Jianhua, who delivered a speech.

articles.title_zh: 2026年《财富》世界500强榜单发布 3家川企上榜
articles.title_en: 2026 Fortune Global 500 List Released: Three Sichuan Enterprises Make the Cut
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月28日，《财富》世界500强榜单发布，3家四川企业上榜，位次呈现两升一降。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, 2026, the Fortune Global 500 list was released, featuring three Sichuan enterprises: Shudao Investment Group, Tongwei Group, and New Hope Holdings. Their rankings showed two rising and one falling.

articles.title_zh: 四川发布“十五五”时期首批城市更新机会清单
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases First Batch of Urban Renewal Opportunity List for 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，四川在成都发布“十五五”时期首批城市更新机会清单，涵盖1753个项目，计划总投资5218亿元。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Sichuan released the first batch of urban renewal opportunity list for the '15th Five-Year Plan' period in Chengdu, covering 1,753 projects with a total planned investment of 521.8 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 村里来了“洋亲戚” 驻华外交官在袁家村串门“取经”
articles.title_en: Foreign Diplomats Visit Yuanjia Village to Learn about Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，来自多国的驻华外交官走进袁家村，体验乡村振兴模式，与村民交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, foreign diplomats from multiple countries visited Yuanjia Village to experience and learn about rural revitalization models, engaging with villagers.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同斯洛伐克总统会谈：相信你这次访问将为中斯关系不断向前发展注入新动力
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Slovak President: Believes This Visit Will Inject New Impetus into the Continuous Development of China-Slovakia Relations
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日上午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的斯洛伐克总统佩列格里尼举行会谈，双方愿打造中斯战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 28, President Xi Jinping held talks with Slovak President Pellegrini, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Both sides expressed willingness to build a China-Slovakia strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 时政微视频丨蹚出来一条路子——习近平推动海南自贸港“样板间”建设
articles.title_en: Political Micro-Video: Xi Jinping Promotes Hainan Free Trade Port as a Model
articles.summary_zh: 微视频回顾习近平2022年考察洋浦经济开发区，强调推动港口与自贸港建设，展示2025年封关运作后成果。
articles.summary_en: A micro-video reviews Xi Jinping's 2022 inspection of Yangpu Economic Development Zone, emphasizing port and free trade port development, showcasing achievements after the 2025 island-wide customs closure.

articles.title_zh: 看到一封封侨批，习近平一席话意味深长
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Remarks on Overseas Chinese Letters and Remittances
articles.summary_zh: 习近平近日对侨务工作作出指示，强调凝聚侨心侨力；此前在汕头参观侨批文物馆时发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping recently instructed on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing unity; earlier he spoke at a Qiaopi museum in Shantou.

articles.title_zh: 扎实做好生态环境法典实施准备工作——生态环境部回应法典实施相关热点问题
articles.title_en: Ministry of Ecology and Environment Responds to Hot Issues on the Implementation of the Ecological Environment Code
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，生态环境部法规与标准司司长赵柯在新闻发布会上介绍法典实施准备工作，包括文件清理、配套措施等进展。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Zhao Ke, Director of the Department of Regulations and Standards of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, briefed the press on progress in preparing for the implementation of the Ecological Environment Code, including document review and supporting measures.

articles.title_zh: 外交部回应强闯中国使馆的村田晃大被起诉
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry Responds to Indictment of Man Who Stormed Chinese Embassy in Japan
articles.summary_zh: 日本东京地方检察厅对持刀闯入中国驻日本使馆的自卫队官员村田晃大提起公诉，外交部发言人林剑28日答问时敦促日方彻查。
articles.summary_en: Japan's Tokyo District Public Prosecutors Office indicted Murata Akihiro, a Self-Defense Force officer who stormed the Chinese embassy in Japan. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian urged Japan to conduct a thorough investigation.

articles.title_zh: 江西宜春拟推进中考体育过程测评改革，多个县市担忧经费和实施难题
articles.title_en: Yichun, Jiangxi Plans to Reform Middle School PE Exam Process Assessment; Several Counties Worry About Funding and Implementation
articles.summary_zh: 江西宜春市教育体育局公布中考体育改革方案征求意见情况，多个县市教体局反映实施难度和经费问题。
articles.summary_en: Yichun City Education Bureau released feedback on the reform plan for the high school entrance exam physical education, with multiple county education bureaus expressing concerns about implementation difficulties and funding.

articles.title_zh: 市场监管总局查办“最忙五人组”相关违法案件4件，罚款17万元
articles.title_en: Market Regulation Authority Investigates 4 Cases Related to 'Busiest Five' Group, Fines 170,000 Yuan
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局今天召开新闻发布会，通报查办节庆展会论坛违法违规行为，其中查办“最忙五人组”相关案件4件，罚款17万元。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation held a press conference today, reporting that during a three-month special rectification, it investigated 4 cases related to the 'Busiest Five' group and imposed fines of 170,000 yuan.

articles.title_zh: 佛山顺德成立全国首个具身智能发展局
articles.title_en: Foshan Shunde Establishes China's First Embodied Intelligence Development Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月28日，广东佛山顺德区成立全国首个具身智能发展局，由海玉宝任局长，旨在统筹产业发展，推动人工智能与制造业融合。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, 2026, Shunde District in Foshan, Guangdong, established China's first Embodied Intelligence Development Bureau, with Hai Yubao as director, to coordinate industrial development and integrate AI with manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 擅自使用“中国”“全国”等字样，一批非法社会组织被取缔
articles.title_en: Illegal Social Organizations Using 'China' or 'National' Titles Banned
articles.summary_zh: 民政部通报今年上半年全国处置非法社会组织702个，其中一批冒用官方背景、擅自使用“中国”“全国”等字样的组织被依法取缔。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Civil Affairs reported handling 702 illegal social organizations in H1 2026, including groups unauthorizedly using 'China' or 'National' in their names, which were dissolved.

articles.title_zh: 两部文物管理文件出台：规范革命文物保护与国有文物数据管理
articles.title_en: Two Cultural Heritage Management Documents Issued: Regulating Revolutionary Heritage Protection and State-Owned Heritage Data Management
articles.summary_zh: 28日，国家文物局召开新闻发布会，介绍出台《革命文物保护工程技术导则（试行）》和《国有文物资源数据管理办法》。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the National Cultural Heritage Administration held a press conference to introduce the issuance of two documents: the 'Technical Guidelines for Revolutionary Cultural Relic Protection (Trial)' and the 'Measures for the Management of State-Owned Cultural Relic Resource Data'.

articles.title_zh: 金圆集团成立15周年：服务产业 融合两岸 打造一流科创金融投资集团
articles.title_en: Jinyuan Group Celebrates 15th Anniversary: Serving Industry, Integrating Cross-Strait, Building First-Class Sci-Tech Finance Investment Group
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，厦门金圆集团成立15周年，上海协同中心揭牌，与国泰海通证券签署战略合作，与复旦大学共建研究基地。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, Xiamen Jinyuan Group marked its 15th anniversary, inaugurated its Shanghai Collaboration Center, signed a strategic cooperation agreement with GTJA Haitong Securities, and established a research base with Fudan University.

articles.title_zh: 广西新能源汽车充电量首次突破10亿千瓦时
articles.title_en: Guangxi New Energy Vehicle Charging Volume Exceeds 1 Billion kWh for First Time
articles.summary_zh: 2026年上半年，广西新能源汽车充电量达11.86亿千瓦时，同比增长46.96%，绿色出行规模创新高。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of 2026, Guangxi's new energy vehicle charging volume reached 1.186 billion kWh, a year-on-year increase of 46.96%, setting a new record for green travel.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记强调建设全国统一大市场 为创业创新营造更优环境
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Emphasizes Building a Unified National Market to Create a Better Environment for Innovation and Entrepreneurship
articles.summary_zh: 2025年3月，习近平总书记在贵州考察时强调要积极融入全国统一大市场建设，破除地方保护，为全社会创业创新营造稳定公平透明可预期的环境。
articles.summary_en: In March 2025, during an inspection in Guizhou, President Xi Jinping stressed the need to actively integrate into the construction of a unified national market, break down local protectionism, and create a stable, fair, transparent, and predictable environment for entrepreneurship and innovation.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲在哈尔滨市调研农机装备产业项目建设工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Investigates Agricultural Machinery Equipment Industry Project Construction in Harbin
articles.summary_zh: 27日至28日，黑龙江省委副书记、省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨市调研农机装备产业项目建设工作，强调加快培育农业新质生产力，推动智能农机产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 27-28, Liang Huiling, Deputy Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee and Governor, inspected agricultural machinery equipment industry projects in Harbin, emphasizing accelerating the cultivation of new agricultural productive forces to promote high-quality development of the intelligent agricultural machinery industry.

articles.title_zh: 许勤：发挥人民政协协商议政职能 促进黑龙江省人工智能高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xu Qin: Leverage Political Consultative Functions to Promote High-Quality AI Development in Heilongjiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月28日，黑龙江省政协召开十三届十五次常委会会议，省委书记许勤出席并讲话，强调发挥政协协商议政职能，促进人工智能高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 28, the Heilongjiang Provincial Political Consultative Conference held its 15th Standing Committee meeting. Provincial Party Secretary Xu Qin attended and spoke, emphasizing the role of political consultation in promoting high-quality AI development.

articles.title_zh: 长江之滨，新能源巨轮何以驶向全球
articles.title_en: New Energy Ships Set Sail Globally from the Yangtze River
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部数据显示，造船业对工业增长贡献率达23.5%；江苏靖江造船业三大指标占全球一定份额，扬子江船业研发清洁能源船，订单排至2030年。
articles.summary_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology data shows shipbuilding contributes 23.5% to industrial growth. Jingjiang, Jiangsu, holds significant global shipbuilding shares; Yangzijiang Shipbuilding develops clean energy vessels with orders through 2030.

articles.title_zh: 江西省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议举行
articles.title_en: 24th Session of 14th Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Convened
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，江西省十四届人大常委会第二十四次会议在南昌举行，省委书记、省人大常委会主任尹弘主持，会议听取多项报告并审议人事任免议案。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 24th session of the 14th Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee met in Nanchang, chaired by Yin Hong. The meeting heard reports and considered personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古鄂尔多斯发布零碳机场技术成果
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia Ordos Releases Zero-Carbon Airport Technical Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古鄂尔多斯市7月27日召开全球首个零碳机场技术成果发布会，该技术由北京大学鄂尔多斯能源研究院研发，达到国际领先水平。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Ordos, Inner Mongolia held a conference to release the world's first zero-carbon airport technical achievement, which was developed by the Peking University Ordos Energy Research Institute and reached international leading level.

articles.title_zh: 青岛市崂山区“十五五”规划纲要发布
articles.title_en: Laoshan District, Qingdao Issues 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 崂山区人民政府印发“十五五”规划纲要，提出打造创新型品质城区，明确十二大战略任务。

articles.title_zh: 景德镇手工瓷业遗存列入《世界遗产名录》
articles.title_en: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain Heritage Inscribed on World Heritage List
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，在韩国釜山召开的联合国教科文组织第48届世界遗产大会上，中国景德镇手工瓷业遗存成功列入《世界遗产名录》，中国世界遗产总数达61项。习近平总书记强调要保护好、传承好、传播好中华文化瑰宝。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, at the 48th UNESCO World Heritage Committee session in Busan, South Korea, China's 'Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain Heritage' was successfully inscribed on the World Heritage List, bringing China's total World Heritage sites to 61. President Xi Jinping emphasized the importance of protecting, inheriting, and promoting this Chinese cultural treasure.

articles.summary_en: On July 25, the Fujian Tea Science and Education Symposium was held in Fuzhou, where a decision was made to form the Fujian 'Three Tea' Research and Education Consortium to integrate tea industry resources.

articles.title_zh: 让全社会创业创新环境更优——总书记关切在各地落地

articles.summary_en: In March 2025, President Xi Jinping stressed the need to integrate into the national unified market, leading regions to break local protection and involution, achieving initial progress.

articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾了习近平总书记2023年7月来川视察三年来，四川在科技创新、产业升级、乡村振兴、生态保护、改革开放和民生改善等方面取得的显著成就。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews Sichuan's achievements over the past three years since General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspection in July 2023, highlighting progress in innovation, industry, rural revitalization, ecology, reform, and people's livelihoods.

articles.summary_en: On July 27, 2026, Hunan Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming delivered a lecture on establishing and practicing a correct view of performance.

articles.summary_en: On July 27, the 10th Congress of the CPC Yangzhou Guangling District was held, where District Party Secretary Zhang Wei outlined six key tasks for the next phase.

articles.summary_en: According to the Ministry of Water Resources, China implemented 33,000 water projects from January to June, with investment reaching 515.1 billion yuan, and major projects like the Yangtze-Han River diversion accelerated.

articles.title_zh: 江苏半年经济观察：关键指标的“升”与“势”

articles.summary_en: Recently, the State Council approved the 15th Five-Year Plan for Disability Protection and Development. On July 27, at a press conference, Li Dongmei, Vice Chairperson of CDPF, said they will promote barrier-free environment construction in urban and rural areas.

articles.title_zh: 中国残联：要把提高困难和重度残疾人社会保障水平摆在突出位置
articles.title_en: China Disabled Persons' Federation: Improve Social Security for People with Disabilities

articles.summary_en: On July 27, Zhou Changkui, Party secretary of the China Disabled Persons' Federation, stated at a press conference that social security for disabled persons will be enhanced through four aspects: basic guarantees, empowerment, rights protection, and cultural supply.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀出台2项区域协同地方标准
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Releases Two Regional Collaborative Standards
articles.summary_zh: 近日，京津冀三地市场监管部门联合发布2项区域协同地方标准，用碳普惠机制促进交通领域减污降碳协同治理。
articles.summary_en: Recently, market regulatory authorities of Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei jointly released two regional collaborative standards to promote carbon inclusion mechanisms for pollution and carbon reduction in transportation.

articles.title_zh: 海南出台“十五五”开放型经济发展规划 推动缩减自贸港跨境服务贸易负面清单
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Open Economy, Pushes to Cut Cross-Border Services Negative List
articles.summary_zh: 海南省政府办公厅印发《“十五五”海南开放型经济发展规划》，明确推动缩减跨境服务贸易负面清单等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: Hainan provincial government issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for open economy, aiming to reduce the cross-border services trade negative list and other key tasks.

articles.title_zh: 海南发布政商交往正负面清单
articles.title_en: Hainan Issues Positive and Negative Lists for Government-Business Interactions
articles.summary_zh: 海南省印发政商交往行为指引清单，列出正面清单十项和负面清单"六个严禁"，营造一流营商环境。
articles.summary_en: Hainan Province issued guidelines listing positive and negative behaviors for government-business interactions, aiming to improve the business environment.

articles.title_zh: 海南省“十五五”服务业发展规划出台 岛内居民日用消费品免税店将实现市县全覆盖
articles.title_en: Hainan's 15th Five-Year Plan for Service Industry Development Issued, Duty-free Shops for Daily Consumer Goods to Cover All Counties and Cities
articles.summary_zh: 海南省政府办公厅印发《海南省“十五五”服务业发展规划》，提出到2030年服务业增加值占GDP比重维持61%左右，实现免税店市县全覆盖。
articles.summary_en: Hainan Provincial Government Office issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for service industry development, aiming to keep service sector value-added at around 61% of GDP by 2030 and achieve full coverage of duty-free shops for daily consumer goods across all counties and cities.

articles.title_zh: 海南启动红色文旅线上推广活动 发布8条红色旅游精品线路
articles.title_en: Hainan Launches Online Promotion for Red Culture Tourism, Releases 8 High-Quality Red Tourism Routes
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南省旅游和文化广电体育厅启动红色文旅线上推广活动，发布8条覆盖多市县的红色旅游精品线路。
articles.summary_en: Recently, the Department of Tourism, Culture, Radio, Television and Sports of Hainan Province launched an online promotion for red culture tourism, releasing 8 high-quality red tourism routes covering multiple cities and counties.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组第四组明查暗访江西省见面会在南昌召开
articles.title_en: Central Work Safety Inspection Team Holds Meeting in Nanchang for Jiangxi
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，中央安全生产考核巡查组第四组在南昌召开见面会，组长凌志峰讲话，江西省省长叶建春作表态发言。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, the fourth central work safety inspection team held a meeting in Nanchang. Team leader Ling Zhifeng spoke, and Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun gave a statement.

articles.title_zh: 江西省委政法委举办第三期全省“政法大讲堂”
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission Holds Third Provincial 'Political and Legal Lecture Hall'
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，江西省委政法委举办第三期全省“政法大讲堂”，省委副书记、省委政法委书记陈永奇主持并讲话，强调学习贯彻习近平党建思想，推进作风建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, the Jiangxi Provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission held the third provincial 'Political and Legal Lecture Hall'. Chen Yongqi, Deputy Secretary of the Provincial Party Committee and Secretary of the Provincial Political and Legal Affairs Commission, presided and delivered a speech, emphasizing the study and implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on party building and promoting work style construction.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏发布工业领域产业创新关键技术揭榜攻关项目
articles.title_en: Ningxia Releases Key Technology Bidding Projects for Industrial Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 7月23日，宁夏工信厅发布2026年工业领域产业创新关键技术揭榜攻关项目立项名单，25个项目获得支持，聚焦现代化工、新材料等产业。
articles.summary_en: On July 23, the Ningxia Department of Industry and Information Technology released the list of 2026 key technology bidding projects for industrial innovation, supporting 25 projects focusing on modern chemicals, new materials, etc.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同巴西总统卢拉通电话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Phone Call with Brazilian President Lula
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日上午，国家主席习近平应约同巴西总统卢拉通电话，双方就中巴命运共同体建设和全球治理等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, President Xi Jinping had a telephone conversation with Brazilian President Lula upon request, exchanging views on building a China-Brazil community with a shared future and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 海西：实施“五大工程” 打造文旅品牌
articles.title_en: Haixi Implements 'Five Major Projects' to Build Cultural Tourism Brand
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，海西蒙古族藏族自治州在西宁举行新闻发布会，宣布“十五五”期间实施五大工程，打造文旅品牌。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, the Haixi Mongolian and Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture held a press conference in Xining to announce the implementation of five major projects during the 15th Five-Year Plan period to build a cultural tourism brand.

articles.title_zh: 2026年长三角一体化示范区开发者大会召开 多项平台清单发布
articles.title_en: 2026 Yangtze River Delta Integration Demonstration Zone Developer Conference Held, Multiple Platforms and Lists Released
articles.summary_zh: 今天下午，2026年长三角一体化示范区开发者大会在上海召开，发布急需紧缺人才目录、场景能力清单等。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Yangtze River Delta Integration Demonstration Zone Developer Conference was held in Shanghai this afternoon, releasing a list of urgently needed talents and scenario capability lists.

articles.title_zh: 上海（普陀）国家数字广告产业园区试点建设启动
articles.title_en: Pilot for Shanghai (Putuo) National Digital Advertising Industry Park Launched
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局批复同意在上海市普陀区开展为期3年的国家数字广告产业园区试点，为上海打造“国际数字广告之都”筑牢承载支点。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation approved a 3-year pilot for the National Digital Advertising Industry Park in Putuo District, Shanghai, aiming to build Shanghai into an 'International Digital Advertising Capital'.

articles.title_zh: 天津市持续推动“津农精品”品牌培育提质升级
articles.title_en: Tianjin Continues to Promote 'Jinnong Premium' Brand Cultivation and Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 天津市农业农村委推进“津农精品”品牌建设，目前品牌达229个，推动农业品牌化、标准化、融合化发展。
articles.summary_en: Tianjin Municipal Agriculture and Rural Committee advances 'Jinnong Premium' brand cultivation, with 229 brands currently, promoting agricultural branding, standardization, and integration.

articles.title_zh: 苏州产业联盟赴林周开展帮扶活动
articles.title_en: Suzhou Industry Alliance Visits Linzhou for Aid Activities
articles.summary_zh: 苏州市智能制造产业联盟组织企业家和党员代表赴林周县，开展党建联建、产业洽谈、爱心助学等综合援藏帮扶活动。
articles.summary_en: The Suzhou Intelligent Manufacturing Industry Alliance organized entrepreneurs and party members to visit Linzhou County for comprehensive aid activities including party building, industry talks, and student support.

articles.title_zh: 综合运输服务发展“十五五”规划发布
articles.title_en: Comprehensive Transport Service Development '15th Five-Year' Plan Released
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部等部门印发规划，提出到2030年基本建成现代化综合运输服务体系。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Transport and other departments issued a plan proposing to basically establish a modern comprehensive transport service system by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 云南新能源电池产业持续强劲增长
articles.title_en: Yunnan's New Energy Battery Industry Continues Strong Growth
articles.summary_zh: 今年上半年，云南新能源电池产业增加值同比增长89.9%，产值过亿项目达24个，产业从材料向电芯制造高地跃升。
articles.summary_en: In the first half of the year, Yunnan's new energy battery industry value-added grew 89.9% year-on-year, with 24 projects exceeding 100 million yuan in output, marking a leap from materials to cell manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 第四届滇商大会在昆举行
articles.title_en: 4th Yunnan Business Conference Held in Kunming
articles.summary_zh: 7月26日，第四届滇商大会在昆明举行，约300名嘉宾出席，省委书记王宁致辞。
articles.summary_en: On July 26, the 4th Yunnan Business Conference was held in Kunming, with about 300 guests attending and provincial party secretary Wang Ning delivering a speech.

articles.title_zh: 浙江发布人工智能OPC术语团体标准
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Releases Group Standard for AI OPC Terminology
articles.summary_zh: 近日，浙江省数字经济发展中心联合14家单位发布国内首个《人工智能OPC术语》团体标准，将于8月1日起实施，为AI一人公司认定提供统一参照。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Digital Economy Development Center, together with 14 entities, released the first group standard for AI OPC (one-person company) terminology, effective August 1, providing unified reference for OPC identification.

articles.title_zh: 世界规模最大！我国卫生健康四大体系交出亮眼答卷
articles.title_en: China Builds World's Largest Health Systems, Says Health Commission Head
articles.summary_zh: 7月21日，国家卫生健康委主任雷海潮在北京表示，我国建成并持续巩固世界上规模最大的医疗服务、传统医药、疾病预防控制和医疗保障体系。
articles.summary_en: On July 21, Lei Haichao, head of the National Health Commission, stated in Beijing that China has built and continues to consolidate the world's largest medical service, traditional medicine, disease prevention and control, and medical security systems.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同巴西总统卢拉通电话
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Phone Call with Brazilian President Lula
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日上午，国家主席习近平应约同巴西总统卢拉通电话，就中巴关系、金砖合作等交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 27, President Xi Jinping held a phone call with Brazilian President Lula upon request, exchanging views on bilateral ties and BRICS cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省安委会全体（扩大）会议召开 刘小涛出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Safety Committee Holds Expanded Meeting, Liu Xiaotao Attends and Speaks
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，江苏省安委会全体（扩大）会议召开，省长刘小涛出席并讲话，强调全面排查整治安全风险隐患。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, the Jiangsu Provincial Safety Committee held an expanded meeting. Governor Liu Xiaotao attended and delivered a speech, emphasizing comprehensive investigation and rectification of safety risks.

articles.title_zh: 刘小涛会见吉利控股集团董事长李书福
articles.title_en: Liu Xiaotao Meets Geely Chairman Li Shufu
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日，省长刘小涛在南京会见吉利控股集团董事长李书福，双方就深化新能源汽车等领域合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 24, Governor Liu Xiaotao met with Geely Chairman Li Shufu in Nanjing to discuss deepening cooperation in new energy vehicles and other areas.

articles.title_zh: 这组数据，看中国“三农”新发展
articles.title_en: Data Shows New Progress in China's Agriculture, Rural Areas, and Farmers
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，农业农村部部长张柱在形势政策报告会上通过一系列数据，展现“十四五”时期我国“三农”发展新成就和未来前景。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, Minister Zhang Zhu presented data at a policy briefing showcasing new achievements in agricultural, rural, and farmer development during China's 14th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 中国世界遗产总数达61项：景德镇手工瓷业遗存申遗成功
articles.title_en: China's World Heritage Sites Reach 61: Jingdezhen Porcelain Industry Heritage Inscribed
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日，联合国教科文组织第48届世界遗产大会上，中国“景德镇手工瓷业遗存”申遗成功，中国世界遗产总数达61项。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, at the 48th UNESCO World Heritage Committee session, China's 'Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain Industry Heritage' was successfully inscribed, bringing China's total World Heritage sites to 61.

articles.title_zh: 七部门联合部署开展全民消防安全素质提升行动
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Jointly Deploy National Fire Safety Quality Improvement Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 近日，国家消防救援局等七部门联合印发方案，部署在全国开展全民消防安全素质提升行动，目标提升公民消防意识和技能。
articles.summary_en: Recently, seven departments including the National Fire and Rescue Administration jointly issued a plan to launch a nationwide campaign to enhance public fire safety awareness and skills.

articles.title_zh: 两部门预拨1.8亿元支持6省防汛防台风应急抢险救灾
articles.title_en: Two Ministries Allocate 180 Million Yuan for Flood and Typhoon Relief in Six Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 7月27日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨1.8亿元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持广东、福建等6省防汛防台风应急抢险救灾。
articles.summary_en: On July 27, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management allocated 180 million yuan for flood and typhoon relief in six provinces including Guangdong and Fujian.

articles.title_zh: 找准为民服务的着力点
articles.title_en: Finding the Right Focus for Serving the People
articles.summary_zh: 文章强调为民服务要找准着力点，通过主动找问题、为开创先例想办法、变“难解”为“优解”等方式，切实解决群众难题。
articles.summary_en: The article emphasizes the need to find the right focus for serving the people, by proactively identifying problems, innovating solutions, and turning difficulties into favorable outcomes.

articles.title_zh: 住房城乡建设部：进一步加强城市桥梁安全管理工作
articles.title_en: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development: Further Strengthening Urban Bridge Safety Management
articles.summary_zh: 住房城乡建设部27日发布通知，要求加强城市桥梁安全管理，包括汛期安全、定期检测和智慧监测。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development issued a notice on July 27, requiring enhanced urban bridge safety management, including flood season safety, regular inspections, and smart monitoring.

articles.title_zh: 三部门调拨2.5万件物资支持粤赣湘等地救灾救助工作
articles.title_en: Three Departments Allocate 25,000 Relief Supplies to Guangdong, Jiangxi, Hunan for Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 7月26日，国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室、应急管理部会同国家粮食和物资储备局向广东、江西、湖南调拨2.5万件中央救灾物资，支持受灾群众安置救助。
articles.summary_en: On July 26, the National Disaster Prevention and Relief Committee Office and the Ministry of Emergency Management, together with the National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration, allocated 25,000 central relief supplies to Guangdong, Jiangxi, and Hunan for typhoon and flood disaster relief and resettlement.

articles.title_zh: 中国梦是国家梦、民族梦，也是每个中华儿女的梦——习近平总书记关于侨务工作的重要论述凝聚共同致力民族复兴的强大力量
articles.title_en: "Chinese Dream is the Dream of the Nation and Every Chinese" — Xi Jinping's Important Discourse on Overseas Chinese Affairs Gathers Strength for National Rejuvenation
articles.summary_zh: 新华社北京7月26日电，文章阐述习近平总书记关于侨务工作的重要论述，强调凝聚侨心侨力，共同致力于中华民族伟大复兴。
articles.summary_en: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing July 26, an article elaborates on Xi Jinping's important discourse on overseas Chinese affairs, emphasizing uniting overseas Chinese to contribute to national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 我国成为世界上少数红树林面积持续增加的国家之一
articles.title_en: China Becomes One of Few Countries with Continuously Increasing Mangrove Area
articles.summary_zh: 7月26日保护红树林生态系统国际日，国际红树林中心正式运行，我国红树林面积达3.17万公顷，比本世纪初增加44%。
articles.summary_en: On July 26, International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem, the International Mangrove Center officially commenced operations. China's mangrove area reached 31,700 hectares, a 44% increase from the beginning of this century.

articles.title_zh: 截至6月底我国智能算力规模同比增长177%
articles.title_en: China's Intelligent Computing Power Capacity Up 177% YoY by End of June
articles.summary_zh: 截至今年6月底，我国智能算力规模达2185EFLOPS，同比增长177%，工业和信息化部发布数据。
articles.summary_en: China's intelligent computing power capacity reached 2185 EFLOPS (FP16) by the end of June, up 177% year-on-year, according to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

articles.title_zh: 汪华东在调研杜集区重点项目时强调大抓项目抓大项目抓高质量项目为高质量转型发展集聚动能
articles.title_en: Wang Huadong Emphasizes Major Projects for High-quality Transformation during Inspection in Duji District
articles.summary_zh: 7月26日下午，市委书记汪华东赴杜集区调研重点项目，强调大抓项目、抓高质量项目，为高质量转型发展集聚动能。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 26, Wang Huadong, Secretary of the Huaibei Municipal Party Committee, visited Duji District to inspect key projects, emphasizing the importance of pursuing high-quality projects to drive transformation and development.

articles.title_zh: 汪华东调研杜集区重点项目
articles.title_en: Wang Huadong Inspects Key Projects in Duji District
articles.summary_zh: 7月26日下午，市委书记汪华东赴杜集区调研重点项目，强调要深入学习贯彻习近平总书记考察安徽重要讲话精神，大抓项目为转型发展集聚动能。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 26, Municipal Party Secretary Wang Huadong inspected key projects in Duji District, emphasizing the need to thoroughly study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech during his inspection of Anhui, and to vigorously pursue projects to gather momentum for transformation and development.

articles.title_zh: 省委常委会（扩大）会议：坚决拥护党中央决定 坚定不移推进全面从严治党
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee (Enlarged) Meeting: Firmly Support the CPC Central Committee's Decision and Unwaveringly Advance Full and Strict Governance of the Party
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月25日，海南省委常委会召开扩大会议，表示坚决拥护党中央决定，并坚定不移推进全面从严治党。
articles.summary_en: On July 25, 2026, the Standing Committee of the Hainan Provincial Party Committee held an enlarged meeting, expressing firm support for the CPC Central Committee's decision and unwavering commitment to advancing full and strict governance of the Party.

articles.title_zh: 陈涛带队督导检查台风“红霞”防御工作
articles.title_en: Chen Tao Leads Inspection of Typhoon 'Red Rainbow' Defense Work
articles.summary_zh: 7月25日上午，汕头市长陈涛赴金平区、潮阳区督导检查台风“红霞”防御工作，强调做实防御措施，保障群众安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 25, Shantou Mayor Chen Tao led an inspection of typhoon 'Red Rainbow' defense work in Jinping and Chaoyang districts, emphasizing concrete measures to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 庄悦群到市应急指挥中心调度部署台风防御工作
articles.title_en: Zhuang Yuequn Deploys Typhoon Defense at Emergency Command Center
articles.summary_zh: 7月24日晚，汕头市委书记庄悦群到市应急指挥中心，调度部署台风'红霞'防御工作，强调人民至上、生命至上，落实各项防御措施。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of July 24, Shantou Party Secretary Zhuang Yuequn visited the municipal emergency command center to deploy defense measures against Typhoon Hongxia, emphasizing people-first and life-first principles.

articles.title_zh: 王相民主持召开市委常委会会议 传达学习习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Wang Xiangmin Presides over Standing Committee Meeting of Siping Municipal CPC Committee

articles.summary_en: Bai He-ping, a member of the Standing Committee of the Jining Municipal Committee in Shandong Province, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 公安机关严厉打击编造传播涉汛涉灾网络谣言
articles.title_en: Public Security Organs Crack Down on Online Rumors Regarding Floods and Disasters
articles.summary_zh: 公安机关采取严厉措施，打击在网络上编造和传播涉汛涉灾谣言的行为，以维护网络秩序和社会稳定。
articles.summary_en: Public security organs are taking strict measures to crack down on the fabrication and dissemination of online rumors related to floods and disasters to maintain cyber order and social stability.

articles.title_zh: 2026年上半年中国元首外交纪实
articles.title_en: A Record of China's Head-of-State Diplomacy in the First Half of 2026
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾了2026年上半年习近平主席开展的元首外交活动，包括与美、俄、朝等国领导人的会晤，旨在推动构建人类命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews President Xi Jinping's head-of-state diplomatic activities in the first half of 2026, including meetings with leaders of the US, Russia, and North Korea to promote a community with a shared future for mankind.

articles.title_en: National Safety Standard for Combined Driving Assistance Systems Released
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部组织制定的《智能网联汽车 组合驾驶辅助系统安全要求》强制性国家标准近日发布，拟于2027年1月1日起正式实施。
articles.summary_en: The mandatory national standard 'Safety Requirements for Combined Driving Assistance Systems for Intelligent Connected Vehicles,' organized by MIIT, has been released and will take effect on January 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: “甘味”系列区域公用品牌价值评价成果发布
articles.title_en: Value Evaluation Results of 'Ganwei' Series Regional Public Brands Released
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日，甘肃省在兰州举办“甘味”区域公用品牌价值评价成果发布会，公布了包括兰州百合在内的五个代表性品牌价值，合计逾668亿元。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, Gansu Province held a conference in Lanzhou to release the value evaluation results of five 'Ganwei' regional public brands, with a total value exceeding 66.8 billion yuan.

articles.title_zh: 海南海洋低空经济发展协会成立
articles.title_en: Hainan Marine Low-Altitude Economy Development Association Established
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南海洋低空经济发展协会在海口成立，旨在推动海南海洋经济与低空经济深度融合，构建全链条产业生态圈。
articles.summary_en: The Hainan Marine Low-Altitude Economy Development Association was recently established in Haikou to promote the integration of marine and low-altitude economies and build a full-chain industrial ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 外籍人士在琼便利化服务工作协调机制专题工作会议在海口召开
articles.title_en: Special Meeting on Facilitating Services for Foreigners in Hainan Held in Haikou
articles.summary_zh: 7月12日，省长刘小明在海口主持召开外籍人士在琼便利化服务工作协调机制专题工作会议，部署优化涉外服务体系以赋能海南自贸港高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 12, Governor Liu Xiaoming chaired a special meeting in Haikou to deploy improvements to services for foreigners to support the high-quality development of the Hainan Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 南通火车站综合客运枢纽开发工程项目通过竣工验收
articles.title_en: Nantong Railway Station Comprehensive Passenger Transport Hub Project Passes Completion Acceptance
articles.summary_zh: 近日，南通火车站综合客运枢纽开发工程项目通过竣工验收，将显著提升南通站客运承载能力，助力南通打造全国性综合交通枢纽城市。
articles.summary_en: The Nantong Railway Station Comprehensive Passenger Transport Hub project recently passed completion acceptance, enhancing passenger capacity and supporting Nantong's goal of becoming a national transport hub.

articles.title_zh: 复兴号动卧列车首次在青藏铁路投运
articles.title_en: Fuxing Sleeper Trains Launched on Qinghai-Tibet Railway for the First Time
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日，CR200J型复兴号动卧列车在青藏铁路西宁至格尔木段正式投运，实现了高原铁路客运服务能级的提升。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, CR200J Fuxing sleeper trains officially began operation on the Xining-Golmud section of the Qinghai-Tibet Railway, enhancing passenger transport services on the plateau.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省数据标注产业发展联盟成立
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Province Data Labeling Industry Development Alliance Established
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省数据和政务服务局统筹牵头成立陕西省数据标注产业发展联盟，旨在推动数据标注产业规范化、集群化发展，助力数字经济。
articles.summary_en: The Shaanxi Provincial Bureau of Data and Government Services led the establishment of the Shaanxi Province Data Labeling Industry Development Alliance to promote the standardized and clustered development of the data labeling industry.

articles.title_zh: 新版国家基本药物目录发布
articles.title_en: New National Essential Medicines List Released
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫生健康委发布《国家基本药物目录（2026年版）》，共收录药品794种，新增116种，将于今年9月1日起实施。
articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission released the 2026 edition of the National Essential Medicines List, featuring 794 drugs including 116 new additions, effective September 1.

articles.title_zh: 第四届中国—中东欧国家新闻发言人对话会举行
articles.title_en: The 4th China-CEEC News Spokespersons Dialogue Held
articles.summary_zh: 近日，第四届中国—中东欧国家新闻发言人对话会举行，20余名中东欧国家新闻发言人围绕新闻发布与现代化进程展开交流并赴多地参访。
articles.summary_en: The 4th China-CEEC News Spokespersons Dialogue was recently held, with over 20 spokespersons discussing news releases and modernization while visiting various Chinese cities.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记讲话为推动世界科技创新发展注入强劲动力
articles.title_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping's Speech Boosts Global Scientific and Technological Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记发表重要讲话，部署科技强国建设及“十五五”规划要求，引发国际科学界及多国人士对中国科技创新与全球治理的高度评价。
articles.summary_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping delivered a speech on building a S&T powerhouse and the 15th Five-Year Plan, receiving high praise from the international scientific community and foreign officials.

articles.title_zh: 全球首个自动驾驶系统统一技术法规发布 重庆多项关键提案被采纳
articles.title_en: First Global Unified Technical Regulation for Automated Driving Systems Released, Key Proposals from Chongqing Adopted
articles.summary_zh: 今年6月，由中国等六国牵头制定的全球首个自动驾驶系统统一技术法规（ADS GTR）正式发布，重庆长安汽车参与编制并贡献了多项被采纳的关键提案。
articles.summary_en: In June, the first global unified technical regulation for automated driving systems (ADS GTR), led by China and five other nations, was released, with key proposals from Chongqing's Changan Automobile adopted.

articles.title_zh: 2026年台湾大学生广州实习体验活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Internship Program for Taiwanese University Students Launched in Guangzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年台湾大学生广州实习体验活动于7月12日在广州启动，旨在通过实习历练促进两岸青年融合发展。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Internship Program for Taiwanese University Students was launched in Guangzhou on July 12 to promote integration and development between youth from both sides of the strait.

articles.title_zh: 两部门联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警
articles.title_en: Two Departments Jointly Issue Red Meteorological Warning for Flash Floods
articles.summary_zh: 水利部和中国气象局于7月12日联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警，提醒辽宁、吉林、安徽等地做好防汛预警和转移避险工作。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources and China Meteorological Administration jointly issued a red flash flood warning on July 12, urging regions like Liaoning, Jilin, and Anhui to take precautions.

articles.title_zh: 广西出台措施加强重度残疾人托养照护
articles.title_en: Guangxi Introduces Measures to Strengthen Foster Care for Severely Disabled Persons
articles.summary_zh: 广西自治区民政厅等11部门联合印发若干措施，通过摸清底数、加强供给等24条具体举措，构建覆盖城乡的重度残疾人托养照护服务体系。
articles.summary_en: Eleven departments in Guangxi, including the Civil Affairs Department, issued measures featuring 24 specific steps to build a comprehensive foster care service system for severely disabled persons.

articles.title_zh: 广西实施灌区工程与全域土地综合整治
articles.title_en: Guangxi Implements Irrigation District Projects and Comprehensive Land Consolidation
articles.summary_zh: 广西自然资源厅等四部门联合印发工作方案，通过协同实施灌区工程与全域土地综合整治，旨在保障粮食安全并助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: Four departments of Guangxi jointly issued a work plan to collaboratively implement irrigation district projects and comprehensive land consolidation to ensure food security and promote rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 湘鄂工程机械产业合作对接会举行 6家湘企与9家鄂企签约
articles.title_en: Hunan and Hubei Construction Machinery Industry Cooperation Meeting Held, Multiple Enterprises Sign Agreements
articles.summary_zh: 7月9日，鄂湘两省工程机械产业合作对接会在湖北随州举办，6家湖南整机制造龙头企业与9家湖北配套企业签署合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On July 9, a cooperation meeting for the construction machinery industry between Hunan and Hubei provinces was held in Suizhou, Hubei, where 6 leading Hunan manufacturers signed agreements with 9 Hubei suppliers.

articles.title_zh: 张工调度本轮强降雨应对工作
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Coordinates Response to Heavy Rainfall
articles.summary_zh: 7月11日至12日，天津市市长张工调度部署本轮强降雨应对及防汛防台风工作，旨在维护群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: From July 11 to 12, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong coordinated flood and typhoon prevention efforts to respond to heavy rainfall and ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 浙江安吉做强高端装备制造业
articles.title_en: Anji, Zhejiang Strengthens High-end Equipment Manufacturing Industry
articles.summary_zh: 6月末，浙江安吉举办中力股份创新发布会，展示数字化智造实力，推动高端装备制造业成为当地第一大工业产业。
articles.summary_en: At the end of June, Anji, Zhejiang hosted an innovation conference for Zhongli Machinery, showcasing digital manufacturing and promoting high-end equipment as the county's leading industrial sector.

articles.title_zh: 青海省省长罗东川在西宁督导检查消防安全与防汛减灾工作
articles.title_en: Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan Inspects Fire Safety and Flood Prevention in Xining
articles.summary_zh: 7月12日，青海省省长罗东川在西宁市突击检查消防安全及防汛减灾工作，要求坚决落实各项防范举措，确保群众安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: On July 12, Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan conducted surprise inspections of fire safety and flood prevention in Xining, emphasizing the implementation of safety measures to protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同金正恩就《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 65th Anniversary of China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月11日，习近平同朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩就《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年互致贺电，强调巩固中朝传统友谊，维护地区和平稳定。
articles.summary_en: On July 11, 2026, Xi Jinping and Kim Jong Un exchanged congratulatory messages on the 65th anniversary of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance, emphasizing the consolidation of traditional ties and regional stability.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在北京调研强调抓好水库安全度汛工作
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes Reservoir Safety During Flood Season During Inspection in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 7月12日，国务院副总理刘国中在北京调研水库安全度汛工作，要求全面落实防洪应对措施，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 12, Vice Premier Liu Guozhong inspected reservoir safety in Beijing, urging the full implementation of flood control measures to protect lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 我国新材料领域持续取得新突破
articles.title_en: China Continues to Make Breakthroughs in New Materials Field
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国新材料产业在智能材料、半导体等领域取得密集突破，产值近10万亿元，成为培育新质生产力的重要引擎。
articles.summary_en: Since the beginning of this year, China's new materials industry has achieved significant breakthroughs in intelligent materials and semiconductors, with an output value of nearly 10 trillion yuan, driving new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 海南自贸港加工增值免关税政策实施5年 享惠货值超121亿元
articles.title_en: Hainan Free Trade Port's Processing Value-Added Duty-Free Policy Marks 5 Years with Over 12.1 Billion Yuan in Benefiting Goods
articles.summary_zh: 海口海关消息，海南自贸港加工增值免关税政策实施5年，内销货值超121亿元，覆盖11个行业，助力海南打造前沿加工基地。
articles.summary_en: Haikou Customs reports that Hainan Free Trade Port's processing value-added duty-free policy has been implemented for five years, with domestic sales value exceeding 12.1 billion yuan across 11 industries.

articles.title_zh: 盐城从新四军历史汲取奋进力量 为民兴业为民造福
articles.title_en: Yancheng Draws Strength from New Fourth Army History to Benefit the People
articles.summary_zh: 江苏盐城传承新四军革命精神，通过建设滨海港和发展海上风电产业，将红色基因转化为推动绿色发展和民生改善的动力。
articles.summary_en: Yancheng, Jiangsu, inherits the revolutionary spirit of the New Fourth Army, transforming red heritage into momentum for green development and improving livelihoods through Binhai Port and offshore wind power.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：打通科技加速向现实生产力转化通道
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Clearing the Path for Accelerating the Transformation of Science and Technology into Actual Productivity
articles.summary_zh: 7月8日，习近平在北京出席中国国家科学技术奖励大会等会议并发表重要讲话，号召加快推进高水平科技自立自强，以科技创新支撑中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, Xi Jinping attended several science and technology conferences in Beijing, calling for high-level self-reliance in science and technology to support Chinese modernization.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到省气象局调研
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Provincial Meteorological Bureau
articles.summary_zh: 7月11日，省委书记刘宁到省气象局调研防汛备汛及预报预警工作，强调要提升监测预报精准度，筑牢防灾减灾救灾安全防线。
articles.summary_en: On July 11, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning inspected the Provincial Meteorological Bureau to review flood prevention and forecasting work, emphasizing the need to improve monitoring precision to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 我国统筹部署建设新型电网
articles.title_en: China Strategically Deploys Construction of New Power Grids
articles.summary_zh: 党中央统筹部署建设新型电网等“六张网”重大基础设施，旨在通过构建“主配微”协同体系和技术创新，保障国家能源安全并支撑中国式现代化。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee has deployed the construction of six major infrastructure networks, including new power grids, to ensure national energy security and support Chinese modernization through a 'main-distribution-micro' collaborative system.

articles.title_zh: 山东部署六大行动推动数据赋能人工智能发展
articles.title_en: Shandong Deploys Six Major Actions to Promote Data-Empowered AI Development
articles.summary_zh: 山东省大数据局起草《关于数据赋能人工智能创新发展的实施意见》，通过六大行动推动数据与人工智能协同发展，目标到2028年打造产业高地。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Big Data Bureau issued implementation opinions deploying six major actions to promote the synergy between data elements and AI, aiming to build an industry highland by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 云南拟出台措施支持旅居群体创新创业
articles.title_en: Yunnan Plans Measures to Support Innovation and Entrepreneurship for Sojourning Groups
articles.summary_zh: 云南省科技厅起草并征求意见的《若干措施》旨在通过设立服务专区、打造科创社区及提供最高200万元奖励，支持旅居群体在滇创新创业。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Department of Science and Technology has drafted measures to support innovation and entrepreneurship for sojourning groups through service zones, sci-tech communities, and financial rewards of up to 2 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省全面启动防台风I级响应，省长刘捷主持防御工作会商调度会议
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Activates Level I Typhoon Response, Governor Liu Jie Chairs Coordination Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 11日上午，浙江省全面启动防台风I级响应，省长刘捷主持召开台风“巴威”防御工作会商调度会议，部署各项防御措施以保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of the 11th, Zhejiang Province activated a Level I typhoon response. Governor Liu Jie chaired a coordination meeting to deploy defense measures against Typhoon Bawi to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 习近平会见朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with DPRK Premier Pak Tae-song
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月10日，习近平在北京会见朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成，双方就巩固中朝传统友好、加强战略协作及落实两国领导人共识进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, 2026, Xi Jinping met with DPRK Premier Pak Tae-song in Beijing to discuss strengthening traditional China-DPRK friendship and enhancing strategic coordination.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Namibian President Ndeetowa
articles.summary_zh: 7月10日下午，国家主席习近平在北京人民大会堂同来华进行国事访问的纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦举行会谈。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 10, President Xi Jinping held talks with Namibian President Ndeetowa, who is on a state visit to China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Meets with Namibian President Ndeetowa
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月10日，国家主席习近平在北京同纳米比亚总统恩代特瓦举行会谈，两国宣布将双边关系提升为新时代中纳命运共同体。
articles.summary_en: On July 10, 2026, President Xi Jinping held talks with Namibian President Ndeetowa in Beijing, where both leaders announced the elevation of bilateral relations to a China-Namibia Community with a Shared Future in the New Era.

tags.name_en: China-Namibia Community with a Shared Future

tags_en: China-Namibia Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 李强同朝鲜内阁总理会谈
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Holds Talks with North Korean Premier
articles.summary_zh: 李强同朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成举行会谈，双方强调将落实最高领导人共识，拓展经贸与民生合作，加强战略协调与配合。
articles.summary_en: Li Qiang held talks with North Korean Premier Pak Tae-song, emphasizing the implementation of the consensus between top leaders and expanding cooperation in trade, livelihood, and strategic coordination.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省政府与中国电力建设集团签订“十五五”战略合作协议
articles.title_en: Gansu Provincial Government and PowerChina Sign "15th Five-Year Plan" Strategic Cooperation Agreement
articles.summary_zh: 7月8日，甘肃省政府与中国电力建设集团在兰州签署“十五五”战略合作协议，旨在深化在能源电力、水利及基础设施等领域的合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, the Gansu Provincial Government and PowerChina signed a "15th Five-Year Plan" strategic cooperation agreement in Lanzhou to deepen collaboration in energy, water conservancy, and infrastructure.

articles.summary_en: Namibian President Ndeetowa arrived in Beijing on July 8 for a state visit, where she will hold talks with President Xi Jinping and meet with Premier Li Qiang and Chairman Zhao Leji.

articles.title_zh: 国开创新资本声明32家公司冒用其名义登记注册
articles.title_en: CDB Innovation Capital Statement on 32 Companies Falsely Using Its Name for Registration
articles.summary_zh: 国开创新资本投资有限责任公司于7月7日发布声明，指称包括湖北崇晏科技在内的32家公司冒用其名义登记注册，并将依法采取法律行动。
articles.summary_en: CDB Innovation Capital issued a statement on July 7, stating that 32 companies, including Hubei Chongyan Technology, falsely registered it as a shareholder and that legal action will be taken.

articles.title_zh: 湖北恩施开展“铁腕治旅”大讨论
articles.title_en: Enshi, Hubei Launches 'Iron-fisted Tourism Governance' Discussion
articles.summary_zh: 7月7日至8日，湖北恩施州开展“铁腕治旅 规范秩序”大讨论，8个县市领导表态将严厉整治旅游乱象，规范市场秩序。
articles.summary_en: From July 7 to 8, Enshi Prefecture in Hubei held a discussion on 'Iron-fisted Tourism Governance,' with leaders from eight counties and cities pledging to crack down on tourism irregularities.

articles.title_zh: 北京交通综治半年“成绩单”发布
articles.title_en: Beijing Releases Semi-Annual Report on Comprehensive Traffic Governance
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日至8日，北京市交通委发布交通综治半年成绩单，重点介绍了非机动车安全、公共交通提升、路口治理及停车管理等方面的成效。
articles.summary_en: From July 6 to 8, the Beijing Municipal Commission of Transport released a semi-annual report on comprehensive traffic governance, highlighting achievements in road safety, public transport, and congestion management.

articles.title_zh: 宁明县政协以精准履职赋能花山岩画高质量发展
articles.title_en: Ningming County CPPCC Empowers High-Quality Development of Huashan Rock Art
articles.summary_zh: 宁明县政协通过精准协商、提案监督及专业赋能，推动左江花山岩画世界文化遗产的保护利用与文旅产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Ningming County CPPCC has promoted the protection and high-quality development of the Zuojiang Huashan Rock Art World Heritage site through precise consultation, proposals, and supervision.

articles.title_zh: 科技金融高质量发展创新实践研究启动
articles.title_en: Research on Innovative Practices for High-Quality Development of Tech-Finance Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月8日，在河北雄安举行的2026中国品牌论坛金融高质量发展报告会上，科技金融高质量发展创新实践研究正式启动。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, 2026, research on innovative practices for the high-quality development of tech-finance was launched at the 2026 China Brand Forum's financial high-quality development report meeting in Xiong'an, Hebei.

articles.title_zh: 林武在潍坊督导调研
articles.title_en: Lin Wu Conducts Supervision and Research in Weifang
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日至7日，山东省委书记林武在潍坊市督导调研，强调要塑强产业优势，抓实整改整治，保障粮食稳定供给，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From July 6 to 7, Lin Wu, Secretary of the Shandong Provincial Party Committee, conducted a supervision and research tour in Weifang to emphasize industrial advantages, rectification of issues, and food security to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 上海发布推进乡村全面振兴“十五五”规划
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases 15th Five-Year Plan for Comprehensive Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 7月8日，上海市政府发布推进乡村全面振兴“十五五”规划，旨在到2030年加快实现农业现代化与城乡深度融合发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, the Shanghai Municipal Government released the 15th Five-Year Plan for Comprehensive Rural Revitalization, aiming to accelerate agricultural modernization and urban-rural integration by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 2026年高原铁路暑运启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Plateau Railway Summer Transport Season Begins
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，中国铁路青藏集团有限公司启动为期62天的2026年暑期运输保障工作，预计发送旅客470万人次。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, China Railway Qingzang Group Co., Ltd. launched its 62-day summer transport guarantee work for 2026, expecting to transport 4.7 million passengers.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平关于基层工作方法的重要论述学习读本》出版发行
articles.title_en: Study Reader on Xi Jinping's Important Expositions on Grassroots Work Methods Published
articles.summary_zh: 7月8日，由中央组织部组织编写的《习近平关于基层工作方法的重要论述学习读本》在全国出版发行。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, the 'Study Reader on Xi Jinping's Important Expositions on Grassroots Work Methods,' compiled by the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee, was published and distributed nationwide.

articles.title_en: Qingyang Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision Reports Three Typical Cases of Violating Central Eight-Point Regulation
articles.summary_zh: 庆阳市纪委监委通报了曹杰、刘广政、李世斌三起违反中央八项规定精神的典型问题，三人均被开除党籍并移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: The Qingyang Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision reported three typical cases of violating the central eight-point regulation involving Cao Jie, Liu Guangzheng, and Li Shibin, all of whom were expelled from the Party and referred for prosecution.

articles.title_zh: 民政部印发城乡三级养老服务网络建设管理指引
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs Issues Guidelines for Construction and Management of Three-Level Urban and Rural Elderly Care Service Network
articles.summary_zh: 民政部日前印发《城乡三级养老服务网络建设管理指引》，明确县、乡镇（街道）、村（社区）三级养老服务网络的设置方式与功能定位，旨在构建多层次养老服务体系。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs issued guidelines to establish a three-level urban and rural elderly care service network (county, township/street, and village/community levels) to provide diversified care for the elderly.

articles.title_zh: 省政府与部分部委在京举行工作会谈
articles.title_en: Hunan Provincial Government Holds Work Talks with Central Ministries in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日至7日，湖南省长毛伟明率团在北京与工业和信息化部、农业农村部、国家烟草专卖局举行工作会谈，旨在深化部省联动，推动湖南高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: From July 6 to 7, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming led a delegation to Beijing for work talks with the MIIT, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, and State Tobacco Monopoly Administration to strengthen cooperation and promote regional development.

articles.title_zh: 国家科学技术奖励大会、两院院士大会及中国科协全国代表大会在京召开
articles.title_en: National Science and Technology Award Conference and Academician Conferences Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月8日，国家科学技术奖励大会、两院院士大会及中国科协第十一次全国代表大会在北京召开，习近平出席并发表重要讲话并颁奖。
articles.summary_en: On July 8, 2026, the National Science and Technology Award Conference and other major scientific assemblies were held in Beijing, where Xi Jinping delivered a speech and presented awards.

articles.title_zh: 祖木热提·吾布力率执法检查组开展《中华人民共和国职业教育法》执法检查
articles.title_en: Zhumuretti Wubuli Leads Law Enforcement Inspection on Vocational Education Law
articles.summary_zh: 自治区人大常委会主任祖木热提·吾布力率组赴乌鲁木齐、博尔塔拉和阿克苏等地，就《中华人民共和国职业教育法》的实施情况开展执法检查。
articles.summary_en: Zhumuretti Wubuli, Director of the Autonomous Region People's Congress Standing Committee, led an inspection group to Urumqi, Bortala, and Aksu to check the implementation of the Vocational Education Law.

articles.title_zh: 周立伟任四川省委常委
articles.title_en: Zhou Liwei Appointed Member of Standing Committee of Sichuan Provincial Party Committee
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中共中央批准周立伟任中共四川省委委员、常委，此前他担任山东省委常委、委员。
articles.summary_en: The CPC Central Committee recently approved the appointment of Zhou Liwei as a member and standing committee member of the Sichuan Provincial Party Committee.

articles.title_zh: 中俄“海上联合-2026”联合演习在青岛举行
articles.title_en: China-Russia 'Joint Sea-2026' Naval Exercise Held in Qingdao
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月7日，中俄“海上联合-2026”联合演习在青岛举行，双方开展指挥推演、战术协同及实战化科目演练，旨在深化务实军事合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, 2026, the China-Russia 'Joint Sea-2026' naval exercise commenced in Qingdao, featuring command simulations, tactical coordination, and combat-realistic drills to deepen military cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中国代表强调不能把人权当作干涉别国内政的政治工具
articles.title_en: Chinese Representative Emphasizes Human Rights Should Not Be Used as Political Tool to Interfere in Internal Affairs
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，中国常驻联合国副代表孙磊在联大表示，评价人权不能搞双重标准，不能将其当作干涉别国内政的政治工具。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, Sun Lei, Deputy Representative of China to the UN, stated at the UN General Assembly that human rights should not be measured by double standards or used as a political tool to interfere in internal affairs.

articles.title_zh: 自然资源部对甘肃启动地质灾害防御Ⅲ级响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Natural Resources Initiates Level III Response to Geological Disasters in Gansu
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部对甘肃启动地质灾害防御Ⅲ级响应，要求省自然资源厅及相关技术机构派出专家组，协助开展搜救、抢险及监测预警工作。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources has initiated a Level III response to geological disasters in Gansu, directing provincial authorities and expert groups to provide technical support for rescue and monitoring.

articles.title_zh: “七一勋章”获得者吴亚琴：被居民群众需要就是最大的幸福
articles.title_en: Wu Yaqin, Recipient of the 'July 1st Medal': Being Needed by Residents is My Greatest Happiness
articles.summary_zh: 报道了“七一勋章”获得者、吉林省长春市长山花园社区党委第一书记吴亚琴通过加强基层党建和创新社区服务，改善居民生活环境并提升养老服务质量的先进事迹。
articles.summary_en: The article profiles Wu Yaqin, First Secretary of Changshan Garden Community in Changchun, Jilin, and recipient of the 'July 1st Medal,' highlighting her efforts in grassroots party building and improving community elderly care.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺藤森庆子当选秘鲁总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Keiko Fujimori on Election as President of Peru
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，国家主席习近平致电祝贺藤森庆子当选秘鲁总统，愿同其共同引领中秘全面战略伙伴关系迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Keiko Fujimori on her election as President of Peru, seeking to elevate the China-Peru comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 多部门联合部署安全生产“打非治违”
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Jointly Deploy Crackdown on Illegal Activities and Violations in Work Safety
articles.summary_zh: 国务院安委会办公室联合中央政法委等部门印发通知，部署在矿山、化工等重点行业深入开展安全生产“打非治违”工作。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Safety Committee Office and other departments issued a notice to launch a crackdown on illegal activities and violations in work safety, focusing on key sectors like mining and chemicals.

articles.title_zh: 中央宣传部新命名一批全国爱国主义教育示范基地
articles.title_en: Central Propaganda Department Names New Batch of National Patriotic Education Demonstration Bases
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，中央宣传部在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年之际，新命名了涵盖31个省区市和新疆生产建设兵团的77个全国爱国主义教育示范基地。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, the Central Propaganda Department named 77 new national patriotic education demonstration bases across 31 provinces and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps to mark the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.title_zh: 习近平对防汛救灾工作作出重要指示
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Gives Important Instructions on Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 习近平对广西、湖北、甘肃等地防汛救灾工作作出重要指示，要求全力组织抢险救援、伤员救治和群众安置，确保人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping issued important instructions on flood control and disaster relief in Guangxi, Hubei, and Gansu, urging all-out efforts in rescue, medical treatment, and resettlement to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 宁波北仑区通过党建联建推动城乡融合发展
articles.title_en: Beilun District of Ningbo Promotes Urban-Rural Integration Through Party Building Joint Construction
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省宁波市北仑区通过建立党建联建机制，统筹园区、社区与村镇资源，实现园村融合与工农互促，推动城乡要素顺畅流动。
articles.summary_en: Beilun District in Ningbo, Zhejiang, has established a Party building joint construction mechanism to integrate industrial parks, communities, and villages, facilitating the flow of urban-rural elements.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同黑山总统米拉托维奇就中国同黑山建交20周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Montenegrin President Milatović Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 20th Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，国家主席习近平同黑山总统米拉托维奇互致贺电，庆祝两国建交20周年，并表示愿深化互利合作，引领双边关系再上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, President Xi Jinping and Montenegrin President Milatović exchanged congratulatory messages to celebrate the 20th anniversary of diplomatic relations and expressed willingness to deepen mutually beneficial cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 国家文物局印发《国有文物资源数据管理办法》
articles.title_en: National Cultural Heritage Administration Issues Administrative Measures for State-owned Cultural Relics Resource Data
articles.summary_zh: 国家文物局近日印发《国有文物资源数据管理办法》，旨在规范国有文物资源数据的生产、安全保障及有序开放利用，将于2026年11月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The National Cultural Heritage Administration issued the "Administrative Measures for State-owned Cultural Relics Resource Data" to regulate data production, security, and open utilization, effective November 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 中央军委集体学习贯彻习近平主席重要讲话精神和习近平党建思想
articles.title_en: Central Military Commission Conducts Collective Study on President Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Party-Building Thought
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，中央军委在北京进行集体学习，学习贯彻习近平主席在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上的重要讲话精神和习近平党建思想。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, the Central Military Commission held a collective study session in Beijing to implement President Xi Jinping's speech at the CPC's 105th anniversary and his thoughts on party building.

articles.title_zh: 两部门开展网络平台涉志愿服务违规信息专项整治
articles.title_en: Two Departments Launch Special Rectification of Illegal Volunteer Service Information on Online Platforms
articles.summary_zh: 中央网信办与中央社会工作部于2026年6月下旬至8月下旬，开展为期两个月的网络平台涉志愿服务违规信息专项整治。
articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and the Central Social Work Department are conducting a two-month special rectification campaign from late June to late August 2026 to clean up illegal volunteer service information on online platforms.

articles.title_zh: 芬兰总统斯图布会见王毅
articles.title_en: Finnish President Stubb Meets Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 7月5日，芬兰总统斯图布在图尔库会见中国外交部长王毅，双方探讨加强高层交往及在绿色经济、人工智能等领域的合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 5, Finnish President Stubb met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Turku to discuss strengthening high-level exchanges and cooperation in green economy and AI.

articles.title_zh: 陕西省委原常委、西安市委原书记方红卫严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职
articles.title_en: Former Shaanxi Provincial Committee Member and Former Xi'an Municipal Committee Secretary Fang Hongwei Expelled from Party and Public Office
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月7日，中央纪委国家监委宣布，陕西省委原常委、西安市委原书记方红卫因严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职，其涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关审查起诉。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, 2026, the CCDI and NSC announced that Fang Hongwei, former member of the Shaanxi Provincial Committee and former Secretary of the Xi'an Municipal Committee, was expelled from the Party and public office for serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_en: Rule of Law Construction in China Achieves Fruitful Results to Safeguard High-Quality Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，司法部部长贺荣在北京出席形势政策系列报告会，就落实“两个更加注重”建设更高水平的社会主义法治国家作专题报告。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, Minister of Justice He Rong delivered a report in Beijing on building a higher-level socialist rule of law state during a policy report meeting.

articles.title_zh: 国务院批复《旅游强国建设“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Approves the '15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Tourism Powerhouse'
articles.summary_zh: 国务院原则同意文化和旅游部呈报的《旅游强国建设“十五五”规划》，要求以高质量发展为主题，加快建设旅游强国。
articles.summary_en: The State Council has approved the '15th Five-Year Plan for Building a Tourism Powerhouse,' emphasizing high-quality development and the integration of culture and tourism.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央组织部关于在防汛救灾工作中发挥基层党组织和党员作用的通知
articles.title_en: Notice of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee on Giving Full Play to the Role of Grassroots Party Organizations and Members in Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央组织部于7月7日发布通知，要求各级领导干部和基层党组织在防汛救灾工作中切实履行责任，发挥先锋模范作用，确保人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 7, the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee issued a notice urging grassroots party organizations and members to play a leading role in flood control and disaster relief to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 西沙自卫反击作战一等功臣吴先锋逝世
articles.title_en: Wu Xianfeng, First-Class Merit Winner of Xisha Self-Defense Counterattack, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 1974年西沙永乐群岛自卫反击作战一等功臣、原共青团广东省委副书记吴先锋于2026年7月5日在海南乐东逝世，享年76岁。
articles.summary_en: Wu Xianfeng, a first-class merit winner of the 1974 Xisha Self-Defense Counterattack and former Deputy Secretary of the Guangdong Provincial Committee of the Communist Youth League, passed away in Ledong, Hainan on July 5, 2026, at the age of 76.

articles.title_zh: 国家科技进步一等奖获得者孙庆瑞逝世
articles.title_en: Sun Qingrui, First Class National Science and Technology Progress Award Winner, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 北京大学发布讣告，国家科技进步一等奖获得者、曾参与原子弹研究的退休教授孙庆瑞于2026年7月2日逝世，享年90岁。
articles.summary_en: Peking University announced the passing of Sun Qingrui, a retired professor and First Class National Science and Technology Progress Award winner who contributed to atomic bomb research, on July 2, 2026, at age 90.

articles.title_zh: 多部门联动打击网络造谣传谣乱象
articles.title_en: Multiple Departments Jointly Crack Down on Online Rumors and Misinformation

articles.summary_en: Cai Dafeng, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, led an inspection team to Tianjin to oversee the implementation of the Vocational Education Law and promote high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: On July 6, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo emphasized the need to systematically improve solid waste governance and accelerate the comprehensive green transformation of economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 滇藏公路通车50周年：穿越横断山的现代之路
articles.title_en: 50th Anniversary of Yunnan-Tibet Highway: A Modern Road Through the Hengduan Mountains
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，滇藏公路迎来通车50周年。该公路自1950年起建设，打破了横断山的封闭，促进了边疆现代化与民族团结。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, the Yunnan-Tibet Highway marked its 50th anniversary. Built since 1950, the road broke the isolation of the Hengduan Mountains, promoting frontier modernization and ethnic unity.

articles.title_zh: 6月份中国物流业景气指数加快扩张
articles.title_en: China's Logistics Industry Prosperity Index Expanded Faster in June
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会数据显示，6月份中国物流业景气指数为50.6%，较上月上升0.3个百分点，业务总量和投资指数均有所回升。
articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing reported that China's logistics industry prosperity index rose to 50.6% in June, reflecting growth in business volume and investment.

articles.title_zh: 今年“两重”建设项目清单全部下达完毕
articles.title_en: List of 'Two Major' Construction Projects for the Year Fully Issued
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委近日下达2026年第三批“两重”建设项目，今年共安排8000亿元资金支持1417个重大项目建设。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission has issued the third batch of 'Two Major' construction projects for 2026, allocating a total of 800 billion yuan to 1,417 major projects this year.

articles.title_zh: 芬兰总统斯图布会见王毅
articles.title_en: Finnish President Stubb Meets Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 7月5日，芬兰总统斯图布在图尔库会见外交部长王毅，双方探讨加强高层交往及在绿色经济、人工智能等领域的合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 5, Finnish President Stubb met with Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Turku to discuss strengthening high-level exchanges and cooperation in green economy and AI.

articles.title_zh: 全年2000亿元设备更新资金总额下达完毕
articles.title_en: Total Annual Allocation of 200 Billion Yuan for Equipment Updates Completed
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委等部门已完成全年2000亿元超长期特别国债资金的下达，共支持22个领域约1.1万个设备更新项目。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC and relevant departments have completed the allocation of 200 billion yuan in ultra-long-term special treasury bonds, supporting approximately 11,000 equipment update projects across 22 fields.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在山东调研强调推动生物医药、农机装备创新及现代化水网建设
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes Innovation in Biopharmaceuticals, Agricultural Machinery, and Modern Water Network Construction During Shandong Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 国务院副总理刘国中于7月4日至6日在山东调研，强调要推动生物医药和农机装备创新发展，并加快推进现代化水网建设。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong conducted a research tour in Shandong from July 4 to 6, emphasizing the innovation of biopharmaceuticals and agricultural machinery, and the acceleration of modern water network construction.

articles.title_zh: 5月高技术制造业相关物流需求同比增长15.1%
articles.title_en: Logistics Demand for High-Tech Manufacturing Grew 15.1% in May
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会公布数据显示，1-5月全国社会物流总额同比增长5.2%，其中5月高技术制造业相关物流需求同比增长15.1%。
articles.summary_en: The China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing reported that total social logistics grew 5.2% from January to May, with high-tech manufacturing logistics demand increasing by 15.1% in May.

articles.title_zh: 中央军委进行集体学习学习贯彻习近平主席重要讲话精神和习近平党建思想
articles.title_en: Central Military Commission Conducts Collective Study on President Xi Jinping's Important Speech and Party-Building Thought
articles.summary_zh: 中央军委于6日进行集体学习，由副主席张升民主持，学习贯彻习近平主席在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上的重要讲话精神和习近平党建思想。
articles.summary_en: On the 6th, the Central Military Commission held a collective study session presided over by Vice Chairman Zhang Shengmin to implement President Xi Jinping's speech at the 105th CPC anniversary and his party-building thought.

articles.title_zh: 乌兰察布市人大常委会主任史良因病去世

articles.summary_en: Shi Liang, Director of the Standing Committee of the Ulanqab Municipal People's Congress, has passed away due to illness.

articles.summary_zh: 中央宣传部在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年之际，新命名了涵盖31个省区市和新疆生产建设兵团的77个全国爱国主义教育示范基地。

articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial CPPCC has officially launched a converged media matrix to showcase its work and create an online platform for public voice, focusing on rural revitalization and livelihood.

articles.summary_en: On July 6, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited state-owned art troupes to emphasize deepening reform and innovation to promote the prosperity of the province's literary and artistic undertakings.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江“人工智能+”系列学术交流活动举办

articles.summary_en: On July 4, the Heilongjiang Association for Science and Technology organized a series of "AI+" academic exchange activities focusing on mechanics equipment, modern agriculture, and computer technology to support regional development.

articles.title_zh: 受贿超22亿元 南京经开区管委会原常务副主任杨有林一审被判死刑
articles.title_en: Yang Youlin, Former Executive Deputy Director of Nanjing Economic Development Zone, Sentenced to Death for Taking Over 2.2 Billion Yuan in Bribes
articles.summary_zh: 南京经开区管委会原常务副主任杨有林因受贿超22亿元、贪污、行贿等多项罪名，被常州市中级人民法院一审判处死刑。
articles.summary_en: Yang Youlin, former Executive Deputy Director of Nanjing Economic Development Zone, was sentenced to death in the first instance by Changzhou Intermediate People's Court for bribery exceeding 2.2 billion yuan and other crimes.

articles.title_zh: 我国自然保护地体系建设进入系统集成、全面推进新阶段
articles.title_en: China's Nature Protected Area System Enters New Stage of Systematic Integration and Comprehensive Advancement
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月6日，人民日报报道我国自然保护地体系建设进入系统集成新阶段，通过法治化管理和生态治理，在保护生物多样性的同时提升民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, 2026, People's Daily reported that China's nature protected area system has entered a new stage of systematic integration, enhancing biodiversity and public welfare through legal frameworks and ecological governance.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏出台实施方案激活知识产权创新动能
articles.title_en: Ningxia Issues Implementation Plan to Boost Intellectual Property Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，宁夏回族自治区政府办公厅印发《进一步强化知识产权运用促进与公共服务实施方案》，旨在通过专利转化、金融赋能等举措激活知识产权创新动能。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, the General Office of the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region Government issued an implementation plan to boost intellectual property innovation through patent transformation and financial empowerment.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏组织召开新一轮空气质量持续改善行动推进会

articles.summary_zh: 宁夏生态环境厅近日召开推进会，统筹推进环境空气质量改善及打击监测数据造假行动，部署大气污染防治重点任务。
articles.summary_en: The Ningxia Department of Ecology and Environment recently held a meeting to promote air quality improvement and crack down on monitoring data fraud.

articles.summary_en: On July 2, Sichuan Tianfu New Area held a community commercial conference and released an opportunity list for community complexes to upgrade the '15-minute community happiness circle' and attract investment.

articles.title_zh: 四川省政府发布厅级领导职务人事任免通知
