articles.summary_zh: 四川省政府日前发布人事任免通知，任命邹青、崔大鹏等5人为相关职务，免去李辉、付东2人职务。
articles.summary_en: The Sichuan Provincial Government recently issued a notice on personnel appointments and removals, appointing five officials and removing two others.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同黑山总统米拉托维奇就中国同黑山建交20周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Montenegrin President Milatović Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 20th Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，国家主席习近平同黑山总统米拉托维奇互致贺电，庆祝两国建交20周年，并表示愿深化互利合作，引领两国关系再上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, President Xi Jinping and Montenegrin President Milatović exchanged congratulatory messages to celebrate the 20th anniversary of diplomatic relations and expressed willingness to deepen mutual cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平致电祝贺藤森庆子当选秘鲁总统
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Congratulatory Message to Keiko Fujimori on Election as President of Peru
articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，国家主席习近平致电祝贺藤森庆子当选秘鲁总统，愿同其共同努力，引领中秘全面战略伙伴关系迈上新台阶。
articles.summary_en: On July 6, President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory message to Keiko Fujimori on her election as President of Peru, expressing a desire to further elevate the China-Peru comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 广州发布第三批智能网联汽车示范应用场景目录

articles.summary_en: On June 30, the Guangzhou Municipal Industry and Information Technology Bureau released the third batch of demonstration application scenario catalogs for intelligent connected vehicles to drive technical innovation and build a trillion-level "Smart Car City."

articles.summary_zh: 7月6日，应急管理部将针对广西的国家地质灾害四级应急响应提升至三级，以应对台风“美莎克”引发的地质灾害及后续暴雨风险。

articles.title_zh: 国家文物局印发《国有文物资源数据管理办法》
articles.title_en: National Cultural Heritage Administration Issues Administrative Measures for State-owned Cultural Relics Resource Data

articles.summary_zh: 4日，湖南省委书记沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议，通报国家监委对张灼华涉嫌严重职务违法进行监察调查的决定。
articles.summary_en: On the 4th, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming chaired a meeting to notify the decision of the National Supervisory Commission to investigate Zhang Zhuohua for suspected serious duty-related violations.

articles.title_zh: 调查：观复博物馆展出铜佛疑似为海口五公祠失窃文物
articles.title_en: Investigation: Bronze Buddha in Guanfu Museum Suspected to be Stolen Artifact from Haikou's Wugong Temple
articles.summary_zh: 网友指认观复博物馆的一尊铜佛与2000年海口五公祠失窃文物高度相似，目前相关部门正进行核验，涉及古玩市场监管及文物保护法律认定。
articles.summary_en: A bronze Buddha in the Guanfu Museum is suspected to be a stolen artifact from Haikou's Wugong Temple. Authorities are verifying the item, highlighting issues in antique market regulation and relic protection laws.

articles.title_zh: 疑似海口失窃铜佛像现北京私人博物馆，相关部门开展核验
articles.title_en: Suspected Stolen Copper Buddha Statue from Haikou Reappears in Beijing Private Museum, Authorities Launch Verification
articles.summary_zh: 2000年海口五公祠失窃的一尊国家级铜佛像疑似出现在北京观复博物馆，目前海口五公祠管理处正配合文物及公安部门进行核验。
articles.summary_en: A national-level copper Buddha statue stolen from Haikou's Wugongci in 2000 has allegedly reappeared at the Guanfu Museum in Beijing; authorities are now conducting verification.

articles.title_zh: 超752亿元融资需求清单发布 重庆产融对接再提速
articles.title_en: Over 75.2 Billion Yuan Financing Demand List Released to Accelerate Industry-Finance Integration in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，重庆举行“33618”产业链投融资专场活动，发布超752亿元融资需求清单并签署超200亿元投融资协议，旨在推动金融资源赋能制造业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Chongqing held a special investment and financing event for the '33618' industrial chain, releasing a financing demand list exceeding 75.2 billion yuan and signing agreements worth over 20 billion yuan to support high-quality manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省成立国内首家冰雪运动与健康医学会
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Establishes China's First Ice and Snow Sports and Health Medical Association
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省近日成立国内首家冰雪运动与健康医学会，旨在打造冰雪运动与医学交叉研究枢纽，推动冰雪产业升级并服务全民健康。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province recently established China's first Ice and Snow Sports and Health Medical Association to create a cross-disciplinary research hub and upgrade the ice and snow industry.

articles.title_zh: 循环经济发展“十五五”规划印发
articles.title_en: Issuance of the '15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy Development'
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委近日印发《循环经济发展“十五五”规划》，目标到2030年主要资源产出率比2025年提高16%左右，推动经济社会全面绿色转型。
articles.summary_en: The National Development and Reform Commission issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy Development,' aiming to increase the main resource output rate by about 16% by 2030 to promote a green transformation.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中、包钢会见国家自然科学基金委主任窦贤康并共同见证签约
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet NSFC Director Dou Xiankang and Witness Signing Ceremony
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区主席包钢在呼和浩特会见国家自然科学基金委主任窦贤康，并见证双方签署区域创新发展联合基金协议。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Inner Mongolia Party Secretary Wang Weizhong and Chairman Bao Gang met NSFC Director Dou Xiankang in Hohhot to witness the signing of a regional innovation development joint fund agreement.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中会见上海交通大学党委书记杨振斌
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets Yang Zhenbin, Party Secretary of Shanghai Jiao Tong University
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见上海交通大学党委书记杨振斌，双方探讨在科研攻关、人才培养及科技成果转化等方面深化务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Party Committee, met with Yang Zhenbin, Party Secretary of Shanghai Jiao Tong University, in Hohhot to discuss deepening cooperation in scientific research, talent cultivation, and technology transfer.

articles.title_zh: 乐山亚洲最大中国同辐放射源研发生产基地全面投产
articles.title_en: Asia's Largest China Isotope & Radiation Corporation R&D and Production Base Fully Operational in Leshan
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，中国同辐放射源研发生产基地在四川乐山夹江全面投产，该基地为亚洲最大，旨在提升国内放射源自主保供能力并壮大核技术应用产业。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, China Isotope & Radiation Corporation's R&D and production base, the largest in Asia, became fully operational in Jiajiang, Leshan, Sichuan, to enhance domestic radiation source supply and nuclear technology application.

articles.title_zh: 周乃翔出席全省审计系统专题培训班并讲话
articles.title_en: Zhou Naixiang Attends Special Training Class for Provincial Audit System
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，山东省长周乃翔出席全省审计系统专题培训班并讲话，强调要树立正确政绩观，深化审计质效，推动审计工作高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Shandong Governor Zhou Naixiang attended a special training class for the provincial audit system, emphasizing the establishment of a correct view of political achievements to enhance audit quality.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇在东城区西城区检查防汛准备工作
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Inspects Flood Prevention Preparations in Dongcheng and Xicheng Districts
articles.summary_zh: 北京市市长殷勇日前在东城区和西城区检查防汛准备工作，强调要压实责任，严防城市内涝，确保首都安全度汛。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong recently inspected flood prevention preparations in Dongcheng and Xicheng districts, emphasizing the need to prevent urban waterlogging and ensure the city's safety during the flood season.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委召开月度工作点评会
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Committee Holds Monthly Work Review Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，北京市委书记尹力主持召开月度工作点评会，点评平谷、怀柔等区及市水务局、市应急局工作，部署生态保护、防汛及城市运行等重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Yin Li, Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Committee, chaired a monthly work review meeting to evaluate the performance of several districts and bureaus, emphasizing ecological protection and flood prevention.

articles.title_zh: 长三角联合出台举措助力国际科创中心建设
articles.title_en: Yangtze River Delta Jointly Issues Measures to Support International Science and Technology Innovation Center Construction
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，沪苏浙皖四地市场监管局联合发布若干举措，旨在通过市场监管一体化助力上海（长三角）国际科创中心建设。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, market supervision bureaus from Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui jointly released measures to support the construction of the Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Science and Technology Innovation Center through integrated market regulation.

articles.title_zh: 全省卫生健康系统消防安全视频会议召开 坚决抓好医疗机构消防安全突出问题整改
articles.title_en: Provincial Video Conference on Fire Safety in Health System Held to Rectify Issues in Medical Institutions
articles.summary_zh: 7月4日，安徽省召开卫生健康系统消防安全视频会议，省委书记梁言顺、省长王清宪作出批示，要求坚决整改医疗机构消防安全突出问题。
articles.summary_en: On July 4, Anhui Province held a video conference on fire safety in the health system. Party Secretary Liang Yanshun and Governor Wang Qingxian issued instructions to rectify fire safety issues in medical institutions.

articles.title_zh: 金融支持重庆高质量发展大会召开 袁家军出席并会见重要嘉宾
articles.title_en: Conference on Financial Support for Chongqing's High-Quality Development Held; Yuan Jiajun Attends and Meets Key Guests
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日上午，市委书记袁家军在重庆出席金融支持重庆高质量发展大会，强调通过金融资源赋能科创高地建设，并与多家金融机构负责人探讨务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun attended a conference on financial support for the city's high-quality development, emphasizing the role of finance in driving innovation and meeting with key financial leaders.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”数字福建规划印发
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan for Digital Fujian Issued
articles.summary_zh: 福建省政府近日印发《“十五五”数字福建规划》，旨在到2030年将数字福建打造为数字中国建设标杆，力争数字经济核心产业增加值年均增长8%以上。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial Government issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Digital Fujian," aiming to make the province a benchmark for Digital China by 2030 with a target annual growth of over 8% in core digital economy industries.

articles.title_zh: 三部门调整节能汽车、新能源汽车车船税优惠政策
articles.title_en: Three Departments Adjust Vehicle and Vessel Tax Preferential Policies for Energy-Saving and New Energy Vehicles
articles.summary_zh: 财政部、税务总局、工信部近日公告，自2027年1月1日起取消节能汽车及部分新能源汽车的车船税优惠政策，以促进税收公平。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance, State Taxation Administration, and MIIT announced that vehicle and vessel tax preferences for energy-saving and certain new energy vehicles will be canceled starting January 1, 2027.

articles.title_zh: 向新而行共绘强农新图景
articles.title_en: Moving Towards Innovation to Paint a New Picture of Strengthening Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 广东通过实施“粤强种芯”等工程及推进农业无人化技术，培育农业新质生产力，旨在建设农业强省。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong is cultivating new quality productive forces in agriculture through projects like 'Yue Qiang Zhong Xin' and unmanned technology to build a strong agricultural province.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省委常委会召开会议 研究部署防汛抗旱及开发区整改工作
articles.title_en: Gansu Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting on Flood Control and Development Zone Rectification
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月4日，甘肃省委书记胡昌升主持召开省委常委会会议，学习习近平总书记重要讲话，并部署防汛抗旱减灾及开发区问题整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On July 4, 2026, Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, presided over a meeting to study President Xi's speech and deploy flood control and development zone rectification efforts.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升在全省防汛减灾电视电话会议上强调精准预报预警
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Emphasizes Precise Forecasting and Warning at Provincial Flood Control Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，甘肃省在兰州召开全省防汛减灾电视电话会议，省委书记胡昌升强调要精准预报预警，加强隐患排查，坚决维护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Gansu Province held a video conference on flood prevention and disaster reduction in Lanzhou. Party Secretary Hu Changsheng emphasized precise forecasting and hazard investigation to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 任振鹤主持召开甘肃省政府性债务管理和财会监督工作领导小组会议
articles.title_en: Ren Zhenhe Chairs Gansu Provincial Government Debt Management and Accounting Supervision Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省长任振鹤主持召开会议，部署全省政府性债务管理和财会监督工作，强调要坚决打好防范化解债务风险攻坚战并提升财政管理水平。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Governor Ren Zhenhe chaired a meeting to deploy provincial government debt management and accounting supervision, emphasizing the mitigation of debt risks and the improvement of fiscal management.

articles.title_zh: 各地各部门大力推进防汛抗旱、抢险救灾工作
articles.title_en: Various Regions and Departments Vigorously Advance Flood Control, Drought Relief, and Disaster Rescue Work
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日习近平主持中共中央政治局会议部署防汛抗旱工作，随后国家防总及各地各部门采取有力措施，在多省开展抢险救灾以确保人民生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: Following a Political Bureau meeting chaired by Xi Jinping on June 30, national and local authorities have implemented flood and drought control measures across multiple provinces to ensure public safety.

articles.summary_en: The launch ceremony and promotion meeting for the 2026 Golden Osmanthus Industrial Design Competition were held in Nanning on July 3, 2026, to enhance Guangxi's industrial brand through design.

articles.title_zh: “七一勋章”获得者李连成：群众满意，我就幸福
articles.title_en: July 1st Medal Recipient Li Liancheng: I Am Happy When the Masses Are Satisfied
articles.summary_zh: 河南省濮阳县西辛庄村党支部书记李连成获评“七一勋章”，他用35年时间带领村民脱贫致富，改善教育医疗，践行无私奉献。
articles.summary_en: Li Liancheng, Party Secretary of Xixinzhuang Village in Henan, received the July 1st Medal for leading his village out of poverty and improving public welfare over 35 years.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明在郴州市调研
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Conducts Research Tour in Chenzhou City
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在郴州市调研，强调要统筹高质量发展和高水平安全，重点考察了煤矿安全、贵金属产业、大数据产业及东江湖生态保护。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming conducted a research tour in Chenzhou, emphasizing the coordination of high-quality development and high-level safety.

articles.title_zh: 省政协召开发展·民生专题协商座谈会
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Holds Special Consultative Symposium on Development and People's Livelihood
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，江苏省政协召开发展·民生专题协商座谈会，围绕促进医疗、医保、医药协同发展和治理进行讨论，省政协主席张义珍出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, the Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC held a special consultative symposium to discuss the synergistic development and governance of medical services, medical insurance, and medicine, attended by Chairman Zhang Yizhen.

articles.title_zh: 发挥兵团优势 助力农业强国建设
articles.title_en: Leveraging XPCC Advantages to Support the Construction of an Agricultural Powerhouse
articles.summary_zh: 新疆生产建设兵团通过科技创新、规模化经营和绿色发展，落实习近平总书记指示，在保障国家粮食安全和推动农业现代化中发挥重要作用。
articles.summary_en: The Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps (XPCC) is implementing President Xi Jinping's instructions to ensure national food security and promote agricultural modernization through technological innovation and scaled operations.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对辽宁吉林启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Launches Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Liaoning and Jilin
articles.summary_zh: 水利部7月4日对辽宁、吉林两省启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，并派出工作组协助指导，以应对7月4日至6日期间的强降雨及潜在洪水风险。
articles.summary_en: On July 4, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Liaoning and Jilin provinces, deploying working groups to manage potential flood risks from heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 四川省人民政府发布一批人事任免
articles.title_en: Sichuan Provincial People's Government Announces Personnel Appointments and Removals
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月4日，四川省人民政府发布通知，任免邹青、崔大鹏等多名官员及事业单位负责人职务。
articles.summary_en: On July 4, 2026, the Sichuan Provincial People's Government issued a notice regarding the appointment and removal of several officials and institution heads, including Zou Qing and Cui Dapeng.

articles.title_zh: 山东低空装备产业链重点产品和典型应用场景发布
articles.title_en: Shandong Releases Key Products and Typical Application Scenarios for Low-Altitude Equipment Industry Chain
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，山东省在滨州举行低空装备产业链高质量发展推介活动，发布重点产品和典型应用场景，并启动创新创业大赛及成立标准化技术委员会。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, Shandong Province held a promotion event in Binzhou to release key products and application scenarios for the low-altitude equipment industry chain, launch an innovation competition, and establish a standardization technical committee.

articles.title_zh: 云南省团队旅游纠纷调解中心成立
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Group Tour Dispute Mediation Center Established
articles.summary_zh: 云南省近日成立团队旅游纠纷调解中心并开通服务热线，通过标准化流程快速解决旅游纠纷，并督促旅游企业优化服务。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Province recently established a Group Tour Dispute Mediation Center and launched a service hotline to resolve tourism disputes efficiently and urge travel agencies to improve their services.

articles.title_zh: 陈滋英同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Chen Ziying Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 原国务院港澳事务办公室副主任、党组成员陈滋英同志于2026年6月20日在北京逝世，享年94岁。
articles.summary_en: Chen Ziying, former Deputy Director and Party Group Member of the Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office of the State Council, passed away in Beijing on June 20, 2026, at the age of 94.

articles.summary_zh: 全国人大代表张巧良就超龄劳动者权益保障新规接受采访，分析其在填补制度空白、规范用工市场及应对人口老龄化方面的意义与挑战。
articles.summary_en: NPC Deputy Zhang Qiaoliang was interviewed regarding new regulations on the protection of over-age workers' rights, analyzing their significance in filling institutional gaps and regulating the labor market.

articles.title_en: Ministry of Education Bans Disguised Exams Under the Guise of "Summer Camps"
articles.summary_zh: 教育部印发通知，要求严控中小学及幼儿园暑期作业总量，严禁变相组织考试，并部署暑期安全工作及减轻教师负担。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education issued a notice to control summer homework volume, ban disguised exams, ensure student safety, and reduce administrative burdens on teachers.

articles.title_zh: 昆明洛羊镇站“11·27”重大铁路交通事故调查报告公布

articles.summary_en: The investigation report on the "11.27" major railway accident at Luoyangzhen Station in Kunming has been released, attributing the crash to illegal operational commands and resulting in party and administrative sanctions for 34 personnel.

articles.title_zh: 中国第16次北冰洋考察在辽宁大连启航
articles.title_en: China's 16th Arctic Expedition Sets Sail from Dalian, Liaoning

articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with Danish Foreign Minister Rasmussen in Copenhagen to discuss deepening the China-Denmark comprehensive strategic partnership, enhancing green cooperation, and upholding multilateralism.

articles.title_zh: 中央网信办整治网络娱乐团播乱象
articles.title_en: CAC Cracks Down on Chaos in Online Entertainment Group Broadcasting

articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China launched a two-month special campaign on July 3 to crack down on six types of issues in online entertainment group broadcasting, including illegal registration and vulgar content.

articles.title_zh: 2026两岸青年峰会在北京开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Cross-Strait Youth Summit Opens in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，由国务院台办、教育部等共同主办的2026两岸青年峰会在北京开幕，旨在促进两岸青年交流合作与和平发展。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Cross-Strait Youth Summit, co-hosted by the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council and other agencies, opened in Beijing on July 2, 2026, to promote exchange and cooperation between youth from both sides of the strait.

articles.title_zh: 《中华人民共和国民族团结进步促进法》起施行
articles.title_en: Law of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion of Ethnic Unity and Progress Comes into Effect
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日起，《中华人民共和国民族团结进步促进法》正式施行，旨在通过法律手段促进各民族交往交流交融，保障民族团结进步。
articles.summary_en: The Law of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion of Ethnic Unity and Progress took effect on July 1, 2026, aiming to promote ethnic integration and safeguard national unity through legal frameworks.

articles.title_zh: 罗东川会见中国工程院院士王宁利一行
articles.title_en: Luo Dongchuan Meets Academician Wang Ningli and Delegation
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，青海省长罗东川在西宁会见中国工程院院士王宁利，探讨深化在高原眼病防治、人才培养及科研成果转化等方面的务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan met with Academician Wang Ningli in Xining to discuss deepening cooperation in plateau eye disease prevention, talent cultivation, and scientific research translation.

articles.title_zh: 青海推动《民族团结进步促进法》落地见效
articles.title_en: Qinghai Promotes Implementation of Law on Promotion of Ethnic Unity and Progress
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，青海省举行新闻发布会，部署通过“五个新跃升”推动7月1日施行的《中华人民共和国民族团结进步促进法》在当地落地见效。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Qinghai Province held a press conference to deploy the "five new leaps" to implement the Law of the PRC on the Promotion of Ethnic Unity and Progress, which took effect on July 1.

articles.title_zh: 四川省委常委会召开会议
articles.title_en: Standing Committee of Sichuan Provincial Party Committee Holds Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，四川省委常委会召开会议，传达学习习近平总书记在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上的重要讲话，研究贯彻落实意见。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, the Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial Party Committee held a meeting to study and implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's speech at the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.title_zh: 山东省政府党组会议召开
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Party Group Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，山东省长周乃翔主持召开省政府党组会议，学习习近平总书记在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上的重要讲话精神并研究落实措施。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Governor Zhou Naixiang chaired a meeting of the Shandong Provincial Government Party Group to study General Secretary Xi Jinping's speech at the 105th anniversary of the CPC and discuss implementation measures.

articles.title_zh: 推进区和乡镇人大换届选举
articles.title_en: Promoting the Election of District and Township People's Congresses in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，上海市区、乡镇两级人大换届选举工作部署会议召开，市委副书记朱忠明、市人大常委会副主任郑钢淼出席并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, a deployment meeting for the election of district and township people's congresses was held in Shanghai, attended by Zhu Zhongming and Zheng Gangmiao.

articles.title_zh: 上海市科学技术奖励大会举行
articles.title_en: Shanghai Science and Technology Awards Conference Held
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，上海市科学技术奖励大会举行。市委书记陈吉宁为科技功臣颁奖，并强调要深化科技体制改革，推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, the Shanghai Science and Technology Awards Conference was held. Party Secretary Chen Jining presented awards to scientists and emphasized deepening tech reforms and integrating innovation with industry.

articles.title_zh: 全力巩固经济向优向新态势
articles.title_en: Fully Consolidate the Trend of Economic Improvement and Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，上海市委书记陈吉宁主持市委季度工作会议，部署三季度经济社会发展重点工作，强调以正确政绩观推动高质量发展与转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining chaired the municipal quarterly work meeting to deploy key tasks for Q3, emphasizing high-quality development and economic transformation.

articles.title_zh: 山西省委书记唐登杰主持召开省委常委会会议
articles.title_en: Shanxi Provincial Party Committee Secretary Tang Dengjie Chairs Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，山西省委书记唐登杰主持召开省委常委会会议，研究部署防汛抗旱工作，听取粮食安全汇报，并审议通过高等教育百亿工程实施方案。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Tang Dengjie, Secretary of the Shanxi Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting to deploy flood and drought control, review food security, and approve a 10-billion-yuan higher education project.

articles.title_zh: 优质水利建设推动林芝高质量发展
articles.title_en: High-Quality Water Conservancy Construction Promotes High-Quality Development in Nyingchi
articles.summary_zh: 林芝市通过实施水利基础设施建设，在“十四五”期间带动农牧民就业增收，并计划进一步完善水安全保障体系以推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Nyingchi City has leveraged water conservancy infrastructure to boost employment and income for farmers and herders, aiming to further enhance its water security system for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 云南省全国“两优一先”代表载誉返昆
articles.title_en: Representatives of Yunnan Province's National 'Two Excellences and One Advanced' Return to Kunming with Honors
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日下午，赴京参加中国共产党成立105周年大会的云南省全国“两优一先”代表返回昆明，省委常委、组织部部长赵月霞前往机场迎接并祝贺。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 2, representatives from Yunnan Province who attended the 105th anniversary of the CPC in Beijing returned to Kunming, where they were welcomed by Zhao Yuexia, member of the Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee.

articles.title_zh: 2026全球数字经济大会在京开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference Opens in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，2026全球数字经济大会在京开幕。北京市委书记尹力、新华社社长傅华致辞，北京市长殷勇主持开幕式。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Global Digital Economy Conference opened in Beijing on July 2, 2026. Yin Li, Beijing Party Secretary, and Fu Hua, President of Xinhua News Agency, delivered speeches.

articles.title_zh: 中央军委举行晋升上将军衔仪式 习近平颁发命令状并向晋衔的军官表示祝贺
articles.title_en: Central Military Commission Holds General Rank Promotion Ceremony; Xi Jinping Presents Orders and Congratulates Officers
articles.summary_zh: 7月3日，中央军委在北京举行晋升上将军衔仪式，习近平出席并向张曙光、王刚颁发命令状。
articles.summary_en: On July 3, the Central Military Commission held a promotion ceremony for General rank in Beijing, where Xi Jinping presented orders to Zhang Shuguang and Wang Gang.

articles.title_zh: 中央军委表彰全军优秀共产党员、优秀党务工作者和先进基层党组织
articles.title_en: Central Military Commission Commends Outstanding Party Members, Party Workers, and Grassroots Party Organizations of the PLA
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，中央军委在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年之际发出通报，表彰一批全军优秀共产党员、优秀党务工作者和先进基层党组织。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, the Central Military Commission issued a notice to commend outstanding CPC members, party workers, and grassroots party organizations across the PLA to mark the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.title_zh: 福田区政协委员陈华建议优化涉外支付场景
articles.title_en: Futian District CPPCC Member Chen Hua Suggests Optimizing Foreign Payment Scenarios
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月2日，在深圳市政协“委员议事厅”活动中，福田区政协委员陈华建议打通涉外支付场景，提升外籍人士在深消费便利度。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, during the Shenzhen Municipal CPPCC 'Committee Discussion Hall' event, Futian District CPPCC member Chen Hua suggested optimizing foreign payment scenarios to improve consumption convenience for foreigners in Shenzhen.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军会见青山实业董事局主席项光达和华峰集团董事局主席尤小平
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Meets with Chairmen of Tsingshan Holding Group and Huafeng Group
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日下午，重庆市委书记袁家军会见青山实业主席项光达和华峰集团主席尤小平，探讨在先进制造业、材料及化工等领域的深化合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun met with Xiang Guangda of Tsingshan Holding Group and You Xiaoping of Huafeng Group to discuss deepening cooperation in advanced manufacturing, materials, and chemicals.

articles.title_zh: 三峡实验室正式揭牌
articles.title_en: Three Gorges Laboratory Officially Unveiled
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日上午，重庆市委书记袁家军与中国科学院副院长汪克强等共同为三峡实验室揭牌，该实验室将聚焦生态环境保护与绿色低碳发展。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 2, Chongqing Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun and CAS Vice President Wang Keqiang jointly unveiled the Three Gorges Laboratory, which will focus on ecological protection and green low-carbon development.

articles.title_zh: 福建省全域实施跨境贸易高水平开放试点
articles.title_en: Fujian Province Implements High-Level Opening Pilot for Cross-Border Trade Province-Wide
articles.summary_zh: 自2026年7月1日起，国家外汇管理局福建省分局将跨境贸易高水平开放试点扩围至福建省全域，旨在构建更便利、开放、安全、智慧的外汇管理体制。
articles.summary_en: Starting July 1, 2026, the Fujian Branch of the State Administration of Foreign Exchange expanded the high-level opening pilot for cross-border trade to the entire province to enhance foreign exchange management.

articles.summary_zh: 水利部7月2日对广东、广西、海南三省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，并派出工作组赴海南协助指导，以应对强降雨带来的汛情。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hainan, and dispatched a working group to Hainan to assist in flood prevention.

articles.title_zh: 组合驾驶辅助系统安全国家标准发布

articles.summary_en: On July 2, 2026, the MIIT and other departments released the mandatory national standard 'Safety Requirements for Combined Driving Assistance Systems for Intelligent Connected Vehicles,' effective January 1, 2027.

articles.title_en: Ren Zhenhe: Leading High-Quality Industrial Development with Technological Innovation and Enhancing Modernization of Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，甘肃省委副书记、省长任振鹤在白银市出席全省新型工业化推进会并讲话，强调要以科技创新引领产业高质量发展，构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Ren Zhenhe, Deputy Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee and Governor of Gansu, attended the provincial new industrialization promotion meeting in Baiyin, emphasizing the role of technological innovation in high-quality industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃分类推进“五区”基层党建推动经济社会高质量发展
articles.title_en: Gansu Promotes "Five Zones" Primary-Level Party Building to Drive High-Quality Economic and Social Development
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省于2025年印发意见，分类推进农区、牧区、林区、景区、园区“五区”基层党建，旨在通过党建引领产业发展与基层治理，推动经济社会高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Gansu Province issued guidelines in 2025 to implement primary-level party building across five specific zones to enhance governance and drive high-quality economic and social development.

articles.title_zh: 省政协党组扩大会议和主席会议召开
articles.title_en: Provincial CPPCC Party Group Enlarged Meeting and Chairperson's Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，省政协主席孔昌生主持召开党组扩大会议和主席会议，学习习近平总书记及省委书记刘宁的讲话精神，研究省政协常委会会议等事宜。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Kong Changsheng, Chairperson of the Provincial CPPCC, presided over a Party Group enlarged meeting and a Chairperson's meeting to study key directives and plan the upcoming Standing Committee meeting.

articles.title_zh: 河南省出台规划用地新政赋能城市更新
articles.title_en: Henan Province Issues New Planning and Land Use Policies to Empower Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，河南省政府新闻办发布《规划用地全链条支持城市更新若干政策》，通过简化审批、优化用地转换等20项措施支持城市更新。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, the Henan Provincial Government Information Office released policies to support urban renewal through 20 measures, including simplifying approvals and optimizing land use conversion.

articles.title_zh: 河南系统部署城市高质量发展工作
articles.title_en: Henan Systematically Deploys Work for High-Quality Urban Development
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，河南省政府新闻办召开吹风会，解读《关于推动城市高质量发展的实施方案》，重点部署城市体系优化、地下管网建设及财政资金支持。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, the Henan Provincial Government Information Office held a briefing to interpret the "Implementation Plan for Promoting High-Quality Urban Development," focusing on urban system optimization, underground pipe network construction, and financial support.

articles.title_zh: 科创楼宇里的产业新图景
articles.title_en: New Industrial Landscapes in Science and Innovation Buildings
articles.summary_zh: 武汉市武昌区通过建设滨江数创走廊，利用楼宇空间和精细政务服务，推动数字技术与实体经济深度融合，吸引科创企业集聚。
articles.summary_en: Wuchang District in Wuhan is promoting the integration of digital technology and the real economy by developing the Binjiang Digital Innovation Corridor and optimizing government services to attract tech enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省启动俄语特色学校招生改革试点
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Launches Enrollment Reform Pilot for Russian-Language Specialty Schools
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省启动普通高中俄语特色学校招生改革试点，旨在构建俄语贯通人才培养体系，服务国家向北开放战略。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province has launched an enrollment reform pilot for Russian-language specialty high schools to build a talent cultivation system supporting the national strategy of opening to the north.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省发布首部冰雪文旅消费地方标准
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Releases First Local Standard for Ice and Snow Cultural Tourism Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省近日发布首部冰雪文旅消费地方标准《冰雪文旅服务消费质量通则》，将于7月14日实施，旨在提升冰雪文旅服务质量与行业规范。
articles.summary_en: Heilongjiang Province has released its first local standard for ice and snow cultural tourism consumption, effective July 14, to enhance service quality and industry standardization.

articles.title_zh: 许勤在哈尔滨督导检查防汛工作
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Supervises Flood Control Work in Harbin
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨市督导检查防汛工作，强调要坚持人民至上，全面做好防汛抗旱准备，保障人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected flood control work in Harbin, emphasizing a people-centered approach to ensure safety against floods and droughts.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省召开推进常态化帮扶持续巩固拓展脱贫攻坚成果工作会议
articles.title_en: Hunan Province Holds Meeting on Normalized Assistance to Consolidate Poverty Alleviation Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日，湖南省在长沙召开推进常态化帮扶工作会议，省委书记沈晓明强调要守住不发生规模性返贫底线，促进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: On July 2, Hunan Province held a meeting in Changsha to promote normalized assistance. Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming emphasized preventing large-scale return to poverty and promoting rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 防止返贫致贫助力乡村全面振兴 湖南出台18条金融举措
articles.title_en: Hunan Introduces 18 Financial Measures to Prevent Poverty and Support Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省人民银行分行、金融监管局等部门近日联合印发通知，提出18条具体金融措施，旨在防止返贫致贫并助力乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: The PBOC Hunan Branch, Hunan Financial Regulatory Bureau, and other departments issued a notice outlining 18 financial measures to prevent a return to poverty and support comprehensive rural revitalization in Hunan Province.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明在宁乡调研产业发展和重大项目建设
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Inspects Industrial Development and Major Project Construction in Ningxiang
articles.summary_zh: 7月2日下午，湖南省长毛伟明在宁乡市调研产业发展和重大项目建设，强调要加快项目建设，培育新质生产力，为高质量发展蓄势赋能。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 2, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming inspected industrial development and major project construction in Ningxiang, emphasizing the acceleration of project construction and the cultivation of new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 信长星刘小涛看望“七一勋章”获得者赵亚夫
articles.title_en: Xin Changxing and Liu Xiaotao Visit 'July 1st Medal' Recipient Zhao Yafu

articles.summary_en: On July 2, Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing and Governor Liu Xiaotao visited Zhao Yafu, a 'July 1st Medal' recipient, praising his dedication to agricultural technology and rural poverty alleviation.

articles.title_zh: 南京市委常委、常务副市长林涛任南京仲裁委员会主任
articles.title_en: Lin Tao, Executive Vice Mayor of Nanjing, Appointed Director of Nanjing Arbitration Commission
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，南京市政府决定由市委常委、常务副市长林涛担任第六届南京仲裁委员会主任。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, the Nanjing Municipal Government appointed Lin Tao, Member of the Standing Committee and Executive Vice Mayor, as the Director of the 6th Nanjing Arbitration Commission.

Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing delivered a speech emphasizing the implementation of Xi Jinping's thought on party building to advance modernization in Jiangsu.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章《做焦裕禄式的县委书记》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Magazine Publishes Important Article by Xi Jinping 'Be a Jiao Yulu-style County Party Secretary'
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日，《求是》杂志重新发表习近平的重要文章《做焦裕禄式的县委书记》，强调县委书记应做到心中有党、有民、有责、有戒。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, 2026, Qiushi magazine republished an important article by Xi Jinping titled 'Be a Jiao Yulu-style County Party Secretary,' outlining the political qualities and responsibilities required for county party secretaries.

articles.title_zh: 世界政党政要热烈祝贺中国共产党成立105周年
articles.title_en: World Political Parties and Dignitaries Warmly Congratulate the 105th Anniversary of the CPC
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，朝鲜、印尼、土耳其等多国政党和政府领导人致电致函中共中央和习近平总书记，热烈祝贺中国共产党成立105周年。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, leaders of political parties and governments from various countries, including North Korea, Indonesia, and Turkey, sent messages to the CPC Central Committee and General Secretary Xi Jinping to congratulate the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.title_zh: 香港举行升旗仪式和酒会庆祝回归祖国29周年
articles.title_en: Hong Kong Holds Flag-Raising Ceremony and Reception to Celebrate 29th Anniversary of Return to Motherland
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日，香港特区政府在金紫荆广场举行升旗仪式并在会议展览中心举行酒会，庆祝香港回归祖国29周年。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, 2026, the Hong Kong SAR Government held a flag-raising ceremony at Golden Bauhinia Square and a reception to celebrate the 29th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to China.

articles.title_zh: 税收数据显示我国具身智能产业总体发展向好
articles.title_en: Tax Data Shows Positive Growth in China's Embodied AI Industry
articles.summary_zh: 国家税务总局数据显示，2026年1-5月我国具身智能产业销售收入快速增长，产业集群效应明显，税务部门将持续落实税收支持政策。
articles.summary_en: Data from the State Taxation Administration shows rapid growth in China's embodied AI industry from January to May 2026, with strong industrial clustering and continued tax support.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝香港回归祖国29周年活动启动礼举行
articles.title_en: Launch Ceremony for the 29th Anniversary of Hong Kong's Return to the Motherland Held
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，庆祝香港回归祖国29周年系列活动启动礼在香港举行。李家超、周霁等出席，强调香港将对接国家“十五五”规划并持续提升民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, a launch ceremony for the 29th anniversary of Hong Kong's return to China was held in Hong Kong. Officials emphasized integrating with the national 15th Five-Year Plan and improving livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在中国白俄罗斯地方合作论坛开幕式上发表视频致辞
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Delivers Video Speech at the Opening Ceremony of the China-Belarus Local Cooperation Forum
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日，中国白俄罗斯地方合作论坛在甘肃兰州开幕，国务院副总理刘国中发表视频致辞，提出以产业融通、人文交流和机制建设深化中白地方合作。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, 2026, the China-Belarus Local Cooperation Forum opened in Lanzhou, Gansu. Vice Premier Liu Guozhong delivered a video speech proposing to deepen local cooperation through industrial integration, cultural exchanges, and mechanism construction.

articles.title_zh: 《求是》杂志发表习近平重要文章《做焦裕禄式的县委书记》
articles.title_en: Qiushi Magazine Publishes Important Article by Xi Jinping on Being a "Jiao Yulu-style" County Party Secretary
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，《求是》杂志重新发表习近平的重要文章《做焦裕禄式的县委书记》，强调县委书记应做到心中有党、有民、有责、有戒。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, Qiushi magazine republished an important article by Xi Jinping titled "Be a Jiao Yulu-style County Party Secretary," emphasizing loyalty to the party, serving the people, responsibility, and integrity.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见下任联合国秘书长候选人埃斯皮诺萨
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Candidate for Next UN Secretary-General Espinosa
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，外交部长王毅在京会见下任联合国秘书长候选人埃斯皮诺萨，双方就联合国改革及全球治理等议题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with UN Secretary-General candidate Espinosa in Beijing to discuss UN reform and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 前5个月我国服务进出口总额同比增长6%
articles.title_en: China's Service Trade Total Grows 6% in First Five Months
articles.summary_zh: 商务部7月1日发布数据显示，2026年1至5月我国服务进出口总额同比增长6%，其中服务出口增长较快，贸易逆差有所缩小。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce announced on July 1 that China's total service trade grew by 6% from January to May 2026, with strong growth in service exports and a narrowing trade deficit.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷土耳其推介会在安卡拉举行
articles.title_en: Promotion Event for the Fifth Volume of 'Xi Jinping: The Governance of China' Held in Ankara, Turkey
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，《习近平谈治国理政》第五卷推介会在土耳其安卡拉举行，旨在深化中土治国理政经验交流与务实合作。
articles.summary_en: A promotion event for the fifth volume of 'Xi Jinping: The Governance of China' was held in Ankara, Turkey on July 1 to deepen the exchange of governance experiences and practical cooperation between China and Turkey.

articles.title_zh: “七一勋章”获得者王於昌曾两次参与击落U-2高空侦察机
articles.title_en: Wang Yuchang, Recipient of the 'July 1st Medal,' Twice Participated in Shooting Down U-2 Spy Planes
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日，习近平在庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会上向曾两次参与击落U-2侦察机的老党员王於昌颁授“七一勋章”。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, 2026, Xi Jinping awarded the 'July 1st Medal' to veteran party member Wang Yuchang during the celebration of the 105th anniversary of the CPC for his role in shooting down U-2 spy planes.

articles.title_zh: 庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在京举行
articles.title_en: Celebration Assembly for the 105th Anniversary of the Founding of the Communist Party of China Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日上午，庆祝中国共产党成立105周年大会在北京人民大会堂举行。习近平向“七一勋章”获得者颁奖并发表重要讲话。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of July 1, a celebration assembly for the 105th anniversary of the CPC was held at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Xi Jinping awarded the 'July 1 Medal' and delivered a key speech.

articles.title_zh: “七一勋章”获得者陈俊武：领衔设计的装置被誉为新中国炼油工业的第一朵“金花”
articles.title_en: Chen Junwu Awarded 'July 1 Medal' for Contributions to China's Oil Refining Industry
articles.summary_zh: 2026年7月1日，党中央决定授予中国科学院院士、炼油工程专家陈俊武“七一勋章”，表彰其在催化裂化等领域的卓越贡献。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, 2026, the CPC Central Committee awarded the 'July 1 Medal' to Chen Junwu, an academician of the CAS and refining expert, for his outstanding contributions to China's oil refining industry.

articles.title_zh: 习近平：坚决打好反腐败斗争攻坚战持久战总体战
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping: Resolutely Fight the Tough, Protracted, and Overall Battle Against Corruption
articles.summary_zh: 习近平强调要持之以恒推进全面从严治党，坚决打好反腐败斗争攻坚战持久战总体战，确保党在新时代成为坚强领导核心。
articles.summary_en: Xi Jinping emphasized the need to persist in strictly governing the Party and resolutely fight the anti-corruption battle to ensure the Party remains a strong leadership core.

articles.title_zh: 新疆沙雅县辟谣可变更防沙治沙土地性质
articles.title_en: Shaya County in Xinjiang Refutes Rumors on Changing Nature of Sand-Control Land
articles.summary_zh: 新疆沙雅县林业和草原局与自然资源局发布声明，辟谣关于可办理变更防沙治沙土地性质的虚假信息，并警示相关投资诈骗行为。
articles.summary_en: The Forestry and Grassland Bureau and Natural Resources Bureau of Shaya County, Xinjiang, issued a statement refuting false claims about changing the nature of sand-control land and warning against investment scams.

tags_en: Shaya County Forestry and Grassland Bureau

articles.title_zh: 今起食用油等液态食品散装运输须持准运证，市场监管总局将部署监督检查
articles.title_en: Bulk Transport of Edible Oils and Other Liquid Foods Now Requires Permits; SAMR to Deploy Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 从今日起，植物油、酒类等5大类重点液态食品道路散装运输须持准运证。市场监管总局将部署监督检查，实施全链条可追溯管理以保障食品安全。
articles.summary_en: Starting today, bulk road transport of five categories of key liquid foods, including vegetable oils and alcohol, requires permits. SAMR will deploy inspections to ensure food safety and traceability.

articles.title_zh: “正义审判”特展开展，呈现日本战犯审判全过程
articles.title_en: Special Exhibition "Justice Trial" Opens, Showcasing the Process of Trials for Japanese War Criminals
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，侵华日军第七三一部队罪证陈列馆与沈阳“九·一八”历史博物馆联合举办《正义审判》特展，系统呈现新中国审判日本战犯的全过程。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, the Museum of Evidence of War Crimes of Japanese Army Unit 731 and the Shenyang "September 18th" History Museum jointly opened the "Justice Trial" exhibition, detailing the process of trials for Japanese war criminals in New China.

articles.title_zh: 北京市郊铁路城市副中心线西段提升工程投运
articles.title_en: Western Section of Beijing Suburban Railway City Sub-center Line Upgrade Project Starts Operation
articles.summary_zh: 北京市郊铁路城市副中心线西段提升工程于2026年7月1日投运，新增3个车站并加密开行，实现房山与通州直连。
articles.summary_en: The western section upgrade of the Beijing Suburban Railway City Sub-center Line started operation on July 1, 2026, adding three stations and enabling direct connection between Fangshan and Tongzhou.

articles.title_zh: 福建省委常委会召开会议研究贯彻落实习近平总书记重要讲话精神
articles.title_en: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Standing Committee Meeting Studies Implementation of Xi Jinping's Important Instructions
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，福建省委书记周祖翼主持召开省委常委会会议，研究推进农业农村现代化、闽宁协作及集体林权制度改革等工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Zhou Zuyi, Secretary of the Fujian Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting to study the implementation of President Xi Jinping's instructions on rural modernization, Min-Ning collaboration, and forest rights reform.

articles.title_zh: 用好工业设计“钥匙”，开启制造业新蓝海
articles.title_en: Using Industrial Design as a "Key" to Unlock New Opportunities in Manufacturing
articles.summary_zh: 山东青岛通过政策引导和平台赋能，将工业设计作为驱动制造业转型升级的“第二核心技术”，推动中国制造向中国创造转型。
articles.summary_en: Qingdao, Shandong, leverages industrial design as a "second core technology" to drive manufacturing transformation and upgrade through policy guidance and platform empowerment.

articles.title_zh: 学习贯彻习近平党建思想 纵深推进政府系统党的建设
articles.title_en: Studying and Implementing Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building to Deepen Party Construction in the Government System
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，河南省省长王凯主持省政府党组理论学习中心组集体学习，并讲授关于树立和践行正确政绩观的专题党课。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired a collective study session of the provincial government's party group and delivered a special party lecture on establishing a correct view of performance.

articles.title_zh: 坚持以改革创新为根本动力 加快推进革命老区振兴发展
articles.title_en: Adhere to Reform and Innovation to Accelerate the Revitalization of Revolutionary Old Areas
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，湖北省长李殿勋在黄冈麻城市、红安县调研，强调要以改革创新为动力，统筹工业化、城镇化、乡村振兴与社会稳定，推进革命老区发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Hubei Governor Li Dianxun conducted research in Macheng and Hong'an, emphasizing reform and innovation to promote industrialization, urbanization, and rural revitalization in revolutionary old areas.

articles.title_zh: 武汉市举行“两优一先”表彰大会
articles.title_en: Wuhan Holds 'Two Excellences and One Advanced' Commendation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，武汉市举行“两优一先”表彰大会，市委书记盛阅春出席并强调要以先进典型为标杆，为全面建设现代化大武汉而奋斗。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Wuhan held a commendation meeting for 'Two Excellences and One Advanced'. Municipal Party Secretary Sheng Yuechun urged the city to strive for a modern Great Wuhan by following exemplary models.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥赴十堰市调研丹江口库区保护发展情况
articles.title_en: Guan Zhiou Surveys Protection and Development of Danjiangkou Reservoir Area in Shiyan
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，湖北省委书记关志鸥赴十堰市走访老党员，并调研丹江口库区生态保护及正确政绩观学习教育情况。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhiou visited veteran party members in Shiyan and surveyed the ecological protection of the Danjiangkou Reservoir area and the implementation of correct performance views.

articles.title_zh: “真材实料 筑基强国”育人共同体在武汉理工大学成立
articles.title_en: Education Community 'True Materials, Building a Strong Nation' Established at Wuhan University of Technology
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，“真材实料 筑基强国”育人共同体在武汉理工大学成立，旨在通过跨行业协同育人，为建材建工、交通、汽车三大产业培养人才。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the 'True Materials, Building a Strong Nation' Education Community was established at Wuhan University of Technology to cultivate talent for the building materials, transportation, and automotive industries.

articles.title_zh: 倪岳峰在河北省“两优一先”表彰大会上强调深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想
articles.title_en: Ni Yuefeng Emphasizes Implementation of Xi Jinping's Thought on Party Building at Hebei's 'Two Excellences and One Advanced' Commendation Conference
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，河北省“两优一先”表彰大会在石家庄召开。省委书记倪岳峰出席并强调要深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，奋力谱写中国式现代化建设河北篇章。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, the Hebei Province 'Two Excellences and One Advanced' Commendation Conference was held in Shijiazhuang. Provincial Party Secretary Ni Yuefeng emphasized implementing Xi Jinping's thought on party building to advance modernization in Hebei.

articles.title_zh: 倪岳峰在石家庄市和定州市调研
articles.title_en: Ni Yuefeng Conducts Research Tours in Shijiazhuang and Dingzhou
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，河北省委书记倪岳峰在石家庄市和定州市调研，强调以高质量党建推动高质量发展，着力培育壮大县域特色产业集群。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Ni Yuefeng, Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, conducted research in Shijiazhuang and Dingzhou, emphasizing the promotion of high-quality development through party building and the expansion of county-level industrial clusters.

articles.title_zh: 航天产业为海南文昌老区发展注入新动能
articles.title_en: Aerospace Industry Injects New Momentum into Development of Old Revolutionary Areas in Wenchang, Hainan
articles.summary_zh: 海南文昌依托商业航天发射场和国际航天城，推动航天产业与红色旅游融合，带动当地经济增长和业态升级。
articles.summary_en: Wenchang, Hainan, is leveraging its commercial aerospace launch site and international aerospace city to integrate the aerospace industry with red tourism, boosting local economic growth and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 弘扬伟大建党精神 传承海南革命文化 奋力谱写中国式现代化海南篇章
articles.title_en: Carry Forward the Great Founding Spirit of the Party and Strive to Write the Hainan Chapter of Chinese-style Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，海南省在中共琼崖一大旧址举行纪念中共琼崖第一次代表大会召开100周年主题活动，省委书记冯飞发表讲话。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Hainan Province held a commemorative event at the site of the 1st Representative Congress of the CPC in Qiongya to mark its 100th anniversary, featuring a speech by Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei.

articles.title_zh: 宿迁出台江苏首部生物多样性保护领域地方性法规
articles.title_en: Suqian Issues Jiangsu's First Local Regulation on Biodiversity Protection
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，宿迁市就《关于加强生物多样性保护的决定》召开新闻发布会，该法规自2026年7月1日起施行，旨在通过法治化手段加强生物多样性保护。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Suqian held a press conference to interpret the "Decision on Strengthening Biodiversity Protection," which takes effect on July 1, 2026, to enhance biodiversity conservation through legal frameworks.

articles.title_en: National Intelligent Industrial Robot Industry Metrology and Testing Alliance Established in Changzhou
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，国家智能工业机器人产业计量测试联盟在常州成立，由常州检验检测标准认证研究院牵头，旨在攻克机器人产业计量测试难题。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the National Intelligent Industrial Robot Industry Metrology and Testing Alliance was established in Changzhou to tackle metrology and testing challenges in the robotics industry.

articles.title_zh: 南京为促进人工智能产业发展立法
articles.title_en: Nanjing Legislates to Promote Artificial Intelligence Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日至30日，南京市人大常委会审议了《南京市人工智能产业发展和创新应用促进条例（草案）》，拟通过立法支持人工智能产业发展及“一人公司”创业模式。
articles.summary_en: From June 29 to 30, the Standing Committee of the Nanjing Municipal People's Congress reviewed a draft regulation to promote the AI industry and support 'one-person company' entrepreneurship.

articles.title_zh: 叶建春讲树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育专题党课
articles.title_en: Ye Jianchun Delivers Special Party Lesson on Establishing and Practicing Correct View of Political Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，江西省省长叶建春为省政府办公厅、研究室和省审计厅党员干部讲专题党课，要求牢固树立正确政绩观，以实干推动全省高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun delivered a special party lesson to cadres of the provincial government's general office, research office, and audit office, emphasizing the need to establish a correct view of political achievements to promote high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 南铁暑运启动 计划增开旅客列车26对
articles.title_en: Nanchang Railway Bureau Launches Summer Transport, Plans to Add 26 Pairs of Passenger Trains
articles.summary_zh: 7月1日，中国铁路南昌局集团有限公司启动暑运工作，计划增开26对旅客列车以满足学生、探亲及旅游客流需求。
articles.summary_en: On July 1, China Railway Nanchang Group Co., Ltd. launched its summer transport operations, planning to add 26 pairs of passenger trains to meet the demand of students, relatives, and tourists.

articles.title_zh: 精准监督推动养老服务提质增效
articles.title_en: Precise Supervision Promotes Improvement of Elderly Care Services
articles.summary_zh: 武宁县纪委监委开展养老服务领域专项监督，纠治资金挪用问题并推动适老化改造，提升养老服务质量。
articles.summary_en: The Wuning County Discipline Inspection and Supervision Committee improved elderly care services through special supervision, correcting fund misappropriation and promoting facility renovations.

articles.title_zh: 坚持以正确政绩观引领推动全省高质量发展

articles.title_zh: 刘宁为全省新一届县（市、区）委书记讲党课

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired a collective study session of the provincial government's party group and delivered a special party lesson on establishing a correct view of political achievements.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府常务会议

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss the development of development zones, food safety, and review the draft of the Henan Province Development Planning Regulations.

articles.title_zh: 省领导分赴全省各地走访慰问

articles.summary_en: On June 29, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling visited honored experts Qin Daqing and Wu Gaohui in Harbin, emphasizing the role of technological innovation in driving industrial revitalization and serving national strategic needs.

articles.summary_en: On June 30, Hunan Province held a commendation meeting in Changsha for outstanding party members, party workers, and primary-level party organizations. Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming delivered a speech to motivate party members to strive for the "Three Highs and Four New" blueprint.

articles.summary_en: Summer railway transport in the Yangtze River Delta officially began on July 1, 2026, with an expected 190 million passengers. Capacity will be increased via extra trains and optimized schedules.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 30, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong coordinated response efforts to heavy rainfall in the city's central urban area, focusing on flood drainage and traffic management.

articles.title_en: Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月5日，国务院常务会议通过《退役军人就业创业促进条例》，旨在通过教育培训、就业支持和创业扶持，促进退役军人高质量充分就业。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, the State Council passed the Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans to support veterans' employment and entrepreneurship through training and policy incentives.

articles.title_zh: 八部门提出到2030年建设5万张工业5G专网
articles.title_en: Eight Departments Propose Building 50,000 Industrial 5G Private Networks by 2030
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等八部门于6月30日在北京发布《关于推动工业互联网高质量发展的实施意见》，目标到2030年建设5万张工业5G专网。
articles.summary_en: Eight departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, issued guidelines in Beijing on June 30 to build 50,000 industrial 5G private networks by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布《退役军人就业创业促进条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree to Publish Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强签署国务院令，公布自2026年8月1日起施行的《退役军人就业创业促进条例》，旨在通过教育培训、就业优待和创业扶持鼓励退役军人就业创业。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to publish the Regulations on Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans, effective August 1, 2026, to support veterans through training and employment preferences.

articles.title_zh: 2025年我国水运多项指标稳居世界第一
articles.title_en: China's Water Transport Indicators Rank First Globally in 2025
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室6月30日举行发布会，交通运输部数据显示2025年我国港口货物吞吐量和集装箱吞吐量均稳居世界第一。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on June 30, reporting that China's port cargo and container throughput ranked first globally in 2025.

articles.title_zh: 全国夏播粮食进度近八成 夏管全面展开
articles.title_en: Nearly 80% of Summer Grain Sowing Completed as Summer Field Management Begins
articles.summary_zh: 全国夏播粮食进度已近八成，夏季田间管理全面展开，山东、安徽等地通过政策补贴和技术指导夯实秋粮丰收基础。
articles.summary_en: Nearly 80% of summer grain sowing has been completed across China, with summer field management underway in provinces like Shandong and Anhui to ensure a bountiful autumn harvest.

articles.title_zh: 京津冀推出首都都市圈通勤圈一揽子务实举措
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region Launches Package of Measures for Capital Metropolitan Area Commuting Circle
articles.summary_zh: 京津冀交通协同专题工作组印发重点举措，旨在通过优化轨道、铁路、道路及枢纽建设，构建高效便捷的首都都市圈通勤交通网络。
articles.summary_en: The Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Transportation Coordination Special Working Group issued key measures to build an efficient and convenient commuting transport network for the capital metropolitan area.

articles.title_zh: 2026年“特种设备安全日”福建主会场活动在福州举办
articles.title_en: Fujian Hosts Main Event for 2026 'Special Equipment Safety Day' in Fuzhou
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月29日，2026年“特种设备安全日”福建主会场活动在福州举办。福建省市场监管局局长黄水木出席并部署特种设备安全监管工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, 2026, the main event for 'Special Equipment Safety Day' was held in Fuzhou, Fujian. Huang Shuimu, Director of the Fujian Provincial Administration for Market Regulation, outlined safety supervision goals.

tags_en: Fujian Provincial Administration for Market Regulation

articles.title_zh: 最高检发布惩治知识产权恶意诉讼典型案例
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate Releases Typical Cases of Punishing Malicious Intellectual Property Litigation
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民检察院于6月29日在北京发布5件惩治知识产权恶意诉讼典型案例，旨在打击以维权之名行牟利之实的行为，营造保护创新的社会氛围。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate released five typical cases of punishing malicious intellectual property litigation in Beijing on June 29 to combat the abuse of legal rights for profit and foster an innovative social environment.

articles.title_zh: 雷山做强茶业与文旅产业
articles.title_en: Leishan County Strengthens Tea Industry and Cultural Tourism
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，雷山县长黎琨在黔东南州成立70周年新闻发布会上，介绍了雷山县茶业和文旅产业的发展情况。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Leishan County Mayor Li Kun introduced the development of the tea and cultural tourism industries during a press conference marking the 70th anniversary of Qiandongnan Prefecture.

articles.title_zh: 河北全面启动跨境贸易高水平开放试点
articles.title_en: Hebei Fully Launches High-Level Opening Pilot for Cross-Border Trade
articles.summary_zh: 国家外汇管理局同意河北全域开展跨境贸易高水平开放试点，将于2026年7月1日起实施7项外汇收支便利化举措，以优化营商环境并助力外贸高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange approved a high-level opening pilot for cross-border trade in Hebei, implementing seven foreign exchange facilitation measures starting July 1, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 万泉河河道清淤疏浚工程（干流琼海段）开工建设
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on Wanquan River Dredging Project (Qionghai Section)
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，万泉河河道清淤疏浚工程（干流琼海段）在琼海市开工，总投资1.59亿元，旨在提升行洪能力并改善水生态环境。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, the Wanquan River dredging project (Qionghai section) commenced in Qionghai City with a total investment of 159 million yuan to enhance flood control and improve the aquatic ecological environment.

articles.title_zh: 2026下半年海南自贸港企业家信心指数发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2026 Second Half Hainan Free Trade Port Entrepreneur Confidence Index
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月30日，海南省企业联合会、海南省企业家协会与海南大学在海口联合发布2026下半年海南自贸港企业家信心指数，总指数提升至103.71，显示企业家对经济形势趋向乐观。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, the Hainan Provincial Federation of Enterprises, Hainan Entrepreneurs Association, and Hainan University jointly released the 2026 H2 Hainan FTP Entrepreneur Confidence Index, which rose to 103.71, indicating growing optimism among entrepreneurs.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲走访慰问功勋荣誉表彰获得者覃大清和老党员武高辉
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Visits Honored Individuals Qin Daqing and Wu Gaohui Ahead of July 1st
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨走访慰问功勋荣誉表彰获得者覃大清和老党员武高辉，强调以科技创新引领产业振兴，服务国家战略需求。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling visited honored individuals Qin Daqing and Wu Gaohui in Harbin, emphasizing the use of technological innovation to lead industrial revitalization and serve national strategic needs.

articles.title_zh: 许勤走访慰问老党员困难党员和先进基层党组织
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Visits Veteran Party Members and Advanced Primary-level Party Organizations
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨走访慰问老党员、困难党员和先进基层党组织，向全省共产党员致以节日问候。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited veteran and struggling party members and advanced primary-level party organizations in Harbin to convey greetings.

articles.title_zh: 江苏出台“AI+住建”行动方案 部署14项重点任务
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Issues "AI + Housing and Urban-Rural Development" Action Plan with 14 Key Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，江苏省住建厅发布《江苏省“人工智能+住房城乡建设”行动方案》，部署14项重点任务，旨在通过AI赋能建筑业转型、城市治理及政务服务。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the Jiangsu Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development released an action plan deploying 14 key tasks to empower construction industry transformation, urban governance, and government services via AI.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues '15th Five-Year Plan for Education Development'
articles.summary_zh: 国务院印发《教育发展“十五五”规划》，部署“十五五”时期加快建设教育强国，旨在构建高质量教育体系并一体推进教育科技人才发展。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Education Development' to accelerate the construction of a strong education nation and integrate education, science, and talent development.

articles.title_zh: 天津市“两优一先”表彰大会召开
articles.title_en: Tianjin Municipality Holds "Two Excellences and One Advanced" Commendation Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，天津市召开“两优一先”表彰大会，市委书记陈敏尔出席并讲话，强调要深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想，推动中国式现代化天津篇章。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Tianjin held a commendation meeting for "Two Excellences and One Advanced." Municipal Party Secretary Chen Min'er attended and emphasized implementing Xi Jinping's thoughts on party building to advance modernization in Tianjin.

articles.title_zh: 中共中央政治局召开会议研究部署防汛抗旱工作
articles.title_en: Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee Holds Meeting on Flood Control and Drought Relief
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月30日，中共中央政治局在北京召开会议研究部署防汛抗旱工作，由习近平主持，强调要把人民生命安全放在首位，严防群死群伤。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, 2026, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met in Beijing to deploy flood control and drought relief work, chaired by Xi Jinping, emphasizing the priority of people's lives.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省“两优一先”表彰大会在合肥召开

articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，安徽省“两优一先”表彰大会在合肥召开。省委书记梁言顺出席并讲话，表彰全省优秀共产党员、优秀党务工作者和先进基层党组织。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Anhui Province held the "Two Excellences and One Advanced" Commendation Conference in Hefei. Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun attended and delivered a speech to honor outstanding Party members, Party workers, and grassroots organizations.

articles.title_zh: 2026北京数字经济体验周启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Beijing Digital Economy Experience Week Launches
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月27日，2026北京数字经济体验周在北京市东城区启动，聚焦数字消费与AI应用，旨在打造数字消费嘉年华。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Beijing Digital Economy Experience Week launched in Dongcheng District, Beijing on June 27, focusing on digital consumption and AI applications.

articles.title_zh: 广东加快强化产业基础能力建设 打造现代化产业体系
articles.title_en: Guangdong Accelerates Strengthening Industrial Foundation to Build Modern Industrial System
articles.summary_zh: 广东省依托粤港澳大湾区产业优势，通过支持粤芯半导体等企业，加快推动制造业向“智造”升级，构建安全高效的产业链供应链。
articles.summary_en: Guangdong is leveraging the industrial advantages of the Greater Bay Area and supporting companies like Yuexin Semiconductor to upgrade manufacturing to 'intelligent manufacturing' and build a secure, efficient industrial chain.

articles.title_zh: 七部门启动全国社会救助法宣传周活动
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Launch National Social Assistance Law Publicity Week
articles.summary_zh: 民政部等七部门于6月29日至7月5日在全国开展社会救助法宣传周活动，旨在提升困难群众对该法的知晓度并保障其合法权益。
articles.summary_en: Seven departments, including the Ministry of Civil Affairs, launched a National Social Assistance Law Publicity Week from June 29 to July 5 to raise awareness and protect the rights of people in need.

articles.title_zh: 兰州市新增城镇就业3.84万人
articles.title_en: Lanzhou Adds 38,400 New Urban Jobs
articles.summary_zh: 截至5月底，兰州市城镇新增就业3.84万人，市人社局通过实施大学生留兰计划、职业技能培训及创业扶持等措施促进就业。
articles.summary_en: As of the end of May, Lanzhou added 38,400 new urban jobs, with the municipal HRSS Bureau promoting employment through college student retention plans and vocational training.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月29日，政协甘肃省第十三届委员会常务委员会第十七次会议通过了相关人员的任免名单。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, 2026, the 17th meeting of the Standing Committee of the 13th CPPCC Gansu Provincial Committee approved a list of personnel appointments and removals.

articles.title_zh: 张晓强“七一”前夕走访慰问老党员和困难党员
articles.title_en: Zhang Xiaoqiang Visits Old and Struggling Party Members Ahead of July 1st
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，甘肃省委常委、兰州市委书记张晓强在兰州新区走访慰问老党员和困难党员，强调要弘扬建党精神，助力兰州高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Zhang Xiaoqiang, Secretary of the Lanzhou Municipal Committee, visited old and struggling party members in Lanzhou New Area to offer greetings and emphasize the spirit of party building.

articles.title_zh: 六盘水举办刺梨产业专题推介洽谈会促成多项签约
articles.title_en: Liupanshui Holds Rosa Roxburghii Industry Promotion Event to Facilitate Multiple Signings
articles.summary_zh: 六盘水市在第四届中国国际供应链促进博览会期间举办刺梨产业推介会，发布招商项目并促成京黔企业签署多项产销合作协议。
articles.summary_en: Liupanshui City held a Rosa roxburghii industry promotion event during the 4th CISCE, releasing investment projects and facilitating cooperation agreements between Beijing and Guizhou enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 第六届“我家住在长江边”主题宣传活动在湖北宜昌启动
articles.title_en: The 6th 'I Live by the Yangtze River' Theme Promotion Activity Launches in Yichang, Hubei
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，由交通运输部主办的第六届“我家住在长江边”主题宣传活动在湖北宜昌启动，旨在服务长江经济带高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the 6th 'I Live by the Yangtze River' theme promotion activity, hosted by the Ministry of Transport, launched in Yichang, Hubei, to support the high-quality development of the Yangtze River Economic Belt.

articles.title_en: Hebei's Consumption Market Grows Steadily at the Start of the 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年1至5月，河北省通过落实扩内需促消费部署及以旧换新政策，实现消费品零售额同比增长6.3%，消费市场平稳增长。
articles.summary_en: From January to May 2026, Hebei Province saw a 6.3% year-on-year increase in retail sales of consumer goods, driven by policies to expand domestic demand and trade-in initiatives.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明开展党性教育活动和“七一”走访慰问
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Conducts Party Spirit Education Activities and July 1st Visits
articles.summary_zh: 6月29日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在长沙开展党性教育活动并走访慰问老党员和困难党员，强调要深入学习贯彻习近平党建思想。
articles.summary_en: On June 29, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming conducted party spirit education activities and visited elderly and distressed party members in Changsha to implement Xi Jinping's party-building thought.

articles.title_zh: 盐宜高铁长江隧道启动盾构掘进
articles.title_en: Shield Tunneling Begins for Yan-Yi High-Speed Railway Yangtze River Tunnel
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，盐宜高铁长江隧道正式启动盾构掘进施工，该隧道连接江苏省靖江市与江阴市。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, shield tunneling commenced for the Yan-Yi High-Speed Railway Yangtze River Tunnel, connecting Jingjiang and Jiangyin in Jiangsu Province.

articles.title_zh: 西十高铁正式通车运营
articles.title_en: Xi-Shi High-Speed Railway Officially Opens for Operation
articles.summary_zh: 6月30日，西安至十堰高速铁路正式通车运营。该铁路全长约257公里，旨在加强西北与华中地区的交通联通，推动东中西部协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 30, the Xi'an-Shiyan High-Speed Railway officially opened for operation. Spanning approximately 257 km, it enhances connectivity between Northwest and Central China to promote regional collaborative development.

articles.title_zh: 我国将迎来第22个中国航海日
articles.title_en: China to Celebrate 22nd China Maritime Day
articles.summary_zh: 交通运输部副部长李兴湖6月30日在国新办发布会上宣布，今年7月11日第22个中国航海日的主题为“数智赋能，领航未来”。
articles.summary_en: Vice Minister of Transport Li Xinghu announced on June 30 at a press conference that the theme for the 22nd China Maritime Day on July 11 will be 'Digital and Intelligent Empowerment, Navigating the Future'.

articles.title_zh: 中国共产党党员队伍稳步壮大 组织体系日趋严密
articles.title_en: CPC Membership Grows Steadily as Organizational System Becomes More Rigorous

articles.summary_en: The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee reported that by the end of 2025, CPC membership reached 101.286 million with 5.431 million primary-level organizations.

articles.summary_en: The "Zheng He Friendship Ambassador" cultural exchange activities were launched in Jakarta, Indonesia on June 30, 2026, aiming to promote the spirit of Zheng He and deepen cultural cooperation between China and Indonesia.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月24日，国务院总理李强在大连出席第十七届夏季达沃斯论坛开幕式并致辞，阐述中国经济态势，强调创新驱动及全球创新合作的重要性。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, 2026, Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 17th Summer Davos Forum in Dalian, discussing China's economic trends and emphasizing innovation-driven growth and global cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在山东德州考察农业农村发展和基层党的建设
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Agricultural and Rural Development and Grassroots Party Building in Dezhou, Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 6月24日，习近平在山东德州考察，就农业农村发展和基层党的建设作出重要指示，强调保障粮食稳定供给并推进宜居宜业和美乡村建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 24, Xi Jinping inspected Dezhou, Shandong, providing instructions on agricultural and rural development and grassroots party building, emphasizing food security and the construction of beautiful villages.

articles.title_zh: 前4个月我国新兴产业和未来产业新设企业37.3万户
articles.title_en: China Sees 373,000 New Enterprises in Emerging and Future Industries in First Four Months
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局数据显示，今年前4个月我国新兴产业和未来产业共新设企业37.3万户，其中生成式人工智能和人形机器人领域增长显著。

articles.title_zh: 习近平嘱托基层党组织进一步发挥党建引领作用
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Urges Primary-level Party Organizations to Further Play Leading Role of Party Building

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Xi Jinping inspected Xiyujia Village in Dezhou, Shandong, urging primary-level party organizations to strengthen their leading role in building beautiful and livable villages.

articles.title_zh: 淮南凤台通过“三个转变”推动“党课开讲啦”活动走深走实

articles.summary_en: Fengtai County in Huainan City has enhanced the quality of party member education by enriching teaching scenes, innovating formats, and integrating learning with practice.

articles.title_zh: “北京大视听”重磅成果集中发布

articles.title_zh: 京津冀将重点实施五方面便利化措施 织密一小时快速通勤网
articles.title_en: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei to Implement Five Facilitation Measures to Build One-Hour Rapid Commuting Network
articles.summary_zh: 北京市交通委印发《促进现代化首都都市圈通勤圈交通便利化重点举措》，拟通过轨道交通、道路、枢纽等五方面措施，构建京津冀一小时快速通勤网。
articles.summary_en: The Beijing Municipal Commission of Transport issued key measures to improve commuting facilitation in the capital metropolitan area, aiming to build a one-hour rapid commuting network across Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei.

articles.title_zh: 福建省长赵龙在省政协常委会会议上部署人工智能产业发展
articles.title_en: Fujian Governor Zhao Long Deploys AI Industry Development at CPPCC Standing Committee Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 福建省长赵龙在省政协常委会第十八次会议上强调，要实施“人工智能+”行动，补齐科技短板，打造数字中国建设福建样板。
articles.summary_en: Fujian Governor Zhao Long emphasized the implementation of "AI+" actions to bridge technological gaps and create a Fujian model for Digital China during a CPPCC Standing Committee meeting.

articles.title_zh: 广西草原综合植被盖度连续6年稳步增长

articles.summary_en: On June 23, the Guangxi Forestry Bureau held a grassland law popularization event in Hengzhou, reporting a steady increase in the region's grassland vegetation cover from 2020 to 2025.

articles.summary_en: The National Health Commission and the National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine launched the 2026 National Elderly Health Promotion Week from June 22 to 28, focusing on safe and rational medication for the elderly.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥在襄阳市、潜江市调研强调要践行正确政绩观

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Ni Yuefeng, Secretary of the Hebei Provincial Party Committee, chaired an expanded meeting to implement Xi Jinping's thought on party building and deploy tasks for party governance and East-West collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 海南自由贸易港国际咨询委员会成立并举行首次咨询活动

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Hainan Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei delivered a special party lesson in Haikou, emphasizing the need for a correct view of political achievements to build the Hainan Free Trade Port.

articles.title_zh: 暑运即将启动 江苏铁路暑期加开临客19对

articles.summary_en: Jiangsu Railway plans to add 19 pairs of temporary passenger trains during the 2026 summer travel rush from July 1 to August 31 to meet travel demand.

articles.title_zh: 尹弘叶建春会见“赣鄱禁毒先锋”先进集体代表和先进个人

articles.summary_en: On June 24, Jiangxi Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong and Governor Ye Jianchun met with "Ganpo Anti-Drug Pioneers" in Nanchang to emphasize deepening the people's war against drugs in the new era.

articles.summary_en: From June 22 to 24, Bao Gang, Chairman of Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, conducted research on the high-quality development of energy and rare earth industries in Ordos and Baotou, and chaired a meeting on economic operation and production safety.

articles.title_zh: 张工会见优必选董事会主席周剑
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Meets UBTECH Chairman Zhou Jian
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日，天津市市长张工会见优必选董事会主席周剑，探讨智能机器人产业合作，随后静海区、天津经开区与优必选签署合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong met with UBTECH Chairman Zhou Jian to discuss cooperation in the intelligent robot industry, followed by the signing of agreements between UBTECH and local districts.

articles.title_zh: 天津机器人产业快速起势，助力高质量发展
articles.title_en: Tianjin's Robotics Industry Gains Momentum to Boost High-Quality Development
articles.summary_zh: 新华社记者团调研天津机器人产业，报道当地将智能机器人列为重点产业链，并依托京津冀协同发展实现快速增长。
articles.summary_en: A Xinhua news team surveyed Tianjin's robotics industry, reporting that the city has designated intelligent robots as a key industrial chain, achieving rapid growth through Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei synergy.

articles.title_zh: 艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜会见香港铜锣湾集团董事局主席陈智
articles.title_en: Erken Tunyaz Meets with Chen Zhi, Chairman of Causeway Bay Group
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日下午，新疆维吾尔自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐会见香港铜锣湾集团董事局主席陈智，探讨在文商旅等领域深化合作，助力新疆高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, Erken Tunyaz, Chairman of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, met with Chen Zhi, Chairman of Causeway Bay Group, in Urumqi to discuss deepening cooperation in cultural, commercial, and tourism sectors.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江、艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜会见国家管网集团董事长张伟
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang and Erken Tunyaz Meet Chairman of PipeChina Zhang Wei
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜在乌鲁木齐会见国家管网集团董事长张伟，探讨深化能源领域战略合作及基础设施建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, Chen Xiaojiang and Erken Tunyaz of Xinjiang met with Zhang Wei, Chairman of PipeChina, in Urumqi to discuss deepening strategic cooperation in energy and infrastructure construction.

articles.title_zh: 杜学毅任最高检检察委员会副部级专职委员
articles.title_en: Du Xueyi Appointed Deputy Ministerial Professional Member of the Supreme People's Procuratorate Procuratorial Committee
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日，最高人民检察院官网宣布，杜学毅已任最高检检察委员会副部级专职委员。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, the Supreme People's Procuratorate announced that Du Xueyi has been appointed as a deputy ministerial professional member of its Procuratorial Committee.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁舰编队完成远海实战化训练
articles.title_en: Liaoning Carrier Formation Completes Far-Sea Combat Training
articles.summary_zh: 辽宁舰编队在西太平洋等海域完成远海实战化训练，开展了体系对抗、舰载机飞行及与两栖攻击舰编队的联合演练。
articles.summary_en: The Liaoning aircraft carrier formation completed far-sea combat training in the Western Pacific, conducting system confrontations, carrier-based aircraft flights, and joint exercises with an amphibious assault ship formation.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：日本“再军事化”是在走回头路，更是一条不归路
articles.title_en: Foreign Ministry: Japan's "Re-militarization" is a Step Backward and a Dead End
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月22日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆在例行记者会上批评日本“再军事化”是走回头路，敦促日方反思侵略罪责并与军国主义切割。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, 2026, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun criticized Japan's "re-militarization" as a step backward and urged Japan to reflect on its aggression and break with militarism.

articles.title_zh: 国家出台多项举措推动利用外资固稳促优
articles.title_en: China Introduces Measures to Stabilize and Optimize Foreign Investment
articles.summary_zh: 国新办于6月22日举行发布会，商务部、发改委、财政部介绍《利用外资固稳促优行动方案》，旨在扩大市场准入并提升投资便利度。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, the State Council Information Office held a press conference to introduce an action plan aimed at stabilizing and optimizing foreign investment and expanding market access.

articles.title_zh: 前5个月全国财政收入向好态势继续巩固
articles.title_en: National Fiscal Revenue Maintains Positive Trend in First Five Months
articles.summary_zh: 财政部6月22日发布数据显示，今年前5个月全国一般公共预算收入100465亿元，同比增长4%，收入向好态势继续巩固。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance reported on June 22 that China's general public budget revenue reached 10.0465 trillion yuan in the first five months, a year-on-year increase of 4%.

articles.title_zh: 前5月国家铁路发送货物16.7亿吨 同比增长1.8%
articles.title_en: National Railway Freight Volume Reaches 1.67 Billion Tons in First Five Months, Up 1.8%
articles.summary_zh: 1-5月，国家铁路累计发送货物16.7亿吨，同比增长1.8%，其中新能源汽车出口和中欧（亚）班列开行量显著增长。
articles.summary_en: From January to May, China's national railway transported 1.67 billion tons of freight, a 1.8% year-on-year increase, with significant growth in NEV exports and China-Europe/Asia Railway Express trips.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥出席第四届中国国际供应链促进博览会开幕式并作主旨讲话
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Opening Ceremony of 4th China International Supply Chain Expo and Delivers Keynote Speech
articles.summary_zh: 6月22日，国务院副总理丁薛祥在北京出席第四届中国国际供应链促进博览会开幕式并作主旨讲话，强调维护全球产业链供应链稳定畅通。
articles.summary_en: On June 22, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attended the opening ceremony of the 4th China International Supply Chain Expo in Beijing and delivered a keynote speech on maintaining global supply chain stability.

articles.title_zh: 全国夏播进入高峰 科技赋能提质增效
articles.title_en: National Summer Sowing Reaches Peak as Technology Boosts Quality and Efficiency
articles.summary_zh: 农业农村部调度显示，全国夏播粮食进度过七成，通过推广新技术和新装备，粮食主产区的播种品质和效率显著提升。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reports that over 70% of national summer sowing is complete, with new technologies and equipment significantly improving quality and efficiency.
