articles.title_zh: “十五五”首个国家重大工程三峡水运新通道开工
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on Three Gorges Waterway New Channel, First Major National Project of 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，我国“十五五”期间首个国家重大标志性工程三峡水运新通道正式开工，旨在提升长江黄金水道的通航能力。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, construction began on the Three Gorges Waterway New Channel, the first major national landmark project of China's 15th Five-Year Plan, aimed at enhancing the navigation capacity of the Yangtze River.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江华电富拉尔基发电厂热电联产项目开工
articles.title_en: Construction Begins on Combined Heat and Power Project at Heilongjiang Huadian Fularji Power Plant
articles.summary_zh: 6日，黑龙江华电富拉尔基发电2×660MW热电联产项目正式开工，总投资59.6亿元，旨在提升齐齐哈尔市供热效率并落实“双碳”战略。
articles.summary_en: On the 6th, the 2x660MW combined heat and power project at Heilongjiang Huadian Fularji Power Plant officially commenced with a total investment of 5.96 billion yuan to improve heating efficiency in Qiqihar and implement the 'dual carbon' strategy.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲主持召开6月8日黑龙江省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Chairs Heilongjiang Provincial Government Executive Meeting on June 8
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲主持召开省政府常务会议，审议通过农产品精深加工业高质量发展三年行动计划，并学习《中华人民共和国科学技术普及法》。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a provincial government executive meeting to approve a three-year action plan for the high-quality development of agricultural product deep processing and study the Science and Technology Popularization Law.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省粮食产能提升重大水利工程（二期）开工
articles.title_en: Second Phase of Heilongjiang Province Grain Capacity Enhancement Major Water Conservancy Project Commences
articles.summary_zh: 6月9日，黑龙江省粮食产能提升重大水利工程（二期）开工，建成后预计可提升粮食年度产能近30亿斤。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, the second phase of the Heilongjiang Province Grain Capacity Enhancement Major Water Conservancy Project commenced, which is expected to increase annual grain capacity by nearly 3 billion jin upon completion.

articles.title_zh: 许勤会见冈比亚国家人民党行政秘书长西塞一行
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Meets with Administrative Secretary General of Gambia's National People's Party Sidi Sheriff Cisse
articles.summary_zh: 6月7日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨会见冈比亚国家人民党行政秘书长西塞一行，双方探讨深化在现代农业、基础设施等领域的务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 7, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, met with Sidi Sheriff Cisse, Administrative Secretary General of Gambia's National People's Party, in Harbin to discuss deepening pragmatic cooperation in modern agriculture and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: 省科技战略咨询委员会第一次会议在长沙召开
articles.title_en: First Meeting of Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Strategic Advisory Committee Held in Changsha
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在长沙主持召开省科技战略咨询委员会第一次会议，旨在为打造科技创新高地提供智力支撑并谋划“十五五”科技创新规划。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming chaired the first meeting of the Provincial Science and Technology Strategic Advisory Committee in Changsha to provide intellectual support for tech innovation and the '15th Five-Year Plan'.

articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 8, 2026, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming chaired the 90th executive meeting of the provincial government to deploy work on future industries, rule of law, service industry expansion, poverty prevention, and urban flood control.

articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，全国首个省级船员行业党委在南京成立，并发布2026年度服务船员十项举措，旨在提升船员权益保障和从业获得感。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, China's first provincial-level seafarer industry party committee was established in Nanjing, releasing ten measures for 2026 to improve seafarers' rights and welfare.

articles.title_zh: 第二十三届世界土壤学大会在南京开幕
articles.title_en: The 23rd World Congress of Soil Science Opens in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，第23届世界土壤学大会在南京开幕，中国科协、中科院及江苏省、南京市相关领导出席并致辞，聚焦土壤健康与可持续发展。
articles.summary_en: The 23rd World Congress of Soil Science opened in Nanjing on June 8, featuring speeches from leaders of CAST, CAS, and local officials on soil health and sustainable development.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查二、三季度明查暗访即将开展
articles.title_en: Central Work Safety Assessment and Inspection to Conduct Q2 and Q3 Inspections
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部宣布，中央安全生产考核巡查二、三季度明查暗访即将开展，重点整治重点行业重大事故隐患及安全生产领域风腐问题。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Emergency Management announced that central work safety assessment and inspection teams will conduct Q2 and Q3 inspections, focusing on major hazards in key industries and corruption in safety production.

articles.title_zh: 三峡水运新通道工程在湖北宜昌开工
articles.title_en: Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel Project Commences Construction in Yichang, Hubei
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，“十五五”首个国家重大标志性工程——三峡水运新通道工程在湖北宜昌开工，旨在提升长江航运效能，推动长江经济带高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel Project, the first major national landmark project of the 15th Five-Year Plan, commenced construction in Yichang, Hubei, to enhance Yangtze River shipping efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 中国发布落实《新城市议程》国家报告
articles.title_en: China Releases National Report on Implementation of the New Urban Agenda
articles.summary_zh: 中国发布落实《新城市议程》国家报告，从社会、经济和环境三个维度展现推动城市可持续发展的行动与成效。
articles.summary_en: China has released a national report on the implementation of the New Urban Agenda, showcasing actions and achievements in promoting sustainable urban development across social, economic, and environmental dimensions.

articles.title_zh: 崇启公铁长江大桥主桥成功合龙
articles.title_en: Main Bridge of Chongqi Road-Rail Yangtze River Bridge Successfully Closed
articles.summary_zh: 6月9日，连接上海崇明与江苏启东的崇启公铁长江大桥主桥成功合龙，该桥是我国首座高铁设计时速350公里的公铁两用长江大桥。
articles.summary_en: On June 9, the main bridge of the Chongqi Road-Rail Yangtze River Bridge, connecting Chongming in Shanghai and Qidong in Jiangsu, was successfully closed. It is China's first road-rail Yangtze River bridge with a design speed of 350 km/h.

articles.title_zh: 三峡水运新通道破土动工
articles.title_en: Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel Breaks Ground
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，我国“十五五”期间首个国家重大标志性工程——三峡水运新通道破土动工，旨在提升长江黄金水道的通航能力。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel, the first major national landmark project of China's 15th Five-Year Plan, broke ground to enhance the navigation capacity of the Yangtze River.

articles.title_zh: 城市更新“十五五”规划印发聚焦23项重点任务
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal Released with Focus on 23 Key Tasks
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，国务院新闻办举行吹风会介绍《城市更新“十五五”规划》，提出建设“好房子”及改造老旧小区等23项重点任务，并部署相关资金支持。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the SCIO held a briefing on the '15th Five-Year Plan for Urban Renewal,' outlining 23 key tasks including 'good house' construction and old community renovation, along with funding arrangements.

articles.summary_en: On June 8, a law enforcement fleet organized by the Ministry of Transport held a flag-raising ceremony in the waters east of Taiwan to exercise administrative jurisdiction and safeguard national rights.

articles.title_zh: “海洋地质六号”最新成果：我国深海电磁测量技术迎新突破
articles.title_en: Latest Results of "Ocean Geology No. 6": New Breakthrough in China's Deep-Sea Electromagnetic Measurement Technology
articles.summary_zh: 广州海洋地质调查局“海洋地质六号”科考船完成第16航次任务，在深海地质调查及万米级全海深电磁采集技术方面取得重要突破。
articles.summary_en: The "Ocean Geology No. 6" research vessel of the Guangzhou Institute of Marine Geology completed its 16th voyage, achieving breakthroughs in deep-sea geological surveys and 10,000-meter class electromagnetic measurement technology.

articles.title_zh: 三峡水运新通道工程正式开工

articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，三峡水运新通道工程正式开工，这是“十五五”期间首个国家重大标志性工程，旨在畅通长江水运。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel Project officially commenced, marking the first major national landmark project of the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 《数字中国发展报告（2025年）》全文发布
articles.title_en: Full Text of Digital China Development Report (2025) Released
articles.summary_zh: 国家数据局6月8日发布《数字中国发展报告（2025年）》，总结了2025年数字中国建设的进展成效并展望2026年发展前景。
articles.summary_en: The National Data Bureau released the Digital China Development Report (2025) on June 8, summarizing progress in 2025 and outlining prospects for 2026.

articles.title_zh: 山东出台20条政策措施促进个体工商户高质量发展
articles.title_en: Shandong Introduces 20 Policy Measures to Promote High-Quality Development of Individual Industrial and Commercial Households
articles.summary_zh: 山东省近日出台《关于促进个体工商户高质量发展的若干政策措施》，从金融支持、创业指导、数智转型及环境优化四个方面推出20条举措，旨在促进个体工商户加快发展。
articles.summary_en: Shandong Province recently issued 20 policy measures across four areas, including financial support and digital transformation, to promote the high-quality development of individual industrial and commercial households.

articles.title_zh: 《山西省长城保护条例》正式发布
articles.title_en: Shanxi Province Officially Releases Great Wall Protection Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，山西省十四届人大常委会审议通过《山西省长城保护条例》，该条例自2026年7月5日起施行，旨在通过法治手段加强长城资源的保护与管理。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the Standing Committee of the 14th Shanxi Provincial People's Congress passed the "Shanxi Province Great Wall Protection Regulations," effective July 5, 2026, to strengthen the legal protection and management of Great Wall resources.

articles.title_zh: 山西平定县推动工业、文旅、农业协同升级
articles.title_en: Pingding County in Shanxi Promotes Synergistic Upgrading of Industry, Culture, Tourism, and Agriculture
articles.summary_zh: 山西省阳泉市平定县通过传统工业提质升级、全域文旅融合及特色富硒农业发展，探索资源型县域高质量发展路径。
articles.summary_en: Pingding County in Yangquan, Shanxi, is pursuing a path of high-quality development through industrial upgrading, cultural and tourism integration, and the development of selenium-rich agriculture.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔调研高校和科研机构，强调推动科技创新和产业创新深度融合

articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，天津市委书记陈敏尔调研高校和科研机构，强调要一体推进教育科技人才发展，推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合，服务天津高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, Tianjin Municipal Party Secretary Chen Min'er visited universities and research institutes, emphasizing the integrated development of education, science, technology, and talent to foster the deep integration of scientific and industrial innovation.

articles.title_zh: 王予波强调持续提升对内对外开放能级 推动辐射中心建设全面跃升
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Emphasizes Enhancing Opening-up Capabilities to Advance the Construction of the Radiation Center
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，云南省长王予波在省发展改革委调研并主持会议，强调要提升对内对外开放能级，推动面向南亚东南亚辐射中心建设取得新突破。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo conducted research at the Provincial Development and Reform Commission and chaired a meeting to emphasize enhancing opening-up capabilities and advancing the construction of the Radiation Center facing South and Southeast Asia.

articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Seed Management Station recently announced 28 non-major crop varieties that passed identification, covering vegetables, coffee, and flowers to enhance the competitiveness of highland characteristic agriculture.

articles.summary_en: On June 9, the Lanzhou People's Procuratorate filed a public prosecution against Han Song, former Party Secretary and Director of the Standing Committee of the Xi'an Municipal People's Congress, for suspected bribery involving a huge amount.

articles.summary_en: On June 8, 2026, the CCDI and NSC announced that Pan Liang, a former deputy minister-level official of the SASAC, was expelled from the CPC for serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥出席三峡水运新通道工程开工仪式
articles.title_en: Ding Xuexiang Attends Groundbreaking Ceremony for Three Gorges Waterway New Channel Project
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日上午，中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥在湖北省宜昌市出席三峡水运新通道工程开工仪式并宣布工程正式开工。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of June 8, Ding Xuexiang, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the groundbreaking ceremony for the Three Gorges Waterway New Channel Project in Yichang, Hubei.

tags.name_en: Three Gorges Waterway New Channel Project

tags_en: Three Gorges Waterway New Channel Project

articles.title_zh: 我国海洋生态状况稳中向好
articles.title_en: China's Marine Ecological Status Steadily Improving
articles.summary_zh: 自然资源部于6月8日发布《中国海洋生态预警监测公报》，显示2025年我国海洋生态状况总体稳中向好，重点生态工程建设提速。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Natural Resources released the China Marine Ecological Early Warning and Monitoring Bulletin on June 8, indicating that China's marine ecological status in 2025 generally improved.

articles.title_zh: 习近平离京对朝鲜进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Leaves Beijing for State Visit to North Korea
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日上午，国家主席习近平应朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩邀请，离京对朝鲜进行国事访问。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of June 8, President Xi Jinping left Beijing for a state visit to North Korea at the invitation of General Secretary Kim Jong Un.

articles.title_zh: 习近平抵达平壤开始对朝鲜进行国事访问
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Arrives in Pyongyang for State Visit to the DPRK
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平抵达平壤，开始对朝鲜进行国事访问，由朝鲜劳动党总书记金正恩迎接。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, General Secretary and President Xi Jinping arrived in Pyongyang to begin a state visit to the DPRK, where he was welcomed by General Secretary Kim Jong Un.

articles.title_zh: 让中朝传统友谊焕发更加璀璨的时代光辉
articles.title_en: Let the Traditional Friendship Between China and the DPRK Shine with an Even More Brilliant Era Glow
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，习近平在赴平壤进行国事访问之际，在朝鲜《劳动新闻》发表署名文章，提出深化战略沟通、加强交流互鉴、拓展务实合作、密切多边协作四点主张。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, President Xi Jinping published a signed article in the Rodong Sinmun ahead of his state visit to Pyongyang, proposing four initiatives to further elevate China-DPRK relations.

articles.title_zh: 习近平在朝鲜媒体发表署名文章
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Publishes Signed Article in North Korean Media
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，习近平在赴平壤进行国事访问之际，在朝鲜《劳动新闻》发表署名文章，强调深化中朝战略协作，续写传统友谊新篇章。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, ahead of his state visit to Pyongyang, Xi Jinping published a signed article in North Korea's Rodong Sinmun, calling for deeper strategic cooperation and the continuation of traditional friendship.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《现代化应急体系建设“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues '15th Five-Year Plan for the Construction of a Modern Emergency System'
articles.summary_zh: 国务院印发《现代化应急体系建设“十五五”规划》，部署“十五五”时期安全生产与防灾减灾救灾工作，旨在构建中国特色大国应急体系。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for the Construction of a Modern Emergency System' to deploy work on safety production and disaster relief, aiming to build a modern emergency system with Chinese characteristics.

articles.title_zh: 推动中朝关系与时俱进取得更大发展
articles.title_en: Promoting the Further Development of China-DPRK Relations to Keep Pace with the Times
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平将于6月8日至9日应金正恩邀请对朝鲜进行国事访问，旨在加强战略沟通并深化双边友好合作。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the DPRK from June 8 to 9 at the invitation of Kim Jong Un to strengthen strategic communication and deepen bilateral cooperation.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”首个国家重大工程开工 三峡枢纽将迎新通道
articles.title_en: First Major National Project of the 15th Five-Year Plan Commences: New Channel for Three Gorges Hub
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月8日，我国“十五五”期间首个国家重大标志性工程——三峡水运新通道在湖北宜昌破土动工，旨在提升长江黄金水道通航能力。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, 2026, the Three Gorges Waterway New Channel, the first major national project of China's 15th Five-Year Plan, commenced construction in Yichang, Hubei, to enhance the navigation capacity of the Yangtze River.

articles.title_zh: 金融监管总局加快制定与房地产发展新模式相适应的融资制度
articles.title_en: National Financial Regulatory Administration to Accelerate Formulation of Financing System Compatible with New Real Estate Development Model
articles.summary_zh: 金融监管总局宣布将加快制定与房地产发展新模式相适应的融资制度，以支持房地产市场的健康发展。
articles.summary_en: The National Financial Regulatory Administration announced it will accelerate the development of a financing system aligned with the new real estate development model to support market health.

articles.title_zh: 原中央纪委驻广播电影电视部纪检组组长金石逝世
articles.title_en: Jin Shi, Former Head of CCDI Inspection Group at Ministry of Radio and Television, Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 原中央纪委驻广播电影电视部纪检组组长、第十二届中央纪委委员金石同志于2026年5月29日在北京逝世，享年102岁。
articles.summary_en: Jin Shi, former head of the CCDI inspection group at the Ministry of Radio and Television and member of the 12th CCDI, passed away in Beijing on May 29, 2026, at the age of 102.

articles.title_zh: 广东韶关浈江区推进小镇撤并
articles.title_en: Zhenjiang District in Shaoguan, Guangdong Promotes Merger of Small Towns
articles.summary_zh: 广东韶关市浈江区人民政府近日公告，经省政府同意，撤销花坪镇和犁市镇，设立新的犁市镇，旨在优化城镇体系并提升公共服务效能。
articles.summary_en: The Zhenjiang District Government of Shaoguan, Guangdong, announced the merger of Huaping and Lishi towns into a new Lishi Town to optimize the urban system and improve public service efficiency.

articles.title_zh: 国家数据局发布推进行业高质量数据集建设行动实施方案
articles.title_en: National Data Bureau Releases Implementation Plan for High-Quality Industry Dataset Construction
articles.summary_zh: 国家数据局发布《关于推进行业高质量数据集建设行动的实施方案》，首次在国家层面系统部署数据赋能人工智能发展。
articles.summary_en: The National Data Bureau released an implementation plan to promote high-quality industry dataset construction, marking the first systematic national-level deployment for data-empowered AI development.

articles.title_zh: 厦港多联中心项目“廉洁文化示范点”揭牌启动
articles.title_en: Integrity Culture Demonstration Point Unveiled at Xiamen-Hong Kong Multi-modal Center Project
articles.summary_zh: 近日，中建海峡厦门公司等单位在厦门厦港多联中心项目举行“廉洁文化建设示范点”启动仪式，旨在通过联创共建营造崇廉尚洁氛围，保障项目高质量推进。
articles.summary_en: Recently, CSCEC Strait Xiamen Company and other entities held a launch ceremony for an 'Integrity Culture Construction Demonstration Point' at the Xiamen-Hong Kong Multi-modal Center project to promote integrity and ensure high-quality progress.

articles.title_zh: 厦门湖里区开展集成电路产业“质量强链”行动
articles.title_en: Xiamen Huli District Implements 'Quality Chain Strengthening' Action for Integrated Circuit Industry
articles.summary_zh: 厦门市湖里区市场监督管理局构建“质量强链”联合体，通过提供检测、标准及融资等一体化服务，助力集成电路企业提升竞争力并推动产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Huli District Market Supervision Administration in Xiamen established a 'Quality Chain Strengthening' consortium to help IC enterprises improve competitiveness through integrated testing, standards, and financing services.

articles.title_zh: “一带一路”国家妇女能力建设研修班调研广西特色产业发展
articles.title_en: Belt and Road Initiative Countries Women's Capacity Building Workshop Researches Guangxi's Characteristic Industry Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月4日，“一带一路”国家妇女能力建设研修班在广西开展实地调研，参观西部陆海新通道及康养企业，学习区域开放与妇女创业经验。
articles.summary_en: On June 4, the Belt and Road Initiative Countries Women's Capacity Building Workshop conducted field research in Guangxi to study regional openness and women's entrepreneurship.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省委书记关志鸥邀请网友通过领导留言板建言献策
articles.title_en: Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhiou Invites Netizens to Share Expectations via Leader's Message Board
articles.summary_zh: 湖北省委书记关志鸥邀请网友通过人民网“领导留言板”就湖北“十五五”规划及发展提出建议和期盼。
articles.summary_en: Guan Zhiou, Secretary of the Hubei Provincial Party Committee, invites netizens to provide suggestions and expectations for Hubei's '15th Five-Year Plan' via the 'Leader's Message Board'.

articles.title_zh: 国内首个省级船员行业党委在南京揭牌成立
articles.title_en: China's First Provincial-Level Seafarer Industry Party Committee Established in Nanjing
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，国内首个省级船员行业党委在南京揭牌成立，并发布2026年度服务船员十项举措，旨在保障船员权益并推动长江航运高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, China's first provincial-level seafarer industry party committee was established in Nanjing, launching ten measures for 2026 to protect seafarers' rights and promote high-quality shipping development.

articles.title_zh: 坚决打好“三北”工程攻坚战
articles.title_en: Resolutely Winning the "Three-North" Shelterbelt Forest Program Battle
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区通过精准施治、近自然治理及多元共治等措施，在“三北”工程攻坚战中取得重大阶段性成果，并部署未来高质量发展目标。
articles.summary_en: Inner Mongolia has achieved significant progress in the "Three-North" Shelterbelt Forest Program through precision treatment and diversified governance, and has outlined goals for future high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 全国首张水泥行业碳足迹标识认证证书在宁夏颁发
articles.title_en: First Cement Industry Carbon Footprint Certification Issued in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月8日，全国首张水泥行业碳足迹标识认证证书在宁夏银川颁发给宁夏赛马水泥有限公司，标志着我国水泥行业碳足迹认证进入实践落地阶段。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, 2026, China's first cement industry carbon footprint certification was issued to Ningxia Saima Cement Co., Ltd. in Yinchuan, marking the practical implementation of carbon footprint certification in the industry.

articles.title_zh: 上海推出网络餐饮电子证照核验应用
articles.title_en: Shanghai Launches Electronic License Verification Application for Online Catering
articles.summary_zh: 上海市市场监管局于6月7日推出网络餐饮电子证照核验应用，旨在通过数字化管理闭环整治“幽灵外卖”。
articles.summary_en: On June 7, the Shanghai Municipal Administration for Market Regulation launched an electronic license verification application for online catering to combat 'ghost kitchens' through digital management.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Guides at CPC First Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在“六一”国际儿童节前夕给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，为强国建设、民族复兴接续奋斗。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer guides at the CPC First Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Halls before International Children's Day, encouraging them to inherit 'red genes' and strive for national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 云南镇雄千亿级磷基新材料产业集群启动建设
articles.title_en: Construction of 100-Billion-Level Phosphorus-Based New Material Industry Cluster Starts in Zhenxiong, Yunnan
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，云南省在昭通市镇雄县举行项目推进会，正式启动千亿级磷基新材料产业集群建设，该项目为云南省8个牵引性重大产业项目之一。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, Yunnan Province held a promotion meeting in Zhenxiong County, Zhaotong, to officially launch the construction of a 100-billion-level phosphorus-based new material industry cluster.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席金正恩举行的欢迎仪式
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcome Ceremony Held by Kim Jong Un
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，中共中央总书记、国家主席习近平在平壤出席由朝鲜劳动党总书记、国务委员长金正恩举行的盛大欢迎仪式。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, General Secretary and President Xi Jinping attended a grand welcome ceremony held by General Secretary and President of the State Affairs Commission Kim Jong Un in Pyongyang.

articles.title_zh: 习近平出席金正恩举行的欢迎宴会
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Attends Welcome Banquet Hosted by Kim Jong Un
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，习近平在平壤出席金正恩举行的欢迎宴会，双方就深化中朝关系、加强高层交往和拓展务实合作达成重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, Xi Jinping attended a welcome banquet hosted by Kim Jong Un in Pyongyang, where they reached a consensus on deepening China-DPRK relations and expanding pragmatic cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平和彭丽媛观看朝鲜专场文艺演出
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan Attend Special Art Performance in North Korea
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日晚，习近平主席和夫人彭丽媛在平壤观看专场文艺演出，金正恩夫妇陪同，旨在巩固和发展中朝传统友好合作。
articles.summary_en: On the evening of June 8, President Xi Jinping and Peng Liyuan attended a special art performance in Pyongyang, accompanied by Kim Jong Un and Ri Sol Ju, to strengthen China-DPRK relations.

articles.title_zh: 水利部对六省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Launches Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Six Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 水利部于6月7日对湖南、广东、广西、重庆、四川、贵州六省份启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，以应对强降雨带来的洪水风险。
articles.summary_en: On June 7, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in six provinces to counter risks from heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 三峡水运新通道工程破土动工
articles.title_en: Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel Project Breaks Ground
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月8日，作为“十五五”时期首个国家重大标志性工程的三峡水运新通道工程正式开工，旨在大幅提升长江干线通航能力，推动长江经济带高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, 2026, the Three Gorges Water Transport New Channel Project, the first major national landmark project of the 15th Five-Year Plan, officially commenced to significantly increase the shipping capacity of the Yangtze River.

articles.title_zh: 武汉白沙洲公铁两用长江大桥主体工程开工
articles.title_en: Main Construction of Wuhan Baishazhou Road-Rail Yangtze River Bridge Begins
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，总投资61.71亿元的武汉白沙洲公铁两用长江大桥主体工程全面动工，旨在完善区域综合交通网络并巩固武汉交通枢纽地位。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the main construction of the Wuhan Baishazhou Road-Rail Yangtze River Bridge, with a total investment of 6.171 billion yuan, officially began to improve the regional integrated transportation network.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲会见国家电投集团总经理徐树彪一行
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Meets with Xu Shubiao, General Manager of State Power Investment Corporation
articles.summary_zh: 6月7日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲在哈尔滨会见国家电投集团总经理徐树彪，双方探讨深化央地合作，推动黑龙江能源绿色低碳转型及投资建设。
articles.summary_en: On June 7, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling met with Xu Shubiao, General Manager of State Power Investment Corporation in Harbin, to discuss deepening central-local cooperation and promoting green energy transition.

articles.title_zh: 许勤主持召开黑龙江省委人才工作领导小组第四次全体会议
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Chairs the 4th Plenary Meeting of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee Talent Work Leading Group
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，黑龙江省委书记许勤主持召开省委人才工作领导小组第四次全体会议，部署人才发展“十五五”规划编制及人才政策落实工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, chaired the 4th plenary meeting of the provincial talent work leading group to deploy the "15th Five-Year Plan" for talent development.

articles.title_zh: 我国已批准注册特殊医学用途配方食品330个
articles.title_en: China Approves Registration of 330 Special Medical Purpose Formula Foods
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局6月8日表示，我国已批准注册330个特殊医学用途配方食品，在罕见病类食品注册和临床可及性等方面取得新突破。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation announced on June 8 that China has approved 330 special medical purpose formula foods, achieving breakthroughs in rare disease food registration and clinical accessibility.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月8日，全国工商联主席高云龙带队赴安徽、浙江开展重点考察调研，研究如何培育壮大未来产业并发挥企业引领作用，为中共中央决策提供参考。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, 2026, Gao Yunlong, Chairman of the ACFIC, led a research trip to Anhui and Zhejiang provinces to study the cultivation of future industries and the leading role of enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 国家网信办、市场监管总局联合印发《网络测评活动规范》
articles.title_en: CAC and SAMR Jointly Issue Regulations on Online Testing Activities
articles.summary_zh: 国家网信办与市场监管总局联合印发《网络测评活动规范》，旨在规范网络测评行为，维护公平竞争秩序并保护合法权益。
articles.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation jointly issued the 'Regulations on Online Testing Activities' to standardize online testing and maintain fair market competition.

articles.title_zh: 实施就业优先战略“十五五”规划审议通过
articles.title_en: 15th Five-Year Plan for Implementing Employment Priority Strategy Reviewed and Passed
articles.summary_zh: 6月5日，国务院常务会议审议通过《实施就业优先战略“十五五”规划》，强调通过加强产业协同和大规模职业技能培训，推动就业扩容提质，实现高质量充分就业。
articles.summary_en: On June 5, the State Council executive meeting reviewed and passed the '15th Five-Year Plan for Implementing the Employment Priority Strategy,' aiming to promote high-quality full employment through industry synergy and large-scale vocational training.

articles.title_zh: 四部门解读《城市更新“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: Four Departments Interpret the "15th Five-Year Plan" for Urban Renewal
articles.summary_zh: 6月8日，国务院新闻办举行吹风会，住房城乡建设部等四部门就我国首部国家级城市更新专项规划《城市更新“十五五”规划》作出解读。
articles.summary_en: On June 8, the State Council Information Office held a briefing where four departments, including the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, interpreted China's first national special plan for urban renewal for the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 新疆启动化妆品企业生产质量提升专项行动
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Launches Special Action to Improve Production Quality of Cosmetics Enterprises

articles.summary_zh: 6月4日至5日，云南省长王予波在昭通市镇雄县调研并接待群众来访，强调要做好信访工作，并调研当地教育与产业发展情况。
articles.summary_en: From June 4 to 5, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo conducted research and received public petitions in Zhenxiong County, Zhaotong, emphasizing the importance of petition work and visiting local education and industrial sites.

articles.title_zh: 国家防总对重庆贵州启动防汛四级应急响应

articles.summary_en: On June 6, the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters initiated a Level IV emergency response for Chongqing and Guizhou, while the Ministry of Emergency Management activated or maintained geological disaster responses for Chongqing, Guangxi, and Guizhou.

articles.summary_en: In the first quarter of 2026, Shaoxing ranked first in Zhejiang Province's "Waste-Free Index" with a score of 90.28, demonstrating its leading role in "waste-free city" construction.

articles.title_en: The 2nd "Yu Chuang Xing Huo" Chongqing Technology Achievement Transformation Competition Launched

articles.title_zh: 做好“海”的文章
articles.title_en: Making the Most of the Ocean for High-Quality Development

articles.summary_en: Reporters visited coastal areas to report on China's achievements in deep-sea technology, modern fisheries, and marine ecological protection, following President Xi Jinping's guidance on maritime strength.

articles.title_zh: 王旭调研检查高考准备工作
articles.title_en: Wang Xu Inspects Preparations for National College Entrance Examination

articles.summary_en: On June 6, 2026, Wang Xu, Vice Governor of Gansu Province, inspected Gaokao preparations at Lanzhou No. 33 Middle School to ensure a secure, fair, and orderly examination.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃印发“人工智能+”行动方案促进文旅融合
articles.title_en: Gansu Issues "AI+" Action Plan to Promote Culture and Tourism Integration
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省文化和旅游厅近日印发“人工智能+”行动方案，旨在利用AI技术推动文旅业态转型升级，助力文化和旅游高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism recently issued an "AI+" action plan to drive the transformation and upgrading of the culture and tourism industry through AI technology.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升调研经济社会高质量发展工作

articles.summary_en: On June 5, Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, conducted research on high-quality economic and social development across several provincial departments, emphasizing a correct view of political performance.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃粮储科技科普活动在定西启动
articles.title_en: Gansu Grain and Material Reserve Science Popularization Activity Launched in Dingxi

articles.summary_en: On June 5, the provincial Grain and Material Reserve Science Activity Week launched in Tongwei County, Dingxi, aiming to popularize grain storage knowledge and ensure food security through technological showcases.

articles.title_zh: 中马钦州产业园人工智能应用合作中心（钦州+吉隆坡）启用
articles.title_en: AI Application Cooperation Centers Opened in Qinzhou and Kuala Lumpur

articles.summary_en: On June 5, AI Application Cooperation Centers were simultaneously launched in Qinzhou and Kuala Lumpur to promote China-Malaysia AI cooperation and facilitate Chinese AI solutions in the ASEAN market.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明会见中德汽车人协会代表团

articles.summary_en: On June 6, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming met with a delegation from the Sino-German Automotive Association in Changsha to discuss deepening automotive industry cooperation and promoting industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 水利部和中国气象局联合发布红色山洪灾害气象预警

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources and China Meteorological Administration issued a red alert for flash floods on June 7, warning of potential disasters in parts of Hunan, Guangxi, and Guizhou.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河马道枢纽实现三项世界之最
articles.title_en: Ma Dao Hub of Pinglu Canal Achieves Three World Records
articles.summary_zh: 6月7日，新华社报道平陆运河马道枢纽工程，该枢纽在规模、水头高度及阀门启闭速度方面均创下世界纪录。
articles.summary_en: On June 7, Xinhua News Agency reported on the Ma Dao Hub of the Pinglu Canal, which has set world records for scale, water head height, and valve opening/closing speed.

articles.title_zh: 青海G109小峡口改建工程建成通车

articles.summary_en: The G109 Xiaoxiakou reconstruction project, a key transportation project in Qinghai Province, has been completed and opened to traffic, providing a fast link between Xining and Haidong.

articles.title_zh: 山西长治沁源县应急管理系统3名负责人接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Three Officials of Emergency Management System in Qinyuan County, Changzhi, Shanxi Under Investigation

articles.summary_en: On June 7, the Changzhi Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision announced that three officials, including Sun Xiaoye, head of the Qinyuan County Emergency Management Bureau, are under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 中央安全生产考核巡查组开展明查暗访

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Central Safety Production Inspection Group conducted inspections in Jiangsu and Liaoning, identifying major hazards such as illegal chemical storage and initiating accountability processes.

articles.title_zh: 云南文山州统筹选派104名优秀科级干部到乡镇（街道）挂职

articles.summary_en: Wenshan Prefecture in Yunnan Province has dispatched 104 section-level cadres to townships and sub-districts for a two-year temporary posting to strengthen grassroots governance and industrial development.

articles.title_zh: 辽宁省将继续撤并28家省级经济开发区
articles.title_en: Liaoning Province to Further Consolidate 28 Provincial Economic Development Zones
articles.summary_zh: 6月6日央视披露，辽宁省将继续撤并28家省级经济开发区，旨在通过整合优化解决产业同质化和管理重叠问题，推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 6, CCTV reported that Liaoning Province will consolidate 28 provincial economic development zones to address industrial homogeneity and administrative overlap, promoting high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 国家安全部就出境游拍摄敏感设施发布安全提示
articles.title_en: Ministry of State Security Issues Safety Tips for Outbound Travelers Regarding Photography of Sensitive Facilities
articles.summary_zh: 国家安全部针对中国公民在海外因拍摄敏感设施被拘押的情况，提醒出境游客遵守当地法律，避免在军事、政府等重点区域拍摄。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of State Security warns Chinese travelers to obey local laws and avoid photographing sensitive areas like military or government facilities to prevent detention abroad.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会启动无障碍环境建设法执法检查

articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee launched a law enforcement inspection on the Law on the Construction of Barrier-Free Environments in Beijing on June 5 to address key issues and ensure effective implementation.

articles.title_zh: 丰富拓展“三好”内涵 推动中朝关系取得更大发展

articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to the DPRK from June 8 to 9, 2026, at the invitation of General Secretary Kim Jong Un for a historic meeting.

articles.title_zh: 国务院新闻办举行“新征程上的奋斗者”中外记者见面会

articles.title_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议

articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing to approve the 15th Five-Year Plan for employment priority and discuss new industrialization and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 公安机关会同教育部门提醒高考考生诚信赴考

articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, public security and education authorities reminded Gaokao candidates to maintain integrity and warned that crimes related to the exams will be strictly punished.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同老挝人民革命党中央总书记、国家主席通伦举行会谈

articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, Xi Jinping held talks with Lao President Thongloun Sisoulith in Beijing during the latter's state visit to discuss deepening China-Laos relations and building a China-Laos community with a shared future.

articles.title_zh: 中央党校（国家行政学院）举行2026年春季学期第二批班次毕业典礼
articles.title_en: Central Party School (National Academy of Governance) Holds Graduation Ceremony for Second Batch of 2026 Spring Semester

articles.summary_en: On June 5, 2026, Cai Qi, a member of the Politburo Standing Committee, attended the graduation ceremony for the second batch of the 2026 spring semester at the Central Party School.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和老挝人民民主共和国关于构建新时代全天候中老命运共同体的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement between the People's Republic of China and the Lao People's Democratic Republic on Building an All-Weather China-Laos Community with a Shared Future in the New Era

articles.summary_en: From June 2 to 6, 2026, Lao President Thonglun Sisoulith paid a state visit to China. President Xi Jinping held talks with him and issued a joint statement to build an all-weather China-Laos community with a shared future in the new era.

articles.summary_en: As of June 5, 2026, 184 million mu of summer grain wheat have been harvested nationwide, with progress reaching 54.29%.

articles.title_zh: 我国服务贸易持续扩能提质

articles.title_zh: 财政金融“组合拳”更大力度支持扩内需

articles.summary_en: China has established a 100 billion yuan special fund for fiscal-financial synergy to promote domestic demand, guiding funds into key investment and consumption areas via loan interest subsidies and financing guarantees.

articles.title_zh: 习近平将对朝鲜进行国事访问

articles.title_zh: 台湾岛东部海域海上交通专项执法行动启动

articles.title_zh: 中国驻罗马尼亚使馆对罗马尼亚众议员窜访台湾表示坚决反对

articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting on June 5 to approve the 15th Five-Year Plan for employment priority and regulations for veterans' employment, and to discuss new industrialization and future industries.

articles.summary_en: On June 5, Premier Li Qiang met with Lao President Thonglun Sisoulith in Beijing to discuss deepening cooperation in trade, railways, and the China-Laos Economic Corridor.

articles.title_zh: 各地麦收高效推进 助力夏粮颗粒归仓

articles.summary_zh: 6月5日起，河北、安徽、河南等地加快冬小麦收获进度，通过调配农机和多部门联动确保夏粮颗粒归仓。

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on June 5 that President Xi Jinping will pay a state visit to North Korea from June 8 to 9 at the invitation of Kim Jong Un to discuss bilateral relations.

articles.summary_en: The General Office of the State Council issued guiding opinions to promote the high-quality development of private investment funds by optimizing registration, strengthening supervision, and managing risks.

articles.summary_en: Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining visited Shanghai Electric Group on June 4, 2026, emphasizing the need to deepen SOE reform and leverage AI to drive industrial intelligent transformation.

articles.summary_en: The National Radio and Television Administration announced on June 3 a two-month special campaign to crack down on harmful, vulgar, and pirated content in micro-short dramas to regulate the industry.

articles.title_zh: 兰州市2025生态环境状况公报发布

articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Lanzhou Municipal Government Information Office held a press conference to release the 2025 Ecological Environment Status Bulletin, reporting overall improvements in air and water quality.

articles.title_zh: 雄安新区数据权益司法保护实验室揭牌成立

articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Xiong'an New Area Intermediate People's Court, Southwest University of Political Science and Law, and Xiong'an Group Digital City Technology Co. jointly unveiled the Data Rights Judicial Protection Laboratory to support the digital economy.

articles.summary_zh: 湖南省出台十条措施，通过落实分级监管职责、量化检查频次及深化多部门协同，强化特种设备安全监管。
articles.summary_en: Hunan Province has introduced ten measures to strengthen the safety supervision of special equipment through hierarchical regulatory responsibilities and multi-departmental collaboration.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明调研院前医疗急救工作
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Investigates Pre-hospital Medical Emergency Work

articles.summary_en: On June 3, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming investigated pre-hospital medical emergency work in Changsha, emphasizing the need to strengthen resource coordination and improve mechanisms to enhance emergency rescue capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部对三地启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Launches Level IV National Emergency Response for Geological Disasters in Three Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部6月3日针对江西、湖南、贵州启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应，以应对大到暴雨引发的地质灾害风险。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Ministry of Emergency Management launched a Level IV national emergency response for Jiangxi, Hunan, and Guizhou to mitigate geological disaster risks caused by heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 省委举行学习报告会 信长星主持 刘小涛张义珍出席
articles.title_en: Provincial Party Committee Holds Study Report Meeting Hosted by Xin Changxing
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，江苏省委举行学习报告会，由省委书记信长星主持，省长刘小涛、省政协主席张义珍出席，重点研究未来产业的前瞻布局与发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee held a study report meeting hosted by Secretary Xin Changxing to discuss the strategic layout and development of future industries.

articles.title_zh: 当前我国夏粮收获进度超四成
articles.title_en: China's Summer Grain Harvest Progress Exceeds 40%
articles.summary_zh: 截至6月3日，农业农村部通报全国夏粮小麦收获进度达42.23%，已收获1.43亿亩。
articles.summary_en: As of June 3, the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs reported that 42.23% of China's summer wheat has been harvested, totaling 143 million mu.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能深度赋能中国千行百业
articles.title_en: Artificial Intelligence Deeply Empowers Various Industries in China

articles.summary_en: The article reports on the widespread application of AI in logistics, industrial inspection, and medical rehabilitation, noting China's goal to empower economic and social development via 'AI+'.

articles.title_zh: 山东力争2028年底累计推出50条以上精品旅游公路
articles.title_en: Shandong Aims to Launch Over 50 Boutique Tourist Roads by End of 2028
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月3日，山东省在泰安召开旅游公路建设推进会议，计划到2028年底建成6000公里旅游公路并推出50条以上精品旅游公路。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, 2026, Shandong Province held a meeting in Tai'an to promote tourist road construction, aiming to build 6,000 km of tourist roads and launch over 50 boutique routes by 2028.

articles.title_zh: 自治区政府召开常务会议研究安排全区安全生产工作等
articles.title_en: Regional Government Holds Executive Meeting to Arrange Production Safety and Other Work
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日下午，自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜主持召开自治区政府常务会议，研究安排全区安全生产工作，并审议通过固废治理、粮食收购及古树名木保护等管理办法。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 3, Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz chaired a regional government executive meeting to arrange production safety work and review measures for solid waste management, grain acquisition, and ancient tree protection.

articles.title_zh: 云南走好绿色发展之路推动长江经济带发展
articles.title_en: Yunnan Promotes Green Development and the Yangtze River Economic Belt
articles.summary_zh: 云南省于6月4日举行新闻发布会，总结实施长江经济带战略十年来在生态保护、工业绿色转型及产业升级方面取得的成效。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Province held a press conference on June 4 to summarize achievements in ecological protection, green industrial transformation, and industrial upgrading over ten years of implementing the Yangtze River Economic Belt strategy.

articles.title_zh: 高兴夫被逮捕并提起公诉
articles.title_en: Gao Xingfu Arrested and Indicted
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省人大常委会原党组副书记、副主任高兴夫涉嫌受贿，被最高人民检察院逮捕，并由江西省宜春市人民检察院提起公诉。
articles.summary_en: Gao Xingfu, former Deputy Secretary and Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Zhejiang Provincial People's Congress, was arrested for bribery and indicted by the Yichun Municipal People's Procuratorate.

articles.title_zh: 教育部打击涉考违法犯罪活动并防范高科技舞弊
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education to Crack Down on Exam-Related Crimes and Prevent High-Tech Cheating

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education and relevant departments have deployed security measures for the 2026 Gaokao, focusing on cracking down on exam-related crimes and high-tech cheating to ensure fairness and safety.

articles.title_zh: 公安部交管局警示近期超员载客违法载人车辆肇事突出
articles.title_en: Traffic Management Bureau of Ministry of Public Security Warns of Surge in Overloaded Vehicle Accidents
articles.summary_zh: 公安部交管局6月3日通报近期湖北、辽宁等多地发生多起超员载客导致群死群伤事故，并提醒农村群众及用人单位注意出行安全。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Traffic Management Bureau of the MPS reported multiple fatal accidents caused by overloaded vehicles in several provinces and issued safety warnings for rural residents and employers.

articles.title_zh: 外交部：文字游戏无法洗白日本整军扩武的实际行动

articles.summary_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning stated on June 3 that Japan is attempting to use word games to disguise its "re-militarization" and actual military expansion.

articles.title_zh: 山东省临沂市人大常委会原党组副书记、副主任徐福田被开除党籍

articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision expelled Xu Futian, former Deputy Director of the Linyi Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee, from the Party for serious disciplinary and legal violations.

articles.summary_en: On June 2, Du Xiangwan, an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, issued a statement denying rumors that his team applied nuclear technology to waste incineration.

articles.summary_en: China's Foreign Ministry announced on June 3 that Myanmar Foreign Minister Tin Maung Swe will pay an official visit to China from June 4 to 6.

articles.summary_en: On June 3, 2026, Vice President Han Zheng met with UN Secretary-General candidate Michelle Bachelet in Beijing to discuss supporting the UN's core role and promoting a more just global governance system.

articles.title_zh: 毫不放松抓好“三夏”生产 扎实有效开展常态化监测帮扶

articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong visited Hebei from June 1-2, emphasizing the importance of "Three Summers" agricultural production for food security and normalized monitoring to consolidate poverty alleviation achievements.

articles.title_zh: 韩正会见英国外交大臣库珀
articles.title_en: Han Zheng Meets UK Foreign Secretary David Cooper
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，国家副主席韩正在北京会见英国外交大臣库珀，双方就发展中英全面战略伙伴关系、加强战略沟通及共同应对全球挑战进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Vice President Han Zheng met with UK Foreign Secretary David Cooper in Beijing to discuss developing a comprehensive strategic partnership and strengthening bilateral communication.

articles.title_zh: 重庆以融合化推动产业升级
articles.title_en: Chongqing Promotes Industrial Upgrading through Integration
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市通过推动先进制造业与现代服务业、数智技术与实体经济以及产业链与区域的深度融合，加快构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing is accelerating the construction of a modern industrial system by promoting the deep integration of advanced manufacturing with modern services, digital technology with the real economy, and industrial chains with regional development.

articles.title_zh: 《习近平的文化情缘》等纪录片在老挝启播
articles.title_en: Documentaries Including 'Xi Jinping's Cultural Ties' Premiere in Laos

articles.summary_en: Three Chinese documentaries, including 'Xi Jinping's Cultural Ties,' premiered on mainstream Lao media starting June 1, with Lao President Thongloun Sisoulith sending a congratulatory letter.

articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, Li Hongzhong, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, inspected county and township People's Congress elections in Hebei to ensure the practice of whole-process people's democracy.

articles.title_zh: 谁能决定“仅退款”

articles.summary_en: The article reports on disputes between merchants and buyers caused by e-commerce 'Refund Only' policies, analyzes the imbalance of platform power, and mentions the 'Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Network Transaction Platform Rules' to regulate market order.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记寄望红色基因薪火相传
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Encourages Passing Down "Red Genes" to Young Pioneers

articles.summary_en: On International Children's Day, President Xi Jinping replied to Young Pioneer guides at the Museum of the First CPC National Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging them to inherit "red genes."

articles.summary_en: Recently, international financial institutions including MSCI and Morgan Stanley have increased investments in Chinese tech firms and raised GDP growth forecasts, reflecting confidence in China's hard tech and economy.

articles.title_zh: 丁薛祥在云南调研强调深入推进基础教育高质量发展

articles.summary_en: From June 1 to 2, Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang inspected basic education and ecological protection in Yunnan, emphasizing the implementation of the Party's education policy and high-quality development of basic education.

articles.title_zh: 5月份我国物流业相关数据分析
articles.title_en: Analysis of China's Logistics Industry Data for May
articles.summary_zh: 中国物流与采购联合会发布数据显示，5月份我国物流业景气指数回升至50.3%，需求重回扩张区间。
articles.summary_en: Data released by the China Federation of Logistics & Purchasing shows that China's logistics prosperity index rose to 50.3% in May, returning to the expansion range.

articles.title_zh: 黄仁勋称台湾缺电，国台办回应
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Responds to Jensen Huang's Comments on Taiwan's Power Shortage
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，国台办在例行新闻发布会上回应黄仁勋关于台湾缺电的言论，批评民进党当局未能解决岛内结构性问题并将能源问题政治化。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Taiwan Affairs Office responded to Jensen Huang's comments on Taiwan's power shortage, criticizing the DPP for failing to address structural issues and politicizing energy.

articles.title_zh: 腾讯测试AI智能体原型或助推其在AI领域翻盘
articles.title_en: Tencent Tests AI Agent Prototype to Boost Comeback in AI Sector
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，受腾讯测试AI智能体原型及计划启动合规审批的消息影响，腾讯股价大涨，市场对其AI竞争力预期回升。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Tencent's stock surged following reports that the company is testing an AI agent prototype and planning regulatory approval, boosting market expectations for its AI competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 骗取贷款890余万元的潜逃嫌疑人被押解回国
articles.title_en: Fugitive Who Defrauded Over 8.9 Million Yuan Extradited to China
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，在公安部统筹指挥下，辽宁公安机关将潜逃境外十余年、涉嫌骗取贷款890余万元的犯罪嫌疑人高某某押解回国。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, Liaoning public security organs, coordinated by the Ministry of Public Security, extradited suspect Gao, who had fled abroad for over a decade after defrauding banks of over 8.9 million yuan.

articles.title_zh: 私挖盗采矿产致5死，云南省安委会挂牌督办
articles.title_en: Yunnan Provincial Safety Committee Supervises Investigation into Illegal Mining Accident That Killed Five
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，云南省安委会决定对曲靖市一起导致5人死亡的私挖盗采矿产事故查处进行挂牌督办。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Yunnan Provincial Safety Committee announced a supervised investigation into an illegal mining accident in Qujing that resulted in five deaths.

tags_zh: 云南省安全生产委员会

articles.title_zh: 公安部通报制售作弊芯片干扰尾气检测等环境污染案件
articles.title_en: Ministry of Public Security Reports Environmental Pollution Cases Including Exhaust Test Cheating Chips
articles.summary_zh: 公安部通报了浙江、广西、重庆、四川四地侦破的污染环境刑事案件，涉及制售作弊芯片、非法处置危废及偷排废水等行为。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security reported several environmental pollution criminal cases in Zhejiang, Guangxi, Chongqing, and Sichuan, involving cheating chips for exhaust tests and illegal waste disposal.

articles.title_zh: 赖清德称“受小红书影响，台青把中国当好人”，国台办回应
articles.title_en: Taiwan Affairs Office Responds to Lai Ching-te's Comments on Taiwanese Youth's Perception of China via Xiaohongshu
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，国台办在例行新闻发布会上回应赖清德关于台湾青年受社交软件影响看待大陆的言论，批评赖当局抹黑并威胁台湾青年。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Taiwan Affairs Office responded to Lai Ching-te's remarks about Taiwanese youth's positive view of China influenced by social media, criticizing the Lai administration for smearing and threatening youth.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中、包钢会见华为高管，推动内蒙古打造“绿色算力+人工智能”应用基地
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang Meet Huawei Executives to Build "Green Computing + AI" Application Base in Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中、自治区政府主席包钢会见华为高管，探讨深化战略合作，旨在将内蒙古打造为全国绿色算力高地和人工智能应用基地。
articles.summary_en: Wang Weizhong and Bao Gang, leaders of Inner Mongolia, met with Huawei executives to deepen strategic cooperation and build the region into a national hub for green computing and AI applications.

articles.title_zh: 人民日报开设“美丽中国行”专栏
articles.title_en: People's Daily Launches "Beautiful China Tour" Column
articles.summary_zh: 人民日报开设“美丽中国行”专栏，并于6月2日在四川雅安启动“探访国家公园”集中采访，旨在宣传生态文明建设成效。
articles.summary_en: People's Daily launched the "Beautiful China Tour" column and started a concentrated interview event on national parks in Ya'an, Sichuan on June 2 to promote ecological civilization achievements.

articles.title_zh: 平陆运河全线通水，将于今年9月通航
articles.title_en: Pinglu Canal Fully Watered and Set to Open for Navigation in September
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日上午，平陆运河全线通水并进入有水调试阶段，预计将于今年9月正式通航，将成为西南地区便捷的出海通道。
articles.summary_en: On the morning of June 3, the Pinglu Canal was fully watered and entered the commissioning phase, with official navigation expected to begin in September.

articles.title_zh: 广播电视主流媒体系统性变革引领工程启动实施
articles.title_en: Implementation of the Leading Project for Systematic Reform of Mainstream Radio and Television Media
articles.summary_zh: 国家广播电视总局近日启动实施广播电视主流媒体系统性变革引领工程，旨在通过内容、传播、技术和组织的一体化，推动广电媒体挺进互联网及经济社会发展主战场。
articles.summary_en: The National Radio and Television Administration recently launched a leading project for the systematic reform of mainstream radio and television media to promote integrated production and communication.

articles.title_zh: 科研人员论文投稿致重要技术细节泄密，国安部提醒
articles.title_en: Ministry of State Security Warns Against Leakage of Technical Details via Research Paper Submissions
articles.summary_zh: 国家安全部于6月3日发布安全提示，提醒科研人员在论文投稿、数据存储及学术交流中严守保密要求，防止重要技术细节泄密。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Ministry of State Security issued a warning urging researchers to strictly follow confidentiality requirements during paper submissions and academic exchanges to prevent technical leaks.

articles.title_zh: 云南持续整治统计造假突出问题
articles.title_en: Yunnan Continues to Rectify Prominent Statistical Fraud Issues
articles.summary_zh: 云南省针对统计造假和形式主义问题开展专项整治，通过叫停排名通报、实施大数据监测及回溯执法，确保统计数据真实可靠。
articles.summary_en: Yunnan Province is conducting a special rectification campaign against statistical fraud and formalism, utilizing big data monitoring and retrospective enforcement to ensure data reliability.

articles.title_zh: 多省份党政一把手检查2026年高考准备工作
articles.title_en: Heads of Party and Government in Multiple Provinces Inspect Preparations for 2026 Gaokao
articles.summary_zh: 近日，海南、山西、河北等多省份党政负责人调研检查2026年高考准备工作，强调确保考试平稳有序、严明考风考纪，实现“平安高考”。
articles.summary_en: Recently, party and government leaders in provinces including Hainan, Shanxi, and Hebei inspected preparations for the 2026 Gaokao, emphasizing stability, security, and strict examination discipline.

articles.title_zh: 安徽、山西、湖南、辽宁省长深入矿区井下检查安全生产情况
articles.title_en: Governors of Anhui, Shanxi, Hunan, and Liaoning Inspect Mine Safety
articles.summary_zh: 5月下旬至6月初，安徽、山西、湖南、辽宁四省省长分别深入矿区井下，督导检查安全生产工作，强调落实矿山安全“八条硬措施”。
articles.summary_en: From late May to early June, the governors of Anhui, Shanxi, Hunan, and Liaoning conducted on-site inspections of mine shafts to supervise production safety and enforce the 'Eight Hard Measures' for mine safety.

articles.title_zh: 马鞍山开展中高考考点周边酒店价格专项检查
articles.title_en: Ma'anshan Conducts Special Price Inspections of Hotels Near Exam Centers
articles.summary_zh: 马鞍山市市场监管局于5月29日前后开展中高考考点周边酒店价格专项检查，严禁借考试之机牟取暴利，保障考生及家长权益。
articles.summary_en: Ma'anshan Market Supervision Bureau conducted special price inspections of hotels near exam centers around May 29 to prevent price gouging and protect the rights of students and parents.

articles.title_zh: 阜阳成立绿电绿证服务中心以重塑企业竞争力
articles.title_en: Fuyang Establishes Green Power and Green Certificate Service Center to Enhance Enterprise Competitiveness
articles.summary_zh: 阜阳市成立绿电绿证服务中心，旨在为当地企业提供绿电认证和交易服务，助力企业应对国际碳关税并提升绿色竞争力。
articles.summary_en: Fuyang has established a Green Power and Green Certificate Service Center to provide certification and trading services, helping local firms tackle international carbon tariffs and boost green competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 2026世界旅游城市联合会北京香山旅游峰会开幕
articles.title_en: 2026 World Tourism Cities Organization Beijing Xiangshan Tourism Summit Opens
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，2026世界旅游城市联合会北京香山旅游峰会在北京开幕，市长殷勇出席并就数智引领未来旅游提出建议。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 WTCsO Beijing Xiangshan Tourism Summit opened in Beijing on June 2, 2026. Mayor Yin Yong attended and proposed suggestions for the future of digital tourism.

articles.title_zh: 重庆以融合化推动产业升级
articles.title_en: Chongqing Promotes Industrial Upgrading through Integration
articles.summary_zh: 重庆市通过推动先进制造业与现代服务业、数智技术与实体经济以及产业链与区域的深度融合，加快构建现代化产业体系，打造先进制造业中心。
articles.summary_en: Chongqing is accelerating the construction of a modern industrial system by promoting the deep integration of advanced manufacturing with modern services, digital technology with the real economy, and industrial chains with regional development.

articles.title_zh: 福州市国土空间基础信息平台项目通过验收
articles.title_en: Fuzhou Land Space Basic Information Platform Project Passes Acceptance
articles.summary_zh: 福州市国土空间基础信息平台项目近日通过专家验收，旨在通过数智化治理提升自然资源管理效率，推动国土空间治理现代化。
articles.summary_en: The Fuzhou Land Space Basic Information Platform project recently passed expert acceptance, aiming to enhance natural resource management efficiency through digital governance.

articles.title_zh: 党建引领乡村振兴：福建宁德柏洋村与渔井村的实践探索
articles.title_en: Party Building Leading Rural Revitalization: Practical Explorations in Baiyang and Yujing Villages of Ningde, Fujian
articles.summary_zh: 人民网党建调研团走进福建宁德，调研柏洋村和渔井村如何通过高质量党建引领，分别通过产业升级和治理创新实现乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: A People's Daily research team visited Ningde, Fujian, to study how Baiyang and Yujing villages achieved rural revitalization through high-quality party building, industrial upgrading, and governance innovation.

articles.title_zh: 广东省科技监督与科研诚信系列培训正式启动
articles.title_en: Series of Training on Science and Technology Supervision and Research Integrity Launched in Guangdong Province
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日下午，由科技部十司指导、广东省科技厅主办的科技监督与科研诚信系列培训在华南理工大学正式启动。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of June 2, a series of training sessions on science and technology supervision and research integrity, guided by the Ministry of Science and Technology and hosted by the Guangdong Provincial Department of Science and Technology, was launched at South China University of Technology.

tags.name_en: Guangdong Provincial Department of Science and Technology

tags_en: Guangdong Provincial Department of Science and Technology

articles.title_zh: “2026年高考护航行动”启动实施
articles.title_en: "2026 Gaokao Escort Action" Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，教育部会同网信、公安等部门在北京部署开展“2026年高考护航行动”，旨在通过打击作弊和综合服务保障，确保高考公平与平安。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, the Ministry of Education, along with cyberspace and public security departments, launched the "2026 Gaokao Escort Action" in Beijing to ensure a fair and safe National College Entrance Examination.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能模型提升沙尘预报精准度
articles.title_en: AI Models Improve Accuracy of Dust Storm Forecasting
articles.summary_zh: 中国气象科学研究院开发的人工智能模型在甘肃等地试运行，大幅提升了沙尘预报的精准度与计算速度，助力防灾减灾。
articles.summary_en: An AI model developed by the Chinese Academy of Meteorological Sciences has been tested in Gansu, significantly improving the accuracy and speed of dust storm forecasting to support disaster mitigation.

articles.title_zh: 2025年甘肃省生态环境状况公报发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 Gansu Province Ecological Environment Status Bulletin
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省政府新闻办召开新闻发布会，发布《2025年甘肃省生态环境状况公报》，通报全省空气、水质及土壤等生态环境状况。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial Government Information Office released the 2025 Ecological Environment Status Bulletin, reporting on the province's air, water, and soil quality.

articles.title_zh: “鹊桥”行动启动仪式暨首场招商会在南宁举行
articles.title_en: Launch Ceremony of "Magpie Bridge" Action and First Investment Promotion Conference Held in Nanning
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，由广西文旅厅主办的“鹊桥”行动启动仪式暨首场招商会在南宁举行，旨在吸引优质运营商，推动广西文旅业转型升级。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the launch ceremony of the "Magpie Bridge" action and the first investment promotion conference, hosted by the Guangxi Department of Culture and Tourism, were held in Nanning to attract high-quality operators and upgrade the region's tourism industry.

articles.title_zh: 强化责任担当 抓实集中整治 推动全省学习教育不断走深走实
articles.title_en: Strengthen Responsibility and Implement Concentrated Rectification to Deepen Provincial Study and Education
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，河南省委书记刘宁出席全省树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育突出问题集中整治工作推进会，强调要抓好整改整治，特别是解决“新官不理旧账”问题。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Henan Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning attended a meeting on the rectification of problems regarding the correct view of political achievements, emphasizing the need to address the issue of "new officials ignoring old accounts."

articles.title_zh: 商丘探索“一县一特色产业”推动县域经济转型发展
articles.title_en: Shangqiu Explores 'One County, One Characteristic Industry' to Promote County Economic Transformation
articles.summary_zh: 河南省商丘市通过实施“一县一特色产业”战略，在钻石、制冷、家纺等领域打造产业集群，推动县域经济高质量转型发展。
articles.summary_en: Shangqiu City in Henan Province is promoting high-quality county economic transformation by implementing the 'One County, One Characteristic Industry' strategy across various sectors.

articles.title_zh: 关志鸥走访省人大常委会省政府省政协省法院省检察院
articles.title_en: Guan Zhiou Visits Provincial NPC Standing Committee, Government, CPPCC, Court, and Procuratorate
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，湖北省委书记关志鸥走访省人大常委会、省政府、省政协、省法院和省检察院，与领导班子成员交流并部署高质量发展与法治建设工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Hubei Provincial Party Secretary Guan Zhiou visited the provincial NPC Standing Committee, government, CPPCC, court, and procuratorate to exchange views and deploy tasks for high-quality development and the rule of law.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省政府与中国气象局召开“十五五”时期协同共建工作座谈会
articles.title_en: Hubei Provincial Government and China Meteorological Administration Hold Symposium on "15th Five-Year Plan" Collaborative Construction
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，湖北省政府与中国气象局在武汉召开座谈会，研究谋划“十五五”时期气象高质量发展及省部协同共建重点事项。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Hubei Provincial Government and the China Meteorological Administration held a symposium in Wuhan to plan key collaborative projects for high-quality meteorological development during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period.

articles.title_zh: 中国气象局启动重大气象灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: China Meteorological Administration Activates Level IV Emergency Response for Major Meteorological Disasters
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，中国气象局启动重大气象灾害四级应急响应，并与农业农村部联合发布设施农业风灾和冬小麦倒伏风险预警。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the China Meteorological Administration activated a Level IV emergency response for major meteorological disasters and jointly issued agricultural risk warnings with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 首个快递领域国际标准化机构成立
articles.title_en: First International Standardization Body for Express Delivery Established
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，国际标准化组织（ISO）快递服务标准委员会在北京成立，秘书处设在中国并由国家邮政局发展研究中心承担具体工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, the ISO Express Service Standards Committee was established in Beijing, with its secretariat located in China and managed by the State Post Bureau's Development Research Center.

articles.title_zh: 河北省组建407支常态化农机应急作业服务队
articles.title_en: Hebei Province Establishes 407 Normalized Agricultural Machinery Emergency Service Teams
articles.summary_zh: 河北省组建407支常态化农机应急作业服务队并投入200万台农机具，旨在保障“三夏”期间阴雨天的小麦抢收工作。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province has formed 407 normalized agricultural machinery emergency service teams and deployed 2 million pieces of equipment to ensure wheat harvesting during the 'Three Summers' period.

articles.title_zh: 河北推动机器人产业跑出“加速度”
articles.title_en: Hebei Promotes Acceleration of Robotics Industry
articles.summary_zh: 河北省今年将深化“北京大脑—河北转化”实践，通过项目建设、京津冀协同及场景应用，推动机器人产业快速发展。
articles.summary_en: Hebei Province will deepen the "Beijing Brain-Hebei Conversion" practice to accelerate the development of its robotics industry through project construction, regional synergy, and scenario applications.

articles.title_zh: 海南省出台关于推动城市高质量发展的实施意见
articles.title_en: Hainan Province Issues Implementation Opinions on Promoting High-Quality Urban Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，中共海南省委和海南省人民政府印发实施意见，旨在到2035年基本建成具有海南特色和优势的现代化人民城市，构建与自贸港建设相适应的城市体系。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the CPC Hainan Provincial Committee and the Hainan Provincial Government issued implementation opinions to build modern people-centered cities with Hainan characteristics by 2035, aligning with the Free Trade Port construction.

articles.title_zh: 海南面向全球旅行商推出十大旅游名片
articles.title_en: Hainan Launches Ten Tourism Calling Cards for Global Travel Agents
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，海南省旅游和文化广电体育厅在海口向全球旅行商推出“十大旅游名片”，旨在通过品牌化营销提升海南国际旅游竞争力。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, the Hainan Provincial Department of Tourism, Culture, Radio, Television and Sports launched "Ten Tourism Calling Cards" in Haikou to enhance Hainan's international tourism competitiveness.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲到牡丹江市督导检查中央生态环境保护督察通报典型案例整改工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Inspects Rectification of Typical Cases Reported by Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection in Mudanjiang
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲到牡丹江市督导检查中央生态环境保护督察通报典型案例的整改工作，强调要从严从实抓好农村环境治理。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling inspected the rectification of typical cases reported by the Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection in Mudanjiang, emphasizing strict rural environmental governance.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省发布寒区公路铜冶炼尾渣路基、基层设计与施工技术规范
