articles.title_zh: 郑州推出“郑检AI·阳光查”平台
articles.title_en: Zhengzhou Launches "Zhengjian AI · Sunshine Check" Platform
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，郑州市上线“郑检AI·阳光查”平台，利用人工智能与大数据技术构建网络餐饮食品安全数字化共治体系。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Zhengzhou launched the "Zhengjian AI · Sunshine Check" platform, utilizing AI and big data to build a digital co-governance system for online catering food safety.

articles.title_zh: 王凯主持召开省政府常务会议
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Chairs Provincial Government Executive Meeting
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，河南省省长王凯主持召开省政府常务会议，研究未来产业布局、城市更新、道路交通安全及长期护理保险制度等工作。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Henan Governor Wang Kai chaired a provincial government executive meeting to discuss future industry layout, urban renewal, road traffic safety, and long-term care insurance.

articles.title_zh: 河北临西工业品直播推动产业转型
articles.title_en: Linxi County in Hebei Promotes Industrial Transformation via Industrial Product Livestreaming
articles.summary_zh: 河北省邢台市临西县通过推进工业品电商直播，探索数字化转型新模式，推动当地轴承产业提质增效。
articles.summary_en: Linxi County in Hebei Province is leveraging industrial product e-commerce livestreaming to drive the digital transformation and efficiency of its bearing industry.

articles.title_zh: 许勤要求做好防灾减灾救灾工作 全力支持服务企业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Xu Qin Urges Disaster Prevention and Support for High-Quality Enterprise Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在绥化肇东市调研，看望受极端天气影响的农户并走访企业，强调要统筹发展与安全，支持民营经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited Zhaodong in Suihua to inspect disaster-affected farmers and enterprises, emphasizing the balance between development and security and supporting the high-quality growth of the private economy.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲督导检查中央生态环境保护督察通报典型案例整改工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Supervises Rectification of Typical Cases Reported by Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲到牡丹江市督导检查中央生态环境保护督察通报典型案例整改工作，强调要从严从实提升农村环境治理水平。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling visited Mudanjiang to supervise the rectification of typical cases reported by the Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection, emphasizing strict rural environmental governance.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省公路水运建设领域启动“安全生产月”活动
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Launches "Safety Production Month" for Highway and Waterway Construction
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省交通运输厅近日启动公路水运建设领域“安全生产月”活动，通过业务培训、实战演练和隐患排查提升交通基础设施建设安全水平。
articles.summary_en: The Heilongjiang Provincial Department of Transport recently launched the "Safety Production Month" campaign for highway and waterway construction to enhance safety through training, drills, and hazard inspections.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明主持省委金融委2026年第一次全会
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Chairs the First Plenary Session of the Provincial Financial Committee in 2026
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日上午，湖南省长毛伟明在长沙主持省委金融委第一次全会，部署金融强省建设，强调防风险、优服务、拓改革与强监管。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming chaired the first plenary session of the Provincial Financial Committee in Changsha to advance the construction of a strong financial province.

articles.title_zh: 湖南建设年轻人友好省份支持青年建功立业
articles.title_en: Hunan Builds Youth-Friendly Province to Support Young People's Career Development
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省实施青年就业、创业、生活、成长四大友好行动，通过设立创业基金、人才驿站等措施吸引和支持青年人才在湘发展。
articles.summary_en: Hunan Province is implementing four "friendly actions" focusing on employment, entrepreneurship, living, and growth to attract and support young talents.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明赴永州市调研
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Conducts Research Tour in Yongzhou City
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在永州市调研，强调要以高水平安全保障高质量发展，并就安全生产、防灾减灾、营商环境及信访工作提出要求。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming conducted a research tour in Yongzhou, emphasizing the need to ensure high-quality development through high-level security.

articles.title_zh: 杨青峰履新苏豪控股集团总裁
articles.title_en: Yang Qingfeng Appointed President of Suhao Holding Group
articles.summary_zh: 近日，杨青峰出任苏豪控股集团总裁、党委副书记及董事，此前他担任江苏省文化科技控股集团总经理。
articles.summary_en: Yang Qingfeng has been appointed President, Deputy Party Secretary, and Director of Suhao Holding Group, having previously served as General Manager of Jiangsu Cultural Technology Holding Group.

articles.title_zh: 习近平关切西海固地区饮水安全与民生改善
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concern for Water Security and Livelihood Improvement in Xihaigu
articles.summary_zh: 文章回顾了习近平总书记对宁夏西海固地区用水问题的长期关切，报道了当地通过实施供水工程显著改善农村饮水安全，提升村民生活质量的成效。
articles.summary_en: The article reviews General Secretary Xi Jinping's long-term concern for water shortages in the Xihaigu region of Ningxia, reporting on the significant improvements in rural drinking water security and quality of life through water supply projects.
articles.source_name_zh: 新华网 领导人活动

articles.title_zh: 广电总局部署微短剧有害低俗和侵权盗版专项治理
articles.title_en: NRTA Deploys Special Campaign to Govern Harmful, Vulgar, and Pirated Micro-Short Dramas
articles.summary_zh: 国家广播电视总局于6月3日通报，将开展为期2个月的微短剧专项治理，集中整治有害低俗内容及侵权盗版等8类问题，以规范行业生态。
articles.summary_en: The National Radio and Television Administration announced on June 3 a two-month special campaign to crack down on harmful, vulgar, and pirated content in micro-short dramas to regulate the industry ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部对三地启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Launches Level IV National Emergency Response for Geological Disasters in Three Provinces
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，应急管理部针对江西、湖南、贵州启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应，以应对大到暴雨引发的地质灾害风险。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Ministry of Emergency Management launched a Level IV national emergency response for Jiangxi, Hunan, and Guizhou to mitigate geological disaster risks caused by heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 四川集中发布20个重点场景项目
articles.title_en: Sichuan Releases 20 Key Scenario Projects
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，四川省发展改革委在成都高新区举办“天府新场景”推介活动，发布20个省级重点场景项目并启动“天府新场景”平台，旨在促进科技与产业创新融合。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Sichuan Provincial Development and Reform Commission held a promotion event in Chengdu High-tech Zone, releasing 20 provincial key scenario projects and launching the 'Tianfu New Scenarios' platform to promote the integration of tech and industrial innovation.

tags.name_en: Sichuan Provincial Development and Reform Commission

tags_en: Sichuan Provincial Development and Reform Commission

articles.title_zh: 2025年山东省生态环境状况公报发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 Shandong Province Ecological Environment Status Bulletin
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，山东省政府新闻办发布《2025年山东省生态环境状况公报》，介绍全省生态环境质量大幅改善，并被明确为美丽中国省域先行区。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, the Shandong Provincial Government Information Office released the 2025 Ecological Environment Status Bulletin, reporting significant improvements in environmental quality and the province's designation as a pilot zone for 'Beautiful China.'

articles.title_zh: 2025山东上市公司社会责任（ESG）行动报告发布
articles.title_en: Release of the 2025 Social Responsibility (ESG) Action Report for Shandong Listed Companies
articles.summary_zh: 大众日报众观智库发布《2025山东上市公司社会责任（ESG）行动报告》，分析山东159家上市公司的ESG实践成效并提出发展建议。
articles.summary_en: The Dazhong Daily Zhongguan Think Tank released the 2025 Social Responsibility (ESG) Action Report, analyzing the ESG performance of 159 listed companies in Shandong and providing development suggestions.

articles.title_zh: 山东省政府印发《推进服务业扩能提质实施方案》
articles.title_en: Shandong Provincial Government Issues Implementation Plan to Enhance and Upgrade Service Industry
articles.summary_zh: 山东省人民政府近日印发《推进服务业扩能提质实施方案》，部署到2030年服务业增加值达7.2万亿元，重点推动生产性与生活性服务业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Government issued an implementation plan to upgrade the service industry, aiming for a value-added of 7.2 trillion yuan by 2030 through enhancing productive and living services.

articles.title_zh: 山西发布公费农科生招录政策
articles.title_en: Shanxi Releases Recruitment Policy for Government-Funded Agricultural Students
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，山西省招生考试管理中心发布2026年公费农科生定向培养招生细则，计划招录90人，旨在引导优质生源扎根基层，助力乡村振兴。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Shanxi Provincial Admissions and Examination Management Center released recruitment details for the 2026 government-funded agricultural student program to support rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 陈敏尔、张工与国家能源集团董事长邹磊座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Min'er and Zhang Gong Hold Symposium with Zou Lei, Chairman of National Energy Investment Group
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，天津市委书记陈敏尔、市长张工与国家能源集团董事长邹磊座谈，探讨在能源保供、科技创新及京津冀协同发展等方面的深度合作。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Tianjin Party Secretary Chen Min'er and Mayor Zhang Gong held a symposium with Zou Lei, Chairman of National Energy Investment Group, to discuss deep cooperation in energy supply, tech innovation, and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei coordinated development.

articles.title_zh: 新疆发展“人工智能+”的机遇与优势
articles.title_en: Opportunities and Advantages of Xinjiang's 'AI+' Development
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，新疆维吾尔自治区党政主要领导就全区推进“人工智能+”工作开展调研并召开座谈会，强调要全面实施“人工智能+”行动以赋能高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, top party and government leaders of Xinjiang conducted research and held a symposium on promoting 'AI+' initiatives to empower high-quality regional development.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江在自治区档案馆调研座谈
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Conducts Research and Symposium at Regional Archives
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，自治区党委书记陈小江在自治区档案馆调研座谈，强调要提高档案工作质量和服务水平，服务建设社会主义现代化新疆。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Chen Xiaojiang, Secretary of the Regional Party Committee, visited the Regional Archives to emphasize improving archive quality and services to support the modernization of Xinjiang.

articles.title_zh: 新疆三农智库研究中心揭牌成立
articles.title_en: Xinjiang San Nong Think Tank Research Center Established
articles.summary_zh: 近日，由自治区农科院牵头组建的新疆三农智库研究中心正式揭牌成立，旨在为新疆打造优质农牧产品供给基地提供智力支撑。
articles.summary_en: The Xinjiang San Nong Think Tank Research Center, led by the regional Academy of Agricultural Sciences, was recently established to provide intellectual support for Xinjiang's agricultural and livestock product supply base.

articles.title_zh: 王予波检查调度云南省高考准备工作
articles.title_en: Wang Yubo Inspects and Coordinates Gaokao Preparations in Yunnan Province
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，云南省长王予波检查调度全省高考准备工作，强调要严肃考风考纪，确保高考平安有序、公平公正。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Yunnan Governor Wang Yubo inspected preparations for the National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao) to ensure a safe, orderly, and fair process.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省科研诚信指数首次发布
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Province Releases First Scientific Research Integrity Index
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省科技厅发布《浙江省科研诚信指数报告（2024）》，首次在省域层面通过指数形式系统反映科研诚信建设进展。
articles.summary_en: The Zhejiang Provincial Department of Science and Technology released the 2024 Scientific Research Integrity Index Report, marking the first provincial-level effort to systematically track research integrity progress.

articles.title_zh: 快递领域首个国际标准化机构在我国成立
articles.title_en: First International Standardization Body for Express Delivery Established in China
articles.summary_zh: 国际标准化组织（ISO）快递服务标准委员会于6月2日在浙江杭州成立，这是快递领域首个国际标准化机构。
articles.summary_en: The ISO Technical Committee on Express Delivery Services was established in Hangzhou, Zhejiang on June 2, marking the first international standardization body in the express delivery sector.

articles.title_zh: 王莉霞涉嫌受贿被提起公诉
articles.title_en: Wang Lixia Indicted on Bribery Charges
articles.summary_zh: 6月3日，最高检决定逮捕内蒙古自治区党委原副书记、自治区政府原主席王莉霞，大庆市人民检察院已向大庆市中级人民法院提起公诉。
articles.summary_en: On June 3, the Supreme People's Procuratorate ordered the arrest of Wang Lixia, former Deputy Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Party Committee and former Chairwoman of the region's government, who has been indicted for bribery.

articles.title_zh: 王浩会见通伦
articles.title_en: Wang Hao Meets Thongloun
articles.summary_zh: 王浩代表浙江省委、省政府会见老挝领导人通伦，双方探讨深化经贸投资、现代农业、数字经济等领域合作，助力中老友好关系。
articles.summary_en: Wang Hao, representing the Zhejiang Provincial Party Committee and Government, met with Laotian leader Thongloun to discuss deepening cooperation in trade, investment, modern agriculture, and the digital economy.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省省长深入煤矿井下检查安全生产
articles.title_en: Anhui Governor Inspects Safety Production at Coal Mine
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，安徽省省长王清宪在淮南市煤矿企业督导检查安全生产工作，强调要守牢生产安全底线，坚决防范重特大事故发生。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Anhui Governor Wang Qingxian inspected safety production at coal mine enterprises in Huainan, emphasizing the need to maintain safety bottom lines and prevent major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫健委健全社区卫生服务体系 落实“日常疾病在基层解决”
articles.title_en: National Health Commission to Improve Community Health Service System to Resolve Common Diseases at Primary Level
articles.summary_zh: 国家卫健委6月2日发布通知，要求到2030年基本实现建制街道社区卫生服务中心全覆盖，落实“日常疾病在基层解决”。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the National Health Commission issued a notice aiming for full coverage of community health service centers by 2030 to ensure common diseases are treated at the primary level.

articles.title_zh: 中央巡视工作领导小组办公室原主任黎晓宏被查
articles.title_en: Former Director of the Office of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group Li Xiaohong Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，中国官方通报中央巡视工作领导小组办公室原主任黎晓宏涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受中央纪委国家监委调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, Chinese authorities announced that Li Xiaohong, former director of the Office of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group, is under investigation by the CCDI and NSC for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

tags.name_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

tags_en: Central Commission for Discipline Inspection and National Supervisory Commission

articles.title_zh: 教育部等八部门联合开展“国聘行动”
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education and Seven Other Departments Jointly Launch "National Recruitment Action"
articles.summary_zh: 教育部、人社部等八部门于5月至12月联合开展“国聘行动”，旨在促进2026届及往届高校毕业生尽早就业。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Education and seven other departments launched the "National Recruitment Action" from May to December to promote employment for 2026 and previous college graduates.

tags.name_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council

tags_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记给少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping Replies to Letter from Young Pioneer Red Scarf Guides
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，习近平总书记给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，做党和人民的红孩子。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, 2026, General Secretary Xi Jinping replied to a letter from Young Pioneer guides at the First National Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging them to inherit the 'red gene'.

articles.title_zh: 中央财政下达育儿补贴补助资金999亿元
articles.title_en: Central Finance Allocates 99.9 Billion Yuan for Childcare Subsidies
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，财政部下达2026年育儿补贴补助资金999亿元，支持各地为符合条件的婴幼儿发放补贴，助力建设生育友好型社会。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Ministry of Finance allocated 99.9 billion yuan in childcare subsidy funds for 2026 to support local governments in providing subsidies for eligible infants.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》
articles.title_en: State Council Issues "15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization"
articles.summary_zh: 国务院日前印发《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》，明确了“十五五”时期农业农村现代化的目标、重点任务和政策措施，以更好推进中国式现代化建设。
articles.summary_en: The State Council issued the "15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization," outlining goals and key tasks to advance agricultural modernization and Chinese-style modernization.

articles.title_zh: 我国将培育壮大农业新兴产业和未来产业
articles.title_en: China to Cultivate and Expand Emerging and Future Agricultural Industries
articles.summary_zh: 国务院6月2日公布《加快农业农村现代化“十五五”规划》，提出将培育壮大农业新兴产业和未来产业，发展农业新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the State Council released the '15th Five-Year Plan for Accelerating Agricultural and Rural Modernization,' aiming to cultivate emerging and future agricultural industries and develop new quality productive forces.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

tags_en: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs

articles.title_zh: 刘国中在河北调研强调抓好“三夏”生产与常态化监测帮扶
articles.title_en: Liu Guozhong Emphasizes "Three Summer" Production and Regular Monitoring and Assistance During Hebei Inspection
articles.summary_zh: 国务院副总理刘国中6月1日至2日在河北调研，强调要抓好“三夏”生产以确保粮食丰收，并扎实开展常态化监测帮扶以巩固脱贫成果。
articles.summary_en: Vice Premier Liu Guozhong inspected Hebei from June 1-2, emphasizing the importance of "Three Summer" agricultural production for food security and regular monitoring to prevent return to poverty.

articles.title_zh: 第十一次中英战略对话在北京举行
articles.title_en: The 11th China-UK Strategic Dialogue Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，外交部长王毅在北京同英国外交大臣库珀举行第十一次中英战略对话，双方就落实两国领导人共识、深化经贸合作及全球治理等议题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held the 11th China-UK Strategic Dialogue with UK Foreign Secretary Cooper in Beijing to discuss implementing leadership consensus, deepening economic cooperation, and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 助力三夏抢收 设备更新政策发力显效
articles.title_en: Equipment Update Policy Boosts 'Three Summers' Grain Harvest
articles.summary_zh: 中国推进大规模设备更新，将粮食干燥机等农机纳入补贴范围，有效助力夏粮抢收并带动相关产业发展。
articles.summary_en: China is promoting large-scale equipment updates, including subsidies for grain dryers and drones, to support the summer grain harvest and boost related industries.

articles.title_zh: 网暴抗洪救灾村干部“戴金耳环”相关网民被行政处罚
articles.title_en: Netizens Punished for Cyberbullying Village Official Over 'Gold Earrings' During Flood Relief
articles.summary_zh: 公安网安部门依法查处15起网暴抗洪救灾村干部的行为，对秦某某、未某某等相关网民实施行政处罚。
articles.summary_en: Public security cyber-police investigated 15 cases of cyberbullying against a village official during flood relief and imposed administrative penalties on several netizens.

articles.title_zh: 中央巡视工作领导小组办公室原主任黎晓宏被查
articles.title_en: Former Director of the Office of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group Li Xiaohong Under Investigation

articles.title_zh: 中方团队列出63项限制出口技术清单

articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，有报道称中方科研团队在《中国科学院院刊》发表研究，拟定一份涵盖63个科技领域的出口管制清单，旨在防止核心技术外流至美西方。

articles.title_zh: 银川中小学招聘“围报”事件后续：相关岗位面试开考比例降至1:1

articles.summary_en: The Jinfeng District Human Resources and Social Security Bureau in Yinchuan, Ningxia, disqualified candidates and lowered interview ratios after discovering illegal coordinated applications for PE teacher positions.

articles.title_zh: 杜祥琬院士声明从未参与将核技术应用于垃圾焚烧
articles.title_en: Academician Du Xiangwan Denies Applying Nuclear Technology to Waste Incineration
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，中国工程院院士杜祥琬发表声明，否认网络传闻称其及其团队将核技术应用于垃圾焚烧，并表示将保留追究法律责任的权利。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Academician Du Xiangwan of the Chinese Academy of Engineering issued a statement denying rumors that he and his team applied nuclear technology to waste incineration.

articles.title_zh: 李鸿忠在河北调研县乡两级人大换届选举工作
articles.title_en: Li Hongzhong Conducts Research on County and Township People's Congress Elections in Hebei
articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，全国人大常委会副委员长李鸿忠在河北省廊坊、沧州等地调研县乡两级人大换届选举工作，强调要践行全过程人民民主，确保选举风清气正。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, Li Hongzhong, Vice Chairperson of the NPC Standing Committee, visited Hebei to research county and township-level NPC elections, emphasizing the practice of whole-process people's democracy.

articles.title_zh: 北京轨道交通R4线一期北段工程正式开工
articles.title_en: Construction of Beijing Rail Transit R4 Line Phase I North Section Officially Begins
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，北京轨道交通R4线一期北段工程建设动员部署会召开，标志着该线路正式进入建设阶段，旨在提升首都东北部交通能级。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, a mobilization meeting was held for the construction of the Beijing Rail Transit R4 Line Phase I North Section, marking the start of the project to enhance transportation in northeast Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 北京市太空算力产业创新中心正式成立
articles.title_en: Beijing Space Computing Power Industry Innovation Center Officially Established

articles.summary_en: On June 2, Beijing's first Space Computing Power Industry Innovation Center was established in Haidian District, approved by the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Economy and Information Technology and led by BUPT.

articles.title_zh: 宇树科技通过上市委审议有望成为A股“具身智能第一股”
articles.title_en: Unitree Robotics Passes Listing Committee Review, Aiming to be A-Share's First Embodied AI Stock
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，福建金投基金参投的宇树科技通过上海证券交易所上市委审议，通过科创板首发申请，有望成为A股首家具身智能上市公司。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Unitree Robotics, invested by Fujian Jintou Fund, passed the Shanghai Stock Exchange's listing committee review for its STAR Market IPO, potentially becoming the first embodied AI company listed on A-shares.

articles.title_zh: 2026海峡（福州）渔业周：将更惠民、旺市场、促消费
articles.title_en: 2026 Strait (Fuzhou) Fishery Week to Promote Public Benefit, Market Growth, and Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 2026海峡（福州）渔业周将于6月12日至16日在福州举行，重点展示科技兴海、闽台融合及现代渔业成果，并开展促消费活动。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Strait (Fuzhou) Fishery Week will be held in Fuzhou from June 12 to 16, focusing on marine technology, Fujian-Taiwan integration, and modern fishery achievements.

articles.title_zh: “启航‘十五五’：中国发展与全球机遇”广东省专题推介会举行
articles.title_en: Guangdong Special Promotion Event 'Sailing into the 15th Five-Year Plan: China's Development and Global Opportunities' Held
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，由外交部与广东省政府联合主办的“启航‘十五五’”专题推介会在广州举行，省长孟凡利与外交部部长助理刘彬出席并致辞。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the 'Sailing into the 15th Five-Year Plan' promotion event, co-hosted by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Guangdong Provincial Government, was held in Guangzhou.

articles.title_zh: 2026年广西交通运输“安全生产月”活动启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Guangxi Transport 'Work Safety Month' Activities Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，广西启动交通运输“安全生产月”活动，通过隐患排查、数智赋能和安全宣传提升行业安全发展水平。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Guangxi launched the 'Work Safety Month' for the transport sector to enhance safety through risk inspection, digital empowerment, and publicity.

articles.title_zh: 海口东站扩建项目即将开工 总投资1.86亿元
articles.title_en: Haikou East Station Expansion Project to Commence with 186 Million Yuan Investment

articles.summary_en: On June 1, the Haikou Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources and Planning announced the expansion plan for Haikou East Station, with a total investment of 186 million yuan to enhance the transport hub's capacity for the Free Trade Port.

articles.summary_en: On June 2, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, visited Zhaodong City in Suihua to inspect disaster relief for farmers and hold a symposium to support the high-quality development of enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 湖南建设年轻人友好省份 实施四大友好行动
articles.title_en: Hunan Builds Youth-Friendly Province and Implements Four Friendly Actions
articles.summary_zh: 湖南省出台《关于建设年轻人友好省份的实施意见》，通过实施就业、创业、生活、成长四大友好行动，吸引并支持青年在湘建功立业。
articles.summary_en: Hunan Province has issued implementation opinions to build a youth-friendly province, launching four friendly actions focusing on employment, entrepreneurship, living, and growth to attract young talent.

articles.title_zh: 叶焜谈宁夏交通运输执法规范化建设与作风锻造
articles.title_en: Ye Kun on Standardizing Transportation Law Enforcement and Improving Work Style in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏交通运输综合执法监督局局长叶焜介绍了该局在执法规范化、制度建设及作风锻造方面的实践，旨在打造交通执法铁军。
articles.summary_en: Ye Kun, Director of the Ningxia Transportation Comprehensive Law Enforcement Supervision Bureau, detailed practices in standardizing law enforcement and improving work style to build a disciplined enforcement team.

articles.summary_zh: 6月2日，四川省纪委监委通报，四川省住房和城乡建设厅党组成员、副厅长程刚涉嫌严重违纪违法，主动投案并接受审查调查。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, the Sichuan Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervision announced that Cheng Gang, Deputy Director of the Provincial Department of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law after surrendering voluntarily.

articles.title_zh: 山东省服务业大会召开

articles.summary_en: The Shandong Province Service Industry Conference was held in Jinan on June 2. Provincial Party Secretary Lin Wu delivered a speech on accelerating the expansion and quality improvement of the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Red-Scarf Guides at CPC First Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在“六一”国际儿童节前夕给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，在新征程上跑好历史接力赛。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of International Children's Day, President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer red-scarf guides at the CPC First Congress and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Halls, encouraging them to inherit 'red genes' and strive for national rejuvenation.

articles.title_zh: 梁言顺王清宪在合肥市看望少年儿童
articles.title_en: Liang Yanshun and Wang Qingxian Visit Children in Hefei
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日上午，安徽省委书记梁言顺和省长王清宪在合肥市看望少年儿童，强调要全面落实立德树人根本任务，促进少年儿童全面发展。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Anhui Provincial Party Secretary Liang Yanshun and Governor Wang Qingxian visited children in Hefei, emphasizing the fundamental task of fostering virtue through education.

articles.title_zh: 九部门部署做好科研助理岗位开发工作
articles.title_en: Nine Departments Deploy Development of Research Assistant Positions
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部等九部门于2026年6月1日印发通知，部署开发科研助理岗位，旨在促进2026届高校毕业生就业并支撑新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: Nine departments, including the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, issued a notice on June 1, 2026, to develop research assistant positions to promote employment for 2026 graduates and support new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升调研督导安全生产工作
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Inspects and Supervises Production Safety Work
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，甘肃省委书记胡昌升在甘肃能化集团金河煤矿调研督导安全生产“百日攻坚”行动，强调要践行正确政绩观，坚决维护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, inspected the '100-day battle' for production safety at Jinhe Coal Mine, emphasizing the need to safeguard public safety and practice a correct view of political achievement.

articles.title_zh: 任振鹤落实立德树人根本任务 努力办好人民满意的教育
articles.title_en: Ren Zhenhe Stresses Implementing Fundamental Task of Fostering Virtue to Provide Satisfactory Education
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，甘肃省长任振鹤在兰州市看望少年儿童，检查教育领域专项整治并调研思政课建设，强调要深化教育改革并整治教育领域腐败问题。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Gansu Governor Ren Zhenhe visited children in Lanzhou, inspected special rectifications in education, and researched ideological and political courses, emphasizing education reform and anti-corruption.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚在来宾市武宣县开展正确政绩观学习教育督导
articles.title_en: Chen Gang Conducts Supervision on Learning and Practicing Correct View of Political Achievements in Wuxuan County, Laibin
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，自治区党委书记陈刚赴来宾市武宣县督导正确政绩观学习教育，整治“新官不理旧账”问题，并实地调研柳梧铁路建设中的群众诉求。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Chen Gang, Secretary of the Autonomous Region Committee, visited Wuxuan County, Laibin, to supervise education on the correct view of political achievements and address the issue of "new officials ignoring old debts."

articles.title_zh: 教育部等部门开展护航行动助力“平安高考”
articles.title_en: Ministry of Education and Other Departments Launch Escort Action to Ensure 'Safe Gaokao'
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月2日，教育部会同网信、公安等部门部署开展“2026年高考护航行动”，通过打击作弊、净化环境和加强服务保障，确保高考公平与安全。
articles.summary_en: On June 2, 2026, the Ministry of Education and other departments launched the '2026 Gaokao Escort Action' to ensure exam fairness and security through anti-cheating measures and comprehensive services.

articles.title_zh: 湖南市场监管系统启动“三考”护航模式
articles.title_en: Hunan Market Supervision System Launches 'Three Exams' Escort Mode
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，湖南省市场监管系统启动“三考”护航模式，聚焦食品安全、价格秩序等领域，为高考、学考、中考营造安心有序的应考环境。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, Hunan's market supervision system launched an 'escort mode' for three major exams, focusing on food safety and price order to ensure a secure testing environment.

articles.title_zh: 江苏加快推动“人工智能+医疗健康”发展
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Accelerates Development of "AI + Healthcare"
articles.summary_zh: 江苏省卫生健康委正推动“人工智能+医疗健康”部署落地，通过构建数据资源体系、研发垂类大模型及印发实施方案，提升医疗健康数智化水平。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangsu Provincial Health Commission is promoting the implementation of "AI + Healthcare" by building data resource systems, developing vertical LLMs, and issuing implementation plans to enhance digital health services.

articles.title_zh: 7273辆新能源车从江苏南通出海欧洲
articles.title_en: 7,273 New Energy Vehicles Exported to Europe from Nantong, Jiangsu
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，装载7273辆新能源汽车的滚装船从江苏南通港启航发往欧洲，标志着南通正式具备大规模商品小汽车出口能力。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, a roll-on/roll-off ship carrying 7,273 new energy vehicles departed from Nantong Port, Jiangsu, for Europe, marking Nantong's capacity for large-scale automobile exports.

articles.title_zh: 习近平考察河南洛阳龙门石窟
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Inspects Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, Henan
articles.summary_zh: 2025年5月，习近平总书记在河南洛阳考察龙门石窟，强调要保护好、传承好、传播好中华文化瑰宝，推动文旅产业高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: In May 2025, President Xi Jinping visited the Longmen Grottoes in Luoyang, Henan, emphasizing the protection, inheritance, and promotion of Chinese cultural treasures and the high-quality development of the cultural tourism industry.

articles.title_zh: 中央生态环境保护督察通报辽宁葫芦岛污水处理问题
articles.title_en: Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspection Reports Sewage Treatment Issues in Huludao, Liaoning
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部通报辽宁省葫芦岛市生活污水处理短板明显，且当地在多次排查中虚报未发现黑臭水体，被督察组暗查揭露。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment reported severe shortcomings in sewage treatment in Huludao, Liaoning, exposing local authorities for falsely reporting the absence of black and odorous water.

articles.title_zh: 山西省省长卢东亮下矿井检查安全生产
articles.title_en: Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang Inspects Coal Mine Safety Production
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，山西省省长卢东亮在太原古交市检查煤矿安全生产工作，要求扎实开展专项整治，严厉打击违法生产，确保安全底线。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang inspected coal mine safety production in Gujiao, Taiyuan, calling for special rectification and strict enforcement to ensure safety.

articles.title_zh: 王琳任乌鲁木齐市委书记
articles.title_en: Wang Lin Appointed Party Secretary of Urumqi
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记陈小江、自治区主席艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜调研“人工智能+”工作，披露王琳已任乌鲁木齐市委书记。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Xinjiang Party Secretary Chen Xiaojiang and Chairman Erkin Tuniyaz conducted research on 'AI+', revealing that Wang Lin has been appointed Party Secretary of Urumqi.

articles.title_zh: 聚焦儿童精神素养培育与关爱帮扶，7部门启动主题活动
articles.title_en: Seven Departments Launch Theme Activity Focusing on Children's Spiritual Cultivation and Care
articles.summary_zh: 民政部等7部门日前联合印发通知，在“六一”国际儿童节之际开展“润心伴成长，同心护未来”主题活动，旨在培育儿童精神素养并加强关爱帮扶。
articles.summary_en: Seven departments, including the Ministry of Civil Affairs, launched the 'Nurturing Hearts for Growth, Joining Hands to Protect the Future' activity to promote children's spiritual cultivation and provide care and assistance.

articles.title_zh: 司法部发布内蒙古留守儿童盗窃获不起诉典型案例
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice Releases Typical Case of Non-Prosecution for Left-Behind Child in Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，司法部发布五个未成年人法律援助典型案例，其中内蒙古一起涉留守儿童盗窃案在法律援助下被检察机关决定不起诉。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the Ministry of Justice released five typical legal aid cases for minors, including a theft case in Inner Mongolia where a left-behind child was not prosecuted.

articles.title_zh: 司法部发布未成年人法律援助典型案例
articles.title_en: Ministry of Justice Releases Typical Cases of Legal Aid for Minors
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，司法部发布五个未成年人法律援助典型案例，其中一起校园霸凌案判决监护人依法承担连带赔偿责任。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, the Ministry of Justice released five typical cases of legal aid for minors, including a school bullying case where guardians were held jointly liable for compensation.

articles.title_zh: 江西省人大常委会原副主任万学文逝世
articles.title_en: Former Deputy Director of Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee Wan Xuewen Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 万学文同志于2026年5月25日在南昌逝世，享年85岁。他曾任第十届全国人大常委会委员、江西省人大常委会副主任及农工党江西省委会主委。
articles.summary_en: Comrade Wan Xuewen, former Deputy Director of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial People's Congress, passed away in Nanchang on May 25, 2026, at the age of 85.

articles.title_zh: 贵州大学回应“萝卜岗”招聘质疑
articles.title_en: Guizhou University Responds to Allegations of "Tailor-Made" Recruitment Post
articles.summary_zh: 贵州大学因招聘管理岗要求应聘者配偶为该校在职优秀博士而引发“萝卜岗”质疑，校方回应称简化招聘可能有特殊情况。
articles.summary_en: Guizhou University responded to allegations of a "tailor-made" recruitment post after requiring a management position applicant's spouse to be a tenured PhD at the university.

articles.title_zh: 阿东赴云南调研共青团和少先队工作
articles.title_en: A Dong Visits Yunnan to Research Communist Youth League and Young Pioneers Work
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日至29日，共青团中央书记处第一书记阿东赴云南调研共青团和少先队工作，并与云南省委书记王宁就党建带团建及青少年交流等事项进行交流。
articles.summary_en: From May 28 to 29, A Dong, First Secretary of the Secretariat of the CYL Central Committee, visited Yunnan to research CYL and Young Pioneers work and discussed youth exchange with Provincial Party Secretary Wang Ning.

articles.title_zh: 川渝通报5款违规APP及小程序
articles.title_en: Chongqing and Sichuan Authorities Report Five Non-compliant Apps and Mini-programs
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，重庆市和四川省通信管理局通报了5款侵害用户权益的违规APP及小程序，要求其在6月9日前完成整改。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Communications Administrations of Chongqing and Sichuan reported five non-compliant apps and mini-programs for violating user rights, demanding rectification by June 9.

articles.title_zh: 陈文清访问哈萨克斯坦
articles.title_en: Chen Wenqing Visits Kazakhstan
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央政治局委员、中央政法委书记陈文清于5月29日至6月1日访问哈萨克斯坦，会见哈方官员并探讨深化执法安全合作。
articles.summary_en: Chen Wenqing, Politburo member and Secretary of the Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, visited Kazakhstan from May 29 to June 1 to discuss deepening law enforcement and security cooperation.

tags_en: Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission

articles.title_zh: 青海省服务业大会召开
articles.title_en: Qinghai Province Service Industry Conference Convened
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，青海省服务业大会在西宁召开。省委书记吴晓军和省长罗东川出席并部署，旨在推动全省服务业优质高效发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Qinghai Province Service Industry Conference was held in Xining. Provincial Party Secretary Wu Xiaojun and Governor Luo Dongchuan attended to deploy measures for the high-quality development of the service industry.

articles.title_zh: 四川颁发首本“千万级”取水权抵押登记证明
articles.title_en: Sichuan Issues First "Ten-Million Level" Water Right Mortgage Registration Certificate
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，成都市邛崃市颁发四川省首本“千万级”取水权抵押登记证明，推动水资源由自然资源转化为可抵押资产，打通金融融资路径。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Qionglai in Chengdu issued Sichuan's first "ten-million level" water right mortgage registration certificate, converting water resources into mortgageable assets to facilitate financing.

articles.title_zh: 西藏将在“十五五”推出“畅游西藏”等系列文旅活动
articles.title_en: Tibet to Launch 'Tour Tibet' and Other Cultural Tourism Activities During 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 西藏自治区政府常务副主席任维在拉萨举行的专题新闻发布会上表示，西藏将在“十五五”期间推出“畅游西藏”等系列活动，旨在到2030年基本建成文化强区、旅游强区。
articles.summary_en: Ren Wei, Executive Vice Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Government, announced at a press conference in Lhasa that Tibet will launch activities like 'Tour Tibet' during the 15th Five-Year Plan to become a cultural and tourism powerhouse by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 西藏持之以恒推进稳定发展生态强边四件大事
articles.title_en: Tibet Persistently Promotes Four Major Tasks of Stability, Development, Ecology, and Border Strengthening
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，西藏在拉萨举行“十五五”专场新闻发布会，由嘎玛泽登等领导介绍西藏在稳定、发展、生态、强边四方面的规划与成效。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, a press conference for the 15th Five-Year Plan was held in Lhasa, where officials outlined Tibet's strategies and achievements in stability, development, ecology, and border strengthening.

articles.title_zh: 西藏将启动首次生物多样性本底调查和物种编目工作
articles.title_en: Tibet to Launch First Biodiversity Baseline Survey and Species Cataloging
articles.summary_zh: 西藏自治区政府常务副主席旦巴宣布，西藏将启动首次生物多样性本底调查和物种编目工作，并探索制定生物多样性保护条例。
articles.summary_en: Danba, Executive Vice Chairman of the Tibet Autonomous Region Government, announced the launch of the region's first biodiversity baseline survey and species cataloging.

articles.title_zh: 冯飞在临高调研乡村振兴工作
articles.title_en: Feng Fei Conducts Research on Rural Revitalization in Lingao
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日至31日，省委书记冯飞在临高县铺仔村蹲点调研，强调坚持党建引领，巩固脱贫攻坚成果并扎实推进乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: From May 30 to 31, Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei conducted a research trip in Puzai Village, Lingao County, emphasizing Party leadership to consolidate poverty alleviation achievements and promote rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自贸试验区满洲里片区首个落地项目开工
articles.title_en: First Project in Manzhouli Area of Inner Mongolia Free Trade Zone Starts Construction
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，由内蒙古国贸集团投资建设的满洲里陆港粮油和化肥产业项目开工，这是内蒙古自贸试验区满洲里片区的首个落地项目。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, the Manzhouli Land Port Grain, Oil, and Fertilizer Industry Project invested by Inner Mongolia International Trade Group commenced construction, marking the first project in the Manzhouli area of the Inner Mongolia FTZ.

articles.title_zh: 成渝中线高铁正式启动铺轨
articles.title_en: Track Laying Officially Begins for Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，成渝中线高铁在四川成都简阳正式启动铺轨施工，标志着项目全面转入线上施工阶段，为全线按期通车奠定基础。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, track laying officially began for the Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway in Jianyang, Chengdu, marking the project's transition to the online construction phase.

articles.title_zh: 寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟成立
articles.title_en: Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance Established
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟在兰州成立。该联盟由甘肃省科技厅发起，旨在协同攻关寒旱区生态保护与可持续发展等关键技术。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, the Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance was established in Lanzhou to collaborate on ecological protection and sustainable development.

articles.title_zh: 四部门印发教育引导未成年人工作指南
articles.title_en: Four Departments Issue Guidelines for Educating and Guiding Minors
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，最高人民法院、教育部、共青团中央、全国妇联联合印发工作指南，旨在健全家校社协同育人体系，预防未成年人思想行为偏差。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Supreme People's Court, Ministry of Education, CYL Central Committee, and All-China Women's Federation jointly issued guidelines to strengthen the education of minors and prevent behavioral deviations.

articles.title_zh: 公安部部署宣传活动守护未成年人成长
articles.title_en: Ministry of Public Security Deploys Publicity Activities to Protect Minors' Growth
articles.summary_zh: 公安部新闻宣传局于5月31日发出通知，组织开展“守护平安 与你‘童’行”宣传活动，旨在提升未成年人的法治素养和安全意识。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Public Security's News Bureau issued a notice on May 31 to launch the 'Guardian of Peace' campaign to enhance legal literacy and safety awareness among minors.

articles.title_zh: 共青团中央书记处召开扩大会议学习习近平总书记给少先队红领巾讲解员回信精神
articles.title_en: Secretariat of CYL Central Committee Holds Meeting to Study Xi Jinping's Reply to Young Pioneers' Red Scarf Commentators
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，共青团中央书记处召开扩大会议，传达学习习近平总书记给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员的重要回信精神。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Secretariat of the CYL Central Committee held an enlarged meeting to study and implement President Xi Jinping's reply letter to Young Pioneers' red scarf commentators.

tags_en: Secretariat of the Communist Youth League Central Committee

articles.title_zh: “歼-8之父”顾诵芬院士逝世，享年96岁
articles.title_en: Academician Gu Songfen, the 'Father of J-8', Passes Away at 96
articles.summary_zh: 中国科学院和中国工程院院士、著名飞机设计大师顾诵芬于2026年5月31日逝世，享年96岁。
articles.summary_en: Gu Songfen, a member of both the Chinese Academy of Sciences and the Chinese Academy of Engineering and a renowned aircraft designer, passed away on May 31, 2026, at the age of 96.

articles.title_zh: 哈尔滨突现强对流天气，市委书记于洪涛与市长王合生部署应对工作
articles.title_en: Harbin Experiences Severe Convective Weather; Party Secretary Yu Hongtao and Mayor Wang Hesheng Deploy Response Measures
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日哈尔滨出现罕见高温及强对流天气，市委书记于洪涛与市长王合生召开视频会议，调度部署极端天气应对工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Harbin experienced rare high temperatures and severe convective weather. Party Secretary Yu Hongtao and Mayor Wang Hesheng held a video conference to deploy emergency response measures.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲到佳木斯市和双鸭山市调研督导中央生态环境保护督察边督边改工作
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Inspects Rectification of Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspections in Jiamusi and Shuangyashan
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，黑龙江省长梁惠玲到佳木斯市和双鸭山市调研督导中央生态环境保护督察边督边改工作，强调要落实整改要求，严守耕地保护红线。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling visited Jiamusi and Shuangyashan to supervise the rectification of central ecological and environmental protection inspections, emphasizing farmland protection.

articles.title_zh: 习近平回信勉励中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Guides at CPC First Congress and Nanhu Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月31日，习近平给中共一大纪念馆和南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励他们传承红色基因，并祝全国少年儿童节日快乐。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, Xi Jinping replied to Young Pioneer guides at the CPC First Congress and Nanhu Memorial Halls, encouraging them to inherit 'red genes' and wishing children a happy International Children's Day.

articles.title_zh: 北京市委党校成立首都国际传播研究中心
articles.title_en: Beijing Municipal Party School Establishes Capital International Communication Research Center
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，中共北京市委党校举办学术研讨会并宣布成立首都国际传播研究中心，旨在提升国际传播能力，服务国家外宣大局。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Beijing Municipal Party School held an academic seminar and announced the establishment of the Capital International Communication Research Center to enhance international communication capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 刘宁到新乡鹤壁调研推进南水北调后续工程高质量发展和防汛备汛工作
articles.title_en: Liu Ning Inspects Xinxiang and Hebi to Promote High-Quality Development of South-to-North Water Diversion Project and Flood Control Preparations
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，省委书记刘宁到新乡市、鹤壁市调研南水北调后续工程及防汛备汛工作，强调要确保工程、供水与水质安全，坚决守住不发生群死群伤底线。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning visited Xinxiang and Hebi to inspect the South-to-North Water Diversion Project and flood control preparations, emphasizing water security and disaster prevention.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到南阳调研“三夏”生产工作
articles.title_en: Wang Kai Conducts Research on "Three Summers" Production in Nanyang
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，河南省省长王凯到南阳邓州市调研“三夏”生产及安全生产工作，强调要扛稳粮食安全重任并守住安全发展底线。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, Henan Governor Wang Kai visited Dengzhou, Nanyang to inspect "Three Summers" agricultural production and safety work, emphasizing food security and safety management.

articles.title_zh: 7273辆新能源车从江苏南通出海欧洲
articles.title_en: 7,273 New Energy Vehicles Exported from Nantong, Jiangsu to Europe
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，装载7273辆新能源汽车的滚装船从江苏南通港启航发往欧洲，标志着南通正式具备大规模商品小汽车出口能力。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, a roll-on/roll-off ship carrying 7,273 new energy vehicles departed from Nantong Port, Jiangsu, for Europe, marking Nantong's capacity for large-scale vehicle exports.

articles.title_zh: 2026年江苏省“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布
articles.title_en: Release of 2026 'New Era Good Youth' Advanced Deeds in Jiangsu Province
articles.summary_zh: 5月31日，江苏省精神文明建设办公室等部门在东台市举行2026年“新时代好少年”先进事迹发布活动，推出30人（组）榜样以引领青少年成长。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, the Jiangsu Provincial Spiritual Civilization Construction Office and other departments held an event in Dongtai to release the advanced deeds of 30 'New Era Good Youth' to inspire teenagers.

articles.title_zh: 天津人工智能传感器产业园开园 首批企业集中签约
articles.title_en: Tianjin AI Sensor Industrial Park Opens with First Batch of Enterprise Signings
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月31日，天津人工智能传感器产业园正式开园，首批10家企业集中签约，并与多家高校、协会达成产教融合与金融赋能合作协议。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, the Tianjin AI Sensor Industrial Park officially opened, featuring the signing of the first batch of 10 enterprises and various cooperation agreements on industry-education integration.

articles.title_zh: 全国人大常委会启动职业教育法执法检查
articles.title_en: NPC Standing Committee Launches Law Enforcement Inspection of Vocational Education Law
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会于6月1日在北京启动职业教育法执法检查，旨在推动法律实施并推进现代职业教育体系建设。
articles.summary_en: The NPC Standing Committee launched a law enforcement inspection of the Vocational Education Law on June 1 in Beijing to promote its implementation and the construction of a modern vocational education system.

articles.title_zh: 打造东中部产业向西转移重要承接地
articles.title_en: Building an Important Receiving Area for the Transfer of Industries from East and Central China to the West
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省委书记胡昌升在《求是》杂志发表署名文章，阐述甘肃打造东中部产业向西转移重要承接地的路径与思考，以推动高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, published an article in Qiushi magazine on strategies to make Gansu a key hub for industrial transfer from East and Central China.

articles.title_zh: 2026年四川省革命博物馆纪念馆“一馆一课”宣传展示月启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Sichuan Revolutionary Museum 'One Museum, One Lesson' Promotion Month Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年6月1日，四川省革命博物馆纪念馆“一馆一课”宣传展示月在绵阳梓潼启动，旨在通过革命文物资源赋能思政教育，传承革命精神。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, 2026, the 'One Museum, One Lesson' promotion month for revolutionary museums was launched in Zitong, Sichuan, aiming to integrate revolutionary cultural relics with ideological and political education.

articles.title_zh: 空间遥感+人工智能 中国团队创新成果助力全球文化遗产保护
articles.title_en: Space Remote Sensing and AI: Chinese Team's Innovation Aids Global Cultural Heritage Protection

articles.title_zh: 中钨高新西南研发中心在成都开工

articles.summary_en: The construction of the Zhongwu High-tech Southwest R&D Center recently began in Chengdu's Economic Development Zone, a collaborative project between China Minmetals and Chengdu to build an innovation platform for hard materials and tools.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Guides of First CPC Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall
articles.summary_zh: 在六一国际儿童节前夕，习近平总书记给上海中共一大纪念馆和浙江南湖革命纪念馆的少先队红领巾讲解员回信，予以亲切勉励。
articles.summary_en: On the eve of International Children's Day, President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer guides from the First CPC Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, offering warm encouragement.

articles.title_zh: 2026年山东省交通运输重点工程“强国示范”劳动竞赛启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'Strong Nation Demonstration' Labor Competition for Key Transport Projects Launched in Shandong Province
articles.summary_zh: 山东省交通运输厅与省总工会近日启动2026年全省交通运输重点工程“强国示范”劳动竞赛，共确认64个参赛项目，旨在提升工程质量与施工进度。
articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Department of Transport and the Provincial Federation of Trade Unions recently launched the 2026 'Strong Nation Demonstration' labor competition for key transport projects, involving 64 projects.

articles.title_zh: 习近平主席复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的两国学生
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Replies to Students Participating in 'Sailing the Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour'
articles.summary_zh: 5月23日，习近平主席复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的中美学生，强调加强青年交流有助于增进两国了解，推动中美关系稳定健康发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 23, President Xi Jinping replied to Chinese and US students participating in the 'Sailing the Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour,' emphasizing that youth exchange helps enhance mutual understanding and promotes the stable development of China-US relations.

articles.title_zh: 浦东政协举行“企业话发展”下午茶活动聚焦生物医药创新
articles.title_en: Pudong CPPCC Holds 'Enterprises Talk Development' Event Focusing on Biopharmaceutical Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，浦东新区政协在张江举行“企业话发展”下午茶活动，与生物医药企业家交流，探讨全链条创新策源及优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Pudong New Area CPPCC held an 'Enterprises Talk Development' event in Zhangjiang to discuss biopharmaceutical innovation and optimize the business environment with entrepreneurs.

articles.title_zh: 习近平给中共一大纪念馆等少先队红领巾讲解员回信
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Young Pioneer Red Scarf Guides at Revolutionary Memorial Halls
articles.summary_zh: 习近平总书记在“六一”国际儿童节前夕给中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员回信，勉励青少年传承红色基因，上海相关单位积极响应并深化红色育人教育。
articles.summary_en: President Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer red scarf guides at the Museum of the First National Congress of the CPC and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging youth to inherit the 'red gene.'

articles.title_zh: 云南红河推动对越合作向“流域模式”升级
articles.title_en: Honghe, Yunnan Promotes Upgrade of Cooperation with Vietnam to "Basin Model"
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日，红河州州长罗萍在新闻发布会上表示，红河州将推动对越合作从“沿边模式”向“流域模式”升级，构建跨境产业廊道并完善互联互通基础设施。
articles.summary_en: On June 1, Honghe Governor Luo Ping announced the upgrade of cooperation with Vietnam from a "border-line model" to a "basin model," focusing on cross-border industrial corridors and infrastructure.

articles.title_zh: “七一勋章”提名建议人选公示
articles.title_en: Publicity on Nominated Candidates for the "July 1st Medal"
articles.summary_zh: 中共中央组织部等部门公示了中国共产党成立105周年“七一勋章”的8名提名建议人选，以表彰为党和人民作出杰出贡献的党员。
articles.summary_en: The Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee and other departments publicized 8 nominated candidates for the "July 1st Medal" to commemorate the 105th anniversary of the CPC.

articles.title_zh: 最高检：2025年未成年人犯罪和侵害未成年人犯罪实现“双下降”
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate: Juvenile Crime and Crimes Against Juveniles See "Double Decline" in 2025
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民检察院于6月1日发布《未成年人检察工作白皮书（2025）》，报告显示2025年未成年人犯罪和侵害未成年人犯罪近五年首次实现“双下降”。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate released the 2025 White Paper on Juvenile Prosecution on June 1, reporting the first "double decline" in juvenile crime and crimes against juveniles in five years.

articles.title_zh: 福建省发布32款2026年适老化新产品
articles.title_en: Fujian Province Releases 32 New Age-Friendly Products for 2026
articles.summary_zh: 福建省工信厅近日发布2026年福建省适老化新产品名单，共有32款产品入选，涵盖厦门、宁德等多个地市。
articles.summary_en: The Fujian Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology recently released a list of 32 new age-friendly products for 2026, featuring products from Xiamen, Ningde, and other cities.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省出台16项举措提质提速“三北”工程建设
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Introduces 16 Measures to Improve and Accelerate 'Three-North' Project Construction
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省政府办公厅印发意见，推出16项举措提升“三北”工程建设质量，目标到2030年建成河西走廊防风固沙阻击带。
articles.summary_en: The General Office of Gansu Provincial Government issued guidelines with 16 measures to enhance the 'Three-North' Project, aiming to establish a wind-sand barrier in the Hexi Corridor by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 花艳履新金陵饭店集团总经理
articles.title_en: Hua Yan Appointed General Manager of Jinling Hotel Group
articles.summary_zh: 近日，花艳出任金陵饭店集团党委副书记、总经理。此前，江苏省委组织部已对其任职前公示。
articles.summary_en: Hua Yan has been appointed as the Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee and General Manager of Jinling Hotel Group following a public notice by the Organization Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Party Committee.

articles.summary_zh: 江西省林业局日前发布2026年林业生物多样性保护公报，介绍了全省在物种资源更新、保护网络体系完善及科研监测方面的成效。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangxi Provincial Forestry Bureau released the 2026 Forestry Biodiversity Conservation Bulletin, highlighting achievements in species resource updates, protection network improvement, and scientific monitoring.

articles.title_en: A Batch of National Standards Related to Children Released
articles.summary_zh: 国家市场监督管理总局近日发布一批儿童相关国家标准，涵盖毛绒玩具、电动童车、儿童伞具及未成年人上网等方面，旨在筑牢儿童安全防护屏障。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation recently released a series of national standards for children's products and internet access to enhance safety protections for minors.

articles.title_zh: 浙江启动高校计算机及人工智能本科教学改革试点“101计划”
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Launches "101 Plan" Pilot for Undergraduate Teaching Reform in Computer Science and AI
articles.summary_zh: 浙江省在温州启动高校计算机及人工智能本科教学改革试点“101计划”，发布44项改革任务及87门核心课程名单，旨在通过产教融合提升人才培养质量。
articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Province launched the "101 Plan" pilot for undergraduate teaching reform in computer science and AI in Wenzhou, releasing 44 reform tasks and 87 core courses to enhance talent cultivation through industry-education integration.

articles.title_zh: 外卖新规实施在即 杭州持续深化外卖聚集区管理
articles.title_en: New Delivery Regulations Imminent as Hangzhou Deepens Management of Delivery Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日起，《网络餐饮服务经营者落实食品安全主体责任监督管理规定》正式施行，杭州市拱墅区通过推行组团式管理模式加强外卖聚集区监管。
articles.summary_en: New food safety regulations for online catering take effect on June 1, with Hangzhou's Gongshu District implementing a cluster management model to enhance supervision of delivery-only shops.

articles.title_zh: “六一”儿童节前夕，多位省级党政一把手调研小学和幼儿园送上节日祝福
articles.title_en: Provincial Leaders Visit Schools and Kindergartens Ahead of International Children's Day
articles.summary_zh: 6月1日国际儿童节前夕，吉林、山东、宁夏、江西、湖南、湖北等多省省级党政领导分别调研学校，看望少年儿童并送上节日祝福。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of International Children's Day on June 1, provincial leaders from Jilin, Shandong, Ningxia, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Hubei visited schools to greet children and teachers.

articles.summary_en: On January 30, 2026, Xi Jinping emphasized the forward-looking layout and development of future industries during the 24th collective study session of the 20th CPC Central Committee Political Bureau.

articles.title_zh: 海底七十八米，为盾构机换刀

articles.summary_zh: 甬舟铁路金塘海底隧道施工中，建设团队通过三元混合气和饱和带压技术，成功解决了海底78米深处盾构机换刀的高压难题。
articles.summary_en: During the construction of the Yongzhou Railway Jintang Undersea Tunnel, teams successfully overcame high-pressure challenges of changing shield machine cutter heads at 78m depth using mixed-gas and saturated pressure technologies.

articles.summary_zh: 5月23日，习近平主席复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的中美学生，指出“5年邀请5万名美国青少年来华”倡议已提前实现目标。
articles.summary_en: On May 23, President Xi Jinping replied to students in the 'Sailing Together in the Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour,' noting that the initiative to invite 50,000 US youth to China has reached its goal ahead of schedule.

articles.title_zh: 首位香港航天员黎家盈乘神舟二十三号奔赴天宫

articles.summary_en: On May 24, 2026, payload specialist Li Jiaying launched as part of the Shenzhou-23 crew, becoming the first astronaut from Hong Kong.

articles.title_en: Zhao Leji Pays Official Friendly Visit to Russia and Attends 11th Meeting of China-Russia Parliamentary Cooperation Committee
articles.summary_zh: 全国人大常委会委员长赵乐际于5月27日至30日对俄罗斯进行正式友好访问，在莫斯科同俄方领导人举行会谈并出席中俄议会合作委员会第十一次会议。
articles.summary_en: Zhao Leji, Chairman of the NPC Standing Committee, paid an official friendly visit to Russia from May 27 to 30, holding talks with Russian leaders in Moscow and attending the 11th meeting of the China-Russia Parliamentary Cooperation Committee.

articles.title_en: Press Conference on the Advanced Deeds of Jiangsu Models of the Times Held

articles.summary_en: On May 27, a press conference was held in Nanjing to honor the "Jiangsu Models of the Times," awarding the title to the breeding team of the Jiangsu (Wujin) Rice Research Institute and researcher Gao Derong.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月28日至30日，由天津和重庆共同主办的2026世界智能产业博览会举行，展示了重庆在AI+制造、场景应用及区域协作方面的战略布局。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Intelligence Industry Expo, co-hosted by Tianjin and Chongqing from May 28-30, showcased Chongqing's strategic focus on AI-driven manufacturing, scenario applications, and regional collaboration.

articles.title_en: Registration and Political Review for Public Security Higher Education Institutions Begin
articles.summary_zh: 河北省公安厅于5月28日宣布，2026年公安普通高等院校公安专业河北省招生报名及政治考察工作已启动，截止日期为6月10日。
articles.summary_en: The Hebei Provincial Public Security Department announced on May 28 that registration and political review for 2026 admissions to public security professional programs in Hebei province have begun, with a deadline of June 10.

articles.title_zh: 河北省立法推动特色产业集群提档升级
articles.title_en: Hebei Province Enacts Legislation to Upgrade Characteristic Industrial Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，河北省十四届人大常委会通过关于促进特色产业集群高质量发展的决定，旨在通过法治保障推动产业集群升级，将于7月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, the Standing Committee of the Hebei Provincial People's Congress passed a decision to promote the high-quality development of characteristic industrial clusters, effective July 1.

articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，黑龙江省委书记许勤在哈尔滨调研基础研究工作，强调要加大政策支持，提升原始创新能力，为建设科技强国作出贡献。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, inspected basic research in Harbin, emphasizing the need to increase policy support and original innovation to contribute to building a science and technology powerhouse.

articles.title_zh: 中国空间站第十批科学实验样品顺利返回

articles.summary_en: On May 29, the tenth batch of space science experiment samples from the China Space Station returned via the Shenzhou-22 spacecraft, with some samples delivered to Beijing for research.

articles.title_zh: 加拿大总理卡尼会见王毅
articles.title_en: Canadian Prime Minister Carney Meets Wang Yi
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，加拿大总理卡尼在渥太华会见中国外交部长王毅，双方探讨构建中加新型战略伙伴关系并深化多领域合作。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Canadian Prime Minister Carney met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi in Ottawa to discuss building a new China-Canada strategic partnership and deepening cooperation.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, a special exchange meeting on the collaborative development of the new energy vehicle and robotics industries in the 'Yi-Tong-Wu-Lang' region was held in Yizhuang, Beijing, to promote high-quality industrial synergy in the Jing-Jin-Ji region.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, 2026, the China Meteorological Administration released the 2025 National Ecological Meteorological Bulletin, reporting that China's vegetation ecological quality in 2025 was the second best since 2000.

articles.title_zh: 倪岳峰主持召开省委理论学习中心组学习会强调加快建设更高水平的平安河北

articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，河北省委书记倪岳峰主持召开省委理论学习中心组学习会，强调要坚定不移贯彻总体国家安全观，统筹发展与安全，建设更高水平的平安河北。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Hebei Provincial Party Secretary Ni Yuefeng chaired a study meeting, emphasizing the implementation of the overall national security concept to balance development and security for a safer Hebei.

articles.title_zh: 粤港澳游艇“自由行”政策落地
articles.title_en: Yacht Free Travel Policy Implemented in Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，国务院批复同意在粤港澳大湾区内地九市对港澳游艇实行免担保和临时船舶国籍登记政策，正式推动游艇“自由行”落地。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the State Council approved the implementation of guarantee-free and temporary ship registration policies for Hong Kong and Macao yachts in nine mainland cities of the GBA.

articles.title_zh: 山西省发布2025年全省生态环境质量状况
articles.title_en: Shanxi Province Releases 2025 Provincial Ecological Environment Quality Report
articles.summary_zh: 山西省生态环境厅于5月29日举行新闻发布会，公布2025年全省生态环境质量状况，各项指标创有监测记录以来最好成绩。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment held a press conference on May 29 to release the 2025 provincial ecological environment quality report, noting record-high performance across all indicators.

articles.title_zh: 王宁与中粮集团董事长李国强会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Ning Meets with COFCO Group Chairman Li Guoqiang
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，云南省委书记王宁在昆明与中粮集团董事长李国强会谈，探讨深化农业全产业链合作，助力乡村振兴与农业农村现代化。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Yunnan Provincial Party Secretary Wang Ning met with COFCO Group Chairman Li Guoqiang in Kunming to discuss deepening agricultural industry chain cooperation and rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 长江朝天门至涪陵河段整治工程竣工验收
articles.title_en: Completion Acceptance of Yangtze River Waterway Improvement Project from Chaotianmen to Fuling
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，由交通运输部组织的长江朝天门至涪陵河段航道整治工程通过竣工验收并正式运行，实现5000吨级货轮可直达重庆中心城区。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Yangtze River waterway improvement project from Chaotianmen to Fuling passed completion acceptance by the Ministry of Transport, enabling 5,000-ton cargo ships to reach downtown Chongqing.

articles.title_zh: 重庆启动超大城市现代化治理民主监督
articles.title_en: Chongqing Launches Democratic Supervision of Modern Megacity Governance
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，重庆召开会议启动超大城市现代化治理民主监督，并总结长江（重庆段）生态环境保护民主监督工作。市委常委商奎出席会议并讲话。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Chongqing held a meeting to launch democratic supervision of modern megacity governance and summarize the supervision of ecological protection for the Yangtze River (Chongqing section).

articles.title_zh: 推进梁滩河流域综合治理工作专题会议召开
articles.title_en: Special Meeting Held to Promote Comprehensive Governance of Liangtan River Basin
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，重庆市人大常委会党组书记、主任王炯出席专题会议，部署贯彻第8号总河长令，推进梁滩河流域综合治理与水生态保护。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Wang Jiong, Director of the Standing Committee of the Chongqing Municipal People's Congress, attended a special meeting to deploy the implementation of the 8th Chief River Officer Order for the governance of the Liangtan River Basin.

articles.title_zh: 胡昌升主持省生态环境保护委员会会议暨祁连山生态环境保护工作推进会议
articles.title_en: Hu Changsheng Chairs Meeting on Ecological Protection of Qilian Mountains
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，甘肃省委书记胡昌升在兰州主持召开省生态环境保护委员会会议，部署祁连山生态环境保护工作，强调统筹推进山水林田湖草沙一体化保护和系统治理。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Gansu Provincial Party Secretary Hu Changsheng chaired a meeting in Lanzhou to deploy ecological protection efforts for the Qilian Mountains, emphasizing integrated protection and systematic governance.

articles.title_zh: 2026面向东盟“AI+跨境电商”创新应用大赛启动
articles.title_en: 2026 'AI + Cross-border E-commerce' Innovative Application Competition for ASEAN Launched
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，由广西商务厅、数据局及南宁、柳州、北海三市主办的2026面向东盟“AI+跨境电商”创新应用大赛启动，旨在推动中国与东盟的跨境电商协同发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the 2026 'AI + Cross-border E-commerce' Innovative Application Competition for ASEAN was launched by Guangxi authorities to promote synergistic development of cross-border e-commerce between China and ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 2026年广西全民数字素养与技能提升月活动启动
articles.title_en: Launch of 2026 Guangxi Universal Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月29日，广西全民数字素养与技能提升月活动在南宁启动，旨在通过多部门协同提升全民数字化能力，筑牢数字广西建设根基。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, 2026, the 2026 Guangxi Universal Digital Literacy and Skills Improvement Month was launched in Nanning to enhance public digital capabilities and support the construction of Digital Guangxi.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲要求抓好风险隐患排查整治 确保人民群众生命财产安全
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Urges Risk Hazard Rectification to Ensure Public Safety
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，黑龙江省安委会第二次全体（扩大）会议在哈尔滨召开，省长梁惠玲强调要坚决守牢安全生产底线，开展全域消防及重点领域安全整治。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the 2nd Plenary Meeting of the Heilongjiang Provincial Safety Committee was held in Harbin. Governor Liang Huiling emphasized safeguarding safety production and conducting comprehensive hazard rectifications.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明专题研究仲景文化园建设工作
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Conducts Special Research on the Construction of Zhongjing Cultural Park
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日下午，湖南省长毛伟明主持专题会议研究仲景文化园建设，强调要挖掘中医药价值潜力，打造中医药特色文化园和城市文化地标。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming chaired a special meeting on the construction of the Zhongjing Cultural Park, emphasizing the need to unlock the potential of TCM and create a cultural landmark.

articles.title_zh: 山西发布2025年全省生态环境质量状况
articles.title_en: Shanxi Releases 2025 Provincial Ecological Environment Quality Report
articles.summary_zh: 山西省生态环境厅于5月29日举行发布会，公布2025年全省生态环境质量状况，各项指标创历史最好成绩，圆满完成“十四五”目标任务。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Department of Ecology and Environment held a press conference on May 29 to release the 2025 ecological environment quality report, noting record-best indicators and the completion of 14th Five-Year Plan goals.

articles.title_zh: 寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟成立
articles.title_en: Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance Established
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，寒旱区生态环境区域科技创新联盟在甘肃兰州成立，旨在整合西部科研力量，以科技创新赋能生态保护修复。
articles.summary_en: The Cold and Arid Region Ecological Environment Regional Science and Technology Innovation Alliance was established in Lanzhou, Gansu on May 30, 2026, to integrate research efforts for ecological protection in western China.

articles.title_en: Determined to Innovate and Reach New Heights to Accelerate the Construction of a Strong Science and Technology Nation
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日全国科技工作者日，报道强调习近平总书记对科技创新的重视，并总结了我国在深化科技体制改革及建设科技强国方面取得的进展。
articles.summary_en: On the 10th National Science and Technology Workers' Day (May 30), the report emphasized President Xi Jinping's focus on S&T innovation and summarized China's progress in systemic reforms.

articles.title_zh: 全国安全生产视频会议在京召开
articles.title_en: National Video Conference on Production Safety Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，全国安全生产视频会议在京召开。李强总理作出重要批示，要求纵深推进安全生产治本攻坚三年行动，坚决遏制重特大事故多发势头。
articles.summary_en: A national video conference on production safety was held in Beijing on May 30, 2026. Premier Li Qiang issued instructions to advance the three-year action for root-cause safety solutions and curb major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 电力市场交易电量同比增长25.6%
articles.title_en: Electricity Market Transaction Volume Increases by 25.6% Year-on-Year
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局数据显示，今年前4月全国累计完成电力市场交易电量24307亿千瓦时，同比增长25.6%。
articles.summary_en: The National Energy Administration reported that China's electricity market transaction volume reached 2,430.7 billion kWh in the first four months of the year, a year-on-year increase of 25.6%.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同埃及总统塞西就中埃建交70周年互致贺电
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Egyptian President Sisi Exchange Congratulatory Messages on 70th Anniversary of Diplomatic Ties
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，国家主席习近平同埃及总统塞西、国务院总理李强同埃及总理马德布利分别互致贺电，庆祝中埃建交70周年。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, 2026, President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Qiang exchanged congratulatory messages with Egyptian President Sisi and Prime Minister Madbouly to celebrate the 70th anniversary of diplomatic ties between China and Egypt.

articles.title_en: 2026 Internet High-Quality Content Creation Ceremony Held in Shanghai
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，2026互联网优质内容创作盛典在上海举行，现场发布了“上海互联网优创赋能计划”以进一步开放场景资源并吸引创作者。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Internet High-Quality Content Creation Ceremony was held in Shanghai on May 30, 2026, launching the 'Shanghai Internet High-Quality Content Empowerment Plan' to open more scenes and attract creators.

articles.title_zh: 著名世界古代史学家王敦书逝世
articles.title_en: Renowned World Ancient Historian Wang Dunshu Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 著名世界古代史学家、南开大学教授王敦书于2026年5月30日在天津逝世，享年92岁。
articles.summary_en: Wang Dunshu, a renowned world ancient historian and professor at Nankai University, passed away in Tianjin on May 30, 2026, at the age of 92.

articles.title_zh: 央企科技成果产业化联合体成立
articles.title_en: Central Enterprise Technology Achievement Industrialization Consortium Established
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，由国务院国资委指导、国家能源集团牵头组建的中央企业科技成果产业化联合体在北京成立，旨在推动科技创新与产业创新深度融合。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, the Central Enterprise Technology Achievement Industrialization Consortium, guided by SASAC and led by China Energy Investment Corporation, was established in Beijing to integrate technological and industrial innovation.

articles.title_en: Ye Jianchun Chairs Provincial Safety Production Video Conference
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，江西省长叶建春主持召开全省安全生产视频会议，强调要扛牢统筹发展和安全的政治责任，扎实开展安全防范工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, Jiangxi Governor Ye Jianchun chaired a provincial safety production video conference, emphasizing the political responsibility to coordinate development and security.

articles.title_zh: 成渝中线高铁启动铺轨
articles.title_en: Track Laying Begins for Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，成渝中线高铁正式启动铺轨施工，预计2027年建成通车，届时成都至重庆仅需50分钟。
articles.summary_en: Track laying for the Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway began on May 30. The project is expected to be completed by 2027, reducing travel time between the two cities to 50 minutes.

articles.title_zh: 成渝中线高铁启动铺轨
articles.title_en: Track Laying Begins for Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，成渝中线高铁在四川成都简阳正式启动铺轨施工，建成后成都至重庆旅行时间将缩短至50余分钟。
articles.summary_en: Track laying for the Chengdu-Chongqing Middle Line High-Speed Railway officially began in Jianyang, Chengdu on May 30, 2026, which will reduce travel time between the two cities to over 50 minutes.

articles.title_zh: 上海发布互联网优创赋能计划
articles.title_en: Shanghai Launches Internet High-Quality Content Empowerment Plan
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月30日，2026互联网优质内容创作盛典在上海举行，会上发布了由市委网信办推出的“上海互联网优创赋能计划”，旨在构建优质内容创作生态。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Internet High-Quality Content Creation Gala was held in Shanghai on May 30, 2026, where the "Shanghai Internet High-Quality Content Empowerment Plan" was launched to support content creators.

articles.title_zh: 北京全力建设人工智能第一城
articles.title_en: Beijing Strives to Become the Leading City for Artificial Intelligence
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，北京市相关领导在国务院新闻办公室记者会上介绍北京科技创新情况，目标将人工智能和绿色低碳培育成万亿级产业集群。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, Beijing officials briefed the State Council Information Office on the city's tech innovation, aiming to develop AI and green low-carbon industries into trillion-yuan clusters.

articles.title_zh: 青岛释放科产融合发展动能
articles.title_en: Qingdao Boosts Integrated Development of Science and Industry
articles.summary_zh: 青岛市通过实施创新驱动发展战略和出台相关政策，推动科技与产业深度融合，重点布局海洋产业及新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: Qingdao is promoting the integration of science and industry through innovation-driven strategies and policies, focusing on marine industries and new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 全省安全生产视频会议召开 刘宁作出批示 王凯出席并讲话
articles.title_en: Provincial Safety Production Video Conference Held; Liu Ning Gives Instructions and Wang Kai Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，河南省召开安全生产视频会议，省委书记刘宁作出批示，省长王凯出席并讲话，部署开展道路交通安全专项整治及重点行业安全排查。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, Henan Province held a video conference on safety production. Party Secretary Liu Ning and Governor Wang Kai emphasized risk rectification and safety inspections following recent accidents.

articles.title_zh: 全省“三夏”工作视频调度会召开
articles.title_en: Provincial Video Scheduling Meeting on "Three Summer" Agricultural Work Held
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，四川省政府召开全省“三夏”工作视频调度会，部署夏收、夏种及安全工作，省委书记刘宁作出批示。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, the Sichuan Provincial Government held a video scheduling meeting on "Three Summer" agricultural work to deploy summer harvesting, planting, and safety measures, with instructions from Provincial Party Secretary Liu Ning.

articles.title_zh: 一汽-大众成立35周年盛典暨粉丝家年华启幕
articles.title_en: FAW-Volkswagen Celebrates 35th Anniversary and Launches Fan Carnival
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，一汽-大众在长春举行成立35周年盛典及粉丝家年华活动，回顾发展成果并部署电动化转型计划。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, FAW-Volkswagen held its 35th anniversary celebration and Fan Carnival in Changchun to review its achievements and announce plans for electric vehicle transformation.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期四川甘孜州将实施亿千瓦清洁能源基地工程
articles.title_en: Ganzi Prefecture in Sichuan to Implement 100-Million-Kilowatt Clean Energy Base Project During 15th Five-Year Plan
articles.summary_zh: 四川省甘孜州计划在“十五五”期间实施亿千瓦清洁能源基地工程，打造国家重要清洁能源基地，并推动“绿电+算力”深度融合。
articles.summary_en: Ganzi Prefecture in Sichuan plans to implement a 100-million-kilowatt clean energy base project during the 15th Five-Year Plan to build a national clean energy hub and integrate green power with computing power.

articles.title_zh: 撬动创新药开发 人工智能虚拟筛选平台在天津发布
articles.title_en: AI Virtual Screening Platform for Innovative Drug Development Released in Tianjin
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日，由国家超级计算天津中心与清华大学联合打造的人工智能虚拟筛选平台GalaxyVS在天津发布，旨在提升创新药物研发效率并降低成本。
articles.summary_en: On May 30, the AI virtual screening platform GalaxyVS, jointly developed by the National Supercomputing Center in Tianjin and Tsinghua University, was released in Tianjin to enhance the efficiency and reduce the cost of innovative drug discovery.

articles.title_zh: 海南省委书记冯飞在临高县蹲点调研乡村振兴
articles.title_en: Hainan Provincial Party Secretary Feng Fei Conducts On-site Research on Rural Revitalization in Lingao County
articles.summary_zh: 5月30日至31日，海南省委书记冯飞在临高县铺仔村蹲点调研，聚焦乡村振兴与脱贫攻坚成果巩固，强调党建引领和产业振兴。
articles.summary_en: From May 30 to 31, Feng Fei, Secretary of the Hainan Provincial Party Committee, conducted on-site research in Puzai Village, Lingao County, focusing on rural revitalization and the consolidation of poverty alleviation achievements.

articles.title_zh: 中国华能坚决拥护党中央决定
articles.title_en: China Huaneng Firmly Supports Decision of the Party Central Committee
articles.summary_zh: 中国华能召开会议，坚决拥护党中央及中央纪委国家监委对王益华涉嫌严重违纪违法进行纪律审查和监察调查的决定。
articles.summary_en: China Huaneng held a meeting to express firm support for the decision of the Party Central Committee and the CCDI/NSC to investigate Wang Yihua for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 我国儿童新药连续五年增长 2025年批准138个创历史新高
articles.title_en: China's Pediatric Drug Approvals Hit Record High in 2025 with 138 New Drugs
articles.summary_zh: 国家药监局于2026年5月31日发布数据，2025年我国批准儿童用药138个，创历史新高，且审批数量已连续五年增长。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, the NMPA announced that China approved 138 pediatric drugs in 2025, marking a record high and the fifth consecutive year of growth.

articles.title_zh: 广西壮族自治区人民政府原副秘书长唐宁接受审查调查
articles.title_en: Tang Ning, Former Deputy Secretary-General of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Government, Under Investigation

articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission announced that Tang Ning, former Deputy Secretary-General of the regional government, is under investigation for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.

articles.title_zh: 民政部部署专项行动保障困境未成年人合法权益
articles.title_en: Ministry of Civil Affairs Deploys Special Action to Protect Legal Rights of Minors in Distress
articles.summary_zh: 中国民政部5月31日发布通知，在全国范围内开展为期半年的未成年人救助保护机构“提质增效”专项行动，旨在保障困境未成年人的合法权益。
articles.summary_en: China's Ministry of Civil Affairs issued a notice on May 31 to launch a six-month special action to improve the quality and efficiency of minor rescue and protection institutions nationwide.

articles.title_zh: 福建构建在闽工作生活台胞多层次住房保障体系
articles.title_en: Fujian Establishes Multi-level Housing Security System for Taiwanese Compatriots
articles.summary_zh: 福建省贯彻落实中央意见，构建涵盖公租房、保租房及金融支持的多层次住房保障体系，助力台胞在闽安居乐业。
articles.summary_en: Fujian Province has implemented a multi-level housing security system, including public rental housing and financial support, to help Taiwanese compatriots settle and work in the region.

articles.title_zh: 最高法等四部门联合印发加强未成年人思想及行为教育引导工作指南
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court and Three Other Departments Jointly Issue Guidelines for Strengthening Education and Guidance of Minors' Thoughts and Behaviors
articles.summary_zh: 最高法等四部门联合印发工作指南，旨在通过加强未成年人的法治意识、心理健康等教育引导，预防违法犯罪，护航未成年人健康成长。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Court and three other departments jointly issued guidelines to strengthen legal awareness and mental health education for minors to prevent crime and ensure healthy growth.

articles.title_zh: 两岸新锐聚漳州 共话闽南文化赋能融合发展
articles.title_en: Cross-Strait Youth Gather in Zhangzhou to Discuss Minnan Culture's Role in Integrated Development
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月31日，在福建漳州举行“台胞视野中的闽南文化：闽南文化新锐谈”活动，探讨闽南文化对两岸融合发展的赋能作用。
articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, the 'Minnan Culture in the Eyes of Taiwanese Compatriots' event was held in Zhangzhou, Fujian, to explore how Minnan culture can empower cross-strait integrated development.

articles.title_zh: 商业航天，浙江谋飞跃
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Seeks Breakthrough in Commercial Spaceflight

articles.summary_en: Zhejiang Province is accelerating the development of a full commercial spaceflight industry chain by implementing supportive policies and constructing launch and computing satellite bases.

articles.title_zh: 中国成功发射卫星互联网技术试验卫星

articles.summary_en: On May 31, 2026, China successfully launched a satellite internet technology test satellite from the Xichang Satellite Launch Center using a Long March 2D rocket to verify mobile broadband direct-to-satellite technology.

articles.title_zh: 安徽持续推进“农业保险+”改革助力乡村振兴
articles.title_en: Anhui Continues to Promote "Agricultural Insurance+" Reform to Boost Rural Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省通过推进“农业保险+”改革，利用保单增信等金融创新手段降低农户融资成本，以金融资源助力乡村全面振兴。
articles.summary_en: Anhui Province is advancing "Agricultural Insurance+" reform, utilizing insurance-based credit enhancement and financial innovation to reduce financing costs for farmers and support rural revitalization.

articles.title_zh: 长江上建起首座“零碳岛”
articles.title_en: First "Zero-Carbon Island" Built on the Yangtze River
articles.summary_zh: 江西九江棉船岛通过建设风电项目实现规模化可再生能源供电，成为长江流域首个“零碳岛”，助力“十五五”绿色低碳发展目标。
articles.summary_en: Mianchuan Island in Jiujiang, Jiangxi, has become the first "zero-carbon island" in the Yangtze River basin through a large-scale wind power project, supporting the 15th Five-Year Plan's green development goals.

articles.title_zh: 陕西推动县域经济高质量发展
articles.title_en: Shaanxi Promotes High-Quality Development of County-level Economy
articles.summary_zh: 陕西省通过实施“一县一策”和构建产业集群，推动县域经济高质量发展，旨在缩小区域差距并实现富民。
articles.summary_en: Shaanxi Province is driving the high-quality development of its county-level economy through 'one county, one policy' and industrial clusters to reduce regional disparities and improve livelihoods.

articles.title_zh: 制造业稳定运行 新动能加速扩张
articles.title_en: Manufacturing Operates Stably as New Growth Drivers Accelerate Expansion
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局与中国物流与采购联合会于5月31日发布5月份采购经理指数，显示制造业运行整体稳定，高技术及装备制造业加速扩张。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics and CFLP released the May PMI on May 31, indicating stable manufacturing operations and accelerated expansion in high-tech and equipment manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: 5月份PMI数据出炉 我国经济总体产出保持扩张
articles.title_en: May PMI Data Released: China's Overall Economic Output Maintains Expansion

articles.summary_en: Data released on May 31 by the NBS Service Industry Survey Center and CFLP show that China's overall economic output expanded in May, with stable manufacturing and recovering non-manufacturing sectors.

articles.title_zh: 人工智能相关产品拉动外贸增长
articles.title_en: AI-Related Products Drive Growth in Foreign Trade
articles.summary_zh: 今年以来，我国人工智能相关产品和服务加快走向国际市场，成为拉动外贸增长的新动能，集成电路、工业机器人等高附加值产品出口快速增长。
articles.summary_en: Since the beginning of the year, China's AI-related products and services have accelerated their expansion into international markets, becoming a new driver for foreign trade growth.

articles.title_zh: 前4月电力市场交易电量同比增长25.6%
articles.title_en: Electricity Market Transaction Volume Increases by 25.6% in First Four Months
articles.summary_zh: 国家能源局数据显示，今年前4月全国累计完成电力市场交易电量24307亿千瓦时，同比增长25.6%。
articles.summary_en: According to the National Energy Administration, China's total electricity market transaction volume reached 2,430.7 billion kWh in the first four months of the year, a year-on-year increase of 25.6%.

articles.title_zh: 云南会泽发生私挖盗采矿产资源垮塌事故，致5人死亡

articles.summary_en: A collapse accident caused by illegal mining occurred in Huize County, Yunnan Province on May 31, resulting in 5 deaths and 1 injury. An investigation is underway.

articles.title_zh: 山西开展全省煤矿安全风险隐患专项整治行动

articles.summary_en: On May 30, Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang chaired a meeting to deploy a special rectification action for coal mine safety risks, emphasizing strict punishment for illegal activities to prevent major accidents.

articles.title_zh: 习近平回信勉励中共一大纪念馆、南湖革命纪念馆少先队红领巾讲解员
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Sends Reply Letter Encouraging Young Pioneer Guides at CPC First Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall
