articles.summary_en: Ahead of International Children's Day, Xi Jinping sent a reply letter to Young Pioneer guides at the CPC First Congress Memorial Hall and Nanhu Revolutionary Memorial Hall, encouraging them to inherit the 'red gene'.

articles.title_zh: AI浪潮下如何培养青少年的思维能力

articles.summary_en: The 2026 World Digital Education Conference released the Global Digital Education Development Index, exploring the cultivation of high-order thinking skills for youth and practices in Zhejiang Province.

articles.title_zh: 北京部署推动首都城市高质量发展

articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, the CPC Beijing Municipal Committee and the Beijing Municipal People's Government released implementation opinions to deploy high-quality urban development goals for the capital for 2030 and 2035.

articles.title_zh: 河南发布“十五五”规划纲要 生产总值年均增长5%左右

articles.summary_zh: 5月28日，河南省省长王凯在新闻发布会上介绍“十五五”规划《纲要》，提出生产总值年均增长5%左右的目标及七大发展路径。
articles.summary_en: On May 28, Henan Governor Wang Kai announced the 15th Five-Year Plan outline, targeting an average annual GDP growth of around 5% through seven key development paths.

articles.title_zh: 许勤调研基础研究工作并看望慰问科技工作者

articles.summary_en: On May 28, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, investigated basic research in Harbin, visiting institutions like HIT to emphasize enhancing original innovation capabilities.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古数据应用场景发布会举办

articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Government Service and Data Management Bureau held a launch event in Hohhot to release trusted data space pilots and public data demonstration scenarios to unlock the value of data elements.

articles.title_zh: 四部门部署2026年提升全民数字素养与技能工作
articles.title_en: Four Departments Deploy Work to Improve National Digital Literacy and Skills for 2026

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期，北京将构建有竞争优势的新质生产力发展格局
articles.title_en: Beijing to Build Competitive New Quality Productive Forces During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，北京市长殷勇在新闻发布会上介绍，北京在“十五五”期间将构建有竞争优势的新质生产力发展格局，加快建设现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Beijing Mayor Yin Yong announced that the city will build a competitive pattern of new quality productive forces and accelerate the construction of a modern industrial system during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 推动现代化首都都市圈建设，北京明确“十五五”实施路径
articles.title_en: Beijing Clarifies Implementation Path for '15th Five-Year Plan' to Promote Modern Capital Metropolitan Area Construction

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Xia Linmao, Executive Vice Mayor of Beijing, outlined the implementation path for the '15th Five-Year Plan' to build a modern capital metropolitan area, focusing on function relief and regional coordination.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期北京将创新文商旅体展融合发展模式
articles.title_en: Beijing to Innovate Integrated Development of Culture, Commerce, Tourism, Sports, and Exhibitions During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Sun Junmin, head of the Beijing Municipal Committee's Publicity Department, announced that Beijing will innovate the integrated development of culture, commerce, tourism, sports, and exhibitions during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: “十五五”时期北京城市更新投资占比将持续增加

articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，北京市政府新闻办公室召开新闻发布会，常务副市长夏林茂介绍“十五五”时期北京将重点推进城市更新，预计2030年相关投资占比将达到30%左右。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Beijing Municipal Government Information Office held a press conference where Executive Vice Mayor Xia Linmao stated that urban renewal will be prioritized during the 15th Five-Year Plan, with investment expected to reach around 30% by 2030.

articles.title_zh: 北京力争通过五年努力使经济高质量发展迈上新台阶

articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Beijing Municipal Government Information Office held a press conference where Mayor Yin Yong outlined the "15th Five-Year Plan" to promote high-quality economic development and optimize capital functions.

articles.title_zh: 北京将进一步强化分级诊疗 让高水平医疗服务惠及更多患者

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Jin Wei, Vice Mayor of Beijing, announced plans for the 15th Five-Year Plan to strengthen hierarchical diagnosis and treatment and optimize medical resource supply to benefit more patients.

articles.title_zh: 联合发布“最美科技工作者”先进事迹

articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Central Propaganda Department and the China Association for Science and Technology jointly released the advanced deeds of 10 "Most Beautiful Science and Technology Workers" in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 国务院批复同意粤港澳游艇自由行

articles.summary_en: On May 29, the State Council approved a policy for yacht free travel in nine mainland cities of the GBA, implementing guarantee exemptions and temporary ship nationality registration.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Autonomous Region Party Committee, chaired a meeting to hear reports on central inspection rectification and deploy the remediation of problems identified in learning and education.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, SASAC held a meeting in Beijing to deploy basic research tasks for central enterprises for the 15th Five-Year Plan, noting that the investment share in basic research reached 9.4% in 2025.

articles.summary_en: Xinhua reports a significant increase in the average weight of NEVs in China, raising safety and energy efficiency concerns. MIIT is implementing policies to guide the industry toward lightweighting and high-quality development.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, chaired a meeting in Lanzhou on high-quality urban development, emphasizing the construction of modern, livable, and smart cities.

articles.title_zh: 湖南省十四届人大常委会第二十二次会议闭幕

articles.summary_en: The 22nd meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Hunan Provincial People's Congress concluded in Changsha on May 29, passing several local regulations and personnel appointments.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Jiangsu Provincial Party Secretary Xin Changxing chaired a Standing Committee meeting to deploy the rectification of central inspection feedback and review the service industry expansion plan for 2026-2030.

articles.title_zh: 省政协召开十三届六十七次主席会议 张义珍主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC Holds 67th Meeting of the 13th Chairman's Meeting Presided over by Zhang Yizhen
articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，江苏省政协召开十三届六十七次主席会议，由张义珍主持，研究服务业发展、安全生产及人工智能产业发展促进条例等事项。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Jiangsu Provincial CPPCC held the 67th meeting of the 13th Chairman's Meeting, presided over by Zhang Yizhen, to discuss service industry development, safety production, and AI industry regulations.

articles.title_zh: 湖北省召开全省领导干部会议

articles.summary_en: A national video conference on work safety was held in Beijing on May 30. Li Qiang issued instructions to curb major accidents and ensure the safety of people's lives and property.

articles.summary_en: A warning education meeting was held in Lhasa, where Tibet Autonomous Region Party Secretary Wang Junzheng emphasized establishing a correct view of political achievements to contribute to the modernization of Tibet.

articles.summary_en: Zhu Aiyong, Secretary of the Huainan Municipal Party Committee, proposed deepening Huaihe culture and building a cultural tourism IP at an innovation conference to promote high-quality tourism development.

articles.summary_en: On May 29, the Huaihe River Basin Civilization Revitalization Think Tank Meeting was held in Huainan, Anhui, where the Huaihe Think Tank Alliance Initiative was launched to support the region's high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 淮河流域博物馆联盟成立倡议在安徽淮南发起

articles.summary_en: On May 29, an initiative to establish the Huaihe River Basin Museum Alliance was launched in Huainan, Anhui, aiming to foster collaboration among museums in five provinces along the Huaihe River.

articles.title_zh: 新能源汽车及零部件产业成为皖北高质量发展重要引擎
articles.title_en: New Energy Vehicle and Parts Industry Becomes Key Engine for High-Quality Development in Northern Anhui

articles.summary_en: On May 29, Yin Qijun, Deputy Director of the Anhui Provincial Auto Office, introduced the development and achievements of the NEV and parts industry in Northern Anhui at a roundtable meeting in Huainan.

articles.title_zh: 安徽推动皖北地区新材料产业加速布局、重点发展

articles.summary_zh: 5月29日，安徽省工信厅副厅长戴琳琳在淮南出席圆桌会，强调支持皖北地区聚焦硅基、化工、生物基等新材料产业加速布局与高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 29, Dai Linlin, Deputy Director of Anhui Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology, emphasized supporting the accelerated layout and high-quality development of new material industries in Northern Anhui.

articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省齐齐哈尔市拜泉县委巡察机构通过强化理论学习、细化统筹部署和严明纪律作风，扎实做好本轮巡察的前期筹备工作。

articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation and the National Development and Reform Commission jointly issued guidelines to build an AI measurement system to promote high-quality AI development and new quality productive forces.

articles.summary_en: Tianjin recently issued an action plan (2026-2030) to promote the Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) industry through 20 key tasks across five areas, including technological innovation and platform construction.

articles.summary_en: The Tianjin Robot Industry Technology Alliance was officially established to promote technical breakthroughs and synergistic development of the robot industry in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region.

articles.summary_zh: 云南省市场监管局发布提醒告知书，督促网络食品交易平台及入网餐饮服务提供者落实食品安全主体责任，防范食品安全风险。

articles.title_en: Yao Gaoyuan Appointed Vice Governor of Zhejiang Province
articles.summary_zh: 姚高员被任命为浙江省副省长；同时，杜旭亮被任命为杭州市人民政府副市长、代理市长。
articles.summary_en: Yao Gaoyuan has been appointed Vice Governor of Zhejiang Province, and Du Xuliang has been appointed Vice Mayor and Acting Mayor of Hangzhou.

articles.title_zh: 嵩县农商行员工骗贷1600万，涉案信贷员被立案侦查
articles.title_en: Songxian Rural Commercial Bank Employee Defrauds 16 Million Yuan; Loan Officer Under Investigation
articles.summary_zh: 河南省嵩县农商行原员工李某因骗贷1600余万元被判刑，随后涉案信贷员杨某松等人因涉嫌违法发放贷款罪被立案侦查。
articles.summary_en: Li, a former employee of Songxian Rural Commercial Bank in Henan, was sentenced for defrauding 16 million yuan. Subsequently, loan officer Yang and others were placed under investigation for illegally issuing loans.

articles.title_zh: 习近平复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的两国学生
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Replies to Students Participating in 'Sailing Together in Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour'
articles.summary_zh: 5月23日，国家主席习近平复信参加“共航蔚蓝：中美青年友谊行”活动的中美两国学生，强调青少年是中美关系的未来和希望。
articles.summary_en: On May 23, President Xi Jinping replied to students from China and the US participating in the 'Sailing Together in Blue: China-US Youth Friendship Tour,' emphasizing that youth are the future and hope of China-US relations.

articles.title_zh: 梁惠玲主持省长办公会议研究推动服务业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Liang Huiling Chairs Governor's Office Meeting to Promote High-Quality Development of Service Industry

articles.summary_en: From May 25 to 26, Heilongjiang Governor Liang Huiling chaired a meeting to deploy actions for expanding the capacity and improving the quality of the province's service industry.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets UN Secretary-General António Guterres
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，外交部长王毅在纽约主持联合国安理会高级别会议期间会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯，双方就维护联合国权威、深化多边合作及一个中国原则等议题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Foreign Minister Wang Yi met with UN Secretary-General António Guterres in New York during a high-level Security Council meeting to discuss upholding the UN's authority and deepening multilateral cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴在山东调研强调坚定不移实施就业优先战略
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Emphasizes Employment-First Strategy During Research Trip to Shandong
articles.summary_zh: 国务委员谌贻琴于5月26日至28日在山东济南、淄博调研就业工作，强调要坚定不移实施就业优先战略，多措并举稳就业促就业。
articles.summary_en: State Councilor Chen Yiqin conducted research on employment in Jinan and Zibo, Shandong from May 26 to 28, emphasizing the implementation of an employment-first strategy to stabilize and promote employment.

articles.title_zh: 武契奇到访嘉兴品尝当地特色美食

articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，塞尔维亚总统武契奇到访浙江嘉兴，参观敏实集团未来工厂并品尝当地特色美食嘉兴原汤粽。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, Serbian President Aleksandar Vucic visited Jiaxing, Zhejiang, where he toured the Minth Group's future factory and tasted local specialty zongzi.

articles.title_zh: 山东省安全生产工作专题会议召开

articles.summary_en: On May 27, Shandong Province held a special meeting on work safety in Jinan. Party Secretary Lin Wu and Governor Zhou Naixiang attended to deploy efforts in eliminating safety hazards across key sectors.

articles.title_zh: 西康高铁顺利通过接触网平推验收

articles.summary_en: On May 27, 2026, the Xikang High-speed Railway successfully completed the overhead contact system acceptance, laying the foundation for subsequent hot-slide tests and joint commissioning.

articles.title_zh: 省十四届人大常委会第二十三次会议召开

articles.summary_en: The 23rd meeting of the Standing Committee of the 14th Gansu Provincial People's Congress was held in Lanzhou on May 27 to review local regulations, government debt management, and environmental protection.

articles.summary_en: On May 27, Xu Qin, Secretary of the Heilongjiang Provincial Party Committee, chaired the 50th collective study session to study Xi Jinping's economic thought and deploy measures for high-quality development and comprehensive revitalization in Heilongjiang.

articles.summary_en: On May 27, the Changchun Public Security Bureau released 20 measures to deepen the construction of a law-based business environment to support the city's overall revitalization and development.

articles.summary_en: On May 27, 2026, the first stop of Liaoning Province's 2026 Digital Talent Collaborative Innovation Cultivation Action was launched in Yingkou to provide talent support for the digital economy and government.

articles.summary_en: On May 27, the expansion and renovation project of Yanzhou North Station in Shandong, led by China Railway Jinan Group and built by China Railway 10th Bureau, was fully completed to enhance regional transport capacity.

articles.title_zh: 天津举行战略合作协议和项目签约活动
articles.title_en: Tianjin Holds Strategic Cooperation Agreement and Project Signing Event

articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, the Ministry of National Defense held a regular press conference where spokesperson Jiang Bin stated China's firm opposition to US arms sales to Taiwan and urged the US to be prudent in handling the Taiwan issue.

articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate released 10 typical cases involving minors, focusing on new types of drugs and cybercrime to promote social governance and balance punishment with protection.

articles.summary_en: On May 28, 2026, Vice Premier Zhang Guoqing attended the launch ceremony of the National "Work Safety Month" in Beijing, emphasizing the need to thoroughly investigate risks and ensure the bottom line of safe development.

articles.title_zh: 国务院印发《城市更新“十五五”规划》

articles.summary_zh: 绍兴市通过实施人工智能产业发展行动方案，推动AI与制造业深度融合，旨在通过场景应用和生态构建激活新质生产力。
articles.summary_en: Shaoxing is promoting the deep integration of AI and manufacturing through its industry development action plan to activate new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同塞尔维亚总统武契奇举行会谈并颁授友谊勋章
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Serbian President Vučić and Awards Medal of Friendship
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日下午，中国国家主席习近平在北京同塞尔维亚总统武契奇举行会谈，并为其颁授“友谊勋章”，旨在深化中塞全面战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Chinese President Xi Jinping held talks with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić in Beijing and awarded him the Medal of Friendship to deepen the China-Serbia comprehensive strategic partnership.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同塞尔维亚总统武契奇、巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹会晤
articles.title_en: President Xi Jinping Meets with Serbian President Vučić and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日下午，国家主席习近平在人民大会堂同塞尔维亚总统武契奇举行会谈，并会见了巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹。
articles.summary_en: On the afternoon of May 25, President Xi Jinping held talks with Serbian President Vučić and met with Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz at the Great Hall of the People.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府召开常务会议 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government Holds Executive Meeting Chaired by Liu Xiaotao
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，江苏省长刘小涛主持召开省政府常务会议，研究部署安全生产、常态化帮扶、长三角一体化发展及法律服务等工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired an executive meeting of the Jiangsu Provincial Government to discuss work safety, regular assistance, Yangtze River Delta integration, and legal services.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省政府党组（扩大）会议召开 刘小涛主持
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Provincial Government Party Group (Expanded) Meeting Held, Chaired by Liu Xiaotao
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，江苏省长刘小涛主持召开省政府党组（扩大）会议，学习贯彻习近平总书记重要讲话精神，部署高质量发展及巡视整改工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Governor Liu Xiaotao chaired a meeting of the Jiangsu Provincial Government Party Group to study Xi Jinping's instructions and deploy tasks for high-quality development and inspection rectification.

articles.title_zh: 华为推出“韬定律”改写全球半导体规则
articles.title_en: Huawei Introduces "Tao's Law" to Rewrite Global Semiconductor Rules
articles.summary_zh: 5月25日，华为在上海的国际电路与系统研讨会上正式发表“韬定律”，提出以“时间缩微”替代传统“几何缩微”作为半导体演进的新逻辑。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, Huawei officially introduced "Tao's Law" at an international symposium in Shanghai, proposing "time scaling" as a new guiding principle for semiconductor evolution to replace traditional "geometric scaling."

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasahar
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，王毅在纽约主持联合国安理会高级别会议期间会见泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨，双方就加强中泰战略合作及推动全球治理交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Wang Yi met with Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasahar in New York during a high-level UN Security Council meeting to discuss strengthening China-Thailand strategic cooperation and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets UN Secretary-General António Guterres
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，王毅在纽约主持联合国安理会高级别会议期间会见联合国秘书长古特雷斯，双方就维护联合国权威、多边主义及深化合作等议题进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Wang Yi met with UN Secretary-General António Guterres in New York during a high-level Security Council meeting to discuss upholding the UN's authority, multilateralism, and deepening cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见巴拿马外长马丁内斯-阿查
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets with Panamanian Foreign Minister Martinez-Acha
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，王毅在纽约会见巴拿马外长马丁内斯-阿查，双方就深化中巴务实合作及恪守一个中国原则达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Wang Yi met with Panamanian Foreign Minister Martinez-Acha in New York to discuss deepening pragmatic cooperation and adherence to the One-China principle.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见哥伦比亚外长比利亚维森西奥
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Colombian Foreign Minister Villa Vicencio
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，王毅在纽约会见哥伦比亚外长比利亚维森西奥，双方就深化中哥战略伙伴关系及共建“一带一路”合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Wang Yi met with Colombian Foreign Minister Villa Vicencio in New York to discuss deepening the China-Colombia strategic partnership and Belt and Road cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 王毅会见捷克副总理兼外长马青卡
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Meets Czech Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ma Qingka
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，王毅在纽约会见捷克副总理兼外长马青卡，双方就改善中捷关系、奉行一个中国政策及应对全球挑战进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Wang Yi met with Czech Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ma Qingka in New York to discuss improving bilateral relations, the One China policy, and global challenges.

articles.title_zh: 王毅主持联合国安理会维护联合国宪章宗旨和原则高级别会议
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Chairs UN Security Council High-Level Meeting on Upholding the UN Charter
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，王毅在联合国主持关于维护联合国宪章宗旨和原则、加强以联合国为核心的国际体系的高级别会议。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Wang Yi chaired a high-level UN Security Council meeting focused on upholding the UN Charter and strengthening the UN-centered international system.

articles.title_zh: 张升民会见巴基斯坦国防军司令兼陆军参谋长
articles.title_en: Zhang Shengmin Meets with Pakistan's Chief of Army Staff
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，中央军委副主席张升民在京会见巴基斯坦国防军司令兼陆军参谋长穆尼尔，双方探讨深化中巴两军关系与务实合作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Zhang Shengmin, Vice Chairman of the CMC, met with Pakistan's Chief of Army Staff General Munir in Beijing to discuss deepening military relations and practical cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 谌贻琴出席第七次中国—中东欧国家地方领导人会议开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Chen Yiqin Attends Opening Ceremony of the 7th China-CEEC Local Leaders Meeting and Delivers Speech
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，国务委员谌贻琴在济南出席第七次中国—中东欧国家地方领导人会议开幕式并致辞，强调深化地方合作与战略对接。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, State Councilor Chen Yiqin attended and addressed the opening ceremony of the 7th China-CEEC Local Leaders Meeting in Jinan, emphasizing the deepening of local cooperation and strategic alignment.

articles.title_zh: 第21届联合国卫塞节在中国无锡开幕
articles.title_en: The 21st UN Day of Vesak Opens in Wuxi, China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，第21届联合国卫塞节在江苏无锡开幕。王沪宁致信祝贺，李干杰出席开幕式并致辞。
articles.summary_en: The 21st UN Day of Vesak opened in Wuxi, Jiangsu on May 26, 2026. Wang Huning sent a congratulatory letter, and Li Ganjie attended the opening ceremony and delivered a speech.

tags.name_en: Exchange and Mutual Learning among Civilizations

tags_en: Exchange and Mutual Learning among Civilizations

articles.title_zh: 六部门亮举措推动基本公共服务“随人走”
articles.title_en: Six Departments Introduce Measures to Promote "Follow-the-Person" Basic Public Services
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，国新办举行吹风会，介绍国务院印发的关于推行常住地提供基本公共服务的实施意见，旨在优化新市民在教育、住房、医保等方面的公共服务。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the SCIO held a briefing on the State Council's implementation opinions to ensure basic public services in education, housing, and healthcare follow the resident's actual location.

articles.title_zh: 中国最高检挂牌督办山西沁源煤矿爆炸重大责任事故案
articles.title_en: China's Supreme People's Procuratorate to Supervise Investigation into Shanxi Qinyuan Coal Mine Explosion
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，最高人民检察院决定对山西沁源煤矿爆炸重大责任事故案挂牌督办，要求依法查明原因并严惩责任人。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, China's Supreme People's Procuratorate announced its decision to supervise the investigation into a major coal mine explosion in Qinyuan, Shanxi, demanding strict punishment for those responsible.

articles.title_zh: 央视曝光境外间谍入侵联网设备窃密手段
articles.title_en: CCTV Exposes Foreign Spies' Methods of Hacking Networked Devices to Steal Secrets
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，央视发布保密科普纪录片《守护》，揭露境外间谍通过伪装身份、网络入侵等手段窃取我国军事及谈判秘密的风险。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, CCTV released a documentary titled "Guardian," exposing the risks of foreign spies stealing Chinese military and negotiation secrets through disguised identities and network intrusions.

articles.title_zh: 北京2026年家庭新能源车指标入围分数线降至36分
articles.title_en: Beijing's 2026 Family New Energy Vehicle Quota Cutoff Score Drops to 36 Points
articles.summary_zh: 北京市公布2026年新能源小客车指标配置结果，家庭指标入围分数线降至36分，共配置家庭指标119,200个。
articles.summary_en: Beijing announced the 2026 new energy vehicle quota allocation results, with the family cutoff score dropping to 36 points and 119,200 family quotas allocated.

articles.title_zh: 让新市民享有更美好生活
articles.title_en: Ensuring a Better Life for New Urban Residents
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，国务院新闻办举行吹风会，介绍国家首次出台的关于在常住地提供基本公共服务的实施意见，旨在完善新市民的就业、住房、教育及医疗保障。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the State Council Information Office held a briefing on the first national implementation opinions for providing basic public services at places of permanent residence to improve employment, housing, education, and healthcare for new urban residents.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省启动“5·26我爱路”主题宣传活动
articles.title_en: Gansu Province Launches '5.26 I Love the Road' Publicity Campaign
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，甘肃省在兰州启动“5·26我爱路”主题宣传活动，旨在通过多部门联动提升公众铁路安全意识，深化平安铁路建设。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Gansu Province launched the '5.26 I Love the Road' publicity campaign in Lanzhou to enhance public railway safety awareness and promote the construction of a 'Peaceful Railway'.

articles.title_zh: 基础电信企业网上营业厅服务国家标准发布
articles.title_en: National Standard for Online Business Hall Services of Basic Telecommunications Enterprises Released
articles.summary_zh: 市场监管总局近日发布《电信和互联网服务 基础电信企业网上营业厅服务规范》国家标准，旨在规范电信服务网上营业厅的信息透明度、无障碍服务及个人信息保护。
articles.summary_en: The State Administration for Market Regulation released a national standard to regulate online business halls of basic telecommunications enterprises, focusing on transparency, accessibility, and data protection.

articles.title_zh: 兰州新区召开《兰州新区条例》立法开题暨调研座谈会
articles.title_en: Symposium Held on Legislative Opening and Research for Lanzhou New Area Regulations
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，兰州新区召开《兰州新区条例》立法开题暨调研座谈会，正式启动条例起草工作，旨在为新区高质量发展夯实法治基础。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Lanzhou New Area held a symposium on the legislative opening and research for the "Lanzhou New Area Regulations" to officially start the drafting process and strengthen the legal foundation for high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 广西深化科技教育融合厚植人工智能创新沃土
articles.title_en: Guangxi Deepens Integration of Science and Education to Foster AI Innovation
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，广西在南宁举行新闻发布会，介绍通过深化科技教育融合、推动“人工智能+”行动来培养AI人才的举措。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, a press conference was held in Nanning, Guangxi, to introduce measures for cultivating AI talent through the integration of science and education and the "AI+" initiative.

articles.title_zh: 中国—东盟国家人工智能应用合作中心企业联盟在广西南宁成立
articles.title_en: China-ASEAN AI Application Cooperation Center Enterprise Alliance Established in Nanning, Guangxi
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，中国—东盟国家人工智能应用合作中心企业联盟在广西南宁成立，旨在通过产业链协同推动中国与东盟在人工智能领域的国际合作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the China-ASEAN AI Application Cooperation Center Enterprise Alliance was established in Nanning, Guangxi, aiming to promote international AI cooperation through industrial chain synergy.

articles.title_zh: 国际生命健康企业海南行合作交流会举行
articles.title_en: International Life and Health Enterprise Hainan Tour Cooperation Exchange Meeting Held
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，国际生命健康企业海南行合作交流会在海口举行。省委书记冯飞、省长刘小明及中信集团负责人出席，旨在推动生命健康产业的国际合作与项目落地。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the International Life and Health Enterprise Hainan Tour Cooperation Exchange Meeting was held in Haikou. Provincial Secretary Feng Fei and Governor Liu Xiaoming attended to promote international cooperation in the life and health industry.

articles.title_zh: 江苏省航空航天产业联盟在无锡成立
articles.title_en: Jiangsu Aerospace Industry Alliance Established in Wuxi
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，江苏省航空航天产业联盟在无锡成立，旨在整合全省资源，推动商业航天、低空经济等核心领域的技术攻关与产业协同发展。
articles.summary_en: The Jiangsu Aerospace Industry Alliance was established in Wuxi on May 26 to integrate provincial resources and promote technological breakthroughs and industrial synergy in commercial spaceflight and the low-altitude economy.

articles.title_zh: 任珠峰在南昌调研经济运行情况
articles.title_en: Ren Zhufeng Conducts Research on Economic Operations in Nanchang
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，江西省委常委、常务副省长任珠峰在南昌调研经济运行情况，强调要加快推动全省经济稳中向好发展，确保实现“双过半”。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Ren Zhufeng, Member of the Standing Committee of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee and Executive Vice Governor, conducted research on economic operations in Nanchang to promote steady economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 江西省召开设区市市委书记座谈会 部署学习教育与经济发展工作
articles.title_en: Jiangxi Province Holds Symposium for Municipal Party Committee Secretaries to Deploy Learning Education and Economic Development
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，江西省委召开设区市市委书记座谈会，由省委书记尹弘主持，中央第一指导组组长徐令义出席，研究学习教育、经济发展及安全生产等工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee held a symposium for municipal party secretaries, chaired by Secretary Yin Hong and attended by Xu Lingyi, to discuss learning education, economic growth, and safety production.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区政协召开专题协商会聚焦加强同粤港澳大湾区互惠合作
articles.title_en: Inner Mongolia CPPCC Holds Special Consultative Meeting on Strengthening Cooperation with Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，内蒙古自治区政协召开专题协商会，探讨加强与粤港澳大湾区互惠合作，以夯实我国向北开放重要桥头堡建设基础。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region CPPCC held a special consultative meeting to discuss strengthening mutual cooperation with the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area.

articles.title_zh: 王伟中会见乌兹别克斯坦共和国驻华大使阿尔济耶夫
articles.title_en: Wang Weizhong Meets Uzbekistan Ambassador to China Alziev
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，内蒙古自治区党委书记王伟中在呼和浩特会见乌兹别克斯坦驻华大使阿尔济耶夫，双方就加强经贸投资、现代农业、生态治理等领域的务实合作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Wang Weizhong, Secretary of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Party Committee, met with Uzbekistan Ambassador to China Alziev in Hohhot to discuss enhancing pragmatic cooperation in trade, investment, modern agriculture, and ecological governance.

articles.title_zh: 王毅谈中国对联合国事业所做贡献
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Discusses China's Contributions to the United Nations
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，外交部长王毅在主持联合国安理会高级别会议时，介绍了中国在维护联合国宪章、推动全球发展及多边主义方面所做的贡献。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Foreign Minister Wang Yi presided over a UN Security Council high-level meeting and detailed China's contributions to upholding the UN Charter, promoting global development, and supporting multilateralism.

articles.title_zh: 王毅主持安理会高级别会议就重振和壮大联合国达成共识
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Chairs High-Level Security Council Meeting on Revitalizing and Strengthening the UN
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，王毅在主持联合国安理会高级别会议后表示，与会各国就维护联合国宪章、重振和壮大联合国以及改革全球治理体系达成重要共识。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Wang Yi stated after chairing a high-level UN Security Council meeting that participants reached a consensus on upholding the UN Charter, revitalizing the UN, and reforming global governance.

articles.title_zh: 广东奋力在推进中国式现代化建设中走在前列
articles.title_en: Guangdong Strives to Lead in Advancing Chinese-style Modernization
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，广东省在广州举行“十五五”专场新闻发布会，省长孟凡利部署了关于先进制造业、粤港澳大湾区建设及城乡协调发展等重点工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Guangdong held a press conference in Guangzhou regarding the 15th Five-Year Plan, where Governor Meng Fanli outlined goals for advanced manufacturing, GBA development, and urban-rural coordination.

articles.title_zh: 上海市人大常委会会议召开
articles.title_en: Shanghai Municipal NPC Standing Committee Meeting Convened
articles.summary_zh: 上海市十六届人大常委会第三十次会议召开，由黄莉新主持，审议了包括浦东新区区块链应用在内的多项法规草案及监督报告。
articles.summary_en: The 30th meeting of the 16th Shanghai Municipal NPC Standing Committee was held, chaired by Huang Lixin, to deliberate on several draft regulations, including blockchain applications in Pudong, and various supervision reports.

articles.title_zh: 陈吉宁主持上海市实施乡村振兴战略现场推进会
articles.title_en: Chen Jining Chairs Shanghai Meeting on Promoting Rural Revitalization Strategy
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月26日，上海市委书记陈吉宁主持实施乡村振兴战略现场推进会，强调要聚焦科技农业、改善人居环境并促进农民增收，走出超大城市城乡融合发展新路子。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, 2026, Shanghai Party Secretary Chen Jining chaired a meeting to promote the rural revitalization strategy, emphasizing agricultural technology, improved living conditions, and increased farmers' income.

articles.title_zh: AI赋能微短剧产业“沪8条”发布
articles.title_en: Shanghai Releases "8 Measures" to Empower Micro-short Drama Industry with AI
articles.summary_zh: 上海发布《加快推进AI赋能微短剧产业高质量发展的若干措施》（“沪8条”），通过算力补贴、审核机制优化及产业集聚，推动AI微短剧产业高质量发展与文化出海。
articles.summary_en: Shanghai released the "8 Measures" to promote the high-quality development of the AI-powered micro-short drama industry, focusing on computing power subsidies, streamlined review processes, and industrial clustering to support cultural exports.

articles.title_zh: 第48届世界技能大赛使节招待会在京举行
articles.title_en: Diplomatic Reception for the 48th WorldSkills Competition Held in Beijing
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，第48届世界技能大赛使节招待会在北京举行。人社部部长王晓萍、上海市市长龚正等出席，邀请各方参加将于9月在上海举办的世赛。
articles.summary_en: A diplomatic reception for the 48th WorldSkills Competition was held in Beijing on May 26. Minister Wang Xiaoping and Mayor Gong Zheng invited international guests to the event in Shanghai this September.

articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省委书记胡昌升表示，甘肃将锚定智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，通过改造传统产业、培育新兴产业和布局未来产业，构建现代化产业体系。
articles.summary_en: Hu Changsheng, Secretary of the Gansu Provincial Party Committee, stated that Gansu will build a modern industrial system by upgrading traditional industries and developing emerging and future industries.

articles.title_zh: 国家统计局解读2026年1—4月份工业企业利润数据
articles.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics Interprets Industrial Enterprise Profit Data for January-April 2026
articles.summary_zh: 国家统计局发布数据显示，2026年1—4月份规模以上工业企业利润同比增长18.2%，其中装备制造业和高技术制造业引领作用明显。
articles.summary_en: The National Bureau of Statistics reported that profits of industrial enterprises above designated size grew by 18.2% from January to April 2026, driven by equipment and high-tech manufacturing.

articles.title_zh: “急独”政党“喜乐岛联盟”称愿有条件地考虑两岸统一，国台办回应
articles.title_en: TAO Responds to "Joy Island Alliance" Claim of Conditional Consideration for Cross-Strait Unification
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，国台办发言人陈斌华在例行新闻发布会上回应“喜乐岛联盟”关于有条件考虑统一的言论，强调两岸必将统一并愿在“九二共识”基础上开展对话。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, TAO spokesperson Chen Binhua responded to the "Joy Island Alliance's" claim of conditionally considering unification, emphasizing that unification is inevitable and dialogue is welcome based on the "1992 Consensus."

articles.title_zh: 国安部提醒警惕二维码陷阱
articles.title_en: Ministry of State Security Warns Against QR Code Traps
articles.summary_zh: 国安部发布提醒，警示群众防范不法分子利用二维码陷阱窃取个人隐私及涉密信息，以维护国家安全。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of State Security warned the public to be vigilant against QR code traps used by criminals to steal personal data and classified information, posing a threat to national security.

articles.title_zh: 中国贸促会淮安支会报案不法分子冒用名义签合同
articles.title_en: CCPIT Huai'an Branch Reports Impersonation and Forged Contracts to Police
articles.summary_zh: 中国贸促会淮安支会近日发布声明，称有不法分子伪造印章冒用其名义签订采购合同，目前已向公安机关报案。
articles.summary_en: The Huai'an Branch of the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade (CCPIT) issued a statement reporting that illegal elements forged its seal to sign procurement contracts and has filed a police report.

articles.title_zh: 机动车驾驶人疲劳驾驶认定规则解读
articles.title_en: Interpretation of the Rules for Determining Fatigue Driving of Motor Vehicle Drivers
articles.summary_zh: 公共安全行业推荐性标准《机动车驾驶人疲劳驾驶认定规则》将于2026年6月1日起实施，旨在规范交通事故中疲劳驾驶的调查认定工作。
articles.summary_en: The 'Rules for Determining Fatigue Driving of Motor Vehicle Drivers' will be implemented on June 1, 2026, to standardize the investigation and determination of fatigue driving in traffic accidents.

articles.title_zh: 《2026金砖国家产业合作案例集》正式发布
articles.title_en: 2026 BRICS Industrial Cooperation Case Collection Officially Released
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月27日，2026金砖国家新工业革命伙伴关系论坛在福建厦门开幕，会上发布了《2026金砖国家产业合作案例集》。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 BRICS Partnership on New Industrial Revolution Forum opened in Xiamen, Fujian on May 27, 2026, where the '2026 BRICS Industrial Cooperation Case Collection' was officially released.

articles.title_zh: 贵州大力培育“专精特新”中小企业推动产业升级
articles.title_en: Guizhou Cultivates 'Specialized and Innovative' SMEs to Drive Industrial Upgrading
articles.summary_zh: 贵州省工业和信息化厅持续培育“专精特新”中小企业，通过科技创新和产业升级，助力全省经济社会高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Guizhou Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology continues to cultivate 'Specialized, Refined, Unique, and Innovative' SMEs to drive industrial upgrading and high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江省制定三年行动方案做强做优寒地特色经济作物
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Province Formulates Three-Year Action Plan to Strengthen Cold-Region Special Economic Crops
articles.summary_zh: 黑龙江省农业农村厅近日制定《黑龙江省经济作物扩规提质增效三年行动方案（2026—2028年）》，旨在通过发展寒地特色经济作物推动乡村振兴和农民增收。
articles.summary_en: The Heilongjiang Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs recently formulated a three-year action plan (2026-2028) to develop cold-region special economic crops to promote rural revitalization and increase farmers' income.

articles.title_zh: 宁夏体彩中心开展世界杯专项调研检查工作
articles.title_en: Ningxia Sports Lottery Center Conducts Special Inspection for World Cup
articles.summary_zh: 宁夏体彩中心近日在五市基层销售一线开展安全生产和合规运营专项调研检查，旨在确保2026世界杯期间体彩销售的安全与合规。
articles.summary_en: The Ningxia Sports Lottery Center recently conducted special inspections on production safety and compliant operations across five cities to ensure the safe and legal sale of lottery tickets during the 2026 World Cup.

articles.title_zh: 青海出台措施加强就业服务赋能文旅产业发展
articles.title_en: Qinghai Introduces Measures to Strengthen Employment Services for Cultural Tourism Industry
articles.summary_zh: 青海省人社厅、财政厅、文旅厅联合出台措施，通过创业补贴、稳岗用工和技能培训等手段，推动文旅产业与就业深度融合。
articles.summary_en: Qinghai Province issued measures to integrate cultural tourism with employment through entrepreneurship subsidies, job stability policies, and skill training.

articles.title_en: From 'Bookshelf' to 'Shelf': Mianyang Science and Technology City New Area Promotes Transformation of Scientific Achievements
articles.summary_zh: 四川省绵阳科技城新区通过搭建中试平台、培育专业技术经理人及优化金融生态，推动科技创新成果实现产业化转化。
articles.summary_en: Mianyang Science and Technology City New Area in Sichuan Province is promoting the industrialization of scientific achievements by building pilot platforms, cultivating professional technical managers, and optimizing the financial ecosystem.

articles.title_zh: “上海设计100+”全球竞赛启动征集
articles.title_en: "Shanghai Design 100+" Global Competition Launches Call for Entries
articles.summary_zh: 上海市经信委启动2025“上海设计100+”全球竞赛征集，涵盖工业、时尚等设计领域，旨在推动设计成果转化与产业升级。
articles.summary_en: The Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization has launched the 2025 "Shanghai Design 100+" global competition to promote design achievement transformation and industrial upgrading.

articles.title_zh: 临港集团注册成立50亿元投资公司打造产业集群资本引擎
articles.title_en: Lingang Group Establishes 5-Billion-Yuan Investment Company to Drive Industrial Clusters
articles.summary_zh: 上海市属国企临港集团注册成立注册资本50亿元的临港投资公司，旨在通过“投招联动”推动园区从传统地产开发向产业投资转型。
articles.summary_en: State-owned Lingang Group in Shanghai has established an investment company with 5 billion yuan in registered capital to transition industrial parks from real estate development to industrial investment.

articles.title_zh: 流域水生态环境质量标准制订技术导则发布
articles.title_en: Release of Technical Guidelines for the Formulation of Basin Water Ecological Environment Quality Standards
articles.summary_zh: 生态环境部发布《流域水生态环境质量标准制订技术导则》，旨在规范和推动流域水生态环境质量标准的制订，将于2026年9月1日起施行。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment released the Technical Guidelines for the Formulation of Basin Water Ecological Environment Quality Standards, effective September 1, 2026, to standardize basin water quality standards.

articles.title_zh: 殷勇会见环球银行金融电信协会全球首席执行官
articles.title_en: Yin Yong Meets CEO of Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication
articles.summary_zh: 北京市市长殷勇日前会见环球银行金融电信协会全球首席执行官哈维尔·塔索，探讨加强金融科技交流合作并优化营商环境。
articles.summary_en: Beijing Mayor Yin Yong met with Javier Tasso, CEO of SWIFT, to discuss strengthening cooperation in fintech and optimizing the business environment in Beijing.

articles.title_zh: 习近平总书记关切事·关键小事｜街巷里的温暖“家”事
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping's Concerns: Improving Livelihoods Through Old Community Renovation
articles.summary_zh: 文章报道了内蒙古阿尔山市、辽宁沈阳市和重庆市在习近平总书记指导下，通过推进棚户区和老旧小区改造，切实改善群众居住环境并提升民生福祉。
articles.summary_en: The article reports on the renovation of shantytowns and old communities in Arshan, Shenyang, and Chongqing under the guidance of Xi Jinping to improve living conditions and people's well-being.

articles.title_zh: 最高检全面加强对立案、侦查、审判、执行等活动的法律监督
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate to Strengthen Legal Supervision of Case Filing, Investigation, Trial, and Execution
articles.summary_zh: 5月27日，最高检副检察长苗生明在国新办发布会上表示，检察机关将全面加强对立案、侦查、审判、执行等活动的法律监督，严惩司法腐败。
articles.summary_en: On May 27, Miao Shengming, Vice Prosecutor General of the SPP, announced at a press conference that procuratorial organs will strengthen legal supervision over judicial activities and crack down on judicial corruption.

articles.title_zh: 安徽省加快布局“人工智能+政务”赋能政府治理现代化
articles.title_en: Anhui Province Accelerates "AI + Government Affairs" Layout to Empower Modernization of Government Governance
articles.summary_zh: 安徽省近日印发《加快推进“人工智能+政务”行动方案》，旨在通过数智化融合赋能政府治理现代化，并设定了2027年和2030年的阶段性目标。
articles.summary_en: Anhui Province recently issued an action plan to accelerate "AI + Government Affairs" integration, aiming to modernize government governance with specific goals for 2027 and 2030.

articles.title_zh: 共探产教融合新路径 推动中高职发展
articles.title_en: Exploring New Paths for Industry-Education Integration to Promote Vocational Education Development
articles.summary_zh: 2026年职业教育产教融合论坛（粤港澳大湾区）在中新广州知识城举办，探讨职业教育高质量发展并签署战略合作协议。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Vocational Education Industry-Education Integration Forum (GBA) was held in China-Singapore Guangzhou Knowledge City to discuss high-quality vocational education and sign strategic cooperation agreements.

articles.title_zh: 甘肃省人民政府关于周立荣等同志职务任免的通知
articles.title_en: Notice of the Gansu Provincial People's Government on Personnel Appointments and Removals of Zhou Lirong and Others
articles.summary_zh: 甘肃省人民政府决定周立荣任省统计局局长，巨鸿文任省应急管理厅副厅长，并免去杨汉杰、张志明相关职务。
articles.summary_en: The Gansu Provincial People's Government announced the appointment of Zhou Lirong as Director of the Provincial Bureau of Statistics and Ju Hongwen as Deputy Director of the Provincial Emergency Management Department, along with other personnel changes.

articles.title_zh: 国产600公斤推力级涡扇发动机首飞
articles.title_en: Domestic 600kg Thrust Turbofan Engine Completes First Flight
articles.summary_zh: 中国航发集团旗下四川天府轻型动力科技有限公司研制的F406涡扇发动机圆满完成首飞，填补了我国中小推力涡扇发动机领域多项技术空白。
articles.summary_en: The F406 turbofan engine developed by Sichuan Tianfu Light Power Technology Co., Ltd. under AECC successfully completed its first flight, filling several technical gaps in China's small-to-medium thrust turbofan engines.

articles.title_zh: 我国创新药实现跨越式发展
articles.title_en: China's Innovative Drug Industry Achieves Leapfrog Development
articles.summary_zh: 国家药监局数据显示，我国创新药研发实力显著提升，今年已批准上市19款创新药，对外授权交易额创历史新高，审评审批制度改革成效显著。
articles.summary_en: Data from the NMPA indicates a significant boost in China's innovative drug R&D, with 19 new drugs approved this year and record-high outbound licensing, driven by regulatory reforms.

articles.title_zh: 胜利济阳页岩油国家级示范区累产突破200万吨
articles.title_en: Shengli Jiyang Shale Oil National Demonstration Zone's Cumulative Production Exceeds 2 Million Tons
articles.summary_zh: 胜利济阳页岩油国家级示范区累计产量突破200万吨，标志着我国中低成熟度页岩油勘探开发取得历史性突破。
articles.summary_en: The Shengli Jiyang Shale Oil National Demonstration Zone has exceeded 2 million tons in cumulative production, marking a historical breakthrough in China's exploration and development of medium-to-low maturity shale oil.

articles.title_zh: 太原市迎泽区委原书记李慧严重违纪违法被开除党籍和公职
articles.title_en: Former Yingze District Party Secretary Li Hui Expelled from Party and Public Office for Serious Discipline and Law Violations
articles.summary_zh: 山西省纪委监委对太原市迎泽区委原书记李慧进行立案审查调查，决定给予其开除党籍和公职处分，并将其涉嫌犯罪问题移送检察机关起诉。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission expelled Li Hui, former Party Secretary of Yingze District, Taiyuan, from the Party and public office for serious corruption and law violations.

articles.title_zh: 山西省发布2026年军队院校招收普高毕业生政治考核工作安排
articles.title_en: Shanxi Province Releases Political Assessment Arrangements for 2026 Military Academy Admissions for High School Graduates
articles.summary_zh: 山西省招生考试管理中心近日发布通知，明确2026年军队院校招收普高毕业生的政治考核安排，考核将于6月10日至24日开展。
articles.summary_en: The Shanxi Provincial Admissions and Examination Management Center announced the political assessment arrangements for high school graduates applying to military academies in 2026, to be conducted from June 10 to 24.

articles.title_zh: 自治区领导同志古尔邦节前夕看望老同志
articles.title_en: Xinjiang Regional Leaders Visit Veteran Comrades Ahead of Eid al-Adha
articles.summary_zh: 古尔邦节前夕，陈小江、艾尔肯·吐尼亚孜等自治区领导看望了司马义·铁力瓦尔地等老同志，就新疆“十五五”规划及社会稳定工作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: Ahead of Eid al-Adha, regional leaders including Chen Xiaojiang and Erken Tunyaz visited veteran comrades to discuss Xinjiang's 15th Five-Year Plan and social stability.

articles.title_zh: 云南省印发《实施方案》推进产业园区用地专项治理
articles.title_en: Yunnan Province Issues Implementation Plan to Promote Special Governance of Industrial Park Land Use
articles.summary_zh: 云南省自然资源厅等部门印发实施方案，通过五项重点任务推进全省产业园区用地专项治理，旨在优化土地配置，推动经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Department of Natural Resources and other departments issued an implementation plan to govern industrial park land use via five key tasks to optimize land allocation and promote high-quality economic development.

articles.title_zh: 水利部在宁夏召开水预算管理试点建设现场会
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Holds Field Meeting on Water Budget Management Pilots in Ningxia
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，水利部在宁夏银川召开水预算管理试点建设现场会，总结试点成效并部署水预算体系建设重点任务。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, the Ministry of Water Resources held a field meeting in Yinchuan, Ningxia, to summarize the achievements of water budget management pilots and deploy key tasks for the system's construction.

articles.title_zh: 吉林省推进低效闲置资产资源盘活利用，年度处置目标一千亿元
articles.title_en: Jilin Province Promotes Revitalization of Inefficient and Idle Assets with 100 Billion Yuan Annual Target
articles.summary_zh: 5月26日，胡玉亭在专题会议上强调，吉林省要锚定一千亿元的低效闲置资产盘活处置年度目标，通过创新举措释放资源价值，赋能高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 26, Hu Yuting emphasized at a special meeting that Jilin Province aims to revitalize 100 billion yuan of inefficient and idle assets to release resource value and empower high-quality development.

articles.title_zh: 白景富同志逝世
articles.title_en: Comrade Bai Jingfu Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 公安部原主持常务工作的副部长、党委副书记白景富同志于2026年4月29日在北京逝世，享年81岁。
articles.summary_en: Bai Jingfu, former Vice Minister and Deputy Party Secretary of the Ministry of Public Security, passed away in Beijing on April 29, 2026, at the age of 81.

articles.title_zh: 海南全面启动2026年林草湿荒调查监测工作
articles.title_en: Hainan Fully Launches 2026 Forest, Grassland, Wetland, and Desertification Survey and Monitoring Work
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日，海南省在海口启动2026年林草湿荒调查监测工作，由省自然资源和规划厅与省林业局联合部署，旨在为自贸港建设提供生态支撑。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, Hainan Province launched the 2026 forest, grassland, wetland, and desertification survey in Haikou to provide ecological support for the Free Trade Port construction.

articles.title_zh: 最高检挂牌督办山西沁源煤矿爆炸重大责任事故案
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Procuratorate Supervises Investigation into Major Coal Mine Explosion in Qinyuan, Shanxi
articles.summary_zh: 5月22日山西沁源县发生煤矿瓦斯爆炸造成重大人员伤亡，最高检现已挂牌督办，要求依法严惩事故主要责任人员。
articles.summary_en: The Supreme People's Procuratorate is supervising the investigation into a gas explosion at a coal mine in Qinyuan, Shanxi on May 22, which caused massive casualties, and has called for strict punishment of those responsible.

articles.title_zh: 留神峪煤矿瓦斯爆炸事故暴露隐蔽工作面等重大违法行为
articles.title_en: Liushenyu Coal Mine Gas Explosion Reveals Major Illegalities Including Hidden Working Faces
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月22日山西长治留神峪煤矿发生瓦斯爆炸造成重大伤亡，初步调查显示该矿存在隐蔽工作面、人员无定位卡等重大违法行为。
articles.summary_en: A gas explosion at Liushenyu Coal Mine in Changzhi, Shanxi on May 22, 2026, caused significant casualties. Preliminary investigations reveal major illegalities, including hidden working faces and lack of personnel positioning cards.

articles.title_zh: 云南首个新的社会阶层人士服务中心成立
articles.title_en: First Service Center for New Social Strata Established in Yunnan
articles.summary_zh: 5月22日，云南首个新的社会阶层人士服务中心在昆明市五华区揭牌，旨在构建引领服务新阶层人士的核心枢纽平台。
articles.summary_en: On May 22, Yunnan's first service center for new social strata was unveiled in Wuhua District, Kunming, aiming to build a hub for guiding and serving new social strata.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同塞尔维亚总统武契奇会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月25日，国家主席习近平在北京同塞尔维亚总统武契奇举行会谈，双方签署多项合作文件并发表联合声明，旨在深化中塞全面战略伙伴关系。
articles.summary_en: On May 25, 2026, President Xi Jinping held talks with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić in Beijing. The two sides signed over 20 cooperation documents and issued joint statements to deepen the China-Serbia comprehensive strategic partnership.

tags.name_en: China-Serbia Community with a Shared Future

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明在常德检查督导防汛救灾和烟花爆竹产业安全整治
articles.title_en: Shen Xiaoming Inspects Flood Relief and Fireworks Industry Safety in Changde
articles.summary_zh: 5月23日至24日，湖南省委书记沈晓明在常德市检查督导防汛救灾和烟花爆竹产业风险隐患排查整治工作，强调要牢牢守住群众生命财产安全底线。
articles.summary_en: From May 23 to 24, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming inspected flood relief and fireworks industry safety in Changde, emphasizing the need to safeguard people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 海淀南开雄安签署人才协同发展合作框架协议
articles.title_en: Haidian, Nankai, and Xiong'an Sign Framework Agreement on Collaborative Talent Development
articles.summary_zh: 5月23日，北京市海淀区、天津市南开区与河北省雄安新区签署人才协同发展合作框架协议，旨在深化人才交流、平台共建及产业协作。
articles.summary_en: On May 23, Haidian District (Beijing), Nankai District (Tianjin), and Xiong'an New Area (Hebei) signed a framework agreement to deepen collaboration in talent exchange, platform construction, and industrial synergy.

articles.title_zh: 神舟二十三号载人飞船成功发射
articles.title_en: Shenzhou-23 Manned Spacecraft Successfully Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月24日，神舟二十三号载人飞船在酒泉卫星发射中心成功发射，首位香港航天员黎家盈随行，任务重点包括太空水稻培养及飞船舷窗升级。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, 2026, the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft was successfully launched from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, featuring the first astronaut from Hong Kong, Li Jiaying.

articles.title_zh: 武契奇访华首站登长城
articles.title_en: Serbian President Vučić Visits Great Wall as First Stop of China Trip
articles.summary_zh: 塞尔维亚总统武契奇于5月24日对中国进行国事访问，首站登上北京八达岭长城，赞赏中国文化并期待拓展科技合作。
articles.summary_en: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić visited the Badaling Great Wall in Beijing on May 24 as the first stop of his state visit to China, praising Chinese culture and seeking expanded cooperation in technology.

articles.title_zh: 港人见证黎家盈搭乘神舟二十三号飞船发射升空
articles.title_en: Hong Kong Residents Witness Launch of Shenzhou-23 with Astronaut Li Jiaying
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月24日，神舟二十三号载人飞船发射升空，香港航天员黎家盈成为第四位飞向太空的中国女性。香港特区政府代表团赴酒泉观礼，强调香港融入国家发展大局。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, 2026, the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft was launched, with Hong Kong astronaut Li Jiaying becoming the fourth Chinese woman to enter space. A HK SAR government delegation witnessed the event in Jiuquan.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和塞尔维亚共和国关于持续推进构建新时代中塞命运共同体的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement between the People's Republic of China and the Republic of Serbia on Continuing to Build a China-Serbia Community with a Shared Future in the New Era
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月24日至28日，塞尔维亚总统武契奇对中国进行国事访问。习近平主席同武契奇总统举行会晤，双方发表联合声明，旨在深化中塞命运共同体建设及全方位互利合作。
articles.summary_en: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić paid a state visit to China from May 24 to 28, 2026. President Xi Jinping held a meeting with him, and both sides issued a joint statement to deepen the China-Serbia community with a shared future and all-round cooperation.

articles.title_zh: 中华人民共和国和塞尔维亚共和国关于共同推动落实四大全球倡议的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement of the People's Republic of China and the Republic of Serbia on Jointly Promoting the Implementation of the Four Global Initiatives
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月24日至28日，塞尔维亚总统武契奇对中国进行国事访问，中塞两国发表联合声明，同意共同推动落实四大全球倡议。
articles.summary_en: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić paid a state visit to China from May 24 to 28, 2026, where both nations issued a joint statement to jointly promote the implementation of the four global initiatives.

articles.title_zh: 李家超祝贺神舟二十三号载人飞船成功发射
articles.title_en: John Lee Congratulates Successful Launch of Shenzhou-23 Manned Spacecraft
articles.summary_zh: 5月24日，香港特区行政长官李家超祝贺神舟二十三号载人飞船成功发射，并强调香港专家参与此次任务标志着香港更好融入国家航天事业。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee congratulated the successful launch of the Shenzhou-23 spacecraft, highlighting the participation of a Hong Kong expert as a milestone in integrating into national space efforts.

articles.title_zh: 108岁红军老战士、开国上校马志选逝世
articles.title_en: 108-Year-Old Red Army Veteran and Founding Colonel Ma Zhixuan Passes Away
articles.summary_zh: 红军老战士、原总后太原基地兵站副站长马志选同志于2026年5月24日在太原逝世，享年108岁。
articles.summary_en: Ma Zhixuan, a Red Army veteran and former deputy station chief of the Taiyuan Base Station of the General Logistics Department, passed away in Taiyuan on May 24, 2026, at the age of 108.

articles.title_zh: 2026京津冀科普资源地图发布

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Beijing Science Week launched with the joint release of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Science Popularization Resource Map, featuring 62 quality sites to promote regional resource sharing.

articles.title_zh: 西洽会签约212个重大项目
articles.title_en: West China International Fair Signs 212 Major Projects
articles.summary_zh: 第八届中国西部国际投资贸易洽谈会于5月24日在重庆收官，累计签约重大项目212个，旨在推动西部地区对外开放与产业升级。
articles.summary_en: The 8th China West International Investment and Trade Fair concluded in Chongqing on May 24, signing 212 major projects to promote opening-up and industrial upgrading in Western China.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军指挥调度重庆市防汛救灾工作并召开会议
articles.title_en: Yuan Jiajun Directs Flood Control and Disaster Relief Efforts in Chongqing
articles.summary_zh: 5月24日，重庆市委书记袁家军指挥调度严重洪涝和地质灾害抢险救灾工作并召开防汛工作会议，强调要切实维护人民群众生命财产安全。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, Chongqing Municipal Party Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun directed emergency rescue efforts for severe floods and geological disasters and chaired a flood control meeting to ensure public safety.

articles.title_zh: 水利部针对安徽、河南、重庆、陕西启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Water Resources Launches Level IV Emergency Response for Flood Defense in Anhui, Henan, Chongqing, and Shaanxi
articles.summary_zh: 水利部于5月24日针对安徽、河南、重庆、陕西等省市启动洪水防御Ⅳ级应急响应，并部署相关防御措施以应对强降雨过程。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, the Ministry of Water Resources launched a Level IV emergency response for flood defense in Anhui, Henan, Chongqing, and Shaanxi to cope with predicted heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 提振消费专项行动实施一年多来成效明显
articles.title_en: Significant Results Achieved After Over a Year of Special Action to Boost Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 2025年3月中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅印发《提振消费专项行动方案》，实施一年多来在商品、服务及新型消费领域成效显著，有力支撑经济增长。
articles.summary_en: Since the 'Special Action Plan to Boost Consumption' was issued by the CPC Central Committee and State Council in March 2025, significant progress has been made in commodity, service, and new consumption sectors, supporting economic growth.

articles.summary_en: On May 24, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Safety Production Committee Office and the Mine Safety Supervision Bureau deployed gas prevention work in coal mines and launched comprehensive safety inspections.

articles.summary_en: The 2026 Inner Mongolia Science and Technology Activity Week launched in Hinggan League on May 24, featuring innovation showcases, cooperation signings, and platform unveilings to drive regional development.

articles.title_zh: 国家卫生健康委全力支持伤员救治和心理疏导
articles.title_en: National Health Commission Fully Supports Injury Treatment and Psychological Counseling

articles.summary_en: On May 24, the National Health Commission organized expert teams to Shanxi Province to provide medical treatment and psychological support for victims of the Liushenyu coal mine gas explosion.

articles.title_zh: 陈小江在博州督导中央生态环境保护督察整改工作
articles.title_en: Chen Xiaojiang Supervises Rectification of Central Ecological and Environmental Protection Inspections in Bortala Mongol Autonomous Prefecture
articles.summary_zh: 5月24日，自治区党委书记陈小江在博尔塔拉蒙古自治州督导中央生态环境保护督察整改工作，强调要走生态优先绿色发展之路，统筹发展与安全。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, Chen Xiaojiang, Secretary of the Autonomous Region Party Committee, supervised the rectification of central ecological and environmental protection inspections in Bortala Mongol Autonomous Prefecture.

articles.title_zh: 应急管理部针对安徽启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应
articles.title_en: Ministry of Emergency Management Launches Level IV National Emergency Response for Geological Disasters in Anhui
articles.summary_zh: 应急管理部于5月24日针对安徽省启动国家地质灾害四级应急响应，以应对预测的大暴雨及地质灾害风险。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, the Ministry of Emergency Management launched a Level IV national emergency response for geological disasters in Anhui Province to address risks from predicted heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 今年首个红色预警发布，安徽和湖北局地有特大暴雨
articles.title_en: First Red Warning of the Year Issued for Extreme Rainstorms in Anhui and Hubei

articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Water Resources and China Meteorological Administration issued the first red mountain flood warning of the year on May 24, forecasting extreme rainstorms in parts of Anhui and Hubei.

articles.title_zh: 袁家军部署重庆市防汛救灾工作

articles.summary_en: On May 24, Chongqing Municipal Committee Secretary Yuan Jiajun directed emergency rescue efforts and chaired a flood control meeting to ensure the safety of people's lives and property.

articles.title_zh: 我国将适时发布以粤港澳大湾区为整体的外贸数据
articles.title_en: China to Release Integrated Foreign Trade Data for Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
articles.summary_zh: 海关总署出台支持粤港澳大湾区建设措施，将联合港澳研究并适时发布大湾区整体对外货物贸易统计数据，以提升市场一体化水平。
articles.summary_en: The General Administration of Customs issued measures to support the GBA, including collaborating with Hong Kong and Macao to release integrated foreign trade statistics to enhance market integration.

articles.title_zh: 陈刚韦韬会见国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室副主任陈敏一行
articles.title_en: Chen Gang and Wei Tao Meet with Chen Min, Deputy Director of the National Committee for Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief
articles.summary_zh: 5月24日，广西壮族自治区党委书记陈刚、自治区主席韦韬在南宁会见国家防灾减灾救灾委员会办公室副主任陈敏一行，就柳州抗震救灾和灾后恢复重建工作进行交流。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, Guangxi Party Secretary Chen Gang and Chairman Wei Tao met with Chen Min, Deputy Director of the National Committee for Disaster Prevention, Reduction and Relief, in Nanning to discuss earthquake relief and recovery in Liuzhou.

articles.title_zh: 2026年河南省科技活动周启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Henan Province Science and Technology Activity Week Launches

articles.summary_en: On May 24, 2026, the 2026 Henan Province Science and Technology Activity Week launched in Puyang. Vice Governor Song Zhenghui attended and announced the start of the event.

articles.title_zh: 毛伟明检查煤矿安全监管工作
articles.title_en: Mao Weiming Inspects Coal Mine Safety Supervision Work
articles.summary_zh: 5月24日，湖南省长毛伟明检查省能源集团煤矿安全监管工作，要求开展隐患大排查大整治，切实提升煤矿本质安全水平。
articles.summary_en: On May 24, Hunan Governor Mao Weiming inspected coal mine safety supervision at the Provincial Energy Group, calling for comprehensive risk rectification to enhance intrinsic safety.

articles.title_zh: 各地各部门全力做好防汛抗洪工作
articles.title_en: Various Regions and Departments Fully Engage in Flood Control and Disaster Relief
articles.summary_zh: 面对近期多地强降雨，国家防总、水利部等部门组织调度，湖南、湖北、重庆等省市全力开展防汛抗洪与救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: In response to recent heavy rains, the National Flood Control Headquarters and the Ministry of Water Resources have coordinated efforts as provinces like Hunan, Hubei, and Chongqing implement flood control and disaster relief.

articles.title_zh: 张工会见乌兹别克斯坦塔什干市市长乌穆尔扎科夫
articles.title_en: Zhang Gong Meets Mayor of Tashkent Umurzakov

articles.summary_en: On May 24, Tianjin Mayor Zhang Gong met with Tashkent Mayor Umurzakov in Tianjin to discuss strengthening cooperation in trade, investment, infrastructure, and higher education.

articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月21日，国务院总理李强在北京主持召开国务院常务会议，研究推进全国统一大市场建设，审议通过现代化应急体系建设“十五五”规划，并讨论中国人民银行法修订草案。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, 2026, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting in Beijing to study the construction of a national unified market, approve the 15th Five-Year Plan for a modern emergency system, and discuss the revised Law of the People's Bank of China.

articles.title_zh: 长三角一体化发展实事项目清单发布
articles.title_en: List of Practical Projects for Yangtze River Delta Integration Released
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，第八届长三角一体化发展高层论坛在上海举行，发布了2026年度实事项目清单、第三批创新联合体名单及省际交通高质量互联互通行动。
articles.summary_en: The 8th Yangtze River Delta Integration High-level Forum was held in Shanghai on May 21, releasing the 2026 practical project list, the 3rd batch of innovation consortia, and an inter-provincial transportation action plan.

articles.title_zh: 加快推动健康医疗数据高水平供给高效能治理高质量应用
articles.title_en: Accelerating High-Level Supply, High-Efficiency Governance, and High-Quality Application of Health and Medical Data
articles.summary_zh: 北京市委书记尹力调研健康医疗数据应用发展工作，强调要深化数据要素市场化配置改革，以数智赋能推动健康北京建设。
articles.summary_en: Yin Li, Secretary of the Beijing Municipal Party Committee, inspected the development of health and medical data applications, emphasizing the need to deepen market-oriented data allocation reforms to empower the construction of a 'Healthy Beijing'.

articles.title_zh: 进一步安排部署重点地区防汛救灾工作
articles.title_en: Further Deployment of Flood Control and Disaster Relief Work in Key Areas
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，国家防总办公室在北京组织视频会商，调度多个重点省份，部署应对中东部新一轮强降雨的防汛救灾工作。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, the Office of the State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters held a video meeting in Beijing to deploy flood control and disaster relief efforts across several key provinces facing heavy rainfall.

articles.title_zh: 规范涉企行政执法专项行动取得明显成效
articles.title_en: Special Action to Regulate Administrative Law Enforcement Involving Enterprises Achieves Significant Results
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，国务院新闻办举行发布会，通报规范涉企行政执法专项行动成果，共查纠案件线索6.6万多件，为企业挽回经济损失307亿元。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, the State Council Information Office held a press conference reporting that a special action to regulate administrative law enforcement involving enterprises has investigated over 66,000 cases and recovered 30.7 billion yuan for businesses.

articles.title_zh: 今年全国夏收夏种气象服务启动
articles.title_en: National Summer Harvest and Planting Meteorological Services Launched for 2026
articles.summary_zh: 中国气象局于5月21日在北京启动2026年全国夏收夏种气象服务，由中央气象台发布首份气象服务专报以支持农业生产。
articles.summary_en: The China Meteorological Administration launched the 2026 national summer harvest and planting meteorological services in Beijing on May 21, with the Central Meteorological Observatory issuing the first special report.

articles.title_zh: “数字丝路·文通四海”敦煌文化全球传播计划在深圳启动
articles.title_en: "Digital Silk Road · Culture Connecting the Four Seas" Dunhuang Culture Global Communication Plan Launched in Shenzhen

articles.summary_en: On May 21, the Gansu International Communication Center and Dunhuang Academy launched the "Digital Silk Road · Culture Connecting the Four Seas" plan in Shenzhen to promote Dunhuang culture globally via digital means.

articles.title_zh: 广西南宁数据领域国际合作试点启动

articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，广西南宁市正式启动数据领域国际合作试点工作，旨在聚焦中国—东盟数据流通与算力协同，打造面向东盟的数据开放合作高地。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, Nanning, Guangxi officially launched a pilot program for international cooperation in the data field to build a hub for open data cooperation with ASEAN.

articles.title_zh: 雄安新区至大兴机场快线计划下半年建成投运
articles.title_en: Xiongan New Area to Daxing Airport Express Planned for Operation in Second Half of Year

articles.summary_en: The Hebei Provincial Government Information Office announced that the Xiongan New Area to Daxing Airport Express is planned to be completed and operational in the second half of 2026 to enhance regional transportation integration.

articles.title_zh: 扎实推进“十五五”时期海南金融业高质量发展
articles.title_en: Solidly Promoting High-Quality Development of Hainan's Financial Industry During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月21日，海南省委金融委召开会议，由省委书记冯飞主持，谋划“十五五”时期海南金融业高质量发展及自由贸易港建设。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, 2026, the Hainan Provincial Financial Committee held a meeting chaired by Party Secretary Feng Fei to plan the high-quality development of the financial industry during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: “开局起步‘十五五’”黑龙江省专题新闻发布会举行
articles.title_en: Special Press Conference on the "15th Five-Year Plan" Held in Heilongjiang Province
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，黑龙江省在哈尔滨举行“十五五”规划专题新闻发布会，省长梁惠玲介绍规划纲要，部署高质量振兴发展及现代化强省建设。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, Heilongjiang Province held a press conference in Harbin. Governor Liang Huiling introduced the "15th Five-Year Plan" outline to promote high-quality revitalization and the construction of a modern strong province.

articles.title_zh: 黑龙江在全面振兴中开创新局面
articles.title_en: Heilongjiang Opens New Chapter in Comprehensive Revitalization
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，黑龙江省在哈尔滨举行“十五五”专题新闻发布会，省长梁惠玲部署了关于粮食安全、科技创新及冰雪经济的高质量发展目标。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, Heilongjiang Province held a press conference in Harbin to outline its '15th Five-Year Plan,' focusing on food security, technological innovation, and the ice and snow economy.

articles.title_zh: 李书磊参观深圳文博会江西馆
articles.title_en: Li Shulei Visits Jiangxi Pavilion at Shenzhen Cultural Industries Fair

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Li Shulei, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and head of the Publicity Department, visited the Jiangxi Pavilion at the 22nd China (Shenzhen) International Cultural Industries Fair to inspect cultural heritage preservation.

articles.title_en: Promoting Rectification of High-Standard Farmland Construction to Consolidate Food Security Foundation

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Chen Yongqi, Deputy Secretary of the Jiangxi Provincial Party Committee, attended a video conference on rectifying high-standard farmland construction to ensure national food security.

articles.title_zh: 包钢调研全区审计工作

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Bao Gang, Chairman of the Autonomous Region People's Government, visited the Audit Office to emphasize enhancing audit efficiency through AI and big data to ensure the implementation of regional party deployments.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区政协召开主席会议研究“一委一品”和“四库”建设

articles.summary_en: On May 21, the Inner Mongolia CPPCC held its 77th chairman's meeting, presided over by Zhang Yankun, to discuss the 'One Committee, One Brand' and 'Four Databases' initiatives.

articles.title_zh: 全区树立和践行正确政绩观学习教育警示教育会召开
articles.title_en: Warning Education Meeting on Establishing and Practicing Correct View of Political Achievements Held in Inner Mongolia
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，内蒙古自治区党委召开学习教育警示教育会，由王伟中主持并讲话，旨在引导党员干部树立正确政绩观，纠治形式主义和官僚主义。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Party Committee held a warning education meeting chaired by Wang Weizhong to guide party members in establishing a correct view of political achievements and combating formalism.

articles.title_zh: 内蒙古自治区十四届人大常委会第二十八次会议闭幕
articles.title_en: The 28th Meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Congress Concludes
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，内蒙古自治区十四届人大常委会第二十八次会议闭幕，表决通过了征兵工作条例（修订）等多项地方性法规及人事任免事项。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, the 28th meeting of the 14th Standing Committee of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region People's Congress concluded, passing several local regulations including the Conscription Work Regulations and personnel appointments.

articles.title_zh: 王毅同摩尔多瓦副总理兼外长波普绍伊会谈
articles.title_en: Wang Yi Holds Talks with Moldovan Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Popșoi
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，外交部长王毅在京同摩尔多瓦副总理兼外长波普绍伊举行会谈，双方就共建“一带一路”、多边主义及乌克兰危机等议题交换意见。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks with Moldovan Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Popșoi in Beijing to discuss the Belt and Road Initiative, multilateralism, and the Ukraine crisis.

articles.title_zh: 青海文化产业新成果亮相深圳文博会
articles.title_en: New Achievements of Qinghai's Cultural Industry Showcased at Shenzhen Cultural Fair
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，李书磊、黄坤明等领导在深圳考察第二十二届中国（深圳）国际文化产业博览交易会青海展区，肯定青海文化产业发展成效。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, Li Shulei and Huang Kunming visited the Qinghai exhibition area at the 22nd China (Shenzhen) International Cultural Industries Fair to review and affirm the province's cultural industry achievements.

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Wang Xiaohui, Secretary of the Sichuan Provincial Party Committee, chaired a special meeting to deploy the concentrated governance of petition issues in the field of people's livelihood.

articles.title_zh: 临港“零碳湾”国家级零碳园区正式启动建设
articles.title_en: Construction of Lingang "Zero Carbon Bay" National Zero-Carbon Park Officially Launched

articles.summary_en: On May 21, 2026, the "Zero Carbon Bay" national-level zero-carbon park pilot was launched in Shanghai's Lingang New Area to promote green high-quality development of key industries.

articles.title_en: Work Promotion Meeting for Joint Central-Local Construction of Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Science and Technology Innovation Center Held in Shanghai

articles.summary_en: On May 21, 2026, a work promotion meeting for the joint central-local construction of the Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) International Science and Technology Innovation Center was held in Shanghai to deploy strategies for building a science and technology powerhouse.

articles.summary_en: The 8th Yangtze River Delta Integration Development High-level Forum was held in Shanghai on May 21, 2026. Leaders from Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Anhui discussed high-quality development and regional integration mechanisms.

articles.title_zh: 山西坚定有序推进转型发展
articles.title_en: Shanxi Firmly and Orderly Promotes Transformation and Development

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang held a press conference in Taiyuan to outline the province's strategic plans for energy transition, industrial upgrading, and diversified development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.summary_en: On May 21, 2026, the Human Resources Service Alliance of Eight Cities in Northern Anhui was established during a matching conference in Huaibei to enhance regional labor synergy.

articles.summary_en: The 8th China Western International Fair for Investment and Trade opened in Chongqing on May 21. Municipal Party Secretary Yuan Jiajun attended and delivered a speech to promote industrial cooperation and opening-up.

articles.title_zh: 重庆发布投资机会清单，总投资规模5794.6亿元

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Chongqing released the 'Investment Chongqing Opportunity List' at the 8th Western China International Fair, featuring 277 projects with a total investment of 579.46 billion yuan to attract global cooperation.

articles.summary_en: On May 21, 2026, a promotion conference for Changdu, Tibet, was held in Chongqing, resulting in the signing of 22 cooperation projects with a total investment of 3.496 billion yuan.

articles.title_en: 2026 Top 30 National Growth Cultural Enterprises List Released, Guangxi Companies Selected

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Guangming Daily and Economic Daily released the '2026 Top 30 National Growth Cultural Enterprises' list in Shenzhen, with Guangxi Shanhai Xingchen Media Group selected.

articles.title_zh: 广西在第二十二届中国（深圳）国际文博会签约9个重点文化产业项目

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Guangxi signed nine key cultural industry cooperation projects totaling over 278 million yuan during the opening of the 22nd China (Shenzhen) International Cultural Industries Fair.

articles.title_zh: 王凯到郑州调研新型基础设施建设工作

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Governor Wang Kai visited Zhengzhou to research new infrastructure construction, emphasizing the role of new infrastructure in promoting green transition and developing new quality productive forces.

articles.title_zh: 沈晓明主持召开省委常委会会议

articles.summary_en: On May 21, Hunan Provincial Party Secretary Shen Xiaoming chaired a Standing Committee meeting to deploy the construction of a modern industrial system and address corruption and inspection rectification.

articles.title_zh: 亚太工商界伙伴关系对话会暨2026苏州全球招商大会在苏州举行

articles.summary_en: On May 21, 2026, the Asia-Pacific Business Partnership Dialogue and Suzhou Global Investment Promotion Conference were held in Suzhou, attracting over 200 global executives to discuss industrial cooperation and the business environment.

articles.summary_en: On May 21, the Jiangsu Provincial Government released a set of policy measures featuring 23 specific actions to support urban renewal in planning, land, and funding to promote high-quality urban development.

articles.title_zh: 山东省出台“人工智能+制造”行动方案

articles.summary_en: The Shandong Provincial Government Information Office interpreted the "AI + Manufacturing" Action Plan (2026-2028) on the 21st, aiming to deepen AI application in manufacturing through six special actions.

articles.title_zh: 天津市委常委会召开会议 陈敏尔主持并讲话
