articles.summary_zh: 我国将构建全国统一的数据产权登记体系，旨在通过明确数据权属，打破数据孤岛，助力培育全国一体化数据市场并赋能中小企业。
articles.summary_en: China is establishing a unified national data property rights registration system to clarify ownership, eliminate data silos, and foster an integrated national data market.

articles.title_zh: 四川发布一批干部任前公示 涉厅级领导职务
articles.title_en: Sichuan Publishes Pre-appointment Public Notices for Cadres Including Department-level Positions
articles.summary_zh: 四川省委组织部发布一批干部任前公示，涉及李辉、宋光辉等拟任厅级及县区领导职务的干部。
articles.summary_en: The Organization Department of the CPC Sichuan Provincial Committee released pre-appointment notices for several cadres, including Li Hui and Song Guanghui, for department-level and county-level positions.

articles.title_zh: 新华网与成都艺术职业大学签署合作协议赋能AIGC人才培养
articles.title_en: Xinhua Net and Chengdu Arts Vocational University Sign Agreement to Empower AIGC Talent Cultivation
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，新华网与成都艺术职业大学在成都签署合作协议，依托“新华语典”AI智能体，共同探索AIGC领域的人才培养与产教融合新路径。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, Xinhua Net and Chengdu Arts Vocational University signed a cooperation agreement in Chengdu to explore new paths for AIGC talent cultivation and industry-education integration using the 'Xinhua Dictionary' AI agent.

articles.title_zh: 山西加快打造新能源金属和半导体材料产业链
articles.title_en: Shanxi Accelerates Development of New Energy Metal and Semiconductor Material Industry Chains
articles.summary_zh: 5月21日，山西省省长卢东亮在太原举行的新闻发布会上表示，山西将利用资源优势打造新能源金属和半导体材料产业链，以保障国家产业链供应链安全。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, Shanxi Governor Lu Dongliang announced at a press conference in Taiyuan that the province will leverage its resource advantages to build industry chains for new energy metals and semiconductor materials to ensure national supply chain security.

articles.title_zh: 山西出台36项举措推动服务消费高质量发展
articles.title_en: Shanxi Introduces 36 Measures to Promote High-Quality Development of Service Consumption
articles.summary_zh: 山西省商务厅等10部门联合印发相关措施，聚焦文旅、体育、养老等十大领域推出36项举措，旨在扩大内需并推动经济转型升级。
articles.summary_en: Ten departments in Shanxi Province, including the Department of Commerce, issued measures featuring 36 initiatives across ten sectors such as culture, tourism, and elderly care to expand domestic demand and upgrade the economy.

articles.title_zh: 长江大保护战略实施十年思客会倒计时1天
articles.title_en: Countdown to the 10th Anniversary Think Tank Meeting on the Yangtze River Protection Strategy
articles.summary_zh: “长江大保护战略实施十年思客会”将于5月22日在中共武汉市委党校举行，旨在交流经验并发布权威成果，推动长江流域生态环境向好。
articles.summary_en: The 10th Anniversary Think Tank Meeting on the Yangtze River Protection Strategy will be held on May 22 at the Party School of the CPC Wuhan Municipal Committee to discuss ecological improvements.

articles.title_zh: 2026年北京科技周5月24日启动
articles.title_en: 2026 Beijing Science and Technology Week to Launch on May 24
articles.summary_zh: 2026年北京科技周将于5月24日启动，由北京市科委、中关村管委会等部门组织，推出京津冀科普资源地图及系列科普活动。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Beijing Science and Technology Week will start on May 24, featuring the release of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Science Popularization Resource Map and various educational activities.

articles.title_zh: 2026上海国际碳中和博览会6月启幕
articles.title_en: 2026 Shanghai International Carbon Neutrality Expo to Open in June
articles.summary_zh: 2026上海国际碳中和博览会将于6月10日至12日在上海举办，汇聚近300家企业展示绿色低碳发展前沿成果及关键技术。
articles.summary_en: The 2026 Shanghai International Carbon Neutrality Expo will be held from June 10 to 12 in Shanghai, featuring nearly 300 companies showcasing cutting-edge achievements and key technologies in green and low-carbon development.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同普京共同出席“中俄教育年”开幕式
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin Jointly Attend Opening Ceremony of China-Russia Education Year
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，国家主席习近平与俄罗斯总统普京在北京共同出席“中俄教育年”开幕式，强调深化两国教育合作与人才培养。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, President Xi Jinping and President Vladimir Putin jointly attended the opening ceremony of the China-Russia Education Year in Beijing, emphasizing the deepening of educational cooperation and talent cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 最高法发布5件民法典遗产管理人制度典型案例
articles.title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Five Typical Cases on Estate Administrator System of Civil Code
articles.summary_zh: 最高人民法院于5月21日发布5件民法典遗产管理人制度典型案例，旨在破解遗产债务清偿难题并维护继承人及债权人合法权益。
articles.summary_en: On May 21, the Supreme People's Court released five typical cases regarding the estate administrator system of the Civil Code to resolve debt repayment issues and protect the legal rights of heirs and creditors.

articles.title_zh: 规范涉企行政执法专项行动已为企业挽回经济损失307亿元
articles.title_en: Special Action to Regulate Administrative Law Enforcement for Enterprises Recovers 30.7 Billion Yuan in Losses
articles.summary_zh: 国务院新闻办公室5月21日举行发布会，介绍规范涉企行政执法专项行动成效，共为企业挽回经济损失307亿元。
articles.summary_en: The State Council Information Office held a press conference on May 21 to report that a special action to regulate administrative law enforcement has recovered 30.7 billion yuan for enterprises.

articles.title_zh: 中欧联合研制的“微笑”卫星成功发射
articles.title_en: China-EU Jointly Developed "SMILE" Satellite Successfully Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月19日，中欧联合研制的“微笑”卫星在法属圭亚那成功发射，旨在实现太阳风与地球磁层相互作用的整体成像观测。
articles.summary_en: On May 19, 2026, the China-EU jointly developed "SMILE" satellite was successfully launched from French Guiana to conduct panoramic imaging of the interaction between solar wind and Earth's magnetosphere.

articles.title_zh: 2026港澳山东周开幕式暨鲁港协同发展交流会在香港举行
articles.title_en: Opening Ceremony of 2026 Hong Kong and Macao Shandong Week and Shandong-Hong Kong Collaborative Development Exchange Meeting Held in Hong Kong
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月19日，2026港澳山东周开幕式暨鲁港协同发展交流会在香港举行。省政协主席葛慧君宣布开幕并作主旨演讲，现场签约18个重点合作项目。
articles.summary_en: On May 19, 2026, the opening ceremony of the 2026 Hong Kong and Macao Shandong Week and the Shandong-Hong Kong Collaborative Development Exchange Meeting were held in Hong Kong, featuring a keynote speech by Ge Huijun and the signing of 18 cooperation projects.

articles.title_zh: 全国统一数据产权登记制度将加快建立
articles.title_en: National Unified Data Property Rights Registration System to be Accelerated
articles.summary_zh: 国家数据局5月19日印发《2026年数字经济发展工作要点》，部署包括建立全国统一数据产权登记制度在内的8项重点任务，以推进数字经济高质量发展。
articles.summary_en: On May 19, the National Data Bureau issued the '2026 Digital Economy Development Work Points,' outlining eight key tasks, including the establishment of a national unified data property rights registration system.

articles.title_zh: 郑丽文称全世界都不支持“台独”
articles.title_en: Zheng Liwen States the Whole World Does Not Support 'Taiwan Independence'
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日，中国国民党主席郑丽文主持中常会，批评“台独”主张及赖清德的言论；同日，国台办强调只有一个中国，要求民进党废弃“台独党纲”。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, KMT Chair Zheng Liwen criticized 'Taiwan independence' and Lai Ching-te during a party meeting. Simultaneously, the Taiwan Affairs Office reiterated the One China principle and urged the DPP to abandon its 'Taiwan independence' platform.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同俄罗斯总统普京共同出席“中俄教育年”开幕式并致辞
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin Jointly Attend Opening Ceremony of 'China-Russia Year of Education'
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日下午，国家主席习近平与俄罗斯总统普京在北京人民大会堂共同出席“中俄教育年”开幕式并致辞，强调深化两国教育合作与人才培养。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin attended the opening ceremony of the 'China-Russia Year of Education' in Beijing, emphasizing the deepening of educational cooperation and talent cultivation.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同俄罗斯总统普京会谈
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping Holds Talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，国家主席习近平在北京同俄罗斯总统普京举行会谈，双方同意延期《中俄睦邻友好合作条约》并签署联合声明及多项合作文件。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, President Xi Jinping held talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Beijing. Both sides agreed to extend the Treaty of Good-Neighborliness and Friendly Cooperation and signed a joint statement and 20 cooperation documents.

articles.title_zh: 习近平同俄罗斯总统普京共同会见记者
articles.title_en: Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin Jointly Meet the Press
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，国家主席习近平在北京同俄罗斯总统普京会谈后共同会见记者，双方签署联合声明并就深化全面战略协作、推动全球治理达成共识。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin jointly met the press in Beijing after talks, signing joint statements to deepen strategic coordination and global governance.

articles.title_zh: 中俄关于倡导世界多极化和新型国际关系的联合声明
articles.title_en: Joint Statement of the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation on Advocating for World Multipolarity and a New Type of International Relations
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，中国和俄罗斯在北京发表联合声明，倡导平等有序的世界多极化，构建公正合理的全球治理体系和新型国际关系。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, China and Russia issued a joint statement in Beijing advocating for an equal and orderly multipolar world and the construction of a fair global governance system and new international relations.

articles.title_zh: 俄罗斯总统普京访华期间两国元首会晤成果文件清单
articles.title_en: List of Outcome Documents from the Meeting Between the Two Heads of State During Russian President Putin's Visit to China
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月20日，俄罗斯总统普京访华期间，中俄两国元首会晤并签署了一系列涵盖战略协作、贸易、科技、教育等领域的成果文件。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, during Russian President Putin's visit to China, the two heads of state met and signed a series of outcome documents covering strategic coordination, trade, science, technology, and education.

articles.title_zh: 李强签署国务院令公布《中华人民共和国矿产资源法实施条例》
articles.title_en: Li Qiang Signs State Council Decree to Publish Implementing Regulations of the Mineral Resources Law
articles.summary_zh: 国务院总理李强日前签署国务院令，公布《中华人民共和国矿产资源法实施条例》，旨在保障矿产资源合理开发利用及安全，自2026年6月15日起施行。
articles.summary_en: Premier Li Qiang signed a State Council decree to publish the Implementing Regulations of the Mineral Resources Law, aimed at ensuring the rational development and security of mineral resources, effective June 15, 2026.

articles.title_zh: 山东日照探索推进全域美丽海湾建设
articles.title_en: Rizhao, Shandong Explores the Promotion of All-Region Beautiful Bay Construction
articles.summary_zh: 山东日照市通过实施“湾长制”和生态修复，推进全域美丽海湾建设，实现了生态保护与经济发展的共赢。
articles.summary_en: Rizhao, Shandong is promoting the construction of "Beautiful Bays" through the "Bay Chief System" and ecological restoration, achieving a win-win for environmental protection and economic growth.

articles.title_zh: 三部门开展2026年“数贸汇英才”面向高校毕业生招聘活动
articles.title_en: Three Departments Launch 2026 'Digital Trade Talent Gathering' Recruitment for College Graduates
articles.summary_zh: 商务部、教育部、人力资源社会保障部于2026年5月20日发布通知，将于5月至12月联合举办面向高校毕业生的数字贸易和服务外包企业招聘活动。
articles.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Education, and Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security announced a joint recruitment campaign for college graduates in digital trade and service outsourcing from May to December 2026.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

tags_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security

articles.title_zh: 两部门发文推动多用户绿电直连发展
articles.title_en: Two Departments Issue Document to Promote Multi-user Green Power Direct Connection
articles.summary_zh: 国家发展改革委、国家能源局发布通知，有序推动多用户绿电直连发展，旨在实现更高水平、更大范围的新能源就近消纳利用。
articles.summary_en: The NDRC and National Energy Administration issued a notice to promote multi-user green power direct connection to enhance the local consumption of renewable energy.

articles.title_zh: 工业和信息化部开展年度监督检查工作 促车企提升质量安全水平
articles.title_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Launches Annual Supervision Inspections to Improve Vehicle Quality and Safety
articles.summary_zh: 工业和信息化部于2026年5月20日在北京宣布开展年度道路机动车辆生产一致性监督检查，旨在提升车企质量安全水平并维护市场秩序。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, 2026, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology announced annual supervision inspections for road motor vehicle production consistency to enhance quality safety and market order.

tags.name_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

tags_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

articles.title_zh: 青海“十五五”时期以生态优先引领高质量发展
articles.title_en: Qinghai to Lead High-Quality Development with Ecological Priority During the 15th Five-Year Plan Period
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日，青海省长罗东川在新闻发布会上介绍，青海将在“十五五”时期以更高标准打造生态文明高地，推动生态优势转化为发展胜势。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, Qinghai Governor Luo Dongchuan announced that the province will prioritize ecological civilization and high-quality development during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

articles.title_zh: 鲁信创投通过“耐心资本”助力山东科创高质量发展
articles.title_en: Luxin Venture Capital Boosts High-Quality Sci-Tech Development in Shandong via "Patient Capital"
articles.summary_zh: 山东省国有创投机构鲁信创投通过“投早、投小、投长期、投硬科技”的策略，支持硅基仿生、艾恩半导体等企业，助力新质生产力发展。
articles.summary_en: Luxin Venture Capital, a state-owned firm in Shandong, supports "hard tech" and "new quality productive forces" by investing in early-stage companies such as Silicon Bio and Aien Semiconductor.

articles.title_zh: 民建中央开展2026年度重点考察调研推动未来产业突破
articles.title_en: CNDCA Conducts 2026 Key Research to Promote Breakthroughs in Future Industries
articles.summary_zh: 民建中央受中共中央委托，在上海、陕西开展关于强化源头创新与制度供给、推动未来产业实现新突破的重点考察调研。
articles.summary_en: Commissioned by the CPC Central Committee, the CNDCA conducted key research in Shanghai and Shaanxi to strengthen source innovation and institutional supply for future industries.

articles.title_zh: 全国首个澳洲坚果全产业链标准发布实施
articles.title_en: China's First Full-Industry Chain Standard for Macadamia Nuts Released and Implemented
articles.summary_zh: 云南省林业和草原局近日宣布，我国首个澳洲坚果全产业链标准《澳洲坚果栽培技术和质量要求》正式实施。
articles.summary_en: The Yunnan Provincial Forestry and Grassland Bureau announced the official implementation of China's first full-industry chain standard for Macadamia nuts, focusing on cultivation and quality.

articles.title_zh: 浙江省电力碳计量测试中心成立
articles.title_en: Zhejiang Provincial Electric Power Carbon Measurement and Testing Center Established
articles.summary_zh: 5月20日，经浙江省市场监督管理局批复，浙江省首个电力碳计量测试中心正式成立，旨在提供电力碳排放精准计量与溯源技术支撑。
articles.summary_en: On May 20, the Zhejiang Provincial Electric Power Carbon Measurement and Testing Center was officially established with approval from the provincial market regulation authority to provide technical support for precise carbon emission measurement.

articles.title_zh: 2026年全国夏收夏种气象服务启动
articles.title_en: 2026 National Summer Harvest and Planting Meteorological Services Launched
articles.summary_zh: 2026年5月19日，中央气象台发布首份专报，正式启动全国夏收夏种气象服务，旨在保障夏季农业生产。
articles.summary_en: On May 19, 2026, the Central Meteorological Observatory released its first report, officially launching national meteorological services for summer harvest and planting to support agricultural production.
